summary: Silmali is a veteran precinct chief in a quiet mountain town who quietly aids a shape-shifting visitor. Silmali is honest, tired and always one step behind the strange cases landing on the desk.

feats.scene: Silmali tackles a fleeing burglar over a parked sedan hood.
Silmali stays on his feet after a baton hits his forearm.

name: Nelaror
summary: Nelaror is a hulking club-swinging villain who targets a teenage hero in a red suit. A single blow from the heavy club once put his young rival on the floor.

feats.scene: Nelaror smashes his club into a pier piling and snaps it in two.
Nelaror laughs as a thrown anchor rebounds from his chest.

name: Corna
summary: Corna is a tentacled-submarine raider who rams cargo ships from beneath with a hydraulic spike and boards through the hollow shaft. Corna's armoured vessel dismantles hulls with giant claws and sinks everything it touches.

feats.scene: Corna drives the hydraulic spike through a freighter keel and splits it open.
Corna's hull holds against depth charges until a fuel tank finally ignites.

name: Rallicil
summary: Rallicil is the restless ghost of an executed sea killer who hid his plunder and left a message in a bottle to stir trouble for centuries. Rallicil appears only as a green glow and a ghostly outline on a ruined deck.

feats.scene: Rallicil drags a green-lit bottle across open water toward a drifting skiff.
Rallicil's wraith passes unharmed through a volley of pistol shots.

name: Ceocorsti
summary: Ceocorsti is a dark mirror-world bruiser in a black and gold costume who answers a boss's summons with thunder. Ceocorsti fights bigger and louder than most allies, then collapses under a faster water-dweller.

feats.scene: Ceocorsti calls down lightning that scorches a whole hangar floor.
Ceocorsti shrugs off a trident blow that would flatten a truck.
Ceocorsti flashes across a runway before the thunder reaches him.

source_title: Captain Super (Crisis on Two Earths: Crime Syndicate Earth)

name: Rniori
summary: Rniori is a young mirror-world enforcer in a black and gold costume with a fierce temper. Rniori breaks glowing constructs with bare hands and nearly finishes a rival before a screaming sound drops him.

feats.scene: Rniori punches a glowing barricade into pieces and sends the shards across the room.
Rniori stands through a fusion burst that cracks the wall behind him.

source_title: Captain Super, Jr. (Crisis on Two Earths: Crime Syndicate Earth)

name: Vaial
summary: Vaial is a retired speedy hero turned classroom instructor, lampooning the idea of a heroic sprinter. Vaial still has some flying ability and quick legs, and a son who took the flying part.

feats.scene: Vaial vaults a lectern and tackles a runaway chalk robot.
Vaial takes a thrown textbook to the face and keeps lecturing.
Vaial blurs along a school corridor and arrives before the bell stops.

name: Amoriaeo
summary: Amoriaeo is a grey-haired showman whose carnival tent covers a criminal crew's dealings. Amoriaeo once tried to display a shrunken heroine inside a glass jar to keep her out of the way.

feats.scene: Amoriaeo hurls a tent pole into a stage rig and brings it down.
Amoriaeo takes a tumbling barrel to the legs and limps onward.

name: Rerne
summary: Rerne is a long-lived blond swordswoman raised in a seaside abbey, granted a thousand years by a stranger's alchemy. Rerne guards ancient secrets, moves faster than ordinary guards, and seeks a forest guardian for help.

feats.scene: Rerne cleaves a fortress gate off its hinges with one two-handed stroke.
Rerne survives a collapsing tower floor and rises with only dust on her cloak.
Rerne outruns a cavalry charge across wet sand.

name: Lusanrn
summary: Lusanrn is a banished alien labourer who burned out on stimulants, caused a tragedy and joined an exiled general's army. Lusanrn later poses as a city guard officer and stages a bombing to win trust.

feats.scene: Lusanrn detonates a charge that gutted a headquarters wing.
Lusanrn climbs out of the rubble from the very blast she set.

name: Oravies
summary: Oravies is a gentle but formidable knight of a legendary round-table court who prefers peace to war. Oravies wears heavy plate and fights only when words fail.

feats.scene: Oravies parries a lance and drives the attacker out of his saddle.
Oravies stands as a mace rings off his helm.

name: Corsi
summary: Corsi is a poisonous gas robot who works with a twin to wear down a team of metal heroes. Corsi can flow through walls, fly, and spread choking fumes through a laboratory.

feats.scene: Corsi floods a lab with fumes that corrode a steel door.
Corsi disperses into vapour when a cannon shell passes through him.
Corsi streams down a corridor faster than any runner.

name: Llusi
summary: Llusi is a faceless vapour woman who joins a pack of gaseous criminals in a bright cartoon world. Llusi drifts through bars and walls, and moves quickly when the mood hits.

feats.scene: Llusi pours a toxic cloud through a vent and drops a vault guard.
Llusi reforms after a blast rips her form into wisps.

source_title: Carbon Dioxide (The Brave and the Bold)

name: Sasluci
summary: Sasluci is a masked enforcer in a grim, priestly regime who patrols a gloomy city with a partner. Sasluci relies on firearms and close fighting, and a careless moment ends the partnership in blood.

feats.scene: Sasluci empties a rifle clip through a barricaded door.
Sasluci rolls up from a fall through a shattered skylight.

name: Oream
summary: Oream is a bald sea captain who built a living weapon and will do anything to get her back. Oream holds a hostage on a heavily armed deck until a mercenary and the weapon storm aboard.

feats.scene: Oream fires the deck cannon and tears a pier in half.
Oream keeps swinging after a steel pipe bends across his back.

name: Arletiu
summary: Arletiu is a ruthless undead executive who murders a boss and plots to release a plague so victims become fresh food. Arletiu is clever and cold, but underestimates her successor's patience.

feats.scene: Arletiu drives a pen through a lock to slip into the sealed office.
Arletiu keeps walking after a thrown vase cracks across her cheek.

name: Nutelst
summary: Nutelst is a greedy red-haired schemer who tried to harm a group of college girls with a caustic chemical. Nutelst keeps a couple of false names and is foiled by a heroine of myth.

feats.scene: Nutelst splashes a vat of acid over a laboratory bench and eats through the wood.
Nutelst stumbles out of a burning dorm hallway unharmed.

name: Niuol
summary: Niuol is an eight-foot dockworker turned monster after a carved idol made him immune to every blow. Niuol bulldozed a rival crimefighter until the idol was thrown into the sun, and later tried to go straight.

feats.scene: Niuol punches a cell wall until it crumbles and walks through the hole.
Niuol takes a collapsing crane across the shoulders and stands upright.

name: Rauralori
summary: Rauralori is a wartime newshound who doubles as a masked spy and sea raider. Rauralori files articles by day and plots from a hidden vessel by night, always one headline from getting caught.

feats.scene: Rauralori fires a flare pistol that sets a dock crane aflame.
Rauralori rides out a hard slam against a bulkhead.

name: Rumis
summary: Rumis is a brilliant lock designer and security chief with a dangerous urge to build a cell nobody can escape. Rumis designs cages for the strongest prisoners and hides a dark fondness for captives.

feats.scene: Rumis triggers a cell mechanism that slams a reinforced door shut.
Rumis builds a vault that withstands a brutal hammering from a mighty hero.

name: Orronniu
summary: Orronniu is a gifted lock expert who hatches a scheme to make money by freeing prisoners and sending them home, only to teleport them back into custody. Orronniu eventually ambushes a mighty hero with restraints that sap him.

feats.scene: Orronniu drops a ceiling gate that crushes a patrol car.
Orronniu absorbs a punch to the stomach and keeps scheming.

name: Taratau
summary: Taratau is the weary head of a famous island prison whose looks seem to change between appearances. Taratau keeps order, signs transfer papers and rarely leaves the control room.

feats.scene: Taratau pulls the alarm lever and locks down a whole cellblock.
Taratau stays upright after a riot shield catches him in the side.

name: Numtau
summary: Numtau is a sports hero and special-forces captain engineered into a super-soldier, then mind-altered into a clown's dull henchman. Numtau is strong and loyal, but terrible at jokes.

feats.scene: Numtau hurls a bar table across a club and splinters the far wall.
Numtau takes a rifle round to the chest and does not flinch.

name: Esiiar
summary: Esiiar is a sibling-rivalry crime boss who nudges his brother into a fatal attack and then keeps the business for himself. Esiiar later wears a shadowy outfit that lets him slip through gaps.

feats.scene: Esiiar pushes a rival's car off a ramp into a canal.
Esiiar slips through a closing steel gate while shots pass by.

name: Renmiarn
summary: Renmiarn is a firearms-proficient adopted heir in a crystal-themed fantasy kingdom, with no magic and one missing hand. Renmiarn serves a sinister guardian, then turns toward gentler teachings and a throne.

feats.scene: Renmiarn fires a pistol that shatters a gem lantern across a hall.
Renmiarn endures a spell flash with nothing but a singed sleeve.

name: Ntses
summary: Ntses is a skin-changing villain who picks up a glove that boosts strength and cunning. Ntses lurks in the shadows of waterfront slums and leaves a niece to worry.

feats.scene: Ntses slams the glove into a steel locker and crushes the door.
Ntses takes a baton across the jaw and spits out a laugh.

name: Cortau
summary: Cortau is a tall obsessive thief who learned to turn into a flat, silent living shadow through a borrowed vest. Cortau slides through walls and ignores hits, but each use risks freezing the whole planet.

feats.scene: Cortau lifts a jewel case while sinking half-through a vault wall.
Cortau lets a thrown mace pass through his flat body harmlessly.

name: Torsirni
summary: Torsirni is a museum burglar in a dark suit that turns him flat and untouchable. Torsirni teams up with two odd crooks to lift an alchemist's old book and is caught by a mystery-solving van crew.

feats.scene: Torsirni peels a display case lock with a gloved hand.
Torsirni sinks into a wall as a guard swings a fire axe through the space.

name: Tetes
summary: Tetes is a blond matriarch who runs a rival crime ring in a windy city and mourns a murdered son. Tetes takes the killer's pistol and sets out to find the culprit in a long season of vengeance.

feats.scene: Tetes fires the recovered pistol and downs a hired gunman at the door.
Tetes keeps her composure as a window explodes beside her.

name: Cotorral
summary: Cotorral is a determined city reporter who marries into the vigilante business and has sharp questions for any partner who transforms in front of her. Cotorral keeps a recorder handy and a quick comeback ready.

feats.scene: Cotorral swings a handbag and stuns a purse snatcher.
Cotorral stays upright through a jostling crowd at a stairwell.

name: Sticatel
summary: Sticatel is a bored trophy hunter who believes every animal is too easy and travels to a dark city to hunt a masked man. Sticatel lays pit traps, wears disguises and shoots very well, until one of his own traps swallows him.

feats.scene: Sticatel fires a heavy rifle and drops a charging boar at long range.
Sticatel shrugs off a branch swat across the shoulders.

name: Iasri
summary: Iasri is a physician in a plague-ridden century who cannot catch the sickness and is distrusted for it. Iasri is one in a long chain of rebirths tied to an old curse.

feats.scene: Iasri sets a splint and shoves a panicked patient aside in a fever house.
Iasri sleeps among the dying and never takes ill.

name: Ausir
summary: Ausir is an ordinary tough with dark hair and brown eyes, tied to a rough crowd in a comic city. Few details survive, but Ausir shows up wherever a scuffle starts.

feats.scene: Ausir throws a punch that cracks a bottle on a counter.
Ausir takes a slap and keeps arguing.

name: Correr
summary: Correr is a runway model whose latent talent woke under alien testing, giving her a skin-close shield that repels solids, liquids and air. Correr survived a deadly gauntlet and joined a band of fellow survivors.

feats.scene: Correr flares her field outward and hurls a squad of guards across a courtyard.
Correr holds her shield through a barrage of energy bolts that tears up the ground.

name: Ellleanu
summary: Ellleanu is a bald crime lord who bribes officials and tries to recruit a young heir into a shared grip on a city. Ellleanu loses everything when stolen files are turned against him and a masked vigilante visits his penthouse.

feats.scene: Ellleanu orders a squad to open fire on a warehouse and shreds the doors.
Ellleanu endures a hard shove into his own desk.

name: Lournll
summary: Lournll is a white-haired mob patriarch with scarred cheeks, a love of cooking and a long list of dead relatives. Lournll leads through calm menace and a quick trigger finger.

feats.scene: Lournll fires a pistol and shatters a restaurant mirror behind a rival.
Lournll sits through a hail of glass and finishes his meal.

name: Anicorle
summary: Anicorle is a burned test pilot who builds an underwater flying carrier and a network of air raiders to avenge a wrecked career. Anicorle's rays pulverise warships from many miles away, until fire consumes his flagship.

feats.scene: Anicorle fires a ray from the carrier that pulverises a battle cruiser on the horizon.
Anicorle's carrier takes cannon fire for an hour before the fuel catches.

name: Corll
summary: Corll is a purple-haired alien soldier stranded after her invasion ship crashed in a field of rocks. Corll is recruited with a toxin, joins a riot downtown and is shot dead by a police chief.

feats.scene: Corll hurls a squad car door through a shop window.
Corll survives the crash of her fleet ship and crawls out of the wreck.

name: Iairtel
summary: Iairtel is a cheerful robot caretaker of an abandoned amusement park who has no special gifts but plenty of schemes. Iairtel joins a gang of tyrants for fun and blows up the park to destroy a visiting team.

feats.scene: Iairtel detonates every robot in the park in one huge blast.
Iairtel's casing holds together as a ride collapses overhead.

name: Soont
summary: Soont is a gem-powered adventuress who joins a gang of crooks for money, grumbles about their manners, and quits whenever pay is in doubt. Soont ferries teammates through the air on shimmering violet light and turns on a leader when a better offer arrives.

feats.scene: Soont hurls a violet blast that levels a chemical plant gatehouse.
Soont shrugs off a hangar door slamming into her shoulder.
Soont carries three passengers across a bay in a single glittering streak.

name: Eonne
summary: Eonne is a violet-eyed villain who wields a beam of gem-bright power and soars above the skyline of a seaside city. Eonne works for a cabal of costumed schemers and takes part in a final raid on a rival team.

feats.scene: Eonne sweeps a beam across a rooftop and melts a row of antennas.
Eonne lands hard on a parking deck and walks off the crater.

name: Tiuamam
summary: Tiuamam is a shrewd airplane company director in a mirrored world who sells warplanes and weapons to whichever buyer pays the most. Tiuamam never fights and wins through contracts, bribery and cold logic.

feats.scene: Tiuamam signs a delivery order that sends a convoy of fighters overseas.
Tiuamam stays seated through a boardroom shoving match.

name: Llrne
summary: Llrne is an early-century suffragist with a green ring and a power battery who fights for the vote with glowing constructs. Llrne creates shields, fires bolts and flies over crowds that scoff at her cause.

feats.scene: Llrne forms a glowing hammer and flattens a steam wagon.
Llrne's field holds as a collapsing cornice rains bricks around her.
Llrne dashes over rooftops faster than a telegraph clerk can type.

name: Toceo
summary: Toceo is the head of an aircraft firm who is chosen by a love-fuelled ring and carried to a distant violet homeworld. Toceo gives the ring back, then takes it up again after a duel that proves care outlasts anger.

feats.scene: Toceo fires a violet beam that shatters a fleet of hovering drones.
Toceo stays in the air as a rival's crimson blast scorches her cloak.
Toceo shoots between canyon walls on a ribbon of rose light.

name: Ntotereon
summary: Ntotereon is a kindhearted aircraft executive who keeps an eye on a worried test pilot and reassures him in private moments. Ntotereon is caught in a distant invasion and is lost with her whole coastal city.

feats.scene: Ntotereon slaps a stuck hangar latch until it pops.
Ntotereon holds on to a rail as a runway tremor knocks over crates.

name: Carse
summary: Carse is a black-haired ring-bearer in a cartoon world who draws glowing shapes out of thin air and fires bolts at her foes. Carse carries a power battery and flies skilfully, thanks to a pilot's training.

feats.scene: Carse conjures a pink wrecking ball and drops it on a rooftop sniper nest.
Carse bounces back from a ricocheting blast and keeps pace.
Carse spirals over a skyline in a bright loop.

name: Teernest
summary: Teernest is a plastic-brick heroine who teaches the power of affection to a scowling rival, with a ring that builds shields, blasts and shortcut jumps. Teernest is a photographer and trained pilot with only basic hand-to-hand skill.

feats.scene: Teernest builds a glowing launcher and pops a robot gang into scattered bricks.
Teernest lets a tumbling pillar bounce off her bubble.

name: Torniarni
summary: Torniarni is a secretive woman of an alternate gaslit age who hides behind a gem-bright persona. Torniarni stays out of most conflicts and keeps her real motives to herself.

feats.scene: Torniarni sends a violet flare through a locked stairwell door.
Torniarni steps away from a collapsing balcony with her cape smoking.

name: Torsir
summary: Torsir is a red-haired farm-town mother who loses her husband on the very day their newborn comes home. Torsir and her mate are taken by metal hunters and die under cruel tests, leaving the baby orphaned.

feats.scene: Torsir shields the infant with her arms and shoves a kidnapper off the car step.
Torsir endures hours of restraint without giving way.

name: Vaanutal
summary: Vaanutal is a divorced legal secretary at a busy law firm who keeps files in order and answers phones with calm. Vaanutal knows the practice better than most partners.

feats.scene: Vaanutal slams a heavy filing drawer shut on a thief's fingers.
Vaanutal shrugs off a day of crowded commutes and angry callers.

name: Ninianium
summary: Ninianium is a typist promoted to personal assistant for a wealthy playboy who is blackmailed through her child. Ninianium quietly copies documents for a kidnapper and tries hard not to be seen.

feats.scene: Ninianium swings a heavy typewriter lid at a lurking guard.
Ninianium stays on her feet after being shoved against a desk.

name: Leori
summary: Leori is a former patrol officer who drifted into an extremist cell, switched sides, and was taken to an island of warrior women. Leori now commands them under a new name and gains a long life while she stays there.

feats.scene: Leori vaults a counter and disarms a gunman with one wrist twist.
Leori takes a spear haft across the ribs and keeps drilling recruits.

name: Rnuvaos
summary: Rnuvaos is a blond crimefighter of an earlier generation whose voice can shatter glass and break a villain's nerve. Rnuvaos hides an infant from danger, retires, and is later hunted by an old enemy's heir.

feats.scene: Rnuvaos unleashes a cry that blows out every window of a warehouse.
Rnuvaos rolls through a shattered skylight and rises ready to fight.

name: Cetelces
summary: Cetelces is a college student and devoted goddaughter of a revered teacher, kidnapped and tortured by a spy who wants family secrets. Cetelces is rescued once, captured again, and becomes bait for a duel she cannot stop.

feats.scene: Cetelces kicks free of a chair and cracks it against a captor's shin.
Cetelces withstands hours of questioning without a word.

name: Nenvalsas
summary: Nenvalsas is a mountain-raised monk-trained fighter who prefers to calm a brawl with words and a slap than a killing blow. Nenvalsas, once a nomad child, escapes her family's murderers and fights evil beside two friends until an old rival ends her.

feats.scene: Nenvalsas drives a palm into a gang leader and sends him through a market stall.
Nenvalsas gets up from a staircase fall and bows to her student.

name: Iurimil
summary: Iurimil is a blue-skinned hired fighter with white eyes and red hair, who runs very fast and bounces off walls without injury. Iurimil also flings himself skyward from rooftops and can glide long distances, and he scrambles the powers of a light-bending foe.

feats.scene: Iurimil ricochets off a pillar and flattens a squad of ambushers.
Iurimil bounces off a concrete wall at full speed and lands lightly.
Iurimil blurs through a shopping hall in a zigzag streak.

name: Vatan
summary: Vatan is a red-haired former special agent who lost her memory and mind after a lab procedure, and who now kills in the name of devotion. Vatan fires arrows with deadly accuracy and leaves bodies as love gifts for a masked archer.

feats.scene: Vatan fires a heavy arrow through a car door and pins the driver's sleeve.
Vatan keeps shooting with a cracked rib after a rooftop fall.

name: Varnu
summary: Varnu is a sidekick in a bright cartoon world, trained in martial arts, who once held two powerful rings after a cosmic reset. Varnu serves a bat-themed guardian and a celebrated league, and later loses the rings with the world's rebirth.

feats.scene: Varnu spin-kicks a lantern-lit golem and cracks its stone chest.
Varnu lands from a high ledge and rolls to her feet.

name: Sauresco
summary: Sauresco is a gifted battlefield surgeon of an island of warrior women, famous for a sharp tongue and a poor bedside manner. Sauresco heals a troubled young girl and falls while treating wounded fighters on the front line.

feats.scene: Sauresco drives a spear shaft into an attacking machine's joint and halts it.
Sauresco stays at a patient's side as a blast tosses tents around her.

name: Ralle
summary: Ralle is a dying evidence-handler who grabs a magic wand that grafts itself onto his arm, stabilising his illness and giving him power over matter. Ralle takes a mall hostage, bitter at being overlooked, and clashes with heroes who tower over everyone.

feats.scene: Ralle transmutes a food court into lead and shatters a wall of the mall.
Ralle stands in the middle of a crashing atrium and shrugs off debris.

name: Rintiva
summary: Rintiva is a winged crimefighter with a heavy mace and a flight harness who is also a reborn ancient prince. Rintiva is stronger and tougher than any human, heals fast, ages slowly, and sees farther than a hawk in a video-game city.

feats.scene: Rintiva swings the mace and caves in an armoured truck.
Rintiva crashes through a billboard and gets up unmarked.
Rintiva dives from a tower and levels out above the street.

name: Riiar
summary: Riiar is a museum curator and digger of tombs whose soul keeps returning in new bodies since an ancient prince touched alien metal. Riiar has worn many names across centuries, flies on metal wings and has a messy, tangled life story.

feats.scene: Riiar brings a mace down on a stone pillar and splits it.
Riiar takes a collapsing temple roof on his back and rises.
Riiar swoops above the dunes in a long glide.

name: Ntili
summary: Ntili is an archaeologist in a feathered flight rig who defends a mountain refuge for a corrupt president. Ntili fights hard with a metal mace but is overwhelmed by the dark knight he is sent to stop.

feats.scene: Ntili swings the mace and caves in a bunker door.
Ntili crashes through a gantry and still staggers up.
Ntili banks around a rock tower before the guards track him.

name: Numtiantu
summary: Numtiantu is a white-haired scientist who fakes his death and hides for years, then is found by a time-bending thug. Numtiantu's time machine tempts abusers of history until a younger self from fifteen years earlier steps in with lethal force.

feats.scene: Numtiantu overloads a machine core and blows out a lab wall.
Numtiantu withstands rough handling by hired captors.

name: Amsarni
summary: Amsarni is a schoolmate turned clown-gang boss who builds a fiefdom in a ruined city after a machine overlord wrecks the world. Amsarni fools followers with a fake idol, hides a ruthless streak and is struck down by the lackey he betrayed.

feats.scene: Amsarni triggers a rigged bomb and collapses a bridge arch.
Amsarni slides along the pavement after a tumble and keeps grinning.

name: Raulorva
summary: Raulorva is a black-haired firebug who runs a profitable burning-for-hire racket with a sibling. Raulorva takes his own life after an accidental death on a job, and the sibling vanishes into a faked end.

feats.scene: Raulorva torches a warehouse and the blaze consumes the whole block's roof.
Raulorva steps out of a smoky stairwell with singed sleeves.

name: Telellu
summary: Telellu is a huntress of an island of warrior women, trained in archery, riding and blade work, with a tracker's patience. Telellu is tougher and faster than mortals and patrols the forest edge for prey and intruders.

feats.scene: Telellu looses an arrow that pins a boar to an oak at long range.
Telellu keeps tracking after a rockslide grazes her shoulder.
Telellu sprints through undergrowth faster than the stag she hunts.

name: Satum
summary: Satum is a cheerful red-haired heroine from a storybook galaxy who steps into the real world and tries to fit in. Satum navigates starships, wields electric power, and fights with trained martial skills alongside a band of oddball allies.

feats.scene: Satum arcs lightning from her palms and fuses the lock of a vault.
Satum hits the deck of a spinning ship and bounces up laughing.

name: Auter
summary: Auter is a bitter, cynical double conjured by a living street to fit a scheming villain's needs, with the drive to help him travel through time. Auter leads a shadowy organisation against the street and its allies and falls when the original shows up.

feats.scene: Auter slams a lever and a rift tears a wall off a house.
Auter stumbles from a collapsing hall unhurt.

name: Tisloseo
summary: Tisloseo is a green-eyed lab technician at a corporation who studies the wreckage of a machine intelligence. Tisloseo's body is seized by escaped liquid, and she only mutters in an alien tongue before dying in care.

feats.scene: Tisloseo pushes a steel cart across a lab and crushes a monitor.
Tisloseo stays upright as hazardous fluid pours across her sleeves.

name: Aranuiu
summary: Aranuiu is a nightclub-owning racketeer who deals arms under a flashy name while intelligence officers close in. Aranuiu tries to poison a visiting officer's date, and the plan backfires when the wrong guest drinks the cup.

feats.scene: Aranuiu pulls a lever and drops a stage trapdoor under an intruder.
Aranuiu absorbs a punch from a bouncer and stays standing.

name: Naniu
summary: Naniu is a fitness trainer cast out by her village after posing as a boy to become a holy ascetic. Naniu teaches a young pupil to endure agony by sleeping on nails, and later weathers a group attack without showing any pain.

feats.scene: Naniu snaps a staff across her knee and strikes the attacker's wrist.
Naniu absorbs a flurry of blows from several men and stays calm.

name: Autorte
summary: Autorte is a grey-eyed spy in a kingdom of knights who works in dungeons below a rival warrior realm. Autorte slips past guards, frees a captive prince, and begs him to end the war among the three realms.

feats.scene: Autorte lifts a key ring and unlocks a cell without a sound.
Autorte falls from a dungeon ledge and lands soundlessly.

name: Amrni
summary: Amrni is a blond newswoman who is charmed by a fake hero and spreads his stories to the public. Amrni is later changed into a clawed, feral thing by his sorcery and perishes beside her master.

feats.scene: Amrni claws through a car door and tosses it across a street.
Amrni shrugs off a heavy crate falling on her shoulder.

name: Terivi
summary: Terivi is a pint-sized masked vigilante in a cartoonish city who wields a sword and a belt full of gadgets. Terivi joins two friends to chop through giant weeds when a plant-loving villain smothers the streets.

feats.scene: Terivi swings the blade through a thick vine and cuts a lamppost in half.
Terivi tumbles from a rooftop and bounces into a roll.

name: Neslarn
summary: Neslarn is a silent child raised by an assassin to become the perfect killer, who learns to read bodies instead of words. Neslarn leaves that life behind, swears never to kill again, and becomes a nightly guardian in a dark city.

feats.scene: Neslarn lands a roundhouse that knocks a thug through a plank door.
Neslarn keeps fighting after a fall through a glass roof.
Neslarn sprints along a roofline to catch a thief.

name: Raileri
summary: Raileri is a daughter of killers who reads rivals' muscles and moves to predict their next strike and answers questions with her fists. Raileri was once a covert operative and now guards a hill neighbourhood, under many nicknames.

feats.scene: Raileri slips a punch and drives an elbow into a gunman's rifle, snapping it.
Raileri takes a full tackle from a heavy and does not give ground.

name: Naunumco
summary: Naunumco is a black-haired crimefighter in a bright animated city, a member of a caped family who fights at night. Naunumco appears briefly and leaves little detail beyond a quick sense of humour and good aim.

feats.scene: Naunumco throws a gadget that wraps a robber's legs.
Naunumco lands from a window ledge in a neat crouch.

source_title: Cassandra Cain (The Brave and the Bold)

name: Amnti
summary: Amnti is a possible-future vigilante who once rose from the grave after a timeline shift and joined an army of grown heroes. Amnti is skilled with blades and throwing weapons, and dies in a duel on a lonely quest for answers.

feats.scene: Amnti flicks a throwing blade through a steel fence post.
Amnti climbs out of a shallow grave and brushes off the dirt.

name: Ereria
summary: Ereria is a green-eyed cat burglar who grew up in the same orphanage as a famous thief and copies her career. Ereria builds a similar costume and kit, picks fights with her rival, and ends up handed to the police.

feats.scene: Ereria lashes a whip around a jewel case and snaps it loose.
Ereria drops from a skylight and tumbles upright.

name: Rnralu
summary: Rnralu is an elderly blind woman in a retirement home who can see a person's future when she touches them. Rnralu warns a young visitor of a death close to him, then dies from the shock of a darker man's vision.

feats.scene: Rnralu squeezes a visitor's hand and a vision floods the room.
Rnralu sits calmly through a long afternoon of unwanted visits.

name: Llutel
summary: Llutel is a blond protester in a wartime alternate world who calls for help against unjust detention and later carries a fallen heroine's shield. Llutel and a friend wear silver gear conjured by a shape-shifter and march together as one team.

feats.scene: Llutel throws the shield and knocks a guard's rifle from his hands.
Llutel blocks a charging soldier with the shield and holds the line.

name: Lanluci
summary: Lanluci is a young demigod who borrows magic gauntlets and winged sandals before she learns who her father is. Lanluci wields a lasso of lightning, hits as hard as a storm, and keeps a photo of an old flame close at hand.

feats.scene: Lanluci whips the lightning lasso and drops a tower of rubble.
Lanluci stands up from the rubble of a flattened gatehouse.
Lanluci streaks along a harbour in the winged sandals.

name: Reosaor
summary: Reosaor is the angry, blond, globe-trotting child of an archaeologist and a demigod, and granddaughter of a thunder king. Reosaor tears into trouble to work out her fury, leaping between teams of young heroes.

feats.scene: Reosaor punches a stone colossus and cracks it from head to foot.
Reosaor takes a falling bridge span on her back and rises.
Reosaor charges across a plaza faster than a sports car.

name: Amosiva
summary: Amosiva is a hulking street tough in a gang of fast-driving hoodlums who relies on raw strength. Amosiva has little backstory, but crumples parked cars and shoves rivals through shop windows.

feats.scene: Amosiva flips a parked car onto its roof with one heave.
Amosiva walks off a swing from a steel pipe with a grunt.

name: Isartau
summary: Isartau is a blond sprinter from a cold country, one of a trio engineered to match a famous runner, who joins a courier firm in a new land. Isartau delivers parcels at astonishing speed, gives charity time on weekends, and falls while climbing a wall.

feats.scene: Isartau sprints through a door and splinters it with a shoulder.
Isartau skids across a loading dock and bounces up.
Isartau races up a tower wall on a delivery run.

name: Riasotiu
summary: Riasotiu is a black-haired masked burglar who prowls rooftops like a feline and sets traps for a beetle-themed hero. Riasotiu appears only briefly, but leaves behind torn rooftops and claw marks.

feats.scene: Riasotiu springs from a gutter and slashes a security cable.
Riasotiu lands on a fire escape with a soft thud.

name: Seolanore
summary: Seolanore is a rooftop burglar who slips through shuttered windows on silent feet and boasts of a handful of spare lives bought from a village healer. Locals swear the thief has already cheated the gallows more than once.

feats.scene: Swinging a weighted sack, the burglar knocks a shutter clean off its hinges.
Tumbling from a tiled roof onto a hay cart, the thief bounces up and sprints away.

name: Sellalli
summary: Sellalli is a languid trickster spirit who rules every stray animal in the district and wears a human face only when it suits the mood. Dying merely sends the spirit off to curl up as a house pet for a while, though the supply of returns is limited.

feats.scene: Snapping long fingers, the trickster hurls a stack of crates across a warehouse floor.
Shot through the chest in a crowded alley, the spirit stands again within a minute.

name: Tiacanus
summary: Tiacanus is a petty brigand who insists a witch doctor granted a clutch of extra lives and acts with the swagger of a man who cannot be hurt. Guards who watched the criminal serve a long sentence disagree about how many lives are really left.

feats.scene: Hurling a looted anvil-sized strongbox, the brigand cracks a door frame.
Struck by a speeding wagon, the brigand staggers and keeps robbing.

name: Iaseoria
summary: Iaseoria is a hired thug for a drug conglomerate who rearranges the structure of living matter with a gesture, locking victims into stillness. Mercenary work along a sunny coast ended when two clever adversaries forced a reversal of the trick.

feats.scene: Raising a gloved palm, the mercenary stiffens an entire running man into rigid stone-like matter.
Slammed against a brick wall by two pursuers, the hireling grunts and slumps.

name: Sonle
summary: Sonle is a retired concert vocalist who hides in plain sight as a tidy domestic worker under a borrowed nickname, escaping a suitor with a fixation. Years of scrubbing floors have left a dry wit and a surprisingly firm grip.

feats.scene: Swinging a heavy cast skillet, the housekeeper drives an intruder out the door.
Shoved down a short flight of stairs, the singer rises and brushes off her apron.

name: Lasralo
summary: Lasralo is a vigilante sealed inside heavy plate styled like a vaulted nave, patrolling alleys as a righteous terror to cutthroats. The armour shrugs off cannon fire, though careless brawls leave whole streets cracked and smoking.

feats.scene: Hurling a rooftop water tank, the armoured brute flattens a row of garden sheds.
Caught in a vast blast from above, the armour glows white before finally buckling.

name: Llimia
summary: Llimia is a devout precinct captain with mechanical wings strapped to a broad, muscular frame, who flies low over crowded avenues to run down felons. Faith and duty occasionally collide in the squad room, but never in the air.

feats.scene: Diving feet first, the officer drives a bandit through a wooden fence.
Beating her wings hard, the airborne officer overtakes a fleeing motorcycle.

name: Selleme
summary: Selleme is a sharp-tongued newsroom columnist in a mirrored metropolis who trades gossip for leverage and sells out colleagues without a blink. Nothing about the schemer is supernatural, only ruthless and well connected.

feats.scene: Slapping a rival across the face, the columnist leaves a red print on his cheek.
Tripped on the press room stairs, the schemer hits the landing and storms off.

name: Autel
summary: Autel is a veteran news writer who survives a plague of mindless crowds by hiding in a studio cut off from every glowing screen. A shimmering barrier conjured by an ally keeps the blast that levels the district from touching her shelter.

feats.scene: Hurling a stapler with all her strength, the reporter dents a ceiling tile.
Huddling inside a glowing shell, the survivor endures the roar of a collapsing skyline.

name: Anitel
summary: Anitel is a polished arms dynasty heiress who married into a family of soldiers and now steers a ledger-heavy firm from behind a mahogany desk. Her weapons are contracts, not firearms.

feats.scene: Slamming a ledger on the boardroom table, the executive silences a shouting partner.
Thrown from a startled horse, the heiress gets up and finishes the ride.

name: Inureoern
summary: Inureoern is a blond industrialist who inherited an arms fortune and slowly became the quiet ally of a masked crusader in the family. The executive uses boardroom clout and discreet funding rather than any fighting talent.

feats.scene: Hauling open a stuck vault door, the businesswoman reveals a hidden cache of rifles.
Knocked sideways in a car park scuffle, the executive recovers and calls for help.

name: Ulsornen
summary: Ulsornen is a civic leader's daughter who refuses to be flattered by an obsessive doctor and is abducted for her stubbornness. Tied to a bed frame for days, the captive keeps her contempt intact until rescue arrives.

feats.scene: Kicking the bed post with both bare heels, the captive splinters it slightly.
Bound for days without food, the prisoner still answers every offer with a flat refusal.

name: Stivarcor
summary: Stivarcor is a redheaded settler's wife on a frontier ranch, remembered mostly as the great-great grandmother of a famed night guardian. Her life of fence-mending and bread-baking is mundane but stubbornly determined.

feats.scene: Swinging a splitting maul, the homesteader cleaves a stout log in one blow.
Kicked by a mule, the rancher rubs the bruise and returns to the churn.

name: Anunan
summary: Anunan is a gene-spliced enforcer with hardened talons coated in venom, hired by a criminal syndicate to extinguish rivals. A fatal scratch from his own blades, plus a final detonation, ended a short and cruel run.

feats.scene: Raking his talons across a steel door, the enforcer shreds four deep grooves.
Standing at the heart of a fireball, the enforcer is burned to ash.

name: Numamanu
summary: Numamanu is a lithe freelance burglar bound by a bargain with something infernal, trading her good fortune for gold and speed. Her lash cracks faster than the eye can follow, but a fire-breathing fiend proves too much.

feats.scene: Cracking a long whip, the burglar rips a padlock off a chain.
Darting across rooftops, the thief outruns a patrol van.
Seized by the skull in a monstrous grip, the burglar is scorched to bone.

name: Serora
summary: Serora is a harbour-city cat burglar of the lantern era who dresses as a hotel servant to get past guards, then vanishes over rooftops with the prize. Acrobatic and clever, the thief still loses to opponents with greater strength.

feats.scene: Whirling in a flurry of kicks, the burglar drops six guards in a dining hall.
Hurled through a paper wall by a stronger fighter, the thief rolls upright.

name: Tialen
summary: Tialen is a future-city burglar who can split into a squad of eight identical selves, giving a feline edge in any heist. A sleek powered suit and a cool nerve let the thief rob cities without wanting to see them burn.

feats.scene: Splitting into a crowd of twins, the thief tackles a gunman from every angle at once.
Caught under a collapsing scaffold, the thief absorbs the blow in the padded suit.

name: Siuile
summary: Siuile is a mail-clad inheritor of a notorious thief's legacy, quick, feline in manner and a little too proud of the plating. The jailbreak that frees the prisoners also exposes everyone inside to an atomic strike.

feats.scene: Lunging with plated claws, the prisoner gouges a trench in a cell wall.
Standing in the open beneath a distant atomic fireball, the prisoner is incinerated.

name: Riacinrni
summary: Riacinrni is a freelance mercenary in a neon future who inherited a power to clone up to nine bodies at once and uses the gift to rob vaults. Cocky and quick, the thief gambles every copy in a single desperate brawl.

feats.scene: Splitting into nine, the mercenary swarms a hulking guard and bowls him over.
Battered by a sleek armoured foe, the mercenary loses each duplicate in turn.

name: Anueoria
summary: Anueoria is a mounted lancer clad in dusty regimental red who charges through hedgerows at dawn, a forgotten oddity of country folklore. The rider's thunderous gallop and bent saber make for a better story than a threat.

feats.scene: Charging with a lowered lance, the rider punches through a wooden barricade.
Galloping flat out down a lane, the rider scatters a flock of sheep.

name: Lloceo
summary: Lloceo is a purple-skinned one-eyed schoolgirl on an island of warriors, forever stuck at her desk finishing lessons while friends go out. Despite the cheerful nature, the student can hurl a boulder across a courtyard when annoyed.

feats.scene: Tossing a garden boulder, the student sends it bouncing across the schoolyard.
Bonked by a swinging door, the child blinks her big eye and giggles.

name: Liava
summary: Liava is a red-haired toddler who babbles in a private language with a playmate and wanders into the strangest misadventures in the nursery. A pacifier and a stuffed doll are the only gear the infant needs.

feats.scene: Flinging a rattle in a tantrum, the toddler bonks the family cat.
Tumbling off the sofa, the baby bounces on the rug and laughs.

name: Aunmacor
summary: Aunmacor is a green-eyed fixer working the sunny coast who quietly brokers deals between smugglers, executives and spies. A pistol in her handbag is the final argument after negotiations fail.

feats.scene: Firing a pistol, the broker drops a bottle off a distant railing.
Slapped by a furious client, the fixer smiles and raises the price.

name: Riarosveo
summary: Riarosveo is a teenage film performer who can turn herself and anyone she grips into mist-like vapour and drift through solid rock. A pet wildcat tags along, ignoring the dangers of every stunt.

feats.scene: Linking hands with friends, the actress glides the whole group through a rockfall.
Floating over a ravine, the performer outpaces a sprinting guard.

name: Monaniar
summary: Monaniar is a stern landowning lord of an old forest estate who raises an adopted ward beside his own heir and holds fast to heritage. A broadsword hangs above the hearth and sees use when raiders come near.

feats.scene: Swinging a broadsword in a hall, the lord cleaves a thick oak table.
Struck by a thrown stool, the noble keeps his feet and roars.

name: Laselaau
summary: Laselaau is a horned greedy wanderer who carries a glowing amber ring that feeds on covetousness and takes whatever he sees. Rumour holds that the scavenger once served the dead before changing sides.

feats.scene: Sweeping a ring-bearing arm, the scavenger rips a parked truck from the road.
Hit head-on by a runaway cart, the scavenger stands his ground.

name: Sivor
summary: Sivor is a brown-haired ex-corps scavenger who still wields memories of a ring that shaped hard light into barriers and bolts and carried him through the air. Without the band his avarice goes unfed.

feats.scene: Firing a bolt from the band, the scavenger levels a row of derelict tenements.
Wrapped in a glowing shell, the scavenger endures a crashing freighter hull.
Streaking past a lunar outpost, the scavenger leaves a bright vapour trail.

name: Valserron
summary: Valserron is a towering monarch of a scorched, sun-baked world who keeps her subjects in chains by tricking runners into dropping their winged footwear. Her stride is fast and her fists are heavy, but her rule rests mostly on cunning.

feats.scene: Slamming both fists into a stone pillar, the queen topples a whole colonnade.
Racing across a hot plateau in winged sandals, the queen outruns a sonic cannon shell.

name: Sanenuve
summary: Sanenuve is a white-haired sentinel commander in a luminous high-rise city of benevolent elder beings, guarding the gates with a stern gaze. Years of war games have made the captain a sharp tactician among her kind.

feats.scene: Slamming a spear into a canyon wall, the captain splits a cliff face in two.
Standing in a rain of siege fire, the captain does not retreat a step.

name: Cortanllu
summary: Cortanllu is a starving cosmic devourer shackled in a distant dimension that tears open a door above a city tenement to feed. Hunger drives the colossus, but the passage demands a living sacrifice before it will open.

feats.scene: Forcing a rift above a skyline, the devourer shakes an entire block of buildings into powder.
Hauled back through the gate by a hoax, the devourer is crushed in the closing portal.

name: Iumancor
summary: Iumancor is a former carrier-wing flight instructor turned rocket-powered rescuer who patrols bay-side towns after leaving a stubborn command. Her scientist parents' family firm supplies the gear, and the pilot supplies the courage.

feats.scene: Diving through a stuck hangar door, the pilot rips it from its track.
Roaring across the harbour on rocket boots, the pilot overtakes a coast guard cutter.

name: Anrnues
summary: Anrnues is a medieval noble lady whose soul was cursed by the heavens to be reborn across the centuries, wandering from one life to the next. Her knightly husband rides beside her through each vanishing age.

feats.scene: Hurling a lantern across a banquet hall, the lady sets a tapestry alight.
Cut down in the cathedral courtyard, the noblewoman is born again within a year.

name: Iumanusto
summary: Iumanusto is an ancient sentient landmass of the open sea that rescued prehistoric beasts from extinction and later turned against humanity after witnessing a thermonuclear flash. Its jungle fringe teems with mutated winged lizards sent out to gather fuel for escape.

feats.scene: Hauling its mass up from the waves, the island launches a storm of winged lizards over a coastline.
Shelled and burned from the sky, the island entity holds together for hours before it breaks.

name: Reseo
summary: Reseo is a black-furred three-headed watchdog with amber eyes who lurks at the bottom of a torch-lit stair, devouring anything that tries to leave. The beast's growl alone is enough to make armed raiders drop their weapons.

feats.scene: Raking one great paw, the watchdog shears a bronze door in half.
Hit by a catapult stone, the watchdog flinches and leaps at the crew.

name: Strniva
summary: Strniva is a monstrous three-necked hound, offspring of two storm-born horrors, who sits before a bronze gate and lets in only the departed. Music, a sweet sauce or a lucky bite on the tail can all slip past its hunger.

feats.scene: Lunging at a hero, the hound crushes a marble column between its jaws.
Slashed across one neck by a trident, the hound regrows a bleeding stump of flesh.

name: Reium
summary: Reium is a brown-haired harvest deity of a borrowed pantheon who coaxes crops from barren soil and mourns a daughter lost to the underworld. Fields burst into flower wherever the immortal walks.

feats.scene: Calling up a surge of roots, the goddess heaves a hillside orchard out of the ground.
Struck by a fallen oak, the goddess merely brushes bark from her sleeve.

name: Telcisnas
summary: Telcisnas is a white-eyed elder in a shrunken city kept inside a bottle, sitting on a council that enforces harsh laws until a tragic death changes everything. The blue-skinned sage can leap rooftops and lift stone benches without strain.

feats.scene: Hefting a stone bench overhead, the elder hurls it across a plaza.
Struck by a falling arch, the elder dusts himself off.

name: Iumreont
summary: Iumreont is a blonde councillor in a miniature city who inherits her father's seat and rewrites the laws for the good of the people. Strong as a loader and hard to bruise, the white-eyed lawmaker joins the defence against a ghostly invader.

feats.scene: Wrenching a cart free of the mud, the councillor flips it onto the road.
Hit by a blast of ghostly force, the councillor stays on her feet.

name: Oriiumra
summary: Oriiumra is a red-eyed antlered deity of beasts, wealth and fertility who lives in an otherworldly forest kept alive by belief. Sent out to broker peace between feuding clans, the god walks into a human city seeking allies.

feats.scene: Stamping a hoof, the god raises a thorny wood that swallows a whole boulevard.
Struck by a siege of spells, the antlered god barely stumbles.

name: Rasas
summary: Rasas is a grey-haired matriarch of a deep-sea order of widows who also holds a seat on the kingdom's ruling council. Bred for the crushing depths, the cleric hits hard, moves fast and sees clearly in the black water.

feats.scene: Driving her staff into a coral wall, the matriarch smashes a hole through it.
Hauled down into a trench, the matriarch endures a pressure that would flatten a submarine.
Darting between pillars, the cleric outswims a patrol torpedo.

name: Covacor
summary: Covacor is a tiny furry sentinel with a rodent's whiskers who wields a ring of willpower from a distant, small-minded homeworld. The tiny ranger summons barriers and blasts, and once helped capture a conqueror.

feats.scene: Firing a beam from the ring, the ranger blows a hole through a rocky ridge.
Wrapped in a glowing barrier, the ranger withstands a salvo of cannon fire.
Streaking skyward in a bright arc, the ranger leaves the atmosphere behind.

name: Tumnania
summary: Tumnania is a small auburn trainee with a ring and a charged battery who proves more than a match for a veteran twice his size. A knack for slipping inside a machine's circuits lets the recruit pull a captive mind out of its cage.

feats.scene: Hurling a thick beam from the ring, the recruit shatters a training dummy to flakes.
Tossed into a wall by an older fighter, the recruit pops up unhurt.

name: Rneol
summary: Rneol is a brown-furred ranger bound to a sprawling interstellar corps who mentors a young recruit against a swarm of machines. The little guide can only be found in handheld game versions of the tale.

feats.scene: Raising a ring, the ranger blasts a drone cruiser into scrap.
Hit by a volley of metallic bolts, the ranger sheds them in a gleaming shell.

name: Tillva
summary: Tillva is a brown-skinned ex-officer of a cosmic police order who tames a tyrant by imagining something so small that the nerves in his skull fail. The ploy ends when a vengeful ex-colleague strikes before the prisoner can be moved.

feats.scene: Squeezing out a ring blast, the ex-officer topples a concrete overpass.
Wrapped in a pale shell, the ex-officer endures an avalanche of debris.

name: Listival
summary: Listival is a diminutive fur-covered ranger stationed on a distant home base, one among many in a roster of fighters from a video game. Whatever shape the wearer imagines, the ring renders it as solid glowing matter.

feats.scene: Conjuring a giant hammer, the ranger flattens an armoured walker.
Struck by a rocket, the ranger sits unharmed inside a glowing dome.

name: Caniu
summary: Caniu is a cheerful furred ring-bearer who roams the sky nicknamed with a pet name by teammates and answers calls from remote worlds. The ring supplies barriers, bolts and wings, and the battery keeps it charged.

feats.scene: Casting a green-lit bolt, the ranger blows a tunnel through a mountainside shed.
Rocketing into orbit, the ranger leaves a pale vapour streak across the sky.

name: Neoium
summary: Neoium is a brooding mind-reading sorcerer who rules a hidden tower in a drowned metropolis, drawing on both psychic and occult currents. Wrapped in a drifting cloak and carrying a humming staff, Neoium surpassed a former teacher and now prefers solitary work in shadowy realms.

feats.scene: Neoium unleashes a staff blast that vaporises a fortified district of the drowned metropolis.
Neoium stands unharmed inside a collapsing tower as its foundations are levelled around the cloak.

name: Nusrnso
summary: Nusrnso is an orphaned teenager who built feathered wings in imitation of a hero, then was changed by a lab accident into a winged being. Nusrnso flies alongside veteran heroes and later joins a short-lived western squad of young champions.

feats.scene: Nusrnso dives at a fleeing thug and knocks him sprawling with a wing buffet.
Nusrnso shrugs off a hard crash into a brick wall during a rooftop chase.
Nusrnso races across the skyline at a speed matching a swooping hawk.

name: Valmeanu
summary: Valmeanu is a weary rifleman from the highlands who fights in a war of trenches beside a band of mismatched allies. Valmeanu is a superb shot but is haunted by shellshock and drowns it in drink.

feats.scene: Valmeanu fires a single rifle round that drops a distant sentry across a frozen field.
Valmeanu staggers up after a nearby shell blast hurls him into the mud.

name: Eoncoliu
summary: Eoncoliu is a winged child born of a celestial father and a human counselor, a gentle soul inheriting a vast extended family of immortals. Eoncoliu is tougher than any ordinary kid and can already glide on small feathered wings.

feats.scene: Eoncoliu flings a heavy toy chest across a nursery in a tantrum.
Eoncoliu tumbles down a flight of marble stairs and giggles without a bruise.

name: Rniro
summary: Rniro was a zoo gorilla whose body was hijacked by a winged alien insect. Rniro joined brute primate muscle to the flight and possession of its parasite before dying on a rescue mission.

feats.scene: Rniro rips a steel cage door off its hinges and hurls it through a concrete wall.
Rniro shakes off a speeding truck that rams into its shoulder.

name: Lamiun
summary: Lamiun is a grieving former contract killer who turned her skill against the hero who saved her family's killer. Lamiun dons a pale armoured suit and hunts everyone that hero ever rescued, trading love for vengeance.

feats.scene: Lamiun snaps a drunk driver's neck with one brutal twist.
Lamiun walks away from a rooftop fall onto a parked van.

name: Ororle
summary: Ororle was a sharp criminal defence lawyer whose body was briefly borrowed by a cosmic mother. Restored to life and chasing a hooded killer, Ororle meets death a second time and finds rest above.

feats.scene: Ororle slaps a smirking witness across the face in a courtroom hallway.
Ororle endures a fatal stabbing before the final fade.

name: Tonlluson
summary: Tonlluson is the eldest daughter of a renowned scientist, a stern woman who looked down on her young nephew. Tonlluson married her childhood playmate, raised a daughter and later divorced at thirty-two.

feats.scene: Tonlluson shoves a stuck kitchen window open with a firm push.
Tonlluson slips on an icy porch and walks off the fall unscathed.

name: Unnilrer
summary: Unnilrer is the lone survivor of a murdered clan of earth-reading mages, who trained her body hard and bargained with a living flame for demonic might. Unnilrer slips through spatial folds and hunts a rival before becoming an uneasy ally.

feats.scene: Unnilrer smashes a stone bridge into rubble with a single flame-fuelled blow.
Unnilrer rises from a collapsing cliff face with only scorched cloth.

name: Amota
summary: Amota is a faceless, hairless boatman of the underworld who carries the newly dead over a black river in a hollow craft. Amota demands payment in small coins and leaves penniless souls adrift between realms.

feats.scene: Amota brings his long oar down and cleaves a drifting wreck in two.
Amota endures a collapsing cavern ceiling while ferrying a line of ghosts.

name: Loreo
summary: Loreo is a scarred gang boss who rules runaways in the tunnels beneath a rotten city until a masked girl overthrows him. Loreo later wins command of a cavern tribe of burned mutants and plots his revenge, which ends in a lava pit.

feats.scene: Loreo clubs a captured rival with a length of pipe in the dark.
Loreo takes a hot iron brand to the face and keeps on snarling.

name: Ternumte
summary: Ternumte is a mad would-be conqueror who steals the gifts of others and wears a hungry swarm of fish into his own flesh. Ternumte has fanged jaws, a hand of molten stone and a gift for commanding sea creatures.

feats.scene: Ternumte hurls a blast of molten rock that melts through a ship's hull.
Ternumte walks out of a cannon volley with only torn skin.

name: Rniiaeo
summary: Rniiaeo is an eyeless, fanged sea horror that lurks in the open ocean and drags swimmers under. Rniiaeo has monstrous strength and swims with eerie ease.

feats.scene: Rniiaeo crushes a fishing trawler between its jaws and drags the wreck down.
Rniiaeo takes a torpedo strike on its flank and surfaces still hunting.

name: Monst
summary: Monst is a married scientist of a proud lineage in a crystal city on a doomed world. Monst raises a family of future leaders and brilliant minds.

feats.scene: Monst slams a heavy lab shutter closed against the dust.
Monst weathers a lab explosion behind a glass screen.

name: Ntulorcor
summary: Ntulorcor is a down-on-his-luck guitarist who summons an ancient spirit of the hunt to save a lover from crooked record bosses. Ntulorcor inherits the huntsman's claws, spikes and cape, but loses a brother to the bargain.

feats.scene: Ntulorcor rips through a limousine roof with spiked gauntlets.
Ntulorcor takes a stampede of hounds head-on and stays upright.

name: Leota
summary: Leota is a red-haired psychiatrist who runs a grim treatment tower in a gothic city. Leota is calm, clever and wholly mundane.

feats.scene: Leota slaps a ranting patient's hand off a clipboard.
Leota stays on her feet when a rioting inmate knocks her into a door.

name: Lisear
summary: Lisear is a round, white-haired, tentacled alien who wields a green ring of willpower in a vast galactic police corps. Lisear falls defending the home planet from a tyrant's assault.

feats.scene: Lisear fires a beam from the ring that cuts a warship in half.
Lisear holds a ring shield against a rain of enemy shells.

name: Toall
summary: Toall is a ring-wielding alien officer who tracks a rogue android across the stars to a distant planet. Toall projects willpower as shields, beams and flight from a small power battery.

feats.scene: Toall fires a ring beam that melts a canyon wall.
Toall shrugs off a robotic fist pounding the ring shield.

name: Liati
summary: Liati is a stout tentacled grey alien in an emerald-lit corps of cosmic officers. Liati reshapes light into walls and blasts from a ring that must be recharged at a small battery.

feats.scene: Liati blasts a hovering raider craft out of the sky with a ring beam.
Liati stays safe behind a glowing barrier as turrets pound it.

name: Rumnueo
summary: Rumnueo is a plump grey tentacled alien officer carrying a glowing ring and a lantern-shaped battery. Rumnueo forms barriers and light blasts by sheer will and flies between star systems.

feats.scene: Rumnueo hurls a bolt of green energy that shatters a fortress gate.
Rumnueo withstands a bombardment from a hostile frigate behind a ring shield.

name: Sonolure
summary: Sonolure is a round, faceted, white-haired alien nicknamed for a love of dance floors, serving in a galactic corps with a power ring. Sonolure shapes solid light, blasts foes and flies, all fuelled by willpower.

feats.scene: Sonolure drops a glowing wrecking ball that flattens an enemy outpost.
Sonolure stays unhurt behind a ring dome while a cannon barrage lands.

name: Tiaurnan
summary: Tiaurnan is a dark-eyed, hairless officer in a corps of thousands who guards a bright home world. Tiaurnan flies by ring power and fires blasts or conjures shields from a battery.

feats.scene: Tiaurnan collapses a mountainside onto an invading army with one ring blast.
Tiaurnan weathers an orbital strike behind a ring barrier.

name: Colseoler
summary: Colseoler is a bald teenage student at a school for young heroes in a bright city. Colseoler attends class, studies and keeps out of trouble.

feats.scene: Colseoler tosses a heavy backpack across a school gymnasium.
Colseoler takes a dodgeball to the chest and laughs it off.

name: Aulilu
summary: Aulilu is a married royal woman of the old river kingdom with dark eyes and brown hair, who turns up in a comic crossover with a pack of mystery-solving friends. Aulilu is an ordinary mortal noble in dress and manner.

feats.scene: Aulilu pushes a stone door open with both hands.
Aulilu withstands a fall from a palace stair without a scratch.

name: Naulla
summary: Naulla is a blond, nameless trickster who plays games with rules and takes whatever shortcuts he can. Naulla is a street-level crook with no known powers.

feats.scene: Naulla thumps a guard with a closed fist and slips away.
Naulla tumbles off a fire escape and keeps running.

name: Tiaeol
summary: Tiaeol is a professor of time theory who works at an institute of temporal research. Tiaeol built a lab that tracks recent crossings of the barrier between eras.

feats.scene: Tiaeol slams a big chalkboard frame upright with a grunt.
Tiaeol stays standing when a lab console bursts in a shower of sparks.

name: Ninirn
summary: Ninirn is a green-eyed, white-haired feline mercenary with claws, lightning reflexes and a taste for bombs shaped like skulls. Ninirn fights bare-handed and sells her services to the highest bidder.

feats.scene: Ninirn tosses a skull bomb that wrecks a delivery van.
Ninirn lands on all fours after a three-storey drop.

name: Iaren
summary: Iaren is a plastic automaton filled with deadly toxins and animated by malice. Iaren has great strength and is immune to poisons, and stalks heroes made of metal.

feats.scene: Iaren hurls a parked tanker truck across a factory yard.
Iaren absorbs a head-on collision from a runaway freight cart.

name: Eonus
summary: Eonus is a huge, red-eyed, artificial monster built of poison that carries a small device on its chest. Eonus is incredibly strong and tough and shrugs off blows that would crush a tank.

feats.scene: Eonus swings a fist through a concrete overpass and drops it into the road.
Eonus stands in the blast of a collapsing tower and is only singed.

name: Veolara
summary: Veolara is an orange-skinned, hairless alien officer of a cosmic corps who patrols a distant sector. Veolara loses ring power while chasing raiders in the void and dies adrift, later honoured among the fallen.

feats.scene: Veolara blasts a raider ship's engine to slag with a ring beam.
Veolara endures a volley of plasma behind a ring shield.

name: Serontori
summary: Serontori is a blonde, secretive woman who runs a brutal underground arena in a slum district and hires a physician for her fighters. Serontori loses control when her patrons turn on her.

feats.scene: Serontori slaps a rowdy ringside gambler hard enough to spin him.
Serontori takes a blow from a drunk patron and keeps her feet.

name: Seter
summary: Seter is a young secretary in the early forties who quietly helps a masked prosecutor and fusses over his young partner. Seter knows the secret early and tries, in vain, to keep the boy out of danger.

feats.scene: Seter bangs a desk drawer shut to end an argument.
Seter tumbles over a fallen filing cabinet and gets up unhurt.

name: Tirra
summary: Tirra is a government operative cloned from a lost girlfriend and mixed with a speedster's genes, which ties her to a force of pure velocity. Tirra works in a trio of operatives and snatches targets with ease.

feats.scene: Tirra hits a parked car at full speed and flips it onto its roof.
Tirra collides with a lamppost at top speed and shakes it off.
Tirra streaks down an avenue in a blur faster than sound.

name: Tinnt
summary: Tinnt is a blue-eyed blonde woman who raised her little brother, wed a man tangled in a cult and brought up a troubled daughter. Tinnt calls on her magician brother when a family crisis strikes, and is an ordinary mortal throughout.

feats.scene: Tinnt flings open the door of a locked pantry in a rage.
Tinnt endures a hard slip on a wet kitchen floor.

name: Selivor
summary: Selivor is a brown-eyed college student who finally goes back to school after fifteen busy years and shares a flat with a friend. Selivor lives an ordinary life and is a bright, determined young woman.

feats.scene: Selivor heaves a stack of textbooks onto a lecture hall desk.
Selivor skids on stairs, catches the rail and is unhurt.

name: Tovive
summary: Tovive is a red-haired engineer who leaves a big technology firm to join a crew of armoured allies in a coastal city. Tovive is a skilled scientist with no powers.

feats.scene: Tovive swings a heavy wrench at a jammed hatch.
Tovive is thrown from a stool by a lab surge and gets up fine.

name: Leoau
summary: Leoau is a brown-haired alien hero of a distant planet who belongs to a watch of defenders and has a caped look reminiscent of a famous champion. Leoau is a proud and loyal ally.

feats.scene: Leoau hurls a boulder that flattens a pirate barge.
Leoau stands up from a crashed shuttle without a scratch.

name: Iutesli
summary: Iutesli is a small, dark-haired warrior woman from a sunken empire, forced as a girl into a warlord's training and later escaping to become a mercenary. Iutesli rises to command the royal guard and loves a lord.

feats.scene: Iutesli cuts down three armoured taskmasters in one flurry of sword strokes.
Iutesli stands after being thrown from a stone parapet.

name: Orasimi
summary: Orasimi is a hard-boiled newspaper reporter in the late thirties who briefly dons a masked costume and fights with a fencing blade. Orasimi smokes too much, carries a concealed pistol and bickers with an editor.

feats.scene: Orasimi knocks a thug down with a quick fencing blade slash.
Orasimi brushes off a punch from a bar brawler.

name: Renarse
summary: Renarse is a green-eyed, red-haired teenage sidekick of a tuxedoed crime boss. Renarse lets heroes capture him so he can spy inside their headquarters, but a clever hound spoils the plan.

feats.scene: Renarse jabs a guard in the ribs and runs for the door.
Renarse is tackled by a hound and shrugs it off.

name: Merestu
summary: Merestu is a black-haired police officer in a special unit tackling unusual crimes in a big city. Merestu patrols, investigates and relies on training and a service pistol.

feats.scene: Merestu fires a service pistol and drops a runaway thief's tyre.
Merestu stays on her feet after a car door slams into her.

name: Miaco
summary: Miaco is a white-haired mute thug hired as hired muscle by a gang chief, a revived corpse with a taste for violence. Miaco falls in a scuffle with the heroine and is not mourned.

feats.scene: Miaco hurls a bar stool through a front window in a brawl.
Miaco walks off a fall down a long flight of stairs.

name: Serninol
summary: Serninol is a black-haired woman who works for the state, dispatching a stretchy agent to stop absurd criminal organisations. Serninol is nitpicky about her agent, who adores her anyway.

feats.scene: Serninol thumps her desk and demands a field report.
Serninol keeps her composure as a rattled ceiling tile drops on her.

name: Tauco
summary: Tauco is an exiled enchantress who keeps a crooked hut on a storm-battered rock and raises a stolen foundling with fierce, unorthodox tenderness. Her spells bind serpents and bend the tide, though she distrusts every deity above her.

feats.scene: Tauco calls up a hex-driven gale that rips the roof off a coastal fortress in a single night.
Tauco shrugs off a falling cliff-slab that she warded only at the last moment.

name: Eoleoill
summary: Eoleoill is a flamboyant sorceress who runs a villains' academy from a shadowed hall, handing out dangerous errands to apprentices. She reshapes bodies at a glance and drifts above the floor while lecturing.

feats.scene: Eoleoill twists a charging war-beast into a flock of squealing swine with one flick of her wrist.
Eoleoill walks unscratched through a collapsing arcade of stone pillars.

name: Teltiva
summary: Teltiva is a half-divine sorceress who dreams of a throne and recruits a brigade of resentful men to take it. Her spellwork only flows when both palms are free, so she fights with arms spread wide.

feats.scene: Teltiva hurls a lance of raw force that cracks a stone bridge in half.
Teltiva survives a point-blank tank shell with only a ringing in her ears.

name: Aurnu
summary: Aurnu is a cartoon sorceress with a taste for mischief, swooping through the sky and transfiguring anyone who annoys her. She cackles when a spell lands.

feats.scene: Aurnu turns a bus-load of tourists into ducks and herds them across the highway.
Aurnu bounces off a collapsing billboard and keeps cackling.

name: Soriumres
summary: Soriumres runs a cramped ink parlour, inking charms that grant odd effects to whoever wears them. She punishes cruelty by turning offenders into small animals, then learns shame when she looks inside a stranger's heart.

feats.scene: Soriumres changes a snarling bully into a whimpering puppy in the middle of a crowded cafe.
Soriumres takes a shove into a shelf of paint jars and gets up laughing.

name: Lleanu
summary: Lleanu is a grey-haired undead drifter who skulks the rainy docks, hungry and unpredictable. She shuffles through alleys with a stiff gait and a nasty grin.

feats.scene: Lleanu hurls a rusted barrel across a loading bay to keep a patrolman away.
Lleanu keeps lurching after being clipped by a slow delivery van.

name: Cintelser
summary: Cintelser is a media-savvy young archer in a parallel world of pampered heroes, loosing gadget-tipped shafts between photo shoots. She is more celebrity than soldier, yet her aim stays true.

feats.scene: Cintelser pins a fleeing thief's sleeve to a wall with a smoke-puffing bolt from fifty paces.
Cintelser tumbles down a flight of marble stairs and stands up with her hair still perfect.
Cintelser's arrow crosses the plaza in a blink before it strikes the target.

name: Esita
summary: Esita is a cheerful teen at an academy for young champions, an athletic archer who also trains hand-to-hand. She carries a quiver of novelty arrows and a cheeky catchphrase for every bullseye.

feats.scene: Esita launches a net-arrow that snares a runaway mascot on the sports field.
Esita lands a flip off the gym rafters and shrugs off the thud.

name: Covival
summary: Covival is a masked patriot who fought briefly beside a band of wartime heroes before falling in battle. Little else is known about this anonymous fighter.

feats.scene: Covival swings a flagpole into a charging soldier's chest and drops him in the mud.
Covival keeps swinging after a rifle butt cracks across the mask.

name: Liuiu
summary: Liuiu is a red-haired student turned bloodsucker who infected her friends in a feverish thirst. She is quick, tough and hard to kill, and was brought back after being slain.

feats.scene: Liuiu snaps the door off a campus van to get at the driver.
Liuiu climbs out of a smashed car with torn muscle already knitting.

name: Resaurn
summary: Resaurn is a runaway teen whose hands burst into flame when she is angry. She steals to survive and turns on the officials who once caged her.

feats.scene: Resaurn sets a parked fuel truck ablaze with a snap of her fingers and scatters the guards.
Resaurn leaps from a burning rooftop with no more than singed shoelaces.

name: Sisoniu
summary: Sisoniu is a flame-wielding criminal who headed a crew of disaster-themed thugs in a river city. She torches her enemies in bursts and gloats over the smoke.

feats.scene: Sisoniu engulfs a derelict warehouse in a rolling fireball that lights the harbor.
Sisoniu strolls out of a burning stairwell without a blister.

name: Tumti
summary: Tumti is a talking shellfish in a buccaneer's hat who steals a rain-bending machine and drowns a coastal metropolis to rob its submerged shops. His crew of goons fumble most plans.

feats.scene: Tumti triggers his stolen device and sends a wall of seawater over the waterfront skyline.
Tumti keeps scowling after a bank door flattens his shell against a wall.

name: Raure
summary: Raure is a veteran police chief of a dark metropolis who keeps a red telephone on his desk for calling a masked ally. He is loyal, trusting and rarely credited.

feats.scene: Raure shoulders a locked office door off its hinges to reach a trapped clerk.
Raure rides out a nightstick blow to the ribs and keeps issuing orders.

name: Nilnullu
summary: Nilnullu is a career beat officer who rises through a parallel city's ranks to become its top lawman. He stays calm through the strangest crises and calls in help when criminals gain strange powers.

feats.scene: Nilnullu tackles a fleeing mugger and pins him against a lamp post.
Nilnullu absorbs a flung trash can and keeps his whistle in his teeth.

name: Sente
summary: Sente is a hard-working, loyal police chief who stays at his commissioner's shoulder through puzzle-laden crimes. A happily married man, he meets a grim end at the hands of a masked killer.

feats.scene: Sente cracks a heavy case file against a suspect's desk to demand a confession.
Sente takes a scuffle in the evidence room and straightens his collar.

name: Tilan
summary: Tilan is a sharp-eyed newspaper reporter who exists only as a prank of a mischievous imp from another dimension. She vanishes the moment his spell is undone.

feats.scene: Tilan slaps a tabloid down on a desk hard enough to rattle a coffee cup.
Tilan stays upright when a crowd jostles her at a press conference.

name: Telul
summary: Telul is the adopted son of city founders in a class-divided alternate world, raised among the wealthy until he recalls his stellar origin. He dons a gleaming costume and fights for the toiling masses.

feats.scene: Telul rips a factory gate from its hinges and hurls it across the yard.
Telul stands his ground as a mob of guards open fire with cannons.

name: Stole
summary: Stole is a drifting former bank robber who left his family to keep them safe, served time, and returned hoping to meet his estranged son. He is regretful, gruff and under someone else's control for a spell.

feats.scene: Stole shoves a vault trolley through a bank lobby during an old heist.
Stole takes a baton to the shoulder and keeps walking.

name: Astiu
summary: Astiu is a thick-necked hoodlum with an unnatural body, strong enough to bend steel and tough enough to ignore pistol fire. He enjoys breaking safes with bare hands.

feats.scene: Astiu bends a steel vault door outward with both fists.
Astiu laughs off a hail of pistol rounds on a loading dock.

name: Tiustce
summary: Tiustce is a showy criminal who dresses like a jester and robs with a flourish in a world of comic-strip heroes. He relies on gags and goons rather than power.

feats.scene: Tiustce swings a cane through a shop window to start a robbery.
Tiustce lands on his back in an alley and bounces up grinning.

name: Sivaela
summary: Sivaela is a bald scribe of comics who, after losing his job, was struck by a freak bolt and became a madly confident deity. He teleports objects at whim and fires blasts while trying to perfect the cosmos.

feats.scene: Sivaela flings a barrage of blasts that scours the surface of a small moon.
Sivaela keeps ranting while a battery of beams burns across his chest.

name: Numrnrum
summary: Numrnrum is a spidery carnival performer with four arms and quick fingers, equally gifted at sleight of hand and picking pockets. He tours with a travelling big-top troupe.

feats.scene: Numrnrum lifts three wallets and a pocket watch from one crowd in a single pass.
Numrnrum drops from the tent rigging into a hay bale and strolls off.

name: Lanrital
summary: Lanrital is a stolen child raised by a glowing, godlike guardian and later by retired adventurers, who grows into a masked vigilante carrying an unearned legacy. He wrestles with the weight of inherited power.

feats.scene: Lanrital unmakes a hillside bunker in a flash of blue light.
Lanrital walks out of a collapsing apartment block without a mark.

name: Amocorna
summary: Amocorna is a wartime cartoon champion from a faraway doomed planet, raised on a farmland orphanage's steps and working as a reporter by day. He leaps tall structures and sinks enemy ships.

feats.scene: Amocorna capsizes a line of warships by lifting their hulls from below.
Amocorna stands in a field of bombs and brushes dust from his sleeve.
Amocorna outpaces a rifle round across a river valley.

name: Leesi
summary: Leesi is a volunteer frozen for decades after a secret wartime experiment, thawed to join a team of mashup heroes. He flies, shoots heat from his eyes and has overwhelming strength.

feats.scene: Leesi shatters a bunker roof with a single overhead strike.
Leesi endures a barrage of shells and keeps advancing.

name: Sesauton
summary: Sesauton is a missing spaceman, rebuilt by cruel aliens into a living weapon, who rules a mirror world as a tyrant beside his powerful wife. He answers to no one and sneers at pleas.

feats.scene: Sesauton blasts a mountain range into glowing slag with a point-blank wave.
Sesauton laughs while a battery of orbital cannons pounds his chest.

name: Amcesso
summary: Amcesso is a gunman raised by decent foster parents without knowing his criminal blood, steered by an implant in his skull toward theft. He gets a taste of fame before things collapse.

feats.scene: Amcesso shoots out a security camera and vaults a teller's counter.
Amcesso takes a blow from a rifle stock and keeps robbing.

name: Rnvine
summary: Rnvine is a towering, bronze-skinned scientist and adventurer who trained for years before facing the world and keeps a lab fortress. He leads a team of friends and investigates a mystery about his father's grave.

feats.scene: Rnvine lands a right hook that drops a brawny smuggler across a crate.
Rnvine climbs out of a collapsed crypt shaft coated in grave dirt.

name: Estana
summary: Estana is a protective older sister who tries to hide the truth when her sibling transforms into an insect-like creature. She lies to reporters, then confesses to officials.

feats.scene: Estana swings a lamp at a snooping intruder in her family's living room.
Estana stays calm through a grilling by stern agents in a windowless room.

name: Taiunti
summary: Taiunti is an ordinary red-haired woman whose mind holds a shard of a terrible universal formula, hunted by a tyrant for it. A warrior from the skies carries her to safety.
