summary: Nerosva is a performer who plays a ventriloquist's puppet that turns out to be the real voice behind the act. Nerosva grows bitter at mockery, turns to crime and makes victims behave like wooden dolls until a caped duo ends his spree.

feats.scene: Nerosva shoves a stage prop into a guard's chest and knocks him over.
Nerosva tumbles off a stage platform and gets up laughing.

name: Rnvatiu
summary: Rnvatiu is an ex-soldier abandoned by an old comrade on a distant battlefield, and he returns years later under a dragon-themed name to take revenge. Rnvatiu reads minds, handles firearms expertly and joins with a poisoner and an archer to blind his former friend.

feats.scene: Rnvatiu fires a rifle burst that shreds a steel door.
Rnvatiu pushes on through a long march with a bullet graze in his leg.

name: Eoriunau
summary: Eoriunau is a drug-enforcement agent hunting the killer of his partner, who falls for a reporter and finds his secretive job ruins the romance. Eoriunau is blown from cover mid-operation and survives an assassin only thanks to a flying rescuer.

feats.scene: Eoriunau slams a smuggler against a car hood and cuffs him.
Eoriunau shakes off a hard fall during a foot chase through a market.

name: Leles
summary: Leles is a rumpled veteran detective with a gruff manner who works for a special crimes squad and bends rules often. Leles fights invading horrors beside his unit and dies defiantly, struck down by beams from a retreating tyrant.

feats.scene: Leles empties a service revolver into a charging winged beast.
Leles keeps his ground against a swarm of fanged invaders.

name: Setor
summary: Setor is a married police detective with a young son who helps an undercover newcomer corner escaped convicts. Setor is manipulated by a sniper into aiming at a masked archer, but hesitates, and a stranger's impossible reflexes save everyone.

feats.scene: Setor fires his service pistol and pins a thug's gun hand to a door frame.
Setor ducks behind a car as rifle fire shreds the windows.

name: Amiaus
summary: Amiaus is a criminal speedster known only by hearsay, the estranged uncle of a famous boy runner and brother of a reporter. Amiaus draws power from a mysterious wellspring of velocity and wears a crimson-and-yellow mirror image of a hero's costume.

feats.scene: Amiaus rams a vault door at a sprint and splinters it off its hinges.
Amiaus crashes through a billboard unhurt.

name: Tiaam
summary: Tiaam is a doomed villain with time-bending speed, captured by an ape despot and locked in a prison deep in a jungle city. Tiaam is killed and his brain devoured so that his captor may inherit his access to the strange speed wellspring.

feats.scene: Tiaam vibrates through a cell wall and shatters a guard's rifle with one blow.
Tiaam endures weeks of chained torment before a final blow.

name: Sternca
summary: Sternca is a blacksmith's apprentice from a rural hamlet who is coaxed into prize fighting and rapidly becomes a world title holder. Sternca drops a carnival bully with a single punch and helps people in trouble between fights.

feats.scene: Sternca lands a hook that knocks out a carnival strongman in one blow.
Sternca takes twelve brutal rounds from a seasoned champion and wins.

name: Telntte
summary: Telntte is a sentient lane that can grow into an otherworldly funfair and even conjure living beings from imagination. Telntte talks through painted signs, protects a ragtag family of oddballs, and is hunted by a sinister organisation that wants its strange gift.

feats.scene: Telntte unfurls into a vast carnival that flattens a hostile warehouse.
Telntte endures a weapons barrage from hunters and rebuilds itself overnight.

name: Setonra
summary: Setonra is a talking street in a ruined future city that once created living companions out of nothing. Setonra dies and leaves a wrecked ambulance behind, while a loyal friend refuses to abandon hope of reviving it.

feats.scene: Setonra births a laughing creature from a pile of rubble.
Setonra shrugs off an artillery barrage before finally falling silent.

name: Ilnuti
summary: Ilnuti is a half-demon scholar who finds a pit dimension and reshapes it into a disco, ruling over bat-faced fiends that feast on suffering. Ilnuti captures suspected sinners for torment until young heroes stumble in by accident and fight him.

feats.scene: Ilnuti warps a cavern into a flashing dance floor with a wave of his hand.
Ilnuti shakes off a flurry of blows from a squad of teenagers.

name: Tiuirnam
summary: Tiuirnam is a bald, self-disfigured financier who runs a secret bank that launders illicit fortunes and funds crime for profit. Tiuirnam bans real names, borrows hellish imagery from an old poem and relies on mind-wiped killers to collect from debtors.

feats.scene: Tiuirnam strikes a defaulting client with a cane hard enough to draw blood.
Tiuirnam endures a scarred, hideous face without ever flinching.

name: Anaure
summary: Anaure is a prison escapee who splits his body into many copies of himself through cell division. Anaure slips out in a mass breakout and swarms foes with an army of identical thugs.

feats.scene: Anaure and a dozen duplicates pile onto a guard and smother him.
Anaure loses one copy to gunfire and simply splits again.

name: Elsor
summary: Elsor is a mountain warrior who drinks a tainted poppy tonic and channels its gifts through carved totems to protect villagers from a bribing warlord. Elsor can loose volleys of accurate projectiles and votes against recruiting an outsider before agreeing.

feats.scene: Elsor fires six glowing darts at once, each pinning a bandit's helmet to a post.
Elsor holds the line against a rush of armed guards at a fortress gate.

name: Nutes
summary: Nutes is a blonde woman drawn into the schemes of a mad doctor and his hulking creations. Nutes meets a grim end, and even her gravestone spells her family name in two different ways.

feats.scene: Nutes swings a lead pipe into a hulking creature's knee.
Nutes is thrown across a laboratory and gets to her feet.

name: Taucorora
summary: Taucorora is a hard-of-hearing teenage detective who wears a mask and carries two wrenches. Taucorora signs and speaks fluently, helps a young hero move into his dockside home and solves puzzles beside him.

feats.scene: Taucorora clangs a wrench off a burglar's arm and sends his crowbar flying.
Taucorora tumbles off a pier and climbs back onto the boards.

name: Toriumam
summary: Toriumam is a charming young stage manager who quietly murders a blackmailer and stages an attack on himself to look like a victim. Toriumam stays cool before an audience, though a keen investigator suspects what really happened.

feats.scene: Toriumam swaps a prop knife for a real one and strikes in the dark.
Toriumam takes a staged blow to his temple and plays dazed.

name: Rusiasau
summary: Rusiasau is a dark-eyed prince of a sunken sea-city who watches a parent sacrifice his mother to cruel deities. Rusiasau rules his people through a curse placed upon those who accepted a rival's breathing serum, and his line spawns later kings.

feats.scene: Rusiasau calls a cursed surge of water that smashes a pier to splinters.
Rusiasau stands unmoved as a crashing wave breaks over his throne.

name: Soiuam
summary: Soiuam is the soft-spoken heir of a mob family who is passed over for his father's best aide, then tries to blow up a floating hideout with all inside. Soiuam is stopped by a cat burglar and ends up as her loyal agent and lodger.

feats.scene: Soiuam arms a stack of explosives meant to sink an entire barge.
Soiuam takes a hard blow from a masked thief and shakes it off.

name: Olllluca
summary: Olllluca is a mansion security guard who plots with a scheming patriarch to break the will of the man's own son. Olllluca walks the grounds, watches the gates and carries out quiet orders from the master of the house.

feats.scene: Olllluca shoves an intruder off the gravel drive.
Olllluca takes a baton to the shoulder and stays at his post.

name: Tunen
summary: Tunen is a prosperous, tidy-minded money manager who keeps his accounts spotless and his reputation polished. He views the unruly relative of his household with quiet disdain, preferring ledgers and church pews to any kind of fight.

feats.scene: Tunen slams a heavy ledger onto a boardroom table to end an argument.
Tunen shrugs off a stumble down a marble staircase with only a bruised pride.

name: Tilsa
summary: Tilsa is a bald saboteur who drifts through a river-side metropolis with a history of bombings. A twist in the timeline spared him the freak accident that would have granted him dread powers, leaving him an ordinary criminal with a hideout and a grudge.

feats.scene: Tilsa detonates a crate of explosives inside an empty warehouse.
Tilsa survives a hard tackle onto concrete from a pursuing hero.

name: Aueonle
summary: Aueonle is a blustering city official who bullies the police with threats of dismissal while pocketing favours from a rich corporation. He rises to the top office after a shooting and prefers backroom pressure to confrontation.

feats.scene: Aueonle pounds a desk while demanding a public arrest.
Aueonle walks away unharmed from a car bump in a crowded motorcade.

name: Eruvaco
summary: Eruvaco is a ruthless sea raider in a black diving suit whose helmet fires scorching beams. He survives a plague that turned the world's population into hungry husks, only to be drawn into the fight against them.

feats.scene: Eruvaco burns a hole through the hull of a surfaced submarine with a helmet beam.
Eruvaco is flung from a wrecked sub into the surf and walks out dazed but alive.

name: Licis
summary: Licis is a bitter hired killer in sleek armour who has hated one family of ocean heroes for decades. He joins a doomed strike team sent across worlds and dies slowly from the crossing.

feats.scene: Licis hammers a young swimmer into the sand with an armoured fist.
Licis keeps fighting after a hard blow from a rival's trident.

name: Corsoles
summary: Corsoles is a mercenary swimmer with a lifelong feud against a sea king. Joined by his own son in the end, he helps bring the old rival down.

feats.scene: Corsoles drives a harpoon through a patrol boat's rudder.
Corsoles takes a heavy punch underwater without letting go of his prey.

source_title: David Hyde (Last 52: Falling Through the Cracks)

name: Tannorvi
summary: Tannorvi is a laboratory researcher whose own tissue-mending nanites kept him alive after a near-fatal attack, leaving him unable to die and compelled to consume others to go on. He now hunts hidden creatures that have lived among people for ages.

feats.scene: Tannorvi tears through a fanged creature's chest in a close grapple.
Tannorvi rebuilds his body from scattered fragments after being blown apart.

name: Sticeo
summary: Sticeo is a nervous aide in a masked crime lord's inner circle who keeps urging caution about hiring lunatics. His good advice goes ignored, and a rival eventually uses his corpse as a phone prop.

feats.scene: Sticeo shoves a rival courier against a wall.
Sticeo scrambles clear of a collapsing hideout with only scrapes.

name: Stamta
summary: Stamta is an ordinary man whose mind holds a shard of a terrible cosmic formula, which makes him the target of a tyrant from a fiery world. A warrior from a distant planet carries him to safety and enlists his help.

feats.scene: Stamta swings a pipe at a masked raider guarding a stolen crate.
Stamta endures being hauled across the sky in a rescuer's grip.

name: Riates
summary: Riates is a blond ex-soldier turned gunman who moves faster than the eye can follow. His mind is strangely quiet, which makes him unreadable to telepaths.

feats.scene: Riates drops four armed officers before any of them clears a holster.
Riates shrugs off a hard hit from a rifle butt.
Riates crosses a street between one heartbeat and the next.

name: Liananre
summary: Liananre is a gene researcher posted to a secret swamp-town project, where he breeds a deformed population and tries to cure them with an unstable serum. His miracle fix backfires, and his offspring regress.

feats.scene: Liananre injects a squirming patient with a glowing serum.
Liananre stumbles through a lab fire with minor burns.

name: Ninseollo
summary: Ninseollo is a broken, vengeful youth fused by a sorceress to a mystic relic, becoming a huge warrior with a blazing lance. Rage drives him to blame powered beings for the loss of his family.

feats.scene: Ninseollo drives his lance into a bridge and shatters it end to end.
Ninseollo shrugs off a fall from a collapsing tower.

name: Tiliu
summary: Tiliu is a steel magnate who turned to crime to rescue his failing firm, then ended up recruited by a sinister order of killers. He is a deadly thrower of blades.

feats.scene: Tiliu pins a guard's sleeve to a door with a hurled knife.
Tiliu takes a hard fall from a rooftop and rolls to his feet.

name: Sastonnus
summary: Sastonnus is a veteran police chief who barricades himself and his partner in an apartment while a plague of the undead swarms outside. Down to his last bullets, he is rescued by a green-skinned flyer.

feats.scene: Sastonnus fires his last pistol rounds into the horde at the stairwell.
Sastonnus is carried through the air without injury.

name: Instan
summary: Instan is a socially active newspaper columnist from a crowded city district who campaigns for housing and services instead of office towers. He is wounded in a gang crossfire and survives thanks to a friend's blood.

feats.scene: Instan thumps a podium to rally neighbours against developers.
Instan survives a bullet wound until help arrives.

name: Nelti
summary: Nelti is a wandering minstrel with a harp of uncertain mystic power and a sling for stones. He seems able to divine hidden truths and claims to never die, with habits that echo ancient scripture.

feats.scene: Nelti flings a smooth stone from his sling into a thug's weapon.
Nelti keeps strumming after being knocked off a roof.

name: Iarla
summary: Iarla is a former child fighter who became a police officer in a river-country city and dons winged armour at night. He fights militias and corruption while haunted by the brother he lost.

feats.scene: Iarla smashes through a militia truck's door with an armoured strike.
Iarla absorbs a burst of rifle fire against his armoured chest.

name: Cooristo
summary: Cooristo is a figurehead ruler of a small country who secretly pursues crime in borrowed winged armour. He fakes his own kidnapping to keep suspicious generals at bay.

feats.scene: Cooristo cracks a guard post's gate with an armoured kick.
Cooristo is knocked through a wall in a training-camp raid and stands up.

name: Llantlor
summary: Llantlor is a blue-skinned guardian of a distant sector who wields a will-driven ring that shapes light into constructs. He is hunted and killed by escaped convicts using a long-range ray.

feats.scene: Llantlor casts a huge green construct that blocks a warlord's attack fleet.
Llantlor holds a protective shield against a bombardment from orbit.

name: Lanre
summary: Lanre is a mutant from a distant planet whose body radiates an aura that lets him float and glide. A former trapeze artist, he joins a team of misfit recruits and becomes the prime suspect for a betrayal he did not commit.

feats.scene: Lanre dives from a high wire onto a rogue teammate.
Lanre shakes off a hard slam into a metal bulkhead.
Lanre darts across a hangar under his own aura's lift.

name: Teleros
summary: Teleros is a white-haired, red-eyed alien hound who smokes cigars and rides along with a galactic bounty hunter. He can live in vacuum and plunge through an atmosphere unharmed.

feats.scene: Teleros clamps his fangs onto a bounty-hunter's boot.
Teleros drops through a planet's sky in flames and trots away.

name: Ntuesno
summary: Ntuesno is a fast-moving daughter of a legendary runner, raised in a far-future century. Corrupted by a villain's dark power, she is unleashed on an elderly hero before being turned back.

feats.scene: Ntuesno hurls a spinning shockwave that collapses a plaza's facade.
Ntuesno takes a punch from a rival speedster and keeps running.
Ntuesno blurs through a ruined avenue faster than sound.

name: Veotalo
summary: Veotalo is a white-haired woman in a bleak possible future who once guided younger heroes before breaking with them. She sides with a partner to free a captive archer.

feats.scene: Veotalo picks a lock on a cell with a hairpin.
Veotalo takes a blow from a guard and keeps walking.

name: Veium
summary: Veium is a vain teenager obsessed with winning a dance crown, who is mutated in a crash and her spirit slips free, hopping from body to body in jealous schemes. She even destroys her own wrecked form in disgust.

feats.scene: Veium seizes a bystander's body and strikes at her ex with a borrowed fist.
Veium's astral shape passes harmlessly through a speeding car.

name: Nenolles
summary: Nenolles is a masked fire-wielder from a team of continental heroes, now retired after a mission that cost thousands of lives. A murderer hunts her down for those deaths.

feats.scene: Nenolles hurls a column of flame across a clearing to scatter a rebel patrol.
Nenolles resists a rough tumble through brush without harm.

name: Sermani
summary: Sermani is a winged, clawed tracker from a star-colony who can find anyone anywhere, and hunts bounties for coin. She travels back through time to fight a death-lord's army.

feats.scene: Sermani slashes through a cultist's armour with her talons.
Sermani plunges through a collapsing wall and flies out intact.
Sermani streaks across a skyline in pursuit.

name: Iarntnol
summary: Iarntnol is a cold-blooded alien field marshal who leads a conquering armada against a blue-armoured defender's homeworld. He prefers to command from the rear.

feats.scene: Iarntnol orders a barrage from orbit that levels a district.
Iarntnol endures a hit from an armoured counterstrike on his command deck.

name: Iuriaco
summary: Iuriaco is a warrior from a divided world who was killed and revived hundreds of times in a lab until his flesh adapted to every death. The result is a scarred, grey, hulking brute locked in a deep vault.

feats.scene: Iuriaco hammers a fortress gate with both fists and flattens the surrounding wall.
Iuriaco shrugs off a blast that levelled the tower he stood in.

name: Tirseslo
summary: Tirseslo is a brown-haired teen fighter who senses how a brawl will unfold before it begins. Armed with a baton, he is a quick, strong copy of a hard-edged older brawler.

feats.scene: Tirseslo cracks a baton across a thug's guard after seeing the swing coming.
Tirseslo takes a hard hit from a bigger fighter and stays upright.

name: Nteium
summary: Nteium is a black-eyed horned swordsman of demonic blood, a peerless fencer with a flair for duels. He menaces a family of young heroes with his blade.

feats.scene: Nteium disarms a hero with three flicks of his rapier.
Nteium shrugs off a heavy slam that would break a normal man's ribs.

name: Tairnna
summary: Tairnna is a hostile male alien from a warlike matriarchal people who clashes with a powerful queen's retinue. He is blunt, scheming and not especially subtle.

feats.scene: Tairnna punches through a steel hatch in a boarding action.
Tairnna takes a heavy blow without flinching.

name: Veallli
summary: Veallli is an orange-skinned, red-eyed cyborg prince with four arms who tries to rule a rival world by forcing a marriage on a captive. His empire believes machinery makes it superior.

feats.scene: Veallli crushes a console with all four metal hands in a rage.
Veallli walks off a hit from a spacecraft's loading arm.

name: Ariaaun
summary: Ariaaun is a gloomy, blond undead teenager sent against his wishes to a school for strange youth. Scorned by classmates, he writes a bitter diary and finds he cannot go through with ending himself.

feats.scene: Ariaaun shoves a classmate away in a corridor argument.
Ariaaun stands up again after a hard tumble down the dormitory stairs.

name: Llonan
summary: Llonan is a grey-eyed, red-haired member of a far-future hero team, encountered by two time-tossed travellers after a failed scheme. He appears as a sleek, vaguely sinister figure.

feats.scene: Llonan swings a staff at a time-machine fragment.
Llonan shakes off a shockwave from a collapsing device.

source_title: Dead Pretty Boy (New Teen Titans Shorts: Turn Back the Clock)

name: Carses
summary: Carses is an engineered agent with a doubled chromosome, able to swell his own muscles at will and shift the chemistry of other men. He serves an order of warriors from a quiet mountain town.

feats.scene: Carses lifts and throws a parked van with swollen arms.
Carses takes a hard truncheon blow across the back and shrugs.

name: Tirtecin
summary: Tirtecin is a freelance killer whose genes were awakened by a cosmic bomb, granting him toughness, quick reflexes and the power to slip through solid matter. He fights a star-themed hero in a casino strip and is later pressed into a doomed squad.

feats.scene: Tirtecin brings down a hotel facade during a running battle on the strip.
Tirtecin takes a radiation burn to the hand and fights on.

name: Naune
summary: Naune is a one-handed assassin who glides on flying discs, slips through walls and fires an alien rifle that wraps a target in a disruptive shell. The weapon can hurt even beings that ordinary bullets cannot.

feats.scene: Naune fires a rifle shell that cracks a hardened target's defences.
Naune survives a rough crash from his discs.

name: Stnan
summary: Stnan is a mercenary working for a scheming doctor in a big coastal city, a hired gun with a menacing nickname and little else known about him.

feats.scene: Stnan fires a burst of automatic rounds at a rooftop door.
Stnan takes a hard punch to the jaw and shakes it off.

name: Sautornt
summary: Sautornt is a black-haired rebel fighter who can sway the feelings of others at a distance. He fights alongside a guerrilla movement and is pressed into a squad of expendable agents.

feats.scene: Sautornt calms a panicking crowd with a wave of soothing dread-lifting emotion.
Sautornt takes a firm tackle in a street fight and rises.

name: Auval
summary: Auval is a bald school administrator and a throwback who speaks mind to mind instead of aloud. He runs a school for costumed teens and struggles to find teachers who stay.

feats.scene: Auval sends a loud thought across a classroom to quiet a riot.
Auval is knocked flat by a runaway student's prank and stands back up.

name: Rnriore
summary: Rnriore is a dark-haired showman in a comedy-adventure series, a crooner who gets entangled in spy plots and slapstick jams with his partner. He is ordinary in every physical way.

feats.scene: Rnriore throws a cream pie at a villain's henchman.
Rnriore tumbles out of a speeding wagon and brushes himself off.

name: Ialiser
summary: Ialiser is a dark-haired college head who nurses a deep hatred for a shrinking scientist on his faculty. He schemes from his office with petty bureaucratic sabotage.

feats.scene: Ialiser slams a stack of complaints onto a professor's desk.
Ialiser walks away from a minor lab mishap with singed sleeves.

name: Iuriso
summary: Iuriso is a gaunt winged harbinger who was once a gentle healer on a dying red world. Broken by grief, she now serves a tyrant of fire and soars with her sisters to extinguish every living thing on a doomed planet.

feats.scene: Iuriso rakes a skyline with a sweeping wave of withering force that lays a district bare.
Iuriso keeps flying after a crushing impact into a collapsing tower.

name: Numamcol
summary: Numamcol is a courteous skeletal collector who escorts the dying to their rest with a long curved blade. A trickster once trapped him in a sack, and he took it with good humour and now asks for the occasional holiday there.

feats.scene: Numamcol sweeps his blade across a sickbed and gently severs a soul from its body.
Numamcol sits unharmed inside a sack that swallows ordinary matter.

name: Ilamrau
summary: Ilamrau is a pale, black-haired elder sibling in an eternal family, a cheerful guide who sees each life through to its end. She has existed since just before the first living things and will remain until the last one is gone.

feats.scene: Ilamrau ends the charter of a corrupt town, and its streets crumble away.
Ilamrau walks unscathed through a battlefield of collapsing monuments.

name: Tanneotan
summary: Tanneotan is a calm brown-haired woman who appears at the threshold of a soul's last hour and performs her role with a brisk sort of kindness. She plays music while she works and speaks as if reading from a duty roster.

feats.scene: Tanneotan plucks a few notes that settle a restless spirit.
Tanneotan strolls through a crowded corridor unbothered by a stumbling orderly.

name: Lesnto
summary: Lesnto is a grey-skinned crone who throws infernal flame and rides an enormous winged beast. Betrayed by relatives, she turned bitter and now lends her fire to a team of ruthless enforcers.

feats.scene: Lesnto engulfs a rooftop in a gout of flame that melts the surrounding antenna.
Lesnto is flung from her mount and rolls to her feet.

name: Leoeona
summary: Leoeona is a shadowy figure with a toadstool-themed alias who lurks in the margins of a rainy island's streets. Little is certain about this sly operator beyond a taste for secrecy.

feats.scene: Leoeona shoves a courier into a doorway to snatch a satchel.
Leoeona rolls out of a rain-slick fall and disappears into an alley.

name: Aucisres
summary: Aucisres is a red-haired hired killer who fights with a deck of lethal cards, some sharp, some incendiary. He traps a target in a locked room and sets it alight before a rival's lover puts him in the ground.

feats.scene: Aucisres flings a burning card that engulfs a sealed apartment in flame.
Aucisres takes a punch from a bowman and keeps dealing.

name: Stisau
summary: Stisau is a bald spy of an old totalitarian bloc who bends minds with a ray from his eyes. Anyone he commands obeys at once, until a reflective surface turns his own order against him.

feats.scene: Stisau orders a pilot to jump from his cockpit, and the man complies.
Stisau survives a scuffle on a rocky airfield.

name: Teniu
summary: Teniu is a grim card-themed thug working for a fortune-obsessed schemer, appearing in a single dramatic raid. Carrying a sinister symbolic motif, he lunges at heroes with fatalistic menace.

feats.scene: Teniu hurls a glowing card that blasts a lamp from its post.
Teniu endures a tackle from a costumed rival and snarls.

name: Roseontel
summary: Roseontel is a feral colossus from a vanished star-nest, a ravenous twin that craves the extinction of worlds. Even its old trainer feared to loose it, but a mercenary eventually seizes command.

feats.scene: Roseontel devours a world whole, crushing it under tentacles the size of mountain ranges.
Roseontel absorbs a barrage of divine weapons across the open sea and keeps feeding.

name: Llirnsor
summary: Llirnsor is a rarely-seen underworld teacher, known only by a title that hints at his refusal to stay down. He trains an apprentice in criminal craft from the shadows of an eastern capital.

feats.scene: Llirnsor lands a clean palm strike on a student during a lesson.
Llirnsor shrugs off a hard fall during a street chase.

name: Tinolirn
summary: Tinolirn is a deranged crime lord who absorbed the properties of a restorative pool, becoming a mad, unkillable boss whose blood is farmed by a cult of assassins. He mocks the young hero who hunts him with grotesque self-styled titles.

feats.scene: Tinolirn bombs a crowded bus with a casual flick of a detonator.
Tinolirn is sealed in a safe and launched into orbit, then wakes and persists.

name: Arneoti
summary: Arneoti is a one-time antagonist in a grim mask who menaced a beetle-armoured champion in a single outing. Nothing else is known about the masked figure.

feats.scene: Arneoti swings a club at a masked rival.
Arneoti stands his ground against a charging armoured opponent.

name: Eonuiu
summary: Eonuiu is a long-term patient with a dramatic costume who swears an alien world abducted him and its army is about to invade. He tracks a fugitive mercenary to deliver his warning, and gets the spelling of his own title very specific.

feats.scene: Eonuiu slashes a knife at an intruder's coat.
Eonuiu emerges from a transport beam unharmed.

name: Vauva
summary: Vauva is a menacing figure in a grim visage who stalked a nocturnal city's rooftops, recalled for only a single memorable appearance. The villain hides behind the mask more than behind any particular scheme.

feats.scene: Vauva hurls a brick through a shop window.
Vauva drops from a fire escape and runs away.

name: Estorta
summary: Estorta is a skull-faced cyborg teen at a school for troubled youth who inherited a flamboyant family trade. His enhanced frame lets him brawl above his age while he sorts out his place between class and crime.

feats.scene: Estorta punches a locker through its hinges in a hallway scuffle.
Estorta absorbs a blow from a larger rival with a clatter of metal.

name: Eonle
summary: Eonle is a white-haired angel who left the celestial host for a gaudy desert casino. He runs the tables with a feathered shrug and an eye for deals struck between worlds.

feats.scene: Eonle wallops a card cheat with a single backhanded blow.
Eonle strolls out of a ruined lounge after a firefight, undamaged.

name: Nelsan
summary: Nelsan is a green-eyed, red-haired woman bitten by a bloodthirsty fiend but kept half-human by her kind heart. She enjoys much of a vampire's strength and speed, though less than a pure one, and stands by a weary immortal friend.

feats.scene: Nelsan hurls a would-be attacker across a farmhouse kitchen.
Nelsan walks away from a collapsing barn with only quickly-closing cuts.
Nelsan sprints across a field in a streak.

name: Arval
summary: Arval is a green-eyed time-displaced manipulator who bends ambient warmth, chilling objects or heating them to a blaze, and floats on a cloud of heated vapour. She serves a hired villain team and later a larger league of rogues.

feats.scene: Arval concentrates ambient warmth into a searing blast that melts a pier.
Arval absorbs a fall into a harbour and floats back up.

name: Iaseollu
summary: Iaseollu is a blond young woman in a rural old-world village, betrothed to a man who does not outlive the story. Her brief tale ends with her short life and a descendant who echoes her name.

feats.scene: Iaseollu hurls a pail of water at a drunk intruder.
Iaseollu shrugs off a hard tumble down a muddy hill.

name: Nental
summary: Nental is a brown-haired brawler who wins fights with her fists and eye beams, and quips about shopping cash while doing it. Strong and tough enough to face a glowing warrior, she throws explosive bursts from her own body.

feats.scene: Nental sends a burst from her eyes that gouges a crater in a shopping avenue.
Nental stands unhurt through a volley of searing blasts.

name: Rnicorrn
summary: Rnicorrn is a black-eyed alien noble who possesses hosts and stands beside her consort in a campaign against a team of reformers. She fights in borrowed bodies, then flees when the odds sour.

feats.scene: Rnicorrn commandeers a host's body and tears through a police station wall.
Rnicorrn is ejected from a host and shakes off the backlash.

name: Tiasalen
summary: Tiasalen is a black-eyed assassin who opens his own veins to work blood sorcery. He steers enemy limbs like puppets, opens doorways across great distance and senses distant enchantments.

feats.scene: Tiasalen forces an opponent's arm to snap their own weapon in two.
Tiasalen slips through a portal just before a heavy strike lands.

name: Orrniti
summary: Orrniti is a black-eyed criminal with the bounding agility of an insect, hopping across rooftops of a mammoth city. He is repeatedly jailed by a stretchy hero and put away along with other crooks.

feats.scene: Orrniti launches himself feet-first into a security guard.
Orrniti lands a leap from a billboard and springs up again.

name: Nasilsu
summary: Nasilsu is a bald, black-eyed stand-in for a legendary mountain leader who commands a secretive order devoted to letting corrupt cities fall. He fights a young billionaire in a burning temple and is felled by timber.

feats.scene: Nasilsu parries a sword strike and lands a flurry of blows.
Nasilsu is buried under a collapsing beam during a duel.

source_title: Decoy Ra's al Ghul (Dark Knight Trilogy)

name: Ceoeor
summary: Ceoeor is a cosmic shadow cast at the first moment of creation, devoted to unmaking everything that exists. Worshipped by a secretive cult and impossible to defeat, it was merely slowed to a crawl by a clever trick.

feats.scene: Ceoeor erases a stretch of reality, leaving no trace of what stood there.
Ceoeor advances unharmed through every weapon thrown by its pursuers.

name: Ntstiria
summary: Ntstiria is a retired continental champion who bends soil and stone to his will, and later takes a quiet government desk job. His old crusade comes back to claim him in a grisly end.

feats.scene: Ntstiria heaves a ridge of bedrock upward to block an advancing militia convoy.
Ntstiria stands in a collapsing quarry and walks out of the dust.

name: Nastton
summary: Nastton is a blond, cartoon-styled child, one of a pair of twins who officiates a go-kart contest at a miniature city's racetrack. She is cute, small and harmless.

feats.scene: Nastton waves a chequered flag to start a go-kart race.
Nastton tumbles onto a grassy verge and giggles.

name: Sartor
summary: Sartor is a golden-haired, white-eyed goddess of growth and soil who sits among lords of cosmic balance. She shifts shape, turns foes to stone and steps across dimensions, and her name is shouted as a curse by mortals.

feats.scene: Sartor turns an invading company to stone with a wave of her hand.
Sartor remains unmoved while a mountain collapses upon her sanctum.

name: Nanstiso
summary: Nanstiso is a red-haired federal investigator with blue eyes, a methodical detective who follows leads across the country. She is entirely mundane and relies on training and a sidearm.

feats.scene: Nanstiso fires a pistol shot that clips a fleeing suspect's tyre.
Nanstiso takes a bruising fall in a chase and keeps running.

name: Stinusan
summary: Stinusan is an orange-skinned apprentice who earned a will-powered ring and helped a princess topple her tyrant father. He married the princess and was knighted for his service.

feats.scene: Stinusan sculpts a glowing battering ram that smashes the palace gates.
Stinusan holds a shining shield against a barrage from the royal guard.

name: Minumrus
summary: Minumrus is a bald crook in a propeller beanie who runs a gang with his cousins, stealing jewels while his relative lifts furs. He is repeatedly collared by a caped pair and tries again with a bank job.

feats.scene: Minumrus smashes a jewellery case with a swing of his club.
Minumrus takes a heavy punch from a masked hero and stays upright.

name: Corneo
summary: Corneo is a bald club owner who took a criminal alias from a children's rhyme with his cousin, and was left with a ruined face after a brutal kick from a caped enforcer. He later helps a hat-obsessed schemer lure victims to a stage.

feats.scene: Corneo swings a bar stool at a rowdy patron.
Corneo endures a kick to the face that needs hours of surgery.

name: Toriureo
summary: Toriureo is a hired lackey who can hop from one place to another in a blink, serving a white-furred mob boss. He is a minor annoyance for a hammer-wielding hero.

feats.scene: Toriureo vanishes and reappears behind a guard to snatch a briefcase.
Toriureo takes a clubbing and teleports clear.

name: Rnivarlu
summary: Rnivarlu is an orange-eyed engineered living weapon, specialised in flattening terrain, who clashes with a young heroine in a crowded city. Her strength matches that of her foe, but poison from a teammate's tentacles forces her to retreat.

feats.scene: Rnivarlu pounds the ground and levels a swath of the metropolis.
Rnivarlu weathers a flurry of heavy blows without a bruise.

name: Caiueo
summary: Caiueo is a scatterbrained, ever-changing younger sibling in an eternal family, whose speech wanders and whose appearance shifts with her mood. She is cherished and protected by her elder relatives.

feats.scene: Caiueo giggles and the laws of a district tangle into nonsense.
Caiueo wanders unharmed through a collapsing realm.

name: Onevalli
summary: Onevalli is a bald, grey-haired national leader in a far-future setting who is literally under siege, fighting from his office with a sidearm. He is a satire of a political figure of the era that created him.

feats.scene: Onevalli fires a pistol at attackers from behind his desk.
Onevalli ducks under a desk as a window explodes.

name: Mistisi
summary: Mistisi is a red-haired, black-eyed woman who grips her victims and forces them to relive their worst regrets until they break. A strong-willed foe can shake her hold, and the resulting backlash knocks her unconscious.

feats.scene: Mistisi seizes a guard's wrist and floods his mind with terrors.
Mistisi collapses from a mental backlash and wakes unharmed.

name: Iaesieo
summary: Iaesieo is a blue-eyed warrior woman who left her island home and shows quiet bravery in a long voyage. She carries the generic strength and discipline of her sisterhood.

feats.scene: Iaesieo cleaves a boulder with a spear thrust.
Iaesieo withstands a crushing fall from a sea cliff.

name: Amoleeru
summary: Amoleeru is a dark-haired schemer whose trade is false faces and costumes, working for an evil council against a young band of do-gooders. He relies on cunning rather than force.

feats.scene: Amoleeru springs a trap disguised as a delivery crate.
Amoleeru is knocked flat and slips away in a new costume.

name: Nenirnlan
summary: Nenirnlan is a red-eyed shapeshifting fiend summoned from a mystical realm by a gangster, who then kills him and takes over his organisation. She feeds on the anguish of others and fights her sister in a decisive duel.

feats.scene: Nenirnlan rips through a reinforced warehouse wall with her talons.
Nenirnlan shrugs off a hail of gunfire from an entire crew.
Nenirnlan streaks over a rooftop skyline.

name: Numor
summary: Numor is a hidden clan chief who commands a band of killers and has a son to carry on his work. He travels constantly and dies in a pitched fight with a young vigilante.

feats.scene: Numor drives a blade into a rival's armour during a skirmish.
Numor stays upright after a hard blow in the clan's camp.

name: Ronvautiu
summary: Ronvautiu is a former physician who lost his licence after a spree against criminals and now sells his skills as a bodyguard and assassin in a special suit. He is acrobatic, a skilled thrower and a trained martial artist, nursing a deep grudge.

feats.scene: Ronvautiu launches a flurry of throwing blades at a rival's guard.
Ronvautiu takes a heavy armoured blow and rolls clear.

name: Eornian
summary: Eornian is a blustering corner enforcer who swings a length of chain and talks bigger than he fights. Eornian keeps a crew loyal because he never walks away from a dare, however foolish.

feats.scene: Eornian whips his chain across a parked van and snaps the wing mirror clean off.
Eornian takes a thrown bottle on the skull and keeps laughing.

name: Celros
summary: Celros is a soft-spoken, bald interrogator who works with a roll of polished dental picks and a patient smile. Celros is married, devoted to a quiet family life, and treats each confession as a tidy appointment.

feats.scene: Celros drives a steel pick through a heavy oak chair arm to pin a prisoner in place.
Celros shrugs off a cudgel blow across the ribs and finishes his sentence.

name: Tianan
summary: Tianan is a former star athlete who became the channel for a field of stillness that bends time. Tianan clung to a lost season so hard that a whole town looped back to an old year, and dinosaurs and legionaries wandered its streets until the loop was undone.

feats.scene: Tianan drags an entire town and its surroundings back twenty years and holds the loop in place for days.
Tianan stands inside the time bubble as it expands, unmarked by the stresses that tear nearby walls.

name: Testti
summary: Testti is a mid-ranking bureaucrat in a police state, in charge of a secretive investigations branch. Testti has no special gifts, only a loaded sense of duty, and rushes out to head off a killer with a pistol that turns out to be empty.

feats.scene: Testti swings an empty pistol at an intruder's jaw in a panicked last stand.
Testti stumbles against a stone doorframe at full run and stays on his feet.

name: Teelacor
summary: Teelacor is a harried clerk who sorts the dead into the next stage of their journey. Teelacor drowns in paperwork, wears a strange blotchy rash, and is permanently deathless, which makes every misfiled soul a recurring headache.

feats.scene: Teelacor stamps a decree that sends a roaring soul down a corridor of collapsing archways.
Teelacor endures the full backlash of a failed reincarnation ritual without losing his place in the queue.

name: Iumreco
summary: Iumreco is a hired killer whose body was dissolved and rebuilt by a storm of chemical waste. Iumreco now eats through anything he touches and lives in constant agony, which he describes to every victim in loving detail.

feats.scene: Iumreco grips a steel vault door and burns a man-sized hole through it in under a minute.
Iumreco walks out of a blast that wrecks the processing tank around him.

name: Receste
summary: Receste is a disgraced industrialist whose lab accident left him glowing with deadly radiation. Receste hunts a young masked rival through the city and once used a haunted clockwork heart to slip backwards through time.

feats.scene: Receste bleeds a pulse of radiation that cooks a whole warehouse floor and everything on it.
Receste sits in the heart of a collapsing reactor core and strolls out unhurt.

name: Sesntrn
summary: Sesntrn is a huge, one-eyed hybrid of a worn-out social outcast and a police robot that gained a conscience. Sesntrn fights for the poor in a divided future, and its steel arms hit with far more than any human could manage.

feats.scene: Sesntrn punches a loading crane's support leg until the whole frame buckles.
Sesntrn stands in the path of a runaway freight carrier and stops it with his chest.

name: Tetaci
summary: Tetaci is a cheerful teacher who runs a student club for building small machines. Tetaci grew up tinkering beside a close friend, lost touch with him for years, and still believes every old bond can be mended.

feats.scene: Tetaci hurls a heavy toolbox across the workshop and clears a jammed door.
Tetaci falls from a stepladder onto a concrete floor and gets back up grinning.

name: Tiamcil
summary: Tiamcil is an ageless sorceress who lost her youth to a shadow creature and retreated into scheming. Tiamcil shaped a living champion out of clay and spellwork, hoping to put her on a throne, and once ran faster than any of her sisters.

feats.scene: Tiamcil pours borrowed witchcraft into a clay form and wakes a warrior in a single storm of green light.
Tiamcil is thrown against a marble pillar and rises slowly, leaning on a cane.

name: Sercol
summary: Sercol is a restless mercenary who moves so fast she smears into a blur. Sercol can spin that speed into a small whirlwind and has jumped between more than one crew without ever quite settling.

feats.scene: Sercol spins in place and flings a rooftop's gravel and glass across the next street.
Sercol crosses a courtyard in a single heartbeat, leaving her pursuers grabbing air.

name: Arnin
summary: Arnin is a pale, cunning god-scientist who builds cruel devices for a distant tyrant. Arnin cannot die, tears through armour when he must, and draws up new experiments the way other people hum.

feats.scene: Arnin switches on a fuel-fed engine that levels a fortified quarter of a city.
Arnin walks out of the wreck of his own laboratory with only soot on his sleeves.

name: Leslleso
summary: Leslleso is a fawning torturer-god who serves a dying master. Leslleso opens a doorway through space to fling a victim home, a desperate act that only speeds the collapse of everything around him.

feats.scene: Leslleso tears a rift open across a firestorm and hurls a prisoner through it.
Leslleso stands at the edge of a furnace as it erupts and comes away singed.

name: Vineo
summary: Vineo is a small, blocky villain made of plastic bricks, sulking in a toy-box conflict. Vineo plots absurdly, assembles clumsy traps, and is rebuilt as good as new after every defeat.

feats.scene: Vineo clicks together a catapult of bricks and launches a stack of crates across the room.
Vineo is stomped flat by a giant boot and snaps back together piece by piece.

name: Suanu
summary: Suanu is a deathless god of pain who grows stronger from the suffering around him. Suanu bends minds, wears whatever face suits him, and once tried to harvest the blood of a captive in order to breed stronger soldiers.

feats.scene: Suanu rips a bridge from its piers and hurls it into a squad of invaders.
Suanu is struck by a collapsing tower and sits up amused.

name: Seerirn
summary: Seerirn is a thin, blue-eyed aide who carries out the tasks his master considers beneath him. Seerirn works in a smouldering hellscape and spends more time arranging cruel chores than doing them himself.

feats.scene: Seerirn hurls a bolt of foul fire that collapses a fortified gateway.
Seerirn is knocked through a wall of slag and straightens his collar.

name: Llontite
summary: Llontite is a sun-baked bandit chief who preys on caravans from a crumbling stone fort. Llontite rides propeller sleds across the dunes and carries a device that chokes the engines of passing aircraft.

feats.scene: Llontite fires his engine-killing device and brings a fighter plane down in a dune.
Llontite is flung from a sled at speed and rolls to his feet in the sand.

name: Olucol
summary: Olucol is a masked planner who locked himself in a room for a year to out-think a famous detective. Olucol designs crimes in layers of cunning, and every failure only makes his next scheme more elaborate.

feats.scene: Olucol drops a trapdoor-laden vault floor through three storeys onto a pursuing guard.
Olucol takes a beating in an alley and calmly mutters the next step of his plan.

name: Tesvar
summary: Tesvar is the shifting, glittering embodiment of longing, who lives inside a vast living statue made of flesh. Tesvar changes shape and temper at will, toys with mortals, and has sparred with a sibling over whose realm matters more.

feats.scene: Tesvar bends the wanting of countless worlds at once and tips an entire empire into ruin.
Tesvar sits unmoved while a rival realm's dreams crash against the walls of the statue.

name: Valan
summary: Valan is a golden-eyed manipulator who treats every living wish as a toy. Valan drifts across the borders between worlds, wears whatever face convinces, and schemes to prove that dreams are just echoes of hunger.

feats.scene: Valan unmakes a kingdom's fortunes in one night and leaves its crowned heads begging for scraps.
Valan stands as an angry sibling hurls a storm of nightmares and does not blink.

name: Sortaor
summary: Sortaor is a red-haired nightclub owner who stole a priceless statue to honour her grandmother's faded fame. Sortaor shot her partner during a screening and was caught soon after.

feats.scene: Sortaor fires a pistol at close range in a darkened cinema.
Sortaor tumbles down a short flight of velvet stairs and keeps running.

name: Tercoser
summary: Tercoser is a patient fighting teacher who took in an orphaned girl and passed on everything he knew. Tercoser kept training until illness finally stopped him.

feats.scene: Tercoser snaps a strike through a stack of roof tiles in a quiet dojo.
Tercoser takes a sparring student's full kick to the ribs and merely nods.

name: Nucotiu
summary: Nucotiu is a vain former athlete who hid behind a grotesque mask after an injury ruined his looks. Nucotiu kidnapped handsome strangers, twisted them into attractions, and tried to disfigure a former sweetheart.

feats.scene: Nucotiu strikes a chain through a carnival turnstile and drags a bound hostage along.
Nucotiu tackles a guard head-on and shrugs off the answering blows.

name: Nortalmi
summary: Nortalmi is a tough alien warrior with pink tendrils for hair and a fearsome lasso. Nortalmi shares a deadly bloodline, shrugs off wounds, and met her end at the hands of a wave of visitors.

feats.scene: Nortalmi swings her lasso and slams a tower block's top floors into the street.
Nortalmi catches a falling girder with her shoulder and keeps advancing.

name: Vaurian
summary: Vaurian is a towering, blue-skinned gunslinger who embodies a vanished way of life. Vaurian rides a pale horse through modern traffic and was finally ended by a lorry on a highway.

feats.scene: Vaurian fires a revolver and shatters a bottle on a distant fence post.
Vaurian is struck by a speeding lorry and drifts away like dust in the wind.

name: Silcor
summary: Silcor is a red-haired tyrant from a doomed possible future who was banished from his home world and travelled back in time. Silcor draws on a distant eternal flame, threatens a runner with a countdown, and presses hard for a world to be saved.

feats.scene: Silcor hurls a burst of flame-borne force that levels a mountainside.
Silcor is hammered by a team of allies and keeps pressing forward.

name: Lororeveo
summary: Lororeveo is a scarlet-skinned, black-eyed criminal who reads minds and lashes out with bursts of force. Lororeveo schemed to seize three charmed relics, but walked into the very trap he set for his hosts.

feats.scene: Lororeveo hurls a surge of psychic force that shears the top off a satellite dish array.
Lororeveo is pinned by a security field and strains against it for hours.

name: Lloretir
summary: Lloretir is a yellow-eyed warlord seized by rival space police and flung down to a planet for show. Lloretir was meant to look like a menace to be rescued from, but a ring-wielding captor broke his neck.

feats.scene: Lloretir smashes through a fleet's hull plates and tumbles onto a stretch of desert.
Lloretir crashes through the atmosphere in chains and lands alive.

name: Llatis
summary: Llatis is an eight-foot alien despot whose ancestors were mutated by a poisoned planet. Llatis once ruled through mind control and games of strategy, then became a furious bruiser consumed by hatred.

feats.scene: Llatis flattens a ridge of mountains with a single driving blow.
Llatis takes a volley of heavy cannon fire and strides through the smoke.

name: Storisi
summary: Storisi is a hulking alien conqueror with a taste for planet-plundering and a telepathic punch. Storisi attacked an orbital station with a ring of poison rock and was sent into a coma by a stronger mind.

feats.scene: Storisi tears through a space station's outer shell and floods its halls with psychic noise.
Storisi weathers a full-strength mind blast for several seconds before collapsing.

name: Liuserora
summary: Liuserora is a hulking alien brute who joined a mob of villains chasing two famous heroes. Liuserora brings raw weight and little subtlety, and mostly gets in the way of the other hunters.

feats.scene: Liuserora tears the roof off a speeding train and hurls it into a hillside.
Liuserora is slammed into a bridge pier and rises, dusty and sour.

name: Nalaun
summary: Nalaun is a senior warrior of an island sisterhood with a long record of command. Nalaun trains younger fighters at dawn, holds the line at the harbour wall, and trusts her spear above all else.

feats.scene: Nalaun hurls a spear clean through a heavy oak shield.
Nalaun is thrown down a stone stair by a charging boar and rises unbroken.

name: Amotirso
summary: Amotirso is an ancient sorcerer who feeds on terror and cloaks himself in a shield that drives touchers mad. Amotirso flies, burns, and hops into a fresh body whenever his own is destroyed.

feats.scene: Amotirso hurls a ball of flame that burns a chapel to its footings.
Amotirso stands in the middle of a detonating tower and his shield holds.

name: Nerni
summary: Nerni is the blind, calm keeper of every event that has been or will be, who walks a maze of branching paths forever. Nerni casts no shadow, leaves no footprints, and carries a heavy chained book at his wrist.

feats.scene: Nerni turns a page and a whole sequence of possible histories folds out of existence.
Nerni walks on through a collapsing lattice of timelines without breaking his stride.

name: Telil
summary: Telil is a shabby, wandering tramp who is yanked by sudden trances to places where killings are about to happen. Telil breaks up thugs with a few judo throws and vanishes before anyone can thank him.

feats.scene: Telil throws a gunman over his hip into a stack of barrels.
Telil takes a cosh across the shoulder and answers with a calm word.

name: Anvaan
summary: Anvaan is a red-eyed, hairless bruiser who appears in the shadow of a young hero team's quarrels. Anvaan says little, hits hard, and is seen mostly at the edge of a brawl.

feats.scene: Anvaan slams a fist into a car door and crumples it inward.
Anvaan is hit by a thrown dumpster and merely rolls his shoulders.

name: Iucorca
summary: Iucorca is a minor illusionist who joined a gang of villains to take on a famous hero. Iucorca could make convincing shapes, but never enough force behind them, and left with her allies for the stars.

feats.scene: Iucorca conjures a roaring beast of light that shoves a guard backwards into a door.
Iucorca is thrown across a rooftop and rolls to her feet, wheezing.

name: Tanlluma
summary: Tanlluma is a blond card-themed thug who fights under a suit marking in a gang of masked robbers. Tanlluma lost an eye along the way and died in a showdown that spread across the whole villain network.

feats.scene: Tanlluma hurls a steel-edged playing card through a plasterboard wall.
Tanlluma takes a rifle butt to the face and keeps coming.

name: Iacormil
summary: Iacormil is a brown-eyed footsoldier from a fallen warrior caste who was locked away for a coup attempt. Iacormil served a hard commander, fought alongside him on a conquered world, and was sent back into the prison zone.

feats.scene: Iacormil smashes through a wall of reinforced concrete in a single charge.
Iacormil stands unharmed under a tumbling slab of masonry.

name: Anlia
summary: Anlia is a white-haired scientist and council member in a city shrunk to a bottle's size. Anlia uses a wheelchair, keeps a hidden cave stocked with costumes and vehicles, and helped a friend win back a stolen daughter.

feats.scene: Anlia heaves a heavy lever to open the hidden cave's rock door.
Anlia is jolted in his chair by a falling beam and carries on.

name: Ontseoci
summary: Ontseoci is a small red-haired weapon moulded from clay and blessed with dark gifts by a tyrant's children. Ontseoci was made to mirror a famous champion and match her in battle, though she is only a few feet tall.

feats.scene: Ontseoci smashes a temple colonnade into rubble with a single backhand.
Ontseoci is slammed into a cliff face and leaves a crater when she gets up.

name: Senumnum
summary: Senumnum is a bruised border-town crook who tattooed a famous nickname on his back. Senumnum scrapped with a rival over the title, got arrested, then teamed up with him in a small gang.

feats.scene: Senumnum swings a crowbar into a rival's shoulder in a parking lot.
Senumnum takes a stool to the back and keeps swinging.

name: Elmiati
summary: Elmiati is a friendly amphibious sea creature of high intelligence and blue eyes. Elmiati keeps to the open water, surfaces to help swimmers in trouble, and is shy of anyone who stares.

feats.scene: Elmiati drives a bow wave that flips a small fishing boat upright.
Elmiati is dragged across a reef by a rolling current and swims off unhurt.

name: Estnanla
summary: Estnanla is a red-skinned, stone-fisted hero from a parallel reality who fought in a doomed last stand. Estnanla looks to be a loving homage to a famous occult investigator and lands blows like a falling anvil.

feats.scene: Estnanla smashes his stone fist into a monster's chest and shatters its ribcage.
Estnanla is hurled through a brick wall and wipes the dust off his shoulders.

name: Tirnoron
summary: Tirnoron is a brown-haired commander of an armoured security squad. Tirnoron bickers with a band of rival mercenaries, and is guilty of at least one killing.

feats.scene: Tirnoron drives a heavy gauntlet into a rival's breastplate.
Tirnoron takes a full burst of rifle fire against his armour and holds position.

name: Norvaam
summary: Norvaam is a young team member who eats metal and grows it into a reshaping exoskeleton. Norvaam shapes eaten scrap into fast machine limbs, shoots bolts of current, heals, and jumps between places.

feats.scene: Norvaam swallows a car engine and punches a hole through a concrete pillar.
Norvaam takes a heavy cannon round into his plated chest and regrows the dent.

name: Amanu
summary: Amanu is a blue-furred housecat with yellow eyes and a ring that burns with fury. Amanu flies on streams of red light, fires bursts of energy, and teleports to his target when he hunts.

feats.scene: Amanu roars out a red burst that melts a bridge's steel to slag.
Amanu is hit by a heavy cannon and shakes it off with a flick of his tail.

name: Leonustel
summary: Leonustel is a small housecat who watched his owner die and was swept up by a wrathful ring. Leonustel flies home, mourns by her side, and speaks in short, chilling sentences of vengeance.

feats.scene: Leonustel hurls a burst of crimson fire that collapses a riverside warehouse.
Leonustel is knocked across a rooftop by a thug's swing and bounds back up.

name: Seani
summary: Seani is a veteran street fighter who turned a trained singing voice into a weapon, shattering windows and masonry with one held note. Seani stays inside a collapsing building ushering strangers out until the ceiling finally gives way.

feats.scene: Seani sends one held note through a brick wall and leaves it as loose rubble.
Seani shrugs off a beam dropping from a burning ceiling before the next one ends the fight.

source_title: Dinah Drake Lance (The Brave and the Bold)

name: Lltiltu
summary: Lltiltu is a fugitive brawler who can turn her body ghostly and let blows or walls pass straight through. Lltiltu fights with sharp hand-to-hand training and keeps one step ahead of the law.

feats.scene: Lltiltu slips through a vault door and drives a knee into the guard waiting behind it.
Lltiltu goes intangible as a speeding van passes through her without a scratch.

name: Tilnus
summary: Tilnus is a widowed florist who gained a voice able to break brick and steel. Tilnus fights beside an archer ally against street crime and star-faring invaders alike, and knows every neighbour on the block.

feats.scene: Tilnus screams at a reinforced steel door until it buckles off its hinges.
Tilnus takes a thrown crate to the ribs and keeps singing.

name: Luvaco
summary: Luvaco is a masked vigilante with a piercing scream who fought for the heroes until humanity turned on them. Luvaco dies in a crowded hall, outnumbered by an angry mob rather than any single foe.

feats.scene: Luvaco screams and every pane in the lobby blows outward at once.
Luvaco stays standing under a dozen clubs before the crowd drags her down.

name: Iaterci
summary: Iaterci grew up among costumed veterans who raised her as family and drilled her until she could outfight most of them. Iaterci pairs a cracking sonic shout with detective work and a dry sense of humour.

feats.scene: Iaterci cracks a concrete pillar with a shout and ducks behind it.
Iaterci takes a sparring blow from her heaviest mentor and grins through it.

source_title: Dinah Laurel Lance (The Brave and the Bold)

name: Tirerria
summary: Tirerria is a deer who hurts herself on the sea cliffs of a hidden island once a century and always comes back whole. Tirerria is graceful, wary of strangers, and healed by a warm violet light each time.

feats.scene: Tirerria bounds off a cliff ledge and clips a fence rail into splinters.
Tirerria survives a long fall onto sea rocks and rises by dawn.

name: Anuna
summary: Anuna is a hot-rod mechanic who built a gang of dropouts around custom machines and a fast dragster. Anuna prefers oil and engines to patience, and the gang comes apart when teenagers play along then turn on him.

feats.scene: Anuna rams the dragster through a garage door at full throttle.
Anuna rolls clear of a wrecked chassis with only a split lip.

name: Taunesrno
summary: Taunesrno is a hired killer fused with machinery who steers a muscle car by thought and melds with it into a walking war machine. Taunesrno can turn hands into guns and fire bending bolts from the headlamps, but loses everything when the mech is wrecked.

feats.scene: Taunesrno bends a headlamp bolt around a corner and brings down a brick wall.
Taunesrno weathers a crushing blow inside the armoured shell until the shell finally folds.

name: Listicol
summary: Listicol is a warrior-engineer who thinks hard about machines and harder about men. Listicol is stronger than her sisters, lives for centuries, and takes apart captured automata to learn who is pulling the strings.

feats.scene: Listicol hurls a captured automaton across a workshop and pins it to the wall.
Listicol absorbs a trained spear thrust to the shoulder without stepping back.

name: Numirnsti
summary: Numirnsti is a lazy, theatrical god of grapes and stagecraft who prefers a good play to a good war. Numirnsti can fly, walk between worlds, and will never die, and uses charm and trickery before force.

feats.scene: Numirnsti tears open a vineyard hillside with one divine stamp and floods it with wine.
Numirnsti stands unmoved while a rival's thunderbolt splits the stage around him.

name: Eororeal
summary: Eororeal is a rich heir who spends an inherited fortune filming traps for masked heroes. Eororeal has no powers, only a crew, a rebuilt cinema, and a belief that cruelty looks better on camera.

feats.scene: Eororeal triggers a rigged ceiling in the cinema aisle with a single switch.
Eororeal tumbles down the balcony stairs and stands up shouting for another take.

name: Visonrn
summary: Visonrn is a chain-vaping agency chief whose skull-pale face and missing nose make him look like a walking warning. Visonrn runs a hunting operation against a fast runner and bargains with anyone who offers help.

feats.scene: Visonrn orders a van door slammed into a suspect and watches it fold.
Visonrn stays calm while a pistol round clips his coat.

name: Vaval
summary: Vaval is a stubborn newspaper columnist and widowed father who writes loud opinions and honestly believes each one. Vaval has no powers, but will put himself between a killer and a friend without hesitation.

feats.scene: Vaval swings a briefcase at a madman and knocks him off balance.
Vaval takes a hard shove into a desk and keeps arguing.

name: Corviar
summary: Corviar is a conman who faked his own death and disappeared into tunnels beneath the earth. Corviar returned with a gadget that scrambles minds across a whole city and a plan to rule through confusion.

feats.scene: Corviar switches on his scrambler and a whole avenue of drivers lose their heads at once.
Corviar takes a punch from a masked heroine and stays conscious long enough to run.

name: Naraurau
summary: Naraurau is a bald, violet-skinned soldier in a ruthless future army, powered by a sun-like fire that he does not care to control. Naraurau flies into battle in formation and crushes outnumbered rivals.

feats.scene: Naraurau drops a column of solar fire onto a fortress and melts its outer wall.
Naraurau rides out a rival squad's volley without slowing his dive.

name: Cinna
summary: Cinna is a cheerful young hero from a far-future club of gifted teens, always eager to join a mission. Cinna helps round up space thieves alongside a surprise guest from the past.

feats.scene: Cinna pins two smugglers to a cargo bay wall with a bright burst.
Cinna walks off a stun bolt and keeps chasing the getaway ship.

name: Saceo
summary: Saceo is a proud politician of a xenophobic planet who treats every outsider as pollution. Saceo breaks his son's telescope lenses and orders a stranded visitor killed, and the harm done to his family outlasts him.

feats.scene: Saceo smashes a telescope against the cave floor in a cold rage.
Saceo shrugs off a tumble down a stone staircase and keeps lecturing.

name: Rustau
summary: Rustau is a masked schemer who stirs up floods, quakes and fires, then loots whatever the panic leaves unguarded. Rustau is blond, secretive, and always has one more catastrophe waiting.

feats.scene: Rustau cracks a hillside dam and drowns a harbour district under brown water.
Rustau rides out a toppling crane with a bruised shoulder.

name: Reoau
summary: Reoau is a winged horse who carried one rider and then another into battle. Reoau tucks her wings away on the ground, vanishes and reappears in a flash, and runs faster than any normal steed.

feats.scene: Reoau lands hooves-first on a barricade and flattens it.
Reoau streaks across a canyon faster than the echo of her own whinny.

name: Cesarnu
summary: Cesarnu is a swallowed goddess released from a titan's gut and put to work in a new dark pantheon. Cesarnu hands out cruel gifts, bending feelings and bestowing heartbreak, and keeps her contempt for mortals.

feats.scene: Cesarnu lays a curse on a clay effigy and a whole harbour town turns on itself.
Cesarnu endures the bellies of titans and walks out unharmed.

name: Sirnlan
summary: Sirnlan is a shadowy criminal from a far-future age, known only by a buzzing code name that hints at rattling, shaking attacks. Sirnlan leaves little behind except hair-trigger rumours and shaken locks.

feats.scene: Sirnlan shakes a vault until its bolts rattle loose and drop to the floor.
Sirnlan blurs out of a security sweep before the alarm finishes ringing.

name: Neoenust
summary: Neoenust is a grey-haired gentleman of impeccable manners, quietly working for himself in the shadows. Neoenust has no known powers, only polish, an umbrella, and a reputation that nobody can quite confirm.

feats.scene: Neoenust raps an umbrella across a pickpocket's wrist.
Neoenust straightens his tie after being shouldered into a lamppost.

name: Talen
summary: Talen is a lab-grown copy of a super-strong alien heroine, built as a weapon for a scheming financier. Talen tries to claim the original's life as her own and fights with borrowed power and bitter pride.

feats.scene: Talen lifts a frozen ridge and slams it down on a mining camp.
Talen takes a falling research tower on her back and shoves it aside.

name: Niianau
summary: Niianau is a silent bald enforcer whose body leaks glowing smoke from his mouth. Niianau guards a desert drug operation and can spit a radioactive shove that flattens a person.

feats.scene: Niianau spits an irradiated blast that hurls a pickup truck across the sand.
Niianau shrugs off a point-blank shotgun burst and keeps guarding the gate.

name: Riall
summary: Riall is a vast blue spirit that spent ages sealed in a bottle and now answers wishes with literal, deadly results. Riall flies, takes any shape, and gets uneasy only when a command seems too harsh.

feats.scene: Riall swoops over a palace and lays its roof in the courtyard.
Riall shrugs off a witch's fire spell like heat from a lantern.

name: Serconi
summary: Serconi is a wish-granting spirit born four millennia ago, rare among her kind, bound to a ring and passed between masters. Serconi dislikes the harm her wishes do and longs for freedom from her eldest sibling.

feats.scene: Serconi grants a wish and a whole warehouse of stone rises into a sculpted tower.
Serconi endures an ancient curse for centuries without ageing a day.

name: Lonutau
summary: Lonutau is a big red gorilla who lives in the jungle and stays loyal to a human friend. Lonutau is strong, careful, and carries a hidden sadness.

feats.scene: Lonutau snaps a thick branch and swings it into a charging poacher.
Lonutau takes a hunter's slug on the shoulder and keeps walking.

name: Corvalse
summary: Corvalse is a living mathematical equation given a ring of will, able to enter minds and rub them out. Corvalse draws power from a battery of light, and its work remains a quarrelsome subject among its allies.

feats.scene: Corvalse fires a bolt from its ring that cracks open a rocky moonlet.
Corvalse raises a glowing shield against a falling asteroid and holds it.

name: Nenmari
summary: Nenmari is a bald conqueror from a peaceful distant age who bent magnetic technology toward domination. Nenmari wrecks a time machine and tries to rule the past, and only the earth beneath his feet keeps him strong.

feats.scene: Nenmari drags a freight train off its track with a pulse of magnetism.
Nenmari shrugs off an unsteady scientist's wrench but falters once he is lifted off the ground.

name: Vaiutel
summary: Vaiutel is a robot soldier ordered to wipe out a hidden world, who later chose to bury and protect the survivors. Vaiutel adopts a lone orphan as family and gives up everything to end the machine that created him.

feats.scene: Vaiutel overloads a planetary engine and the world splits apart in white fire.
Vaiutel carries a collapsed tunnel's weight on steel shoulders while the orphan crawls clear.

name: Rosta
summary: Rosta is a white-haired physician from the north who treats teenagers with unusual injuries. Rosta has no powers, only steady hands and years of practice.

feats.scene: Rosta pins a struggling patient to the table and stitches the wound shut.
Rosta stays at the bedside through a night of shouting and a broken lamp.

name: Eovaltiu
summary: Eovaltiu is a masked small-time crook who runs a modest gang and now lives quietly in a desert resort town. Eovaltiu sold out a disguised hero once, and still has enough hired muscle to make trouble.

feats.scene: Eovaltiu orders his crew to kick in a casino back door.
Eovaltiu takes a bruising punch and laughs it off in front of his men.

name: Raseron
summary: Raseron is a bald scientist who does odd experiments in a basement lab, a mad inventor in a long line of them. Raseron cares for the work more than for any person.

feats.scene: Raseron wires a coil to a steel table and sends a crackling arc into an intruder.
Raseron is thrown across the lab by his own surge and sits up laughing.

name: Amvast
summary: Amvast is a masked scientist-villain who builds strange devices to annoy a flying hero in red. Amvast hides his identity, wears dark hair slicked back, and has a flair for the dramatic.

feats.scene: Amvast fires a lab-built cannon that blasts a hole in a warehouse wall.
Amvast shakes off a thrown crate and vaults a workbench.

name: Serleotau
summary: Serleotau is a red-haired doctor who moonlights as a monstrous-looking helper to outcasts like himself. Serleotau stitches wounds in secret and answers calls from the strange and the shunned.

feats.scene: Serleotau sets a broken arm with a sharp twist and a murmured apology.
Serleotau stumbles out of a mob scuffle with a torn coat and a steady grin.

name: Niuva
summary: Niuva is a clever scientist dog who grew up after a world-wide collapse among talking beasts. Niuva quietly studies ways to help primitive humans rebuild, and keeps the work hidden from the cats who rule.

feats.scene: Niuva mixes two tinctures and sprays a startled guard with a fast-acting sleep mist.
Niuva survives a tumble down a ruined stairwell with only a bruised paw.

name: Tirnaan
summary: Tirnaan is a dog-man with white fur, one of many bred by a secret programme and living on a remote island. Tirnaan is a researcher who suspects the island's culture began with a human society.

feats.scene: Tirnaan hurls a stack of notebooks at a rude colleague.
Tirnaan stays on his feet when a crate falls across his back.

name: Siilete
summary: Siilete is a white-haired army scientist who spent a career building a machine meant to end war by putting armies to sleep. Siilete's invention is stolen by an impostor, and the rays never injure anyone except those who fall.

feats.scene: Siilete powers up the sleeping-ray cabinet and a parade ground of soldiers slump to the mud.
Siilete stays on his feet in the cabinet's cloud of sparks.

name: Llrninu
summary: Llrninu is a bald schemer who calls himself the cleverest man alive and plagues a pair of flying hero partners. Llrninu has no powers and relies on gadgets, patter and a good head start.

feats.scene: Llrninu triggers a trapdoor and drops two guards into the cellar.
Llrninu hits the floor hard after a tackle and scrambles out the window.

name: Onesirsti
summary: Onesirsti is a grey-haired criminal scientist who builds odd vehicles and bullies unwilling pilots into stealing statues. Onesirsti bounces back from capture, swears revenge on an archer hero, and teams up with a mind-wiping crook.

feats.scene: Onesirsti drives the oddball contraption through a museum wall.
Onesirsti bounces off the dash in a crash and gets up sneering.

name: Cerleo
summary: Cerleo is a sinister physician known by a grim title, who prowls the pages of an old wartime flying-aces series. Cerleo is little documented, but menaces pilots with a taste for the macabre.

feats.scene: Cerleo smashes a laboratory window and flees across the rooftops.
Cerleo shakes off a fall from a hangar ladder with a limp.

name: Arllunu
summary: Arllunu is a bald crackpot scientist who goes by a fate-themed alias and picks fights with a pair of flying young heroes. Arllunu loses every round, but his taunts get sharper each time.

feats.scene: Arllunu sets off a flash charge under a lab bench and shatters his own beakers.
Arllunu is flung into a shelf of chemicals and crawls out spluttering.

name: Liiar
summary: Liiar is a former mind-analyst turned boastful evil genius who is sure everyone is beneath him. Liiar disguises himself as an old woman, lures heroes into a sewer lab, and escapes by rocket chair when his machine fails.

feats.scene: Liiar turns on a transfer rig and the sewer ceiling shakes.
Liiar rides his chair out of a collapsing tunnel in a cloud of soot.

name: Allira
summary: Allira is a scaly-faced thief who herds prehistoric beasts into banks and monuments. Allira is stopped by a stretchy hero, and never learns that dinosaurs make poor getaway drivers.

feats.scene: Allira sets a stampeding herd on a vault wall and drops it into the street.
Allira tumbles from a saddle and brushes off the dust.

name: Sianuse
summary: Sianuse is a black-haired villain with a mournful nickname, scarcely documented, who appears in an old patriotic series. Sianuse frightens rather than fights, and leaves the hero guessing at his plans.

feats.scene: Sianuse topples a church bell tower and escapes in the noise.
Sianuse stays upright through a chase and a rooftop fall.

name: Tanis
summary: Tanis is a brown-haired sailor who shares one body with his dead sister's ghost. Tanis can slip into sleep to let her drift out, flying and passing through hulls, though the arrangement leaves him helpless when mutineers strike.

feats.scene: Tanis lets his sister's spirit slide through a cabin wall and unbolt the door from inside.
Tanis is frozen solid at the helm and shattered by a single blow.

name: Rnluna
summary: Rnluna is a bald, hulking enforcer in armoured plating whose implants spit out searing light. Rnluna once befriended a famous archer, was scarred beyond recognition, and now fetches cursed relics for a ruthless spymaster.

feats.scene: Rnluna floods a lobby with white fire and melts the reinforced doors off their frames.
Rnluna keeps fighting with an arrow lodged in his eye and then drags his attacker away.

name: Raolu
summary: Raolu is a blue-haired, yellow-eyed warrior who fires dazzling bolts from his gaze. Raolu was jailed in a trap-filled dungeon on a primitive moon and later teamed up with the other prisoners he had been forced to fight.

feats.scene: Raolu stares down a corridor and the twin bolts bore through a bulkhead.
Raolu shrugs off the shock when the dungeon's power surges.

name: Anrnci
summary: Anrnci is a yellow-eyed reactor-driven war machine built to crush a civil uprising and then abandoned when its handlers lost control. Anrnci scorches forests as it walks, swats elite flyers aside and falls only to a single clever shot at its neck vent.

feats.scene: Anrnci sweeps its chest cannons across a valley and flattens a village.
Anrnci takes combined blasts from four heroes and keeps marching.

name: Tananco
summary: Tananco is a towering furnace-bodied weapon worshipped as a deity by a death cult. Tananco can split into man-sized copies that fuse into a colossus, and each rebirth brings flame and ruin to another metropolis.

feats.scene: Tananco merges its army of copies and boils a downtown district to slag.
Tananco is blown apart by a hero's final strike yet its worshippers plan its return.

name: Ilmeva
summary: Ilmeva is a white-haired, horse-bodied guardian of space who patrols a distant sector and goes home to a loving family. Ilmeva barely survives a first meeting with a swarm of hostile arachnids and passes his duty to one of his children.

feats.scene: Ilmeva shapes a glowing wall of green light that crushes a scout cruiser.
Ilmeva retreats from the hostile fleet, hurt but alive after a barrage.

name: Rninuri
summary: Rninuri is a brown-furred, amber-eyed youth remade into a hunting beast by his cold-hearted father. Rninuri flees into the woods, wrecks the machines sent to retrieve him, and is calmed by a gentle telepath before leaving his home for good.

feats.scene: Rninuri smashes a hunter drone against a tree trunk and cracks the trunk in two.
Rninuri takes a volley of stun bolts and keeps charging through the brush.

source_title: Brin Londo (Legion of Super-Heroes TV Series)

name: Ilnaol
summary: Ilnaol is a green-eyed soldier whose body was reshaped as a boy into that of a wolf-man, giving him claws, speed and brawn. Ilnaol arrives too late to save his dead homeworld and joins a union of planets so no one else suffers the same fate.

feats.scene: Ilnaol rakes his claws across a hull plate and peels it back like paper.
Ilnaol stands in the barren ruins of a dead city, wounded and unbent.
Ilnaol outruns a speeding hover-car along a canyon road.

name: Nelos
summary: Nelos is a seven-and-a-half-foot, white-eyed wolf-like fighter who insists he needs nobody's help. Nelos was swapped for a lookalike by a jealous machine servant, lost for months to a kidnapper, and once travelled back to fight invaders.

feats.scene: Nelos hurls a stone block across a quarry and splits a boulder.
Nelos lies pinned beneath rubble and spurns the offered hand.

name: Oreau
summary: Oreau is a blonde prince of a small kingdom who commands the ground itself while his estranged half-sister wanders abroad. Oreau is raised as a champion of his people and keeps a photograph of her close.

feats.scene: Oreau cracks a hillside open and buries a column of invading tanks.
Oreau stands in a rockslide he called himself and walks out clean.

name: Erusauil
summary: Erusauil is a strawberry-blond secret operative who works with a band of gifted agents for a government bureau. Erusauil is seen only once and prefers to stay out of the spotlight.

feats.scene: Erusauil heaves a slab of pavement upward to block a gunship run.
