Urnstu absorbs a hail of broken glass in a dream and reforms without a mark.

name: Lesceore
summary: Lesceore is a brown-haired citizen of a sunken kingdom, a husband and father living an ordinary life under the waves. He swims strongly and keeps his family close.

feats.scene: Lesceore hauls a heavy fishing net up onto the reef shelf.
Lesceore is knocked tumbling by a rolling current and swims clear.

name: Corresle
summary: Corresle is a red-eyed spirit of darkness sealed in a black gem, who leaps into the body of anyone who touches it. Once loose he reads minds, sows fear, hurls shadow blasts and calls storms, but light and lightning harm him.

feats.scene: Corresle looses a lance of black energy that flattens a row of barns and a water tower.
Corresle weathers a stampede of blasts that would topple a wall.
Corresle blurs across a field in a gale-driven rush.

name: Valcolti
summary: Valcolti is a seven-foot red-haired, white-eyed fiend wreathed in flame, who has enforced the will of the underworld for ages alongside a twin. Rulers come and go, but he keeps his post and his taste for punishment.

feats.scene: Valcolti hurls a fist of fire into a gatehouse and reduces it to burning rubble.
Valcolti stands in a roaring blaze that melts the surrounding stone.

name: Riliont
summary: Riliont is a cheerful steam-train driver on a frontier line, shovelling coal and pulling the whistle cord with pride. With his brakeman partner and a lawman, he foils a gang of bandits eyeing the freight.

feats.scene: Riliont wrenches the throttle full open and sends the engine thundering into a barricade of ties.
Riliont rides out a lurching derailment scare in the cab and keeps his grip.

name: Stuvallu
summary: Stuvallu is a nervous brown-haired clerk at a broadcasting firm who quietly lifts company funds, always paying them back, until an anonymous extortionist catches him. He is more frightened than wicked.

feats.scene: Stuvallu shoves a heavy filing drawer shut with a loud bang.
Stuvallu stumbles on the office stairs and lands hard on his hip.

name: Stllco
summary: Stllco is a slick suit-wearing manager at a chemical conglomerate whose firm cuts corners with lethal results. He sits behind a glass desk and trusts paperwork over conscience.

feats.scene: Stllco slams a thick ledger onto a conference table and silences the room.
Stllco is shoved against a glass partition and slides to the carpet.

name: Titeres
summary: Titeres is a red-haired scoundrel from an advanced alien city who swaps places with a convicted twin and fakes flashy powers with a stolen belt. His bluff works until a scientist spots the trick.

feats.scene: Titeres floats above a plaza and heaves a stone fountain into a transport barge.
Titeres crashes out of a wrecked capsule and staggers away unhurt.
Titeres skims over rooftops on his borrowed lift-belt.

name: Cerer
summary: Cerer is a sour-tempered food reviewer, expelled from a fancy cruise dinner, who is suddenly filled by a strange force that lets him bellow with terrible power. His thunderous shouts hurl people across the deck until a stage magician ends it.

feats.scene: Cerer screams at a row of tables and flings a dozen diners across the ballroom.
Cerer is toppled by a counter-spell and lands face down on the carpet.

name: Lluliore
summary: Lluliore is a red-eyed, hairless ring-bearer serving a galactic peace corps, willing and bold. His glowing band shapes solid light into walls, shields and weapons while a lantern recharges it.

feats.scene: Lluliore weaves a glowing ram of green light and smashes it through a fortress gate.
Lluliore raises a shimmering dome that withstands a barrage of artillery.
Lluliore streaks between planets at a staggering pace.

name: Satalre
summary: Satalre is a black-haired nineteenth-century newspaper man and storyteller, a foster child of a stern merchant, who gets drawn into a strange tale of masked justice. He survives by wit and a good ear for a ghost story.

feats.scene: Satalre swings a heavy ink pot and cracks a ruffian's knuckles.
Satalre tumbles down a cobbled alley bank and gets up with his notebook intact.

name: Cororamo
summary: Cororamo is a tiny, bitter mind doctor whose scorned theories turn into terrifying psychic power. He sinks into dreams, bends wills and paints false visions over whole crowds, then makes heroes fight each other.

feats.scene: Cororamo seizes the minds of an entire school gym and sends them marching on the city hall.
Cororamo takes a hard slap to the cheek and tumbles across the stage.

name: Orlliniu
summary: Orlliniu is a bald mastermind in a cartoon crimewave, fond of gizmos shaped like his own shiny head. He schemes with bombs and trapdoors, but his pride blinds him to his own blunders.

feats.scene: Orlliniu detonates a giant novelty device and cracks the facade of a bank.
Orlliniu slips on his own slick floor and crashes into a cabinet.

source_title: Edgar Heed (The Brave and the Bold)

name: Lliancor
summary: Lliancor is a vain heavyweight prize-fighter who abuses his fame, then escapes justice through clever lawyers. A masked vigilante baits him into swinging in public, which ends his streak.

feats.scene: Lliancor throws a roundhouse hook that caves in a gym locker.
Lliancor absorbs a flurry of body shots from a sparring partner without a grunt.

name: Miasi
summary: Miasi is a black-haired scion of a notorious mastermind, living in a foggy old capital on the family name. He tries to inherit a dynasty of crime, plotting with more nerve than skill.

feats.scene: Miasi swings a walking stick and shatters a street lamp's glass.
Miasi is pushed into a brick wall and shakes it off with a sneer.

name: Anutecor
summary: Anutecor is a rumpled, absent-minded inventor in a boarding house, always scribbling formulas and forgetting lunch. He lends gadgets and clever advice to a family of magic-fuelled champions.

feats.scene: Anutecor switches on a homemade coil and pops every bulb in the parlor.
Anutecor tumbles from a stool in his workshop and dusts off his coat.

name: Entlle
summary: Entlle is a blind, blond ex-soldier turned crime lord who runs a dragon-themed gang across two continents. His fighting skill is so sharp that sightlessness hardly matters, and a prisoner-born son carries his shadow.

feats.scene: Entlle snaps a hardwood staff through a rival's guard by sound alone.
Entlle takes a rifle butt to the ribs and answers with a pinpoint counter.
Entlle dashes across a dockside warehouse floor with sure footing.

name: Ntrniu
summary: Ntrniu is a fair-haired mad scientist in a pulp thriller who plots under an eerie nickname. His schemes last a single issue and end when a masked flier thwarts them.

feats.scene: Ntrniu sets off a coil-powered cannon and blasts a doorway out of a laboratory.
Ntrniu is knocked out cold by a heavy punch at the climax.

name: Olern
summary: Olern is a bald sleuth who studies strange cases, and a member of a secretive circle of seekers. His patient deductions solve riddles that baffle the police.

feats.scene: Olern pushes a stuck window sash open and climbs out onto a ledge.
Olern slips on wet tile in a stakeout and takes the fall.

name: Teran
summary: Teran is a bald, overworked marine researcher who stitches the cells of deadly sea creatures into a dying patient. His experiment works too well, and the monster he made turns on him.

feats.scene: Teran hurls a steel tray at a cabinet and rattles the glass.
Teran is thrown against a bulkhead by his own creation and does not rise.

name: Ialamneo
summary: Ialamneo is a warm black-haired scientist who runs a centre for gifted young people and worries about his own son. He solves problems with careful tests and patient talks.

feats.scene: Ialamneo hauls a heavy equipment case onto a lab bench.
Ialamneo is knocked over by a sudden tremor and rises unhurt.

name: Tiarern
summary: Tiarern is a green-eyed mercenary hardened by a dreadful prison, who guzzles a potent serum to swell his muscles. Once a trusted soldier, he now leads a pack of hired guns and a campaign of terror.

feats.scene: Tiarern drives both fists through a steel shutter and rips the frame free.
Tiarern takes a speeding car's hit on the hip and keeps charging.

name: Vanone
summary: Vanone is a pink-haired hitman with a brain rewired by gangsters, who butchers his own family and then devours his victims' faces. His moods flip without warning, and he fires with deadly flair.

feats.scene: Vanone empties a pair of pistols and punches a line of holes through a thick door.
Vanone shrugs off a hard fall down a flight of marble stairs.

name: Teeorus
summary: Teeorus is a hired killer from a tropical country who bends light, radio and heat to his will. His long career ends when a daughter he abandoned focuses sunlight on him.

feats.scene: Teeorus overloads a power substation with a surge of invisible energy and blacks out a district.
Teeorus tumbles through a window and comes up bruised but unbroken.

name: Ialiaamo
summary: Ialiaamo is a white-eyed, white-haired fighter with a demonic edge, who battles in a war-torn alternate timeline to shield a continent from two warring armies. He is nimble and daring in the resistance.

feats.scene: Ialiaamo blasts a flaming kick into a tank turret and rips it off its ring.
Ialiaamo shrugs off a shell that cracks a barricade beside him.

name: Sorta
summary: Sorta is a wartime tank crewman riding a war machine said to be watched over by a phantom. He follows orders under fire and shares a heavy burden with his father's name.

feats.scene: Sorta fires the tank's main gun and shatters an enemy bunker's front wall.
Sorta sits inside a hull that takes a shell on its armour and rings like a bell.

name: Lesco
summary: Lesco is an eight-foot, red-maned beast, a scholar changed by touching a space rock into a rampaging cat-man bent on ruin. Cold air at great height shrinks him back to a mild-mannered digger of old tombs.

feats.scene: Lesco rips a museum door from its frame and hurls it down the steps.
Lesco absorbs a spear through the gut and fights on.
Lesco bounds across a plaza on all fours at the pace of a sports car.

name: Cosaunu
summary: Cosaunu is a widowed, brown-haired tycoon in a grim alternate tale where evil gets the upper hand. He guards his empire and his daughter with cold calculation.

feats.scene: Cosaunu slams a hand down on a boardroom table and the decision stands.
Cosaunu is shoved off balance by an angry creditor and recovers.

name: Soreon
summary: Soreon is a black-haired small-time gang boss hungry for power, who hides his crew of masked enforcers behind a self-help dojo. He tests an unstable serum on his followers and plots a heist against a rich family.

feats.scene: Soreon snaps a board with a swift chop in front of his rapt recruits.
Soreon takes a boot to the chest in the dojo and bounces up smiling.

name: Nausirn
summary: Nausirn is a by-the-book police detective in a sprawling western city, wary of lawyers and loopholes. He reins in a headstrong warrior ally with patient talk and procedure.

feats.scene: Nausirn tackles a fleeing suspect over the hood of a squad car.
Nausirn takes a punch to the jaw during an arrest and holds on to the cuffs.

name: Seteroro
summary: Seteroro is a covert operative of a chessboard-themed agency, sent on a ruse to snare a masked archer. His plan nets a quick scuffle and a hard shock from a stun gun.

feats.scene: Seteroro throws a fast jab at a masked opponent and clips his shoulder.
Seteroro is hit by a stun dart and drops to the pavement.

name: Amorlan
summary: Amorlan is a green-eyed puzzle-loving genius in a mirror world, a widower who leads a hidden resistance against ruling tyrants. He fights from the shadows with traps, codes and plans.

feats.scene: Amorlan triggers a hidden charge that drops a tunnel ceiling onto a pursuing patrol.
Amorlan is dragged across stone by a patrol and still sends his signal.

name: Naseter
summary: Naseter is a red-haired thief with a limp and a hooked cane, drawn to jobs that others call impossible. His motives baffle even hardened villains, who urge him to leave town.

feats.scene: Naseter cracks his cane across a guard's wrist and snatches the parcel.
Naseter is shoved against a railing and clings on with a grimace.

name: Lecorse
summary: Lecorse is a brown-haired prankster-genius in a mobile-game universe who trades threats for rhymes. He rallies with a cane and gadgets and, in a pinch, sings a silly chant at ancient horrors.

feats.scene: Lecorse swings his cane and sends a gadget-laden drone crashing into a wall.
Lecorse is shoved aside by a rampaging brute and shakes it off.

name: Eonnu
summary: Eonnu is a tall black-haired mastermind who cannot stop leaving clues for the law at every crime scene. He tries to cure the habit by conditioning but is caught again and again by a famous pair of vigilantes.

feats.scene: Eonnu triggers a giant trap-device that smashes a museum hall's display cases.
Eonnu falls into a river and is hauled out still smirking.

name: Sotiaent
summary: Sotiaent is a dark-haired schemer left near death by a savage lizard-like beast that is hunting every rogue in town. Torn half through and unconscious, he lies in a hospital bed under guard.

feats.scene: Sotiaent raps his staff against a table to command a room's attention.
Sotiaent survives a mauling that would kill most men and clings to life.

name: Rnveo
summary: Rnveo is a mocking tricksterly criminal in a reimagined story, carrying a staff in the shape of a hook. He ends his run in a bitter final chapter.

feats.scene: Rnveo cracks his staff over a thug's shoulder with a loud thump.
Rnveo is flung into a bin by a rival and climbs out grinning.

name: Lennusval
summary: Lennusval is the son of a puzzle-loving schemer in a grim possible future, known only by his name on a headstone. His link to a masked guardian remains a secret in the asylum grounds.

feats.scene: Lennusval is remembered for slamming a tin lid on a rusty gate.
Lennusval falls to a sudden blow and does not rise.

name: Talreo
summary: Talreo is a red-haired electronics wizard from a rough district, scarred by a brutal giant, who rebuilds himself with cold circuitry and glowing eyes. A loyal boyhood friend of a masked hero, he crashes crime networks with a few keystrokes.

feats.scene: Talreo overloads a city server hub and every light along the waterfront bursts.
Talreo's cybernetic frame absorbs a heavy crash from a falling shipping container.

name: Ianiaam
summary: Ianiaam is a black-haired psychiatrist in a swinging-sixties alternate city, known for steep fees and a clever book of word games. A gentle questioner, he helps a grieving young woman face her guilt.

feats.scene: Ianiaam closes his thick book with a clap that startles his patient.
Ianiaam is jostled in a crowded foyer and keeps his composure.

name: Liunau
summary: Liunau is a brown-eyed lab technician with a split mind, who turns from awkward colleague to cold, boastful killer leaving puzzles at each crime. He plots bombings and chess-themed murders, sometimes allied with a smooth crime boss.

feats.scene: Liunau wires a bomb beneath a bridge toll plaza and collapses the whole span.
Liunau is knocked off his feet by a blast and crawls away.

name: Siamvau
summary: Siamvau is a vain schemer who dresses every robbery up as a puzzle and gloats when pursuers fail to solve it. He relies on clever traps, a long walking staff and a mind that no one can read. Careful planning is his craft, not brute force.

feats.scene: Siamvau cracks his staff across a vault door hinge until the bolt shears off.
Siamvau drops through a skylight onto a concrete floor and strolls away without a limp.

name: Taole
summary: Taole is a frail, forgetful old crook whose mind has drifted far from his glory days. He still shuffles out of the ward to rob banks on holidays, never noticing that the vaults stand empty.

feats.scene: Taole swings a rolled newspaper at a bank clerk and knocks his glasses askew.
Taole tumbles down a flight of stairs outside the hospital and complains only about his hat.

name: Ritorcor
summary: Ritorcor is a sharp-minded schemer who turns up only as a rumour at first, then as a gunman inside a dreamed-up false world. He carries a stolen lucky coin and trusts cunning over muscle.

feats.scene: Ritorcor fires a pistol at a young costumed fighter across a rooftop and drops him with one round.
Ritorcor takes a heavy blow from a masked avenger and is left unconscious but alive.

name: Iumenu
summary: Iumenu is a corrupt detective struck by lightning during a particle blast, which turned him into a channel for a boundless speed field. He grew into a tyrant who rules by terror, though his racing body burns through food at a ruinous rate.

feats.scene: Iumenu streaks across the downtown grid and arrives before the thunder from his lightning strike fades.
Iumenu vibrates a fist through a parked armoured van, leaving a smoking tunnel.
Iumenu skids across a highway at top pace and rises with scorched clothes only.

name: Nauorecor
summary: Nauorecor was once a loyal apprentice to a monster slayer, until a cult of bloodsuckers turned him into one of the creatures he hunted and fed him a lie about who was to blame. Decades of hate drove him to take his old master prisoner, and shame finished him when the truth came out.

feats.scene: Nauorecor hurls a grown man through a wooden door and into the far wall of the cellar.
Nauorecor stands unharmed after a fall from a bell tower, shrugging off every broken bone.

name: Liatelam
summary: Liatelam was a pupil at a school for aspiring wrongdoers, nimble and quick on the bars but outmatched in a real fight. When two classmates switched sides, his short criminal career ended in handcuffs.

feats.scene: Liatelam springs off a wall and plants both feet in a guard's chest.
Liatelam lands badly from a vault and walks off the mat.

name: Soriarum
summary: Soriarum is a polished tycoon whose public smile hides a ruthless underworld empire. He built his fortune by cheating a partner, then moulded a bright protege only to ruin him when loyalty wavered.

feats.scene: Soriarum slaps a rival's phone from his hand across a boardroom table.
Soriarum is thrown against a glass wall by an angry employee and straightens his tie.

name: Veoone
summary: Veoone is a teenage hacker in a suit lined with vials of gas that grant different gifts at will, which he uses to wreck his father's company and win a glance of approval. A bad overdose once turned him to solid rock until scientists reversed it.

feats.scene: Veoone dials up a heat-blast vial and burns a hole through a loading dock wall.
Veoone takes a full volley from a squad of armed guards while his skin turns hard as stone.

name: Ralinas
summary: Ralinas is a boy ghost who died long ago at school and now solves supernatural cases alongside a friend who chose to stay with him instead of moving on. He is polite, curious, and quietly searching for a romance he cannot quite feel.

feats.scene: Ralinas slams a haunted wardrobe shut with a burst of cold spectral force.
Ralinas lets a swinging iron gate pass straight through his chest without harm.

name: Ciltel
summary: Ciltel is a small-time thief turned lawman whose body was altered by strange chemicals after a botched job, letting him twist into any shape. Bullets bounce off his stretchy frame, and even clean cuts knit together quickly.

feats.scene: Ciltel extends an arm thirty metres down a corridor and flattens a gunman with a single smack.
Ciltel stretches around a burst of machine-gun fire and snaps back unmarked.

name: Ceoal
summary: Ceoal is a sea monarch who lost her undersea kingdom to a rival queen and fled ashore to plot a counterstrike. She killed traitors, gathered stolen recipes, and in the end rallied an army to retake the throne.

feats.scene: Ceoal drives a spear through a traitor's shield in a dockside alley.
Ceoal takes a rifle butt to the ribs and keeps hunting her quarry through the night.

name: Caiumta
summary: Caiumta is a bald, balding spellcaster who rules a small kingdom of his own and sets his hexes against two famous heroes. His power comes from unspecified magic, wielded with more spite than skill.

feats.scene: Caiumta calls down a green storm that levels a watchtower on the border of his domain.
Caiumta weathers a hail of arrows that turn to ash against his warding spell.

name: Ontarti
summary: Ontarti is a cartoon fowl who lives in a world of talking animals and attends lessons with his classmates. He is so gullible that nearly any trick works on him.

feats.scene: Ontarti flaps a wing and knocks a schoolbook off a desk.
Ontarti is flattened by a falling anvil and pops back into shape with a squawk.

name: Loriuial
summary: Loriuial is a shy, timid scholar who built a glass helmet to concentrate lunar glow into his brain. Now every full night his head blazes like a lantern and he is overwhelmed by an urge to steal, then wakes up full of regret.

feats.scene: Loriuial releases a pulse of pale light that bursts a row of streetlamps.
Loriuial is knocked flat by a bat-wielding guard and rises with his glow undimmed.

name: Terstarn
summary: Terstarn is a tall, bald mastermind who builds every scheme around his love of oval shells and puns to match. He once grabbed a city's lease and banished its guardians, only to lose it to a legal loophole.

feats.scene: Terstarn heaves a stone urn at an approaching henchman who refused to laugh at the pun.
Terstarn tumbles from a rooftop awning and brushes off the dust.

name: Santean
summary: Santean is a short military officer who seized power in a small desert state and kept up its loud hostility toward a faraway superpower. He survived an assassination plot dressed up as a rescue mission.

feats.scene: Santean backhands a captured reporter hard enough to split his lip.
Santean is shoved into a marble pillar during a palace scuffle and stays on his feet.

name: Ansase
summary: Ansase is a man who was kept from true death, glimpsed an empty beyond, and now preaches that nothing waits there. He hunts those who shorten other lives, joins a revolutionary band hoping for a way to finally rest, and endures even when others think him dead.

feats.scene: Ansase hurls a burning chapel bell across a valley and shatters a stone bridge.
Ansase stands in the heart of a collapsing tower and walks out of the rubble untouched.

name: Amriaaul
summary: Amriaaul is a card-themed hired hand in a costumed band of thieves, doing as he is told under a commanding boss. His part in the story is a brawl against a pack of masked rogues for the price on their heads.

feats.scene: Amriaaul swings a gun butt at a masked rogue's jaw.
Amriaaul is thrown across a casino floor and gets back up.

name: Rerila
summary: Rerila is a blond thief who wears a playing-card motif and fights as part of a costumed gang. She appears briefly, a minor figure in a band that stays together by habit more than loyalty.

feats.scene: Rerila lashes out with a card-edged baton and drives a guard back.
Rerila takes a tumble over a balcony rail and lands on her feet.

name: Eretia
summary: Eretia is the heir of a powerful clan of racketeers who secretly dons a sleek cat costume to undo her late father's worst deals. She is a gifted acrobat and fighter, with claws and a whip, and finds an uneasy ally in the former thief she once spied on.

feats.scene: Eretia whips a pistol from a gangster's grip and kicks him through a screen door.
Eretia hits a wall from a rooftop leap and rolls clear without a sound.

name: Anunt
summary: Anunt is a bald, blue-eyed killer-for-hire who walks in shadow beside her brother, serving a dark house in a city of crystal. She favours blades and silence, and her career is brief.

feats.scene: Anunt throws a curved knife the length of a courtyard and pins a guard's cloak to a post.
Anunt crashes through a lattice window and rolls up unhurt.

name: Esisa
summary: Esisa is a deity of calm who is bound to a war-bringing counterpart and spreads serenity as he spreads strife. When the balance breaks she is driven mad, and she can fly, grow large, vanish and reappear, and release bolts of power.

feats.scene: Esisa casts a ring of white light that flattens a mountain plateau and everything on it.
Esisa stands at the centre of a divine duel's shockwave and her robe barely stirs.

name: Neseoern
summary: Neseoern is a soldier granted a hero's gifts by his homeworld's leaders, who built him as a counter to a distant champion. Discovering he was a copy and a safeguard, he turned bitter and lashed out at those who made him.

feats.scene: Neseoern punches a crater into a mountain range and the shock rolls out across the plain.
Neseoern walks through a bombardment from an orbiting fleet with no wound.
Neseoern crosses a continent in the span of a breath.

name: Numauliu
summary: Numauliu is a grey-haired mastermind who hides his lair behind a fake shop and designs lethal contraptions for fun. His ultimate trap was meant to be tested by a famous hero, who instead escaped and ended his career.

feats.scene: Numauliu triggers a counterweighted blade rig that cuts a steel beam in half.
Numauliu is knocked off his feet in a scuffle with two crime-fighters and cannot rise.

name: Teamo
summary: Teamo is a bald, blue-eyed killer-for-hire who walks in shadow beside his sister, serving a dark house in a city of crystal. He prefers blades and silence, and his career is brief.

feats.scene: Teamo drives a short sword through a wooden shield from three paces.
Teamo drops from a high wall onto stone and slips away unhurt.

name: Liune
summary: Liune is the aging head of a gang in a big city who is tricked by a scheming woman into taking a potion that gives him a raven's traits. He gains wings and great strength, then turns on the very organisation he led.

feats.scene: Liune wrenches a car door off its frame mid-flight and tosses it over a rail.
Liune takes a long fall from a tower window and flaps upright at the bottom.

name: Sestnen
summary: Sestnen is a colossal green drifter who sails the void between stars and needs no food or rest. One of his eyes was torn away and became a weapon that others have wielded for conquest.

feats.scene: Sestnen opens a gaze of green fire and cuts a barren world's crust in two.
Sestnen drifts through a dying star's flare without losing a single scale.

name: Iusia
summary: Iusia is a green-skinned, red-eyed wanderer who knows the secrets of many worlds and claims to be nobody at all. He guides a hero with riddles and visions, carries a staff, and can fly on wings, peer ahead in time and read minds.

feats.scene: Iusia points his staff and a beam of light flattens a ring of stone pillars.
Iusia stands calm while a fortress wall crashes down around him.

name: Llcoont
summary: Llcoont is a stage conjurer and tinkerer who pursues wrongdoers with spells and strange gadgets in the early years of a great war. He can send out a ghostly double, move objects with thought, and stretch ropes with a spoken word.

feats.scene: Llcoont lifts a delivery truck with a wave of his hand and sets it on a rooftop.
Llcoont is thrown by a kidnapper and catches his fall with a floating ring of rope.

name: Numcillan
summary: Numcillan is a prisoner of a tiny shrunken city who breaks out and swaps places with a young reporter, then gains great power under the glare of a golden sun. He sets out to kill the planet's champion and is soon returned to a cell.

feats.scene: Numcillan hurls a tanker against a cliff and brings down half the hillside.
Numcillan laughs off a tank battalion's barrage on an open field.

name: Eruser
summary: Eruser is a bandit chief in the old frontier who travels with a feathered pet and loots banks and garrisons. His family was slain by a gang, so he swore revenge and clashed again and again with a hired gun who sold him useless rifles.

feats.scene: Eruser fires a revolver and saber together in a single sweep through a saloon.
Eruser rolls from a galloping horse onto rock and remains in the saddle moments later.

name: Tirror
summary: Tirror is a mutated outlaw from a blended frontier world who rides with a band of misfits. Little is known beyond a stray mention in a fan letters column.

feats.scene: Tirror hurls a mutated claw into a saloon table and splits it in two.
Tirror eats a point-blank shotgun blast and sneers.

name: Retelseo
summary: Retelseo is a four-armed, tailed peacekeeper who patrols a distant sector with a power ring and a charging lantern. His partner is a cheerful oddball whose bravery contrasts with his own grim seriousness.

feats.scene: Retelseo hurls a ring blast that shatters a derelict freighter into drifting slag.
Retelseo hovers inside a green field as a pirate cruiser opens fire.

name: Lasles
summary: Lasles is a white-haired radiant monarch who rules a paradise from a keep named after his son and is loved by his people. His strength is nearly limitless, but it fades if worshippers forget him, and he is missing a limb.

feats.scene: Lasles floods a sky with golden light that boils an ocean to steam.
Lasles holds firm at the centre of a collapsing sun-gate and shrugs off the blast.

name: Ialeorvor
summary: Ialeorvor is an elder spirit that joined a council of ancient forces who lent their gifts to a mortal wizard. His own gift is the sharing of strength with others, and he counts courage as a weapon.

feats.scene: Ialeorvor pours stored force into a chosen mortal and a mountain lifts off its roots.
Ialeorvor remains whole as the plane around him folds in on itself.

name: Vaamo
summary: Vaamo is a coastal dark-arts practitioner who has traded souls since decades past and was rewarded by hidden forces with a very long life. A single spoken word can freeze police in place, and he has killed children in ritual.

feats.scene: Vaamo speaks one word and a bus rolls on its side, spilling glass across the road.
Vaamo is struck by a thrown bottle and hardly flinches.

name: Ausam
summary: Ausam is the sea-born queen of a drowned kingdom in a grim future, strong, quick and tough beyond any surface person. She bends water to her will, flies by magic, and wields a great three-pronged spear.

feats.scene: Ausam raises a wall of surf and drives it through a coastal tower.
Ausam stays standing as a collapsing seawall slams down on her.

name: Iumcotir
summary: Iumcotir is a girl who died young and was later conjured back as a living construct of coloured light by her grieving brother. She serves a corps that draws on hope and comforts a mother who has forgotten the loss.

feats.scene: Iumcotir shapes a glowing blue wall and slams it into a crumbling gate.
Iumcotir is struck by a falling beam and flickers back together.

name: Leoaulnt
summary: Leoaulnt is a self-charging fighter from an old console game who claims to be the strongest on his world. He fires a killer beam from his arm and is beaten by a masked hero.

feats.scene: Leoaulnt aims his arm at a steel bulkhead and a blinding beam melts a hole through it.
Leoaulnt takes a thrown batarang to the chest and keeps advancing.

name: Cosorrn
summary: Cosorrn is a blond thug who inherits the shock gloves of his dead boss and upgrades them under threat. He shocks a famous crimefighter a couple of times before taking a frozen blast to the mouth and a fatal visit from a rival.

feats.scene: Cosorrn jams both gloves against a metal railing and a crackling arc jumps the length of the rooftop.
Cosorrn spits blood after a punch to the face and keeps lunging.

name: Ntarium
summary: Ntarium is a blond swordsman in a wired suit that lets him generate current through his hands, adjusting it to stun or to kill. He is sent as an envoy to strike a deal, walks into a trap, and bleeds out against a wall.

feats.scene: Ntarium sends a blue arc across a banquet table and blows every candle out.
Ntarium takes a duelist's cut across the shoulder and keeps his blade up.

name: Amoiu
summary: Amoiu is a green-eyed killer from an ancient desert land who treats cats as her family and wears a headdress shaped from a sacred relic. She is a fine acrobat, thief and knife-thrower, and rumour credits her with several spare lives.

feats.scene: Amoiu throws a trio of knives that pin a guard's sleeve to a temple door.
Amoiu drops from a high ledge, lands light and sprints away.

name: Nianen
summary: Nianen is a common pooch who gained the power to rearrange the matter around and within him after exposure to a glowing relic. He can turn to vapour and float, and his teeth can chew through stone.

feats.scene: Nianen clamps his jaws on a boulder and crunches it into gravel.
Nianen turns to vapour as a hammer swings through him and re-forms wagging.

name: Titumoro
summary: Titumoro is the head scientist of a secret military programme, inheriting an obsession from a grandfather who tried to open a gate to a realm of living energy. Brilliant and guarded, she works alongside a hero team.

feats.scene: Titumoro hurls a heavy clipboard at a trespasser and cracks his visor.
Titumoro is caught in a lab blast and walks out with singed sleeves.

name: Aulraser
summary: Aulraser is a grey-skinned, bald bruiser with the bulk and strength of a tusked giant, fighting for a gang of villains. He once held a metal-limbed hero to a standstill until his gang was whisked away.

feats.scene: Aulraser stomps the floor of a warehouse and cracks the concrete from wall to wall.
Aulraser takes a heavy cannon blast square on the chest and barely rocks.

name: Iuamva
summary: Iuamva is a bitter little worker at a holiday theme park who dreams of ruling the frozen north after a lifetime of mockery for his height. With a ghostly partner he plots to tilt the planet's axis, and sends wind-up toy soldiers against a team of heroes who beat him with ease.

feats.scene: Iuamva detonates a crate of toy cannons that blow a hole through a stockroom wall.
Iuamva is bowled over by a hero's shield and surrenders at once.

name: Eorses
summary: Eorses is the eldest and most beautiful of a race of smokeless spirits, a rebel who led his kin against the people they were made to serve. He imprisons his sister in a ring, rents her out for centuries, and hunts a relic said to have fallen from the sky.

feats.scene: Eorses reveals his monstrous face and a wave of black fire erases a desert caravan town.
Eorses stands in a collapsing temple as the whole roof falls on him and walks out unmarked.

name: Telestol
summary: Telestol is a hairless instructor at an academy on a distant planet who sends thoughts across space for a year to invite a famous runner to speak to his pupils. He is patient, kind and devoted to teaching.

feats.scene: Telestol taps a pointer on a desk and a startled student drops his slate.
Telestol trips over a lab cable and rises dusting off his robe.

name: Siama
summary: Siama is an aging widow whose family is bound up with a famous reporter and a hero from another world. A factory blast left her hospitalised, and a rich schemer kept her alive with monthly medicine as leverage.

feats.scene: Siama tosses a hospital pillow at a visitor and knocks over a water jug.
Siama survives the chemical blast that wrecked the factory floor around her.

name: Vauurn
summary: Vauurn is a government lawman who hunted a mob boss in the dry years and, frustrated by the law's limits, became a masked avenger of the night. He fights with fists and a typewriter and meets a grim end.

feats.scene: Vauurn smashes a typewriter into a gangster's jaw and drops him.
Vauurn takes a round from a tommy gun in his armoured coat and keeps coming.

name: Stoseo
summary: Stoseo is a black-haired criminal drafted into a doomed team of expendable agents, who can sense and sway the moods of beasts. She appears only briefly before she dies.

feats.scene: Stoseo throws a handful of gravel into a guard dog's face and slips past.
Stoseo rolls out of a jeep as it flips and bruises her shoulder only.

name: Raust
summary: Raust is a small-town student who begged a billionaire for speed and got it, but could not slow down without a drug. She joined his hero team, quit, returned, and was stripped of her gift in the middle of a battle.

feats.scene: Raust races down a main street faster than a bullet-train and skids to a stop outside a diner.
Raust runs through a wooden fence at top pace and leaves a splintered gap.
Raust hits a brick wall at a sprint and walks it off.

name: Iurival
summary: Iurival is a pink, bright-eyed pachyderm kept as a pet by a green young hero in a cartoon world of tiny teen sidekicks. She trumpets cheerfully and mostly causes harmless mess.

feats.scene: Iurival swings her trunk and tips over a school-yard slide.
Iurival sits on a toy car and it flattens while she stays unbothered.

name: Lluautiu
summary: Lluautiu is a kind, homeless former government worker who knows every comer and goer on her run-down block. She saved a boy's life after his father's murder and then helped him run his rag shop.

feats.scene: Lluautiu shoves a shopping cart into a thief's shins and he drops the cash register.
Lluautiu sleeps through a freezing storm under newspapers and wakes up cheerful.

name: Llornile
summary: Llornile is a stage-trained performer and thrower who has been married to two masked adventurers in a world of retro science heroes. Skilled at sleight of hand, she calls for help when others come under attack.

feats.scene: Llornile throws a playing card that pins a gunman's sleeve to a door frame.
Llornile tumbles from a speeding carriage and rolls to her feet.

name: Stratal
summary: Stratal is a long-reigning monarch with a strict sense of protocol, who lives in a grand palace by a river. Her life is threatened twice, and a caped crimefighter and a secret agency save her.

feats.scene: Stratal raps her cane on a marble floor and a footman springs to attention.
Stratal steps unharmed from a car that a would-be assassin rams.

name: Eollia
summary: Eollia is a white-haired criminal who was believed dead after a childhood crash and was raised in captivity, where she became obsessed with a famous storybook. She leads a gang under a fairytale name and has a twin sister who hunts her.

feats.scene: Eollia drives a long blade through a car door and pins a driver in his seat.
Eollia falls from a bridge rail into water and swims away uninjured.

name: Ntoauinu
summary: Ntoauinu is a blond marksman in a bleak possible future who stalks the bloodsucking monster her twin sister has become. She carries only firearms and a sorrow she cannot put down.

feats.scene: Ntoauinu fires a silver round that blows a hole through a barn door.
Ntoauinu is slammed into a stone wall and rises with her rifle ready.

name: Ceiasor
summary: Ceiasor is a red-haired, pale woman who was broken by a kidnapping long ago and now speaks only in lines from a children's fantasy novel. She rises fast through a doomsday cult under a royal pen name.

feats.scene: Ceiasor swings a ceremonial blade through a wooden door in one cut.
Ceiasor leaps from a rooftop and shrugs off the impact with a giggle.

name: Annteeo
summary: Annteeo is a tall, green-eyed twin who was kidnapped at twelve, believed dead, and raised into a cult's high ranks before breaking free. She fights alongside agencies and secret teams, bearing a battle-title of her own.

feats.scene: Annteeo kicks a heavy door off its hinges during a hostage rescue.
Annteeo is blasted through a window by a grenade and rolls to her feet.

name: Sttiuium
summary: Sttiuium is a blonde young crimefighter in a cartoon team-up world, masked and eager to join a band of costumed allies. She runs on enthusiasm and quick reflexes rather than heavy weapons.

feats.scene: Sttiuium swings from a rooftop line and boots a thug through a billboard.
Sttiuium is flung into a stack of crates and springs back up grinning.

source_title: Elizabeth Kane (The Brave and the Bold)

name: Urnrate
summary: Urnrate is a doctor who grew up under the shadow of a criminal father and cut him out of her life to escape judgment. Pregnant and hidden in a village abroad, she is tracked down and asked to speak to him.

feats.scene: Urnrate slaps a clinic door open and startles a waiting patient.
Urnrate slips on a wet step during the move and catches herself.

name: Valen
summary: Valen is the half-warrior, half-mortal child of a fabled warrior princess and a fallen pilot, born after her mother crossed into the land of the dead. She grows up among island warriors and joins their hero team.

feats.scene: Valen swings a shield into a stone colonnade and drops the whole front of it.
Valen stands firm as a falling statue crashes on her and splits in half.

name: Esiteia
summary: Esiteia is a green-eyed fast-food worker whose accident with a deep fryer goes viral and carries her all the way to national leadership in a bleak, twisted future. She wins as a long shot and rules with surprising stubborn decency.

feats.scene: Esiteia swings a fry basket at a lunging heckler and clangs it off his head.
Esiteia shrugs off a splash of hot oil across her apron and carries on.

name: Siareta
summary: Siareta is a pink, trunked pachyderm who was one of several animals rescued by a team of costumed pets from a captor. She is gentle, loud and surprisingly heavy.

feats.scene: Siareta charges a cage door and bursts the hinges open.
Siareta takes a swung net and a stunning jolt and keeps trumpeting.

name: Tetinirn
summary: Tetinirn is a blond farm wife who lives quietly with her husband in a small rural town and raises two daughters who go on to become reporters and soldiers. Her life is simple and domestic.

feats.scene: Tetinirn flings a wet dishcloth at a crow and sends it off the porch.
Tetinirn slips in the barnyard mud and stands up laughing.

name: Tisvili
summary: Tisvili is a girl from a small town whose scientist parents work at a lab. A strange mineral put her in a coma, and when she woke she showed the gifts of a famous flying heroine and believed she was her. A spy hunted her until the real hero helped her heal.

feats.scene: Tisvili hurls a boulder into a quarry wall and collapses a whole cliff face.
Tisvili walks through a spy's gunfire in a corridor as the bullets flatten.

name: Vallletau
summary: Vallletau is a red-haired, green-eyed psychiatrist who works in an old asylum and serves a dark cause with a secret order. Her main skill is medical science, which she bends to her employers' ends.

feats.scene: Vallletau jabs a sedative into a patient's arm and holds him down.
Vallletau falls down a stairwell in the asylum and gets up calmly.

name: Rimitil
summary: Rimitil is a cheerful young woman who took a risky job and was nearly killed by a monster for it, then followed a stranger's tip to steadier work. She enjoys her night off at her boyfriend's concert.

feats.scene: Rimitil tosses her handbag at a mugger and bruises his cheek.
Rimitil is shoved into a bar-room door and carries on chatting.

name: Reoneo
summary: Reoneo is a blue-skinned prince of an ancient and advanced people, the only one spared when a time ripple wiped his race from history. He has spent a hundred thousand years guarding the remains of their technology from the wrong hands.

feats.scene: Reoneo swings a glowing torch and splits a ridge of bedrock in half.
Reoneo walks calmly through a collapsing citadel and brushes dust from his shoulder.

name: Nutau
summary: Nutau is a starving stray hound who was healed by an experimental ray, gaining size, strength and a human-level mind. He now follows orders, plans traps, and plays tricks as the partner of tiny crimefighters.

feats.scene: Nutau body-slams a locked warehouse door and bursts it from its frame.
Nutau takes a pipe across the ribs from a smuggler and growls back.

name: Cornanter
summary: Cornanter is a grey-haired alchemist who invented a blend of science and the occult and hopes to become famous by cutting a demon out of a man's soul. His boastful plan is carried out in a warehouse by the sea.

feats.scene: Cornanter sets off a ring of glowing glyphs and rips a rusted shipping container in two.
Cornanter is thrown into a steel shelf by the backlash and stands up smiling.

name: Rertotel
summary: Rertotel is a blond, grey-streaked widow who knows the occult and handles a gun, and who fights alongside a crew of sea adventurers. She lives at a clifftop home overlooking the water.

feats.scene: Rertotel fires a harpoon gun across a boat deck and pins a raider's coat to the mast.
Rertotel climbs from a capsized skiff after a rogue wave and keeps hold of her rifle.

name: Veolenan
summary: Veolenan is a grey-skinned swordswoman who wanders with a band of comet-chasing adventurers across a grim world of assassins. She prefers blades to words, and keeps her black hair tied back.

feats.scene: Veolenan cuts a bronze gate chain in two with one stroke of her blade.
Veolenan takes a spear thrust on her armoured shoulder and answers with a counter cut.

name: Siucoce
summary: Siucoce is an exile-born youth who leads a strike team of super-powered children from a prison world into a war meant to jolt their government awake. He goes on a rampage through a great city, crushes a headquarters, and is stopped by a speck of dust.

feats.scene: Siucoce brings down a tower complex with a single sweep and levels the street around it.
Siucoce walks away from a collapsing skyscraper without a scratch.

name: Rerlla
summary: Rerlla is a red-haired swordsman from a crystal-ruled realm who claims an inherited gift from one of its noble houses but will not say what it is. He fights with a blade and a hint of old magic.

feats.scene: Rerlla strikes a stone lintel and a flash of unnamed power splits it clean.
Rerlla stays upright under a collapsing archway and brushes off the rubble.

name: Oluor
summary: Oluor is a brown-haired mother in the stone age who belongs to two rival tribes and raises sons beside her husband. Her days are spent gathering food, tending children and keeping peace.

feats.scene: Oluor hurls a stone at a thieving ape and knocks it off the fruit rack.
Oluor slides down a muddy bank and wades out laughing.

name: Virerll
summary: Virerll is a blond agent of a covert strike team who obeys a shadowy government office and conjures protective barriers. A hero strong enough can break through her barriers.

feats.scene: Virerll pushes a glowing shield into a guard and sends him across a parking lot.
Virerll braces behind a shimmering wall as a van slams it at speed and it holds.

name: Tornceo
summary: Tornceo is a blond woman in the stone age whose father insists her elder sister must wed first, so she wins her husband through a dowry contest. She moves between two tribes and raises a child.

feats.scene: Tornceo hurls a wooden club at a rival suitor and cracks his shield.
Tornceo tumbles from a boulder in the dowry contest and stands unhurt.

name: Tauolcor
summary: Tauolcor is the local masked hero of a small town who tries to stop a gang of freakish raiders and is paralysed by a toxic glow before being cut down. His brave stand lasts only moments.

feats.scene: Tauolcor hurls a lamppost at an attacker and bends it around him.
Tauolcor takes a crushing slap from a raider and staggers but stays on his feet.

name: Corva
summary: Corva is a white-haired science professor and genius who secretly built the first one-man rocket and protects a gifted student from those who would exploit him. He later dies protecting his friend's secret.

feats.scene: Corva hurls a lab beaker at a spy and drives him back from the controls.
Corva is knocked against a chalkboard in a break-in and gets up gasping.

name: Stiia
summary: Stiia is a pale, hairless archer from a collapsing timeline who betrayed her half-brother and joined a demon lord's army, mutated into a fanged horror. She hurls arrows and throws weapons until a hostile sorceress knocks her into a burning pit.

feats.scene: Stiia looses an arrow that punches clean through a cave pillar and sends it crashing.
Stiia takes a hit from a rock slide and tears free with her fangs bared.

source_title: Emiko Queen (Last 52: Falling Through the Cracks)

name: Narerta
summary: Narerta is a research scientist at a big laboratory who cheers up his coworkers by wearing a red suit and white beard to their party. He appears only as a passing mention in a rowdy holiday gathering.

feats.scene: Narerta pops a cork from a bottle and launches it across the party.
Narerta trips over a stray present and rises with his beard askew.

name: Irtiia
summary: Irtiia is a grey-haired scientist with brown eyes who works near a small farming town in an alternate world where a single nail changed history. His methods turn him into a villain, though the details are not shown.

feats.scene: Irtiia triggers a hidden lab trap and a spring-loaded arm hurls a crate at a visitor.
Irtiia is thrown from his chair by an explosion and stands dusting his coat.

name: Anlas
summary: Anlas is a wiry cat burglar from a harbour town who folds the air around him and steps out a street away. He robs vaults for a cause he calls pride, though his crew mostly wants the payout.

feats.scene: Anlas yanks a loaded delivery van through a fold in the air and drops it onto a rooftop.
Anlas shrugs off a thrown bar stool and a cracked rib without slowing his escape.

name: Iuveoca
summary: Iuveoca is a wanderer with no fixed address who opens doorways in empty air and can push crates, cars or captives through them. A cruel experiment left a hole in the wanderer's memory that still leaks into every plan.

feats.scene: Iuveoca opens twin gateways above a bridge and drops a freight container through them onto a pursuing convoy.
Iuveoca takes a rifle volley at close range and stumbles up bruised and furious.

name: Liatele
summary: Liatele is a hulking gangster whose hands grew so oversized in childhood that the neighbourhood nicknamed him after a mallet. He runs a protection racket and insists he is only a shopkeeper with a sideline.

feats.scene: Liatele flattens a steel shutter with a single downward blow of his fists.
Liatele takes a bat across the shoulders and keeps counting his takings.

name: Orsereo
summary: Orsereo is a masked vengeance-seeker from a far-future federation of youth squads, driven by a grudge nobody else remembers. Orsereo hunts rivals across the stars with stolen weapons and patient cruelty.

feats.scene: Orsereo fires a stolen cannon and melts a docking clamp the size of a barn door.
Orsereo walks out of a collapsing hangar with only a scorched cloak.

name: Liunelle
summary: Liunelle is a dry-witted field handler who runs ugly missions from a basement control room and never raises her voice. Her father drilled her to be a soldier, and she treats loyalty as something to be audited.

feats.scene: Liunelle swings a rifle butt and drops a guard who tried to leave his post.
Liunelle rides out a stairwell fall and walks back to her desk muttering about paperwork.

name: Ianrn
summary: Ianrn is a former clerk from a quiet city who learned she belonged to a buried race with pale skin and a hunger for blood. She moves objects with her mind and smiles for cameras between rescues.

feats.scene: Ianrn lifts a parked truck with her mind and hurls it against a tunnel wall.
Ianrn shakes off a collapsing cavern ceiling and brushes dust from her sleeves.

name: Telau
summary: Telau is a bright schoolgirl who drowned trying to save a friend, then lived on in old film reels and a grieving father's laboratory. Telau has no powers of her own, only a legacy of love and a copied face.

feats.scene: Telau splashes frantically and tugs a friend toward the pier with all the strength a child has.
Telau holds her breath under cold water far longer than a child should.

name: Rnili
summary: Rnili is a wartime spy who stepped into a haunted laboratory and stayed trapped in a timeless pocket for generations. Rnili still moves with the discipline of a commando and has aged not a day.

feats.scene: Rnili vaults a railing and drives a boot heel through a brittle wooden door.
Rnili survives years in a place without food, light or sleep and still stands her ground.

name: Rantanu
summary: Rantanu is a harried aide and parent who was dosed with a glowing mineral and made to carry a second mind that takes the wheel on command. Rantanu fights the hijacker daily to keep a family together.

feats.scene: Rantanu punches through a barn wall and sends a farm truck tumbling across the yard.
Rantanu brushes off a canister of caustic gas and a flurry of blows.

name: Llenuter
summary: Llenuter is a composed academic administrator who once helped a beloved teacher chase a hole in time and lost him for decades. Llenuter now runs a faculty office with calm authority and a private soft spot.

feats.scene: Llenuter slams a ledger onto the desk and silences a rowdy committee.
Llenuter endures decades of regret and a bruising divorce without losing her poise.

name: Statiusor
summary: Statiusor is a violet-eyed shapeshifter whose body rearranges into whatever substance the moment demands, from brick to vapour. A fractured mind makes allies nervous, yet the help is genuine.

feats.scene: Statiusor hardens an arm into granite and caves in the roof of an armoured transport.
Statiusor turns to vapour as a shell strikes and re-forms in the next doorway.

name: Iumcoran
summary: Iumcoran was a loft painter who sketched a nightmare without meaning to, and the nightmare stepped off the canvas. A sorrowful tale among occultists, and her art still hangs in a few dusty galleries.

feats.scene: Iumcoran flings a jar of turpentine and a palette knife at the thing crawling from her easel.
Iumcoran clings to a windowsill for a few seconds before the horror shoves her loose.

name: Liunumeor
summary: Liunumeor is a grandiose schemer who builds a humming device that drains ambition from a whole nation, then crowns himself ruler by popular apathy. His scheme works on everyone but a certain caped visitor.

feats.scene: Liunumeor switches on a rooftop emitter and floods a metropolis with a dulling radiance.
Liunumeor tumbles down a marble stair in his ceremonial robes and bounces up unhurt.

name: Sematir
summary: Sematir is an aloof sovereign over a ring of frozen moons who sends spies down to a warring world before planning conquest. Sematir reads minds across a throne room and trades treaties like cattle.

feats.scene: Sematir orders a battery of ice cannons to fire and levels a mining dome.
Sematir sits through a shattering mutiny with the throne cracking beneath him.

name: Stistesi
summary: Stistesi is a cruel monarch of a lost island city dressed like an ancient capital, where bloodshed is a festival. Stistesi lives for applause and orders captives into the arena.

feats.scene: Stistesi signals the gladiators to charge and the crowd roars at her command.
Stistesi absorbs a thrown goblet and a rebel's slap without losing her smile.

name: Ornist
summary: Ornist is a vast limb of primordial darkness that woke up and learned to command nightmares from the fifth dimension. Ornist erases whole story-worlds to feed a machine built for finality.

feats.scene: Ornist closes its fist and a bundle of parallel worlds goes dark at once.
Ornist is struck by a coalition of champions and the blow dissolves into nothing.

name: Talneo
summary: Talneo is a blue-skinned warrior from a scorched dominion of tyrants whose lightest touch can freeze a victim's muscles or stop a heart. Talneo serves a vicious cult as a living poison dart.

feats.scene: Talneo lays a palm on an armoured guard and the man drops rigid like a felled tree.
Talneo walks through a collapsing furnace hall and out the other side.

name: Tauanceo
summary: Tauanceo is an ancient sorceress who dresses as a street musician or a sweet old landlady and sheds the disguise at a single spoken word. Tauanceo stashes a shard of fate in a drawer and trades gossip with gods.

feats.scene: Tauanceo whispers a word and her cottage swells into a stone hall with sealed gates.
Tauanceo sits calmly as a ceiling beam crashes through her and she re-forms as a cat.

name: Seoror
summary: Seoror is a grey-skinned being who says it was present before the beginning and will remain after the end. Seoror trades fearlessness for tears and later comes to collect, waking statues to do the work.

feats.scene: Seoror whispers over a graveyard and a hundred stone angels climb down to hunt.
Seoror stands unmoved as a rain of bullets turns to harmless dust in her palm.

name: Vorco
summary: Vorco is a sealed-away deity of an older age who borrows a mortal host to walk again, bringing a brother and a plan to bury cities in darkness. Vorco is worshipped in an unmapped cave and hated in every other place.

feats.scene: Vorco raises a swirling ring of dark light above a city centre and its towers crumble.
Vorco walks through a barrage of heavy shells with a bored expression.

name: Anran
summary: Anran is a spiteful spirit that rides in an innocent painter and floats over the roofs shouting at passers-by. Anran can do nothing alone and stays tangled in an argument for control of a single body.

feats.scene: Anran flings a column of green fire at a parked car and sends it spinning down the avenue.
Anran is shaken by a thrown talisman and nearly slips out of the borrowed body.

name: Liallole
summary: Liallole is a witch who lodged inside a designer and fed on her for years, whispering of a conquest that spans dozens of worlds. Liallole throws bolts, bends minds and conjures minions when bored.

feats.scene: Liallole hurls a lance of violet energy and levels a row of warehouses.
Liallole wraps herself in a glimmering dome and a tank shell splashes across it.

name: Amotiu
summary: Amotiu is the idea of finality wearing the shape of a quiet boy, born to a mother who thought he was a messiah of fear. Amotiu can become a cosmic projectile that unmakes stories, and a gunner sent him through a rift.

feats.scene: Amotiu is fired through a crack in reality and every shelf of the great archive begins to blank.
Amotiu is hurled into the heart of a dying cosmos and comes out untouched.

name: Titeson
summary: Titeson is a smalltime counterfeiter who carves printing plates by candlelight and sells forged notes to anyone with a bag of cash. Titeson fights with a chisel and a lot of nerve against a masked hero in a bulletproof helmet.

feats.scene: Titeson swipes a chisel at a pursuer and gouges the door frame.
Titeson takes a fall from a warehouse loft and limps for the alley.

name: Niirn
summary: Niirn is a puzzle-obsessed crook who leaves cryptic notes at each heist and wears a question-mark mask. Niirn picks locks, forges alibis and runs from a scarab-armoured pursuer.

feats.scene: Niirn swings a crowbar and shatters a jewellery case.
Niirn is thrown into a stack of crates and scrambles up again.

name: Siulloll
summary: Siulloll is a red-haired schoolkid in a cartoon version of a heroic team who tells groan-worthy jokes with a staff in hand. Siulloll proves the punchline can floor a stronger classmate.

feats.scene: Siulloll taps a playground bully with her staff and he collapses in giggles.
Siulloll tumbles off the monkey bars and bounces up laughing.

name: Iumiu
summary: Iumiu is a yellow-skinned jailer who feeds on the terror of captives and presides over torture cells on a living planet. Iumiu swings a glowing cutlass until a young soldier splits him in two, and he later rises again as a hollow husk.

feats.scene: Iumiu sends a wave of dread-powered light through a prison block and shatters its walls.
Iumiu takes a cutting blast across the ribs and stays on his feet for a moment.

name: Sovor
summary: Sovor is the stern warden of a shadowy afterlife where fallen gods go to rest. Sovor tests visitors with rock-splitting blows and is outwitted when a trickster simply refuses to fight back.

feats.scene: Sovor swings a fist and cracks a stone pillar the width of a tower.
Sovor is buried beneath a toppled column and digs himself out, cursing.

name: Ralvalu
summary: Ralvalu is a gentle conservationist who can reshape living tissue, turning beasts into people and back again. Ralvalu is stuck in a lion-like body and spends his days protecting dwindling species.

feats.scene: Ralvalu lunges and claws a steel gate off its hinges.
Ralvalu stumbles out of a crashed transport shuttle with a few scratches.

name: Teranli
summary: Teranli is a haunted man who bargained with a smiling merchant to save his town and became a hulking creature of water and rubbish. Teranli has lost the curse but keeps a knack for stealing strength from nearby bargainers.

feats.scene: Teranli smashes a gas pump apart with a swollen fist and a blast of foul water.
Teranli, in his junkyard shape, shrugs off a shotgun at point blank range.

name: Torrn
summary: Torrn is an elderly mafia patriarch who runs racketeering rings from a dim restaurant and speaks quietly about respect. Torrn bribes officials, crushes rivals through lawyers and trusts family before everyone else.

feats.scene: Torrn raps his cane on the table and three bodyguards leap to work.
Torrn sits through a hostile interrogation without a flicker of worry.

name: Ausial
summary: Ausial is a vast cosmic force that settles into a dying alien pilot and tries to guide the world toward peace. Ausial gives its host flickering power while pulling the strings from a place beyond sight.

feats.scene: Ausial pours light through its host and burns a canyon through a mountain range.
Ausial endures a stellar flare with its host body glowing but whole.

name: Sersesrnu
summary: Sersesrnu is a green-eyed demon in a family of squabbling brothers who gather in the underworld for gatherings and picnics. Sersesrnu is jealous of everything and is easily tricked into brawling with his own siblings.

feats.scene: Sersesrnu hurls a flaming boulder across the cavern and splits a pillar of obsidian.
Sersesrnu falls from a ledge of basalt and shakes it off with a snort.

name: Aunanurn
summary: Aunanurn is a scientist-turned-criminal who taps a hidden current of velocity and runs in a sulphur-yellow costume. Aunanurn is accused of being a hero in disguise by his own crew of thieves.

feats.scene: Aunanurn sprints into a vault door and tears it from its mount.
Aunanurn is knocked cold and unmasked by a lucky swing of a bottle.
Aunanurn blurs across a casino floor and is gone before the dice stop rolling.

name: Nenco
summary: Nenco is a mad inventor from the far future who rides a surge of speed and reaches back to plague a family of runners. Nenco allies with a space-ring villain to swap places with rivals and send them to prison.

feats.scene: Nenco charges a vibrating blow and drills a hole through a reinforced bank wall.
Nenco is flung through a billboard and rolls to his feet in a flash.
Nenco outpaces a jet fighter across the desert and laughs at the dust.

name: Nallu
summary: Nallu is a shambling gestalt of thousands of living brains, stitched into one body to serve a distant tyrant. Nallu hurls psychic and physical blasts, reshapes his limbs and flies, and dies only if every brain does.

feats.scene: Nallu focuses a psychic storm that tears the facade off a skyscraper.
Nallu rebuilds his body mid-fall and takes a missile on the chest.

name: Vaarcol
summary: Vaarcol is a centuries-old blade assassin infused with a mineral alloy that mends flesh again and again, powered by body heat. Vaarcol lost his post for sloppiness and is hungry to win back standing.

feats.scene: Vaarcol hurls five knives in a fan and pins a fleeing target to the wall.
Vaarcol is hurled from a skyscraper ledge and rises, bones knitting back.

name: Rautir
summary: Rautir is a calm island physician in a nation of warrior women, trained with bow, blade and horse yet happiest with poultices. Rautir mends comrades after battles and carries the blessing of two goddesses.

feats.scene: Rautir draws a bow and sends an arrow through a practice shield.
Rautir takes a sword cut across her arm and finishes bandaging a patient.

name: Enunus
summary: Enunus is a lab-grown agent blended from several heroic donors who works for a hidden agency and jokes with her two sisters. Enunus is strong, quick and tough enough to topple a hero with a distraction.

feats.scene: Enunus slams a car door through a windshield and grabs the shopping cart with a baby clone inside.
Enunus tumbles off a rooftop and sprints toward the getaway car.

name: Iasve
summary: Iasve is a blue-haired alchemist who was sent to a school of brews as a girl and can mix a potion for love, sleep or revival. Iasve is a loyal helper to a scruffy occultist and bears the cost of every botched resurrection.

feats.scene: Iasve shatters a vial of volatile salts and blows the door off a crypt.
Iasve sinks into an enchanted coma and breathes slowly for weeks.

name: Torsiuora
summary: Torsiuora is a greedy chrono-thief who learned to bend minutes and centuries, plundering every age he can reach. Torsiuora lugs stolen weapons from the far future and rules a palace outside the stream of days.

feats.scene: Torsiuora freezes a battlefield between two ticks and smashes a fortress with arrows plucked from tomorrow.
Torsiuora is caught under a collapsing roof and steps sideways into an earlier hour.

name: Riaole
summary: Riaole is a blond temporal engineer who haunts a ship graveyard and constructs a machine meant to rewrite history. Riaole remembers futures that never happened and wears a suit that shields him from paradox.

feats.scene: Riaole powers up a mechanism and a wing of the wreckage rewinds into whole condition.
Riaole is blasted by a salvage crew and the suit disperses the hit.

name: Stnenria
summary: Stnenria is a sullen orphan with a ghostly talent that flows through a host child and pretends to be a friendly vigilante. Stnenria shows his true colours after earning a team's trust and then turns on them.

feats.scene: Stnenria hurls a burst of raw force that dents a patrol car and sends cops sprawling.
Stnenria is hit by a tranquilliser volley and keeps going on adrenaline.

name: Velasor
summary: Velasor is a blond mage born from light and shadow, aged into manhood almost at once. Velasor draws power from both lamp and gloom, though he never inherited his mother's famous strength.

feats.scene: Velasor gathers dusk and dawn in his hands and detonates a spire of crystal.
Velasor stands within a ward of shimmering force as the cavern caves in.

name: Colsorlu
summary: Colsorlu is a masked mediator raised by rival cosmic forces to keep them level, who burned out and began enforcing balance with traps and giant scales. Colsorlu dangles captives over fire to prove his point.

feats.scene: Colsorlu tips a colossal scale and a platform of molten stone drops into the dark.
Colsorlu is struck by a flurry of gadgets and answers with a shrug.

name: Rireo
summary: Rireo is a mammoth cyborg mercenary clad in synthetic skin over a metal frame, grown in a hidden bunker and unleashed to test travellers. Rireo has red eyes, bone talons and limbs that regrow.

feats.scene: Rireo tears a rail wagon in half with bare claws.
Rireo is hit by a flying kick and a chop that severs an arm, then regrows it.

name: Valntiton
summary: Valntiton is a mechanical enforcer built to police a conquered world for a ruling dynasty and the face of its harsh purity. Valntiton is strong, fast and airborne, and fires energy bolts at prisoners.

feats.scene: Valntiton fires a lance of white energy and rips open a prison gate.
Valntiton walks through a collapsing bunker with only a smoking shoulder plate.
Valntiton streaks over a plain in pursuit of escapees.

name: Annese
summary: Annese is a spectral guardian that gathers a fallen hero's body into a glowing matrix and fails to revive him. Annese asks his widow to share a body and carry on the fight, and the two merge hand to hand.

feats.scene: Annese channels glowing energy through a joined hand and lifts a collapsed overpass.
Annese endures the heat of the burning matrix without flinching.

name: Eocorleo
summary: Eocorleo is a living copy built from a dead hero's blueprint, keeping a quiet watch in an arctic hall of crystal. Eocorleo took the vanished champion's place in a bleak alternate timeline where everyone forgot the original.

feats.scene: Eocorleo punches a rogue asteroid fragment out of the sky and it shatters over empty sea.
Eocorleo is hit by a runaway train and keeps walking toward the horizon.
Eocorleo races a missile along the coast and arrives first.

name: Ronllelu
summary: Ronllelu is a dark-haired war machine built to purify a conquered homeland, scornful of any hero who loves the adopted world. Ronllelu flies, hits like a freight train and believes a hero's death is a fair price for a rebirth.

feats.scene: Ronllelu drives a fist into a bridge pylon and the span sags into the river.
Ronllelu is hit by a collapsing tower crane and the steel bends around her.
Ronllelu tears across the sky above a harbour in a straight line.

name: Vataleol
summary: Vataleol is a ragged preacher who founded a doomsday faith and claims the dead whisper orders to him. Vataleol preaches purification by flame and leads the faithful into a hospital riot.

feats.scene: Vataleol slashes a straight razor across a locked door and rattles it off its latch.
Vataleol takes a beating from orderlies and keeps chanting through bloody teeth.

name: Sianumnum
summary: Sianumnum is the grey-skinned embodiment of darkness, a god who insists that when the last battle ends the shadows still remain. Sianumnum drags the dead to serve him and swallows daylight over entire kingdoms.

feats.scene: Sianumnum draws a veil of black across a whole continent and every flame on it dies.
Sianumnum is struck by a coalition of divine spears and the wounds fill with night.

name: Niaser
summary: Niaser is a bodiless spirit of unknown origin who drifts between towns and sometimes helps a team of heroes. Niaser can slip through walls and chat with the living, though no one can say whom he used to be.

feats.scene: Niaser pulls a crate across the floor with a chilly gust and blocks a doorway.
Niaser stays calm as a shotgun blast passes through his misty chest.

name: Temiau
summary: Temiau is a glowing criminal who commands raw energy in a bright suit and brags about being unbeatable. Temiau drains power plants and turns the stolen charge into crackling bolts.

feats.scene: Temiau siphons a substation and unleashes a crackling bolt that melts a patrol boat.
Temiau is struck by a rifle volley and the shots fizzle in his shimmer.

name: Orasisia
summary: Orasisia is a blue-skinned peacekeeper from a distant harbour world who wields a ring of willpower and patrols a sector of stars. Orasisia falls in a battle against a swarm and is remembered by her sector.

feats.scene: Orasisia shapes a glowing wall and slams it through a hostile warship.
Orasisia takes a plasma volley on her shield and slides back across the deck.

name: Onttor
summary: Onttor is a grey-haired fighter pilot from two wars who flies a patched biplane and carries the grief of a lost son. Onttor is a ruthless duellist in the clouds and an honest one on the ground.

feats.scene: Onttor dives and rakes a convoy of lorries with machine-gun fire.
Onttor crash-lands in a field and climbs out coughing but whole.

name: Ntirer
summary: Ntirer is a blond ex-soldier who ran a warehouse, then ended up in a strange dimension after a reckless lorry cut him off. Ntirer survives on field craft and bad-tempered resourcefulness.

feats.scene: Ntirer drives a knife into a rope bridge and drops a pursuer into the gorge.
Ntirer scrambles out of a mud slide after a night with no sleep.

name: Ialnumni
summary: Ialnumni is a quiet student at a boarding school who sketches glyphs and loves a good riddle. Ialnumni joins friends to explore hidden passages and never looks for a fight.

feats.scene: Ialnumni shoulders a stuck cellar door open after three tries.
Ialnumni tumbles down a spiral stair and laughs it off with a scraped palm.

name: Ritiute
summary: Ritiute is a balding toymaker who carved two wooden figures and wished them to life against a hero. Ritiute fights with clockwork soldiers rather than his own bruised fists.

feats.scene: Ritiute winds a key and a tin soldier marches through a brick wall.
Ritiute is knocked off his workbench and clambers back, wheezing.

name: Sasornil
summary: Sasornil is a brown-haired thief who tags along with a villain gang and fusses over their schemes. Sasornil grabs what he can, runs when needed and defers to a talking gorilla.

feats.scene: Sasornil heaves a loot sack through a window and tumbles out after it.
Sasornil is flung into a stack of barrels and dusts himself off.

name: Coliumeo
summary: Coliumeo is a smirking showman who narrates his own scenes and hops out of reality through blank white voids. Coliumeo bends the stage, warps any room he enters and talks directly to the audience.

feats.scene: Coliumeo snaps his fingers and folds an entire street into a painted backdrop.
Coliumeo is shot at point blank range and the bullet turns into confetti.

name: Soncorntu
summary: Soncorntu is a bald, weightless scientist who unravelled his own existence and now preaches chaos as a cult of absurdity. Soncorntu rewrites streets, buildings and people on a whim.

feats.scene: Soncorntu declares a skyline absurd and the whole metropolis melts into a single glittering puddle.
Soncorntu is punched through the chest and the hole simply fails to exist.

name: Seosirna
summary: Seosirna is a tall gun-for-hire in a spider-print mask who accepts any contract and dies on a hard mission. Seosirna shoots from rooftops and slips through windows in the dark.

feats.scene: Seosirna fires a rifle across a courtyard and drops a target in one shot.
Seosirna absorbs a baton blow and scales a drainpipe anyway.

name: Tilen
summary: Tilen is a lonely assassin who lost a wife and a son and takes contracts to numb the silence. Tilen wears a spider-pattern costume and fights with hidden blades and cold reflexes.

feats.scene: Tilen throws a barbed dart and pins a guard's sleeve to a wooden beam.
Tilen drops two storeys onto a fire escape and rolls to his feet.

name: Listra
summary: Listra is a freelance killer who joins a crowd of mercenaries chasing a huge reward on a famous hero. Listra works for a billionaire and values payment above any grudge.

feats.scene: Listra empties a pistol at a moving limousine and punctures all four tyres.
Listra staggers from a thrown crate and fires back anyway.

name: Rauntlla
summary: Rauntlla is a gentle elder from a far-off century who founded a famous family of sprinters through his descendants. Rauntlla lacks any power himself, but his line carries a legacy of speed.

feats.scene: Rauntlla pushes a heavy garden gate shut against a rising wind.
Rauntlla sits unfazed as a toppling bookshelf bounces off his shoulders.

name: Tiacor
summary: Tiacor is a former parole officer who still checks on the people he once supervised, trusting few colleagues. Tiacor works the beat with patience and a battered notebook.

feats.scene: Tiacor tackles a runner on a wet pavement and pins him in a doorway.
Tiacor takes a hit from a cheap pipe and holds the line.

name: Ninser
summary: Ninser is a poised aristocrat who runs a clandestine syndicate and a corporate empire behind a charming marriage. Ninser issues orders in a velvet voice and never touches a weapon herself.

feats.scene: Ninser pushes a letter opener through a contract and pins a rival's hand beside it.
Ninser sits through a gunfight in her office without a hair out of place.

name: Leoeonvor
summary: Leoeonvor is a stiff, grey-haired field marshal of a collapsing empire who takes an experimental gas to win a lost war. Leoeonvor dies in a duel against a warrior woman on a wrecked airfield.

feats.scene: Leoeonvor swings a sabre in a frenzy and cleaves a table in two.
Leoeonvor takes a hammering from a steel plate and stays standing.

name: Varnimi
summary: Varnimi is a blond henchman from a hellish industrial world who serves a sadistic torturer. Varnimi snaps his chains, hauls the weight and relishes his master's orders.

feats.scene: Varnimi swings a barbed chain and wrecks a rank of stone pillars.
Varnimi takes a blast of furnace flame and keeps grinning.

name: Tesonos
summary: Tesonos is a pink-haired alien from a backwards world who speaks in opposites and says goodbye when she means hello. Tesonos leads a mirror-image team and hurls glowing bolts with cheerful clumsiness.

feats.scene: Tesonos fires a green bolt from her palms and flattens a row of vending machines.
Tesonos sits on a falling anvil and thanks it for the kind gesture.

name: Numval
summary: Numval is a grey-haired biology scholar who stumbled on lost notes about mutation and tried the process on himself. Numval evolves faster than he can think and fights as part of an angry rebellion.

feats.scene: Numval sprouts thick spurs and rips a steel locker door in half.
Numval grows a shell of bone in time to shrug off a heavy rifle round.

name: Vanuta
summary: Vanuta is a blond burglar who disguises himself in a mask of false smiles and joins a club of wealthy collectors. Vanuta steals trophies and flees across rooftops.

feats.scene: Vanuta swings from a chandelier and kicks a display case into splinters.
Vanuta is smacked off a balcony and clutches a rail to avoid falling.

name: Lloirn
summary: Lloirn is a red-haired crimelord who inherited a feud-ridden family and mourns her twin. Lloirn runs smuggling, bribery and revenge from a pub backroom.

feats.scene: Lloirn hurls a whiskey bottle across the room and breaks a rival's nose.
Lloirn takes a slap and answers with a grin and a bigger bounty.

name: Iuliro
summary: Iuliro is a vain, balding goddess of squabbling who throws banquets for the sole purpose of starting arguments. Iuliro hurls fate-twisting pettiness and shakes mountains with a tantrum.

feats.scene: Iuliro hurls a golden apple and a valley erupts in a feud of brawling statues.
Iuliro takes a hammer swing from a rival deity and laughs off the crater.

name: Tellorco
summary: Tellorco is a red-eyed deity of rivalry and quarrels who sours any gathering with a single whisper. Tellorco turns allies against each other and enjoys the aftermath.

feats.scene: Tellorco whispers to two armies and both turn their spears on their own camps.
Tellorco is struck by a javelin and the point turns to dust against her skin.

name: Rnllusau
summary: Rnllusau is a bald, green-eyed goddess of conflict who sits on a high mountain throne and sets mortals on edge. Rnllusau stays neutral and delights in clashes between pantheons.

feats.scene: Rnllusau tosses a gleaming coin and a nearby crag splits into jagged shards.
Rnllusau stays seated while a thunderbolt strikes her throne.

name: Tirstiva
summary: Tirstiva is a red-skinned, purple-haired being from a shadowed realm, born to a nameless parent and a restless brother. Tirstiva shares power with a spiritual force and breeds trouble wherever she walks.

feats.scene: Tirstiva hurls a crimson spear and a stone arch collapses in the courtyard.
Tirstiva steps through a rain of fire and emerges unscorched.

name: Cimon
summary: Cimon is a veteran recruiter for a corps of space guardians, seen only through memory. Cimon trained a huge rookie with a stubborn will and sent him out to the stars.

feats.scene: Cimon sculpts a green girder from willpower and drops it on a pirate frigate.
Cimon holds a pocket shield as the pirate cannons pound it.

name: Nuneaul
