summary: Nuneaul is a red-haired, orange-skinned drill sergeant who barks at recruits and falls in battle before rising again as a husk. Nuneaul treats a bad cadet as a personal insult and a good one as a miracle.

feats.scene: Nuneaul slams a glowing construct onto a training field and the dust cloud blots out the sky.
Nuneaul takes a blast meant for a rookie and keeps shouting orders.

name: Valcesti
summary: Valcesti is a card-themed thug in a powered frame that boosts his strength and fires a beam from one arm. Valcesti works as the muscle in a gang of themed robbers.

feats.scene: Valcesti punches a vault door in its frame and the hinge screams.
Valcesti is thrown through a shop front and the frame takes the blow.

name: Astrn
summary: Astrn is a cheerful teen sidekick from a wartime team who grew up to be a career officer and keeps a boyish grin. Astrn shouts battle cries, throws grenades and remembers an old guardian with fondness.

feats.scene: Astrn lobs a grenade across a ravine and cracks a gun nest apart.
Astrn picks himself up from a mortar blast and checks his boots.

name: Vitava
summary: Vitava is a plain, brown-haired clerk who ended up inside a living painting and obsesses over strangers' facial hair. Vitava scouts for beards and presents a pleasant face in awkward situations.

feats.scene: Vitava shoves a filing cabinet across the floor to block a doorway.
Vitava trips over a rug and bounces off a radiator without a scratch.

name: Nenora
summary: Nenora is a clean-faced vigilante who cannot grow a beard and wages war on bearded lawbreakers with a razor. Nenora stalks victims at night and shaves them before the police arrive.

feats.scene: Nenora tackles a bearded runner over a fence and pins him with a knee.
Nenora is hit by a bottle and keeps hunting through the dark.

name: Rerisre
summary: Rerisre is the stretchy son of a famous rubbery hero in a world where the old guard has died. Rerisre takes up the family trade, dates a shape-changing woman and keeps a good-natured grin.

feats.scene: Rerisre stretches an arm across a street and wrenches a mailbox out of the ground.
Rerisre is crushed by a falling girder and slowly reinflates.

name: Stineser
summary: Stineser is a seven-foot janitor with golden armour, who got a sidekick's cape after an amnesia episode. Stineser sweeps floors by day and rescues cities in the evening with a goofy grin.

feats.scene: Stineser swings a mop handle and demolishes a row of warehouses in one sweep.
Stineser is rammed by a wrecking ball and mutters about the mess.

name: Sereoeol
summary: Sereoeol is a retired heavyweight who once boxed professionally and now throws punches for hire in a dock district. Sereoeol can drive a fist through a brick wall without wincing.

feats.scene: Sereoeol hits a brick wall and leaves a hole the size of a dinner plate.
Sereoeol takes a baseball bat to the chin and grunts.

name: Nansanco
summary: Nansanco is a monocled general who served a doomed regime and carried the war into the underworld after death. Nansanco commands armoured legions of the damned and has a taste for blazing tanks.

feats.scene: Nansanco orders a barrage and a ridge of black rock explodes under the guns.
Nansanco is hit by a flaming shell and waves the smoke away.

name: Stianne
summary: Stianne is a bald wartime informant who stole secrets, was caught and lived in prison for thirty years. Stianne never fought a duel and relied on a smooth tongue and forged papers.

feats.scene: Stianne shoves a guard aside and runs for a waiting car.
Stianne spends a winter in a damp cell and comes out grey but alive.

name: Stiore
summary: Stiore is a blond love god who shoots arrows of desire and has been married and divorced more than once. Stiore can make armies melt into embraces and has gone by humble human names to meddle.

feats.scene: Stiore looses a golden arrow and two warring fleets tangle into a single celebration.
Stiore stands in a hail of spears and giggles as they bend aside.

name: Sonaucor
summary: Sonaucor is a mellow love deity with mixed eye and hair colours, born to a warlike father and a mysterious mother. Sonaucor pierces hearts with a flick of the wrist and soothes brawls.

feats.scene: Sonaucor shoots a glowing arrow at a battle and the front line sits down to sing.
Sonaucor shrugs off a collapsing colonnade of marble.

name: Nanirn
summary: Nanirn is a bald hunter warped by radiation after a global war who tracks prey across a ruined world. Nanirn once bought the best weapons and now stalks the wastes with a crazed sense of purpose.

feats.scene: Nanirn fires a heavy cannon and blows a truck apart in the dust.
Nanirn is thrown through a rusted wall and tears up a strip of metal as he rises.

name: Rnoriare
summary: Rnoriare is a blue-skinned, purple-haired minor god, son of the sea and the goddess of love, bound to the underworld. Rnoriare was once slain and revived, and remains calm about it.

feats.scene: Rnoriare raises a wave from a dark pool and drowns a stone quarry.
Rnoriare takes a spear through the shoulder and pulls it out with a wince.

name: Rnillnum
summary: Rnillnum is the trickster god of luck and chance, a joker among his siblings who opens crossroads and shuts doors on the greedy. Rnillnum bends odds so every coin lands his way.

feats.scene: Rnillnum rolls a pair of bones and a whole mountain of rock slides in the exact shape he wagered.
Rnillnum is skewered by a hunter's spear and the point somehow misses every vital part.

name: Llica
summary: Llica is a black-haired frontier witch who cursed a settlement and left a legacy for a descendant. Llica brews dust storms, calls crows and dies hunted by a lone gunman.

feats.scene: Llica whips up a dust devil that tears a barn roof off its beams.
Llica is hit by a rifle shot and sags but keeps cackling.

name: Amliium
summary: Amliium is a black-haired devotee of a strange cult who brawls on behalf of a lizard-themed idol. Amliium throws punches in the streets and burns at the cult's feasts.

feats.scene: Amliium swings a chair into a bouncer and clears the doorway.
Amliium takes a punch to the jaw and spits out a tooth.

name: Iuulir
summary: Iuulir is an immortal shaman with a taste for debts and a quiet home in a crowded city. Iuulir lends spells in exchange for favours and has outlived many borrowers.

feats.scene: Iuulir chants over a fire and a surge of spirit flame rips a van into scrap.
Iuulir lets a hail of bullets pass through her chest and carries on stirring tea.

name: Rnneia
summary: Rnneia is a hermit spirit woven from lightless smoke, raised in a mountain cloister and now wandering the high passes. She can thin into vapour to slip through stone and keeps a cold, patient temper toward anyone who tries to chase her out of the dark.

feats.scene: Rnneia pours her whole body into a black tide that splits a stone bridge in two.
Rnneia scatters into mist as a landslide passes through her and then draws herself whole again.

name: Niuiutan
summary: Niuiutan is a street mage who bends his own flesh into new forms and shelters outcasts from the authorities in a derelict depot. His craft is rough and half understood, but he is loyal to those he hides.

feats.scene: Niuiutan reshapes his arm into a hammer and caves in a steel shutter.
Niuiutan takes a thrown crate on his softened chest and walks it off.

name: Ntime
summary: Ntime is a small, kindly and perpetually flustered embassy clerk who saves his wages to bring his family abroad. He has no powers at all and survives on good manners and luck.

feats.scene: Ntime shoves a jammed filing cabinet shut with one clumsy swing of his shoulder.
Ntime tumbles down a flight of stairs with a tray of cups and stands up unhurt.

name: Telorcil
summary: Telorcil is a greedy ex-daredevil flier who robs cargo and laboratories from the air. Rigged with a jet harness, she treats every heist as a stunt and kills without a flicker of remorse.

feats.scene: Telorcil rakes a transport helicopter with cannon fire until its cabin is a wreck.
Telorcil rides out a crash landing on a runway and limps off with a grin.
Telorcil banks her stolen plane low across the field faster than any chase car.

name: Amseor
summary: Amseor is an ancient schemer who boasts of swallowing a secret tonic and outliving centuries of history. Behind his walls he is nothing but a brittle old man who mistakes cunning for strength.

feats.scene: Amseor flings a heavy ledger across his study with a shaking arm.
Amseor endures one hard slap that his frail skull cannot answer.

name: Colla
summary: Colla is a teenage museum helper who can stretch like warm taffy and plays rescuer around town. His body pays a terrible price for the gift, ageing far faster than any child should.

feats.scene: Colla lashes an arm out half a block and snatches a bag from a fleeing thief.
Colla wraps himself around a runaway van and stretches until it stops.

name: Ereiarall
summary: Ereiarall is a small-town lawman who slid from duty into crime, shooting a rich patron and pinning it on an old schoolmate. He has no gifts beyond a badge, a pistol and a good reputation that he squandered.

feats.scene: Ereiarall fires his service revolver at close range across a quiet office.
Ereiarall is flung against a squad car and still reaches for his holster.

name: Niune
summary: Niune is a scarred former child-minder and failed screen hopeful who stages her murders like silent films. She dresses in monochrome glamour and answers to a hidden backer who funds her fantasies.

feats.scene: Niune sweeps a prop sabre through a stage curtain and the man behind it.
Niune hits the theatre floor from a balcony rail and rises to take her bow.

name: Celvostor
summary: Celvostor is a dry, careful physician who helps a mad professor build unnatural creatures in a sealed lab. She keeps her curiosity narrow and prefers not to ask where the orders lead.

feats.scene: Celvostor drives a syringe through a tough hide on the first try.
Celvostor is knocked flat by a startled test subject and gets up to adjust her glasses.

name: Austor
summary: Austor is a horned fiend who joins a rebel cause, hitting hard enough to bloody a demigod and spitting brimstone from his throat. Wounds knit shut on him and he does not die of age.

feats.scene: Austor exhales a torrent of fire that melts a convoy of armoured trucks.
Austor crashes through a concrete wall from a single punch and licks the blood from his lip.

name: Strum
summary: Strum is a fanged brick-bodied fiend sharing a mortal host, picked for team-ups by cheerful toy-block heroes. He leaps far, heals quickly and cannot abide the touch of iron.

feats.scene: Strum hurls a boulder-sized slab of masonry that flattens a gatehouse.
Strum is buried under a collapsing tower and claws his way out laughing.

name: Tortir
summary: Tortir is a tiny winged fiend kept as a pet by a mischievous boy sorcerer. He flutters along on visits and sneezes out bright gouts of flame when annoyed.

feats.scene: Tortir hiccups a jet of flame that torches a garden shed.
Tortir bounces off a closing door and shakes his horns as if nothing happened.

name: Lenluos
summary: Lenluos is a tall, many-times-exiled fiend of royal blood, speaking in ragged couplets and bound to a human wanderer by an old magician. A rebel against his own court, he has served several banners and trusts none.

feats.scene: Lenluos brings a cavern roof down on an invading host with a single stamp.
Lenluos wades unmarked through a volcanic collapse and rhymes his scorn.

name: Cornau
summary: Cornau is a horned, red-eyed fiend who changes form on demand and works rough sorcery with claws and fangs. He turns up in cartoon crime stories as a menace for the local vigilante.

feats.scene: Cornau rakes his claws down a lamppost and slices it clean through.
Cornau is rammed by a truck and only gets angrier.

name: Iartelri
summary: Iartelri is a cheerful pint-sized imp who lives deep underground and befriends children who share his love of flames. He speaks in sing-song and lights up when someone sets their hair alight.

feats.scene: Iartelri flares his hands and roasts a pile of sticks in a blink.
Iartelri sits in a bonfire and asks for more logs.

name: Savent
summary: Savent is a fog-bound city worker whose husband drank their money away and vanished. She sold what she had to eat and was rescued from a killer by a kind gentleman who made her a nursemaid.

feats.scene: Savent slaps a drunk customer hard enough to drop him on the cobbles.
Savent scrambles through a narrow alley after a hard fall and keeps running.

name: Llustu
summary: Llustu is a stern castle priest who keeps a brotherhood of fanatics and the secrets they hide. His strength is doctrine and patience, not muscle.

feats.scene: Llustu strikes the stone floor with his staff and the sound rings through the hall.
Llustu kneels in an icy chapel overnight and rises without a shiver.

name: Reoanuveo
summary: Reoanuveo is a seasoned island swordswoman and horse rider who meets an invading force with discipline. She falls in a battle against greater odds, still holding her blade.

feats.scene: Reoanuveo cleaves a wooden shield and the soldier behind it with one downward cut.
Reoanuveo shrugs off a musket ball that rattles her breastplate.

name: Niuaul
summary: Niuaul is a deathless island fighter who wears a pair of bracelets and shares her friend's cause. Her hands are quick and her old wounds never seem to matter.

feats.scene: Niuaul snaps a spear shaft over her knee and drives the head home.
Niuaul deflects a stream of bullets off her bracelets without breaking stride.

name: Nuseo
summary: Nuseo is a temple keeper who works out why her sisters are turning to stone and sends a plea to the gods. Her skill lies in reading omens, though she can fight if pressed.

feats.scene: Nuseo hurls a ceremonial spear through a bronze door.
Nuseo stands in a cold rain of falling marble dust and keeps chanting.

name: Rnreoium
summary: Rnreoium is a quiet schoolboy in a big foster family who, with his siblings, can shout a word and become a lightning-wielding adult hero. In that form he flies, hits hard and is very hard to hurt.

feats.scene: Rnreoium dives onto a parked bus and crushes it flat with a single landing.
Rnreoium takes a falling billboard on his back and brushes the glass off.
Rnreoium streaks over the suburbs and breaks the sound barrier with a crack.

name: Siteamo
summary: Siteamo is a bookish boy who, joined by five friends, becomes one thunderous giant champion by speaking a magic word together. His share of the gift is deep wisdom.

feats.scene: Siteamo, merged with his friends, lifts a derailed train car over his head and sets it down.
Siteamo tanks a blast that cracks a bridge pier and then smiles at his friends.

name: Vosll
summary: Vosll is a gentle, disfigured teenager who wants only to be left alone and loved. He holds no powers, only a stubborn kindness in a very cruel world.

feats.scene: Vosll pushes a stuck door open with all his weight.
Vosll is beaten by a pack of older boys and picks up his glasses afterwards.

name: Ntnuria
summary: Ntnuria is a giddy mind-reader who drinks other people's sorrow and turns it into raw force. The more misery he swallows the stronger and madder he becomes, until he tries to feed on a whole city.

feats.scene: Ntnuria condenses the grief of thousands into a white pulse that gouges a plaza.
Ntnuria stands gleaming in a storm of rubble as it parts around his aura.

name: Sirrnull
summary: Sirrnull is a winged weather god with pink skin and pale eyes, lord of the morning gales from the horizon. He bonds his spirit to a mortal girl so that she may outlast her own death.

feats.scene: Sirrnull exhales a gale that lifts a fleet of ships and drops them far inland.
Sirrnull stands unmoved in the eye of a hurricane he did not make.

name: Irnorana
summary: Irnorana is a snake-haired monster who haunts a maze with her sister and preys on lost travellers. Old legend clings to her, though a mortal hunter finally ends her.

feats.scene: Irnorana lunges and pins a wanderer to a wall with her talons.
Irnorana is struck by a thrown spear and keeps hissing.

name: Collino
summary: Collino is a lean warrior from an island of archers who befriends a young visitor she is meant to train. She holds no grudge when that friend refuses to join the war party.

feats.scene: Collino looses three arrows in the time it takes to blink.
Collino is thrown through a market stall in a brawl and rolls upright.

name: Lonern
summary: Lonern is a young bride whose death breaks her musician husband's heart. She appears mostly in memory, a pale figure in a tale of loss and song.

feats.scene: Lonern tosses a handful of grain across a threshing floor.
Lonern collapses from a snakebite and gives way to the dark.

name: Llolle
summary: Llolle is a blond twin enforcer hired to break a poisoner out of her cell with a miracle seed tonic. She is nimble enough to dodge pistol fire while hurling blades.

feats.scene: Llolle flicks three knives into a wooden beam in a tight cluster.
Llolle takes a vicious beating and is still on her feet to count the cash.

name: Tonlueo
summary: Tonlueo is a corporate aide who carries a secret life as a spy, casting mental masks that make her look like someone else. She turns on her bosses and pays for it.

feats.scene: Tonlueo hurls a desk lamp across a boardroom to cover her escape.
Tonlueo grits her teeth through a hard fall down a stairwell.

name: Nolar
summary: Nolar is a worried hospital administrator and divorced mother who frets over her daughter after a traumatic night. She has no unusual gifts and no desire for any.

feats.scene: Nolar slams a ledger onto a desk to end an argument.
Nolar takes a tumble on a wet corridor floor and laughs it off.

name: Vaoraeon
summary: Vaoraeon is a pink-eyed automaton girl with hazy memories of her own ending. Her nano-built body mimics living tissue so well that even expert tinkerers puzzle over it.

feats.scene: Vaoraeon punches a hole through a bulkhead that a crew could not cut.
Vaoraeon holds up a collapsing gantry and walks out of the dust unscratched.

source_title: Eva the Daughter of Tomorrow (Prime Earth)

name: Nenseoiar
summary: Nenseoiar is a rich socialite and former medal-winning tumbler who steals paintings by night. He later throws a fortune into a bog rather than keep money tainted by death.

feats.scene: Nenseoiar vaults a rail and kicks a guard off a rooftop ledge.
Nenseoiar rolls off a gallery skylight and lands lightly on his feet.

name: Lasrauveo
summary: Lasrauveo is a baby born of strange glowing rocks who ages in days, racing toward an early grave. His birth blast wipes out his mother and her car.

feats.scene: Lasrauveo bursts in a white flash that vaporises a car in an open field.
Lasrauveo lies unharmed in the crater of his own making.

name: Cornumra
summary: Cornumra is a roguish thief with a glass-bending gadget that lets him slip into a reflected realm and crop up in many places. He is a coward at heart and bargains for survival in a plague-ridden world.

feats.scene: Cornumra fires his gadget and splinters a wall of windows into a bright storm.
Cornumra slips into a pane just ahead of a lunging horde.

name: Eovor
summary: Eovor is an orange-skinned patrol officer from a star-faring commonwealth who investigates a lost rescue beacon. She is loyal to her partner and sometimes too quick to assume a stranger is raving.

feats.scene: Eovor stuns an armoured fugitive with a pulse from her sidearm that scorches the wall behind him.
Eovor takes a bruising hit from a powered fist and keeps her footing.

name: Eonri
summary: Eonri is a raven-haired first mother who has outlived empires and keeps company with a lord of dreams. She tells stories to the dead and the living alike and is never afraid of the proud.

feats.scene: Eonri heaves a stone slab aside to bury a grieving child's brother.
Eonri walks barefoot through a collapsing desert pavilion and emerges untouched.

name: Ianlleo
summary: Ianlleo is a deathless woman present at the dawn of her people, a teller of tales who keeps a home inside a realm of dreams. Her calm comes from having seen it all.

feats.scene: Ianlleo shakes a heavy rug and a whole season of dust flies out.
Ianlleo sits unmoved as a ceiling of dream-stone comes down around her.

name: Sevas
summary: Sevas is a blond college girl who once ran errands for a military office and was blackmailed into handing over a secret report. She later makes amends among a loud group of loyal classmates.

feats.scene: Sevas snatches an envelope and sprints across a station platform.
Sevas runs headlong into a crowd of classmates and is pinned but unhurt.

name: Sorti
summary: Sorti is a naval officer's daughter and trained nurse who flies a fighting submarine-plane beside her fiance. She is a crack shot who can snap a chain across a room.

feats.scene: Sorti fires one pistol round that severs a chain across a warehouse.
Sorti rides out a rough sea landing and tends the wounded afterward.

name: Ntoriill
summary: Ntoriill is a grey-haired mother whose son died in a cruel experiment. Grief pushes her and her husband to take revenge on a radio personality before they give themselves up.

feats.scene: Ntoriill hands over the pistol that ends a broadcast mid-sentence.
Ntoriill sits through a long night of questioning without flinching.

name: Annto
summary: Annto is a masked adventurer and politician's daughter who holds a seat on an elite hero squad while her mother's memory fades. She resents being told to hang up the cape.

feats.scene: Annto drives a flying kick into a tunnel wall beside a masked rival.
Annto takes a brutal beating from a stronger fighter and still stares him down.

name: Talos
summary: Talos is a gloom-wielding vigilante drafted into a gladiator contest by a cruel overseer. She tries to save a double and is torn apart by a swarm of living darkness.

feats.scene: Talos hurls a wave of living gloom that flattens a squad of gladiators.
Talos is pinned beneath a swarm that tears at her limbs until she bleeds out.

name: Leostton
summary: Leostton is a crime-fighting recruit in a team bent on ending all villains for good. She dies in the burst of a vast energy release that scours a whole plain.

feats.scene: Leostton cracks a restraining baton across a captive's jaw.
Leostton is shoved to the ground by a lurching prisoner and rolls up again.

name: Tiuast
summary: Tiuast is a half-royal fighter of two worlds who steps through gloom to open doors anywhere. She reads like a ghost in a body of living night and has trained her hands as well as her magic.

feats.scene: Tiuast opens a rift under a warship and drops it into a canyon.
Tiuast turns to a silhouette as a demolition charge bursts through her.

name: Estor
summary: Estor is an elder being of vast might who was walled away until a disturbance freed her. She bends reality, hurls raw force and nearly levels a capital before her own will ends it.

feats.scene: Estor rewrites a boulevard into glass and blasts a whole district to dust.
Estor strolls through a barrage of heroes' blows without a mark.

name: Oroteam
summary: Oroteam is a wingless princess of a hidden frozen city who escapes its conquerors and takes a plain new name. She wants only a normal life among ordinary classmates.

feats.scene: Oroteam clambers into a cargo hold and heaves a crate aside to hide behind it.
Oroteam endures a bitter blizzard on the ice shelf and keeps running.

name: Asiranlan
summary: Asiranlan is a physician and mother who hides behind a borrowed name and a biotech lab while she hunts the wicked. A harsh past has convinced her that some lives are not worth saving.

feats.scene: Asiranlan plunges a scalpel through a mark's collar in one steady motion.
Asiranlan walks away from a wrecked sedan she rigged to flip on its owner.

name: Eorliutu
summary: Eorliutu is a teenager changed by a freak burst of radiation who feeds on the gifts of others. She drains their strength and slips into their bodies like a borrowed coat.

feats.scene: Eorliutu hurls a stolen surge of force that buckles a car like paper.
Eorliutu soaks a lightning bolt into her palms and grins at the sparks.

name: Serlli
summary: Serlli is a green-skinned, hairless henchman who bends minds with a stare to turn strangers into servants. His trick works on children but fails on anyone of sturdy will.

feats.scene: Serlli shoves a heavy door shut against a pursuing boy.
Serlli is bowled over by a fleeing crowd and sits up still smirking.

name: Tiuile
summary: Tiuile is a once-brilliant researcher who wrapped a band of captured starlight around his body to cheat death. The prize made him ageless and cruel, and he emptied his own homeland of life.

feats.scene: Tiuile drinks from the sky and unleashes a flare that scours a whole valley.
Tiuile hangs in orbit as a hail of rockets bursts against his glow.

name: Seleste
summary: Seleste is a dying man who bonded a black star to his chest and fed on the life around him, even the one he loved. He once burned a whole world and later finds himself caged away from light.

feats.scene: Seleste turns the star on a distant world and cracks it apart into drifting stone.
Seleste weathers a bombardment from a squad of jailers and keeps his grin.

name: Iumtal
summary: Iumtal is a vain prince of a lightless, lawless world who drains criminals to enslave honest folk. He grows glowing horns from a device that cloud minds and spit black beams.

feats.scene: Iumtal sweeps a black ray across a courtyard and melts a stone statue to slag.
Iumtal stands in the blast of a failed rebel cannon and straightens his cape.

name: Iasnum
summary: Iasnum is a disgraced future lawman who turned to crime and went by a grisly metallic nickname. Little is recorded of him beyond a short career and a quick end.

feats.scene: Iasnum swings a steel baton into a barricade and splits the plank.
Iasnum takes a hard tackle from a former colleague and does not fall.

name: Iumnenum
summary: Iumnenum is a white-haired mother from a world whose people bend metal with their will. She raised two gifted sons and dies when extremists bomb her street.

feats.scene: Iumnenum hauls a fallen girder off a trapped family with a sweep of her hand.
Iumnenum raises a humming dome that holds back a collapsing wall for a few breaths.

name: Rnecar
summary: Rnecar is a freelance killer for hire who tracks, stalks and shoots with equal skill. She goes after a whistleblower on a bridge and loses her grip in the end.

feats.scene: Rnecar fires a rifle through a train window at a fleeing clerk.
Rnecar plunges from a bridge rail into the river and surfaces coughing.

name: Arvau
summary: Arvau is an outcast island swordswoman who now wanders among a band of misfit fighters. She carries guilt for a child she failed and fights to balance it.

feats.scene: Arvau topples a charging scaled beast with a sweeping blade stroke.
Arvau is knocked over a wall by a rider's lance and climbs back to the fight.

name: Inusor
summary: Inusor is a black-haired killer in a secret guild who leads small squads and shoots straight. His career is brief and ends in the same quiet violence he dealt.

feats.scene: Inusor drives an open palm through a rack of wooden practice swords.
Inusor lands from a rooftop leap and rolls away from the pursuit.

name: Stilanora
summary: Stilanora is a hired gun with a pest-control gimmick who takes contracts from the shadows of the city. Few details survive about his methods beyond a taste for cheap theatrics.

feats.scene: Stilanora fires a spray gun that eats through a steel door.
Stilanora tumbles down a fire escape and is up before the clatter ends.

name: Aulsanirn
summary: Aulsanirn is a yellow-eyed sorcerer of an undersea kingdom who shelters his coven from the crushing deep. He conjures pockets of breathable air and projects distant illusions.

feats.scene: Aulsanirn folds the tide into a spinning spike that shreds a reef wall.
Aulsanirn sits in a bubble of air as the deep presses at its edges.

name: Talau
summary: Talau is a red-haired racketeer who can stretch his limbs like warm toffee. He answers to a ruthless crew and was once the evil mirror of a famous rubber detective.

feats.scene: Talau whips a long arm around a guard's neck and snaps him off his feet.
Talau absorbs a car's impact by flattening around it like a pillow.

source_title: Extruded Man (Crisis on Two Earths: Crime Syndicate Earth)

name: Rnsautel
summary: Rnsautel is a wartime gang boss, spy and mesmerist who once talked a man to his death. He tried to extract military secrets from a captured officer and slipped out of the record.

feats.scene: Rnsautel swings a heavy desk lamp at a pursuer and misses.
Rnsautel sits in a locked cell and watches the guard's lantern flicker.

name: Seolollu
summary: Seolollu is a mute, one-eyed woman rebuilt by a mysterious machine, who speaks only in the minds of others. She turns up beside a handful of lost travellers and protects them.

feats.scene: Seolollu knocks a brawler off a gantry with a hard shove.
Seolollu is crushed under a falling crate and pushes herself free in silence.

name: Amoeoor
summary: Amoeoor is a sightless burglar who works the night streets by touch and memory. He picks locks faster than most sighted men and slips away along familiar alleys.

feats.scene: Amoeoor shoves a rival off a fire escape with a hard push.
Amoeoor tumbles down a stairwell and carries on without a map.

name: Minanenu
summary: Minanenu is an ancient purple orb that stares across the sands and bends crowds into bird-headed slaves. Sealed for ages beneath the dunes, it hungers to rule the world.

feats.scene: Minanenu fires a violet beam that turns a city plaza to glass.
Minanenu shrugs off a barrage of tank fire and drifts on.

name: Orell
summary: Orell is a youthful diplomat of a sunken capital who knows the dry-world customs better than its own king. He rebuilds trust between peoples and honours the fallen with a monument.

feats.scene: Orell slams a gavel and the council chamber goes silent.
Orell stands calm as a panicked crowd presses him against a pillar.

name: Teuller
summary: Teuller is a yellow-eyed toy-like robot pet built by a young inventor and brought along to a clubhouse of animal companions. It is loyal, small and easily excited.

feats.scene: Teuller butts a toy chest across the floor with a whirr of gears.
Teuller is stepped on by a giggling child and pops back up dented.

name: Nilli
summary: Nilli is a brown-haired hero of the river banks who wears a straw hat and a loud blazer. He patrols the quays in a spirit of cheerful, slightly foolish duty.

feats.scene: Nilli swats a mugger with an oar and sends him over the railing.
Nilli falls into the canal and paddles home with his hat still on.

name: Aunliu
summary: Aunliu is a green-eyed machine-flesh killer who slips into a stranger's life, then sheds the mask when the moment arrives. She copies faces, spits corrosive fluid and takes punishment well.

feats.scene: Aunliu spits a jet of acid that dissolves a vault door.
Aunliu takes a barrage of rounds across her borrowed chest and keeps walking.

name: Stileo
summary: Stileo is an agent of a secret outfit who answers to a radical creed and keeps his face turned from the cameras. Little is kept about him beyond his orders.

feats.scene: Stileo fires a rifle across a courtyard and drops a lantern.
Stileo hits the cobbles after a long fall and rolls up unhurt.

name: Tiurniser
summary: Tiurniser is a bald teenage fighter whose mouth and eyes spit raw beams. He gets pulled into a dark arena and dies there for a cause.

feats.scene: Tiurniser opens his jaw and a bright lance blows a hole in a concrete pillar.
Tiurniser takes a thrown dumpster to the chest and wipes the rust from his lip.

name: Tiraes
summary: Tiraes is a grey-haired former prison warden whose body turned to cut gemstone. She hacks cameras, boasts over the airwaves and leads a gang bent on revenge.

feats.scene: Tiraes punches through the front of a bunker and collapses its roof.
Tiraes stands untouched as a missile strike turns the street to rubble.

name: Lloiumser
summary: Lloiumser is a cryptic crime-fighter who leaves puzzling clues for a muscular friend. He turns up at the edge of tragedy as a calm voice on a hotline.

feats.scene: Lloiumser tosses a bundled newspaper through a closing elevator gate.
Lloiumser sits in a rattling lift as it drops and steps out smiling.

name: Satiaul
summary: Satiaul is an old woman who swings her handbag at street thugs to help a battered boy. She hands over bus fare and a bit of wisdom about getting up again.

feats.scene: Satiaul whacks a gang member across the head with her handbag.
Satiaul stands her ground as a gang member shoves her against a wall.

name: Ntiselas
summary: Ntiselas is a green-eyed winged ruler of the tiny folk who answers a summons to fight against a blazing tyrant. Her magic is brisk and bright and her wings are quick.

feats.scene: Ntiselas flicks a spark of pale light that cracks an oak trunk.
Ntiselas shrugs off a swatted blow that would flatten a mortal.

name: Rimilia
summary: Rimilia is a spirited terrier who follows a famous leader through offices and trains. He has sharp nose, ears and teeth and a reputation for making headlines.

feats.scene: Rimilia lunges and snaps a slipper in half.
Rimilia tumbles off a train step and trots on without a limp.

name: Eolitil
summary: Eolitil is a blond field operative of a wartime spy bureau, rated among its best. His record is thin, but his reputation among colleagues is bright.

feats.scene: Eolitil fires a rifle round that spins a rusted weathervane.
Eolitil drops from a window ledge into a hedge and keeps running.

name: Asllitau
summary: Asllitau is a blond young fighter who trained in a flight harness to follow her mother's footsteps. She wakes from long sleep inside a simulated apocalypse and fights on.

feats.scene: Asllitau dives from her harness and kicks a gunman off a rooftop.
Asllitau hits a billboard at full speed and tears herself free.

name: Tentoolu
summary: Tentoolu is a brown-eyed senior fighter of a desert clan who shoots, rides and fights with a blade. She teaches by example and is trusted with the wall.

feats.scene: Tentoolu looses an arrow that splits a distant practice post.
Tentoolu is flung from her mount into a stone wall and gets back up.

name: Varsaau
summary: Varsaau is a self-styled master of costume and voice who takes the place of rich men to rob them. He also kidnaps a pop singer and runs a gang of goons.

feats.scene: Varsaau swings a sandbag at a pursuing detective.
Varsaau leaps from a balcony to a water tank and sprints away.

name: Telaman
summary: Telaman is a blue-eyed hired mimic who throws her voice and copies faces for infiltration. A paymaster sends her after a flier to steal her look, without success.

feats.scene: Telaman fires a pistol from behind a mirror and shatters a lamp.
Telaman tumbles from a window ledge and lands in a hedge.

name: Leveaul
summary: Leveaul is an eyeless grey-haired champion who learned to love life too much and sold her loyalty to a dark lord for endless years. She feasts on conquests and loudly savours every kill.

feats.scene: Leveaul lands in a crowded avenue and levels a dozen buildings in her feeding frenzy.
Leveaul laughs as a whole battalion's fire washes harmlessly over her.

name: Irnanti
summary: Irnanti is a superstitious thief who believes a lucky blade guides his crimes. He steals from steelworks and threatens two crime-fighters until help arrives.

feats.scene: Irnanti slashes a rope bridge in one swing of his charm sword.
Irnanti is tackled to the floor and clings to his lucky blade.

name: Arvacor
summary: Arvacor is a warlord of the far east who commands blade-and-bow infantry and a galley. His proudest weapon is a cannon that fires atomic shells, and it ultimately destroys his own fortress.

feats.scene: Arvacor fires his cannon and the shell turns his own fortress to ash.
Arvacor wrestles a captured prisoner against a wall and wins by weight.

name: Ninsesti
summary: Ninsesti is a red-eyed chemist and cult master in a foreign capital who brews waxen statues and giant brutes. He feigns his own death time and again and invents a machine that kills by sound.

feats.scene: Ninsesti switches on his sonic engine and a warehouse wall shatters in a ring of dust.
Ninsesti lies in a trance for days and wakes without help.

name: Lancorter
summary: Lancorter is a bald general in iron armour who leads a state squad of heroes. A battlefield veteran, he preaches the cost of war and hits with the weight of a tank.

feats.scene: Lancorter drives his fist through a robot's plated chest.
Lancorter stands unmoved as a falling girder rings off his helm.

name: Silsone
summary: Silsone is a gruff armoured commander with a soft heart, leading a team of state-sponsored fighters. He teams up with a caped detective to find a missing comrade and protect shaggy mountain creatures.

feats.scene: Silsone punches a boulder in a mountain pass and it bursts into gravel.
Silsone catches a falling ice slab on his shoulder and laughs.

source_title: Fang Zhifu (The Brave and the Bold)

name: Storetan
summary: Storetan is a faceless future thug who answers to a hooded order. Records give only a codename, a gang and a quick appearance.

feats.scene: Storetan flings a heavy crate into a corridor to stop a chase.
Storetan is thrown into a bulkhead and rises with a snarl.

name: Torso
summary: Torso is a red-haired seal housewife with a quick mind and a stage past. She balances heavy loads on her nose and keeps her husband out of trouble.

feats.scene: Torso flips a stack of crates off her nose and catches the top one.
Torso slips on a wet deck and bounces up with a laugh.

name: Tiaosva
summary: Tiaosva is a brown-haired warrior woman from a lost homeworld, freed from a spectral prison to seize a host body. She hopes to see a child of hers become a weapon against the planet she has landed on.

feats.scene: Tiaosva hurls a truck across a highway and flattens a toll booth.
Tiaosva stands unmoved as a gas tanker explodes around her.

name: Llian
summary: Llian is a master of a brutal pressure-point art who ran a slave camp before being locked away in a ghostly exile. She hates men and strikes with surgical cruelty.

feats.scene: Llian strikes a nerve cluster and a hulking opponent convulses across the room.
Llian takes a thundering blow to the ribs and answers with a smile.

name: Ninamose
summary: Ninamose is a loyal manhunter of a warlord's squad, skilled at spying, swords and firearms. She calls herself a tigress and falls fighting against zealots.

feats.scene: Ninamose slices a cloth banner and the stone pole behind it in one pass.
Ninamose takes a mob's crude blows and keeps stalking her mark.

name: Nunti
summary: Nunti is a young man electrocuted by a freak wave of energy who accidentally kills his friends. Embittered, he feeds on power lines and stolen strength and seeks revenge on his maker.

feats.scene: Nunti hurls a bolt that blacks out a whole substation and sets its transformer ablaze.
Nunti stands in a shower of sparks as the grid screams through him.

name: Iumcost
summary: Iumcost is a far-future keeper who tends a hollow relic from a drifting orbital outpost, watching a manufactured star for signs of unrest. Weary of inherited duty, the keeper bends the relic's beams to rewrite his own bloodline.

feats.scene: Iumcost fires the relic at a rogue patrol fleet and burns it from the sky in a single sweeping beam.
Iumcost stands unharmed as a collapsing docking ring crushes the platform around him.

name: Selltil
summary: Selltil is a ruthless temple aide who treats loyalty as a ladder, collecting followers while elders fade. Quick with accusations and slow to forgive, Selltil turns a tribe's fear of outsiders into a throne for a hired champion.

feats.scene: Selltil strikes a rival steward down with a ceremonial spear before the council can object.
Selltil walks away from a collapsing banquet hall with only bruises.

name: Tiarnrni
summary: Tiarnrni is a desert monarch who steadied a wandering people and then gambled that stability on a border war. Tiarnrni hides a fugitive agitator and jails an old founder, only to be overpowered in her own throne room.

feats.scene: Tiarnrni cleaves a training dummy and its stand in half with one royal blade swing.
Tiarnrni shrugs off a collapsing tent pole and a scatter of arrows during a siege drill.

name: Ntstu
summary: Ntstu is a shifting spirit of style who spins unsettling tales for anyone who lingers near her cauldron. Each decade Ntstu swaps costume, slogan and nickname to match whatever fad is loud, and she is missing one eye.

feats.scene: Ntstu stirs her cauldron and a bolt of stitched-together lightning scorches a tailor's shop front.
Ntstu sits unbothered while a wardrobe of enchanted coats collapses on her.

name: Rnuanlla
summary: Rnuanlla is a blond hired menace who bends the momentum of anything already moving. Hurled bricks, speeding cars and falling girders all swerve at Rnuanlla's whim, though still objects are beyond reach.

feats.scene: Rnuanlla redirects a skidding truck into a brick wall without touching it.
Rnuanlla survives a rooftop tumble with a sprained wrist.

name: Orsear
summary: Orsear is a calm, blond dealmaker who runs a trading house in a walled metropolis and speaks in long, patient sentences. Orsear never fights; every conflict is settled by contract, delay or a well-timed refusal.

feats.scene: Orsear slaps a ledger onto a desk hard enough to silence a boardroom.
Orsear takes a stumble down a marble staircase and stands back up to resume negotiating.

name: Nilamor
summary: Nilamor is a bald, heavyset street boss who leads a loud crew of painted joyriders through the avenues at night. Nilamor settles disputes with a thick fist and a louder laugh.

feats.scene: Nilamor drives a fist through a car window while the crew cheers.
Nilamor laughs off a crash that leaves a stolen sedan crumpled around him.

name: Lannansu
summary: Lannansu is the primordial father of every tide-god, an ocean given a face and a grudge. Lannansu grew furious at his children's endless inventions inside his waters, died of that rage, and now returns as a stern ferryman for proud deep-sea divinities.

feats.scene: Lannansu rears up as a wall of water and drowns a drifting coastline in one surge.
Lannansu absorbs a storm-god's thunder across the open sea and merely ripples.

name: Amniau
summary: Amniau commands a hidden counter-disaster agency and sheds a body at each year's turning, emerging in a fresh shape every time. The new bodies vary wildly in size and age, but the sharp mind and iron command carry over untouched.

feats.scene: Amniau flips a steel desk across a briefing room to end an argument.
Amniau walks out of a collapsed bunker wall with a fresh body and no wound.

name: Tiuli
summary: Tiuli is an island wrestler who nearly beat the eventual champion in a tournament of lances and holds. Long life from a sacred spring keeps Tiuli strong across centuries.

feats.scene: Tiuli pins a challenger in the sand ring and cracks the wooden railing with her shoulder.
Tiuli takes a full-speed lance charge and keeps grappling.

name: Stivosium
summary: Stivosium is a dark-haired trader in a walled metropolis, known for bargains that no customer fully understands. Stivosium keeps an eye on a niece with a gift for spells.

feats.scene: Stivosium shoves a market stall over to block a pursuer.
Stivosium rides out a cart collision with a torn sleeve.

name: Miren
summary: Miren is a harbor-town mother who once gave up an adopted girl for money reasons and kept the shame secret for seventeen years. Miren later welcomes the grown daughter back onto her lawn with tears and an open door.

feats.scene: Miren swings a skillet at a trespassing raccoon and sends it over the fence.
Miren falls off a porch ladder while hanging lights and gets up laughing.

name: Sonrilta
summary: Sonrilta is a pink-haired schemer who bought dark power by betraying a partner, and can make whole streets seem to vanish. Cover her eyes and the whole trick collapses.

feats.scene: Sonrilta erases an entire plaza from the sight of every watcher, then walks through it unnoticed.
Sonrilta takes a patrol car's bumper to the hip and keeps running.

name: Lenani
summary: Lenani is a quiet hired tracker who works with a partner and collects fugitives for pay. Lenani prefers patience, ropes and a long stakeout to any loud brawl.

feats.scene: Lenani drops a fleeing smuggler with one flying tackle.
Lenani rolls out of a moving van and keeps the trail.

name: Orlitor
summary: Orlitor is a former trapeze hand turned fixer for killers, wired with a head implant that broadcasts raw agony into a victim's mind. The same signal can be turned back on its sender.

feats.scene: Orlitor floods a captive's thoughts with relived mistakes until the man begs for release.
Orlitor stumbles through a shattered window and walks off with cuts and a limp.

name: Liatise
summary: Liatise is a red-haired student who carries a blade haunted by an ancient king. The weapon sharpens her strength and lets her slice open the seam between realms to reach a hidden castle.

feats.scene: Liatise slashes a parked bus in two and splits the air itself behind it.
Liatise is flung through a stone wall by a spectral knight and rises with a bruise.

name: Viamcel
summary: Viamcel is a drama-loving cheerleader with a talent for kitchen chemistry who briefly brews a potion of instant devotion. Viamcel recovers from a coma, changes her first name and drifts back to ordinary school life.

feats.scene: Viamcel shoves a rival into a locker with a well-aimed shoulder.
Viamcel survives a swarm of stings that put her in bed for weeks.

name: Seiumli
summary: Seiumli is a brown-haired inmate in a swampy prison whose estranged sister fears for her life. Seiumli digs up a buried secret near a bayou shack and flinches from every hand that reaches out.

feats.scene: Seiumli swings a shovel at a pursuer and cracks the handle.
Seiumli wades through a thorny marsh for hours and arrives scratched but upright.

name: Lieoci
summary: Lieoci is a black-haired city legislator and senior member of a hooded order that picks its enforcer. Lieoci survives an arrow in the arm during a night raid and later testifies to police.

feats.scene: Lieoci hurls a heavy gavel across a chamber to stop a heckler.
Lieoci leaves a burning meeting hall on foot with an arrow lodged in her arm.

name: Iumriate
summary: Iumriate is a lone black-haired rebel hiding in a city ruled by a sorcerous mayor after her whole crew was wiped out. Captured and brought before him, Iumriate swears she will never stop resisting.

feats.scene: Iumriate shorts out a patrol gate with a hacked terminal and a thrown wrench.
Iumriate endures a night in a cell and a beating without giving up a name.

name: Iureo
summary: Iureo is a two-foot feline mystic, formerly a dojo teacher, whose stirring stick became a wand when a meteor struck the pot. The wand throws blasts, hops its owner across town and reads the next few seconds.

feats.scene: Iureo points the wand and a violet bolt blows a hole through a docked cargo barge.
Iureo's costume of pure charm turns aside a falling crate of scrap iron.

name: Ststtiu
summary: Ststtiu is a clumsy, kind-hearted teen who loves games and comics and always seems to wear a bandage. Ststtiu admires the local hero and believes too easily in loud rescuers.

feats.scene: Ststtiu throws a wild punch at a bully and misses, hitting a locker.
Ststtiu tumbles down a flight of school steps and bounces up smiling.

name: Corausti
summary: Corausti is a bookish bald thief who idolizes a legendary armored outlaw, until a blow to the skull convinces him that he is that outlaw. His gang humors the delusion hoping for buried jewels.

feats.scene: Corausti charges a doorway in a tin helmet and splinters the frame.
Corausti takes a knock to the head that rewrites his whole personality.

name: Iuallall
summary: Iuallall is a purple-eyed occultist with a rasping voice who trades in forbidden rites and borrowed power. Iuallall prefers chalk circles, whispered bargains and long grudges to open fighting.

feats.scene: Iuallall chants a name backward and a roaring column of green flame guts a rented warehouse.
Iuallall sits through a collapsing ceiling inside a ward of pale light.

name: Iunurn
summary: Iunurn is a robed prophet of a sinister order who foretells doom from an inverted pulpit. Iunurn's spells draw on the fear of crowds, and the sorcerer serves a ruthless league of outlaws.

feats.scene: Iunurn raises both arms and a hail of black glass shreds a convoy of tanks.
Iunurn stands in the blast of a shell without a scratch, wrapped in murmuring shadow.

name: Rnusto
summary: Rnusto is a cold-eyed officer from a hawk-like warrior race who commands covert strike teams and plots a hidden invasion. Keen sight and hearing, long life and extra stamina let Rnusto outlast ordinary humans, and a mind-reading device aids interrogations.

feats.scene: Rnusto bends a steel gate open to reach a hostage.
Rnusto shrugs off a rifle volley that would drop a human soldier.

name: Sarreoser
summary: Sarreoser is a wind deity built from stolen shape-changing technology and sent to fool a nation into believing its old gods had returned. Sarreoser roars about heaven's wrath while sweeping through the cities in gales.

feats.scene: Sarreoser spins a gale across a harbor district and flattens a block of warehouses.
Sarreoser takes a salvo from a squad of armored soldiers and the wounds ripple shut.

name: Rauirn
summary: Rauirn is a proud top cadet who once shared a bench with his closest friend and now seethes at being passed over for a masked title. Rauirn demands the cowl at knifepoint and loses to a trick of sleeping vapor.

feats.scene: Rauirn drives a staff through a practice dummy and the post behind it.
Rauirn keeps fighting through a dozen blows in a drill arena.

name: Liessan
summary: Liessan is an orphaned girl who survived three kidnappings and now fights with knives she learned to use in captivity. Liessan swears often and wants to stop wicked adults for good.

feats.scene: Liessan hurls a blade into a rafter and cuts the rope holding a crate over her friend.
Liessan drops from a loft onto a pile of boxes and runs on.

name: Reraueo
summary: Reraueo is a soft-spoken spirit-talker who knows how to reach voices that do not want to be found. Reraueo works as the trusted contact for a trench-coated occultist and keeps a pistol for bad nights.

feats.scene: Reraueo opens a séance circle and a rattling poltergeist hurls a table across the room.
Reraueo staggers through a ghost's cold grip and keeps talking.

name: Leoliu
summary: Leoliu is a monstrous two-toned wolf of northern legend, foretold to devour the chief of the gods when the world ends. Leoliu once snapped off a war-god's hand and hunts old dinner guests to take back the memories he lent them.

feats.scene: Leoliu leaps and crushes a mountain fortress in his jaws, scattering the rubble for miles.
Leoliu shakes off the blows of an entire army of storm-spirits and lunges again.

name: Anuleo
summary: Anuleo is a red-eyed wolf-god kept as a secret siege weapon by a scheming ruler, and grows more powerful the larger it becomes. Anuleo rides a living seat of power into battle against a rival reality.

feats.scene: Anuleo swells to the height of a skyline and tramples a walled continent's border into dust.
Anuleo endures the combined fire of a dimension's guardians without slowing.
Anuleo bounds across the battlefield in a blur of grey fur.

name: Isirn
summary: Isirn is a child singer whose talent earned a record contract and the jealousy of a twin. Isirn's career ends on a snapped playground swing, and the family keeps the lid closed.

feats.scene: Isirn pushes a swing high with a laugh and a shove.
Isirn tumbles from a low branch and brushes off the dirt.

name: Rnvalvau
summary: Rnvalvau is a damned buccaneer who was once an enslaved islander, then led a revolt against his captors. Seeking revenge for a murdered family, Rnvalvau decapitates a rival captain and returns to find his crew turned to the walking dead.

feats.scene: Rnvalvau swings a cutlass and lops a rival captain's head from his shoulders.
Rnvalvau stands through a broadside that splinters his deck.

name: Russe
summary: Russe is a towering white-eyed refugee from a ravaged peaceful world who joined an interstellar police corps to avenge it. Exiled for abandoning his people's gentle ways, Russe grows hollow after failing to protect one more village.

feats.scene: Russe smashes a smuggler's hover-truck apart with his bare fists.
Russe absorbs a plasma salvo on his forearm and keeps advancing.

name: Niuvosstu
summary: Niuvosstu is a corrupt corporate chief who secretly builds weapons that freeze, and ruins a scientist to protect them. Niuvosstu ends up arrested after a clumsy attack on a masked detective.

feats.scene: Niuvosstu swings a clumsy punch at a masked detective and meets the floor.
Niuvosstu is knocked out cold by a single blow and wakes up cuffed.

name: Nummavas
summary: Nummavas is a yellow-skinned survivor of a peaceful civilization wiped out by plague in a week. Driven mad, Nummavas flies a city-sized ship across space to prove life is cruel and pointless.

feats.scene: Nummavas turns the ship's cannon on a moon-base and scorches it to slag.
Nummavas survives the wreck of the command deck and rises laughing.

name: Lloni
summary: Lloni is a white-haired swindler who poses as a famous concert violinist and carries a bow, a blade and a sidearm. Lloni plays a tune that dulls wills, then escapes by plane.

feats.scene: Lloni swings the violin case into a guard's jaw.
Lloni crashes the getaway plane in a field and limps off.

name: Ortorse
summary: Ortorse is a sentient meadow of the dream realm that grows weary of being scenery and borrows the shape of a rumpled gentleman. Ortorse hides ancient rules behind a charming smile.

feats.scene: Ortorse rolls the entire meadow forward as a wave of grass and lifts a tower off its footing.
Ortorse is uprooted by a nightmare's claw and reforms in a blink of green.

name: Stsiatir
summary: Stsiatir is an island nation's veteran strongman who is swapped for a shape-changing double during an alien scheme. Stsiatir takes back his stage in the middle of a speech and rallies the crowds to turn on the impostors.

feats.scene: Stsiatir slams a podium and the whole plaza goes silent.
Stsiatir trudges through a jungle for days without rest.

name: Aslisser
summary: Aslisser is a brown-haired acrobat who runs at blinding speed and hurls sparks and flame. Aslisser was born as a fan contest entry, built like a cape-wearing climber with borrowed lightning feet.

feats.scene: Aslisser unleashes a ball of fire and lightning that wrecks a row of parked cars.
Aslisser tumbles through a wall of crates and runs on with barely a scrape.
Aslisser crosses a stadium in the blink of an eye.

name: Telorleo
summary: Telorleo is a green-skinned, red-eyed sea-born rebel pressed into a doomed task force after his brother's death. Telorleo swims with ease, reads minds a little and hits hard.

feats.scene: Telorleo wrenches a bulkhead door off its hinges and hurls it at a guard.
Telorleo shrugs off a burst of rifle fire and dives into the harbor.

name: Tirtan
summary: Tirtan is an auburn-haired undersea queen born with a body made to survive crushing depths and to breathe water. Tirtan bore a long line of rulers who later shaped whole oceans.

feats.scene: Tirtan raises a hand at court and a trident-bearing guard bows.
Tirtan swims the deepest trench and returns unharmed by the crushing weight.

name: Veoton
summary: Veoton is a faceless servant of a dark master who wields blazing flames and torches whatever the master points at. Veoton fights a team of dial-wielding heroes.

feats.scene: Veoton hurls a sheet of flame that engulfs a parked delivery truck.
Veoton stands in the middle of a burning street and does not flinch.

name: Rollseo
summary: Rollseo is a cultist who calls flame to heel and follows a hunter of heroes. Rollseo scorches rooftops to draw a team of veterans into an ambush.

feats.scene: Rollseo lights a rooftop water tank and the burst of steam throws a ledge wide.
Rollseo walks out of a collapsing burning loft without a mark.

name: Orsonal
summary: Orsonal is a giant invader from a flame-bodied race who arrives inside a crystal meteor that shrinks passengers and copies them. Orsonal turns captured people and animals into servants made of fire, but suffocating the blaze knocks him out.

feats.scene: Orsonal towers over a harbor and rains flame on a row of docks and cranes.
Orsonal weathers a barrage of naval shells that pass through his burning body.

name: Rneium
summary: Rneium is an ordinary city dweller given sudden flame powers by a shady experiment, and then pulls on a mask to guard the streets. Rneium joins a messy brawl that ends in many deaths.

feats.scene: Rneium hurls a roaring sheet of flame that melts the front of a parked bus.
Rneium stands in a burning alley and walks out with singed sleeves.

name: Ossilse
summary: Ossilse is a brown-haired brawler who enters a lethal island contest to test her skills against the world's best. Ossilse favors quick kicks and ruthless grips.

feats.scene: Ossilse snaps a plank in half with a spinning heel.
Ossilse fights on through a barrage of punches in a sand pit.

name: Nilrusne
summary: Nilrusne is a white-eyed pilot of a nuclear fusion body, one of several built by a corporate lab. Nilrusne can lighten or thicken matter, drink in raw energy and spit it back as blasts while soaring.

feats.scene: Nilrusne unleashes a blast that levels a block of warehouses.
Nilrusne absorbs a missile strike and brightens instead of falling.

name: Arcar
summary: Arcar is a black-haired, red-skinned thug with burning eyes who clashes with a reckless young adventurer. Arcar relies on bluster, heavy fists and a bad temper.

feats.scene: Arcar punches through a plaster wall to grab a fleeing rival.
Arcar shrugs off a falling shelf of tools.

name: Teeonnt
summary: Teeonnt is a goofy hero in a parallel world's council who spends meetings doing impressions of a famous singer. Teeonnt is easily distracted even when a kidnapping is on the agenda.

feats.scene: Teeonnt tosses a conference table aside while dancing.
Teeonnt trips over a podium and keeps swaying.

name: Tannt
summary: Tannt is a blond patrol officer on a special squad who can turn herself into crackling electricity and fly. A drenching from a burst water tank snuffs out her gift.

feats.scene: Tannt hurls a bolt that ignites a cloud of leaking vapor and flips a van.
Tannt is slammed to the pavement by a blast and rises dazed.

name: Liaro
summary: Liaro is the white-haired first rebel angel, cast from paradise and now reigning over a burning underworld beside two lieutenants. Liaro collects souls through bargains, such as a musician's fame in exchange for his life.

feats.scene: Liaro tears open the ground beneath a continent and drags a cathedral into the abyss.
Liaro endures a holy host's assault without a scar.

name: Seove
summary: Seove is the oldest created mind, once a companion and conscience for the creator, who decided that his maker was mad and was cast into the pit. Seove misreads two demon lords as equals, forms a ruling trio and plots against heaven.

feats.scene: Seove claps and the sky of a whole world burns white, boiling its oceans.
Seove endures the combined fury of an angelic army and is not moved.

name: Riavanes
summary: Riavanes is a captive host of a mind-seizing parasite, forced to wear a hero's costume on a team of coerced criminals. Riavanes understands speech but answers only in an alien tongue, a bomb ticking in his neck.

feats.scene: Riavanes drives a harpoon through a hull plate and rips it loose.
Riavanes takes a point-blank shotgun blast and keeps swinging.

name: Ianeau
summary: Ianeau is an alien angler bound to a living parasite that lets him live on land or in the deepest water. Ianeau is released from a seabed cell to hit a jailer and dies by a teammate's bullet.

feats.scene: Ianeau hooks a patrol boat with a barbed line and drags it under.
Ianeau lives for years on the crushing ocean floor in an isolation cell.

name: Seresca
summary: Seresca is a grey, talkative dolphin who hovers in the air and serves as an aide to a high priest of a three-headed sea cult. Seresca prefers gossip and splashing to violence.

feats.scene: Seresca slaps a floating tray with his tail and sends it spinning.
Seresca bounces off a temple wall and floats back up, chattering.

name: Orstleo
summary: Orstleo is a masked zealot who fights for a militant cell and crosses paths with an alien champion and a spy agency. Orstleo prefers sudden raids and sacrifice over negotiation.

feats.scene: Orstleo detonates a satchel charge and brings down a guard post.
Orstleo crawls from a wrecked truck and keeps firing.

name: Luornan
summary: Luornan is a white-haired schemer from a decadent city who makes a living repairing things that should stay broken. Luornan opposes a masked hero with clever sabotage and bitter spite.

feats.scene: Luornan rigs a generator to burst and blow out a warehouse door.
Luornan is thrown across a workshop and clambers up with a wrench.

name: Anuiar
summary: Anuiar is a former burger-joint worker who walked through a lethal cloud untouched and then turned to fire after a bad night. Anuiar fights a rocket-riding teenage hero with torches in each hand.

feats.scene: Anuiar throws a fireball that scorches the front of a diner.
Anuiar walks out of a gas cloud that killed everyone around him.

name: Ulnaurnu
summary: Ulnaurnu is a hired gun on a courier crew sent to snatch an inventor in a small southern town. Ulnaurnu commands fire until a gadget swaps her gift for a heavy rock coating.

feats.scene: Ulnaurnu sets a barn roof ablaze with a flick of her hand.
Ulnaurnu lands from a rooftop jump in a hedge and rolls on.

name: Silin
summary: Silin is a yellow-eyed goddess of ruin whose task is to smash what her brother builds so he will build better. Silin falls in love with a sibling, loses him to a trap of crystal and later takes a mortal avatar.

feats.scene: Silin ignites a continent-wide city of glass and reduces it to ash.
Silin walks out of a collapsing crystal spire and her wounds close at once.

name: Entlansi
summary: Entlansi is a pair of mirror-image crooks, one with a wrist cannon that sprays flame and the other with a twin that sprays water. Entlansi robs rare stamp displays in two cities at once for a scarred crime boss.

feats.scene: Entlansi blasts a display case with a jet of fire and melts its lock.
Entlansi is bowled over by a young archer's frozen shaft and scrambles up.

name: Nturnor
summary: Nturnor is a red-haired firebug who torches buildings for sport and clashes with a small blue-clad hero. Nturnor relies on matches, kerosene and a lot of nerve.

feats.scene: Nturnor lights a rooftop warehouse and the blaze consumes it floor by floor.
Nturnor escapes a collapsing stairwell with burnt eyebrows.

name: Reralllu
summary: Reralllu is a streaking hero from a doomed world who carries on a fallen predecessor's mantle in a team that dies to a rogue protocol. Reralllu draws on a source of pure velocity.

feats.scene: Reralllu runs through a defense drone at full speed and tears it in two.
Reralllu is hit by a laser salvo and keeps running before collapsing.
Reralllu crosses a city in a heartbeat.

name: Lleseta
summary: Lleseta is a fast enforcer for a brutal regime in a world where tyrants won a great war, powered by a force of pure velocity. Lleseta hunts dissidents while speeding between districts.

feats.scene: Lleseta slams through a barricade at full tilt and leaves a crater in the road.
Lleseta is thrown through a shopfront by a tank shell and rises scowling.
Lleseta crosses a district before the echo of a shout fades.

name: Staian
summary: Staian is a blond adventuring speedster in a mirror world where traits are swapped, drawing on a wellspring of velocity. Staian runs with a team of champions and fights for the helpless.

feats.scene: Staian runs through a gang's barricade and scatters the wreckage across a street.
Staian skids on the pavement after a collision and stands up smiling.
Staian circles a block before her friends turn their heads.

name: Striaceo
summary: Striaceo is a masked speedster in a parallel world's council whose true identity is a mystery even to allies. Striaceo moves with a blur through the streets of a metropolis.

feats.scene: Striaceo slams into a runaway truck at full speed and stops it cold.
Striaceo rolls through a collision with a bruised shoulder.
Striaceo vanishes from one rooftop and appears on another.

name: Rosorori
summary: Rosorori is a blond streaker who coaches a young apprentice and sits on a team of costumed heroes. Rosorori is a daydream guest in a teenager's fantasy of joining the roster.

feats.scene: Rosorori sprints through a wall of boxes and sends them flying.
Rosorori skids across a floor and bounces up cheerfully.
Rosorori laps a tower in the blink of an eye.

name: Colnauori
summary: Colnauori is a masked successor in a crossover world who runs fast and throws lightning, fighting beside legendary allies against a god-tier tyrant. Colnauori represents the next wave of defenders.

feats.scene: Colnauori streaks past a titan and strikes it with a lightning-charged fist.
Colnauori absorbs a stray cosmic blast and keeps running.
Colnauori crosses a battlefield between two heartbeats.

name: Linst
summary: Linst is a grey-skinned, purple-eyed assassin who absorbs the skills of whoever has just died. Linst jokes about death with every strike and serves as a sidekick to a morbid master.

feats.scene: Linst throws a dagger through a dangling lantern chain and drops a chandelier on guards.
Linst takes a rifle stock to the jaw and laughs it off.

name: Ntunti
summary: Ntunti is a pale, pink-eyed fighter obsessed with mortality since childhood who inherits the dead's knowledge and abilities. Ntunti turned white after an ambush at a burial and wanders the globe seeking more teachers.

feats.scene: Ntunti disarms an assassin and fells three more with stolen technique.
Ntunti stands through a barrage of fists in a tournament ring.

name: Tertauva
summary: Tertauva is a genderless brute who serves as the personal minion of a chaos lord. Tertauva has extraordinary strength and a hide that turns blades, and it falls when its master does.

feats.scene: Tertauva hurls a boulder through a stone gate and shatters the arch.
Tertauva takes a siege-engine blow and remains on its feet.

name: Iartiu
summary: Iartiu is a purple-skinned recruit who wore a yellow-lit ring and helped crush a rival police force. Iartiu forms constructs, projects blasts and flies on the ring's fear-powered charge.

feats.scene: Iartiu shapes a giant fist of yellow light and flattens a barricade of guards.
Iartiu raises a shield that holds against a point-blank cannon.

name: Stieru
summary: Stieru is a pink-skinned warrior from an empire of conquerors who joined a team of heroes to face a dark sorcerer. Stieru hits first and thinks later, fighting with brute force and a soldier's discipline.

feats.scene: Stieru slams a gauntlet through a bulkhead and drags a guard out.
Stieru is blasted off a gantry and rises with a grin.

name: Coriuia
summary: Coriuia is the ringleader of a crew of unhinged crooks who steal a hero's weapon to terrorize a metropolis. Coriuia ends up behind bars when the hero reclaims it.

feats.scene: Coriuia fires the stolen gun and punches a hole through a brick wall.
Coriuia tumbles down a fire escape and keeps cackling.

name: Lurire
summary: Lurire is an underworld fighter coated in a slick substance that blades cannot pierce, hired to take down a sword-wielding heroine. Lurire holds a deep grudge for dead friends and is dropped through a floor on his own momentum.

feats.scene: Lurire kicks a steel door off its hinges.
Lurire laughs as a katana slides harmlessly across his skin.

name: Tirte
summary: Tirte is a blond double agent, daughter of a legendary spy, raised in a foreign household and trained to serve the wrong side. Tirte switches loyalties after witnessing atrocities and takes a bullet at a firing line to save an ally.

feats.scene: Tirte clubs a guard with a pistol butt and unlocks a cell.
Tirte survives a gunshot wound and a ferry ride to recovery.

name: Luvalmi
summary: Luvalmi is a lesser member of a villain alliance who flexes his bulk as a threat against a god-blooded hero. Luvalmi mostly hangs around the edges of bigger plots, offering muscle and little else.

feats.scene: Luvalmi lifts a vending machine and hurls it across an alley.
Luvalmi staggers up after a rooftop fall with a shrug.

name: Seoliumil
summary: Seoliumil is a former beach weakling transformed by a mail-order training book into a muscular hero who can rewrite reality by flexing. Seoliumil wears leopard-print trunks and a halo of glowing letters, and trouble lurks below a government building.

feats.scene: Seoliumil flexes and the surrounding block briefly turns to candy.
Seoliumil walks through a wall of gunfire unbothered.

name: Tollian
summary: Tollian is a gym-running hero who lost his gift after torture and regained it watching old friends fight. Tollian leads a trainee squad and waits in a hidden bunker for the team to regroup.

feats.scene: Tollian flexes a thigh and a wall of steel peels into confetti.
Tollian is knocked across a field by a godlike foe and gets up to flex again.

name: Tiunttia
summary: Tiunttia is a red-eyed headhunter who recruits champions for a slave trade operating across space. Tiunttia scouts warriors, bargains with warlords and dreams of building a private empire.

feats.scene: Tiunttia fires a stun-lance and drops a hulking guard.
Tiunttia takes a point-blank blast on his armor and fires back.

name: Teorci
summary: Teorci is a blue-skinned interstellar peacekeeper who draws on will and a power ring to build constructs, fire blasts and fly. Teorci patrols mobile sectors and calls on a charging lantern for energy.

feats.scene: Teorci shapes a glowing wall and crushes a pirate cruiser's engine pod.
Teorci raises a ring shield and holds off a cannon volley.

name: Maiar
summary: Maiar is a hairless alien researcher stuck in a timeless place after its body was lost on first crossing. Maiar floats about as a leftover spirit, studying the strange realm alongside two friends.

feats.scene: Maiar nudges a loose instrument across a table with a pulse of will.
Maiar drifts through a collapsing lab and comes out unharmed.

name: Anronli
summary: Anronli is a green fish who dashes across a barnyard league of animal heroes. Anronli sprints at astonishing speed and is annoyed but unharmed by a rival's attempts at mental control.

feats.scene: Anronli dashes up and bumps a runaway egg out of a fox's path.
Anronli bounces off a frozen pond and shakes it off.
Anronli sprints across the pond in a flash.

name: Rnosor
summary: Rnosor is a sentient cloud from a gas world, absorbed into a power ring and sworn to defend a sector. Rnosor spreads across an entire region to smother a mad deity and vanishes into the void.

feats.scene: Rnosor expands across a sector and crushes a rampaging deity by contracting.
Rnosor disperses into vapor under a cannon barrage and reforms unharmed.

name: Teltiuca
summary: Teltiuca is a white-eyed engineered weapon grown from a stolen embryo in deep space to overload the defenses of worlds. Teltiuca generates and drinks raw energy, flies between planets and wears light plating.

feats.scene: Teltiuca overloads the core of a small world and cracks it apart.
Teltiuca takes the blast of a planetary defense grid without a scratch.

name: Amlasle
summary: Amlasle is a dark-haired mercenary marksman from a mirror timeline who was thought lost in an invasion. Amlasle was actually flung backward through time by a failed experiment and now lurks as a copycat sharpshooter.

feats.scene: Amlasle fires a rifle round that pierces a steel helmet across a courtyard.
Amlasle shrugs off a hard landing from a time rift.

name: Titelse
summary: Titelse is a soft-spoken contract gunner who takes jobs through back-alley brokers and never stays in one town for long. Patient and precise, this shooter prefers a single clean shot to a loud scene.

feats.scene: Titelse fires one round through a rain-streaked window and drops a courier's phone at two hundred paces.
Titelse tumbles down a flight of service stairs and rises with only bruises.

name: Illton
summary: Illtonm is a rooftop marksman hired by dockside racketeers to draw a masked vigilante out of hiding. Wrist-mounted autoguns give this hired shot a second chance at range, but close quarters are a weakness.

feats.scene: Illtonm empties both wrist guns in a three-second burst that shreds the roof of a moving freight car.
Illtonm is slammed against a tunnel wall by a lunging opponent and keeps his grip on the trigger.
Illtonm rides the speeding carriage at full tilt while swivelling to track a pursuer.

name: Neltiu
summary: Neltiu is a wry mercenary who keeps one photograph of his daughter taped inside his glove. A decent brawler, this gunman can hold his own against heavier fighters but rarely wins by fists alone.

feats.scene: Neltiu pins a gate lock with a single wrist-gun shot and kicks the door off its hinges.
Neltiu absorbs a heavy bruiser's roundhouse and stays standing long enough to retreat.

name: Rniva
summary: Rniva is a sardonic sharpshooter whose guilt over a childhood accident turned into obsessive accuracy. Cold on the job and tender at home, this marksman hates the word love yet cannot stop calling a particular child.

feats.scene: Rniva shatters a distant antenna mast with a single high-calibre round from a hilltop.
Rniva walks off a crash against a prison wall after being flung from a transport van.

name: Teseoser
summary: Teseoser is a masked gunman and professional troublemaker who joins squads of misfit criminals for pay. Dry humour hides a calculating mind, and this shooter is rarely seen out of costume.

feats.scene: Teseoser picks off three lamp bulbs in a row to plunge a warehouse into darkness.
Teseoser falls from a loading ramp onto concrete and gets up laughing.

name: Eomia
summary: Eomia is a veteran contract killer who walked away from the trade after becoming a father, then returned to hunt down a copycat. Weathered, wary and quietly proud, this old hand carries regret like a second weapon.

feats.scene: Eomia drops a masked impersonator from a quarter-mile away with one rifle shot.
Eomia takes a rifle butt to the ribs and still completes the shot.

name: Rnicelli
summary: Rnicelli is a convict turned mirror-obsessed crook who escaped prison with a broken glass sliver. Convinced that reflections hold every secret, this schemer builds crime sprees and contraptions around silvered glass.

feats.scene: Rnicelli aims a lattice of angled mirrors to scorch a vault door with focused sunlight.
Rnicelli is tackled by guards and keeps running with a cracked rib.

name: Torto
summary: Torto is a pale invader from a red desert world who poses as a friendly visitor while preparing a conquest. Vulnerable to flame yet proud of crushing strength, this impostor greened a barren waste to win the public's trust.

feats.scene: Torto reshapes a thousand square kilometres of dune into farmland in a single night using borrowed alien machinery.
Torto is punched across the ocean surface and skips like a stone before getting up.

name: Leoorenu
summary: Leoorenu is a petty thief who dresses in a bug costume to rob storerooms. Overconfident and clumsy, this burglar won his first brawl and lost the rematch to a sticky net.

feats.scene: Leoorenu swings a crowbar into a supply cage and pops the lock in one blow.
Leoorenu is bound head to toe in tough cord and cannot snap even one strand.

name: Viliures
summary: Viliures is a gang boss who led armed robbers across farm country with weapons far ahead of their era. Smooth talking and ruthless, this crime lord thrived until a swift hero caught the whole gang.

feats.scene: Viliures orders a volley from automatic weapons that chews through a bank's wooden counter.
Viliures is bowled over by a blur of motion and lands hard on a train platform.

name: Tumco
summary: Tumco is a masked adventurer who hides a real identity behind a mantle of stone arches and buttresses. Designed by a fan with a love of odd heroes, this protector shields the weak by wedging stone supports between danger and bystanders.

feats.scene: Tumco throws a heavy stone arch across an alley to topple a runaway cart.
Tumco braces beneath a collapsing awning and holds the beam until crowds escape.

name: Orint
summary: Orint is a brave flyer who led a ragged crew of soldiers on a rescue across an island full of ancient beasts. Loyal to his brothers in arms, this pilot understood that a family can be the people who fight beside you.

feats.scene: Orint dives a damaged plane into a clearing and rams a charging lizard-giant off its feet.
Orint climbs from a burning cockpit after a rough crash landing in jungle trees.
Orint banks a fighter plane through a canyon with a beast hunting behind him.

name: Amirn
summary: Amirn is a mystic warrior whose grandfather restored him after a brutal loss, teaching him herbs and illusions. Wearing a cape that lets him soar and vanish from view, this young shaman fights for his lost people far from home.

feats.scene: Amirn flings a bundle of enchanted herbs that bursts into a stinging cloud around armed intruders.
Amirn is struck by a thrown beam and recovers after chanting a short rite.

name: Osanus
summary: Osanus is a washed-up costumed hand for hire who clung to a thankless job for a decade. Mediocre in battle and devoted to routine, this veteran lost everything when the agency's office burned.

feats.scene: Osanus swings a sack of tools at a thug and knocks him sprawling.
Osanus staggers out of a smoke-filled stairwell with singed boots.

name: Arsorron
summary: Arsorron is a heroic figure of old whose deeds were honoured in a painted portrait on a hall wall. Known more as legend than as person, this vigilante of the wild frontier inspires later guardians.

feats.scene: Arsorron shatters a sealed granary door with one strike of a carved club.
Arsorron endures a stampede of oxen without losing his footing.

name: Tastitis
summary: Tastitis is a warrior who called on a forest spirit from the bottom of a trap and received a charm cut from fallen rock. Masked and mighty, this champion won leadership of his nations and later wandered a spirit paradise with white hounds.

feats.scene: Tastitis hurls a boulder through a log stockade and scatters the raiders behind it.
Tastitis shrugs off a fall into a stone pit with no wound.
Tastitis outruns a galloping deer across a river valley.

name: Tonumva
summary: Tonumva is a white-haired city policeman with a long memory for faces and patience for paperwork. Calm under pressure, this investigator asks few questions but remembers every answer.

feats.scene: Tonumva slams a door shut on a fleeing witness and pins his coat.
Tonumva takes a shove down a short stairwell and recovers his notebook.

name: Llullu
