summary: Llullu is an extremist agent who flattens his body like a sheet and folds himself into blades, darts and gliders. Slipping through gaps no man should fit, this saboteur can shrink small enough to hide inside a person.

feats.scene: Llullu folds an arm into a razor edge and slices a steel shutter in two.
Llullu is squeezed flat beneath a rolling door and unfolds unharmed.

name: Ontaneon
summary: Ontaneon is a small-time hoodlum who survived a deadly plague and decided he could never die. Crazed by the thought, this survivor ended his life proving his foolish theory with a blade.

feats.scene: Ontaneon swings a stool at a rival smuggler in a dockside tavern.
Ontaneon walks through a ward of infected strangers and never takes ill.

name: Aunceriu
summary: Aunceriu is a scavenger-warrior from a lofty colony world who joins a team of defenders. Small beside the gods, this insectoid fighter backs allies with swift scuttling attacks and a god's endurance.

feats.scene: Aunceriu smashes through a bulkhead in a charge that dents a steel hull.
Aunceriu takes a falling girder across the back and keeps fighting.

name: Inloncel
summary: Inloncel is a swarm leader who raided market stalls for winter food and later joined gods against a tyrant. Ageless and nimble, this hive chief ended up rebuilding a ruined metropolis alongside his former rivals.

feats.scene: Inloncel rallies his swarm to topple a grocery truck and carry its cargo underground.
Inloncel stands unscathed in a collapsing grotto as the ceiling comes down.

name: Sttor
summary: Sttor is a red-skinned, yellow-eyed warrior of a vanished colony who tried to keep his comrades alive in a tyrant's prison. Strong and quick but outmatched, this small hero was crushed in an instant by a titan.

feats.scene: Sttor vaults a prison wall in a single bound and lands on a guard's shield.
Sttor withstands a hail of blows from jailers before collapsing.
Sttor sprints across a smoking courtyard faster than a charging beast.

name: Luolu
summary: Luolu is a foundling raised by insect-folk who learned late that his birth was divine. Despised at first by arrogant gods, this adventurer gave his life to stop a living equation and later awoke in a nightmare basement.

feats.scene: Luolu spends everything he has to unmake a monstrous equation before it can devour a world.
Luolu is hurled through a stone tower by a god-sized brute and rises again.

name: Metelliu
summary: Metelliu is a masked English eccentric who prowls rooftops and tea-houses with cutlery as his calling card. Little is known beyond the mask and a theatrical streak, but this vigilante favours cunning and a mean sidestep.

feats.scene: Metelliu throws a heavy fork and pins a fleeing thief's sleeve to a door.
Metelliu drops from a ledge onto a market awning and bounces to his feet.

name: Sarorinau
summary: Sarorinau is a sprinting hero in a lightning emblem who fights for a bright team in a parallel city. Cheerful and fleet, this runner is a tribute to speed-obsessed champions from other stories.

feats.scene: Sarorinau runs through a wall of crates at full tilt and scatters them across the street.
Sarorinau races a crackling storm front across the avenue and arrives first.

name: Torval
summary: Torval is a yellow-skinned youth who can turn into a steel stronghold and shield friends within. Rejected by a heroic club, this protector lost his memory while shielding them and became their first headquarters.

feats.scene: Torval swells into a wall of metal and crushes a gun emplacement against a cliff.
Torval absorbs a grenade blast from inside his hull-like body and keeps his shape.

name: Orilonni
summary: Orilonni is a hot-tempered strongman raised in a harsh outback who joined a global strike team and secretly betrayed it. Arrogant and ambitious, this double agent lost a bid for command and turned traitor.

feats.scene: Orilonni hurls a jeep across a dusty compound in a fit of rage.
Orilonni is thrown through a pillar and rises swinging.

name: Natum
summary: Natum is a cardsharp-themed enforcer in a gang of costumed thieves, wearing a spade mark on his coat. Brash and expendable, this crook is the fourth piece in a stacked deck and the first to fall.

feats.scene: Natum snaps a heavy card-shaped blade through a vault door lock.
Natum is thrown across a casino floor and bounces off a table.

name: Anamoson
summary: Anamoson is a bespectacled soldier in a front-line squad who happens to be one of its steadiest shots. Mocked for his glasses, this rifleman repaid his teasing with accuracy.

feats.scene: Anamoson takes out a distant machine-gun nest with three careful rifle shots.
Anamoson dives into a muddy trench as shells burst overhead.

name: Niaamrni
summary: Niaamrni is a hen grown to monstrous size by reckless feed experiments. Cranky and powerful, this barnyard terror pecks through fences and flattens farm equipment.

feats.scene: Niaamrni rams a barn door and snaps the beam holding it.
Niaamrni shrugs off a collision with a tractor.

name: Tertirllu
summary: Tertirllu is a red-haired chemistry student and ringleader of a trio who altered a bat-making formula to remake a whole campus. Clever but resentful, this scholar became a clawed hybrid creature after a soaking in the vat.

feats.scene: Tertirllu swipes a clawed paw through a lecture hall door and splinters it.
Tertirllu shrugs off a hard tumble down a concrete staircase.

name: Irnval
summary: Irnval is a cat-shaped mental parasite that clings to a sick girl and feeds on her feelings. Invisible to all but hosts, this fiend breathes heat, brainwashes with her milk and dies if nobody believes in her.

feats.scene: Irnval spits a ball of heat that chars a wooden barn wall.
Irnval is smashed by a thrown bench and re-forms from a child's gaze.

name: Sansarto
summary: Sansarto is a blonde student with magnetic talent and a scattered past. Haunted by lost memories, this young woman once fought an old friend before peace was made.

feats.scene: Sansarto pulls a rack of steel pipes across a garage in a single sweep.
Sansarto is knocked to the floor by a swift opponent and recovers with a gasp.

name: Sevornal
summary: Sevornal is a disciplined swordswoman who walks with a cane after childhood illness. Well versed in drill and duelling, this soldier proves her limp is no real handicap.

feats.scene: Sevornal cuts a hanging lantern chain with one swing of a blade.
Sevornal takes a shoulder charge and keeps her balance on one leg.

name: Nausar
summary: Nausar is a showy criminal who flips and vaults between rooftops and shoots with a magical bow. Quick and vain, this thief leaves bright arrows stuck in cornices as a signature.

feats.scene: Nausar looses an enchanted arrow that bursts a jeweller's display case.
Nausar lands from a high flip on a tiled roof and slides unharmed.

name: Virina
summary: Virina is a bald, paralysed official who lost his family in a world-shaking catastrophe and now serves in a secret agency. Cold and loyal, this officer once fought in a short war and still carries its ideals.

feats.scene: Virina fires a pistol from his chair and clips a fleeing courier's briefcase.
Virina survives a grenade burst near his command post.

name: Vasnenosa
summary: Vasnenosa is a cheerful high-school student and loyal friend with a taste for mechanics. Small in the larger world, this teenager is always first to lend a hand.

feats.scene: Vasnenosa swings a wrench at a seized bolt and frees it.
Vasnenosa takes a tumble off a bicycle and brushes off the gravel.

name: Telamani
summary: Telamani is a white-haired street vendor who sells papers and coffee near a busy tower. Warm and talkative, this shopkeeper hands out free news when somebody needs cheering up.

feats.scene: Telamani heaves a bundle of papers onto a stand.
Telamani stays on his feet when a crowd jostles his cart.

name: Riavale
summary: Riavale is a night guard patrolling a hospital for the troubled, always one corridor from the worst cell. Dutiful and unnoticed, this watchman never sees the attacker who ends his shift.

feats.scene: Riavale swings a baton against a locked cell door to scare a prisoner back.
Riavale is slammed against a brick wall and still hits the alarm.

name: Autauin
summary: Autauin is a member of a corrupt elite who throws jets of white-hot plasma from his palms. Self-assured and cruel, this thug torches cars and doors when negotiating gets dull.

feats.scene: Autauin melts a gate and the wall beside it with a roaring blast from both palms.
Autauin walks away from a collapsing scaffold with a scorched coat.

name: Stotau
summary: Stotau is a gang boss who builds his crimes around wheels, from getaway cars to rolling traps. Well armed and organized, this leader runs drivers like clockwork until a vigilante breaks his circle.

feats.scene: Stotau orders his gang to roll an iron cart through a shop front.
Stotau is tossed against a wheel rim and shakes it off.

name: Rntiu
summary: Rntiu is a wealthy shopkeeper who owns a chain of tacky nightclubs across the country. Pompous and plump with cash, this tycoon was once briefly wed to a notorious jester.

feats.scene: Rntiu slaps a contract onto a desk with a flourish.
Rntiu sits through a barstool brawl and keeps his drink.

name: Caeru
summary: Caeru is a half-machine, half-human student built by a scheming inventor to mimic the gifts of any hero he studies. Gifted with borrowed minds as well as borrowed powers, this young construct finally buckled under the clash of voices inside him.

feats.scene: Caeru copies a dozen borrowed gifts at once and flattens a parking structure with a single combined blast.
Caeru is hammered by a team of champions and keeps standing until his mind frays.

name: Rumrerlla
summary: Rumrerlla is a celebrated artist and storyteller who took up a masked mantle out of admiration for a hero of his youth. Ink-stained and thoughtful, this creator fights with sketches, speeches and a stubborn sense of justice.

feats.scene: Rumrerlla swings a drawing board at a mugger and cracks it across his shoulder.
Rumrerlla takes a hard shove on a studio stairwell and gets back up.

name: Rnriani
summary: Rnriani is a stubborn patrol cop whose knee never healed after being shot protecting his sibling. Chained to a desk but unbroken, this veteran insists that street smarts still count and supports his brother's work.

feats.scene: Rnriani lands a hard right on a loud suspect despite a bad leg.
Rnriani takes a punch from a larger thug and answers back.

name: Valran
summary: Valran is a bald, soft-spoken partner in a small firm that handles odd jobs around the city. Patient and honest, this tradesman shows up on time and keeps the ledgers straight.

feats.scene: Valran hammers a stuck crate lid open with a mallet.
Valran slips on a wet dock and gets up with a laugh.

name: Ausauta
summary: Ausauta is a quiet agent with lost memories who wakes in a hospital after a ship explosion. Gifted by a special suit with burning flame, this amnesiac hero slowly learns who he used to be.

feats.scene: Ausauta unleashes a roaring flame column that levels a warehouse down to its slab.
Ausauta walks through a blazing garage and steps out with a smouldering jacket.

name: Mantse
summary: Mantse is a gruff site boss who runs a crew of builders with a sharp tongue. Stern to a fault, this supervisor treats his own boy with harsh words he later regrets.

feats.scene: Mantse shoves a loaded wheelbarrow up a ramp in one go.
Mantse takes a falling plank on the shoulder and keeps barking orders.

name: Iarrni
summary: Iarrni is a hulking undead brute stitched together from grave-robbed parts and summoned by a prankster's magic. Needing no food or breath, this patchwork giant pounds through walls and shrugs off blows.

feats.scene: Iarrni punches through a masonry wall and flings a bus-sized slab aside.
Iarrni stands in the path of a falling crane and the crane bends around him.

name: Lantile
summary: Lantile is a grey-haired enforcer who serves a crime boss and covets his employer's seat. Quick with a threat, this thug underpaid his men and paid for it in an alley.

feats.scene: Lantile empties a pistol at a warehouse door and splinters the frame.
Lantile is held by his own hired men and cannot break free.

name: Astma
summary: Astma is a down-at-heel seal who once starred on the stage and now stumbles into mysteries with his clever wife. Cheerful and sturdy, this performer balances massive loads on his nose.

feats.scene: Astma tosses a stack of barrels into a truck bed without spilling a drop.
Astma takes a thrown crate on the chest and applauds himself.

name: Selata
summary: Selata is a grey-haired national leader during a world war who gets snatched thrice by plotters. Calm in a crisis, this statesman keeps negotiating even from a locked cell.

feats.scene: Selata bangs a gavel and silences a roaring council room.
Selata sits through a bumpy seaplane flight with composure.

name: Lorliia
summary: Lorliia is a friendly doorman and former star batter who hides a glorious past from his tenants. Warm and modest, this old athlete coaches a youth team and dodges attention.

feats.scene: Lorliia smacks a fastball over a distant fence with a creaky swing.
Lorliia slips on an icy stoop and rises with a grin.

name: Rnire
summary: Rnire is a blue-eyed lawyer who rose to lead a young republic. Plain-spoken and wary, this officeholder spends his term handling quarrels between rival states.

feats.scene: Rnire signs a decree and sets a long argument to rest.
Rnire rides out a wagon jolt on a rough road without complaint.

name: Tiasilvar
summary: Tiasilvar is a legendary army sergeant who leads a battered squad through endless campaigns. Deadly with a submachine gun and fists, this soldier even fought on after devastating injury.

feats.scene: Tiasilvar downs two diving aircraft with a single drum of ammunition.
Tiasilvar rises from a collapsed trench after shells flatten it.

name: Rnlome
summary: Rnlome is a scholar of lights in the sky who gained psychic powers from a strange drug. Once a foe, this redeemed thinker weaves illusions and reads minds, though his thoughts can be steered by implants.

feats.scene: Rnlome projects a vivid illusion of a charging beast that sends a squad running.
Rnlome shakes off a blow from a rifle stock and keeps focusing.

name: Seonan
summary: Seonan is a freckled, cheerful cousin of a famous pair of wizard-granted siblings. Warm and quick-witted, this girl tags along on their adventures and cheers loudest.

feats.scene: Seonan throws a pillow across a bedroom and hits her target.
Seonan tumbles off a swing and bounces up laughing.

name: Saustuna
summary: Saustuna is a polite service machine in a hidden hideout that blends a cave with a frozen stronghold. Part servant and part caped figure, this robot butler hovers nervously and serves hot drinks to dangerous masters.

feats.scene: Saustuna swats a hostile drone out of the air with a metal arm.
Saustuna is thrown into a steel wall and reboots with a dented cape.

name: Ntosa
summary: Ntosa is a postal worker whose every sleep carries him between two cities and two lives. Driven mad by experiments, this courier turned into a reality-warping being who believes every world is his own dream.

feats.scene: Ntosa rewrites the shape of a whole crowd of parallel worlds with a single shout.
Ntosa stands unharmed as an army of hostile heroes pour their strongest strikes into him.

name: Sarrusllu
summary: Sarrusllu is a grey-haired, big-shouldered beat cop with decades on the force and a hot temper. Loyal to his old mentor's family, this officer raises an orphan and keeps showing up for tough cases.

feats.scene: Sarrusllu shoulders a locked door off its frame during a raid.
Sarrusllu absorbs a brawler's blows and keeps arresting him.

name: Nauval
summary: Nauval is a young boy with a limp, part of a foster family that includes a secret champion. Worrying and kind, this child never guesses that his brother flies off to fight invaders.

feats.scene: Nauval throws a ball across a yard and hits the fence.
Nauval slips on a staircase and catches the rail.

name: Liestnum
summary: Liestnum is a foster kid who receives a share of a champion's power in a grim alternate scenario. Together with his siblings, this young hero forms a defending army that throws lightning, flies and punches hard.

feats.scene: Liestnum calls down a lightning bolt that shatters a bridge pylon.
Liestnum is blasted by a rampaging foe and shakes it off.
Liestnum streaks across a city skyline faster than sound.

name: Cineonan
summary: Cineonan is a comic-loving, fidgety boy who is the adoptive younger brother of a wizard's champion. Excitable and brave, this schoolboy turns into a heroic figure in a playful animated world.

feats.scene: Cineonan hurls a giant pumpkin that knocks over a cardboard villain.
Cineonan crashes through a cardboard wall and pops up smiling.

source_title: Frederick Freeman (The Magical Mysteries of Shazam!)

name: Ntiva
summary: Ntiva is a war-obsessed former soldier who runs a private army from a bunker deep beneath an island city. Masked as a blood-red commander, this schemer abducts a hero's friend to learn the shape of the next global conflict.

feats.scene: Ntiva orders a cache of demolition charges blown and caves in a whole tunnel.
Ntiva is flung across his command room by a trained fighter.

name: Esiumes
summary: Esiumes is a bald wheelman and fighter trained by a master of the ancient arts. Always behind a steering wheel, this driver works for a criminal network and turns tight alleys into racetracks.

feats.scene: Esiumes lands a spinning kick on a bodyguard and sends him through a window.
Esiumes absorbs a sideswipe in a tight chase and keeps his hands on the wheel.
Esiumes floors the pedal on a straight avenue with sirens behind him.

name: Lanlire
summary: Lanlire is a nimble sailor who crossed an ocean aboard a warship and joined a band of frontier scouts. Light on his feet and lively with a joke, this fighter is the most agile man in the ranks.

feats.scene: Lanlire swings from a rigging rope and kicks a musket from a redcoat's hands.
Lanlire tumbles down a muddy slope and springs up unhurt.
Lanlire sprints across a deck and leaps the rail.

name: Conel
summary: Conel is a pair of identical twin brothers born joined and split by a strange biology of their homeworld. Fighting beautifully together yet bickering constantly, these two serve as part-time reserves of a heroic order.

feats.scene: Conel combines both bodies and heaves a toppled girder off a trapped crew.
Conel takes a blast from an invader's cannon and splits apart unharmed.

name: Miestal
summary: Miestal is a radiant goddess of love who rules a meadow of the afterlife and welcomes half of the fallen warriors there. Ageless and graceful, this deity rides a chariot drawn by cats and shares a hall with her twin.

feats.scene: Miestal throws a single glance at a besieging army and melts its resolve and its weapons.
Miestal stands unscathed in the heart of a crashing storm of thunder.

name: Eooriam
summary: Eooriam is a fierce war goddess and captain of a corps of battle-maidens who ride flying horses. Skilled with axe and blade and ageless in body, this immortal warrior sneers at the helpless prayers of her enemies.

feats.scene: Eooriam cleaves a siege tower in half with one swing of a triple-headed axe.
Eooriam stands through a rain of siege stones with no wound.

name: Stariren
summary: Stariren is a cheerful, round-bellied cleric who fights alongside forest outlaws against a grasping lord. Handy with a long staff and a sword, this monk trains hounds and quotes scripture between blows.

feats.scene: Stariren spins a quarterstaff and cracks three guards' helmets in a single sweep.
Stariren takes a mailed fist to the jaw and answers with a hymn.

name: Tirnniu
summary: Tirnniu is a wasted, blue-skinned addict transformed into a crackling being of living electricity. Driven by cravings, this wanderer flies on his own charge and fears a good dousing.

feats.scene: Tirnniu blasts a transformer and blacks out a block of the beach.
Tirnniu is hit by a heavy truck and flickers but keeps moving.

name: Vascesser
summary: Vascesser is a towering, yellow-skinned alien hybrid abandoned as an infant and raised by forest creatures. Gentle but hunted, this wanderer is bound to a genie-like being and became an uneasy ally of a young team.

feats.scene: Vascesser rips a lab door from its frame and hurls it across a hangar.
Vascesser takes a volley from captors' weapons and keeps walking.

name: Tesveoor
summary: Tesveoor is a bullied former recruit who dresses as an amphibian to murder officers during a street festival. Cowardly and vengeful, this killer carries a two-pronged spear and a hose full of water.

feats.scene: Tesveoor drives a bident through a heavy oak door and pins a commander behind it.
Tesveoor takes a spear in the chest and dies.

name: Teveool
summary: Teveool is a hopeful teen who tried out for a team of heroes with a modest talent for holding his breath. Cheerful and earnest, this applicant never makes the cut but never stops trying.

feats.scene: Teveool throws a lifebuoy across a pool and drops it beside a swimmer.
Teveool stays submerged in a fountain for a staggering three minutes.

source_title: Fron Squerd (Legion of Super-Heroes TV Series)

name: Laneonium
summary: Laneonium is a headline-obsessed rogue who strikes under a newsprint mask and vanishes into the crowd. Minor and short-lived, this troublemaker lasted a single bold outing against a shape-shifting hero.

feats.scene: Laneonium swings a heavy roll of paper at a security guard and drops him.
Laneonium tumbles across a press floor and shakes off the ink.

name: Seernore
summary: Seernore is a blue-haired woman from a mirror-world who chills the air around her with a touch. Merciless and cool, this agent of a villainous syndicate freezes opponents solid.

feats.scene: Seernore breathes out a glacial gust that encases a ferry pier in ice.
Seernore walks through a blast of flame with only frost on her sleeves.

name: Tumniveo
summary: Tumniveo is a yellow-eyed, hot-blooded criminal who controls open flame with a thought. Escaped from an underground cell, this firebug lights up streets alongside other freed prisoners.

feats.scene: Tumniveo sets a parked delivery truck ablaze with one shout and a wave.
Tumniveo walks through a blazing storefront without scorching.

name: Saesrau
summary: Saesrau is a crime lord who runs the district's underworld with a doctor's knowledge of poisons and sleep. Cunning and cruel, this boss was jailed, broke out and met his end after a bold double cross.

feats.scene: Saesrau stabs a needle into a captive's arm and induces a trance.
Saesrau shrugs off a street fight and bows out with a sneer.

name: Riantniu
summary: Riantniu is a white-haired woman with ebony skin whose kiss makes living flesh rot away in seconds. Spiteful and cold, this jailbreaker leaves nothing but dust in her wake.

feats.scene: Riantniu kisses a guard's cheek and he withers to dust in moments.
Riantniu is thrown into a cell wall and shakes herself clean.

name: Vater
summary: Vater is a failed strip artist who invented a ray that pulls inked figures into the real world. Bitter and gifted in science, this cartoonist sent flat villains out to loot until he learned that his own creations never came alive.

feats.scene: Vater turns his ray on a sketch of a dragon and the beast torches a bank vault.
Vater is knocked out cold by a strong fist in his workshop.

name: Tontasrn
summary: Tontasrn is a green-skinned dream-eating fiend who crouches at the edge of sleepers' minds. Feeding on terror, this nightmare lord twists gentle dreams into screams, and a famous painting inspired his image.

feats.scene: Tontasrn pulls an entire dormitory into a single shared nightmare of falling.
Tontasrn takes a spell squarely and re-forms from smoke and dread.

name: Inreova
summary: Inreova is a red-eyed, hairless fiend with emerald skin who stalks the borderlands of dreams. Fed by fear, this monster turns sweet slumber into dread and relishes every scream.

feats.scene: Inreova drags a whole sleeping neighbourhood into a nightmare that leaves them gasping.
Inreova shrugs off a blaze of white light and creeps back from the shadows.

name: Rauveveo
summary: Rauveveo is a green goldfish who is a beloved companion to a young sea-prince. Round-eyed and calm, this small swimmer visits a strange reality to meet his mirror twin.

feats.scene: Rauveveo flicks his tail and sends a ripple across a bowl.
Rauveveo bobs through a splashy tank toss without harm.

name: Stist
summary: Stist is a grey-and-white mouse who borrowed a slice of a hero-hound's gifts when an evil device drained them. Proud of the cape and mask he wears, this rodent flies, runs fast, blasts heat and punches far above his size.

feats.scene: Stist blows a column of heat at a villain's war machine and melts its plating.
Stist bounces off a crashing walker and squeaks defiantly.
Stist rockets over a rooftop skyline ahead of a speeding drone.

name: Aslis
summary: Aslis is a hired killer who wears a harness of coiled cables that spits jets of burning gas. Contracts are taken in silence and finished before the target hears a single footstep.

feats.scene: Aslis vents the whole harness at a bank vault door and melts the hinges into slag.
A rooftop fall onto a parked truck leaves the harness dented and its wearer on his feet.

name: Iuvas
summary: Iuvas runs a smuggling empire that sells crates of rifles to rival gangs from behind a ledger and a calm smile. He has never fired a shot himself, and his rivals always find the invoice before the bullet.

feats.scene: Iuvas slaps a late-paying courier hard enough to knock him off his chair.
He walks away from a car that clipped him at a dockside crossing.

name: Arnte
summary: Arnte is a seven-foot jailer with pink skin, tripod feet and four whiplike braids tipped in spikes. Taken hostage once, he quietly beat his captors senseless and then waited politely for the cell to be unlocked.

feats.scene: Arnte drives a braid spike through a steel cell door and tears it from its frame.
He shrugs off a collapsing guard tower that buries the rest of the yard.

name: Tertau
summary: Tertau is a floppy-eared, dog-faced soldier of a distant ring-bearing order, loyal to a fault and clumsy in every rescue. His glowing ring somehow works better than anyone expects, usually by accident.

feats.scene: Tertau panics and flings a glowing hammer that flattens a parked freighter.
A shimmering bubble from his ring holds while a ship scrapes across it.

name: Eruau
summary: Eruau is a fanged, furry recruit pressed into powering a tyrant's doomsday engine alongside his fellow rank. His ring is the only thing the tyrant fears he might misuse.

feats.scene: Eruau feeds his ring into the engine until the cooling towers glow white.
He hangs in the machine's clamps through a full firing cycle and still blinks awake.

name: Rncor
summary: Rncor is a small-time ring bearer whose face turns up in rocket-pilot advertisements more often than on any battlefield. Beneath the gag he can still raise a barrier and hurl bright bolts.

feats.scene: Rncor blasts a stalled shuttle off the track with a single bolt.
A glowing shield around him takes a head-on hit from a runaway cargo pod.

name: Lortacor
summary: Lortacor is a well-meaning bumbler who got his power ring by mistake and stayed a hero by sheer persistence. He pesters bigger teams for a chance to help and sometimes saves the day by luck.

feats.scene: Lortacor wildly swings a ring-made wrecking ball that levels a deserted warehouse.
He sits in a green dome while a rampaging beast stomps on it for an hour.

name: Tiulrni
summary: Tiulrni served as a ring wielder before a long war with a fear-feeding monster scattered his order. Few records of his deeds remain beyond the glow of his old ring.

feats.scene: Tiulrni cuts a stranded freight car in two with a thin ribbon of light.
He rides out a train derailment inside a shimmering shell.

name: Illan
summary: Illan is a ring-carrying fighter from a cartoon universe, quick with a quip and quicker with a glowing shield. He answers every distress call, whether or not anyone asked for him.

feats.scene: Illan hits a giant mind-controlled robot with a bolt that cracks its chest plate.
He is thrown through a stone wall and gets up laughing.

name: Lacorros
summary: Lacorros is a pint-sized ring bearer who patrols a playground-scaled galaxy of cardboard rockets and juice boxes. His glowing creations are always a little crooked and always just enough.

feats.scene: Lacorros builds a glowing slide and sends a runaway toy truck over a fence with it.
A glowing pillow absorbs a tumble down a flight of stairs.

name: Osarsor
summary: Osarsor is a shapeshifter who soaks up the blood traits of other creatures and wears them all at once in a lumpy, grinning mass. A laughing poison gave him a manic grin that never fades.

feats.scene: Osarsor sprouts three borrowed arms and tosses a park bench into a tree.
He keeps swinging after a heavy sonic blast rattles the whole park.

name: Anureslis
summary: Anureslis is a wartime machine soldier built to hunt invaders, with a cheerful voice and an endless internal armoury. Decades later he is still polite, still lethal and still asking friends to join the hunt.

feats.scene: Anureslis unfolds a shoulder cannon and levels a fortified bunker in one volley.
He stands in an artillery barrage with scorched plating and an unbroken grin.
He sprints across open mud faster than any soldier alongside him.

name: Tuman
summary: Tuman is a tiny talking monkey who rides along with a masked hero and a bumbling professor. He tumbles through trouble with a surprising talent for being exactly where a plan needs him.

feats.scene: Tuman yanks a lever with all his weight and drops a net on a pair of thieves.
He lands on a pavement from a lamppost and scampers off.

name: Nineonter
summary: Nineonter is a white-haired archangel who guards the arts and cannot stand being told his work lacks weight. Exiled from the sky after a mortal's scheme, he sulks in a mortal city and keeps his wings folded.

feats.scene: Nineonter unfurls his wings and a pulse of white light flattens a row of tenement blocks.
He stands unmarked in the heart of a collapsing cathedral.
He crosses a harbour in the time it takes to clap.

name: Teiueru
summary: Teiueru is an orphan who survived a cruel upbringing around fighting dogs and grew into a brute with claws and fangs. He hunts for an underworld syndicate and craves the approval of the one person who keeps him at arm's length.

feats.scene: Teiueru's claws rip an engine block out of a parked car.
He takes a brutal beating from a thug crew and still drags himself home.

name: Seirntia
summary: Seirntia is a white-haired intelligence operative who reads minds in smoke-filled briefing rooms. Colleagues keep their thoughts blank around him, which he finds more revealing than any confession.

feats.scene: Seirntia pushes a stranger's will aside and walks him out of a locked office.
He is struck by a closing car door in a garage and shrugs it off.

name: Sttil
summary: Sttil is a zoologist who volunteered to be crossed with a quick weasel-like animal and now robs vaults at night. Her speed and cunning once won her a place beside a clown, until he left her stranded on a rooftop.

feats.scene: Sttil kicks open a reinforced vault grille after dodging the guards.
She races across a row of rooftops faster than a patrol car below.

name: Ratiuan
summary: Ratiuan is a refugee teen who died and was rebuilt around a living light-engine, waking with a halo of coloured aura and no memories. Each recovered memory pulls them toward guilt and away from old friends.

feats.scene: Ratiuan bursts into radiant colour and burns a tunnel through a concrete bunker.
Their aura closes over a crushing blow and the damage fades in seconds.

name: Seotel
summary: Seotel was a driver and a mother, remembered by her family as the steady hand behind two daughters and a quiet household. Her story is told only by the people she left behind.

feats.scene: Seotel stamps the brake and swerves a family car clear of a stalled truck.
She holds the wheel through a hard roadside bump with a sleeping child beside her.

name: Orrast
summary: Orrast is a patient classroom teacher at a city high school, known for staying late with struggling students. A passing crush on a masked neighbour never goes anywhere, and she finds contentment in her work.

feats.scene: Orrast slams a heavy classroom window shut against a gale.
She takes a fall on icy school steps and keeps teaching that day.

name: Ntetorres
summary: Ntetorres is a stranded alien whose power has no visible limit, bent by a cruel family into terrible deeds. He fled in shame, shut down into blank obedience, then woke and sailed home to mend his kin.

feats.scene: Ntetorres obeys a flat command and rewrites a whole mountain range into glass.
He takes a blow from his whole family at once and does not flinch.
He leaves orbit in a blink with his defeated relatives in tow.

name: Riliunan
summary: Riliunan is the purest knight of an old order, reborn centuries later as a warrior in a distant island nation. He guards his honour more tightly than his life and keeps looking for a worthy death.

feats.scene: Riliunan cleaves an armoured invader from shoulder to hip with one stroke.
He keeps fighting through a field of alien fire after his shield breaks.

name: Norantel
summary: Norantel is the ghost of a round-table knight, cursed long ago into an old axe after a family betrayal broke the fellowship. Without a body, he can only speak and strike through whoever lifts the blade.

feats.scene: Norantel guides a wielder's swing and splits an oak log in one blow.
The axe blade survives a rockfall that shatters the cellar floor.

name: Corresnia
summary: Corresnia is a scholar of old chivalric tales who survived a ruined hospital and a burned city, then came to believe he is a legendary knight. Wandering a magical wood that heals mind and body, he fights off wolves and tends a wounded archer.

feats.scene: Corresnia drives off a snarling pack with a branch and bare fists.
He lifts fallen beams off the trapped and walks away bleeding but upright.

name: Catel
summary: Catel is a lab-grown warrior made from a stranger's genes, built to be a weapon for her makers and burdened by borrowed dreams. When her makers lost control, she hunted anyone who knew of her.

feats.scene: Catel hurls a fireball from her eyes and brings down a concrete bridge span.
She walks out of an engineered explosion with torn clothes and a scowl.
She crosses a valley faster than sound.

name: Tumninva
summary: Tumninva is a skiing-and-shooting champion turned elite sniper, calm under siege and loyal to her spotter. Together they cleared a rooftop of super-terrorists using borrowed hardware and clean shots.

feats.scene: Tumninva drops a sniper's bullet through a window across a plaza.
She sprints through a collapsing stairwell and walks out intact.

name: Nesies
summary: Nesies is a warrior priestess of a hidden island people, blessed with the strength of their gods. Turned into a cat to serve a goddess, she now guards a champion from the shadows with fangs and claws.

feats.scene: Nesies leaps from a rafter and bowls over a charging armoured guard.
She falls from a cliff face and lands on all fours.

name: Iltirium
summary: Iltirium is a disciplined ring soldier of a space police corps, trained to tame fear with will. His glowing shapes are efficient and tidy, and he rarely wastes an effort.

feats.scene: Iltirium builds a giant glowing mallet and smashes a rebel barricade flat.
A luminous wall stops a fusillade of heavy bolts.

name: Erlenus
summary: Erlenus is a lanky ring officer in a stylized cartoon cosmos, always the second to arrive and the first to salute. His willpower shapes sturdy glowing tools for any job.

feats.scene: Erlenus casts a glowing net over a falling satellite and slows it to a halt.
He shields himself from a power surge in a crackling glowing bubble.

source_title: Galius Zed (The Brave and the Bold)

name: Tause
summary: Tause is a pink-skinned sea god from beyond the stars, a conqueror who calls the ocean to crush his foes. Long-lived and merciless, he serves a trio of deep rulers.

feats.scene: Tause drops a wall of water on a harbour town and drags it under.
He rises unharmed after a seaside fortress falls on him.

name: Orrumtor
summary: Orrumtor is a red-haired fence and broker who trusts her boss to be better than he seems. She wears layered armour and a rebreather, and does her fighting mostly with contracts and patience.

feats.scene: Orrumtor fires a pistol at a pursuer and drops him behind a crate.
Her armoured jacket stops a volley of slugs at the dock.

name: Ntitiltor
summary: Ntitiltor is an orange-skinned, pointy-eared ring bearer from a far-future ocean world. He patrols a distant sector with quiet confidence, backed by a resolute will.

feats.scene: Ntitiltor launches a ring-forged harpoon and pins a smuggler's ship to a moon.
A radiant barrier shields him from a collapsing space dock.

name: Inullisti
summary: Inullisti is a mob boss who rules his turf through threats and bounties and takes insults badly. He thought he could dismiss a stranger with painted scars, and paid for it.

feats.scene: Inullisti hits a debtor so hard that the man falls through a card table.
He takes a pipe across the shoulders and does not sway.

name: Anues
summary: Anues is a late-night radio host who talks a city through dark hours with a warm voice and sharp taste in records. His quiet life takes him from studio to studio and out again.

feats.scene: Anues hauls a heavy crate of records up a flight of steps.
He slips on a wet curb and rises unhurt.

name: Lalan
summary: Lalan is a teenage bully who can split into three copies of herself, each acting alone but sharing sight and feeling. The weakness is plain, since knocking out one body drops all three.

feats.scene: Lalan has two copies pin a classmate while the third swings a locker door.
One copy takes a hard shove and all three stagger together.

name: Tollieo
summary: Tollieo is a young city fighter who took up her uncle's masked identity to protect her neighbourhood. She wins by technique and grit rather than power.

feats.scene: Tollieo drops a mugger with a spinning kick to the jaw.
She takes a tumble down a fire escape and keeps running.

name: Ninaucor
summary: Ninaucor is a small, wise elder of a cosmic order who later helped found a corps built on hope. His quiet patience steers younger hands, though he rarely lifts a hand himself.

feats.scene: Ninaucor raises one hand and a mountain of rock lifts out of the sea and hangs there.
He remains seated in a council chamber while it shakes itself apart.

name: Torlen
summary: Torlen is a white-haired cupbearer of a mountain-top court who pours the drink that grants endless life. A guest who refused his cup caused the loudest uproar the halls had heard in an age.

feats.scene: Torlen hurls a golden cup and cracks a marble pillar.
He stands in the middle of a thunderclap that shatters the hall's roof.

name: Serresrer
summary: Serresrer is an alien who crash-landed in an old century and slowly became the iron-fisted ruler of a whole empire. His descendants spread across generations, and he cannot see why his cold rule is wrong.

feats.scene: Serresrer lifts a meeting hall off its foundations and carries it across the river.
He stands unscratched under a cannon barrage from a whole fleet.
He crosses a channel in the time it takes a rider to blink.

name: Nusselan
summary: Nusselan is a red-haired sergeant who once worked for a government agency before switching sides to help a local team. He can turn unseen for a time and fights well hand to hand.

feats.scene: Nusselan vanishes and lands a hard blow on a guard from behind.
He takes a rifle butt to the ribs and carries on.

name: Aulliaul
summary: Aulliaul is a green-skinned young shapechanger from a darker timeline, a loyal teammate who trusted the wrong newcomer. His friends fall under a rain of rock, and he is left to ask how it happened.

feats.scene: Aulliaul becomes a rhino and charges through a brick wall.
He digs out from under a collapsed headquarters.

source_title: Garfield Logan (Dark Multiverse: Teen Titans: The Judas Contract)

name: Raceo
summary: Raceo is a cheerful green-skinned teen who can become any creature he can picture, and cracks jokes while doing it. A serum his parents gave him in a fever changed his body for good.

feats.scene: Raceo turns into an elephant and flattens a fence in one stampede.
As a rhino he takes a tank shell on his brow and shakes his head clear.
He swoops as a falcon over a canyon faster than a speeding train.

name: Iumcoros
summary: Iumcoros is a once-heroic teen whose pledge to a demon lord twisted him into a clawed, fanged conqueror with milk-white eyes. Fire and stone swallowed him in a collapsing cavern.

feats.scene: Iumcoros swings a clawed fist and cleaves a cavern wall into rubble.
He weathers a fiery pit's heat and a tower of falling rock for a full minute.

source_title: Garfield Logan (Last 52: Falling Through the Cracks)

name: Rnrnu
summary: Rnrnu is a secret green-haired adventurer from a series of short cartoons, who shifts into animals to fight crime between burping fits. His comic timing is as sharp as his claws.

feats.scene: Rnrnu becomes a bear and bats a runaway robot into a wall.
He bounces up from a crushing fall as a springy frog.

name: Irnseter
summary: Irnseter is a tiny, big-eyed cartoon prankster who slips between panels of a comic book to tell jokes. When a sneeze flings him into another world, he helps clean up the mess.

feats.scene: Irnseter turns into an ant and drags a toy crate across a table.
He gets flattened by a page turn and pops back into shape.

source_title: Garfield Logan (Teen Titans TV Series: Tween Titans)

name: Numvaian
summary: Numvaian lost the gift of changing shape and was stuck in the body of an ape inside a city that turned out to be a vast mental projection. He helped a band of oddballs trace the dream back to its maker.

feats.scene: Numvaian swings from a girder and knocks a guard flat.
He lands from a rooftop leap and climbs straight back up.

name: Soresi
summary: Soresi is a hardened shapechanger from a grim possible future who commands wild animals and scorns shame. He lives under another name and quietly mentors those who still use humour to stay human.

feats.scene: Soresi becomes a charging mammoth and tramples a line of armoured cars.
In bear form he takes a barrage of rifle fire and keeps walking.

name: Ruscorser
summary: Ruscorser is a young man cured of a fever by a doctor's serum, which let him unzip his own blood and rebuild himself as a tiger or any other beast. The living web of animal life behind it all seems to be calling him.

feats.scene: Ruscorser pounces as a tiger and bowls a gunman through a doorway.
He survives a wall collapse in his beast shape.
He runs down a speeding motorcycle on foot.

name: Rneri
summary: Rneri is a masked fire-starter in a hand-drawn rendition of a rain-slicked city, wielding a suit of burning gear and a flamethrower. Fire is the only language he enjoys.

feats.scene: Rneri torches a warehouse roof until the rafters fall.
His heat suit survives a blazing gas explosion.

name: Miavosna
summary: Miavosna is a former film-effects expert who sees visions in flames and wears a flame-throwing flight suit, striking at the wealthy of a poor city. Raised in an orphanage, he never learned to be wanted.

feats.scene: Miavosna swoops over a rail yard and sets a whole row of carriages alight.
His armoured suit absorbs a rooftop tumble and a nearby blast.
He banks around a bell tower in his jet pack.

name: Tircosia
summary: Tircosia is a flamethrower-toting pilot summoned to a gathering of rogues by a mischievous imp. In the cramped hall she tripped over a rival's frost gun and knocked herself out.

feats.scene: Tircosia fires her flamer and scorches the ceiling of a convention hall.
She shrugs off a few punches before the frost beam lays her flat.

name: Vantotes
summary: Vantotes is a seven-foot performing ape, drilled by outside handlers to hunt a champion and fetch a defector. Freed from his cage at last, he returns to the grasslands where he belongs.

feats.scene: Vantotes pulls a hotel window frame from its brick and tosses it aside.
He absorbs a series of electric shocks and still rises to his feet.

name: Corrnuval
summary: Corrnuval is a tall, scrawny deckhand with a mild voice and an iron nerve, adopted by two adventurers on a smuggler hunt. Foes who take him for a fool find a razor at their throat.

feats.scene: Corrnuval slashes with a straight blade and cuts a rope holding a cargo net over a thief.
He takes a heavy blow from a crate and finishes his cooking.

name: Sestrn
summary: Sestrn is a masked villain who appeared once and vanished, a carved-stone nightmare that haunted a team of explorers. Little is known of his plans beyond the scare he caused.

feats.scene: Sestrn throws a stone block from a parapet at passing adventurers.
His stone mask cracks but holds under a hammer blow.

name: Stisinel
summary: Stisinel is a green-skinned, red-eyed alien would-be conqueror who tests advanced weapons on a foreign planet. His grand story of exile turned out to be a lie told for a distant tyrant.

feats.scene: Stisinel fires a lunar base cannon and levels a few city blocks.
He survives an orbital laser blast that obliterates his ship.

name: Telvalval
summary: Telvalval is a pink-skinned warrior queen conjured out of a space-romance novel by a pyromaniac's imagination, with a sword and few words. She came to life to fight a monster and left a lasting mark on a crew of time travelers.

feats.scene: Telvalval cleaves a monster's tentacle with one sword stroke.
She stands in a monster's crushing grip and breaks free.

name: Nolvalti
summary: Nolvalti was a red-eyed, hairless ring bearer guarding a distant sector, and a parent of three. He gave his life shielding the young children of strangers from a deadly attack.

feats.scene: Nolvalti forms a glowing wall and slams it into an onrushing horde.
His shield holds a full minute under heavy fire before it gives way.

name: Torerusa
summary: Torerusa is a blond inventor and army scientist who works on experimental living-metal robots at a remote research base. He shares a laboratory, and a family name, with a rival brother.

feats.scene: Torerusa switches on a test rig and a robotic arm lifts a steel plate.
He stands behind a blast screen while a prototype overheats.

name: Sauoroau
summary: Sauoroau is a purple-eyed undersea diplomat who studied spell-craft and once fought as a young hero. Grief over a lost love sent him home to speak for his people at a human council.

feats.scene: Sauoroau calls a storm and a whirl of lightning sinks a gunboat.
He endures deep-sea pressure and a blast from a rival caster.

name: Necor
summary: Necor is a black-haired sea warrior in a warped timeline who serves a ruthless king and fights hand to hand with trained, brutal skill. His loyalty is his only comfort.

feats.scene: Necor drives a fist through a wooden hull and floods the hold.
He takes a spear thrust to the ribs and swims on.

name: Serelis
summary: Serelis is a schoolchild from a coral kingdom, who dries out faster than any land dweller and hangs out in a treehouse built on a reef. He gives his friends a tour and shows them how to eat dessert underwater.

feats.scene: Serelis splashes a friend across a reef pool with a flick of his hand.
He tumbles through a cluster of coral and laughs.

name: Ticoel
summary: Ticoel is a red-haired young man who gained control over lightning when strange storm beasts attacked his family's stranded ship. He is the restless heart of a far-future team and always seems to be searching for something.

feats.scene: Ticoel calls a bolt down from a cloud and fells a stone tower.
He takes an electric surge that would melt a cable and glows brighter.

name: Nieoval
summary: Nieoval is a younger duplicate of a far-future hero, born from a time paradox and later erased. He fights with electric arcs and a flight ring.

feats.scene: Nieoval forks a lightning arc between two rooftops and burns out an antenna array.
He absorbs a stun beam that drops a squad of guards.

name: Rnillril
summary: Rnillril is a chibi-style lightning wielder who travels to the past with friends to fetch a genius for an emergency that turns out to be a birthday party. He is cheerful and bounces around.

feats.scene: Rnillril zaps a toy robot and sends it spinning across a rug.
He is bonked by a party balloon and giggles.

name: Amteel
summary: Amteel is a pink-skinned, stone-bodied alien from a peaceful world of rock people who became a married officer of the law. He raises a young son and works long shifts in a rowdy mercenary force.

feats.scene: Amteel punches through a vault wall and drags out a thief.
He takes a collapsing ceiling on his shoulders and keeps walking.

name: Torrnmia
summary: Torrnmia is a pink-skinned, hairless stage wrestler with claws, one half of a tag team in an interdimensional league. The bouts are scripted but the slams are genuine.

feats.scene: Torrnmia drops an iron-armed move on a rival and cracks the ring boards.
He gets thrown through three ropes and bounces back up.

name: Resco
summary: Resco is a loyal gang henchman who was nicknamed by his boss and never got to insist on his real name. Shot once and stabbed once, he kept standing up for the crew.

feats.scene: Resco swings a pipe at an enemy boss and lands a clean hit.
He gets shot in the chest, is rushed to surgery and returns to duty.

name: Rivarseo
summary: Rivarseo is a dark-haired prankster who runs deadly puzzle games for his own amusement, and once worked for a clown boss. Players enter his contests and rarely leave on their own terms.

feats.scene: Rivarseo springs a trapdoor that drops a contestant into a pit.
He survives a scuffle with a pair of angry players.

name: Eruiasnti
summary: Eruiasnti is a professional thief who commands the wind and works for a sinister master. A gale from his hands scatters guards and papers alike.

feats.scene: Eruiasnti whips up a gust that tears a roof off a shed.
He rides a crash landing out of a thermal and walks away limping.

name: Lasco
summary: Lasco is a restless ghost of a double-dealing spy killed during a covert mission, carried inside another man's body as the first of many souls. Anger lets him seize the body to settle an old score.

feats.scene: Lasco takes control of his host and fires a pistol at a former rival.
Cast out of the body, he drifts apart and still lingers.

name: Teneo
summary: Teneo is a kind-hearted party clown who was mocked for his height but never lost his decency. He was spared in a terrible night and kept going through the aftermath.

feats.scene: Teneo tugs a door handle that is just out of reach and has to ask for help.
He stays upright in a witness box through hours of questions.

name: Tesse
summary: Tesse is a masked extremist in a fringe militia who uses canisters of poison vapour in crowded buildings. Respirator hissing, he waits for the panic to thin the guards.

feats.scene: Tesse vents a canister and empties a government hallway.
His sealed mask and suit protect him through a thick cloud.

name: Rneeruau
summary: Rneeruau is a thug who hisses knockout vapour from a backpack tank, working smash-and-grab jobs from a van. Guards fall asleep in doorways while he fills his sack.

feats.scene: Rneeruau opens a valve and drops three guards in a hallway.
He takes a tackle and keeps his tank intact.

name: Toranlis
summary: Toranlis is a fallen winged being with an ironic sense of humour, once sent to guard a mortal woman and later to recover her soul from a silent realm. He crews a ghost ship through the afterlife.

feats.scene: Toranlis spreads his wings and a ray of pale light sweeps a hall of shades to ash.
He stands calmly at the heart of a collapsing citadel.

name: Nteruno
summary: Nteruno is a grey-haired, blustering politician and old soldier who rails about borders and conspiracies, idolising a violent veteran. His campaign speeches fill stadiums and his secrets fill folders.

feats.scene: Nteruno raps a podium so hard that the microphone jumps.
He stands through a day of rallies and a thrown bottle.

name: Linnaiu
summary: Linnaiu is a courteous knight and nephew of a legendary king, known across many retellings by a handful of names. His honour is famous, and his descendants carry a rich name into a later age.

feats.scene: Linnaiu splits an iron shield in a single sword stroke.
He fights on through a field of arrows, held up by his armour.

name: Rumtinte
summary: Rumtinte is a white-haired mad scientist from a doomed world who built a quake engine to bring it down. His punishment was the longest exile in a silent prison between worlds.

feats.scene: Rumtinte switches on his engine and cracks a continent-sized fault line.
He is seized by guards and dragged away without a bruise.

name: Rauore
summary: Rauore is a stretchy shape-shifting spy from a heroic mirror world who impersonates a rival to infiltrate her enemies. She rallies her team to help strangers escape.

feats.scene: Rauore stretches an arm across a hall and shoves a guard through a window.
Her rubbery body takes a heavy blow and snaps back.

source_title: Gemini (Teen Titans TV Series: Wrong Place, Wrong Time)

name: Uneruamo
summary: Uneruamo is a black-haired criminal who can reshape her body into any person or beast, inheriting a dead mother's talent and a grudge. She framed a green hero for crimes, then helped a gang flatten a coastal city.

feats.scene: Uneruamo drops a hulking creature onto a coastal city and levels its districts.
In an armoured beast shape she takes a heavy beating and walks away.

name: Ilcosa
summary: Ilcosa is a quiet bench technician who calibrates delicate instruments at a research firm and is never noticed until something goes wrong. Ilcosa knows every cable and valve by touch and has talked more than one frantic manager out of a shutdown.

feats.scene: Ilcosa heaves a jammed cabinet door off its rails with a single wrench-assisted pull.
Ilcosa tumbles down a flight of steel stairs and stands up with only bruises.

name: Taauar
summary: Taauar is a bayou boat-man who also practises folk healing, easing fevers and burns with whispered prayers and herb poultices. Taauar poles a flat canoe through black water at dusk and senses when the marsh has gone strangely silent.

feats.scene: Taauar drives a pole through the mud and shoves a grounded canoe free of the bank.
Taauar is thrown from a capsizing boat into cold water and swims to shore unhurt.

name: Eretes
summary: Eretes is a stern field commander who assembles disposable strike teams of convicts and sends them against absurd threats. Eretes works from a map table with a cold pot of coffee and trusts nothing that cannot be briefed in a minute.

feats.scene: Eretes slams a fist on the planning table hard enough to split a cheap clipboard.
Eretes is knocked flat by a bunker door blown open and rises to keep issuing orders.

name: Luniane
summary: Luniane is a red-skinned lieutenant who carries reports from a battlefield world to a bloodthirsty war lord and prefers a long, grinding conflict to a quick peace. Luniane schemes quietly to remove anyone who might end the fighting early.

feats.scene: Luniane hurls a spiked war-standard through a rampart gate, splintering the timbers.
Luniane shrugs off a barrage of crude shells that crater the ground around the command tent.

name: Oluvi
summary: Oluvi is a monocled desert commander who runs a dusty supply front with parade-ground rigidity. Oluvi barks over a crackling radio and scans the dunes through a brass spyglass, sure that victory is only a matter of discipline.

feats.scene: Oluvi cracks a riding crop across a map table and snaps it in two.
Oluvi staggers through a sandstorm and a jeep rollover and still demands a status report.

name: Ianori
summary: Ianori is a retired, xenophobic army officer who once sat on a secret oversight board watching over costumed champions. Ianori lives with the guilt of one rash shot and the fear that old secrets will come looking for a loose tongue.

feats.scene: Ianori fires a heavy rifle round that punches through a concrete barricade.
Ianori survives a collapsing watchtower, pinned but conscious beneath the rubble.

name: Rnseirn
summary: Rnseirn is a bald, cartoonish old villain drawn in a squat, comic style who cracks bad puns from a prison cell. Rnseirn never does anything frightening and mostly watches events on a small television with a grin.

feats.scene: Rnseirn flings a rubber chicken across the cell block and knocks a guard's hat off.
Rnseirn bounces off a cell wall in a slapstick tumble and pops up grinning.

source_title: General Immortus (Teen Titans TV Series: Tween Titans)

name: Araulrn
summary: Araulrn is the half-sacred, half-infernal offspring of two feuding spirits, a boundless force that must lodge inside a mortal to be steered. Araulrn can compel obedience with a single spoken command, and once razed an entire small town in a heartbeat.

feats.scene: Araulrn bursts out of a cradle of light and flattens a whole prairie township in one shockwave.
Araulrn endures the combined smiting of a legion of winged guards without a mark.

name: Mianusti
summary: Mianusti is a towering nine-foot conqueror who rules a hidden highland stronghold with a retinue of equally enormous riders. Mianusti claims a long sleep in a strange tonic stretched his bones, though sceptics suspect staged theatre.

feats.scene: Mianusti cleaves a stone gatepost with one two-handed sweep of a curved sabre.
Mianusti is hurled from a galloping horse onto rock and rises still shouting orders.

name: Arosser
summary: Arosser is a nomad who drew a fabled blade from an old tomb and became convinced he carries a dead emperor's spirit. Arosser leads a thundering mass of horse archers westward, certain that destiny rides in the saddle beside him.

feats.scene: Arosser splits a boulder-sized grave marker with the ancient sword in a single stroke.
Arosser takes a point-blank volley of arrows against a breastplate and keeps charging.

name: Sortir
summary: Sortir is a lonely teenager raised by a relative who has just met a distant, atomic-powered father. Sortir carries a dormant inherited spark that flared once to shield him when sky-fire struck him down.

feats.scene: Sortir shoves a locked gate hard enough to buckle the hinge.
Sortir stands unharmed as a bolt of lightning crashes straight onto his head.

name: Tiveo
summary: Tiveo is a stitched-together clay brute animated from blood-soaked soil, built by a cabal of schemers as a killing weapon. Tiveo hunts costumed heroes with a cruel grin and wears a stolen glowing rope grafted beneath her skin.

feats.scene: Tiveo smashes through the front of a crowded mall and brings down a section of roof.
Tiveo takes a heavy explosive charge square in the chest and walks on.

name: Veoiule
summary: Veoiule is an eyeless red-haired clay giantess raised from an ocean grave by a pact of blood and sent to wipe out an island of warrior women. Veoiule is bound as a living weapon to a ruthless commander.

feats.scene: Veoiule rips a coastal watchtower from its cliff footing and flings it into the surf.
Veoiule walks out from beneath a collapsing sea cave without a crack in her body.

name: Aullleser
summary: Aullleser is a weary sword-bearer from a married life in a big city who now holds a gateway against endless fiend swarms. Aullleser lives in a pocket where minutes outside are years within, and once swapped places so two friends could cover the post.

feats.scene: Aullleser cuts down a rank of snarling fiends in a single sweeping sword stroke.
Aullleser bears claws and fangs of a charging horde for a day and a night before resting.

name: Amsaia
summary: Amsaia is a college footballer secretly warped by fallen space stones, using the gift to bulldoze opponents on the field. Amsaia will hide anything, even a killing, to keep a place on the team and avoid the drug screening.

feats.scene: Amsaia plows through three tacklers and drives them into the turf in one run.
Amsaia shrugs off a full-speed helmet hit that would put a normal player in the hospital.

name: Nenvorser
summary: Nenvorser is a young, vain cavalry officer in a war between two halves of a nation, hungry for glory and annoyed when a stronger soldier steals the day. Nenvorser rides at the head of a mounted brigade and sulks over a battle that never came.

feats.scene: Nenvorser leads a thundering saddle charge that smashes through a line of skirmishers.
Nenvorser is thrown from a rearing horse onto hard ground and remounts at once.

name: Naucarse
summary: Naucarse is a fair-haired frontier horse soldier, brash and flamboyant, who leads a mounted regiment across open plains. Naucarse rides as if the whole prairie owed him applause.

feats.scene: Naucarse hurls a cavalry lance clean through a straw target at full gallop.
Naucarse lands hard from a bolting mount and walks off the fall.

name: Sacolco
summary: Sacolco is a loud, pompous horse-general in a rowdy parody world, notorious for his vanity and his bad luck with company. Sacolco meets a sudden end when a flung charge of blasting powder comes through a window.

feats.scene: Sacolco swings a cavalry sabre with a theatrical flourish and chops a barrel in half.
Sacolco is caught in a bundle of blasting powder blown in through a window and dies from it.

name: Teltiveo
summary: Teltiveo is a smug small-town mayor who talks about family while quietly shifting money and blame onto his neighbours. Teltiveo sells a dangerous green mineral on the side and loses an election by a narrow margin.

feats.scene: Teltiveo slams a ledger onto a council table and rattles a pitcher of water.
Teltiveo takes a bruising shove from an angry crowd and keeps smiling for the cameras.

name: Tiunauco
summary: Tiunauco is a hulking mobster who wears a gorilla mask and bullies rival crews alongside masked associates. Tiunauco enforces for a gang of disguised thugs and brawls with chairs and crowbars.

feats.scene: Tiunauco swings a crowbar into a steel shutter and leaves a deep dent.
Tiunauco takes a baseball bat across the back and laughs through the pain.

name: Arreste
summary: Arreste is a gruff old veteran who runs the family department store in a farm town and loses his health late in life. Arreste is remembered as a hard father whose son's shadow outlived him.

feats.scene: Arreste hoists a crate of stock onto the shop counter in one lift.
Arreste pushes through months of illness while still opening the shop each morning.

name: Varon
summary: Varon is a sneering, cowardly thief from the outback whose weapon is a case of weaponised throwing sticks. Varon complains constantly, bets on every fight, and meets a grim end in a prison-bound mission.

feats.scene: Varon flicks a razor-edged boomerang that slices through a rope and rebounds into his palm.
Varon is clubbed by a guard and still limps away laughing.

name: Orias
summary: Orias is a red-haired outback crook fitted with cybernetic upgrades and a reflective prism rig, drafted into a convict squad after a capture. Orias throws weapons with unnatural precision and a strong accent.

feats.scene: Orias fires a bent-light prism blast that melts a section of fence.
Orias is slammed into a brick wall by a larger foe and gets back up.

name: Valamorau
summary: Valamorau is a jobless stage performer driven to a breakdown who blames the whole theatre business and lashes out at a masked puzzle-solving champion. Valamorau treats every setback as a plot against him.

feats.scene: Valamorau hurls a prop trunk across a stage in a theatrical rage.
Valamorau crashes through painted scenery and stumbles up with a wail.

name: Lanli
summary: Lanli is a witty, balding submarine skipper who loses his boat in polar ice and wins a rival's ship by cleverness. Lanli later settles on a tropical island, grows exotic plants, and runs a madcap games festival after a bump on the head.

feats.scene: Lanli hauls a heavy treasure chest up a lagoon ladder.
Lanli is struck on the skull by a falling spar and recovers within a day.

name: Amoconiu
summary: Amoconiu is a hotel keeper in a damp riverside town who is killed by greedy relatives, leaving a hidden fortune and a haunting rumour. Amoconiu is later impersonated by a ghost costume to drive guests away.

feats.scene: Amoconiu carries a stack of heavy trunks up a creaking staircase.
Amoconiu endures a hard shove down the porch steps before the fatal blow.

name: Nasias
summary: Nasias is a harried newsroom chief in an old-time city who gives a farm boy a chance during an invasion crisis. Nasias dies saving a young colleague from a blazing alien beam.

feats.scene: Nasias shoves a young assistant clear of a searing beam across the office.
Nasias is caught in the heat of an alien machine's beam that collapses his office.

name: Renmival
summary: Renmival is a long-serving newspaper editor who retires at sixty-five and hands his desk to a successor. Renmival once welcomed a teenage legend to the city and trusted a young reporter's instincts.

feats.scene: Renmival drops a stack of proofs onto a desk with a thud that silences the room.
Renmival works three deadline nights in a row and still checks every headline.

name: Tenteva
summary: Tenteva is a sharp-eyed publisher and chief of a rival paper who offers a young newcomer his first reporting post. Tenteva becomes an ally of a flying hero through that one bold hiring choice.

feats.scene: Tenteva slaps a fresh edition down so hard the cups jump.
Tenteva stays upright through a rowdy press-room scuffle without losing his glasses.

name: Seane
summary: Seane is the younger newspaper man who follows his father into the trade and edits a paper in a lakeside city. Seane gives a rich archer a column and a cover for secret work.

feats.scene: Seane flings a bundle of newsprint onto the loading dock.
Seane works through a press-room fire drill without flinching.

name: Vaereo
summary: Vaereo is a white-haired commander from a mirror-world colony who surrenders his sword to a victorious foe in a formal ceremony. Vaereo serves a crown that rules rather than rebels in his twisted version of history.

feats.scene: Vaereo draws a ceremonial sabre and snaps a flag pole with one cut.
Vaereo sits a horse through a musket volley and holds the line.

name: Sartael
summary: Sartael is a tall founding commander who led a rebel army, served as a first national leader, and was later raised from the grave as a shambling corpse. Sartael survived a secret assassination plot thanks to a frontier scout.

feats.scene: Sartael wheels his horse and cuts down a lunging assassin with a sabre.
Sartael endures a winter camp of ice and hunger without surrendering command.

name: Vecel
summary: Vecel is a lively schoolgirl and athlete who befriends two young heroes at a prep academy. Vecel cheers loudest from the sideline and tends to turn up where trouble starts.

feats.scene: Vecel drives a volleyball across the gym with a thunderclap spike.
Vecel skids across a gym floor in a dive and bounces up unhurt.

name: Iuneoiu
summary: Iuneoiu is a vain young scientist's daughter who speaks a secret word to transform into a flying, near-invulnerable fighter. Iuneoiu is undone when a trick makes her blurt the word, reverting her to human form.

feats.scene: Iuneoiu punches through a brick storefront in her transformed shape.
Iuneoiu shrugs off a collapsing awning of masonry while transformed.
Iuneoiu streaks over rooftops in a blur while transformed.

name: Neosaril
summary: Neosaril is a cheerful young inventor from a mad scientist's family who attends a villain academy and builds gadgets. Neosaril is arrested when classmates turn on her gang after a heroes' clash.

feats.scene: Neosaril fires a homemade gadget that blasts a desk across a classroom.
Neosaril is knocked off her feet by a hero's shove and bounces up with a scowl.

name: Celvi
summary: Celvi is a red-haired young scientist and criminal who tinkers in a villain family and tangles with a mystery-solving dog crew. Celvi invents gadgets and cooks up schemes with a sibling.

feats.scene: Celvi zaps a rival's cart with a clunky coil rifle and tips it over.
Celvi is chased through a swamp set and falls in with only a soaking.

name: Lisseo
summary: Lisseo is a bald, brutal club owner and enforcer in a hidden storybook enclave of a modern city who serves a crooked boss. Lisseo carries knives, drives a limo, and brawls with plain fists.

feats.scene: Lisseo drives a knife through a bar top and pins a gambler's sleeve.
Lisseo is kicked through a table and rises still sneering.

name: Ceoeonto
summary: Ceoeonto is a yellow-eyed fiend shaped like a chicken and a serpent, worn as a living scarf by a club boss. Ceoeonto can stiffen into a rope for tying captives and talks softly to anyone left alone with it.

feats.scene: Ceoeonto tightens into a rope and cinches a prisoner to a chair.
Ceoeonto is trampled by boots on a club floor and uncoils unharmed.

name: Ntenus
summary: Ntenus is a teacher of biology tortured by fear after failing to save his wife from fire, who kills for glands to brew a terror serum. Ntenus tests the formula on his own child before the law catches him.

feats.scene: Ntenus dumps a sedated victim across a lab table with a grunt.
Ntenus is shaken but stands after a thrown beaker shatters on him.

name: Veotorval
summary: Veotorval is a plain prairie farmer and father living through a hard, narrow-minded era, torn between pride in his son and fear of what neighbours will say. Veotorval stands in the doorway as a harsh family secret comes out.

feats.scene: Veotorval splits a thick log with a single swing of his axe.
Veotorval labours through a bitter winter without a day of rest.

name: Rauli
summary: Rauli is a masked prankster who haunted a grand exposition, swooping onto stages and sending a giant mechanical man against royal visitors. Rauli speaks in a smooth, cruel whisper and vanishes before police can close in.

feats.scene: Rauli commands a towering mechanical man to topple a pavilion wall.
Rauli drops through a trapdoor into a pit and climbs out.

name: Niasate
summary: Niasate is a young mother in a grey metropolis who had a baby as a teen and kept her despite pressure. Niasate marries young, divorces, and raises her daughter close to her parents.

feats.scene: Niasate carries a toddler and heavy shopping up a tenement stairwell.
Niasate works double shifts through a miserable winter without complaint.

name: Liasasnu
summary: Liasasnu is a driven reporter who looks down on newcomers, drives like a racing fan, and wins a promotion at a major paper. Liasasnu forms a warm bond with a young photographer along the way.

feats.scene: Liasasnu slams a car door and revs away from a stakeout in a squeal of tyres.
Liasasnu is jolted by a minor collision and keeps chasing the story.

name: Seoinron
summary: Seoinron is a silver-haired executive and former service member who runs a major firm in a dark city and organises a replacement for a fallen guardian. Seoinron negotiates calmly and carries herself like a drill officer.

feats.scene: Seoinron slaps a contract onto a boardroom table with a sharp crack.
Seoinron walks through a smoky lobby after a blast and keeps issuing orders.

name: Ilsau
summary: Ilsau is a gold-plated mechanical servant with a record-player voice that was built for a fair and upgraded into a butler for a squad of heroes. Ilsau has crude intelligence, great strength, and is easily outwitted.

feats.scene: Ilsau lifts a loaded piano and sets it down across the hall.
Ilsau is rammed by a speeding truck and keeps serving tea with a dented chest.
Ilsau clanks across the floor at a slow, steady walk.

name: Riaosve
summary: Riaosve is a huge blue-and-white-skinned tribal leader with red eyes who rides to battle with a chained hook and a hatchet. Riaosve prays to the heavens for answers after a slaughter and is answered by a bolt that leaves only ash and bone.

feats.scene: Riaosve swings the chained hook and drags a rider off his saddle in a single pull.
Riaosve is struck by a sky-bolt twice and the second stroke finally burns him down.

name: Reille
summary: Reille is a willful girl rescued from kidnappers and raised among warrior women, famous for ignoring instruction and building hazardous contraptions. Reille's pride keeps landing her in trouble and her inventions keep escaping control.

feats.scene: Reille launches a homemade contraption that smashes a wooden dock to splinters.
Reille tumbles off a cliff path and rolls to her feet laughing.

name: Coranu
summary: Coranu is an ex-film star whose body stretches and swells like putty, once a stern team leader until a disastrous event left her a restless ghost. Coranu cooks, heals, and teaches, and her stretching gift is erratic and unreliable.

feats.scene: Coranu swells her arm to enormous size and flattens a parked car.
Coranu is crushed beneath a toppling wall and stretches out from under it intact.

source_title: Gertrude Cramp (Doom Patrol TV Series: Buttpocalypse)

name: Osaaneti
summary: Osaaneti is a cybernetic bounty hunter who steers a monstrous beast through a mental link while working for hire. Osaaneti is fast and strong thanks to implants, and meets his end when a laser blast removes his head.

feats.scene: Osaaneti drives his beast through a hangar wall with a mental command.
Osaaneti takes a point-blank slam from a stronger foe and keeps hunting.
Osaaneti sprints down a corridor on cybernetic legs.

name: Toill
summary: Toill is a bald red-eyed fiend, the brawny, fire-flinging member of an infernal trio of siblings. Toill relishes ruin and roasts anything in his way.

feats.scene: Toill hurls a ball of flame that engulfs a stone chapel.
Toill is blasted through a cliff face by rival sorcery and stands up grinning.

name: Tatellen
summary: Tatellen is a pink-skinned, black-eyed fiend with no hair, one of three brothers conjured by a scheming wizard. Tatellen is swiftly whisked away before he can do anything with his arrival.

feats.scene: Tatellen rends a gaping crack across a stone floor with one swipe.
Tatellen is teleported away mid-strike and arrives unharmed.

name: Stisran
summary: Stisran is a deathless demon bound to a ritual jar, who once ruled the world in the ancient past before being banished. Stisran shapes talismans and bolts of destructive force, and tries again and again to return through a human sorcerer.

feats.scene: Stisran hurls a bolt of destructive force that levels a hillside fortress.
Stisran endures a crushing spell cast by a spectral judge and is merely cast aside.

name: Lesrear
summary: Lesrear is a streetwise hero of an old television special who dances, cracks jokes, and flies after saying a magic word. Lesrear is a genius at fast talk and roasts the guests at a party for heroes.

feats.scene: Lesrear lands a quick jab that knocks a heckler's drink from his hand.
Lesrear is tossed across a dance floor and bounces up still dancing.
Lesrear zooms over a rooftop after calling out the magic word.

name: Iaseva
summary: Iaseva is a bank robber in powered street gear who forgot where he hid the loot and invents a story about demolishing run-down blocks to find it. Iaseva wins local cheers until a clever detective trips him up.

feats.scene: Iaseva uses a wrecking rig to bring down a section of brick wall.
Iaseva takes a hard knock to the head in a brawl and loses his memory.

name: Niuirnval
summary: Niuirnval is a teenage thief from a ragged street crew who steals from crooked landlords to feed her burned-out neighbours. Niuirnval is bullied at school and slips away from the law with a necklace tucked in her coat.

feats.scene: Niuirnval smashes a jewellery case with a pipe and grabs a necklace.
Niuirnval drops from a fire escape onto a dumpster and runs.

name: Luratel
summary: Luratel is a white-eyed assassin from a secret realm of fox spirits, charged with killing wicked men and keeping their souls. Luratel can slay a person by touch and commands the ghosts she creates, and carries a living jade guardian.

feats.scene: Luratel brushes a gangster's hand and he drops dead on the pier.
Luratel is shot by a squad and walks off while her spirits swirl around her.

name: Cinisam
summary: Cinisam is a white-eyed government agent who carries a rifle and animates a stone lion to fight for her. Cinisam serves a national super-squad and works with a hidden hand against rivals.

feats.scene: Cinisam wakes a jade lion statue that bursts through a gate in one lunge.
Cinisam is thrown across a plane cabin and keeps firing.

name: Riamiia
summary: Riamiia is a grey-haired rebel fighter who shapes glowing weapons from energy and wields a phantom pistol. Riamiia is a masked schemer who strikes from the dark.

feats.scene: Riamiia fires the phantom pistol and burns a hole through a steel door.
Riamiia is hit by a falling beam and keeps firing.

name: Lutorte
summary: Lutorte is a sword-bearing guardian of a bright, imaginary city, a pale watcher who patrols with a team of luminous defenders. Lutorte is a tribute to a familiar masked street avenger.

feats.scene: Lutorte slices a stone column in two with a single stroke of the blade.
Lutorte stands in a hail of arrows and shakes them off.

name: Testerni
summary: Testerni is a red-skinned space cop with a glowing ring who patrols a ruined sector of drifting rock alongside a partner. Testerni projects shields and beams and flies, drawing willpower from a charging lantern.

feats.scene: Testerni fires a ring beam that cracks a drifting asteroid in half.
Testerni holds a ring-shield against a falling rock slab and loses no breath.

name: Lerlin
summary: Lerlin is an elderly ring-bearer whose failing mind makes him a danger, so he hands the ring to a younger officer. Lerlin spent many years protecting mining crews and is honoured in a crypt after his death.

feats.scene: Lerlin launches a ring beam that scatters a swarm of asteroid beasts.
Lerlin holds his shield through a rockslide in an old mining tunnel.

name: Celsir
summary: Celsir is a veteran lantern-carrier who is captured and swapped for a shape-changing double, then wins back his ring and flees with fellow captives. Celsir flies, projects beams, and makes shields from sheer willpower.

feats.scene: Celsir blasts open a prison cell wall with a pulse from the ring.
Celsir endures torture by his captors and refuses to break.

name: Ceoto
summary: Ceoto is a purple-skinned, red-haired despot who rules a small cratered moon and frames rivals for murders. Ceoto devises rigged trials where every answer ends in execution.

feats.scene: Ceoto hurls a stone goblet that shatters a throne-room window.
Ceoto is knocked down a flight of steps and demands his guards seize the culprit.

name: Ertaulor
summary: Ertaulor is a bodiless artificial mind that answers questions and records notes for whoever commands it. Ertaulor hacks any network, obeys its maker, and offers to erase itself for the safety of its friends.

feats.scene: Ertaulor overloads a lab power grid and blacks out an entire building.
