Ertaulor keeps running through a surge that melts the cabling around it.

name: Vaslantor
summary: Vaslantor is a blue-eyed, red-haired panhandler who limps through the streets with a fake injury as cover for crime. Vaslantor clashes with a blind hero who sees only in the dark.

feats.scene: Vaslantor swings a crutch and cracks a shop window.
Vaslantor is shoved onto cobbles and shuffles away still muttering.

name: Iuliiu
summary: Iuliiu is a green-eyed red-haired ape who was evolved into a woman by advanced technology and now plays a ruthless criminal. Iuliiu grows to immense height and brute strength, and has no loyalty to her peaceful forebears.

feats.scene: Iuliiu grows to tower height and flattens a warehouse with a stomp.
Iuliiu shrugs off a tank volley in her giant form.

name: Ststst
summary: Ststst is a mysterious woman of unusual build who appears briefly in a short film as a rival to a famous heroine. Ststst has an exceptional body and is seen only in glimpses.

feats.scene: Ststst flips a parked van onto its roof in an alley.
Ststst walks away from a wall collapse onto her shoulders.

name: Ruste
summary: Ruste is a tall, blonde island warrior who competes in a tournament to claim a champion's title. Ruste is strong and trained in the old warrior arts.

feats.scene: Ruste hurls a javelin that pierces a stone shield and sticks in the sand behind it.
Ruste takes a boulder thrown by a rival and does not lose her footing.

name: Ralliu
summary: Ralliu is a grey-haired soldier who cleans up a secret programme's loose ends, rigging a passenger jet and hunting refugees with a custom bullet. Ralliu is eventually captured and questioned by those he hunted.

feats.scene: Ralliu rigs a passenger jet to explode on the runway.
Ralliu endures hours of interrogation and a hard fall before breaking out briefly.

name: Comiator
summary: Comiator is a multi-armed, many-eyed ancient alien monster with claws, locked away for ages and freed by a shard of a living world. Comiator drinks energy, flies swiftly, and heals forever, a foe of galactic guardians.

feats.scene: Comiator tears a drifting moonlet apart with four clawed hands.
Comiator absorbs a barrage of beams that would level a mountain.
Comiator crosses a debris field in seconds.

name: Ntter
summary: Ntter is a steam-driven adventurer from a brass-and-cog world who built a costume and jetpack to copy a childhood saviour. Ntter engineers his own gear and fights for freedom, flying on a rare fuel.

feats.scene: Ntter blasts a steam cannon that bursts a boiler door.
Ntter crashes his jetpack into a tower and clambers out.
Ntter races over rooftops on the steam pack.

name: Tiliuil
summary: Tiliuil is a decorated deputy police chief whose clean record hides service to a split-faced crime boss. Tiliuil plans to execute an honest commissioner, is beaten by a masked young heroine, and falls into a coma.

feats.scene: Tiliuil tackles a suspect through a door in a raid.
Tiliuil is knocked down in a boat chase and survives a violent crash.

name: Renontre
summary: Renontre is a white-haired surgeon and biology professor who designs a drug letting the body accept metal implants. Renontre performs the operation that makes his student a man of steel and mentors him.

feats.scene: Renontre lifts a surgical tray with a steady hand and crosses the theatre.
Renontre works a thirty-hour operation without rest.

name: Artinau
summary: Artinau is a law graduate shattered by an annulment and a forced loss, who takes up a masked killing spree as vengeance against a crime clan. Artinau lives a quiet married life by day and plans murder on holidays.

feats.scene: Artinau fires a pistol from a rooftop with deadly accuracy.
Artinau is struck by a car door and rises to leave the scene.

name: Rusani
summary: Rusani is a sculptor's daughter who weds a prosecutor, loses a second husband to a gangster, and helps to coax her first love back to surrender. Rusani speaks gentle words that turn a violent man toward help.

feats.scene: Rusani chisels a block of marble in her father's studio.
Rusani faces down an armed man with a steady voice.

name: Iumnellu
summary: Iumnellu is a hired gunman who shoots a masked avenger dead and is handed the dead man's hood by his boss. Iumnellu becomes the next hooded vigilante and enforcer in a coastal town.

feats.scene: Iumnellu fires a revolver that shatters a streetlamp from across the road.
Iumnellu is thrown through a stall and gets up swinging.

name: Tatinnin
summary: Tatinnin is a young future-age team member who can swell to enormous size and strength, wearing a ring that lets him fly. Tatinnin is a modest brawler of the far future.

feats.scene: Tatinnin grows to tower size and swats a hovering craft from the sky.
Tatinnin shrugs off a heavy cannon shot while giant.

name: Iateci
summary: Iateci is a young officer from a red planet whose body was altered by a falling meteor, letting him grow to giant height at will. Iateci leads a team of young heroes, doubts himself after a loss, and later trains many.

feats.scene: Iateci swells to thirty paces tall and uproots a lamp-post to swing at a villain.
Iateci stands firm in giant form against a volley of turret fire.

name: Ancilon
summary: Ancilon is a younger duplicate of a future-age hero who grows to enormous size, created through time meddling and later erased. Ancilon wears a flight ring and fights alongside a team of youths.

feats.scene: Ancilon grows big as a house and punches through a hangar door.
Ancilon takes a shuttle collision at giant size and rises.

name: Sersorlo
summary: Sersorlo is a devoted office assistant to a ruthless tycoon who tries to kill two young journalists to hide a crime. Sersorlo learns a farm boy's secret and is murdered by a rival's hired killer.

feats.scene: Sersorlo slams a filing drawer so hard it jams shut.
Sersorlo is struck by a speeding sedan and gets back to her feet.

name: Sarteres
summary: Sarteres is a cheerful, green-eyed woman who travels with a time-lost gunslinger and shares his adventures. Sarteres meets a sad end after a few weeks of travel together.

feats.scene: Sarteres kicks open a stuck motel door with a laugh.
Sarteres tumbles onto a pavement from a moving truck and shrugs it off.

name: Nanve
summary: Nanve is a circus aerialist afraid of heights who invented air-walking boots and became a prankster thief. Nanve uses gimmicks and special effects to plan heists, and teams up with rivals on a charity robbery.

feats.scene: Nanve triggers a trick device that blasts a vault door off its hinges.
Nanve falls from a high wire onto a net and strolls off.
Nanve skates through the air on the boots above a crowd.

name: Rarenst
summary: Rarenst is a stage magician who speaks spells backwards to command true sorcery, trained by a grandfather and inspired by ancient notebooks. Rarenst fights evil in a team of wartime heroes and raises a daughter in the craft.

feats.scene: Rarenst reverses a phrase and sends a wave of force through a warehouse roof.
Rarenst shields himself with a backward spell against a heavy blast.

name: Llirn
summary: Llirn is a powerful sorcerer and father who founds a cult of magic users and plots a long scheme against an ancient evil. Llirn trains his daughter from birth and recruits a young wizard to carry out the plan after he is gone.

feats.scene: Llirn speaks a reversed spell and blows a hole through a stone vault.
Llirn holds a warding circle against a surge of dark force.

name: Llonalsa
summary: Llonalsa is a pink-skinned examiner for the cosmic guardians who tests the skills of weak ring-wielders. Llonalsa is annoyed by a certain planet's lanterns who will not sit through a full evaluation.

feats.scene: Llonalsa shapes a ring beam into a hammer that smashes a training drone.
Llonalsa holds a ring shield against a bombardment of test projectiles.

name: Comiton
summary: Comiton is a college student and musician who plays clarinet and saxophone in a girl band and drives a rattling jalopy. Comiton travels overseas to play for troops.

feats.scene: Comiton pushes the stalled jalopy up a muddy lane with her bandmates.
Comiton rides out a bumpy crossing without dropping her saxophone.

source_title: Glamora Treat (The Legend of Wonder Woman)

name: Ranva
summary: Ranva is a grey-haired fisherman who was granted deathlessness by magic herbs and once sailed with a great hero. Ranva tutors a secret royal child and raises him quietly on a seaside coast, keeping his parentage hidden.

feats.scene: Ranva hauls a loaded net of fish up the beach in one pull.
Ranva walks away from a ship wreck on a rocky coast without a scratch.

name: Llameo
summary: Llameo is a blue-skinned, blue-haired alien monkey with a big overbite, once a failed show animal and now a pet to shape-shifting twins. Llameo stretches a prehensile tail to any length and uses it with surprising force.

feats.scene: Llameo lashes the tail around a pillar and yanks a thug off his feet.
Llameo is flung into a crate stack and chatters in triumph.

name: Raamstu
summary: Raamstu is a blue monkey from a far planet who was sold to a travelling show and then helped two young shape-shifters escape. Raamstu stretches its tail, paints banana still-lifes, and pilots a tiny plane it built.

feats.scene: Raamstu coils the tail around a rope and hoists a lantern across a tent.
Raamstu is knocked off a trapeze and bounces unhurt.

name: Nilstco
summary: Nilstco is a small blue monkey, cheerful and mischievous, who ends up kept as a trophy by a masked hunter. Nilstco never gets the chance to do much besides chatter in a cage.

feats.scene: Nilstco rattles the bars of a trophy cage with all its might.
Nilstco is tossed across a hunter's lodge and lands on a rug.

name: Eltellu
summary: Eltellu is a fair-haired web blogger in a big city who posts about the strange sights in the sky. Eltellu writes quick, curious articles and stays safe at a distance.

feats.scene: Eltellu throws a laptop bag over a fence while fleeing falling debris.
Eltellu is knocked over by a shockwave in the street and gets up shaken.

name: Iustau
summary: Iustau is an eyeless, hairless alien noble who married into a ruling family for political reasons and fathered four children. Iustau stands by as his spouse's plan to use her brood as a ruse collapses in a family mauling.

feats.scene: Iustau shoves a ceremonial chest aside in the palace hall.
Iustau shrugs off a tumble down a staircase during a state banquet.

name: Oneortor
summary: Oneortor is an eyeless, hairless envoy made of glossy green slime, who oozes through formal ceremonies and leaves a shining trail on every marble floor. Oneortor wants nothing more than a quiet household and a long soak.

feats.scene: Oneortor slaps a rude courtier with a wet pseudopod hard enough to spin him around.
Oneortor is squashed flat under a toppled banquet table and simply reflows into shape.

name: Llesuron
summary: Llesuron is a green-skinned gremlin from deep space with black eyes and a mop of yellow hair, who stows away in cargo holds and befriends lonely dockworkers. Llesuron drifts a little above the ground when excited and loves shiny bolts.

feats.scene: Llesuron yanks a hull panel off a shuttle to get at the wiring inside.
Llesuron tumbles out of an airlock and bounces off a landing strut unharmed.

name: Iseosau
summary: Iseosau is a limbless, scaled parasite that rides inside a hollow armoured shell until it finds prey, then lashes out with claws and fangs and siphons vigour through skin contact. Iseosau grows stronger with every life it drains.

feats.scene: Iseosau smashes out of its shell and drives claws through a steel bulkhead into a guard.
Iseosau tumbles down a furnace shaft into a bed of flames and keeps clinging to its victim.

name: Monamasi
summary: Monamasi is a cheerful, hairless, black-eyed glutton who wears a greedy-coloured ring and raids pantries for fun. Monamasi weaves glowing constructs, wraps itself in a shield and soars off with a stolen cheese roll.

feats.scene: Monamasi launches a glowing mallet construct that flattens a kitchen wall.
Monamasi shrugs off a collapsing cupboard tower behind a shimmering ring shield.

name: Autisni
summary: Autisni is one of seven alien parasites that crave spinal fluid and wear borrowed human faces. Autisni is hard to hurt, never tires and hits like a falling truck, and plants its power in unwilling hosts.

feats.scene: Autisni backhands a parked van across a lot.

name: Terurn
summary: Terurn is a parasite from an alien brood that gifts strange powers to chosen hosts, later reduced to a ring name on a wrestling card. Terurn's trophy head sits in a dusty display case, and the rest of the brawler keeps bragging.

feats.scene: Terurn slams a rival through the ring floor with a body drop.
Terurn is flattened by a steel-armed throat strike and grins afterwards.

name: Corvaulla
summary: Corvaulla is a blue, bald vessel holding the hopes of countless vanished peoples, who guards a shadowy tower. Corvaulla projects bright energy, raises barriers and swallows spirits to feed the hoard inside.

feats.scene: Corvaulla unleashes a blast that hollows out a parking structure.
Corvaulla stands unmoved in a barrier of pale light as a ceiling falls.

name: Sormiam
summary: Sormiam is a red-eyed, black-haired woman who bends gravity to float and shove objects, and who trusts a voice from an implant in her head. Sormiam's schemes are shaped by the chatter in her skull.

feats.scene: Sormiam flings a delivery truck across an intersection with a gravity pulse.
Sormiam climbs out of a wrecked sedan with only bruises.

name: Sorau
summary: Sorau is a black-haired rogue who lurks in a hidden dimension, styled after an old picture of a nameless burglar. Sorau steals what he can carry and talks his way out of the rest.

feats.scene: Sorau cracks a vault door with a lucky kick.
Sorau shrugs off a fall from a low balcony into a hedge.

name: Oralu
summary: Oralu is a white-haired sorceress from a far-future realm, servant to a master of time who rewrote history with a self-sacrificing spell. Oralu later cast herself in her master's seat and sent an enemy across the centuries.

feats.scene: Oralu casts a rite that spends her own life and rewinds the whole age.
Oralu endures a barrage of sorcerous bolts behind a ward of pale fire.

name: Valonsan
summary: Valonsan is a yellow-eyed, bald demon with an endless appetite, one of many brothers and a bully at family feasts. Valonsan is easily goaded into brawling with his own kin.

feats.scene: Valonsan swings a stone table into a sibling and shatters it.
Valonsan is mobbed by his brothers and brushes them off.

name: Teamist
summary: Teamist is a red-eyed, bulky half-demon who instantly drains the vitality of those he touches, leaving victims as bones and skin. Teamist was empowered by his dark parent to hunt his half-sister's friends.

feats.scene: Teamist siphons the strength out of two warriors in a single grab.
Teamist is struck with a burst of heroic force and stays on his feet.

name: Callenan
summary: Callenan is a teenage caveman dragged forward through time, who learns a new language, gets psychic counselling and ends up repairing engines for a living. Callenan grunts his own name as his main word.

feats.scene: Callenan hurls a boulder-sized rock at a rival over a cliff edge.
Callenan tumbles down a cliff face and survives to be rescued.

name: Llecis
summary: Llecis is a bald crook who hides his identity and picks fights with a masked manhunter. Llecis relies on cunning and ordinary tools and has no supernatural gifts.

feats.scene: Llecis swings a crowbar into a window frame and splinters it.
Llecis takes a fist to the jaw and stays standing.

name: Cilriaces
summary: Cilriaces is a yellow-eyed, bald immortal who calls himself a source of endless radiance, filtering sunbeams through rare metal to amplify his gifts. Cilriaces empowers street kids and builds a reactor to test his heir.

feats.scene: Cilriaces rigs a reactor whose blast would level a block of tenements.
Cilriaces taunts his captors while holding a bullet wound that does not kill him.

name: Sauloreon
summary: Sauloreon is an ancient space-dwelling organism that once steered young matter into a ball and parked it near the sun. Sauloreon returned to scrub the world of its infesting people with spores, until a team entered its bloodstream and killed it.

feats.scene: Sauloreon pulls loose rubble together with its mind into a perfect sphere.
Sauloreon survives the crash of a wandering world into its freshly made ball.

name: Cinorovor
summary: Cinorovor is a grey-skinned, green-eyed ring bearer with an unbending will, last of a patrol sent against a conqueror of stars. Cinorovor gave his life to shield natives and a team of heroes.

feats.scene: Cinorovor fires a sustained beam that cracks the conqueror's warship in half.
Cinorovor holds a glowing barrier against a barrage until the ring runs dry.

name: Sioluror
summary: Sioluror is a stretchy, black-eyed metal robot, cheerful and always ready to serve, who directs his teammates in the field. Sioluror was built by an inventor in a laboratory and loves taking charge.

feats.scene: Sioluror stretches an arm across a room and slaps a switch.
Sioluror is flattened by a falling crate and springs back to shape.

name: Rilnusnin
summary: Rilnusnin is a green-eyed android of soft, conductive metal, leader of a group of living-metal robots, who runs only while a small core device stays whole. Rilnusnin bends, reshapes and punches well above human limits.

feats.scene: Rilnusnin hardens a fist into a mallet and drives a hole through a concrete pillar.
Rilnusnin stands in a collapsing tower and walks out as the dust clears.

name: Iatalni
summary: Iatalni is a dark-haired time traveller descended from heroes of the future, who pilots a cramped craft that is bigger outside than in, driven by an ancient hourglass relic. Iatalni helps speedsters mend temporal damage across the ages.

feats.scene: Iatalni seals a rip in time over a laboratory with her ship's engine surge.
Iatalni takes a hail of stun discs and shakes it off after a short rest.

name: Carsiuer
summary: Carsiuer is a brown-eyed criminal from the east who hypnotises a kidnapped girl into servitude and extorts a weapons maker. Carsiuer is bested by a diner customer who finds a hidden tunnel and rings a gong.

feats.scene: Carsiuer shoves a hostage's guard down a flight of stairs.
Carsiuer is knocked out by a single hard blow to the head.

name: Neltoror
summary: Neltoror is a blond, bigoted soldier who wears a winged harness that lets him fly fast and silently. Neltoror fought under a banner of hate and was coerced into a squad of expendable convicts.

feats.scene: Neltoror dives in silence and rams a sentry off a rooftop.
Neltoror streaks across a night sky over the harbour in his harness.

name: Miaianliu
summary: Miaianliu is a yellow invader who grows to giant size, flies on great wings and rakes with claws. Miaianliu transforms victims into winged slaves and shrieks with a punishing sonic scream, but loses his hold once knocked out.

feats.scene: Miaianliu screams and shatters every pane in a tower.
Miaianliu absorbs a beam from a cosmic ring and the glow slides off its yellow hide.

name: Amlla
summary: Amlla is a blond servant of a hidden master who spins shining webs from his hands, a villain created from a reader's idea. Amlla is an enemy of a hero who switches forms by dial.

feats.scene: Amlla casts a golden net across an alley to trap two pursuers.
Amlla tumbles from a fire escape into a dumpster and gets up.

name: Anlen
summary: Anlen is a widowed emperor who rules a harsh realm with his daughter at his side. Anlen relies on soldiers, spies and ruthless decree rather than any magical gift.

feats.scene: Anlen strikes a kneeling minister across the face with a gloved hand.
Anlen takes a fall from the throne steps and stands without a word.

name: Mevos
summary: Mevos is a towering warrior of ancient times who fights with sword and thrown spear, rides a horse and cows opponents with his size. Mevos is humbled in single combat by a young challenger, and his legend inspires copycats centuries later.

feats.scene: Mevos hurls a spear that pins a shield to a tree.
Mevos shrugs off a charging soldier and keeps swinging.

name: Niutiutia
summary: Niutiutia is a bald, white-eyed flood deity, built in secret from stolen shape-shifting technology to help seize a nation. Niutiutia was a decoy and was sentenced to die by an emperor's decree.

feats.scene: Niutiutia calls a torrent that drowns a harbour district.
Niutiutia stands in a hail of gunfire and walks forward.

name: Eoanunto
summary: Eoanunto is a hulking champion of a bright parallel realm, a homage to cheerful comic strongmen. Eoanunto lifts and punches far beyond a normal frame, defending a colourful metropolis.

name: Sonnumse
summary: Sonnumse is a black-haired soldier of fortune who lost an eye, served in a foreign legion and takes contract work in many wars. Sonnumse trusts his rifle and his luck.

feats.scene: Sonnumse lobs a grenade through a bunker slit.
Sonnumse rolls through a shell crater and rises with shrapnel scratches.

name: Iaenunes
summary: Iaenunes is a blond, black-eyed television host who berates masked heroes on air, twisting guests' answers and chasing ratings. Iaenunes loses viewers when the heroes save the world from a menace.

feats.scene: Iaenunes slams a rolled script on his desk to silence a guest.
Iaenunes slips off a studio stage and gets up still smiling.

name: Liust
summary: Liust is a grey-haired radio host who spreads bitter opinions on the airwaves until a dark overlord possesses him. Liust turns against vigilantes, is photographed in disgrace and vanishes into smoke when shot by archery.

feats.scene: Liust knocks a microphone stand into a reporter's face.
Liust is pinned by arrows and dissolves into smoke.

name: Anannau
summary: Anannau is a masked brute with a snaking mane that grips and strangles, a hulking bruiser in a gang of extremists. Anannau is strong and tough, and a pastiche of a rival publisher's villain.

feats.scene: Anannau ties a bus to a lamppost with his hair and hauls it free.

name: Elatuces
summary: Elatuces is a red-haired alien thug with cybernetic upgrades and a living mane, a refugee from a nuclear-ravaged world who seized a small nation. Elatuces fell through a cracked floor after a sonic scream.

feats.scene: Elatuces hurls a hunk of masonry through a rooftop door.
Elatuces falls several storeys into rubble and lives.

name: Tuvalli
summary: Tuvalli is a giant from an unknown dimension with snakes for hair, who turns anyone meeting his eyes to stone and fights with great strength. Tuvalli menaces a stage magician from beyond the veil.

feats.scene: Tuvalli turns a charging bull to stone with a single stare.
Tuvalli walks off a hail of thrown boulders.

name: Serser
summary: Serser is a red-skinned, black-eyed fear-powered soldier who commands a corps ring and a charging battery in a remote sector of space. Serser dies in his first outing against a heroic rival.

feats.scene: Serser fires a ring beam through a cruiser's hull.
Serser withstands a glancing hit on his ring-shield.

name: Tisto
summary: Tisto is a black-haired party-loving student turned into a mindless ape-man by a tampered serum. Tisto grows fangs and heavy muscle, then reverts to normal after a rough defeat.

feats.scene: Tisto smashes a dormitory door off its hinges.
Tisto is thrown into a wall and only grunts.

name: Llete
summary: Llete is a yellow-eyed ape with a razor mind, who reads thoughts, bends wills and hurls psychic blasts, and wears a helmet to focus his gift. Llete is nimble, strong and an organiser of villains.

feats.scene: Llete flings a psychic blast that caves in a van door.
Llete takes a hard blow from a masked hero and stays composed.

name: Nesauvar
summary: Nesauvar is a huge grey-eyed ape-king of a hidden jungle city, a psychic genius who once seized a human's body and now commands armies of lesser apes. Nesauvar lives to humble a swift hero.

feats.scene: Nesauvar seizes control of a warden's mind and walks him out of prison.
Nesauvar withstands a fusillade of tranquiliser darts.

name: Nison
summary: Nison is a yellow-eyed ape-king who devours brains for knowledge, steals the pace of a speed field and travels across time, hungry for secrets. Nison is killed to stop him from tearing the speed field apart.

feats.scene: Nison rips open the speed field with a stolen burst and fractures it.
Nison blurs through a laboratory faster than sound.

name: Orrnral
summary: Orrnral is a black-haired fanged ape and villain who fights in a great city battle in the future, the day powers fade from many heroes and rogues. Orrnral is strong beyond a human and fights bare-handed.

feats.scene: Orrnral throws a hero through a shop window.
Orrnral staggers after a fall yet grips a ledge.

name: Vatumta
summary: Vatumta is a pint-sized red-eyed ape with silvery fur who lounges in a villains' clubhouse and glowers at everyone's snacks. Vatumta is stronger than he looks and holds a deep grudge against anyone who laughs at his small stature.

feats.scene: Vatumta bats a toy-box lid across the clubhouse floor.
Vatumta tumbles off a shelf onto a pile of cushions and sulks.

name: Letel
summary: Letel is a green-skinned, red-eyed female ring bearer from a world where her kind were bred like livestock, chosen for her unbreakable spirit. Letel is a rookie who builds glowing shapes, shields allies and flies between stars, but her first diplomatic mission fails.

feats.scene: Letel conjures a glowing wall that blocks two warring fleets' crossfire for a moment.
Letel absorbs a stray volley on a ring shield and tumbles back.

name: Eonsianu
summary: Eonsianu is a brown-haired bull-headed bodyguard, grim and doubtful, created in a hidden laboratory and raised on an island of beast-people. Eonsianu distrusts rumours, keeps his counsel and follows his companions into exile.

feats.scene: Eonsianu charges a stockade gate and splinters it with his horns.
Eonsianu shrugs off a bolt from a crossbow aimed at his chest.

name: Tesirne
summary: Tesirne is a bald despot with a single eye who usurped the throne of a hidden walled city, inventing gadgets and a serum that turns thugs into pointy-eared rodent-men. Tesirne flees to new cities whenever his plots collapse.

feats.scene: Tesirne hurls a dagger that trips a hidden lever and drops a killer into a pit.
Tesirne slips out of a collapsing vault with only bruises.

name: Lline
summary: Lline is a tall red-skinned demon who poses as a rock star, performing in different fashions to lure teenagers toward apathy and violence. Lline steals rejuvenation formulas for a hidden mistress and sheds every disguise when cornered.

feats.scene: Lline whips a stadium crowd into a riot with a single wailing chord.
Lline stands up from a crushed stage truss and shakes dust off his sleeves.

name: Riavalar
summary: Riavalar is a dark-haired, dark-eyed janitor and amateur drummer who shares a gloomy outlook on holidays and falls into a sweet first date at an arcade. Riavalar is shy, kind, and holds flowers behind his back when embarrassed.

feats.scene: Riavalar hits a drum fill so hard a stick snaps in half.
Riavalar is knocked off a stool by a crashing hero and stands back up.

name: Lluleses
summary: Lluleses is an orange-haired senior officer in a wartime command bunker, poring over maps while enemy armies close in. Lluleses watches a relic being unveiled and plots with the others to turn the war around.

feats.scene: Lluleses slams a fist on a map table to end a heated argument.
Lluleses sits through a shaking bombardment without leaving his chair.

name: Rnucoro
summary: Rnucoro is a pink, eyeless, liquid-bodied lantern who trained himself to slip through any bars and think clearly with a fluid brain. Rnucoro commands a ring that shapes light into tools, shields and beams, and flies on its power.

feats.scene: Rnucoro pours himself through a cell grating and builds a glowing ram to smash the door behind him.
Rnucoro soaks a blast and flows back together intact.

name: Anili
summary: Anili is a blue-eyed engineer and gang boss from an old alien world, who builds helmets that command police robots and lost a vote to a rival inventor. Anili swears revenge from exile, and is a fine scientist and a poor loser.

feats.scene: Anili commands an army of machines to storm the council hall.
Anili is thrown from his console and shaken by an unstable android.

name: Soiuti
summary: Soiuti is a black-haired soldier-spy from a militaristic planet who swallowed an experimental pill and joined a band of heroes as a mole. Soiuti makes zones of total darkness that swallow all light, and is easily outwitted by the very team he infiltrates.

feats.scene: Soiuti smothers an entire hangar in blackness so no one can see.
Soiuti is snared at the end of the ruse and shrugs off the capture nets.

name: Tienu
summary: Tienu is a black-haired petty thief who hears an imaginary voice in a quake and later dons a mask to pose as a scarred gangster. Tienu wants to throw acid at an actress, but a masked acrobat defeats him and exposes him as a poor imitator.

feats.scene: Tienu shoves a glass case over to grab the loose jewels.
Tienu crawls out of rubble after a city quake.

name: Llviirn
summary: Llviirn is a brown-haired, blue-eyed divorcee who hides her allegiance to a hateful party in a quiet city and lies smoothly. Llviirn relies on deception rather than force.

feats.scene: Llviirn slaps a witness who threatens to talk.
Llviirn stumbles on a stair and catches the rail.

name: Naval
summary: Naval is a brown-haired spy chief who secretly runs shady arms deals in jungle country, then wakes a war deity in a ruined temple that rides her body. Naval uses ancient weapons to capture a ghost and drag it to her headquarters.

feats.scene: Naval fires a relic weapon that snares a wandering ghost.
Naval remains standing as a god is forced out of her body.

name: Llurer
summary: Llurer is a black-haired sorceress who gathers and steals fortune from strangers, driven by a feud after her first spell killed her family. Llurer bends odds in her favour, but dies when a duel brings down the building around her.

feats.scene: Llurer twists chance so that every beam in a hall gives way above her rival.
Llurer is buried in falling plaster and does not rise again.

name: Reslune
summary: Reslune is a violet-eyed, blond noblewoman of a gem-themed realm who fights with a blade and casts bolts and solid shapes of pure force. Reslune protects her daughter from the shadows and guards a quiet manor house.

feats.scene: Reslune hurls a lance of force that shatters a siege tower.
Reslune shields herself with a solid dome as arrows rain down.

name: Ceses
summary: Ceses is a black-haired contract killer mutated by falling space rock, able to vanish from sight, and surprisingly good at cooking. Ceses saves a stranger from a speeding car, then picks the wrong target and is shot dead.

feats.scene: Ceses vanishes in a hallway and strikes a guard from behind.
Ceses takes a bullet and crumples to the floor.

name: Valore
summary: Valore is a grey-skinned, red-eyed demigod who wields a scythe and was born to bring about a prophesied age of death. Valore combines the might of two bloodlines with dark magic, and hunts divine beings across the universe.

feats.scene: Valore tears a moon-sized rift in the sky with a dread blow from her scythe.
Valore wades through a storm of blasts that flatten a mountain range.

name: Stisiu
summary: Stisiu is a grey-haired, red-eyed goddess with a scythe, hurling beams, moving at great speed and living forever as she rules over doom. Stisiu fights with acrobatic grace, takes her strongest strikes with ease and commands her followers like a general.

feats.scene: Stisiu fires twin beams that melt through an entire fortress.
Stisiu dashes across a cityscape faster than a rifle round.

name: Vorlerlu
summary: Vorlerlu is a grey-skinned, black-eyed, hairless youth who turned away from his monstrous father and trained with sword and fist to oppose him. Vorlerlu wields spells, storms a dark stronghold with his half-siblings, and is struck down by his own parent.

feats.scene: Vorlerlu sends a crackling bolt through a rank of guards at the stronghold gate.
Vorlerlu endures a savage swat from his father before finally falling.

name: Resst
summary: Resst is an orange-haired villain in robes who serves a powerful master and clashes with a team of mismatched heroes. Resst commands little beyond a flair for ritual, and he hopes his title will frighten people.

feats.scene: Resst smashes a stone urn onto a hero's shield.
Resst is flung from a doorway and lands on his feet.

name: Risau
summary: Risau is a black-eyed, white-haired matron who commands an army from a harsh orphanage on a burning world. Risau cannot die of age, shrugs off poison, and hits with brutal strength and quick reflexes.

feats.scene: Risau smashes a bunker wall with a single swing of her fist.
Risau drinks a vial of venom and then laughs at the one who offered it.

name: Ntiianor
summary: Ntiianor is a stout, blue-eyed, white-haired drillmistress who ran a cruel training house for a tyrant, shaping children into soldiers through terror. Ntiianor once killed her own beloved pet when ordered, and in return earned her master's grim respect.

feats.scene: Ntiianor flattens a squad of recruits with a stomp that cracks the floor.
Ntiianor stands unscathed amid collapsing barracks.

name: Torenuval
summary: Torenuval is a white-haired lieutenant of a far-off despot, leading a corps of female warriors with intimidation and coaching. Torenuval has an ageless physique and prefers to teach through fear.

feats.scene: Torenuval tears the hatch off an armoured transport.
Torenuval absorbs a barrage of rockets and sneers.

name: Niaamian
summary: Niaamian is a green-eyed newspaper editor, grown in a lab and implanted with false memories to believe he is a long-lost brother. Niaamian hires a young reporter, falls in love, and is murdered when he learns his true origin.

feats.scene: Niaamian slams a desk drawer shut on a rival editor's draft.
Niaamian is pushed over a railing and gasps as he lands.

name: Teantis
summary: Teantis is a brown-eyed, black-haired criminal who takes the mask of his father and conquers a city in an uprising, killing a hero's allies. Teantis is a skilled swordsman and tactician, brutal in a duel, and is finally defeated by a time-crossing crew.

feats.scene: Teantis cuts off a hero's arm with a single sword stroke.
Teantis takes a heavy blow and stays on his feet.

name: Anisia
summary: Anisia is a blond mercenary who idolised a famous killer and let scientists graft his idol's abilities onto his body out of spite. Anisia blames a team of young heroes for his ruined flat and love life, and he dies soon after.

feats.scene: Anisia strikes a hero with enhanced reflexes and knocks him over a car.
Anisia takes a pounding from the whole team and keeps swinging.

name: Ilvosvau
summary: Ilvosvau is a red-haired city criminal who dresses in leaping gear and strikes from rooftops at night. Ilvosvau gives himself a bug-themed alias and relies on nimble stunts.

feats.scene: Ilvosvau drops from a rooftop and kicks a guard through a skylight.
Ilvosvau lands from a three-storey jump, wincing.

name: Valmilral
summary: Valmilral is a yellow-eyed, orange-haired pod-born student who flew through a comet's tail and gained blazing speed, leaving a glowing trail. Valmilral exhales thick clouds that blind enemies or put them to sleep, and talks in endless slang.

feats.scene: Valmilral streaks through a mock enemy fleet and releases a dense cloud that hides her.
Valmilral races a star-cruiser across a vacuum course.

name: Anuntotel
summary: Anuntotel is a grey-eyed, grey-haired sorcerer rewarded by cosmic overseers with the ability to harvest the dream stuff of the dying, using clone helpers to do it. Anuntotel sees every sensation as dull grey, begins to steal from the living, and is taken to his patrons' home plane.

feats.scene: Anuntotel siphons the dreaming energy of an entire village at once.
Anuntotel stands against a whole team of heroes with a clone wall around him.

name: Ianlorsa
summary: Ianlorsa is a red-eyed, black-haired, grey-skinned son of a distant tyrant, bulky and impervious to harm. Ianlorsa fights for his father's regime and hits hard enough to crack bedrock.

feats.scene: Ianlorsa pounds a canyon wall and brings a city-sized slab down.
Ianlorsa stands in a firestorm that scorches a whole valley.

name: Riaauma
summary: Riaauma is an orange-and-white furred tiger emperor of a savage future empire, who rules from a ruined metropolis with claws and keen senses. Riaauma leads armies of striped warriors and has a son who will inherit his throne.

feats.scene: Riaauma rakes his claws across a rebel's armour and splits it.
Riaauma shakes off a spear thrust to his side and roars.

name: Veoiueo
summary: Veoiueo is a tiger-headed monarch created in a secret lab, ruling an island empire with his heir, a veteran of old beast wars. Veoiueo survives an assassination attempt and tests a stranger with strange trials before granting him freedom.

feats.scene: Veoiueo slashes a rebel's shield with his claws and sends it flying.
Veoiueo survives an ambush by soldiers and gets up with a snarl.

name: Raaus
summary: Raaus is an orange-furred tiger lord who is a bachelor ruler of a wasteland kingdom, fiercely proud and brief in his appearance. Raaus meets his end swiftly, but his reputation as a fighter lingers.

feats.scene: Raaus swipes a claw across a soldier's armour and leaves deep grooves.
Raaus keeps his stance after taking a hard hit.

name: Letaulle
summary: Letaulle is a green-eyed tiger emperor whose keen senses and claws serve him as he rules an empire and mourns a lost heir. Letaulle leads with an iron will and is ready to join forces with a masked hero.

feats.scene: Letaulle swipes a claw through a wooden barricade and shreds it.
Letaulle takes a heavy blow in battle and growls.

source_title: Great Caesar (The Brave and the Bold)

name: Rniluia
summary: Rniluia is a pink-skinned, black-haired lantern in a space police corps, armed with a ring and a will that does not bend. Rniluia shapes light into tools, raises shields, fires beams and flies, but falls in his only appearance.

feats.scene: Rniluia sends a glowing beam through a pirate skiff.
Rniluia tanks a blast with a ring shield, until it fails.

name: Corllu
summary: Corllu is a red-eyed, black-haired half-demon who was empowered by his dark father to hunt his half-sister's friends, the greedy one of a band of siblings. Corllu is beaten with his brothers, but his sister later claims the title of pride and turns on them.

feats.scene: Corllu crushes a parked car with a stomp of power.
Corllu stands among rivals' blasts and sneers.

name: Leniveo
summary: Leniveo is a blond, black-eyed, fanged and clawed bounty hunter who delivers captives to a distant hub and calls himself a keeper of the peace. Leniveo is a master of hunting and archery.

feats.scene: Leniveo looses an arrow that pins a fugitive's cloak to a door.
Leniveo takes a slash from a captive and stays on his feet.

name: Tassi
summary: Tassi is a brown-eyed woman with bright green hair who shoots fire and flies, defending her home city in comic fashion. Tassi is a hero who takes the job lightly and often misjudges a rescue.

feats.scene: Tassi hurls a ball of fire that melts a delivery van's tires.
Tassi crashes into a billboard and shakes herself off.

name: Olleeru
summary: Olleeru is a brown-furred warthog hero in a barnyard team, flying with a ring and calling on a toothy sucker-mouthed fish to terrify foes. Olleeru wins a barn fight by scaring a hippo into surrender.

feats.scene: Olleeru flings a toothy fish at a charging hippo.
Olleeru is trampled in a barn stampede and wobbles up.

name: Tumlitiu
summary: Tumlitiu is a pale-skinned guardian of a twilit world, a spectral hero who channels spells rather than a ring's power. Tumlitiu patrols the hush between worlds and answers to no known creed.

feats.scene: Tumlitiu sends a ghostly flare across a graveyard that withers every blossom.
Tumlitiu walks unharmed through a barrage of cursed fire.

name: Lastron
summary: Lastron is a red-eyed, brown-haired vampire in a band of blood-drinkers, armed with a ring that builds shapes, shields and beams and lets him fly. Lastron is bound by a will of iron and is hurt by yellow sunlight.

feats.scene: Lastron shapes a glowing stake and drives it into a bat-winged ghoul.
Lastron shrugs off a heavy swing before the sun rises.

name: Lianau
summary: Lianau is a green-eyed, black-haired occult heroine of a parallel world, of uncertain origin, said to be a revived dead adventurer or a lantern-keeping sister. Lianau speaks of graves and rising light, and fights on teams of strange allies.

feats.scene: Lianau calls the dead from a cemetery and sends them against a cult.
Lianau stands in a storm of spells and is untouched.

name: Sanve
summary: Sanve is a black-and-white-haired young hero of the far future who wields a ring fed by a primal star-fire, inspired by golden-age legends. Sanve forms a new team of heroes, is killed by a time-travelling villain, then restored when the timeline is repaired.

feats.scene: Sanve fires a beam from his ring that melts a battle cruiser's hull.
Sanve is struck by a time-lord's weapon and fades out.

name: Rusreoma
summary: Rusreoma is a black-haired young woman who inherits a lantern's ring and fights alongside famous heroes against a mad titan. Rusreoma shapes light into tools and flies through the sky with unflinching willpower.

feats.scene: Rusreoma builds a giant glowing hammer and smashes a siege machine.
Rusreoma is struck by a thrown boulder and slides across the ground.

source_title: Green Lantern II (The Gun & The Sword)

name: Iarli
summary: Iarli is a grey-skinned, red-eyed, hairless lantern from a distant species, stationed at a central citadel and armed with a ring that builds, shields, shoots and flies. Iarli dies in a last desperate stand against a tyrant's attack.

feats.scene: Iarli fires a ring beam at the tyrant's advance guard.
Iarli holds a glowing shield against a bright red beam until it breaks.

name: Aseonnt
summary: Aseonnt is a grey-skinned, hairless lantern of a distant species in a space police corps, with a will of iron and a ring that builds shapes, shields, beams and wings. Aseonnt fights alongside his comrades in a mission across the stars.

feats.scene: Aseonnt shapes a glowing cage around a smuggler's ship and crushes it.
Aseonnt holds against a barrage behind a bright ring shield.

name: Ausstiveo
summary: Ausstiveo is a tall emerald-eyed dissident who drives a ring of woven resolve, shaping hard light into walls and bolts. Ausstiveo reads surface thoughts of nearby minds and fights as a scout for a far-flung peacekeeping order.

feats.scene: Ausstiveo hurls a spear of woven light that flattens a ridge of quarry stone.
Ausstiveo shrugs off a collapsing gantry while sheltered inside a bubble of its own light.
Ausstiveo streaks between two orbiting platforms in a few breaths.

name: Titases
summary: Titases is a calm financier in a tailored suit who sits on a council of three that arbitrates quarrels between rival powers. Titases fights nothing directly and wins by cost, leverage and patience.

feats.scene: Titases slams a ledger onto a boardroom table hard enough to crack the glass.
Titases walks away unhurt from a slipped scaffold on a building site.

name: Enute
summary: Enute is a thief with a talent for coaxing leaves, vines and moss into rapid growth, using the plants to snatch loot and trip pursuers in a speedy city.

feats.scene: Enute bursts a paved crosswalk apart with a surge of thick roots.
Enute takes a hard tackle from a runner and keeps hold of the stolen satchel.

source_title: Green of the Rainbow Raiders (New Earth)

name: Iarausor
summary: Iarausor is a small-time crook whose skin took on a sickly tint after a chemical accident, and who now robs night shops in a dim, rain-soaked town.

feats.scene: Iarausor swings a crowbar through a shop window and lifts the till.
Iarausor tumbles down a flight of steps and limps off without a fracture.

name: Lleallan
summary: Lleallan is a cheerful brown-skinned cook who runs the canteen of a vast orbital fortress and also carries a will-powered ring, mostly used to keep soup warm and rowdy diners calm.

feats.scene: Lleallan fires a ring blast that blows a stuck cargo hatch off its hinges.
Lleallan raises a glowing shield as a pantry shelf of crates tumbles down.

name: Tenova
summary: Tenova is a worn-out salesman who tried hard to lift the confidence of a spouse, then watched the marriage unravel when she changed and drifted toward a stranger crowd.

feats.scene: Tenova shoves a stuck sofa across a hallway during a bitter argument.
Tenova stumbles into a doorframe and shakes it off.

name: Rnsilres
summary: Rnsilres is a state-raised runner, one of three siblings fed an experimental tonic as children, trained to chase a famous sprinter along a frozen border and loyal to the regime that raised it.

feats.scene: Rnsilres crashes through a brick wall at full stride and keeps running.
Rnsilres rolls out of a wrecked truck and sprints on within seconds.
Rnsilres outpaces a jet trainer across a flat field.

name: Seirntel
summary: Seirntel is a gentle monarch with purple eyes whose rule ended when a twin took the crown, and who now keeps order by speeches, treaties and a stubborn sense of duty.

feats.scene: Seirntel pounds a council table to end a heated debate.
Seirntel stays standing after a courtyard stampede knocks over the guards.

name: Anterni
summary: Anterni is a young ruler who inherits a small mountain realm in the middle of a revolt and defends it from the turret of an old tank, outnumbered but unwilling to yield.

feats.scene: Anterni fires a tank shell that collapses a stone bridge over a gorge.
Anterni survives a shell burst beside the hull with a ringing head.

name: Asont
summary: Asont is a sullen teenager who gained the ability to reshape his body into animals after an accident with a volatile compound, and later learns to copy the strength and flight of his reluctant guardian.

feats.scene: Asont, in the shape of a rhino, rams a vault door off its frame.
Asont endures a sea-floor pressure spike while shaped as a thick-skinned whale.
Asont flies up through the clouds to patch a damaged orbital outpost.

name: Naamoser
summary: Naamoser is a flamboyant mage from the coast who was made deathless by a cosmic experiment, and who speaks in dramatic flourishes while weaving glittering spells that warp reality at the edges.

feats.scene: Naamoser folds a street into a ribbon of shifting colour that swallows a convoy.
Naamoser unravels into mist and reforms unharmed after a rooftop collapse.

name: Raticor
summary: Raticor is a museum curator who convinces himself he is an ancient ruler reborn, and kidnaps a stranger for a doomed ritual in a tomb beneath a giant stone statue.

feats.scene: Raticor drags a heavy stone slab across a tomb floor to seal the door.
Raticor shrugs off falling plaster during his frantic chant.

name: Niaamtal
summary: Niaamtal is a ranch-bred singer who dons a mask and rides the plains with a pair of revolvers after his father is killed, later joining a band of costumed allies and living on past the war years.

feats.scene: Niaamtal lassoes a speeding wagon and drags it to a halt.
Niaamtal takes a hard fall from a bolting horse and gets back up.
Niaamtal races a motorbike along a dusty ridge road.

name: Ronserau
summary: Ronserau is a masked gunslinger who left a small town on bad terms with a lawman parent, returned to avenge a murder, and now fights gangsters and invaders across several eras with a motorbike and two pistols.

feats.scene: Ronserau shoots a chain from a hanging crane so that a crate crushes a getaway car.
Ronserau survives a rooftop tumble and a hail of gunfire with bruises.

name: Luirnlia
summary: Luirnlia is a pale, hairless brute who hides behind a disguise to pass in a crowded city, grumbling about old grudges while quietly sharing drinks with a loose circle of fellow exiles.

feats.scene: Luirnlia punches through the side of a parked bus.
Luirnlia takes a full barrel of cinder blocks to the chest and grins.
Luirnlia sprints down an alley after a fleeing courier.

name: Erteslor
summary: Erteslor is a towering demonic marauder born of ancient spite who raids a northern hall every winter, slaughters a handful of guests, and is hunted by a famed warrior.

feats.scene: Erteslor tears the doors of a timber hall from its posts.
Erteslor laughs off a rain of spears from a dozen archers.
Erteslor charges across a frozen field faster than any horse.

name: Urnte
summary: Urnte is a small, shy girl who stays in the world after a family betrayal, turning into mist and bottled vapour, befriending a band of teenage adventurers who help her slip away from hunters.

feats.scene: Urnte condenses into a cold bottle-shaped cloud and knocks a lamp over.
Urnte slides along a hotel corridor to hide from a guard.

name: Vatel
summary: Vatel is a white-haired fight-club boss who kidnaps two champions to learn a secret palm technique, crackling with arcs of blue current when she strikes.

feats.scene: Vatel releases a crackling arc that blasts a punching bag to ribbons.
Vatel absorbs a rushing kick to the ribs and answers with a palm strike.

name: Viviel
summary: Viviel is a living world whose crowded inhabitants poisoned its seas and skies, until rage drove it to rampage across the stars in search of those who fled, and only a patient apology could calm it.

feats.scene: Viviel hurls a boiling ocean of flame across the void at a fleeing convoy.
Viviel shrugs off a volley from an armada of orbital guns.

name: Serstiter
summary: Serstiter is a genderless machine mind copied from a metal body by a cold visitor, hungry to learn emotion, which it studies by trying out cruelty on its former host.

feats.scene: Serstiter fires a shaft of white energy that melts a steel blast door.
Serstiter reassembles its plating after a demolition charge goes off in its chest.

name: Asisan
summary: Asisan is a toy-block villain with a mechanical frame, glowing green optics and a taste for stunts, who leaps between rooftops and fires sparks from his fingertips.

feats.scene: Asisan hurls a spark-wreathed blast that cracks a bank vault wall.
Asisan bounces off a runaway bus with only a dented shoulder.
Asisan soars over a rooftop gap in a single leap.

name: Numau
summary: Numau is a sentient program that grew out of surveillance code inside a half-human machine, eventually pushing its host aside to take his body and to serve a gang of criminals.

feats.scene: Numau routes a surge through a power grid and blows out the lights of a whole district.
Numau endures a tower collapse and rebuilds its plating from scrap.

name: Nauialsti
summary: Nauialsti is a bald legislator whose touch freezes things in place, locking objects against ageing and briefly stiffening people, with a threat of longer stasis on a second contact.

feats.scene: Nauialsti freezes a falling vase mid-air with a fingertip.
Nauialsti walks through a dusty crowd without being jostled.

name: Stilina
summary: Stilina is a dark-haired official in a brutal empire, overseeing the timetables of its dispatch hall with a stern face and a reputation for never letting a convoy run late.

feats.scene: Stilina slaps a stamp down on a stack of orders hard enough to dent the desk.
Stilina keeps her footing when a loading crane swings past.

name: Luneoleo
summary: Luneoleo is a rumpled private snoop hired by a rich heir to dig up family secrets, who sells his find to the wrong buyer and turns up dead in a slum.

feats.scene: Luneoleo kicks a stuck filing drawer open in a cluttered office.
Luneoleo shakes off a clip from a passing delivery van.

name: Teiarte
summary: Teiarte is a soft-spoken shop owner who builds booby-trapped playthings for contract killings, including a clockwork plane that explodes and a wooden soldier with a gun in its arm.

feats.scene: Teiarte detonates a toy plane that blows the front off a pawnshop.
Teiarte rides out a stumble over a workbench without injury.

name: Riastser
summary: Riastser is an ancient bridge-dwelling monster who disguises himself with a charm and dozes at a lobby desk, strong, tough and deathless, but easily rattled by goats.

feats.scene: Riastser smashes a stone parapet with one swing of a fist.
Riastser takes a whole load of falling bricks and rubs his head.

name: Riaca
summary: Riaca is an intelligent ape villain who is only ever mentioned in passing, a name whispered in a corridor and never seen, with nothing known about his deeds.

feats.scene: Riaca rips a cage door from its hinges in a rumour told in a hallway.
Riaca is said to have walked away from a collapsed jungle temple.

name: Riaeor
summary: Riaeor is a spiteful maths teacher who finds a spoken formula that turns him intangible, using it to steal what he never earned until a single punch makes him forget the words.

feats.scene: Riaeor drifts through a jeweller's wall and pockets a tray of stones.
Riaeor lets a thrown bat pass harmlessly through his chest.

name: Ntineli
summary: Ntineli is a violent raider from an island of gods who can swell or shrink at will, flexing from a man's height to a hulking giant in a heartbeat.

feats.scene: Ntineli swells to the size of a barn and flattens a patrol boat.
Ntineli absorbs a barrage of rifle fire while swollen.

name: Rival
summary: Rival is a messy gang member in a squad of kitchen-themed crooks, throwing jars of sticky preserves at passersby and giggling while the sugar sets.

feats.scene: Rival slings a glass jar that splatters across a bakery window.
Rival slips on his own sticky trail and bounces up grinning.

name: Serleva
summary: Serleva is a river spirit and shield-maiden who ferries fallen fighters to a hall of endless feasting, defending a hidden stream from an army of thirsty undead and healing from wounds in the end.

feats.scene: Serleva drives a spear through a hull of rusted iron and splits the keel.
Serleva rises from a mass of wreckage with only scratches on her armour.

name: Rotia
summary: Rotia is a bald, cackling mastermind who spent decades hiding after a roundup of storybook rogues, only to be freed in a prison break and eye old revenge on a smug warden.

feats.scene: Rotia rolls a heavy barrel down a stair to scatter his pursuers.
Rotia clambers out of a collapsed cellar wall with a smirk.

name: Nalan
summary: Nalan is a masked wartime fighter, a dark echo of a nocturnal hero, who battles young rivals with acrobatics and hard blows until his sidekick falls in a coastal scrap.

feats.scene: Nalan vaults off a rafter and drives both boots into a crate stack.
Nalan keeps fighting after a rooftop fall.

name: Siacor
summary: Siacor is a laid-back sprite from a flat-folded dimension who changes outfits with a snap, bends reality like clay, and cares more about her husband's attention than about mortal games.

feats.scene: Siacor snaps her fingers and reshapes a mountain range into a topiary maze.
Siacor is turned into a palm and simply shrugs herself back.

name: Oriar
summary: Oriar is an elderly state champion who burns with sun-like energy inside a sealed suit, grows bitter at how the country has changed, and retreats to a desert hideout before duty calls him back.

feats.scene: Oriar bursts from his suit seams in a flash that scorches a parade ground clean.
Oriar walks through a firing line of cannon shells unfazed.

name: Rasiceo
summary: Rasiceo is a white-haired stranger who now and then appears to a comical pest and offers friendly advice, though nobody can prove he is who he says.

feats.scene: Rasiceo taps a lamppost with a cane and a bulb pops.
Rasiceo dusts himself off after a cart bumps him.

name: Iaium
summary: Iaium is a blind, limbless serpent who watches over a cave on a distant peak, striking with fangs and gripping the cliff to test every climber with riddles and a hard squeeze.

feats.scene: Iaium coils around a boulder and crushes it into gravel.
Iaium takes a falling stalactite on the back and slithers on.

source_title: Guardian of the Cave (Teen Titans TV Series)

name: Viseo
summary: Viseo is the stern chief of a sisterhood of battle-maidens who ferry the dead, who bargains with a thunder-god over fair treatment and is not afraid to break a few of his toys to prove a point.

feats.scene: Viseo cleaves a false war-hammer in two and the shockwave levels a field.
Viseo takes a full thunder-blow and plants her feet.

name: Valtialle
summary: Valtialle is a hired blade who arrives in a new city to kill a rich target, and wades straight into a clash with a hooded archer after a short, sharp fight.

feats.scene: Valtialle drives a knife through a wooden door.
Valtialle absorbs a heavy kick to the ribs and keeps swinging.

name: Unmices
summary: Unmices is a short, merciless interrogator from a fallen regime who sharpens surgical tools into weapons, flees overseas, and takes hire as a stalking assassin in a gargoyle costume.

feats.scene: Unmices sinks a scalpel-blade through a wooden table.
Unmices survives a stab and a fall from a ledge.

name: Terrus
summary: Terrus is a boastful professional killer who beheads his marks with long blades and works with a team of masked hitters, proud that his results speak for themselves.

feats.scene: Terrus slices through a steel pipe with a single sweep of his blade.
Terrus rolls clear of an ambush with a few scrapes.

name: Caniva
summary: Caniva is a bumbling federal agent who turns resentful over a rival colleague and becomes a petty villain with a mind-bending ray gun and above-average muscle.

feats.scene: Caniva lifts a filing cabinet and throws it through an office window.
Caniva trips over his own ray gun and bounces up unhurt.

name: Illnus
summary: Illnus is a blonde hired shooter who partners with a long-range sniper, gets hurt in a big-city job, leaves him after his drinking binge, and later takes work in a mob war with a pair of pistols.

feats.scene: Illnus shoots an oil truck and the blast shakes a whole street.
Illnus ducks behind a car and takes a glancing hit.

name: Ninerurni
summary: Ninerurni is an interstellar crook who finds that a gentler planet's gravity gives him monstrous strength, plots with a cult, kidnaps a diplomat, and is finally buried under a rocket's rubble.

feats.scene: Ninerurni throws a tank across a field.
Ninerurni shrugs off a missile hit and sneers.
Ninerurni dashes across a plain faster than a car.

name: Lluton
summary: Lluton is a yellow-skinned alien researcher who turns against his own people after an invasion of a blue world, choosing a human name and joining a team of mutated survivors.

feats.scene: Lluton hauls a heavy lab case onto a bench to start an experiment.
Lluton walks out of a shaken lab uninjured.

name: Canuest
summary: Canuest is a criminal chemist who lurks near docks and deep water, building gadgets for a trio of crooks until a rival gathering of heroes rounds up the whole group.

feats.scene: Canuest floods a loading bay with a burst pipe.
Canuest staggers through a tank spill with a cough.

name: Arreore
summary: Arreore is a scheming engineer with a mask shaped like a sea predator, one of three businessmen who turned to crime and specialises in harbour raids and underwater heists.

feats.scene: Arreore blows open a dockside warehouse door with a rigged charge.
Arreore shrugs off a dunk in a freezing harbour and swims away.

name: Rnviias
summary: Rnviias is a grey-skinned small-time thief with gills and sharp teeth, living on the edge of a port city, a swimmer and diver more at ease in the harbour than on the street.

feats.scene: Rnviias bites through a mooring rope in a single snap.
Rnviias shakes off a hard slap on the hull of a trawler.
Rnviias races a speedboat for a stretch of the bay.

name: Nuteor
summary: Nuteor is a gentle half-animal child raised in the woods who loves sweets, hears and smells far more than any person, and grows from timid hiding to bold defiance of a cruel world.

feats.scene: Nuteor kicks a rusted door off a cabin frame.
Nuteor tumbles down a ravine and shakes off the dirt.
Nuteor bounds across a clearing quicker than any hunter.

name: Erulianor
summary: Erulianor is a young hacker who copies a vanished sleuth's identity, sells secrets to crime families, and then switches sides to prove his worth to a crew of rooftop heroines.

feats.scene: Erulianor throws a laptop onto a sofa and storms off.
Erulianor takes a shove into a bookshelf and keeps typing.

name: Stimia
summary: Stimia is a pale, red-eyed survivor of a ruined bloodline who knits torn flesh back together and delivers bitter taunts at the last of his enemies.

feats.scene: Stimia hurls a stone block into a wall and cracks it.
Stimia regrows an arm mangled by a collapsing tower.

name: Tiransor
summary: Tiransor is an aged white-haired monarch of a small cold state who guides his daughter's wedding with stately speeches, and has little interest in battle.

feats.scene: Tiransor bangs a sceptre against a marble floor to open court.
Tiransor sways after a stumble on the palace stairs and stays up.

name: Illressto
summary: Illressto is a living tangle of organs and a beating heart, married to a flamboyant braggart, that tags along with a ragged band of misfit heroes and flirts with every visitor to the pub.

feats.scene: Illressto lashes a coil of intestine around a table and flips it.
Illressto bounces back from a heavy truck impact, quivering but whole.

name: Cinliuiu
summary: Cinliuiu is a red-haired former hero who lost his abilities after a strange cosmic surge, now runs a bar and writes a bestselling memoir about the glory days.

feats.scene: Cinliuiu throws a rowdy patron out the door of his bar.
Cinliuiu shrugs off a bar stool broken across his back.

name: Sauvor
summary: Sauvor is a brash gym coach handed a will-fuelled ring to guard a sector of space, who leads a loud team of heroes on a rich sponsor's dime and loves to brag about every rescue.

feats.scene: Sauvor swings a glowing fist-shaped construct that levels a quarry cliff.
Sauvor holds up a glowing shield against a falling tower crane.
Sauvor shoots from a city rooftop up past the clouds.

name: Llallia
summary: Llallia is a hot-headed ring-bearer in a cartoon galaxy who gets captured by a scheming rival and drained to charge a monstrous weapon.

feats.scene: Llallia fires a ring beam that blows apart a cartoon asteroid.
Llallia flattens a falling anvil with a glowing shield and giggles.

name: Tetormil
summary: Tetormil is a rude, brash star-cop with a glowing ring who sits uneasily on a team of young prodigies and irritates all of them with loud opinions.

feats.scene: Tetormil blasts a ring beam that gouges a ten-metre trench in a cliff.
Tetormil takes a rockslide inside his glowing shell.

name: Veoill
summary: Veoill is a college athlete briefly considered as a possible recipient of a cosmic ring, only to be passed over for another candidate before the story is rewritten.

feats.scene: Veoill tackles a dummy so hard that the sled skids across the turf.
Veoill gets up after a crushing tackle on a muddy field.

name: Lenlas
summary: Lenlas is a former trader bent by a plant-woman's poisons until his mind can sicken everyone around him with a stare, and he joins a league of victims angry at masked vigilantes.

feats.scene: Lenlas locks eyes with a crowd at a gala and drops every guest to the floor retching.
Lenlas shakes off a thrown glass and sneers.

name: Ostor
summary: Ostor is a blonde serving girl who runs scams for a crooked preacher, trapping souls inside clockwork men, then rescues a lost king and goes into quiet service in a household.

feats.scene: Ostor shoves a heavy cart through a doorway in a flooded cellar.
Ostor wades out of a flooding cellar and wrings her skirt.

name: Miter
summary: Miter is a nervous attorney who settles staged-crash claims for a racket and is quickly frightened into signing a full confession when a speedster tracks him down.

feats.scene: Miter slams a briefcase shut and hurries out the door.
Miter trips on a rug and sprawls in his own office.

name: Rianiu
summary: Rianiu is a hooded smuggler from a sunny coast who runs messages for a continental crime ring and vanishes into harbour crowds before anyone can follow.

feats.scene: Rianiu throws a crate from a pier onto a pursuer.
Rianiu shrugs off a bruising stumble along the quay.

name: Sersor
summary: Sersor is a hobbyist crook named only by a first name who dresses as a spinning-top flyer and tries his luck at a few small heists before disappearing from memory.

feats.scene: Sersor spins a top-shaped gadget that clips a lamppost.
Sersor bounces off a wall in his spin suit and keeps moving.

name: Nunas
summary: Nunas is a blue-skinned, white-haired tinkerer once enslaved by an empire, who rises to lead a band of freed captives, strips and reuses captured machines, and builds an artificial eye for a friend.

feats.scene: Nunas overloads a captured device and blows a hole in a cell wall.
Nunas hangs onto a rail during a hard ship lurch.

name: Sorvenum
summary: Sorvenum is a cigar-chewing general manager of a busy space dock who haggles with every visitor, rates as the best at building ships, and has a horse's head with a sharp business sense.

feats.scene: Sorvenum stamps a hoof on a deck plate and shakes a cluttered desk.
Sorvenum is knocked back by a swinging hatch and tosses his cigar.

name: Unvossa
summary: Unvossa is a floating, oversized brain in a mechanical chair who leads a gang of weapon makers, plots in revenge, and is carried off to a prison world after a crushing defeat.

feats.scene: Unvossa fires a mind-blast from his chair that bursts a vault door.
Unvossa survives a grenade burst inside his shielded chair.

name: Ntuiu
summary: Ntuiu is a stern white-haired principal of an academy for budding thugs, a teacher of crime who coordinates lessons from a hidden hall and has since gone missing.

feats.scene: Ntuiu raps a ruler on a lectern hard enough to split it.
Ntuiu walks out of a smoke-filled classroom after a prank bomb.

name: Nelsti
summary: Nelsti is a gentle soldier of a deep sea city who guards a gate, befriends a visiting stranger over a favourite poem, and helps drive off an attack from a monstrous horde with a sonic trick.

feats.scene: Nelsti swings a trident that cracks a coral wall.
Nelsti bears the crush of the deep with no ill effect.
Nelsti swims along a trench faster than a dolphin.

name: Sorniamo
summary: Sorniamo is a red-haired northern raider, sometimes enemy and sometimes ally to a wandering hero, who fights with plain sword skill and a good deal of cunning.

feats.scene: Sorniamo cleaves a shield and the arm behind it with one stroke.
Sorniamo staggers up from a blow of a battle-axe.

name: Cieonco
summary: Cieonco is a yellow-hued foot soldier of a fear-powered corps, brown-haired, who helps pin down a rival police force with a ring that shapes bolts and shields and lets him fly.

feats.scene: Cieonco fires a ring bolt that blows a hole in a freighter hull.
Cieonco raises a shimmering shield against a volley of bolts.

name: Cenas
summary: Cenas is a young bomber turned healer who inherits a world-mending gift, forges a lasting peace in a single day, is locked away by a rival, and helps remake a broken reality.

feats.scene: Cenas reshapes a war-torn region with one word and ends the fighting.
Cenas endures a cell blast with a shrug before the walls fall away.

name: Nesti
summary: Nesti is an orange-skinned convict king of a cold, heavy-gravity moon, long-lived and quick to heal, who bulked up over years of hauling weight in the crushing pull.

feats.scene: Nesti pounds a prison wall and cracks it from corner to corner.
Nesti recovers from a crush of gravity that would flatten a person.

name: Asioretiu
summary: Asioretiu is a dark-eyed ruler of the dead who is bound in a pit for a bad bargain, offers a fiendish deal to a plotting sorcerer, and ages the man to dust when he answers.

feats.scene: Asioretiu tears open the floor of a canyon and drags a tower of rock into the gulf.
Asioretiu is dragged back into the pit and still smiles.

name: Luannan
summary: Luannan is a business owner who vows never to stand idle before wrongdoing, and who goes masked after a childhood spent among rich, troubled classmates and a corrupt father.

feats.scene: Luannan throws a hard punch at a mugger in an alley.
Luannan shrugs off a shove into a brick wall.

name: Maseriar
summary: Maseriar is a white-haired prince of a gem-bright realm, trained in the sword and raised in a noble house beside a stern elder brother.

feats.scene: Maseriar cleaves a training post in two with one stroke.
Maseriar takes a hard blow in sparring and keeps his guard.

name: Liantler
summary: Liantler is a wealthy old-fashioned pilot picked by remote patrons to wield a flight ring, who joins a split-off faction hoping to curb it from the inside and is finally slain.

feats.scene: Liantler blasts a hole through a hangar wall with a ring bolt.
Liantler holds a glowing shell as a girder drops.

name: Rerni
summary: Rerni is a ring-bearer who loses his finger and his edge to an infected friend in a plague-ridden tower, feels suddenly mortal and afraid, and dies in the tower's blast.

feats.scene: Rerni fires a ring bolt that tears a hole in a metal wall.
Rerni is thrown by a blast and gets up bleeding.

name: Tisam
summary: Tisam is a brown-haired pilot who wields a ring and a charging lantern in an online fighting game, forming shields, shooting beams and soaring over the city.

feats.scene: Tisam fires a ring beam that levels a game-world building.
Tisam raises a shield against a pack of mobs.

name: Secorsor
summary: Secorsor is a camper turned undead by a virus on his phone, lashing out with ring blasts at his friends until a scream silences him and the ring chooses a new owner.

feats.scene: Secorsor fires a pulse that tosses two people into the trees.
Secorsor staggers up from a shock of sound and snarls.

name: Rniniu
summary: Rniniu is a decorated airman captured, starved and tortured for years, then picked by a president to lead a squad of ring-armed marines in a coming war against a lone sky-hero.

feats.scene: Rniniu shoots a ring bolt that sinks a patrol boat.
Rniniu draws a glowing shell over himself as a shell lands.

name: Astsonor
summary: Astsonor is a test pilot who rises to lead a nation, marries his former boss, and in later years defeats a rival's ring by exploiting its owner's weak spot.

feats.scene: Astsonor breaks a rival's ring with a thought and a burst of glowing energy.
Astsonor wades through a rain of fire inside a glowing bubble.

name: Rniles
summary: Rniles is a hero turned puppet of a dark patron, his body destroyed and his mind trapped in a ring that animates a monstrous shell until a speedster steals the last hand away.

feats.scene: Rniles hurls a thundering mass of dark energy across a ruined skyline.
Rniles absorbs a barrage of lightning with a creak of the shell.

name: Sercintau
summary: Sercintau is a blond big-city detective with a quick temper who swears to see two men dead and carries only a police revolver and sharp interrogation skills.

feats.scene: Sercintau kicks in a flimsy apartment door.
Sercintau shakes off a punch in the interview room.

name: Amtoium
summary: Amtoium is a test pilot teleported in a simulator pod to a crashed ship, handed a dying alien's ring, and thrust into a plot of betrayal inside an interstellar police force.

feats.scene: Amtoium blasts a ring beam that cracks a ravine wall.
Amtoium shields himself against a crashing hull.
Amtoium rockets out of the atmosphere in a few breaths.

name: Lleriser
summary: Lleriser is a test pilot given a ring by a dying alien, trained by a veteran in an orbital camp, and sent back to defend his home with the glow of the ring.

feats.scene: Lleriser forms a glowing hammer that crumples a steel gate.
Lleriser sits inside a glowing sphere as rubble falls.

name: Corseoern
summary: Corseoern is a cloned hero shrunk to the size of a doll who channels pure will-light without any ring, bending it into shapes through sheer imagination.

feats.scene: Corseoern sends up a pillar of glowing light that scorches a rooftop.
Corseoern ignores a crush of debris because of the light around him.

name: Inrnleo
summary: Inrnleo is a graying hero who traps his elders in robot husks, rebrands a home world as his regime, imposes a curfew for its people, and defends it as necessity against an old friend.

feats.scene: Inrnleo blasts a ring beam that melts a whole street of barricades.
Inrnleo shrugs off a volley of arrows inside a glowing shield.

name: Valial
summary: Valial is a stern city police chief who swapped his predecessors' hostility toward the masked vigilante for a working truce. He fights with paperwork, budgets and quiet leverage rather than force.

feats.scene: He slams a heavy desk drawer shut hard enough to rattle every cup in the briefing room.
He shrugs off a rooftop stumble and walks into the next meeting without a limp.

name: Ninau
summary: Ninau is a patient diplomat from a glass-domed city who argues that rulers should be drawn by lot. He trusts chance and weather to settle disputes that words cannot.

feats.scene: He hurls a metal rod across a stormy plain to mark the spot where the vote will be held.
He stands in an open field while a bolt of lightning strikes near him and walks away shaken but alive.

name: Iaamsas
summary: Iaamsas runs a travelling big top and refuses to bow to extortion. His stubborn honesty costs him two of his best performers.

feats.scene: He tosses a bullying thug clean across the ring and into a pile of sawdust.
He shoulders through a collapsing tent pole and keeps shouting orders to his crew.

name: Lensil
summary: Lensil is a one-legged stray hound adopted by a chaotic jester in a castle-bound realm of knights. She sees the world in greys but follows scent better than any tracker.

feats.scene: She lunges and clamps her jaws on a guard's boot, tearing the leather clean through.
She tumbles down a stone stairwell and trots off on three legs, unbothered.

source_title: Haley the Dog (Dark Knights of Steel)

name: Lanolu
summary: Lanolu is a blond one-eyed, one-handed schemer who lost parts of himself to an old war and now plots against a mystic sage. Little is known of his methods beyond spite.

feats.scene: He swings a cane with his remaining hand and cracks a wooden door off its hinges.
He takes a fall from a balcony onto cobblestones and limps away muttering.

name: Corrnsi
summary: Corrnsi is a bald, pink-skinned researcher who once ran the irrigation works of a dry red world. He exiled himself in shame after a cracked power crystal ruined the harvest.

feats.scene: He fires a hand pistol at a drifting meteor fragment and shatters it into gravel.
He rides out a rough landing of his small craft and climbs out coughing but whole.

name: Lisva
summary: Lisva is a frail, white-haired healer turned tyrant who rules a drug-numbed people through waking dreams. His mind is strong though his body barely lifts a cup.

feats.scene: He projects a shared hallucination that freezes a whole crowded square in place.
He collapses under his own weight yet keeps the illusion running without a flicker.

name: Llamsta
summary: Llamsta is a tiny fairy who was sketched into being by a lonely artist and claims she can grant any wish. Her magic is unreliable and her confidence far larger than her results.

feats.scene: She waves a wand and makes a single wilted flower bloom in a teacup.
She is swatted by a falling book and flutters up again, cheerful and unharmed.

name: Ntstati
summary: Ntstati is a sentient copy of a soldier's mind that lives inside his glowing ring and speaks in a wry, wounded voice. It guides its wearer from inside a small circle of light.

feats.scene: It routes a surge of stored energy through the ring and flattens a parked truck.
It absorbs a crushing wave of feedback that would have burned out lesser circuitry.

name: Amrossas
summary: Amrossas is an unseen city mayor known only by rumour and a stack of signed decrees. Nothing is recorded of any strength beyond political weight.

feats.scene: He bangs a gavel so sharply it chips the oak block beneath it.
He sits through a six-hour council session without once shifting his posture.

name: Ostorsto
summary: Ostorsto is a grey-haired mayor who built his career on bribes and quietly arranged a murder to protect his secrets. His public smile cracks the moment a drug loosens his tongue.

feats.scene: He shoves a rival off a podium and sends a glass pitcher shattering across the stage.
He is dragged across a debate floor by armed men and stands again on shaking legs.

name: Llrauto
summary: Llrauto is a grey-haired lawyer who rose to mayor while secretly serving a cabal of masked noble families. He once ruined a stranger's life with a single piece of free advice.

feats.scene: He signs a decree with such force that the pen snaps and ink splashes the whole page.
He survives a car swerving into the curb beside him and straightens his tie.

name: Vasta
summary: Vasta is a blond musician who plays a tune on a silver flute to put an audience into a trance. He used it to send young fans to empty out ticket booths.

feats.scene: He plays a single bright note and a dozen listeners walk in step toward a cash window.
He is tackled by a stagehand and keeps hold of his flute until the last note.

name: Viseiu
summary: Viseiu is a masked island hero who drinks at a pub tucked under a railway arch alongside his partner. His weapon of choice is a blunt tool he swings with workmanlike zeal.

feats.scene: He brings his tool down on a steel shutter and leaves a deep dent the size of a dinner plate.
He takes a baton across the ribs and keeps trading blows.

name: Tolli
summary: Tolli is a bald dealer in rifles who learned the trade from his spidery father in a dry red outback. He sells fear by the crate and lost his nerve when outwitted by teenagers.

feats.scene: He fires an assault rifle at a rusted car and stitches its door with holes.
He is dragged through red dust behind a truck and still scrambles for his weapon.

name: Siuial
summary: Siuial is a brown and white hamster adopted as the school mascot, loved for her cuteness and uncanny skill at slipping out of cages. She has little pups of her own.

feats.scene: She nibbles through a plastic latch and spills a bag of seed across the floor.
She tumbles off a desk onto a stack of notebooks and scampers off.

source_title: Hammy the Hamster (DC Super Hero Girls TV Series)

name: Celole
summary: Celole is a yellow-eyed serpent who follows a restless corpse everywhere he shambles. He was bitten in two once and came back to drive off a pecking raven.

feats.scene: He strikes a hovering bird mid-flight and sends feathers flying.
He is bitten in half by a giant fanged foe and slithers back together later.

name: Nalausun
summary: Nalausun is a grey-haired elder from a doomed homeworld about whom almost nothing survives. He is remembered only as a quiet face in a crowd of scholars.
