Anore works a double shift on her feet without a break.

name: Lessori
summary: Lessori is a marine veteran of a jungle war, thrown together with others on an island of ancient beasts. He fights with a rifle and a hard head.

feats.scene: Lessori fires a rifle round that drops a charging raptor.
Lessori crawls through a muddy trench under fire.

name: Vosserlen
summary: Vosserlen is a burly sergeant from a pine-wooded state who earned a nickname by lobbing iron balls at the enemy. He is steady, dry and loyal to his leader.

feats.scene: Vosserlen hurls a cannonball by hand into a fort's wooden gate.
Vosserlen marches through a rain of arrows.

name: Eonnelan
summary: Eonnelan is a hired thug from a distant century with unbreakable tusks and a near-indestructible frame. Rejected by a hero club, he grows monstrous and bitter.

feats.scene: Eonnelan rams his tusks into a steel hull and tears it open.
Eonnelan stands up after a collapsing prison tower falls on him.

name: Rertivas
summary: Rertivas is a lanky, bullied janitor who falls into a vat and comes out thin as a sheet. He turns to crime for the sake of a crush and blows up a dam to escape.

feats.scene: Rertivas sets off charges that burst a dam and flood a valley.
Rertivas folds himself into a kite and rides a gust out of a window.

name: Lleva
summary: Lleva is a flat, papery troublemaker in a cartoon world, who crashes a wedding with other rogues. A hero lures him into a fireworks man, and he goes up in smoke.

feats.scene: Lleva slashes a ribbon of sharp paper across a banquet table.
Lleva smoulders for a moment and then crumples away.

source_title: Horace Throstle (The Brave and the Bold)

name: Nuseol
summary: Nuseol is a falcon-headed god of daylight and high sky, an avenger of his murdered father. His blade carries the brightest beam of morning, and he rules from a hidden realm.

feats.scene: Nuseol sweeps a sunrise-bright blade through a range of peaks and slices their summits off.
Nuseol rides out a rival's cataclysmic storm without a mark.

name: Anuvita
summary: Anuvita is a black-eyed sky god worshipped by a hawk-winged people, who sleeps in the depths of a world and lets his essence seep into it. He grants speed and strength to his chosen.

feats.scene: Anuvita stirs in his sleep and a continent-wide quake runs along the crust.
Anuvita slumbers within a world's core for ages, unharmed.

name: Norsa
summary: Norsa is a sharp-minded young hacker who breaks into systems for a ruthless employer. He marries on a whim to dodge revenge and slowly falls for his wife.

feats.scene: Norsa slams a laptop shut on a stranger's hand.
Norsa runs a long chase up a fire stair, winded but alive.

name: Lereo
summary: Lereo is a red-furred dachshund hero from a patrol in deep space. His body runs hot and he bends any nearby flames to his will.

feats.scene: Lereo steers a fireball through a hangar door and melts a robot guard.
Lereo trots out of a burning shed unharmed.

name: Numviin
summary: Numviin is a short-tempered dachshund with a furnace for a body, who breathes fire and can cool himself when scolded. He joins a team of space dogs to stop a robotic cat.

feats.scene: Numviin exhales a wall of flame that melts a mechanical cat's armour.
Numviin leaps through his own fire unhurt.

name: Rnune
summary: Rnune is a brown-haired speed-obsessed crook from a big port city. He tunes engines more than he trains his fists.

feats.scene: Rnune swings a tyre iron at a rival's fender.
Rnune rolls out of a wrecked coupe with a scowl.

name: Soseoest
summary: Soseoest is a showman-magician who uses stage tricks to shrink and menace small heroes. He is vain and boastful, and thinks his squashing line is clever.

feats.scene: Soseoest slams down a giant fake hand that flattens a stage prop.
Soseoest tumbles from a trapdoor and takes a bow.

name: Tatiir
summary: Tatiir is an orange-skinned guardian who wields a glowing ring and later joins an elite order that links his mind to an ancient book. His will is strong and his strength is boosted.

feats.scene: Tatiir fires a ring beam that cracks a moon-sized slab.
Tatiir endures a shipboard explosion behind a ring shield.

name: Vaiunu
summary: Vaiunu is a white-haired industrialist of a magnetic people who can drag iron through the sky and fly along planetary fields. He once pulled meteors out of orbit with minimal effort.

feats.scene: Vaiunu drags an iron meteor from orbit and sets it down in a field.
Vaiunu wraps a force-field around a crowd as a rooftop collapses.

name: Miltalla
summary: Miltalla is a government agent who can trigger a beastly change that turns him into a lumbering, savage giant. In that shape he hurled boulders at pursuers and killed in the hills.

feats.scene: Miltalla hurls a boulder from an icy slope and flattens a camp tent.
Miltalla barrels through a rockfall on a steep ridge.

name: Vacace
summary: Vacace is a swaggering fencer in a plumed hat, who duels with a rapier and a madman's grin. He is conscripted into a doomed squad and dies in a single blow.

feats.scene: Vacace thrusts a rapier through a plank door in one strike.
Vacace takes a baton to the ribs and laughs.

name: Lleall
summary: Lleall is a guilt-ridden nuclear scientist who joins a squad of misfits, hoping to atone. He dies when a monster chews on his thermite charges.

feats.scene: Lleall sets off a belt of thermite inside a flying beast's jaws.
Lleall endures a creature's bite before the charges blow.

name: Raunaueo
summary: Raunaueo is a private detective who climbs inside a stolen iron robot and rides it into street fights. The machine is strong, tough and can fly short hops.

feats.scene: Raunaueo pounds a getaway car flat inside a clanking iron suit.
Raunaueo's iron shell shrugs off a hail of machine-gun fire.

name: Asallti
summary: Asallti is a grey-haired vigilante of a bygone era whose deeds are remembered with a portrait in a hall of heroes. Little else is known about him.

feats.scene: Asallti breaks a heavy door off its hinges to reach a victim.
Asallti takes a beating from several thugs and stays up.

name: Miasan
summary: Miasan is a gruff officer who leads an elite commando unit with a pistol and a bad temper. He is proud of a long line of soldiers and is hounded by regret.

feats.scene: Miasan fires a rifle at an armoured car and punctures the tyre.
Miasan shoulders through an exploding trench wall.

name: Amonumrn
summary: Amonumrn is a brilliant inventor of armoured machines and a skilled surgeon who alters faces. He trains bats to carry tiny bombs and later sells his skills to the other side.

feats.scene: Amonumrn drives a giant tunnelling machine through a hillside and collapses a bunker.
Amonumrn is arrested without resistance by a small team.

name: Llieol
summary: Llieol is a hazel-eyed college crook who passes himself off as a hero for a night. He is brash and loud, and is caught before dawn.

feats.scene: Llieol punches a locker door and dents it.
Llieol takes a hard tackle in the campus quad.

name: Suniuti
summary: Suniuti is a smooth, bald psychiatrist who runs an asylum by day and plots for a shadowy outfit at night. He tries to brainwash heroes in an undersea base.

feats.scene: Suniuti flips a switch that powers a mind-bending machine in an undersea vault.
Suniuti is dragged off by guards without a bruise.

name: Tautelle
summary: Tautelle is a courteous university lecturer and part-time staff doctor at a troubled hospital. He sends warm letters to students and puzzles over violent patients.

feats.scene: Tautelle slams a thick case file onto a lectern.
Tautelle sits through a day of tense interviews.

name: Tesnen
summary: Tesnen is a bald scholar who belongs to a secret society and teaches by day. He comes to a sudden end in the story that introduces him.

feats.scene: Tesnen pounds a lecture desk to make a point.
Tesnen holds his ground against a hostile crowd.

name: Ralreoliu
summary: Ralreoliu is a green-eyed warden of a grim asylum who resents outside meddling. He grudgingly allows a young doctor to run her studies, then loses his job.

feats.scene: Ralreoliu slams a cell hatch shut with a loud clang.
Ralreoliu faces a long inquiry without flinching.

name: Litil
summary: Litil is a bald, bearded psychologist obsessed with a masked rival, who deduces his foe's secret by reasoning alone. He breeds a private army of engineered brutes in a hidden lab.

feats.scene: Litil unleashes a pack of engineered monsters that flatten a warehouse wall.
Litil shrugs off a blow from a gloved fist and keeps lecturing.

name: Nensute
summary: Nensute is a soft-spoken mind doctor who treats troubled patients while quietly testing how far a fractured psyche can be steered. Nensute builds helmets and consoles that let a visitor wander inside a sleeper's dreams, valuing the data over any cure.

feats.scene: Nensute swings a heavy clipboard into a guard's ribs to break free of a cell corridor.
Nensute tumbles down a flight of stairs and gets up with only bruises.

name: Miias
summary: Miias is a small-time arsonist who dresses in scorched leathers and carries a bottled torch to frighten shopkeepers. Miias has no true gift beyond nerve and a lighter, and mostly lurks in alleys waiting for easy marks.

feats.scene: Miias hurls a burning bottle that engulfs a delivery van's front seat.
Miias shrugs off a baton blow to the shoulder before sprinting off.

name: Llori
summary: Llori is a cheerful wartime hero whose body sheaths itself in a mystic glow of flame. Llori uses the fire for rescues, signalling and, to the dismay of friends, baking elaborate cakes.

feats.scene: Llori bursts into a roaring blaze that melts a tank's gun barrel flat.
Llori walks unharmed through a burning factory to carry out the night shift.

name: Mateti
summary: Mateti is a thug who coats his skin in a hard glaze that turns bullets and brick alike. Mateti batters through walls but loses everything once the coating is scoured away.

feats.scene: Mateti lowers a shoulder and bursts through a brick wall into the bank vault corridor.
Mateti stands calmly while a squad empties pistols into his chest.

name: Meauor
summary: Meauor is a bald robber who served a long sentence and came out with murder in mind. Meauor hums constantly as he stalks old enemies and has no gift beyond a grudge.

feats.scene: Meauor lands a hard punch on a witness who then falls against a door.
Meauor takes a cudgel to the back and keeps walking.

name: Orosa
summary: Orosa is a gentle father from a distant colony world, blessed with a family trait that splits his body into three identical selves. Orosa uses the trick for chores and, rarely, for defence of home.

feats.scene: Orosa splits into three and shoves a collapsing shelf off a neighbour.
Orosa survives a hard fall from a loft onto a stone floor.

name: Seceti
summary: Seceti is a blue-skinned arena champion with a fair-minded heart and a lifetime of boxing training. Seceti would sooner win by honest rounds than by treachery and says so loudly.

feats.scene: Seceti lands a pivoting hook that lifts a rival off the canvas and over the ropes.
Seceti stays on his feet through a dozen rounds of heavy blows.

name: Nasiu
summary: Nasiu is a long-lived soldier who has not aged since a jungle war, and can read a victim's past from the smell of their last breath. Nasiu fights with a blade and spreads conflict for hire.

feats.scene: Nasiu cleaves a sandbag wall in half with a single sweeping blade stroke.
Nasiu pulls a spear from his own chest and keeps fighting.

name: Tiaanren
summary: Tiaanren is a masked axe fighter who serves a hateful cabal and drags a heavy blade everywhere. Tiaanren is trained, brutal and mortal, relying on timing rather than any gift.

feats.scene: Tiaanren splits a thick oak door with one overhead chop.
Tiaanren shrugs off a thrown chair and charges again.

name: Lollonel
summary: Lollonel is a killer turned runner who borrows the pace of a vast cosmic current and wears his friendliness like a mask. Lollonel moves faster than lightning bolts and has been cursed to serve the current forever.

feats.scene: Lollonel blurs across a river valley and back before a thrown bottle lands.
Lollonel vibrates a fist through a steel door at full sprint.
Lollonel skids across pavement at top speed and tears up the street without a scratch.

name: Corne
summary: Corne is a diving assassin who works for a sinister syndicate and slips through harbours like a seal. Corne eventually sells out her bosses to the people hunting them.

feats.scene: Corne drives a spear gun into a hull plate and tears it loose.
Corne endures a long dive in freezing water and a rough shoreline tumble.

name: Lloor
summary: Lloor is an engaged archer who hunts rivals with a hand-built bow. Lloor is patient and accurate, a fine shot with an average person's body.

feats.scene: Lloor looses a shaft that pins a coat to a wall across the room.
Lloor takes a fall from a fire escape and rolls to her feet.

name: Llulli
summary: Llulli is a costumed thief and gymnast who vaults across rooftops beside her spouse. Llulli trains in archery and hand combat and plans every heist like a stage routine.

feats.scene: Llulli kicks a gate latch off its hinges mid-flip.
Llulli lands badly from a long rooftop leap and keeps running.

name: Ossialli
summary: Ossialli is a one-eyed tribal leader condemned to wander a sunken continent with his people. Ossialli tracks fugitives with a sword at his hip and is too proud to accept defeat quietly.

feats.scene: Ossialli brings a heavy sword down through a shield and the arm behind it.
Ossialli keeps fighting after a deep slash across the ribs.

name: Erunorniu
summary: Erunorniu is a diminutive ancient king of the dream-born folk, wary of bargains and weary of old debts. Erunorniu rules a hidden country that his people carved from a stolen corner of the underworld.

feats.scene: Erunorniu snaps a gnarled staff and a wave of wild vines flattens a siege tower.
Erunorniu endures a collapsing hall of living wood without a scratch.

name: Sorvallen
summary: Sorvallen is a swaggering young man given a gale-spinning gift by an ancient sorcerer, and he speaks like a knight from a bygone tale. Sorvallen tears rooms apart in the joy of a brawl but retreats when outmatched.

feats.scene: Sorvallen whips up a roaring cyclone that peels the roof from a dance hall.
Sorvallen is thrown through a wall and rises laughing.

name: Lluvaurnu
summary: Lluvaurnu is a young volunteer bound to a shared atomic matrix that lets him bend density and project blasts of raw energy. Lluvaurnu flies at highway speeds and can absorb heat and light to recharge.

feats.scene: Lluvaurnu fires a roaring nuclear pulse that bores through a bridge span.
Lluvaurnu streaks above a river at supersonic-ish pace trailing a streak of sparks.
Lluvaurnu takes a direct tank shell and coalesces back intact.

name: Eltenan
summary: Eltenan is a young seafarer who commands a disguised raiding vessel packed with hidden guns and a launching ramp. Eltenan wears an antique uniform and leads his crew against a hostile fleet.

feats.scene: Eltenan orders a torpedo spread that breaks a warship in two.
Eltenan holds the bridge as a shell crater rips through the deck beside him.

name: Nansent
summary: Nansent is a stern director of a cosmic police force who secretly studies black holes and parallel worlds. Nansent plots to replace the cosmos with one built to his own plan, free of oversight.

feats.scene: Nansent releases a sealed singularity and swallows an orbital station whole.
Nansent weathers a shattered viewport blast in his command room.

name: Rnllta
summary: Rnllta is a stern matriarch from a winged-people homeworld, divorced and fiercely proud of her daughter's line. Rnllta fights only with wit and with the iron stare of an elder.

feats.scene: Rnllta slaps a rude envoy hard enough to spin him round.
Rnllta takes a stumble down a stone stair and stands unbothered.

name: Aulorern
summary: Aulorern is a young woman gifted by an old sorcerer with command over liquids. Aulorern bursts pipes and tanks to keep rivals stumbling, but retreats once outmatched.

feats.scene: Aulorern bursts a street main and floods an intersection knee-deep in seconds.
Aulorern is thrown into a lamp post and scrambles away.

name: Rninenll
summary: Rninenll is a masked brawler from an alternate decade who prowls alleys and fights with trained hands. Rninenll is dangerous to ordinary guards but outclassed by a true hero.

feats.scene: Rninenll snaps a roundhouse into a bouncer's jaw and drops him.
Rninenll takes a baton across the back and keeps swinging.

name: Mivant
summary: Mivant is a bald, hopeful space-faring knight who wields a ring of blue light and guards a communal battery. Mivant chooses to die rather than hand the power source to a destroyer.

feats.scene: Mivant casts a ring-born bolt that flattens a landing ship's engines.
Mivant stands firm inside a glowing shield as a hull beam hammers it.

name: Carrn
summary: Carrn is a genderless time-hopping hunter-weapon, a living curse built to chase one quarry across the ages. Carrn adapts to wounds and infests any host it touches, and cannot be reasoned with.

feats.scene: Carrn tears open a fortress wall and spreads its taint through an entire city block.
Carrn shrugs off a barrage that levels the room around it.

name: Riaeo
summary: Riaeo is a golden-haired champion of a parallel world who vanished for a time and returned to rally its defenders. Riaeo battles swarms of dark-matter beasts that threaten his home.

feats.scene: Riaeo drives a fist through a monstrous beast and the shockwave levels a district.
Riaeo takes a falling tower on the shoulders and stands firm.

name: Tellli
summary: Tellli is a rioting prisoner who bends the minds of others to his will. Tellli overreaches in a forced duel with other mind-benders and the clash of wills proves fatal.

feats.scene: Tellli orders a guard to throw himself across a stair rail.
Tellli withstands a lingering psychic storm before his skull gives way.

name: Iaial
summary: Iaial is a green-skinned scout turned into a shambling plague-bearer in the middle of a fortress siege. Iaial endures wounds that would drop a normal soldier and moves in a hungry horde.

feats.scene: Iaial rips a steel hatch from its frame as the horde pours into the vault.
Iaial is buried under falling masonry and climbs out.

name: Orora
summary: Orora is a long-lived, eyeless scientist from a technologically gifted race who speaks to any being mind to mind. Orora once clashed with a band of young heroes on a far-off world.

feats.scene: Orora triggers a lab device that scorches a doorway clean.
Orora endures a harsh jolt of static from a damaged console.

name: Numseo
summary: Numseo is a widowed monk and the last of a mountain sect that holds that spellcraft and science are two sides of one coin. Numseo has blended many fighting styles and can numb his own pain at will.

feats.scene: Numseo snaps a staff strike through a stack of roof tiles.
Numseo deadens his nerves and endures a cracked-rib kick without flinching.

name: Neosirri
summary: Neosirri is a bulky cyborg student at a villain academy, training to be a hired menace. Neosirri leans on raw muscle and a metal frame rather than finesse.

feats.scene: Neosirri hurls a metal locker across a gym and dents the far wall.
Neosirri is flattened by a swinging beam and gets up with sparks.

name: Leoar
summary: Leoar is a techno-organic being who grows tools from his own body and is hired out as a living workshop. Leoar eventually finds friends who value him as more than equipment.

feats.scene: Leoar extrudes a cutting arm that carves through a bulkhead.
Leoar survives heavy damage and reboots from a stored repair routine.

name: Olereo
summary: Olereo is a quiet moon deity who runs a small farm and a still alongside a twin brother. Olereo grows stronger when mortals remember the old tales and weaker when they forget.

feats.scene: Olereo pulls the tides in a great surge that drowns a coastline.
Olereo walks out unharmed from a crumbling cliffside.

name: Llitalia
summary: Llitalia is a brother who takes the other's place in a galactic tournament and wins fights by shaping sound. Llitalia amplifies whispers into blasts and wears an indestructible cloak to the ring.

feats.scene: Llitalia magnifies a clap into a booming pulse that cracks an arena wall.
Llitalia hides inside a flowing cloak as a rival's barrage lands.

name: Socoriu
summary: Socoriu is an elder giant of the old pantheon, keeper of justice and father to famed sons. Socoriu rules from a restored hall and cannot die.

feats.scene: Socoriu strikes the ground and a mountain range splits along a new fault.
Socoriu stands in the heart of a collapsing volcano and strolls out.

name: Rnlle
summary: Rnlle is a once-mortal warrior turned river spirit, half woman and half fish, who lures trespassers to deep water. Rnlle guards sacred streams and remembers the family that cast her down.

feats.scene: Rnlle drags a boat under with a coil of her tail.
Rnlle survives a drop from a sea cliff and rises changed.

name: Tiltint
summary: Tiltint is an appointed ruler of a harsh desert land, resented by its people. Tiltint governs from a stone castle and relies on guards rather than strength.

feats.scene: Tiltint strikes a petitioner across the cheek with a ringed hand.
Tiltint topples from his dais and is helped to his feet.

name: Iurer
summary: Iurer is a raider-king from an age long past, turned to stone by a hero and revived by a curse that picks a fatherless host each generation. Iurer returns bitter and cruel.

feats.scene: Iurer swings a stone-hard fist that caves in a temple door.
Iurer is bound and stabbed yet staggers to his feet.

name: Amtanan
summary: Amtanan is a winged architect of a heavenly city who fled in shame after a forbidden romance. Amtanan guards one rule above all, and carries a cursed knife as a weakness.

feats.scene: Amtanan sweeps a hand and a radiant tower rises from empty ground in an hour.
Amtanan takes a falling spire on one wing and is unmarked.

name: Milolu
summary: Milolu is a bold son of a master craftsman who escapes a tower on wings of feather and wax. Milolu flies too high in his joy and falls into the sea.

feats.scene: Milolu hurls a stool at a door latch and shatters it.
Milolu plunges from a great height into the waves.

name: Stilli
summary: Stilli is a cold-hearted villainess from a sister world who freezes whatever she touches. Stilli is part of a murderous quintet that stays hidden for years.

feats.scene: Stilli exhales a freezing mist that turns a lobby into a block of white.
Stilli is slammed through a window and gets up shivering with cold fury.

name: Varornau
summary: Varornau is a white-haired royal who joins a council of crowned guests to coach a friend. Varornau trusts ritual duels and loses them with grace.

feats.scene: Varornau lobs a snowball that bursts against a banquet table.
Varornau is thrown across a throne room by a ceremonial blast.

name: Telsaram
summary: Telsaram is a bearded monarch of a frozen people who wake after an age of sleep. Telsaram rides tusked beasts and plans to power a freezing machine with stolen gold.

feats.scene: Telsaram fires a frost beam that coats a mining town in thick ice.
Telsaram is knocked from his mount and brushes off the snow.

name: Vaeole
summary: Vaeole is a scientist who turns a heat device on the polar caps to flood coastal towns for ransom. Vaeole is eventually frozen into an iceberg by a stage magician.

feats.scene: Vaeole melts a shelf of ice and sends a surge over a harbour district.
Vaeole stumbles on a wet deck and bumps his head.

name: Iusorlu
summary: Iusorlu is a young woman chosen to switch on a festive tree for a city crowd. Iusorlu is snatched by schemers and plays a doomed part in their frame-up.

feats.scene: Iusorlu presses a big red button and the tree blazes with bulbs.
Iusorlu falls from a rooftop edge onto the stage below.

name: Niniala
summary: Niniala is a grey-haired alien teen who admires crooks and joins a gang of young troublemakers. Niniala wears a cold-themed outfit and helps steal a prized cube from a hero's fortress.

feats.scene: Niniala shoves a vault door off its tracks during the heist.
Niniala is hurled across a hangar and shakes it off.

name: Elaanst
summary: Elaanst is a blue-skinned sorceress who rules a frozen palace and draws power from a trapped crystal. Elaanst keeps youth by keeping the world cold, and is willing to freeze it whole.

feats.scene: Elaanst exhales a blizzard that buries a fortress valley overnight.
Elaanst walks through an avalanche of her own making and is unharmed.

name: Entteseo
summary: Entteseo is an elderly widow and landlady who survived war, loss and exile. Entteseo rents rooms to young people and wants only a quiet last stretch of years.

feats.scene: Entteseo swats a burglar with a rolling pin and sends him out the door.
Entteseo endures a hard winter march with little food.

name: Lasont
summary: Lasont is a scheming pet lizard in a tycoon's glass tank who steals a lab gadget to farm bugs for dinner. Lasont accidentally causes chaos in town and relies on a rubbery tongue to survive falls.

feats.scene: Lasont whips his tongue at a fat caterpillar and tugs it off a branch.
Lasont drops from a high bough and bounces on his tongue.

name: Letaeor
summary: Letaeor is a seven-foot armored brute of unknown nature, a living weapon that may be more suit than man. Letaeor uproots trees and tears down buildings, and is nearly immune to harm.

feats.scene: Letaeor wrenches a girder from a tower and brings the wall down with it.
Letaeor stands in a hail of heavy rounds and a crumbling façade without a dent.

name: Nusst
summary: Nusst is a red-eyed robot villain who attacks a city for attention and mostly gets embarrassed. Nusst fires radiant bolts and can be pulled apart without lasting harm.

feats.scene: Nusst fires a glowing bolt that cracks a bus in half.
Nusst loses his head to a furious blow yet snaps back whole.

name: Ceslenial
summary: Ceslenial is an alien soldier who lives inside a human host and leads a secret government squad to atone for the host's crimes. Ceslenial carries the guilt of stolen memories.

feats.scene: Ceslenial fires a service pistol that drops a runner mid-sprint.
Ceslenial endures a rough tackle from two guards.

name: Aunvi
summary: Aunvi is a polished young regent of a hidden mountain kingdom who smiles for crowds while building armies. Aunvi dreams of conquest and cloaks it as progress.

feats.scene: Aunvi slaps a courtier with a gloved hand to quell a whisper.
Aunvi tumbles from a balcony railing and rolls to safety.

name: Aniirn
summary: Aniirn is a blonde stage performer who dresses as a beloved old costume figure at fan gatherings. Aniirn befriends a team of metal heroes and plays her part with enthusiasm.

feats.scene: Aniirn shoves a prop door open on stage with a grunt.
Aniirn trips over a cable and gets up laughing.

name: Corliu
summary: Corliu is a young shapeshifter whose radiant childhood left him able to take any animal form. Corliu leads a band of five and chafes under the rules of a rival council.

feats.scene: Corliu becomes a charging bull and flattens a wooden barricade.
Corliu falls from a cliff as a hawk and lands as a boy.

name: Colause
summary: Colause is a shadowy rogue with no real name who hounds a masked heroine until she beats him. Colause is little more than a footnote to the story of a defeated crook.

feats.scene: Colause swings a crowbar at a lock and snaps the hasp.
Colause takes a boot to the stomach and wheezes.

name: Ansanne
summary: Ansanne is a white-haired inventor-crook who fades from sight to rob victims and runs electrical rigs in his hideout. Ansanne is defeated once and vanishes from record.

feats.scene: Ansanne triggers a wired coil that shocks a doorknob live.
Ansanne takes a thrown chair and flickers back into view.

name: Navalau
summary: Navalau is a white-bearded lord of a glass world who throws countless reflections at intruders. Navalau kidnaps a hero to test his reflection army and is undone by shaking his own domain.

feats.scene: Navalau sends a horde of reflected selves crashing at a visitor.
Navalau is shaken as his glass palace splinters around him.

name: Anniunan
summary: Anniunan is an imagined childhood friend who resurfaces to scold the man who forgot him. Anniunan is spry and surprisingly strong for a figment.

feats.scene: Anniunan shoves a pew across the floor to block a door.
Anniunan shrugs off a hard shove down a flight of steps.

source_title: Imaginary Jesus Christ (Doom Patrol TV Series)

name: Luvaiu
summary: Luvaiu is a bald armored volunteer granted odd abilities by a corporate program and tries to protect a city. Luvaiu joins a doomed battle against a floating robot.

feats.scene: Luvaiu rams a shoulder into a fighting machine and dents its plating.
Luvaiu is blasted by a stray beam and crashes through a shopfront.

name: Cinnu
summary: Cinnu is a dark-eyed rover whose body mends from nearly any harm and whose touch revives the freshly fallen. Cinnu ages slowly thanks to a gene that feeds on a hidden agent.

feats.scene: Cinnu sends a pulse through a fallen comrade and sparks the heart back to life.
Cinnu regrows a burned arm over a single night.

name: Iarrosirn
summary: Iarrosirn is a red-haired fallen angel who slips between the high realm and the mortal one with ease. Iarrosirn can heal, fly, cast forbidden rites and cannot die in any ordinary way.

feats.scene: Iarrosirn spreads golden wings and a shockwave shatters every window on a street.
Iarrosirn stands still as a speeding truck folds against her chest.

name: Ntoleo
summary: Ntoleo is a captive warrior who soaks any blow and hurls it back tenfold. Ntoleo fights in a forced arena and later helps hold a quiet moon post for freedom fighters.

feats.scene: Ntoleo returns a rival's strike amplified tenfold and cracks the cage floor.
Ntoleo drinks in a thrown spear's force without a bruise.

name: Miastores
summary: Miastores is a petty crook who vanishes from view to work for a crime boss. Miastores ends up in a city prison and is remembered only for the trick.

feats.scene: Miastores lifts a wallet and a watch from a stranger without being seen.
Miastores takes a truncheon to the knee and limps away.

name: Llsor
summary: Llsor is a cosmic destroyer known only through a fragment of its armor that a young hero keeps close. Llsor lingers as a looming legend rather than a present threat.

feats.scene: Llsor's armor shard flares and levels a city block when struck by a hammer.

name: Seosti
summary: Seosti is an embodiment of entropy who ends worlds so that a better one can be born from the ashes. Seosti rolls through whole star systems, razes planets one by one, and heads for the pivot of creation.

feats.scene: Seosti pulls a whole galaxy apart in a single sweeping wave.
Seosti rides out the burst of a dying planet and keeps advancing.

name: Telviter
summary: Telviter is a bald operative with a gift for speed, sent ahead to scout a secret base. Telviter is burned down by a fire trap and later resurrected as a mindless copy.

feats.scene: Telviter dashes down a long corridor and back before the others reach the door.
Telviter is caught in a firebomb that burns him to ash.

name: Telanll
summary: Telanll is a glimmering energy being born of random thoughts of racers in a cosmic current. Telanll joins a far-future squad and moves with a cheerful, scattered grace.

feats.scene: Telanll flickers around a moon and back in a blink.
Telanll bursts through a hull plate in a streak of sparkles.

name: Erora
summary: Erora is a blonde telepath from a ringed world who leads a youthful team with a calm voice. Erora forms mind-links, casts illusions, and lashes out with a psychic blast when pressed.

feats.scene: Erora unleashes a psychic burst that drops a charging guard flat.
Erora is shaken by a thrown crate but stays upright.

name: Auorar
summary: Auorar is a young telepath who watches a far-off conflict from her headquarters tower. Auorar reads minds with ease and guides her teammates through a battle from afar.

feats.scene: Auorar slips a command into a guard's mind and he drops his weapon.
Auorar is jolted by a feedback burst and stays calm.

name: Ronron
summary: Ronron is a pink-eyed telepath who links the thoughts of a whole squad for private talk. Ronron wears a small ring that lets her fly and is hinted to be fond of a lightning-wielder.

feats.scene: Ronron projects a flash of thought and a rival stumbles back.
Ronron is knocked into a console and shakes off the sparks.

source_title: Imra Ardeen (Legion of Super-Heroes TV Series)

name: Orire
summary: Orire is a younger copy of a veteran telepath, born of a time paradox and living in a team headquarters. Orire reads thoughts and rides a ring-lifted breeze as she trains.

feats.scene: Orire pushes a suggestion into a scout's mind and he walks out.
Orire is flung off her feet by a shock-pulse and rises smiling.

name: Oracoli
summary: Oracoli is a yellow-eyed demon who usurps a dimension's rulers by wearing human bodies like coats. Oracoli bends elements and reality yet dies when his host is shot.

feats.scene: Oracoli twists the air and a hall of pillars falls in on itself.
Oracoli's borrowed body takes a bullet and his power flickers.

name: Cinliin
summary: Cinliin is a tattooed leader of a mystic tribe that wields a light of compassion through a coral staff. Cinliin blinks entire parties across the stars and speaks a tongue even translators cannot read.

feats.scene: Cinliin channels light through her staff and vaporises a horde of risen corpses.
Cinliin stands fast as a cosmic shockwave washes over her.

name: Tonlole
summary: Tonlole is a red-haired schoolboy racer who boasts he can circle the globe five times. Tonlole bumps into friends and ruins a lemonade stand in his hurry.

feats.scene: Tonlole loops the globe in a streak and trips a friend at the finish.
Tonlole skids through a stand and scatters cups across the lawn.

name: Isorau
summary: Isorau is a yellow-eyed brute who generates and shapes lava as he soars over a battlefield. Isorau is burned out in a single clash with a team of mystic heroes.

feats.scene: Isorau rains molten rock on a village square and ignites every roof.
Isorau shrugs off a barrage of stone fragments.

name: Tiuar
summary: Tiuar is a green-skinned blonde wanderer from a hot world who punches with a charge of raw energy. Tiuar hides in the thirty-first century with a roaming crew.

feats.scene: Tiuar slams a glowing fist into a cargo crate and splits it in two.
Tiuar is thrown through a hull door and rises scorched.

name: Telsto
summary: Telsto is a hairless soldier from a fire-pit world who serves a tyrant and carries the strength of an old divinity. Telsto flies, burns and holds his own against a famed warrior.

feats.scene: Telsto hurls a sheet of flame that gutted a city tower.
Telsto is hit by a pounding blow and lands upright in a crater.

name: Vaanria
summary: Vaanria is a new agent of a covert team who can pass through walls and slip into minds. Vaanria blames a curse for her telepathy and prefers to stay out of sight.

feats.scene: Vaanria phases her hand through a lockbox and pulls out the key.
Vaanria goes intangible and lets a thrown knife pass.

name: Semonin
summary: Semonin is a purple-skinned super-clone stitched together from every weapon his maker ever grew. Semonin is fast, strong, shielded and able to vanish, but short-lived.

feats.scene: Semonin drives a fist through a transport hull in a burst of speed.
Semonin stands unscathed as a missile detonates against his shield.

name: Lancor
summary: Lancor is the joined form of several young demigods, a towering figure who needs a shared box to appear. Lancor fires blasts and wades through a fight, but weakens if his parts do not commit.

feats.scene: Lancor fires a lance of light that cuts a mountain to the roots.
Lancor takes a fusion blast on the chest and stays upright.

name: Iaosor
summary: Iaosor is a warm-hearted physician who brought care back to a grim ward and married its director. Iaosor goes into labour in the middle of a riot and is helped by unlikely hands.

feats.scene: Iaosor pushes a gurney through a swinging door.
Iaosor is jostled in a crowded corridor and grips the rail.

name: Narneam
summary: Narneam is a grim, engineered soldier from a defeated regime who ages slowly and hits very hard. Narneam is nearly unhurt when a famed hero strikes back.

feats.scene: Narneam backhands a jeep and rolls it onto its side.
Narneam shrugs off a hero's fist that nearly breaks his hand.

name: Unanva
summary: Unanva is a cartoon man who knows he is drawn and tears out of his panels to rewrite events. Unanva carries only a pen and paper yet bends the page around him.

feats.scene: Unanva redraws a locked door as an open window and hops through.
Unanva erases a falling anvil and sketches a feather in its place.

name: Oluis
summary: Oluis is a hidden pest-handler in a big city, remembered mostly for a single failed scheme. Oluis commands swarms and is quickly put away.

feats.scene: Oluis tosses a hive at a policeman and ducks away.
Oluis takes a punch and goes down.

name: Storineo
summary: Storineo is a green-eyed alien queen with a fearsome appetite for living prey. Storineo rules a hive and stalks people she means to devour.

feats.scene: Storineo rips a steel door off a bunker and drags a guard out.
Storineo is hit by a car and walks out of the wreck.

name: Esiauser
summary: Esiauser is a red-haired alien queen who bargains with a tycoon and wants to grow drones from foreign blood. Esiauser mimics a woman's shape, takes over minds and is trapped in amber.

feats.scene: Esiauser rips a hangar door from its rails and flings it at a rescuer.
Esiauser is battered into a wall and shakes off the rubble.

name: Miriase
summary: Miriase is a sharp-eyed detective at a famed police yard in the thirties. Miriase twice crosses paths with a masked thief and breaks a plot of forged faces.

feats.scene: Miriase tackles a runner at the head of an alley.
Miriase is struck by a cosh and keeps the suspect pinned.

name: Sanviton
summary: Sanviton is a brain-collecting alien researcher who rides a floating disc and carries a ray that enlarges things. Sanviton hypnotises victims to steal their minds and hides in a ship.

feats.scene: Sanviton fires an enlarging beam that swells a cat to the size of a van.
Sanviton is jolted off his disc and lands hard on the deck.

name: Seoela
summary: Seoela is a pink-haired anarchist who hijacks networks to blind the powerful and feed her cell. Seoela scrambles scanners, takes over machines and watches her allies blow up a landmark.

feats.scene: Seoela jams a power grid and triggers a blackout across a district.
Seoela dives behind a desk as a flash grenade goes off.

name: Riaisrni
summary: Riaisrni is a white-haired maker of machines who builds gadgets for crimes in a dark city. Riaisrni invents an electromagnetic tracker and is caught by three allies.

feats.scene: Riaisrni clamps a magnet to a belt and watches the screen light up.
Riaisrni is knocked down by a punch and cuffed.

name: Irnnte
summary: Irnnte is a hairless prisoner known for turning things inside out, who wears a strange helmet. Irnnte sits in a frozen penitentiary and is rarely seen.

feats.scene: Irnnte flips a padlock inside out and it falls open.
Irnnte is shoved against a cell wall and slides down.

name: Ereson
summary: Ereson is a radiant sky-shepherd who folds a pocket dimension out of the ashes of a drowned star cluster and rules it as a stern, beloved deity. Its worshippers pray daily, unaware how much of their devotion is engineered.

feats.scene: Ereson tears a seam between two folded realms and floods one with sunfire to scatter an invading swarm.
Ereson stands unmoved in the heart of a collapsing cathedral-sphere while its vaulted ribs burn away around him.

name: Oraco
summary: Oraco is a stitched-lip horror conjured by cartel sorcerers to guard a crumbling mission. It lumbers on all fours, tireless and nearly impossible to hurt, and it obeys only the hand that fed it.

feats.scene: Oraco hurls a parked truck across a courtyard hard enough to crush the cab against a stone wall.
Oraco shrugs off a point-blank shotgun volley and keeps crawling toward its target.

name: Nasunser
summary: Nasunser is a retired scholar who once wore a golden mask that lent her a god's borrowed sorcery. She still hums with leftover power, and old foes remember how swiftly she could cross a battlefield.

feats.scene: Nasunser rips a rolling siege engine off its axles with a pulse of golden force and drops it in a field.
Nasunser weathers a falling balcony beneath a shimmering ward woven from nothing but will.

name: Amoamar
summary: Nasunser's quieter twin, Amoamar is a widow who spent years visiting a husband in a quiet ward. She is gentle, stubborn and entirely ordinary, with a store of patience that outlasts every visiting hour.

feats.scene: Amoamar slaps a corridor orderly hard enough to turn his head when he tries to bar her way.
Amoamar takes a hard fall down a flight of stairs and rises to keep walking.

name: Auoll
summary: Auoll is a seaside smith who hammers blades by day and trains with spear and shield at dusk. She admires her sovereign openly and defends her at the first drumbeat of war.

feats.scene: Auoll drives a quenching hammer through a bronze breastplate laid on the anvil.
Auoll takes a thrown boulder on her shield and stays upright, teeth gritted.

name: Annaori
summary: Annaori forges spear tips and armour for a clan of island warriors, and fights better than most of them. Once she endured a flurry of blows delivered faster than the eye could follow, and swore she could not take it twice.

feats.scene: Annaori swings a forge hammer to crack a stone anvil in two.
Annaori absorbs a rapid storm of fists without a single bone giving way, though it leaves her swaying.

name: Rasannau
summary: Rasannau is a one-eyed armourer who guards a mountain gate and hammers axes in her free hours. Calm, dry and proud of her craft, she trusts a heavy double-bladed axe above any charm.

feats.scene: Rasannau cleaves a seasoned oak log in one overhead swing of her axe.
Rasannau holds the gate against a charging boar until the horn sounds relief.

name: Siaamso
summary: Siaamso is a pink-skinned regent who inherited a ring of condensed resolve and a lantern to recharge it. She sculpts glowing shields and blades from raw will and patrols her home sector as its guardian.

feats.scene: Siaamso shapes a glowing lance as long as a freighter and drives it through a rogue asteroid.
Siaamso braces behind a bubble of light while a collapsing space station falls onto it.

name: Esllo
summary: Esllo is a purple-skinned queen who doubted her own leadership until a ring chose her. Now she rules by example, building towering constructs of light to shelter her subjects.

feats.scene: Esllo conjures a luminous fist the size of a tower and slams it through an armoured gunship.
Esllo hovers inside her shield as a barrage of siege fire bursts against it without a crack.

name: Stirennin
summary: Stirennin is a brown-skinned rookie in a training academy, eager and slightly awed by a gruff drill sergeant. Her ring answers sharply but she is still learning how hard to push it.

feats.scene: Stirennin fires a ragged beam that melts a practice drone into slag.
Stirennin raises a wobbling shield and holds it against a lashing training turret.

name: Ressir
summary: Ressir is a white-haired mentor who coaxes young recruits through the mental discipline of ring-craft. She patiently teaches construct shaping and quietly takes the worst of any lesson that goes wrong.

feats.scene: Ressir sculpts a shimmering bridge across a canyon and shoves a stampeding herd off its path with a gust of light.
Ressir shields a trainee from a rolling avalanche with a dome of solid radiance.

name: Lloont
summary: Lloont is a drifting spirit of pure resolve that can live inside a battery or ride a willing host. Free of any ring, it pours out emerald force and mends itself from nearly any wound.

feats.scene: Lloont pours its glow into a single shockwave that cracks a rocky world's crust from pole to pole.
Lloont stays whole while a drifting star-forge detonates around its host.

name: Orerllu
summary: Orerllu is a blue-skinned wanderer who carried a pocket battery instead of a ring. Mortally wounded in a street crash, he passes the device on to a stranger with a few clipped words.

feats.scene: Orerllu shapes a sheet of glowing force to stop a runaway truck before it reaches a crowd.
Orerllu is thrown from his seat by a speeding cycle and cannot rise again.

name: Seniti
summary: Seniti is a sea-dwelling king with a sharp tongue and a proud trident arm. He marches into a ruined harbour to protect the people he thinks of as lesser, and loses a duel with grace.

feats.scene: Seniti drives his trident through a ship's oak hull in a single thrust.
Seniti takes a shark's full bite on his armoured forearm and keeps advancing.

name: Inulasle
summary: Inulasle is a bald, green-eyed brute assigned to flank a masked tyrant's trio of enforcers. He hurls bolts of crackling heat from his palms and sneers at anything that survives them.

feats.scene: Inulasle blasts a concrete wall into rubble with a flash from both hands.
Inulasle shrugs off a fusillade of slugs fired from a dozen rifles.

name: Tilam
summary: Tilam is a nervous therapist-turned-crook who wears a humming suit that mesmerises anyone who looks into its lenses. Take the suit away and he is just a smug man with a whisper.

feats.scene: Tilam shoves a rival and sends him stumbling into a rack of chairs.
Tilam rolls down a gutter after a mugging and limps away with only bruises.

name: Cinaurn
summary: Cinaurn is a wiry crook who stumbles into a glowing fragment that makes him brilliant in daylight and dull in shadow. He builds absurd machines to commit elaborate robberies.

feats.scene: Cinaurn detonates a homemade rocket sled to blow open a vault door.
Cinaurn tumbles out of a collapsing crane cab and walks away dazed.

name: Cortilu
summary: Cortilu is an absent-minded old professor who earned prizes he can no longer find. He raised a foundling as his favourite and spent decades afraid of the day she would learn the truth.

feats.scene: Cortilu knocks a heavy book from a shelf onto a lab table while hunting for his glasses.
Cortilu tumbles off a wooden stepladder and laughs it off.

name: Enuterco
summary: Enuterco is a stretchy alloy automaton built by a mad inventor to serve as a sister to a team of metallic misfits. She reshapes her body freely and obeys a small control device.

feats.scene: Enuterco stretches an arm across a warehouse and slams a crate stack through a wall.
Enuterco is flattened by a falling girder and reforms into her shape without a scratch.

name: Illllasor
summary: Illllasor is a ruthless war-chief who seizes a hostile empire through a bloody coup and pilots a captured god-weapon in a bid to rule every neighbouring cosmos.

feats.scene: Illllasor fires the beast's mouth cannon to level the skyline of a harbour metropolis.
Illllasor survives the destruction of his vessel by ejecting through a burning hatch.

name: Veoneta
summary: Veoneta is a glassy double born in a looking-glass realm and sent out to imitate a reporter. She cheerfully swaps friends with their reflections and fears nothing but a shattered surface.

feats.scene: Veoneta pushes a bystander through a mirror and steps out wearing his coat.
Veoneta smashes through a shop window and brushes glass from her sleeves.

name: Lancocol
summary: Lancocol is a magazine photographer trapped in a nightmare city ruled by a bat-faced tyrant. She hides in stairwells, keeping her camera dry and her family in mind.

feats.scene: Lancocol swings a camera strap to knock a lantern from a thug's hand.
Lancocol is flung against a fire escape and still carries the film to safety.

name: Niustuias
summary: Niustuias is a reporter in a rewritten timeline where she marries a stranger and raises a daughter. She never knows what was lost, only that she misses someone she cannot name.

feats.scene: Niustuias throws a plate in a kitchen quarrel and cracks it against the doorframe.
Niustuias tumbles from a bicycle on a cobbled hill and laughs off the scrapes.

name: Rnitiir
summary: Rnitiir is a seated chronicler who lost her mobility in a roadside wreck that also took a child from the family. Decades later she argues against a time traveller's plan to unpick the tragedy.

feats.scene: Rnitiir pounds her wheelchair armrest to force a wandering visitor to listen.
Rnitiir survives a head-on collision that crumples the car around her.

name: Iarneltan
summary: Iarneltan is a courier who wakes one dawn threaded with a humming current that lets her outpace trains. She runs headlines across the city before the ink dries.

feats.scene: Iarneltan punches through a brick wall at full sprint and keeps going.
Iarneltan streaks across a salt flat so fast the dust rises in a wall behind her.

name: Rensau
summary: Rensau is a copper-haired runner conjured by a scheming ancient to keep a visiting boy from going home. Her speed is genuine, but her loyalty melts when the trick is exposed.

feats.scene: Rensau dashes through a line of training dummies and leaves them in splinters.
Rensau races a wind-whipped storm front across a plain and wins by a mile.

name: Corival
summary: Corival is a red-haired girl whose metabolism races as she grows, so she ages in leaps and sprints rather than steps. She challenges her father to every footrace and often wins.

feats.scene: Corival whirls through a junkyard and pulverises a rusted crane arm with one hit.
Corival laps a mountain ridge in the time it takes a bell to toll once.

name: Stoan
summary: Stoan is a teen throwback whose eyes turn flesh into temporary stone. He hides behind tinted lenses at all times and dreads even a single stray glance.

feats.scene: Stoan lowers his lenses for a heartbeat and turns a charging mastiff into a statue.
Stoan falls from a school stairwell and shakes the dust from his hair.

name: Auresa
summary: Auresa is a laboratory engineer whose rare knowledge could revive a continent's ruined machines. She is kidnapped for her skill, and mistaken by her rescuer for someone he lost.

feats.scene: Auresa swings a clipboard to knock a kidnapper's flashlight loose.
Auresa tumbles from a speeding van and limps off with scrapes.

name: Serarlen
summary: Serarlen is a retired widow with silver hair who lives next door to a polite newspaperman. She lectures him about overwork and bakes for the whole block, though her legs tire easily.

feats.scene: Serarlen taps her cane sharply on a stoop to scold a loitering cat.
Serarlen slips on wet steps and still gets up with only a bruise.

name: Tiunist
summary: Tiunist is a small-town assistant who absorbs rare radiation from the soil and becomes a host to an alien mind. She enforces the will of a warlord with superhuman might.

feats.scene: Tiunist lifts a grain silo and hurls it across a field into a barn.
Tiunist stands unharmed as a rail-gun round flattens against her ribs.

name: Illno
summary: Illno is a molten-grey automaton built to be the muscle of a team of metallic siblings. He bends into any shape but wilts when moisture rusts his joints.

feats.scene: Illno drives his fist through a steel bulkhead in a single punch.
Illno takes a wrecking-ball swing to the chest and reforms before the dust settles.

name: Illserres
summary: Illserres is a cartoonish metal hero with a rubbery grin and a springy frame. He bounces through slapstick fights, flexing a pair of heavy arms that never tire.

feats.scene: Illserres swings a girder like a bat and smashes a parked truck flat.
Illserres bounces back from a flattening steamroller without a dent.

name: Racice
summary: Racice is a winged, hammered-steel guardian built by a mad tinkerer for a squad of automated defenders. Twisted by outside darkness, he must be fought by his own friends.

feats.scene: Racice dives from the clouds and drives his fists through a dam wall.
Racice endures his own world collapsing around him with his armour barely scorched.

name: Insau
summary: Insau is a hulking hired fist with a cruel cause and a thick neck. He leans on raw strength to intimidate, and meets a swift end when his employer's rival loses patience.

feats.scene: Insau punches a parked motorcycle across a parking lot.
Insau takes a baton to the jaw and shakes it off with a grunt.

name: Milanso
summary: Milanso is a mercenary with a cybernetic arm that spits streaks of heat. He takes over an offshore platform and wires it to blow when his terms are refused.

feats.scene: Milanso cuts a hole through a steel door with a bright stream from his forearm.
Milanso is caught in the blast of the platform he rigged and does not survive it.

name: Coramtil
summary: Coramtil is a silver-skinned automaton who bends and flows into any form. She is built tough and trusts chemistry, but dislikes damp weather that can corrode her limbs.

feats.scene: Coramtil stretches a fist and punches a tank turret off its ring.
Coramtil is struck by a falling bridge span and pulls herself together in seconds.

name: Torlimi
summary: Torlimi is a masked old soldier who resurfaces decades after a lost war to menace a squad of flyers. His weapon of choice is a heavy mallet, and his grudge is older than his knees.

feats.scene: Torlimi swings a mallet and caves in a wooden crate.
Torlimi tumbles from a hangar ledge and grips the rail with one hand.

name: Sorral
summary: Sorral is a loyal timber wolf who guards a young girl after her village falls to sickness. He later rescues a lonely gunman from certain death and pays for it with his life.

feats.scene: Sorral lunges and clamps a bandit's wrist hard enough to drop his pistol.
Sorral endures a venomous strike and still finishes the fight on his feet.

name: Iuamce
summary: Iuamce is a freckled, red-haired hired blade known for her cold smile. She falls for a rival agent and bears a child, but never loses her taste for contract work.

feats.scene: Iuamce flips a knife into a target from across a warehouse.
Iuamce leaps from a moving train and rolls clear without a limp.

name: Llone
summary: Llone is a stern officer who lost a hand saving a friend from a frozen river and replaced it with a hard prosthesis. He runs a fortress prison with a rigid code and meets an unlikely nemesis there.

feats.scene: Llone swings his hard prosthesis and shatters a wooden chair.
Llone clings to an icy ledge in a winter river without letting go.

name: Eonvenor
summary: Eonvenor is a bald, scarred mercenary hired by shadowy patrons to break up a rival's operation. He is armoured, blunt and rarely says more than he must.

feats.scene: Eonvenor rams a shoulder through a flimsy warehouse door.
Eonvenor takes a rifle-butt to the helmet and keeps walking.

name: Vavar
summary: Vavar is a violet-haired former killer who is reshaped by a ring of compassion into the first guide of a peaceful order. She speaks softly and wields a long ceremonial staff.

feats.scene: Vavar traces a glowing arc that cuts a rogue cruiser in two.
Vavar stands calm inside a violet shell as debris rains down.

name: Anuaures
summary: Anuaures is a violet-eyed elder who tries to talk a hardened soldier out of despair. Her ring lets her blink across a battlefield, but it cannot protect her from a sudden blade.

feats.scene: Anuaures hurls a violet spear that pierces a hovering gunship.
Anuaures is stabbed and cannot rise again.

name: Rnieo
summary: Rnieo is a mild chemist who is overcome by fumes from a fallen rock and wakes as a costumed menace. His gadget-laden suits mimic distant worlds, but he forgets everything when the gas fades.

feats.scene: Rnieo fires a heated suit cannon that burns through a lab door.
Rnieo tumbles down a stairwell inside his suit and keeps muttering formulas.

name: Nilislo
summary: Nilislo is a frail professor who touches a strange space rock and bursts into a mountain of muscle. He rampages in hopes of revenge until a stretchy hero outwits him.

feats.scene: Nilislo uproots a street lamp and swings it through the front of a bank.
Nilislo takes a falling billboard on his back and bats it aside.

name: Asianlan
summary: Asianlan is a fourth-wall-aware field reporter who blinks anywhere he can see, though the exit is always loud and a bit off target. Little can hurt him, and he enjoys that fact too much.

feats.scene: Asianlan teleports behind a charging brute and punches him hard enough to knock down a wall.
Asianlan is slammed into the pavement and leaves only a small dent in the ground.

name: Seotenil
summary: Seotenil is a red-eyed, bald sprite who blinks into any scene to warn a hero that the audience is drifting away. He volunteers to be punched repeatedly to keep ratings up.

feats.scene: Seotenil jabs a cape-wearing fighter in the arm to get his attention.
Seotenil takes a fist to the face over and over and bounces back with a grin.

source_title: Irwin Schwab (The Brave and the Bold)

name: Rnconen
summary: Rnconen is a vain, gaslight-era criminal who plays a trick violin to lull victims. He appears at a public rally and slips away when the crowd turns violent.

feats.scene: Rnconen slaps a guard with the flat of his bow.
Rnconen is knocked over in the stampede and wriggles out through a side door.

name: Liunt
summary: Liunt is a white-haired former criminal who plays a humming violin that rattles bones and numbs minds. He retires to a sunny town and loses a game of cards with deadly consequences.

feats.scene: Liunt draws one sour note that shatters every window on a street.
Liunt stands up after being thrown into a card table and straightens his coat.

name: Ranseti
summary: Ranseti is a gentle exile from a dead red world who guides younger heroes and hides among ordinary people. Ranseti's body obeys the mind, shaping and unshaping itself at will, but open flame makes that control slip away.

feats.scene: Ranseti held a collapsing bridge span together with a single sustained thought until the traffic cleared.
Ranseti stood unharmed inside a blast that levelled the plaza around the spot.

name: Serian
summary: Serian is a cheerful patrol officer in a cartoon world of big-headed heroes. Serian naps by sitting upright in a trance and bolts from anything hot, a habit the local bullies have learned to exploit.

feats.scene: Serian flung a lamppost across a schoolyard to stop a runaway ice cream truck.
Serian shrugged off being flattened by a falling billboard and popped back up smiling.

name: Tumeo
summary: Tumeo is a politician who came home from a long voyage subtly wrong, a copy grown by something patient. Tumeo gives warm speeches about trust while quietly arranging for the world's defences to fail.

feats.scene: Tumeo shoved a guard through a glass door without changing expression.
Tumeo walked away from a limousine rollover with a pressed collar and a smile.

name: Telllonum
summary: Telllonum is a loud, wealthy socialite who treats every garden party as a contest. Telllonum plays squash with alarming force and loses real estate to disasters without ever losing good cheer.

feats.scene: Telllonum drove a squash ball clean through a plasterboard wall.
Telllonum tumbled down a marble staircase at a charity gala and demanded another drink.

name: Niuleore
summary: Niuleore is a secretive spymaster who collects other people's secrets the way some collect stamps. Niuleore built a masked-hero programme as a leash, and learned that leverage works only until someone stops fearing exposure.

feats.scene: Niuleore slammed a heavy desk drawer on an intruder's hand and held it there.
Niuleore took a thrown paperweight to the ribs and kept dictating the memo.

name: Rnleses
summary: Rnleses is a steel soldier built in a secret wartime lab, a stiff-jointed machine with photocell eyes and a heavy arsenal. Rnleses fights alongside one human partner in jungle campaigns and was built to be expendable.

feats.scene: Rnleses fired a rocket salvo that flattened a fortified timber bunker.
Rnleses stood in the path of a shell burst that wrecked the trench around it.

name: Mintna
summary: Mintna is a replacement battle automaton delivered by air crate and assembled by confused soldiers. Mintna powers on late, then rips off its own head and swings it on a cable like a flail.

feats.scene: Mintna whirled its detached head around and smashed a rival war machine into scrap.
Mintna took a point-blank cannon round to the chest and kept advancing.

name: Renllrnu
summary: Renllrnu is a bitter weather forecaster who found a way to take the sky's temper for his own. Renllrnu calls down lightning and gales on coastal towns that once mocked his predictions.

feats.scene: Renllrnu raised a squall that tore the roofs off an entire harbour district.
Renllrnu was struck by his own lightning and merely smoked at the edges.

name: Ialrest
summary: Ialrest is a young heir to a vast fortune who swells into a tall, shaggy beast when angry. Ialrest speaks several tongues, which makes the transformation more startling to bystanders.

feats.scene: Ialrest hurled a parked delivery van over a fence in a fit of rage.
Ialrest took a head-on collision with a bus and shook it off like rain.

name: Llval
summary: Llval is a blue-skinned, short-tempered cop from a world where sorcery replaced science. Llval once hunted dragons for coin, and now carries old shame and a crushing grip into every precinct brawl.

feats.scene: Llval drove a bare fist through the armoured flank of a charging troll.
Llval stood in a dragon's fire for a full breath and walked out swearing.

name: Iacena
summary: Iacena is a silent household servant used as a blade by a sinister doctor. Iacena stalks the targets of blackmail and has no plan for the day a better-trained opponent shows up.

feats.scene: Iacena drove a knife through a heavy oak door at a closing distance.
Iacena took a rope across the jaw and dropped like a sack of grain.

name: Elaco
summary: Elaco is the estranged son of a rich family who takes up a stolen mantle in a police-state future. Elaco fights in a heavy suit, trading polish for blunt force and stubbornness.

feats.scene: Elaco kicked in a reinforced checkpoint gate and kept running.
Elaco fell from a rooftop onto a patrol car and stood up swinging.

name: Ntuniu
summary: Ntuniu is a lab technician whose grief curdled into a campaign of revenge. Ntuniu wears a winged rig built from stolen parts that lets him glide above the rooftops and strike.

feats.scene: Ntuniu hurled a pressurised canister that burst a van's side open.
Ntuniu crashed through a skylight and rolled to his feet without a limp.

name: Intasco
summary: Intasco is a runaway teenager who stole from the wrong house and found a better road than petty crime. Intasco looks after a younger brother and has learned to talk faster than anyone can chase.

feats.scene: Intasco threw a shoulder into a locked storeroom door and burst it open.
Intasco took a tumble down a fire escape and kept sprinting.

name: Rniaril
summary: Rniaril is a boarding-school athlete who refuses to throw a match for a bribe. Rniaril wins on stubborn lungs and clean form, and shrugs off the stranger who tries to stop him on the slopes.

feats.scene: Rniaril hurled a football the length of the pitch into a tyre swing.
Rniaril crashed down a ski jump landing and walked off the snow.

name: Neniu
summary: Neniu is a clever boy who despises costumed heroes and decides to become the opposite of one. Neniu plans elaborate crimes from a tiny whirling flyer, and nobody takes the scheming seriously.

feats.scene: Neniu dropped a spring-loaded net from his flyer that tore a lamppost down.
Neniu bounced off a hedge after his flyer crash-landed in a park.

name: Estelel
summary: Estelel is a hired animal handler who bought the name and gear of a more famous predecessor. Estelel runs guard dogs for criminal bosses and dies the way hired help usually does, fed to something worse.

feats.scene: Estelel hauled a snarling mastiff off a fence by the scruff in one pull.
Estelel took a mauling from a lizard-beast and still crawled for the exit.

name: Eorrni
summary: Eorrni is a fourteen-year-old boy chasing the truth of his parentage across a hard city. Eorrni reads old letters, makes a guess too large for his age, and meets someone who has no mercy.

feats.scene: Eorrni threw a satchel at a gate latch and knocked it open.
Eorrni scrambled over a wall and landed hard on a pile of crates.

name: Ville
summary: Ville is a flashy thief who steals gems and leaves a playing card on the empty shelf. Ville works for a laughing crime lord and trusts a pistol and a quick exit more than any plan.

feats.scene: Ville smashed a display case with a pistol butt and pocketed the stones.
Ville took a blow from a rolling pin and still vaulted a counter.

name: Amito
summary: Amito is a rumpled detective who moves from one scene to another only to wait around for witnesses. Amito shares cases with a spouse and a badge, and wins by outlasting people rather than outfighting them.

feats.scene: Amito shouldered a warehouse door off its hinges to reach a hostage.
Amito took a fist to the jaw and kept taking notes.

name: Tirtarau
summary: Tirtarau is a pale, blunt henchman with frost on his breath and no filter on his mouth. Tirtarau tells a gunman something true and unwelcome, and does not survive the conversation.

feats.scene: Tirtarau breathed a freezing cloud that glazed a whole loading dock in rime.
Tirtarau took a wild punch from a rival thug and only blinked.

name: Valiarar
summary: Valiarar is the weary commander of a flying fortress built to watch for alien danger. Valiarar carries an odd body, and gives the last order of a crew trapped aboard a ship that turns on itself.

feats.scene: Valiarar redirected a deck turret volley into a hull breach to seal it with molten slag.
Valiarar held a corridor door shut against a blast of venting plasma.

name: Erloau
summary: Erloau is a homeless survivor rebuilt by a secret agency to thrive in smog and rubble. Erloau steps between places in a blink and grows sick the moment the streets empty out.

feats.scene: Erloau stepped out of nowhere into a gang's circle and broke it with one swing.
Erloau took a tumble through a collapsing tenement stairwell and walked out.

name: Iumtiva
summary: Iumtiva is a gambler whose face went soft as clay after an untested drug. Iumtiva molds it into other people's features, and is outplayed by a partner who plants the fingerprints.

feats.scene: Iumtiva swung a heavy ashtray at a guard in a casino hall and dropped him.
Iumtiva survived a booby-trapped pistol that blew back at close range.

name: Nteori
summary: Nteori is a quiet attorney from a family of daredevils who prefers contracts to cockpits. Nteori argues cases in a small coastal town and never learned to throw a punch.

feats.scene: Nteori slammed a thick case file on a table hard enough to crack its leg.
Nteori stumbled down courthouse steps and picked up his briefcase.

name: Eonancin
summary: Eonancin is a retired adventurer who once wielded a humming staff that bent the sky. Eonancin handed the staff to an eager successor and now sits on a porch, remembering how bright the beams used to get.

feats.scene: Eonancin swept the staff in an arc and carved a trench through a ridge of stone.
Eonancin stood in a crossfire of rifle volleys behind a shield of humming light.

name: Raltorres
summary: Raltorres is a white-haired private eye who was once a legend's partner and now fights a conspiracy alone. Raltorres relies on stubbornness and hand grenades, and has the burn scars to prove both.

feats.scene: Raltorres lobbed grenades into a flower shop and collapsed the burning roof on a pursuer.
Raltorres crashed through a shop window after a blast and kept running.

name: Ausonsi
summary: Ausonsi is a pale-faced crime boss whose chemistry degree became an art project of poison. Ausonsi laughs at his own jokes, and plans to sell the city a cure for its own failed lives.

feats.scene: Ausonsi blew up a parade float full of canisters and scattered a gas cloud over a plaza.
Ausonsi dropped through a skylight into a vat of acid-stained water and swam out grinning.

name: Oreli
summary: Oreli is a petty criminal who steals the workshop and name of a retired toy-maker. Oreli sends life-sized puppets to rob banks, and meets a grim end from a clockwork bird.

feats.scene: Oreli sent a giant wind-up soldier through a bank vault door at full power.
Oreli took a thrown wrench on the shoulder and ducked behind a crate.

name: Niiar
summary: Niiar is a cartoon-world inventor who builds gadgets, weapons and clanking machines from scrap. Niiar suffers from a mental disorder that makes every new invention a crueller joke than the last.

feats.scene: Niiar launched a spring-loaded cannon doll that flipped a cargo truck.
Niiar took a hit from a boxing-glove contraption and sat down hard.

name: Ilcol
summary: Ilcol is a volunteer in a rich man's experiment who got a mixed bag of small powers. Ilcol tried to defend a big city, and became one casualty among many in a fight between giants.

feats.scene: Ilcol hurled a bus bench through a storefront with a burst of unsteady strength.
Ilcol took a laser blast across the chest that scorched his costume.

name: Niava
summary: Niava is a gambler's pawn who leads a gang of card-themed thieves into a museum on a bet. Niava is beaten by two heroes in the first rush, and mostly cares about the wager.

feats.scene: Niava swung a crowbar at a display case and shattered the glass.
Niava took a blow from a heroine's lasso and went down.

name: Valresern
summary: Valresern is a smooth television presenter who reads out the evening headlines with a perfect jaw. Valresern investigates scandals from a studio chair and has little taste for physical danger.

feats.scene: Valresern slapped a rolling camera away from his face.
Valresern tripped over a cable and hit a studio floor.

name: Reoto
summary: Reoto is a flashy broadcaster who pushes every story as far as it will go. Reoto jokes about time and speed, and is quicker with a quip than with a fist.

feats.scene: Reoto threw a microphone at a heckler and cracked a monitor.
Reoto fell off a podium at a rally and bounced up unhurt.

name: Serne
summary: Serne is a pun-loving reporter in a cartoon city who turns yellow-skinned and frantic when someone calls him a name. Serne bounces around a convention hall like a rubber ball.

feats.scene: Serne leapt from rafter to rafter and kicked a prop dragon off its stand.
Serne fell through a paper-mache wall and laughed.

name: Ntrnuseo
summary: Ntrnuseo is a newspaper reporter who lands one big exclusive after a crisis. Ntrnuseo spends the story mostly offstage, and is remembered only through a single quoted interview.

feats.scene: Ntrnuseo slammed a notebook on a desk to silence a loud room.
Ntrnuseo stumbled in a crowd and picked himself up.

name: Rnulesan
summary: Rnulesan is a masked night-watcher in a miniature world of insects and gadgets. Rnulesan creeps along shadowed walls, unseen by the guards, and has no name beyond a hushed alias.

feats.scene: Rnulesan kicked a rusted grate off its frame from a crouch.
Rnulesan dropped from a ledge to the pavement without a sound.

name: Veonte
summary: Veonte is a naval officer who built a one-man submarine and took the fight to an enemy coast. Veonte rams warships with a hardened bow and fights ashore with a machine gun.

feats.scene: Veonte rammed a destroyer's hull below the waterline and split it open.
Veonte rode out a depth-charge barrage inside a thick steel shell.

name: Lerrn
summary: Lerrn is a condemned prisoner given a second life by a sinister master who handed him a humming trident. Lerrn enjoys the work, and wounds a golden hero with a single thrust.

feats.scene: Lerrn drove the trident through an armoured plate and crackled it with light.
Lerrn took a heavy club to the back and kept charging.

name: Iartia
summary: Iartia is a blue-haired, trench-coated enforcer who polices the roughest sector of space with a ring and a pistol. Iartia has an outlaw's manners, bends the rules, and drives his superiors up the wall.

feats.scene: Iartia shaped a glowing wall that stopped a crashing freighter above a city.
Iartia took a railgun slug at the chest behind a ring shield and kept walking.

name: Nalstu
summary: Nalstu is a faceless killer who stalks foggy streets in a long-ago century. Nalstu moves silently and favours blades, and leaves behind a rumor that outlives the body.

feats.scene: Nalstu drove a long knife through a shutter latch in one thrust.
Nalstu fell from a low roof and rolled into an alley without a sound.

name: Rormiliu
summary: Rormiliu is a patriotic soldier at peak human fitness who fights saboteurs in a flag-coloured costume. Rormiliu is a trained athlete, a marksman and a brawler, and was frozen by a villain's globe for decades.

feats.scene: Rormiliu landed a straight punch that folded a saboteur over a rail.
Rormiliu fell two storeys through an awning and ran on.

name: Tarer
summary: Tarer is a young lieutenant who fought in a distant war under a costume and a nickname. Tarer's only trace in the present is a faded poster, but old records say he was among the best.

feats.scene: Tarer vaulted a barricade and landed a boot that cracked a rifle stock.
Tarer took a bayonet thrust on a leather harness and shoved the attacker back.

name: Vartor
summary: Vartor is a one-eyed mercenary who strikes once and vanishes. Vartor works for a shadowy cell and is remembered mostly for the patch and a single, short raid.

feats.scene: Vartor kicked open a guarded gate with a single stamp.
Vartor took a rifle butt to the head and stayed on his feet.

name: Seceoser
summary: Seceoser is a museum assistant who dons a stolen ceremonial mask and styles himself an emperor of jackals. Seceoser uses his boss as a decoy, and is undone by the keen eye of a masked detective.

feats.scene: Seceoser hurled a stone urn across a gallery to block a doorway.
Seceoser was knocked down by a thrown rope and tangled in it.

name: Reteror
summary: Reteror is a night-shift lamplighter who became warden of a rain-soaked harbor town, famous for noticing small lies. Locals trade him gossip for tea, and he repays them by solving thefts before breakfast.

feats.scene: Reteror shoulders a swollen cell door off its rusted hinges.
Reteror takes a tumbling crate across the back and keeps walking.

name: Unvalra
summary: Unvalra is a silver-haired constable of a clockwork city whose rooftop lantern calls help from far districts. Rivals describe him as stubborn, and his ledgers have outlived three corrupt mayors.

feats.scene: Unvalra swings a heavy ledger into a smuggler's jaw and ends the chase.
Unvalra stays upright after a stair collapses beneath him.

name: Linamo
summary: Linamo is a ginger-bearded sergeant who distrusts every masked helper yet quietly leaves windows unlocked for them. Neighbors say his stern speeches hide a soft heart for strays.

feats.scene: Linamo hurls a lantern across an alley to stagger a fleeing thief.
Linamo shrugs off a brawler's club blow during a market riot.

name: Asimicar
summary: Asimicar is an elderly retired chief who spins long stories over cheap whiskey for any visiting scribe. His memory for faces is sharper than his knees, and he misses nothing that happens on his street.

feats.scene: Asimicar raps a cane against a pickpocket's wrist and drops him.
Asimicar stumbles down a flight of steps and rises with only a bruise.

name: Auniacor
summary: Auniacor is a methodical chief who keeps color-coded case maps pinned across a dim office. He solves puzzles through patient questioning, and his team follows him with quiet loyalty.

feats.scene: Auniacor kicks a locked evidence cabinet until the latch snaps.
Auniacor absorbs a falling shelf of files without losing his footing.

name: Lluernia
summary: Lluernia is a weathered lawman in a dynastic city where noble houses hire private guards. He settles feuds by reading contracts aloud until both sides yawn and shake hands.

feats.scene: Lluernia drives a baton into a door and splinters its middle panel.
Lluernia is thrown against a stone pillar and simply dusts himself off.

name: Taenuau
summary: Taenuau is a stout, red-haired chief who stands by a vigilante when every colleague doubts him. He organizes raids with calm precision and has the nerve to face monsters with only a flashlight.

feats.scene: Taenuau swings a flashlight and cracks a gunman's wrist.
Taenuau is knocked down by a lurching beast and returns to his feet shouting orders.

name: Aulorrum
summary: Aulorrum was a decent chief whose life ended when a mocking clown hid a trap inside a notebook. His fall reminds everyone in a ruined timeline that kindness gets punished.

feats.scene: Aulorrum slaps a lit fuse away from a bystander in a crowded square.
Aulorrum survives a minute of burning acid before the trap finishes him.

name: Cornumll
summary: Cornumll is a gray-haired friend of a grieving family who attends a funeral after a tragic string of killings. He carries flowers, a worn coat and a stubborn hope that streets can be safer.

feats.scene: Cornumll shoves a rowdy mourner aside and clears the church aisle.
Cornumll holds his ground in a pelting storm for the whole service.

name: Naseonleo
summary: Naseonleo is a detective who dies in a dark alley beside his wife, leaving a daughter to be raised by a wealthy clan. His sacrifice seeds a young avenger's long campaign for justice.

feats.scene: Naseonleo wrestles a mugger's arm up and away from his family.
Naseonleo stays standing after the first gunshot long enough to shield his child.

name: Anasi
summary: Anasi is a white-haired veteran detective and widower who also joins a society of puzzle solvers. He wears several disguises across the years and refuses to let fear shut down hope.

feats.scene: Anasi heaves a case file cabinet over to block a doorway.
Anasi is swatted by a runaway cart and keeps interrogating the driver.

name: Soncilval
summary: Soncilval is a dark-eyed chief who works from a tidy headquarters and calls his clever daughter whenever trouble grows. Cartoon villains bounce harmlessly off his patience.

feats.scene: Soncilval bats a cartoonish anvil aside with his clipboard.
Soncilval is flattened by a falling piano and pops up dizzy.

name: Sornitel
summary: Sornitel is a brown-haired patrolman who stumbles into a pulp adventure among bronze-skinned heroes. He keeps the crowd calm while stranger people save the day.

feats.scene: Sornitel throws a loose cobblestone at a runaway automaton.
Sornitel is tossed over a barrel and rolls up unhurt.

name: Sirsirnu
summary: Sirsirnu is a divorced detective who secretly helps an outlaw hero, and who once let a young boy walk away from a dark night. He later unravels a killer who strikes pressure points.

feats.scene: Sirsirnu pins a suspect to a brick wall with one forearm.
Sirsirnu shrugs off a punch from a gym enforcer and finishes his sentence.

name: Cortautor
summary: Cortautor is a former field medic and bare-knuckle champion who hides terrible crimes behind a respected badge. His war memories twisted his mind until neighbors feared the foggy streets at night.
