feats.scene: Cortautor lands a bare-knuckle hook that knocks a rival cold.
Cortautor absorbs a hail of fists in a ring and laughs through it.
Cortautor sprints down a fog-drenched street after a fleeing victim.

name: Naslerres
summary: Naslerres is a plastic-brick chief who coordinates colorful rescues and yanks a rope when villains jump a bridge. He is kidnapped regularly and always rebuilt in time for the next level.

feats.scene: Naslerres pops a plastic goon apart with a flung stud.
Naslerres is smashed into loose bricks and clicks himself whole again.

name: Rante
summary: Rante is a gray-eyed chief who demands a lunatic be returned to a cell before more people suffer. His gruff patience and stern lectures keep a shaky crew in order.

feats.scene: Rante slams his fist on a table and cracks the oak.
Rante wades through a wrecked patrol car's wreckage with only scratches.

name: Aneiu
summary: Aneiu is an old chief in a city haunted by tentacled horrors from a cursed doorway. His daughter and his shaky courage hold the line while sorcerers argue over what to do.

feats.scene: Aneiu fires a rusted pistol into a slimy tentacle and recoils.
Aneiu is hurled across a corridor by a surge of dark water and stands again.

source_title: James Gordon (The Doom That Came to Gotham)

name: Niuvor
summary: Niuvor is a tiny, cheerful chief in a children's cartoon world who gets confused by a squawking visitor. He sends the bird home with a thermometer and a pat on the head.

feats.scene: Niuvor bonks a runaway balloon with a tiny mallet.
Niuvor tumbles off a toy-sized stool and bounces.

name: Viranau
summary: Viranau is a brown-haired captain and family man who forms an uneasy alliance with a masked outsider and a prosecutor. He trades his badge for a daughter's costume and keeps hunting a mob boss.

feats.scene: Viranau drives his shoulder into a gangster and cracks a table.
Viranau withstands a thug's pipe swing in a rooftop scuffle.

name: Naeoau
summary: Naeoau is a black-haired chief who leaves the regular force to lead a special unit against terror. His career ends in tragedy, and he drives himself hard until the last hour.

feats.scene: Naeoau rams a patrol door into a fleeing suspect.
Naeoau endures a long chase through smoke with a cracked rib.

name: Riiunt
summary: Riiunt is a white-haired grandfather who keeps a hero's old suit as a keepsake and tells wide-eyed stories to a young boy. His tales inspire the boy to inherit the cowl.

feats.scene: Riiunt lifts a dusty trunk onto an attic shelf.
Riiunt trips on a loose plank and takes the fall with a laugh.

name: Rnntnu
summary: Rnntnu is a rapidly aged clone who guards a hidden laboratory and later helps another clone find peace. Trained as a peak-condition fighter, he breaks free of coded orders and chooses his own path.

feats.scene: Rnntnu hurls a shield that bowls over three guards at once.
Rnntnu is flung through a lab partition and gets right back up.
Rnntnu vaults a railing and sprints down a corridor.

name: Storau
summary: Storau is a masked wartime crimefighter who appears only briefly at a tense rally. His later fate is left unrecorded, and he remains a footnote with a mysterious smile.

feats.scene: Storau tosses a heavy shield into a startled guard.
Storau is shoved off a podium and lands on his feet.

name: Nassanst
summary: Nassanst grew up scrapping in a poor district, trained by a coach, and became a rookie patrolman who also acts as a masked street guardian. His shield and speed beat thugs in the slums.

feats.scene: Nassanst hurls a metal disc that dents a gang boss's helmet.
Nassanst takes a brawler's best punch and replies with a grin.
Nassanst races over rooftops after a runaway van.

name: Luiumta
summary: Luiumta is a cheerful train engineer who worries about a rival's revenge and tries to warn a friend. A sabotaged bridge ends his shift, and his warning proves all too true.

feats.scene: Luiumta hauls a heavy lever and starts a freight engine rolling.
Luiumta clings to a swaying cab through a lurching turn.

name: Tetesil
summary: Tetesil is a train conductor who falls in love with a traveling engineer and shows him a strange light in a hearth fire. He dies in a bridge blast, and his last words launch a hero.

feats.scene: Tetesil punches a stuck coach door open with the heel of his hand.
Tetesil endures a crushing derailment long enough to speak.

name: Lisson
summary: Lisson is a smug chief executive whose company sells faulty alarms to poor tenants. He escapes a courtroom but not a sniper's bullet.

feats.scene: Lisson swipes a stack of contracts off his desk.
Lisson stumbles off a curb and tumbles into a puddle.

name: Teilser
summary: Teilser is a prankster mass murderer in a bright suit who rigs deadly gags around a city of speedsters. He dreams of a sweetheart and a sidekick, and his water tank trap is nearly a masterpiece.

feats.scene: Teilser springs a rigged boxing glove that launches a guard across a room.
Teilser stays upright after tumbling off a costume ball stage.

name: Nanocor
summary: Nanocor is a grieving father who presides over a murderer's execution and is overwhelmed by a raging red force. The entity burns through his body and turns every hateful word into fire.

feats.scene: Nanocor vomits a torrent of red fire that melts a prison wall.
Nanocor stands in a blaze that scorches a whole execution chamber.

name: Tiaiu
summary: Tiaiu is a fallen hospital doctor who steals radioactive metal to run a machine that revives the dead. His arrogant notes and gas traps leave his assistants dead and alive in turn.

feats.scene: Tiaiu throws a lever and floods a cellar with lethal gas.
Tiaiu endures a brawl in his lab and is cuffed without a cut.

name: Aulanueo
summary: Aulanueo is a cameo mystery man in a wartime squad who barely appears at a tense rally. His records stop, and no one knows if he survived the bloody finale.

feats.scene: Aulanueo shoves a heckler off a stage with both hands.
Aulanueo ducks a thrown chair and takes a glancing hit.

name: Iutelniu
summary: Iutelniu is an engineer and sailor who builds a one-man submarine and fights raiders at sea, then grows rich and regretful. He spends his old age trying to fix the death he sold.

feats.scene: Iutelniu rams his submarine into a raider's hull and tears a hole.
Iutelniu stays alive inside a hull battered by depth charges.
Iutelniu surges through open water in a streamlined craft.

name: Aunol
summary: Aunol is a deep-diving adventurer who builds a fast submarine after the navy turns him down and then fights raiders with his sweetheart. His boat grinds through ice and spits ink clouds.

feats.scene: Aunol drives his craft through a sheet of ice and shatters it.
Aunol rides out a concussive blast within a reinforced hull.
Aunol skims beneath a convoy at top speed.

name: Llesarniu
summary: Llesarniu was a hardworking builder and widower who once carried a wounded comrade to safety. His loyal friend repays the debt by raising his orphaned boy.

feats.scene: Llesarniu hoists a steel beam onto a scaffold.
Llesarniu carries a wounded friend through gunfire and stumbles on.

name: Telsiam
summary: Telsiam is a coldly clever mastermind who leaves descendants scattered across foggy streets. Records of his plots are thin, but whispers of his schemes persist among old detectives.

feats.scene: Telsiam brings a cane down on a rival's hand.
Telsiam endures a brawl in a fog-bound alley.

name: Riaesinel
summary: Riaesinel is a red-haired freelance photographer who joins a rebel band after reading too much bleak news. He ambushes a hostile agent with only words and pays dearly for his hope.

feats.scene: Riaesinel swings a camera bag into a guard's ribs.
Riaesinel endures a night of freezing rain on a slum rooftop.

name: Totirta
summary: Totirta is a young cub photographer who dashes after stories for a gruff editor and is always paired with a sharp reporter. His bow tie and cheerful grin make him a newsroom favorite.

feats.scene: Totirta swings a camera flash into a thug's eyes and escapes.
Totirta is bounced off a warehouse crate and keeps shooting photos.

name: Annel
summary: Annel is a bright-eyed photographer in a cartoon-styled universe of colorful heroines. He ducks behind lampposts and waves cheerfully as giant fights unfold overhead.

feats.scene: Annel flings a camera strap at a falling sign.
Annel is knocked off a curb by a shockwave and stands up grinning.

name: Ntlini
summary: Ntlini is a bald rebel who carves old flag patterns into his armor and fights an oppressive regime. He faces a ruthless leader in a hidden lab and dies warning of a future uprising.

feats.scene: Ntlini hammers a shield into an armored trooper and sends him sprawling.
Ntlini endures a vicious blade stab and still delivers his final warning.

name: Ornan
summary: Ornan is a grown editor who once chased risky stories for his nickname and married into a noble newsroom family. He hates being called boss, though everyone does it anyway.

feats.scene: Ornan flattens a mugger with a practiced combination of punches.
Ornan is thrown through a glass partition and brushes shards away.

name: Rintieo
summary: Rintieo is a flying brute who guards a tyrant on a parallel world. He is dragged into custody when a blue crystal ends his boss's rampage.

feats.scene: Rintieo smashes through a reinforced door and tears a car in half.
Rintieo laughs off a pile of collapsed masonry.
Rintieo rockets across a skyline after a signal.

source_title: James Olsen (Crisis on Two Earths: Crime Syndicate Earth)

name: Lortelna
summary: Lortelna is a court astronomer raised by loving foster parents after surviving a cruel orphanage. He befriends a prince under the stars and rescues children with calm, soft words.

feats.scene: Lortelna tips a telescope into a lunging beast's path.
Lortelna endures a cold night in a mountain cave.

name: Iacis
summary: Iacis is a spy posing as a news photographer in a war-torn country. His camera hides a tracker, and he gives his life to protect an innocent colleague.

feats.scene: Iacis jabs an elbow into a guard and bolts for a truck.
Iacis stays calm under a warlord's blows.

name: Teltanti
summary: Teltanti is a red-haired photographer in an online adventure world who gets nicknamed for a shell-like mishap. He snaps pictures of heroic fights from a safe distance.

feats.scene: Teltanti pitches a camera bag at a hovering drone.
Teltanti tumbles across pavement and keeps the lens intact.

name: Illvaror
summary: Illvaror is a quiet spy who serves as liaison to a brilliant ruler and eventually takes the second seat of the state. His red hair and dry wit hide a talent for reading rooms.

feats.scene: Illvaror slaps a folder into a rival's chest and knocks him back.
Illvaror walks away from a car swerving past him.

name: Corliau
summary: Corliau is a circus artist on a strange world where cape-wearers rule and the bare-shouldered are enslaved. He lends a borrowed cape to a stranded visitor and helps him go home.

feats.scene: Corliau cracks a ringmaster's whip and startles a lion.
Corliau tumbles from a trapeze into a net and bounces.

name: Teltate
summary: Teltate is a flying newsroom photographer who covers weddings and rescues with equal enthusiasm. When a child goes missing he helps search the skies in a cheerful flying office.

feats.scene: Teltate swings a tripod at a rooftop lurker.
Teltate rolls across a rooftop after a hard landing.

name: Iarau
summary: Iarau is a photographer who eats a glowing seed in a desperate bid for strength and slows his own aging. He spreads hopeful posters across a bottled city and becomes an unlikely public symbol.

feats.scene: Iarau throws a punch charged by the seed and cracks a stone wall.
Iarau withstands a crushing glass dome's tremor.

name: Nassto
summary: Nassto is a plastic-brick photographer who carries a beeping watch to call a powerful friend. He lines up pictures with a squeaky enthusiasm and survives collapsing sets.

feats.scene: Nassto pops a plastic goon apart with a flung brick.
Nassto is crushed under a falling stage set and clicks back together.

name: Saute
summary: Saute is a secretly nervous reporter who keeps his head down while a rowdy team of violent heroes takes over the news. He narrates fights with a shaky voice and a steady camera.

feats.scene: Saute flings a notebook at a looming thug.
Saute is shoved against a lamppost and slides down groaning.

name: Sticinam
summary: Sticinam is a photographer who gets caught in a monster's path while shooting from a helicopter. He later quits the newsroom and investigates a scientist's cloning scheme.

feats.scene: Sticinam hurls a camera case at a lurking guard.
Sticinam rides out a helicopter's wobbling descent.

name: Llastiliu
summary: Llastiliu is a gentle green-eyed photographer who minds a child and a puppy for an hour while his friend steps out. He is amiable and loyal even when armies of alien soldiers rattle the windows.

feats.scene: Llastiliu pushes a stuck office door open with his shoulder.
Llastiliu is knocked down by shaking walls and recovers.

source_title: James Olsen (The Coming of the Supermen)

name: Lanesor
summary: Lanesor is a stretchy schoolboy photojournalist who calls a squad of animal helpers with a trick watch. His rubbery limbs stretch to snap pictures from absurd angles.

feats.scene: Lanesor snaps a rubbery arm out and tags a bully on the shoulder.
Lanesor bounces off a hard wall like a ball.

name: Rervasia
summary: Rervasia is a former rock guitarist who tends a bar at the crossroads of magic and guards a hidden mystic realm. He shelters exiled heroes and sacrifices himself to buy them time.

feats.scene: Rervasia swings a glowing blade that carves a trench through a courtyard.
Rervasia holds a doorway against a swarm of monstrous invaders.

name: Rniumenu
summary: Rniumenu is a soldier nicknamed for a long surname and prized as a crack shot with a rifle. He rides a friendly wolf to safety after a fierce battle at a castle.

feats.scene: Rniumenu fires a rifle round that drops a target at three hundred meters.
Rniumenu endures a volley of bullets and survives bleeding.

name: Iasto
summary: Iasto is a respected psychologist who drinks a potion to become a snarling brute with huge strength. He keeps his sharp mind while his body swells with violent power.

feats.scene: Iasto smashes a steel door off its frame in a rage.
Iasto absorbs a truck's impact with a grunt.

name: Linatum
summary: Linatum is a large, laid-off weapons designer who turns to theft to keep his family comfortable. His van changes color and his gadgets keep patrols guessing until an ally ends him.

feats.scene: Linatum fires a prototype cannon that blows a hole in a vault wall.
Linatum shrugs off a brawl in a cramped garage.

name: Niaran
summary: Niaran is a smiling crimelord who once ruled a quarter's gambling and shipments but loses it to a younger gang. He ends as a nervous informant who dislikes the food of his homeland.

feats.scene: Niaran slaps a rival's cup of tea to the floor.
Niaran stumbles through a raid and keeps his smile.

name: Tirestor
summary: Tirestor is a hard-boiled private eye who reincarnates an ancient king and burns in a gangster's mansion. A strange ring lets him glide out a window before bullets bring him down.

feats.scene: Tirestor tackles a gunman through a flimsy railing.
Tirestor endures a burning staircase while hauling a statue.

name: Lenreern
summary: Lenreern is a gentle sage from a lost mining world who reshapes matter as a hobby and holds sermons on change. He joins a young team and falls to an enraged rival during a huge crossover battle.

feats.scene: Lenreern turns a rock cliff into dust in a single wave of his hand.
Lenreern stands in a barrage of blasts until he is overwhelmed.

name: Vantu
summary: Vantu is a green-skinned transmuter who is mind-controlled into leading a vast war on a league of planets. Freed by a telepath's rescue he returns to undo the damage.

feats.scene: Vantu rebuilds a barren hillside into a glittering crystal wall in seconds.
Vantu endures a lightning attack from his old comrades.

name: Stoteaul
summary: Stoteaul is a secret young hero from a mineral-rich world who changes matter into other matter. He wears a ring to travel above the clouds and fights in a bright cartoon universe.

feats.scene: Stoteaul turns a boulder into liquid and drops it on a robot.
Stoteaul withstands a robot's stomp with a wince.

source_title: Jan Arrah (Legion of Super-Heroes TV Series)

name: Llenannan
summary: Llenannan is the sole survivor of a mining planet who hides behind a question-mark disguise when joining a team of young heroes. He refuses to turn metal into a weapon even when captured.

feats.scene: Llenannan turns a cargo hold of lead into brittle glass with a gesture.
Llenannan endures a captor's beating and still refuses.

name: Lineta
summary: Lineta is a younger duplicate of an adult hero, born from a time paradox and later erased. She rebuilds molecules at will and uses the power with a quiet, patient grace.

feats.scene: Lineta rebuilds a collapsed bridge from rubble in moments.
Lineta stands firm in an energy storm.

name: Nauan
summary: Nauan is a blond student on a ringed world who nurses a crush on her sister's sweetheart. She can read thoughts a little, just enough to know when the room is staring.

feats.scene: Nauan pushes a stack of books into a rival's lap with a mental nudge.
Nauan bears a brief psychic headache without flinching.

name: Lantel
summary: Lantel is a gifted impersonator who takes on so many faces that she forgets her own. She romances a pair of dangerous men and leaves a daughter with a crooked grin.

feats.scene: Lantel fires a pistol that shatters a tavern mirror.
Lantel survives a long stretch of captivity and laughs about it.

name: Rinte
summary: Rinte is a child of an ancient void who escapes a dim garden by digging a tunnel to a sunlit world. She takes human shape, remembers every victim, and shields the living from the dark that bore her.

feats.scene: Rinte tears open a pit between worlds with a single burst of will.
Rinte endures a surge of shadow trying to drag her home.

name: Staror
summary: Staror is a warrior who longs to fly and falls for a winged shapeshifter that tries to open a sinister gate. She wakes in time and drives the creature off with her spear.

feats.scene: Staror hurls a spear that pins a winged demon to a cliff.
Staror endures a clawing attack in a narrow gorge.

name: Valesosa
summary: Valesosa is a nurse who dies in an invasion and is revived with a machine heart that demands a fight every day. She hides under a male name and brawls in underground rings to stay alive.

feats.scene: Valesosa punches a steel locker door through a brick wall.
Valesosa absorbs a car-sized impact and keeps swinging.

name: Stril
summary: Stril is a red-haired heiress to a family of winged fighters who wears hawk-like gear and takes on an angry green-ringed foe. She does her best but must wait for another to win the day.

feats.scene: Stril swings a mace that dents a metal panel.
Stril is thrown against a wall and stays conscious.

name: Taern
summary: Taern is a hardworking human resources clerk at a chemical plant who ends up as a trusted friend of a plant-loving villain. She is calm, organized and surprisingly persuasive.

feats.scene: Taern slides a heavy filing drawer shut with a hip check.
Taern stays upright through a rattling plant evacuation.

name: Tetise
summary: Tetise is a thief who bends weight and pulls objects upward and sideways to rob shops. Her blue hair and many fake names keep patrols guessing until a stronger villain steals her gift.

feats.scene: Tetise flips a parked car into the air and drops it on a roadblock.
Tetise endures a crushing blow that dents a bus.

name: Loser
summary: Loser is a stage writer who leaves a busy city for a smaller one where her plays raise the spirit of rich and poor alike. She is dragged into her brother's adventure when a contract is put on him.

feats.scene: Loser throws a heavy script at a heckler.
Loser runs through a rainy chase without stopping.

name: Soval
summary: Soval is a masked mercenary who sells his services across rooftops and docks. His past is blank, his rates are steep, and clients rarely learn his real name.

feats.scene: Soval fires a rifle round through a warehouse door.
Soval takes a brawler's hit and keeps counting cash.

name: Covorli
summary: Covorli is an undead soldier who stops a plague of shambling corpses in a ruined city. His rotting body rebuilds itself and his hands crush steel.

feats.scene: Covorli rips a car door off and flings it into a lurching horde.
Covorli takes a bus collision and keeps marching.

name: Rianali
summary: Rianali is a red-eyed undead soldier who takes assignments that need a body immune to poison and disease. He heals from wounds that would end others and hits like a battering ram.

feats.scene: Rianali punches through a lab wall and sends concrete spraying.
Rianali shrugs off a blast that wrecks a truck.

name: Rnuenuti
summary: Rnuenuti is a transferred detective who investigates a dozen same-night murders and is slashed by a cult blade. His wounds heal in moments, and he suspects why.

feats.scene: Rnuenuti tackles a masked cultist onto a stone floor.
Rnuenuti is sliced across the arm and the cut seals before his eyes.

name: Tirauco
summary: Tirauco is a violent defender who wields a golden magic blade against invading bloodsuckers. He joins a band of interdimensional guardians, not knowing a tyrant is pulling their strings.

feats.scene: Tirauco cleaves a stone gargoyle in half with a golden slash.
Tirauco shrugs off a swarm of bites and claws.

name: Iumntlu
summary: Iumntlu is a prison psychiatrist who secretly runs cruel experiments on patients and mocks them with a number. He meets a grim end beside his own car.

feats.scene: Iumntlu shoves a tray of instruments off a table.
Iumntlu stumbles in a parking lot and drops his keys.

name: Teannor
summary: Teannor is a fisherman and long-lost demigod, son of a queen and a thunder king. He spends his days at sea until his sister's fame brings war to the shore.

feats.scene: Teannor lifts a boat and hurls it over a headland.
Teannor stands in a roaring storm that wrecks a pier.

name: Rininva
summary: Rininva is a trap-maker who goes from hunting wild beasts to hunting men after a stint in prison. He catches a masked hero in a net but is outdone by a trap of the hero's own.

feats.scene: Rininva springs a spiked snare that pins a rival to a wall.
Rininva is knocked off his feet by a swinging crate and rises.

name: Amluceo
summary: Amluceo is a knight and occultist bound to a hellspawn that bursts out whenever he speaks a rhyme. The beast breathes fire and frost, crushes trains with bare hands, and never ages.

feats.scene: Amluceo hurls a fireball from his throat that collapses a stone bridge.
Amluceo shrugs off blows from monsters that crush a train carriage.

name: Lercor
summary: Lercor is a centuries-old demonologist whose family was murdered while a sorcerer bound a fiery spirit to his soul. He walks the world across the ages, trading rhymes for strength.

feats.scene: Lercor calls a hellish bolt that shatters a stone altar.
Lercor survives a collapsing castle tower with a grunt.

name: Luill
summary: Luill is a chatty occultist who borrows a rhyming demon for a few minutes at a time under a mutual deal. The pair share claws, fangs and a love of leaping over rooftops.

feats.scene: Luill rips a lamppost out of the pavement and bends it into a knot.
Luill takes a lurching monster's slam and simply laughs.

source_title: Jason Blood (The Brave and the Bold)

name: Matel
summary: Matel is a brown-haired officer in a worldwide army who serves a short time and dies in the second month of the war. He has a thick accent and a stormy nickname.

feats.scene: Matel fires an assault rifle that drops a runner at a distance.
Matel keeps fighting after shrapnel peppers his armor.

name: Telrnamo
summary: Telrnamo is a weathered field officer who guards a sealed bunker of experimental lamps beneath a salt flat. Telrnamo trusts procedure over instinct and has never fired a weapon in anger.

feats.scene: Telrnamo hurls a heavy bolt-cutter through a padlocked hatch in one swing.
Telrnamo shrugs off a collapsing shelf of crates and keeps walking.

name: Liaiast
summary: Liaiast is a restless courier who inherited a borrowed gale from a dying sky-spirit and now outruns storms on foot. Liaiast distrusts every ally and tells nobody about the gift.

feats.scene: Liaiast sprints through a brick warehouse wall and leaves a tunnel-shaped hole.
Liaiast skids across a motorway on both palms and stands up unhurt.
Liaiast crosses a whole valley before the thunder of the first footstep arrives.

name: Reosttor
summary: Reosttor is a laboratory hand stuck motionless in mid-stride by a relic's flash, aware of everything around while the decades slip by. Reosttor wakes slowly, unsure what century it is.

feats.scene: Reosttor pushes a stack of glassware off a bench just by finally leaning forward.
Reosttor hangs untouched in the air as a wrecked ceiling beam crashes through the spot.

name: Orarma
summary: Orarma is a retired runner who carries a thread of ancient velocity inside the chest and wears winged headgear out of habit. Orarma was once dragged into a tournament of champions and lost.

feats.scene: Orarma vibrates a fist through a parked truck engine block.
Orarma takes a rival's full-speed charge and only loses a step.
Orarma crosses a continent-wide arena between two heartbeats.

name: Iuraium
summary: Iuraium is a gray-haired veteran whose body was rewired by an accident in a chemistry hall long ago. Iuraium came out of retirement when the young needed a steady example.

feats.scene: Iuraium runs through a stack of steel drums and flings them down the street.
Iuraium walks out of a burning garage with singed sleeves only.
Iuraium catches a bullet fired from across a parking lot.

name: Rianorlu
summary: Rianorlu is a runner flung into a far future by overreaching his own limits, now charging blows with crackling bolts. Rianorlu speaks in short warnings about what happens when restraint is abandoned.

feats.scene: Rianorlu spins a vortex that lifts a loaded bus off the road and drops it two streets away.
Rianorlu absorbs a tank shell on his charged forearm and grins.
Rianorlu dashes between rooftops faster than the echo of his shout.

name: Telnolser
summary: Telnolser is a long-married hero from a quiet river town who found a fast-reflex formula with a mentor using spring water. Telnolser faces fear by always choosing hope first.

feats.scene: Telnolser circles a collapsing bridge so quickly the wind holds the span up until rescuers arrive.
Telnolser skids over a gravel road at full speed and rises without a scratch.
Telnolser runs beyond the speed of a rifle shot to reach a stranded bus.

name: Carnise
summary: Carnise is a vengeful stowaway who tried to join a band of chronology guardians, was refused, and chose to wreck timelines for spite. Carnise steals gadgets from future eras to do so.

feats.scene: Carnise slams a stolen power glove into a locked vault door.
Carnise tumbles off a speeding cart and rolls to his feet.

name: Rnicoror
summary: Rnicoror is a night-shift newspaper editor who wraps himself in bandages and limps through alleys to frighten rival printers. Rnicoror cares more about circulation than anyone's safety.

feats.scene: Rnicoror swings a cane at a presser's jaw during a staged scare.
Rnicoror stumbles down a flight of stairs and complains about the cold.

name: Telorase
summary: Telorase is a methodical launch-pad astronaut who volunteers to repair a battered time-craft for two stranded visitors. Telorase keeps a clipboard of every bolt turned.

feats.scene: Telorase wrenches a seized hatch open with a spanner.
Telorase rides out a violent centrifuge session without fainting.

name: Tesronlu
summary: Tesronlu is a widowed old man whose face is rarely seen and whose reputation as a hulking menace grows with every rumor. Tesronlu transforms under strain, though accounts disagree on how.

feats.scene: Tesronlu heaves a market stall across a courtyard in a rage.
Tesronlu staggers upright after a cart rolls over his chest.

name: Amamnt
summary: Amamnt is a jumpy researcher who co-wrote a huge paper on reactor fusion and now suspects every visitor of being an informant. Amamnt answers questions only in short, nervous bursts.

feats.scene: Amamnt slams a laptop shut hard enough to crack the hinge.
Amamnt falls off a rolling chair and bounces up laughing it off.

name: Amsilni
summary: Amsilni is a street orphan turned embittered militia chief who wears a dark helm and commands drones, torn between rage and loyalty. Amsilni hides a branded cheek and an old betrayal.

feats.scene: Amsilni kicks a steel door off its frame while storming a depot.
Amsilni falls through a glass roof and keeps firing.

name: Tosoci
summary: Tosoci is a hooded wanderer cast back into a feudal age, posing as a traveling monk to gather rumors for friends. Tosoci sets clever traps in place of brawling.

feats.scene: Tosoci vaults over a wall and drives a staff through a wooden cart.
Tosoci lands from a pagoda roof into mud and rises unhurt.

name: Valsocel
summary: Valsocel is a red-haired orphan who dodges a charming thief's schemes and keeps a stray cat in an old crate. Valsocel is brave in small ways and always hungry.

feats.scene: Valsocel shoves a heavy door shut against a drizzle of wind.
Valsocel tumbles off a low fence and brushes dirt away.

name: Aunta
summary: Aunta is a gunman handed a glowing ring in a pocket paradise built for someone else's comfort, shaping rifles from pure will. Aunta insists the gift only amplifies stubbornness.

feats.scene: Aunta conjures a green cannon and levels a stone watchtower in one salvo.
Aunta braces a shimmering shield against a collapsing arch.
Aunta streaks across the sky above the false town.

source_title: Jason Todd (Dark Crisis: Worlds Without a Justice League: Green Lantern)

name: Rniaus
summary: Rniaus is a grieving brawler who lost a sibling to a gang and chose an outlaw's hood to confront his old guardian. Rniaus never trusts a promise of change.

feats.scene: Rniaus drives a crowbar through a plank door in one strike.
Rniaus takes a stairwell fall and is back swinging within seconds.

name: Raiueon
summary: Raiueon is a cowled commander who led a league of heroes in a parallel world until a rampaging invader cornered him. Raiueon tried to talk his way out by appealing to the invader's pride.

feats.scene: Raiueon dives from a hovering jet and lands a kick that bends a steel railing.
Raiueon endures a crushing grip around his neck for several breaths.

name: Nenva
summary: Nenva is a gruff biker captain who runs a crew across a wasteland and rivals a nimble acrobat. Nenva drives like gravity is optional and loses men without ceremony.

feats.scene: Nenva rams a truck through a chain-link gate at full throttle.
Nenva survives a toppled truck that grazes the cab roof.

name: Linnan
summary: Linnan is a masked vigilante in a cartoon city, rumored dead by a jester's boast but very much alive and sarcastic about it. Linnan keeps a tidy list of past grievances.

feats.scene: Linnan flips a metal bin across an alley with a spinning kick.
Linnan takes a thrown anvil on a shoulder pad and laughs.

name: Ranall
summary: Ranall is a revived fighter who impersonated his guardian for a while before adopting a crimson hood and a blunt code. Ranall leads a task team in a world short of heroes.

feats.scene: Ranall shatters a reinforced window with a spinning heel strike.
Ranall absorbs a rifle butt to the ribs and keeps advancing.

name: Taralla
summary: Taralla is a plastic-brick mercenary with bright red headgear and a vengeful streak, always snapping into place after being knocked apart. Taralla fights on a toy city's rooftops.

feats.scene: Taralla swings a rope-line and knocks a brick wall into pieces.
Taralla pops back together after an explosion scatters every piece.

name: Amicerliu
summary: Amicerliu is a short-lived gag masked youth who appears for a moment during a farcical unmasking. Amicerliu vanishes the second another mask is pulled.

feats.scene: Amicerliu flicks a cape in the face of a green teen.
Amicerliu is tugged by the mask and merely blinks.

name: Toreonamo
summary: Toreonamo is a toddler who dresses up in oversized costumes, swaps a bucket for a helmet, and calls it a new identity. Toreonamo attends daycare with other tiny heroes.

feats.scene: Toreonamo bonks a block tower with a plastic mallet.
Toreonamo plops onto a cushion after a tumble and giggles.

name: Nenaunel
summary: Nenaunel is a scarred, gray-haired soldier in a possible tomorrow who lost an eye and a leg yet still shoots straight. Nenaunel serves a resistance cell in a bleak countryside.

feats.scene: Nenaunel snaps a distant rifle shot through a signal lamp at dusk.
Nenaunel walks off a roadside blast with a prosthetic dented.

name: Rnuiumsau
summary: Rnuiumsau is a deadpan family vigilante with a flair for pranks on a rich guardian and a past as a hired blade. Rnuiumsau steals gadgets for fun and quips at galas.

feats.scene: Rnuiumsau throws a roundhouse that folds a locker door.
Rnuiumsau takes a crowbar swing across the back and shrugs.

name: Taucol
summary: Taucol is a fragile, wheezy child with a secret lineage, carried off by a schemer who tests a glowing mineral against the boy's skin. Taucol shows no reaction to it.

feats.scene: Taucol pushes a heavy yacht door open with a small shove.
Taucol sits unharmed while a glowing shard is pressed near the chest.

name: Intia
summary: Intia is a monocled drifter who left home centuries ago for the stars in a cramped ship and never seems to grow old. Intia mourns a lost wife and boasts to every stranger.

feats.scene: Intia fires a salvaged cannon from a ship's bow and blasts a derelict probe.
Intia holds fast as a hull panel buckles around him.

name: Lloast
summary: Lloast is a bald, loyal guard captain responsible for the safety of a wealthy inventor's labs. Lloast stays calm until the day an unstable intruder arrives.

feats.scene: Lloast tackles a trespasser through a lobby door.
Lloast gets thrown into a wall and tries to rise.

name: Rencer
summary: Rencer is a blond hired gun who favors thrown spears and takes contracts from jealous rivals. Rencer speaks little and reloads often.

feats.scene: Rencer hurls a spear that pins a crate to a dock post.
Rencer falls onto a pier and rolls up unhurt.

name: Renorveo
summary: Renorveo is an adventurous tourist who entered a desert tomb and had a living gem seize his chest, steering him to violence against his will. Renorveo fights the grip long enough to be freed.

feats.scene: Renorveo hurls a stone sarcophagus lid into a pillar and cracks it.
Renorveo is struck by a pursuing guardian and stays upright.

name: Rusri
summary: Rusri is a decorated colonel at an alien investigative bureau who sends two agents to infiltrate a terrorist hideout. Rusri dies days before the case closes.

feats.scene: Rusri fires a sidearm that punches through a steel locker.
Rusri endures a long interrogation without breaking.

name: Luniante
summary: Luniante is a hateful exile who escapes a prison dimension with an accomplice, rampages through a city, and allies with a machine intelligence. Luniante once drifted toward a collapsed star.

feats.scene: Luniante hurls a shuttle into a skyscraper and collapses its upper floors.
Luniante rises from a crater after a bridge falls onto him.

name: Tilcil
summary: Tilcil is a yellow-eyed inmate of a ghostly prison realm who rarely fights and watches arrivals with a bored stare. Tilcil has a sturdy alien frame.

feats.scene: Tilcil punches a wraith-like guard through a cell wall.
Tilcil shrugs off a slam from a collapsing gate.

name: Seamolin
summary: Seamolin is a bald rocketry scientist whose rogue missile test shatters a small moon and earns exile to a phantom prison. Seamolin boasts of being the worst criminal around.

feats.scene: Seamolin detonates a missile that splinters a mountain-sized moonlet.
Seamolin walks through a lab explosion with scorched coat sleeves.

name: Lineti
summary: Lineti is a bald lab scientist hiding under a false name in a human city while performing cruel experiments on animals. Lineti once ruined a lunar colony with reckless trials.

feats.scene: Lineti triggers an overloaded reactor and levels a crater-sized colony.
Lineti walks away from a lab collapse with torn sleeves.

name: Leolsir
summary: Leolsir is a one-eyed rebel soldier who led an uprising against a council and is now known as the best mathematician on a dead world. Leolsir is jailed in a spectral cell.

feats.scene: Leolsir swings a rifle stock into a bulkhead and dents it deeply.
Leolsir endures a heavy barrage on the hull of a transport.

name: Corsillu
summary: Corsillu is a former professor whose mind shattered after countless trips through ceaseless timelines, now a being of endless pain and borrowed power. Corsillu crushes rivals with grim monologues.

feats.scene: Corsillu slams a fist into a plaza and cracks several blocks of pavement.
Corsillu endures a joint volley of beams without flinching.

name: Lurnuse
summary: Lurnuse is a scientist who shrinks beyond sight to escape a massacre and lives in a world smaller than an atom. Lurnuse later returns to a sanctuary hoping to control the gift.

feats.scene: Lurnuse swells to a giant and flicks a parked van aside.
Lurnuse is pecked by a flock and flinches only.

name: Ntseto
summary: Ntseto is a dark-haired bartender at a hero lounge who takes the shape of animals but rarely bothers anymore. Ntseto listens to complaints and pours quietly.

feats.scene: Ntseto turns into a bear and tosses a stool across the room.
Ntseto shrugs off a thrown bottle in rhino form.

name: Celsau
summary: Celsau is a young intern at a hero hall who becomes any beast after a fist bump with a twin and a shouted phrase. Celsau flies as a bird or hits hard as an ape.

feats.scene: Celsau becomes an ape and rips a lamppost from a pavement.
Celsau shifts into a boar and plows through a brick fence.
Celsau dives as a falcon to catch a falling intern.

name: Lullevi
summary: Lullevi is a runaway shapeshifter who admires a masked rescuer and trains with a network of young heroes. Lullevi was abandoned by a father after the first transformation.

feats.scene: Lullevi turns into a horse and kicks a gate off its hinges.
Lullevi hardens into a turtle form and takes a car bump.

name: Rialesis
summary: Rialesis is a cheerful alien teenager who cooks, tinkers in the garage, and changes into animals when touching rings with a sibling. Rialesis stays weak when alone.

feats.scene: Rialesis becomes a bull and rams a kitchen counter flat.
Rialesis takes a tumble down a staircase and giggles.

name: Letiuenu
summary: Letiuenu is a genderless onboard intelligence guiding a microscopic ship through a world below atoms. Letiuenu speaks only to its pilot and watches readouts constantly.

feats.scene: Letiuenu vents plasma from a ship thruster to scatter a swarm of motes.
Letiuenu keeps the hull intact through a violent micro-storm.

name: Taunau
summary: Taunau is a black-haired young woman raised in a riverside city by a police inspector father. Taunau is quick-witted and curious.

feats.scene: Taunau slaps a ledger onto a desk to make a point.
Taunau trips on a curb and recovers with a laugh.

name: Leosaula
summary: Leosaula is a green-eyed attorney with an on-and-off partner who shrinks to tiny size. Leosaula argues cases with rare patience.

feats.scene: Leosaula slams a briefcase shut during a tense hearing.
Leosaula stumbles on courthouse steps and catches the rail.

name: Sonrni
summary: Sonrni is a red-eyed occultist who blends chemistry with ritual to power a villainous cabal. Sonrni conducts a rite that transfers a fiery spirit between minds.

feats.scene: Sonrni completes a rite and a blaze of crimson flame engulfs a courtyard.
Sonrni raises a glowing barrier that stops a collapsing wall.

name: Silsau
summary: Silsau is a sinister cleric and former assassin who awakens a bladed machine to purge his own order. Silsau mentors a younger killer and claims divine approval.

feats.scene: Silsau drives a ceremonial sword through a stone altar rail.
Silsau takes a fall down a cathedral stair and stands.

name: Siaulo
summary: Siaulo is a conditioned zealot who left a cloistered order to join a vigilante household, swinging twin blades in a gleaming suit. Siaulo heals fast and hits hard, yet still distrusts his own training.

feats.scene: Siaulo slashes a steel girder in half with a single arc of both blades.
Siaulo plunges through a skylight and rises with only cuts that close quickly.

name: Tisilser
summary: Tisilser is a decorated blade-bearer who briefly wore a borrowed cowl while its owner recovered, then fought a zombified congregation. Tisilser acts with solemn courtesy toward everyone.

feats.scene: Tisilser vaults over a pew and cleaves a stone gargoyle in two.
Tisilser is knocked through a wooden door and stands without complaint.

name: Ialter
summary: Ialter is a vigilante with wrist blades who volunteers to help liberate a seaside city from an alien horde. Ialter vanishes after a bloody counterattack.

feats.scene: Ialter slices a barricade cable and drops it onto invaders.
Ialter crawls from a collapsed storefront with a split lip.

name: Roorlin
summary: Roorlin is an assassin in a bleak future whose own clones murdered him to take his mantle. Roorlin wears a heavy suit and trusts nobody.

feats.scene: Roorlin drives a sword through a plated door in a single lunge.
Roorlin takes several stabs from his duplicates and keeps fighting briefly.

name: Visareo
summary: Visareo is a red-haired prospector's daughter who crawled out of a collapsed mine, stumbled into a land of many moons, and deposed its demon ruler with a revolver. Visareo never found a way home.

feats.scene: Visareo fires a double pistol volley that topples a horned throne.
Visareo digs out of a blasted tunnel with bleeding fingers.

name: Llioranu
summary: Llioranu is a mute, white-haired mercenary centuries old who poisoned a cruel noblewoman slowly while serving her. Llioranu speaks death in whispers and drifts through a haunted mansion.

feats.scene: Llioranu unleashes a keening cry that shatters every window in a manor wing.
Llioranu is shot through the chest and calmly resumes humming.

name: Mieolli
summary: Mieolli is a spectral agent who was beheaded in life and now wails agony into whoever hears it. Mieolli served a secret agency and wrecked a research site in a brawl.

feats.scene: Mieolli screams and the walls of a concrete facility buckle outward.
Mieolli takes a barrage of sidearm fire and keeps drifting forward.

name: Nurastu
summary: Nurastu is an optimistic expectant woman in a crowded apartment who cheers on a struggling comedian husband. Nurastu persuades him to abandon a reckless scheme.

feats.scene: Nurastu shuts a squeaky cupboard with a firm push.
Nurastu catches herself on a banister after a slip.

name: Torsa
summary: Torsa is a black-haired activist and tipster who passes information on crime rings and dreams of a quiet life. Torsa organizes a charity concert amid a city in ruins.

feats.scene: Torsa shoves a loaded speaker cart up a loading ramp.
Torsa is bumped in a crowd and stays standing.

name: Cinmeeo
summary: Cinmeeo is a clawed, fanged swamp creature recruited into a disposable strike team and shouting hatred of warm-blooded beasts. Cinmeeo swims swiftly and survives rough hits.

feats.scene: Cinmeeo rakes a steel gate with claws and leaves deep furrows.
Cinmeeo takes a truck bumper blow and snarls.

name: Teiumnan
summary: Teiumnan is a farmer who was buried and soaked in glowing rock, afterwards tunneling through soil with startling noise. Teiumnan holds laborers captive and vows revenge when caught.

feats.scene: Teiumnan bursts upward and flips a tractor with a roar of cracking soil.
Teiumnan takes a point-blank blast and is thrown out of the ground.

name: Neern
summary: Neern is a bald temple master of a southern fighting style who escaped a burned monastery and later faced a rival in a duel to the death. Neern is presumed lost in the fight.

feats.scene: Neern cracks a stack of roof tiles with an open palm.
Neern is struck by a spear shaft and merely exhales.

name: Rnlita
summary: Rnlita is a wealthy socialite who hides behind a mask and runs a fixed gambling ring at an amusement park. Rnlita is soon exposed by a stronger hero.

feats.scene: Rnlita slams a dice cup against a roulette table.
Rnlita is dragged across a carnival floor and gasps.

name: Veval
summary: Veval is a friendly newsroom intern who fetches coffee and laundry for a demanding reporter and eventually earns a staff badge. Veval shares an apartment with a close friend.

feats.scene: Veval hefts a box of newspapers onto a desk.
Veval trips over a cable and catches a desk.

name: Lentvas
summary: Lentvas is a mechanic and former sports star who fused with an old scientist into a nuclear-powered hybrid after a lab explosion. Lentvas later lost the fusion when his partner died.

feats.scene: Lentvas merges and vaporizes the center of an empty freight depot in a flash.
Lentvas weathers a tower collapse with a faint glow.

name: Raltilore
summary: Raltilore is a high-school teacher and former track champion who channels lightning to shield his old neighborhood from a gang. Raltilore trades speeches for sparks.

feats.scene: Raltilore fires a crackling bolt that blows apart a parked sedan.
Raltilore raises a sparking barrier against a hail of gunfire.

name: Nurnutor
summary: Nurnutor is a school principal whose body was cursed into dark living lightning and confined to a spectral vessel. Nurnutor can sense disturbances in the earth's field and fly as a bolt.

feats.scene: Nurnutor discharges a black bolt that gouges a trench across a road.
Nurnutor disperses into sparks as a patrol vehicle explodes beside him.
Nurnutor streaks over a skyline as a black bolt.

name: Amoveoor
summary: Amoveoor is a decathlete turned educator in a toy-brick city who learned to hold back inborn electric gifts for years. Amoveoor returns to a rough district with a family in tow.

feats.scene: Amoveoor releases a crackle that melts the lock of a warehouse gate.
Amoveoor shakes off a stun baton hit and smiles.

name: Ventior
summary: Ventior is a city pimp and dealer who works for a crime clan and runs into a masked vigilante early on. Ventior has a brother in the same racket.

feats.scene: Ventior slaps a thug across the face in a bar.
Ventior is thrown over a table and lands wheezing.

name: Sonvaure
summary: Sonvaure is a bald, quiet man whose worn photograph with a friend carries deep value. Sonvaure speaks rarely and carries the picture everywhere.

feats.scene: Sonvaure taps a table in thought and rattles a cup.
Sonvaure takes a stumble on a curb and recovers.

name: Onttelcor
summary: Onttelcor is a gifted assistant to a chronology explorer, an expert on time mechanics and energy-matter relationships. Onttelcor lives in a cluttered lab with a time-sphere.

feats.scene: Onttelcor throws a lever and a time-sphere hums, scattering loose tools.
Onttelcor holds on during a jolting trip through the stream.

name: Mianolmi
summary: Mianolmi is a pink-skinned royal heiress who hides a serpentine form and projects illusions that overwhelm every sense. Mianolmi flies on a ring and sees through falsehoods.

feats.scene: Mianolmi casts a dream that traps a squad of guards in their own heads.
Mianolmi shrugs off a thrown bolt without losing concentration.

name: Auiaos
summary: Auiaos is a red-skinned, hairless alien criminal who reads minds, bends wills, and blasts energy. Auiaos intimidates foes more than he brawls.

feats.scene: Auiaos fires a ruby burst that blasts a bus on its side.
Auiaos stops a tank shell with his chest.

name: Vaceoeo
summary: Vaceoeo is a tall, yellow-eyed, red-skinned prince from a moon colony who allies with a green hero and prays to a distant sun-god. Vaceoeo holds a cloned heritage.

feats.scene: Vaceoeo punches a transport door off a hangar bay.
Vaceoeo withstands a crashing shuttle without injury.

name: Auleseo
summary: Auleseo is a blond sidekick-thief who helps a master burglar with schemes across a crowded city. Auleseo has quick fingers and a quicker tongue.

feats.scene: Auleseo pries a window latch with a thin tool.
Auleseo drops from a fire escape and rolls out.

name: Rniesce
summary: Rniesce is a lead scientist at a research lab in a big city who analyzes strange visitors with patience. Rniesce keeps calm during crises.

feats.scene: Rniesce slams a lab door shut on a gale of smoke.
Rniesce is tossed by a tremor and grips a counter.

name: Eorreola
summary: Eorreola is a young runner from a far-future era who joins a family of speedsters to fight a time-hopping gang. Eorreola has amber eyes and endless energy.

feats.scene: Eorreola dashes through a steel gate and leaves a clean opening.
Eorreola skids across asphalt and stands without a mark.
Eorreola outruns a shockwave over a plain.

name: Nansasar
summary: Nansasar is a red-haired twin from a dark future who wields hard-light constructs across the entire emotional palette. Nansasar emerges in the past and glows with different hues.

feats.scene: Nansasar constructs a giant hard-light hammer and flattens a warehouse.
Nansasar conjures a glowing shield against a missile.
Nansasar flies over a city skyline in a streak of color.

name: Teinte
summary: Teinte is a brown-haired woman who sees visions of the future and feels the distress of a twin through an empathic link. Teinte follows the visions to track a detective and a killer.

feats.scene: Teinte shoves open a stuck motel door.
Teinte falls on a gravel path and brushes herself off.

name: Eontonan
summary: Eontonan is a bank employee and childhood friend of a hero who once posed as a married hostage to help a mission. Eontonan lives quietly in a big river city.

feats.scene: Eontonan slams a vault drawer shut.
Eontonan stays calm while being roughly grabbed.

name: Eotiuto
summary: Eotiuto is an ancient spirit of craft powered by the defining tool of her era, living inside communication lines and carrying heavy current. Eotiuto drank heavily after a long peace talk.

feats.scene: Eotiuto surges through cables and blows out a city block of lights.
Eotiuto scatters into signals and reforms after a blast.

name: Stitireon
summary: Stitireon is a white-haired sorceress from a hidden land who uses spells against oppressors. Stitireon is the daughter of a pilot turned warlord.

feats.scene: Stitireon calls a fireball that scorches a fortress gate.
Stitireon is thrown into a pillar and rises with a sigil flaring.

name: Osalia
summary: Osalia is a corporeal spirit of a century who aged herself to teen years to fight a menace and now leads a team on a flying fortress. Osalia is adopted by a pair of heroes.

feats.scene: Osalia bends reality and flattens an entire district in a heartbeat.
Osalia shrugs off a warhead detonation against her chest.

name: Stuva
summary: Stuva is a green-skinned, green-eyed water hag who crawls out of the muck when a drowned god reclaims the seas. Stuva possesses minds and bends plants.

feats.scene: Stuva drags a moored boat under with a lash of vines.
Stuva takes a harpoon in the chest and laughs.

name: Nieoial
summary: Nieoial is a university con artist who survived a bombed cathedral with insect wings and a sonic voice. Nieoial joins a resistance and grows loyal.

feats.scene: Nieoial belts a sonic howl that topples a stone arch.
Nieoial is buried in rubble and climbs out.
Nieoial buzzes over the ruined streets between rooftops.

name: Tarostu
summary: Tarostu is a black-haired mystic cult leader who clashes with a stage magician and meets a quick end. Tarostu chants in a mountain temple.

feats.scene: Tarostu strikes a temple gong with a ritual mallet.
Tarostu is hit by a magician's trick and staggers.

name: Sornienu
summary: Sornienu is a chemist with a gift for formulas who is blackmailed by a pharmaceutical firm and hunted for a stolen compound. Sornienu loses memories after a rescue.

feats.scene: Sornienu slams a lab flask rack onto a bench.
Sornienu survives a long interrogation in suspended sleep.

name: Racor
summary: Racor is a black-haired museum staffer in a small port town who catalogs artifacts at night. Racor lives a quiet bachelor life.

feats.scene: Racor lifts a crate of relics onto a shelf.
Racor bumps a display and steadies it.

name: Telnautal
summary: Telnautal is a seven-year-old merged with a guardian angel, gaining wings, leaps, and vast speed to rescue a hero from a clown. Telnautal loses innocence and power after being tortured.

feats.scene: Telnautal smashes a basement wall with a radiant fist.
Telnautal shrugs off a sledge swing and keeps smiling.
Telnautal darts across the sky in a streak of white feathers.

name: Levor
summary: Levor is a bald, white-eyed wrestler who swells into a hulking titan and bests foes with brute strength. Levor transfers a friend's mind into a chip in his spare time.

feats.scene: Levor swells and hurls a wrestling ring post through a barrier.
Levor takes a belt-boosted punch and stays upright.

name: Mitoram
summary: Mitoram is a purple-skinned biochemist and professor who transforms into a huge titan to fight in an interstellar war. Mitoram mourns a lost love and quits the team.

feats.scene: Mitoram swells and punches a bunker into rubble.
Mitoram stands through a missile barrage with soot-stained skin.

name: Anistveo
summary: Anistveo is a gambler whose flesh was seared away and replaced by a cursed deck that flies off at command and slices. Anistveo escapes prisons and joins a rogue crew.

feats.scene: Anistveo flings razor-edged cards that slice a parked car in two.
Anistveo shrugs off a collision with a rampaging brute.

name: Numoreasi
summary: Numoreasi is a pacifist street hero in a rough district, murdered by a mob before he could do much. Numoreasi is remembered as a trailblazer in a case file.

feats.scene: Numoreasi shoves a door open and calls for the kids to stop.
Numoreasi takes a thrown bottle without retaliating.

name: Lerosaan
summary: Lerosaan is a green-skinned adventurer from a steamy planet who pilots aircraft and fires a blaster alongside a friend. Lerosaan is possibly amphibious, though unproven.

feats.scene: Lerosaan fires a blaster that blows a hole in a crate wall.
Lerosaan survives a rough landing in a cockpit and climbs out.

name: Vitau
summary: Vitau is a sickly hermit who blames every machine and potion for a failing body, and turns to forbidden rites to drag the whole world back to an age of mud and silence. The rites open a crack toward an older realm whose masters are not fooled.

feats.scene: Vitau finishes a chanted rite that tears a shimmering crack in the air and hurls a market stall across the square.
Vitau shrugs off a blow from a cudgel while wrapped in a ward of scratched bone.

name: Nasse
summary: Nasse is a widowed farmer with white hair and a stubborn streak who will not sell the old homestead, no matter how many bribes, threats and mysterious accidents arrive at the gate. Neighbors rally to keep the roof over his head.

feats.scene: Nasse swings a wooden gate shut on a trespasser with a loud crack.
Nasse stands unmoved in a doorway as a gust of burning gas rolls past him.

name: Lloreo
summary: Lloreo is a scarred, grinning carnival runaway who preaches that order is a cage and sanity is a joke. He gathers a cult of followers, dies, returns, and keeps bending to a cleverer sibling's will.

feats.scene: Lloreo detonates a crate of stage fireworks in a crowded tent and scatters the audience.
Lloreo climbs back to his feet after a fall from the top of a ferris wheel.

name: Nusrni
summary: Nusrni is a gentle red-haired girl who lives in a sprawling country house and does not understand why strangers keep threatening her family. Her brother and a masked friend always arrive in time.

feats.scene: Nusrni shoves a heavy parlor door shut against a hurrying intruder.
Nusrni tumbles down the porch steps and rises with only a scraped knee.

name: Siaros
summary: Siaros is a pipe-smoking old salt who sails a battered boat across warm islands with a single loyal deckhand, finding small adventures four panels at a time. He is a capable brawler when a dock fight breaks out.

feats.scene: Siaros lands a roundhouse punch that drops a dockside smuggler.
Siaros rides out a storm swell that slams him against the mast.

name: Ianlon
summary: Ianlon is a calm brown-haired tactical commander who leads a rapid-response squad through the worst nights a rebuilt city can offer. He is trusted, honest and quick with a sidearm.

feats.scene: Ianlon fires a controlled burst through a hostage taker's pistol and ends the standoff.
Ianlon takes a vest-stopped round in the chest and keeps directing his squad.

name: Tellu
summary: Tellu is a bumbling young man whose every errand turns into a calamity, tormented by a mischievous nephew and rescued by the luck of the foolish. He meets all manner of masked heroes and understands none of it.

feats.scene: Tellu swings a rolled newspaper and accidentally topples a shelf of crockery.
Tellu survives a flight through a plate glass window with a bruised pride.

name: Valler
summary: Valler is a red-haired schemer obsessed with headwear, who kidnaps a jury to ransom a collection of historic caps. His heists revolve around one prize above all, the cowl of a caped rival.

feats.scene: Valler fires a spring-loaded hat that knocks a guard's feet from under him.
Valler is thrown across a ballroom and gets up adjusting his collar.

name: Cesronsan
summary: Cesronsan is a grey-haired inmate in a far-future ward, moved from one hospital to another when his old asylum closes. His mind has frayed, but the ward keeps him docile.

feats.scene: Cesronsan throws a tin tray that clatters against the cell bars.
Cesronsan sits through a transport ride that tumbles his cot across the floor.

name: Nausonlan
summary: Nausonlan is a brown-haired inmate and gadget tinkerer who hacks terminals and builds contraptions from salvaged wiring. His rhyme-and-riddle gang counts him as the genius at the back.

feats.scene: Nausonlan rigs a car battery to zap a door lock free in a shower of sparks.
Nausonlan takes a jolt from his own wiring and keeps typing.

name: Rioraiu
summary: Rioraiu is a white-haired hacker who builds headbands that bend a wearer's will, selling the trick to a masked clown's crew. Each band is a small fragile circuit and a large amount of nerve.

feats.scene: Rioraiu discharges a band's capacitor and bends a guard to his will for a moment.
Rioraiu ducks a thrown chair and tumbles behind a console.

name: Asamori
summary: Asamori is a pink-skinned guardian of a peaceful world who breaks her people's creed to save them, wiping out an entire invasion fleet by herself and then leaving home in shame. Her ring answers to her will.

feats.scene: Asamori sweeps a green lance of light through an armada's formation and cracks every hull in it.
Asamori holds a shimmering shield against a salvo of ship cannons.

name: Cinniasil
summary: Cinniasil is a quiet runner from a neighboring reality who crosses over to warn a world of a plot, then stays to help hold its heroes together. A hidden identity and a secret romance complicate every mission.

feats.scene: Cinniasil punches through a hovering barricade at running speed and flings it into the harbor.
Cinniasil dashes across a lake faster than the ripples can spread.

name: Miliumias
summary: Miliumias is a blonde courier paid to carry a wealthy man out of harm's way when disaster strikes. She delivers him in time, goes back for the others, and is a half step too slow.

feats.scene: Miliumias skids to a stop and her wake of wind overturns a row of parked trucks.
Miliumias endures the heat of a falling fireball long enough to shield a frightened child.

name: Astal
summary: Astal is a blonde sprinter who shares a bloodline of swift heroes and a stormy marriage. Erased once, trapped in a stream of motion, and restored again, she tells young runners that heroes do not back down.

feats.scene: Astal rockets through a convoy of armored trucks, leaving each flipped on its side.
Astal outruns a ricocheting rocket and catches it from behind.

name: Ternurn
summary: Ternurn is a fair-haired boy who walks off a near-crash with borrowed gifts from a lightning strike, and is soon dragged into a kidnapping plot. The gifts fade with use, and he goes back to ordinary school days.

feats.scene: Ternurn hurls a parked van across a lot and giggles at the noise.
Ternurn bounces a thrown pipe off his shoulder without noticing.

name: Nennau
summary: Nennau is a woman who spent years hiding behind a locked door after a roadside killing, until a dying alien lawman knocks and hands her a green ring of will. She leaves her home town for a living moon.

feats.scene: Nennau shapes a green hammer of light and flattens a rusted tower in one swing.
Nennau holds a wall of green glow against a pile of falling rubble.

name: Tiurusnt
summary: Tiurusnt is a brown-haired woman who beat down her crippling fear after a gang killed her friends, wrestled free of a haunted ring, and took up a green one. Her light constructs grow as her nerve does.

feats.scene: Tiurusnt fires a green beam through a derelict barge and splits it down the keel.
Tiurusnt braces a glowing shield against a shower of blaster fire.

name: Lluontser
summary: Lluontser is a blonde civic leader who loses her twin to a gunman and half her face to an explosion, and develops a second self that mirrors the dead sibling. She runs the underworld from the mayor's chair.

feats.scene: Lluontser fires a coin-flipped shot that shatters a window across a hall.
Lluontser endures the blast of a bombed corridor with a scarred cheek.

name: Llant
summary: Llant is a blonde federal agent whose partner is killed by a shapeshifting spy. Fooled once, she vows to catch the impostor, and enlists an old friend and a captive clone to do it.

feats.scene: Llant fires a service pistol and pins a fleeing suspect's jacket to a wall.
Llant takes a body slam from a bigger agent and returns a clean hook.

name: Invarer
summary: Invarer is a yellow-skinned minstrel with red eyes who haunts rocky crags and trades in banned songs and half-told tales. His voice carries secrets nobody should hear.

feats.scene: Invarer holds a note so high that a wall of loose stone shatters.
Invarer drifts through a falling rockslide and comes out dusty.

name: Tiserlu
summary: Tiserlu is a quiet craftsman and preacher whose words are borrowed by modern speakers to warn that lifting a society up can get a person killed. His legend is told, not shown.

feats.scene: Tiserlu planes a plank until it shines and sets it against a doorframe.
Tiserlu walks a long dusty road under a hot sun without complaint.

name: Stmiul
summary: Stmiul is a gentle teacher whose touch is said to heal, calm and cast out dark things, and whose drinking vessel and robe keep a share of his grace. A rescuer in later years remembers his kindness without condition.

feats.scene: Stmiul lays a hand on a sick child and a golden warmth floods the room.
Stmiul faces a jeering crowd and takes their blows without raising a hand.

name: Niran
summary: Niran is a brown-haired yellow-skinned officer of a galactic peacekeeping force, a respected mentor who trained a promising student. Her ring flies, shields and fires bolts, and her body rests among fallen colleagues.

feats.scene: Niran fires a lance of green light that cleaves a rogue asteroid in half.
Niran holds a glowing barrier steady against a barrage of cannon fire.

name: Oretomi
summary: Oretomi is a black-haired mercenary from a moon whose people have lost their voices and speak only by thought. She reads minds, projects words and has a talent for planting an idea where it will do the most harm.

feats.scene: Oretomi sends a sharp mental jolt that makes a guard drop his weapon.
Oretomi rolls clear of a stun volley with a short grunt.

name: Cilarore
summary: Cilarore is a red-haired former catwalk model who inherits a small country after her adoptive father is toppled. She carries a letter from a doomed mother and a grudge that a secret club knows how to use.

feats.scene: Cilarore slaps a champagne glass out of a rival's hand and it hits the far wall.
Cilarore keeps her poise through a long fall on a hard marble stair.

name: Serresti
summary: Serresti is a brown-haired former dancer turned undead biker queen who leads a pack of hungry women across the desert at night. A cruel master forces her to bring fresh victims, and she hates him more each time.

feats.scene: Serresti rips a motorcycle fork from its frame and swings it like a club.
Serresti walks out of a roadside crash with a split jaw that knits shut.

name: Celiureo
summary: Celiureo is a black-haired deity of truth and learning who raised a young prince as her own. Her gifts come from a dark world of origin, and include bolts of pale fire, sharp wits and stepping between planes.

feats.scene: Celiureo hurls a pale bolt that shears the crown from a sea cliff.
Celiureo stands calm as a wall of tidal surf crashes over her temple.

name: Ronra
summary: Ronra is a patient aunt from a shapeshifting people who raised her sister's children when their father was away. A first trip off her home world ends in an ambush by an old grudge-bearer.

feats.scene: Ronra swats a thrown crate aside with a firm sweep of her arm.
Ronra shakes off a stun bolt after a moment of dizziness.

name: Losau
summary: Losau is a black-haired scientist who kills her husband, lies about it, and allies with a rival time-tinkerer to wreck a quiet college town. Her gadgets bend the clock, but her plans keep coming undone.

feats.scene: Losau fires a time-twisting device that ages a brick wall into dust.
Losau shrugs off a clumsy tackle in the lab and fires back.

name: Ntlico
summary: Ntlico is a hardy warrior from a lofty race of star-born giants, tireless in battle and stronger than any mortal soldier. He is sent to hunt dangerous beasts that threaten a far-off colony.

feats.scene: Ntlico hurls a boulder the size of a house through a monster's carapace.
Ntlico walks through a collapsing cliff and brushes off the dust.

name: Noeoniu
summary: Noeoniu is a black-haired graduate student who inherits a dead scientist's research, and uses it to shrink to the size of a bug while keeping her full strength. She joins a team of heroes in a world short on men.

feats.scene: Noeoniu pops to full size and shoulders a locked door off its frame.
Noeoniu drops from a high ledge at tiny size and lands unhurt.

name: Eonveoar
summary: Eonveoar is a black-haired spirit of vengeance pulled wherever a pair of cursed pistols want to go. She slips through walls, vanishes and reappears, and tries to atone for old wrongs by leading a team through time.

feats.scene: Eonveoar fires both cursed pistols through a steel door and the bolt hisses across the hall.
Eonveoar lets a thrown dagger pass through her without a mark.

name: Liasti
summary: Liasti is a red-haired assistant who keeps a busy newsroom running, and relocates with her colleagues when rising water makes the old city unlivable. She is cheerful and quietly resourceful.

feats.scene: Liasti hauls a stack of file boxes up a flight of steps in one go.
Liasti wades through knee-deep floodwater with a heavy bag and a smile.

name: Misti
summary: Misti is a blonde party girl known for ever-changing hair dye, who drifts through a green-skinned friend's past and later returns to comfort him through his grief. She is loyal if flighty.

feats.scene: Misti flings a pillow with surprising force and knocks a lamp from the table.
Misti dances all night and bounces back at dawn with a grin.

name: Seticis
summary: Seticis is a stern infantry officer who defends a fortified island base, survives the sinking of his patrol boats, and blows up an enemy arsenal with a fire-starter made from field glasses. He fights by wit and grit.

feats.scene: Seticis sets off a shed of stacked shells and the whole depot goes up in a roaring flash.
Seticis wades ashore after a bomber wrecks his boat and shakes off the cold.

name: Veoentse
summary: Veoentse is a shuttle pilot whose body is destroyed by a burst of strange radiation, then reforms from soil and scrap in a form that brings him agony. His new body is strong and tough, but weak against magnetic pulls.

feats.scene: Veoentse smashes a fist through a loading dock wall and flings a girder across the yard.
Veoentse walks through a collapsing hangar door and keeps his stride.

name: Lisst
summary: Lisst is a small, hairless shellfish kept as a pet by an aquatic teen. It is round, black-eyed and mostly just sits there looking pleased.

feats.scene: Lisst snaps shut on a drifting strand of weed and holds on.
Lisst sits through a tumbling wave and stays firmly closed.

name: Nesce
summary: Nesce is a blue-eyed farmer from the south who rose to the highest office in the land and then spent years working on peace and houses for the poor. He is a soft-spoken, determined leader.

feats.scene: Nesce drives a fence post into hard ground with a mallet in four swings.
Nesce works a long day in the field under a blazing sun.

name: Arntnan
summary: Arntnan is a brown-haired government liaison who helps a hero cross the sea for a business meeting and buys him time with a round of golf. He fades from the story as quietly as he arrived.

feats.scene: Arntnan drives a golf ball clean over a distant fence.
Arntnan sits through a rough overnight flight and steps off fresh.

name: Tanirnco
summary: Tanirnco is a red-haired mercenary with a split personality who smiles like a friend and strikes from behind. He is hired for his acting skill, his camera and his handgun in an attack on a heroes' tower.

feats.scene: Tanirnco fires a handgun from behind a curtain and shatters a trophy case.
Tanirnco shrugs off a hard shove and slips away through the crowd.

name: Sonter
summary: Sonter is a bald sorceress who commands the wind, throws bolts of force and green flame, dissolves solid matter, and shakes the ground under her enemies. She works for hire in a band of villains and is bailed out more than once.

feats.scene: Sonter hurls a green flame that melts a parked bus into slag.
Sonter shrugs off a battering volley behind a shimmering ward.

name: Eonvatu
summary: Eonvatu is a pink-haired thief and bounty hunter who spins whirlwinds, blinds foes with a flash, bends minds and vanishes in a swirl of wind. She is a sly ex-lover who allies with a team, briefly.

feats.scene: Eonvatu flings a bolt of green light that bursts a stack of crates.
Eonvatu withstands a lunge from a snarling horde before she vanishes.

name: Silceo
summary: Silceo is a blond henchman who can open a round doorway between two places and step through it. He is the man a crime boss sends when somebody needs to be in two spots at once.

feats.scene: Silceo opens a round gate and shoves a guard through to the far side of the building.
Silceo ducks through his own gate to avoid a swinging crowbar.

name: Naunan
summary: Naunan is a black-eyed young alien from a far-future club of teen heroes who rides the sky with a small ring. He is strong, fast and eager, and arrives in a world that never knew him.

feats.scene: Naunan stands in a burst of plasma and comes out singed but grinning.

name: Iurnute
summary: Iurnute is a brown-haired teen from a distant century who joins a cartoon detective crew on a haunted case. He is cheerful, brave and a little out of his depth.

feats.scene: Iurnute takes a fall through a rotten floor and dusts himself off.

name: Telsaunan
summary: Telsaunan is a black-haired circus performer who is tricked into posing as a famous heroine, and nearly fools everybody. A sceptical suitor sees through her kiss.

feats.scene: Telsaunan flips off a trapeze and kicks a lamp stand across the ring.
Telsaunan tumbles off a high wire into a net and bounces up.

name: Orsas
summary: Orsas is a blonde newspaper reporter who chases leads across town with a notebook and a sharp tongue. She digs up stories that others miss.

feats.scene: Orsas slams a press door open and startles a clerk.
Orsas stays on her feet through a pushing crowd outside a courthouse.

name: Oreon
summary: Oreon is a red-haired married scientist who helps her husband build a machine that shows visions of a coming disaster. She looks uncannily like someone else's lost mother, and her world is later erased and restored.

feats.scene: Oreon flips a lab switch and a bank of coils discharges in a sheet of blue sparks.
Oreon shelters behind a steel bench as a console shorts out.

name: Viauau
summary: Viauau is a brown-haired mother in a small mill town who raises a son bound for an extraordinary life. She worries, cooks and waits by the phone.

feats.scene: Viauau carries a heavy laundry basket up a steep flight of stairs.
Viauau sits through a long cold night at a hospital bedside.

name: Esteaul
summary: Esteaul is an orange-haired peacekeeper of a galactic corps who wears a ring that conjures shields, bolts and sky-borne flight. She patrols a quiet sector and falls in a later war.

feats.scene: Esteaul fires a green bolt that splits a derelict freighter along its seam.
Esteaul braces behind a glowing shield as a missile salvo bursts against it.

name: Rusval
summary: Rusval is a gang boss with an ice-throwing gun, who prowls the aftermath of a long war looking for easy scores. His frozen shots coat street corners in sheets of white.

feats.scene: Rusval fires his frost gun and a loading dock freezes solid in one sweep.
Rusval shrugs off a tackle on a slick of his own ice.

name: Escoriu
summary: Escoriu is a red-eyed assassin and spy who breaks out of a prison cell in space and joins a ragtag crew of thieves. She favors knives and quiet exits, and is beaten by a loudmouth brawler.

feats.scene: Escoriu pins a guard's sleeve to a door with a thrown knife.
Escoriu takes a rough fall from a fire escape and slips away.

name: Lorsenum
summary: Lorsenum is a white-skinned, red-haired criminal who slips free of a cell block with a crowd of other villains. She is a minor threat with a long list of grudges.

feats.scene: Lorsenum shoulders a guard through a swinging door.
Lorsenum crawls out of a collapsed vent shaft and keeps running.

name: Corornu
summary: Corornu is a red-haired schoolgirl who loses weight too fast after a strange meal, and discovers she can pull body fat out of living things. Hunger drives her to hurt people she does not want to hurt.

feats.scene: Corornu drains a classmate with one touch and he crumples to the floor.
Corornu walks away from a car crash with hardly a scrape.

name: Stillnti
summary: Stillnti is a brown-haired racketeer who takes in his widowed sister-in-law and her children, and treats them as unpaid servants. His meeting room is hidden behind a fake wall.

feats.scene: Stillnti backhands a crate off a table and it slams into the wall.
Stillnti shoulders through a locked door and keeps going.

name: Vartir
summary: Vartir is a curly-haired enforcer in a crime family who takes orders and breaks bones at the back of a restaurant. His career is short.

feats.scene: Vartir swings a bat into a car's side mirror and it flies across the street.
Vartir takes a punch to the jaw and laughs.

name: Restiu
summary: Restiu is a street criminal with a pistol, a bad temper and a cheap suit. His gun is a battered thing that he treats as a lucky charm.

feats.scene: Restiu fires a pistol and shatters a streetlamp bulb.
Restiu takes a shove into a brick wall and stays upright.

name: Celillli
summary: Celillli is a dark-haired hood who runs with a smiling boss and snatches a pearl necklace in a back alley. A scuffle leaves two dead, and he flees in panic.

feats.scene: Celillli wrenches a necklace free in one hard tug.
Celillli is grabbed and shoved against a wall and breaks loose.

name: Rossil
summary: Rossil is a blue-eyed mugger who is a punchline in a cartoon where his past crime is retold as a ridiculous stage show. He is more embarrassed than dangerous.

feats.scene: Rossil fires a pistol at a streetlamp and misses by a mile.
Rossil flops off a stage and bounces back up.

name: Lenole
summary: Lenole is a shadowy street criminal who prowls alleys after dark in a cold gray city. Little is known about him beyond a grim reputation.

feats.scene: Lenole swings a pipe into a dumpster and dents it.
Lenole tumbles down a stairwell and walks away.

name: Toram
summary: Toram is a white-haired old thug who retires to a far city and takes a job with a smuggling ring. Frail and slow, he is caught at his hideout and frozen by a cold-wielding villain.

feats.scene: Toram shoves open a heavy steel door with a grunt.
Toram stands in a freezing draft for a long minute before he falters.

name: Corarami
summary: Corarami is a bald, yellow-eyed man who absorbs the gifts of a whole team of heroes, only to be cut down and scattered in pieces. Rival groups hunt the remains, and a puppet-master rebuilds him.

feats.scene: Corarami hammers a fist through a building front and the floors sag behind it.
Corarami shrugs off a volley of rifle rounds and keeps walking.

name: Sesesia
summary: Sesesia is a dark-haired royal from a red-skinned people on a far moon, one of the rare few of his line who can fly. He is strong, mind-reading and survives longer than most of his kin.

feats.scene: Sesesia lifts a loaded freight cart overhead and tosses it across a gorge.
Sesesia soars over the capital faster than a hunting hawk.

name: Ntivali
summary: Ntivali is a young barmaid at a roadside inn between worlds, where she pours drinks for travelers of every kind. She falls for a visitor, forgives a clumsy deception, and befriends a lost girl.

feats.scene: Ntivali slaps a rude patron and he spins into a table.
Ntivali walks through a howling storm to find the lost inn.

name: Setocor
summary: Setocor is a blonde noblewoman born in a bygone century who loses her title, raises a daughter alone, and dabbles in magic to win it back. A royal errand sends her to open a box that no one should open.

feats.scene: Setocor chants a binding and a church window bursts in a swirl of colored glass.
Setocor stays upright in a freezing northern gale for hours.

name: Tereonis
summary: Tereonis is a white-haired colonial villain who runs a plantation on a tropical island and clashes with a team of flyers. He is a short-lived antagonist.

feats.scene: Tereonis fires a rifle shot that rings off a tin roof.
Tereonis falls from a verandah rail and gets up cursing.

name: Taulle
summary: Taulle is a convict who turns to crime in reverse, planting frozen explosive sculptures of loot that thaw and blow up after his gang has fled. He speaks his orders backwards over the radio.

feats.scene: Taulle's thawing ice bombs go off one after another and blow out a vault's front wall.
Taulle takes a hard knock from a thrown crate and keeps barking orders.

name: Iumamoco
summary: Iumamoco is a balding, grey-haired lawyer and statesman who helps found a country and then leads it as its second chief. He is stubborn, precise and quarrelsome.
