Ricin is knocked over by a rioter and picks himself up.

name: Amorniser
summary: Amorniser is a vacationing husband who dreams of being locked naked outside his own car and goes house hunting with his spouse. Cheerful and quarrelsome, he wanders through a boarding house full of odd guests.

feats.scene: Amorniser bangs on a car window with his fist until it rattles.
Amorniser slips on a wet staircase and lands on his back without injury.

name: Asiri
summary: Asiri is an underground-born survivor lost for decades in suspended sleep inside a drill capsule. Freed as an adult, he hides inside a convict identity and breaks out whenever his cousin needs a hidden trump card.

feats.scene: Asiri punches through a cavern wall and brings down an entire block of tunnels.
Asiri tanks the collapse of a cavern ceiling without a mark.

name: Stalist
summary: Stalist is a mage fused with a sprawling metropolis who senses every spell cast beneath its streets. His wits wax and wane with the city's mood, and he can fold himself between distant cellars.

feats.scene: Stalist calls the city's buried energy up through the pavement and wrecks a whole warehouse block.
Stalist is hit by a collapsing viaduct and the stones flow around him.

name: Eontorsti
summary: Eontorsti is a rocket-program chief and councillor who funds launches nobody else wants. He mentors younger engineers and ends up helping a time-lost visitor beat a fixed schedule.

feats.scene: Eontorsti fires a needle-rocket from his gantry and it tears through the upper atmosphere.
Eontorsti is knocked flat by a test blast and rises dusty.

name: Soian
summary: Soian is a beacon-bearing frontier officer who was crucified on a wall by native thugs as a warning, then raised as a hollow servant of death. Her few surviving admirers keep her name on a memorial.

feats.scene: Soian sweeps a glowing blade of light through a bunker line and cleaves the entire row.
Soian's shield of light holds as a guard tower falls on her.

name: Raulian
summary: Raulian is a winged heroine who is the latest reincarnation of a cursed heavenly messenger, bound to a lover who once slaughtered nations. She rehearses endings and seems most alive when the world looks finished.

feats.scene: Raulian dives from the clouds and crushes a bridge pier with her mace.
Raulian takes a falling gantry across her wings and flies away.

name: Illori
summary: Illori is a technologist with a perfect memory who can redraw blueprints from a decade ago without a single flaw. She works explosives into every plan she makes.

feats.scene: Illori drops a shaped charge on a vault door and blows it off its hinges.
Illori is thrown across a workshop by her own blast and stands up laughing.

name: Tauall
summary: Tauall is a criminal whose body radiates toxic emerald glare, worn through a flying suit that keeps it from killing him. He is an early nuisance to a far stronger hero.

feats.scene: Tauall blasts a delivery truck apart with a beam of poisonous glare.
Tauall takes a rooftop impact in his armored suit and climbs out.

name: Sianirne
summary: Sianirne is a once-popular schoolboy who absorbed a cursed painting's misfortune and now ruins the luck of his foes by weeping. He outbids rivals on houses they wanted and distracts dangerous captors.

feats.scene: Sianirne weeps and a delivery truck slides into a ditch beside his enemy.
Sianirne is shoved into a locker and sobs until his captor trips.

name: Leonin
summary: Leonin is a pulp-era vigilante who clouds minds with a glowing ring and kills without mercy, announcing himself with an eerie laugh. He may be a time-displaced original or a later successor.

feats.scene: Leonin fires a pistol through a skylight and drops a gunman on a fire escape.
Leonin crashes through a window and hits the street rolling.

name: Valanmi
summary: Valanmi is a lab-grown copy built to serve a cloning cabal, with false memories and a sturdier body than his original. He becomes the original's resentful rival in a long, sour contest.

feats.scene: Valanmi hurls a reactor housing into a lab wall and drops the roof.
Valanmi takes the blast of an exploding compound and walks out ailing but whole.

name: Nauno
summary: Nauno is a sorcerer in a gold cowl who retreats from public heroism after a political purge. He argues that humankind needs new champions and watches from a moonlit banquet of mages.

feats.scene: Nauno casts a bolt of golden fire and brings down a crumbling guard tower.
Nauno raises a ward as a rockslide buries the road around him.

name: Liasoia
summary: Liasoia is a founder of a patriotic strike team whose cloak vanishes him from sight. He works quietly, rarely credited, and is long remembered by his former teammates.

feats.scene: Liasoia tackles an unseen sentry and knocks him cold.
Liasoia drops from a pier onto a barge deck and continues unharmed.

name: Streni
summary: Streni is a motorcycle-loving teen whose guilt-ridden treatment gave him the gift of wiping people's memories. He only wants a clean slate and uses the gift on a driver who blocks his escape.

feats.scene: Streni weeps and a stranger forgets his own name for a week.
Streni falls off a dirt bike on a jump and shakes it off.

name: Vamonser
summary: Vamonser is a mild bookkeeper who shouts a mystical word and swells into a massive golden champion. Years of failing to remember the word cost him decades of heroism.

feats.scene: Vamonser rips a ridge off a mountain and hurls it into a valley.
Vamonser takes a collapsing hillside on his chest and breathes steadily.

name: Terlu
summary: Terlu is a small boy in a busy capital who lives with his mother and father. Little is written about his days beyond his tiny frame and schoolyard daydreams.

feats.scene: Terlu kicks a soccer ball against a brick wall and cracks a pane of glass.
Terlu trips on a curb and bounces up smiling.

name: Aucorar
summary: Aucorar is a tyrant king sealed in a tomb whose corpse swelled to colossal size when a chosen hero woke the sacred seal. A single heroic strike put him down for good.

feats.scene: Aucorar stamps a bandaged foot through a temple floor and flattens a wing.
Aucorar is struck by a falling pillar and breaks it.

name: Nelnumos
summary: Nelnumos is an ancient tyrant sealed away as a ruby insect, able to possess others and swell to titanic size. He feeds on stolen vitality and returns whenever his seal is broken.

feats.scene: Nelnumos swells to the height of a tower and steps through a stone gate.
Nelnumos shrugs off a falling temple lintel without cracking.

name: Cinca
summary: Cinca is a criminal scientist who escaped a world's doom and found frozen travelers drifting in space. He uses a recorded message to lure a young hero into a trap that kills them both.

feats.scene: Cinca hurls a metal sled across a launch yard and shatters a hangar door.
Cinca takes a hard landing on a rocky moon and stands up.

name: Oluentrnu
summary: Oluentrnu is a hulking, rose-skinned drill sergeant who trains rookies aboard a hovering barracks, armed with a wrist-band that conjures glowing constructs. Oluentrnu builds shields from sheer willpower and shoves heavy wreckage aside by hand.

feats.scene: Oluentrnu hurls a conjured wrecking slab through a stone tower and flattens it.
Oluentrnu stands inside a collapsing hangar and shrugs off the falling beams.

name: Nenauso
summary: Nenauso is a broad-shouldered combat teacher who drills new recruits in the arts of fighting, genetics and gadgetry. Nenauso can link minds with kin of the same species and fights with luminous constructs summoned from a power cell.

feats.scene: Nenauso punches a crashed freighter hull apart in a single blow.
Nenauso walks out of a toppled cargo crane without a scratch.

name: Viceose
summary: Viceose is a cartoonish schoolyard guardian with a stubby build and a glowing finger-band. Viceose zips around the playground, blasts bubbles of light, and raises a cheerful shield to protect classmates.

feats.scene: Viceose blasts a toy fortress to rubble with a bright beam.
Viceose bounces off a tumbling slide without a bruise.

name: Nttor
summary: Nttor is a blonde street enforcer for a crooked outfit, riding a humming hoverbike through the avenues. Nttor relies on speed and intimidation rather than any gift.

feats.scene: Nttor swings a steel pipe into a parked van door and dents it deeply.
Nttor takes a hard shove into a brick wall and keeps on riding.
Nttor tears down an avenue on the hoverbike with a squad car in pursuit.

name: Coraure
summary: Coraure is a green-haired water-dweller who dreams of fame and keeps losing opportunities to prove it. Coraure rarely lands a spectacular win, yet stays loyal to friends and refuses to wear glasses for vanity.

feats.scene: Coraure kicks a rusted dock gate off its hinges.
Coraure takes a tumble down a flight of stairs and laughs it off.

name: Seunta
summary: Seunta is a cold, ruthless physicist and former space traveller who can vanish from sight and shape unseen walls of force. Seunta tears steel doors from frames and uses invisible spikes to rupture foes from within.

feats.scene: Seunta wrenches a vault door off its frame and flings it across a lobby.
Seunta shrugs off a falling stone balcony behind a shimmering barrier.

name: Eontin
summary: Eontin is a stern future-era police chief who spends his days wrangling heroes in a crowded capital. Eontin has no gifts beyond rank and caution, and falls to a cult of shapeshifters.

feats.scene: Eontin pounds a desk to silence a noisy briefing room.
Eontin endures a shove from a panicked suspect without falling.

name: Torneorn
summary: Torneorn is a calm astronomer whose body glows with stored starlight, letting her hover through open space unprotected. Torneorn weaves hard-light barriers and blinding flashes from her palms.

feats.scene: Torneorn fires a concentrated beam that carves through a stadium roof.
Torneorn shields a crowd from a collapsing bridge behind a thin pane of light.

name: Riastaore
summary: Riastaore is a government researcher who helped craft countermeasures for a team of powerful guardians. Riastaore hides at a country estate with fellow scientists and dies to a mechanical assassin.

feats.scene: Riastaore slams a laptop shut and storms out of a tense meeting.
Riastaore stumbles against a stone wall and quickly recovers.

name: Numriari
summary: Numriari is a proud star-watcher struck by a beam from a distant sun, which left her able to bend light into weapons and wings. Numriari commands a corporation, leads a hero squad, and fights with fierce radiance.

feats.scene: Numriari unleashes a sunbeam that cuts a ridge in half.
Numriari wraps herself in glare and survives a shockwave that levels a district.

name: Tumtia
summary: Tumtia is a glowing hero who drifts through the background of a strange crossover, present at a funeral for a fallen champion. Tumtia is mostly a witness, and shows only modest feats.

feats.scene: Tumtia flicks a flash of light that stuns a pair of guards.
Tumtia is knocked backward by a blast and rises unharmed.

name: Inlire
summary: Inlire is a blond rogue in a borrowed battle-suit, a fugitive who fires dark pulses at anyone in his path. Inlire serves rival masters in turn and ends up dead in a backstreet brawl.

feats.scene: Inlire fires a dark pulse that rips a parked bus in two.
Inlire's suit holds together after a collision with a stone pillar.

name: Cormia
summary: Cormia is a grey hound who follows his masters across worlds to a cartoon city of tiny sidekicks. Cormia fetches, barks and guards loyally, and never leaves their side.

feats.scene: Cormia clamps down on a bully's sleeve and holds fast.
Cormia tumbles off a high porch and trots away unhurt.
Cormia bolts across a park to reach a thrown stick.

name: Rusne
summary: Rusne is a vain, ageless imp-monarch of a higher plane who bends reality to his whim. Rusne is cruel to his own children, yet admires cunning in them.

feats.scene: Rusne folds a mountain range out of existence with a wave of his hand.
Rusne sits unharmed at the centre of a collapsing palace of mountains.

name: Uleoltia
summary: Uleoltia is a horned demon-lord who lived for centuries on a burning peak before making peace with his old enemies. Uleoltia can change his shape in seventy-two ways and charges into battle to defend his family.

feats.scene: Uleoltia butts a cliff face and brings down a hillside of rock.
Uleoltia endures a storm of divine blades with only bruises.

name: Ralrico
summary: Ralrico is a bald, one-armed outlaw who runs with a band of escapees. Ralrico fights dirty and trusts only a few allies.

feats.scene: Ralrico lands a heavy punch on a guard.
Ralrico takes a blow from a baton and stays upright.

name: Varorcin
summary: Varorcin is a masked young illusionist who inherited the trick of bending light and sound from a mother in a secret order. Varorcin turns invisible, projects false images, and hides a private purpose from team-mates.

feats.scene: Varorcin throws a flare of light that blinds a pursuer.
Varorcin takes a hard tackle in a hallway and stands up quickly.

name: Varamoti
summary: Varamoti is a masked criminal who leads a card-themed gang against a youthful hero. Varamoti trades on theatrics more than skill.

feats.scene: Varamoti swings a club at a window and shatters it.
Varamoti is slammed to the pavement and gets up grumbling.

name: Tatan
summary: Tatan is a white-haired old monarch from a nursery rhyme who acts as an envoy among exiled storybook folk. Tatan prefers negotiation and music over violence.

feats.scene: Tatan raps a cane on a table to call a meeting to order.
Tatan sits through a heated argument without flinching.

name: Races
summary: Races is a towering ape who fights alongside frontier patriots, drawing an enormous bow against redcoats. Races uses size and cunning to scatter enemy lines.

feats.scene: Races looses an oversized arrow that splinters a wooden palisade.
Races withstands cannon fire during a river crossing.

name: Ninasi
summary: Ninasi is a dark-haired schemer who briefly plagued a pair of reporters. Ninasi has no special gifts and relies on bluff.

feats.scene: Ninasi shoves a reporter into a hedge.
Ninasi tumbles down a ramp and shakes it off.

name: Suniaor
summary: Suniaor is a white-haired sorcerer who clashed with a stage magician on a high mountain slope. Suniaor was caught in a landslide and may or may not have survived.

feats.scene: Suniaor hurls a crackling spell that splits a boulder.
Suniaor is buried by tonnes of loose rock and is never found.

name: Saslu
summary: Saslu is a bald, snake-obsessed warlord who tries to seize a ruined planet during a blackout. Saslu fires bolts of raw energy and uses stolen satellite data to move troops.

feats.scene: Saslu blasts a hole through a concrete bunker wall.
Saslu is flung through a lab window and gets up.

name: Llunianto
summary: Llunianto is an ancient subterranean ruler who commands a race of cave-dwellers and answers to a titan. Llunianto cannot die easily and hurls huge boulders at invaders.

feats.scene: Llunianto drives a fist into an avenue and collapses a block of old buildings.
Llunianto climbs from the rubble of a collapsed tunnel unharmed.

name: Necerni
summary: Necerni is a white-haired thug who zips around on a flat scooter, repeatedly arrested and escaping again. Necerni is a nuisance to a cartoon team of heroes and a sprite who keeps interrupting.

feats.scene: Necerni rams a loading dock door with the scooter and splinters it.
Necerni crashes into a stack of crates and climbs out grinning.
Necerni races the scooter down an alley ahead of the police.

name: Terliast
summary: Terliast is a blond organiser who recruits street gang members into a card-themed crew. Terliast leads through contacts and bluster.

feats.scene: Terliast smacks a rival across the jaw during a meeting.
Terliast takes a punch in a parking lot and shrugs.

name: Cesst
summary: Cesst is an eyeless horror dwelling in a hidden layer between worlds, master of a sorrowful puppet. Cesst whips up vortices, summons servants, twists reality and strides between dimensions.

feats.scene: Cesst spins a storm that scours a whole moon down to bare stone.
Cesst endures a blast that bursts a drifting world.

name: Varsir
summary: Varsir is a mysterious feline-themed figure who surfaces in an old tale and a modern reboot. Varsir is known more for mystery than for feats.

feats.scene: Varsir lunges across a rooftop and clips a guard.
Varsir tumbles off a fire escape and lands on his feet.

source_title: King of the Cats II (New Earth)

name: Amlese
summary: Amlese is a bald professor of electrical engineering who builds apparatus to terrorise a rubbery hero. Amlese calls down artificial lightning from rooftop coils.

feats.scene: Amlese discharges a coil array that blackens a factory wall.
Amlese is knocked off his chair by a rival and stays shaken.

name: Siseoni
summary: Siseoni is a hoary bloodsucking lord said to be the very first of his kind, with possible origins in another reality. Siseoni crushes rivals with fearsome strength and mends wounds quickly.

feats.scene: Siseoni rips an iron gate from a crypt entrance and flings it.
Siseoni walks away from a truck collision with torn robes only.

name: Corla
summary: Corla is a red-haired inventor who terrorises sunny islands with a contraption that stirs up violent storms. Corla is a clever schemer, ultimately beaten by a squad of airmen.

feats.scene: Corla's machine whips up a hurricane that flattens a harbour town.
Corla ducks a punch in his lab and stumbles into a console.

name: Taustinil
summary: Taustinil is a white-haired, blue-skinned monarch of a frozen realm who forces captives to farm and to be offered up. Taustinil swims well and wages bitter feuds with a neighbouring queen.

feats.scene: Taustinil strikes a gate with a spear and cracks the ice.
Taustinil dives into frozen water and swims out unharmed.

name: Neterlu
summary: Neterlu is a wealthy mystery man of the forties who slips into gangs by swapping places with members. Neterlu relies on stage make-up, mimicry and sleight of hand.

feats.scene: Neterlu clocks a hoodlum with a quick right hook.
Neterlu takes a thump from a gang boss without breaking his act.

name: Lecosi
summary: Lecosi is a grey-skinned mutant gang boss with sharp jaws and a fish-like hide, once feared across a seaside city. Lecosi wrestles and swims with brutal power and falls ill late in life.

feats.scene: Lecosi smashes a car roof with a single overhead slam.
Lecosi shrugs off a ramming van on a pier.

name: Torvaere
summary: Torvaere is a widowed ruler of a feudal, superstitious planet who tests his daughter's suitor with a quest. Torvaere is immune to a sleeping drug common among his people.

feats.scene: Torvaere raps a sceptre against a stone throne to quiet the hall.
Torvaere resists a dose of sedative that drops guards.

name: Aulti
summary: Aulti is a hungry dandelion spirit that slips into a young woman's body and speaks through her. Aulti fades when starved of attention and squabbles with its partner spirit.

feats.scene: Aulti hurls a chair across a kitchen using borrowed arms.
Aulti endures a heavy fall while riding a borrowed body.

name: Ianeo
summary: Ianeo is a white-haired deity of a river-valley pantheon, keeper of fate-bearing slabs and spouse of his own mother. Ianeo swells to a huge size, reads minds, never dies, and swims through the sea like a native.

feats.scene: Ianeo stamps a cliff and drops an entire mountainside into the sea.
Ianeo stands unmoved as a mountain collapses on him.

name: Iumle
summary: Iumle is a brown-haired scholar's daughter who found she could shape golden light into dazzling bolts and fly. Iumle joins a young team after her parents vanish at an old dig site.

feats.scene: Iumle sends a golden bolt that burns a hole through a warehouse.
Iumle takes a blast from a fanged monster and stays aloft.

name: Tesalsi
summary: Tesalsi is a dark-haired young heroine who turns her body to glowing light to travel at will. Tesalsi stays beside a captive lover in a prison world and later turns up as a ghostly patient.

feats.scene: Tesalsi fires a beam of light that bores through a steel hangar.
Tesalsi bursts into glowing form and takes a cannon shell cleanly.

name: Enttereo
summary: Enttereo is a stern mountain teacher who tests outsiders with a dinner and a long course of training. Enttereo guides a wealthy student in discipline and combat.

feats.scene: Enttereo snaps a wooden post with a single strike.
Enttereo takes a hard kick to the ribs and does not shift.

name: Stiamo
summary: Stiamo is a white-haired sensei high in a remote temple who teaches a deadly trembling-hand strike. Stiamo accepts anyone able to find him and passes no judgment on motives.

feats.scene: Stiamo lays a palm on a stone slab and cracks it through with a faint tremor.
Stiamo rides out a flurry of blows from a trained assassin.

name: Reoceo
summary: Reoceo is a miserly clone mercenary who heals quickly and fights with trained skill. Reoceo works for hire in a firm of heroes, and meets his end at the hands of a broken hunter.

feats.scene: Reoceo drives a spinning kick into a door and splits the frame.
Reoceo recovers within minutes from a deep slash.

name: Olloraan
summary: Olloraan is a bookish zoologist who swallowed a serum and became a winged beast that goes on rampages. Olloraan later befriends the hero who tamed him and mourns a lost spouse.

feats.scene: Olloraan crashes through a rooftop skylight and rips the frame loose.
Olloraan survives a fall through a glass ceiling and flaps away.

name: Enunt
summary: Enunt is a grey-haired, red-eyed soldier who changes into a winged, clawed beast. Enunt hides in a cave and is tracked down by a vengeful hunter.

feats.scene: Enunt tears a truck door off with his claws.
Enunt endures a rifle volley in a cavern and keeps fighting.

name: Sertelso
summary: Sertelso is a gaunt scientist whose cure for illness turned him into a blood-drinking night prowler. Sertelso patrols a gloomy city as a masked protector and grieves for two lost loved ones.

feats.scene: Sertelso hurls a thug through a brick wall.
Sertelso shrugs off a wrecked car hitting his back.

name: Ntniaau
summary: Ntniaau is a dazed chemist who injects himself to become a winged brute with clawed hands and sonar. Ntniaau serves a tyrant's regime as a foot soldier until a trickster knocks him unconscious.

feats.scene: Ntniaau slashes through a steel shutter with his claws.
Ntniaau takes a thrown crate and stays airborne.

name: Eoaula
summary: Eoaula is a green-eyed, comical flapper who joins a dinner of rogues and gets hauled off to jail. Eoaula later whispers a warning of walking corpses.

feats.scene: Eoaula swipes at a candle stand and topples it.
Eoaula bonks into a lamp post and flutters on.

name: Learva
summary: Learva is a pint-sized schoolkid who sprouts wings and fangs and keeps landing in detention. Learva eats lunch in a toy city of tiny helpers.

feats.scene: Learva flaps a paper plane across the cafeteria.
Learva takes a spill from the playground slide and giggles.

name: Veeor
summary: Veeor is a blond washout who siphons the leftover energy from empowered beings and borrows their gifts. Veeor leads a xenophobic gang of rejects and wins fights by stealing power.

feats.scene: Veeor drains a hero's aura and hurls a copied punch through a tower wall.
Veeor soaks up a shock of stolen force and keeps charging.

name: Tacelnan
summary: Tacelnan is a former model and actress raised like a son by a stern officer, and expert in sport, shooting and combat. Tacelnan becomes a spy after a street scrape, working for a secret group.

feats.scene: Tacelnan chops a pimp's neck with a single karate strike.
Tacelnan takes a hard kick during a sparring match and keeps her stance.

name: Ceotator
summary: Ceotator is a brown-haired aeronaut from a bird-like people who soars above the rooftops with a small team. Ceotator is a tribute to a famous winged hero, with a feminine twist.

feats.scene: Ceotator dives into a gunman and bowls him off a rooftop.
Ceotator tumbles through a billboard mid-flight and keeps going.
Ceotator streaks over a city skyline ahead of a helicopter.

name: Ntnal
summary: Ntnal is the daughter of a crime dynasty who is mentioned in passing and stays offstage. Ntnal shares a house with a famous thief as adoptive sister.

feats.scene: Ntnal slaps a rival's hand away at a family dinner.
Ntnal stumbles on a marble stair and recovers quickly.

name: Telseosi
summary: Telseosi is a street-wise teen mapmaker who idolises a famous cat burglar and copies her style. Telseosi lives by petty theft and a network of urchins, charting rival turf for kicks.

feats.scene: Telseosi swings from a fire escape and kicks a thug off a ledge.
Telseosi tumbles down a rooftop stair and shakes it off.

name: Uneoco
summary: Uneoco is a spoiled, blonde bow-handler who robs banks and complains when she has to carry loot. Uneoco mostly tags along with a scheming parent.

feats.scene: Uneoco fires an arrow that pins a guard's sleeve to a vault door.
Uneoco bounces off a revolving door and stamps her foot.

name: Tirnlu
summary: Tirnlu is a bored teenage terrorist who starves for a parent's attention and dons the costumes of rival villains' children. Tirnlu fools a team of heroes with a string of disguises.

feats.scene: Tirnlu hurls a smoke canister that blows a store window out.
Tirnlu tumbles from a fence in disguise and runs on.

name: Ausatiu
summary: Ausatiu is a scheming scientist of a doomed alien world who plots against his own council with two brothers. Ausatiu has the sturdy body of his people, and uses it for villainy.

feats.scene: Ausatiu smashes a lab wall and topples a tower of equipment.
Ausatiu shrugs off a collapsing ceiling during an escape.

name: Taure
summary: Taure is a black-haired syndicate chief who speaks two languages and fights with a blade. Taure took over from a murdered father and leads a secret society.

feats.scene: Taure slices a wooden beam clean in two with a single stroke.
Taure takes a hard blow from a rival and does not give ground.

name: Lortaco
summary: Lortaco is a mechanical figurehead who fronts a scheming warlord's raids on distant worlds. Lortaco is the muscle, and breaks defenders without remorse.

feats.scene: Lortaco swings an iron fist and wrecks a defence gate.
Lortaco stands up after being flattened by a falling wall.

name: Esinilseo
summary: Esinilseo is a grey-haired teacher at a shady academy, quietly rooting for her pupils. Esinilseo lets them slip away to fight corruption and keeps rumours about her past alive.

feats.scene: Esinilseo raps a ruler on a desk and silences the class.
Esinilseo keeps her composure under a harsh scolding.

name: Nainu
summary: Nainu is a gloomy, blue-skinned apprentice sorcerer with a pet cat that she can summon and vanish at will. Nainu fires bursts of raw magic, floats, lifts people without touching them, and cancels others' spells at a cost.

feats.scene: Nainu blasts two cloaked fighters off their feet with a magical burst.
Nainu endures a heavy strike while keeping a spell-cancelling focus.

name: Cernant
summary: Cernant is a witch boy who briefly joined a doomed circle of seven. Cernant seemingly ended his own life under outside influence.

feats.scene: Cernant hurls a minor hex that flips a table.
Cernant is thrown across a room and gets up dizzy.

name: Valrum
summary: Valrum is an ancient, blue-skinned sorcerer born in a puritan village of necromancers, and a pest to demons and teen heroes alike. Valrum keeps a cat familiar and a mischievous streak.

feats.scene: Valrum shatters a stone bell tower with a single curse.
Valrum is buried in rubble from a falling steeple and rises smiling.

name: Levaleo
summary: Levaleo is a bitter cult leader who spent years in a cell sharpening his mind until he could shift objects at a distance. Levaleo wants revenge and loses his gift in a machine mishap.

feats.scene: Levaleo hurls a filing cabinet across a corridor with his mind.
Levaleo collapses under a failed machine and wakes dazed.

name: Autest
summary: Autest is an orange, faceless hunter who can shrink to atoms or swell far taller than a person. Autest reads and controls minds, absorbs energy and fires it back, flies, and feeds on sunlight.

feats.scene: Autest absorbs a lightning bolt and returns it as an explosion that levels a barn.
Autest withstands a tank shell on his enlarged frame.

name: Eoserseo
summary: Eoserseo is an eyeless alien who competes in a multiversal wrestling bout and loses quickly. Eoserseo reads minds, takes control of weak wills, grows larger, and sees in every direction at once.

feats.scene: Eoserseo grows tall in the ring and slams a rival into the mat.
Eoserseo takes a flying tackle from a speedster and gets up.

name: Tonartiu
summary: Tonartiu is a hopping insect used as a mount by a wandering young hero. Tonartiu serves faithfully until killed a few chapters later.

feats.scene: Tonartiu kicks a rusted gate off its posts.
Tonartiu lands hard after a long leap and keeps hopping.
Tonartiu bounds across a ruined highway with a rider.

name: Natesli
summary: Natesli is a golden-skinned drifter who can turn whatever he touches into metal, and eventually transmuted his entire body. Natesli joins a band of outcasts who dislike outsiders and ends up in prison.

feats.scene: Natesli touches a pillar and turns it to metal, then topples it.
Natesli stands unmarked as a hail of bullets bounces off his golden body.

name: Tevasamo
summary: Tevasamo is a pink-skinned warrior woman from a militant empire, built like a tank and quick to fire bolts. Tevasamo flies and hits like a falling beam when she wants to.

feats.scene: Tevasamo fires a bolt that demolishes a warehouse.
Tevasamo takes a falling gantry and keeps fighting.

name: Amneaus
summary: Amneaus is a bald, cold-blooded assassin skilled with a blade who escaped his own execution. Amneaus fears firearms and meets a grisly end in a circus cage.

feats.scene: Amneaus slides a blade between a boss's ribs.
Amneaus is mauled by a big cat and cannot fight back.

name: Stoiaton
summary: Stoiaton is a gangster who a lightning strike and a vial turned into a child that ages backwards and runs at tremendous speed. Stoiaton tricks two visiting youngsters into attacking a masked vigilante.

feats.scene: Stoiaton shoots by at speed and wrecks a parked truck.
Stoiaton plows through a wall at full tilt and keeps running.
Stoiaton blurs through a city crossing and leaves a trail of shattered glass.

name: Eorseamo
summary: Eorseamo is a brown-haired city dweller known only by a nickname. Eorseamo goes about quiet errands and has few notable deeds.

feats.scene: Eorseamo shoves a stuck door open.
Eorseamo bumps into a lamp post and carries on.

name: Anillont
summary: Anillont is a tall red-haired brawler from a warrior sisterhood who changes sides and gives her life to save others. Anillont is mighty, tough, and heals quickly.

feats.scene: Anillont hurls a battleship hull against a cliff and splits the rock.
Anillont is struck by a monster and stands untouched.

name: Oreluser
summary: Oreluser is an exiled warrior of a godly race who settled in a sunny beach town with two wives. Oreluser is immensely strong, heals swiftly, and will outlive nearly everyone.

feats.scene: Oreluser flattens a mountain fortress with one stomp.
Oreluser bears a falling mountain face without damage.

name: Levetan
summary: Levetan is a godly warrior who lives in a sunlit island city in a twisted timeline, ally of a doom-bringer. Levetan carries unusual strength.

feats.scene: Levetan punches a bridge pylon and drops a road deck into the bay.
Levetan is hit by a truck and walks off.

name: Iasle
summary: Iasle is a brown-haired thief from a spotless future who got bored and fled back in time to rob people. Iasle uses a wish-granting device that builds anything he can imagine, including a machine for travelling through time.

feats.scene: Iasle's device conjures a steel vault that crushes a getaway car.
Iasle tumbles off a lamp post and limps off.

name: Monelco
summary: Monelco is a thief from a distant century who time-travelled to the forties to rob and fight a lantern-bearing foe. Monelco has only been mentioned and not seen in action.

feats.scene: Monelco cracks open a safe with a quick pry.
Monelco drops from a window ledge and rolls away.

name: Ntnaulu
summary: Ntnaulu is the brown-haired brother of a famous champion who wins a contest to guard a shrunken city's adopted world. Ntnaulu works under an alias at a newspaper and teams with his sibling against invaders.

feats.scene: Ntnaulu punches a tank and sends it into a quarry.
Ntnaulu takes a rocket volley without a scratch.

name: Irraucin
summary: Irraucin is a purple-haired schemer who began as a caveman and was gifted a huge mind and long life by an alien overseer. Irraucin manipulates humanity to trigger a flood of metahumans and sets the stage for a cosmic disaster.

feats.scene: Irraucin redirects a power surge that blows out a city grid.
Irraucin survives a blast in his lair and keeps scheming.

name: Amoauau
summary: Amoauau is a quiet resident of an underground community beneath a big lakeside city. Amoauau has no known gifts and few notable deeds.

feats.scene: Amoauau pushes a rusted hatch open.
Amoauau bumps a tunnel wall and rubs his arm.

name: Eonval
summary: Eonval is a grey-haired elder of a sea-dwelling people, bred for crushing depths and sharp senses. Eonval is strong, sturdy and swift, but dies in a failed assassination.

feats.scene: Eonval slams a bulkhead and buckles the plating.
Eonval withstands deep ocean pressure and a ramming sub.

name: Loeona
summary: Loeona is a red-haired vigilante in a spiked harness who fights with a barbed staff and chain gloves. Loeona works from a hidden warehouse with a small crew and flies with a backpack thruster.

feats.scene: Loeona cracks a thug's rifle in half with a staff swing.
Loeona takes a heavy kick and returns a spinning strike.

name: Invillu
summary: Invillu is a ranting criminal who takes hostages in a coastal city and goes mad from silly jokes. Invillu surrenders to a squad of teen heroes.

feats.scene: Invillu shoves a hostage into a chair.
Invillu staggers from a nudge and gives up.

name: Tiuirnco
summary: Tiuirnco is a brown-haired financier turned terrorist leader who claims to be the rebirth of a serpent goddess. Tiuirnco runs an investment firm by day and a cult by night.

feats.scene: Tiuirnco slams a ledger on a boardroom table.
Tiuirnco is shoved by an aide and stays upright.

name: Celoter
summary: Celoter is a red-eyed villain who robs worlds of warmth and light by drawing on sunlight of every colour. Celoter serves a powerful queen and hates a band of young heroes.

feats.scene: Celoter pours out stored heat that boils a lake and fuses a shoreline to glass.
Celoter soaks a blast that would melt a bridge and keeps walking.

name: Estsi
summary: Estsi is a blue-furred space monkey cloned for a scientist's amusement. Estsi pesters whoever feeds him and does little else.

feats.scene: Estsi swats a bowl off a console.
Estsi falls off a shelf and chatters.

name: Orseeo
summary: Orseeo is a pink-haired girl who plays hidden-picture games on a children's show with her best friend. Orseeo is friendly and has no apparent gifts.

feats.scene: Orseeo throws a soft ball across a studio.
Orseeo trips over a prop and laughs.

name: Seosircer
summary: Seosircer is a tall, orange-skinned elder princess who grew up scorned and bitter and now craves the throne. Seosircer sells out family for power and is a rival to her younger sister.

feats.scene: Seosircer rips a gate from a palace wall and hurls it.
Seosircer walks away from a falling spire.

name: Rertoenu
summary: Rertoenu is the scheming eldest sister of a young hero and wants power at any price. Rertoenu trades her sibling to invaders and later arrives in a new world to cause trouble.

feats.scene: Rertoenu hurls a burst of energy that demolishes a house.
Rertoenu takes a blast from a rival and glares back.

name: Nanestval
summary: Nanestval is a green-eyed alien queen who betrayed her kin to an empire for a throne. Nanestval fires bolts of energy, flies, and has great strength.

feats.scene: Nanestval fires a bolt that levels a palace wing.
Nanestval is hit by a falling gantry and keeps standing.

name: Lenumnia
summary: Lenumnia is a squire in a medieval-style world who fights alongside several versions of a hero against an invader. Lenumnia floats, touches things with a mental force, withstands blows, and swings a blacksmith-made sword.

feats.scene: Lenumnia heaves a siege tower over his head and flings it into a moat.
Lenumnia stands up from a mace blow that would crack a boulder.

name: Aucistor
summary: Aucistor is a clone who took up a fallen champion's mantle and keeps a yearly truce with his dead mentor's successor. Aucistor honours both lost heroes and keeps fighting.

feats.scene: Aucistor flattens a crumbling tower with a single punch.
Aucistor takes a falling tower and rises without a scratch.

name: Ntoeo
summary: Ntoeo is a clone of a young hero's friend, raised in a darkened branch of time and made into a leader. Ntoeo touches things with a mental force and weathers harsh blows.

feats.scene: Ntoeo heaves a truck into a bridge and brings the span down.
Ntoeo takes a grain-silo collapse and stands up unhurt.

name: Irniumri
summary: Irniumri is a clawed mercenary who flies and takes jobs from a warlord. Irniumri is a hired hand with little loyalty.

feats.scene: Irniumri slashes through a hull plate with his claws.
Irniumri takes a laser shot and keeps up the chase.

name: Cenau
summary: Cenau is a back-alley enforcer who leans on a crew of rough friends to shake down shopkeepers. Fast with a crowbar and slow with plans, cenau relies on numbers more than nerve.

feats.scene: Cenau folds a steel shutter with one swing of a crowbar.
Cenau stays upright after being slammed against a brick wall by a rival.

name: Lanaslor
summary: Lanaslor is a bronze-age swordmaster who bends the air itself, hurling gusts that flatten palisades and drawing breath out of foes' lungs. Chroniclers of a vanished dynasty named a whole season of storms after this warrior.

feats.scene: Lanaslor spins a gale that flattens a fortified hill village in a single breath.
Lanaslor weathers a falling watchtower while wrapped in a cushion of thickened air.
Lanaslor rides a self-made gust across a river gorge in a few heartbeats.

name: Ontval
summary: Ontval is a cheerful brawler whose skull can pop loose and drift around for an hour, scouting rooftops while the body keeps fighting. A prank-loving rogue, ontval treats it as a party trick.

feats.scene: Ontval headbutts a stone gargoyle off its perch.
Ontval's detached skull bounces down a stairwell and rolls up grinning.
Ontval's floating head darts over a market to spy on a rival.

name: Rusriarus
summary: Rusriarus is a ruthless regional boss who hides a smuggling empire behind a polished office and speeches about togetherness. Cold with money and colder with witnesses, rusriarus rules a frozen industrial city by fear.

feats.scene: Rusriarus beats a defiant clerk senseless with a heavy brass desk lamp.
Rusriarus walks away from a bar-room brawl with only a split lip.

name: Amoorocar
summary: Amoorocar is a mild digger-turned-engineer who rigs ruins with clever pulleys and brittle gadgets. A bookish schemer, amoorocar would rather collapse a tunnel on pursuers than face them.

feats.scene: Amoorocar triggers a rigged tunnel beam so a ceiling of rubble drops on pursuers.
Amoorocar survives a stumble down a crumbling excavation shaft with bruises.

name: Tonco
summary: Tonco runs a smoky basement club and a quiet ring that moves people across borders. Charming at the bar and brutal in the back room, tonco's grip on the district was absolute until an unexpected flame arrived.

feats.scene: Tonco hurls a heavy bottle crate across a cellar into a gang of runaways.
Tonco takes a pistol-whip from a bodyguard gone rogue and keeps issuing orders.

name: Tumliror
summary: Tumliror is a fire-skinned alien princess raised on a lost world who fights with radiant bolts and hurls herself through vacuum without strain. Dazzling in a brawl, tumliror refuses to yield even when buried under falling stone.

feats.scene: Tumliror fires a green bolt that vaporises the face of a rocky ridge.
Tumliror holds her ground as a wall of collapsing masonry buries her.
Tumliror crosses an orbital shipping lane in one long dive.

source_title: Koriand'r (Dark Multiverse: Teen Titans: The Judas Contract)

name: Autesau
summary: Autesau is a sunlit alien envoy who sprints through the void to part warring fleets. Gentle in speech but fierce in the air, autesau flies, lifts hulls and hurls star-bright bolts to keep a peace.

feats.scene: Autesau blasts a derelict warship hull into drifting slag.
Autesau shrugs off a barrage of cruiser cannon fire.
Autesau races between two moons carrying a negotiator.

name: Renilto
summary: Renilto is a scorch-eyed soldier in a war-queen's host who torches towns to flush out hiding enemies. Her fire blasts and soaring leaps make her dreadful in open ground, though a spilled fuel trap proved fatal.

feats.scene: Renilto engulfs a stone chapel in white flame until its roof falls in.
Renilto shrugs off a volley of lances without a scratch.

name: Restilrnu
summary: Restilrnu is a gold-eyed alien champion in a tomorrow-world who feeds on light, hurls bolts and holds the line for a young band of heroes. Tireless and tough, restilrnu learns any tongue within hours.

feats.scene: Restilrnu launches a blazing bolt that cracks a steel dam in half.
Restilrnu stands unmoved inside a collapsing tower of reinforced concrete.
Restilrnu streaks across a continent-wide storm front.

name: Iuialrn
summary: Iuialrn is an exiled alien princess whose captors turned her into a living furnace. Freed, iuialrn became a wandering heroine who flies between worlds, absorbs energy and blasts warships out of the sky.

feats.scene: Iuialrn pours stored starlight into a single beam that erases a fortress city.
Iuialrn weathers a bombardment meant to level a city block.
Iuialrn crosses the gap between planets in a single sustained burn.

name: Reost
summary: Reost is a tiny-world noble who tumbled into a larger place and never forgave the rescuer. Reost hurls fierce bolts, flies on instinct and fights like a stormcloud when cornered.

feats.scene: Reost shoots a green lance that melts a bridge span into slag.
Reost endures a point-blank blast from a mercenary cannon.

name: Tiaenu
summary: Tiaenu is a red-haired cat burglar who haunts rooftop galleries and slips through skylights. Tiaenu steals for a hidden gate society and leaves nothing behind except a faint scent of lilac.

feats.scene: Tiaenu snaps a vault's padlock with a single twisting kick.
Tiaenu drops from a roof gutter onto a parked awning and rolls clear.

name: Colvetor
summary: Colvetor is a champion of a magnet-sport who bends metal at a distance and has a grudge against anyone who beat his team. Colvetor lifts girders, crushes armour and flings scrap like a storm of knives.

feats.scene: Colvetor tears a rail bridge from its pylons and flings it into a plaza.
Colvetor survives being buried under a collapsed steel crane.

name: Mianen
summary: Mianen is a lab-coated schemer who builds contraptions to sabotage a band of space knights. Brilliant and bitter, mianen has a twin who shares the same sneer and a nearly identical toolbox.

feats.scene: Mianen staggers through a lab fire with singed sleeves.

name: Lesamiu
summary: Lesamiu is a hot-tempered half-sea youth raised among ice and seal-hunters who stormed into a drowned kingdom. Lesamiu swims, hits like a falling pier and carries a stubborn pride that lured an old sea-beast into the open.

feats.scene: Lesamiu smashes a tunnel pillar with one blow and floods a lower district.
Lesamiu resists crushing deep-sea pressure and keeps swinging.

name: Ontauleru
summary: Ontauleru is a violet-eyed slave-catcher who seized a prison ship by killing its master and now hauls captives between stars. Ontauleru wields a brutal war club, rocket-armed gauntlets and a personal barrier that shrugs off small arms.

feats.scene: Ontauleru fires wrist rockets that bring down a docking tower.
Ontauleru's barrier holds under a volley of hull-piercing rounds.

name: Arserosa
summary: Arserosa is a green-skinned warlord and trusted lieutenant who marches sky-fleets across lesser worlds. Arserosa crushes defences with brute weight and loves nothing more than a surrendering capital.

feats.scene: Arserosa cleaves a siege gate and the wall behind it with one swing.
Arserosa stands unmoved as a siege engine shells him at close range.

name: Stamoanu
summary: Stamoanu is a hulking insectoid sentinel who never leaves his charge's side during tense summits. Plated and patient, stamoanu stops blades with his carapace and ends brawls with a single shove.

feats.scene: Stamoanu hurls a stone table across a council chamber at an assassin.
Stamoanu blocks a blast meant for his charge with his armoured back.

name: Iarrn
summary: Iarrn is a winged, half-machine officer who flew point for an invading armada. Strong and stubborn, iarrn trades judgment for raw force and has a habit of charging first and thinking later.

feats.scene: Iarrn rams a patrol skiff into a hillside and shatters it.
Iarrn shakes off a dozen crossbow-bolt-sized slugs.
Iarrn dives on a fleeing courier faster than sound.

name: Erusonnt
summary: Erusonnt is a tide-born sea-beast from a deeper realm who sought a conquest to please his drowned gods. His water-bound sorcery, once dried out, left him weak, but at full strength he drags whole fleets under.

feats.scene: Erusonnt raises a wave that tears a harbour pier from its moorings.
Erusonnt endures a naval broadside while sheathed in churning surf.
Erusonnt launches from the waves on a column of spray.

name: Aumonniu
summary: Aumonniu is a brown-haired stranger whose crimes are whispered about but never documented. Lean and secretive, aumonniu slips from rented room to rented room before anyone can ask a question.

feats.scene: Aumonniu shoulders a locked door off its hinges.
Aumonniu walks away from a stairwell fall.

name: Eoliutel
summary: Eoliutel is a one-eyed ring-bearer who shapes will into hard light constructs and soars through patrol sectors. Stern and focused, eoliutel keeps a battery close and an iron spine under every order.

feats.scene: Eoliutel shapes a glowing wrecking ball that levels an abandoned city block.
Eoliutel's ring shield holds against a crashing freighter.
Eoliutel crosses a gas giant's orbit in a single burn.

name: Iuiuci
summary: Iuiuci is a former warlord who tried to end wars by buying a dangerous captive and instead earned a ring of will. As a patrol knight, iuiuci builds glowing weapons, flies between suns and quarrels with a stricter colleague.

feats.scene: Iuiuci forges a giant lance of light that destroys a fortress.
Iuiuci's shield holds against a collapsing hangar.
Iuiuci flies between neighbouring worlds in an afternoon.

name: Celsiniu
summary: Celsiniu is a blue-skinned ring wrestler whose finishing punch knocks opponents out of the flow of time. Celsiniu's matches are scripted for show but the knockdowns are real and the arena bleeds clock hands.

feats.scene: Celsiniu lands a haymaker that sends a stage rope and three rivals flying.
Celsiniu rebounds from a chair-and-ladder pile-up and rises grinning.

name: Iaviti
summary: Iaviti is a red-haired psychologist who joined a patrol of will-bearers and grew weary of the elders who command it. Iaviti calls up hard-light shapes, flies between worlds and returns to the home planet only when it is in danger.

feats.scene: Iaviti conjures a vast hammer of light that flattens a warship.
Iaviti's barrier holds against a thrown asteroid chunk.
Iaviti arrives at a besieged sector within hours.

name: Ancorni
summary: Ancorni is a former soldier turned municipal fixer who mimics the gifts of nearby metahumans. Tough and orderly, ancorni borrows speed and hide from allies and enemies alike to keep a city in line.

feats.scene: Ancorni borrows a rival's speed and sends a patrol cruiser spinning with a punch.
Ancorni shrugs off a car crash with a copied skin.
Ancorni sprints down a boulevard with borrowed speed.

name: Rumnanlu
summary: Rumnanlu is a former lab assistant fused with stolen gear by a lightning strike during a chase. Rumnanlu reaches into any machine within sight and bends it to his bidding, from alarms to engines.

name: Anceltel
summary: Anceltel is a dog-shaped genius born of a secret prenatal project who builds gadgets and lets a collar do the talking. Strong and sharp-nosed, anceltel hacks any system faster than a human can type.

feats.scene: Anceltel bites through a steel hatch lock.
Anceltel shrugs off a gang's baseball bats.

name: Iaoluaus
summary: Iaoluaus is a bald, yellow-eyed crocodilian crook who keeps two odd pets and leads a small crew of animal sidekicks. Heavily scaled, iaoluaus bites and claws his way out of any scrape.

feats.scene: Iaoluaus rips a car door from its frame with his claws.
Iaoluaus takes a van collision on his scaly back.

name: Ratonse
summary: Ratonse is a conquering warlord from a mirror world who subdued a thousand planets before a sorcerer cast him out. His dense body stores vast energy, letting him flatten armies and shrug off the mightiest rivals.

feats.scene: Ratonse swats a flying hero into a mountain and splits the summit.
Ratonse takes a pair of combined champions' blows without flinching.
Ratonse tears across the void between worlds.

name: Aulati
summary: Aulati is a white-haired monarch of a deep-earth people whose blood unlocked an ancient horror. Aulati commands subjects with measured speech and a quiet strength that has never been tested in open war.

feats.scene: Aulati strikes a stone gong so hard it cracks.
Aulati survives a cave-in without a bruise.

name: Riter
summary: Riter is a rogue elder of a cosmic order who tried to harness a fear-fuelled force and was consumed by it. Gaunt and blue-skinned, riter ended as a swirling cloud of dread that devours worlds.

feats.scene: Riter's fear cloud swallows the surface of a planet whole.
Riter's cloud shrugs off a volley from an entire fleet.

name: Lorlita
summary: Lorlita is a mad elder scientist so hungry to see what came before creation that he cracked open the cosmos itself. Lorlita slaughtered a world with rewritten sentries and spawned a multiverse in an act of curiosity.

feats.scene: Lorlita tears the cosmos open and spawns a tangle of rival universes.
Lorlita stands unharmed amid the collapse of a shattered galaxy cluster.

name: Ialstrni
summary: Ialstrni is a spy who tumbled into a particle ring and came out glowing with deadly rays. Ialstrni killed a stray cat as a demonstration and was caught fast by a lead-lined trap.

feats.scene: Ialstrni shrugs off a heavy chair thrown by a guard.

name: Irnllran
summary: Irnllran is an immortal caveman warlord who lives for centuries and falls and rises with every empire. Irnllran is brutal, patient and strong enough to break a boulder, and holds a grudge for ages.

feats.scene: Irnllran smashes a rampart with a single overhand blow.
Irnllran survives a falling wall of stone blocks.

name: Reois
summary: Reois is a cruel weapons broker who tormented his studious cousin and sold forbidden devices to the underworld. Reois built a mind-swapping device that nearly worked, and spent years locked in a ghost dimension.

feats.scene: Reois detonates a custom weapon that levels a warehouse.
Reois shrugs off a point-blank ray with a personal barrier.

name: Surno
summary: Surno is a loyal hunter from a lost world who chases fugitives through counterfeit streets alongside a ruthless partner. Surno flies, hits hard and keeps going long after most trackers would give up.

feats.scene: Surno tears a rooftop fortress door from its frame.
Surno stands steady inside a collapsing sky-bridge.
Surno chases a runaway car at supersonic pace.

name: Astlu
summary: Astlu is a poison-wielding assassin who taught a young bride his craft and was repaid in kind. Quiet and lethal, astlu relied on toxins and patience instead of muscle.

feats.scene: Astlu stabs a dart into a courier's neck in a crowded bazaar.
Astlu survives a night chase through thorn scrub.

name: Miinill
summary: Miinill is a red-skinned reptilian warrior who marches under a tyrant father and can be talked into any foolish attack. Miinill roars, charges and hits like a falling tree.

feats.scene: Miinill smashes through a fence line and rams a delivery truck.
Miinill shrugs off a volley of cannon fire from a surprised garrison.

name: Uliurau
summary: Uliurau is a grey-skinned warlord and former arena fighter who lost a family when invaders harvested his home. Chained by grief and ecology-minded cunning, uliurau commands a war-fortress and crushes foes with focused fury.

feats.scene: Uliurau drives a fortress cannon through a city block's worth of defences.
Uliurau stands unmoved as a bombardment strikes his armour.

name: Lleorava
summary: Lleorava is a white-furred family pet on a doomed homeworld, loyal to a noble household. Quick and warm-hearted, lleorava follows a child everywhere and sniffs out danger before anyone else.

feats.scene: Lleorava leaps and knocks a prowler off a balcony.
Lleorava tumbles down a garden slope and bounds back up.

name: Natersa
summary: Natersa is a sun-fed white hound who left a dying world and became a caped guardian. Natersa flies, blows freezing gusts, melts steel with heat vision and joins a pack of heroic pets.

feats.scene: Natersa melts a girder mass with a burst of searing heat.
Natersa shrugs off a collapsing bridge deck.
Natersa zips across an ocean to reach a stranded ship.

name: Riast
summary: Riast is a white-coated alien pup with a hero's gifts and a taste for chasing sticks. Riast flies low over rooftops, tackles thieves and returns to a game of fetch afterwards.

feats.scene: Riast bowls through a brick wall to catch a burglar.
Riast shakes off a bank-vault door that fell on top of him.
Riast races a speeding train across a valley.

name: Estst
summary: Estst is a caped alien dog whose boundless enthusiasm often wrecks the scenery. Estst flies, blasts heat from his eyes and chews through steel, and causes as many problems as he solves.

feats.scene: Estst crashes through a tower floor chasing a ball and splits the building.
Estst is struck by a missile and sneezes.
Estst sprints into the sky after a passing jet.

name: Ilrncin
summary: Ilrncin is a faithful alien hound who was lost in a ghost dimension and rescued by his old friend. Sun-charged, ilrncin flies, tracks scents across oceans and stands guard in a crystalline fortress.

feats.scene: Ilrncin charges a stone giant and shatters it into rubble.
Ilrncin takes a battering from a rampaging monster and stays on his feet.
Ilrncin flies across a continent after a faint scent.

name: Tosianal
summary: Tosianal is a space-faring white hound who patrols alongside canine allies and rivals a stray cat. Tosianal flies, hits hard and once kept a transformed friend busy until a cure arrived.

feats.scene: Tosianal tackles a rampaging brute and sends it through a wall.
Tosianal weathers a hulking brute's clubbing blows.

name: Eolrn
summary: Eolrn is a bounding white pup who guards a crystal fortress and trades barbs with a feline rival. Eolrn swims, flies and carries a long family line of space hounds behind him.

feats.scene: Eolrn digs through an ice cliff and collapses a cavern wall.
Eolrn takes a fall from orbit and shakes his fur.

name: Nesiasti
summary: Nesiasti is a twisted tentacled hound, once a loyal pet, whose borrowed gifts are failing as its body unravels. Nesiasti drifts over rooftops guarding a city, growing frailer with every night.

feats.scene: Nesiasti shrugs off a rooftop collapse in its early days.

name: Rneiuser
summary: Rneiuser is a lab-grown copy of a famous hound, created to test heroes and loyal to the first friend it meets. Rneiuser flies, burns steel with its gaze and fights beside a strong heroine until a gunshot ends the battle.

feats.scene: Rneiuser burns a wall of reinforced steel with its gaze.
Rneiuser takes a blast from a lab cannon and keeps fighting.
Rneiuser rockets between lab corridors faster than gunfire.

name: Teanu
summary: Teanu is a scruffy white pup rescued from a harbour and passed between caretakers. Small and soft, teanu has a nose for kindness and a bark that carries across a whole block.

feats.scene: Teanu bowls over a bowl of kibble and a startled cat.
Teanu survives a tumble down a flight of stairs.

name: Amolaseo
summary: Amolaseo is a prisoner who volunteered for a doomed test flight and turned green after passing through a drifting cloud of glowing gas. Amolaseo and a lab companion returned with gaseous-mineral powers and a score to settle with a boy hero.

feats.scene: Amolaseo fires a green beam that melts a rooftop water tank.
Amolaseo shrugs off a cannon barrage on a hillside.
Amolaseo flies across a valley before a rival can blink.

name: Cinstuolu
summary: Cinstuolu is a laboratory-grown double soaked in glowing green mineral, built to test a hero. Cinstuolu flies, burns with heat from the eyes and hits like a falling bridge before a teleport misfire erased it.

feats.scene: Cinstuolu fires a heat beam that slices a gantry in half.
Cinstuolu endures a fighter jet's strafing run.
Cinstuolu streaks across a skyline in an instant.

name: Ntiau
summary: Ntiau is a winged conqueror who served a void-dwelling devourer and was redeemed by a patient friend. Ntiau, doomed to be reborn across the ages, flies and fights with the strength of a seasoned general.

feats.scene: Ntiau tears a citadel gate apart with a wing-powered dive.
Ntiau survives a death-cult siege tower collapse.
Ntiau dives on a besieged wall faster than sound.

name: Mitorium
summary: Mitorium is a golden-winged hermit of a high plateau who senses the hopes and fears of strangers. Mitorium soars over cloud banks to bring comfort and warns of storms days before they arrive.

feats.scene: Mitorium knocks a stone from a cliff ledge with a wing buffet.
Mitorium tumbles down a cliff face and recovers in the air.

name: Rusllema
summary: Rusllema is a war god of a sun-drenched island chain who commands armies with a mere gaze and wields a sword wreathed in flame. Rusllema rides a white horned steed and merges with siblings into a colossal giant when the war is dire.

feats.scene: Rusllema's flaming blade cuts a hillside fort in half.
Rusllema walks through a rain of cannonballs unscathed.

name: Remonti
summary: Remonti is a red-haired swordswoman raised by two famous parents in a darkened mirror world. Trained in the old fighting arts, remonti guards a bat-shaped fortress and swings with disciplined fury.

feats.scene: Remonti cuts through a tunnel wall with a two-handed cleave.
Remonti shrugs off a tunnel blast and rises with her blade ready.

name: Ontte
summary: Ontte is a miniature-city inventor who inherited a grudge from a bitter father. Ontte built a body-swapping machine and a lifelike mask to impersonate a hero, and used a hero's gifts for revenge.

feats.scene: Ontte flattens a bank vault door while using a stolen gift.
Ontte shrugs off a wrecking ball while in disguise.
Ontte flies across a skyline in an instant.

name: Titalli
summary: Titalli is a black-haired shape-shifting killer who inherited the name of an older mercenary. Titalli joined a coalition of enchantress allies to ambush a warrior queen and was beaten by a cheeky sidekick.

feats.scene: Titalli twists into a blade-armed form and slashes a rope bridge.
Titalli shrugs off a flurry of kicks in a shifting form.

name: Numseoone
summary: Numseoone is a musical crook with a banjo and a bad attitude who joined a society of oddball villains. Numseoone plucks tricks out of thin air and runs off with the cash before the final chord.

feats.scene: Numseoone smashes a banjo over a guard's head.
Numseoone tumbles down a stage stairwell and bows.

name: Tireoli
summary: Tireoli is a blond spy who has served in many roles, from sub officer to under-cover agent. Tireoli changes names and uniforms as often as most people change socks and slips through any checkpoint.

feats.scene: Tireoli slips a knife into a sentry's pocket and escapes.
Tireoli rides out a depth-charge shake inside a hull.

name: Eoncoco
summary: Eoncoco is a black-haired pilot who climbs into a hammer-fisted armoured suit to defend the coast from giant monsters. Eoncoco swings colossal mallets with her suit's servos and steps through rubble unharmed.

feats.scene: Eoncoco flattens a monster's shell with a hammer-fist blow.
Eoncoco's suit takes a lunging bite and keeps walking.

name: Niacoreo
summary: Niacoreo is a black-haired sovereign who dispatches expeditions to see what other planets do. Niacoreo sits on a crystal throne and relies on loyal scouts, cunning and a sky-fleet to gather specimens.

feats.scene: Niacoreo shatters a crystal pillar with a hurled staff.
Niacoreo survives a throne room tremor.

name: Nenrumaul
summary: Nenrumaul is an orange-skinned, bald sector guardian who kept the peace for two centuries with a power ring. Nenrumaul spent a final day visiting each world before retirement and passed on a quiet legacy.

feats.scene: Nenrumaul builds a vast hard-light shield and rams a warfleet back.
Nenrumaul's barrier absorbs a warlord's cannon blast.
Nenrumaul flies between his worlds within a day.

name: Corsiva
summary: Corsiva is a silent blue-skinned thief in a bat-themed outfit who haunts the city's night. Corsiva never says a word, and the crowd is left only with a menacing red glare.

feats.scene: Corsiva shoves a stack of crates onto a security guard.
Corsiva falls off a fire escape and lands lightly.

source_title: Kyd Wykkyd (Teen Titans Go! TV Series)

name: Ntuiuri
summary: Ntuiuri is a white-haired gang member who dared a friend to steal a gem and left him behind. Ntuiuri gained a charge of invulnerability by accident and used it to loot, brag and bully.

feats.scene: Ntuiuri smashes a jewel vault door with a single punch.
Ntuiuri laughs off a volley from a guard's ray guns.

name: Rusnanrus
summary: Rusnanrus is a gang enforcer who transforms into a snarling beast under moonlight. Rusnanrus lurks in the sewers beneath a gloomy city, guarding a warehouse and a crooked secret.

feats.scene: Rusnanrus claws a steel hatch off its hinges.
Rusnanrus ignores a pistol volley in beast form.

name: Resni
summary: Resni is a former commando who could shift into a wolf and who turned on his crooked allies to prevent a city's destruction. Resni now leads a small cult of believers, strong and fast in beast form.

feats.scene: Resni tears a car door off its frame in beast form.
Resni shakes off a bullet volley in beast form.
Resni sprints through an alley on all fours.

name: Numnum
summary: Numnum is a former jet pilot who survived a plane crash and now chases mysteries with three fellow survivors. Numnum leads the team, flies anything with wings and treats every day as bonus time.

feats.scene: Numnum swings a wrench at a hatch and dents it.
Numnum steps out of a crashed plane with a limp.

name: Ramatil
summary: Ramatil is a blond power-cell magnate who can thin his body into mist or harden it like stone. Ramatil punches hard when solid and drifts through walls when gaseous, though he cannot do both at once.

feats.scene: Ramatil hardens his fist and cracks a vault door.
Ramatil turns to vapour and lets a machine-gun burst pass through.

name: Valval
summary: Valval is a sightless ring-bearer who leads an elite squad in a paradise pocket world. Valval builds glowing constructs by sheer will and keeps order in a realm conjured for a friend.

feats.scene: Valval builds a gigantic hard-light fist that flattens a siege tower.
Valval's shield holds against a falling cliff.
Valval flies across a pocket sky in moments.

source_title: Kyle Rayner (Dark Crisis: Worlds Without a Justice League: Green Lantern)

name: Recolnti
summary: Recolnti is a black-haired artist turned ring-bearer who works alongside his friend on a distant station. Recolnti flies, shields allies and shapes dazzling light into whatever tool the moment demands.

feats.scene: Recolnti sculpts a huge hard-light hammer and flattens a pirate base.
Recolnti's shield holds against a pirate cruiser's cannons.

name: Loram
summary: Loram is a former gang member turned graphic artist in a gritty, alternate city, wearing a ring that conjures light shapes. Loram married his boss's daughter-figure and keeps a pen name on the side.

feats.scene: Loram builds a wrecking ball of light and flattens a warehouse.
Loram's shield absorbs a gangster's barrage.

name: Tesna
summary: Tesna is a brown-haired knight of a cosmic patrol wearing a ring that builds shapes and shields. Tesna flies from sector to sector and wins by cheerful stubbornness more than by planning.

feats.scene: Tesna builds a giant hard-light mallet and flattens a pirate outpost.
Tesna's shield absorbs a rogue comet fragment.

source_title: Kyle Rayner (The Brave and the Bold)

name: Numern
summary: Numern is a masked bank robber with a hockey mask and an old rifle who rolls with a gang of playing-card thieves. Numern knows how to run, hide and pull a trigger, and little else.

feats.scene: Numern fires a rifle burst through a bank window.
Numern tumbles off a loading dock and sprints on.

name: Villu
summary: Villu is an auburn-haired civil agent who works for a hush-hush bureau. Villu files reports, follows leads and keeps most secrets to himself.

feats.scene: Villu shoves a locked file cabinet across a room.
Villu walks away from a minor car bump.

name: Lorsuseo
summary: Lorsuseo is a brown-haired knight of a cosmic patrol in a mirrored world, wielding a ring that shapes light and shields. Lorsuseo flies across sectors and joins a hero league whenever worlds are in danger.

feats.scene: Lorsuseo builds a gigantic hard-light drill and bores through a fortress.
Lorsuseo's barrier holds against a falling space station panel.
Lorsuseo crosses a sector in a single burn.

name: Nacorir
summary: Nacorir is a hulking alien conqueror with great strength and stamina who can transfer energy between bodies. Nacorir storms across worlds with a heavy stride and a conqueror's contempt.

feats.scene: Nacorir shatters a battlement with a single blow.
Nacorir shrugs off a salvo of cannon shells.

name: Orallaami
summary: Orallaami is a bald, black-eyed girl from a winged people's city who lives under her mother's watchful care. Orallaami practises flight lessons and dreams of one day patrolling the sky.

feats.scene: Orallaami flaps hard and knocks a toy off a shelf.
Orallaami drops from a low perch and lands on her feet.

name: Iumvalcor
summary: Iumvalcor is a bald dojo outcast who stole sacred weapons and later learned a deadly touch technique. Iumvalcor hunts his former classmate, duels at a volcano's rim and strikes pressure points with deadly accuracy.

feats.scene: Iumvalcor shatters a stack of tiles with a vibrating palm.
Iumvalcor takes a rolling fall at a volcano's edge and keeps fighting.

name: Lluium
summary: Lluium is a grey-skinned bounty hunter who performs a ritual to peer into the future and kill criminals before they strike. Lluium mourns a lost family and carries out one last assignment with grim calm.

feats.scene: Lluium unleashes a ritual burst that topples a watchtower.
Lluium shrugs off a blast from a rival's armour.

name: Riiumni
summary: Riiumni is a floating robot servant who babbles in many tongues and follows a villain's orders. Riiumni hovers around the lair with a photocell gaze and a stubborn sense of duty.

feats.scene: Riiumni slams a metal arm into a stack of crates.
Riiumni survives a tumble down a steel stairwell.

name: Liuirnleo
summary: Liuirnleo is a prissy robot assistant who is reprogrammed against his will. Liuirnleo glitches into honesty at the worst moments and spends his days fretting about leadership and card files.

feats.scene: Liuirnleo swings a metal tray into a guard's helmet.
Liuirnleo reboots after a heavy fall and tidies up.

name: Ortausil
summary: Ortausil is a loyal robot servant with a glowing photocell gaze who works for a fiery pair. Ortausil fetches drinks, runs errands and quietly watches over the household.

feats.scene: Ortausil lifts a heavy trunk with a metal arm.
Ortausil takes a tumble down a flight of stairs and continues.

name: Ntsto
summary: Ntsto is a tarot-reading sorcerer who leads a band of regional heroes and controls the weather with her magic. Ntsto can project her spirit for hours at a time and loves romance as much as occult study.

feats.scene: Ntsto calls a hailstorm that flattens a farm village's roofs.
Ntsto's warding circle holds under a mob's thrown stones.

name: Telcesllo
summary: Telcesllo is an immortal bloodsucker raised by a kind stranger who patrols an old seaside city at night. Telcesllo is strong at dusk, wary of sunshine and fights crime with sharp fangs and sharper wit.

feats.scene: Telcesllo throws a thug through a window with one hand.
Telcesllo takes a bullet volley and heals over within minutes.

name: Valiium
summary: Valiium is a fading goddess of fate who determined the course of mortal lives and later lost her powers. Valiium hunts the pieces of a shattered loom, teleports, weaves illusions and mourns her lost immortality.

feats.scene: Valiium rips a hole in a throne room's wall with a snap of her fingers.
Valiium shrugs off a wave of fire while still divine.

name: Minunan
summary: Minunan is a blue-eyed dragon who guards a garden of golden fruit for a vengeful goddess. Minunan breathes fire, spreads dread and takes to the sky on huge wings.

feats.scene: Minunan breathes a column of flame that melts a temple colonnade.
Minunan shrugs off a barrage of lightning bolts.
Minunan dives from a cloud bank onto a fleeing hero.

name: Stumi
summary: Stumi is a red-eyed, green-scaled dragon who guards golden fruit in an ancient orchard. Stumi has watched heroes and thieves come and go and sleeps lightly with one eye open.

feats.scene: Stumi lashes his tail and topples a stone statue in the orchard.
Stumi endures a spear volley across his scales.
Stumi swoops over the orchard wall after a thief.

name: Ollstli
summary: Ollstli is a working actress who joins a clandestine team and slips into roles for missions. Ollstli uses wit, makeup and nerve instead of muscle.

feats.scene: Ollstli slaps a would-be thief hard enough to stagger him.
Ollstli walks away from a staged fall with a smile.

name: Iusir
summary: Iusir is a black-haired flyer in a squad of ace pilots who joined a society of hero-types in a parallel world. Iusir pilots biplanes with an easy grin and a steady hand.

feats.scene: Iusir strafes a supply truck with machine-gun fire.
Iusir climbs out of a crashed biplane and waves.
Iusir dives a plane out of cloud cover at full throttle.

name: Tasreote
summary: Tasreote is a dark-haired patriot who grabs objects from afar and fires destructive beams through a torch. Tasreote flies, shelters allies in bubbles and carries a tablet-shaped shield that shrugs off modern weapons.

feats.scene: Tasreote pulverises a concrete slab with a focused torch beam.
Tasreote's tablet shield blocks a heavy cannon round.
Tasreote flies a squad across a river inside a bubble.

name: Colcin
summary: Colcin is a hired sentry in a flag-coloured costume who patrols a ruined district and turns away gifted trespassers. The post ended in a flash of heat when a radiant brute finally reached the gate.

feats.scene: Colcin swung a riot shield into a barricade and tore the planks clear.
Colcin held a burning corridor for a full minute before the heat won.

name: Amvavor
summary: Amvavor is a noblewoman of a crystal-fantasy realm who pairs courtly sorcery with fencing. She rides to war beside her husband against a tyrant of glass and shadow.

feats.scene: Amvavor hurled a crackling lance of violet light that split a castle gate.
Amvavor stood unharmed inside her own ward while a siege ram struck it.

name: Sarstco
summary: Sarstco rules a walled, suspicious fortress-realm and bargains hard for what she wants, most of all a husband. She stays out of the great war and guards her borders with spellwork.

feats.scene: Sarstco sealed a mountain pass beneath a slab of conjured crystal.
Sarstco weathered a barrage of catapult stones behind a shimmering shell of blue light.

name: Cilnator
summary: Cilnator is a ruthless sky-borne swordswoman from a mirror reality who conquers with a blade and a snarl. She dies shouting a threat she never gets to finish.

feats.scene: Cilnator cleaved a steel girder during a dive-bombing pass.
Cilnator slammed into a rooftop at full tilt and rolled up swinging.
Cilnator streaked across a canyon in a gliding dive.

name: Stimiason
summary: Stimiason is a gentle noblewoman locked away by a usurping duke, who escapes with help and rides with loyalists to topple him. Her talent is horsemanship rather than any gift of power.

feats.scene: Stimiason leapt from a saddle and drove both boots into a guard's shield.
Stimiason endured a night in a damp cell and walked out unbroken.
Stimiason galloped a borrowed mare flat out across a drawbridge.

name: Coleruse
summary: Coleruse is a green-eyed, red-haired duellist of the glass kingdoms who fires bolts of raw force and loses all dignity after a single drink. Admirers call her tough, and the legend is mostly true.

feats.scene: Coleruse fired a bolt from her palm that blew a tower door off its hinges.
Coleruse took a charging war-horse on her shoulder and stayed upright.

name: Seiumau
summary: Seiumau is the restless ghost of a silver-screen starlet who traps victims inside painted film posters and makes them act out the plots. She wants only to be left in her grave.

feats.scene: Seiumau pulled an entire film crew into painted posters with one sweep of her hand.
Seiumau let a thrown stake pass through her pale chest and merely sighed.

name: Ancorna
summary: Ancorna is a centuries-old queen who becomes a towering figure of stone and soil when angered. She shakes the ground, rides lava flows, and shapes rock to her will.

feats.scene: Ancorna split a plateau with a quake that rolled through a whole district.
Ancorna stood in a collapsing lava vent and rose from it unhurt.

name: Liarne
summary: Liarne is a six-inch princess of a tiny hidden city who sides with rebels against her harsh father. She marries a visiting stranger who joins her cause.

feats.scene: Liarne hurled a pebble the size of a grain at a guard's helmet.
Liarne survived a tumble down a vine from a tall branch.
Liarne sprinted across a leaf as a downpour began.

name: Iramita
summary: Iramita is a pocket-sized royal with a taste for adventure, engaged to a shrinking scientist in a cartoon retelling. She is bright, brisk and unafraid of beetles.

feats.scene: Iramita flicked a seed hull into a guard's shin.
Iramita rode out a raindrop splash without a scratch.

name: Arntnt
summary: Arntnt is a green, red-eyed sea-dweller eight feet tall and weighing about two tons, fascinated by the dry world. He joins a team of young heroes without losing his love of cheap television.

feats.scene: Arntnt flipped a delivery truck onto its roof with one shove.
Arntnt waded through a hail of coastal patrol gunfire with only a grumble.
Arntnt surged through open water in a rolling wake.

name: Lertesau
summary: Lertesau is a green-skinned sea youth shaken by the loss of his young teammates, who seeks help for his grief. A strange twist of time returns him to the fight in a replacement body.

feats.scene: Lertesau drove a fist through a hospital door during a panicked rush.
Lertesau withstood a surge of wild force that felled the patients near him.

name: Iaveti
summary: Iaveti is a green-scaled schoolchild in a world of cartoon toddlers, who fusses over flippers and soap. The biggest threat is a missing scrub brush.

feats.scene: Iaveti splashed a puddle across a classroom floor with one stomp.
Iaveti bounced off a playground slide and laughed.
Iaveti paddled across a wading pool at full tilt.

name: Nelliucor
summary: Nelliucor is a blue-skinned scout of an interstellar police corps, armed with a glowing ring and a charging lantern. She wields a will strong enough to give hard light a shape.

feats.scene: Nelliucor condensed a green beam into a hammer and flattened a landing craft.
Nelliucor sat inside a ring-made bubble while debris from a shattered hull pounded it.
Nelliucor crossed a moon's shadow in a long ring-powered streak.

name: Nteorene
summary: Nteorene is an undying spinner who measures out the length of each life and can bend the plot of reality by weaving strands. She sits among her sisters and decides who gets an ending.

feats.scene: Nteorene snipped a single strand and rewrote the ending of a thousand lives.
Nteorene let a collapsing sky wash over her loom and kept weaving.

name: Iucel
summary: Iucel is a sly hopeful who sabotages rivals to win an audition for a team of young heroes. He is exposed and beaten in a duel by someone who deserved the spot.

feats.scene: Iucel cut a rival's rope-line and sent the contestant tumbling into a pit.
Iucel absorbed a stinging backhand and kept scheming on his feet.

name: Sernau
summary: Sernau is a pompous local administrator who longs for glory and keeps trying to grow a rival hero team into something famous. His best recruits keep leaving for a bigger club.

feats.scene: Sernau thumped a lectern so hard that a pitcher of water jumped.
Sernau endured a full afternoon of complaints with his smile intact.

name: Seiar
summary: Seiar is a gold-skinned child of an engineered pairing whose power grows until it rivals a mother's world-breaking fury. Fearing madness, he once asked to be shut inside a dampening cell.

feats.scene: Seiar lit a gas giant's core and unmade it in a single pulse.
Seiar sat inside a dampening cell as raw force howled against its walls.

name: Tumvanen
summary: Tumvanen is a white-haired dowager of an undersea kingdom who tamed the royal war-beasts and keeps her own spy network. Pressure that crushes lesser beings does not bother her.

feats.scene: Tumvanen wrestled a charging sea-beast to the sand with her bare arms.
Tumvanen walked through a trench where the weight of the water would crush steel.
Tumvanen shot through a kelp forest in a single breathless dash.

name: Tuler
summary: Tuler is a bald convict with a metal lantern grafted into his body, a battery that renews itself and lets him cross the stars. It also conjures hollow copies of the dead from a victim's mind.

feats.scene: Tuler fired a wide lantern beam that knocked down a block of warehouses.
Tuler stood in the open as his lantern drank a shell burst and glowed brighter.

name: Veocarri
summary: Veocarri is a bald operative of a secret squad whose gift lets him summon the dead and lend them solid form. His team is abandoned by its master, and a stronger foe ends him quickly.

feats.scene: Veocarri raised a rank of grey spirits that bowled over a line of guards.
Veocarri survived a fall from a bunker catwalk and clambered back up.

name: Tatelaul
