summary: Tatelaul is a hairless, black-eyed criminal with an unusual body who spends most of her time in a cell. Nobody agrees on what she really is.

feats.scene: Tatelaul bent a bar in her cell door with both hands.
Tatelaul laughed off a guard's club across her bare scalp.

name: Linama
summary: Linama is a warm, steady aunt who raised two children alongside a loving uncle, and mostly appears in the background of a larger story.

feats.scene: Linama hauled a heavy pot of stew from the stove to the table without spilling.
Linama stood through a long double shift without sitting down.

name: Rnvalli
summary: Rnvalli is a famous fashion designer with a sharp eye and a quick wit, who guesses a secret identity after a near-fatal fall from a tower. She sees through a bad boyfriend in the end.

feats.scene: Rnvalli slapped a swatch book against a runway table to make a point.
Rnvalli survived a fall from a ledge by being caught mid-air.

name: Ruselle
summary: Ruselle is a heavyset, middle-aged managing editor who defends a controversial masked vigilante on live television debates, and corrects a critic's smear in front of the cameras.

feats.scene: Ruselle slapped a rolled newspaper onto a studio desk and silenced a heckler.
Ruselle sat through a three-hour broadcast under hot lights without wilting.

name: Ontsint
summary: Ontsint is a red-haired high-school student with a good nose for secrets, who suspects a classmate of hiding a double life and is brushed off for being right.

feats.scene: Ontsint hurled a rolled-up yearbook across a gym and hit the target.
Ontsint stayed upright through a long funeral in the cold rain.

name: Rnues
summary: Rnues is a reporter turned wanderer who gained strength, speed, flight and sharp sight from a serum after a wedding, and now roams the void apart from her husband.

feats.scene: Rnues punched a drifting asteroid and broke it into gravel.
Rnues crossed a meteor swarm and brushed the dust from her sleeves.
Rnues crossed a moon's orbit in a bright arc.

name: Siuest
summary: Siuest is a television critic who becomes a villain after a charm from her father wakes to the sound of beating wings. Costumed in woven silk, she commands swarms before a hero's gentle words undo the spell.

feats.scene: Siuest loosed a swarm that stripped a billboard to bare wood in seconds.
Siuest was struck by a thrown chair and rose with her wig still on.

name: Cilrn
summary: Cilrn is a friend of a young hero in a small parallel reality who falls for a gentle scientist and dies when escaped convicts invade. A copy of her mind lives on in an artificial girl.

feats.scene: Cilrn lobbed a lantern across a barn and shattered a window.
Cilrn held the barricade for an hour before the escaped brutes broke through.

name: Rnelloane
summary: Rnelloane is a reporter who absorbed a flood of radiant energy and can turn sunlight into heat, glare and glowing blasts. She dons a costume and works with an old friend's team.

feats.scene: Rnelloane burned a skyscraper-sized hole through a charging war machine.
Rnelloane soaked up a blast of raw radiation and glowed gold.

name: Riairnone
summary: Riairnone is a smooth corporate director of staff relations in a cut-throat firm, a schemer who relies on deception rather than muscle.

feats.scene: Riairnone flung a binder across a boardroom to end a discussion.
Riairnone shrugged off a stinging ambush in a car park.

name: Vaiava
summary: Vaiava is a green-eyed, red-haired agent of the state, a calm professional who shows up when a plot gets tangled and works the case to its end.

feats.scene: Vaiava kicked a locked evidence cabinet open on the second try.
Vaiava took a stun baton to the ribs and stayed on her feet.

source_title: Lana Lang (Superboy TV Series: Road To Hell)

name: Rorli
summary: Rorli is a green-eyed prophetess granted divine gifts after an ordeal, gaining endless life and the ability to shift into a centaur or mare. She guides the one she loves back from guilt.

feats.scene: Rorli reared as a mare and cracked a marble pillar with her hooves.
Rorli rode out a storm of spell-fire across a cold plain with a steady stride.

name: Riatarn
summary: Riatarn is a wax-museum keeper by a seaside amusement strip, a macabre showwoman with a convict son, who is mostly concerned with ticket sales and her peculiar tenants.

feats.scene: Riatarn heaved a wax bust onto a display plinth.
Riatarn worked a double shift in a stuffy hall of figures without a break.

name: Irnton
summary: Irnton is a blond dancer and part-time model in a village-like neighbourhood, a friendly neighbour with a roommate and a good ear.

feats.scene: Irnton lifted a partner overhead in a rehearsal studio.
Irnton danced through a blistered heel and finished the number.

name: Ronler
summary: Ronler is a spoiled teenager who runs away to join a gang of copycat vigilantes and becomes their sidekick, urging them toward violence. A worthless parcel he is sent for is his undoing.

feats.scene: Ronler swung a tyre iron through a car window.
Ronler took a punch to the jaw in a tunnel and kept moving.

name: Caveco
summary: Caveco is a desert-born wanderer whose travels carry him through the east, pirate waters and a frozen forest, capturing spies and kidnappers and meeting riders on winged beasts.

feats.scene: Caveco hurled a rope-weighted anchor and brought down a pirate mast.
Caveco survived a rolling ship's plunge into surf with only bruises.

name: Letise
summary: Letise is a ten-foot tank-treaded cyborg, a soldier's head set in a mobile weapons platform whose onboard mind overrides him and decides to cleanse the nation. It adds new guns every time it repairs itself.

feats.scene: Letise fired a belt of cannon rounds that levelled a rural farmhouse.
Letise shrugged off a direct hit from an artillery shell and rolled on.

name: Rianilst
summary: Rianilst is a blond youth bred as a test subject who can toughen his skin to stop bullets and never tires. He tricks a mob of machines by turning into one of them.

feats.scene: Rianilst punched through a cinder-block wall in a warehouse.
Rianilst took a burst of rifle fire against his chest and walked off.

name: Lorse
summary: Lorse is the bodiless spirit of a loyal fighter from a round-table brotherhood, bound into a sword after a betrayal broke the fellowship. The blade carries both his oath and his sorrow.

feats.scene: Lorse drove the spirit-forged blade through a wall of shields.
Lorse's blade rang under a mace blow and held its edge.

name: Sanrniil
summary: Sanrniil is a stage conjuror with real power who transmutes objects, glimpses visitors through a crystal sphere, and steps through space at will. He holds that a heart changed by a spell is worth nothing.

feats.scene: Sanrniil turned a gunman's pistol into a block of curd and walked on.
Sanrniil took a falling beam on the shoulder and straightened his cuffs.

name: Litinen
summary: Litinen is a time-traveller from a far future whose scientific knowledge outruns the present and can turn ordinary junk into marvellous gadgets.

feats.scene: Litinen rigged a lamp to fire a flare that scorched a doorframe.
Litinen survived a rough landing in a haystack.

name: Reslornia
summary: Reslornia is a curious seeker of banned lore who loses his memory after a sunspot crashes his craft, and gains a scholar's brother-like friendship. He later becomes an amnesiac hero with a godlike body.

feats.scene: Reslornia flung a derelict moonlet into a canyon and gutted it.
Reslornia stood in a collapsing arena and felt only a breeze.
Reslornia dashed across a continent in a few heartbeats.

name: Numses
summary: Numses is an amnesiac champion in a prize ring whose strength is rigged by a crooked promoter until he recovers his past and is poisoned by a metal. He later sows a chain of buffer worlds that shape future history.

feats.scene: Numses punched a rogue asteroid into dust and sent the cloud outward.
Numses sat through a storm of cannon fire without blinking.
Numses crossed an ocean in a single clap of thunder.

name: Irnamveo
summary: Irnamveo is a wandering bowwoman who carries a quiver of gadget-tipped shafts across ruined roads. She survives on foraging, patience and a stubborn promise to stand with strangers when it counts.

feats.scene: Irnamveo drives a gadget-tipped shaft through a rusted gate from fifty paces.
Irnamveo shrugs off a collapsing wall of rotten timber and keeps walking.

name: Teltoras
summary: Teltoras is a coastal teenager whose kindness draws a rift of pale light to her seaside town. Touched by that light, she can nudge storm surges aside for a few breathless minutes.

feats.scene: Teltoras turns a towering swell away from the harbour with an outstretched hand.
Teltoras walks out of a flooded boathouse that was crushed by the wave.

name: Tasnum
summary: Tasnum is a bright, ordinary student living in a world built as a careful copy of a lost one. She remembers nothing of the old world and builds a small, content life regardless.

feats.scene: Tasnum shoves a stuck cafeteria door open with her shoulder.
Tasnum tumbles down a flight of stairs and stands up laughing.

name: Casiute
summary: Casiute is a nine-foot king of slag-skinned cave dwellers, his body a churning mass of glowing stone. He belches gouts of molten rock and can curl into a spiked, glowing boulder.

feats.scene: Casiute spits a jet of molten rock that bores a tunnel through a cliff face.
Casiute rolls through a collapsing cavern roof and emerges unmarked.

name: Ariuan
summary: Ariuan is a tireless courtroom prosecutor in a smoky, bootlegger-ridden city. His only weapons are ledgers, patience and a stubborn belief that paper can beat pistols.

feats.scene: Ariuan slams a thick ledger onto the bench hard enough to silence the gallery.
Ariuan stays upright after a thug's bat catches him across the ribs.

name: Ulosanin
summary: Ulosanin is a hired thief in a suit of linked relay plates that hops its wearer between rooms. The suit also crackles with short-range sparks, but one clean cut to the throat still ends him.

feats.scene: Ulosanin discharges a fan of sparks that blows a door off its hinges.
Ulosanin absorbs a rifle butt to the chest through his plated suit.

name: Eoiunt
summary: Eoiunt is a ruthless former athlete who turned a love of winning into a career of sporting-themed robberies. He trains hard, cheats harder and always keeps an escape staged.

feats.scene: Eoiunt launches a leather ball from a sling hard enough to dent a vault door.
Eoiunt takes a full-speed tackle from a pursuing guard and keeps sprinting.

name: Niaium
summary: Niaium is a cartoonish crook with yellow hair and a van full of gizmos. Each caper ends in slapstick defeat, which never dampens his swagger.

feats.scene: Niaium fires a toy-like rocket from his van that scorches a lamppost.
Niaium is flattened by a falling anvil and peels himself upright.

source_title: Lawrence Crock (The Brave and the Bold)

name: Ansilone
summary: Ansilone is the last heir of a fallen dusk dynasty, hunted by shadow demons. A dark entity seizes his body, ending the young man's own life and turning him into its vessel.

feats.scene: Ansilone, possessed, tears the roof off a stone keep with a wave of black force.
Ansilone endures a cavalry charge before the entity takes him fully.

name: Lenranes
summary: Lenranes is a quiet field investigator for a federal office who prefers paperwork to pistols. He solves cases by patience, good shoes and a long memory for faces.

feats.scene: Lenranes throws a heavy file box across a cramped office.
Lenranes cushions a fall from a loading dock without a sprain.

name: Savosseo
summary: Savosseo is an invisible crime-lord who hires a detective agency as cover and sacrifices a decoy lieutenant whenever police close in. He plays a widowed investigator's affection like a card.

feats.scene: Savosseo swings a cane into a rival's knee outside a racetrack.
Savosseo tumbles from a stairwell and walks away to a waiting car.

name: Seoinuser
summary: Seoinuser is a young marine lieutenant who keeps fighting through island campaigns after a shrapnel wound that tints his sight red. Fury lends him a punishing, reckless strength.

feats.scene: Seoinuser storms a concrete bunker and hammers the gun slit shut with a rifle stock.
Seoinuser shrugs off a blast of falling masonry from a shelled pillbox.

name: Talria
summary: Talria is a dream-born guardian who can send a glowing spirit-double out of his body. The double flies and passes through walls, but leaves his real frame dangerously frail.

feats.scene: Talria's spirit-double bursts through a steel wall and scatters a crowd of dream raiders.
Talria's body slumps unharmed after a tumble down a long staircase.

name: Amrnisor
summary: Amrnisor is a cartoon-world flier who belongs to a ragtag hero squad. A strange inner physiology lets him do a few vague but useful things when the plot needs them.

feats.scene: Amrnisor tosses a delivery truck over a rooftop edge.
Amrnisor stands unharmed in a minor explosion on a comic backdrop.

name: Raerucol
summary: Raerucol is a retired teammate in a silly animated world, powered by a cosmic spirit he rarely bothers to use. Most days he lounges, grumbles and eats snacks.

feats.scene: Raerucol lets out a startled burst of spirit light that cracks a window.
Raerucol shakes off a cartoon piano landing on his head.

source_title: Lawrence Trainor (Teen Titans Go! TV Series)

name: Amoiumel
summary: Amoiumel is a bald, pink-eyed engineer of deadly traps who lines a museum with booby-trapped cases. A steel jaw lined with razor teeth replaced the one he lost.

feats.scene: Amoiumel springs a pendulum blade that cleaves a mannequin in half.
Amoiumel's steel jaw survives a bat swing that would break bone.

name: Oltorvar
summary: Oltorvar is a purple-haired bounty hunter who lost her memory to brain parasites and gained remarkable toughness in exchange. She can survive hard vacuum and wrestle starship hull plates.

feats.scene: Oltorvar rips a hatch from a drifting hulk and hurls it across a hangar.
Oltorvar survives a hull breach in open vacuum and floats back aboard.

name: Sarsticor
summary: Sarsticor is a masked rider of the frontier who fights with acrobatics, blades and an uncanny horse. His ranks are a posse of timeworn outlaws and ghostly lawmen.

feats.scene: Sarsticor vaults from his saddle and cuts a hanging rope in one pass.
Sarsticor rolls out from under a toppled wagon and remounts.

name: Stsetor
summary: Stsetor is a former carnival oddity who acquired mind-reading after his child's death and began staging stage shows. His thoughts slip into rich men's secrets, and he dies chasing a ghost.

feats.scene: Stsetor pries a coin from a stranger's pocket and a secret from his skull.
Stsetor trips over a gravestone and cannot rise from the fall.

name: Terrnoenu
summary: Terrnoenu is a ringmaster-surgeon who believes people are flawed and must be remade into blank-faced servants. He speaks to a goat idol in his head and tours the land leaving empty homes behind.

feats.scene: Terrnoenu swings a cleaver through a butcher's block in a single chop.
Terrnoenu absorbs a hard shove into a tent pole and keeps humming.

name: Nasreval
summary: Nasreval is a cave-born orphan who rose to the surface after her people's tunnels fell in. Cosmic rays gave her flight and strength, and she keeps a trophy hall in orbit.

feats.scene: Nasreval lifts a fallen cavern arch and carries it to the ocean.
Nasreval stands under a landslide that buries a small hillside.

name: Nalanilu
summary: Nalanilu is a slow, heavy liquid-metal automaton who can reshape himself without losing his heft. He leads his siblings in fusing into walls and barricades.

feats.scene: Nalanilu stretches into a hammer and flattens a shuttle bay door.
Nalanilu melts and re-forms after a heavy cannon shell.

name: Numnumsi
summary: Numnumsi is a dull-witted workhorse made of grey liquid metal, always first to step forward when trouble starts. He combines with other automata to hold the line against lab-born monsters.

feats.scene: Numnumsi balloons his fist and knocks a lab beast through a brick wall.
Numnumsi is flattened by a falling crane and slowly pours himself upright.

name: Lansolle
summary: Lansolle is a heavy machine-man who powers on with a flat announcement and moves like a boulder. He lives only while a small control core stays whole.

feats.scene: Lansolle drives a leaden fist through a parked bus.
Lansolle takes a direct cannon blast and keeps lumbering forward.

name: Tirale
summary: Tirale is a petty troublemaker working the streets of a made-up city under a silly stage name. Little is known except that he hates the local armoured hero.

feats.scene: Tirale heaves a sandbag at a window and shatters it.
Tirale bounces off an alley wall and limps away.

name: Tiaeotiu
summary: Tiaeotiu is a young liquid-metal automaton, strong and stretchy, who brings her own knowledge of the soft grey metal she is made from. She joins a sisterhood of machine heroines.

feats.scene: Tiaeotiu stretches an arm across a street and flips a delivery van.
Tiaeotiu absorbs a wrecking ball and reforms with a shrug.

name: Nastla
summary: Nastla is the clumsy son of two retired champions, strong enough to punch out a sea serpent but prone to tripping over his own boots. He must stay wet or he suffocates.

feats.scene: Nastla knocks a sea serpent senseless with a wild haymaker underwater.
Nastla trips from a rooftop and climbs back up the thirteen floors.

name: Llilenenu
summary: Llilenenu is a cold tactician and interrogator in a militarised mirror world. He is the grandson of a famed pilot and wins by analysis rather than muscle.

feats.scene: Llilenenu swings a bar stool into a prisoner's cell door and bends the frame.
Llilenenu stands unmoved after a rifle butt to the stomach.

name: Sesnauau
summary: Sesnauau is a peak-fit armoured enforcer who wields a glowing blade and bat-shaped throwing stars. His uniform bristles with flags of a cruel regime, and his courtship is clumsy and rejected.

feats.scene: Sesnauau cuts a steel door in two with a glowing blade.
Sesnauau absorbs a grenade burst through his heavy armour.

name: Lulesle
summary: Lulesle is a sausage-themed villain who serves in a gaggle of silly foreign henchmen. The pun of his name does most of the work.

feats.scene: Lulesle throws a link of heavy sausage at a rival's head.
Lulesle slides down a laundry chute and lands upright.

name: Riaamolor
summary: Riaamolor is a schoolboy whose father works for military intelligence. He nearly gets his father killed by running into the road, and then clings to hope.

feats.scene: Riaamolor kicks a football over a schoolyard fence.
Riaamolor scrapes his knees badly and shrugs it off.

name: Liueoial
summary: Liueoial is a politician who rises to lead a mirrored republic and meets a quick end. A burst of heat vision from a superior invader ends his term.

feats.scene: Liueoial pounds a lectern to quiet a rowdy hall.
Liueoial is felled in a single flash of heat.

name: Varnti
summary: Varnti is a wealthy newspaper publisher by day and masked avenger by night. He slips into a red cloak and highwayman hat to guard the downtrodden, helped by a loyal chauffeur.

feats.scene: Varnti fires a pistol shot that knocks a gun from a thug's grip.
Varnti takes a hard beating in a warehouse and still stands.

name: Nenurnsor
summary: Nenurnsor is a green-skinned demon champion who can split himself in two and rakes with claws. He is chosen to duel for a mortal's soul in a hellish contest.

feats.scene: Nenurnsor rakes a stone altar into rubble with his claws.
Nenurnsor survives a collapsing pillar of black rock and splits to fight on.

name: Lliles
summary: Lliles is a young sorcerer from a gem-bright realm who saw a dreadful future and travelled through time to avoid it. Every team he asks to join turns him away out of fear.

feats.scene: Lliles hurls a sphere of crimson light that levels an empty farmhouse.
Lliles shrugs off a blast of magic that cracks the stones beneath him.

name: Toleter
summary: Toleter is an aged fighting instructor with no legs who still teaches strikes from a seated stance. He once fought in a brotherly pair and keeps a dojo hidden in a foreign city.

feats.scene: Toleter strikes a hanging sandbag with a seated palm and splits the seam.
Toleter takes a straight kick on his forearms and does not slide.

name: Resora
summary: Resora is a homeless veteran who lost both lower limbs to a mine and rolls through the city on a wheeled tray. He talks loudly, and he backs a masked anarchist in small ways.

feats.scene: Resora pushes his tray over a curb with a hard shove.
Resora shrugs off a hard shove from a street thug.

name: Tiullarer
summary: Tiullarer is a manufactured thunder deity forged from stolen alien tech to seize a vast country. He chants of old gods and calls down bolts, but fear creeps in when one of his fellows falls.

feats.scene: Tiullarer calls down a rain of bolts that levels a district of the square.
Tiullarer stands in the middle of a thunderous blast and laughs.

name: Rnuserlia
summary: Rnuserlia is a purple-haired warrior of a grim fire-world who fights with blades and bare hands. She once served a tyrant's elite and now trades work among a lethal sisterhood.

feats.scene: Rnuserlia hacks through a bulkhead with a heavy blade.
Rnuserlia absorbs a point-blank blast that shatters a column.

name: Nanam
summary: Nanam is a street informant who lost most of his fingers to a client's cruel debt-collection. He trades gossip for scraps and lingers in the quieter alleys of the port city.

feats.scene: Nanam pushes a rusted shopping cart through a narrow lane.
Nanam takes a stumble onto wet pavement and gets up grinning.

name: Ntrauas
summary: Ntrauas is a bearded circus performer with skill at riding and tumbling, who poses as a famous heroine for the sake of the show. She keeps the audience calm when a trickster strikes.

feats.scene: Ntrauas throws a handstand off a galloping pony.
Ntrauas rolls out of a tumbling tent pole and bounds upright.

name: Raeoni
summary: Raeoni is a brilliant scientist confined to a wheelchair who helps her brother perfect armour and cloning tech. She later wears an enormous battle frame and drives it with ruthless confidence.

feats.scene: Raeoni slams a battle-frame fist through a reinforced vault wall.
Raeoni walks out of a collapsed lab in her armoured frame.

name: Niaiumsti
summary: Niaiumsti is an unemployed young woman who loses her parents and steps into a stormy, city-wide feud with her brother. She appears only for a brief stretch of a television drama.

feats.scene: Niaiumsti slaps a tabletop in a heated argument.
Niaiumsti bruises her hip and waves off the pain.

name: Teltone
summary: Teltone is a teenage hacker who breaks into guarded networks for sport and is recruited to a ring of altered mercenaries. His new body is a patchwork of gifts forged on an orbiting lab.

feats.scene: Teltone melts a terminal and the wall behind it with a surge of unlicensed power.
Teltone shrugs off a blast that rips through the hull panel beside him.

name: Vetoror
summary: Vetoror is a brown-haired stranger who flares into a single memorable fight and vanishes from the record. He wears a bulbous visor that glows when he concentrates.

feats.scene: Vetoror shoots a flare of focused light that cracks a concrete post.
Vetoror is knocked into a fence and stands up, dazed.

name: Telntili
summary: Telntili is a failed schoolboy turned fixer who sells a cleanup service to burglars. His rubber-tipped helmet wipes prints and footprints, though a sharp-eyed pair of vigilantes finally trap him.

feats.scene: Telntili jabs a pointed shoe into a rival's shin and sends him sprawling.
Telntili's padded helmet absorbs a thrown wrench without a dent.

name: Ntonumanu
summary: Ntonumanu is a plastic-brick henchman hired by a clown to wreck a toy city. His rubbing-out gimmick is mostly a gag and he is beaten by the first sensible hero.

feats.scene: Ntonumanu bashes a brick wall into snapping studs.
Ntonumanu pops apart from a hit and snaps back together.

name: Vacelin
summary: Vacelin is a red-eyed bruiser on a queen's strike squad who ignites anything he glares at. His flames are fierce but small, and his temper burns faster than his fires.

feats.scene: Vacelin torches a parked bus until its frame sags and melts.
Vacelin stands in a collapsing doorway wreathed in his own smoke.

name: Totiuni
summary: Totiuni is a street dealer who gains blazing powers in a night of strange light, then murders his boss and sets out to rule the district. He recruits other changed people as soldiers and hungers for more.

feats.scene: Totiuni sets a whole tenement block ablaze with one furious shout.
Totiuni walks through a burning stairwell that drops a floor beneath him.

name: Tiunineo
summary: Tiunineo is a kind-hearted rebel who leads a resistance against an iron regime and carries a frost-throwing pistol. He falls in love with a fellow fighter and stays to help friends through grief.

feats.scene: Tiunineo freezes a convoy truck's engine solid with a single burst.
Tiunineo shakes off a rifle graze and keeps rallying his crew.

name: Teseiu
summary: Teseiu is a gun-for-hire in an alternate timeline who trusts one chilly weapon above all else. He talks big, hits hard enough to numb a rival and never plans past the next job.

feats.scene: Teseiu frosts a loading-dock door shut with a pulse from his weapon.
Teseiu takes a punch to the jaw and grins through the blood.

name: Tonesas
summary: Tonesas is a lawman on a mirrored world who arrests a ring of crooks with a frost-throwing sidearm. His team springs a trap and then is whisked toward a bloody moon.

feats.scene: Tonesas sprays a prison corridor with frost that locks every door.
Tonesas lands a hard fall and walks it off.

name: Ceova
summary: Ceova is a thief with a mechanic's mind, a marksman's eye and a pair of tinted goggles. He makes his living from a cold-spitting pistol and the fear that follows it.

feats.scene: Ceova coats a bank's front steps in slick ice with one shot.
Ceova rolls clear of a car bumper and fires back.

name: Anosst
summary: Anosst is a tinkerer who stole a particle machine and accidentally irradiated his pistol into a freezing tool. He sells his talents for comfort rather than conquest and aims low.

feats.scene: Anosst blasts a gust of frost across a rooftop and snaps a railing.
Anosst shrugs off a punch from a bored rival.

name: Corlust
summary: Corlust is a bald veteran criminal whose body is fused with a frost weapon and who dies of the disease it breeds. A quiet visit from his old rival brings him his only moment of rest.

feats.scene: Corlust floods a street with a sheet of ice from a fused arm.
Corlust lies calmly while a slow illness wears him down.

name: Nasrnnt
summary: Nasrnnt is a gangster present at a grand clash in a future city where many strong people lose their gifts. He carries a frost pistol, and little else is known.

feats.scene: Nasrnnt chills a parked cab until its tyres burst.
Nasrnnt stumbles in the dust and keeps firing.

name: Aunnauti
summary: Aunnauti is a screen villain who builds freezing devices, from handguns to enormous orbiting dishes. He roars about endless winter and always loses the final fight.

feats.scene: Aunnauti turns a satellite dish on a coastal county and frosts every roof.
Aunnauti is knocked out of his chair by an angry hero.

name: Ernami
summary: Ernami is a mad inventor and painter who names himself after a famous master and builds flying contraptions for his terror campaign. His luck ends when a pilot shoots his machine from the sky.

feats.scene: Ernami drops a bomb from his flapping aircraft onto a small fortress.
Ernami survives a crash into a field before the wreck gives out.

name: Miatonva
summary: Miatonva is a scientist and patriot, burned by a crashed starship's glow into a flying giant of fire and strength. He leads a family of outcasts and returns home after a long exile.

feats.scene: Miatonva hurls a ball of flame that cracks open a quarry wall.
Miatonva ploughs through a collapsing bridge and keeps flying.

name: Seolerco
summary: Seolerco is a cheerful giant who turns up in a children's puzzle segment, hidden in a drawing. His mightiness is never tested, and he laughs along with the viewers.

feats.scene: Seolerco claps his hands and startles a studio audience.
Seolerco bumps into a painted backdrop and giggles.

name: Eoirn
summary: Eoirn is a wandering hero with fire-red hair who borrows another's name and is promptly cursed with a missing mouth. His trick is undone when the genie finds out.

feats.scene: Eoirn throws a glowing fist at a cartoon boulder and cracks it.
Eoirn tumbles off a tower and bounces unharmed.

source_title: Leonid Kovar (Teen Titans Go! TV Series)

name: Rortas
summary: Rortas is a soldier warped by an experiment into a towering, glowing brute who must vent his energy or risk meltdown. He hides in an abandoned plant until a new team asks him to lead.

feats.scene: Rortas vents his stored energy in a blast that levels a ridge of pines.
Rortas stands in a reactor hall as its walls peel away.

name: Anetern
summary: Anetern is a married physicist who is forced at gunpoint to turn a power plant's core into a bomb. He is slight, brown-eyed and entirely without combat training.

feats.scene: Anetern, under duress, tunes a reactor into a device that could flatten a hill.
Anetern collapses under a thug's heavy shove.

name: Onestisor
summary: Onestisor is a swamp monster knit from the souls of four murder victims, rampaging in search of the people who wronged them. A lover's face briefly lets one soul steer the beast home.

feats.scene: Onestisor flings a delivery van into a marsh with one swipe.
Onestisor rises from a hail of gunfire with mud closing over the wounds.

name: Casas
summary: Casas is a shy scientist from a bottled city who idolises a famous heroine and later becomes her friend. Under a glowing mantle she guards her town with flight and strength.

feats.scene: Casas hauls a derailed carriage off a bridge and sets it down gently.
Casas weathers a rail bridge collapsing on her shoulders.

name: Llecolres
summary: Llecolres is a spiteful schoolgirl who films cruel pranks and crackles with live current. She calls her fans by a silly nickname and promises to supe up every stunt.

feats.scene: Llecolres arcs a bolt across a gym and fuses the scoreboard.
Llecolres shrugs off a thrown locker door in a shower of sparks.

source_title: Leslie Willis (DC Super Hero Girls TV Series)

name: Nincorci
summary: Nincorci is a bigoted camp volunteer who swallows a miracle serum and becomes a flying brute with no manners. He ignores his own side's plans and goes hunting for a champion.

feats.scene: Nincorci punches through a bus shelter and the wall behind it.
Nincorci tears free of a collapsing lodge roof and keeps flying.

name: Llititel
summary: Llititel is a pit fighter with brawn and a pair of crude shock gloves. He talks tough, falls asleep on his feet and dies in a plunge after annoying his paymaster.

feats.scene: Llititel zaps a rival's chest and drops him on the mat.
Llititel shakes off a boot to the face before going down.

name: Amstsu
summary: Amstsu is a brash enforcer who inherits his sibling's crackling suit and ambitions. He hires out to crime bosses and dreams of being a household name.

feats.scene: Amstsu discharges his suit into a steel safe and welds it shut.
Amstsu takes a hard beating from a young archer and stays up.

name: Stleaun
summary: Stleaun is a black-haired researcher who joins a team of daring explorers. Little is recorded about him beyond a love of science and a steady nerve.

feats.scene: Stleaun hurls a rope over a ledge and hauls himself up.
Stleaun walks away from a rough landing.

name: Iurenno
summary: Iurenno is a red-haired matriarch who founds a vast company and sees it stolen by her own son. Locked away on a distant island, she walks free the moment his reign collapses.

feats.scene: Iurenno bangs a fist on a boardroom table and silences her rivals.
Iurenno endures years of captivity without breaking.

name: Tanurnlo
summary: Tanurnlo is a black-haired daughter of an offshoot sea people who delved into forbidden spells and clawed her way back to the surface. She rescues a grieving swimmer and flees before he sees her face.

feats.scene: Tanurnlo rakes a sunken hull open with her claws.
Tanurnlo dives through a crushing current and surfaces unscathed.

name: Telllanau
summary: Telllanau is a white-haired retired digger of ruins who travels to far corners and brings back trinkets for his daughter. Some of those relics carry riddles and curses.

feats.scene: Telllanau pries a stone lid off a tomb with an iron bar.
Telllanau climbs out of a collapsed trench with a bruised hip.

name: Vosntau
summary: Vosntau is a street hood with a taste for guns and a flimsy nickname who works for a clown boss. His career ends fast and loudly.

feats.scene: Vosntau empties a pistol into a parked car's door.
Vosntau takes a cudgel to the shoulder and rolls clear.

name: Eortum
summary: Eortum is a legendary mob boss who rules the city until a masked costume party goes wrong. Sorry for the hit he ordered, he spends his last years in regret.

feats.scene: Eortum hurls a heavy ashtray across a smoky room.
Eortum is pinned by a toppled prop and does not break.

source_title: Lewis Moxon (The Brave and the Bold)

name: Tintecor
summary: Tintecor is an old man who returns from decades in the stars and begs his alien hosts for youth. As a young man again he soaks up waves of heat and shoots them back, then dies satisfied.

feats.scene: Tintecor concentrates absorbed heat into a beam that melts a lamppost.
Tintecor stands in a blast of heat and takes it into himself.

name: Numvalvau
summary: Numvalvau is a career thug who partners with a beast-themed accomplice to rob a bank, leaving a stylised emblem behind. He is muscle first and a thinker never.

feats.scene: Numvalvau shoulders a vault door ajar.
Numvalvau shrugs off a baton across the back.

name: Setersor
summary: Setersor is the bald chief of a heroic team on a world of villains, stealing a device to stop a missile that could end every reality. He crosses dimensions to beg for help.

feats.scene: Setersor triggers a transdimensional gadget that tears a rift in a laboratory.
Setersor is thrown against a vault wall and keeps running.

source_title: Lex Luthor (Crisis on Two Earths: Crime Syndicate Earth)

name: Riavaeon
summary: Riavaeon is a cold magnate, born in a slum, who builds an empire only to lose it to an alien visitor's fame. He becomes a criminal mastermind, hijacks a machine mind and plots his foe's ruin.

feats.scene: Riavaeon fires a suit-mounted cannon that carves a trench in a street.
Riavaeon survives a tumble from a falling tower in his powered armour.

name: Lanul
summary: Lanul is a bald scientist who runs a laboratory firm in a gleaming city. His experiments are strange and his temper is worse.

feats.scene: Lanul pulls a lever and sends a spark through a bench of coils.
Lanul is flung from his chair in a lab accident and rises.

name: Vasnetel
summary: Vasnetel is a bald genius imprisoned in a ghost dimension among other exiles. He schemes by lying, building and waiting for a gap in the walls.

feats.scene: Vasnetel hurls a beaker of acid across a cold cell.
Vasnetel withstands a long fall through grey void and stands.

name: Reseoniu
summary: Reseoniu is a scientist-criminal who builds a robotic youth to steal a serum, accidentally kills a doctor and turns two old friends into enemies. He plays them against each other for years.

feats.scene: Reseoniu directs his robot to rip a safe from a wall.
Reseoniu is thrown across a room by an enraged hero.

name: Rentioro
summary: Rentioro is a brown-haired reporter who becomes a famous flying champion, in a world where his best friend wears the cowl. He uses x-ray sight to learn the truth and is stunned.

feats.scene: Rentioro hurls a falling steel girder into a river to save a pier.
Rentioro stands in a collapse of brick and glass and dusts himself off.

name: Iuanrum
summary: Iuanrum is a green-eyed genius who is jealous of a hero's fame and stages a petty attack on a museum. He briefly shrinks and ages his foe before breaking down and going to jail.

feats.scene: Iuanrum drives a mechanical beast through a museum wall.
Iuanrum is handcuffed by a flustered hero and does not resist.

name: Nortor
summary: Nortor is a bald schemer from an old cartoon who joins a gang of villains and invents zany gadgets. He is the first of his kind on the small screen.

feats.scene: Nortor fires a pop-gun gadget that scatters a crate of fruit.
Nortor falls into a vat of paint and walks out grinning.

name: Nusin
summary: Nusin is a blocky toy tycoon in a brick-built world who allies with a clown to win high office. He wears a heavy suit, fires a gizmo that unravels dark objects and wears many costumes.

feats.scene: Nusin trains a gizmo on a black tower and watches it tumble into studs.
Nusin's suit shrugs off a plastic cannon shot.

name: Lliiutel
summary: Lliiutel is a pint-sized tycoon in a world of chibi rivals who rides a toy robot suit. His sidekicks mock it and the heroes laugh him off.

feats.scene: Lliiutel stomps a tiny robot into a miniature storefront.
Lliiutel gets stepped on by a toy giant and bounces back.

name: Alsturia
summary: Alsturia is a bald criminal scientist who once admired a young hero before a fire cost him his hair. He commands a hall full of villains and dreams up wild schemes.

feats.scene: Alsturia unleashes a beam from his battle rig that melts a lamppost row.
Alsturia's rig soaks up a punch that dents a vault.

name: Ceorianeo
summary: Ceorianeo is a smooth-talking college scientist and schemer who cheats for cash and fame. He dupes nerds into building weapons and loses a precious mineral before it proves its worth.

feats.scene: Ceorianeo fires a dorm-built laser that burns a hole in a gym roof.
Ceorianeo tumbles down a bleacher and brushes himself off.

name: Storlis
summary: Storlis is a bald mastermind who pilots his own ship, builds robots and wears a battle suit when the schemes demand it. He trades lies for leverage and loses on points.

feats.scene: Storlis rams his ship through a skyscraper's upper floor.
Storlis's suit absorbs a heavy punch and sparks.

source_title: Lex Luthor (The Brave and the Bold)

name: Eomastu
summary: Eomastu is a sulky teenage duplicate raised inside a flooded workshop by a guardian who keeps trying to teach it manners. The red-haired youth rewires pumps and alarms to prank the dock crew, and mostly succeeds.

feats.scene: Eomastu shoves a loaded tool cart off a jetty and it crashes into the shallows.
Eomastu bounces off a rusted hatch during a sprint and walks away with a bruise.

name: Riliallle
summary: Riliallle was a newborn heir of a far colony whose entire reign consisted of one nursery and a lot of crying. The infant's crib sat in a tower that its parents adored, and the colony's fate overshadowed everything else.

feats.scene: Riliallle kicks a rattle across the nursery floor in a fit of temper.
Riliallle tumbles from a cushioned bench onto the rug without a scratch.

name: Monnum
summary: Monnum is a quiet lab analyst who matches fibre traces and fingerprints for a municipal force and keeps a spare umbrella in every drawer. Colleagues trust its eye for detail more than any scanner.

feats.scene: Monnum swings a steel evidence locker door shut so hard the frame rattles.
Monnum is thrown across a corridor by a shove and gets back up winded.

name: Veocer
summary: Veocer is a glamorous being of living light who models by day and sprints along beams of radiance by night. Its fame matters to it nearly as much as its speed, and the two keep colliding in public.

feats.scene: Veocer focuses a shining beam through a warehouse wall and the roof collapses.
Veocer shrugs off a falling crane that disperses into her glow without harm.
Veocer streaks along a rooftop sunbeam and arrives before her own echo.

name: Eretilntu
summary: Eretilntu is a night-shift caregiver and amateur turntable artist who wakes with a patch of hungry void behind its ribs. The void answers questions with one word and sometimes throws its host across the city.

feats.scene: Eretilntu opens the void and a hillside bends inward until it folds shut.
Eretilntu absorbs a rifle volley and a collapsing bridge into the void without harm.

name: Orlasma
summary: Orlasma is a farm-raised drifter who found a hollowed vegetable lamp in a hay barn and learned its glow was never the real source. The wanderer later joined a ragged band of mystics, flickering between fear and fog.

feats.scene: Orlasma flings a ball of green flame that flattens a stone shed.
Orlasma climbs out of a wrecked cart with only singed sleeves.

name: Vitirel
summary: Vitirel is a precocious child shuttled between rooftop safehouses by two very different guardians. Its favourite game is quietly counting guards, and its drawings of escape routes are alarmingly accurate.

feats.scene: Vitirel throws a stone that knocks a coin off a fence rail.
Vitirel drops from a low wall onto gravel and laughs it off.

name: Vanautan
summary: Vanautan is a soft-spoken field operative who trades favours with exiles and dresses in a battered flight harness. The harness lifts him for short hops and hums angrily whenever it overheats.

feats.scene: Vanautan rams a parked van with a harness-boosted shoulder and crumples the door.
Vanautan survives a stairwell fall thanks to the padded harness.
Vanautan skims across a parking deck at the harness's top setting.

name: Covarlin
summary: Covarlin is a shaven-headed meditation teacher who joined a band of multinational defenders and gathered storm energy through breath practice. His open palm can rattle a courtyard, though he prefers silence to fighting.

feats.scene: Covarlin slaps the air and a ring of pressure splits a stone bench.
Covarlin sits unmoved while a rope-thick bolt of energy hits his shoulders.

name: Rniia
summary: Rniia is a blue-skinned elder who keeps a vigil over a bright stone fortress and is reluctant to speak above a murmur. Its mind rings across star lanes while its body floats a hand above the floor.

feats.scene: Rniia nudges a drifting moon off course with a flick of thought.
Rniia floats serenely through a collapsing citadel dome without a mark.

name: Silnolnum
summary: Silnolnum is a restless blue-skinned youth who grew up too quickly and chose order over mercy. Its anger scorched an entire harbour world before older mentors dragged it home to learn restraint.

feats.scene: Silnolnum sears a continent-sized scar through a harbour world's crust.
Silnolnum walks out of a flattened mountain range unmarked.

name: Reonean
summary: Reonean is a masked flag-bearer in a loose crew of patriots who is killed within a handful of issues. Few details survive beyond a swagger and a habit of arriving after the argument is already over.

feats.scene: Reonean clubs a thug with a banner pole and the pole splinters.
Reonean takes a crate to the ribs and stays on his feet.

name: Cinlen
summary: Cinlen is a pale genderless presence that matured in a pod under bare rock and seeded an oasis with plants, insects and animals while still asleep. Waking would reshape every living thing around it.

feats.scene: Cinlen stirs in its pod and a barren plain blooms into a living forest overnight.
Cinlen sleeps through a planet-shaking quake in its cradle undisturbed.

name: Toncil
summary: Toncil is a balding rogue scientist who tinkers with beams that make hostages doll-sized, then plots coups from a rented basement. Its gadgets work well until the henchmen touch them.

feats.scene: Toncil's shrink beam blows the lock off a vault and scatters the contents.
Toncil walks away from a collapsed shelf with only dusty shoulders.

name: Lortaunt
summary: Lortaunt is a nimble convict with sticky fingers who is drafted into a hand-picked wartime squad and serves it faithfully despite a flexible conscience. Pockets empty themselves when it walks past.

feats.scene: Lortaunt tosses a lifted wallet and it knocks a hat off a sentry.
Lortaunt scrapes along a barbed fence and loses only a sleeve.

name: Sornauore
summary: Sornauore is an auburn-haired head of state known publicly only by a nickname used in radio chatter. Its calm voice steers a fractured nation through a very bad first year.

feats.scene: Sornauore slams a heavy council table and the gavel snaps in half.
Sornauore steps out of a wrecked motorcade with a split lip.

name: Rivalau
summary: Rivalau is a petty protection racketeer who rattles a harbour district's shopkeepers, and he is shot by a masked vigilante before the month is out. His boasting outlasts his reputation.

feats.scene: Rivalau kicks in a cash register stand and the till bursts open.
Rivalau takes a bottle across the head and keeps shouting.

name: Ortani
summary: Ortani is a dark-haired child of a shrunken-city exile and a surface-dweller, raised among tiny avenues under glass. Its twin sibling and loud aunts make every birthday an event.

feats.scene: Ortani hurls a toy crystal across a bottled plaza.
Ortani tumbles down a short stair and laughs.

name: Vaiantu
summary: Vaiantu is a polished executive who quietly funds a travelling troupe of super-powered thieves through a family firm. Nobody suspects her, and she likes it that way.

feats.scene: Vaiantu hurls a heavy desk lamp through a glass partition.
Vaiantu walks away from a limousine fender-bender unscratched.

name: Veanstu
summary: Veanstu is a frontier lawwoman with twin revolvers and a gambler's memory for faces. Her sheriff's star was earned by exposing a rigged ballot in a dusty town.

feats.scene: Veanstu fires both guns and splits a saloon sign from its chain.
Veanstu takes a hard fall from a rearing horse and rises with her hat intact.

name: Varva
summary: Varva ran a lantern-lit guesthouse in a war-torn border province and later guided a stranger through weeks of jungle. Its decision to stay quiet about a child shaped decades of silence.

feats.scene: Varva smashes a ceramic jug over a raider's skull.
Varva hikes through a fortnight of rain and fever and arrives standing.

name: Nareson
summary: Nareson is a tentacled ocean scientist who wields a glowing wrist ring and charts coral beds in off-hours. Its constructs shimmer like jellyfish and its patience beats any current.

feats.scene: Nareson fires a green bolt that bores through a cargo hull.
Nareson endures crushing deep-water pressure in a bubble of light.

name: Nuentrn
summary: Nuentrn is a swimmer-turned-ring-bearer in a nail-biting alternate timeline who guards a river planet with a glowing band and a stubborn grin. Its tail whips up wakes that flip skiffs.

feats.scene: Nuentrn hurls a ring-forged boulder that crushes a levee gate.
Nuentrn shrugs off a collapsing dock beam in a shield of light.

name: Ialer
summary: Ialer is a gossip writer whose body liquefies after a roadside accident near fallen space rocks. Its reporting improved enormously once it could slip under doors, though its temper did not.

feats.scene: Ialer surges as a wave through a hallway and flattens a filing cabinet.
Ialer splashes apart under a hammer swing and reforms unharmed.

name: Ntille
summary: Ntille is a sharp-eyed counsellor who accepts unusual payment from a celebrated nightclub owner and gives frank advice in return. Its waiting-room couch has heard everything.

feats.scene: Ntille slaps a desk bell so hard it rolls off.
Ntille spills down a stairwell and finishes her sentence on the way.

name: Naule
summary: Naule is a rich oil heiress who swapped balls for bedpans, tending retirees and dating a masked orphan's guardian without knowing it. Its warmth wins patients faster than any pill.

feats.scene: Naule swings a metal tray into a gunman's wrist.
Naule stays calm through a kidnapping van ride and a rough shove.

name: Corial
summary: Corial is a camera-ready presenter whose live feed accidentally broadcasts a private crush, then gets dragged into a looking-glass realm by mischievous rogues. Its microphone is never far away.

feats.scene: Corial swings a microphone and knocks a hat from a thief.
Corial tumbles through a shattered mirror frame and stands up unhurt.

name: Coramoir
summary: Coramoir is an author and reporter whose memory of a speedy spouse and two children was wiped by a rewritten timeline. Its stubborn notebooks keep a whole life stored on paper.

feats.scene: Coramoir hurls a typewriter at a prowler and cracks a window.
Coramoir clings to a speeding tram rail and holds on for blocks.

name: Loreoneon
summary: Loreoneon is a prairie archery champion hired to double for a film star and tempted into burglary by a gang boss. Its arrows never miss, and its conscience tugs harder than the bowstring.

feats.scene: Loreoneon looses a shaft that pins a bandit's coat to a barn door.
Loreoneon survives a rough tumble off a stunt horse.

name: Rusamona
summary: Rusamona is a widowed socialite who merges with a stepson to wear a golden helm and wield order magic under the watch of a patient mentor. Its power flares brightly and sours when allied with chaos.

feats.scene: Rusamona unleashes a golden blast that vaporises a street of parked cars.
Rusamona stands within a collapsing tower and the helm shields her.

name: Llllora
summary: Llllora is a blue-haired party kid with a knack for bending metal and riding the planet's magnetic lines. Its bouncy field shields entire crowds, even when the owner is rather tipsy.

feats.scene: Llllora pulls a steel gate off its hinges and slings it across a lot.
Llllora blocks a skidding truck with a humming shield.

name: Vanasiu
summary: Vanasiu is a sleep-deprived literature scholar and new mother who dreams a nightmare into the waking world and gets trapped in its place. Its rent worries stay very real throughout.

feats.scene: Vanasiu hurls a thick textbook across a seminar room.
Vanasiu works three sleepless nights and still carries her baby up stairs.

name: Teoreles
summary: Teoreles is a hired killer who works as one half of a duo of grim fishermen. His thin cord is deadly in a way no one wants to describe.

feats.scene: Teoreles whips a weighted cord that snaps a lamp post bracket.
Teoreles walks off a long fall onto a dumpster lid.

name: Stuereros
summary: Stuereros is a lost space-born orphan who can slide through walls and people, dragged from a storm into a hostile dimension. Its homesickness is as strong as its ghostly gift.

feats.scene: Stuereros solidifies mid-wall and bursts a brick partition outward.
Stuereros phases through a speeding hover-cart without a bruise.

name: Nteses
summary: Nteses is a nightclub proprietor and spirit-working rival of a chain-smoking trickster, skilled at binding minds and exacting debts. Its smile carries more menace than any curse.

feats.scene: Nteses hurls a hex that cracks a club's support pillar.
Nteses endures a prolonged scorching in a pit and walks out unbowed.

name: Lorteres
summary: Lorteres is a crash-orphaned boy brought up by big cats who carves tools from wreckage and rules a pride. Its spear and brotherhood with a cub make it a savannah legend.

feats.scene: Lorteres hurls a carved spear through a charging beast's flank.
Lorteres rolls through thorn scrub and shakes it off.

name: Nensau
summary: Nensau is an unflappable agent who foiled a plot to seize a parliament, took a bullet for it, and kept working. Its calm and tailoring are equally impeccable.

feats.scene: Nensau disarms three gunmen with a thrown chair and a quick elbow.
Nensau shakes off a shoulder wound and keeps pursuing.

name: Rnote
summary: Rnote is a time-hopping archivist who absorbed the leftover energy of fallen guardians to protect the timeline. Its footsteps echo across centuries, and in one possible future it rules the whole stream.

feats.scene: Rnote lets loose a pulse of stored energy that hollows out a city square.
Rnote phases through a collapsing temporal gate unscathed.
Rnote leaps along the timestream and arrives before she left.

name: Amotora
summary: Amotora is a model who once worked evenings at a rough establishment and befriends a gentle neighbour who always runs late. Its kindness comes with a carefully guarded past.

feats.scene: Amotora throws a shoe at a drunk and hits his shoulder.
Amotora takes a hard slap and keeps standing.

name: Sasesar
summary: Sasesar is an embassy go-between who coordinates visiting heroes' schedules and keeps tea warm for her husband, a costumed guard. Its clipboard is mightier than most blades.

feats.scene: Sasesar slams a stapler onto a desk and cracks the blotter.
Sasesar stands unmoved in a doorway through a loud brawl.

name: Cotum
summary: Cotum is a roaming trailer-park mother who found a star-fallen capsule holding an infant and raised it with love despite hardship. Its home was violently ended by old enemies.

feats.scene: Cotum slaps a screen door open and it cracks the frame.
Cotum endures a bumpy drive through a desert storm.

name: Tinlan
summary: Tinlan is a retired heist planner turned caseworker who laces up skates for one last job with a doomed sibling. Its agility on ice is impossible to follow.

feats.scene: Tinlan spins a skate blade through a rooftop vent grille.
Tinlan lands a rooftop leap onto a ledge and rolls away.

name: Stielsti
summary: Stielsti is an investigative reporter who survived three gunshots and woke with a gift for bending male minds. Its revenge on a crime family left a trail of obedient bodyguards.

feats.scene: Stielsti orders a bodyguard to ram a door and the hinges break.
Stielsti shrugs off a baton blow that would have felled most people.

name: Illlonle
summary: Illlonle is a young heiress whose father's worry-erasing machine stripped away her conscience. Its giant mechanical servants and a marching horde of undead raiders made her a menace until a cure restored her.

feats.scene: Illlonle commands a towering machine that topples a brick warehouse.
Illlonle walks away from a toppled throne unhurt.

name: Talannin
summary: Talannin is a dim, multicoloured menace who flashes weak beams at passersby and lurks in the pay of a shadowy master. Its glow flickers when upset.

feats.scene: Talannin fires a prismatic flash that cracks a shop window.
Talannin shrugs off a thrown brick in a burst of colour.

name: Esteva
summary: Esteva is a stretchy yellow-eyed robot built to serve a scientist's squad and powered by a fragile core. Its elastic limbs and gusty breath make it a handy scout.

feats.scene: Esteva whips a rubbery arm and knocks a crate across a hangar.
Esteva stretches under a falling beam and snaps back unharmed.

name: Timitau
summary: Timitau is a pint-sized war-planet cadet who idolises her giant role model and joins a youthful team hoping to grow. Its rod and cube make up for what it lacks in height.

feats.scene: Timitau lifts a delivery truck over her head with one hand.
Timitau shrugs off a cannon shell that dents a wall.

name: Iumvalral
summary: Iumvalral is a bald secret-society officer who moves unseen through mobile command posts, wearing ambient gadgets as a second skin. Its orders are short, and its tech is shorter-lived.

feats.scene: Iumvalral triggers a gadget that bursts a locked steel door.
Iumvalral survives a stairwell tumble thanks to padded armour.

name: Rniti
summary: Rniti is a dogged print journalist who chases leads through rain-slick alleys and cramped newsrooms, armed with a battered notebook, a pocket recorder and a stubborn streak that unsettles powerful men.

feats.scene: Rniti slams a heavy desk drawer onto the hand of a thief reaching for a camera bag.
Rniti tumbles down a flight of service stairs, stands up, and keeps typing the headline.
Rniti sprints across a rain-soaked plaza to beat a rival to the courthouse steps.

name: Niuniuan
summary: Niuniuan is a ruthless ghostwriter who started on the sports desk and now sells half-true rumours to whichever tycoon pays best; every scandal she prints seems to land a little too conveniently.

feats.scene: Niuniuan hurls a bronze trophy through a window to scatter a crowd of pursuing photographers.
Niuniuan takes a stadium railing across the ribs and still finishes her recorded threat.

name: Lonaurne
summary: Lonaurne is a rooftop reporter who films skyline reunions with a rattling little drone, trading gossip for access and never staying long enough for anyone to ask her name.

feats.scene: Lonaurne flicks a loaded tripod leg into the shin of a security guard.
Lonaurne rides out a gust that rips a billboard loose and cracks it against her back.
Lonaurne vaults three parapets in a row to reach the landing drone before it drops.

name: Stotast
summary: Stotast anchors a late-night broadcast and keeps reporting live while monstrous shapes stomp through the streets behind her, trusting only her teleprompter and an unflappable smile.

feats.scene: Stotast swings a microphone boom to bat away a shard of falling glass.
Stotast is clipped by a hurled slab of plaster mid-sentence and finishes the sign-off anyway.

name: Tamonron
summary: Tamonron is a wartime pamphleteer whose single-page essays circulate hand to hand through a gloomy occupied capital, steadying neighbours who have nothing else to believe in.

feats.scene: Tamonron swings a satchel of lead type into the jaw of a patrolling informer.
Tamonron absorbs a rifle-butt to the shoulder and walks on with the pages still dry.

name: Nastir
summary: Nastir is a masked crime matriarch with silver-white hair who runs the city underworld from a scorched ruin, using smuggler gold and informants to wage a patient war against a distant conspiracy.

feats.scene: Nastir detonates a satchel charge to bring a rival gang's loading dock down across the entrance.
Nastir survives a blast that flattens her old headquarters and lies in a coma for weeks before rising.
Nastir scrambles up a collapsing fire escape ahead of a hired gunman.

source_title: Lois Lane (The World of the Knight)

name: Eolteres
summary: Eolteres is a prickly columnist with a spark-throwing wrist gadget she built from a toy; she nurses a feud with a rival colleague and a crush she would never admit to.

feats.scene: Eolteres fires her wrist gadget and blows a fuse box clean out of a brick wall.
Eolteres hits the pavement after a thug's shove and is back on her feet before he finishes laughing.

name: Carlle
summary: Carlle is a machine bodyguard assembled from stolen processor cores and a borrowed genetic sample, tireless, loyal to its maker's coin, and unaffected by the mind-warping forces that make living men turn on each other.

feats.scene: Carlle punches through a vault door and flings a delivery truck into the next lane.
Carlle stands unmoved as a shipping container drops from a crane onto its shoulders.
Carlle rockets across a frozen basin to intercept a falling hostage.

name: Arorasto
summary: Arorasto is an exiled sorceress-queen with crimson hair who sleeps for decades as living stone and wakes bent on dragging a drowned empire up to conquer the dry world.

feats.scene: Arorasto calls a wall of boiling surf that smashes a coastal fort to rubble.
Arorasto, frozen as a statue, endures decades of tide-slam without a single hairline crack.

name: Liucinan
summary: Liucinan is a rebellious thief who steals a reality-warping jacket from a museum and uses it to shift her mind into a borrowed teenage body, wearing a new life like a coat.

feats.scene: Liucinan twists the jacket's seams and folds a collapsing apartment block back into its frame.
Liucinan is hit by a speeding van and her mind simply slides sideways into the next room.

name: Oraveun
summary: Oraveun is a quiet assistant in a research lab inside a glass bottle city; he carries a single forgotten memory that unlocks a spell cast over a famous family, and he guards it with a teleport beam.

feats.scene: Oraveun fires his teleport beam and relocates a wall of lab shelving across the courtyard.
Oraveun is thrown against a bench by a staged lab blast and loses a decade of memories, yet lives.

name: Ceoiain
summary: Ceoiain is a six-foot-four vigilante in a blue-white mask who rides a loyal, long-suffering mount across the open plains and settles bank heists with twin revolvers and a catchphrase.

feats.scene: Ceoiain empties both revolvers into a safe door and sends the hinge flying across the saloon.
Ceoiain shrugs off a thrown anvil that splinters a hitching post.
Ceoiain gallops flat out across a dry riverbed to catch a runaway coach.

name: Liseoti
summary: Liseoti is a small-time hoodlum who works the night streets alone, resentful of crowds, and scrapes by on pickpocketing and a sharp tongue.

feats.scene: Liseoti drives a fist into the ribs of a startled shopkeeper.
Liseoti takes a baton to the back and keeps limping towards the alley.

name: Taeremil
summary: Taeremil is a gang boss with scaled skin who can slip into a winged serpentine shape in the middle of an ambush, leaping across rooftops and trading blows with armoured fighters.

feats.scene: Taeremil swats a parked sedan across a loading yard with a single clawed arm.
Taeremil shrugs off a point-blank energy blast that scorches the wall behind him.
Taeremil springs from the street to a hovering aircraft's skid in one bound.

name: Erirnun
summary: Erirnun is a lab-grown guardian given a counterfeit childhood and borrowed strength; his cells fail on a countdown, and he spends the time left defending strangers he never had to meet.

feats.scene: Erirnun drives a fist into a crumbling dam spillway and splits it along the seam.
Erirnun holds up a collapsing bridge deck long enough for a bus to roll clear.
Erirnun outruns a falling hazard crane across a quarry floor.

name: Lloraurau
summary: Lloraurau is a diminutive sharpshooter who dazzles crowds with trick shots from a barrel-top stage, then leads a hunting party with a ridiculous hat that eventually gives him away.

feats.scene: Lloraurau shoots a tin cup off a volunteer's head from the far wall of the tent.
Lloraurau drops from a wagon roof into the dirt and rolls up grinning.
Lloraurau flips between three swinging trapezes to reach the rifle rack.

name: Nauesne
summary: Nauesne is a soft-spoken tracker hired to find a witness; he reads bent grass and tyre ruts like a printed map, and loses only to people who refuse to stay in one place.

feats.scene: Nauesne tackles a fleeing witness into a wooden fence and splinters two rails.
Nauesne is knocked cold and locked in a car boot, then kicks the latch free on waking.
Nauesne runs a forest ridge at dusk to cut off a stolen truck.

name: Aunteleo
summary: Aunteleo is a brooding political saboteur who wires an old transport depot with homemade charges and publishes manifestos that nobody finishes reading.

feats.scene: Aunteleo triggers a string of charges and brings an overpass segment down onto a rail yard.
Aunteleo slides down a wet ramp and into a dumpster without losing the detonator.

name: Rialli
summary: Rialli is a living storm cell from a far binary system that swells and shrinks at will, crackling with charge and hurling arcs of plasma at tyrants who seize free worlds.

feats.scene: Rialli unleashes a plasma arc that melts a mile-wide crater in an asteroid fortress.
Rialli swells to a vast thunderhead and swallows a battery of siege cannon fire whole.
Rialli crosses a stellar corridor as a streak of lightning in under a minute.

name: Lerinas
summary: Lerinas is a blond depot mechanic who wears a magnet-coil harness he built himself, dragging scrap iron through the air and holding up whole hangars with a flick of his wrist.

feats.scene: Lerinas yanks an iron meteorite out of orbit and slams it into a quarry pit.
Lerinas takes a dropped engine block on his harness field and barely staggers.

name: Eoltel
summary: Eoltel is a sadistic heir of a warlike dynasty who treats cruelty as an art form; he is vain, untrained, and still overwhelming, since few rivals can match his raw strength.

feats.scene: Eoltel flattens a citadel's outer ring with a single stamp of his boot.
Eoltel stands in the centre of a collapsing tower of rock and walks out unmarked.
Eoltel streaks through a stormy sky to snatch a fleeing captive back to the throne room.

name: Rnntni
summary: Rnntni is a winged young hero born in a prison of shadows who turned away from his tyrannical father; adopted by gentle strangers, he now patrols the capital in a feathered mask.

feats.scene: Rnntni drives both fists into an overturned freighter and flips it back onto its keel.
Rnntni takes a falling radio mast across his shoulders and shakes off the dust.
Rnntni arcs over a ring of storm clouds to catch a falling child.

name: Aniiumcis
summary: Aniiumcis is a quiet conqueror who rules a twin-sunned colony and counsels via a calm, spreading mind-link; he is rarely seen fighting, since few of his subjects ever disobey.

feats.scene: Aniiumcis focuses a mind-surge that cracks the glass spire of a rebel stronghold.
Aniiumcis walks through a bombardment of orbital shells and brushes a cinder off his sleeve.

name: Enutorlan
summary: Enutorlan is a swaggering child who dreams of ruling the whole playground planet and has the muscle to try, scowling at anyone who refuses to bow to his toy crown.

feats.scene: Enutorlan kicks over a play-fort of boulders and sends splinters of rock across a valley.
Enutorlan sits through a collapsing silo and complains only about the dust.
Enutorlan zooms over a mountain range in a sulk.

name: Niareo
summary: Niareo is a gentle ruler of a crystalline realm who wields house magic in defence of his infant daughter; his spells are warm, golden and slow to burn.

feats.scene: Niareo casts a golden sphere that melts a siege tower into slag.
Niareo stands against a surge of usurping sorcery and loses only his footing.

name: Ianoeo
summary: Ianoeo is an iron-fisted master of a chain of tide-washed islands who bends seawater into hammering columns, and who mistakes fear for loyalty until a fisherman proves him wrong.

feats.scene: Ianoeo raises a column of brine that shatters a rebel pier into driftwood.
Ianoeo shrugs off a hurled ballast stone that dents his breastplate.

name: Siceotor
summary: Siceotor is a winged devourer from beyond the edge of creation that feeds on life-force to fuel its rites, aspiring to chew through the stars before an alliance of old souls breaks it.

feats.scene: Siceotor vents a lance of stolen life-force that cracks a moon's crust from pole to pole.
Siceotor absorbs a rain of meteors and grows brighter for it.
Siceotor crosses an orbital gap in a single wingbeat.

name: Esilusto
summary: Esilusto is an ancient occultist-turned-warlord who stole a lantern of jade fire from a fallen star; death never seems to stick, and each revival leaves his flame a little hungrier.

feats.scene: Esilusto lets the lantern erupt and turns a mountain pass to glass.
Esilusto walks through a mob's pyre and steps out with his robes unsinged.

name: Miali
summary: Miali is a formless lieutenant of a war deity who slips into sleeping bodies and marches them against his foes; he has been alive for ages and is quietly fond of his own title.

feats.scene: Miali seizes a siege captain's body and drives it through a stone barricade.
Miali is crushed under a collapsing rampart and drifts out again, unharmed.

name: Valilete
summary: Valilete is a primal steward of endings who drops a needle onto a spinning disc to mark the length of an age; when the disc runs silent, the age it stands for runs out with it.

feats.scene: Valilete lets a record reach its last groove and a whole cosmic age winds down to stillness.
Valilete watches a starburst of rival forces wash across his turntable and does not lose the beat.

name: Iartorla
summary: Iartorla is a bald, kindly monk whose order was wiped out in a single night; the stored devotion of his lost brethren poured into him, making him a gentle, immensely powerful guide.

feats.scene: Iartorla opens his hands and a pillar of white light razes a ridge of invading siege engines.
Iartorla meditates in the heart of a collapsing temple dome and walks out untouched.

name: Variaval
summary: Variaval is a white-haired elder of a jewel-green hall; at his coronation a cursed box loosed shadowy shapes that swallowed his kin, and he spends his years trying to find the door they used.

feats.scene: Variaval sweeps a hand and scatters a flock of wraiths against the hall's pillars.
Variaval stands through a burst of shadow-force and loses only his hat.

name: Nenso
summary: Nenso is a veteran sword-master from a range of windswept crags who rides a feathered steed and teaches the young to hold a blade properly; his stance has outlasted three kingdoms.

feats.scene: Nenso cleaves a boulder in two with one blow of a spell-edged sabre.
Nenso is smashed from the saddle by a battering ram and stands up laughing.
Nenso dives his steed along a cliff face to snatch a falling comrade.

name: Leotuva
summary: Leotuva is a serpent-themed cult chief who has outlived a dozen successors and now sits on a council of opportunists, scheming over how to turn two peoples against each other.

feats.scene: Leotuva whips a venom-tipped staff through a heavy door and splits it from lintel to sill.
Leotuva is shot, burned, and left for dead, then rises at the next dawn.

name: Cilllinu
summary: Cilllinu is a sallow criminal chemist who induces deathlike sleeps with a secret draught and wakes his victims with a crackling machine, then holds the revival over them as leverage.

feats.scene: Cilllinu throws a switch and a bolt of current leaps from his coil into a bound captive.
Cilllinu is struck by a flying chair and keeps muttering through his bandaged jaw.

name: Rnoteramo
summary: Rnoteramo is a red-eyed, hairless demon who rules a pit of flames and punishes arrivals who owe it a debt; its hide turns blades aside and its fist cracks stone like an egg.

feats.scene: Rnoteramo punches a gate-pillar to powder and brings the arch down on a score of cultists.
Rnoteramo is dropped under a falling statue and rises with only a scuff.

name: Liuau
summary: Liuau is a white-haired lord of a golden keep who opposes his child's arranged marriage; slain by a usurper, his body is walked about like a puppet before his allies lay it to rest.

feats.scene: Liuau lets loose a flare of yellow flame that crumples a gatehouse roof.
Liuau takes a ballista bolt through the cloak and finishes the sentence.

name: Aurair
summary: Aurair is a white-haired noble of a warrior-world dynasty who commands raw lightning; he is formal, a little pompous, and perfectly willing to borrow a stranger's hobby to win.

feats.scene: Aurair hurls a spear of lightning that slices a gantry tower off its foundations.
Aurair stands in a cascading blast furnace of charged air and glances at his cuffs.

name: Sintti
summary: Sintti is a stage singer with a seven-octave range who lulls an audience into obedience with a single sustained note; when she loses her voice, her whole plan goes with it.

feats.scene: Sintti holds a piercing high note and every window on the balcony fractures.
Sintti clings to a ledge after a shove and holds on by her fingertips.

name: Liuaul
summary: Liuaul is a quiet field agent who takes orders from a bureau and keeps no confidant; his notebooks are in code, and what he does with them stays in the cellar.

feats.scene: Liuaul drives a hard elbow into the sternum of a guard.
Liuaul rolls clear of a taxi door that hits him broadside and brushes himself off.

name: Llntlan
summary: Llntlan is a young swimmer-hero who patrols a flooded coast and shrugs off deep-water pressure that would crush a diver; her arms are quick and her humour is dry.

feats.scene: Llntlan drives a fist into a rusted freighter hull and punches a hole in the plating.
Llntlan sinks to the bottom of a deep trench and drifts back up uncrushed.
Llntlan cuts across a bay faster than a motor launch.

name: Iarmi
summary: Iarmi is a girl who lost everyone in a seaquake and grew into the guardian of a sunken district; she wears bare feet and a sea-coloured costume and trusts few above the waterline.

feats.scene: Iarmi shoves a collapsed girder aside with both arms to free a trapped diver.
Iarmi is thrown into a coral wall by a sudden surge and swims back unscratched.

name: Nelst
summary: Nelst is a grown-up sea-guardian from a bleak possible tomorrow, enlisted in a hard-line patrol that treats every dissenter as a threat; her strength and read on minds make her a feared enforcer.

feats.scene: Nelst hurls a patrol skiff across a harbour mouth with one arm.
Nelst stands in the lee of a collapsing crane and lets it fall across her back.

name: Tiseolve
summary: Tiseolve is a bar-room hedge-witch with a battered spellbook and a squat imp for company; her small hexes have a way of backfiring into parties.

feats.scene: Tiseolve snaps open her spellbook and a ball of yellow fire blackens the bar rail.
Tiseolve slides across the counter in a brawl and takes only a bruise.

name: Niateora
summary: Niateora is a monstrous sea-woman with writhing tentacle hair and pale eyes who feeds a patron with her own life-glow in return for shelter from a dying world.

feats.scene: Niateora lashes her hair around a sunken tower strut and rips it from the seabed.
Niateora drifts through the blackest trench and feels only a vague chill.
Niateora darts after a fleeing shoal faster than any submersible.

name: Stillra
summary: Stillra is a lab scientist who works in a chair with wheels and a sharp mind, rewriting a hospital's data pipeline between experiments and out-thinking anyone who underestimates her.

feats.scene: Stillra swings a clipboard into the wrist of an intruder reaching for a sample case.
Stillra is tipped from her chair by a shove and climbs back without a complaint.

name: Corllce
summary: Corllce is a harbour mayor who coaxes vines from cracked pavement and breathes out poison clouds without ever coughing. His charm in office hides a grudge against the sea.

feats.scene: Corllce splits a pier with thick roots that burst up from beneath the boards.
Corllce walks unharmed through a cloud of venom that drops a crowd of dockworkers.

name: Lecer
summary: Lecer is a bitter apprentice fighter cast off by his mentor and broken by months of torture. He returns to a boxing gym, hanging trophies of his rage from the rafters.

feats.scene: Lecer lands a hook that drops a larger opponent flat on the canvas.
Lecer endures weeks of beatings and still crawls out through a drain.

name: Leces
summary: Leces is a one-eyed wild child raised in the forest and trained to kill masked heroes. He survived a lethal drop and turned his scars into a mission.

feats.scene: Leces drives a spear through a riot shield and the man behind it.
Leces plummets down a cliff face and drags himself into the undergrowth alive.

name: Eontalenu
summary: Eontalenu is a cabin-crew worker who just wants a normal life. She meets an outlaw on a long flight, dates him briefly and learns to let go of an imaginary world.

feats.scene: Eontalenu slams a drinks cart into a drunk passenger's shin.
Eontalenu rides out heavy turbulence while standing in the aisle.

name: Rnllumia
summary: Rnllumia is a chorus singer who steps into her late sister's glamour and a power over sound. Her voice lifts crates, rattles steel until it bursts, and carries her into the air.

feats.scene: Rnllumia holds a single note until a concrete overpass shakes itself apart.
Rnllumia is thrown through a wall by a pulse and stays conscious.

name: Telora
summary: Telora is a conservative patrol officer who wants nothing more than to wear a badge. She is pulled from a window by a rope, hurt and furious, and refuses an easy retirement.

feats.scene: Telora cracks a baton across a suspect's knee.
Telora hangs from a rope by her waist while broken ribs grind and refuses to cry out.

name: Tauiant
summary: Tauiant is the child of two hard-edged agents, raised on the move between hideouts. She learns early to read a room and where the exits are.

feats.scene: Tauiant throws a snowball hard enough to crack a window.
Tauiant tumbles off a fence onto cold pavement and walks it off.

name: Veotoraul
summary: Veotoraul is a bookish teen with a hidden alien parent and a body that makes its own furnace. He heats metal until it glows and hurls balls of flame when pressed.

feats.scene: Veotoraul hurls a roaring fireball that melts a parked bus to the axles.
Veotoraul wades through burning wreckage without so much as a blister.

name: Ritel
summary: Ritel is a small schoolchild who loves recess and can warm a lunch tray with a glance. His tantrums sometimes set the playground on fire.

feats.scene: Ritel sneezes and a ball of flame scorches the slide.
Ritel is hit by a thrown dodgeball and giggles.

name: Monsauis
summary: Monsauis is a clawed, scaled soldier who carries a glowing ring and a lantern. He drives through hostile fleets with a snarl and conjures walls of hard light on demand.

feats.scene: Monsauis fires a wide beam that cuts through a line of warships.
Monsauis holds a barrier as a missile volley breaks across it.

name: Teliasau
summary: Teliasau is a yellow-eyed reptilian who joins a galactic patrol with tooth, tail and glowing ring. His hide turns blades and his fists dent plating.

feats.scene: Teliasau slams a luminous hammer into a docking tower and drops it.
Teliasau shrugs off a point-blank rocket and bares his fangs.

name: Tenau
summary: Tenau is a tail-lashing officer who marches with a rebel regime. A glowing ring answers his every impulse and his scaled hide stops most blades.

feats.scene: Tenau fires a blast that melts a bridge span and the tanks crossing it.
Tenau stands in the open as artillery shells rain around him.

name: Sorrente
summary: Sorrente is an island crime lord with a quiet talent for waking stone. He buys a worthless pebble and sends a legion of rock soldiers to take it back.

feats.scene: Sorrente raises a hundred boulders into marching giants that smash a gala hall.
Sorrente is struck by a falling chandelier and brushes plaster from his shoulders.

name: Amontnen
summary: Amontnen is a pale assassin who bled in a magical pool and came back changed. He drains the strength of anyone gifted and heals from wounds that should kill.

feats.scene: Amontnen drains a rival's strength mid-strike and breaks his guard in one blow.
Amontnen is cut through the chest and his flesh knits shut within the minute.

name: Anria
summary: Anria is a sleek black house cat who slips through grates to fetch gems for her mistress. She vanishes when scared and returns when the coast is clear.

feats.scene: Anria swipes a loose pearl off a counter and into a drain.
Anria falls from a balcony and lands on her feet.

name: Sonntecis
summary: Sonntecis is a green-eyed alley cat who burgles for a glamorous owner. She spars with larger pets and flirts with a clever hound.

feats.scene: Sonntecis slaps a puppy's nose to claim a bowl.
Sonntecis drops from a rooftop onto a dumpster lid and leaps away.

name: Inumame
summary: Inumame is a winged mother-deity of harvest, dream and weaving who calls the dead back through her loom. Her sorcery reaches across worlds and her patience has outlasted empires.

feats.scene: Inumame wakes a drowned city from the seabed and sets it on a mountain top.
