Inumame endures a falling moon-shard and reweaves herself from threads of light.

name: Reeon
summary: Reeon is a cat mentioned in whispers among thieves, her jewelled collar a prize the criminal world covets. She is rarely seen and never caught.

feats.scene: Reeon bats a dangling necklace off a shelf.
Reeon tumbles from a ledge and trots off.

name: Rautumsu
summary: Rautumsu is a yellow-eyed cat who prowls the rooftops beside her mistress. Her claws are quick and her loyalty total.

feats.scene: Rautumsu rakes a thug's sleeve to ribbons.
Rautumsu leaps from a chimney onto a slanted roof and keeps running.

name: Ialntima
summary: Ialntima is a lone extremist who raids a mountain monastery with explosives. He dies at the hands of the gods he came to burn.

feats.scene: Ialntima detonates a satchel charge that brings down a gatehouse.
Ialntima is thrown against a stone pillar and cannot rise.

name: Sariucar
summary: Sariucar is a big-hearted elephant who can shrink to the size of a peanut. He charges through crowds at full size, then ducks under a door at the last second.

feats.scene: Sariucar charges and flattens a fence post and the shed behind it.
Sariucar takes a fallen tree on his back and walks on.

name: Cinst
summary: Cinst is a tiny starfish-like creature who befriends a pilot and grows into a vast gas giant of a being. He wanders the void with his mate, hunted by raiders.

feats.scene: Cinst swells to a drifting cloud and crushes a raider ship in his billows.
Cinst sails through a cannon salvo that merely stirs his vapour.

name: Liami
summary: Liami is a bald smuggler who stalks a one-handed spy across oceans. His schemes keep failing, and one costs him a partner.

feats.scene: Liami strikes a shopkeeper with the back of his hand.
Liami escapes through a smoky window after a hard fall.

name: Corntos
summary: Corntos is a gang boss who gains command over shadow, and later fuses with a rival into a two-headed monster. His rage burns through the streets when his power fades.

feats.scene: Corntos flings a wall of shadow that crushes a freight container.
Corntos soaks up a blast that cracks the deck beneath him.

name: Ricisllo
summary: Ricisllo is a street legend who steps through walls and drags victims into the dark. Most people think he is just a story told in late-night truck cabs.

feats.scene: Ricisllo pulls a man into the dark and throws him in front of a tram.
Ricisllo vanishes into shadow as a dozen rounds punch through the spot where he stood.

name: Raresia
summary: Raresia is a war-forged enforcer, bred in secret labs for an old regime. He served unthinkingly and lived for decades as a peasant before being called back.

feats.scene: Raresia lifts a farm cart and flings it into a barn wall.
Raresia takes a rifle volley square in the chest and keeps marching.

name: Riaium
summary: Riaium is a vast, red-eyed brute freed from endless punishment who stomps through a harbour town. A mighty champion hurls him across the bay before he begs for an end.

feats.scene: Riaium tears a bridge from its piers and hurls it into the surf.
Riaium is thrown across a bay and gets back up.

name: Racorias
summary: Racorias is a snow-haired elder ruler of a bright world who gave up a son for peace. He moves entire peoples by thought and dies as he lived, offering his people a choice.

feats.scene: Racorias sends a whole city of survivors across a gulf of space in one gesture.
Racorias holds a shattering world together long enough to save his people.

name: Nencor
summary: Nencor is an ancient patriarch who hides from a dark lord by taking the shape of a puppy. He is unharmed by weapons and carries his grandson to safety.

feats.scene: Nencor drops his disguise and throws back an invading fleet in a flash of light.
Nencor stands in the open as a warship's weapons burst against his skin.

name: Corline
summary: Corline is a decorated national hero with a gift for fire, framed for a crime and driven to prison. He breaks out to seek justice and falls to a hidden enemy.

feats.scene: Corline sets a prison gate aflame and melts the bars in seconds.
Corline is cut down by a single decisive blow.

name: Costli
summary: Costli is a forgotten ancestor entombed in carved stone for thousands of years. A visiting descendant frees his spirit, and he drifts away in peace.

feats.scene: Costli rattles the walls of his tomb with a surge of will that cracks the lid.
Costli rests through millennia of desert wind and sand.

name: Autia
summary: Autia is a green-skinned mirror villain among six criminal overlords of a grim parallel world. He is killed by a trickster's bomb before he can meet his hero twin.

feats.scene: Autia levels a warehouse with a roaring blow.
Autia is caught in a trap blast and does not rise.

source_title: J'edd J'arkus (Crisis on Two Earths: Crime Syndicate Earth)

name: Riiuser
summary: Riiuser is a shape-changing refugee posing as a psychic leader to hide from his own kind. His team first sees betrayal, then accepts him when an ally speaks up.

feats.scene: Riiuser stretches into a giant fist and punches a pirate skiff apart.
Riiuser is crushed by falling stone and reforms his body in moments.

name: Suser
summary: Suser is the last survivor of a red world who works as a detective and agency chief. He wears many faces, reads minds, and walks through walls when needed.

feats.scene: Suser lifts a wrecked airliner overhead and sets it gently on a field.
Suser stands unharmed in a burning tower as it collapses around him.

name: Seseil
summary: Seseil is a warrior from a lost people who protects an adopted planet. He turns into a sea serpent to coil around a smuggler and bring him in quietly.

feats.scene: Seseil coils as a serpent and crushes a freight crate flat.
Seseil weathers a round of heavy gunfire without slowing.

name: Rninior
summary: Rninior is a last survivor of a vanished people who serves in a medieval court as master-at-arms. He trains a young prince and grieves for a lost family.

feats.scene: Rninior disarms three squires in one sweeping parry.
Rninior takes a lance to the shield without budging.

name: Rniasam
summary: Rniasam is a gruff alien hero who joins a patrol corps in a licensed game world. He is strong, quick and a bit of a loner.

feats.scene: Rniasam lifts a tower crane and hurls it into a barricade.
Rniasam takes a direct shot from a turret and does not flinch.

name: Rnear
summary: Rnear is a grim enforcer of a cold regime in a world where heroes became rulers. He wields mind-reading and raw power to hold the city in line.

feats.scene: Rnear tears the roof off a prison and hurls it into the sky.
Rnear takes a missile barrage on his chest and keeps walking.

name: Nolcorlle
summary: Nolcorlle is a captive seer forced to read minds for a conqueror. Tortured to madness, he reaches across worlds to call for help before he dies.

feats.scene: Nolcorlle sends a psychic cry that shatters every window in the fortress.
Nolcorlle endures years of torment in a cell without breaking his spirit.

name: Stuleseru
summary: Stuleseru is a gentle leader of a wasteland settlement after a global war stripped his gifts. He argues for peace and is killed by a once-trusted friend.

feats.scene: Stuleseru shoves a crate aside to clear the road into camp.
Stuleseru takes a gun-butt to the ribs and keeps talking peace.

name: Torlli
summary: Torlli is a machine-bodied member of a toy-like team in a world run by a hidden hand. He fears flame above all and flinches at a lit match.

feats.scene: Torlli hammers a steel door with a servo-driven punch.
Torlli takes a rifle burst across the chassis and keeps standing.

name: Tellrn
summary: Tellrn is a retired hero in a bleak future who hides behind a mild face. Beneath it he still has strength, flight and a mind that can reach across a city.

feats.scene: Tellrn lifts a tram off its rails and sets it on a rooftop.
Tellrn walks through a collapsing building and leaves the rubble behind him.

name: Tisrnca
summary: Tisrnca is a friendly hero in a bright toy-shop world who helps neighbours using flight and strength. He is wary of flame, which saps his gifts at once.

feats.scene: Tisrnca hoists a fallen bridge segment and sets it on its pillars.
Tisrnca shrugs off a falling girder and brushes off his sleeves.

name: Llioluam
summary: Llioluam is a member of a heroic alliance in a world that is about to vanish. He stands beside his friends as the sky tears and then fades with them.

feats.scene: Llioluam hurls a collapsing tower aside to shield his friends.
Llioluam braces against falling masonry as the whole base crumbles.

name: Llores
summary: Llores is a passing cameo, a crimefighter who appears at the dawn of a new era of heroes. He steps in quietly, waves and leaves the stage to others.

feats.scene: Llores shoves a stalled car off the street and tips his cap.
Llores takes a thrown bottle on the shoulder and smiles.

name: Sernori
summary: Sernori is a gentle visitor who arrives for a first date and is beaten up by an overprotective teen. He is a pushover in cartoons but a hero in earnest.

feats.scene: Sernori lifts a sofa with one hand to make room for a guest.
Sernori is stuffed into a closet and politely knocks to be let out.

source_title: J'onn J'onzz (Teen Titans Go! TV Series)

name: Llulo
summary: Llulo is an enormous ape in a ragged clown suit who studies living things with a scientist's patience. Llulo swings a machete and a rapid-fire gun, and shouts at the world's decay from a gutted rooftop.

feats.scene: Llulo tore a steel shutter from its frame and flung it across an alley.
Llulo took a full burst of rifle fire and laughed through the smoke.

name: Leseoias
summary: Leseoias is a newsroom reporter who chases tips on foot and on the phone. Leseoias is quick-witted, careful with sources and has never thrown a punch in earnest.

feats.scene: Leseoias shoved a stuck desk drawer shut with her hip.
Leseoias slipped on wet stairs and caught the rail.

name: Sercortan
summary: Sercortan is a long-serving police sergeant who jokes with the squad and quietly resents a missed promotion. Sercortan has two decades of patrols behind him and a knack for finding the real culprit.

feats.scene: Sercortan cuffed a struggling suspect to a radiator in one move.
Sercortan took a thrown chair on the forearm and kept talking.

name: Stiau
summary: Stiau is a sea-born young hero raised to guard the tides, wearing an armour borrowed from an estranged father. Stiau reconciles the two halves of his heritage and fires beams from the helm.

feats.scene: Stiau split a freighter's hull with a single beam from the visor.
Stiau shrugged off a depth charge at point-blank range beneath the waves.

source_title: Jackson Hyde (Dark Crisis: Worlds Without a Justice League: Aquaman)

name: Sanvinor
summary: Stiau-like Sanvinor is an older sea hero who inherits a trident-bearer's duties and trains a headstrong child. Sanvinor shocks a monster with living lightning after the ocean folds into a strange waterscape.

feats.scene: Sanvinor discharged a crackling bolt that stunned a tentacled leviathan the size of a cruiser.
Sanvinor was squeezed by thick coils and burst free without a bruise.

name: Saullo
summary: Saullo is a retired film actor who floats unless a heavy belt ties him down. Saullo can shoot glowing blasts from the same energy, and reunites with estranged kin when an old fiend comes for its fountain.

feats.scene: Saullo unclipped his belt, drifted skyward, and blasted a demon's gate to rubble.
Saullo took a rake across the chest and kept floating.

name: Miates
summary: Miates is a city mayor who ignores the poor district and hates the vigilante who works there. Miates is more at home with a ribbon and scissors than a fight.

feats.scene: Miates slapped a stack of papers down on a rival's desk.
Miates tripped on a ceremonial carpet and caught the podium.

name: Numnitel
summary: Numnitel is a school football player who ignores a firm refusal and takes what he wants. Numnitel's bulk is all he has, and it isn't much against a determined crowd.

feats.scene: Numnitel tackled a blocking sled and knocked it over.
Numnitel took a tackle from two linemen and stayed upright.

name: Amise
summary: Amise is a nervous, fair-haired criminal who coils around a victim and squeezes until he gives in. Amise is a minor enemy of a masked detective, remembered mostly for his coiled grip.

feats.scene: Amise wrapped a chain around a safe door and wrenched it open.
Amise took a blow from a gas-masked foe and fell back against a wall.

name: Tilve
summary: Tilve is a farm-raised volunteer who was handed flight by a rich man's program and joined a team of fliers. Tilve survives a mass fall and a terrible betrayal by a shape-copying teammate.

feats.scene: Tilve dived from a rooftop and drove a thug through a billboard.
Tilve hit a rooftop hard after a fall and lived.

name: Letianiu
summary: Letianiu is a drowned magistrate who came back blind with eyes sewn shut and can see the rot in every heart. Letianiu offers deals to the guilty, and cannot be killed by anything that ends other men.

feats.scene: Letianiu seized a witness by the throat from across a room and lifted him off the floor.
Letianiu was run through by a harpoon and went on speaking.

name: Nteeon
summary: Nteeon is a nervous busboy who panics and fires a gun when two strangers walk into a diner. Nteeon holds two women hostage for an afternoon and ends up a cautionary footnote.

feats.scene: Nteeon heaved a tray rack across the kitchen at a pursuer.
Nteeon slipped on a wet floor and slammed into the fryer.

name: Sisti
summary: Sisti is a pilot who flew to the dark of space and returned as a hulking monster, hidden from everyone by his own face. Sisti kills for a cabal of changed men and is finally left drifting among the stars.

feats.scene: Sisti tore a steel hangar door from its rails and threw it through a wall.
Sisti stood in a rocket's exhaust and walked out of the fire unharmed.

name: Iulinsa
summary: Iulinsa is a retired army colonel who has buried a wife and a daughter and kept the rest of his family together. Iulinsa speaks in orders, and fights with discipline rather than rage.

feats.scene: Iulinsa forced a locked door with a shoulder charge.
Iulinsa took a punch and returned to parade rest.

name: Sorrus
summary: Sorrus is a bitter field surgeon whose unreturned love turned into a rage against women and a grudge against a surviving boy. Sorrus carves a trail through a foggy century and is shot down mid-lunge.

feats.scene: Sorrus brought a long blade down through a wooden door in one strike.
Sorrus staggered from a cudgel blow and kept his grip on the blade.

name: Neserliu
summary: Neserliu is the daughter of a gadget-wielding heroine who tries to follow her mother with a bag of tricks. Neserliu survives a demon's assault, builds a quirky career, and dies on her first team mission.

feats.scene: Neserliu popped a spring-loaded device that blew a vent cover across a hall.
Neserliu took a hard fall on the stone floor and rolled up.

name: Vinusceo
summary: Vinusceo is a future-born teenager who fades from sight at will, working with a team of costumed peers. Vinusceo slips past guards, plants devices, and drops back into view with a shrug.

feats.scene: Vinusceo, unseen, slammed a helmet down on a startled guard's head.
Vinusceo took a stun bolt and shook it off with a wince.

source_title: Jacques Foccart (Legion of Super-Heroes TV Series)

name: Valora
summary: Valora is a green-haired, green-skinned member of an alternate world's heroic society who radiates raw power. Valora is too busy rolling her eyes at a teammate's mimicry to pay attention to the meeting.

feats.scene: Valora launched a glowing blast that melted a bridge cable.
Valora walked through an exploding fuel truck with a flickering shield.

name: Anuliule
summary: Anuliule is a counterfeit sovereign of the skies, built from stolen technology by schemers who needed a distraction. Anuliule sentences the faithful to death by decree and escapes a missile in a flash of light.

feats.scene: Anuliule hurled a golden bolt that levelled a hillside monastery.
Anuliule stood still as artillery shells burst against a golden aura.

name: Aulerniu
summary: Aulerniu is a blocky, toy-brick assassin who works for a gang of cartoon rogues. Aulerniu fights with blades and poison darts and has a sister in the same trade.

feats.scene: Aulerniu hurled a brick-stud dart that cracked a window pane.
Aulerniu was knocked into a pile of plastic bricks and sprang back up.

name: Reiumto
summary: Reiumto is a purple-haired fiend who drains the life from the living and flits through walls after dying once. Reiumto serves a covert squad and shares an afterlife with a ghostly gentleman.

feats.scene: Reiumto drained a whole stand of trees to grey ash with a sweep of her hand.
Reiumto took a shotgun blast at close range and simply came together again.

name: Reoir
summary: Reoir is a speedy young hero who gave up a gift for his sister and spent years lost in a dark void. Reoir came home as a changed man and runs on sparks of kinetic power.

feats.scene: Reoir ran a lap around a quarry and set off a shockwave that cracked the walls.
Reoir took a collapsing overpass across the back and stood up.
Reoir crossed a valley in a blur faster than the sound of his own steps.

name: Aniti
summary: Aniti is a teenager bonded to an alien armour that wants to take his mind but is too damaged to try. Aniti uses it to fight when worlds blur together, though the armour builds weapons uninvited.

feats.scene: Aniti formed a cannon on his arm and levelled a rooftop water tower.
Aniti stood under a collapsing overpass and the armour did not crack.

source_title: Jaime Reyes (Infinite Crisis Video Game: Earth-0)

name: Naces
summary: Naces is a young adult who inherited a living war suit and hates what it is. Naces trained under a mentor, lost him to murder, and charges into a sanctuary in anger.

feats.scene: Naces smashed the glass dome of a wildlife sanctuary with a single blast.
Naces stood against a barrage of heavy cannons with the suit's plating glowing.

name: Cosautia
summary: Cosautia is a teenager from a border town fused with an alien scarab after finding it in a river. Cosautia has mastered the weapon-forming armour and answers to a council of heroes.

feats.scene: Cosautia fired a beam that burned a crater in a desert hillside.
Cosautia took the full blast of a siege cannon and flew on.

name: Vantres
summary: Vantres is a cultist's daughter who took her father's power and set out to find three pieces of a seeking device. Vantres wields a pale flame that freezes rather than burns, and hides a soft spot for a rival.

feats.scene: Vantres breathed a pale flame that froze a lake from shore to shore.
Vantres was clawed by a trapped butcher and healed the wound with a whisper.

name: Resau
summary: Resau is a small green lizard kept as a pet by a shape-changing boy. Resau sits in a sunny window, flicks a tongue at flies, and has no schemes.

feats.scene: Resau snapped up a cricket from a tabletop in a blink.
Resau fell off a bookshelf and landed on all four feet.

name: Ilete
summary: Ilete is a foul-mouthed street kid who comes into possession of a wish-granting spirit by way of a magic pen. Ilete learns to speak the right words and to keep the spirit on his side.

feats.scene: Ilete uttered a rhyme and the spirit flattened a row of warehouses.
Ilete stood inside a sphere of humming light as bricks fell around him.

name: Iumtiu
summary: Iumtiu is a former lawyer, general and statesman who is remembered for an assassin's bullet. Iumtiu appears as a figure of ghost stories, calm and dignified even after death.

feats.scene: Iumtiu pounded a table to bring a council to order.
Iumtiu was jostled by a crowd and kept his footing.

name: Tanlinasi
summary: Tanlinasi is a police captain divorced from a fellow officer and fighting for custody of a daughter. Tanlinasi mellows when a monster threatens the child, and earns a plaque for a year of good work.

feats.scene: Tanlinasi tackled a fleeing suspect on a loading ramp.
Tanlinasi took a punch from a drunk and stayed standing.

name: Rormi
summary: Rormi is a city police lieutenant who takes cases door to door and keeps a notebook for every one. Rormi is calm, observant and tired, and hunts for patterns in the paperwork.

feats.scene: Rormi kicked in a locked apartment door in one go.
Rormi took a bat to the arm and arrested the swinger.

name: Esvaria
summary: Esvaria is a grieving brother who embezzled a fortune to turn his body into a living bomb. Esvaria flings volatile blasts across great distances and wraps himself in a shield that explodes on contact.

feats.scene: Esvaria snapped his fingers and a blast tore the front off a bank.
Esvaria took a missile on the chest and the shield flashed outward.

name: Toseria
summary: Toseria is a vengeful spirit's host who wields something close to unlimited power. Toseria bends reality with a gesture, and is bound only by whatever the spirit's judgement allows.

feats.scene: Toseria unmade a dying sun with a lifted hand.
Toseria stood unmoved inside a collapsing star.

name: Iuani
summary: Iuani is a patrol detective who helps a lightning-wielding hero and a young reporter on separate cases. Iuani knows basic scuffling, plenty of law, and not much else.

feats.scene: Iuani clipped a purse-snatcher with a forearm in a stairwell.
Iuani took a punch on the cheek and kept the suspect pinned.

name: Cororise
summary: Cororise is a forensic technician who sells crime-scene souvenirs and has an officer silenced to cover it. Cororise ends up drunk and begging, and is murdered by the son of the man he wronged.

feats.scene: Cororise swung an evidence box at a colleague and knocked a lamp off.
Cororise fell drunk down a basement stair and got up groaning.

name: Mionemia
summary: Mionemia is a ghostly gentleman who sips drinks at a bar for retired heroes. Mionemia hears a call to reform, and floats over the counter while the room goes quiet.

feats.scene: Mionemia shoved a stool across the floor with a cold hand.
Mionemia let a thrown bottle pass through his chest.

name: Seros
summary: Seros is a well-mannered ghostly thief who haunts old houses and takes control of nervous servants. Seros has a long feud with winged heroes and walks through walls with a tip of the hat.

feats.scene: Seros drew a cold mist that locked a rusty gate and shattered a chandelier.
Seros let a cannon shot pass through him and tipped his hat.

name: Cacoveo
summary: Cacoveo is a young recruit from a distant planet who freezes time in a small bubble with the aid of a belt. Cacoveo is cocky and disobeys orders, and the belt shorts out at the worst moment.

feats.scene: Cacoveo froze a falling beam mid-air for a few seconds.
Cacoveo took a grabbing strike from a spidery foe and went limp.

name: Sallala
summary: Sallala is a precinct captain who knows about a bat-winged vigilante and chooses not to help. Sallala runs a tight shift, rarely leaves the station, and trusts procedure over instinct.

feats.scene: Sallala pinned a squirming suspect against a desk with a forearm.
Sallala took a thrown mug on the shoulder and shouted for order.

name: Riaiute
summary: Riaiute is a dying convict whose cancer is held at bay by a strange serum that lets him pass through solid walls. Riaiute breaks into a secure building for a criminal syndicate and fights a strong hero to a standstill.

feats.scene: Riaiute lunged out of a wall and drove a stolen blade into a hero's shoulder.
Riaiute was thrown against a concrete wall and was left half inside it.

name: Litorrne
summary: Litorrne is a former federal investigator who edits a lurid magazine and solves crimes for the cover story. Litorrne is respected by police, helped by a clever secretary, and fights only when cornered.

feats.scene: Litorrne threw a typewriter at a thug and knocked him flat.
Litorrne took a blackjack to the head and kept writing.

name: Lerria
summary: Lerria is a rebel cavalry general who leads a headlong charge into a line of horsemen. Lerria is outpaced by a fast-moving foe and captured in the middle of the mud.

feats.scene: Lerria brought a sabre down on a drum and split it down the middle.
Lerria was unhorsed by a rush and rolled upright.

name: Ralrni
summary: Ralrni is a gruff, white-haired chief of police in a bright, campy city who relies on two costumed champions. Ralrni has an uncanny sense for when disaster is close, and calls for help over a red phone.

feats.scene: Ralrni slammed a hand on the desk and the phone jumped.
Ralrni was shoved over a table by a goon and came up shouting.

name: Tiacoris
summary: Tiacoris is a sharp, red-haired lawmaker who leads hearings into a disaster and refuses to be bullied by a tycoon. Tiacoris is killed by a bomb planted to frame an innocent, and her stubbornness outlives her.

feats.scene: Tiacoris slams her palm on a hearing table to silence a witness.
Tiacoris is caught in the first shock of a hall explosion.

name: Rereru
summary: Rereru is a pioneering woman agent of a federal bureau in the years before a great war. Rereru follows a hunch into a killer's hideout, wins a close fight and holds a whole gang at gunpoint for hours.

feats.scene: Rereru kicks a gunman's shin, twists the weapon free and fires.
Rereru is shoved against a brick wall by two thugs and holds her ground.

name: Taull
summary: Taull is a blind engineer who builds and mends automatons in a mountain workshop. Taull understands machines by touch and sound, and she found a cure for a friend's tainted blood.

feats.scene: Taull cranks a heavy servo arm by hand to free a jammed robot.
Taull is knocked off her stool by a lurching robot and gets up unhurt.

name: Valer
summary: Valer is a talented painter who gains a second self, a dark-haired sorceress, by speaking a single word. Valer drifts between heroism and villainy as her magic pulls her, and she keeps a secret from the man she dates.

feats.scene: Valer's sorceress half rips the roof from a haunted keep with a wave of power.
Valer weathers a collapsing tower of stone in a ring of magic.

name: Nteil
summary: Nteil is a designer chained to an enormous, unstable spell-being that surges up at moments of fear. Nteil, once split from it, saw the being grow mad and spill ruin across the world.

feats.scene: Nteil's unleashed spirit flattens a whole city block in a spiral of black magic.
Nteil shrugs off a hail of conjured lightning that wrecks a bridge.

name: Telanco
summary: Telanco is a strawberry-haired adventurer who joins a band of daredevils in cartoon-flavoured missions. Telanco is cheerful, quick and unafraid of dusty ruins.

feats.scene: Telanco swings a rope-line across a gap and kicks a door open.
Telanco falls into a muddy ravine and climbs out grinning.

name: Lerli
summary: Lerli is the son of a scientist who was treated to bend any beast to his will and then rejected by a hero club for being unreliable. Lerli rallies the fiercest creatures he can find and sets them against his old judges.

feats.scene: Lerli sends a bellowing beast to topple a tall gate.
Lerli is tossed in the dust by a runaway beast and sits up cursing.

name: Letulle
summary: Letulle is a young boy from a quiet comic-strip family with a doting mother and father. Letulle pulls pranks, sticks his nose in and gets into scrapes that always end in laughter.

feats.scene: Letulle tosses a ball through a neighbour's pane.
Letulle tumbles from a low tree and giggles.

name: Nolvatau
summary: Nolvatau was one of a few survivors whose bodies drank in a poisoned sky and gave them near-divine force. Nolvatau became a grey-skinned warlord who nurses a grudge against the stronger tyrant who beat him.

feats.scene: Nolvatau levels a mountain range with a single thrust of his palm.
Nolvatau walks out of a collapsing mountain without a scratch.
Nolvatau crosses a battlefield faster than the eye can follow.

name: Tellitiu
summary: Tellitiu is a bald minister who keeps the monstrous beasts of a drowned kingdom and trains them with a firm hand. Tellitiu's people are adapted to crushing depths, so his body is strong, fast and hard to hurt.

feats.scene: Tellitiu throws a beast-handler's cage across a harbour dock.
Tellitiu walks the deep trench floor where pressure would flatten a tank.
Tellitiu swims past a patrol raft in the open sea.

name: Vatiro
summary: Vatiro is a noble knight who lives long past his own age and carries an enchanted blade and armour from a wizard. Vatiro rides a winged steed into battle and refuses an unjust order even from his king.

feats.scene: Vatiro splits a stone gatehouse arch with one stroke of his enchanted blade.
Vatiro's enchanted armour turns aside a giant's club.
Vatiro swoops over a field on his winged steed.

name: Ntocoos
summary: Ntocoos is a smooth, grey-haired drug-company boss who funds terror and releases a plague on a small town. Ntocoos is hunted down by a hooded archer, and his son swears revenge years later.

feats.scene: Ntocoos shoves a lab worker aside and snaps a vial shut.
Ntocoos is slammed into a boardroom table and gasps.

name: Toriala
summary: Toriala is a shape-shifting operative of a shadowy network who takes on a new identity for each job. Toriala fights with a double-bladed spear and tries to hold off a vicious assassin during a gang war.

feats.scene: Toriala drives a double-bladed spear through a wooden crate.
Toriala takes a vicious kick to the ribs and stays in the fight.

name: Rnvassti
summary: Rnvassti is a colossal, venom-breathing serpent from ancient lore that curls around the whole globe and waits for a final battle. Rnvassti is the sibling of two other monsters and has lived for ages without ageing.

feats.scene: Rnvassti tightens its coils and cracks a continental plate from below.
Rnvassti is struck by a divine hammer and merely turns its head.

name: Misosta
summary: Misosta was a young girl of a green-skinned people on a dying red world. Misosta had gifts typical of her kind and a deep fear of flame, and she perished in a plague alongside her mother.

feats.scene: Misosta lifts a boulder from a dry riverbed with a stretch of her mind.
Misosta endures a rockslide in a canyon and climbs out.

name: Rerore
summary: Rerore is a distant, half-remembered girl of a lost green-skinned race, kept alive only by a keepsake her father cherishes. Rerore appears in the tale as an echo, with traces of her people's gifts.

feats.scene: Rerore nudges a stone cart aside with a gentle push of thought.
Rerore is struck by a falling beam and rises unhurt.

name: Tercortal
summary: Tercortal is a young girl of a green people who lived in a vast city of red stone and died in a holocaust with her mother. Tercortal had the usual gifts of her kin and the same terror of flame.

feats.scene: Tercortal tips a loaded cart over with a flick of her mind.
Tercortal brushes off the crumble of a clay wall around her.

name: Lescarnt
summary: Lescarnt was a schoolgirl on a far red planet, the only daughter in a family of scholars. Lescarnt died in a plague, yet a trace of her self lingers inside her father's mind through a ritual of exchange.

feats.scene: Lescarnt lifts a desk across a classroom by will alone.
Lescarnt takes a tumble down a stone stair and stands without a mark.

name: Nausonte
summary: Nausonte is a quiet girl of a green-skinned people whose life ends under an ancient curse that took her mother as well. Nausonte shares her people's gifts and their dread of flame.

feats.scene: Nausonte slides a heavy stone door open with a thought.
Nausonte is knocked back by a stumbling beast and rises easily.

name: Rioraia
summary: Rioraia is a white-eyed child of a vanished green people who dies beside her mother in a great burning. Rioraia holds the strengths of her kin and the weakness that undid them.

feats.scene: Rioraia hurls a stone slab across a plaza using only thought.
Rioraia endures a collapsing archway and walks out of the dust.

name: Lenenan
summary: Lenenan is a cartoon-styled red-eyed girl of a bald green race who perishes in a global tragedy alongside her mother. Lenenan has her people's gifts and the fear of flame that ruined them.

feats.scene: Lenenan sends a wooden crate flying across a hangar with a flick of thought.
Lenenan is bowled over by a stampede and stands up laughing.

source_title: K'hym J'onzz (The Brave and the Bold)

name: Coarnt
summary: Coarnt is a young girl in a film-length tragedy, a bald green child who dies with her mother during a world-ending blaze. Coarnt has the strengths of her race and its weakness to fire.

feats.scene: Coarnt lifts a stalled tram wheel from a track with a thought.
Coarnt is thrown against a stone column and shakes it off.

name: Vorrios
summary: Vorrios is a red-haired fury who butchered a crowd of winged soldiers on arrival and later slew her own sister and teacher to prove loyalty to a dark lord. Vorrios fights like a storm, bends rivals to her will and calls herself by a martial title.

feats.scene: Vorrios drives a fist through a bunker wall and cracks the slab behind it.
Vorrios stands up from a blast that levels a house.
Vorrios closes a field in a heartbeat to seize a champion.

name: Amretor
summary: Amretor is a white-haired recruit of a cosmic police force who patrols a sector far from home. Amretor shapes glowing constructs, flies and shields herself with a ring and a charged lantern.

feats.scene: Amretor fires a ring beam through the hull of a rogue freighter.
Amretor's ring shield stops a drifting rock slab.
Amretor crosses a harbour moon's sky in a green blur.

name: Llaeru
summary: Llaeru is an insect-like soldier who holds her larval shape through will and enters a cocoon when her power source breaks. Llaeru later survives captivity, serves in a new squad and dies defending a besieged world.

feats.scene: Llaeru launches a ring blast that carves a trench across a quarry floor.
Llaeru's ring shield holds against a hail of slave-trader cannon fire.
Llaeru streaks across a dim sector in a pale glow.

name: Eovaveo
summary: Eovaveo is a one-eyed, one-legged rabbit-folk space pilot with a cybernetic replacement and a talent for thieving. Eovaveo flies a battered ship, trusts a worn sidearm and boasts of a lucky leg that someone took.

feats.scene: Eovaveo fires a heavy sidearm and blows a hatch off its hinges.
Eovaveo is thrown across a cockpit in a hard landing and keeps steering.

name: Seostte
summary: Seostte is an ancient, red-eyed spirit that hides inside a black gem and takes over whoever holds it. Seostte flies, shields himself, bends minds and moves matter, and he has spread chaos for ages.

feats.scene: Seostte flattens a block-wide district with a pulse of dark light.
Seostte rises untouched from the blast of a thousand shells.
Seostte streaks across a night sky as a black comet.

name: Ntianli
summary: Ntianli is a pair of masked sisters trained in stealth, acrobatics and a lethal martial style, with steel blades extended from their fingertips. Ntianli works for a clown crime boss and is feared in the dark alleys.

feats.scene: Ntianli slices through a steel locker door with the finger blades.
Ntianli lands a rooftop fall on both feet and keeps fighting.
Ntianli bounds across a rooftop gap in a flash.

name: Siarni
summary: Siarni is a high priestess and alchemist of a desert warrior sisterhood who is skilled with bow, horse, blade and poison. Siarni was a keeper of rites and lore, and she dies in battle.

feats.scene: Siarni snaps a bow string and sends an arrow through a shield.
Siarni endures a heavy blow from a warhammer and keeps chanting.

name: Riaone
summary: Riaone is a steward of a sunken court who runs the daily business of a sea monarch's palace. Riaone has the tough, deep-water body of his people, and he is calm, fast and strong.

feats.scene: Riaone lifts a stone gate off its track in the palace halls.
Riaone strolls through a pressure that would crush a steel diving bell.
Riaone races a courier eel through a reef channel.

name: Teial
summary: Teial is a red-eyed dictator who feeds on energy and grows stronger and harder to hurt the more he drains. Teial rules by fear and treats any rival's power as fuel.

feats.scene: Teial gathers drained force and slams it into a fortress wall.
Teial soaks a barrage of cannon blasts and grins.

name: Nuceam
summary: Nuceam is a boy from a harbour city who was blessed by a god of edged weapons and cannot be cut by any blade. Nuceam visits a spirit realm through a shrine and learns that the gift has a price.

feats.scene: Nuceam shoves open a sealed shrine gate with a spirited push.
Nuceam is slashed by a sword and not a mark is left.

name: Seceoane
summary: Seceoane is a bald, soft-spoken envoy of a small nation who negotiates in a glass tower beside a river. Seceoane relies on tact, a gift for policy and a steady voice.

feats.scene: Seceoane slides a heavy treaty folder across a long table.
Seceoane stumbles on a stair and catches the rail.

name: Amvicel
summary: Amvicel is a white-haired dictator of a small island nation who is obsessed with breeding stronger people. Amvicel funds secret experiments and is finally struck down on a covert mission.

feats.scene: Amvicel slams a ceremonial staff on the marble floor.
Amvicel is knocked from a throne dais and recovers in a rage.

name: Nanusle
summary: Nanusle is the castoff child of a tyrant, raised in the slums where he builds a secret network and steals from his own father. Nanusle plans a coup, but a global catastrophe scorches the land and offers a rougher chance at the throne.

feats.scene: Nanusle snaps a rusted lock with a pry bar.
Nanusle is beaten by street thugs and rises plotting.

name: Rennt
summary: Rennt is a pale-green scientist from a world of thinkers who raises a gifted son and dies while the boy is small. Rennt has a mind far above the norm and plans several steps ahead.

feats.scene: Rennt slams a lab lever to start a long machine.
Rennt is shaken by a failing generator and keeps working.

name: Serriltel
summary: Serriltel is a farmhand from a stratified world who labours with his hands and is told he is nothing special. Serriltel is a kind, wandering champion of working people and grows into a hero of the poor.

feats.scene: Serriltel throws a punch that flattens a block of company housing.
Serriltel walks out of a collapsing mine face unscathed.
Serriltel races a freight train across a dry plain.

name: Linliu
summary: Linliu is a steam-age adventurer who leads a band of inventors and helps raise a great power plant by a waterfall. Linliu befriends a great engineer and quarrels with a rival's assistant over progress.

feats.scene: Linliu hoists a generator housing onto a platform in front of a crowd.
Linliu walks from a boiler blast that wrecks a workshop.
Linliu streaks over the fairgrounds with a torch in hand.

name: Ancorrne
summary: Ancorrne is a young newspaper reporter in a quiet small town who hides a heritage from a far-off star. Ancorrne is shy and honest, and he is still learning what he can do.

feats.scene: Ancorrne tears a silo from its footing during a storm to save a farmhand.
Ancorrne shrugs off a barn fire and a collapsing roof.
Ancorrne sprints across a wheat field in a blur.

name: Lanrnco
summary: Lanrnco is a grieving editor who loses his wife and son to a prank gone fatal and carries a dark crest as a vow to keep hoping. Lanrnco later stands with others in a war across many worlds.

feats.scene: Lanrnco hurls a fist into a giant invader and cracks its armour across a city.
Lanrnco stands in a wall of fire that melts a bridge.
Lanrnco crosses an ocean in a burst of speed to catch a falling tower.

name: Reoulnin
summary: Reoulnin is a retired hero who gave up his gifts to farm and raise daughters with his wife. Reoulnin flings away a glowing stone, then is hit by a rival's punch and brushes it aside because he is merely an ordinary man now.

feats.scene: Reoulnin tosses a glowing stone into the field.
Reoulnin is punched across a yard and lands on the grass.

name: Estserli
summary: Estserli is a widowed farmer, once a reporter, whose people feel hope in everything he does. Estserli was born naturally, unlike others of his race, and raises two sons in a small farm town while guarding the world.

feats.scene: Estserli slams a fist into a rampaging machine and splits it down the middle.
Estserli takes a blast that would flatten a district and stays standing.
Estserli rockets between two towns in the blink of an eye.

name: Reoantal
summary: Reoantal is a widowed hero of a possible tomorrow who raised his son alone in a lonely fortress. Reoantal faces his own family's old enemies and thinks back on what he has lost.

feats.scene: Reoantal punches a hole through a steel hull across a hangar.
Reoantal absorbs a barrage of heavy cannon fire and does not flinch.
Reoantal crosses a continent in a streak of sound.

name: Ntrerre
summary: Ntrerre is a silent alien agent bred as a conquest tool by a star-faring empire of artificers. Few records survive of her, only that she answered to a hidden directorate.

feats.scene: Ntrerre drives a bladed arm through a freighter hull and splits it open.
Ntrerre is tossed into a bulkhead and her shell merely scuffs.

name: Vaauore
summary: Vaauore is an excavator turned diplomat who wore an ancient sage's golden cowl and suffered fits of madness afterward. He sealed the relic in a remote spire to keep its power from being taken.

feats.scene: Vaauore calls down a column of golden fire and levels a rogue warlock's courtyard.
Vaauore raises a ward as a ceiling of sandstone drops on him.

name: Racese
summary: Racese is a future-era scholar who bargains his own freedom for the lives of strangers while wearing a seer's cowl. He bends shields, illusions and flight around a circle of dark mages.

feats.scene: Racese hurls a bolt of force that collapses a ruined chapel.
Racese's ward holds as a siege spell hammers the courtyard around him.

name: Elraneo
summary: Elraneo is a trauma technician turned sorcerer, chosen by a cat-headed deity to bear an ancient cowl. He banters with himself about his nerves while defending order against dark mages.

feats.scene: Elraneo unleashes a surge of golden force that wrecks a whole dockyard row.
Elraneo weathers a wave of dark magic that levels a city block around his ward.

name: Teltonma
summary: Teltonma is a gifted hacker who tore through a defense network on a false errand and spent years in a harsh prison. He emerged quieter, still sharp, and drawn back into a covert team.

feats.scene: Teltonma slams a laptop lid shut and the casing cracks.
Teltonma is shoved into a cell wall and shakes it off.

name: Anteoll
summary: Anteoll is a yellow-skinned jailer-servant of a warlord on a moving fortress, who let a captive slip away and now waits for punishment. His hide is thick but his nerve is not.

feats.scene: Anteoll rips a cell door off its frame in a panic.
Anteoll takes a tumbling girder across the back and barely grunts.

name: Rantorlas
summary: Rantorlas is a winged monarch who used strange experiments to grow black feathered eyes and wings, and who ruled a floating city for two thousand years. A murder from her distant past still shadows her.

feats.scene: Rantorlas drives a metal dagger through a bronze shield and pins a rival to the wall.
Rantorlas takes a ballista bolt in the shoulder and keeps ruling.

name: Stuam
summary: Stuam is a zealot who leads a holy war and claims to be a conduit of old gods who feels no pain and cannot be killed. His boasts are not entirely empty.

feats.scene: Stuam tears a tank turret off its ring and hurls it into a wall.
Stuam walks through a shell burst and keeps preaching.

name: Vivasran
summary: Vivasran is a dawn deity who pushes the renewed sun up out of a nightly tunnel and whose name means becoming. He lends his might through a talisman shaped like an insect and fades without worshippers.

feats.scene: Vivasran heaves the sun up out of the underworld at the start of each morning.
Vivasran bears the full heat of the rising sun on his own back.

name: Teltico
summary: Teltico is a red-haired champion chosen to represent her people in a galactic tournament, granted heavy durability and strength. She is undefeated, and her fights settle the quarrels of whole worlds.

feats.scene: Teltico punches through an arena wall and shatters an entire stand.
Teltico takes a rival's thrown boulder in the chest and does not step back.

name: Astelntu
summary: Astelntu is a cursed beauty who refused a god's advances and was condemned to drain the vitality of men to stay alive. She posed as her own descendants for centuries and gave her fortune to worthy causes.

feats.scene: Astelntu drains a mugger and sends him sprawling across the pavement.
Astelntu is hit by a speeding van and gets up.

name: Eoseore
summary: Eoseore is a silver-haired, white-eyed assassin from a woodland people who works for a league of killers. Nothing about her habits survives, only the blade and her cousin.

feats.scene: Eoseore swings a long blade through a door and cuts a bolt in two.
Eoseore drops from a branch to a stone path and slips into the dark.

name: Aulenia
summary: Aulenia is a patrol officer in a riverside city who has known her partner for years and loves debating how law should be used. She survived a massacre at her station and later rescued her niece.

feats.scene: Aulenia fires a service pistol and drops an attacker in a corridor.
Aulenia is thrown against a locker and keeps shooting.

name: Siaiasel
summary: Siaiasel is a small student at a cartoonish elementary school who carries a big book everywhere. He is cheerful, sidekick-minded and hopelessly literal.

feats.scene: Siaiasel drops an enormous book on a desk and the desk wobbles.
Siaiasel tumbles off a swing and bounces upright.

name: Sistu
summary: Sistu is a green-skinned, two-toned-hair apprentice runner from a distant century who shows off her sparks of lightning. She admires a mentor and visits a museum on a tiny planet.

feats.scene: Sistu streaks across a museum floor in a blur of sparks.
Sistu crashes into a statue at full run and shatters it.
Sistu skids across polished stone and hops back up.

name: Ntiniuva
summary: Ntiniuva is a sideshow barker with a nose for trouble who organizes his carnival crew to find out who killed a friend. A shot to the shoulder forces him to lead them away from the law.

feats.scene: Ntiniuva slams a tent mallet on a stake and drives it deep.
Ntiniuva takes a bullet graze on the shoulder and keeps shouting orders.

name: Oraau
summary: Oraau is a one-armed veteran who begged on the street until a parasite woke a hidden gene in him. His prosthetic hook glows with plasma and his eyes read heat, but he is haunted by old war memories.

feats.scene: Oraau slashes a plasma-lit hook through a vault door.
Oraau is thrown into a brick wall by a foe and rises slowly.

name: Rnomon
summary: Rnomon is the last remaining islander of a deserted island, taken in by a kindly adoptive father. She follows a thunder-bolt hex mark to a distant hospital.

feats.scene: Rnomon tugs a rope and hauls a small boat up a beach.
Rnomon slips on wet rocks and rolls to her feet.

name: Siueo
summary: Siueo is a would-be dictator who plots to overthrow a capital government and conquer his whole homeworld. Two undercover agents infiltrate his lab and a time-traveler complicates everything.

feats.scene: Siueo fires a pistol through a lab window and drops a guard.
Siueo is tackled by agents and does not go down at once.

name: Vaiumli
summary: Vaiumli is a blond informant in a dark city who sells tips to a teenage masked hero. Nothing else survives about him beyond a nickname and a nervous grin.

feats.scene: Vaiumli shoves a garbage can into an alley and trips a pursuer.
Vaiumli is shoved against a brick wall and keeps whispering.

name: Irvalo
summary: Irvalo is an engineered ape-man who commands a fortress of fighting apes on a hidden island. He conspires against a king and leads an assault on a distant naval base.

feats.scene: Irvalo hurls a jeep over a fortress rampart.
Irvalo is hurled into a cliff face and rises, snarling.

name: Toriumsor
summary: Toriumsor is a grey-skinned former wrestler with fangs and claws who moved to a gloomy city to rule its underworld. He is among the three strongest brawlers of his rogues' circle and loves a swim.

feats.scene: Toriumsor bends a steel cell bar with his bare hands.
Toriumsor takes a thrown dumpster to the chest and laughs.

name: Rntorse
summary: Rntorse is a costumed criminal who robs a library with a cocoon-spinning gun and a gang of moth-masked henchmen. He exists only in a presentation reel and a later comic tie-in.

feats.scene: Rntorse fires a cocoon gun and pins a guard to a shelf.
Rntorse is flipped over a table and lands on a rug.

name: Lltaan
summary: Lltaan is a scheming noble from a fiery hell-world, son of a disgraced warlord, who plots to seize a throne by possessing a hero's body. His kind hide a fatal weakness to a rare mineral.

feats.scene: Lltaan drives a fist through an apocalyptic fortress wall and drops a whole bastion.
Lltaan stands unharmed in the middle of a firestorm that flattens a whole city block.

name: Serstau
summary: Serstau is a former soldier turned assassin who claims cybernetic enhancements of an unknown extent. He keeps his skills sharp and his past secret.

feats.scene: Serstau fires a rifle shot through a window and drops a target on a balcony.
Serstau absorbs a baton blow and finishes the job.

name: Animaial
summary: Animaial is a white-haired thief who gained speed from a storm and uses it to pay for treatment, not knowing the speed worsens her illness. A dimensional tear later cost her an arm.

feats.scene: Animaial streaks through a bank lobby and empties the till before a guard turns.
Animaial slams into a vault door at top speed and dents it.
Animaial skids across wet asphalt and tumbles up.

name: Enuamst
summary: Enuamst is a pink-hided veteran of an interstellar peacekeeping order who died in a final stand against a tyrant god. He charged the foe alone and was the last of his comrades to fall.

feats.scene: Enuamst slams a glowing war-hammer into a god's fortress and the entire bastion collapses.
Enuamst shrugs off a barrage that levels the field behind him.

name: Llaseo
summary: Llaseo is the pink-skinned guardian of a fishing world, sworn to watch over its sector as part of a larger order. He wields a wristlet that builds shields and projectiles from willpower.

feats.scene: Llaseo sweeps a wave of green-less light across a harbor and clears the sunken wrecks.
Llaseo holds a barrier of light while a cliff slides into the bay.

name: Vicesti
summary: Vicesti is a heat-and-cold scientist who eats anything and calls it delicious, even a whole bucket of dessert and its container. He aids a team of heroes against a mind-controlling tyrant and rebuilds a ruined planet.

feats.scene: Vicesti fires a spear of light through a hangar and demolishes it.
Vicesti is slammed through a hull wall and gets up clapping his hands.

name: Iltelco
summary: Iltelco is a hairless veteran summoned to a far planet to confront a rogue colleague, and he was struck down alongside his whole squad. His final act was to follow orders.

feats.scene: Iltelco fires a bolt of light that cracks open a ridge of stone.
Iltelco's shield flickers and buckles under a rogue's assault.

name: Ntures
summary: Ntures is a thug bodyguard for a crooked billionaire, ordered to dispose of a double-crossing archaeologist. He is killed by his employer's panicked shot.

feats.scene: Ntures lifts a struggling woman and hurls her into a car boot.
Ntures takes a punch from a rival and does not blink.

name: Licel
summary: Licel is a heavy-set warden sent by the old guardians to bring home a wayward colleague who neglected distant worlds. He fails to catch his target and is told to return home.

feats.scene: Licel drops a boulder of hard light on an asteroid base and flattens a hangar.
Licel takes a thundering counter-blast and stays on his feet.

name: Soanvor
summary: Soanvor is a yellow-hued warden from a film adaptation, trusted with a sector near a distant harbor. He fights alongside a ragtag band of watchmen, sharing a weary sense of humor.

feats.scene: Soanvor hammers a pillar of light through an enemy cruiser and splits it.
Soanvor stands in the blast of a siege cannon and keeps swinging.

name: Sttis
summary: Sttis is a barking drill sergeant with a mate waiting at home, who is dragged across the frontier to chase a killer of his colleagues. He later helps stop a hive of rogue machines.

feats.scene: Sttis drives a giant fist of light into a machine hive and caves the dome.
Sttis takes a missile volley on his shield and keeps bellowing.

name: Reolu
summary: Reolu is a widowed geneticist and mechanic turned instructor who trains a doomed pilot's replacement by letting him fall toward a sun. He teaches willpower with exhausting simulation drills.

feats.scene: Reolu hurls a constructed anchor of light that skewers a cruiser.
Reolu holds a barrier of light as a shattered moon fragment falls on him.

name: Stivaure
summary: Stivaure is a veteran too busy to mentor a new recruit and sends a substitute instead. He appears only as a mention in a tale of passing the torch.

feats.scene: Stivaure blasts a training drone to splinters with a wristlet bolt.
Stivaure takes a falling transport on his shield and walks off.

name: Comiaori
summary: Comiaori is a pink-hided veteran recalled to lead a squad against a world-ruling regime, and he is captured and strangled after trading insults with a captor. He taunts his captors even as they argue over his fate.

feats.scene: Comiaori smashes a defense turret to scrap in a flash of light.
Comiaori survives an orbital bombardment alongside his squad.

name: Reovi
summary: Reovi is a white-eyed guardian who appears in a cabbie's collection of celebrity selfies. He flies and builds shields and bolts with a wristlet, but mostly poses for photos.

feats.scene: Reovi pokes a hole through a cab roof with a bolt of light.
Reovi is bumped by a speeding cab and doesn't flinch.

name: Tuamsau
summary: Tuamsau is a pink-skinned guardian of a far-off world and an alien of a heavy-set race. He wears a wristlet that builds constructs, shields and flares of energy and flies between stations.

feats.scene: Tuamsau erects a giant ram of light and punches through a station bulkhead.
Tuamsau holds a barrier of light as a collapsing dock buries him.

name: Lulesar
summary: Lulesar is a blue-eyed wanderer who crashed on a farm with no memory, was taken for a brother, and now keeps a prison realm of ghostly exiles. He is one of the strongest beings in his world.

feats.scene: Lulesar drove a fist into a drifting comet and split it down the middle.
Lulesar stood at the heart of a collapsing prison and was merely dusted.
Lulesar crossed a sea in a streak of blue.

name: Osntotau
summary: Osntotau is a long-lived young soldier in a cartoon crossover who drinks sunlight, shrugs off blows and fires heat from his eyes. A pinch of the wrong metal drops him.

feats.scene: Osntotau scorched a ridge with a blast from his eyes and left a glassy scar.
Osntotau took a falling bridge on his back and shrugged it off.

name: Tuamte
summary: Tuamte is a younger duplicate of a veteran hero, strong, quick and nearly unbreakable, who flies with a team of teenagers. His origin turns out to be a trick of time.

feats.scene: Tuamte hurled a derelict freighter through a wall of space debris.
Tuamte held position under a barrage of ship cannons and shook it off.
Tuamte streaked across a gas giant's rings in a heartbeat.

name: Coveoiu
summary: Coveoiu is a red-haired exile whose curse turns him into a wolf-beast under moonlight and makes him stronger than the finest hero of his world. A red sun and an odd mineral weaken him.

feats.scene: Coveoiu tore a cell door from its hinges and flung it down a corridor.
Coveoiu was hit by a cannon salvo and kept lunging.

name: Nastmi
summary: Nastmi is a banished townsman turned into a ravening beast by a poisoned stone, freed after long years and brought down by a young hero. His body is no longer even close to what it was.

feats.scene: Nastmi smashed through a lab wall and flipped a transport van.
Nastmi took a volley from a dozen rifles and bellowed at the moon.
Nastmi charged down an access tunnel in one howling burst.

name: Toncel
summary: Toncel is a devoted wife who refuses to leave her husband's side when their home world begins to tear itself apart, and tells him to save their son instead.

feats.scene: Toncel slammed a heavy lab shutter against a rolling tremor.
Toncel stayed on her feet as the floor split beneath her.

name: Amoseoori
summary: Amoseoori is a borrowed face, a recollection of a mother used by alien zookeepers who stole a boy's memories to build a lifelike trap.

feats.scene: Amoseoori pushed a heavy cage door shut in a simulated cottage.
Amoseoori remained steady while the false room around her shook.

name: Veonusnum
summary: Veonusnum is a widow who slipped into a spirit prison to survive, then returned to fight beside her grown son. She revives her husband for a single day by singing a crystal into shape.

feats.scene: Veonusnum raised a lattice of crystal that pinned a giant machine in place.
Veonusnum stood in a fallen tower and walked out of the rubble.

name: Stuler
summary: Stuler is a brown-haired scholar who stands beside a husband who foretold the end of their world, and trusts him when no one else does.

feats.scene: Stuler slammed a lab drawer shut on a stack of reports.
Stuler kept her footing during a violent tremor.

name: Aneno
summary: Aneno is a glowing recording of a long-dead mother, kept in an icy fortress to advise a grieving son.

feats.scene: Aneno flickered a beam across the floor, warm enough to dry a puddle.
Aneno held her projected shape through a power surge.

name: Erseco
summary: Erseco is a scientist whose second marriage and two sons shaped a doomed world. She built a device that stored the minds of her people, and it later fell into the wrong hands.

feats.scene: Erseco fired up a lab engine that tore a door off its frame.
Erseco braced against a shaking bench as the walls split.

name: Tumres
summary: Tumres is a quiet mother in a modern retelling, wife of a visionary and sister-in-law to rival nobles. She helps send a child away before her home is lost.

feats.scene: Tumres carried a heavy case up a spiral stair.
Tumres sat through a day of tremors without panic.

name: Nianaumi
summary: Nianaumi is a brown-haired mother who can speak mind to mind and lets that quiet gift ease the farewell to her only son.

feats.scene: Nianaumi sealed a crystal casket with a firm push.
Nianaumi calmly faced the quaking floor of her home.

name: Tiesre
summary: Tiesre is a blond officer of her home world's armed forces who is also a scientist, wed to a visionary. She is known for discipline, protocol and a mother's grit.

feats.scene: Tiesre drove a rifle butt into a hatch seal and sprang it open.
Tiesre took a crushing fall in training and stood back up.

name: Riaoreori
summary: Riaoreori is a blond mother who slips through a portal to check on the family that will raise her son, and later leaves behind a living echo in an icy hall.

feats.scene: Riaoreori pushed a crystal key into a console and blew the lights in the hall.
Riaoreori stepped through a collapsing portal and emerged intact.

name: Oluest
summary: Oluest is a red-and-brown-haired waitress who doubles as a bodyguard for a crime boss, a brawler who gets tied to the ceiling when a swordsman visits.

feats.scene: Oluest threw a spinning kick that cracked a bar stool in half.
Oluest hit the floor hard after a sucker punch and rolled up smiling.

name: Stuel
summary: Stuel is a black-haired chauffeur and bodyguard to a short-fused crime lord, adept at fighting and at keeping the books straight.

feats.scene: Stuel drove an open palm into a bouncer's chest and sent him through a curtain.
Stuel got up from a bad car crash and finished the ride.

name: Oroore
summary: Oroore is a boy sailor swept into a long castaway adventure in the thirties, game for any scheme if it helps a friend.

feats.scene: Oroore hurled a coconut across a beach and rang a cooking pot.
Oroore clung to a spar in a rough sea for a full night.

name: Orviirn
summary: Orviirn is a brown-haired gang member who tries to take out a clown boss and persuades the leader to come home. A hail of fire during a siege ends him.

feats.scene: Orviirn fired a pistol clip into a door and splintered it.
Orviirn took a baton blow on the shoulder and did not drop his weapon.

name: Taural
summary: Taural is the son of a politician and an exiled princess, taken on a trip to her shadowy homeland where an attacker kills his mother. His own fate is left unknown.

feats.scene: Taural heaved a stone into a dark pond and sent up a wave.
Taural tumbled down a bank in a panic and kept running.

name: Valletiu
summary: Valletiu is a former stunt performer who works for the war office as a rescuer, spy and assassin, flying in daring missions across the globe.

feats.scene: Valletiu fired a belt of rounds that chewed through a bridge rail.
Valletiu crashed a glider through trees and clambered out.

name: Ularern
summary: Ularern is a disgraced heir who invents a criminal mastermind to ruin his family's firm, and is foiled by his own sister posing as the villain.

feats.scene: Ularern hurled a ledger across an office and toppled a lamp.
Ularern was thrown into a shelf and kept shouting orders.

name: Rntan
summary: Rntan is a beat officer in an experimental radio-car patrol of the thirties, working beside a partner, keeping a big city quiet.

feats.scene: Rntan rammed a shoulder into a warehouse door and burst it open.
Rntan took a swing from a thug and answered with cuffs.

name: Autes
summary: Autes is a trio of laughing, black-eyed hyenas kept as pets by a pair of criminals. Their claws, fangs and keen noses are all the weapons they need until a dart drops them.

feats.scene: Autes lunged together and brought down a guard with a triple bite.
Autes bounded away from a thrown crate and circled back.

source_title: Larry, Moe and Shemp the Hyenas (DC Animated Movie Universe)

name: Norsente
summary: Norsente is a blond young hunter of a stone-age clan, maimed while killing a huge wolf with a spear. He walks with a crutch and fights on regardless.

feats.scene: Norsente drove a flint spear into a giant wolf's shoulder.
Norsente survived a mauling that crippled his leg.

name: Llosticor
summary: Llosticor is a small, round, yellow-eyed grub drawn in cute style, tagging along with a gang of chibi heroes.

feats.scene: Llosticor nibbled a crayon in half.
Llosticor bounced off a toy block unharmed.

source_title: Larva M319 (Teen Titans TV Series: Tween Titans)

name: Numnte
summary: Numnte is a genderless, many-armed, one-eyed sentinel of an interstellar police corps, captured to feed a villain's machine and then freed to help a cartoon duck.

feats.scene: Numnte fired a ring beam that cracked a space-station wall.
Numnte withstood a blast of a vortex engine inside a ring shield.

name: Miaeorno
summary: Miaeorno is a mute, hive-minded being who speaks only through a glowing ring, a veteran guardian of a sector who fights invaders and recruits a mushroom-like ally.

feats.scene: Miaeorno shaped a ring-made tower and drove it through a warship's keel.
Miaeorno stood in a battlefield haze behind a shell of ring light.

name: Numsttel
summary: Numsttel is a one-eyed, tentacled ring-bearer in an alternate history where a nail kept the world from changing. The wearer flies with ring power and builds barriers of light.

feats.scene: Numsttel carved a gap in a barricade with a green beam.
Numsttel held a protective bubble against a hail of shrapnel.

name: Stses
summary: Stses is a grad student on roller skates who jumps through space whenever touched, after a failed organ donation woke a hidden gene. Her unstable jumps collapse a lab in a violent implosion.

feats.scene: Stses jumped in a panic and left a lab as a crushed shell.
Stses was clipped by a wall of white noise and wobbled upright.

name: Tumiantu
summary: Tumiantu is a turquoise-haired whip-fighter raised in a harsh orphanage, who leads a gang of fierce women and grumbles about her assignments.

feats.scene: Tumiantu cracked a steel-tipped lash and shredded a wooden gate.
Tumiantu tumbled off a ledge and landed in a crouch.

name: Lunte
summary: Lunte is a tall, black-haired lieutenant of a tyrant's elite squad who wields electrified steel lashes that reach, coil and sear. She is stronger, quicker and tougher than most soldiers.

feats.scene: Lunte whipped a lash across a tank turret and sheared it off.
Lunte took a volley of rounds and sneered at the smoke.

name: Iurniter
summary: Iurniter is a pink-skinned, six-armed ring-bearer thought lost in a battle and later found frozen in stasis. Her recovery is bitter, and an old flame is not welcome.

feats.scene: Iurniter shaped six ring-made fists and flattened a drone swarm.
Iurniter held a bright shell as a ship's cannons hammered it.

name: Lasiri
summary: Lasiri is a racing driver rebuilt by his government into a fast, strong, fast-healing brawler, a bitter knock-off of a famous pair. His smirk gets him burned.

feats.scene: Lasiri drove a fist through the hood of a sports car.
Lasiri took a heavy beating and sprang back with his wounds closing.

name: Nenrosco
summary: Nenrosco is a nightmare hero twisted by passing through a million stars, whose hunger is unquenchable. His power dwarfs a normal member of his race.

feats.scene: Nenrosco shattered a continent-sized slab with one clenched fist.
Nenrosco walked out of the core of a dying star unharmed.

name: Lertor
summary: Lertor is a grinning machine plague, the lingering spite of a dead clown, that teams with an old enemy to steal rogue wishes. It is exposed by two hero disguises.

feats.scene: Lertor warped a ring of dwarf-planet rock into a mocking face.
Lertor flickered and rebuilt itself after a burst of static.

name: Elamost
summary: Elamost is a blond young woman raised by a fearful father to trust nobody and shoot straight. She wears a mask, fires two handguns, and dies beside her partner.

feats.scene: Elamost fired twin pistols and punched a line of holes through a bar sign.
Elamost dove off a porch and took the landing on her shoulder.

name: Anteva
summary: Anteva is a shapeshifting saboteur who stretches like rubber and wears other faces, infiltrating a team of oddballs. A single slip of grammar gives her away.

feats.scene: Anteva coiled her arms around a rival and crushed a steel locker.
Anteva flattened under a falling beam and bounced back.

name: Erunteser
summary: Erunteser is a tall, golden-haired recruit of a far-future club, seen in an animated crossover.

feats.scene: Erunteser tossed a metal bench across a plaza.
Erunteser stood under a falling banner pole and shrugged.

name: Ronorri
summary: Ronorri is a tall, golden-haired heroine raised in a prejudiced community who gains great strength, speed and flight away from her home star. A trace of one metal could kill her.

feats.scene: Ronorri shattered a floating habitat ring with a single blow.
Ronorri took a starship's volley and brushed the dust off her suit.

name: Lestna
summary: Lestna is a seven-foot heroine, descended from a famous hero's brother, who learned to use a station's guns as a child and wiped out an invading fleet. She married and raised a daughter.

feats.scene: Lestna swept a raiding fleet out of the sky with a barrage from the station guns.
Lestna endured a barrage that split a hangar and walked out unhurt.

name: Nintauler
summary: Nintauler is an acrobatic fighter, pushed into the family trade by her mother, who tires of masked life until a partner revives the thrill. She is lithe, quick and fond of three a.m. mischief.

feats.scene: Nintauler spun into a flying kick that split a plank barricade.
Nintauler hit a rooftop in a roll and sprang to her feet.

name: Lortel
summary: Lortel is a cynical federal agent and former masked vigilante who hunts the people who still dress up. She has a talent for needling and a bitter sense of humour.

feats.scene: Lortel threw a hard punch and cracked a heavy door panel.
Lortel shook off a car door slammed into her back.

name: Neotoca
summary: Neotoca is a brown-haired gymnast who inherits a crimefighting mantle but dislikes it, and settles down with a quiet inventor after a world-shaking plot she could not stop.

feats.scene: Neotoca launched a flip-kick into a thug's chest and sent him through a crate.
Neotoca tumbled across a gravel yard and sprang up unbroken.

name: Luorares
summary: Luorares is a farm-raised teenager, half human and half star-born, who flies, runs and lifts without effort and laughs when a blast hits her. Her parents fret over her best friend.

feats.scene: Luorares shoved a hovering craft into a quarry wall and flattened it.
Luorares took a beam in the chest and said it tickled.
Luorares zipped across an island chain between two heartbeats.

name: Ntamoont
summary: Ntamoont is a pair of hungry seed-puff spirits that slip into a person's body when ignored and sulk until noticed. Its twin voices bicker over the steering wheel of one borrowed frame.

feats.scene: Ntamoont makes a borrowed arm punch through a plaster wall.
Ntamoont lets a borrowed body fall down stairs and gets up giggling.

name: Amressa
summary: Amressa is a patrol officer on a rough dead-end boulevard who befriends a gang of street kids and carries a sidearm she rarely draws. Its kindness earned a cheeky nickname.

feats.scene: Amressa fires a round that drops a lamp off its post.
Amressa takes a hit on a vest and finishes her patrol.

name: Estcaau
summary: Estcaau is a green-skinned schemer who built a humming device to stir up feelings in distant crowds. Its machine rewrites moods from a hidden tower, and its owner is a terrible loser.

feats.scene: Estcaau overloads his machine and a console bursts in a shower of sparks.
Estcaau is thrown into a bulkhead and rises dizzy.

name: Luiar
summary: Luiar is a dream-born archivist who exists only inside a hallucination, blending the looks of one woman with the wit of another. Its marriage and child vanish the moment the dreamer wakes.

feats.scene: Luiar throws a scroll tube across a library hall.
Luiar fades gently when the dream ends, unharmed.

name: Amotorne
summary: Amotorne is a moon-dwelling lecturer who runs mind-training simulations for visiting cadets and nudges young couples toward honest choices. Its simulations are gentle but exhausting.

feats.scene: Amotorne slaps a lecture lectern hard enough to rattle the tray.
Amotorne steadies himself through a rough simulated quake.

name: Anval
summary: Anval is a hulking space hunter who turns up late to every brawl and blames the traffic of drifting rocks. Its hide shrugs off blasts and its wounds seal within minutes.

feats.scene: Anval swings a barbed chain and brings down a brick gatehouse.
Anval walks out of a collapsed hangar picking his teeth.

name: Elasil
summary: Elasil is a leering mercenary on a rumbling space bike who races a masked vigilante and mocks his limp. Its fists and hooked chain settle every argument.

feats.scene: Elasil drives a punch through a vault door and the wall behind.
Elasil shakes off a rocket hit and lights a cigar on the flames.

name: Elcor
summary: Elcor is a lone alien contractor who joined a heroic roster mainly for the fights and keeps a very flexible code. Its daughter's existence is the only thing that slows its trigger finger.

feats.scene: Elcor throws a hover-car into a billboard and it topples.
Elcor takes a missile to the chest and complains about the noise.

name: Reosansi
summary: Reosansi is a grey-skinned loner who claims to be the last of a ruined world and hunts targets with a blaster that shoots dim-sun rays. Its grin lasts through every bruise.

feats.scene: Reosansi bats a freight shuttle out of the sky with a chain.
Reosansi emerges from a crushed cargo bay still chewing.
Reosansi tears across a salt flat on his roaring bike.

name: Nilamo
summary: Nilamo is a bounty hunter who tracks cabbies and cartoon villains alike, with a chain, a ray-gun and no patience. Its voice is gravel and its boasts are louder than its engine.

feats.scene: Nilamo drags a hooked chain and rips a streetlight from the pavement.
Nilamo laughs off a head-on collision with a taxi.

name: Ntecoeol
summary: Ntecoeol is a blocky plastic brute who leaps over skyscrapers, blows up scenery for fun, and photographs the wreckage. Its toy-sized bricks scatter wherever it lands.

feats.scene: Ntecoeol detonates a building made of bricks with a single demolition charge.
Ntecoeol pops back together after being scattered into pieces.

name: Eoncores
summary: Eoncores is a seven-foot stubble-chinned mercenary who wiped out his own kin, tried priesthood, and found it dull. Its knack for regrowing limbs makes it more of an annoyance than a menace.

feats.scene: Eoncores heaves a battered freighter onto its side and sets it ablaze.
Eoncores regrows from a charred skeleton and demands a drink.
Eoncores thunders over an ice moon on a wrecked sled.

name: Sanas
summary: Sanas is a muscle-bound alien hired hand who appears in a digital serial, leaning on gang bosses with a chain and a snarl. Its hand-to-hand skill is its most useful trick.

feats.scene: Sanas punches a dumpster through a brick wall.
Sanas laughs off a car crash into his chest.

name: Seserler
summary: Seserler is a fang-toothed double who insists he is the genuine one, a former palace guard who fled a dying world. Its sharp nose and acrobatics make it a surprisingly nimble hunter.

feats.scene: Seserler tackles an armoured crawler and flips it on its roof.
Seserler heals a broken arm between one rooftop and the next.

name: Nolli
summary: Nolli is a luckless prairie bounty man whose trousers keep getting stolen by the very outlaw he chases. Its closest ally is a feather-wearing guide, and its best trick is a hasty kiss.

feats.scene: Nolli lassoes a runaway wagon wheel and halts it.
Nolli tumbles into a cactus patch and sulks.

name: Nancote
summary: Nancote is a petulant alien teenager who rewrites matter by whim, dismisses heroes in seconds and carries a crush like a loaded weapon. Its remodeled home world changes shape with its mood.

feats.scene: Nancote reshapes a whole continent into a heart-shaped garden in a tantrum.
Nancote smiles through a cannon barrage that crumples a battleship.

name: Serst
summary: Serst is an orange-skinned planetary guardian who defended his village against a totalitarian neighbour and trained a son to take his glowing ring. Its sacrifice is remembered in a quiet crypt.

feats.scene: Serst fires a green bolt that wrecks an invading gunship.
Serst raises a ring shield against a firing line.

name: Torrnuva
summary: Torrnuva is a blue-eyed spymaster who serves a tyrant and files secrets in a drawer shaped like a cage. Its power rests in whispers, not weapons.

feats.scene: Torrnuva drives a cane through a wooden office door.
Torrnuva survives an ambush on a staircase with a gash.

name: Tiunausi
summary: Tiunausi is a black-haired city reporter whose first name keeps getting her paired with the wrong partners until she meets the right one. Its family grows slowly and happily, with grandchildren named for friends.

feats.scene: Tiunausi swats a rude phone off a desk.
Tiunausi walks home through a snowstorm with a heavy bag.

name: Orlia
summary: Orlia is a flirty, headstrong newsreel reporter drawn in a black-and-white serial who flies planes and fires guns, but always winds up dangling from a rope. Its pluck inspires a worldwide band of look-alikes.

feats.scene: Orlia fires a pistol and shatters a lantern from across a room.
Orlia crashes a prop plane into a hedge and climbs out.

name: Nalivi
summary: Nalivi is a young newsroom hire who covers small-town oddities for a big paper and hides her curiosity behind a notebook. Its stubborn questions will eventually crack a famous secret.

feats.scene: Nalivi hurls her notebook and knocks a hat off a clerk.
Nalivi sprints three blocks in the rain and keeps taking notes.

name: Nutinu
summary: Nutinu is a ruthless mirror-world warrior queen who rules from an orbiting base alongside a corrupt consort. Its eyes burn through steel and its lasso bends the will of rivals.

feats.scene: Nutinu sweeps a heat blast across a harbour and boils half of it away.
Nutinu strolls out of a crumbled tower with her cape unsinged.
Nutinu soars over a coastline faster than any jet.

name: Rnaul
summary: Rnaul is a widowed reporter in a doomed parallel reality who mourns at her partner's side as an antimatter wave rolls closer. Its fate is sealed, then reversed by a cosmic reset.

feats.scene: Rnaul throws a wilted bouquet at a looming shadow.
Rnaul is erased with her world by the antimatter wave and later restored.

name: Staanu
summary: Staanu is a grieving journalist who fused with a relic of a fallen alien hero and vowed to build a stern utopia in his memory. Its fury cracks stone and its logic closes no doors for mercy.

feats.scene: Staanu hurls a heat beam that levels a downtown plaza.
Staanu weathers a sky-high impact that sends a skyscraper crumbling.
Staanu rockets over a river in a heartbeat.

source_title: Lois Lane (Dark Multiverse: Death of Superman)

name: Vatialan
summary: Vatialan is a teen news cub at a school for costumed kids who spars with a goofy speedster and files stories on cafeteria wars. Its camera is its weapon of choice.

feats.scene: Vatialan hurls a tray across a lunch hall.
Vatialan takes a tumble down a hallway and keeps filming.

name: Eonveo
summary: Eonveo is a briefly glimpsed office reporter drawn in the background of one panel, mute and unnamed. Its desk is crowded, and its relationship to anyone is a mystery.

feats.scene: Eonveo drops a coffee mug onto a counter.
Eonveo is jostled by a crowd in a doorway and remains upright.

name: Valortor
summary: Valortor was the spouse of a flawless hero until a descent into madness cost her life, and her loss turned her friend's despair into a vow. Its only legacy is a vow of vengeance.

feats.scene: Valortor pushes a door shut against a storm.
Valortor shields a child from a falling shelf.

name: Oluam
summary: Oluam is a freshly arrived reporter in a reimagined modern city who jokes with an uncle and observes a mysterious newcomer. Its questions are clever, and its sources are everywhere.

feats.scene: Oluam shoves a revolving door and jams it.
Oluam walks through a downpour and arrives on deadline.

name: Silsia
summary: Silsia is a war correspondent who rides helicopters through hostile fields, covers boxing matches, and meets mountain explorers who tackle monstrous beasts. Its articles describe a decade of upheaval.

feats.scene: Silsia throws her helmet at a bird and scares it off.
Silsia endures a bumpy landing in a field of smoke.

name: Titelval
summary: Titelval was a newsroom veteran who survived a cruel massacre by wearing a mask, then spent her last breath urging her husband to stay merciful. Its final words still echo through a ruined hall.

feats.scene: Titelval swings a nameplate and strikes her attacker.
Titelval holds on through a savage blow before falling.

name: Senau
