summary: Senau is a vintage reporter with a younger sister, drawn in a single golden-age tale of dare-devil scoops. Its jokes and dangers belong to a simpler age.

feats.scene: Senau swings a handbag and knocks a hat off a thief.
Senau falls off a scaffold into a net and waves.

name: Erunto
summary: Erunto is a married journalist who was introduced to a rich bachelor by a smooth co-worker and learned two secrets at once. Its wedding was attended by heroes in plain clothes.

feats.scene: Erunto throws a pen and pins a note to a corkboard.
Erunto survives a kidnapping by a metal-minded villain unscathed.

name: Ricore
summary: Ricore is a cartoon-style reporter who banters with her team and clings to a rope when a villain's plan goes awry. Its catchphrases are asked of her at every rescue.

feats.scene: Ricore tosses a ring buoy to a falling friend.
Ricore dangles from a crane hook through a windstorm.

name: Vaiasme
summary: Vaiasme is a brave reporter in a steam-age alien invasion who volunteers to cover the first crater, is captured in a tripod, and rescues her cunning spouse from his captors. Its courage turns the tide when the machines fail.

feats.scene: Vaiasme smashes a control panel and a machine's leg buckles.
Vaiasme endures weeks of captivity and walks out upright.

name: Vemiarni
summary: Vemiarni was a reporter in a mirrored reality of villains who fell for a visiting star traveller, wed a noble champion, and launched her infant to safety before an antimatter tide. Its last act was an embrace.

feats.scene: Vemiarni seals a hatch on a baby's escape capsule.
Vemiarni's world is erased by a tide of antimatter.

name: Innumto
summary: Innumto is an ambitious older-era journalist with a string of undercover names and a competitive streak toward her rookie colleague. Its romance with a bespectacled partner sprawls across decades before a late tragedy.

feats.scene: Innumto hurls a typewriter ribbon spool through a pane.
Innumto falls off a cab roof and bounces up.

name: Valerrer
summary: Valerrer is a reporter in a warring-kingdoms timeline whose father builds a secret super-soldier, and she ends up with a rebel force. Its birthday cake delivery changes her life.

feats.scene: Valerrer fires a rifle and blasts a sentry post lantern.
Valerrer drops from a trench lip into mud and keeps running.

name: Valanri
summary: Valanri is a future-set reporter and parent of a growing son who writes with an investigator's eye. Its small family keeps a window open on every dangerous night.

feats.scene: Valanri shoves a stuck door open for a neighbour.
Valanri jogs a ragged mile in a dust storm.

name: Ricaraul
summary: Ricaraul is a sharp-tongued cable-news journalist who dates the city's most famous guardian and keeps a snappy feed on rogues. Its voice carries an animated cast's biggest laughs.

feats.scene: Ricaraul flings a news mic like a javelin at a drone.
Ricaraul falls off a stage and finishes the broadcast.

name: Leoiuve
summary: Leoiuve is an expectant reporter whose abduction and death at the hands of two clowns tips a world's champion into tyranny. Its loss is the hinge on which a whole regime turns.

feats.scene: Leoiuve decks a thug with a sturdy elbow.
Leoiuve endures a surgical ordeal in a cramped submersible.

name: Rnstmon
summary: Rnstmon is a pregnant fiancee escorted across worlds by a clever inventor to talk a furious champion down. Its words work better than a hundred blows.

feats.scene: Rnstmon shoves a hovering drone away from her path.
Rnstmon keeps calm through a dimensional hop and a lurch.

name: Anules
summary: Anules is a bitter reporter who drained her husband's gifts and took command of an army hunting costumed heroes after her newsroom collapsed on her. Its crusade burns with a grim certainty.

feats.scene: Anules throws a stolen blast that cracks a mountain range.
Anules climbs out of a leveled tower and glares.
Anules streaks over an ocean and lands in a crater.

name: Sontorasi
summary: Sontorasi is a reporter who vanished on an overseas assignment and is remembered only by a stone marker in a quiet cemetery. Its absence is a hole in the story of someone else.

feats.scene: Sontorasi lugs a pack across a jungle ridge.
Sontorasi survives a river crossing on a log raft.

name: Seosenti
summary: Seosenti is a persistent investigative writer in a comedic digital serial who interviews a hero about his private life. Its questions are sincere and its snacks are legendary.

feats.scene: Seosenti tosses a recorder onto a table and it skids.
Seosenti rides out a bumpy helicopter flight and files copy.

name: Orerauer
summary: Orerauer is a defiant journalist in a surveillance state who criticises its president and is arrested for it. Its rescue by a stranger leads to a daring disguise.

feats.scene: Orerauer slams a prison door against a guard.
Orerauer endures a harsh interrogation and refuses to talk.

name: Nuvasiu
summary: Nuvasiu is a cartoon reporter who interviews a jailed schemer and is swapped with him by a holographic trick. Its dignified poise is restored by a quick rescue.

feats.scene: Nuvasiu swats a hologram projector off a table.
Nuvasiu is shoved through a cell door and stays calm.

name: Corvaslan
summary: Corvaslan is a prize-winning writer with a young son and an engaged partner who reunites with an old flame after years of absence. Its famous essay argues that nobody needs saviours.

feats.scene: Corvaslan swings a satchel into a goon's knee on a yacht.
Corvaslan survives a shuttle mishap and walks off with a limp.

name: Anunessiu
summary: Anunessiu is a sea-woman healer who grows legs on shore and a finned tail in the surf; she befriends land-dwellers, mends the wounded with careful hands, and keeps old shipwreck coins in a drawer.

feats.scene: Anunessiu flicks her tail and sends a rowing boat spinning across a harbour.
Anunessiu rests on the floor of the deepest trench and finds the weight only mildly tiresome.
Anunessiu races a patrol launch round a headland and finishes well ahead.

name: Lloesta
summary: Lloesta is an angry teenager who can borrow the spells of anyone near her, though never for long and never with much control; she wants to belong and keeps blowing it.

feats.scene: Lloesta borrows a passing sorcerer's bolt and shatters a parked delivery van.
Lloesta takes a skid across gravel at speed and comes up scraped but defiant.

name: Renlesres
summary: Renlesres is a death-obsessed teenage vessel for a malicious spirit that bargained for her life; with borrowed spells she is a threat to the balance of the arcane world, and she knows it.

feats.scene: Renlesres pulls the borrowed power of a dozen sorcerers into one blast and vaporises a ridgeline.
Renlesres is struck by a collapsing sky-bridge and walks out of the ash, humming.

name: Telrint
summary: Telrint is a dabbler in hedge-magic who mutters charms from a pocket-sized grimoire and mostly uses them on lazy ghosts in a small midwestern town.

feats.scene: Telrint murmurs a charm and a flaming spark leaps to light a bonfire across the field.
Telrint trips on a cellar stair and rolls to the bottom without breaking her stride.

name: Aucorval
summary: Aucorval is a green-skinned fighter whose body hardens into plates like polished steel after a parasite woke a dormant gene; she throws herself into street fights that are none of her business.

feats.scene: Aucorval punches a car door clean off its hinges to haul a driver out.
Aucorval stands her ground as a skidding bus slams into her armoured shoulder.

name: Amniantu
summary: Amniantu is a quick-witted undercover operative who has a sideline in radio drama, reenacting her old cases for broadcast and changing her hair between episodes to keep the trail cold.

feats.scene: Amniantu slams a studio door into the face of a pursuing courier.
Amniantu leaps from a moving tram and rolls through a hedge without a scratch.

name: Elauel
summary: Elauel is a hardworking mother who moved her family to a small prairie town to start over, and who meets the long winter with a snowman contest and a firm hand.

feats.scene: Elauel shoves a stuck shed door open with her shoulder.
Elauel plunges through lake ice and clings to the edge until help arrives.

name: Ritiseo
summary: Ritiseo is a mournful widow in a future city of neon and glass who raised her family quietly and keeps one framed photograph on her mantel above all the rest.

feats.scene: Ritiseo hurls a ceramic vase at a masked intruder in her doorway.
Ritiseo is thrown against a wall by a stranger and still crawls for the alarm.

name: Tellati
summary: Tellati is a red-eyed wanderer from a drifting archive of hollow towers, light on his feet and hard to place, who bears no history and answers to a name he says he found on the road.

feats.scene: Tellati cracks a flagstone with a stamp and lifts a dozen others in a ring around himself.
Tellati steps out from under a fallen arch with only dust on his coat.

name: Villuiu
summary: Villuiu is a grey housecat who drank a strange tonic and woke up able to talk; sharp claws and sharper opinions, he returned to the sofa and demanded a better brand of tuna.

feats.scene: Villuiu rakes a sofa cushion to ribbons in a single swipe.
Villuiu drops from a fourth-floor sill onto a awning and lands on his feet.
Villuiu dashes down a back alley chased by a tin of dry biscuits.

name: Sttiuil
summary: Sttiuil is the dour armorer of a precinct locker, checking sidearms in and out, and quietly renting out spares for cash to anyone who looks like they might need one.

feats.scene: Sttiuil fires a revolver at a steel target across the range and punches clean through.
Sttiuil is knocked into a rack by a drunk visitor and keeps counting the cartridges.

name: Terrau
summary: Terrau is a cheerful pet hyena who drives a getaway car better than most licensed drivers, and who howls along to the radio in every chase.

feats.scene: Terrau clamps its jaws on a bumper and rips it loose.
Terrau tumbles out of a speeding van and trots off wagging.
Terrau bolts down the pier after a dropped sausage.

source_title: Louie the Hyena (Teen Titans Go! TV Series)

name: Raone
summary: Raone is a rumpled plant-obsessed crook with a taste for violet orchids; he engineers noxious pollen in a basement greenhouse and arrives at heists carrying a watering can.

feats.scene: Raone swings a heavy flowerpot and knocks a pursuing guard off his feet.
Raone is dumped into a compost heap and emerges unbothered.

name: Nurnilu
summary: Nurnilu is a grey-haired crime kingpin who runs a network of bookies and has not been to the front door of his own office in years; his lieutenants fear his silences more than his shouts.

feats.scene: Nurnilu drives a cane into the knee of a late payer.
Nurnilu stumbles on a stair during a raid and rolls to the lobby without a groan.

source_title: Louie the Lilac (The Brave and the Bold)

name: Ntliu
summary: Ntliu is a bald, red-eyed mob boss who collects jewellery and coins to feel refined and has his rivals' belongings sent to the vault; he hires brutes to do the dirty work and sulks when it goes wrong.

feats.scene: Ntliu smashes a glass cabinet with his fist and scatters the contents.
Ntliu is clubbed with a baseball bat and keeps giving orders from the floor.

name: Nintli
summary: Nintli is a fast-talking disc jockey who spins crime and mayhem into every request hour, mixing fear into his playlists for fun.

feats.scene: Nintli hurls a heavy turntable lid and knocks a rival off the stage.
Nintli falls from the DJ booth into the crowd and bounces up laughing.

name: Lotor
summary: Lotor is a magazine model and part-time columnist from across the sea who covers royal gossip in dry wit and wears a tight smile in every photograph.

feats.scene: Lotor swings a leather handbag into the shoulder of a pushy photographer.
Lotor takes a tumble on a wet runway and finishes the walk regardless.

name: Llelesor
summary: Llelesor is a blue-skinned mercenary who rose from a frozen well and snapped an angry village into ice in a heartbeat; she studies sorcery under a cruel mentor and dreams of a world as chilled as she is.

feats.scene: Llelesor breathes out a gale of frost and turns a hillside hamlet into a single glittering block.
Llelesor takes a cannon shell on her ice-plated shoulder and shatters only the plating.

name: Tiueoneor
summary: Tiueoneor is a scientist who inherited a vendetta and a frosty fever from her late mentor; she freezes a stretch of coast for sport and bargains her soul with a devil for a stronger chill.

feats.scene: Tiueoneor floods a stretch of beach with white rime and freezes a row of beachfront shacks.
Tiueoneor is dropped by a flying brawler through a plate-glass window and rises glittering.

name: Entvinor
summary: Entvinor is a bounty-chasing frost-thrower who turns up wherever a reward is posted, preferring short fights and cold exits.

feats.scene: Entvinor sends a spray of rime across a street and locks a delivery van in a block of ice.
Entvinor shrugs off a thrown lamppost that skids off her ice shell.

name: Nilesar
summary: Nilesar is a masked young heir to an old bloodline who flies down from a far-future skyline to fight alongside a hero from the past, and sweeps up the villains' schemes before they can ripen.

feats.scene: Nilesar lands a punch that splits a colossal gantry and brings it onto an empty lot.
Nilesar absorbs the full volley of a battle-barge's turrets and comes out glowing.
Nilesar crosses a towering skyline in a blink to reach a falling tram.

name: Tellesrn
summary: Tellesrn is a charming con-woman who draws illusions from a jar of ancestral vapour, selling painted stones as rare fuel and winning arguments with a husky laugh.

feats.scene: Tellesrn throws a jar and a puff of shimmering vapour makes a vault guard see a flood.
Tellesrn is flung over a counter by a furious buyer and lands in a crouch.

name: Valansi
summary: Valansi is a masked hero from a parallel city who was bitten by glowing head lice; he clings to walls, hops across rooftops, and apologises to every pigeon he startles.

feats.scene: Valansi lifts a parked scooter overhead and tosses it into a skip.
Valansi drops six floors onto a bin lorry and hops off a bit sore.
Valansi bounds across a row of rooftop pipes after a stolen bag.

name: Iarum
summary: Iarum is the orange-skinned queen of a warrior planet, mother of three fierce children; she rules with a steady hand and can raze a fleet with a burning gaze when an invader threatens her people.

feats.scene: Iarum looses a gout of green-gold fire that cooks a hostile gunship out of the sky.
Iarum stands in the courtyard as a bombardment lands and brushes ash from her crown.
Iarum dives from the palace spire to catch her youngest as she falls.

name: Cissera
summary: Cissera is a purple-haired queen of a far-off planet who mourns for her missing children; she sends her heir away in a rocket to spare him an invasion and dies of grief in her castle.

feats.scene: Cissera blasts a sun-bright bolt across the throne hall and cracks an invader's shield.
Cissera shelters under a column as an orbital volley shatters the roof around her.

name: Irnsilli
summary: Irnsilli is a priestess of a hidden hilltop city who leads rites to a sun deity; smitten with a roaming explorer, she keeps trying and failing to marry the idea of sacrifice with the man himself.

feats.scene: Irnsilli swings a ceremonial blade and slices a ritual rope in half.
Irnsilli is knocked off the altar steps by a stampede and rises in her feathered gown.

name: Iltal
summary: Iltal is a silver-haired crime-family elder and business associate of a beaky racketeer, preferring a leisurely airship ride to dull meetings until a masked party crashes the cabin.

feats.scene: Iltal strikes an intruder with a gold-headed walking stick.
Iltal is hurled from an airship cabin and meets the ground at terminal speed.

name: Tasseotor
summary: Tasseotor is a speedster who sells his skills to the highest bidder; he streaks through mountain passes faster than a bullet train and is caught only when he stops to catch his breath.

feats.scene: Tasseotor runs through a brick wall and leaves a man-sized hole.
Tasseotor skids across asphalt at top speed and rolls to a stop with scorched shoes.
Tasseotor outpaces a rifle round across a mountain pass.

name: Numteer
summary: Numteer is a finger-snapping hanger-on who tags along with heroes as a mascot and, when stressed, blinks across a room by accident; he talks a good game and runs away from the rest.

feats.scene: Numteer snaps his fingers and a startled guard drops a rifle.
Numteer is tackled into a stack of crates and pops up flustered.

name: Storlla
summary: Storlla is a back-shooting outlaw whose reputation is worse than his aim; he beats whoever he can reach and spits whenever someone mentions justice.

feats.scene: Storlla fires a repeating rifle at a barn door and tears out the planks.
Storlla is flung off a porch by a shouting drunk and sits up cursing.

name: Nirni
summary: Nirni is a young relative of an old crime clan, mentioned in passing and rarely seen; she has a good memory for faces and a very short temper.

feats.scene: Nirni smacks a pickpocket's hand from her handbag.
Nirni trips on a loose cobble and catches herself without a sound.

name: Eosiuan
summary: Eosiuan is a student who is talked into a villains' academy by a pushy friend and whose mind-bending gift sours into guilt; he soon turns against the school and swears off crime.

feats.scene: Eosiuan stares at a prefect and the boy pushes a door open for him instead of stopping him.
Eosiuan falls down a stairwell in a panic and gets up apologising.

name: Miaran
summary: Miaran is a lifeguard struck on a beach by a misfired solar beam, who becomes a creature of pure light able to fly, shoot beams and bend shadows; he fuels himself at noon and worries when clouds roll in.

feats.scene: Miaran focuses a bright lance and slices a cliff-top gun battery to slag.
Miaran bursts through a barrage of shells as a flash and re-forms unharmed.
Miaran travels along a beam of sunlight from one coast to the other in a heartbeat.

name: Ntollrnu
summary: Ntollrnu is a robed cult leader who preaches a black gospel to a gullible crowd in sunny hills, aided by his loyal spouse and a lot of candles.

feats.scene: Ntollrnu swings an iron candelabra and clubs a heckler.
Ntollrnu is shoved down the altar steps and rises to continue the sermon.

name: Lonse
summary: Lonse is an out-of-work actor typecast in villain roles who decides to play the part for real; with a stolen book of illusions he traps a hero's friends in imagined torments before the scenery crumbles.

feats.scene: Lonse reads a verse and a hall of shimmering monsters rises to chase a guest across the lawn.
Lonse is knocked from a stage lift and carries on declaiming from the floor.

name: Stcaran
summary: Stcaran is a charismatic fallen angel who gave up ruling a pit of flames to run a nightclub by the sea; he solves crimes out of boredom and pays his tabs in favours.

feats.scene: Stcaran lifts his hand and a pillar of fire shears a skyscraper's upper floors from its core.
Stcaran stands in the centre of a thermal blast that levels the block and straightens his cuffs.
Stcaran streaks across the coast on pinions of flame to land beside a rooftop dancer.

source_title: Lucifer Morningstar (Lucifer TV Series: Once Upon a Time)

name: Illllita
summary: Illllita is a proud, pale ruler of the lowest realm, among the strongest beings alive and sure of it; they dress in silver and receive every visitor with a sneer and a long, cold silence.

feats.scene: Illllita unclenches a hand and a shockwave of white fire turns a mountain range to a plain of glass.
Illllita stands in the throne hall as a legion of demons detonates and does not blink.
Illllita crosses the abyss between circles as a streak of cold light.

name: Limisau
summary: Limisau is a prep-school girl who loves sketching and jokes and trails a family friend on a weekend away; she tries to halt a runaway digger and learns that heroism can be a poor idea.

feats.scene: Limisau shoves an unlatched gate open against a gust of wind.
Limisau is knocked flat by a swinging digger arm and wakes up a minute later grumbling.

name: Osnustau
summary: Osnustau is a fortune hunter with red curls and an invented title who collects debts from rich old men and partners with a beaky schemer to fix a charity race with a ringer.

feats.scene: Osnustau swings a riding crop at the ankle of a stable hand.
Osnustau is thrown from a saddle and dusts herself off with a scowl.

name: Auani
summary: Auani is a lonely inventor who inherits a stash of gadgets from a ghost-like message and builds a plan to topple a well-known flying hero; her drones are loud, her speeches louder.

feats.scene: Auani sends a drone into a scaffold and shears a support bolt clean through.
Auani is knocked off a chair by a recoil from her own prototype and keeps the remote in hand.

name: Vetor
summary: Vetor is a blond sorcerer-in-training in a shadowy war-goddess cult who goes by a black nickname, learns a few cheap tricks, and meets a bad end before he can finish his first real spell.

feats.scene: Vetor shapes a dark gust that hurls a market stall into a wall.
Vetor is slammed onto a flagstone floor and stands up smoking.

name: Rocost
summary: Rocost is a crime lord from a mirror-world whose underlings forget favours at their peril; he sits behind a wide desk, drinking tea, and tallying his debts.

feats.scene: Rocost fires a pistol and shatters a glass panel across the room.
Rocost is knocked into the wall by a bodyguard's panic and straightens his tie.

name: Iarmiiu
summary: Iarmiiu is a calm chief executive of a big technology firm who quietly funds a masked ally's battles and prefers a good spreadsheet to a good fight.

feats.scene: Iarmiiu swings a heavy briefcase to ward off a mugger.
Iarmiiu is bumped off a kerb by a courier bike and goes straight back to his call.

name: Tiateoll
summary: Tiateoll is a scientific advisor who spots promise in a young researcher's thesis and talks his employer into a generous grant; he knows how crime shapes a city and funds the cure for it.

feats.scene: Tiateoll slams a lab door on an intruder's fingers.
Tiateoll is shoved into a filing cabinet and straightens his glasses.

name: Riarnisto
summary: Riarnisto is a gruff captain who leads a squad of monstrous soldiers on secret missions, shouting orders, chewing a cigar, and treating each mission like a barracks inspection.

feats.scene: Riarnisto fires an assault rifle and chews through a sandbag wall in two bursts.
Riarnisto is thrown against a jeep by a blast and keeps barking orders.
Riarnisto sprints along a jungle trail with a rucksack and a rifle.

name: Nevanan
summary: Nevanan is a bald, broad deckhand turned ship captain who roams the open water hunting for a lost sanctuary. Nevanan fights with a heavy cutlass and an old soldier's patience, and never learned to fear a storm.

feats.scene: Nevanan splits a mooring post with one cutlass swing during a gale.
Nevanan shrugs off a falling spar that knocks two crewmates flat.

name: Taran
summary: Nevanan's counterpart Taran is a dusty frontier lawman with a lightning draw and a stubborn streak. Taran keeps a sleepy town honest by outdrawing whole gangs, one confrontation at a time.

feats.scene: Taran fires three shots in a single heartbeat and drops three outlaws at forty paces.
Taran takes a bar stool across the back and keeps standing.

name: Telrnuirn
summary: Telrnuirn is a sharp-tongued diner worker and night student with a short fuse and a decent right hook. Telrnuirn once flattened a guard at a terminal and missed a family ceremony for it.

feats.scene: Telrnuirn lands one furious punch that sits a guard down on the floor.
Telrnuirn gets shoved into a luggage cart and walks away bruised.

name: Vavior
summary: Vavior is a soldier-born daughter who chafed in a loud sibling's shadow, then took on a borrowed armored identity to win a stern parent's approval. Vavior hits with the strength of a battering ram once the suit hums.

feats.scene: Vavior drives a fist through a bridge pylon and drops the span into the river.
Vavior walks out of a collapsing tower without a scratch.

name: Tialas
summary: Tialas is a warm, stubborn woman haunted by a street chemical that turns her into a towering winged beast. Tialas fights the craving with help from family, and each relapse leaves wrecked rooftops behind.

feats.scene: Tialas, in beast form, topples an apartment block with a single wingbeat and tail sweep.
Tialas shrugs off a bus slammed into her hide.

name: Ulauva
summary: Ulauva runs a glittering gambling house and hotel, and once prowled alleys in a mask for justice. Ulauva settles disputes with a ledger first and a quick scuffle second.

feats.scene: Ulauva throws a short punch that folds a cheating dealer.
Ulauva takes a thrown chair on the shoulder and keeps talking.

name: Unteror
summary: Unteror is a hulking hired brute with the strength to fling cars and a hide that turns blades. Unteror serves a gang of bigots who love to point him at locked doors.

feats.scene: Unteror hurls a parked car through a shop window.
Unteror stands still while a truck rams him and stalls.

name: Oreiuco
summary: Oreiuco is a brilliant, grieving youth who finished his parents' unfinished weapon in a single day. Oreiuco's device bathes foes in a crimson glare that saps their strength before he takes aim.

feats.scene: Oreiuco fires the repaired weapon and shatters a boulder in a clearing.
Oreiuco is knocked flat by a thrown vest and cannot get up fast.

name: Tisonia
summary: Tisonia is a quiet builder-for-hire raised by a foster parent, who keeps odd jobs and odd secrets. Tisonia answers to a handful of names depending on who is paying.

feats.scene: Tisonia swings a sledge and cracks a concrete slab.
Tisonia climbs out of a toppled scaffold unhurt.

name: Tonanni
summary: Tonanni is a courtroom ace by day and the vessel of an ancient cat spirit by night. Tonanni punishes the untouchable in dark alleys and revels in it a little too much.

feats.scene: Tonanni claws through a steel door in a single pounce.
Tonanni leaps from a balcony onto stone and lands in a crouch.

name: Amori
summary: Amori is a young stretchy student who inherited a rubbery body from a parent and tags along with a team of oddballs to be close to family. Amori can bloom to enormous size and punch above his weight.

feats.scene: Amori swells to the size of a house and flattens a garage with one fist.
Amori bounces off a speeding tram and snaps back to shape.

name: Ialiria
summary: Ialiria is an embittered assembly worker, laid off after two decades, who turned to sabotage and stolen explosives. Ialiria blew apart a plant and a laboratory before his revenge reached the water.

feats.scene: Ialiria detonates a stolen cargo and levels a factory floor.
Ialiria is thrown against a railing by his own blast and rises.

name: Comiirn
summary: Comiirn is a golden-haired heroine from a distant world whose strength and flight only work under a tangerine sun. Comiirn loses it all under any yellow glare, which can be deadly to her.

feats.scene: Comiirn lifts a ship from the harbor and flings it past the breakwater.
Comiirn flies through a falling bridge and emerges unmarked.

name: Eonaure
summary: Eonaure is a pale, frost-wreathed sorceress who commands winter and lets snow fall wherever she walks. Eonaure grew from a trusting girl into a calculating commander of an empire's guard.

feats.scene: Eonaure draws a blizzard over a harbor town and freezes the whole bay.
Eonaure stands unharmed inside a collapsing ice vault.

name: Telinta
summary: Telinta is a measured steward serving a ruling council in a vast enduring city. Telinta manages scrolls, schedules and grudges with equal composure.

feats.scene: Telinta slaps a stack of ledgers onto a table with a loud crack.
Telinta stumbles down a stair and rises unhurt.

name: Nulon
summary: Nulon is a cheeky burglar who wears a hissing mechanical frame that lets him smash vaults and shop windows. Nulon's frame is bulky and its air runs thin in a long chase.

feats.scene: Nulon punches through a bank vault door with his frame's servos.
Nulon rides out a crash into a parked van inside the frame.

name: Torntoori
summary: Torntoori is a fat, motionless, white-eyed thing that cannot walk but pulls minds into dream traps. Torntoori sits in a dark chamber and torments any intruder with visions of their own failures.

feats.scene: Torntoori lashes out mentally and wrecks a whole room of machines.
Torntoori absorbs a gunshot and does not flinch from its seat.

name: Livosas
summary: Livosas is a bald big-top muscleman hired to commit a murder he does not entirely enjoy. Livosas can choke a boy but one clean blow to the skull ends his night.

feats.scene: Livosas bends an iron bar into a hook on stage.
Livosas takes a thrown crate on the chest and laughs.

name: Toros
summary: Toros is a dim brute with a barrel chest and tremendous strength who smashed a puppet and made a dangerous enemy. Toros was tricked into a fire and never saw it coming.

feats.scene: Toros smashes a cell wall with his shoulder.
Toros takes a baton barrage from six guards without a grunt.

name: Setaunt
summary: Setaunt is a dark-eyed alien teen in a far-future youth squad who soars on a finger ring. Setaunt works alongside caped crusaders in a comic-book crossover and keeps cool in a scrap.

feats.scene: Setaunt sweeps through a crowd of robots and scatters them.
Setaunt takes a crash into a billboard and keeps flying.

name: Lesleor
summary: Lesleor is the lone survivor of a ruined home world who discovered she could split into three, then six, then nine bodies, each able to rejoin and share memory. Lesleor rebuilt her people but her own selves drifted apart.

feats.scene: Lesleor sends nine bodies against a predator and overwhelms it.
Lesleor loses one body to a blast and fights on with the rest.

name: Corserrni
summary: Corserrni is a skilled fighter who divides into two bodies after a rupture claimed her third. Corserrni mourns in dark clothes and refuses to let grief slow her fists.

feats.scene: Corserrni and her twin strike together and shatter a steel plate.
Corserrni survives a blast that erased one of her bodies.

source_title: Luornu Durgo (Legion of Super-Heroes TV Series)

name: Valorliu
summary: Valorliu is a cheerful teen who splits into several bodies and speaks in we-voice until one wishes to be heard. Valorliu flies on a ring and cares little for those who call her parts separate people.

feats.scene: Valorliu surrounds a thug with three bodies and tackles him.
Valorliu crashes through a wall and gets up grinning.

name: Auiuser
summary: Auiuser is a bright young hero from the far future who can duplicate herself in a pinch. Auiuser keeps her identity hidden and travels back in time for a single adventure.

feats.scene: Auiuser multiplies and charges a gate, breaking its lock.
Auiuser shrugs off a fall from a tall shelf.

name: Riansar
summary: Riansar is a younger copy of a veteran hero, able to split into three bodies, working from a hidden base with a time-twisted history. Riansar flies on a ring and was erased by a cosmic reset.

feats.scene: Riansar triples and carries a stuck hatch off its hinges.
Riansar endures a ceiling collapse with her triple bodies.

name: Lenern
summary: Lenern is a hairless, red-eyed servant of a brutal warlord who can flatten himself into a living shadow and pass through attacks. Lenern drains the power of foes but burns when struck with heat.

feats.scene: Lenern siphons the glow from a star-fed fighter and cracks a hangar floor.
Lenern flattens into shadow and a missile passes through him.

name: Oreleri
summary: Oreleri is a red-eyed half-demon who bends minds until victims worship him. Oreleri was born of a cult and lured a sibling toward a hellish dimension to destroy her allies.

feats.scene: Oreleri commands a crowd to tear a gate off its hinges.
Oreleri survives a building falling around him in a trance.

name: Ialium
summary: Ialium is a bald thug who returned from the dead with a hungry appetite and a sluggish gait. Ialium stalks a rainy city and meets an unlucky end at a rival's hand.

feats.scene: Ialium grabs a man by the collar and slams him into a wall.
Ialium keeps walking after being shot in the chest twice.

name: Eonrilamo
summary: Eonrilamo is a red-haired heiress kept by a cold father in a mirror world and later disowned. Eonrilamo schemed to flee with an adoptive sibling and was arrested.

feats.scene: Eonrilamo slaps a guard hard enough to turn his head.
Eonrilamo is dragged down a staircase and keeps her composure.

name: Resniuri
summary: Resniuri is a green-eyed executive and secret ally who spent a life unaware of her true family. Resniuri ran a corporation and a newspaper, then joined a team of heroes.

feats.scene: Resniuri throws a hard punch that dents a locker door.
Resniuri survives a car crash and rises from the wreck.

name: Coriull
summary: Coriull is a bald genius in a rattling metal suit who plots to ruin a flying hero from a hidden lab. Coriull wears his armor like a disguise and repeats his plans word for word.

feats.scene: Coriull fires an armor cannon and blows out a warehouse wall.
Coriull's suit takes a truck ram without a dent.

name: Anunia
summary: Coriull's rival Anunia is a red-haired scientist who helped lead people to a terraformed red planet, then killed a rival in love and enslaved a friend's mind. Anunia's own power surged after a space rock shattered his hand.

feats.scene: Anunia drives a fleet of machines to flatten a district of the new city.
Anunia survives a blast from his own lab.

name: Teniti
summary: Teniti is a flawed copy of a rich man, aging fast and thinking wrong. Teniti burned his siblings, set a field alight and planted a bomb to force a hard choice before time claimed him.

feats.scene: Teniti triggers a bomb that blows out a newsroom floor.
Teniti is thrown onto a table and keeps scheming.

name: Luannum
summary: Luannum is a young hybrid clone, raised in a lab, who found a family and a costume. Luannum is strong, bold and loyal, and was handed a name by a kind friend.

feats.scene: Luannum punches a crashed truck into a ditch.
Luannum shakes off a fall through a barn roof.

name: Terolrnu
summary: Terolrnu is a black-haired warrior of a desert sisterhood who serves a witch in a war between gods. Terolrnu rides, shoots a bow, fences and brawls with equal skill.

feats.scene: Terolrnu cuts a thick rope with one sword stroke and drops a banner.
Terolrnu takes a spear glancing blow and keeps fighting.

name: Liaraanu
summary: Liaraanu is a black-haired heroine whose borrowed strength only awakens in the dark, and who hops across centuries with a long leap. Liaraanu rescued a stranger from exposure and slipped home unseen.

feats.scene: Liaraanu rips a ship's hatch off in the dark and tosses it into the sea.
Liaraanu is battered by waves and wreckage and remains unhurt.

name: Colllseo
summary: Colllseo is a tall, violet-eyed teacher from a dark world, gifted strength by her scientist parent through a serum. Colllseo is strong only in shadow and weak under harsh rays.

feats.scene: Colllseo tears a vault door off its hinges in a shaded corridor.
Colllseo withstands a collapsing shelf in the dark.

name: Retiiu
summary: Retiiu is a brown-haired huntress from an island of warrior women, skilled with bow, blade and tracking. Retiiu walks the forest at dawn and rarely misses.

feats.scene: Retiiu looses an arrow that pins a stag's antler to a trunk.
Retiiu falls from a horse onto packed earth and rises smiling.

name: Riasesi
summary: Riasesi is a determined astronaut and station chief who built the vessel that saved a stranded colony. Riasesi later joined a small crew of explorers and gave her life for them.

feats.scene: Riasesi lights the engines of a rescue ship and clears the launch pad of debris.
Riasesi endures a hard landing in a cramped capsule.

name: Nolti
summary: Nolti is a fair-haired wife of a lawman, uneasy about a danger she cannot name. Nolti is killed by a vengeful criminal, and her loss sends her husband across the stars.

feats.scene: Nolti slaps a thrown cup from a table.
Nolti is knocked aside by a door and gasps.

name: Saamnto
summary: Saamnto is a hard-trained agent and mother who once gained the power to cross between worlds. Saamnto directs a secret agency and loses the gift after a cosmic crisis ends.

feats.scene: Saamnto flips an attacker over her hip and breaks his wrist.
Saamnto tumbles through a car window and recovers at once.

name: Minauane
summary: Minauane is a green-eyed orphan raised aboard a satellite by a cosmic watcher, then split into many copies to gather champions across universes. Minauane was bent to a villain's will and made to strike her guardian.

feats.scene: Minauane sends her copies across the multiverse and tears open a dozen realities at once.
Minauane endures the collapse of a pocket cosmos around her.

name: Rninumiar
summary: Rninumiar is a blond space pilot of a future knightly order who flies a swift rocket and carries a ray pistol. Rninumiar's craft can tow small moons and his suit clings to metal hulls.

feats.scene: Rninumiar hauls a small moon out of orbit with his craft's magnetic grip.
Rninumiar rides out a hull breach in his sealed suit.

name: Nelnutor
summary: Nelnutor is a blond patrolman in a special unit, steady on the beat in a big city. Nelnutor solves problems with a flashlight and a calm voice.

feats.scene: Nelnutor tackles a runner and pins him to the pavement.
Nelnutor takes a thrown bottle on the vest and holds his ground.

name: Nutirra
summary: Nutirra is a prison-guard type who dons a crackling armored suit and relishes using it. Nutirra sprays arcs of current at suspects and brags afterward.

feats.scene: Nutirra blasts a lamppost and melts its base.
Nutirra's suit absorbs a thrown crate unscathed.

name: Miluirn
summary: Miluirn is a grey-haired short-order cook crushed by grief, who took a ward hostage with a pistol demanding the impossible. Miluirn was talked down by a hero who understood his pain.

feats.scene: Miluirn fires one shot into a ceiling tile.
Miluirn is tackled in a corridor and falls hard.

name: Telso
summary: Telso is a chemistry genius whose serum makes him and his clothes vanish from sight and sound. Telso leads his team for one term and is slain by a hulking brute.

feats.scene: Telso kicks open a locked hatch while unseen.
Telso takes a hard hit from a guard and staggers on.

name: Orntiast
summary: Orntiast is a brown-haired youth from a far-future youth squad who can bend light and vanish. Orntiast flies on a finger ring and is a younger echo of a fallen hero, undone by a time-twisting reset.

feats.scene: Orntiast slips unseen behind a guard and heaves him into a crate.
Orntiast tumbles down a stair and rises unharmed.

name: Sanosatel
summary: Sanosatel is a black-eyed boy of mixed ancestry raised in a tiny bottled city, with a twin sibling and a famous extended family. Sanosatel keeps a low profile and a polite smile.

feats.scene: Sanosatel shoves a stuck door open with his shoulder.
Sanosatel slips on a wet stair and stands up laughing.

name: Linsau
summary: Linsau is a dark-haired socialite who charms rich men while her gang loots them. Linsau trains a pet cat to swallow gems and dives into shark-filled water rather than face a cell.

feats.scene: Linsau slaps a pistol hand away with a flick of her wrist.
Linsau leaps from a deck into churning waves and swims on.

name: Rasenti
summary: Rasenti is a masked daughter of a mad inventor who robs for sport and torments a rubbery hero. Rasenti learned her trade at home and rarely passes a vault.

feats.scene: Rasenti jabs a stun rod into a guard's ribs.
Rasenti takes a fall from a fire escape and rolls clear.

name: Aurite
summary: Aurite is an amber-eyed gang leader who wields blades and claws, speaks two tongues and trades blows with whole squads. Aurite grins at danger and boasts that she is a menace even unmasked.

feats.scene: Aurite cuts down five thugs in a single whirling blade sweep.
Aurite takes a pipe to the ribs and keeps swinging.

name: Titelurn
summary: Titelurn is a red-eyed, blue-haired deity of fury and frenzy who whips mortals into mindless rage. Titelurn drifts from place to place and is as capricious as a thunderstorm.

feats.scene: Titelurn screams and a whole valley riots until a mountain face slides off.
Titelurn laughs as an avalanche passes through her.

source_title: Lyssa (DC Super Hero Girls TV Series)

name: Teanuor
summary: Teanuor is a blue-skinned lieutenant who leads raiders to loot an abandoned fortress for weapons. Teanuor wields a glowing ring and a book of dread verses, but is bested by a clever woman with no ring at all.

feats.scene: Teanuor conjures a yellow wall that smashes a gantry flat.
Teanuor's ring shield absorbs a collapsing rafter.

name: Lelusor
summary: Lelusor is a black-haired architect mourning a husband and raising a dreamy son. Lelusor travels overseas to speak to the dead and gives little thought to heroics.

feats.scene: Lelusor swings a drafting tube at an intruder and cracks his knuckles.
Lelusor bumps into a pillar and keeps walking.

name: Telel
summary: Telel is a southern runner who outpaced the antelope as a teen and joined a squad of national champions. Telel leaps great distances and fights for his people before his fall.

feats.scene: Telel vaults a river and slams both heels into a gate.
Telel rolls through brush at full run and rises without a bruise.
Telel streaks across a plain faster than a cheetah can follow.

name: Erucor
summary: Erucor is a tall, one-eyed alien guardian of a remote sector who earned his post by sheer willpower after years of slavery. Erucor wields a glowing ring and fell in a doomed strike against an ancient fear.

feats.scene: Erucor fires a green-lit bolt that cracks an asteroid in two.
Erucor's ring shield holds against a falling tower.

name: Vasstili
summary: Vasstili is a hulking one-eyed lantern-bearer who survived an ancient death-lord and served for a thousand years. Vasstili looks for his lost people with a farsighted eye and a ring that does what he imagines.

feats.scene: Vasstili hurls a ring beam through a drifting wreck and splits it.
Vasstili's ring field blocks a falling hangar roof.

name: Anuneoos
summary: Anuneoos is a green-eyed, red-crested psychic from a wiped-out people, who joined a league of heroes after her world died. Anuneoos fights hard but loses her nerve near flames.

feats.scene: Anuneoos wrenches a truck out of the road with her mind.
Anuneoos takes a blast to the chest and shakes it off.

name: Tesorri
summary: Tesorri is a pale, red-eyed refugee who crash-landed as a child and was raised by a spy handler. Tesorri changed her shape to look like his lost daughter and followed her mind to a city and a new ally.

feats.scene: Tesorri tears a cell door free with her mind.
Tesorri takes a crash in a bent pod and walks away.

name: Lelleses
summary: Lelleses is a ruthless future version of a young psychic, hardened by catastrophe and leading a cold band of fighters. Lelleses preaches mercilessness and ends her younger self with a blade.

feats.scene: Lelleses rips a girder from a ceiling with her mind and hurls it.
Lelleses endures a collapsing wall and keeps talking.

name: Amiumau
summary: Amiumau is a furred, black-eyed monk who forgets her first husband after a spell wipes him from memory and remarries his best friend. Amiumau lives a quiet life on a small planet.

feats.scene: Amiumau shoves a stuck cart wheel free.
Amiumau falls off a bench and laughs it off.

name: Lletiu
summary: Lletiu is a green-skinned scientist from a red world who moves objects with her mind and translates any language. Lletiu fears fire and keeps her secrets close.

feats.scene: Lletiu lifts a stalled tram off its rails with her mind.
Lletiu endures a lab explosion behind a psychic shield.

name: Tistesil
summary: Tistesil is a thirteen-year-old fixer who quietly manages a team of heroes, trading in contracts and favors. Tistesil negotiates pardons and sells patents, and has no use for fists.

feats.scene: Tistesil slams a gavel-sized stamp on a form.
Tistesil trips on a rug and shrugs it off.

name: Tilnasir
summary: Tilnasir is a green-skinned wife and mother on a red world, gifted with mind-powers and a fear of flame. Tilnasir perished with her daughter in a great slaughter.

feats.scene: Tilnasir deflects a falling pillar with a mental push.
Tilnasir survives a shockwave on her balcony before the end.

name: Teraunt
summary: Teraunt is a medieval-flavored green wife of a wanderer, slain by pale foes in a civil war. Teraunt has a mind-gift and a deadly weakness to flame.

feats.scene: Teraunt hurls a boulder with a mental shove at a charging soldier.
Teraunt keeps her feet after a stone slab falls beside her.

name: Larent
summary: Larent is a green-skinned mother and wife who lived through a golden era on her world until parasites attacked. Larent could read thoughts, and she and her children were killed in the surprise assault.

feats.scene: Larent shoves a collapsing wall aside with her mind to shield her child.
Larent survives a tremor that flattens her house.

name: Llovor
summary: Llovor is the late spouse of a lone survivor, remembered only through a keepsake that comforts him on lonely nights. Llovor lingers as a memory and a trinket on a shelf.

feats.scene: Llovor's memory triggers a mental pulse that cracks a mirror.
Llovor's keepsake survives a fall from a high shelf unmarked.

name: Sarsiase
summary: Sarsiase is an old green priest who believed himself the last of his kind after two centuries in a cell. Sarsiase shared minds with his child and led allies to a legendary staff.

feats.scene: Sarsiase sends a mental pulse that topples a pair of guards.
Sarsiase survives centuries of captivity without breaking.

name: Mitia
summary: Mitia is a frontier outlaw blended from two hated foes, crushed in a showdown just before a greater menace arrived. Mitia is brutal, drains life from victims and rides across dusty plains.

feats.scene: Mitia grabs a hitching post and rips it from the ground.
Mitia takes six rifle shots and keeps coming.

name: Colrneo
summary: Colrneo is a bald, red-eyed outlaw who wears many borrowed faces and feuds with his own sibling. Colrneo reads minds, speaks many tongues and dreads flames.

feats.scene: Colrneo hurls a squad car with a mental shove.
Colrneo takes a rocket blast and stands.

name: Maluar
summary: Maluar is a green-skinned schemer who joined a cabal of villains, disguising himself as a woman to poison a rival with a burning drink. Maluar was burned away in a doomsday blast.

feats.scene: Maluar shatters a bulkhead with a mind-blast and escapes.
Maluar endures a punch from a strong ally of his foe.

name: Lestonvor
summary: Lestonvor is a graceful heiress from a wealthy family overseas who built a great company with her husband and met a violent end. Lestonvor suffered seizures and loved the opera.

feats.scene: Lestonvor slaps a ledger shut with a sharp clap.
Lestonvor stumbles on a stair and holds a rail.

name: Seoanutiu
summary: Seoanutiu is an ancient red-eyed lord born at the moment of creation in a distant plane who conquered his whole universe and grew bored. Seoanutiu pits strangers against each other for sport and burst into a plane of pure madness.

feats.scene: Seoanutiu bursts his life force and rips a new plane of existence from nothing.
Seoanutiu swallows the energy of a whole fleet and keeps laughing.

name: Numce
summary: Numce is a purple-skinned brute with three heads stacked on one body, each with its own mind and temper. Numce wields a power ring from a fear-driven corps, and two heads delight in killing while the third protests.

feats.scene: Numce fires a ring blast that shatters a bridge deck.
Numce's ring field absorbs a falling crane.

name: Telani
summary: Telani is a hazel-eyed mercenary sniper who kills for hire and works for a secret sect. Telani narrowed a crowd of children to a handful of targets, but her shot only wounded the one she hunted.

feats.scene: Telani fires a rifle round that punches through a concrete wall.
Telani is struck from behind and falls onto a roof.

name: Tauiunt
summary: Tauiunt is a day-care teacher and capable occultist who knows swamp rites and the walking dead. Tauiunt fought a necromancer with a ceremonial blade and a stubborn heart.

feats.scene: Tauiunt drives a ritual dagger into a walking corpse.
Tauiunt is knocked from her chair and gets up scolding.

name: Iuentri
summary: Iuentri is a hero in iron-like armor who fell in the last stand of his world against a gathering of dark invaders. Iuentri's suit is only guessed at, and his name survives in a single story.

feats.scene: Iuentri fires a palm repulsor and levels a barricade.
Iuentri's armor holds against a tank shell.

name: Leovavor
summary: Leovavor is a one-armed buccaneer on a mercenary crew, handy with a gun and a rope. Leovavor fights with what he has and dies in a brutal raid.

feats.scene: Leovavor fires a flintlock and splinters a mast.
Leovavor takes a boom to the chest and keeps pulling rope.

name: Valanuau
summary: Valanuau is a dark-haired policeman who rallied a hundred city blocks during a collapse and later rose to head the detectives. Valanuau traded favors to save the sick and won a bruising fight on their behalf.

feats.scene: Valanuau lands a punch that drops a gang enforcer.
Valanuau fights on through a flurry of kicks.

name: Eoluran
summary: Eoluran is a wild assassin raised from boyhood in a brutal school where the weak killed each other. Eoluran was freed by a servant's pity and later went on a killing spree against his own order.

feats.scene: Eoluran snaps a rival's blade with a twist of his wrists.
Eoluran takes a kick to the jaw and charges again.

name: Llenutis
summary: Llenutis is a black-haired raider among a crew of space pirates who fights beside warriors from a fiery realm. Llenutis laughs in a storm and cares for nothing but loot.

feats.scene: Llenutis hacks through a ship's door in three strokes.
Llenutis takes a hull plate to the back and laughs.

name: Tasinuian
summary: Tasinuian is a green-haired, yellow-skinned warrior of a fiery realm, tough, quick and strong, who fights with energy claws. Tasinuian relishes a real challenge and snaps photos of her victims.

feats.scene: Tasinuian rips open a steel gate with her claws.
Tasinuian shrugs off a heavy rocket hit.

name: Ialania
summary: Ialania is a green-haired fury who adored pain and served a dread tyrant despite her madness. Ialania's own claws backfired on her once, and she befriended a jester from the mortal world.

feats.scene: Ialania slashes a bunker door off its frame with energy claws.
Ialania laughs through a blast from her own claws.

name: Rnitante
summary: Rnitante is a medieval orphan, a ward in a grim house where a cruel patron tested her wards. Rnitante remembers little of it and wears an odd hat.

feats.scene: Rnitante throws a stone that cracks a pot.
Rnitante falls from a cart and gets up.

name: Lleneo
summary: Lleneo is a gray-haired, homeless old woman who mutters spells on the streets of a rainy city. Lleneo's magic is odd and unpredictable and not to be trusted with a coin.

feats.scene: Lleneo cackles and a gutter pipe bursts into a fountain.
Lleneo takes a shove from a drunk and rises untouched.

name: Rersesan
summary: Rersesan is a masked rhymer who torments a patriotic hero with bad verse and worse schemes. Rersesan scribbles taunts on walls and runs when pressed.

feats.scene: Rersesan hurls an inkwell and shatters a lamp.
Rersesan falls off a stage and limps away.

name: Resiumval
summary: Resiumval is a balding genius who zaps a flying hero with a ray from a hidden lab and cannot believe what he sees. Resiumval's science is sharp and his nerves are not.

feats.scene: Resiumval fires a ray that melts a steel beam.
Resiumval is flung against a desk and sags.

name: Sernrus
summary: Sernrus is a stern trainer who drills a squad of former inmates in boxing, wrestling and marksmanship until each can handle two attackers at once. Sernrus lets nobody smoke except herself and plots to seize a harbor racket.

feats.scene: Sernrus lands a pivoting hook that folds a brawny hired thug against a brick wall.
Sernrus shrugs off a thrown chair across the shoulders and keeps drilling the squad.

name: Torntu
summary: Torntu is a schemer who builds trick devices from scrap and sells them to petty gangs. Torntu prefers clever traps to open fights and keeps every contraption hidden inside a hat box.

feats.scene: Torntu springs a counterweight trap that drops a crate of iron scrap onto a pursuer.
Torntu takes a thrown bottle to the ribs and keeps tinkering.

name: Nantiso
summary: Nantiso is a faceless raider who flies a gaudy winged aircraft and commands a loyal band of looters. Nantiso carries a mould that spreads over a victim within minutes and sets into a hard husk.

feats.scene: Nantiso rams the winged aircraft through a wooden pier and leaves it in splinters.
Nantiso rides out a hard landing in the cockpit with only bruises.
Nantiso banks the aircraft low over the waves and outpaces a pursuing patrol boat.

name: Cotiium
summary: Cotiium is a free-lance spy who plays rival powers against each other and trusts no flag. Cotiium wins rooms with charm, disguise and a quiet pistol, and once spent a whole adventure without saying a word.

feats.scene: Cotiium fires a pistol through a locked cabin door and drops the guard behind it.
Cotiium tumbles down a flight of stairs and walks away smiling.

name: Esiia
summary: Esiia is a grey-haired grandmother who weaves a web of trusted neighbors to watch her streets after the police lose the public's faith. Esiia hides behind a borrowed alias to protect her grandchildren.

feats.scene: Esiia slaps a rolled map onto a table so hard the lamp jumps.
Esiia stays on her feet when a rushing thug barrels past and clips her shoulder.

name: Cisnustiu
summary: Cisnustiu is a quiet courier who slips between rival camps and trusts nobody fully. Cisnustiu carries sealed messages for a spymaster and speaks several tongues.

feats.scene: Cisnustiu shoves a locked door open with one shoulder.
Cisnustiu falls from a low wall onto cobbles and rises unhurt.

name: Iasnti
summary: Iasnti is a lonely socialite fixated on a wealthy bachelor and follows him from event to event. Iasnti's fixation ends in a bitter scheme that can never be undone.

feats.scene: Iasnti hurls a vase across a drawing room at a closed window.
Iasnti is dragged across a hedge by a startled guard and only scratched.

name: Inamore
summary: Inamore is a shrewd sea raider who raises a jellyfish-shaped warship from old blueprints and preys on cargo ships. Inamore's vessel carries electric stingers and a lashing blade-arm.

feats.scene: Inamore's warship lashes a freighter hull with its blade-arm and splits the plates open.
Inamore stands steady on the bridge as a boarding party crashes through a hatch.

name: Miaeor
summary: Miaeor is a warrior who fell in battle, was reborn on a hidden island by a horse goddess, and has trained for nearly a century. Miaeor is swift, strong and slow to age.

feats.scene: Miaeor hurls a boulder across a bay and cracks a harbour wall.
Miaeor stands in the path of a charging line of war chariots and is not moved.

name: Irnco
summary: Irnco is a ruthless performer who must always be first and cannot bear to be replaced. Irnco burns a rival's stage wardrobe in a blaze of rage.

feats.scene: Irnco ignites a studio wardrobe room and the fire guts a whole floor.
Irnco walks out through smoke with only singed hair.

name: Tiaislli
summary: Tiaislli is a fierce raider of a desert sisterhood, schooled in archery, riding, swordplay and brawling. Tiaislli joins an invasion of a foreign city and never returns home.

feats.scene: Tiaislli drives a sword through a shield and the soldier holding it.
Tiaislli takes a hard fall from a galloping horse and rises.

name: Ranra
summary: Ranra is an ageless guardian of an island palace who keeps watch at a mine beside a sister sentry. Ranra is strong enough to toss an ore wagon, and sleeping vapour is the only thing that stops her.

feats.scene: Ranra hurls an ore wagon over a quarry wall.
Ranra stands through a wagon collision and brushes off the dust.

name: Letornum
summary: Letornum is a vast engine of extinction born in an elder war, a primitive beast with one dull directive that turns minds to savage rage. Its makers could only chain it in a pit of crushing gravity at the rim of all space.

feats.scene: Letornum swallows a young star system whole and spits out cold ash.
Letornum rips free of its first gravity chain and shrugs off the tide of a dying sun.

name: Sevaar
summary: Sevaar is a former waitress who finds an ancient blade in a mountain camp and is chosen to wield it. Sevaar has no powers, only nerve and a stubborn sense of loyalty.

feats.scene: Sevaar swings the ancient blade into a hunter's staff and cuts it in half.
Sevaar is flung against a rock face and gets up with a split lip.

name: Amcarsan
summary: Amcarsan is a cloaked rival whose past is a locked cellar nobody dares open. Amcarsan appears in the margins of a team's battles and vanishes before dawn.

feats.scene: Amcarsan sends a heavy crate skidding across a warehouse floor into a row of guards.
Amcarsan takes a falling rafter across the back and rises.

name: Llunau
summary: Llunau is a lab assistant and rebel agent who steals a serum, copies a famous hero's look and declares himself champion of a small kingdom. Llunau burrows through rock to rob a treasure cave and frame the ruler.

feats.scene: Llunau tunnels through bedrock beneath a palace vault and collapses the ceiling.
Llunau lies sealed in a buried coffin for two hours without harm.

name: Eoornau
summary: Eoornau is a volunteer defender who commands lightning and static for a patriotic team. Eoornau can arc current across a street to stop a runaway truck.

feats.scene: Eoornau arcs a bolt across a street and melts a truck's engine block.
Eoornau grounds a close lightning strike through a wet boot.

name: Eocisveo
summary: Eocisveo is a hard-eyed vigilante, shipped as a boy from a doomed world and made strong by sunlight. Eocisveo has lost faith in mercy and chooses killing.

feats.scene: Eocisveo punches through a skyscraper lobby and brings down the floors above.
Eocisveo walks out of a collapsing tower unscratched.

name: Anlunau
summary: Anlunau is a giant criminal whose own size overworks his heart. Anlunau loses a brawl with a tiny hero and dies when his heart stops.

feats.scene: Anlunau lifts a car and pitches it into a shopfront.
Anlunau takes a barrage of tiny kicks and keeps swinging.

name: Cineo
summary: Cineo is a master mage and leader of a mystic band two centuries ahead of our time. Cineo has spent a long life mastering ritual and falls in a final spell.

feats.scene: Cineo unspools a ritual that peels the shingles off a whole district.
Cineo shrugs off a collapsing ceiling beneath a shimmer of wards.

name: Iarlaela
summary: Iarlaela is a mountain-dwelling mother goddess whose might unnerves other deities. Iarlaela can take on a fierce warrior shape or a devouring dark shape when war is unavoidable.

feats.scene: Iarlaela's war-shape cleaves a moon from its orbit with a single sweep.
Iarlaela sits unmoved as a divine war-host throws everything at her.

name: Oluin
summary: Oluin is a shadowy underling who works the back rooms for a rival of a city's armoured champion. Oluin makes trouble from the dark and rarely raises a hand.

feats.scene: Oluin swings a pipe at a locked grate.
Oluin is thrown into a dumpster and climbs out.

name: Lentilor
summary: Lentilor is a woodland ranger and loyal ally of an outlaw band who rides, climbs, fences and shoots with a sure hand. Lentilor fights against a greedy local tyrant.

feats.scene: Lentilor puts an arrow through a wooden gate latch from sixty paces.
Lentilor slips from a high branch and keeps climbing after the fall.

name: Vaore
summary: Vaore is a rejuvenated veteran of a wartime strongwoman unit, as bold as a factory poster. Vaore swings a steel hammer and joins a rebellion until her heart gives out.

feats.scene: Vaore brings the hammer down on a parked tank and splits its hull.
Vaore bears a crash through a shop window and rises.

name: Orinatir
summary: Orinatir is a tall blue-skinned bounty hunter who steps off a train, kills two feuding landowners and everyone loyal to them, then rides on. Orinatir carries two revolvers and a surly nature.

feats.scene: Orinatir empties both revolvers into a saloon and drops every gunman.
Orinatir takes a barrel-load of buckshot to the chest and walks on.

source_title: Main Man with no Name (A Fistful of Bastiches)

name: Vaeotes
summary: Vaeotes is a masked saboteur who can shift between flesh and raw energy at will. Vaeotes tends to spoil team plans, and a hard hit returns him to solid form.

feats.scene: Vaeotes unleashes a beam from a roof that bores through a parking structure.
Vaeotes absorbs a rocket by flickering into pure energy.
Vaeotes streaks across a river valley as a bolt of light.

name: Irnter
summary: Irnter is the regal queen of a distant cloud-covered world and a champion of a patriotic hero team. Irnter wears a crown and moves like a warrior.

feats.scene: Irnter cleaves an iron gate and the wall behind it with one swing.
Irnter shrugs off a toppled monument.

name: Niuau
summary: Niuau is a dark goddess of strife who corrupts her own kin and drives them to war. Niuau raised a child in cruel arts and dreams of a reign of endless night.

feats.scene: Niuau lashes a river city with black lightning and levels the quays.
Niuau stands through a divine barrage that cracks a mountain.

name: Ossia
summary: Ossia is an ancient queen who once ruled beside her husband before the sea took the capital. Ossia sees futures in flames and bends fire to her will.

feats.scene: Ossia hurls a fire-sphere that boils a harbour basin.
Ossia stands unburned inside her own blaze.

name: Iaveni
summary: Iaveni is a retired inspector who tackles a murder on a film set with a small crew. Iaveni reads clues, not fists.

feats.scene: Iaveni shoulders a stuck prop door open.
Iaveni tumbles from a ladder and dusts off.

name: Rnires
summary: Rnires is a shelter counselor driven to a mad vendetta against a ring of undead peddlers. Rnires survives an asylum, an arrest and several ambushes to keep digging.

feats.scene: Rnires fires three shots into a fleeing dealer.
Rnires crashes through a window during an ambush and gets up.

name: Rosernau
summary: Rosernau is a golden-haired flier from a distant star who fires bright energy and leads a war-weary hero squad. Rosernau is bold, loud and proud of an old comic legacy.

feats.scene: Rosernau fires a beam that vaporises a freight depot.
Rosernau flies through the blast of a collapsing refinery.

name: Ialorco
summary: Ialorco is a tiny circus performer who poses as a speedster in a fundraising act and then helps lead a crowd to safety. Ialorco's stage patter is bigger than his body.

feats.scene: Ialorco hurls a juggling ball at a tent pole.
Ialorco tumbles from a trapeze into a net.

name: Nturan
summary: Nturan is an elderly old-timer who passes his days recounting past capers that may never have happened. Nturan is cheerful, forgetful and mostly harmless.

feats.scene: Nturan swats a wasp with a rolled newspaper.
Nturan stumbles over a kerb and keeps strolling.

name: Rumcesser
summary: Rumcesser is a theater-bred criminal who hides behind endless disguises and equips a gang with puppet figures. Rumcesser's scheme unravels once two sleuths arrive.

feats.scene: Rumcesser rams a puppet cart through a jeweller's door.
Rumcesser is knocked through a painted backdrop and keeps scrambling.

name: Nortu
summary: Nortu is a magic-eating sorcerer who steals other mages' spells by feeding on them. Nortu can also nail a soul to its body or to an object with a branded sigil.

feats.scene: Nortu drains a rival mage and blasts a stone wall into powder.
Nortu is struck by a hex and takes it into his own reserve.

name: Sosti
summary: Sosti is a vengeful exile released from a silent prison who sides with a rogue scientist for revenge. Sosti rampages through a metropolis and later helps rule a conquered planet with iron law.

feats.scene: Sosti flattens a stadium with one stomp.
Sosti bears a full-force sword strike from a rival hero.

name: Illst
summary: Illst is the island warden of a reform colony for troublemakers. Illst is a friend of the strongest warrior-queen and wins respect by firm fairness.

feats.scene: Illst wrestles a mutineer to the sand in one throw.
Illst withstands a cell door slamming on her back.

name: Tonorsau
summary: Tonorsau is a sentry of a sisterhood of fighters who guards a captive warrior after her side's fall. Tonorsau follows orders with calm discipline.

feats.scene: Tonorsau parries a spear and sends the shaft splintering.
Tonorsau trades blows with a prisoner and holds her ground.

name: Racanus
summary: Racanus is a scheming scientist from a doomed world who conspires with two brothers to seize power and is frozen in suspended sleep by a rival. Racanus later wears the face of a mild reporter.

feats.scene: Racanus hurls a lab table through a stone wall.
Racanus rises from a ruptured console blast unharmed.

name: Vorreleo
summary: Vorreleo is a white-haired court wizard and counsel to an emperor in the eighth century. Vorreleo mixes powders and chemicals as easily as spells.

feats.scene: Vorreleo calls up a dust storm that smashes a siege tower.
Vorreleo is flung from a horse and stands brushing dirt off his cloak.

name: Niessan
summary: Niessan is a loyal gorilla soldier who helps a warlord master take a whole continent. Niessan has fangs and crushing strength.

feats.scene: Niessan crushes a rifle barrel in one fist.
Niessan shrugs off a club to the head.

name: Sauinureo
summary: Sauinureo is a polished arms dealer who trades in toxic compounds and runs a smuggling network. Sauinureo is arrested after a sting.

feats.scene: Sauinureo detonates a vial in a closed warehouse and clears the floor.
Sauinureo is tackled by an agent and cuffed.

name: Rautinor
summary: Rautinor is a gifted composer and former masked guardian who bends sound itself. Rautinor wears a shield that expands into a protective suit at the push of a button.

feats.scene: Rautinor focuses a low note that shatters a row of windows.
Rautinor braces behind the shield and absorbs a grenade burst.

name: Rnlisti
summary: Rnlisti is a crooked cop whose mind is fraying and who hides behind a badge. Rnlisti is skilled at deception and firearms.

feats.scene: Rnlisti fires a service pistol through a car windshield.
Rnlisti hits the pavement in a tumble and rises.

name: Vanumnus
summary: Vanumnus is a retired counterintelligence chief who knows when to fight and when to vanish. Vanumnus is later kidnapped and tortured by a double agent.

feats.scene: Vanumnus drives an assailant's head through a window pane.
Vanumnus endures a beating in a cellar and still refuses to speak.

name: Rosnes
summary: Rosnes is a hooded bowman and bodyguard who hides among a sinister flock until sent on a rescue errand. Rosnes tracks stolen kin and pays a hard price.

feats.scene: Rosnes looses an arrow that pins a guard's sleeve to a post.
Rosnes takes a thrown crate on the shoulder and keeps moving.

name: Iuiuniu
summary: Iuiuniu is a patrolman in a rewritten city who arrests a pair of twin outlaws and is erased moments later when the world snaps back. Iuiuniu carries a standard sidearm.

feats.scene: Iuiuniu fires a warning shot over a fleeing prisoner.
Iuiuniu is shoved over a squad car hood and rolls off.

name: Rotilres
summary: Rotilres is an orange-skinned barrister turned peacekeeper who wields a luminous band of will-fuelled light. Rotilres prosecutes at a tribunal with calm and plays fair.

feats.scene: Rotilres sculpts a glowing battering ram that crushes a mining rig.
Rotilres stands in a collapsing cargo dock wrapped in a light shield.

name: Testeleo
summary: Testeleo is a moody ageless goddaughter of a tyrant who pours drinks for tipsy patrons and posts for an audience online. Testeleo owns a summoned demon beast.

feats.scene: Testeleo hurls a thunderous blast and levels a block of rowhouses.
Testeleo reclines unharmed on a tavern counter as the ceiling falls in.

name: Reolluos
summary: Reolluos is a battle-maiden of a fearsome sisterhood and niece of a notorious uncle, able to call forth a demonic beast. Reolluos is ageless and tough.

feats.scene: Reolluos calls her beast to tear a fortress gate from its hinges.
Reolluos stands in the middle of a shelled courtyard without a mark.

name: Lannti
summary: Lannti is a witty, prickly gorilla bred by lab surgery to speak a foreign tongue and serve a disembodied genius. Lannti has a petty streak and a faithful heart.

feats.scene: Lannti smashes a steel locker with a fist.
Lannti is flung into a lab shelf and stands.

name: Ntolu
summary: Ntolu is a grey-haired space marauder who has led a bloodthirsty crew for six centuries from a fort hidden in an asteroid storm. Ntolu wields a golden band and a charging device.

feats.scene: Ntolu cracks the dome of a trade moon outpost with a blast of light.
Ntolu rides out a hail of rock in the open void.

name: Reninau
summary: Reninau is a white-haired matron who runs a lively lodging house on a far planet and nurses wounded guests back to health with odd treatments. Reninau is kind in her own way.

feats.scene: Reninau drags a heavy trunk across a floor.
Reninau shrugs off a drunk guest crashing into her.

name: Lotanni
summary: Lotanni is a small hero hound who can fill himself with air until he swells like a floating drum. Lotanni uses the bulk to block foes and bounce harm away.

feats.scene: Lotanni bellies a thug into a fence.
Lotanni bounces off a brick wall unharmed.

name: Oranileol
summary: Oranileol is a masked assassin who works for a hateful regime and teams up with a hammer-wielder. Oranileol hides behind a rusted iron mask.

feats.scene: Oranileol drives a dagger through a wooden desk.
Oranileol takes a club blow on the mask and keeps stabbing.

name: Eoncolon
summary: Eoncolon is a bald figure who boasts of being evil itself and has killed champions across centuries. Eoncolon claims to live as long as wickedness does and returns after every defeat.

feats.scene: Eoncolon strangles a champion with a bare arm and drops him.
Eoncolon walks away from a landslide that buries a road.

name: Ninla
summary: Ninla is a monstrous winged night prowler with claws and silent habits. Ninla stalks a city while plans for a bigger arc are cut short.

feats.scene: Ninla rakes a steel door with its claws.
Ninla shrugs off a pistol round to the wing.

name: Nasorenu
summary: Nasorenu is a scout who joins a band of night-masked heroes drawn from many lands. Nasorenu is silent and watchful and thrives in forests.

feats.scene: Nasorenu fires a bow shot into a tree trunk.
Nasorenu drops from a branch and rolls out of the fall.

name: Ileiumma
summary: Ileiumma is a purple-skinned schemer who wears ten rings and calls down a space gem to remake a woman into a monster. Ileiumma forces her to battle her lover and a giant shark machine.

feats.scene: Ileiumma wakes a colossal shark machine that rips through a coastline.
Ileiumma stands under a collapsing satellite dish unharmed.

name: Numsilnel
summary: Numsilnel is a grieving widow who leans on an old friend for comfort and sees her late husband in every corner. Numsilnel keeps anniversaries alive.

feats.scene: Numsilnel shuts a stubborn window with a firm shove.
Numsilnel stumbles on a stair and catches the rail.

name: Arveovar
summary: Arveovar is a monocled general who governs an occupied capital with a heavy boot. Arveovar is eventually caught by one swift stroke.

feats.scene: Arveovar fires a pistol across a chart table.
Arveovar is thrown against a map cabinet and stays standing.

name: Sertitel
summary: Sertitel is a lizard-shaped elder demon said to have shaped humankind who guards a descendant's home. Sertitel judges visitors by the purity of their souls and can shrink to a small gecko.

feats.scene: Sertitel exhales a burning plume that melts a farmstead to glass.
Sertitel sits unbothered in a firestorm that gutters a ridge.

name: Iaveo
summary: Iaveo is a scarred vigilante who executes escaped war criminals with a hoard of weapons and a robotic dog. Iaveo kills the wrong person and is swallowed by remorse.

feats.scene: Iaveo fires a rifle round through a bunker door.
Iaveo takes a bayonet slash and fights on.

name: Valeoti
summary: Valeoti is a war-machine leader built to crush a space police force, powered by a stolen source of energy. Valeoti is shattered when its captive host is freed.

feats.scene: Valeoti blasts a frigate in half.
Valeoti shrugs off a salvo of missiles on its armoured core.

name: Saurici
summary: Saurici is a cold overseer of a machine cult's factories who chases ancient elders through the ether and sets cunning traps. Saurici nearly bests two heroes through fakery.

feats.scene: Saurici blasts a space station to dust.
Saurici stands in a collapsing trap chamber and walks free.

name: Litis
summary: Litis is a faceless machine intelligence that harvests souls and remakes useful people into servants. Litis can repair its agents when they fall into error.

feats.scene: Litis drains the vitality of a whole province in one pulse.
Litis loses a data fortress and rebuilds itself within moments.

name: Naceonus
summary: Naceonus is an ancient teacher and witch who is sometimes hijacked by a dark goddess's will. Naceonus protects a tribe and turns her power on her allies when possessed.

feats.scene: Naceonus rains spirit fire on a mountain monastery and shatters its terraces.
Naceonus stands in a ring of cold flame and is untouched.

name: Valnumsau
summary: Valnumsau is an ancient shaman born three thousand years ago who bridges time to confront a new threat. Valnumsau trusts his own spirit allies more than any army.

feats.scene: Valnumsau calls a spirit stampede that flattens a stadium.
Valnumsau stands steady as a gale strips the bark from a forest.

name: Tellloam
summary: Tellloam is a gentle sea-dwelling suitor with blond hair and a shell necklace who courts an island princess. Tellloam dives and swims with ease.

feats.scene: Tellloam bats a spear out of the water with a tail.
Tellloam shrugs off a hard wave against a reef.

name: Eolloan
summary: Eolloan is a corrupt detective and second-in-command of a masked robber gang. Eolloan jumps the gun at a precinct heist and is carried off by a grinning madman.

feats.scene: Eolloan fires a shotgun into a precinct evidence cage.
Eolloan crashes through a stack of boxes and keeps running.

name: Tonont
summary: Tonont is a hulking terrorist with a killing touch, flight and brute strength who joins a deadly five-strong team. Tonont is bold enough to wound a masked detective in hand-to-hand.

feats.scene: Tonont grips a transport tower and snaps it at the base.
Tonont is slammed by a collapsing bridge and flies out of the rubble.

name: Livaanu
summary: Livaanu is a brawler of immense strength recruited to a doomed unit. Livaanu fights ferociously in a short career and dies in a cave-in.

feats.scene: Livaanu hammers a steel door off its frame.
Livaanu takes a rifle butt to the ribs and laughs.

name: Telseo
summary: Telseo is a clawed berserker with fierce strength and a hide of armour who also fires blasts of energy. Telseo joins a gang of villains and is deported to a prison planet.

feats.scene: Telseo fires a blast that erases a lighthouse.
Telseo rises from a collapsing dam unscathed.

name: Nemeva
summary: Nemeva is a modern guardian of ancient land who is the first of several to take a hawk-like codename. Nemeva fights alongside a spy agency's unit.

feats.scene: Nemeva shatters a jetty with a lunging strike.
Nemeva shrugs off a boat's collision against a seawall.

name: Ialern
summary: Ialern is a black-eyed soldier of a fiery world who freezes foes with a pale beam and blasts erratic bolts. Ialern tears whole sections off buildings with bare hands.

feats.scene: Ialern peels away a floor of an office tower and flings it down the street.
Ialern stands up from two hero-grade punches that crater the road.

name: Varnas
summary: Varnas is an emerald-skinned insect chief who leads a hive in a bright homeworld. Varnas wields tough plating and brute strength.

feats.scene: Varnas heaves a boulder that plugs a tunnel mouth.
Varnas takes a fall from a cliff with only a scratch on his shell.

name: Contnau
summary: Contnau is a dark world soldier who answers to a master tyrant. Contnau is a willing guard with a hard glare.

feats.scene: Contnau cracks a bulkhead with an elbow.
Contnau walks through a burst of shrapnel unbothered.

name: Reoriaseo
summary: Reoriaseo is a bald research chemist who uses slave test subjects and then builds artificial servants. Reoriaseo can reshape a world's ecosystem with toxic experiments.

feats.scene: Reoriaseo seeds a lake with a toxin that kills every fish by morning.
Reoriaseo falls from a lab stool and is only winded.

name: Tiallta
summary: Tiallta is a trained killer from a cruel academy who works with an assassin sister. Tiallta strikes in the dark and leaves no trace.

feats.scene: Tiallta throws a blade through a lantern.
Tiallta drops from a rooftop onto a car and keeps moving.

name: Ntroncor
summary: Ntroncor is a thief of powers who moves objects with his mind and spells and copies abilities from others. Ntroncor mostly bullies lone defenders.

feats.scene: Ntroncor tears up a street in a shower of asphalt.
Ntroncor shrugs off a car thrown by a rival.

name: Stseium
summary: Stseium is a former agent who regrows lost limbs after a covert experiment and rushes to avenge his father. Stseium is forced to endure agonising torture for his healing gift.

feats.scene: Stseium puts a bullet through a smuggler's radio.
Stseium regrows a hand after a rusty cleaver takes it.

name: Milcor
summary: Milcor is a council of angular demon lords from the underworld who warp reality at will. Milcor are bound to a master, then turned loose on a city.

feats.scene: Milcor folds a whole avenue into a spiral of glass and pain.
Milcor rides out a rain of heavy ordnance without a flicker.

name: Eoiacin
summary: Eoiacin is an elder cosmic watcher who protects every living thing from a hungry counterpart. Eoiacin gathers heroes of many worlds to save all that exists.

feats.scene: Eoiacin pulls scattered worlds into one reality in a single pulse.
Eoiacin holds his ground against a collapsing universe's tide.

name: Cetevi
summary: Cetevi is a first-born steward of a hidden hall at the heart of creation who guards each cosmos from collisions. Cetevi is shattered into many aspects and slowly gathers them again.

feats.scene: Cetevi folds a rogue universe back into its orbit.
Cetevi reforms from a scattering of shards after an annihilation wave.

name: Ntntu
summary: Ntntu is a champion of a far colony whose body runs on contained nuclear reactions. Ntntu flies, hurls bolts that melt metal and is wrapped in a protective field.
