feats.scene: Ntntu hurls a bolt that melts an armoured bridge.
Ntntu flies out of a reactor breach untouched.

name: Inole
summary: Inole is a tall red-haired actor from a colony world with a body that runs on nuclear reactions. Inole turns his imposing presence into stagecraft and fights with it.

feats.scene: Inole fires a heat bolt that slags a stage rigging and the stage beneath.
Inole strolls out of a burning theater after the roof falls.

name: Arreias
summary: Arreias is a white-haired space corsair with raider manners who preys on a famous hero with tricks and fake weapons. Arreias allies with other villains and brainwashes a hero's friend.

feats.scene: Arreias blasts a freighter's engines with a deck cannon.
Arreias stands in a burning cockpit after a hull breach.

name: Rerrncel
summary: Rerrncel is a bondservant who hauls brine buckets through a collapsing salt mine for a debt-owner who never shows a face. Obedient to a fault, Rerrncel follows every order without question and has never once looked up at the sky.

feats.scene: Rerrncel swings a pickaxe into a seam of rock salt hard enough to split it.
Rerrncel keeps hauling after a loose timber cracks across the shoulders.
Rerrncel sprints along a tunnel to outrun a flooding pocket of brine.

name: Numsotor
summary: Numsotor is a hired killer rebuilt with salvaged hydraulic limbs, selling his skills to any crew that pays for underwater salvage raids. He fights best in dark water, where his weight and plating shrug off blows that would fold a diver.

feats.scene: Numsotor peels a vault door off its hinges with a single hydraulic arm.
Numsotor stays upright as a charge of demolition explosive detonates against his chest plating.

name: Tesmilni
summary: Tesmilni teaches rock and sediment to restless students and rides a battered camper from one fossil dig to the next. A gentle mentor with a taste for strong tea, Tesmilni carries a rock hammer more as a prop than a weapon.

feats.scene: Tesmilni cracks a stubborn boulder open with a well-placed hammer blow.
Tesmilni walks away from a slide of loose gravel down a quarry wall.
Tesmilni jogs across a dig site to haul a student clear of a falling ledge.

source_title: Marc Bartow (Rest in Peace Michael Pembrook)

name: Steoni
summary: Steoni is a quiet loner who runs a failing bait shop and nurses a grudge against a family of shipping brokers. Nothing about Steoni suggests danger until the dock lights go out.

feats.scene: Steoni drives a gaff hook through a plank door in one furious swing.
Steoni shrugs off a pistol-whipping behind the cold storage shed.
Steoni sprints the length of a pier with a rival close behind.

name: Rnisium
summary: Rnisium was a soldier altered by an experimental graft, left with spiked tendrils that coil out of the forearms and hum with stored charge. A second voice in the mind urges Rnisium toward ritual violence and a promised paradise.

feats.scene: Rnisium lashes charged tendrils through a steel door as if it were wet card.
Rnisium keeps moving after a rifle burst chews across the ribs.
Rnisium bolts across a frozen field faster than any trained athlete.

name: Irnau
summary: Irnau is a drifting broker of conquest who prepares worlds for invaders by softening resistance and scouting weaknesses. With a mind that bends to any circumstance, Irnau steps between star systems as easily as crossing a street.

feats.scene: Irnau overloads the power grid of a whole coastline in one pulse to blind a defending fleet.
Irnau walks out of a collapsing orbital fortress with barely a scratch.
Irnau crosses from one world to the next in a flicker no instrument can time.

name: Estntse
summary: Estntse is a reckless heiress who turns cliff-edge stunts into entertainment, then discovers that stealing pays better than applause. Charm covers every betrayal, and the pace of her schemes never slows.

feats.scene: Estntse lands a slap that echoes across a crowded ballroom.
Estntse tumbles off a rooftop awning and gets up laughing.
Estntse races a runaway carriage along a seafront promenade.

name: Tonau
summary: Tonau is a travelling trader and scribe who maps caravan routes through deserts and mountain passes, filling notebooks with rumours of distant courts. Tonau can ride, sail and swim well enough to survive the long road.

feats.scene: Tonau swings a curved blade at bandits closing in on a camel train.
Tonau survives a fall from a saddle onto a stony pass.
Tonau gallops across a salt flat to deliver a warning.

name: Ausas
summary: Ausas never speaks and instead performs cruel street theatre with shattered bottles and a hard stare. Wherever a crowd gathers, Ausas stages a show nobody wants to see.

feats.scene: Ausas hurls a bottle that bursts against a lamp post across the square.
Ausas takes a baton across the back and keeps miming.
Ausas vaults market stalls to vanish into an alley.

name: Sauarco
summary: Sauarco is a veteran spearman taken from an ancient arena by visitors from a faraway star and schooled for a decade in their methods. Returned to a world two millennia later, Sauarco guards a modern harbour town with unshaken discipline.

feats.scene: Sauarco hurls a boulder through the hull of a beached freighter.
Sauarco stands firm as a runaway truck slams into his raised shield.
Sauarco outruns a speeding patrol car along the quay.

name: Arnolser
summary: Arnolser is a smiling property developer who buys waterfront blocks with money nobody can trace. Rivals sense a pleasant face that hides a ledger of favours owed.

feats.scene: Arnolser slams a desk drawer hard enough to split the wood.
Arnolser steps away from a glancing car bumper without a stagger.
Arnolser hurries across a parking lot with a briefcase under one arm.

name: Taurneanu
summary: Taurneanu is a freed labourer turned aerial fighter, whose stretchy limbs and bladed metal wings make for a swift, tireless raider. Flying low over occupied streets, Taurneanu strikes guards and vanishes before alarms spread.

feats.scene: Taurneanu slices through a guard tower cable with one pass of a razor-edged wing.
Taurneanu stretches around a thrown crate and bounces back unharmed.
Taurneanu dives between chimneys at a speed no sentry can track.

name: Amran
summary: Amran is a gunsmith and tinkerer raised by a patron who funded a workshop and taught kindness. Each of Amran's lives has ended the same way, in service to the one who raised him.

feats.scene: Amran hammers a barrel straight in a single ringing strike.
Amran survives a bench explosion with only singed sleeves.
Amran sprints through a foundry to reach a trapped apprentice.

name: Misena
summary: Misena is a shepherd framed for a crime, chained to a galley oar and then pushed into fighting pits for sport. Every bout deepens his stubborn pride and his hatred of schemers.

feats.scene: Misena wrenches an iron chain from its bolts and swings it like a flail.
Misena stays on his feet after a charging bull clips his shoulder.
Misena dashes across sand to catch a thrown spear.

name: Oriumse
summary: Oriumse is a frontier marshal who commands a band of living light, wielded to shield a mining colony from raiders. After helping uncover a grim massacre on a distant world, she hunts the culprits with patient fury.

feats.scene: Oriumse carves a canyon through a ridge with a single sustained beam.
Oriumse holds a barrier of light against a collapsing shaft entrance.

name: Tialan
summary: Tialan is a sea-born princess who shapes tides and speaks silently into other minds. Banished from her father's court for choosing a surface life, Tialan guards a harbour district from smugglers.

feats.scene: Tialan folds a harbour swell into a wall that crushes a smugglers' pier.
Tialan survives a collapsing breakwater with only a bruised arm.

name: Sonntocer
summary: Sonntocer is a tide-sovereign of a drowned kingdom, famed for a punch that cracks reinforced floors and for commanding the water inside clouds. Reluctantly drawn into wars beyond her coast, she hates being called anything but her own name.

feats.scene: Sonntocer shatters a concrete deck with one fist, dropping a whole hall into the cellar.
Sonntocer stands unhurt in the heart of a colossal energy blast.

name: Osaul
summary: Osaul is a draughtsman who drafts plans for towers in a rebuilt capital after a long and bitter conflict. Osaul trusts ink and a spirit level more than any sword.

feats.scene: Osaul drives a surveyor's stake deep into hard clay.
Osaul lands in a heap of scaffolding poles and walks off sore.
Osaul hurries across a building site carrying a roll of plans.

name: Iumnulor
summary: Iumnulor is a toymaker's rival who conjures cheap hexes with a cracked mirror and a bag of nails. Her schemes are small, loud and quickly forgotten.

feats.scene: Iumnulor hurls a spark from a cracked mirror that scorches a workbench.
Iumnulor survives a tumble down a cellar stair.
Iumnulor scuttles through a crowded workshop with her bag of nails.

name: Valaram
summary: Valaram is a compulsive pilferer who works the coat check of a lawless tavern, confiscating blades at the door and pocketing the shiniest ones. Valaram cannot resist glittering things.

feats.scene: Valaram heaves a heavy crate of confiscated blades onto the counter.
Valaram takes a thrown stool across the shoulders and keeps grinning.
Valaram darts through a rowdy crowd with a stolen brooch.

name: Anteam
summary: Anteam is a veteran police chief who runs on stubbornness, black coffee and a runner's endurance. Anteam keeps order in a coastal town that never quite trusts masked vigilantes.

feats.scene: Anteam kicks in a warehouse door during a late raid.
Anteam walks off a rooftop fall that ends in a stack of mattresses.
Anteam finishes a long race along the seawall in a respectable time.

name: Oritumti
summary: Oritumti is a newspaper reporter who chases leads on foot across a sprawling port, filing copy at dawn. Oritumti's best weapon is a notepad and a stubborn question.

feats.scene: Oritumti shoves open a jammed archive door with one shoulder.
Oritumti shakes off a hard shove against a brick wall.
Oritumti sprints for a tram with a deadline story in hand.

name: Riateltes
summary: Riateltes manages harvest policy for a shattered nation and ends up carrying the whole government after a sudden collapse. Riateltes is tired, funny, and very unlikely to flinch.

feats.scene: Riateltes bangs a gavel so hard that the whole chamber falls silent.
Riateltes endures a sleepless week of crisis meetings without complaint.
Riateltes hurries down a stairwell to reach an emergency briefing.

name: Senassor
summary: Senassor is a precinct detective who handles the odd cases the others avoid, armed with a sidearm and a sharp tongue. Senassor defies a hard family history with a stubborn sense of fairness.

feats.scene: Senassor puts a hard elbow into a fleeing suspect in a stairwell.
Senassor rolls clear of a cracked window ledge and climbs back up.
Senassor runs down a suspect across three crowded blocks.

name: Milse
summary: Milse is a wealthy parent who wages petty war on a rival at school fundraisers, winning with homemade pastry and a sweet smile. Milse never raises a voice and never loses a bake sale.

feats.scene: Milse whisks a bowl of batter into a perfect peak in seconds.
Milse keeps smiling through a long afternoon of polite sniping.
Milse strides to the best seats before anyone else can move.

name: Miatator
summary: Miatator reads fortune cards in a sunny seaside neighbourhood, and the cards are unsettlingly accurate. A stray gang turns her talent into a crime, and something unseen begins to hunt for her.

feats.scene: Miatator turns a card and a gust of cold air flings a table across the room.
Miatator staggers but holds her ground as the unseen thing howls past.
Miatator flees down a crowded boardwalk with a deck in her fist.

name: Iarreco
summary: Iarreco is a noble wife whose quiet resolve has carried her through revolutions and a famous husband's masks. Iarreco rarely appears in the foreground, yet no plan succeeds without her.

feats.scene: Iarreco flings a heavy candlestick at a pursuing guard.
Iarreco rides through a storm in an open coach without complaint.
Iarreco gallops a borrowed horse through a night-time forest.

name: Miltelnum
summary: Miltelnum serves a pack of grim warrior women with a hunter's patience and a ready spear. Born in a southern coastal country, Miltelnum mistrusts bows and marksmen.

feats.scene: Miltelnum hurls a spear that pins a door shut from thirty paces.
Miltelnum laughs off a blow from a shield bash.
Miltelnum sprints along a ridge to cut off a messenger.

name: Lllini
summary: Lllini is a mother in a crime clan, loving and careful, who learned to read danger in the quiet before a storm. An early tragedy shadows every decision Lllini makes.

feats.scene: Lllini hurls a ceramic pot that shatters on a thug's shoulder.
Lllini endures a long night of grief and fear without breaking.
Lllini runs to the nursery at the sound of breaking glass.

name: Ausronanu
summary: Ausronanu is a ruthless matriarch who built a syndicate from grief and revenge after losing her family. Ausronanu hides behind a bird-themed alias and a fixed smile.

feats.scene: Ausronanu cracks a heavy ledger across a debtor's desk.
Ausronanu survives an ambush in her own car with only cuts.
Ausronanu hurries through a rear kitchen to an idling sedan.

name: Tanianal
summary: Tanianal is a child of an infernal bargain, raised on false memories and sent to harm those her father loved. Questioning her own purpose, she wields sleep-spells, thought-moving talents and short hops through space.

feats.scene: Tanianal flings a ruined bus aside with a flick of her mind.
Tanianal shrugs off a collapsing chapel roof that buries the nave.

name: Sironil
summary: Sironil lives in a cramped house with two daughters and a husband who rules by fear. Sironil's sorrow shapes the lives of everyone around her.

feats.scene: Sironil scrubs a stubborn stain from the floor with her whole weight.
Sironil endures a cruel winter without heat or comfort.
Sironil hurries her daughters down a dim stairwell.

name: Nesolnus
summary: Nesolnus can melt into living water at will, slip through walls, split into linked copies and turn tidal droplets into frost. A local defender of harbour neighbourhoods, Nesolnus fights traffickers with salt spray and stubborn humour.

feats.scene: Nesolnus floods a loading dock with a surge that scatters a convoy of trucks.
Nesolnus turns to liquid and lets a hail of bullets pass through.

name: Rerntiul
summary: Rerntiul runs a nightclub empire and plots to take over a rival's throne, using gangsters as pawns and betrayals as stepping stones. Cheated by a protege, Rerntiul ends up an exile who later returns altered.

feats.scene: Rerntiul drives a stiletto through a tabletop to pin a hand.
Rerntiul is dumped from a speeding car and rises to walk away.
Rerntiul strides out of a burning club ahead of her guards.

name: Nausauti
summary: Nausauti is a bodyguard for a spoiled puppeteer, pairing sensible advice with thick spectacles and reliable fists. Nausauti knows that every scheme will end badly and helps regardless.

feats.scene: Nausauti decks a rival goon with a single swing.
Nausauti takes a crowbar blow and stays between the doll and the door.
Nausauti sprints through a toy shop after a grabbed puppet.

name: Ilelle
summary: Ilelle lives in the foothills of a southern mountain range, writing letters to a brother who flies mail routes. Ilelle can handle a light plane well enough to ferry medicine across the ridges.

feats.scene: Ilelle hauls a heavy crate of medicine into the cargo bay.
Ilelle walks away from a rough landing on a goat track.
Ilelle banks a light plane through a narrow mountain pass.

name: Llevalco
summary: Llevalco is an intelligence officer of a secretive board, carrying devices that bend nearby signals and cameras. Llevalco plays long games with a calm that unnerves allies.

feats.scene: Llevalco jams a rival's radios with a single palm-sized gadget.
Llevalco survives a staircase fall inside a padded coat.
Llevalco sprints across a rain-soaked plaza to a waiting car.

name: Rnuceocin
summary: Rnuceocin is a frail but terrifying matriarch who governs a ranch empire from a wheelchair. Rnuceocin's men fear her whisper more than any gun.

feats.scene: Rnuceocin raps a cane across a hired gun's knuckles hard enough to snap a finger.
Rnuceocin remains unmoved as a rival threatens her at her own table.
Rnuceocin rolls her chair down a ramp faster than her guards can follow.

name: Anlurni
summary: Anlurni is a former television performer who now protects wildlife in a desert country with her son. Anlurni sits with orphaned animals until they sleep.

feats.scene: Anlurni lifts a tranquilised antelope into the back of a truck.
Anlurni endures a day of scorching heat on a bare plain.
Anlurni sprints across a dry riverbed after a runaway cub.

name: Lliratau
summary: Lliratau drives a forklift at an electronics plant and repairs it with a spanner, a rag and a dry joke. Raising kids alone taught Lliratau to stretch every hour and every coin.

feats.scene: Lliratau cranks a seized bolt loose with a long wrench.
Lliratau finishes a double shift after a pallet clips a hip.
Lliratau steers a forklift down the loading bay with a full pallet.

name: Orseoval
summary: Orseoval is a gene researcher and peace officer from a tiny marine world who once weighed far more than today. A mystical gem slowly reshaped her body and her loyalties.

feats.scene: Orseoval pins a smuggler to a lab bench with a steel grip.
Orseoval survives a lab fire that gutted the sample room.
Orseoval sprints through a customs shed after a fleeing courier.

name: Rannalone
summary: Rannalone is a thief who hijacks shipments at sea using a costume lined with radio emitters, which command whales and other sea animals. Rannalone escapes by confusing sonar pings with false echoes.

feats.scene: Rannalone sends a school of whales to ram a freighter's rudder.
Rannalone survives a plunge from a deck into cold water.
Rannalone rides a surfacing whale away from a pursuing cutter.

name: Satorto
summary: Satorto is a pompous mayor of a storm-battered port, forever the target of a clown's pranks. Satorto's speeches are long and his hair never moves.

feats.scene: Satorto thumps a podium so hard that a microphone topples.
Satorto sits through a pie in the face without losing his composure.
Satorto waddles from a stage to his limousine at record pace.

name: Asisania
summary: Asisania is a mind from the stars transplanted into a hollow mechanical body, jerked about by wires held by a distant puppeteer. Asisania remembers its true flesh only in static.

feats.scene: Asisania punches a dent into a steel locker with a jerking arm.
Asisania keeps moving after a heavy girder drops across its chassis.
Asisania lurches down an alley as its wires pull taut.

name: Valmil
summary: Valmil is a young masked rider in a sunny western city who patrols at dusk on a battered motorcycle. Valmil lost a father too early and now guards the block he loved.

feats.scene: Valmil swings a spiked club that dents a getaway car door.
Valmil lays the bike down at speed and rolls to her feet.
Valmil races a motorcycle down a boulevard at night.

name: Vaaul
summary: Vaaul is a rebel courier from a toy-market quarter who can shrink to the size of a button or swell to the height of a lamppost. She slips through keyholes to carry messages past patrols, then grows to heave barricades aside.

feats.scene: Vaaul swells to lamppost height and shoves a parked wagon across a cobbled lane.
Vaaul shrinks to a button and survives a cart wheel rolling over her.

name: Terstseo
summary: Terstseo is a patient widow who keeps a lantern lit in a harbour window for her lost family. Neighbours trust her sharp memory and her habit of feeding every stray in the lane.

feats.scene: Terstseo slaps a thief's hand away from her market basket.
Terstseo stumbles down a flight of stone steps and stands up with only bruises.

name: Sercanu
summary: Sercanu is a theatre-going socialite who funds orphan schools and never misses a matinee. Her gentle fame leaves her exposed on dark streets after the final curtain.

feats.scene: Sercanu swings her beaded purse into a pickpocket's ribs.
Sercanu is knocked from her seat by a toppled stage lamp and rises unhurt.

name: Seolli
summary: Seolli is a night-shift nurse who keeps a clinic running on tea and stubbornness. She trusts steady hands and calm words over any weapon.

feats.scene: Seolli pins a feverish patient's arm to a cot to place a needle.
Seolli works through a double shift after a ceiling beam clips her shoulder.

name: Terarsan
summary: Terarsan is a salon hostess whose sharp wit makes allies and rivals in equal number. She guards her jewellery box with a cold glare and a heavy candlestick.

feats.scene: Terarsan cracks a candlestick across a burglar's forearm.
Terarsan tumbles down a carpeted staircase and brushes off the dust.

name: Ntosesle
summary: Ntosesle is a cheerful charity organiser who turns every gala into a fundraiser for the dockside clinic. Her only weapon is a stack of ticket stubs and a loud voice.

feats.scene: Ntosesle shoves a rowdy guest out of a ballroom doorway.
Ntosesle takes a fall from a velvet stool onto marble and laughs it off.

source_title: Martha Wayne (Teen Titans Go! TV Series)

name: Ortiau
summary: Ortiau is a formless thinker that drifts through collective worry and lodges inside a borrowed human. Together they sense dread before it blooms and push back against a hungry rival mind.

feats.scene: Ortiau floods a whole district with a wave of calm that snuffs out a rival mind's rage.
Ortiau endures a weeks-long assault of despair without losing its grip on the host.

name: Valiu
summary: Valiu is a long-snouted talking beast who sips cosmic dust from an anthill on a red moon. He joins a ragtag band of cartoon animals for the free snacks.

feats.scene: Valiu flicks a beetle across a crater with his sticky tongue.
Valiu is flattened by a falling dust pile and puffs back to shape.

name: Cellle
summary: Cellle is a bald flirt who spends his days chasing introductions and rejections in equal measure. He means well, but his pickup lines clear rooms faster than any alarm.

feats.scene: Cellle waves a bouquet so hard that a vase topples off a shelf.
Cellle takes a slap from a startled clerk and keeps grinning.

name: Iuiacel
summary: Iuiacel is a stern flight officer carrying an old grudge into a secret test programme. A mentor talks him out of vengeance and he becomes a loyal right hand instead.

feats.scene: Iuiacel drives a rifle butt into a locked hangar door and splinters the frame.
Iuiacel endures months of captivity and hard interrogation without breaking.

name: Stoeol
summary: Stoeol is a ruthless party boss who flees to the jungle and plots to poison a distant capital with a stolen canister. A masked vigilante stops him, and a bomb in his plane finishes the job.

feats.scene: Stoeol's rigged plane detonates in mid-air above the treeline.
Stoeol walks out of a collapsed bunker doorway with a split lip.

name: Coltumor
summary: Coltumor is a quiet contract killer who takes jobs from feuding gang bosses. His plans keep unravelling because a masked rooftop watcher is always one step ahead.

feats.scene: Coltumor fires a pistol round through a diner window.
Coltumor takes a kick to the chest and keeps his footing.

name: Amtiarn
summary: Amtiarn is a haunted drifter who hears voices of a saint demanding terrible deeds. Locked in a grim asylum ward, he never stops muttering about what he has done.

feats.scene: Amtiarn smashes a ward window with his bare fist.
Amtiarn grinds on through a beating from orderlies and a night in restraints.

name: Tetolor
summary: Tetolor is a desk-bound prison chief who cares more about budgets than corridors. He loses an eye in a breakout and is saved by a masked stranger at the last moment.

feats.scene: Tetolor slams a ledger onto his desk and rattles a cup.
Tetolor survives a mauling during a riot and walks to the infirmary.

name: Sarsta
summary: Sarsta is a jumpy thief who hops across rooftops and prefers dodging to fighting. He ends up as cannon fodder in a bar brawl against a bounty hunter from space.

feats.scene: Sarsta kicks off a chimney and lands a boot on a guard's jaw.
Sarsta drops two storeys onto an awning and bounces away.

name: Vaamoos
summary: Vaamoos is an ordinary clerk whose weekdays pass between a bus stop and a corner shop. Little is known about him beyond a steady, forgettable routine.

feats.scene: Vaamoos throws a crumpled receipt at a bin and misses.
Vaamoos trips over a kerb and stands up laughing.

name: Arani
summary: Arani is a balding aircraft magnate who hides a secret second family and a ledger of shady deals. His many enemies eventually catch up with him.

feats.scene: Arani slams a boardroom table and sends a pen flying.
Arani takes a punch from a furious engineer and keeps shouting.

name: Ianrananu
summary: Ianrananu is a crooner with a stage name and a grudge who briefly plots against his own brother's crew. Tears and a lost eye reshape him into a reluctant ally.

feats.scene: Ianrananu hurls a microphone stand across a nightclub stage.
Ianrananu keeps singing through a night of terrible dreams.

name: Silelreo
summary: Silelreo is a dockside executive who sells shipping lanes to a smuggling ring. He plays the polite host until the cargo goes missing.

feats.scene: Silelreo shoves a crate aside with a grunt.
Silelreo shrugs off a shove into a wharf railing.

name: Naustoco
summary: Naustoco is a cold scholar who stitched his mind into a lifeless body to study the line between living and dead. He walks as a gaunt storm of rot and radiance.

feats.scene: Naustoco unleashes a wave of decay that hollows out a warehouse in a heartbeat.
Naustoco takes a blast that levels a loading yard and keeps walking.

name: Lersiatin
summary: Lersiatin is a grey-haired lecturer whose mind rides inside a younger partner who burns with atomic fire. One speaks as a voice, the other fights with a blazing body.

feats.scene: Lersiatin channels a burst of fission that flattens a row of empty warehouses.
Lersiatin stands in a furnace blast that melts the street around him.

name: Ialvi
summary: Ialvi is a petty tyrant who rallies a red-world rabble behind a crude propaganda machine. His invasion plan collapses when a hero ignores the hoax label and strands him on a lonely rock.

feats.scene: Ialvi pounds a lectern so hard it cracks.
Ialvi lives out his days on a barren rock with no air complaints.

name: Cisrnau
summary: Cisrnau is a cheerful boy raised by a nurse and her husband who gets a place on a hero team as a mascot. He mostly carries snacks and shouts encouragement.

feats.scene: Cisrnau tosses a ball over a fence.
Cisrnau falls off a bicycle and brushes the gravel from his knees.

name: Lunisu
summary: Lunisu is a street scavenger who sells salvage to pawn shops and passes whispers to a masked watcher. She turns down every offer of a better flat.

feats.scene: Lunisu hauls a battered dresser into her cart.
Lunisu sleeps through a freezing night on a doorstep.

name: Rnusirore
summary: Rnusirore is a schoolgirl who shouts a magic word and rises into the air as a caped champion. She juggles homework with rescuing classmates.

feats.scene: Rnusirore dives from a rooftop and flattens a delivery truck with her fist.
Rnusirore takes a collapsing gym wall on her back and stands up.

name: Renrelas
summary: Renrelas is a bold twin who shares a lightning-blessed gift with a sibling and a friend. She defends a bright city from a mad inventor who sells hours.

feats.scene: Renrelas smashes a siege engine in a single overhead swing.
Renrelas stands firm against a barrage of rocket fire from a bandit fortress.

name: Rilcor
summary: Rilcor is a candidate for office who hides a painful past behind a new name. A leaked secret ends her campaign and she walks away from her family.

feats.scene: Rilcor slams a campaign door in a reporter's face.
Rilcor endures a crowd of reporters jostling her on a hospital stair.

name: Lislloiu
summary: Lislloiu is a white-haired physician who runs the infirmary of a remote swamp prison. She worries her younger sister is carrying too much alone.

feats.scene: Lislloiu hoists a stretcher with an orderly across a muddy yard.
Lislloiu works a full day in swamp heat with a cracked rib.

name: Arteanu
summary: Arteanu is a student mage who speaks a mighty name and becomes a thunderous warrior. She leaps, heals, vanishes and reappears in the middle of a brawl.

feats.scene: Arteanu hurls a boulder the size of a bus through a quarry wall.
Arteanu walks out of a collapsing bridge span without a bruise.
Arteanu blurs across a training field before the dust settles.

name: Stiori
summary: Stiori is a studious older sister in a big foster family who becomes the chosen guardian of a wizard's gift. She balances pop quizzes with monster fights and a very noisy dinner table.

feats.scene: Stiori punches a rampaging monster through a stadium wall.
Stiori walks out of a collapsed stadium with her cape smouldering.

name: Rniserla
summary: Rniserla is a woman who stopped ageing as a child and now wears an oversized ribbon in her hair. She lives with a hulking sewer-dweller and mourns when things go wrong.

feats.scene: Rniserla swings a tiny parasol at a guard's knee.
Rniserla tumbles down a flight of steps and bounces upright.

name: Stoium
summary: Stoium is a hospital chemist who invents a liquid that shrinks living things so surgeons can work inside the body. A betrayal by her fiance leaves her palm-sized.

feats.scene: Stoium rolls a thimble across a lab bench to trip a guard.
Stoium survives a drop from a workbench onto a sponge.

name: Sautes
summary: Sautes is a flame-coloured vigilante who flips through windows and fights dirty. In one grim future, she grows violent and fascist-minded under a harsh leader.

feats.scene: Sautes lands a spinning heel kick that dents a steel locker.
Sautes keeps fighting after a hard fall from a fire escape.

name: Annaela
summary: Annaela is a circus aerialist who performs with her husband high above a sawdust ring. A snapped rope ends the act and orphans a young boy.

feats.scene: Annaela swings from a bar and kicks a ring light loose.
Annaela plummets from the tent top onto the ring floor.

name: Lesora
summary: Lesora is a grey-haired retired woman who raised a long family in a rough tenement district. She watches the street from her stoop and knows every name.

feats.scene: Lesora raps a cane across a bully's knuckles.
Lesora walks home through freezing rain without a coat.

name: Raarrni
summary: Raarrni is a newspaper writer who changed her name to protect her son from a violent past. She mocks masked heroes in print until a friend shows her how many lives they have saved.

feats.scene: Raarrni slaps a press pass onto a security desk.
Raarrni stays upright after a shove from a panicking crowd.

name: Iuniu
summary: Iuniu is a painter and sorceress who draws power from the old lines under the earth. She helps a scruffy trickster topple a nightmare god built from fear and gears.

feats.scene: Iuniu pulls current along buried lines and cracks a rival's engine in half.
Iuniu weathers a rush of dark energy while chanting at a standing stone.

name: Orini
summary: Orini is a student who shares a laughing alias with two friends and they fight tyranny as a single prankster. A new overlord captures her first and stops her heart.

feats.scene: Orini vaults a rail and lands a double kick on a masked guard.
Orini holds out through long hours of mental interrogation.

name: Iaraulnil
summary: Iaraulnil is a student pricked by a syringe of bird genes that makes her blindingly fast. She dodges gunfire, throws punches by the dozen each second and outruns light itself.

feats.scene: Iaraulnil runs a full lap of a stadium in a blink and the draft rips the banners down.
Iaraulnil crashes through a brick wall at full tilt and keeps going.

name: Lasirn
summary: Lasirn is a pumpkin-masked killer from a competitive family who turns on her own kin to win a grim contest. She plans her murders around themes rather than numbers.

feats.scene: Lasirn drives a carving blade through a thick wooden table.
Lasirn walks off a fall from a rear stair landing.

name: Lureveo
summary: Lureveo is the wife of a wartime leader and a keen observer of state dinners and tragic evenings. She is remembered most for one night at a playhouse.

feats.scene: Lureveo drops a fan onto a table with a sharp snap.
Lureveo sits through a long vigil beside a hospital bed.

name: Iunusrn
summary: Iunusrn is a respected elder on the ruling council of a doomed homeworld who keeps the council's best scientist in good favour. Delay and paperwork leave her people unable to act before the sun flares.

feats.scene: Iunusrn raps a gavel and ends a long session.
Iunusrn sits unmoved through a heated council debate for a full day.

name: Rertalenu
summary: Rertalenu is a silent red-haired girl who dons a sidekick mask in a dark city. She communicates through gestures and bold leaps.

feats.scene: Rertalenu swings from a cable and kicks a gunman's wrist.
Rertalenu slides down a drainpipe and lands in a crouch.

name: Naiali
summary: Naiali is a young academy trainee who exhales streams of acid or roaring flame. She hates rules, rides a glowing ring through the air and has no fear of ending a fight.

feats.scene: Naiali breathes a gout of flame that melts a transport hull.
Naiali shrugs off a blast of acid thrown by a rival trainee.

name: Llilleall
summary: Llilleall is a pair of twin runners from a poor village who learned to keep each other safe. Their speed flows through them whenever they stay close, and they bounce back from being kidnapped.

feats.scene: Llilleall sprints through a market stall and splinters it.
Llilleall is thrown from a bus roof and lands running.
Llilleall races a train and is home before it reaches the bridge.

name: Sancar
summary: Sancar is a pair of twin cooks who whip up festival snacks and sprint like gales whenever they hold on to each other. Kept apart too long, their pent-up energy locks them together.

feats.scene: Sancar bowls through a stack of barrels while clutching hands.
Sancar bounces off a brick wall mid-sprint and keeps running.
Sancar leaves a trail of steaming dumplings across a whole plaza in an instant.

source_title: Mas y Menos (Teen Titans Go! TV Series)

name: Latasa
summary: Latasa is a chubby-cheeked pair of sprinters who swoon over a starry heroine on a holiday. They zip about the party blowing paper hearts.

feats.scene: Latasa tears across a party hall and flips a table of cupcakes.
Latasa crashes into a balloon wall and giggles.
Latasa zips between guests faster than the eye can follow.

source_title: Mas y Menos (Teen Titans TV Series: Tween Titans)

name: Cornceo
summary: Cornceo is a devoted husband and father betrayed by his jealous brother. Bound inside a cursed blade, he is forced to fight the woman he loves and finally frees himself by choosing to die.

feats.scene: Cornceo cleaves through a stone pillar with a single blade stroke.
Cornceo rises from an undead state and walks through a fusillade.

name: Sauntsia
summary: Sauntsia is a corrupt detective who steals gadgets from the evidence room and poses as several wanted criminals at once. His own partner and a speedy hero bring him down.

feats.scene: Sauntsia fires a stolen cannon and blows a hole in a parked van.
Sauntsia takes a tackle from his partner and keeps swinging.

name: Telnti
summary: Telnti is a bald career criminal who prowls a faraway continent with pistols and a fierce reputation. He relies on blunt fists and steady aim.

feats.scene: Telnti fires a pistol and shatters a bottle at forty paces.
Telnti takes a rifle butt to the jaw and answers with a grin.

name: Ntocar
summary: Ntocar is a masked brown-haired crook who plagues a speedy rival with one grand scheme. Little else is recorded about him.

feats.scene: Ntocar swings a crowbar into a shop shutter and bends it.
Ntocar takes a thrown chair across the back and runs on.

name: Stintna
summary: Stintna is a blond conqueror from an ancient vanished people who bends minds, steps across space and freezes bodies in endless sleep. He sets up a throne among four warlords on a hot continent.

feats.scene: Stintna sweeps a hundred soldiers into a trance with a single glance.
Stintna shrugs off a volley of cannon fire from a siege line.

name: Iumselia
summary: Iumselia is a retired lorry driver and carpenter who once idolised an ear-snipping vigilante. He befriends a neighbour, takes up the old costume himself and gives it up after a short, clumsy run.

feats.scene: Iumselia hammers a nail through a plank in one swing.
Iumselia is knocked off a ladder and laughs with the crowd.

name: Auiaia
summary: Auiaia is a pirate who builds a secret base in a ruined undersea city and raids supply ships with flying submarines. He is later a general in a grim army.

feats.scene: Auiaia sinks a laden freighter with a salvo of torpedoes.
Auiaia rides out a depth charge blast inside his armoured dome.

name: Misar
summary: Misar is a red-skinned wanderer who kills across the stars for sport and reads the twitch of a foe's nerves. He once pummels the city's champion before carrying away a fallen companion.

feats.scene: Misar punches an armoured vehicle through a shop front.
Misar stands through a barrage of hard blows and shrugs.

name: Amtonol
summary: Amtonol is a gloomy schemer who flies a weaponised airliner and lobs atomic darkness pellets. The black fog they release expands and eats away at metal and stone.

feats.scene: Amtonol drops a pellet that smothers a whole rail yard in corrosive murk.
Amtonol rides out a burst of anti-aircraft fire in his armoured cabin.

name: Llunaute
summary: Llunaute is a masked militiaman who hides in a capital's alleys and trades in whispers. Few details of his past survive.

feats.scene: Llunaute vaults a fence and lands a boot on a pursuer's chest.
Llunaute shrugs off a tumble from a loading dock.

name: Natelci
summary: Natelci is a dark-haired schemer who plans one big heist against a band of adventurers. His cunning is his only real weapon.

feats.scene: Natelci throws a wrench through a control-room window.
Natelci stumbles through a smoke-filled hall and keeps barking orders.

name: Oraeo
summary: Oraeo is an alien tinkerer who flies a scout vessel and builds clever gadgets for a raid on a team of heroes. His invasion ends in a single afternoon.

feats.scene: Oraeo fires his scout vessel's cannon and cracks a mountain ledge.
Oraeo weathers a hard landing in the wreck of his scout.

name: Telalle
summary: Telalle is a cursed mercenary who cannot die and must devour the souls of those he kills. He carries pistols and curved blades and drifts between cities.

feats.scene: Telalle slices a steel pipe in two with a sword swing.
Telalle rises again after a fall from a high bridge.

name: Careonria
summary: Careonria is a sky-born clone made from damaged blueprints whose face twisted over the years. He serves a masked schemer and fights with raw skill and a dull mind.

feats.scene: Careonria slams a fist into a steel gate and folds it like paper.
Careonria stands through a rocket strike without a mark.

name: Ronsti
summary: Ronsti is a thug who turns ordinary kitchen matches into traps, distractions and calling cards. He ambushes patrolmen until a masked hero and his dog sit him in a puddle.

feats.scene: Ronsti punches a patrolman cold and flicks a match onto the kerb.
Ronsti takes a fall into a puddle with scorched trousers.

name: Roniunto
summary: Roniunto is a smug web mogul who pairs lonely users with the worst predators and broadcasts the results. His empire collapses when a trio of rescuers tears it down.

feats.scene: Roniunto slaps a tablet onto a glass desk.
Roniunto stays upright through a shove in an elevator.

name: Stotist
summary: Stotist is a short-tempered general who seizes an island nation and dreams of unleashing a monster on bigger powers. His ruthless streak shows even toward the old friend who raised him up.

feats.scene: Stotist fires a pistol at a portrait and shatters the frame.
Stotist keeps ranting after a fist to the jaw.

name: Rnvisa
summary: Rnvisa is a grey dolphin who swims beside a sea king in a world where dinosaurs never died out. She loves a good chase through coral.

feats.scene: Rnvisa rams a shark in the flank and sends it spinning.
Rnvisa survives a heavy wave crash against a reef.

name: Taliu
summary: Taliu is a ragged former agent who sleeps on the stairs of an abandoned office and flinches at every stranger. He mutters that nobody cares about odd cases any more.

feats.scene: Taliu throws a bottle at a wall and covers his head.
Taliu bolts down a stairwell and tumbles without a scratch.

source_title: Matt Ritter (Superboy TV Series: Roads Not Taken)

name: Anllutir
summary: Anllutir is a former spy who died when his support was cut, then came back as the sarcastic bird companion of a dream king. He flits through a ghostly castle and gives advice nobody asked for.

feats.scene: Anllutir dives and pecks a thief's hand open.
Anllutir returns from the grave and brushes off his feathers.

name: Tirnllu
summary: Tirnllu is a reborn bird whose body can grow into any plant form, spread wings, mend itself and stretch from tiny to tower height. His mind can leap to any leaf in existence.

feats.scene: Tirnllu raises a forest wall that hurls a siege tower from its path.
Tirnllu regrows a torn limb of vines after a blast of fire.

name: Nauron
summary: Nauron is a sarcastic former human turned into a black bird who serves a dream lord. He rebuilds a kingdom of visions and distrusts people on principle.

feats.scene: Nauron digs his talons into a thief's sleeve and pulls.
Nauron is swatted from a ledge and flaps back up unhurt.

name: Valstotis
summary: Valstotis is a blond fighter raised in a secret compound who moves objects with his mind and rises into the air. He reads thoughts and strikes with trained skill.

feats.scene: Valstotis hurls a parked car through a wall with a glare.
Valstotis takes a hard slam into a concrete pillar and stands.

name: Allaste
summary: Allaste is a clay-bodied crime fighter on a mirror world who teams up with a brilliant inventor. Together they catch two crooks and reform them with machines.

feats.scene: Allaste shapes his arm into a mallet and smashes a lockbox.
Allaste melts back together after a blow from a thug's pipe.

name: Seosesneo
summary: Seosesneo is a treasure diver who bathes in a strange pool and turns into shifting clay. He steals for profit and needs a regular dip to keep his gift.

feats.scene: Seosesneo shapes both fists into hammers and wrecks a vault door.
Seosesneo reforms from a flattened puddle after a drop from a roof.

name: Tentoeo
summary: Tentoeo is a dark-haired newsman with a grudge against a band of earth-mystics. He is a minor menace with a camera and a loud voice.

feats.scene: Tentoeo swings a camera bag into a rival's shoulder.
Tentoeo falls on a wet pavement and keeps filming.

name: Telantiu
summary: Telantiu is a hired muscle man with a snaky tentacle that slides from one eye socket. He bullies a doctor until she turns frosty and nearly ends him.

feats.scene: Telantiu whips his eye-tentacle across a table and cracks the top.
Telantiu shrugs off a frozen shove and slinks away.

name: Auosatir
summary: Auosatir is a student with no memory who was fished from the sea after falling from the sky. He picked his own name from an old rhyme and pitches in whenever a barn is burning.

feats.scene: Auosatir hauls a hose across a yard and douses a barn wall.
Auosatir survives a long plunge into open water.

name: Arsater
summary: Arsater is a being of living quantum fire who sees what was and what will be. He soars, slips through walls, absorbs energy and hurls it back.

feats.scene: Arsater fires a beam through a mountain-sized slab of rock.
Arsater absorbs a volley of blasts and glows brighter.
Arsater flashes across a harbour and is gone before the wake forms.

name: Rnanutor
summary: Rnanutor is a young keeper of the flow of hours who grew up in a different future. He helps found a band that guards the stream of events from tampering.

feats.scene: Rnanutor hurls a ball of warped time that unstitches a bridge.
Rnanutor stands inside a ruptured machine core as it breaks apart.

name: Rnotaiu
summary: Rnotaiu is a trail boss who herds cattle across wide plains with a tough crew. He once pulls a lost traveller from a stampede and helps recover a deadly device.

feats.scene: Rnotaiu fires his rifle and drops a charging steer's hat.
Rnotaiu is thrown by a horse and gets right back in the saddle.

name: Leotaco
summary: Leotaco is a stern field commander who leads a squad of misfit monsters on dangerous missions. He barks orders and trusts his men.

feats.scene: Leotaco fires a rifle volley across a trench.
Leotaco is knocked flat by a blast and stands to give orders.

source_title: Matthew Shrieve (The Brave and the Bold)

name: Amamniu
summary: Amamniu is a blond hired gun based in a river capital who works for a vengeful boss. A hero lets him go, and his employers punish him for it.

feats.scene: Amamniu fires a pistol round through a hotel window.
Amamniu takes a sharp kick to the ribs and runs off.

name: Ernnute
summary: Ernnute is a lonely boy given an ancient charm that feeds on belief and grants him god-like might. The more his followers trust him, the stronger he grows, and he lashes out at every grown-up.

feats.scene: Ernnute reshapes a whole street with a wave of his hand.
Ernnute withstands a hail of rockets and giggles.

name: Tumva
summary: Tumva is a precinct captain who runs a busy station with patience and a dry sense of humour. Two lieutenants answer to him.

feats.scene: Tumva slams a desk drawer shut with a bang.
Tumva walks off a bruising fall on wet pavement.

name: Laore
summary: Laore is a teenage heir to a crime boss's empire who is more interested in being left alone than inheriting a throne. His family name follows him wherever he goes.

feats.scene: Laore throws a rolled-up jacket across a hallway.
Laore takes a shove into a locker and keeps his temper.

name: Vivaeor
summary: Vivaeor is a towering orange machine colony grown from borrowed human code who can step through the ages. A careless leap breaks his order and leaves a mess.

feats.scene: Vivaeor stamps through a bunker wall in a single hammer blow.
Vivaeor shrugs off a salvo of heavy shells with his metal frame.

name: Lonvint
summary: Lonvint is a rich boy who idolised an orphaned hero so deeply that he had his own parents killed. He carves their names into his cheeks and calls himself by a servant's pet name.

feats.scene: Lonvint scratches a headstone with a stone.
Lonvint sits through a long night in a cold cell.

name: Anuriore
summary: Anuriore is a black marketeer fused with a meteor-borne alien who takes control of his body. Together they crush a prosecutor's career and brawl in the capital's streets.

feats.scene: Anuriore smashes a tram car sideways with a swing of his arm.
Anuriore walks through a burst of gunfire in the street.

name: Niaseora
summary: Niaseora is an old stage performer and escape artist who can pick any lock. She fusses over her grandson's flat and scolds him for ignoring family.

feats.scene: Niaseora twists a hairpin and clicks open a padlock.
Niaseora wriggles out of a knotted rope in under a minute.

name: Stone
summary: Stone is a blond single mother who raises her son alone and nurtures his art. She is proud of him, and she is once threatened and later struck by a strange illness.

feats.scene: Stone shuts a car door with a slam.
Stone keeps cooking dinner through a day of fever.

name: Lonrn
summary: Lonrn is a hairless schemer who works the wet docks of a fog-bound harbour, trailing a sour stench that unsettles anyone who tries to follow. Lonrn survives on cunning and a lead pipe, never on raw power.

feats.scene: Lonrn cracks a crate lid with one swing of a lead pipe.
Lonrn drops from a loading gantry onto wet planks and limps away.

name: Rntortis
summary: Rntortis is a quiet archivist in a provincial museum who reads old notebooks for fun. When strange events begin, Rntortis calls for outside help rather than fighting, trusting patience and books over muscle.

feats.scene: Rntortis slams a heavy display case lid shut to protect a manuscript.
Rntortis tumbles down a short staircase carrying an armful of folios.

name: Naleol
summary: Naleol is a heating engineer who bored a deep shaft over a thermal vent and learned to trigger eruptions along a whole mountain chain. Naleol planned to rule the peaks as a private realm, backed only by pipes and valves.

feats.scene: Naleol opens the vent valves and a ridge erupts in a column of ash and stone.
Naleol hurls himself down the drill shaft rather than face capture.

name: Lenvalor
summary: Lenvalor is an eight-foot warlord forged from five dead butchers fused into a single body, carrying a pistol in each of ten arms. Lenvalor cannot be harmed by ordinary weapons, and answers only to a council of gun-spirits.

feats.scene: Lenvalor empties ten pistols at once and shreds the front of a tenement.
Lenvalor stands unhurt as a truck rams him and folds around his chest.

name: Tanstnan
summary: Tanstnan is a winged horse with a single horn, given as a pledge of loyalty to a young gem-realm princess. Tanstnan carries a rider across the sky and has no voice but a ringing whinny.

feats.scene: Tanstnan rears and strikes a bandit sword aside with a hoof.
Tanstnan flies through a hail of crystal shards and lands unscathed.
Tanstnan dives from the clouds to snatch a falling rider.

name: Rninanam
summary: Rninanam is a dismissed city policeman who now prowls rooftops with a cudgel, beating small-time thieves far past any reasonable limit. Rninanam is brutal, bitter and entirely mortal.

feats.scene: Rninanam clubs a fleeing thief off a fire escape with a single blow.
Rninanam crashes through a skylight and stands up swinging.

name: Serluasi
summary: Serluasi is a circus tumbler who murdered a teacher for a lightweight inflatable cape, then used it to glide through night raids. Serluasi is humbled when a strong wind hurls the glider into open water.

feats.scene: Serluasi swings a pistol butt into a watchman and glides off a ledge.
Serluasi is snatched by a gale and tumbles hundreds of metres into the surf.
Serluasi rides a thermal off a skyscraper and crosses a plaza in seconds.

name: Milcose
summary: Milcose is a drilled field soldier sent after a fugitive sibling, trained in rifles and close-quarters fighting. After death, an alien parasite wears the corpse, leaving Milcose a puppet that begs for a final mercy.

feats.scene: Milcose fires a rifle burst through a windshield from a moving jeep.
Milcose takes a rifle-butt to the jaw and keeps pressing forward.

name: Torvorso
summary: Torvorso is a bio-engineer jailed for fatal experiments, who rebuilt his own body into something beyond ordinary. Torvorso leads a band of freaks under the thumb of a secret patron.

feats.scene: Torvorso overturns a laboratory bench of steel and spills it across the floor.
Torvorso walks away from a collapsing storage shelf with only bruises.

name: Saustnu
summary: Saustnu is a young illustrator who spends nights inking covers for other people's stories. Saustnu has no powers, just a steady hand and a restless eye.

feats.scene: Saustnu shoves a stuck studio door open with a shoulder.
Saustnu slips on wet pavement and gets up laughing.

name: Reotanca
summary: Reotanca is a wandering elder who channels a river of pure motion, mentoring youths who burn too fast. Reotanca runs with calm precision, trading raw speed for patient craft.

feats.scene: Reotanca vaults down a canyon road and flattens a boulder with a single running punch.
Reotanca runs through a wall of flame and emerges with singed cloth only.
Reotanca crosses a desert valley before a thrown stone lands.

name: Rennus
summary: Rennus began as a contract killer sentenced to the chair, then was reshaped by a field of quantum energy into a terrifying new being. Rennus hunts his old employers and fights a glowing soldier to a standstill.

feats.scene: Rennus tears the roof off a mansion with a single heave.
Rennus shrugs off an energy blast that melts a squad car.

name: Stistta
summary: Stistta is a tall, flame-haired monarch of a distant world who chases the one man she judges worthy. Stistta fights alongside a team of heroes and is flattened by a brutal monster, yet keeps her crown and her pride.

feats.scene: Stistta punches a cruiser from orbit and leaves a crater the size of a district.
Stistta is knocked senseless by a beast's blows yet her bones hold.

name: Tiltor
summary: Tiltor is a married criminal with a god complex who carries a rod crackling with discharge. Tiltor is a peak athlete and tactician whose body is hijacked during a long plot, and he ends up in custody.

feats.scene: Tiltor thrusts the rod and blasts a steel door off its hinges.
Tiltor is pulled from the wreckage of a collapsed ward with broken ribs.

name: Nensauau
summary: Nensauau is a small child who commands living flesh and hears a vast chorus of animals calling from a hidden realm. Nensauau raises the bodies of dead pets and acts as the chosen vessel of a primal life force.

feats.scene: Nensauau coaxes a dozen corpses to rise and march across a lawn.
Nensauau steps through a swarm of thorned vines without a scratch.

name: Rumra
summary: Rumra is a tiny green worm that gnawed through a vault of spellbooks and swallowed their lore. Rumra reads minds from afar and hungers for every scrap of magic in the world.

feats.scene: Rumra releases a stolen spell and levels a stone watchtower.
Rumra, no longer than a finger, survives being crushed under a heavy boot.

name: Rusnin
summary: Rusnin is a sergeant who trained to match a famous sibling and became an expert with firearms. Rusnin serves in a covert team as a stand-in, and dies in a field mission.

feats.scene: Rusnin fires a rifle through a narrow gap and drops a distant sentry.
Rusnin takes a stray round to the vest and keeps firing.

name: Naucelrau
summary: Naucelrau is a single detective on a big-city force who works long nights over cold files. Naucelrau relies on notebooks and instinct, with no special gifts.

feats.scene: Naucelrau tackles a suspect on a stairwell landing.
Naucelrau rolls down a ramp after a missed grab and gets up.

name: Tiltel
summary: Tiltel is a small-statured acrobat who left a bank job in guilt and found work among travelling performers. Tiltel is nimble, brave and loyal to a restless ghost.

feats.scene: Tiltel vaults off a trampoline and kicks a lantern from a thug's hand.
Tiltel lands badly from a trapeze and rolls to his feet.

name: Selorral
summary: Selorral is a mind-reader and agent of a secret agency who pulls memories from kidnapped witnesses and tortures a rival with visions. Selorral uses a machine to rebuild a hero's body from photographs.

feats.scene: Selorral aims a pistol at a hostage while prying into her memories.
Selorral is forced into a limousine at gunpoint and bears the beating.

name: Serrau
summary: Serrau is a respected elder whose only trace is a mention in a family tree of an ambitious dynasty. Serrau has no known deeds beyond fatherhood and a quiet end.

feats.scene: Serrau slaps a stuck window open in an old house.
Serrau falls from a porch step and bruises a knee.

name: Colaunau
summary: Colaunau is a beloved monarch of a united northern kingdom whose weakness for one woman invites assassination. Colaunau dies to a single arrow from a hired killer, and a vengeful spell turns the land to endless winter.

feats.scene: Colaunau swings a ceremonial blade and splits a banquet table.
Colaunau is pierced through the throat by a distant bowshot.

source_title: Maxwell of the Clan Lord (Dark Knights of Steel)

name: Storaurn
summary: Storaurn is a bitter weapons expert who runs a junkyard of discarded arms and builds a copy-android and a clanking robot. Storaurn dies in a fight with his own copy.

feats.scene: Storaurn fires a salvaged cannon and blows a wreck in half.
Storaurn is bowled over by his own android and left for dead.

name: Iumcenen
summary: Iumcenen is the tiny ruler of a green people that lives in a pocket world reached by passing through plants. Iumcenen is kidnapped by a scheming exile and later helps outwit him with disguises.

feats.scene: Iumcenen calls vines to bind a pair of kidnappers.
Iumcenen survives a tumble from a branch with only a bruise.

name: Valtinen
summary: Valtinen is a shunned girl who commands plant life and joins a patriotic strike team. Valtinen binds foes in vines but suffers a jolt when her plants are cut.

feats.scene: Valtinen raises a thicket of vines that pins an armoured fighter.
Valtinen reels from a backlash as her vines are torched.

name: Ceilau
summary: Ceilau is a red-haired outlaw who skulks in the margins of a team's early cases. Ceilau leaves no clear mark beyond a handful of scuffles.

feats.scene: Ceilau throws a punch at a pursuing guard on a fire stair.
Ceilau drops from a low roof and runs off.

name: Tiventi
summary: Tiventi is a bald civic leader who stands before cameras to unveil a clean-energy rail project. Tiventi is polite, cheerful and in no danger.

feats.scene: Tiventi cuts a ribbon with a ceremonial blade.
Tiventi stumbles on the dais steps and recovers with a smile.

name: Liastinau
summary: Liastinau is a white-haired lawyer turned civic leader who buries a witness and frames his widow. Liastinau cons a whole police office until a masked heroine unravels his scheme.

feats.scene: Liastinau slams a heavy ledger onto a desk to silence a clerk.
Liastinau is hauled out of his office by two officers.

name: Eoluori
summary: Eoluori is a hard-line civic leader who ran on a pledge to crush wrongdoing in a gloomy metropolis. Eoluori clashes with a stubborn lieutenant and a young prosecutor.

feats.scene: Eoluori pounds a podium to punctuate a speech.
Eoluori shoves through a crowd of protesters unhurt.

name: Anuanucor
summary: Anuanucor is a grinning tyrant who rules a conquered metropolis in a nightmare timeline, proclaiming that no law applies. Anuanucor runs a cruel game in which citizens wear masks and are hunted for sport.

feats.scene: Anuanucor swings a crowbar through a shop window to open the hunt.
Anuanucor takes a thrown brick to the face and laughs on.

name: Reoresto
summary: Reoresto is an aged vigilante from a darker timeline who retired after losing a child and took up civic office instead. Reoresto is murdered mid-speech by a visitor from another world.

feats.scene: Reoresto throws a harness hook that stops a mugger in his tracks.
Reoresto absorbs a rooftop fall and keeps going.

name: Serres
summary: Serres is a sharp young prosecutor who dislikes rule-bending crusaders and quietly loves a newspaper reporter. Serres dies in a car bomb and spends her last breath realizing a hidden truth.

feats.scene: Serres slaps a case file onto a judge's bench.
Serres is thrown from her car by a blast and lives long enough to speak.

name: Iutorile
summary: Iutorile is a demon-born queen of an infernal kingdom who once served a fallen ruler as barkeep and bodyguard. Iutorile hides half her face and carries an old anger from long exile.

feats.scene: Iutorile punches a barred gate off its hinges in a single blow.
Iutorile walks out of a furnace blast with only scorch marks.

name: Leoesst
summary: Leoesst is a grey-skinned demon lieutenant who cannot die, with lightning reflexes and bone-breaking strength. Leoesst excels at threats, blades and interrogation.

feats.scene: Leoesst hurls a car into a barricade and crumples both.
Leoesst takes a collapsing wall on her back and stands up.

name: Sicocil
summary: Sicocil is a white-haired ruler of a people who live below the surface, and spouse of an adventuring driller. Sicocil dies in the first chapter of her tale, leaving a daughter behind.

feats.scene: Sicocil pushes a stone door open in a cavern hall.
Sicocil bears a cave-in of loose gravel across her shoulders.

name: Lantesor
summary: Lantesor is an android built to wear the memories of a lost queen, in order to help calm a monstrous whisperer. Lantesor flies, hurls rock with a thought, reads minds and shrugs off blows.

feats.scene: Lantesor wrenches a slab of bedrock from the cavern wall and hurls it.
Lantesor withstands a rockfall that buries a truck.
Lantesor streaks up a shaft in a single breath.

name: Ortis
summary: Ortis is a masked thug in a grim future city, bulked up by a stimulant that dulls pain and swells muscle. Ortis runs with a gang that likes laughter and chaos.

feats.scene: Ortis folds a steel railing around a fleeing bystander.
Ortis is struck by a speeding van and gets up snarling.

name: Oluvais
summary: Oluvais is a blue-skinned mind-doctor of a galactic ring corps, who mends frazzled warriors. Oluvais wields a will-driven ring that makes constructs, shields and bolts of light, and once staged a trial for a doubtful veteran.

feats.scene: Oluvais shapes a green ram of light and flattens a block of derelict towers.
Oluvais raises a ring shield against a falling gantry.

name: Ntoasau
summary: Ntoasau is a sleek black cat who has crossed centuries on his mistress's shoulder. Ntoasau sleeps on spellbooks and cares nothing for conquest.

feats.scene: Ntoasau swats a feather duster off a shelf.
Ntoasau lands a drop from a bookcase on four feet.

name: Celraamo
summary: Celraamo is an ink-drawn robot boy, brushed into life by a painter-villain to harass a team. Celraamo flies on rocket boots but is dissolved by water.

feats.scene: Celraamo dives into a street lamp and bends it double.
Celraamo is smudged by a fist but reforms and flies on.
Celraamo darts between rooftops before a camera can focus.

name: Nauleosau
summary: Nauleosau is an anonymous tinkerer who fixes engines and gadgets for a pair of costumed locals. Nauleosau has no flashy gifts but keeps the toolbox ready.

feats.scene: Nauleosau cranks a seized engine back to life with a wrench.
Nauleosau slides under a rolling cart and escapes with grease only.

name: Vaiumor
summary: Vaiumor is a white-haired rural saboteur who builds clanking contraptions in a barn. Vaiumor appears once and is never seen again.

feats.scene: Vaiumor starts a grain thresher that tears a fence apart.
Vaiumor tumbles off a hay wagon and runs on.

name: Nunorseo
summary: Nunorseo is a white-haired tinkerer of wartime gadgets who wars on a winged hunter. Nunorseo crafts brittle machines that clatter loudly before they fail.

feats.scene: Nunorseo drives a steam-rig into a brick wall and caves it in.
Nunorseo is flung from a cart seat and bounces upright.

name: Terlormi
summary: Terlormi is a trained warrior officer from an island of fighting women, skilled in bows, riding and blades. Terlormi leads a squad in a war of gods and holds her ground against divine foes.

feats.scene: Terlormi looses an arrow that pins a raider's shield to a gate.
Terlormi takes a war-club blow on her shield and keeps her feet.

name: Oreluent
summary: Oreluent is a green-eyed, hairless plant-folk guardian of a space-police corps in a comic cartoon galaxy. Oreluent carries a ring and a charging battery and flies into trouble with a silly grin.

feats.scene: Oreluent shapes a glowing boxing glove and bats a freighter off course.
Oreluent raises a bubble of light and weathers a comet's graze.

name: Tanlint
summary: Tanlint is a black-eyed, bald guardian drawn from a vast roster of ring-bearers, one of thousands in a policing corps. Tanlint relies on stubborn will to shape light into shields and blasts.

feats.scene: Tanlint hammers a pirate ship with a lance of green light and splits its hull.
Tanlint holds a shimmering barrier against a cannonade.

name: Antes
summary: Antes is a veteran orange-skinned plant being, among the earliest recruited to a cosmic police order, and a mentor to rookies. Antes calms a rampaging swarm-mind by weaving a dazzling cage of light.

feats.scene: Antes forms a luminous net that cages a roaring swamp colossus.
Antes endures a surge of tangled minds without breaking his focus.
Antes crosses a continent of forest in a handful of seconds.

name: Riacortum
summary: Riacortum is the last ring-bearer sent to a planet gripped by rot, captured by a thorned villain and rescued by a patchwork army. Riacortum recovers his stolen power cell from a hidden stone sphere.

feats.scene: Riacortum blasts a path through a wall of rotting vines with a green beam.
Riacortum is bound in a cage of thorns and endures the squeeze.

name: Telronan
summary: Telronan is a hairless, green-eyed ring-bearer who bursts into a campy adventure with a starry sash of light. Telronan fights beside a cowled hero in a bright animated series.

feats.scene: Telronan hurls a giant mallet of light that pounds a rogue robot flat.
Telronan bounces off a bursting tank and shrugs.

name: Liauco
summary: Liauco is a small blond ring-bearer from a toddler-sized comedy, who flies around a classroom-sized world with a glowing battery. Liauco is cheerful, well-meaning and a little clumsy.

feats.scene: Liauco shapes a green swing and launches a friend across a playground.
Liauco bumps into a cardboard wall and sheds the dent in a blink.

name: Siillin
summary: Siillin is a snake-haired immortal revived to be a secret weapon, who turned on her masters and chose destruction. Siillin petrifies by gaze, bites with venom, and drinks a formula that swells her to a giant.

feats.scene: Siillin grows to colossal size and stomps a temple colonnade to rubble.
Siillin shrugs off a volley of spears and sword strokes.

name: Stveores
summary: Stveores is a brown-skinned, white-eyed sea-hag who dwells in a pit of the dead and freezes the living into statues with a look. Stveores appears in an online action game as a foe for hordes of players.

feats.scene: Stveores glares at a charging soldier and he hardens to granite mid-stride.
Stveores endures a barrage of blows from a crowd without flinching.

name: Ntnere
summary: Ntnere is a green-skinned deathless goddess with yellow eyes who reshapes flesh with a look and conjures shields of force. Ntnere is an actor of deception who appears in a digital family adventure.

feats.scene: Ntnere stares at a stone bridge and it turns to flesh, then crumbles.
Ntnere stands unharmed behind a shield of force as a tower falls.

name: Nanlate
summary: Nanlate is a grey-haired commander of a rebel band on an undersea frontier, who turned to violence after peaceful marches failed. Nanlate frames a young man for a bombing to draw him into the struggle.

feats.scene: Nanlate fires a rifle volley at a patrol and drops its leader.
Nanlate endures a blast of shrapnel and keeps rallying her troops.

name: Ntnesel
summary: Ntnesel is a stern college head whose campus hides secret tunnels and labs for a band of student spies. Ntnesel scolds a general over reckless missions and stands up for her girls.

feats.scene: Ntnesel raps a ruler on a desk and silences a hall of students.
Ntnesel is shoved by an attacker and holds her ground.

name: Sevael
summary: Sevael is a winged, clawed spirit of vengeance, one of three sisters who hound wrongdoers. Sevael flies in packs and can share and trade strength with her kin.

feats.scene: Sevael tears through a bell tower with taloned fists.
Sevael weathers a barrage of lightning from a storm cloud.

name: Minineo
summary: Minineo is a villainous double of a shape-changing hero, glimpsed on a list of henchmen in a mirror world. Minineo is never named on screen and appears only briefly.

feats.scene: Minineo swells a fist into a boulder and smashes a gate.
Minineo reforms after being cut by a heavy blade.

source_title: Megamorpho (Crisis on Two Earths: Crime Syndicate Earth)

name: Strnrn
summary: Strnrn is a red-haired assistant grown in a lab to serve a scientist, who clones heroes to avenge his death. Strnrn kills her own copies and herself, then is reborn as a toddler to start again.

feats.scene: Strnrn turns a fire axe on a cloned soldier and ends the fight.
Strnrn is flung down a stair and crawls onward.

name: Neoeocol
summary: Neoeocol is a jungle-war survivor who nurses a wounded soldier back to health and later marries into a powerful house. Neoeocol raises a son and helps a husband quiet his rage.

feats.scene: Neoeocol hauls a wounded man onto a cart.
Neoeocol endures a long march through monsoon mud.

name: Corluani
summary: Corluani is a mother with an unsteady sight into the future, who warns of a coming wave. Corluani sends her child and husband to safety and perishes with her younger sons.

feats.scene: Corluani pushes her daughter out the door ahead of a surge.
Corluani faces a rising flood and cannot hold against it.

name: Nanlentan
summary: Nanlentan is a loner from a farming world, born without a twin, who is charged with electricity by native storm-beasts after a crash. Nanlentan turns to banditry across the stars.

feats.scene: Nanlentan flings a bolt that flattens a silo and a fence of stone.
Nanlentan absorbs a counter-jolt and stands up smiling.

name: Ntonttau
summary: Ntonttau is a red-and-white-haired elder sibling, an outcast among paired siblings, who rages through the centuries as a founder of a villain league. Ntonttau commands lightning to terrorise worlds.

feats.scene: Ntonttau hurls a crackling arc that vaporises a hillside.
Ntonttau shakes off a stun blast that fells a squad of guards.

name: Stase
summary: Stase is a red-haired seer who dwells in a land of dreams and sees events far away. Stase serves a league of heroes in an alternate telling and is the child of a cosmic father.

feats.scene: Stase focuses and a dream-lantern bursts open before her.
Stase wades through a storm of dream-sand unharmed.

name: Lenva
summary: Lenva is a brown-eyed wife of an ancient immortal, who watches her adopted foster-son grow dark. Lenva falls into a forbidden pool and dies in front of her child.

feats.scene: Lenva pulls a heavy tapestry aside to reveal a hidden room.
Lenva is shoved into a bubbling basin and cannot climb out.

name: Rntinlli
summary: Rntinlli is a young star-reader at a charity music night, who falls for an older accountant and bears his child. Rntinlli is later cast aside, and shouts her name to her grown daughter.

feats.scene: Rntinlli throws a book of star charts at a retreating guard.
Rntinlli is dragged off by two guards and keeps shouting.

name: Llura
summary: Llura is a campus sorceress who swells into a vast bee and runs a sorority of brainwashed thralls fed with enchanted drinks. Llura smiles as she befriends rivals before turning them into hive-slaves.

feats.scene: Llura swells into a huge bee and pins a rival to a dormitory wall.
Llura endures a spell of flame in the common room and buzzes on.

name: Niltorsti
summary: Niltorsti is a brown-haired chemist whose lab accident left a trace of radiation and a mysterious new name. Niltorsti stalks the edges of a hooded vigilante's adventures.

feats.scene: Niltorsti flings a flask of glowing fluid and cracks a window.
Niltorsti collapses in a cloud of vapour and rises dazed.

name: Iasserer
summary: Iasserer is a red-haired student, descended from an ancient winged forebear, who can fly on feathered wings. Iasserer is a rich man's son who is liked by his classmates.

feats.scene: Iasserer flaps hard and knocks a bully off a ledge.
Iasserer plunges from a rooftop and glides to a rough landing.
Iasserer flaps across a quad faster than a sprinter.

name: Nanretas
summary: Nanretas is a seer among an island warrior sisterhood who foretells a dark prophecy about a rival's child. Nanretas is mentioned in a fleeting scene and speaks in riddles.

feats.scene: Nanretas throws open a temple shutter at dawn and stares at the sky.
Nanretas swoons under a rush of visions and recovers.

name: Linurn
summary: Linurn is a red-haired oracle who witnesses a child's birth and sees a war that will shake all things. Linurn is struck down by an envious sister before she can warn the others.

feats.scene: Linurn lifts a newborn from a birthing bed and recoils from a vision.
Linurn is cut down by a sister's spear.

name: Tiucano
summary: Tiucano is a married king of a stern warrior city who figures in an ancient siege. Tiucano is a brown-haired ruler whose name is remembered rather than his deeds.

feats.scene: Tiucano drives a spear through a bronze shield.
Tiucano takes a sword blow on his cuirass and answers in kind.

name: Raurn
summary: Raurn is a red-haired sea queen in a stylised cartoon world, wielding a weapon, speaking to ocean life with her mind. Raurn rules a drowned city in the company of a half-sister.

feats.scene: Raurn thrusts a trident and splits a harbour breakwater.
Raurn is thrown into a pier and swims away unharmed.

name: Reoamo
summary: Reoamo is a green-eyed sea sorceress who commands water and ice, and wears machine parts grafted by a tyrant. Reoamo was brainwashed into servitude and later broke free.

feats.scene: Reoamo flash-freezes a harbour and shatters it with one thrust.
Reoamo withstands a falling crane and strikes back at once.

name: Ortelva
summary: Ortelva is a secret sea queen who joins a wartime alliance of young heroines, and fights submarines and a tentacled beast. Ortelva loses much of her strength after a long, bitter campaign.

feats.scene: Ortelva calls a wall of surf that overturns a gunboat.
Ortelva is drained by exhaustion and fights on.

name: Iartalra
summary: Iartalra is a widowed queen of a sunken kingdom who sneaks past guards and swings a heavy mace at traitors. Iartalra raises her children in a time of grief and war.

feats.scene: Iartalra swings a mace and caves in a bronze helm.
Iartalra weathers a trooper's charge and shoves him back.

name: Notalst
summary: Notalst is a widowed sea queen who joins a league of survivors in a plague-ravaged timeline. Notalst bends water to her will and tutors the young in the craft of swimming.

feats.scene: Notalst pulls a river up into a flailing, whipping lash.
Notalst staggers from a burst dam and wades on.

name: Nanvor
summary: Nanvor is a black-eyed, red-haired sea queen of an old cartoon, who voices a gentle command from a coral throne. Nanvor is married to a king of the deep.

feats.scene: Nanvor rings a bell of shell to rally her court.
Nanvor takes a net across the shoulders and swims free.

name: Voriumse
summary: Voriumse is a blue-eyed sea queen of a grim alternate world, strong enough to halt a tidal wave when pushed to the limit. Voriumse is tough, hard-handed and wary of oaths.

feats.scene: Voriumse pushes back a towering wave and shatters it against the cliff.
Voriumse takes a falling statue to the back and brushes the dust off.

name: Tesstaium
summary: Tesstaium is a deposed queen from a watery pocket realm who flees to the surface world, meets a sea king and eventually marries him. Tesstaium later wears a crimson ring of rage and endures great loss.

feats.scene: Tesstaium lashes a sea-dragon with a rope of water and drags it ashore.
Tesstaium rides out a typhoon on the open waves.

name: Iucinnte
summary: Iucinnte is a married sea queen who lives for a time on a swampy peninsula, away from her drowned palace. Iucinnte is calm and devoted.

feats.scene: Iucinnte hauls a heavy net into a boat.
Iucinnte swims against a heavy tide and arrives unharmed.

name: Liselli
summary: Liselli is a blond, winged-footed messenger of the high gods, the swiftest among them, who gifts speed to mortal champions. Liselli slips between worlds and can tinker with a car's motor in a few heartbeats.

feats.scene: Liselli streaks past a tower and the wake shatters every pane.
Liselli is hit by a wall of storm winds and merely smiles.
Liselli races a comet across the sky and wins.

name: Nelli
summary: Nelli is a hot-tempered quicksilver machine built by a gifted engineer, who stretches and reshapes at will and wants to lead his siblings. Nelli spars constantly with the cleverest of them.

feats.scene: Nelli hardens into a hammer and caves in a vault door.
Nelli is blasted into puddles by a cannon and flows back together.

name: Raull
summary: Raull is a blue-eyed deity of trade, trickery and travel who delivers swiftness to his chosen champions. Raull knows the shape of all realms, steps between them, and weakens when faith fades.

feats.scene: Raull rushes a mountain gate and the shockwave breaks the cliff.
Raull fetches water from the realm of the dead and returns unscathed.
Raull crosses from sea to summit in the time of a heartbeat.

name: Tauiueo
summary: Tauiueo is a gleaming robot of an animated team-up series, who bursts into the fray with a talkative bravado. Tauiueo bounces off foes in comic fashion and rarely stays down.

feats.scene: Tauiueo pounds a villain's gadget flat with a shining fist.
Tauiueo splashes into a puddle of slag and reforms with a grin.

name: Soton
summary: Soton is a eyeless, silent pool of liquid that crawled from a falling stone, sustained without air and reshaping at will. Soton speaks only in thoughts and turns living things into liquid beings under its control.

feats.scene: Soton engulfs a squad of soldiers in a silvery wave.
Soton re-forms after a blast splits it in two.

name: Ralleial
summary: Ralleial is a green-eyed thief in a grim, mechanised wasteland who plays two masters at once. Ralleial slices, sneaks and lies her way through a rebel hideout.

feats.scene: Ralleial slashes a blade across a guard's strap and drops his shield.
Ralleial tumbles from a gantry and lands rolling.

name: Arleran
summary: Arleran is a six-foot, blond bodyguard of a scheming tycoon, expert with pistols and brawling. Arleran dons a mask for a spell on a team of heroes, then quits when she nearly kills a man.

feats.scene: Arleran fires a pistol through a car window and drops a gunman.
Arleran takes a thrown chair across the back and keeps fighting.

name: Aulrniti
summary: Aulrniti is a bodyguard whose frame was rewritten by a strange radiance into a living suit of weapon-metal. Limbs flow into blades and blasters, and torn flesh seals itself within seconds.

feats.scene: Aulrniti reshapes a palm into a muzzle and melts a bank vault door together with the wall behind it.
Aulrniti walks onward after a steel girder punches through its torso, then the wound knits shut.

name: Vaiumvos
summary: Vaiumvos is a nimble pickpocket who lifts valuables from crowded bazaars on a distant colony world. The thief depends on quick fingers and a forged guild badge, with no special gift at all.

feats.scene: Vaiumvos shoves a guard sideways and vaults a fruit stall to escape.
Vaiumvos tumbles down a long stairway and sprints off without stopping.

name: Rnineliu
summary: Rnineliu is a hard-eyed saboteur who plants charges in transit depots to force political concessions. A tall, patient planner, the saboteur works alone and vanishes after every strike.

feats.scene: Rnineliu detonates a pallet of blasting gel that drops a rail footbridge into the cutting below.
Rnineliu rolls clear of a collapsing scaffold and rises with only bruises.

name: Tuamoll
