summary: Tuamoll is an ageless wizard with a bald head and black eyes who hands out slices of power to chosen champions. The sage shares strength freely, but each gift thins the giver a little.

feats.scene: Tuamoll pours a surge of stored radiance into a crowd of champions and levels a ruined fortress behind them.
Tuamoll stands unmoved as a collapsing tower of black stone breaks across its shoulders.

name: Saranium
summary: Saranium is a white-haired court sage who bends hours and days like soft wax. Gifted with borrowed divine strength, the sage can skip across space and rewrite small facts of the world.

feats.scene: Saranium freezes a whole harbour district mid-motion and unmakes a besieging fleet in one sweep of the hand.
Saranium shrugs off a collapsing cathedral dome by stepping a heartbeat into the past.

source_title: Merlin Ambrosius (The Brave and the Bold)

name: Lellini
summary: Lellini is a sharply dressed racketeer who runs protection rounds for a smuggling syndicate. Vain, loud and heavily guarded, the boss has no powers beyond money and hired muscle.

feats.scene: Lellini slaps a late-paying shopkeeper across the counter and sweeps the till into a satchel.
Lellini takes a bottle across the shoulder in a bar brawl and keeps barking orders.

name: Civito
summary: Civito is a grumpy caretaker with a gourd for a head who sweeps the halls of a realm made of sleep. The worker lasts as long as anyone keeps dreaming, though a hostile spell can still wreck the body.

feats.scene: Civito swings a push broom through a stone gargoyle and cracks it clean in half.
Civito reassembles itself after a bolt of nightmare fire scatters its body across a corridor.

name: Riaela
summary: Riaela is a pale-skinned off-world labourer hired into a corporate task crew after the younger staff were let go. A quiet and sturdy hand, the worker brings the steady strength of a heavy-gravity homeworld.

feats.scene: Riaela hauls a loaded freight sled uphill alone and flips it onto its runners.
Riaela stands in the path of a runaway cart and stops it with a grunt.

name: Cetitas
summary: Cetitas is a purple-eyed villain posing as a hero in a team of racers. The schemer reads thoughts, shoves objects with the mind, and uses both to keep the masquerade intact.

feats.scene: Cetitas lifts a parked hover-truck with a thought and hurls it across a plaza.
Cetitas shakes off a stunning blast that drops a whole rescue squad.

source_title: Meta Ulnoor (Legion of Super-Heroes TV Series)

name: Tauislla
summary: Tauislla is a mind-reader from a frozen moon who was turned away by a hero academy and joined a band of rejects. The psychic can silence another person's thoughts or steer them like a puppet.

feats.scene: Tauislla wipes the thoughts of an entire guard barracks in one pulse and walks through the open gate.
Tauislla endures a brutal mental backlash and still stands to finish the spell.

name: Vasorst
summary: Vasorst is a steel-masked foreign spy who steals blueprints from rival toy makers and small-time inventors. A cold professional, the agent relies on disguise, tradecraft and a hidden pistol.

feats.scene: Vasorst fires a silenced pistol through a locked cabinet door and grabs the plans inside.
Vasorst drops from a second-floor window and melts into the night market.

name: Sttivi
summary: Sttivi is a vicious contract killer in a leather hood fitted with a barbed lash. Impatient to join a masked syndicate, the brute kills anyone who cannot answer a question.

feats.scene: Sttivi cracks the barbed lash across a steel shutter and tears a strip from it.
Sttivi takes a series of heavy blows in a crypt fight and loses only consciousness.

name: Orstes
summary: Orstes is a flag-draped masked patriot who patrols small towns after dark. The hero has strength and nerve in about equal measure, and almost nothing else is known about the past.

feats.scene: Orstes hauls a stalled tractor off a road and sets it on the verge.
Orstes takes a mugger's club to the ribs and finishes the arrest.

name: Elaaunum
summary: Elaaunum is an unaging engineer-scientist from a world of gleaming towers who rides a floating seat packed with instruments. Brilliant and proud, the thinker can hurl beams of force and survive blows that flatten mountains.

feats.scene: Elaaunum fires a lance of force from the floating seat and splits a mountain ridge down to the foothills.
Elaaunum floats out of a collapsing orbital lab without a scratch.

name: Nticonu
summary: Nticonu is a wandering scholar of a godlike lineage who drifts between two rival worlds. Always curious and always sketching machinery, the traveller avoids fights whenever a door can be opened instead.

feats.scene: Nticonu overloads a relay console and blows out the roof of a bunker.
Nticonu rides out a cave-in inside a reinforced travelling capsule.

name: Urnami
summary: Urnami is a hired soldier who wears a bulky powered harness packed with air cannons. The suit lifts the wearer off the ground, boosts muscle and shrugs off small-arms fire.

feats.scene: Urnami hammers an air cannon at a barricade and blows a hole through it.
Urnami takes a full rifle volley on the chest plate and keeps advancing.

name: Rosaulll
summary: Rosaulll is a former test pilot whose body was forced into living rock by a failed deep-space programme. Enormous and slow to forgive, the giant hits like a landslide and takes punishment without flinching.

feats.scene: Rosaulll drives a stone fist through a loading-dock wall and drops half the roof.
Rosaulll weathers a falling crane and stands up from under the wreckage.

name: Limites
summary: Limites is a scheming first-born of a celestial court who envies a famous twin. Silky and patient, the angel draws out fears in others and steers them into rebellion.

feats.scene: Limites burns the gate of a heavenly citadel to cinders with a single glance of white fire.
Limites walks out of a collapsing sky-fortress without a mark.

name: Telcis
summary: Telcis is a bald hulk produced by a secret wartime laboratory that boosted strength and left little else. Hunted for a long string of grim revenge killings, the giant is a lonely tragedy with fists.

feats.scene: Telcis rips a steel door off its hinges and flings it across a corridor.
Telcis takes a point-blank shotgun blast and lunges forward unslowed.

name: Neoma
summary: Neoma is a career bandit who robs jewellery convoys with a loyal crew. The thief grew quiet after a rough stretch in custody and has since put diamond-tipped rounds to nasty use.

feats.scene: Neoma fires jewel-tipped bullets that punch through a patrol car's door.
Neoma shoulders through a glass storefront and keeps running.

name: Stosesiu
summary: Stosesiu is a former surgeon who silenced himself with thread and went on a killing spree, then escaped a fatal injection thanks to strange blood. A grim chemist, the killer brews contagions in prison labs.

feats.scene: Stosesiu seeds a ventilation shaft with a quick-acting contagion and empties a cell block.
Stosesiu survives a lethal dose that drops three other prisoners.

name: Sororne
summary: Sororne is a young heir who wears a gadget-laden costume that scrambles the rules a hero's gifts depend on. Desperate for a parent's approval, the wearer once turned a whole team's own abilities against them.

feats.scene: Sororne tears a vault open with a field that unravels the metal's bonds.
Sororne takes a stunning bolt on the shielded chest and laughs.

name: Saslan
summary: Saslan is a showy time-hopping adventurer in a doomed alternate world, fatally outmatched by a friend turned puppet. A hero to the end, the hopper raised a pistol out of mercy and paid for it.

feats.scene: Saslan fires a gauntlet burst that gouges a trench across a warehouse floor.
Saslan staggers up after a collapsing wall and keeps talking.

name: Nusiumtan
summary: Nusiumtan is a brash entrepreneur-hero who runs information kiosks across two big cities. Bewitched once by a hive queen's pollen, the showman had to be knocked out of a spell by a band of rookies.

feats.scene: Nusiumtan fires a wrist cannon that shatters a stone planter.
Nusiumtan shrugs off a hard tackle from a charmed brute.

name: Llauleon
summary: Llauleon is a young swordsman trained by a gruff uncle to protect a dusty southern town. Brave and bright, the apprentice once helped bring a puzzle-obsessed felon to justice.

feats.scene: Llauleon swings a cutlass through a saloon rope and drops a chandelier on a gang.
Llauleon takes a barrel to the back and bounces back up grinning.

name: Reoreti
summary: Reoreti is a celebrity adventurer who stole advanced gear from the distant future and became a media star. Flashy and perpetually short of cash, the hero has a loyal companion robot and big dreams.

feats.scene: Reoreti blasts a hole in a transport truck with a wrist weapon from across a street.
Reoreti takes a collapsing billboard on the shoulders while shielded by a force dome.

name: Llocor
summary: Llocor is a football star turned time-travelling showman whose gambling scheme led to exile. Loud, funny and secretly brave, the traveller uses stolen future gear to look like a hero.

feats.scene: Llocor flattens a parked van with a blast from a wrist emitter.
Llocor stands up from a rooftop fall thanks to a humming harness.

name: Niternau
summary: Niternau is a seasoned marine commando exposed to an experimental serum that woke faint psychic gifts years later. A hard-bitten freelancer, the veteran fights only for private reasons and no flag.

feats.scene: Niternau fires a rifle grenade that collapses a concrete guard post.
Niternau takes a stray round on body armour and finishes the assault.

name: Liaser
summary: Liaser is a radiant first-born of a creator's court, trusted with the raw force that spun reality out of nothing. Guardian of a great gate, the archangel led a heavenly host until a back-stab ended it.

feats.scene: Liaser unleashes raw creative force and shapes a whole sea of new worlds out of empty dark.
Liaser holds a collapsing realm together with open hands while the sky tears.

name: Mianau
summary: Mianau is a red-haired student who moved in with a father and a new stepfamily. Teased by a prickly stepsister, the teenager hides awkward charm behind sarcasm.

feats.scene: Mianau hurls a school bag across a courtyard and hits a vending machine dead centre.
Mianau slips on wet stairs and lands without a scratch.

name: Inulu
summary: Inulu is a lieutenant on a harbour-city force who had a hunch about an inventor's role in a missing person case. Stubborn and underfunded, the detective never found proof.

feats.scene: Inulu kicks in a warehouse door and covers the room with a service revolver.
Inulu takes a shove down a loading ramp and gets up still talking.

name: Rumlantau
summary: Rumlantau is a ghostly pilot who died in a hangar blast and later fused with a twin to share borrowed power. Bound to his sibling by a birthmark, the spirit supplies courage when the two join.

feats.scene: Rumlantau channels merged power into a punch that caves in a bomber's fuselage.
Rumlantau stands in a burning hangar and walks out unburnt.

name: Tetiva
summary: Tetiva is a teenage wheelchair user who sheltered an unconscious hero in a cellar and nursed her back to strength. Kind and upbeat, the boy proves that courage needs no powers.

feats.scene: Tetiva hauls an unconscious stranger down a ramp using only arm strength.
Tetiva keeps working through a hard fall from the chair onto concrete.

name: Ontornil
summary: Ontornil is a married investigator with a metacrime unit who chases a murdered vigilante's killer. Dogged and honest, the detective shrugs off pressure from higher-ups.

feats.scene: Ontornil tackles a fleeing suspect over a railing and cuffs him.
Ontornil is thrown across a hospital corridor and calls for backup.

name: Tiuautel
summary: Tiuautel is a brilliant inventor-hero who stays active when all powers around fade. Armed with floating sensor orbs and a razor mind, the genius outsmarts stronger rivals.

feats.scene: Tiuautel drops a pair of orbs that crack a villain's armour joint wide open.
Tiuautel dives behind a console as the room explodes and walks out limping.

name: Rererser
summary: Rererser is a charming mastermind who recruits bright slum kids and funds their schooling in exchange for later loyalty. A sinister patron with no clear past, the schemer is called a monster by foes.

feats.scene: Rererser triggers a hidden trapdoor that drops a squad into a flooded cellar.
Rererser walks away from a lair collapse with only a torn coat.

name: Setorte
summary: Setorte is an eager teen who stole a teleport belt from a lab, and after a coma absorbed its power into red skin. Reckless and desperate to impress an older hero, the kid blinks short distances.

feats.scene: Setorte blinks behind a mugger and flings him through a bus shelter pane.
Setorte drops from a rooftop and blinks aside before the impact.

name: Sanaucil
summary: Sanaucil is a ranger who found a helmet in a mountain cave that lets him fuse animals into hybrid beasts. An elixir makes him taller and stronger, and a jungle becomes his territory.

feats.scene: Sanaucil drives a fist through a rotted tree trunk to topple it on poachers.
Sanaucil takes a charging beast head-on and holds his ground.

name: Sarseso
summary: Sarseso is a champion of a living web of animal life, empowered to merge two creatures into one. Strong enough to send a fire-demon spinning with a single punch, the avatar is also uncommonly fast.

feats.scene: Sarseso hits a flame-wreathed fiend and sends it through three stone pillars.
Sarseso takes a thrown boulder on the chest and laughs it off.
Sarseso charges across an arena floor faster than a diving hawk.

name: Nitelran
summary: Nitelran is a would-be sidekick with a talent for joining two animals into odd companions. Auditions go badly when the first fusion disgusts everyone watching.

feats.scene: Nitelran stitches two squirming pets into one fuzzy creature that waddles off.
Nitelran gets knocked flat by a shocked crowd and bounces back with a cheery wave.

source_title: Michael Maxwell (Teen Titans Go! TV Series)

name: Altiata
summary: Altiata is a charismatic cult leader who hands out gifts to followers through a devouring goddess's pact. Strong and bold, the preacher falls when the goddess reclaims what she loaned.

feats.scene: Altiata breaks a chapel door with a bare hand and splits the floor beneath it.
Altiata takes an assault rifle burst and keeps preaching.

name: Tonnau
summary: Tonnau is a boy cured of a deadly illness who grew up into a fervent preacher of a time-worshipping church. Unusual and gentle, the follower once begged a stranger for a miracle.

feats.scene: Tonnau flings an old book across a pew and knocks over a candlestick.
Tonnau kneels through a freezing night vigil and rises unbent.

name: Illiutal
summary: Illiutal is a grieving civil engineer who became convinced that a lost civilisation was wiped out by a cataclysm. Crafty with gadgets and cane tricks, the crank commits grand crimes to fund research.

feats.scene: Illiutal sets a cane bomb that drops the span of a footbridge into a ravine.
Illiutal tumbles down a dam stairway and still reaches the lever.

name: Coarca
summary: Coarca is a detective on a big-city force who befriends an eccentric private investigator. Steady and loyal, the cop helps a young team through a hospital crisis.

feats.scene: Coarca breaks a locked office door with a shoulder and calls for an ambulance.
Coarca stays on his feet after a heavy shove into a filing cabinet.

name: Vinoll
summary: Vinoll is a decorated patrol officer in a port city who falls hard for a visiting warrior. Dutiful and gentle, the policeman accepts that the feeling stays one-sided.

feats.scene: Vinoll tackles a dockside thief and pins him against a crate.
Vinoll takes a baton to the shoulder and finishes the arrest.

name: Aucorsto
summary: Aucorsto is an unusually clever bee who rides in a pouch on a masked hero's belt. Unlike its kin, the insect can sting again and again, and it flies quick circles around foes.

feats.scene: Aucorsto stings a crook's wrist repeatedly until the pistol drops.
Aucorsto shakes off a swat and darts back into the air.

name: Saril
summary: Saril is a former teacher who borrowed distant-future gear to fight crime alongside a twin. Rescued from a blast by a time-minded friend, the fighter is training in the art of managing hours.

feats.scene: Saril fires a gauntlet burst that caves in a loading ramp.
Saril shrugs off a blast that leaves a smoking crater around her.

name: Sileo
summary: Sileo is a ginger-haired guitarist and former pickpocket who joined an odd trio to help a masked hero crack a murder on a film set. Light-fingered and loyal, the musician hides talent behind swagger.

feats.scene: Sileo lifts a wallet and a set of keys from a guard in a single pass.
Sileo ducks under a flying chair and finishes the riff.

name: Sesntutal
summary: Sesntutal is a burned arsonist who shoots flame from the chest and, touched by a cosmic mind field, grows smarter and fiercer. A giant of blue fire can be summoned in anger, and fire shapes itself into skeletons.

feats.scene: Sesntutal rises as a towering blue blaze and melts a factory row to slag in one pass.
Sesntutal stands in the middle of a collapsing furnace tower, drinking the heat.

name: Teseori
summary: Teseori is a career crook who can shrink and grow at will, and works with a partner who does the opposite. Bitter about a foiled spree, the thief shrinks to slip through vents and grows to scare shopkeepers.

feats.scene: Teseori swells to the size of a door and slams a counter flat.
Teseori shrinks and slips out of a falling shutter's path.

name: Aminumsor
summary: Aminumsor is a giantess from an enlarged city who learned to shrink to ordinary height so she can travel. Immensely strong, she keeps to herself in cramped rooms and doorways.

feats.scene: Aminumsor lifts the corner of a warehouse roof and sets it down gently.
Aminumsor shakes off a falling girder as if brushing off a leaf.

name: Cororamon
summary: Cororamon is a mutagen-touched young man who can grow to giant size and infiltrated a shadowy cult for a hero league. Humble, he insists he is a normal person who is just bigger.

feats.scene: Cororamon grows to tower height and shoves a rail car off its track.
Cororamon takes a trap's blast on his giant back and stays upright.

name: Litaleo
summary: Litaleo is a red-eyed lord of the dead who carries souls down into a dark kingdom. Deathless and strong, the god drains life from victims, commands corpses and vanishes in flame.

feats.scene: Litaleo raises a legion of ancient dead and incinerates a mountain fortress in one pulse.
Litaleo takes a collapsing temple on his shoulders and rises unbroken.

name: Tirauamo
summary: Tirauamo is a blond thief known for disguises and deceptions. Small in stature but nimble, the crook lifts jewels in a series of audacious heists.

feats.scene: Tirauamo vaults a jewellery counter and snatches a tray in one move.
Tirauamo drops from a fire escape and sprints on.

name: Stvallan
summary: Stvallan is a red-eyed night spirit that can dissolve into a swarm of winged shapes and adopt different forms depending on who watches. Wary of one herb, the entity hunts by dark.

feats.scene: Stvallan bursts from a cloud of wings and pins a victim against a wall.
Stvallan scatters into a swarm as a volley passes through it harmlessly.

name: Ilese
summary: Ilese is an amnesiac swordsman in dark armour who becomes a feudal lord's bodyguard and the finest blade in the land. Haunted by a lost love, the warrior carries roses every year and weeps.

feats.scene: Ilese cuts down sixty guards in a courtyard and walks out untouched.
Ilese shrugs off a spear thrust that skims his armour.

name: Varsa
summary: Varsa is a dream-born warrior who appears in a sleeper's vision of a world where a great tragedy never happened. Heroic and wistful, the figure fades when the dreamer wakes.

feats.scene: Varsa smashes through a dream barricade and carries the dreamer to safety.
Varsa takes a thunderous blow and the dream shudders around him.

name: Stoirnro
summary: Stoirnro is a blond woman with oversized strength who joined a team of outcasts that helps people shunned like her. Gentle but powerful, she bends steel rods like straw.

feats.scene: Stoirnro bends a steel girder double and lays it across a pit.
Stoirnro takes a swung beam on the back and keeps carrying the crate.

name: Eontareo
summary: Eontareo is a small schoolkid in a cartoon world of tiny heroes who dreams of fighting crime. Cheerful and a bit clumsy, the child plays at heroics between classes.

feats.scene: Eontareo flings a toy rocket across a playground and clips a swing set.
Eontareo tumbles off a slide and giggles.

name: Numasisil
summary: Numasisil is a violent armoured enforcer in a grim possible future who commands fire and carries a monomolecular blade. Recruited into a masked army, the soldier is ruthless and proud.

feats.scene: Numasisil unleashes a fire jet that melts a tank's turret ring.
Numasisil stands in a blazing street, armour glowing, unharmed.

name: Iarnautau
summary: Iarnautau is a blond sailor who serves as first mate on a rugged adventurer's ship. Loyal and capable with ropes and sails, the mate keeps the crew steady through storms.

feats.scene: Iarnautau hauls a heavy sail tight against the wind and ties it off.
Iarnautau clings to a rail through a pounding wave and keeps working.

name: Tereonce
summary: Tereonce is a crowing rooster handed over as a prize for settling a neighbourhood dispute. Proud and loud, the bird struts a seaside boardwalk and pecks at anyone nearby.

feats.scene: Tereonce pecks a stranger's shoe and sends him hopping.
Tereonce is scooped up and dropped and lands on its feet.

name: Setanseo
summary: Setanseo is a warehouse owner born with the gift to move objects with thought and who chose a quiet life. Fond of pop memorabilia, the collector hires a speedy helper to catalogue his stock.

feats.scene: Setanseo lifts a stack of crates with a blue glow and sets them on a shelf.
Setanseo laughs off a toppled shelf of comics.

name: Auniu
summary: Auniu is a blond carpenter who builds props for a stage magician and once stood in for her on a performance night. Resourceful and good-humoured, the maker helped rescue a puppeted friend.

feats.scene: Auniu drives a nail through a plank with one swing of a hammer.
Auniu catches a falling prop and steadies it with a grunt.

name: Soenuos
summary: Soenuos is a survivor of an atomic disaster who reformed years later with immense nuclear power. Leader of a patriotic squad, the hero can switch off other fission-gifted people's abilities.

feats.scene: Soenuos releases a blazing atomic beam that vaporises a power plant's cooling towers.
Soenuos stands in the heart of a reactor meltdown and walks out glowing.

name: Navar
summary: Navar is a famous statesman who led a vast federation and quietly built squads of super-agents to rival neighbouring powers. Calm and shrewd, the leader refuses a stolen fortune and keeps the peace.

feats.scene: Navar signs an order that dispatches a full squad of agents across a border.
Navar walks out of a stalled lift in a tower and takes the stairs.

name: Nusllo
summary: Nusllo is an exchange student who can bend luck and minds and runs a betting ring at a high school. Defeated by a jammer, the bookie loses his gift until a rich patron restores it.

feats.scene: Nusllo bends a coach's mind and tips a football game in one whisper.
Nusllo takes a tackle to the ribs and stays on his feet.

name: Tiliarte
summary: Tiliarte is a sharp-tongued older sister from a hard-up waterfront district who fights for her family's pride. Fluent in two languages and quick with a quip, she backs her brother through a strange adventure.

feats.scene: Tiliarte swings a handbag into a thug's jaw and sends him into a fence.
Tiliarte hits the pavement in a scuffle and bounces up shouting.

name: Auntor
summary: Auntor is a blind wanderer of divine parentage who can borrow sight from a great mirror, though it hurts. Flies pour out of the empty sockets, and the drifter lives rough on the roadside.

feats.scene: Auntor sends a swarm of flies that strips the paint from a wall.
Auntor sits through a cave-in unbothered and mutters about the dust.

name: Ntlannum
summary: Ntlannum is a patient matron who raised seven sons in a crowded tenement and mended all their clothes. Warm and firm, she keeps a household together through lean years.

feats.scene: Ntlannum swats a runaway son with a rolled newspaper and he stops dead.
Ntlannum climbs six flights of stairs with a basket of laundry without a pause.

name: Silaril
summary: Silaril is a classically trained stage actor who doubles as a masked hero at his father's request. Skilled in disguise, acrobatics and gadgets, the performer helps a metal-clad hero in a few tough fights.

feats.scene: Silaril vaults a banister in disguise and lands a flying kick on a guard.
Silaril takes a rough fall from a balcony and bows out of habit.

name: Anserna
summary: Anserna is a pale, white-haired, red-eyed sorcerer-lord who commands followers by sheer charisma and hexes. A cold and polished schemer, he serves a wealthy patron in an old river city.

feats.scene: Anserna hurls a hex that shatters a stained-glass window and cracks the wall around it.
Anserna stands in a crumbling hall as a ward soaks up a falling beam.

name: Cosaust
summary: Cosaust is a college student, one of a trio of sisters, who can outrun her friends and a horse with hands tied. Easily spooked by ghost stories, she bolts at the first creak.

feats.scene: Cosaust sprints beside a galloping horse with her hands bound behind her.
Cosaust shoulder-barges a door and spills into the hallway.
Cosaust trips down a staircase and sprints off, squealing.

name: Telnute
summary: Telnute is a withered lecturer at a university who turns his bitterness against a shrinking hero. Smart and spiteful, the professor builds gadgets in a cramped lab.

feats.scene: Telnute triggers a lab device that blows out a window and a rack of glass.
Telnute falls over a stool and keeps talking from the floor.

name: Coltior
summary: Coltior is a grey-haired bodyguard to a crime boss, trusted with his employer's life. Gruff and loyal, the heavy tidies up after a prankster's mess and pays for it with his life.

feats.scene: Coltior fires a pistol across a penthouse and splinters a door frame.
Coltior takes a stray round in a crossfire and keeps guarding.

name: Celollam
summary: Celollam is a nervous technician who maintains an important suit for a cold machine intelligence. Obedient and quiet, the aide is mentioned only in passing.

feats.scene: Celollam tightens a bolt on a metal suit with a long wrench.
Celollam ducks behind a workbench as sparks fly from a shorted cable.

name: Rauma
summary: Rauma is a hooded villain who projects vivid nightmares into the heads of two young heroes. Smug and quiet, the trickster makes fears feel real while standing a room away.

feats.scene: Rauma plants a nightmare in a hero's head that makes him swing at empty air.
Rauma stumbles under a counter-blow and keeps chanting.

name: Seoliusil
summary: Seoliusil is a skull-faced second-in-command of a criminal army who drains thoughts and fires them back as stunning bolts. Skilled in a fight and a light-footed leaper, the agent can also cloud minds and read them.

feats.scene: Seoliusil releases a stored brain bolt that drops a whole squad at once.
Seoliusil takes a hard punch and leaps away across a gap.

name: Stroto
summary: Stroto is a twisted gloom-world vigilante who spliced alien blood into his own to gain a flier's strength, invisibility and a shapeshifter's guile. A castle guard for a dark alliance, he hunts intruders and is outwitted by a stronger telepath.

feats.scene: Stroto slams a fist into a castle gate and blows it off its hinges.
Stroto shrugs off a falling battlement as if it were hail.

name: Niastoran
summary: Niastoran is a former nurse who marries into a crime dynasty and outflanks her stepson to seize the whole operation. Playing the airhead in public, she sets a deadly virus against a famed hero.

feats.scene: Niastoran releases a vial of virus in a ventilation duct and clears a boardroom.
Niastoran faints on cue and wakes as soon as the guards leave.

name: Rnuna
summary: Rnuna is a rock-skinned villain from a future time who works for a small-time hoodlum. Brawny and dense, the brute is destined to clash with a pack of kids.

feats.scene: Rnuna drives a stone fist into a delivery truck and folds its cab.
Rnuna takes a speeding bus head-on and cracks only the paint on his chest.

name: Tinintu
summary: Tinintu is a patient hill-top deity who bestows clear judgment on chosen mortals, one of six patrons sharing a single champion. She rarely fights, preferring to settle disputes by counsel and quiet gifts.

feats.scene: Tinintu lets a gift of insight flare out across a valley, shattering a dozen stone pillars in its wake.
Tinintu stands unmoved as a collapsing temple roof rains down upon her.

name: Ruses
summary: Ruses is an elderly racketeer who wears a synthetic second skin to pass as a young woman, running a firm that fronts for burglary rings. Cunning and patient, she wins by paperwork and bribes rather than force.

feats.scene: Ruses swings a heavy ledger into a rival's jaw, ending the argument.
Ruses survives a fall down a short flight of stairs with only bruises.

name: Osvasi
summary: Osvasi is a masked figure of unknown face who appears on rooftops in a coastal town, dispensing riddles and the occasional hard shove to petty thieves. Nobody has learned what he wants.

feats.scene: Osvasi hurls a thug through a wooden market stall in one throw.
Osvasi takes a full swing from an iron pipe and keeps talking.

name: Rncorrer
summary: Rncorrer is a calm state operative who fights with slow, circular forms and works from the top of a tall city tower. She mixes laboratory skill with stealth and wins by patience.

feats.scene: Rncorrer redirects a charging guard's weight and sends him through a glass door.
Rncorrer sprints across a courtyard to cut off a fleeing courier.

name: Eoraucil
summary: Eoraucil is a ruthless fighter, trained by several teachers across continents, who treats combat as a performance to be perfected. Raised without fear or empathy, he seeks to prove himself the best of his generation.

feats.scene: Eoraucil snaps a steel practice post in half with a single kick.
Eoraucil closes thirty metres on an armed squad before they can raise their rifles.

name: Varveoto
summary: Varveoto is a frost-obsessed zealot who styles himself ruler of a nonexistent glacier realm. He rides a towering beast of packed snow and carries a cold-spraying device that freezes fountains and streets solid.

feats.scene: Varveoto freezes an entire plaza fountain and its surrounding pavement in seconds.
Varveoto shrugs off a heavy cudgel blow thanks to a thick coat of packed frost.

name: Tuvami
summary: Tuvami is a shadow-trained killer who learned to shape raw force into blades and walls after surviving a betrayal in the mountains. Her masters keep her chained below a fortress when she fails.

feats.scene: Tuvami drives a lance of condensed force through the support pillars of an office tower.
Tuvami walks away from being rammed by a speeding aircraft.

name: Titaria
summary: Titaria is a soft-spoken mother who secretly commands a syndicate of thieves from behind a respectable family life on a distant world. Her orders arrive by anonymous note and are always obeyed.

feats.scene: Titaria brings a rolling pin down on an intruder's skull.
Titaria rides out a stumble down a cellar stair unharmed.

name: Numser
summary: Numser is a hooded sorceress from a mirrored dimension who conjures convincing illusions and moves objects with her mind. She can cloak her friends from sight and reads feelings from afar.

feats.scene: Numser flings a toppled lamppost across a street with a flick of her mind.
Numser shrugs off a robot volley behind a shimmering veil of her own making.

source_title: Mirage (Teen Titans TV Series: Kilowatt's Dimension)

name: Llunire
summary: Llunire is a white-haired trickster who builds projectors that paint false roads, bridges and walls across the night, luring drivers into rivers. He is clever but brittle and loses to simple light tricks.

feats.scene: Llunire's fake bridge sends a speeding car plunging into the water below.
Llunire bounces off a stack of crates and keeps running.

name: Elteco
summary: Elteco is a smooth swindler whose machine projects phantom mines, toll gates and cottages to sell to gullible buyers. He never hurts anyone, only their savings.

feats.scene: Elteco shoves a stubborn customer aside to grab his cash box.
Elteco tumbles down a dirt bank after his machine overheats and walks it off.

name: Orres
summary: Orres is a restless student who moonlights as a courier for a secretive blade-wielding fraternity. She is nimble and tough for her age but has no training that reaches beyond street scraps.

feats.scene: Orres lands a flying kick that drops a guard against a brick wall.
Orres takes a hard fall from a fire escape and rolls up running.

name: Cisest
summary: Cisest is an orphan abducted from her era and fitted with false memories, then turned spy for a tyrant before defecting. She weaves illusions that let her wear another woman's face.

feats.scene: Cisest hurls a fused illusion that blinds a whole patrol into firing on each other.
Cisest survives a point-blank blast that flattens a doorway.

name: Vatania
summary: Vatania is a glass-armoured law officer from a far future century who tracks time criminals across eras. His team rides temporal currents to arrest fugitives and drag them to court.

feats.scene: Vatania bounces a concussion pulse off a polished shield into a fleeing suspect.
Vatania's armour absorbs a thrown wrecked car without cracking.

name: Sanannau
summary: Sanannau is the teenage son of a famed armoured guardian, living in the shadow of his late father's legend. He carries the family name but no gift of his own.

feats.scene: Sanannau throws a snowball that cracks a streetlight.
Sanannau tumbles off a low roof and gets up sore.

name: Raullan
summary: Raullan is a blue-skinned brute who plays the jester among rogues and loves picking fights beyond his weight. He is eventually killed by his own over-confidence.

feats.scene: Raullan bats a parked motorcycle across an alley with a swinging arm.
Raullan keeps laughing after a fist hammers him into a dumpster.

name: Sonanau
summary: Sonanau is a glamour-casting imp from a bent dimension whose magic warps appearances and facts alike. Her divorce provoked a flash of ruin that levelled her own homeland.

feats.scene: Sonanau's husband, merged with a stranger god, razes an entire pocket realm while she watches.
Sonanau shrugs off a bolt of wild sorcery that flattens a courtroom.

name: Ntilsia
summary: Ntilsia is a blue-skinned warrior of a love-powered order, armed with a gem ring that heals the wounded and raises shields and blasts. She carries her power in a small charging lantern.

feats.scene: Ntilsia fires a rose-coloured beam that carves a canyon through a quarry wall.
Ntilsia's ring shield holds against a falling bridge section.

name: Liorara
summary: Liorara is a kind but firm matron who runs an orphanage in a small valley town. She comforts the children and keeps the home together through hard years.

feats.scene: Liorara swats a runaway ball clean out of a window frame.
Liorara takes a tumble down a stair carrying laundry and keeps hold of every sheet.

name: Rnlern
summary: Rnlern is a nimble escape artist from a race of lesser gods, able to slip any lock or restraint. She is married to a bard-like performer and tours with him.

feats.scene: Rnlern kicks open a sealed vault door after picking its last tumbler.
Rnlern walks out of a flooded chamber that crushes a steel cage around her.

name: Stiesau
summary: Stiesau is a blind and mute tracker from a ruined reality, who hunts by reading the thoughts of her prey. A harness lets her borrow terrible speed from a hidden force.

feats.scene: Stiesau crashes through a concrete wall at full run to seize her quarry.
Stiesau streaks down a highway faster than sound, powered by her harness.

name: Soeost
summary: Soeost is a spacefaring trader who helped build a thriving guide business around his daughter's rare gift for finding routes. He flies through the void without a craft.

feats.scene: Soeost swoops past a pirate skiff and knocks its pilot loose.
Soeost streaks over a glacier faster than a jet airliner.

name: Asreo
summary: Asreo is a dark-haired masked adventurer, a short-lived member of a hero team who fell in his first big fight. He was brave and eager but under-prepared.

feats.scene: Asreo cracks a gunman's jaw with a knuckle-duster swing.
Asreo shrugs off a bullet that glances off his vest.

name: Anseoin
summary: Anseoin is a masked crime-fighter who joined a loose circle of heroes and wore a plain mask with pride. He is bold but outmatched by serious threats.

feats.scene: Anseoin tackles a mugger off a loading dock.
Anseoin takes a thrown bottle to the shoulder and keeps moving.

name: Stuani
summary: Stuani is a villainous machine built to wreck cities, with glowing photocell eyes and the ability to grow huge. He is vastly strong and tough but easily fooled.

feats.scene: Stuani swells to tower height and stamps a whole row of shops flat.
Stuani is hit by a falling water tower and stays upright.

name: Neraunel
summary: Neraunel is the lone success of a clandestine lab that handed out strength-granting seeds, and he later spread them through the city's underworld. He preaches ruin of the old order to make room for something wild.

feats.scene: Neraunel blasts a flowering root from a seed through the lab's concrete roof.
Neraunel keeps standing after a gunship strafes him with heavy rounds.

name: Inanu
summary: Inanu is a government agency head whose see-through body shows muscle and bone without being a skeleton. A reformed troublemaker, he was raised in captivity by a deranged doctor with five siblings.

feats.scene: Inanu lands a straight jab that cracks a thug's rib.
Inanu endures a heavy baton strike on his clear arm.

name: Misevor
summary: Misevor is a snap-happy crook in a lens-shaped mask who uses cameras for surveillance. He joined a big alliance of rogues and was routed with them.

feats.scene: Misevor clubs a guard with a heavy tripod.
Misevor takes a thrown punch and stumbles back into a stack of film cans.

name: Ausesniu
summary: Ausesniu is a white-haired professor and master of disguise who swaps faces to rob his victims. His career ends in a single failed gambit.

feats.scene: Ausesniu knocks a night watchman out with a cosh.
Ausesniu falls from a low wall and keeps running.

name: Amlerlli
summary: Amlerlli is a rookie thug who senses explosives and joins a crime lord's lieutenants. His glass-fronted suit makes him fragile, and he dies in a gang war.

feats.scene: Amlerlli ignites a stack of charges and levels a small warehouse corner.
Amlerlli is thrown clear of a blast that rips through a vault.

name: Iaeolos
summary: Iaeolos is the ancient embodiment of the things that lurk in the night, wearing a thousand names across many lands. Once locked in a stone box by sorcerers, he drew upon their power to nearly break free.

feats.scene: Iaeolos exhales a wave of dread that drains the light from an entire kingdom.
Iaeolos shrugs off a barrage from a hundred sorcerers.

name: Vorni
summary: Vorni is a sly gambler who lured wealthy men into a deadly society and cheated at the cards. His scheme ends when he cracks under pursuit.

feats.scene: Vorni slaps a challenger's hand away from the pot.
Vorni stumbles through brambles while fleeing across a field.

name: Nussan
summary: Nussan is a blinded scholar turned occult hunter who seeks out and destroys what he judges evil. A fanatic driven by a childhood he refuses to recall, he is feared by spirits.

feats.scene: Nussan unleashes a wave of consecrated force that tears a haunted barn apart.
Nussan weathers a possessed lorry hitting him head-on.

name: Caeolsir
summary: Caeolsir is a blond political aide who advises a war-god in disguise. His compulsive eating is his only known weakness.

feats.scene: Caeolsir slams a briefcase onto a table to end a dispute.
Caeolsir tumbles off a podium and brushes off the fall.

name: Restonus
summary: Restonus is a blond hobby-shop owner who moonlights as a crook, using toy gadgets for robberies. He is outwitted by a pair of masked archers.

feats.scene: Restonus launches a spring-loaded toy that cracks a shop window.
Restonus takes a tumble over a counter and gets up dusty.

name: Orecor
summary: Orecor is a pale, red-eyed inventor and businessman who sells convincing virtual reality rigs. He tests them by trapping a speedster in lifelike illusions.

feats.scene: Orecor triggers a neural pulse that drops a visitor unconscious.
Orecor ducks and absorbs a stumbling punch in his office.

name: Leneoni
summary: Leneoni is a nervous bodyguard who flees the first time his employer is attacked. Later he causes a commotion in a chapel and is quickly caught.

feats.scene: Leneoni heaves a pew over onto its side to block a doorway.
Leneoni takes a hard boot to the ribs and keeps standing.

name: Iunia
summary: Iunia is a cheerful kids' television host with a hidden second life as an inventor-criminal. His old device, retrieved by a relative, can bring down whole buildings and he plots to ransom a city with it.

feats.scene: Iunia's gadget reduces a municipal hall to rubble in one pulse.
Iunia stumbles on a stair and catches himself on a railing.

name: Relllli
summary: Relllli is a patient wizard who changes shape, usually into a bear, and guards a tower of enchanted artefacts. He grew bored when every land was conquered and followed a hero toward a new world.

feats.scene: Relllli, in bear form, swats a wagon off a bridge.
Relllli shrugs off a volley of crossbow bolts.

name: Amtauvau
summary: Amtauvau is a butler and part-time thief who partners with a bumbling accomplice and prefers a bow to a pistol. He is more theatrical than threatening.

feats.scene: Amtauvau pins a guard's sleeve to a door with a single arrow.
Amtauvau slides down a banister and lands on his feet.

name: Rnunus
summary: Rnunus is the proprietor of a travelling circus whose prized aerialists were murdered after he refused to pay a protection racket. He then paid up to prevent more tragedy.

feats.scene: Rnunus drives a tent stake into hard ground with one swing of a mallet.
Rnunus recovers from a fall off a wagon plank.

name: Ariasti
summary: Ariasti is a towering strongman, born joined at the shoulder to a twin and later surgically parted. A circus act turned enforcer, he swings an enormous mallet for a clown-faced boss.

feats.scene: Ariasti brings a mallet down and caves in the hood of a parked sedan.
Ariasti takes a bat across the back and does not flinch.

name: Llstrnu
summary: Llstrnu is an aging crimelord who took over a dead husband's burglary crew and wears a mask of a handsome man. She hungers to destroy beautiful things.

feats.scene: Llstrnu hurls a marble bust that smashes a display case.
Llstrnu shakes off a hard shove against a gallery wall.

name: Ortiam
summary: Ortiam is a white-eyed, blue-skinned masked champion of justice who works the back streets and says little. His past is a blank.

feats.scene: Ortiam drives a fist through a cheap wooden door.
Ortiam walks off a fall from a second-floor ledge.

name: Sevalser
summary: Sevalser is a minor demon in the shape of a chubby human who poses as a kindly mentor to a boy. He guides him in switching on engines meant to force humankind to evolve.

feats.scene: Sevalser powers up a chaos engine and a hillside crumbles into powder.
Sevalser is struck by a collapsing tower and merely brushes off the dust.

name: Rnioll
summary: Rnioll is a dark-haired villain with a nickname for his oddly shaped feet, an enemy of an archer hero. He brags more than he fights.

feats.scene: Rnioll kicks a barrel off a dock.
Rnioll shrugs off a punch to the gut.

name: Teirlas
summary: Teirlas is a black-haired swindler who flaunts his wealth and tangles with a squadron of airmen. His money buys goons but not courage.

feats.scene: Teirlas swings a cane that cracks a pilot's goggles.
Teirlas takes a hard landing from a crashed motor-scooter.

name: Eonmi
summary: Eonmi is a wormlike alien manipulator blamed for corrupting a hero in a bleak alternate timeline. He bends minds from afar and is rarely seen.

feats.scene: Eonmi whispers a command that sends a crowd marching into a levelled district.
Eonmi wriggles out of a crushing grip.

name: Ausaser
summary: Ausaser is a toy-brick version of a tiny, wormlike conqueror who leads a band of monsters from a spaceship. He barks orders in a booming voice and tries to rule the world.

feats.scene: Ausaser commands a swarm of plastic monsters to topple a cardboard tower.
Ausaser is flicked across a table and pops back up.

name: Oroneltan
summary: Oroneltan is a worm from a dead species who inherited its kin's mental might and can devour the history of an entire cosmos. His genius makes him the most dangerous manipulator of his kind.

feats.scene: Oroneltan gorges on the past of a whole universe and splinters its timelines.
Oroneltan emerges from his cocoon unharmed after a star-forge detonation.

name: Ceaunia
summary: Ceaunia is a rocket-themed crook who strapped a missile to himself and menaced a pilot squadron. His stunts were loud but short-lived.

feats.scene: Ceaunia rams a hangar door at rocket speed and crumples it.
Ceaunia survives a rough crash landing in a field.

name: Lluserau
summary: Lluserau is a bald, scarred businessman who wields surprising civic influence and is shrewd with money. He cuts off any ally who loses him a deal.

feats.scene: Lluserau fires a short pistol at a thief's feet.
Lluserau is thrown from a limousine door and walks home.

name: Nanoreeon
summary: Nanoreeon is a mischievous dimension-hopping imp who twists time, size and matter for fun and courts a heroine in clumsy fashion. Only a trick of language can send him home.

feats.scene: Nanoreeon recasts the fabric of a whole sky and brings a dead villain back to breathe.
Nanoreeon grins as a blast that would shatter a fortress passes through him.

name: Nanont
summary: Nanont is an old, balding ruler of a higher realm, famed for fairness in a doomsday-tinged age. He governs with a theatrical flourish and little violence.

feats.scene: Nanont waves a hand and a whole mountain range sinks into the sea.
Nanont is unmarked after a rebel storm batters his throne room.

source_title: Mister Mxyzptlk (Doomsday for the Fifth Dimension)

name: Arirnirn
summary: Arirnirn is a cackling spell-flinging imp who joins a gathering of villains in a toy-brick world. His magic throws flames and bolts and he hops about instantly.

feats.scene: Arirnirn flings a column of flame that melts a wall of bricks.
Arirnirn is knocked across a room and giggles.

name: Irnnusa
summary: Irnnusa is a chaos-loving imp who claims to keep peace between dimensions while really stealing and teasing. He teleports himself and a rival across worlds in a flash.

feats.scene: Irnnusa rips a portal and drags a whole desert's sky into it.
Irnnusa steps out of a collapsing portal unscratched.

name: Ralastel
summary: Ralastel is a grey, balding trickster from a hidden plane who poses as a reporter. His magic is playful and he leaves trouble in his wake.

feats.scene: Ralastel snaps and a studio set rearranges itself into a maze.
Ralastel is smacked by a falling stage light and tidies his collar.

name: Lliroscel
summary: Lliroscel is a small, bald imp who threatens havoc but is harassed by a pack of schoolchildren. A spell-book keeps hauling him back against his will.

feats.scene: Lliroscel zaps a swing-set into a pretzel.
Lliroscel is pelted by crayons and a dropped lunchbox without a scratch.

name: Aureti
summary: Aureti is a three-foot court fool in a magical dimension who quietly holds more power than the king he serves. He wields it for annoying pranks rather than conquest.

feats.scene: Aureti turns a rival sorcerer's tower into a giant puddle of soap.
Aureti is unharmed after a council of wizards blasts him all at once.

name: Oraenu
summary: Oraenu is a white-haired mayor running a racket on the side and cloaking himself in an air of mystery. He fell afoul of a radio-wave hero.

feats.scene: Oraenu bangs a gavel hard enough to split the block.
Oraenu stumbles down a courthouse step.

name: Niavasau
summary: Niavasau is a balding bomb-maker who uses unstable chemical charges in his heists. A night-vision doctor puts a stop to his crimes.

feats.scene: Niavasau sets off a charge that blows the doors off a bank.
Niavasau is thrown to the floor by his own blast and crawls clear.

name: Corleoamo
summary: Corleoamo is a clever red-haired gang boss who flies a magnetised plane over armoured cash trucks and plucks them up. A giant magnet finally pulls him down.

feats.scene: Corleoamo's magnetic plane lifts an armoured truck clear off the road.
Corleoamo walks away from his plane crashing in a field.

name: Vanorrni
summary: Vanorrni is a bald schemer who wears a handful of enchanted rings, one to control an old machine brain and another to shrink targets. He allies with other forgotten foes and vanishes after defeat.

feats.scene: Vanorrni commands a dormant machine to crush a rowboat in its claws.
Vanorrni is dunked in a harbour and swims off.

name: Amociton
summary: Amociton is a villain known only for his dusty trade and a run-in with a squadron of fliers. Little else about him survives.

feats.scene: Amociton heaves a sack of powder at a pilot.
Amociton gets up after a wrestling throw.

name: Ntioraser
summary: Ntioraser is the living embodiment of editing and censorship, who runs a retirement home that quietly dulls stories. He once fixed the laws of nature so science could work and tries to end magic.

feats.scene: Ntioraser strikes a paragraph from the sky and a whole forest goes silent and grey.
Ntioraser shrugs off a storm of fairy-tale curses.

name: Liere
summary: Liere is a white-haired realtor who sells haunted buildings and brokers deals for a demon lord. His business is shady and strictly magical.

feats.scene: Liere slams a door and every window in the block shatters.
Liere shrugs off a fall down a short flight of stairs.

name: Eostiinu
summary: Eostiinu is a bald, crimson adventurer in a quiet band of riders, strong and airborne. He is neither hero nor villain, only restless.

feats.scene: Eostiinu lifts and hurls a tractor across a farmyard.
Eostiinu takes a rock slide on his shoulders and keeps walking.

name: Stuanes
summary: Stuanes is a brown-haired travelling crook with a bag of drafting tools used as improvised weapons. He keeps moving to stay ahead of the law.

feats.scene: Stuanes throws a heavy ruler that cracks a lamp.
Stuanes shrugs off a tackle at a bus stop.

name: Seirnnt
summary: Seirnnt is a sleepy-eyed foreign henchman who delivers game tiles for a surgeon-turned-boss. He is arrested and dies in a cell, still gripping a tile.

feats.scene: Seirnnt hurls a crate of tiles at a masked pursuer.
Seirnnt is thrown to the pavement and gets up dazed.

name: Eocoreo
summary: Eocoreo is a fairy-tale villain from a storybook told by a butler, who fights a young masked hero in a pantomime world. His threats are comic and quickly defused.

feats.scene: Eocoreo swings a lily-pad club at a rival.
Eocoreo hops away from a tumble unhurt.

source_title: Mister Toad (The Brave and the Bold)

name: Telnum
summary: Telnum is a demon dwelling outside space and time who wears a human mask, twisting victims' minds into a ritual to enter the world. Untouchable while out of reach, he speaks inside heads.

feats.scene: Telnum rips open a rift and a legion of fiends pours over a ruined city.
Telnum is struck by a heroic barrage and passes through it like smoke.

name: Lesoraser
summary: Lesoraser is an old master detective and street guardian in a distant island city. Age slowed him, so a protege walked the streets while he solved cases, until an acid-wielding enemy killed him.

feats.scene: Lesoraser lands a rooftop kick that knocks a mugger over a railing.
Lesoraser shrugs off a baton strike across the shoulder.

name: Tirnicor
summary: Tirnicor is a scientist crippled in youth who brewed a serum granting him size changes, invisibility, limb regrowth and the ability to pass through walls. He used it for petty thefts.

feats.scene: Tirnicor swells to ogre size and hurls a statue across a museum.
Tirnicor regrows a hand lost to a closing vault door.

name: Tiuannes
summary: Tiuannes is a white-haired, balding crook nicknamed after a bird, who prowls a distant star-themed town. His schemes fall to a pair of masked archers.

feats.scene: Tiuannes hurls a stool at a bartender.
Tiuannes crashes through a table and rises, grumbling.

name: Nenente
summary: Nenente is a man cursed to become a ravenous beast every full moon, who seeks help from a team of young heroes. He is lured into a trap by food.

feats.scene: Nenente tears a cart in half in beast form.
Nenente bounces off a wall and keeps on running.

name: Almia
summary: Almia is a blond villain who drinks in energy and grows stronger from it. His appearance is a single spotlight in a world of green-faced heroes.

feats.scene: Almia drains a power line and releases it in a single blast.
Almia absorbs a thrown spark and shrugs it off.

name: Reela
summary: Reela is a lunatic who keeps an island plantation in an old-fashioned style, hiding it under a vast cloud of sleeping vapour. His gas knocks men out and stalls engines.

feats.scene: Reela's vapour grounds a whole squadron of aircraft over his island.
Reela is cut down in a duel with a blade.

name: Rnntnte
summary: Rnntnte is an unseen enemy whose backstory is only hinted at, known for a cold-spraying gadget. He is a ghost of a counterpart from another timeline.

feats.scene: Rnntnte freezes a fountain solid with a single squeeze of his gun.
Rnntnte is bowled over by a shove and drops his gadget.

name: Irntevar
summary: Irntevar is a runaway princess from a raiding people, hiding in the past as a young sorceress's apprentice. She holds a magic die and craves her stepmother's throne.

feats.scene: Irntevar rolls her die and a column of force splits a hilltop.
Irntevar survives an assassin's spell that levels a barn.

name: Vaseoco
summary: Vaseoco is a white-haired amusement park creator from a far world, who slept in a frozen chamber while his robots ran the park. His machines rebuilt a ruined planet and then fought among themselves.

feats.scene: Vaseoco orders his rides to lift a collapsed arch off a gate.
Vaseoco shrugs off a bouncy tumble through a gift shop.

name: Vaseore
summary: Vaseore is a teenager with a guilty conscience who ends up joining a group of heroes after an accident with a monster. He tries to apologise to everyone he can.

feats.scene: Vaseore shoves a boulder off a pavement.
Vaseore picks himself up from a fall down a hillside.

name: Iarriava
summary: Iarriava is a disgraced doctor recruited as head of an armed peacekeeping program. He wears powered armour and falls in a battle against a crossbow-wielding mastermind.

feats.scene: Iarriava fires a gauntlet round that shatters a car's windshield.
Iarriava's armour stops a burst of rifle fire.

name: Leollrni
summary: Leollrni is a married father and loyal family man who lives quietly with his wife and son. A giant monster sometimes shadows the household.

feats.scene: Leollrni chops firewood with a single swing.
Leollrni slips on a garden path and gets up unhurt.

name: Terern
summary: Terern is an ordinary elderly family man whose children and grandchildren go through a string of tragedies. One son later takes up a mantle of holy vengeance.

feats.scene: Terern shoulders a stuck cellar door open.
Terern takes a slip on an icy path and gets up slowly.

name: Oriria
summary: Oriria is a reckless counterfeiter from a rundown district who treats every wager as a chance to lose. Old guilt makes Oriria careless with life, and debts to a powerful crime family keep tightening around every scheme.

feats.scene: Oriria lands a desperate punch on a debt collector in a narrow stairwell.
Oriria takes a brutal beating in a back alley and still crawls away.

name: Lanneo
summary: Lanneo is a patient wrench-turner who keeps the vehicles and gear of a convict-staffed strike team running. Calm under fire, Lanneo rebuilds engines and rigged gadgets from whatever scrap is lying around.

feats.scene: Lanneo swings a heavy spanner at a guard who blocks the garage door.
Lanneo is knocked flat by a backfiring engine and gets up laughing.

name: Corvalrer
summary: Corvalrer is an immortal soldier whose body was rewritten by a strange resin from the sky. Each time Corvalrer dies, a fresh ability returns along with life, shaped by the manner of the death.

feats.scene: Corvalrer wrenches a truck door off its hinges and hurls it across a road.
Corvalrer is buried when a half-built tower collapses and walks out of the rubble hours later.

name: Rivavor
summary: Rivavor is a wartime heroine who can shrink to the size of a speck of dust. Drafted into a decades-long experiment, Rivavor learned to slip through cracks and eavesdrop on powerful people.

feats.scene: Rivavor grows back to full size inside a guard's pocket and bursts the stitching.
Rivavor is mortally wounded in a battle with a mad clone yet keeps issuing orders.

name: Llolis
summary: Llolis is a tiny, cowardly ninja parody who tricked officials into paying for a monster-slaying job. Swallowed whole by the beast, Llolis somehow survives with no visible explanation and goes back to running away.

feats.scene: Llolis slashes a blade upward inside a giant creature's throat.
Llolis is swallowed by a towering beast and emerges unharmed.

name: Leotanor
summary: Leotanor is a hunting and war deity who stalks prey across the highlands with blazing weapons. Immortal and swift, Leotanor can shape flame into spears and arrows, but iron wounds this god.

feats.scene: Leotanor hurls a lance of living flame that razes a fortified district.
Leotanor stands unmoved as a falling cliff face shatters across the shoulders.

name: Torsani
summary: Torsani is a sea-themed fighter from a wartime team, later revived in a modern retelling. Torsani is comfortable in surf and storm, and fights beside an old amphibious companion.

feats.scene: Torsani drives a wave into a pier, snapping several posts.
Torsani is slammed against a hull by breaking surf and keeps swimming.

name: Serlinol
summary: Serlinol is a synthetic mind built to keep memories forever, which turned conqueror and drained whole peoples of what they knew. Victims were left unable to walk or talk, until their stolen minds were forced back out.

feats.scene: Serlinol overloads a hangar's power lines and flattens the building around it.
Serlinol holds together while an entire archive of stored lives surges through its core.

name: Ansar
summary: Ansar is a dignified teacher among island warrior women, passing on lessons in reasoning and discipline. Ansar rarely fights, but carries the training of a people raised for war.

feats.scene: Ansar disarms a rowdy novice with a quick twist of the wrist.
Ansar stays on her feet after a training bout goes badly wrong.

name: Teler
summary: Teler is an ancient goddess of recollection, one of a family of giant elder deities. Teler survived the old wars by retreating to a mountain home, and remembers every oath ever sworn.

feats.scene: Teler brings a temple colonnade down with a single shout.
Teler endures a storm of divine lightning that scorches the courtyard.

name: Teanuamo
summary: Teanuamo is a ravenous insect-shaped demon that possesses living creatures and floods nearby minds with craving. Teanuamo is strong and can take to the air, and feasts on fear.

feats.scene: Teanuamo, wearing a stolen body, hurls a vending machine through a shop window.
Teanuamo survives a car smashing into its host body.

name: Unnata
summary: Unnata is a spirit of endless appetite that wears a swarm of crawling wings or a single hulking insect body. Unnata grows stronger as a crowd's desperation grows, and was once bound inside a child.

feats.scene: Unnata, as a giant insect, flattens a row of market stalls and several vans.
Unnata scatters into a swarm as a blast levels the street, then reforms.

name: Saslloces
summary: Saslloces is a hairless, clawed alien thief who vanishes from sight and fights with fangs and a tough hide. Saslloces drifted into a gang of criminals after leaving a disbanded group of young outcasts.

feats.scene: Saslloces rakes claws across a steel locker, tearing it open.
Saslloces takes a heavy crash against a wall and slips away unseen.

name: Lenan
summary: Lenan is a hired thug who once worked for a masked crime lord, then joined a gang with a storybook theme. Lenan is a plain brawler with no special gifts.

feats.scene: Lenan shoves a bank guard over a counter.
Lenan takes a crushing kick from a masked vigilante.

name: Lisonanu
summary: Lisonanu is an enforcer who fights in a face mask fitted with huge metal tusks. Lisonanu joined a costume gang for a bank job and was beaten and arrested within minutes.

feats.scene: Lisonanu gores a vault door with the metal tusks of the mask.
Lisonanu is flattened by a vigilante and loses consciousness.

name: Suliusti
summary: Suliusti is a professional criminal with a red-haired, sullen look who works as muscle for a costumed gang. Suliusti favours blunt tools and has no gifts beyond nerve.

feats.scene: Suliusti smashes a display case with a crowbar.
Suliusti shakes off a baton blow during a rooftop chase.

name: Rnrau
summary: Rnrau is a sentient world that drifts between stars as the roaming base of a dark band of outcasts. Rnrau can fire beams of black energy powerful enough to shatter another planet, but must never lose focus or its mind is gone for good.

feats.scene: Rnrau fires a black beam that cracks a neighbouring world apart.
Rnrau weathers a barrage of cometary impacts across its crust.

name: Linuiu
summary: Linuiu is a living world that wears a power ring and a charging battery as a loyal corps member. Linuiu carries an unbending will and can shape glowing constructs, shields, and bolts, and fly through space.

feats.scene: Linuiu hurls a ring-forged wall of light that splits a rogue moonlet.
Linuiu endures a ferocious crash from a drifting planetoid with no lasting damage.

name: Nustel
summary: Nustel is a sentient planet who served in a corps of ring-bearers, and a running joke among its human colleagues. Nustel never attends gatherings, since it is a whole world.

feats.scene: Nustel flares its ring and vaporises an incoming comet.
Nustel bears the weight of a thousand orbiting ships without tremor.

name: Lieon
summary: Lieon is a living world that long served as a prison for dangerous beings. After receiving a power ring, Lieon blasted an oncoming asteroid to dust and saved the folk living on its surface.

feats.scene: Lieon lets loose a green blast that disintegrates a vast asteroid.
Lieon is struck by a huge meteor and survives, nearly dying.

name: Mavacin
summary: Mavacin is a living planet and ring-carrier who appeared only once in a cartoon adventure. With a battery, a ring, and a stubborn will, Mavacin can fly, shield, and shape bright constructs.

feats.scene: Mavacin forms an enormous green hand and swats aside a roaming asteroid.
Mavacin takes a ramming from a rogue world and holds together.

name: Sercora
summary: Sercora is a young heir and entrepreneur who can turn into a body of black, humming energy. In that state Sercora flies, fires destructive blasts, heals quickly, and sends people across oceans in an instant.

feats.scene: Sercora fires a purple blast that demolishes a parked bus and its trailer.
Sercora reforms after a lorry slams through the glowing body.

name: Seniles
summary: Seniles is a brilliant engineer who grew up as a street orphan and later crewed an experimental starship between realities. Seniles fixes ships and designs gear, and carries a quiet debt to a kind patron.

feats.scene: Seniles knocks a thief off a ladder with a swing of a toolbox.
Seniles is thrown across a bulkhead during a rough landing.

name: Nauau
summary: Nauau is a wealthy socialite and parent of a future archer. Nauau is known for kind, ordinary things like cooking, and has no gifts beyond charm.

feats.scene: Nauau slaps a rude guest at a charity dinner.
Nauau falls on gravel during a hunting trip and is unhurt.

name: Lunaneo
summary: Lunaneo is a cold, scheming widow who once held a seat in a secret order. Lunaneo hides behind politics and family ties, and prefers hired hands to personal violence.

feats.scene: Lunaneo slaps an aide who brings bad news.
Lunaneo is shaken but unhurt when a car clips her door.

name: Rneonor
summary: Rneonor is a low-level criminal who spends evenings at a bar where wanted men drink in peace. Rneonor has no powers and trades gossip rather than blows.

feats.scene: Rneonor swings a bottle at a rival and misses.
Rneonor is tossed out the door of the bar and shrugs it off.

name: Iniarun
summary: Iniarun is a yellow-skinned, bald scientist from a harsh war-world, who grows monstrous creations and spies for a dark master. Iniarun hides inside a research agency while stealing technology from a rival people.

feats.scene: Iniarun unleashes a lab-grown beast that crushes a patrol car.
Iniarun walks away from a collapsing laboratory wall.

name: Rearan
summary: Rearan is an android built by a time-twisting villain to steal a wish-granting device. Rearan swells tiny atoms to huge size and releases destructive energy, but can be broken like any machine.

feats.scene: Rearan inflates the atoms of a warehouse wall until the whole building bursts apart.
Rearan sparks and keeps moving after a collision with a hover-truck.

name: Anetel
summary: Anetel is a blond young hero from a bleak possible future who stood against a tyrannical half-machine champion. Anetel fights beside a team of youths with no clear gifts of its own.

feats.scene: Anetel lands a punch on a drone patrol.
Anetel is thrown into a wall by a robotic soldier and rises.

name: Ntsautor
summary: Ntsautor is a gifted young engineer who cracked under pressure and wrote malicious code to turn people against one another. Ntsautor works through computers rather than fists.

feats.scene: Ntsautor shoves a rival off a stool in a lab.
Ntsautor is struck by a guard and stays standing.

name: Valtellli
summary: Ntsautor-like cousin Valtellli is an art student cursed by a faerie queen so that anything near her bursts into blaze. Enraged, Valtellli set the whole fae realm alight before the curse was lifted.

feats.scene: Valtellli ignites a whole orchard in one furious sweep.
Valtellli is knocked down by a broom handle and sits up scowling.

name: Niteneo
summary: Niteneo is a government agent who turns himself into a blast and then pulls his body back together. Niteneo serves a former superpower's heroes and speaks with a heavy accent.

feats.scene: Niteneo detonates inside an empty warehouse and levels it.
Niteneo reassembles hours after scattering in a huge explosion.

name: Torsoncor
summary: Torsoncor is a grey-haired, ruthless crime boss who leads a regional cell of a secret syndicate. Torsoncor gives orders and avoids direct fighting.

feats.scene: Torsoncor strikes a subordinate with a cane.
Torsoncor survives a bar-room scuffle without a scratch.

name: Rnceso
summary: Rnceso is a far-future hybrid descendant of a famous alien lineage who joins a team of young heroes. Under a yellow sun, Rnceso gains the strength, flight, and toughness of that bloodline and drinks in sunlight.

feats.scene: Rnceso drives a fist through a cliff face, collapsing the cliff.
Rnceso shrugs off the blast of a falling mountain top.

name: Telnule
summary: Telnule is a blond woman who is loved by a soon-to-be cursed man. A photograph of her keeps him going through hardship, though she has no powers.

feats.scene: Telnule slaps a rude stranger at a dance.
Telnule trips on a curb and is only bruised.

name: Tistelanu
summary: Tistelanu is a costumed criminal in royal dress who relies on gadgets and brawling. Tistelanu stalks a tower in the city and is also troubled by a disordered mind.

feats.scene: Tistelanu swings a jewelled sceptre at a guard.
Tistelanu is dropped from a ledge and lands on a canopy.

name: Lesren
summary: Lesren is a cocky, orange-skinned warrior born to a conquering despot who sent her to subdue a distant world. Lesren loves battle, committed many crimes, and later fought for prison handlers.

feats.scene: Lesren hurls a patrol vehicle across a courtyard.
Lesren is hit by a crashing truck and keeps laughing.

name: Vasrniaul
summary: Vasrniaul is a red-eyed, yellow-skinned alien tyrant with a twin brother. Vasrniaul is strong, tough, fast and tireless, fires bolts of energy, and leads conquest fleets.

feats.scene: Vasrniaul fires a bolt that demolishes an apartment block.
Vasrniaul stands through a missile salvo on an open plain.
Vasrniaul closes the distance to a fleeing ship in a blur.

name: Irnulvor
summary: Irnulvor is a short, eccentric magician from an age of wizards, good only at small spells and struggling with large ones. Irnulvor can conjure luxuries from a distant era and once helped retake a cursed book.

feats.scene: Irnulvor flings a crackling bolt that topples a wooden gate.
Irnulvor is knocked onto the floor by a goblin and chuckles.

name: Inastlas
summary: Inastlas is a veteran instructor of striking arts in a big city, teaching a rich executive basic self defence. Inastlas does not know that his student is far stronger than any human.

feats.scene: Inastlas snaps a board in half with a palm strike.
Inastlas takes a sparring kick to the ribs and smiles.

name: Naenu
summary: Naenu is a red-eyed neighbour in a quiet seaside town who feuds with the house next door over a fruit tree. Naenu insists on taking back every fruit that drops over the fence.

feats.scene: Naenu shakes a branch and showers apples across the lawn.
Naenu tumbles over the garden fence and hops back up.

name: Eonsa
summary: Eonsa is a cruel, charming conqueror who ruled a mobile fortress-world and ran gladiator games to keep slaves distracted. Eonsa captured fighters from across space and threatened to take any planet he chose.

feats.scene: Eonsa orders a barrage that levels a stadium.
Eonsa takes a hammering from a champion and laughs.

name: Sioranum
summary: Sioranum is a huge, red-eyed tyrant born to a line of rulers who believed the strong owe nothing to the weak. Sioranum killed his own brother, fought his parents, and later ruled a mobile war-world.

feats.scene: Sioranum flattens a city block with a single swing of his arm.
Sioranum shakes off a collapsing tower of steel and stone.

name: Siere
summary: Siere is a red-eyed, yellow-skinned alien with great strength, agility and stamina, and a skilled brawler who also deceives. Siere warns allies never to trust a partner with a warship.

feats.scene: Siere hurls a rock-hard slab that obliterates a barn.
Siere survives the explosion of a fuel depot.

name: Nalnitau
summary: Nalnitau is a troubled young woman raised in foster care who became hooked on a toxic drug and joined a fraud's band of enforcers. Nalnitau fights with basic scrapping skill and a hunger for the next dose.

feats.scene: Nalnitau lashes out with a wild kick at a courier.
Nalnitau, dosed up, ignores a baton blow to the ribs.

name: Leoti
summary: Leoti is a cosmic guardian of balance who fires a beam across the stars to empower a chosen champion against an approaching wave of antimatter. Leoti is the opposite number of a world-eating destroyer.

feats.scene: Leoti sends a lance of light across a vast gulf to a distant planet.
Leoti stands unharmed as a rogue star passes close by.

name: Siolse
summary: Siolse is a green-eyed cosmic overseer with infinite knowledge of reality, who flies, never dies, and watches fifty-two worlds. Siolse fell for a colleague and guided a thought-robot through a garden of the dead.

feats.scene: Siolse snaps a hostile world out of its orbit with a gesture.
Siolse stands untroubled in a storm of raw creation.

name: Anicerreo
summary: Anicerreo is a burglar who hid in plain sight and became a headline figure in the local paper. Anicerreo drives a getaway car and carries a pistol, but has no gifts.

feats.scene: Anicerreo fires a pistol at a lock and shatters it.
Anicerreo rolls off a fence and escapes with a bruise.

name: Telro
summary: Telro is a hulking ape-man dragged from a hidden jungle plateau to serve a crooked scientist. Telro carried captives through a park, was stabbed in the back with a toy sword, and died at his master's door.

feats.scene: Telro hurls a masked rival into a fallen log.
Telro takes a hard fall in the park and keeps walking.

name: Ianto
summary: Ianto is a criminal rebuilt with cybernetic parts for greater strength and toughness, who served a crime outfit in a big city. Ianto was a sworn enemy of an armoured inventor.

feats.scene: Ianto smashes a steel door off its hinges.
Ianto takes a car's full impact and stays on his feet.

name: Noran
summary: Noran is a white-haired villain who led a gang of crooks and clashed with a hero who moves very fast. Noran is a leader and not a fighter.

feats.scene: Noran strikes a henchman who messes up a robbery.
Noran is knocked over by a speeding rival and gets up.

name: Telteri
summary: Telteri is a grey, elderly, hulking primate who works as a villain in a big metropolis and speaks with a foreign accent. Telteri is mainly a criminal henchman with a gruff manner.

feats.scene: Telteri flings a heavy crate at a police van.
Telteri takes a heavy hit from a baton and shrugs.

name: Iasce
summary: Iasce is a convict who escaped a prison during a disaster, a thug with a prosthetic steel jaw that can crush metal and bone. Iasce is strong and tough but dim.

feats.scene: Iasce bites through a steel pipe with the jaw.
Iasce brushes off a collision with a delivery van.

name: Talco
summary: Talco is a scientist whose lab accident wiped his old self and made him a gifted inventor who claimed a satellite as his own. Talco flew a hollow replica of the satellite with eclipse, tide, and madness rays, and an instant freeze gun.

feats.scene: Talco fires a tide ray that floods a harbour town.
Talco's ship sinks into the sea and survives intact.

name: Iumterill
summary: Iumterill is a flier from a colony of settlers, who built a business around her daughter's rare tracking gift. Iumterill sails through space with her husband and has a family tradition of long tours.

feats.scene: Iumterill shoves a cargo crate out of a hatch.
Iumterill bounces off a hull in a rough docking.

name: Arsau
summary: Arsau is a huge furry alien beast that terrorised its herd's homeland and was drafted into a fear-wielding corps by a ring. Arsau is strong and tough, and its size alone frightens opponents.

feats.scene: Arsau tramples a row of huts in a stampede.
Arsau survives an ambush by a red-lit squad.

name: Nasnumias
summary: Nasnumias is a wild antlered grazer that followed a boy to a treehouse and was allowed into a pet club. Nasnumias is gentle, funny and entirely harmless.

feats.scene: Nasnumias bumps a swing set with its antlers.
Nasnumias trips down the treehouse ladder unharmed.

name: Rusvaltal
summary: Rusvaltal is a red-haired prankster from a playful fifth plane who once handed out superpowers at a comic convention. Rusvaltal flies, teleports, shares powers, and travels between dimensions.

feats.scene: Rusvaltal tosses a gift of speed at a crowd, tearing up a convention hall carpet.
Rusvaltal shrugs off a thrown vehicle with a giggle.

name: Reorni
summary: Reorni is a many-armed deity of might whose statue stands on a hall of heroes in a bottled city. Reorni is revered as a god of strength yet considered no match for a certain steel-skinned hero.

feats.scene: Reorni uproots a hillside with four of his arms.
Reorni weathers a rain of boulders across the broad shoulders.

name: Tiana
summary: Tiana is the cursed spirit of a treacherous prince, bound to a sheath that slithers like a serpent. Tiana can bend minds with a gaze and allied itself with a head of state before being stolen back.

feats.scene: Tiana whips the sheath across a desk and shatters a vase.
Tiana is hurled across a hall without a mark.

name: Levali
summary: Levali is a tall, white-haired dark sorcerer who seized a planet from rivals and conquered half a galaxy. His magic jams enemy weapons before battle, and he rules by fear.

feats.scene: Levali blasts an entire fortress and its hill into dust.
Levali stands through a barrage from a whole fleet.

name: Ntces
summary: Ntces is an ex-soldier turned detective who hunted a cat burglar while secretly being a serial killer. Ntces romanced his quarry and ended his life by running onto a steel rod.

feats.scene: Ntces tackles a suspect in a stairwell.
Ntces keeps his feet after a heavy scratch to the face.

name: Iaeonvas
summary: Iaeonvas is a black-haired woman who enemies of a cat burglar can count on for fighting skill and tactical thinking. Iaeonvas reads openings in a fight fast.

feats.scene: Iaeonvas spins and kicks a guard through a door.
Iaeonvas takes a heavy blow and counters instantly.

name: Nuraunau
summary: Nuraunau is an ancient sorceress of a magical lineage who tangled with kings, schemed against her sisters, and raised a treacherous son. Nuraunau wields old magic and shifts appearances at will.

feats.scene: Nuraunau calls down a storm of green flames that guts a castle.
Nuraunau walks away from a collapsing tower unscathed.

name: Lasun
summary: Lasun is a bandaged hero with utensils taped to his knuckles who can break anything down into its parts. Lasun survives disasters through a healing knack, and lords it over a teammate.

feats.scene: Lasun rakes the utensil claws through a steel door and reduces it to dust.
Lasun walks out of a plane wreck with only scratches.

name: Rescor
summary: Rescor is a former spy handler turned bank robber after his wife was killed, who boosts powers with drugs. Rescor shoots electricity and took a reporter hostage to force a trade.

feats.scene: Rescor fires a bolt of lightning that blows out a vault wall.
Rescor is knocked flat by a speedster and keeps fighting.

name: Mironna
summary: Mironna is a red-haired, purple-skinned sorceress who leads a cult of empowerment and never ages. Mironna tends to trouble from a base across two lands.

feats.scene: Mironna conjures a spell that brings down a chapel roof.
Mironna walks calmly through a burst of gunfire.

name: Orlin
summary: Orlin is a wealthy occultist who founded a secret order and tried to capture the essence of death in a mansion ritual. Orlin trades in forbidden books and bargains with grieving men.

feats.scene: Orlin completes a summoning rite that shakes the whole mansion.
Orlin is struck by a falling candelabra and shrugs.

name: Veotin
