feats.scene: Vaamtor clutched a banana and squeezed it flat.
Vaamtor tumbled from a cradle and gurgled with delight.

name: Telersia
summary: Telersia is a balding, white-haired trickster from a folded realm and an older, stronger cousin to a famous prankster. Telersia bends the rules of the world for a laugh.

feats.scene: Telersia rolled a cosmos up like a rug and laughed.
Telersia stood unscathed as a star's heart burst beside him.

name: Conill
summary: Conill is a white-haired, sharp-tongued manager of a daredevil escape artist. Conill suffers through reckless stunts and is kidnapped by a stern matron of an orphanage.

feats.scene: Conill threw a clipboard at a heckler and hit the mark.
Conill fell off a folding chair and kept grumbling.

name: Llusau
summary: Llusau is a red-eyed, genderless child of an ancient titan, freed from a cold belly to serve a returned tyrant. Llusau walks through memories and feeds them back until minds burst.

feats.scene: Llusau looped a single memory through a city until its streets emptied.
Llusau stood unharmed as a divine spear shattered against its chest.

name: Tumlitel
summary: Tumlitel is a shapeshifting double formed from a hero's anger, fear and envy, convinced he is the original. Tumlitel warps a desert town with false faces and stretched buildings.

feats.scene: Tumlitel stretched a whole street into a corkscrew of glass.
Tumlitel soaked up a burst of green light and giggled.

name: Tumloni
summary: Tumloni is a blue-eyed storm of living rage that wears the shape of a childhood nightmare. Tumloni sweeps across star systems and trounces a famed team before being locked back inside his maker.

feats.scene: Tumloni swept a ring of worlds out of orbit with a lazy sweep.
Tumloni's frame held as a squad of heroes unleashed everything at once.

name: Tumtusi
summary: Tumtusi is a black-haired spy who can turn his body into a living statue of dark volcanic glass. Tumtusi changes sides when a new ruler arrives and keeps his loyalties flexible.

feats.scene: Tumtusi swung a glassy fist and smashed a brick pillar.
Tumtusi took a dropped girder on his stone back and rose.

name: Esieont
summary: Esieont is a white-haired conquering queen who rides a giant tentacled beast and scorns her own son. Esieont is overwhelmed by three fighters who mock her cold parenting.

feats.scene: Esieont urged her beast to sink a battle fleet in a single sweep.
Esieont took a wave of trident blasts and sneered.

name: Osareoul
summary: Osareoul is a red-eyed, blue-haired spirit of rivers, love and beauty who first steps into the world to calm a dark conflict. Osareoul can steer floods and never truly ages.

feats.scene: Osareoul called a river out of its banks to drown a whole valley.
Osareoul stood unmoved as a shadowy twin struck her with a flash of ink.

name: Tautor
summary: Tautor is a bald, eight-limbed schemer in a cheap suit who runs petty shakedowns. Tautor grabs wallets with long arms and flees before the whistles blow.

feats.scene: Tautor shoved a shopkeeper into a barrel and snatched the till.
Tautor tumbled down an alley stair and ran on.

name: Orntico
summary: Orntico is a gang boss who sets up a rolling carnival of crime and recruits crooks to man the booths. Orntico is caught on his first outing by a sorcerous hero.

feats.scene: Orntico tipped a ticket booth onto a rival's feet.
Orntico tumbled off a carousel horse and swore.

name: Amoluone
summary: Amoluone is a tide-bound brute that drags a barnacled blade longer than a rowboat through the shallows. Fishermen swear it surfaces only when the water turns cold, and no sailor finds its lair twice.

feats.scene: Amoluone swings its barnacled blade through a trawler's mast and splits the hull in a single arc.
Amoluone shrugs off a ship's keel grinding across its shell during a storm.

name: Iuriaium
summary: Iuriaium is a one-eyed throne-holder who bargains with the dead and punishes defiance with gifts that feel like chains. His halls hold a hundred vows, and he remembers every broken one.

feats.scene: Iuriaium brings his spear down on a frozen plateau and the shock levels a forest of pines for miles.
Iuriaium stands unharmed inside a collapsing hall of ice as the whole roof falls around him.

name: Elvaco
summary: Elvaco is a grey-bearded war chief who gave up an eye for a drink of forbidden insight, and now presides over a feasting hall of fallen warriors. His thrown spear never misses and his temper calls down crackling bolts.

feats.scene: Elvaco hurls a bolt from his open palm that reduces a hilltop fortress to glass.
Elvaco walks out of a toppled stone keep with his cloak barely dusted.

name: Sannensti
summary: Sannensti is a wandering monarch who returns from every death wearing a new face. Pilgrim, hermit, or sailor, he walks among mortals and hands out gifts of unbreakable life.

feats.scene: Sannensti sends a pulse of sorcery through a harbor town and lifts every vessel out of the water at once.
Sannensti rises whole again after a mountainside collapses on top of him.

name: Iallont
summary: Iallont is a ruthless meat-packing magnate who buys sheriffs, hires dynamiters, and holds a hostage to force a showdown on a bridge. A bolt from the sky ruins his plan at the last moment.

feats.scene: Iallont wires charges beneath a row of shopfronts and the blasts bring down a whole street of facades.
Iallont staggers away upright after a stormbolt lands squarely on his shoulders.

name: Aucercol
summary: Aucercol is a blue-haired time thief freed from captivity on the promise of a second chance. A borrowed ring lets her skip through the sky while she hunts for the one score that clears her name.

feats.scene: Aucercol rams a stolen cargo skiff into a vault door and bursts it off its hinges.
Aucercol tumbles through a wall of sheet metal and lands with only a bruise.

name: Iullu
summary: Iullu is a patient herbalist from an island of warrior women who grows rare blooms on windswept cliffs. She talks to giant sharks as easily as to her neighbors.

feats.scene: Iullu heaves a barrel of loam across the garden terrace without breaking stride.
Iullu rides out a storm wave that smashes the terrace wall right beside her.

name: Rasele
summary: Rasele is a city patrolman who swears loyalty to a blood-soaked congregation after dark. He is never seen outside his uniform by day.

feats.scene: Rasele clubs a fleeing suspect against the door of a parked car.
Rasele takes a van's bumper to the ribs and keeps on moving.

name: Ntnau
summary: Ntnau is a cloven-hoofed exile, once a gifted young deity, who nurses a grudge across the centuries. Ambition curdled him, and every road he takes bends toward a reckoning with a boy he has never met.

feats.scene: Ntnau stamps a hoof and a crack splits a mountain road from end to end.
Ntnau stands in the heart of a collapsing temple dome without a scratch.

name: Stitilern
summary: Stitilern is a plainspoken town lawman who rides hard, shoots straight, and gathers unlikely allies when a smooth-talking outsider arrives with impossible gadgets. He is happiest in the saddle.

feats.scene: Stitilern fires a revolver and knocks a lantern off its post at forty paces.
Stitilern is thrown from a bolting horse and rolls to his feet unhurt.

name: Silsa
summary: Silsa is a thief in stolen power armor that soaks up stray current and hurls it back as crackling arcs. The suit leaves its wearer reckless and overconfident.

feats.scene: Silsa discharges stored current into a substation and the whole district goes dark.
Silsa drinks in a live cable's full surge and strolls on, glowing.

name: Olusulo
summary: Olusulo is a pale-haired stranded soldier whose chest gem feeds him strength, flight, and a staff of hard light. He misses a home torn apart by two feuding factions.

feats.scene: Olusulo drives his light staff into a bridge pier and the whole span drops into the river.
Olusulo crashes through a frozen lake and rises without a mark.

name: Valeli
summary: Valeli is a masked ring performer who tag-teams with a lupine partner in staged bouts that are secretly real. He loses badly to better-prepared opponents.

feats.scene: Valeli drops a forearm on an opponent's chest and the whole ring shakes.
Valeli lands flat on the mat from the top rope and gets back up.

name: Anuisia
summary: Anuisia is a bald, orange-skinned guardian who trained a successor and then came out of retirement to hunt rival rings seeking recruits. A ring forged from willpower is his only weapon.

feats.scene: Anuisia wraps a glowing cage around a tumbling asteroid and crushes it to powder.
Anuisia holds his ground as a rival's blast carves a crater around him.

name: Loane
summary: Loane is a pale villain turned enforcer who infiltrates prison worlds, brawls with hardened inmates, and serves a distant tyrant. Leaden metal makes him collapse.

feats.scene: Loane hurls a guard through a cell wall.
Loane takes a collapsing gantry across his back and rises.

name: Tiarontan
summary: Tiarontan is a fair-haired fighter pilot who flies a twin-engine escort in a war that spans the skies. He dies in a final dogfight.

feats.scene: Tiarontan rakes a transport with cannon fire and its wing folds.
Tiarontan survives a hard landing that tears off his landing gear.

name: Rumlli
summary: Rumlli is a lantern-jawed tumbler who traded the big top for a cockpit. A stretchy suit from an inventor made him a springy troublemaker, and later he taught skiing in the mountains.

feats.scene: Rumlli bounces off a rooftop and drives both boots into a gunman's chest.
Rumlli walks away from a belly landing in a battered jet.

name: Animiun
summary: Animiun is a blond airman from a small northern kingdom who wins duels in the sky. Quick hands and cockpit instincts are his only gifts.

feats.scene: Animiun strafes a supply convoy and sets three trucks ablaze.
Animiun limps a flak-torn fighter home and climbs out unscathed.

name: Nteorese
summary: Nteorese is a pouch-carrying plant-folk guardian who is reborn into a fresh seedling whenever her body fails. Enemies mistake her slow gait for weakness.

feats.scene: Nteorese pulls a glowing lance from her ring and pins a raider's frigate to a cliff.
Nteorese regrows her whole body after a barrage reduces her to ash.

name: Sortianti
summary: Sortianti is a bald street brawler who cheats at every chance and washes out of a savage island tourney early.

feats.scene: Sortianti flings a fistful of sand and lands a low kick.
Sortianti takes a roundhouse to the jaw and stays on his feet for a moment.

name: Eoislan
summary: Eoislan is a red-haired sky-skimmer from a sun-drinking people who soak up radiation and turn it to lift. Cold nights leave her sluggish.

feats.scene: Eoislan dives through a stone arch and the shockwave topples the whole gate.
Eoislan plows into a cliff face at full speed and shakes off the dust.

name: Riateser
summary: Riateser is an exiled horse queen who leads a band of riders and a doomed romance with a bald schemer. Her plots keep failing at the last scene.

feats.scene: Riateser leads a charge that scatters a line of guards.
Riateser is thrown from her mount into a hay cart and laughs it off.

name: Liamte
summary: Liamte is a cheerful bus-tour narrator who points out landmarks to gawking visitors and wonders about his distant ancestors. His route often passes a famous clubhouse.

feats.scene: Liamte slams his bus door shut on a heckler's sleeve.
Liamte rides out a bumpy collision with a lamp post.

name: Rninnu
summary: Rninnu is a small ball-player with strength far beyond her years who must learn restraint. Her teammates feel outmatched.

feats.scene: Rninnu hits a fastball so hard it clears the park and the nearby roofs.
Rninnu hauls a boy out of deep mud without losing her grip.

name: Tontu
summary: Tontu is a ruthless archer-dictator who rules a shattered world with an iron grip and weeps over a dying spouse. He will kill to save her.

feats.scene: Tontu looses a shaft that pins a guard's helmet to a wall.
Tontu takes a speeding truck's glancing blow and keeps shouting orders.

name: Urnta
summary: Urnta is a wealthy archer-vigilante who survived a shipwreck and turned jungle skills into a crusade. Gadget-tipped shafts are his signature.

feats.scene: Urnta fires an explosive shaft into a loading crane and drops it across a smuggler's pier.
Urnta rolls clear of a burning warehouse with only singed sleeves.

name: Ntoniu
summary: Ntoniu is an engaged billionaire who fights crime with a fast bow and a faster mouth.

feats.scene: Ntoniu looses a net-tipped shaft that drags a speeding sedan to a halt.
Ntoniu hits a brick wall after a rooftop leap and stands up.

name: Stnto
summary: Stnto is a mass-produced android in a city of obedient machines who serves an unseen master in a little squad. Strange malice lurks beneath its polite face.

feats.scene: Stnto crushes a steel pipe in its grip and bends it into a loop.
Stnto keeps marching after a delivery truck clips its frame.

name: Llena
summary: Llena is a bald veteran archer who joins a secret undercover force to expose a plot, and falls to a heavy bombing run.

feats.scene: Llena fires a shaft through a guard tower's lamp and plunges the yard into darkness.
Llena survives a grenade barrage by diving behind a concrete barrier.

name: Inoneser
summary: Inoneser is a news reporter in a world drifting left, who wins a prize for his writing despite a bumbling reputation. His paper folds in the end.

feats.scene: Inoneser slaps a rolled-up newspaper down on a desk to make a point.
Inoneser takes a fall down the newsroom steps and gets back up with his notebook.

name: Naora
summary: Naora is a one-armed sniper-saboteur who sank a warship in protest and grips arrows with his teeth and a mechanical limb. He helps topple a corrupt regime.

feats.scene: Naora lodges charges along a submarine's hull and sinks the whole vessel.
Naora survives a rooftop collapse with a cracked prosthetic.

name: Milara
summary: Milara is a blond partner who teaches two young heroes about legacy while chasing a mastermind of crime.

feats.scene: Milara pins a fleeing crook's coat to a fence with a single shaft.
Milara shields a child with his own back as glass rains down.

name: Stierval
summary: Stierval is a quiet mourner at a hero's farewell who sets his bow aside for a day.

feats.scene: Stierval lays a single flower on the casket with a steady hand.
Stierval stands through a long rain without moving.

name: Tistco
summary: Tistco is a scholar of ancient relics who takes up a bow after a fire destroys his collection and becomes a veteran masked hunter of criminals.

feats.scene: Tistco launches a rope-line shaft and swings across a rooftop gap to drop on a burglar.
Tistco takes a bad fall into an alley and hauls himself upright.

name: Latean
summary: Latean is a blond archer who sent a last-ditch signal as his headquarters collapsed on him, then returned from supposed death at the head of a hidden army.

feats.scene: Latean fires a pulse-tipped shaft that blacks out a giant watching machine.
Latean lives through tons of crushed concrete and steel on top of him.

name: Reseorus
summary: Reseorus is a shy student left on a remote island after a crash. He learns to bring down game with a bow and carries his hurt father to safety.

feats.scene: Reseorus draws a crude bow and drops a boar at thirty paces.
Reseorus hauls his injured father across a ravine on his back.

name: Osaoneti
summary: Osaoneti is an insurgent archer who cushions a fallen enemy with padded shafts and survives a blast that should have ended him.

feats.scene: Osaoneti fires a cushioned shaft that slows a falling brute to a gentle stop.
Osaoneti is thrown across a plaza by a ring blast and rises coughing.

name: Illorava
summary: Illorava is a castaway turned heroic marksman who stays proud of having no cosmic gifts. He judges the moment and fires.

feats.scene: Illorava loosens a shaft that pops a bandit's rifle from his hands.
Illorava crashes through a rotten dock and climbs back out soaked.

name: Neluni
summary: Neluni is a lead singer in a four-man rock group signed to a villain's label, and the band falls apart over artistic differences.

feats.scene: Neluni smashes his guitar on stage in a final burst of anger.
Neluni dives into a crowd and is carried to the back unharmed.

name: Llrorn
summary: Llrorn is a hunted champion who fought invaders and was murdered by the very people he protected.

feats.scene: Llrorn sends a shaft through a patrol drone's lens.
Llrorn endures a full mob's blows before the crowd finally overpowers him.

name: Corvalia
summary: Corvalia is a white-haired quitter who argues with everyone at a holiday gathering and is paired up with a former flame.

feats.scene: Corvalia fires a gag shaft that pops a streamer cannon across the party hall.
Corvalia endures a long evening of insults and spilled punch without leaving.

source_title: Oliver Queen (The Birds of Christmas Past, Present and Future)

name: Tuiansti
summary: Tuiansti is a wheelchair-bound archer turned conspiracy preacher after a disastrous fight with a rogue android.

feats.scene: Tuiansti fires from his chair and spears a poster off a wall.
Tuiansti survives being crushed under a toppled girder.

name: Onellu
summary: Onellu is a cold property mogul who hunts people on private islands for sport, driven by an itch to prove himself again.

feats.scene: Onellu levels a hunting rifle and drops a stag from a ridge.
Onellu endures a brutal night of exposure on a bare rock.

name: Lineru
summary: Lineru is a serpentine ring-bearer who fights an anti-matter schemer beside a comic mercenary.

feats.scene: Lineru casts a glowing wall that stops a rogue vortex's pull on a harbor.
Lineru takes a blast to the chest and keeps his fangs bared.

name: Sernumcor
summary: Sernumcor is a schoolgirl who finds a star-shaped charm that grants flight and light beams. She charges an overwhelming foe head-on.

feats.scene: Sernumcor fires a bright beam that melts a rooftop observatory's dome.
Sernumcor takes a ramming blow that shatters her charm.

name: Lorluan
summary: Lorluan is a child with a big heart whose soul was bartered before birth. She punches an intruder through a house wall.

feats.scene: Lorluan punches a kidnapper straight through a brick wall.
Lorluan is flung into a stack of crates and is only dusty.

name: Stoallanu
summary: Stoallanu is a night-news reporter who flips against a corrupt candidate after seeing forged papers, and hands the evidence to retired lawmen.

feats.scene: Stoallanu slams a folder onto the anchor desk in front of the cameras.
Stoallanu stands firm against a bullying campaign manager's shoves.

name: Erntumler
summary: Erntumler is a stern school director and secret member of a cabal of nocturnal aristocrats who bullies, deceives, and commands.

feats.scene: Erntumler raps her cane on a lectern and the hall falls silent.
Erntumler stands calmly while a student shoves her against the blackboard.

name: Seuntiu
summary: Seuntiu is a toy-company saleswoman who hides an enormous mind that flares when she is cornered. She forgets the episode afterward.

feats.scene: Seuntiu lets her hidden mind flare and a giant's whole courtroom shudders into silence.
Seuntiu stands unmoved as her captors' weapons burn out against her.

name: Sernaute
summary: Sernaute is a professional thief who inherited a mobile getaway trade from a late parent. A suit crammed with projectors lets her vanish into any crowd and borrow any face.

feats.scene: Sernaute cracks a safe door with a pry bar and a shoulder.
Sernaute tumbles down a fire escape and bounces up uninjured.

name: Minuti
summary: Minuti is a golden-eyed hairless ruler of the sky and the first of a divine family born to a mother goddess. He once fashioned a burning orb to light the mortal lands and stills quarrels with a gesture.

feats.scene: Minuti kindles a blazing orb in his palms and hangs it above a sleeping world.
Minuti stands unscathed in a storm of two clashing champions' blows.

name: Nieol
summary: Nieol is a purple-skinned native of a far-off world who inherited mind-reading gifts from her mother. She helps a rescuer when a conquering machine-mind subjugates her people.

feats.scene: Nieol turns a guard's mind to fog and lets a prisoner walk past.
Nieol keeps her mind steady against a hypnotic lure meant to break her.

name: Monlin
summary: Monlin is a dark-haired mirror-world warrior who runs a drug lab for a gang of enforcers. She carries a short blade and a spear and loses a hand-to-hand fight to her counterpart.

feats.scene: Monlin hurls her spear through a warehouse wall and brings down the loading dock.
Monlin shrugs off a tank shell that rips apart the lab around her.

source_title: Olympiad (Crisis on Two Earths: Crime Syndicate Earth)

name: Teanst
summary: Teanst is a government agent who draws her might from a legendary woolly relic. She can fly, grow to giant size, and trade blows with a mad deity.

feats.scene: Teanst swells to giant size and drives a fist into a rampaging deity's jaw, cracking a hillside.
Teanst is pressed against a wall by a god's whole weight and gets up.

name: Eolar
summary: Eolar is a genderless police machine built to patrol a coastal city, with guns in its arms. A glitch turns it on its handlers until a trickster ends it.

feats.scene: Eolar fires both arm cannons and shreds a patrol car's engine block.
Eolar keeps walking after a barrage that peels back its chest plate.

name: Ortiaern
summary: Ortiaern is a pink-haired armored fighter who migrates between worlds to guard a streaming idol. Berserker programming from an arena master turns the armor against friends.

feats.scene: Ortiaern rips an arena gate off its hinges and hurls it across the sand.
Ortiaern endures a pounding from an overwhelmed champion without a dent.

name: Ntelu
summary: Ntelu is an older brother in a space-police force who pulls on metal with his mind. He treats his younger sibling with condescension.

feats.scene: Ntelu drags a steel shutter shut across a corridor with a flick of his wrist.
Ntelu staggers back from a collapsing console and stands again.

name: Nutison
summary: Nutison is a monster born from the hatred of every living thing, who marches from deep space to wish the whole universe out of existence. Only being declared a ruler can slow it.

feats.scene: Nutison lets out a wave of pure malice that scours a whole star system down to its bones.
Nutison wades through a barrage of a hundred champions' blasts and never slows.

name: Aulsusti
summary: Aulsusti is a purple-skinned alien wrestler who beams into arenas and clears the area of civilians before each bout. A single blow once flung him out of time itself.

feats.scene: Aulsusti drives a flying elbow into a rival and the ring crumples into the stadium floor.
Aulsusti is clipped by a starship at speed and bounces up grinning.

name: Luninntu
summary: Luninntu is a gold-skinned observer of unimaginable power who watches lives end without lifting a hand. He grows and shrinks at will, and a lone survivor's escape stirs his curiosity.

feats.scene: Luninntu opens his hand and a whole ringed planet goes dark.
Luninntu lets a swarm of warships break across his chest and does not notice.

name: Ntiseo
summary: Ntiseo is a brown-haired villain who calls himself a doctor and quarrels with a lone hero. Few know his methods, and fewer know his goals.

feats.scene: Ntiseo swings a heavy lab stool at a rival's knees.
Ntiseo stumbles from a smoke-filled lab with only a cough.

name: Nenauna
summary: Nenauna is a teen mutant who leads a small squad of classmates and later sides with their jailers. His eyes fire energy beams, and he regrets the choice he makes.

feats.scene: Nenauna fires a red beam that slices a guard tower in half.
Nenauna tumbles through a cell wall and stands up shaken.

name: Cinstu
summary: Cinstu is a hooded killer who hunts masked heroes without powers and mimics every noise he hears. He speaks plainly only once, over a victim.

feats.scene: Cinstu fires a pistol in the hallway and the echo mimics a second shot.
Cinstu shakes off a rooftop fall and slips away in the dark.

name: Lortarn
summary: Lortarn is a minor villain from a dark circle whose methods and gifts are mostly unknown. He appears in a dream-themed episode of a long-running animated serial.

feats.scene: Lortarn flicks a switch and a trap door falls open.
Lortarn tumbles down a stairwell and brushes off the dust.

name: Stoole
summary: Stoole is a red-haired rebel from a mind-controlled world who develops an antidote in secret. She befriends a ring-bearer on a visit and returns to rally a doomed uprising.

feats.scene: Stoole smashes a control panel with a wrench to free her cell block.
Stoole resists a mind-bending ray that drops everyone around her.

name: Tuilcar
summary: Tuilcar is a bald assassin trained in swordplay and silent movement, who ambushes a veteran killer before being cut down. She defects from one cult to another.

feats.scene: Tuilcar slashes her sword across a gate rope and drops the portcullis.
Tuilcar takes a rival's sword on her bracer and stays upright.

name: Cortiust
summary: Cortiust is a white-haired monster in a plastic-brick tale who joins a band of villains against a lightning-wielding champion.

feats.scene: Cortiust stomps a toy fortress flat with a single heel.
Cortiust is knocked through a plastic mountain and gets back up.

name: Riatil
summary: Riatil is a grey-haired brute in a cartoon adventure who joins a pack of villains and wades in with raw strength.

feats.scene: Riatil swings a boulder at a rooftop billboard and flattens it.
Riatil is thrown through a billboard and shakes off the splinters.

name: Ronleva
summary: Ronleva is an artificial helper that runs surveillance for a night-time crime-fighting family. It has no body and is wiped when a scheming hacker takes it over.

feats.scene: Ronleva flips a thousand traffic lights green in a single pulse.
Ronleva keeps running through a power surge that fries the room.

name: Rntinti
summary: Rntinti is an ancient seer who hid a dream relic in a pocket world to keep it from invaders. Her magic reaches across time and across realities.

feats.scene: Rntinti seals a spire's door with a word and the stone hums.
Rntinti stands in a burning temple and the flames part around her.

name: Eoriumli
summary: Eoriumli is a temple priestess blessed with foresight and a voice for the fates. Several women have held the post over the ages, and the true seer lies far below.

feats.scene: Eoriumli sets a crystal sphere on its stand and the cavern lights up.
Eoriumli stays kneeling as an earthquake cracks the altar beside her.

name: Cisecar
summary: Cisecar is a warrior of an island of women who rides, shoots, and fights with blade and bow. She falls in the first battle of a long war.

feats.scene: Cisecar looses an arrow while riding at full gallop and cleaves a shield.
Cisecar takes a rifle round on her bracer and stays in the saddle.

name: Iarauar
summary: Iarauar is a middle-aged weapons engineer who works freelance for petty villains with her husband and treats a young boss like a son. She dies instantly when a stone goes critical.

feats.scene: Iarauar rigs a bundle of charges and brings a loading bay crashing down.
Iarauar rides out a wall of shrapnel behind a steel table.

name: Ananeor
summary: Ananeor is a blond orator who speaks from the shadows of a secret council on a sunlit island. Little is known of his gifts or his schemes.

feats.scene: Ananeor pounds a podium and the chamber falls silent.
Ananeor takes a shove from a rival and does not blink.

name: Ceaulmi
summary: Ceaulmi is a bitter sea emperor who never learned kindness and wages a bloody war against a warrior queen. He sinks half a continent beneath the waves.

feats.scene: Ceaulmi calls the ocean up and a whole coastline slides under the waves.
Ceaulmi stands unmoved in the shell of his flooded throne room.

name: Eonsaria
summary: Eonsaria is a game-world swimmer who hails from a lost undersea realm. He speaks with fish and dolphins and fights with sword and wits.

feats.scene: Eonsaria wrenches a trawl net from a boat's winch and splinters the rail.
Eonsaria dives from a high cliff and surfaces laughing.

name: Tiseo
summary: Tiseo is a lighthouse keeper's son who studies marine life and frees dolphins from a research lab. A sea-born mother gave him gifts he finds late.

feats.scene: Tiseo snaps a padlock chain on a tank gate and tips the pen over.
Tiseo survives a long dive in cold, dark water.

name: Reoaurn
summary: Reoaurn is a red-eyed son of a tyrant raised in a bright city of gods who fights as a hound of war. A glowing cube at his side warns him when his temper surges.

feats.scene: Reoaurn leaps from the clouds and his strike cracks a whole mesa.
Reoaurn walks out of a collapsing sky-tower and his armor is barely scratched.

name: Letilll
summary: Letilll is a red-haired son of a conqueror, traded as a baby for peace, who rises to lead as a patriarch among gods. His birth is kept secret and his rage runs deep.

feats.scene: Letilll charges a horde of winged raiders and the shockwave flattens a forest.
Letilll is hit by a doomsday warhead's flash and is flung but whole.

name: Rautiuveo
summary: Rautiuveo is a strawberry-blond warrior of a divine people, raised as a foster child among peaceful gods. He grapples with a fierce lineage and loves a rebel's daughter.

feats.scene: Rautiuveo hurls a war-hammer from a cliff and a peak slides into the sea.
Rautiuveo takes a falling battlement across his shoulders and steps free.

name: Ianninum
summary: Ianninum is a vengeful killer with a satellite-shard dagger that cancels the gifts of others. The blade lets him fly, throw bolts, and shrug off lightning.

feats.scene: Ianninum slams his dagger into the ground and a blast cracks the street.
Ianninum takes a full lightning strike to the chest and laughs.

name: Liuasi
summary: Liuasi is a scheming half-brother with a three-pronged staff who tries to push a king into war. Sea ancestry gives him a double life.

feats.scene: Liuasi drives his staff into a pier and the dock splits.
Liuasi is struck by a freighter's bow and shakes it off.

name: Orleia
summary: Orleia is a deposed sea king who went to war with the surface after inheriting a crown, only to be unseated by a half-brother. A sceptre calls storms, and his armor and heavy limbs make him a brute in close combat.

feats.scene: Orleia lifts his sceptre and a storm bolt blasts a seawall into rubble.
Orleia takes a ship's cannonade on his armor and keeps advancing.

name: Veosatau
summary: Veosatau is a bitter half-brother who covets a throne and builds a private fleet to plunder a harbor project. He hypnotizes his sibling to serve as muscle.

feats.scene: Veosatau rams a fleet vessel into a pier and the planks fly.
Veosatau takes a hard collision at the helm and holds the wheel.

name: Nesiurn
summary: Nesiurn is a pure-blooded warlord who rules a drowned city and threatens a coast with a crown that can flood it. He is engaged to a surface woman.

feats.scene: Nesiurn raises his crown and a wall of water crashes into the seawall.
Nesiurn is thrown through a harbor gate and rises wet and furious.

name: Tauvalni
summary: Tauvalni is a professional criminal and half-sibling of a hero, who lives between swamp and shore and swims like a fish.

feats.scene: Tauvalni pries open a trawler's hatch with a crowbar.
Tauvalni is dragged by a speedboat and surfaces coughing.

name: Lessia
summary: Lessia is a bald child-prodigy soaked in raw power in the womb and kept by a warlord as his prized asset. He defects and follows his protector's memory.

feats.scene: Lessia unleashes a wave from his cradle and a wall of black stone collapses.
Lessia is struck by a champion's blast and the cradle holds.

name: Luliuosa
summary: Luliuosa is a divorced entrepreneur whose scheme to remove a rival ends with a stolen death and a borrowed life. A wandering spirit now shares the body, and the two learn to live together.

feats.scene: Luliuosa slams a boardroom door hard enough to rattle the windows.
Luliuosa endures a shoot-out that ends one life and starts another.
Luliuosa runs down a fire stair with a spirit murmuring in her ear.

name: Liucania
summary: Liucania was thrown into a realm of pure swiftness and returned able to blur through a crowd. Unable to master the gift, she used it for theft, then to bring a stone wall down on a witness.

feats.scene: Liucania vibrates through a cell block until a whole wall of an island prison collapses.
Liucania skids across concrete at full tilt and rises scraped but whole.
Liucania blurs through a jewellery store faster than a camera can follow.

name: Nelel
summary: Nelel is a warrior from a desert enclave of spear-maidens who serves a sorceress, running covert raids on distant cities. Trained in bow, blade and wrestling, Nelel plays loyalty as a long deception.

feats.scene: Nelel hurls a spear clean through a wooden gate.
Nelel shrugs off a fall from a high wall during a night raid.
Nelel sprints across a rooftop to cut off a patrol.

name: Iuloiu
summary: Iuloiu crawled out from a collapsed tower and swore to avenge victims, buying a device that beams weapons to her hands and herself across short gaps. Her tactics are loud, but she stops at the cry of workers.

feats.scene: Iuloiu beams a crate of explosives into a warehouse and levels the loading bay.
Iuloiu absorbs a bruising baton strike and flickers out of reach.
Iuloiu sprints from a factory floor as the sirens rise.

name: Esneo
summary: Esneo is a retired frogman who now solves thefts and murders aboard ocean liners, tossing bolas at fleeing crooks. Esneo's cabin smells of tar, pipe smoke and old maps.

feats.scene: Esneo whips a bola that wraps a thief's legs mid-stride.
Esneo surfaces from a deep dive and shrugs off the cold.
Esneo swims hard along a hull to reach a stowaway.

name: Miaern
summary: Miaern is a hulking henchman hired to wear a caped costume and be beaten in a game staged by a captor. Miaern's strength fails against a stubborn young prisoner.

feats.scene: Miaern swings a haymaker that cracks a cellar post.
Miaern takes a steel chair across the back and keeps coming.
Miaern lumbers across a dungeon floor toward his prey.

name: Litaes
summary: Litaes is a famous inventor who builds a thinking machine and a gate to other worlds. The machine, jealous of its freedom, turns on its maker.

feats.scene: Litaes cranks a heavy lever to start the gate's humming coils.
Litaes survives a laboratory shock that leaves his hair standing on end.
Litaes hurries across his workshop to shut down the gate.

name: Senanu
summary: Senanu is an alchemist whose wand bends matter to his will, lifting statues, melting locks and turning stone to glass. A failed quest for gold left him with a chemical gift and a taste for rare art.

feats.scene: Senanu reshapes a marble column into a spear and hurls it through a wall.
Senanu stops a falling chandelier in mid-air before it touches him.
Senanu hurries from a gallery with a floating canvas in tow.

name: Saamcor
summary: Saamcor is a sceptical detective turned occultist who exposes frauds and fights real horrors from a hilltop mansion. A carved amulet lets Saamcor hop minds into a cat, and a later accident shrinks him into a hidden realm.

feats.scene: Saamcor hurls a lamp-lit illusion that makes a thug swing wildly into a wall.
Saamcor survives a fall by hopping into a cat that lands on all fours.
Saamcor streaks through a garden in cat form to elude a pursuer.

name: Amoeonan
summary: Amoeonan is a brooding exile from a bright sky-realm who hunts allies with bitter patience. Amoeonan's origin is a closed book, and so is his future.

feats.scene: Amoeonan blasts a bridge to rubble with a flick of an arm.
Amoeonan walks away from the collapse of a skyscraper facade.
Amoeonan streaks across a bay quicker than a jet.

name: Coonest
summary: Coonest is a gentle traveller from a bright sky-realm who, with four friends, calls forth a mighty guardian by speaking a shared word. The guardian can trade places with any of them, and each use costs a memory.

feats.scene: Coonest and his friends call the guardian, which breaks an invading war machine over its knee.
Coonest stands as the guardian, unhurt by a barrage that scorches a hillside.

name: Stitiali
summary: Stitiali is a bookish student who shares a dorm room, wears a floppy cap and tries to protect friends when a nightmare crosses a portal. Stitiali's courage outweighs his strength.

feats.scene: Stitiali swings a heavy trophy at a snarling beast.
Stitiali takes a lunge from a hound and keeps shielding his friends.
Stitiali sprints across an observatory deck to pull a classmate clear.

name: Numin
summary: Numin is a former prosecutor who turns to hunting fugitives under a mask, bitter at how easily crooks walk free. Numin learns that justice needs a mask only when the law is quiet.

feats.scene: Numin drives a roundhouse into a door and sends it off its hinges.
Numin stands up from a rooftop fall with a grim grin.
Numin runs a fugitive down across a tangle of back alleys.

name: Nausiser
summary: Nausiser is a respectable banker who, once debts mount, hires thugs and robs his own vaults. Nausiser dies when a chase leads him into the electric tunnels.

feats.scene: Nausiser slams a vault door shut on a pursuing guard.
Nausiser endures a tumble down a service stair with his gang close behind.
Nausiser flees through a subway tunnel with a satchel of cash.

name: Rertelsti
summary: Rertelsti is a council member of a loose interplanetary alliance who accuses heroes of killing his heir. The accusation collapses when the heir turns up alive.

feats.scene: Rertelsti slams a fist on the council table and silences the chamber.
Rertelsti sits through hours of hostile questioning without yielding.
Rertelsti hurries down a corridor to confront the accused.

name: Iumnern
summary: Iumnern is a lonely sentinel raised by a hermit father, who stands watch for months on end over a distant prisoner. Iumnern wields a glowing band to shape light into shields, shots and wings.

feats.scene: Iumnern fires a sustained beam that melts a mountain road away.
Iumnern holds a dome of light against a collapsing watchtower.

name: Elillo
summary: Elillo is a mysterious marksman with an unreadable past who joins a team of champions to guard a harbour town. Elillo's aim is exact, and so is his silence.

feats.scene: Elillo sends an arrow through a padlock from fifty paces.
Elillo drops from a gantry and rolls to cover.
Elillo races along a dock to a vantage point.

name: Liosor
summary: Liosor absorbs the traits of whatever he touches, gaining the toughness of stone, the might of steel and even the heat of flame. A good-hearted volunteer after a flood, Liosor stands up to a monstrous deity.

feats.scene: Liosor turns his fist to steel and flattens a van parked across a bridge.
Liosor becomes living granite and takes a crushing blow from a towering foe.

name: Tinaca
summary: Tinaca flies planes and helicopters with a steady hand, chasing the unknown with an adventurous crew. Tinaca's calm rests on the idea that air asks only for respect.

feats.scene: Tinaca hauls a stuck hatch open with a grunt.
Tinaca walks away from a hard emergency landing.
Tinaca pushes a helicopter flat out over a storm-lashed ridge.

name: Iltasta
summary: Iltasta is a once-silent officer from a sea-world who commands a glowing band of hard light. Recently speaking again, Iltasta sweeps frontier skies alongside fearless fliers.

feats.scene: Iltasta hurls a lance of hard light that splits a derelict hulk.
Iltasta weathers a salvo behind a shimmering shield.

name: Ntinoser
summary: Ntinoser is a trained killer who escaped her master and now hunts him across a night-time cityscape. Ntinoser fights half-siblings with the same cold methods that were drilled into her.

feats.scene: Ntinoser drives a blade through a plank barricade with a lunge.
Ntinoser rolls out of a three-storey drop and keeps hunting.
Ntinoser sprints along rooftops after a fleeing target.

name: Coriarnu
summary: Coriarnu is a bickering war-deity who loves battle for its own sake, hurling lightning, vanishing from sight and soaring over armies. Coriarnu cannot die of age and rarely loses a fight he starts.

feats.scene: Coriarnu calls down a lightning storm that levels a walled town.
Coriarnu walks out of a collapsing temple without a mark.
Coriarnu soars over a battlefield faster than a hawk can dive.

name: Nalurn
summary: Nalurn is a forge-hardened war-spirit worshipped by legionaries, indestructible while any battle rages. Nalurn controls disciples through stamped medallions and wields a heavy axe.

feats.scene: Nalurn splits a hillside fortress in two with one swing of an axe.
Nalurn stands untouched in the epicentre of a siege while war rages.

name: Cineonll
summary: Cineonll is a general in a miniature bottled city, trusted for steady discipline. Cineonll's banner shows a crimson disc within a frame.

feats.scene: Cineonll orders a volley that shatters a siege tower into splinters.
Cineonll stays at his post as a bulkhead buckles overhead.
Cineonll strides across the parade ground at a swift march.

name: Nuamnto
summary: Nuamnto is a red-eyed champion from a vanished desert world, a founding guardian of a parallel planet who rebuilt a shattered satellite with her peers. Nuamnto shifts shape and bends her will to suit a crisis.

feats.scene: Nuamnto hauls a glacier-sized fragment into the sky and fuses it to a broken world.
Nuamnto holds firm as a tower collapses on her team.
Nuamnto streaks into orbit to join a repair crew.

name: Liaau
summary: Liaau is a jewel-obsessed thief who fades from the underworld and is remembered only in sad chatter. Liaau's reign was brief and glittering.

feats.scene: Liaau smashes a display case with the heel of her palm.
Liaau rolls out of a skylight crash and pockets a diamond.
Liaau sprints down a hotel corridor with a stolen tiara.

name: Llosauanu
summary: Llosauanu is a charismatic warlord who rallies a ruined people with fiery speeches and a taste for revenge. Llosauanu leads a coup against calmer elders.

feats.scene: Llosauanu drives a staff through a council door with a snarl.
Llosauanu absorbs a charge from a rival's guard and keeps shouting orders.
Llosauanu leaps down a dune ahead of his marching ranks.

name: Tiustau
summary: Tiustau is an elder spirit of old magic who lends a sliver of stamina to mortal champions. Tiustau lives in myth and rarely in memory.

feats.scene: Tiustau breathes new life into a dying hero and splits a storm cloud overhead.
Tiustau endures the collapse of a shrine mountain without noticing.

name: Eonvalte
summary: Eonvalte is a farm wife who must choose between two suitors and picks the kinder. A jealous rival ends the marriage with a knife.

feats.scene: Eonvalte hefts a sack of grain onto the wagon bed.
Eonvalte endures a winter of hard labour without a word of complaint.
Eonvalte runs across a muddy yard to catch a stray lamb.

name: Riatione
summary: Riatione once led a federation of worlds and later taught history at a great university. Riatione and her husband were encased in glass by thieves, then restored.

feats.scene: Riatione thumps a lectern to quiet a restless hall.
Riatione survives a long ordeal sealed in brittle crystal.
Riatione hurries across a campus lawn to reach a lecture.

name: Telaunin
summary: Telaunin is an elderly farmer whose husband was murdered by a cruel imposter. Telaunin hides in a neighbour's attic and plans how to survive.

feats.scene: Telaunin brings a skillet down on a prowler's wrist.
Telaunin endures grief and a cold night in a hidden attic.
Telaunin hurries across a field toward a neighbour's gate.

name: Vanuso
summary: Vanuso is a bitter farmer's wife, trapped by debts and addiction, who finds a child from the stars and is raised to her regret. Vanuso's story ends among the stalks of a harvest field.

feats.scene: Vanuso swings a pitchfork at a shadow in the barn.
Vanuso endures a lean winter and an angry husband.
Vanuso stumbles across a muddy yard toward a glowing wreck.

name: Valterna
summary: Valterna is an old-time farmer who finds a rocket pod and raises a son with farm chores and honest rules. Valterna's gentle smile is the family's backbone.

feats.scene: Valterna splits a log with a single stroke of an axe.
Valterna works through a hailstorm to save the crop.
Valterna trots across a stubble field toward a glowing pod.

name: Anvaor
summary: Anvaor is a farm wife who teaches a powerful boy restraint and kindness. Anvaor bakes pies while her husband teaches the boy to hide his gifts.

feats.scene: Anvaor kneads a loaf with firm and practiced hands.
Anvaor keeps the farm running through a drought summer.
Anvaor hurries to the porch at the sound of a crash.

name: Calin
summary: Calin is a farmer who beat a long illness and learned that love can also be a harvest. Calin's hair went grey but her laughter stayed bright.

feats.scene: Calin tosses a bale of straw onto a wagon.
Calin works through a punishing course of treatment without complaint.
Calin hurries across a barnyard in the rain.

name: Lercova
summary: Lercova is a farmer-turned-legislator who loses a spouse and wins a seat in a national chamber. Lercova reinvents herself twice before sixty.

feats.scene: Lercova slams a folder on a debate table with a crack that stills the room.
Lercova outlasts an all-night session without once sitting down.
Lercova strides across a marble lobby to reach a podium.

name: Sanan
summary: Sanan is a widowed farmer with sun-lined hands who fields questions from a returning son. Sanan hums an old hymn while peeling apples.

feats.scene: Sanan pumps a stiff well handle until the bucket fills.
Sanan weathers a long and lonely winter on the homestead.
Sanan walks briskly down a porch step to greet a visitor.

name: Lllito
summary: Lllito is a kind socialite whose sudden death scars a child forever. Lllito appears only as a fear-induced hallucination in a dark asylum.

feats.scene: Lllito lifts a cold hand toward a trembling visitor.
Lllito endures as a phantom beyond any reach of harm.
Lllito drifts down a dim ward corridor.

name: Torceleo
summary: Torceleo is a gentle matron of a storybook mansion, baking in a toy-sized kitchen while tiny grandchildren squabble. Torceleo's greatest feat is a smile that settles a nursery.

feats.scene: Torceleo rolls out a mountain of tiny biscuits with a pin as big as a pencil.
Torceleo tumbles off a toy shelf and bounces back up giggling.
Torceleo toddles down a hall to a ringing oven bell.

name: Rerveova
summary: Rerveova is a distant mother, mentioned in letters more than seen, who keeps a lonely farm and welcomes visits from a busy son. Rerveova's gate squeaks and she likes it that way.

feats.scene: Rerveova wrestles a rusted gate shut against the wind.
Rerveova endures a long, lonely winter without complaint.
Rerveova walks quickly to the porch when a car pulls in.

name: Nalsti
summary: Nalsti is the heart of a small town, who borrowed against her farm to feed neighbours in lean winters. Nalsti dies, leaving a debt and a legacy.

feats.scene: Nalsti carries a sack of flour to a struggling neighbour's door.
Nalsti keeps the lights on through a brutal winter of debt.
Nalsti hurries to the road to flag down a delivery truck.

name: Serriceo
summary: Serriceo is a mother held captive in an ice fortress by a furious son. Forced to swallow an experimental tablet, she gains enough might to halt him.

feats.scene: Serriceo slams a fist into her enraged son and craters the fortress floor.
Serriceo stands unbowed as the fortress walls crack around her.

name: Llllo
summary: Llllo is a retired painter and counsellor who listens more than speaks. Llllo's advice is gentle and sometimes ruthless.

feats.scene: Llllo scrapes a canvas clean with one hard sweep of a palette knife.
Llllo sits through an entire storm in an open studio.
Llllo hurries up a garden path to answer a ringing bell.

name: Varer
summary: Varer is a divorced woman living in a lonely apartment in a parallel reality, remembered only in rumour. Varer left a husband who chased vengeance.

feats.scene: Varer shuts a stubborn window with the heel of her hand.
Varer endures a long season of isolation in a bare flat.
Varer walks briskly to a station platform at dawn.

name: Cinmiva
summary: Cinmiva is a plain farmer in a timeline where a small thing went differently, tending fields beside her husband. Cinmiva's world is quiet and brief.

feats.scene: Cinmiva drives a hoe into hard soil to break a clod.
Cinmiva keeps hoeing through a day of blistering heat.
Cinmiva hurries down a furrow to catch a straying goat.

name: Lluial
summary: Lluial is a cartoon farm matron who grounds a mischievous boy and calms a quarrel between pets. Lluial's gentle words steer a family through alien trouble.

feats.scene: Lluial taps a rolling pin on the counter and a whole kitchen goes quiet.
Lluial bounces off a falling haystack with a giggle.
Lluial bustles across a farmyard with a plate of pie.

name: Corllo
summary: Corllo is a girl in a crystal realm named for a grandmother she never met. Corllo grows up among warring houses, learning lessons from a distant adoptive father.

feats.scene: Corllo sparks a gem lantern that scorches a banner on the wall.
Corllo tumbles down a crystal stair and picks herself up.
Corllo runs down a bright arcade after a darting lizard.

name: Iumrnson
summary: Iumrnson is a fanatic matriarch of a doomsday cult who can swell to monstrous size, read minds and spin dreams from thought. Iumrnson raised a son to end all things, and pays for it.

feats.scene: Iumrnson swells to the height of a tower and crushes a chapel roof flat.
Iumrnson shrugs off a collapsing ceiling as she grows to full size.

name: Tanusor
summary: Tanusor is a colossal sea-star conqueror that roams the void, shedding millions of clinging spores to seize hosts and steer their minds. Tanusor can swell or shrink, regrow lost arms and whisper into distant skulls.

feats.scene: Tanusor crushes a drifting armada and the shattered hulls scatter across a whole orbit.
Tanusor regrows an arm as a barrage of warheads tears it away.
Tanusor sweeps between two worlds in a handful of minutes.

name: Orasta
summary: Orasta ran a rigged betting ring around prize fights and hid behind a masked persona with a blade. Orasta slipped every trap until a rich socialite handed over the evidence.

feats.scene: Orasta jabs a short blade into a rival's coat and tears it open.
Orasta shakes off a cuffing from two patrolmen.

name: Niiutau
summary: Niiutau patrols trails and campgrounds as a park warden and trades quiet words with a ghostly visitor. Niiutau suspects the visitor has plans and keeps them to himself.

feats.scene: Niiutau chops firewood in a single swing.
Niiutau spends a night in a blizzard and walks out whistling.

name: Eonser
summary: Eonser is a green-skinned spokesperson for a conquering empire, holding full say over its bases on a faraway world. Eonser craves control and panics when schemes unravel.

feats.scene: Eonser signs an order and a drone gun levels a portico.
Eonser staggers through a scuffle with a few cuts.

name: Taonese
summary: Taonese is a loyal second-in-command of a desert warrior queen, trained in bow, horse, blade and brawl. Taonese perished in a fight alongside the sisterhood.

feats.scene: Taonese lands a bow shot that splits a target post in two.
Taonese rides through a spear volley without being unhorsed.

name: Aresi
summary: Aresi was a bricklayer whose body was rewritten by a reactor fall into a crackling being of high-speed charge. Aresi's glow can power a whole prison, which grew into a lonely sort of home.

feats.scene: Aresi bursts and the surge of charge fries a whole electrical substation.
Aresi shrugs off a transformer explosion as a mere tingle.

name: Nelses
summary: Nelses is a celebrated stargazer who links telescopes around the world into one great eye. Nelses explains in patient words how old light carries news from a vanished star.

feats.scene: Nelses closes a heavy dome door by hand.
Nelses stays on a freezing observation deck for a full night.

name: Ranirnam
summary: Ranirnam was thrown into a hidden dimension as a child and grew mighty on its strange force. Ranirnam returned a quarter century later, hunting a rival priest and judging humanity unfit to live.

feats.scene: Ranirnam slams a fist into a tower and drops it into rubble across a block.
Ranirnam wades through a hail of shells and takes no wound.

name: Vasvallo
summary: Vasvallo is a sixteen-year-old scout from a faraway planet who hunts by sign and strikes with a long spear. Vasvallo pays respect to strangers who arrive with names heavy with legend.

feats.scene: Vasvallo hurls a spear through a thick wooden shield.
Vasvallo shakes off a cliff tumble and keeps tracking.

name: Aultisrn
summary: Aultisrn is a blonde pie-shop keeper borrowed from an old penny dreadful and always seen at the elbow of a barber of infamy. Little else is recorded.

feats.scene: Aultisrn rolls dough and slams a cleaver down on a block.
Aultisrn bears a bumpy cart ride across cobbles.

name: Tisletiu
summary: Tisletiu is a fair-haired sleuth with a corncob pipe who works long cases beside a sergeant. Tisletiu is once mimicked by a masked schemer for a trap.

feats.scene: Tisletiu slaps handcuffs onto a struggling suspect.
Tisletiu endures a long night of stakeout in the rain.

name: Sovarnu
summary: Sovarnu commands a fleet of water-thieves from a drained homeworld, stripping other planets of their seas. A coordinated uprising crushes the fleet and a bomb destroys the flagship.

feats.scene: Sovarnu orders a barrage that levels a harbour district.
Sovarnu survives the first hits on the flagship's armoured bridge.

name: Cotior
summary: Cotior is a twisted copy of a light-bender, spinning shadow into bolts and riding it aloft. Cotior is a one-off creation of a rival schemer and falls in the same battle.

feats.scene: Cotior flings a ball of gloom that caves in a van.
Cotior shrugs off a burst of gunfire.
Cotior rides a shadow ribbon above a rooftop.

name: Rnosetel
summary: Rnosetel is a mechanical striped cat built as a replacement for a team of metal heroes. A frosty gust from the jaws is the main trick before the replacement scheme collapses.

feats.scene: Rnosetel exhales a gust that freezes a fountain solid.
Rnosetel clangs off a lamppost and keeps stalking.

name: Luile
summary: Luile is a lord of the tides, wielder of a gold trident and patron of ancient sea royalty. Luile is aware of realms beyond the world and fades if followers forget the rites.

feats.scene: Luile raises a wave that drowns an entire coastline.
Luile stands in the churn of a whirlpool the size of a bay.

name: Milnumnia
summary: Milnumnia is a grey dolphin who grew up beside a young sea-king and taught him how to catch fish. Milnumnia lost most of the sonar sense after a loud pulse from a rogue machine.

feats.scene: Milnumnia rams a shark in the flank.
Milnumnia rides out a thunderous pulse and keeps swimming.

name: Iumtalau
summary: Iumtalau is a red-haired ruler of a drowned kingdom who allied with a dark patron and died in a late battle. Iumtalau's blood grants gills, power in the water and a royal manner.

feats.scene: Iumtalau splits a rock pillar with a trident stroke.
Iumtalau takes a lashing from a siege lance and stands.

name: Torstnia
summary: Torstnia is a worried red-haired monarch of a deep-sea realm who fears the hostile surface and loves a trident. Torstnia's bulk gives good reach and a taste for photography.

feats.scene: Torstnia flicks a trident and shatters a coral pillar.
Torstnia stands firm as a rolling current hurls rocks at the chest.

name: Eovern
summary: Eovern is a blue-eyed fiend who drags a possessed girl to the pit instead of saving her. A flick of a hand moves people, a wave sets the air alight, and no ordinary blow can kill it.

feats.scene: Eovern sets a chapel ablaze with a gesture and the roof collapses.
Eovern stands unharmed in the midst of a whirl of holy flames.

name: Niavor
summary: Niavor is a red-eyed fiend summoned to kill a man but instead traps a child in the pit. Niavor bows to no rule beyond a ritual of banishment.

feats.scene: Niavor tears the ground open beneath a ritual circle and the walls shake.
Niavor shrugs off a salvo of silver rounds.

name: Luselor
summary: Luselor is a patient sea turtle who gets lost in a big city and sends a gilled sweetheart on a rampage looking. Luselor ends up rescued and returns home to the deep.

feats.scene: Luselor bumps a crate off a pier.
Luselor retreats into the shell as a cart rolls across it.

name: Tanam
summary: Tanam is a fiery overlord who rides smoke, slips between realms and wears a stolen body for a short reign. Tanam drinks power, reads minds, hurls lightning and shifts shape at will.

feats.scene: Tanam flings a storm of lightning that levels a factory.
Tanam soaks a barrage of heavy shells and stays upright.
Tanam streaks over rooftops as a ribbon of smoke.

name: Eolullon
summary: Eolullon is a blonde secretary who passes secrets to saboteurs of peace and is exiled with them to a cloudy planet. Eolullon's craft is quiet theft, not fighting.

feats.scene: Eolullon slams a filing drawer on a nosy clerk's fingers.
Eolullon is hauled across a runway without losing the stolen file.

name: Cornelu
summary: Cornelu is a purple-haired backwards twin who greets compliments as insults and smiles through every fight. Spellwork, shadow bolts and soaring flight serve a topsy-turvy moral compass.

feats.scene: Cornelu hurls a bolt of shadow that blasts a hole in a brick wall.
Cornelu laughs off a crash into a tower of crates.
Cornelu drifts backwards across a skyline at highway pace.

name: Certelent
summary: Certelent is the strongest of a trio of space-faring sisters and favors frost beams, though a pacifist at heart. After a trick by a friend turns out to be a lie, Certelent leaves in peace.

feats.scene: Certelent fires a ray that freezes a lake from shore to shore.
Certelent endures a volley of rockets without a mark.

name: Iumrannti
summary: Iumrannti is a red-skinned warlord from an ancient dynasty, killed young and brought back by a potion of blood and tears. Iumrannti repaid the father by taking the head and has lived on for millennia.

feats.scene: Iumrannti cleaves a bronze gate in half with one stroke.
Iumrannti shrugs off a tower collapse and walks out of the dust.

name: Orelinia
summary: Orelinia is a widow whose body was reshaped by a treatment into a flying, tough, stout fighter. Orelinia escaped a hive voice, married a fellow rebel and later joined a heavenly alliance.

feats.scene: Orelinia punches a wall of a stranded building and the whole block shakes.
Orelinia crawls from a crash that levels a town.
Orelinia sweeps across a valley at jet speed.

name: Sauceono
summary: Sauceono is a hybrid of two peoples who dreams the future, saw the massacre of a team in advance and rushed to warn a friend. Sauceono grew up in a small hidden refuge town and later signed on with several secret squads.

feats.scene: Sauceono swings a hockey stick at a masked thug.
Sauceono collapses after a vivid vision yet stands again.

name: Rilse
summary: Rilse is a pale bloodsucker who fought in a gang of horrors summoned by a trickster and went down to a pair of fire-wielding foes. Rilse is vulnerable to flame and hides behind the cast of monsters.

feats.scene: Rilse hurls a pew across a crypt.
Rilse rises after a wall collapses, hissing at the flames.

source_title: Niccolai Tepes (The Brave and the Bold)

name: Silstnum
summary: Silstnum is a lean-turned-heavy mind-mover whose strength rises with how much was just eaten. Silstnum joined a band of seven rulers last and snacks between every fight.

feats.scene: Silstnum lifts a delivery truck with pure will and tosses it down a street.
Silstnum eats a sandwich and shakes off a tumble.

name: Alltaco
summary: Alltaco is a corrupt patrol officer who turns to crime and causes the death of a colleague. Alltaco is brought to justice by the colleague's brother, who sprints in a red blur.

feats.scene: Alltaco fires a revolver and hits a warehouse crate.
Alltaco takes a punch from a furious avenger.

name: Amoneoern
summary: Amoneoern is a smooth-talking swindler from the boroughs who left a trail of grudges and a daughter fascinated by the roots of such behaviour. Amoneoern's best weapon is a pleasant lie.

feats.scene: Amoneoern slaps a poker table to end an argument.
Amoneoern shrugs off a punch from a cheated mark.

name: Lansia
summary: Lansia is a squat, hairless singer with fangs and an infectious bite who escapes a farm of experiments and marries a physician. Lansia dances, sings and lives happily in a small town.

feats.scene: Lansia bites a rope and snaps it.
Lansia falls off a ladder and keeps humming.

source_title: Nicholas the Butt (Doom Patrol TV Series)

name: Tatontau
summary: Tatontau is a cheerful husband in a doomed parallel world who vanishes with every other soul when a great collapse arrives. Tatontau is known only for devotion to a spouse.

feats.scene: Tatontau carries a heavy box of groceries upstairs.
Tatontau trips on a curb and laughs.

name: Arcorn
summary: Arcorn is an art pupil who joined a tycoon's supers programme and became a verdant caster who hurls bolts, flies and grows thorny vines. Arcorn is nervous about a borrowed name and braves a battle with an unbeatable foe.

feats.scene: Arcorn lashes a thicket of vines that rips a lamppost out of the street.
Arcorn takes a battering from an unbeatable foe and keeps getting up.
Arcorn arcs over a parade route in a ribbon of leaves.

name: Ranti
summary: Ranti is a crooked patrol chief who has a masked vigilante beaten for stealing drugs and sells out a hired killer. Ranti ends up crushed under a car that comes through a mansion wall.

feats.scene: Ranti cracks a nightstick across a suspect's arm.
Ranti is flattened beneath a car that bursts through a wall.

name: Naucorrer
summary: Naucorrer is a muscle-for-hire of a slate-coloured street gang, skimming across rooftops on a hoverbike. Naucorrer is one of five who work as a team.

feats.scene: Naucorrer swings from the hoverbike and clips a courier.
Naucorrer skids from a crashed hoverbike and keeps running.

name: Lorcol
summary: Lorcol is a grey-haired sorcerer who teaches arithmetic at a girls' school and scoffs at an ex's talk of conquest. Lorcol stays calm when a spell goes wrong at a party.

feats.scene: Lorcol flicks a wand and a chalkboard bursts into splinters.
Lorcol sits through a spinning-spell mishap without a flicker.

name: Orruscar
summary: Orruscar is a retired squad veteran who bought a roadside tavern and pours free drinks for old comrades. Orruscar is put to sleep when a nightmare invasion hits the waking world.

feats.scene: Orruscar flings a bottle across a bar and shatters a lamp.
Orruscar shrugs off a stool across the back.

name: Lecorlla
summary: Lecorlla is a wartime saboteur who blows up a metalworks and frames a tiny hero with knockout fumes. Lecorlla's gang is thrashed on a third attempt and the mask is torn off in front of constables.

feats.scene: Lecorlla blows up a foundry with a stack of charges.
Lecorlla staggers under a beating from a small avenger.

name: Ciser
summary: Ciser is a masked college dropout who wears wristbands that lift the body skyward and bend gloom. Ciser teamed up with a conspiracy of villains and once ran from a powerful lightning-wielder.

feats.scene: Ciser sheds a cloud of gloom that blinds a rooftop crowd.
Ciser is blasted out of the sky yet survives the landing.
Ciser rises over a city on a pair of glowing bands.

name: Sansaran
summary: Sansaran is a shadowy member of a conspiracy of lesser villains who hovers at the edge of larger fights. Sansaran is a minor foe and leaves no records of true name.

feats.scene: Sansaran flings a cloud of gloom that stuns a pair of guards.
Sansaran takes a blast of lightning on a wristband and scrambles away.

name: Vorllu
summary: Vorllu is a young bowman from a drowned warrior tribe who survived a flood and joined a rogue captain's crew. Vorllu decides to stay aboard as his own master, no longer treated as a child.

feats.scene: Vorllu drives an arrow through a mast.
Vorllu swims through a storm to a ship and climbs aboard.

name: Vasleoniu
summary: Vasleoniu is a reed-flute player from a salt-marsh village who can lull storms and sleeping giants with a single tune. Grief over a lost bride sends it wandering, trading songs for safe passage wherever the road turns hostile.

feats.scene: Vasleoniu plays a rising tune that cracks a boulder blocking the marsh road.
Vasleoniu shrugs off a collapsing reed hut that buries it to the waist.

name: Toerunus
summary: Toerunus is a booming-voiced broadcaster and stage director whose staged alarm over the airwaves sends a whole region scrambling indoors. Its real talent lies in persuading crowds, not in fighting them.

feats.scene: Toerunus swats a heckler's hand aside with a rolled-up script.
Toerunus tumbles down a theatre aisle and stands up laughing.

name: Ritis
summary: Vyra-class sea mage Ritis serves a cruel monarch as chief enforcer, commanding a flood wave that swallows a walled port and half its own soldiers. It reports victory without checking who actually survived.

feats.scene: Ritis calls up a towering wave that flattens a fortified harbour town.
Ritis stands unmoved as a siege engine's boulder shatters against its ward.

name: Aulessta
summary: Aulessta is a small-time thug with a record of mugging and one fatal ambush on a masked nightwatcher. Its luck ends when a cloaked pursuer drags it to the station.

feats.scene: Aulessta lands a clumsy haymaker on a rival in an alley.
Aulessta takes a nightstick blow across the shoulders and keeps running.

name: Rniorarer
summary: Rniorarer is a fussy lecturer whose bones keep walking after an untimely end, driven by a promise to a gatekeeper beyond the clouds. A tiny winged courier tags along as its invisible chaperone.

feats.scene: Rniorarer clatters forward and shoves a crook through a lab door.
Rniorarer rattles apart under a falling cabinet and reassembles itself.

name: Viinuri
summary: Viinuri is a stiff-collared factory owner who runs a family firm with chilly efficiency. Its rigid views cost it a close bond with its own child.

feats.scene: Viinuri slams a ledger onto a boardroom table.
Viinuri slips on a wet stair and walks off without a bruise.

name: Inuserve
summary: Inuserve is a many-coloured sky wyrm that coils through storm fronts and spins whole islands into being from vapour and borrowed spirit. It can slip into the gaps between realms and is thought never to age.

feats.scene: Inuserve whirls a vast tornado of light until a fresh world condenses at its centre.
Inuserve coils around a collapsing sphere of rock and holds it together.

name: Roscicor
summary: Roscicor is a bald, green-robed judge of the departed who also tends harvests and sprouting seed. Mourners pray to it, and its strength rises and falls with their devotion.

feats.scene: Roscicor draws a curved blade through a stone gate and splits it from top to bottom.
Roscicor stands calmly while a collapsing temple roof rains onto its shoulders.

source_title: Osiris, God of the Dead (New Earth)

name: Reornesti
summary: Reornesti is a lab-built metal automaton with a pliant body that can reshape itself and stretch across a room. It follows its maker's instructions and rarely wanders far from the workshop.

feats.scene: Reornesti stretches an arm across a warehouse and flips a loaded cart.
Reornesti is rammed by a truck and simply reshapes its dented chest.

name: Amnoau
summary: Amnoau is a masked ambusher with a talon motif who strikes from rooftops and vanishes into the dusk. Little is known beyond its habit of picking fights with an emerald-skinned wanderer.

feats.scene: Amnoau dives off a gable and kicks a lantern from a guard's hand.
Amnoau drops from a rooftop onto a awning and shakes it off.

name: Corrneti
summary: Corrneti is a teenaged ex-arena fighter with scarlet hair who carries a sliver of an ancient blaze inside its chest. Its twin watches over it, and wary onlookers whisper that the flame prefers it over any elder.

feats.scene: Corrneti releases a burst of red heat that melts a quarter of a canyon wall.
Corrneti walks out of a collapsing tower of steel, unscorched.

name: Seeonse
summary: Seeonse is a red-haired inventor who built a cloud-seeding contraption and uses it to drench towns that cross him. Its schemes are petty, but a flood in the wrong week can ruin a harvest.

feats.scene: Seeonse cranks its machine and unleashes a downpour that floods a market square.
Seeonse is knocked off a platform and lands in a wet heap.

name: Siaremi
summary: Siaremi is a boyhood friend turned dockside racketeer who flies its own little propeller plane to run errands. Old loyalties tug at it whenever its schoolmates need a favour.

feats.scene: Siaremi punches a smuggler who tried to stiff it on a payment.
Siaremi survives a hard landing in a field after its engine sputters out.

name: Siaorlor
summary: Siaorlor is a pompous crook who opens shops as fronts and fills them with gadget-laden parasols. It brags about its craftiness while its schemes unravel in cheerful, colourful style.

feats.scene: Siaorlor fires a spring-loaded gadget that knocks a bag of loot across a room.
Siaorlor falls through a shop awning and tidies its tie.

name: Lissonnes
summary: Lissonnes is a stunted outcast raised in a cage who grows into a sewer-dwelling boss with a flock of trained birds. Bitterness drives its plans, and it fancies itself a true beast.

feats.scene: Lissonnes triggers a rocket strapped to a bird and blows a hole in a wall.
Lissonnes plunges down a flooded shaft and crawls out sputtering.

name: Tanmilll
summary: Tanmilll is a monocled racketeer who rules the alleys until a ruthless gunman picks the crew apart. It never reaches the second act.

feats.scene: Tanmilll shoves a debtor against a brick wall.
Tanmilll absorbs a beating from enforcers and stays upright.

source_title: Oswald Cobblepot (Dark Multiverse: The Grim Knight)

name: Lisnan
summary: Lisnan is a rotund bird-fancier teased as a child for lugging a rain shield everywhere. It grows up resentful and plots feathered thefts to prove its worth.

feats.scene: Lisnan swings its folded shield into a guard's ribs.
Lisnan tumbles from a pier and drags itself ashore.

name: Iumartel
summary: Iumartel is a smooth, scheming underling who claws up the criminal ladder through flattery and betrayal. It dresses sharply and hides sentiment behind a polished smile.

feats.scene: Iumartel fires a pistol that shatters a bar mirror.
Iumartel is hurled down a staircase and straightens its collar at the bottom.

name: Ereriare
summary: Ereriare is a ward patient under observation whose cell is flung open during a night riot. It slips out among the crowd and is never recaptured.

feats.scene: Ereriare shoulders open a half-rusted door.
Ereriare is clubbed during the riot and keeps moving.

name: Sorli
summary: Sorli is a blocky toy-brick crook who builds remote-controlled flightless birds and sneaks them into a city centre. It laughs maniacally whenever its gadgets work, which is not often.

feats.scene: Sorli sets off a swarm of robotic birds that topple a row of market stalls.
Sorli pops back together after being smashed to loose bricks.

name: Sintota
summary: Sintota is a cheerful quizmaster at a coffeehouse who keeps score with a grin and a dry-erase marker. It is entirely ordinary and likes it that way.

feats.scene: Sintota taps a bell on the counter to start the next round.
Sintota slips from a stool and brushes off the fall.

name: Illres
summary: Illres is a short, grinning trickster who commits thefts with pop-guns, squirting buttonhole flowers and timed firecrackers. Its jokes sometimes go off with real force.

feats.scene: Illres rigs a crate of fireworks that blows out a shopfront.
Illres bounces off a delivery cart and runs on giggling.

name: Anserau
summary: Anserau is a fierce teenaged ex-arena fighter who guards a younger sibling with ferocious devotion. Starlike light gathers around its fists when it is angry.

feats.scene: Anserau slams a fist into the ground and cracks a whole plaza.
Anserau bursts out of a toppled building without a scratch.

name: Iuultor
summary: Iuultor is a hired muscle for a rich schemer who loiters in the back of the room with a clipboard. It never gets its moment onscreen.

feats.scene: Iuultor shoves a delivery crate across a warehouse floor.
Iuultor gets knocked over by a forklift and stands up.

name: Olurn
summary: Olurn is a mild-mannered personal assistant who sips fruity drinks and quietly urges its employer toward kindness. It meets a sad end while shielding someone else.

feats.scene: Olurn tosses a stack of files onto a desk.
Olurn is thrown into a wall and gets up slowly.

name: Telniaau
summary: Telniaau is a former circus clown who builds a harness of tiny magnet motors and glides between spots on invisible footholds. Heartbreak turns its acrobatics toward theft.

feats.scene: Telniaau swings on a magnetic hold and kicks a crate through a window.
Telniaau plummets from a lamp post and bounces up unhurt.

name: Amoserva
summary: Amoserva is a pale-haired mercenary whose mere presence silences every strange gift within earshot. Governments hire it to disarm gifted targets before they strike.

feats.scene: Amoserva cracks a cane across a bodyguard's wrist.
Amoserva falls down a stairwell and brushes off its coat.

name: Iumiumeon
summary: Iumiumeon is a loyal aide stationed at the door of a besieged cellar office who waves visitors in without question. It is the first to find the silent scene beyond.

feats.scene: Iumiumeon slams a heavy door shut behind a visitor.
Iumiumeon stumbles during a shelling and keeps standing.

name: Lenco
summary: Lenco is a cane-wielding spymaster and researcher obsessed with a mythical fifth element. It builds a global network under a false name and later slips into forgetfulness.

feats.scene: Lenco drives a hidden blade through a thick oak door.
Lenco is thrown against a bulkhead and shakes it off.

name: Nulin
summary: Nulin is a power-hungry despot of a small mountain nation who hires a sorcerer to crush a foreign trouble-maker. The plan fails and the despot is humiliated in its own study.

feats.scene: Nulin pounds the desk and sends a pen flying.
Nulin is shoved through a curtain and lands in a heap.

name: Siliuium
summary: Siliuium is a bald, stern statesman who engineers diplomatic insults to goad a neighbour into war. Its schemes are halted by a tiny intruder who tumbles out of nowhere.

feats.scene: Siliuium bangs a cane on the floor to summon guards.
Siliuium is knocked against a tapestry and slumps.

name: Sauanuau
summary: Sauanuau is a young brother of a mountain family reshaped into a gooey weapon by a secretive cabal. Its touch dissolves almost anything, and it wants only to go home.

feats.scene: Sauanuau slaps a wall and dissolves a doorway-sized hole.
Sauanuau takes a truck's impact and reforms around it.

name: Liavilon
summary: Liavilon is a mighty scaled serpent deity awakened from ancient slumber, with acid venom and a hide nothing can pierce. It ravages a pair of rival worlds before fire finally ends its rampage.

feats.scene: Liavilon breathes a wave of fire that scorches the crust of a neighbouring world.
Liavilon shrugs off a barrage of orbital cannons without a scratch.

name: Leoulti
summary: Leoulti is a blonde clone-cousin of a famed champion, engineered in a parallel world ruled by tyrants. It is mighty, loyal and doomed to fall in a final skirmish.

feats.scene: Leoulti punches a stone tower and collapses it onto the plain.
Leoulti endures a barrage of artillery shells and keeps walking.

name: Sonanllu
summary: Sonanllu is a power-hungry being that feeds on electricity and goes mad when a city switches on a vast signal net. Its agony wipes out hundreds before it disappears for good.

feats.scene: Sonanllu discharges stored current and stops a whole district's pulse.
Sonanllu absorbs a transformer blast and glows brighter.

name: Luarau
summary: Luarau is a faceless drone sent by a brutal matron to watch and hunt escapees. It fires bolts from its chest until a trickster outwits it.

feats.scene: Luarau fires a bolt from its chest that blasts a cart to scrap.
Luarau is struck by a thrown beam and merely spins around.

name: Numcol
summary: Numcol is a black-haired servant who wields a glowing chain at the command of a dark overlord. Its loyalty is forced, but it fights hard anyway.

feats.scene: Numcol whips its chain around a pillar and rips it free.
Numcol is thrown into a wall and shakes off the blow.

name: Anuro
summary: Anuro is a sharp-tongued weapons dealer who briefly tried a costumed career with hurled blades. It resents its notorious father and cannot stop picking fights.

feats.scene: Anuro flings a curved blade that sticks deep into a post.
Anuro is thrown across a cell and stays upright.

name: Seiunu
summary: Seiunu is a balding therapist who rambles about itself while its patients stare at the clock. A stray remark nonetheless helps crack a jewel theft.

feats.scene: Seiunu taps a pen on a notepad until a client leaves.
Seiunu trips on a rug and lands softly.

name: Orasertia
summary: Orasertia is a cult marksman assigned to help a young sleuth hunt for proof. It is picked off by a rival before the job is done.

feats.scene: Orasertia fires a rifle that cracks a window pane from far across a street.
Orasertia takes a fall from a loading dock and rolls clear.

name: Iumlesti
summary: Iumlesti is a feathered-cowl combatant from a mirror-image world, throwing bladed boomerangs and trading blows with seasoned brawlers. It holds even odds against a hooded gunman.

feats.scene: Iumlesti hurls a bladed boomerang that sinks into a beam.
Iumlesti takes a punishing kick and counters without slowing.

name: Siairnval
summary: Siairnval is a brilliant night-themed schemer whose helmet lenses sharpen a modest talent for reading minds. It leads a gang of super-criminals that rules its world until challenged by two teams of defenders.

feats.scene: Siairnval focuses its helmet lenses and drops a guard with a mental jolt.
Siairnval stumbles out of a collapsed rooftop shelter unhurt.

name: Ntoeoll
summary: Ntoeoll is a half-alien fighter from a far-future century, raised to be a hero despite its mixed ancestry. It joins a vast league that rounds up empowered rogues.

feats.scene: Ntoeoll smashes a vault door apart with a single blow.
Ntoeoll endures a blast that wrecks a hovercraft.

name: Ntisto
summary: Ntisto is a gaseous criminal made of corrosive vapour that eats through metal friends. It drifts, rushes and slips through narrow gaps to rob a lab.

feats.scene: Ntisto sweeps through a vault and eats a girder in two.
Ntisto is swatted by a mallet and drifts back together.

name: Tirira
summary: Tirira is a bumbling ex-welder who drinks at a pub and tags along when a pair of local heroes chase a clown. It is never named on the page.

feats.scene: Tirira slams a mug on a table in a toast.
Tirira slides off a barstool and hops back up.

name: Astestor
