summary: Astestor is a grey-haired elder statesman who chairs a council on a rebuilt star-colony. It speaks slowly and weighs every vote.

feats.scene: Astestor lifts a fallen beam off a trapped delegate.
Astestor stays standing as a chamber ceiling gives way.

name: Unrneor
summary: Unrneor is a street dancer who keeps a neighbourhood safe after dark and later earns a portrait in a hall of heroes. Its moves are quick and showy, never deadly.

feats.scene: Unrneor spins out of a pirouette and kicks a mugger's knife away.
Unrneor bounces off a car hood and keeps dancing.

name: Leviria
summary: Leviria is a homeless kid with a flair for nicknames who rescues a stretchy hero and nearly gets taken in. It survives on charm and quick feet.

feats.scene: Leviria shoves a trash can into a pursuer's path.
Leviria tumbles off a fence and bounces up grinning.

name: Stonancol
summary: Stonancol is a former runway star who dons a theatrical face-covering and kidnaps her old bosses over a bruised ego. She fights well and carries a scythe themed on seasons.

feats.scene: Stonancol swings a scythe and cleaves a mannequin in two.
Stonancol is slammed into a rack and keeps swinging.

name: Santer
summary: Santer is a blade-master from a drowned island world whose own skin seals a dangerous inner power. It learns any weapon within minutes and works as a hired killer.

feats.scene: Santer lets a sliver of caged energy slip and cracks a canyon ledge.
Santer takes a barrage of blades and walks on.

name: Tecis
summary: Tecis is a glowering automaton built to inflict hurt and later taught to want other things. Its fists spark with a stinging charge.

feats.scene: Tecis fires a stinging bolt from its palm that shatters a lamp pole.
Tecis is thrown across a garage and clatters upright.

source_title: Pain Bot (Teen Titans Go! TV Series)

name: Sotorosa
summary: Sotorosa is a hired gun who numbs limbs with a touch, leaving targets unable to run. It works for a corpulent boss and a street crew until its luck ends.

feats.scene: Sotorosa hurls a man across an alley.
Sotorosa takes a heavy blow without flinching and answers with a grin.

name: Lliron
summary: Lliron is a yellow-skinned guardian who wears a glowing ring and draws on a central power cell. It is cut down in a ruinous assault on its home post.

feats.scene: Lliron forms a vast beam that blasts a crater into a moon.
Lliron holds a shimmering shield while tower debris crashes down.

name: Riaornan
summary: Riaornan is a pink-skinned sector sentinel who patrols with a glowing ring and a recharging lantern. It relies on stubborn willpower more than skill.

feats.scene: Riaornan forms a green lance that pierces a drifting asteroid.
Riaornan raises a bubble that withstands a collapsing space station.

name: Enuli
summary: Enuli is a cartoonish patrol officer with a glowing ring and a shared battery. It flies, shoots and shields, always cheerfully.

feats.scene: Enuli blasts a glowing bolt through a rocky cliff.
Enuli ducks inside a bubble as a ship crashes into it.

name: Vavasas
summary: Vavasas is an ancient sea goddess worshipped in a drowned kingdom before its fall. Fishermen praise it as the stronger of two rival tide-spirits.

feats.scene: Vavasas raises a tide that drowns a whole coastline.
Vavasas rides out a volcanic eruption beneath the waves.

name: Catausi
summary: Catausi is a warrior woman from an island sisterhood who gathers with her peers to pray before a wedding journey. She is a minor figure with a trained eye.

feats.scene: Catausi cracks a wooden practice post with a spear butt.
Catausi is thrown in the sparring ring and rises quickly.

name: Nesllte
summary: Nesllte is a tiny orange-haired queen of a far-off planet who kidnaps strong travellers to build a sun-blocking bomb. She complains that a planet is in the way of her view.

feats.scene: Nesllte detonates a prototype charge that levels a hill.
Nesllte is flung from her throne and bounces up cross.

name: Riarare
summary: Riarare is a plant-obsessed eco-radical locked in a cell, desperate to save her leafy companions. She blossoms into a menace once her vines are free.

feats.scene: Riarare sends a thick vine through a window and cracks a guard's baton.
Riarare shrugs off a poison cloud that fells nearby guards.

name: Tatelra
summary: Tatelra is a botanist transformed by a rival's toxic experiments who grows to command plants and spread scents that sway minds. She wants a cleansed city, whatever the cost.

feats.scene: Tatelra grows a root that splits a sidewalk and flips a parked van.
Tatelra laughs off a lungful of poison gas.

name: Costi
summary: Costi is a leafy spirit whose awareness spreads through every tree and bush in a city park. It guards a sanctuary against a harsh regime by snaring intruders.

feats.scene: Costi tightens a thicket around a patrol truck and crumples it.
Costi regrows a burned grove within moments.

name: Lence
summary: Lence is a pint-sized botanist who races in a goofy tournament and frets about seasonal harvests. It lands in a cell with two partners in mischief.

feats.scene: Lence swings a watering can at a rival racer.
Lence tumbles off a go-kart and bounces upright.

name: Rorvos
summary: Rorvos is an elderly plant-whisperer who has long since divorced her wild partner. She still waters her garden and shrugs off any toxin.

feats.scene: Rorvos coaxes a vine to snap a fence rail.
Rorvos sips a poisonous brew and does not flinch.

name: Sercorni
summary: Sercorni is a sultry cartoon villainess who bends plant life to her will and bosses henchmen around. Her blooms snag heroes and hold them in place.

feats.scene: Sercorni sends a thorny vine through a billboard and shreds it.
Sercorni weathers a crash through a greenhouse roof.

source_title: Pamela Isley (The Brave and the Bold)

name: Riian
summary: Riian is a green-tinged radical genius who knows chemistry and toxins and leads a movement for the wild. Her story is told over audio and her enemies never see her coming.

feats.scene: Riian floods a ventilation shaft with a pollen that drops a room of guards.
Riian drinks a lethal dose and walks away laughing.

name: Anucaia
summary: Anucaia is a nimble thief who runs with a gang of hired muscle and sneaks past guards. It has had a few narrow escapes from a cat-eared burglar.

feats.scene: Anucaia shoves open a jammed window and slips inside.
Anucaia drops two floors onto a trash heap and scampers off.

name: Seotorcol
summary: Seotorcol is a reformed sneak-thief trained by a famed cat-burglar who moves to a port city with her boyfriend. A support circle helps her stay out of jail.

feats.scene: Seotorcol pops a lock with a bent wire and a sharp twist.
Seotorcol is slammed against a cell wall and stays on her feet.

name: Taureorer
summary: Taureorer is a smuggler turned scent-brewer whose perfume sends soldiers to sleep and tints her skin green. She travels with allies across wartime lands on the back of a winged ray.

feats.scene: Taureorer uncorks a sweet vapour that drops a squad of soldiers.
Taureorer is thrown from a flying mount and lands in a haystack.

name: Sasinnes
summary: Sasinnes is a blue-haired scout with red eyes who cloaks herself and her squad from sight and sound. She prefers a quiet firearm to a loud fight.

feats.scene: Sasinnes fires a silenced rifle at a guard's helmet from across a courtyard.
Sasinnes drops down a ledge and rolls to cover.

name: Coostel
summary: Coostel is a masked wind-themed defender who watches over a southern territory. It rides gusts across the pampas to help a local league.

feats.scene: Coostel hurls a gust-driven punch that shoves a bandit through a fence.
Coostel is tossed from a horse and rolls up unhurt.

name: Tanern
summary: Tanern is a horned, hoofed deity of tunes who retires to a forest, then a noisy city, and plays flute for a jazz crowd. Its notes force listeners to dance or sprout fur.

feats.scene: Tanern blows a single note that sends a dance-crazed crowd stampeding through a hall.
Tanern shrugs off a falling stage truss without breaking its tune.

name: Telsau
summary: Telsau is a flirtatious wood-spirit with horns who trails a swarm of sprites and carves a set of reed pipes. Its melodies make hearts race and mortals lose their wits.

feats.scene: Telsau plays a lilting tune that pulls a trance over a whole camp.
Telsau tumbles down a ravine and trots away humming.

name: Sasve
summary: Sasve is a cheerful caravan outfitter secretly descended from a famed warlord. It splits a legendary hoard among friends and keeps its lineage quiet.

feats.scene: Sasve slaps a camel's flank to start a convoy rolling.
Sasve is thrown from a pony and brushes off the dust.

name: Orton
summary: Orton is a hulking blue-skinned outlaw who leads a pack of raiders and disguises itself as a pack animal. It hides a rotary cannon beneath the costume.

feats.scene: Orton rips open its disguise and sprays a rotary cannon across a barricade.
Orton is beaten by an angry mob and stands up laughing.

name: Nenelrau
summary: Nenelrau is a woman of old tales who is named only in passing before a cosmic tribunal. Whatever she did, the record has nothing more to add.

feats.scene: Nenelrau slams a lid shut on a clay jar.
Nenelrau is shoved across a courtyard and stands again.

name: Soniusto
summary: Soniusto is an ancient forager cursed to wander forever after prying open a skull that unleashes terrible spirits on her village. She now carries a blue-eyed stare and a weary sense of guilt.

feats.scene: Soniusto lets a burst of cursed power flatten a cluster of stone huts.
Soniusto survives the collapse of a cavern without a mark.

name: Ranvesti
summary: Ranvesti is a white-haired protector spirit from an ordered realm who takes shape as a gem and rides inside a host. It flies and hurls blasts of eldritch force before falling in a clash with chaos agents.

feats.scene: Ranvesti sends a violet bolt that collapses a fortress tower.
Ranvesti holds its ground as a chaos lord's spell tears up the earth.

name: Tentu
summary: Tentu is a freelance rifleman available to anyone with cash who joins a kidnapping crew. A duel with an expert sharpshooter proves fatal.

feats.scene: Tentu fires a rifle round that cracks a brick wall from far away.
Tentu falls off a roof and rolls to cover.

name: Islor
summary: Islor is a muscular grappler who appears in a goofy hidden-picture segment on a children's show. She likes wrestling holds more than puzzles.

feats.scene: Islor hoists a prop crate overhead for a pose.
Islor takes a body slam on a foam mat and grins.

name: Seauau
summary: Seauau is a giant purple feline that serves as a reluctant flying steed for a haughty rider. It has sharp fangs and claws and a short temper.

feats.scene: Seauau swipes a claw and rips a post from a stable wall.
Seauau tumbles from the sky and crash-lands on a tower roof.

name: Neniumam
summary: Neniumam is a hired mercenary in a gang of muscle-bound villains sent after a hitman. Its crew is wiped out before the job even begins.

feats.scene: Neniumam wrenches a steel door from its hinges.
Neniumam shakes off a handful of pistol rounds.

name: Neltas
summary: Neltas is a pale youth who stretches her limbs like a ribbon and works with two partners sent by a scheming headmistress. They flop against a team of teens within one episode.

feats.scene: Neltas whips a stretched arm and trips a startled teen.
Neltas is crumpled and flattens herself back out.

name: Malon
summary: Malon is a trained sea mammal who helps a crew of divers and bonds with one of them. It balances a ball on its nose and barks at danger.

feats.scene: Malon flips a ball off its nose into a bucket.
Malon slides off a dock and splashes in unhurt.

name: Seonava
summary: Seonava is a white-haired shock-trooper who defects from a brutal matron and is pressed into a team of rogues. It rides a rocket sled and carries several humming cubes.

feats.scene: Seonava rams its rocket sled through a brick facade.
Seonava crawls from the wreck of its sled with a grin.

name: Aunlianum
summary: Aunlianum is a dawn-of-time parasite that feeds on dread and drives whole civilisations to ruin out of paranoia. It lives in a yellow reservoir and prefers a famous host.

feats.scene: Aunlianum feeds on a sector's panic and unleashes a wave that sterilises a star system.
Aunlianum is sealed in a vault and stays intact for ages.

name: Oricava
summary: Oricava is a brown-haired crook who conjures showers for his crimes and meets his end in a first appearance. Not much else is known.

feats.scene: Oricava shoves a tin bucket into a guard.
Oricava is soaked by his own downpour and slips on the cobbles.

name: Taniaslle
summary: Taniaslle is a green-eyed alien grub that hitchhikes inside a host and befriends her while eating her nutrients. It grows into a bristling, hungry brute.

feats.scene: Taniaslle bursts from a cocoon and tosses a couch across a room.
Taniaslle absorbs a lamp hit and wriggles free.

name: Tirartu
summary: Tirartu is a golden-haired song-spirit cursed into a twisted tree and carved into a wrist bangle. Her voice entrances men, and whoever wears the bangle borrows her power.

feats.scene: Tirartu sings a note that sends a ship's crew staggering overboard.
Tirartu endures an axe blow on her carved wood and hums on.

name: Ralvauel
summary: Ralvauel is a walking figure of speech who can animate any object within sight. It insists on a friendlier nickname and loves having tea with chairs.

feats.scene: Ralvauel animates a sofa that charges through a wall.
Ralvauel shrugs off a falling bookshelf.

name: Rnlloce
summary: Rnlloce is a meek designer brought back from drowning by a stray feline and gifted with cat-like reflexes. She prowls at night to find those who wronged her.

feats.scene: Rnlloce leaps between rooftops and kicks a sentry clean off a ledge.
Rnlloce lands from a fourth floor window without a bruise.

name: Lieorau
summary: Lieorau is a desert-city warrior woman who trains in archery, horsemanship and swords and befriends a rival princess. She is blessed by two goddesses of war and the hunt.

feats.scene: Lieorau draws a bow and sends an arrow through a shield.
Lieorau is flung from a horse and rolls to her feet.

name: Iurontel
summary: Iurontel is a brown-eyed officer in a covert chess-themed agency who is cut down on her first mission. She holds the rank of queen.

feats.scene: Iurontel slams a briefcase into an agent's chest.
Iurontel takes a shove against a wall and stands again.

name: Osarnisor
summary: Osarnisor is a red-haired, decadent member of a hidden society that hires a costumed killer to guard its secrets. It lures a recruit into cruelty and ruin.

feats.scene: Osarnisor shoves a clubgoer against a bar.
Osarnisor takes a punch in a back alley and staggers on.

name: Asitor
summary: Asitor is a tinkerer who pilots a hulking armoured suit from inside its head, fixing the base in quiet hours and joining brawls when needed. The suit is strong, tough and rocket-boosted.

feats.scene: Asitor drives the suit's fist through a reinforced bulkhead.
Asitor takes a volley of blasts on the armour and keeps walking.

name: Nelserse
summary: Nelserse is a gruff garage mechanic who welds himself a lumbering steel exosuit and wades into brawls beside a teenage partner. Cleverness with tools and blunt loyalty carry him further than any raw talent.

feats.scene: Nelserse swings a hydraulic gauntlet through a brick wall to free a trapped partner.
Nelserse stands in his welded suit while a delivery truck slams into it and stops dead.

name: Tasiu
summary: Tasiu is a quiet retired sidekick who now fixes cars in a small farm town. A dusty trunk of old gear in his garage hides the stories he never tells his stepdaughter.

feats.scene: Tasiu drops a would-be thief with one swing of a wrench behind the shop.
Tasiu shrugs off a hard shove through a plank fence and goes back to work.

name: Anivitum
summary: Anivitum is a corrupt, vain leader raised in a wealthy household of bigots, scheming his way into the highest office. His incompetence and old crimes finally unravel his career in a public scandal.

feats.scene: Anivitum slams a fist on the desk and orders a whole agency built overnight.
Anivitum takes a hard blow from an angry crowd member and stays on his feet.

name: Lluiu
summary: Lluiu is a red-haired slum kid turned brawler who defends his corner of the city with scrappy fists. Grown up, he trades the street fight for running a research outfit and teaching children.

feats.scene: Lluiu lands a looping haymaker that flattens a bully twice his size.
Lluiu takes a tumble down a flight of tenement stairs and gets up laughing.

name: Tuestles
summary: Tuestles is a small-town lawman who patrols a quiet coastal village. He relies on a sidearm, patient questions and careful reading of crime scenes.

feats.scene: A single pistol shot from the sheriff disarms a smuggler across a dock.
The sheriff takes a thrown crate to the ribs and keeps interrogating.

name: Vaesral
summary: Vaesral is a grey-haired hired killer who takes jobs in dark alleys and has long since stopped feeling anything. Late in life he wonders aloud whether anyone is watching, and the answer is never kind.

feats.scene: Vaesral fires a revolver twice in an alley and walks away without looking back.
Vaesral staggers through a hard beating from rival thugs and still reaches the door.

name: Nenorean
summary: Nenorean is a loudmouthed arms supplier who hides his nerves behind jokes and bravado. When captors torture him, he finally proves to the friend he admires that the bluster was never the whole of him.

feats.scene: Nenorean heaves a crate of rifles onto a van bed and grins.
Nenorean endures a long beating without giving up a single name.

name: Venin
summary: Venin is a rubbery hero whose whole body bends, stretches and rebounds like warm putty. He fights crime with gags, lasso arms and impossible reach, never bothering to hide his grin.

feats.scene: Venin coils one arm into a spring and snaps a punch through a parked van.

name: Iartenum
summary: Iartenum is a fallen jester whose stretchy body becomes a living moat around a besieged shelter, hungry and mindless. Only a wall of fire and a spell finally put him down.

feats.scene: Iartenum lunges as a wide wave of flesh and crushes a bunker door inward.
Iartenum shrugs off fanged blows and spreads thinner until only furnace heat harms him.

name: Siurne
summary: Siurne is a sly rubbery crook who slips into a prison inside a fellow inmate and helps stage a mass escape. A rival melts him with a flame gun, yet he oozes back to settle the score.

feats.scene: Siurne stretches into a fist and knocks a cell door off its hinges.

name: Llunenvor
summary: Llunenvor is a cartoonish cousin of a stretchy hero, bending into silly shapes for a children's tale. Danger rarely sticks to a body that gives way and snaps back.

feats.scene: Llunenvor stretches a noodle arm across a playground and flicks a ball over the fence.
Llunenvor is sat on by a clumsy giant toy and pops back up round again.

name: Tortires
summary: Tortires is an ex-thief whose body stretches, twists and inflates like a balloon into any shape he can dream up. He insists the gift only magnified a decency he already carried inside.

feats.scene: Tortires swells his fist to the size of a boulder and flattens a warehouse door.

name: Corso
summary: Corso is a schoolhouse janitor by day and a bendy hero by night, with a young crime-fighting child of his own. His mop and his stretchy limbs get the same cheerful workout.

feats.scene: Corso stretches an arm down a hallway and swats a runaway cart.
Corso is flattened under a falling shelf and inflates back to full height.

name: Vement
summary: Vement is a flag-draped champion from a parallel city, married to a fellow hero and father to a hero-in-training. Little is known of his deeds except that he marches under a patriotic banner.

feats.scene: Vement hurls a shield-shaped disc across a plaza and knocks a robber off his feet.
Vement stands firm as a runaway bus clips his shoulder.

name: Vecor
summary: Vecor is a loyal spearman of an old war, fighting shoulder to shoulder with a beloved companion on a windy plain. His death in battle sets a far greater warrior alight with grief.

feats.scene: Vecor drives a bronze spear through a raider's shield in a single thrust.
Vecor blocks a heavy mace with his shield and keeps advancing.

name: Inautum
summary: Inautum is a legendary warrior whose remains are sought by a vampire who wants to rewrite memory with a bone spell. Two unlikely heroes stop the ritual and keep the old love story intact.

feats.scene: Inautum cuts down a charging raider with a single sweep of a short blade.
Inautum takes a spear in the shoulder and fights on to cover a retreat.

name: Iartaser
summary: Iartaser is a stocky, white-furred family dog who guards a suburban household with growls and a fierce nose. He is brave far beyond his size and always first to the door.

feats.scene: Iartaser clamps his jaws on a burglar's sleeve and drags him off the porch.
Iartaser tumbles down a flight of stairs and shakes it off.

name: Aststueon
summary: Aststueon is a crook who steals a hero's notebook, hires scientists to build gadgets that conjure quakes and storms, and wears a device that shields him from his own mess. Later he reforms and joins a team.

feats.scene: Aststueon triggers a rig that shakes a whole district until chimneys topple.
Aststueon walks out of a blast that levels the lab around him, shielded by his belt.

name: Iutece
summary: Iutece is a gentle woodsman from tall tales who apologises for the clumsiness of his giant ox. Mountains of timber fall to his axe in a single morning.

feats.scene: Iutece fells an entire hillside of pines in one long sweep of his axe.
Iutece shrugs off a toppling cliff face as if it were a snowball.

name: Leolli
summary: Leolli is a minor villain in a jokey cartoon world who wears a colourful helmet and auditions for a bigger bad guy's side. Nobody takes him seriously, least of all himself.

feats.scene: Leolli throws a flimsy punch that barely rattles a lamp.
Leolli collides with a stage prop and bounces off dizzy.

name: Stanser
summary: Stanser is a manufactured soldier who rebels against his programming, gathers a ragtag band of outlaws and turns them against a tyrant from the sky. He dies finishing the job.

feats.scene: Stanser drives a hard right through a steel locker to break out.
Stanser takes a hail of rounds across a corridor and keeps running.

name: Valnanll
summary: Valnanll is a retired officer who spends his twilight years writing down the deeds of costumed legends he glimpsed as a boy. He once collected protection money before a shopkeeper's murder changed him.

feats.scene: Valnanll shoves a bully off a newsstand and shouts for help.
Valnanll takes a beating in an alley and still holds on to his papers.

name: Varresci
summary: Varresci is a working actor who plays a dashing romantic lead in a television show within a show. A fan fashions her own fantasy partner from his performance.

feats.scene: Varresci throws a staged punch and sells it with a dramatic stumble.
Varresci falls through a breakaway table during a rehearsal and laughs.

name: Ceocor
summary: Ceocor is an engineer who goes to prison, then builds a helmet that scrambles the structure of matter to take revenge on those who put him there. A masked detective ends his spree and takes the gadget.

feats.scene: Ceocor aims his helmet at a vault door and its steel turns to crumbling sand.
Ceocor takes a hard tackle and goes down with his gadget hand twitching.

name: Nauserium
summary: Nauserium is a cold, blond henchman serving a ruthless dictator at the height of a terrible war. He dies in the same chapter he is introduced.

feats.scene: Nauserium fires a pistol across a command tent without flinching.
Nauserium takes a rifle butt to the jaw and sneers.

name: Lorosaone
summary: Lorosaone is a widowed genius from a parallel world who gains angelic wings after meeting every version of herself at the dawn of time. She swings a blade that cuts across ages and sees past the edge of her own story.

feats.scene: Lorosaone slices through the sky with a time-cutting blade and splits a whole storm front.
Lorosaone folds her wings around herself while a collapsing tower buries her.

name: Eoncorosa
summary: Eoncorosa is a reformed scientist who lives among warrior sisters on a hidden isle and tunes a purple healing beam to work faster. She saves a dying youth and builds a flying kite for an ally.

feats.scene: Eoncorosa triggers a stripped-down lamp that cooks a training dummy to cinders.
Eoncorosa is thrown against a lab bench and gets up with a scraped elbow.

name: Nuiarti
summary: Nuiarti is a gifted gene scientist who leads humans from a dying home to a terraformed red planet, then builds her own floating city. She breeds a beast-like sisterhood there and loses control as it fractures.

feats.scene: Nuiarti triggers a terraforming engine that melts a frozen plain into a lake.
Nuiarti falls under a mob's blows and does not rise again.

name: Raullo
summary: Raullo is a boyish-looking soldier who is really half a century old, a living reactor that fires nuclear blasts and soaks up the same. His strikes can hurt even an ancient divine being.

feats.scene: Raullo releases a blast of glowing atomic fire that vaporises a bunker and the hill above it.
Raullo drinks in a radiant barrage meant to kill him and glows brighter.

name: Ticorna
summary: Ticorna is a blue-furred space dog with several arms, serving a patrol of alien canine heroes. He crosses the stars to fight for justice on four legs and a few extra limbs.

feats.scene: Ticorna swings three arms at once and knocks a smuggler through a hatch.
Ticorna rides out a gravity surge in a damaged shuttle without a scratch.

name: Sorlla
summary: Sorlla is a ruthless young heir who schemes to take over his father's tech empire at any price. He wears expensive suits and has never thrown a punch in his life.

feats.scene: Sorlla slaps a contract down so hard the pen jumps off the desk.
Sorlla is pushed over a conference chair and complains for an hour.

name: Iuseval
summary: Iuseval is an ancient blue-skinned elder who commands willpower-based energy, shaping hard light constructs and firing great blasts. He lives for ages and helps a council subdue a colleague gone mad.

feats.scene: Iuseval shapes a glowing wall of green light and flings it through an asteroid, cracking it open.
Iuseval absorbs a furious blast from a mad colleague and gestures it away.

name: Llusti
summary: Llusti is a red-eyed lord of the underworld who possesses living victims, hurls infernal flame and opens gates between worlds. Brute strength and dark rites make him a patient menace until an exorcism sends him packing.

feats.scene: Llusti pours a river of black fire across a church and collapses its roof.
Llusti walks unharmed through a hail of blessed bullets, leaving steaming footprints.

name: Nuleniu
summary: Nuleniu is a masked rogue who joins a team of troublemakers hired to break up heroes. He carries a loud nickname and little else, his past a closed book.

feats.scene: Nuleniu rams a shoulder into a locked door and splinters the frame.
Nuleniu takes a baton to the ribs and returns a grin.

name: Russan
summary: Russan is a hard-nosed visiting operative with pistols and a helmet, drawn from another reality to hunt down gifted people on a government's orders. She is trained, tactical and utterly pitiless.

feats.scene: Russan fires two pistols in a smooth cross-draw and drops a pair of targets.
Russan absorbs a hard body blow in her vest and keeps aiming.

name: Nesraule
summary: Nesraule is a hyperactive orphan with blonde hair who grows into a successful businesswoman, then becomes a wish-spirit in a higher plane. Her mischief spills out as flying bolts of crackling charge.

feats.scene: Nesraule hurls a bolt of crackling charge that shatters a garden wall.
Nesraule shrugs off a stumble into a power line, humming with delight.

name: Oraorri
summary: Oraorri is a fleshless winged horse, a raised skeleton that breathes fire and soars as a rider's steed. Death gave it a stranger, hungrier shape than the living animal.

feats.scene: Oraorri exhales a tower of flame that melts a stone gatehouse.
Oraorri takes a rain of cannon fire on its bare ribs and keeps flying.

name: Orlinu
summary: Orlinu is a winged horse born of a sea lord and a snake-haired monster, serving a hero as a mount. He can take a human shape and rise again as long as people still believe in him.

feats.scene: Orlinu dives from the clouds and shatters a rampart with his hooves.
Orlinu is struck down by a rival champion and is later seen alive again.

name: Oluancar
summary: Oluancar is a radiant white steed of the sky rulers, galloping on air faster than any storm. He stays at the summit of a sacred peak, tireless and unchanging.

feats.scene: Oluancar kicks off a cloud bank and the shock wave flattens a forest below.
Oluancar races across the sky ahead of his own thunder.

name: Ntimiaiu
summary: Ntimiaiu is a talking sea-bird crusader who stuffs his huge throat pouch with gadgets and fights for order across the clouds. He flies to great heights and swims with ease.

feats.scene: Ntimiaiu drops a torpedo from his pouch onto a smugglers' skiff and sinks it.
Ntimiaiu tumbles through a fence of branches and dusts off his feathers.

name: Ialcel
summary: Ialcel is a warrior-seer of a hidden island kingdom who tries to stop a prophesied child of chaos. She is killed by a sister, then restored to life when the multiverse reshuffles.

feats.scene: Ialcel drives a spear through a training post with a roar.
Ialcel takes a strike from a friend's hand and still fights on.

name: Setoore
summary: Setoore is a naval soldier who talks to machines with her mind and wears a big suit of battle plating. Her armour lends her strength, flight and extra toughness against an invading army.

feats.scene: Setoore punches a harbour crane in her armour and bends it like a reed.
Setoore holds her ground while a destroyer's deck gun fires at her chest.

name: Nttate
summary: Nttate is a blonde warrior of a rival desert tribe, schooled in bow, horse, blade and bare-handed fighting under divine favour. She enters the great tournament of her people beside a famous archer.

feats.scene: Nttate looses an arrow that pins a banner to a wooden post across the arena.
Nttate takes a blunt practice blade to the ribs and keeps her footing.

name: Satilnus
summary: Satilnus is a cold, ambitious psychiatrist who runs a research ward and brews a strength-boosting formula from a captive brute's blood. Her experiments mutate patients into monsters and eventually consume her.

feats.scene: Satilnus plunges a syringe into a restrained patient and steps back.
Satilnus is flung against a glass cabinet and does not rise.

name: Aranar
summary: Aranar is a one-eyed, tentacled deep-sea native who conquers an old terror of light and wields a power ring. He fires spines, sees far, and shapes hard-light constructs before falling in a final fight.

feats.scene: Aranar fires a bolt from his ring that punches a hole in a floating wreck.
Aranar's ring shield absorbs a barrage of cannon fire without a crack.

name: Eosti
summary: Eosti is a stout, aquatic being from lightless depths who pushes past a lifelong dread of brightness to earn a place among galactic guardians. He joins a vast gathering to hear of a looming horror.

feats.scene: Eosti shapes a glowing lance that skewers a drifting hulk in orbit.
Eosti holds a glowing shell around himself as debris pounds it from all sides.

name: Ntlia
summary: Ntlia is a pink-skinned, green-eyed space guardian with a glowing ring and a lantern-shaped charger, caught in a political war on a faraway world. His courage flickers but never fails.

feats.scene: Ntlia fires a bright beam that slices an armoured gate off its hinges.
Ntlia raises a glowing shield against a tank column and stops the shells.

name: Ontser
summary: Ontser is a ten-foot tentacled hero from a lightless ocean world, famous for hauling his whole planet away from its sun so the seas would not boil. Humble and shy, he prefers solitude beneath the waves.

feats.scene: Ontser wraps a glowing grip around his drowning home and drags it onto a cooler orbit.
Ontser shrugs off a stellar flare that scorches the sea's upper layer around him.

name: Cinsiutor
summary: Cinsiutor is a swimmer from an ocean planet who wears a ring and carries a battery to recharge it. A band of raiders kills him, yet he later turns up alive.

feats.scene: Cinsiutor spears a pirate skiff with a glowing beam and splits it.
Cinsiutor weathers a volley of cannon fire behind a bright barrier.

name: Nelluir
summary: Nelluir is a green-eyed warrior woman who began as a snake that trained its inner energy to cross into human form. She defends a coastal metropolis as a member of a heroic team and bears her old life with quiet loyalty.

feats.scene: Nelluir snaps a punch that dents a steel shutter and sends a thief flying.
Nelluir shrugs off a truck bumper and answers with a quick kick.

name: Rncorau
summary: Rncorau is a brown-haired member of a galactic peacekeeping corps, miscoloured in the records. He wields a glowing ring for shields, beams and flight.

feats.scene: Rncorau lashes out a glowing beam that cuts a hovering gunship in half.
Rncorau stands behind a ring barrier as a missile bursts on it.

name: Rnseurn
summary: Rnseurn is a corrupt arms broker who sells cybernetic upgrades alongside smaller rackets. His penthouse empire collapses when two rival masked figures turn it into a brawl.

feats.scene: Rnseurn clubs a guard with the butt of a pistol to hurry him along.
Rnseurn rides out a helicopter crash on a bridge deck and walks away.

name: Lulli
summary: Lulli is a queen of a first-generation tribe devoted to a harvest goddess, raised in an island kingdom of warrior women. Her authority rests on both fierce training and steady leadership.

feats.scene: Lulli drives a spear through a stone practice target and the target splits.
Lulli takes a hammer blow on her shield and does not give ground.

name: Cinsiiu
summary: Cinsiiu is a would-be world conqueror, son of the ruler of a sprawling business empire, tutored by an ancient immortal. He kills his own father and is later betrayed by his teacher.

feats.scene: Cinsiiu drives a letter opener into a sleeping man's chest.
Cinsiiu takes a hard punch in the jaw and spits blood.

name: Iumlanli
summary: Iumlanli is a small, red-haired scientist obsessed with travel through time, a saboteur turned rogue who keeps a robot's severed head as an advisor. He wants to rule the world from the past.

feats.scene: Iumlanli fires up a bulky time ray and blows a hole in a lab wall.
Iumlanli is thrown against a console and lies dazed.

name: Ernamone
summary: Ernamone is a giant, talking tapeworm with a flowery manner who sees himself as a gallant protector of the host he lives inside. He challenges a peeping intruder to a duel and loses badly.

feats.scene: Ernamone lashes a coil at an intruder and slaps his face.
Ernamone is squashed under a shoe yet keeps up his speech.

name: Auriaan
summary: Auriaan is a nobleman who started as a squire to a gallant armoured rider, then became a champion of his own nation. His son takes up his role after a bomb kills him.

feats.scene: Auriaan unhorses an enemy with a lance in a muddy field.
Auriaan takes a heavy sword strike on his breastplate and answers back.

name: Irnvarra
summary: Irnvarra is a foppish nobleman who hides a daring second life, smuggling the condemned out of a revolution's guillotine under a flower alias. Wit and nerve are his only weapons.

feats.scene: Irnvarra trips a guard with his cane and slips a prisoner out the gate.
Irnvarra endures a hard beating from guards and keeps up the charade.

name: Teliutel
summary: Teliutel is a masked knightly crusader who fights beside foreign fellow heroes in a cartoon world. He favours a sword and cheerful bravado.

feats.scene: Teliutel swings a broadsword and cleaves a cardboard tank in two.
Teliutel bounces off a spring-loaded trap and straightens his helmet.

source_title: Percy Sheldrake (The Brave and the Bold)

name: Ialauso
summary: Ialauso is a patient of an asylum who is handed a power ring by a wounded peacekeeper because he feels no fear. Oblivious to danger, he confuses an invasion fleet with giant bugs and scares it away.

feats.scene: Ialauso grabs a warship in a glowing fist and examines it through a giant magnifying glass.
Ialauso ignores a volley of fire that splashes across his glowing shield.

name: Milanuse
summary: Milanuse is a ring-bearing peacekeeper who is ambushed by a shape-shifting traitor in his own ranks. He later finds a stray ring appearing from nowhere in his patrol area.

feats.scene: Milanuse carves a trench into a moon rock with a glowing beam.
Milanuse raises a barrier that withstands a barrage from a hostile shape-shifter.

name: Sonmanau
summary: Sonmanau is a fearless newspaper editor in a world ruled by an immortal sorcerer-king. He prints the truth about the tyrant and dies under the lash, inspiring a young rebel to fight on.

feats.scene: Sonmanau slams a press lever and a damning headline rolls off the machine.
Sonmanau endures forty lashes from a whip before collapsing.

name: Insor
summary: Insor is a blue-haired winged ruler of a drifting fortress-kingdom who rescues refugees from dying worlds and feeds on their life force. His clawed, near-unbreakable body and strict rule drive his subjects to revolt.

feats.scene: Insor rakes a claw through a ruined skyscraper and the frame shears apart.
Insor stands in a collapsing citadel and is untouched by falling stone.

name: Numriasto
summary: Numriasto is a priest twisted by a parasite from space into a figure that drains the life force of those near him. He travels to kill a saintly elder, but his power fizzles out in a clash with a relative.

feats.scene: Numriasto touches a hedge and it withers to grey dust in seconds.
Numriasto reels from a feedback jolt and drops to his knees.

name: Llurnti
summary: Llurnti is a thrill-seeking red-haired naval officer from the south who loves loud music and breaks every rule. He serves on fast attack boats and sinks many enemy ships alongside a stuffy rival.

feats.scene: Llurnti launches a torpedo that splits an enemy freighter at the waterline.
Llurnti is blasted off a sinking boat and swims to shore.

name: Terill
summary: Terill is a grey-haired newspaper editor let go after thirty-five years when his failing paper must save money. He knows the craft of reporting better than the owners who dismiss him.

feats.scene: Terill throws a stack of proofs on a table with a thud that silences the room.
Terill takes a shove in the lobby and straightens his tie.

name: Resirnra
summary: Resirnra is a grey-haired, barking editor-in-chief who bosses a mild-mannered reporter around a bustling city room. He demands deadlines and trusts his gut.

feats.scene: Resirnra pounds the desk and a coffee mug leaps off the edge.
Resirnra is knocked over by a falling cabinet and demands the story anyway.

name: Nteau
summary: Nteau is a hard-driving newsman who sends a reporter to question everyone who knew a dead millionaire and learn what his final word meant. He wants the whole man, flaws and all.

feats.scene: Nteau slaps a case file onto a junior's desk with a sharp crack.
Nteau is shoved aside by a rushing messenger and barely blinks.

name: Nunensu
summary: Nunensu is a newspaper chief in a world where a rival power's champion has appeared, and he is overwhelmed by public panic. He retires late in life and gives his successor some blunt marital advice.

feats.scene: Nunensu bangs a fist on a blotter to quiet a restless newsroom.
Nunensu is pinned under a falling beam until a rescuer lifts it off.

name: Lliia
summary: Lliia is a brown-haired newspaper editor who regularly packs his two best reporters off to interview people in distant towns. He enjoys the quiet when they are gone.

feats.scene: Lliia stamps an assignment slip and flicks it across the room.
Lliia walks off a stumble over a cable with a grunt.

name: Ritinan
summary: Ritinan is a white-haired, married chief of a big-city paper in an old animated adventure. He fusses over headlines while weird menaces roam outside.

feats.scene: Ritinan slams a window shut against a howling storm.
Ritinan is sprayed with ink from a burst machine and carries on.

name: Aulust
summary: Aulust is a black-haired, single editor-in-chief who answers to no one but the deadline in a far-future city. His staff fears his bark and respects his fairness.

feats.scene: Aulust drops a heavy ledger on a desk and the whole floor stops talking.
Aulust is bumped by a drifting hover cart and shrugs.

source_title: Perry White (Legion of Super-Heroes TV Series)

name: Llaoll
summary: Llaoll is a gruff boss known to his staff as chief, running a busy newsroom while a team of mystery-solving teenagers and a talking dog turns up at the door. He wants a scoop and a coffee.

feats.scene: Llaoll flings open the office door and sends it banging into the wall.
Llaoll is knocked flat by a charging dog and sits up demanding a quote.

name: Tonlliu
summary: Tonlliu is a black-haired reporter who splits his career between two rival city papers in an alternate tale. He writes with equal ease about mobsters and mayors.

feats.scene: Tonlliu heaves a bundle of newspapers onto a truck bed.
Tonlliu is jostled by a crowd outside a courthouse and keeps scribbling.

name: Stoamo
summary: Stoamo is the black-haired owner of a newspaper who offers an after-school job to a young boy while the boy's parents are away. He is patient and quietly kind.

feats.scene: Stoamo slides a heavy desk drawer shut with a thump.
Stoamo stumbles on a step and catches himself on the rail.

name: Rnilote
summary: Rnilote is a grey-haired, neutral editor-in-chief nicknamed the chief in a bright animated adventure. He barks at his staff while costumed heroes squabble outside his window.

feats.scene: Rnilote pounds a rolled newspaper against his palm and growls.
Rnilote is flung off his chair by a loud explosion and brushes himself off.

source_title: Perry White (The Brave and the Bold)

name: Vailmi
summary: Vailmi is a restless young man raised by a stepfather in a big city, unaware that his real father is a scheming tycoon. He drifts into crime with a gang and dies young.

feats.scene: Vailmi throws a wild punch at a gang rival in an alley.
Vailmi is dragged into a van by kidnappers and bruised but alive.

name: Nienunum
summary: Nienunum is a green-skinned, green-haired goddess of spring who spends part of every year as queen below the earth. Life follows her wherever she walks, though it dies almost at once in the dark.

feats.scene: Nienunum raises a forest overnight that splits an old stone road into pieces.
Nienunum wades through a collapsing cavern and the rock parts around her.

name: Nusvareo
summary: Nusvareo is a one-eyed rogue warrior woman who turns against her island sisters and serves a god of war. She fights with swords, deception and a body that does not age or die.

feats.scene: Nusvareo cuts down a guard with a swift sword stroke and flees.
Nusvareo takes a deep wound across the chest and keeps fighting.

name: Varcisil
summary: Varcisil is a red-eyed daughter of a scrap-trader on a plague-stricken world, jailed for stealing medicine and recruited as an agent infected with disease. She turns against her recruiters and joins a tyrant's herald sisterhood.

feats.scene: Varcisil flings a blade across a dim hall and a guard drops.
Varcisil shrugs off a lethal plague dose that would drop a crowd.

name: Tillatil
summary: Tillatil is a penniless gambler who discovers that his dreams predict the future, but telling anyone ruins them. He plots to kill a masked rival and dies sleeping in a freezer.

feats.scene: Tillatil fires a rifle through a diamond-shop window and shatters the glass.
Tillatil is tackled hard on the pavement and keeps running.

name: Amvalile
summary: Amvalile is a green-eyed prisoner on a ship who lives by the creed that heroism means dying so others live. He pilots a torpedo into a blockage to free a submarine full of allies.

feats.scene: Amvalile rides a torpedo into a clogged hull and the blast clears the passage.
Amvalile is roughed up by guards and stands fast.

name: Nisesosa
summary: Nisesosa is a costumed crimefighter in a team of hardline enforcers who sets out to subdue an energy-eating menace. A freed burst of quantum force wipes him out with most of his allies.

feats.scene: Nisesosa drives a flying kick into a thug and drops him.
Nisesosa is caught in a vast energy burst that levels the field around him.

name: Tauliu
summary: Tauliu is a wanted circus performer who gains the ability to become fire, water, earth or wind from an ancient ritual. He uses an earthquake to break open a bank and loses everything when he is smothered in glass.

feats.scene: Tauliu cracks a bank vault in half with a rolling earthquake.
Tauliu turns to water and flows through a hail of bullets.

name: Iaterium
summary: Iaterium is a smooth-talking attorney who quietly poisons distant kin to claim a buried hoard. It fights with paperwork, patience and a weighted cane, and collapses once a stronger hero takes notice.

feats.scene: Iaterium cracks a rival's skull with a single swing of a weighted cane.
Iaterium shrugs off a hard shove down a flight of courthouse steps.

name: Rniural
summary: Rniural is a spoiled yacht-owner whose lab-grown muscle turned him into a hulking gill-breather. It grabs hostages, tears hulls apart and rages like a toddler denied a toy.

feats.scene: Rniural rips the bow off a motor yacht with bare hands.
Rniural walks away from a speedboat slamming into its back.

name: Nucortiu
summary: Nucortiu is a polished stage performer from a wealthy family who looks down on a disgraced sibling. It has no fighting talent and relies on charm, a famous face and good tailoring.

feats.scene: Nucortiu slaps a heckler across the cheek during a rehearsal.
Nucortiu tumbles off a low stage and gets straight back up bowing.

name: Stasti
summary: Stasti is a hired telepath who bends stubborn minds into obedience. It dies in a gas-filled asylum, proof that a loud will is brittle against poison.

feats.scene: Stasti forces a squad of guards to club each other senseless.
Stasti survives a collapsing cell wall before the fumes finish it.

name: Anutiuvau
summary: Anutiuvau is a rooftop-prowling criminal with a frightening gift for the bow, determined to show that ordinary people can bring down masked heroes. It wins one cheap shot and then loses its nerve under a steady gaze.

feats.scene: Anutiuvau sends an arrow through a window pane from three streets away.
Anutiuvau slams onto a gravel roof and crawls up wheezing.

name: Tanami
summary: Tanami is a island-hopping smuggler whose tattooed palm lets objects drop out of the world at a touch. It teams with a partner who smothers light and sound, and together they rob freely until two famous heroes arrive.

feats.scene: Tanami lays a palm on a parked truck and the whole vehicle vanishes.
Tanami is thrown through a plank door and stands up grinning.

name: Nintri
summary: Nintri is a surgically loosened contortionist killer who strangles targets with impossibly bent limbs. It was driven by a craving for a parent's approval and went down in a prison break gone wrong.

feats.scene: Nintri coils around a guard and snaps his spine in one squeeze.
Nintri folds through a collapsing gate and walks out unharmed.

name: Luorast
summary: Luorast is a brutal, boastful augmented enforcer who smashes through crowds and then changes employers when politics shift. A hidden kill-switch bluff once kept it from its rivals, and it never tested the claim.

feats.scene: Luorast hurls a delivery van through a lobby wall.
Luorast stands unmoving as a bus clips its shoulder.

name: Mille
summary: Mille is a vain, silver-skinned adventurer from the far future who wears a stolen, patched-together power suit. It cares only for fame and profit, and loses the suit to a time-travelling lawman.

feats.scene: Mille blasts a hovering drone out of the sky with a wrist emitter.
Mille's suit turns aside a salvo of rifle rounds without a scratch.

name: Lieotiu
summary: Lieotiu is a pocket-sized hobo pig who works a furnace job and, after a stray shard of radiating rock, becomes a purple-skinned powerhouse. It is cheerful, strong and nearly unbreakable, though it still bickers with the neighbourhood wolf.

feats.scene: Lieotiu flips a loaded freight wagon onto its side.
Lieotiu shrugs off a collapsing smelter beam.

name: Aunatan
summary: Aunatan is an ordinary diner waiter who once sat on a bus that rolled into a river. It remembers a schoolmate's odd strength and points a reporter toward the truth.

feats.scene: Aunatan hauls a heavy tray rack and bangs it down on a counter.
Aunatan slips on wet tile and crashes into a table without injury.

name: Renraron
summary: Renraron is a small-town youth in an older era who notices a neighbour turning into something magical. It is a bystander, bold only in what it chooses to tell.

feats.scene: Renraron shoves a stuck barn door open.
Renraron falls from a hay loft and rolls up laughing.

name: Sauirn
summary: Sauirn is a towering horned beast reshaped from a gentle slum dweller by a cruel drill-mistress. It would rather guard the weak than brutalise them, and it fled carrying a stolen fragment of fate.

feats.scene: Sauirn pounds the ground and levels a wooden tenement.
Sauirn holds up a collapsing avalanche shelf over a crowd of children.

name: Miiuori
summary: Miiuori is a small blue-skinned winged water creature who keeps silent so that her voice never hurts anyone. She was caged in an underground maze and now trusts only one warrior.

feats.scene: Miiuori lets out one tiny shriek and shatters a rack of glass.
Miiuori is dashed against a steel cell wall and stands again.

name: Estcole
summary: Estcole is a sharp prosecutor who sides with a friend hiding an awful secret. It leads a task force with grim determination and fights only through argument.

feats.scene: Estcole slaps a file folder across a suspect's face.
Estcole is knocked across an office and shakes it off.

name: Iumneeor
summary: Iumneeor is a puppeteer-thief who speaks through a wooden dummy to bully jewellers. Once the dummy is smashed, it has no nerve left.

feats.scene: Iumneeor cracks a display case with the dummy's wooden head.
Iumneeor is tossed into a stack of crates by a masked child.

name: Tiusocor
summary: Tiusocor is an ancient puppeteer living out its years in a retirement home for bad guys. It mumbles in two voices and has not fought in decades.

feats.scene: Tiusocor whacks an orderly with a cane.
Tiusocor tumbles out of a wheelchair and wheezes with laughter.

name: Ntesira
summary: Ntesira is a blue-skinned warlord commanding a winged army for a soul-draining tyrant. It slips through walls and fades from sight, but loses to a teleporting trick and dies for failure.

feats.scene: Ntesira leads a charge that flattens a roadside barn.
Ntesira survives a fall of hundreds of feet onto bare earth.

name: Rnuest
summary: Rnuest is a ghostly villain conjured by a hostile dial and bound to an evil master. It drifts through walls, howls and summons angry spirits to do its dirty work.

feats.scene: Rnuest calls a swarm of wailing shades that tear a billboard apart.
Rnuest lets a bus drive through its misty body.

name: Tasete
summary: Tasete is a spirit gestalt fused from a boy, a mother and a chorus of dead souls. It floats through matter, reads minds and pushes objects by will alone.

feats.scene: Tasete lifts a collapsing bridge span with pure will.
Tasete lets a tank shell pass through without effect.

name: Telci
summary: Telci is a pale, flawed copy built in a lab and discarded as a failure. It survives by possessing hosts until it steals the body of its template.

feats.scene: Telci hurls a pickup across a field in a fit of rage.
Telci takes a collapsing silo to the chest and keeps coming.

name: Neauva
summary: Neauva is a bald menace with a razor and a grudge who haunts a scarab-wearing hero. Little else about it is certain.

feats.scene: Neauva slashes a straight razor through a leather jacket.
Neauva tumbles through a shop window and rises.

name: Teeolor
summary: Teeolor is a masked robber in ancient royal dress who lurks on the rooftops of a dark metropolis. It is a theatrical thief of modest ability.

feats.scene: Teeolor swings a ceremonial staff into a guard's ribs.
Teeolor hits a skylight and keeps running.

name: Tisntau
summary: Tisntau is a robed mystic who appears in a child's dream and offers cryptic aid. It wields vague sorcery that bends the dream to its will.

feats.scene: Tisntau opens a rift in the dream sky and a mountain of fog falls through.
Tisntau stands unmarked as the dreamscape collapses.

name: Terresva
summary: Terresva is a pale-haired wanderer who appears exactly when disaster looms. It carries a legendary spear and a handful of silver coins, and it throws shields, bolts and doorways of force.

feats.scene: Terresva fires a bolt of pure force that cracks a hillside open.
Terresva stands inside a bubble of light as a tower falls on it.

name: Riaren
summary: Riaren is a grey-haired mystic who refuses to join any fight directly. It reaches across the cosmos to rescue a lost ally and then slips away.

feats.scene: Riaren opens a path across the dark and drags a lost hero home.
Riaren stands calm as a storm of enemy fire falls without effect.

name: Silinau
summary: Silinau is a small, hooded spirit that drifts through a child's school on a night of the dead. It comes only to watch and warn.

feats.scene: Silinau lets out a whisper that rattles every window.
Silinau drifts through a thrown chair.

name: Surnton
summary: Surnton is a cursed traitor who died of shame and was sent to roam the world forever, helping others to atone. It never ages, never rests and cannot be killed by any human weapon.

feats.scene: Surnton raises a hand and a collapsing cathedral hangs in the air.
Surnton walks out of a burning ruin without a mark.

name: Illcesi
summary: Illcesi is a ghostly stranger who speaks into the minds of sleepers and leaves a grave with a cryptic line carved on it. It lingers around a marsh of fire.

feats.scene: Illcesi sends a whispered dream that knocks a man to his knees.
Illcesi stays whole while a lantern is swung through its chest.

name: Teranuco
summary: Teranuco is a grey-haired watcher in a lonely stone tower on a cold coast. It broods over events that it chooses to leave alone.

feats.scene: Teranuco snaps its fingers and the tower door slams the lock shut with a thunderclap.
Teranuco stays unharmed under a falling beam.

name: Isiarti
summary: Isiarti is a quiet vigilante raised by a cold mentor after a robbery took its parents. It trains for years and fights with discipline, trying to prove it is no burden.

feats.scene: Isiarti drives a kick through a plank door.
Isiarti is trapped under rubble from a collapsed wall and waits it out.

name: Nacosia
summary: Nacosia is a ring-bearing peacekeeper who builds light constructs and fires beams from a lamp-like battery. It flies, shields itself and dies a hero in a short tale.

feats.scene: Nacosia launches a green bolt that collapses a stone bridge.
Nacosia raises a barrier that holds back a falling tower.

name: Iumrosmi
summary: Iumrosmi is the last survivor of a forgotten pantheon who shrank itself into a mortal travel agent to avoid fading away. It books strange passages between worlds for those who ask.

feats.scene: Iumrosmi tears open a doorway between worlds in a shop cellar.
Iumrosmi sits unmoved while a ceiling falls on its desk.

name: Rosvau
summary: Rosvau is a dark-eyed tyrant in ancient royal wear who commands cursed servants. Little is known of its power, only that it frightens everyone.

feats.scene: Rosvau commands a stone statue to fall and crush a wagon.
Rosvau stays standing after a pillar falls on it.

name: Rnsor
summary: Rnsor is a deformed hive-born soldier who learned to survive as an abandoned infant and now plots revenge on its cruel world. It wears a hard metal shell and slips through guarded vaults unseen.

feats.scene: Rnsor claws through a bulkhead door in the armoury.
Rnsor's shell turns aside a blast of heavy gunfire.

name: Valvau
summary: Valvau is a stuttering, overfed stargazer mutated by a falling rock into a lumpy grey giant. It plays drums for a band of fellow outcasts.

feats.scene: Valvau pounds a drum set so hard that the stage floor splits.
Valvau takes a bulldozer nudge without flinching.

name: Testesli
summary: Testesli is a senior army officer who acts as a trusted contact in wartime. It speaks with authority and has no powers.

feats.scene: Testesli slams a fist on a map table.
Testesli is knocked off a jeep and walks it off.

name: Vasverer
summary: Vasverer is a gifted street musician in a big city who becomes the romantic interest of a visiting hero. It plays soulful melodies and has no fighting skill.

feats.scene: Vasverer bangs a drum rim hard enough to snap a stick.
Vasverer is bumped by a bicycle and keeps playing.

name: Amanseo
summary: Amanseo is a charming young scholar who courts a wealthy retired heroine and plots to drain her fortune. Its schemes end in a broken neck.

feats.scene: Amanseo shoves a library cart into a rival.
Amanseo falls hard down a dormitory stair and complains.

name: Oleaus
summary: Oleaus is a fringe criminal who claims its fingertips can see, and who performs rituals against a ghost. Whether the gift is real is never settled.

feats.scene: Oleaus jabs a spread hand into a guard's collarbone.
Oleaus is flung against a cell wall and gets up humming.

name: Rnnean
summary: Rnnean is a petty crook with fingertips that supposedly see, pulled into a villains' convention by a prankster. It trips over a servant's feet and knocks itself out.

feats.scene: Rnnean flicks a stack of chairs at a pursuer.
Rnnean cracks its head on a marble floor and is only dazed.

name: Iunumnte
summary: Iunumnte is a writer who hides a cellar of horrors from a loving family and kills to protect them from the world. Its mask of kindness hides a cold killer.

feats.scene: Iunumnte swings a hammer into a stranger's temple.
Iunumnte absorbs a tumble down basement stairs.

name: Llanta
summary: Llanta is a travelling physician who takes in an orphaned nephew and leaves its day-to-day care to a housekeeper. It means well and is often away.

feats.scene: Llanta slams a car trunk shut.
Llanta trips on a train platform and rises smiling.

name: Coonturn
summary: Coonturn is a veteran island general of a warrior sisterhood who rides, fences and shoots with the best. It drills its troops on a hidden shore.

feats.scene: Coonturn cleaves a training dummy from shoulder to hip with a long blade.
Coonturn is tossed from a galloping horse into a stone wall and rises.

name: Numamo
summary: Numamo is a deathless officer of a hidden island sisterhood who keeps her post across ages. It follows orders, marches and fights in step with her troops.

feats.scene: Numamo drives a spear through a wooden shield.
Numamo takes a heavy mace blow to the helm and stays upright.

name: Secianu
summary: Secianu is the right hand of an island queen, who fights twin blades to the end as a plague closes in. It buys time for survivors to flee aboard a departing ship.

feats.scene: Secianu cuts down a charging attacker with two quick sword strokes.
Secianu holds a gate against a stampede of infected raiders.

name: Resamlle
summary: Resamlle is a general, chief counselor and devoted partner of an island queen. It teaches young warriors, serves loyally through changes of rulers and guards a gateway to a cursed realm.

feats.scene: Resamlle breaks a rival's spear shaft with a hard parry.
Resamlle stands firm as a monster's claw glances off its armour.

name: Tiueon
summary: Tiueon is a frost-bred warrior queen who, once beaten, swears loyalty and captains a ruler's guard. It swings a heavy mace, is proud and deathless until a cursed blade ends it.

feats.scene: Tiueon swings a mace and shatters an ice-slab wall.
Tiueon takes a charging boar to the ribs and stays on her feet.

name: Sturn
summary: Sturn is a one-armed mercenary who bolts a shock-absorbing exo-suit and an energy cannon to its stump. It escapes prison twice for revenge and is caught twice by a stronger hero.

feats.scene: Sturn fires its stump cannon and blows a car off the road.
Sturn's armour soaks up a hard fall from a ledge.

name: Eolorliu
summary: Eolorliu is a fight instructor who runs gyms and summer camps as cover to recruit teen thieves. It is a good brawler with blades but a poor judge of talent.

feats.scene: Eolorliu snaps a roundhouse kick into a bag and splits the seam.
Eolorliu is thrown to a mat and springs up unhurt.

name: Amisau
summary: Amisau is a quiet, orange-haired schoolboy who has a few casual friends. Two bullies lure it away from class and kill it.

feats.scene: Amisau tosses a textbook across a lunchroom.
Amisau is shoved into a locker door.

name: Setinern
summary: Setinern is a white-haired time-travelling professor who builds odd gadgets with solid engineering skill. It trusts machines over muscle.

feats.scene: Setinern fires a coil pistol that cracks a brick wall.
Setinern tumbles out of a lab window and gets up grumbling.

name: Tesaneo
summary: Tesaneo is a blue-eyed god of panic who, with a twin, seizes a child's soul to hunt a hidden island. It wants to free its father and feed on despair.

feats.scene: Tesaneo spreads a panic wave that makes a whole district flee in the night.
Tesaneo withstands a collapsing temple roof without effort.

name: Iunenrer
summary: Iunenrer is a white-eyed deity who wants a cursed child to keep her bloodline of strife. It rides mortals gripped by panic and reshapes them to resemble itself.

feats.scene: Iunenrer drives a mob into a frenzy that topples a wall.
Iunenrer absorbs a hurled boulder without a mark.

name: Toornin
summary: Toornin is a dark-haired goddess of the night sky who drives a lunar chariot and lulls foes to sleep. It dies hunting for a lost seed.

feats.scene: Toornin pulls a veil of night over a city and the streets fall silent.
Toornin stands in a flood of fire and walks out unscorched.

name: Vaanva
summary: Vaanva is a golden-eyed deity of the sun, song and healing arts who flies, blazes and pierces fate with arrows. It briefly seizes a throne from a false memory and is killed by a captive monster.

feats.scene: Vaanva fires a fireball that melts a hillside and fuses the stones.
Vaanva shrugs off a truck and a hail of bullets.

name: Tannilnau
summary: Tannilnau is a carnival villain wrapped in lethal fire that does not seem to burn it. It rushes to a rescue and is caught by a new masked hero.

feats.scene: Tannilnau engulfs a trailer in flames and leaves a blackened shell.
Tannilnau walks through a burning tent unharmed.

name: Ilton
summary: Ilton is a brash young hero of a far-future colony world with a bizarre title. Few details about it are known.

feats.scene: Ilton hurls a crate across a plaza.
Ilton is knocked into a wall and shakes it off.

name: Tiste
summary: Tiste is a prison-planet captive who can turn his body into a solid steel barricade. He gives his life shielding a friend during an escape.

feats.scene: Tiste rams a guard post as a slab of steel and flattens it.
Tiste hardens into a barrier and absorbs a cannon volley.

name: Leosti
summary: Leosti is a college student who raises the dead as puppets and once accidentally spawned a rampaging blob. It is sarcastic and rarely impressed.

feats.scene: Leosti raises a row of corpses that smash a lecture hall door.
Leosti is thrown into a dorm wall and stands up complaining.

name: Veotene
summary: Veotene is a wealthy foreign charity worker who marries a college sweetheart in a world that later burns. Nobody knows whether it survived.

feats.scene: Veotene shoves a stuck gate open.
Veotene trips on a cobbled street and stands up laughing.

name: Reveoran
summary: Reveoran is a silent mime in white face who fights with fast, precise martial moves. It fails to capture a young hero and ends in cuffs.

feats.scene: Reveoran lands a flurry of strikes that drops a hardened thug.
Reveoran is tangled in thrown cords and breaks free in a roll.

name: Asiterolu
summary: Asiterolu is a white-haired speedster from a blended world, a time-travelling descendant who partners with a hero in red. It blurs between streets in a heartbeat.

feats.scene: Asiterolu hits a wall at full tilt and punches a hole through it.
Asiterolu is flung through a billboard and runs on.
Asiterolu crosses a desert in the time it takes to blink.

name: Nustes
summary: Nustes is a white-haired thief with a flock of trained birds who aims to steal every outdoor monument in the country. A rain of snack cakes makes the flock desert her.

feats.scene: Nustes launches a hundred birds that peck a guard off a ladder.
Nustes is netted and thrown to the ground without injury.

name: Seonerne
summary: Seonerne is a petty crook who plots revenge on a heroine at a medal ceremony. It has no special talent.

feats.scene: Seonerne swings a crowbar into a door.
Seonerne is tossed down a stair and gets up cursing.

name: Miirnau
summary: Miirnau is a disgraced soldier with a sniper's eye who now takes dull security work. It once refused an order that haunts it.

feats.scene: Miirnau sends a rifle round through a window from a long way off.
Miirnau drops from a loading dock and rolls to his feet.

name: Sonliu
summary: Sonliu is a deadly hired killer who bends time itself and threatens a target's loved ones to force surrender. It carries a compact energy pistol and lives by terror.

feats.scene: Sonliu freezes a hallway mid-motion and fires into a stunned crowd.
Sonliu takes a heavy blow across the jaw and keeps talking.

name: Iareorva
summary: Iareorva is a sea-changed slum dweller adapted to deep-water pressure, with fangs and great strength. It joins a rebel lord, then defects and sits on a new council.

feats.scene: Iareorva bites through a steel hawser and snaps it.
Iareorva shrugs off the crush of a deep trench.

name: Irnseton
summary: Irnseton is a plucky teenage sidekick adopted by a masked hero. It drives, tumbles and brawls a little, and lives with a nickname it hates.

feats.scene: Irnseton flips off a trapeze and kicks a thug.
Irnseton crashes through a fruit stall and bounces up.

name: Aniarco
summary: Aniarco is a small boy from a crime family who dies young. Its loss shapes a sister's whole life.

feats.scene: Aniarco throws a rubber ball through a window.
Aniarco falls off a swing and cries.

name: Iusarrn
summary: Iusarrn is a laboratory rabbit fitted with cybernetic gear that lets it deliver mines and gas. It escapes with its companions and dies bravely in a final fight.

feats.scene: Iusarrn drops a mine in a corridor and blows a door off.
Iusarrn is thrown across a lab by a stronger machine and keeps fighting.

name: Aunist
summary: Aunist is a blue-haired gang boss who clashes with a masked avenger. It rules a dock district through fear and hired guns.

feats.scene: Aunist fires a revolver that blasts a bottle off a shelf.
Aunist is bounced off a car hood and keeps barking orders.

name: Stcareo
summary: Stcareo is a rogue sea-dweller who joins terror cells and underwater gangs. It is amphibious, strong and attacks coastal towns.

feats.scene: Stcareo rips a pier piling out of the seabed.
Stcareo takes a ship's collision on the shoulder and swims off.

name: Licorse
summary: Licorse is a city thug with a metal-climbing theme about whom little is recorded. It is a minor menace in a big city.

feats.scene: Licorse swings a steel spike into a van door.
Licorse drops from a fire escape and trots off.

name: Iasmiaria
summary: Iasmiaria is a pink-eyed young killer whose diseased touch rusts steel, rots wood and crumbles stone. It was taken as an infant by a shadowy order and trained to hunt.

feats.scene: Iasmiaria lays a palm on a girder and it crumbles to flakes.
Iasmiaria is hurled into a wall and rolls clear.

name: Lanttau
summary: Lanttau is a crook with a helmet that conjures a cube of blinding blackness and sends signals to wake dangerous gadgets. It plans every crime carefully and loses to ordinary teamwork.

feats.scene: Lanttau triggers a trophy room of weapons that wreck a hangar.
Lanttau is slammed against a console and cuffed.

name: Iuosata
summary: Iuosata is a criminal mastermind with a helmet screen that spells out its thoughts. It plots small heists and has no combat ability.

feats.scene: Iuosata clubs a watchman with the rim of its helmet.
Iuosata tumbles down a ramp and straightens its visor.

name: Cilores
summary: Cilores is a gadget-minded villain on a private island who grows hostile vines with his machines. It is a screen rogue of modest power.

feats.scene: Cilores floods a lab with vines that burst a window frame.
Cilores is dropped into a trench and climbs out.

name: Lanser
summary: Lanser is a fiery, jealous liquid-metal robot who loves her maker and bickers with her hot-headed brother. She stretches into any shape and is rebuilt after every battle.

feats.scene: Lanser flows into a hammer and flattens a monster's claw.
Lanser is melted by a furnace and later poured whole again.

name: Stilemi
summary: Stilemi is a living-metal robot with a stretchy body, sharp humour and a fragile heart-like component. Her body is melted in a battle, but the component survives.

feats.scene: Stilemi stretches into a wall of metal and shoves a truck away.
Stilemi takes a blast of heat and loses her body but not her mind.

name: Inuanse
summary: Inuanse is a vain, shape-shifting metal robot, built as a mate for another yet far too narcissistic. It later returns as a hired thug and holds a hostage.

feats.scene: Inuanse extends a fist into a girder and bends it double.
Inuanse shrugs off acid spray and heavy blows alike.

name: Rasorser
summary: Rasorser is a pink-skinned warlord who lost every campaign at home and fled to a pristine pocket world. It builds a hypnotic lure to drag in victims and rule them.

feats.scene: Rasorser fires a fleet cannon that cracks a hillside.
Rasorser stumbles back from a crashing console and stands.

name: Eolniunas
summary: Eolniunas is a villainous robot copy built by a wicked double of its maker. It shifts shape, joins a hostile team and is destroyed in its first battle.

feats.scene: Eolniunas swells its fist and flattens a lab bench.
Eolniunas takes a hit from a metal rival and barely dents.

name: Nianvor
summary: Nianvor is a radioactive shape-shifting robot built in a moment of madness, hating its sibling machines. It splits into a mind and a drone before a fissure ends both.

feats.scene: Nianvor goes critical and fills a quarry with white fire.
Nianvor takes a beating from five rivals and stands.

name: Anrnsi
summary: Anrnsi is a faithful household robot, first run by steam and later upgraded with a thinking mind. It looks after a family, trades barbs with a gorilla and was never meant for fighting.

feats.scene: Anrnsi lifts a stuck gate off its track.
Anrnsi survives a stone wall falling across its shoulders.

name: Seurnte
summary: Seurnte is a green-eyed hairless minion chained to a hostile master, born from a fan's idea. Little else is known.

feats.scene: Seurnte bursts a steel door with a hurl.
Seurnte stands up after a falling crate.

name: Lltirti
summary: Lltirti is the leader of a freelance mercenary company sent to seize an inventor. A fast kid flings it into the sky with an anti-gravity beam.

feats.scene: Lltirti fires a pistol that splinters a doorpost.
Lltirti is hurled skyward by a beam and keeps shouting orders.

name: Valeonan
summary: Valeonan is a pink-eyed, hairless castaway from another dimension who passes through walls and moves objects by thought. It poses as a haunting figure to fund a trip home.

feats.scene: Valeonan flings a safe across a vault with a thought.
Valeonan lets a thrown crate pass through its body.

name: Nasiiu
summary: Nasiiu is a lab-grown copy of a famous runner, raised overnight and starved for food whenever it speeds up. It kills its makers, then takes a bullet for a hero.

feats.scene: Nasiiu runs through a lab door and splinters it.
Nasiiu takes a bullet meant for another.
Nasiiu sprints down a corridor faster than any guard can aim.

name: Vautornum
summary: Vautornum is a scheming teenage genius with a grudge against a pair of classmates. It builds traps from scrap and talks fast.

feats.scene: Vautornum triggers a rigged spring that bashes a locker door open.
Vautornum is shoved into a desk and stands up laughing.

name: Nuialte
summary: Nuialte is a pale, many-legged mind-dweller that lives inside one lonely host and feeds on being noticed. It slides between a crawling shape and a slim person-shaped one, and fades from every eye but its host's. Starved of notice, it slowly dims.

feats.scene: Nuialte tore a steel door from its frame with one hooked swipe.
Nuialte shrugged off a fall down a stairwell without a mark.

name: Lananole
summary: Lananole is a scheming harbour noble who wears a rival's face and borrows his good name to rob ships. Clever with disguises and betrayals, Lananole is far better at plotting than at fighting.

feats.scene: Lananole shoved a rival off a quay into the churning surf with a single push.
Lananole took a thrown crate to the ribs and kept talking.

name: Ranasam
summary: Ranasam is a small, mute, furry crawler that rides on its mistress's shoulder and moves by rippling along on a belly of tiny suction cups. Its devotion is total, and it bites at anything that threatens her.

feats.scene: Ranasam clamped its suckered body onto a bandit's ankle and held fast.
Ranasam bounced off a wall after being flung and crawled back to its post.

name: Vitiaco
summary: Vitiaco is a veiled killer from a secret sect who hunts those who brew false miracles. Armed with a long polearm, smoke pellets and old stories, Vitiaco fights with acrobatic stick work and vanishes when a duel turns confusing.

feats.scene: Vitiaco swung a polearm through a wooden shutter and the man behind it.
Vitiaco rolled out of a rooftop plunge onto stone and kept running.

name: Rellaium
summary: Rellaium is a sharp-witted design student who stitches bold coats late into the night and cheers loudly for her closest friend. She has no powers, only stubborn optimism and nimble hands.

feats.scene: Rellaium swung a heavy bolt of cloth into a thief's shoulder to protect a friend.
Rellaium fell off a stage platform and stood up laughing.

name: Nilmon
summary: Nilmon is a calm, polished clinician who hides a brainwashed loyalty behind soft questions. Sent undercover into a spy outfit, Nilmon steals an organ-like relic and plays a long game of bait.

feats.scene: Nilmon lunged with a syringe and a pistol-whip in the same motion.
Nilmon absorbed a flying kick from a trained agent and stayed upright.

name: Tirsia
summary: Tirsia is a masked figure with a glossy, expressionless face who works for hire in a gang of frontmen. Tirsia moves in jerks like a toy, and nobody has ever heard a real voice.

feats.scene: Tirsia snapped a lamp post's glass with a brittle backhand.
Tirsia was thrown through a shop window and brushed off the shards.

name: Stocavi
summary: Stocavi is a black-haired burglar who wears a coat of bristling quills and pricks his way through crowds. A common crook in a silly costume, Stocavi relies on spiky tricks and running fast.

feats.scene: Stocavi flung a handful of quills that pinned a guard's sleeve to a door.
Stocavi dropped from a balcony and rolled away from the guards.

name: Llianu
summary: Llianu is a one-night hoodlum in a quilled disguise who picked a fight with a masked hero and lost within pages. Llianu leans on bluster, bruises and a lot of nerve.

feats.scene: Llianu swung a lead pipe into a stack of barrels and scattered them.
Llianu crashed through a rotten fence and groaned his way upright.

name: Numme
summary: Numme is a green-haired, white-faced swine in a clown's ruff who stages ridiculous crimes for a cartoon cast of animal heroes. Numme's big laughs hide a surprisingly mean right hook.

feats.scene: Numme hurled a cream pie packed with a brick at a passing cart.
Numme bounced off a trampoline of his own making and giggled.

name: Vasar
summary: Vasar is a wise, bald-skinned bottlenose who rules her pod as a mother rather than a monarch. Vasar guides lost swimmers home and trims their tangled plans down to one clear step.

feats.scene: Vasar rammed a drifting net-boat and cracked its keel.
Vasar dived into crushing deep water and surfaced calm.

name: Cotesci
summary: Cotesci is a dim-witted thief whose body was rewritten by a lab accident into a blend of opposing matter. Sparking fists, a towering growth spurt and a knack for flipping the nature of objects made Cotesci a menace until sealed in a lead tube.

feats.scene: Cotesci grew to the height of a tower and flattened a warehouse with one swing.
Cotesci took a full broadside from a gunship and stayed on his feet.

name: Eotaulas
summary: Eotaulas is a rubbery, orange-eyed hitman who can stretch, detach and keep fighting in pieces. Hired to lure a target into a trap, Eotaulas plays dead until someone steps close enough to bite.

feats.scene: Eotaulas punched a clean hole through a brick wall with a stretched arm.
Eotaulas was blasted into pieces and crawled back together.

name: Sautirus
summary: Sautirus is a morbid surgeon with razor claws who can reshape living tissue just by laying a hand on it. Sautirus fights alongside a sibling and prefers patients who cannot argue.

feats.scene: Sautirus raked four furrows through a steel shutter.
Sautirus knit a gashed shoulder shut before the guard could swing again.

name: Tesornau
summary: Tesornau is a spear-throwing warrior who gave up her grip on a cliff to land a perfect throw. Even in a shadowy afterlife, Tesornau stays proud and sends the living onward with a calm blessing.

feats.scene: Tesornau launched a spear through a charging raider's shield.
Tesornau stood her ground against a hail of arrows and a battering ram.

name: Amoliu
summary: Amoliu is a hulking bruiser from a far-future ruin who joins a band of mighty fighters. Amoliu's whole style is walking up and hitting things until they quit being obstacles.

feats.scene: Amoliu drove a fist into a bridge pier and dropped the span into the river.
Amoliu walked out of a collapsing tower with dust on his shoulders.

name: Lliurn
summary: Lliurn is a broad, blue-eyed brute from a harsh foundry world who deserted his master out of a lovesick fixation. Lliurn is tall, strong and awkward, and mostly just wants to be noticed.

feats.scene: Lliurn cracked a dam wall with a single overhead blow.
Lliurn took a crashing airship on his back and stayed upright.

name: Rintan
summary: Rintan is a spaceborne hero with a soft heart and a heavy punch, who flies, bends light into glowing shapes and heals fast. Rintan was stabbed in a training raid and left for dead, and the team never quite recovered.

feats.scene: Rintan flung a glowing blast that levelled a row of abandoned warehouses.
