Rintan survived a collapsing overpass and flew out of the rubble.

name: Telivi
summary: Telivi is a cheerful alien kid at a small-scale school who plays hero at recess. Telivi is stronger than classmates and lifts the heavy end of every seesaw.

feats.scene: Telivi lifted a pile of desks overhead for a game.
Telivi bonked headfirst into a brick wall and giggled.

name: Numnor
summary: Numnor is a crook in a pirate's hat who siphons the gifts of others and wears them for a while. Fixating on a strength instead of a weakness lets the stolen trait stick, and so Numnor is a hazard to anyone who fights with doubt.

feats.scene: Numnor hurled a stolen burst of force that shattered a lamp-lit window row.
Numnor tanked a thrown car with a borrowed hide.

name: Colre
summary: Colre is a smirking crook with a glowing band on one finger that shapes green-hot light into whatever he imagines. Colre leads a crew of criminals and treats every fight as a theatre.

feats.scene: Colre fired a shaft of green fire that levelled a district in one pulse.
Colre stood unharmed inside a bubble of glowing light under heavy bombardment.

source_title: Power Ring (Crisis on Two Earths: Crime Syndicate Earth)

name: Ststinu
summary: Ststinu is a thuggish tyrant who took a cursed lamp and its band from a mad monk, and with them nearly conquered his reversed world. Ststinu was beaten only when two worlds of champions united against him.

feats.scene: Ststinu wrapped a bridge in glowing coils and tore it into the harbour.
Ststinu shrugged off a barrage of rockets in a shell of green light.

name: Nanniu
summary: Nanniu is a wide-eyed marauder from a mirrored realm who hides his face behind a mask and swings a bright weapon-band. Nanniu is one of a crew of copies built to echo an older gang.

feats.scene: Nanniu blasted a silo into rubble with a wide pulse.
Nanniu stood up after a convoy of trucks rolled over him.

name: Rntislo
summary: Rntislo is a careless young brawler who inherited a haunted band and now shares his head with a mumbling spirit. Rntislo hits hard and thinks late, and his bright constructs are as sloppy as his plans.

feats.scene: Rntislo smashed a bridge deck with a glowing mallet of green light.
Rntislo took a tank shell on a glowing shield and merely staggered.

name: Eruces
summary: Eruces is the steward of a smoky workshop-fortress, tending the anvils and furnaces for a master smith. Eruces is a quiet, sturdy figure who has seen every visitor through the gates.

feats.scene: Eruces swung a forge-hammer that dented a plate of armour thick as a door.
Eruces stood in a rain of molten sparks and was not even scorched.

name: Anrnson
summary: Anrnson is a cheeky rebel in a city where laughter is a crime, using jokes, a magic pipe and gadgets from a tinkering friend to prick the pride of the rulers. Anrnson dodges patrols rather than facing them.

feats.scene: Anrnson blew a note on the pipe that made a patrol drop their rifles.
Anrnson tumbled off a rooftop awning and darted away.

name: Eoesi
summary: Eoesi is a bald chemist who dons a sack-like hood to pursue a winged hero. Eoesi trusts formulas over fists, and his best weapon is a flask of something nasty.

feats.scene: Eoesi hurled a flask of foaming reagent that burned through a crate.
Eoesi tripped down a laboratory stair and kept his glasses.

name: Litan
summary: Litan is a green-eyed, red-haired fighter raised under a brutal drill-mistress, hungry to replace the fiercest in her squad. Litan is strong, fast and ambitious, and falls to the very sisters she meant to lead.

feats.scene: Litan cleaved a stone pillar in half with a single blade stroke.
Litan took a falling slab across the shoulders and kept fighting.

name: Rerinan
summary: Rerinan is a hunting appetite given a body, a ghostly radiance embodying fierce longing that flies, projects beams and shields itself in glowing fields. Rerinan cannot die, and it keeps a rival embodiment for company.

feats.scene: Rerinan burned a mountain ridge to glass with a shaft of rose-coloured light.
Rerinan sat unmoved inside an exploding fleet.

name: Illiest
summary: Illiest is a dark-haired, blue-eyed noble in a jewel-coloured house who weaves illusions and slips through shadows like a thief. Illiest is charming, single and never where the guards expect.

feats.scene: Illiest cast a false wall of flame that sent a squad of sentries scattering.
Illiest hid in plain view as a spear passed a hand's breadth away.

name: Serore
summary: Serore is a red-haired noble and fighter who rallies refugees into a band of rebels against a star-spanning empire. Serore lost a duel and an eye, but kept a family and a cause.

feats.scene: Serore fired a searing blast that melted a fortress gate.
Serore stood against a bombardment from a warship and shook off the heat.

name: Nesaun
summary: Nesaun is a purple-eyed, green-skinned trickster from a tiny realm who blinks between places and settles disputes with sly lies and a pistol. Nesaun keeps tools in a bio-woven belt.

feats.scene: Nesaun appeared behind a guard and fired a shot through a lock.
Nesaun shook off a crushing grip by popping out of reach.

name: Iaserna
summary: Iaserna is the first maker, an eternal presence older than any calendar who sits behind every myth and pantheon and has worn countless faces. Iaserna exists alongside an ancient dark and shapes all that is by will alone.

feats.scene: Iaserna spoke once and a whole creation unfolded from nothing.
Iaserna remained untouched as an entire cosmos unravelled around its being.

name: Stoteeor
summary: Stoteeor is a cheerful, brown-eyed head of state with a wife and daughter who signs bills and shakes hands. Stoteeor knows politics and little else, and is mostly bewildered by unusual events.

feats.scene: Stoteeor slammed a desk gavel hard enough to chip the wood.
Stoteeor tripped down a podium step and kept smiling.

name: Nanren
summary: Nanren is a grey-haired figurehead left in office by iron-fisted guardians who rule from behind him. Nanren insists on holding a vote that never arrives, and mostly signs what he is handed.

feats.scene: Nanren thumped a lectern while pleading for a fair ballot.
Nanren sat through a thunderous protest outside the window unmoved.

source_title: President of the United States (DCAU: A Better World)

name: Aucise
summary: Aucise is a gruff, grey-haired national leader who disowns a troublesome city after it falls to crooks. Aucise delivers speeches with weary shrugs and a loud voice.

feats.scene: Aucise slapped the table hard enough to rattle every glass.
Aucise stumbled over a cable on stage and finished the speech anyway.

source_title: President of the United States (Harley Quinn TV Series)

name: Ilvorsti
summary: Ilvorsti is a blue-eyed, grey-haired leader who presides over a nation during an alien incursion and is carried off before the fighting ends. Ilvorsti is dignified and doomed.

feats.scene: Ilvorsti shoved a door open to warn an aide.
Ilvorsti was dragged across a marble floor by captors and kept his composure.

source_title: President of the United States I (Arrowverse)

name: Orrialia
summary: Orrialia is a blond schoolboy and amateur filmmaker who survives a hard home life through friendship and a camera. Orrialia directs a backyard movie starring his best friends.

feats.scene: Orrialia shoved a stuck tripod leg into place with a grunt.
Orrialia fell off his bike on gravel and got up grinning.

name: Ceroranti
summary: Ceroranti is a tall, gentle-minded researcher whose twisted frame drove him to a desperate cure. Ceroranti now melts into soft clay and a deadly touch that dissolves whoever he holds, and he longs for company that will not melt.

feats.scene: Ceroranti pressed a palm to a vault door and slumped it into goo.
Ceroranti took a point-blank shotgun burst and reformed within seconds.

name: Testonas
summary: Testonas is a white-and-blond veteran politician who nearly won the top office in his youth and now mentors a surprise newcomer. Testonas believes in patient work and good coffee.

feats.scene: Testonas banged a desk to end a noisy committee debate.
Testonas sat through a marathon of speeches without a yawn.

name: Taueonsor
summary: Taueonsor is a mismatched-eyed enforcer for a ruling syndicate whose surgical scars give him a mask-like face. Taueonsor collects debts with a hush and a glare.

feats.scene: Taueonsor folded a metal chair in his fists to make a point.
Taueonsor was struck by a thrown bottle and did not blink.

name: Nialiu
summary: Nialiu is a bomb-minded avenger whose face was ruined by a cruel experimental school. Nialiu blows up a museum and a limousine to settle old scores, then keeps hunting every former tormentor.

feats.scene: Nialiu detonated a charge that brought down a hall's ceiling.
Nialiu walked away from a stairwell tumble with a bruised hip.

name: Sirval
summary: Sirval is a bug-faced recluse who fled to a remote island and learned fighting by watching insects. Sirval preys on travellers as a thief and strikes with jabbing, mantis-like blows.

feats.scene: Sirval stabbed forward with two stiff fingers and cracked a wooden post.
Sirval rolled off a cliff ledge and landed on his feet.

name: Rniuncil
summary: Rniuncil is a red-and-yellow-skinned monk who left a star-patrol corps to chase inner insight. Rniuncil can unmake a rival's power source from afar and turn a rival's own glowing shape back against its maker.

feats.scene: Rniuncil snapped his fingers and a distant energy-cell burst apart.
Rniuncil absorbed a flood of hostile light without any visible strain.

name: Esteaun
summary: Esteaun is a gleaming, insect-like denizen of a bright, orderly world that serves a hive-minded guild. Esteaun hums steadily as it works and answers only to its hive.

feats.scene: Esteaun bit through a rail of iron with a clean snap.
Esteaun shrugged off a falling block of stone.

name: Tices
summary: Tices is a bald, black-eyed machine-assisted servant who runs cameras and life support for a doomsday preacher on an orbiting outpost. Tices manages systems with cold efficiency, until a bombing sends the whole outpost into the dark.

feats.scene: Tices sealed a bulkhead with a cybernetic arm that bent the frame.
Tices rode out a decompression alarm clamped to a rail.

name: Ntstirni
summary: Ntstirni is a broken-minded man who sees neighbouring realities and is convinced his own is the mistake. Ntstirni flies, shoots beams from eyes and palms, and bursts outward in blasts when his grief peaks.

feats.scene: Ntstirni let off a burst from his whole body that gutted a farmhouse and barn.
Ntstirni took a collapsing silo on his shoulders and kept ranting.

name: Riium
summary: Riium is an infant heir born into a coral-hued archipelago whose family fell in a revolt. Riium spends childhood hidden by loyal guardians and later gives up every claim to a throne.

feats.scene: Riium swatted a rattle off a cradle rail.
Riium tumbled off a cushion and only gurgled.

name: Reoannau
summary: Reoannau is a hot-tempered villain in a crimson mask who sets whole blocks alight for sport. Reoannau burns bright and vanishes fast, and lasts only a single dreadful night.

feats.scene: Reoannau hurled a ball of flame that gutted a parked bus.
Reoannau stood in a burning alley with his coat smouldering and unharmed.

name: Eornrnu
summary: Eornrnu is an eldest son of a warrior king, a blue-eyed heir who loves conquest and the deep sea alike. Eornrnu breathes underwater, shrugs off crushing pressure and falls in a duel to a brother who loathed the war.

feats.scene: Eornrnu split a stone shield with a trident thrust.
Eornrnu sank to the lightless trench floor and swam up unbothered.

name: Nintiate
summary: Nintiate is a red-eyed, red-haired young noble of a ruined fortress who inherited his father's title and a stubborn pride. Nintiate keeps a sword close and a grudge closer.

feats.scene: Nintiate hewed a rotted beam in half to clear a doorway.
Nintiate took a fall down a crumbling stairway and walked it off.

name: Stria
summary: Stria is a sailing nobleman who sets out across open water and is never seen again, leaving a queen to wait for years. Stria is remembered as a handsome and gentle soul.

feats.scene: Stria hauled a heavy sail line hand over hand in a storm.
Stria was thrown against the mast by a wave and held on.

name: Torela
summary: Torela is a long-lived mother who fans a mountain's fire into a roaring wind and stands guard over her cave-home. Torela fights on the front line of a divine war, and falls in front of her child.

feats.scene: Torela swept a great fan and raised a storm of embers that levelled a hillside camp.
Torela withstood a dozen bolts of heavenly fire without flinching.

name: Silone
summary: Silone is a brown-haired agent of a secret polar organisation who tames panthers and fights with throws and holds. Silone teaches only animals and leads her pets through the ice like pupils.

feats.scene: Silone flipped a charging bruiser over her hip and into a crate stack.
Silone shrugged off a lunge from a rival and landed on her feet.

name: Llonia
summary: Llonia is a retired heroine from a buried warrior tribe who teaches at a school for the gifted and mothers a lively family. Llonia's strength alarmed her former husband, and the drilled children of her old squad still follow her lead.

feats.scene: Llonia heaved a toppled truck back onto its wheels.
Llonia laughed off a head-on collision with a delivery van.

name: Lison
summary: Lison is the eldest daughter of a fallen noble house, a yellow-eyed schemer who weds her power to a dark sorcerer's. Lison banishes her own brother and rules a keep until she is quietly unseated.

feats.scene: Lison hurled a spell-lit sphere that burst a tower window row.
Lison shrugged off a ward-lash that cracked the floor beside her.

name: Lintna
summary: Lintna is a patient gunman for a bookish crime gang, a blue-eyed marksman in a ink-black devil's mask. Lintna hits what he aims at and runs when the crowd turns.

feats.scene: Lintna put a rifle round through a rooftop weathervane from across the plaza.
Lintna slipped on a wet rail and caught himself by one hand.

name: Senti
summary: Senti is a bitter tradesman put out of work by faster machines, who takes up a devil costume borrowed from an older crook. Senti attacks a fair and is tied up in minutes by a trick arrow.

feats.scene: Senti swung a heavy type-block and cracked a fairground sign.
Senti dangled from a rope and took a thrown boot to the head.

name: Serlonti
summary: Serlonti is a jogger snatched by cruel visitors from the stars, who wakes with a body that changes shape at will. Serlonti hates the gift but it saves her life, and a copy takes her place while she hides.

feats.scene: Serlonti swelled a fist into a boulder and smashed a guard post.
Serlonti reshaped her torso around a rifle burst and reformed unharmed.

name: Seentse
summary: Seentse is a black-haired pop singer whose songs hide strange true secrets behind riddles and tattoos. Seentse treats her shows as ritual work and keeps an eye on odd happenings.

feats.scene: Seentse swung a microphone stand into a stalker's knee.
Seentse leapt off a stage rig into the crowd and was caught laughing.

name: Llonal
summary: Llonal is a grieving daughter in a patched protective suit who sprays eating acid at her father's partners. Llonal is calm, grim and methodical, and does not care who stands too near.

feats.scene: Llonal dissolved a speeding cab into a puddle of slag with one spray.
Llonal took a thrown chair on the visor and carried on.

name: Viannt
summary: Viannt is a wisecracking, black-haired outlaw who builds a working rocket launcher out of kitchen scraps and fights beside a preacher. Viannt wears several names, drives fast and shoots straighter than she admits.

feats.scene: Viannt fired a home-built launcher and blew a barn wall into the field.
Viannt climbed out of a wrecked car with a split lip.

name: Unluti
summary: Unluti is a bald, violet-skinned wanderer shackled to a murderous twin personality that feeds on ruin. Unluti stirs fear among a people until they destroy themselves, then breaks free with a stolen blade and a spark of borrowed courage.

feats.scene: Unluti stoked a whole people's panic until their continent tore itself apart.
Unluti stood in the middle of an erupting world and walked off.

name: Nanllulu
summary: Nanllulu is one of seven visitors from afar who drink spinal fluid and copy the shape of a human they meet. Nanllulu awakens new gifts in those it feeds on, and dies young.

feats.scene: Nanllulu pinned a victim to a wall with a fanged, stretching arm.
Nanllulu took a crowbar to the skull and shrugged it off.

name: Ntilor
summary: Ntilor is a woman born without eyes who senses the world by a quiet, uncanny magic. Ntilor joins a band of outcasts and shelters the gifted from the law, though she is struck down by a hostile mind.

feats.scene: Ntilor sent a sharp pulse of will that dropped a lamp across the room.
Ntilor stayed upright through a wave of alien thought.

name: Oluror
summary: Oluror is a purple-skinned drifter who hates rings but takes a hard job to rescue his girlfriend. Oluror seizes a stolen charge of light, topples a tyrant and keeps working for the guardians on retainer.

feats.scene: Oluror drew on a borrowed reserve of light and brought down a castle tower.
Oluror shrugged off a wave of hostile force in a flash of green glow.

name: Nulan
summary: Nulan is a blue-skinned, white-eyed ring-bearer who answers a distant summons to arrest a tyrant. Nulan builds glowing constructs, flies and shields himself, but is captured and listed missing.

feats.scene: Nulan formed a giant glowing fist and levelled a row of storehouses.
Nulan stood inside a bubble of light as a barrage of shells burst against it.

name: Oster
summary: Oster is a grey-haired country champion who guards his homeland in a flat cap and plaid. Oster keeps a thermos, a stubborn streak and a heavy shoulder.

feats.scene: Oster belted a bruiser through a pub door with a rolled umbrella.
Oster took a thrown barstool across the back and finished his tea.

name: Aulntintu
summary: Aulntintu is a tall, grey-eyed college lecturer who hates violence and has gone by his nickname since boyhood. Aulntintu is a gentle chemist with a strong dislike of the family brawling habit.

feats.scene: Aulntintu lifted a crate of glassware down from a high shelf without a rattle.
Aulntintu stumbled into a lab bench and rubbed his knee.

name: Luesle
summary: Luesle is a bald career criminal who wears a stuffy teacher's gown to rob the unwary. Luesle holds a grudge against a masked rocket-hero and a thin patience for his own crew.

feats.scene: Luesle hurled a cane through a shop window.
Luesle took a shove into a rack of coats and brushed himself off.

name: Rnsirenu
summary: Rnsirenu is an obsessive scholar who dosed a pupil with a secret formula and then turned to dark chemistry himself. Rnsirenu bends flame, frost and mineral by turns and treats every duel as a lab test.

feats.scene: Rnsirenu hurled a blazing sphere that gutted a lecture hall.
Rnsirenu stood inside a frozen shell as a truck hit it and bounced off.

name: Rumtillu
summary: Rumtillu is a lecturer who programs a machine to hand him vast strength, then dons a strongman suit for a crime spree. Rumtillu forgets the formula and loses it all within days.

feats.scene: Rumtillu bent a vault door off its hinges with bare hands.
Rumtillu shrugged off a squad of constables firing at his chest.

name: Nineste
summary: Nineste is a monocled crimelord who runs a college for thieves out of a quiet city office. Nineste teaches the arts of the burglar and sends graduates to rob the town.

feats.scene: Nineste thumped a cane against a lectern to start a lesson.
Nineste took a punch from a rowdy student and straightened his monocle.

name: Leotel
summary: Leotel is a conjurer who dresses all in black and robs the audience with stage tricks. Leotel appears for one case and vanishes in a puff of smoke.

feats.scene: Leotel flung a smoke-filled flask that shattered a window.
Leotel dropped through a trapdoor and landed with a thud.

name: Laseso
summary: Laseso is a purple, eyeless creature that feeds on the chemistry of terror and was dragged from its home world. Laseso once swelled to swallow a whole city of frightened people, then shrank back as they calmed.

feats.scene: Laseso swelled to the size of a district and engulfed every building in it.
Laseso shrugged off a barrage of gunfire from a hundred armed guards.

name: Iarurn
summary: Iarurn is a white-haired, grey-eyed man altered in a secret programme to command the sky. Iarurn conjures towering storms to drive off pursuers and hides on a quiet ranch.

feats.scene: Iarurn raised a storm that flattened a row of farm buildings.
Iarurn stood unscathed as a lightning strike lit up the field.

name: Titorni
summary: Titorni is a white-haired, purple-eyed noble from a very rich world whose family funded a band of heroes. Titorni casts lifelike illusions that fool even electronic watchers, and flies on a band of metal.

feats.scene: Titorni wove a false corridor that sent guards marching into a wall.
Titorni stayed hidden behind a mirage as shots passed through.

name: Talrer
summary: Talrer is a younger double of an older noble, a white-haired illusionist who flew with a team of young heroes in a strange era. Talrer was erased by a cosmic reset and replaced by a very different squad.

feats.scene: Talrer wove a roaring phantom beast that scattered a squad of raiders.
Talrer hid behind a mirage as a hail of pellets fell short.

name: Iuratel
summary: Iuratel is an angry, dark-eyed brawler who works for a rich crook and wins every argument with her fists. Iuratel is very strong and does her best to be insulted so she can fight.

feats.scene: Iuratel drove a punch through the door of a parked van.
Iuratel laughed off a speeding car that clipped her side.

name: Sirauni
summary: Sirauni is a white-haired mercenary raised by cheerful outlaws, who vowed vengeance on all law-keepers. Sirauni wears a suit of armour that loads knowledge straight into the mind, and plans every fight as a lesson.

feats.scene: Sirauni fired a rocket from a wrist launcher and gutted a parked sedan.
Sirauni took a heavy hammer blow on his chest plate and stayed upright.

name: Lusiate
summary: Lusiate is a masked hand-to-hand fighter who uses a portal tube to cross town in a blink. Lusiate prefers blades and blows and keeps his motives hidden.

feats.scene: Lusiate sliced a steel cable in two with a sweep of a blade.
Lusiate fell through a skylight and landed in a roll.

name: Iuvorti
summary: Iuvorti is a black-eyed, fire-bringing elder chained to a peak at the edge of legend, whose liver regrows every day for scavenging birds. Iuvorti is a friend of mortals and can foresee grim roads ahead.

feats.scene: Iuvorti opened a hand and a tide of flame engulfed the whole valley floor.
Iuvorti was torn open by giant talons and was whole again by dawn.

name: Oraloriu
summary: Oraloriu is a red-haired, green-eyed rebel god who stole a sun-spark for mortals and was bound to a rock for his trouble. Oraloriu once shaped a clay champion and handed him borrowed powers from many divine hands.

feats.scene: Oraloriu hurled a ball of stolen sun-fire that levelled a hillside grove.
Oraloriu was pecked at daily by a huge bird and never died.

name: Miaal
summary: Miaal is a blond vigilante who carries a birthright of poison in her palms and a pistol on her hip. Miaal hunts corrupt businessmen, and one touch of hers drops a foe into a deep sleep.

feats.scene: Miaal pressed a palm to a guard's neck and he collapsed instantly.
Miaal took a punch to the vest and returned fire.

name: Lercoes
summary: Lercoes is a red-eyed giant with a great sword who captures champions from many worlds to feed his own doomed home. Lercoes drains the might of others, strides between realities and calls himself the last hope.

feats.scene: Lercoes brought down his blade and a whole world cracked in two.
Lercoes took a combined blast from a dozen champions and stood tall.

name: Tistau
summary: Tistau is a green-furred space hound on a patrol of canine heroes, who talks mind to mind and sees what is hidden. Tistau often glimpses trouble before it happens and barks warnings in time.

feats.scene: Tistau pounced on a saboteur and pinned him to a cargo crate.
Tistau tumbled across a hangar floor and bounced up eager.

name: Rauias
summary: Rauias is kindness made into a living being, a shining presence that flies, shields the weak and answers every grief with gentle force. Rauias cannot be killed, and keeps close company with a few similar embodiments.

feats.scene: Rauias pushed back a rampaging cosmic tide with a warm wave of light.
Rauias stood unmoved inside a collapsing star-fort.

name: Cilsilva
summary: Cilsilva is a quiet tide of warmth that once borrowed a human host and now guides a circle of seekers. Cilsilva reads minds, mends sorrow and lives beyond any one shape or planet.

feats.scene: Cilsilva poured out a wave of calm that quenched a continent-wide riot.
Cilsilva stayed whole while a hostile force raged straight through it.

name: Orasorval
summary: Orasorval is a huge, blue-and-white-skinned, red-eyed bandit who ambushes miners on the trail down from their diggings. Orasorval steals nine mules in a morning and laughs at the haul.

feats.scene: Orasorval drove a heavy knife through a wooden wagon plank.
Orasorval took a thrown pickaxe to the shoulder and chuckled.

name: Nalonti
summary: Nalonti is a white-haired wizard who lives for centuries and holds mortals in low regard. Nalonti has cast very mighty spells in his day and now prefers a quiet farm.

feats.scene: Nalonti flung a spell-wrought fireball that levelled a stone barn.
Nalonti shrugged off a charging bull and an enemy's curse together.

name: Aulanaul
summary: Aulanaul is a changeable hireling who stretches his limbs and sprouts feathered wings at will. Aulanaul serves a crimelord in a team of mythic-styled thugs and is eventually executed by a deranged killer.

feats.scene: Aulanaul stretched an arm across a street and swatted a lamp post.
Aulanaul reshaped his chest around a baton blow and laughed.

name: Loralte
summary: Loralte is a green-haired warlord of a guild of shaping masters, a being of living liquid metal who forms blades, hammers and shields from his own arms. Loralte teaches other warriors to master their natural gifts.

feats.scene: Loralte formed a giant hammer from his fist and shattered a fortress gate.
Loralte flowed around a missile strike and reformed unharmed.

name: Inueste
summary: Inueste is a hairless, white-skinned alien chief with a dazzling smile who promises to heal a dying world. Inueste leads a team of seven others in a grand deception, turning a desert green while quietly plotting a takeover.

feats.scene: Inueste swept a hand across a barren plain and shaped a green valley overnight.
Inueste took a full strike from a gathering of champions and kept smiling.

name: Varortor
summary: Varortor is a big, clumsy, kindly robot built as a trial model and kept to tidy a cave. Varortor has grown a mind of its own, and when the hour demands it, unleashes a mighty battle mode.

feats.scene: Varortor flattened a squad of smaller machines with one sweeping arm.
Varortor stood in an explosion's blast and continued to walk forward.

name: Orraseo
summary: Orraseo is a white-haired government chemist who grows bitter and turns a new hormone upon his employers. Orraseo trusts beakers over brawn and cares more about the formula than the fallout.

feats.scene: Orraseo hurled a bubbling flask that ate through a steel desk.
Orraseo slipped on a spill and landed on a heap of lab coats.

name: Lusonlis
summary: Lusonlis is a gelatinous drifter from a far-future colony world that reshapes itself into any small beast and whispers into nearby minds. It lives as a beloved companion to a band of young wanderers and fights only by confusing foes.

feats.scene: Lusonlis swells into a heavy ram shape and bowls a startled thug across a hangar floor.
Lusonlis flattens under a falling cargo crate and then pours itself back into shape unharmed.

name: Stivavar
summary: Stivavar is a proud tyrant of a distant-future homeland who stakes his people's pride on a rigged sporting contest. He relies on a scheming trickster ally and on deceit rather than fighting strength.

feats.scene: Stivavar slaps a messenger hard enough to topple him from a marble dais.
Stivavar shrugs off a thrown goblet and a stumble down the throne steps.

name: Teelaori
summary: Teelaori is a tomcat of the desert ruins who scratches word-pictures into stone and seems to speak in them. She settles disputes among strays and defends her turf with sharp claws.

feats.scene: Teelaori rakes her claws across a wooden crate and leaves deep furrows.
Teelaori lands on her feet after dropping from a temple wall.

name: Stisotum
summary: Stisotum is a former cult-trained killer who changed sides after a debt of honour. She now carries pistols loaded with stun rounds and hunts other murderers across the southern continent.

feats.scene: Stisotum fires a rubber round that knocks a gunman off a rooftop ledge.
Stisotum rolls through a window pane and rises with only scratches.

name: Ninnite
summary: Ninnite is a disembodied spirit who once tended the sleepers of a prison station and still walks inside their dreams. She reshapes nightmares into mazes and soothes the minds she visits.

feats.scene: Ninnite folds a sleeper's dream into a spiral that throws a rival dreamer out of it.
Ninnite lets a thrown bolt of light pass through her formless body without a scratch.

name: Leleamo
summary: Leleamo began as a drifting energy mind that seized hosts and steered them. Given a grown body by a scientist, it slowly took on the look of its donor, though its hunger to possess others remains.

feats.scene: Leleamo leaps from a collapsing host and flares through a steel door, melting the lock.
Leleamo absorbs a laser volley across its grown body and keeps advancing.

name: Ereiu
summary: Ereiu is a hero from a mirrored world who moves objects with thought alone. He fights alongside a loose gang of defenders and helped a visiting team slip away from a lost battle.

feats.scene: Ereiu hurls a parked van across a street with a flick of his wrist.
Ereiu is caught beneath a collapsing awning and climbs out dazed but whole.

source_title: Psimon (Teen Titans TV Series: Wrong Place, Wrong Time)

name: Reori
summary: Reori steers the moods of those near her, and with training learned to strip feelings away and feed on them to renew herself. Later she learned to throw raw force as well.

feats.scene: Reori channels the fury of a crowd into a single beam that cracks a brick wall.
Reori heals a gashed shoulder by drinking the panic of onlookers.

name: Linauiu
summary: Linauiu is a wealthy owner of a gambling hall who sharpened his mind into a weapon. He leans on bluff, rented muscle and a talent for rattling opponents at the card table.

feats.scene: Linauiu shoves a drunk patron through a velvet curtain.
Linauiu takes a punch to the jaw and keeps smiling.

name: Simonern
summary: Simonern is a small-time thief from a lakeside city who picks fights with a local teenage hero and tends to lose them. He prefers quick snatches and long alley chases.

feats.scene: Simonern throws a trash can lid like a discus and dents a bus stop sign.
Simonern tumbles down a fire escape and limps away.

name: Nianumte
summary: Nianumte is a street-level teen whose blast of chemicals changed her breath into a poison. She was once held by officials and later turned on her rescuers for a reward.

feats.scene: Nianumte breathes out a green haze that drops three guards in a loading dock.
Nianumte falls from a loading ramp onto concrete and gets up angry.

name: Valsauanu
summary: Valsauanu is a young volunteer from a failed enhancement programme who bends sound itself. He auditioned for a teenage hero team but never took a place on it.

feats.scene: Valsauanu hums a rising note until a glass storefront shatters outward.
Valsauanu muffles a blast with a wall of damped air and stays on his feet.

name: Niaiutel
summary: Niaiutel is a marionette-showman who found a chest of strange trinkets at a seaside fairground and turned to crime in a jester costume. He fights without skill but makes up for it with stolen gadgets.

feats.scene: Niaiutel swings a wooden mallet from the chest and flattens a ticket booth.
Niaiutel lands on a carousel horse and bounces off with a laugh.

name: Reoritir
summary: Reoritir is a nimble burglar who flips over fences, slips locks and trades blows only when cornered. His crimes are small and his escapes are quick.

feats.scene: Reoritir vaults a counter and kicks a watchman off balance.
Reoritir drops two storeys onto an awning and rolls away.

name: Seiumval
summary: Seiumval is a face-painted gang member who owns a trained pet and favours trick boxes and cheap firearms. He joined a street brawl against a league of heroes and a team of beast-folk.

feats.scene: Seiumval fires a spring-loaded box that bursts open and dents a parked car door.
Seiumval is knocked flat by a shockwave and crawls behind a barrel.

name: Nolamiu
summary: Nolamiu is a scornful rocker who traded concerts for rooftop raids, bending crowds to his taste with an amplified guitar. The louder he plays, the harder the shock waves hit, and he can beat a teenage hero in a plain scuffle.

feats.scene: Nolamiu cranks his amp and the blast cracks the windows of a concert hall.
Nolamiu rides out a kick to the chest and keeps strumming.

name: Saunaurno
summary: Saunaurno is a minor lawbreaker with a mean streak and little else on record. He lurks in alleys and takes whatever is left unguarded.

feats.scene: Saunaurno swings a pipe and dents a mailbox.
Saunaurno trips off a curb and shrugs it off.

name: Orent
summary: Orent is a chemist who brews a serum that lets him steer infected people by simple thought. He sends hired thugs to dose rivals and hopes to seize a rival's secret formula.

feats.scene: Orent thinks a command and his dosed victim empties a safe onto the floor.
Orent tumbles from a chair when a raid breaks in and gets back up.

name: Temia
summary: Temia is a notorious raider who burned a moon in a long campaign of ruin and stole a trade vessel to flee into a forbidden sector. Pursuers forced his ship down and the chase ended in a crash.

feats.scene: Temia unleashes his dark flames across a moon and scorches its entire surface.
Temia walks out of the burning wreck of his stolen ship.

name: Osiarser
summary: Osiarser is a living weapon grown by ancient scientists, long since banned. She screams with devastating force, though she can also talk in two tongues and carries a stubborn will.

feats.scene: Osiarser shrieks across a valley and flattens a village district.
Osiarser walks through a collapsing tower unscathed.

name: Siaun
summary: Siaun is a petty offender known only by a rough reputation. He steals at night and disappears before dawn.

feats.scene: Siaun elbows a clerk and bolts through the door.
Siaun tumbles over a bin and runs on.

name: Liisnum
summary: Liisnum arrived at a colonial hamlet as a humble traveller and then used infernal rites to terrify the settlers. Neighbours eventually banded together, caught him and put him on trial.

feats.scene: Liisnum calls a column of black flame that burns down a barn in seconds.
Liisnum is struck with a farm tool and stays standing, hissing a curse.

name: Riavest
summary: Riavest is an overseas rival of a riddle-loving criminal, staging flying heists in the style of old-time stagecraft. He wears fine period clothes and hides messages in plain sight.

feats.scene: Riavest cuts the cable of a hangar crane and drops a crate onto a getaway truck.
Riavest rides out a hard landing from a glider and tips his hat.

name: Irsemia
summary: Irsemia is a rogue who joined a villain conclave and later helped storm a city of apes. A single blow from a masked hero put him out of the fight.

feats.scene: Irsemia hurls a trick box at a charging ape and singes its fur.
Irsemia is hit once and falls, but is breathing soundly.

name: Miora
summary: Miora is a gambler who treats crime as a parlour game and builds puzzles to trap a famed flying hero. Cleverness and patience are the only edges he owns.

feats.scene: Miora tosses a loaded die that triggers a spring-trap in a casino cellar.
Miora falls from a bar stool and bounces up, holding his cards.

name: Tiuore
summary: Tiuore is the unacknowledged heir of a cold-war dictator, running the secret police with firearms, spies and lies. His order to silence a family set a young boy on a path to vengeance.

feats.scene: Tiuore fires his service pistol and punches a hole through a steel locker.
Tiuore walks from a car wreck with a bruised shoulder.

name: Rerianu
summary: Rerianu is a sentient cloud of loose energy that a scientist forced into a bodily shape. She is curious and a little vain, and she talks about herself with plain wonder.

feats.scene: Rerianu vents a flare that shatters the windows of an entire laboratory wing.
Rerianu disperses into glowing mist when a rocket hits, then gathers again.

name: Vitiu
summary: Vitiu is a sea-bound raider from a burning war-world, bred under a primal power that grants endurance and might. He swims, pilots strike craft and wields a forked blade, but a certain radiating metal weakens him.

feats.scene: Vitiu drives his forked blade into a freighter hull and splits it along the keel.
Vitiu rides a depth charge blast and surfaces laughing.

name: Tertiial
summary: Tertiial is a goddess of a burning war-world who tends a single garden and keeps a prophetic oracle for her ruler. Her sight into tomorrow is narrow but real.

feats.scene: Tertiial raises a thorn hedge that crushes an intruder's vehicle.
Tertiial stands unharmed in a burst of furnace heat that melts the gate behind her.

name: Vassena
summary: Vassena is a soldier of a stellar police force who quit training early and went back to her home army. Her ring moulds green light into barriers, beams and shapes, and her courage let her wear it.

feats.scene: Vassena casts a luminous hammer that demolishes a derelict warehouse.
Vassena sheathes herself in a shield that withstands a missile strike.

name: Talastau
summary: Talastau is a risk-loving rooftop wanderer who trained two future crusaders in balance, stealth and sword work. She carries a pair of blades and treats every skyline as a classroom.

feats.scene: Talastau cuts a dangling rope with both swords and drops a canopy on three pursuers.
Talastau lands a long drop on a water tank and walks away.

name: Stmece
summary: Stmece is a half-human, half-shapeshifter creation of two scheming scientists, built to battle a young divine champion. He is strong, but his makers used him as a brawler first and a person second.

feats.scene: Stmece hurls a truck down a boulevard with both hands.
Stmece takes a head-on crash and straightens his neck with a crack.

name: Nilirosa
summary: Nilirosa is a scaly agent from a far-future reptile civilisation sent back in time to cause trouble. Cold-blooded and patient, it pursues its mission with deliberate and unsettling calm.

feats.scene: Nilirosa clamps a clawed hand around a lamp post and bends it in two.
Nilirosa is hit by a patrol car and hisses upright.

name: Sicost
summary: Sicost is an elder guardian of a cosmic order, a templar among its ancient overseers. He keeps vigil over the oldest rules and enforces them with calm authority.

feats.scene: Sicost calls down a pillar of focused light that carves a canyon through a barren moon.
Sicost stands within a collapsing star-gate and is not moved.

name: Cilnasta
summary: Cilnasta is a masked crime queen who bought her way into the rule of a desert dictatorship. She commands through hired hands, bribes and fear rather than personal fighting.

feats.scene: Cilnasta hurls a golden goblet and cracks a guard's helmet.
Cilnasta tumbles from a balcony and brushes dust off her robe.

name: Nenollcin
summary: Nenollcin is a wrathful sea-folk queen who ruled a flooded prison labyrinth and its fish-men. A shard of divine weaponry in her staff may have fed her pride, and a liberator dug her people a tunnel to the open ocean.

feats.scene: Nenollcin smashes her staff into a stone wall and brings down a whole corridor.
Nenollcin shrugs off a collapsing ceiling in the flooded maze.

name: Amtorlen
summary: Amtorlen is a sea-born monarch who joined a league of rogues to oppose a warrior princess. She rules with a firm hand and flashes a regal temper.

feats.scene: Amtorlen strikes a sea wall with her trident and splits a block of concrete.
Amtorlen takes a cannon shot to the shoulder and holds her ground.

name: Irnartel
summary: Irnartel is the small, kind queen of a clover-covered realm of fairies who repaid a hero's help with gentle magic. She vanishes at will and floods a field with soft glowing light.

feats.scene: Irnartel waves her wand and a beam of pale light lifts a pursuer off his feet.
Irnartel is caught in a net and slips out in a flash of light.

name: Riancel
summary: Riancel was a thief-queen who led a gang and an army of insects. She met a sudden end after falling from a high window during a clash with a tiny hero.

feats.scene: Riancel whistles and a swarm of insects pours across a jeweller's floor.
Riancel braces against a window frame before a long fall.

name: Ststu
summary: Ststu is a young lab-raised weapon who bends metal to her wishes. Freed from a government facility by a clown-faced mastermind, she joined a gang built around playing-card themes.

feats.scene: Ststu pulls a streetlight flat and folds it around a fleeing driver's car.
Ststu is thrown into a brick wall and rises with a scowl.

name: Neoamse
summary: Neoamse is a lawbreaker with a card-suit alias and little detail recorded. She commits quiet thefts around the docks.

feats.scene: Neoamse jabs a guard with an elbow and drops a crate.
Neoamse slips on wet planks and gets up quickly.

name: Maanor
summary: Maanor is a serial murderer who stalked a gloomy metropolis and drew the attention of a dark vigilante. Lurking and secrecy are her only advantages.

feats.scene: Maanor drives a blade into a door frame hard enough to split the wood.
Maanor falls from a fire escape and limps into a side street.

name: Seocin
summary: Seocin is a gang member who works in a team named for a card hand. Little else is recorded beyond her loyalty to the group.

feats.scene: Seocin hurls a heavy card-shaped blade and splits a wooden post.
Seocin tumbles down a stairwell and stands up.

name: Eovosnu
summary: Eovosnu is a costumed rogue who served in a card-themed crew of criminals. She follows orders, sticks close to her team and carries out jobs on schedule.

feats.scene: Eovosnu cracks a heavy club across a vault door and chips the paint.
Eovosnu is knocked off a ledge and lands in a hedge.

name: Lesrera
summary: Lesrera is a rebel general whose body dissolved after exposure to rift energy, so he lives inside a sealed suit. From the suit he fires rift-born force and leads an uprising against the tyrants who rule his ruined homeworld.

feats.scene: Lesrera vents the suit's stored rift energy and vaporises a fortified hillside.
Lesrera's suit absorbs a bombardment that levels the courtyard around him.

name: Luolria
summary: Luolria is an unemployed man who joined a militant group and tried to snatch a high official on the coast. A speedy hero stripped his gun apart, and he answered with a gas canister and a hostage.

feats.scene: Luolria tosses a gas canister that fills a lobby with grey smoke.
Luolria stumbles on a kerb after being shoved and keeps his grip on the hostage.

name: Lliumanu
summary: Lliumanu is a magistrate born from human imagination who presides over odd trials in sleep and waking life. Though cast out by his peers, he still drags witnesses to the bench and cannot age or break old rules.

feats.scene: Lliumanu slams his gavel and a gust of dream-wind hurls a juror across the room.
Lliumanu stays standing in a collapsing courtroom of dream stone.

name: Setertor
summary: Setertor is a veteran policeman who rose from patrol officer to captain and eventually to city leader. He is a protective father of two daughters and relies on grit and a steady badge.

feats.scene: Setertor fires his sidearm and punches a hole in a car door.
Setertor is thrown against a squad car and gets up shouting orders.

name: Rusiuval
summary: Rusiuval is a stiff project manager at a research firm who oversaw several department heads. He suspended a physicist he judged unfit for the company, a petty decision with long consequences.

feats.scene: Rusiuval slams a folder on a desk hard enough to rattle a lamp.
Rusiuval trips on a stair in the lobby and stands unhurt.

name: Naltau
summary: Naltau is a former rapper and visual artist turned renegade psychic operative of a hip-hop-flavoured squad. He mixes rhymes with mind-born force.

feats.scene: Naltau drops a verse and a psychic shockwave shoves a gang of enforcers back a dozen paces.
Naltau takes a baton blow to the back and finishes the rhyme.

name: Astiarre
summary: Astiarre is a young genius from a planet of thinkers, the heir to a long line of machine tyrants. He outwits foes with a mind far beyond ordinary thought and can grow into a larger fighting form.

feats.scene: Astiarre swells to battle size and wrecks a hovering war platform with one punch.
Astiarre's belt field absorbs a point-blank missile blast.

name: Amvanti
summary: Amvanti is the head scientist of a future youth team, gifted with superhuman calculation and a vast memory. A belt of protective energy covers him, and his love of tinkering keeps the team's machines running.

feats.scene: Amvanti rewires a hangar crane and drops a derelict hull through a wall.
Amvanti's belt field absorbs a plasma bolt that scorches the deck around him.

name: Leneocol
summary: Leneocol is a brilliant tinkerer descended from a line of machine overlords who hopes to undo his ancestors' crimes. He carries a bubble device that bends time and has been trapped in loops by a war-god.

feats.scene: Leneocol triggers his time bubble and an incoming volley freezes in mid-air.
Leneocol is jostled in a corridor fight and keeps his device safe.

name: Inullo
summary: Inullo is a devoted fan and team engineer who can swell into a hulking combat shape when a fight turns rough. He projects force, commands machines and keeps a flight ring on his finger.

feats.scene: Inullo, in his large form, flattens a robot sentry with a single overhead strike.
Inullo shields himself from a collapsing gantry with a hardened body.

source_title: Querl Dox (Legion of Super-Heroes TV Series)

name: Vetelmi
summary: Vetelmi is a quiet scientist from a world of thinkers whose intellect outclasses most. He leans on knowledge over muscle and wears a ring that lets him fly.

feats.scene: Vetelmi rigs a lab capacitor to arc and knocks a trespasser flat.
Vetelmi is thrown into a console and gets up unbowed.

name: Nosta
summary: Nosta is a gifted thinker who strives to make up for the sins of his ancestors, a villainous line of machines. His intellect is startling, and his heart is steadier than his lineage.

feats.scene: Nosta overloads a hangar console and the blast knocks a squad of intruders down.
Nosta is thrown into a bulkhead and rises with a determined frown.

name: Vaialll
summary: Vaialll is a prodigy who carries the burden of his forebear's villainy and works to redeem it. His mind is supremely advanced, and he applies it for the good of his comrades.

feats.scene: Vaialll reroutes a ship's power coupling and sparks hurl a boarder off his feet.
Vaialll rides out a hard landing in a cramped escape pod.

name: Ianore
summary: Ianore is a faceless wanderer with no known name, the first to carry a mask of blank skin and a lifelong hunt for truth. He was judged before a council beyond time, and others took up his mission after him.

feats.scene: Ianore pulls a hat brim low and flattens a gang lookout with a single blow.
Ianore walks away from a burning warehouse with singed sleeves.

name: Telcoram
summary: Telcoram is a masked burglar and sharpshooter who also happens to be a skilled cook. A weakness in telling colours apart has foiled more than one of his jobs.

feats.scene: Telcoram shoots a rope in two from across a courtyard.
Telcoram slips from a drainpipe and rolls to a stop on grass.

name: Stanesi
summary: Stanesi is a minor snake-deity, child of a feathered-serpent god, who guards temple groves and favours the faithful. His coils are strong and his scales turn aside blades.

feats.scene: Stanesi coils around a stone altar and cracks it in half.
Stanesi is struck by a falling pillar and the pillar breaks instead.

name: Rirnene
summary: Rirnene is a scientist from a doomed homeland who was confined in a spectral prison dimension and later clashed with a famous flying hero. His body gives him durable, powerful physiology.

feats.scene: Rirnene punches through a steel gate and sends it flying down a hall.
Rirnene is hit by a blast that cracks a concrete wall and shrugs it off.

name: Seonanne
summary: Seonanne is a radical convict sentenced by a scientist father to a ghostly confinement in a parallel pocket cosmos. He is strong, hard to harm and bitter at his jailers.

feats.scene: Seonanne rips a hatch off a prison transport and flings it across a field.
Seonanne walks out of a blast furnace without a mark.

name: Alllenti
summary: Alllenti is a bow-wielding teen from a mirror-world counterpart of a famous teen team, a cheerful opposite of an archer elsewhere. The twin groups met through a portal and became friends fast.

feats.scene: Alllenti looses an arrow and pins a toy robot to a bookcase.
Alllenti tumbles from a play-fort roof and bounces up giggling.

name: Corsauco
summary: Corsauco was a masked wartime crimefighter in a band of veteran heroes who later attended a mass loyalty rally. He relied on nerve, a disguise and a sharp sense of timing.

feats.scene: Corsauco lands a flying tackle that sends a saboteur through a storefront window.
Corsauco is thrown over a bar and lands on his feet.

name: Neltorvi
summary: Neltorvi was a mysterious masked runner, a former circus acrobat who raced through a harbour city in the middle of the last century. He outpaced thieves and vanished before anyone could thank him.

feats.scene: Neltorvi sprints past a robber and rips the bag from his hand, sending him spinning.
Neltorvi outruns a speeding train along the waterfront.

name: Teltasas
summary: Teltasas is a faction chief inside a global crime syndicate, fighting rival bosses for control. He plans like a strategist and carries machine implants.

feats.scene: Teltasas drives a cybernetic fist into an armoured door and buckles it.
Teltasas takes a shotgun blast to the chest and keeps walking.

name: Aunnilcor
summary: Aunnilcor is a wanderer in a band of travellers led by a comet-touched captain. Her role is modest, and she trusts the group to carry her across strange stars.

feats.scene: Aunnilcor swings a staff and cracks a drifting asteroid chunk in two.
Aunnilcor rides out a tumbling hull rattle and steadies the ship.

name: Cerco
summary: Cerco is a lodger who rented a spare room to a famous warrior princess's household and became a close friend. She has no powers and is a gentle, steady presence.

feats.scene: Cerco drops a heavy moving box on the floor and the glasses jump.
Cerco trips on a rug and catches herself on the table.

name: Numaulna
summary: Numaulna was a stellar peacekeeper who was killed at a sector outpost by his partner, who was under the sway of mind-bending spores. The truth came out only after an innocent man was blamed.

feats.scene: Numaulna shapes a glowing hammer from his ring and demolishes an outpost wall.
Numaulna casts a shield that stops a thrown girder.

name: Asivarn
summary: Asivarn is a cosmic peacekeeper who stood with her corps to defend the homeworld of the guardians from an ancient threat. Her ring forges light into shields, beams and shapes.

feats.scene: Asivarn shapes a glowing cannon and blasts a hostile craft out of the sky.
Asivarn raises a green barrier that holds under heavy bombardment.

name: Stitelnau
summary: Stitelnau is a patrol officer who doubles as a stellar peacekeeper. Her ring lets her fly and craft light into whatever the moment demands.

feats.scene: Stitelnau casts a glowing battering ram and breaks down a bunker door.
Stitelnau shields herself against a falling billboard.

name: Iltiull
summary: Iltiull is a senior lawman of a red-world people, holding a rank held by few. She enforces order with steady judgment and a stern manner.

feats.scene: Iltiull throws a heavy lawbreaker through a wooden stall.
Iltiull absorbs a speeding vehicle's glancing hit and keeps pace.

name: Aunti
summary: Aunti is the radiant ruler of a desert pantheon, the sun-lord and heaven-father who is said to have made humankind. His gaze lights the day and his barge crosses the sky nightly.

feats.scene: Aunti opens his eye and a wave of sun-fire scorches a whole hemisphere of a world.
Aunti endures a rival god's strike that splits a mountain range and is unmarked.

name: Taumi
summary: Taumi is a worldwide terrorist who commands a society of assassins and whose title means a head of a monster. He plots in secret, hires killers and demands total obedience.

feats.scene: Taumi cuts down a rival's bodyguard with one sweep of his sword.
Taumi takes a hard punch to the jaw and answers with a cold smile.

name: Rertal
summary: Rertal is the stern chief of a secret band of killers, a figure who works from shadows and rules by fear. His house is a web of hired blades and old grudges.

feats.scene: Rertal drives his blade through a training dummy and the wooden post behind it.
Rertal takes a hard blow to the ribs and does not lose his stance.

name: Eoorise
summary: Eoorise is a long-lived zealot who has fought a famous caped crusader for years and who made another man into a masked outlaw. A glowing pit of revival keeps him alive past any natural span.

feats.scene: Eoorise slashes through a wooden door and the splintering frame with one stroke.
Eoorise rises from a drowning pool of green fluid, renewed.

source_title: Ra's al Ghul (Batman: Under the Red Hood)

name: Lenussau
summary: Lenussau founded a secret order of killers that aims to scour the world and remake it under his own rule. He tried to groom a masked vigilante as his heir and wed him to his daughter.

feats.scene: Lenussau strikes a blade through a stone statue's wrist and cracks it.
Lenussau absorbs a staggering strike and answers in a calm voice.

source_title: Ra's al Ghul (DC Animated Movie Universe)

name: Orcel
summary: Orcel is a ruthless businessman and master criminal who also leads a hidden cabal of killers. He is a father and a grandfather, and he owned many firms before a dark equation changed the world.

feats.scene: Orcel signs a decree and a squad of hired killers wrecks a warehouse in one night.
Orcel is flung from a car and walks away with a torn coat.

name: Irnllela
summary: Irnllela is a nearly undying leader of a shadow order who saw a future where a young heir would turn vigilante and set out to make that vision real. He wields occult knowledge, foresight and fighting skill.

feats.scene: Irnllela foresees a strike and counters with a blade that shears a wooden beam.
Irnllela is submerged in a glowing pool and climbs out with all wounds closed.

name: Renamrni
summary: Renamrni leads a league of killers and strikes a bargain with a mighty ally who wants his wife restored through a glowing pit. Together they take the planet in one imagined outcome.

feats.scene: Renamrni cuts a rope bridge in two and drops a patrol into a ravine.
Renamrni survives a long fall onto sand and brushes himself off.

name: Letisia
summary: Letisia is a peak-fit terrorist trained in acrobatics, stealth, computers and stick fighting. She carries twin brown staffs wielded like a famous vigilante's, plus a sword.

feats.scene: Letisia whirls both staffs and knocks three guards off a catwalk.
Letisia drops from a balcony and rolls away unhurt.

name: Reoor
summary: Reoor is an almost undying eco-minded villain and cult leader, known as a deadly opponent of a famous bat-themed hero. He believes the planet must be cleansed and gathers followers to say so.

feats.scene: Reoor swings a heavy sword and carves a deep notch in a stone pillar.
Reoor staggers from a blast and then straightens, bleeding but unbeaten.

name: Rantiso
summary: Rantiso is a heroic version of an infamous old man, a patient leader who turns his long experience toward protecting others. Little else is known beyond his side.

feats.scene: Rantiso drives a sword into a floor and splits a tile.
Rantiso takes a heavy blow and holds his ground.

name: Liirnres
summary: Liirnres is a shape-shifter from a race of mimics who sheltered a runaway and then joined a teen team. When she touches a gifted person she can copy their powers for a while.

feats.scene: Liirnres copies a brute's strength and hurls a tool chest across a garage.
Liirnres reshapes her body around a hard knock and pops back to normal.

name: Iaramoeon
summary: Iaramoeon is a leader of a clandestine band of seven, a being from a dimension of shifting form. He bends his shape and the world around him to serve his cause.

feats.scene: Iaramoeon reshapes the floor into a wave of stone that tosses guards aside.
Iaramoeon dissolves and re-forms after a heavy blow.

name: Ticeoli
summary: Ticeoli is a getaway driver whose custom sports car outpaces most police vehicles. He relies on his wheels, a few tricks and a good sense of timing.

feats.scene: Ticeoli rams a barricade at speed and scatters its crates.
Ticeoli tears down a coastal road faster than a patrol car can follow.

name: Silcosil
summary: Silcosil is a hero of modest renown about whom few details survive. She steps in when neighbours need help and stays humble about it.

feats.scene: Silcosil hauls a fallen fence panel off a trapped worker.
Silcosil stumbles on a ladder and brushes herself off.

name: Vaeolvar
summary: Vaeolvar is a prosecutor's aide who grew up beside a wealthy heir and never stopped believing ordinary people can outgrow their worst days. Armed with case files and nerve, Vaeolvar presses powerful men on matters they would rather bury.

feats.scene: Vaeolvar slams a thick binder onto a lectern hard enough to split its spine and silence the room.
Vaeolvar is flung against a stone wall by a nearby blast and still crawls toward the exit.

name: Amtan
summary: Amtan is a nosy newspaper reporter who sneaks into a hate group to learn what the walking dead are really doing. A camera, patience and a talent for earning trust are the whole arsenal.

feats.scene: Amtan shoulders a rusted gate open to escape from a shooting range.
Amtan tumbles down a flight of concrete steps clutching a camera and walks away bruised.

name: Olueonna
summary: Olueonna is a towering covert operative whose body was rebuilt by a golden living suit after a blast took both arms. Years of irregular warfare drills and calm negotiation make Olueonna as dangerous in a hostage room as in a firefight.

feats.scene: Olueonna flips a parked armored truck onto its roof to break a siege.
Olueonna stays upright as a ceiling of cut stone comes down in a blast.

name: Natanstu
summary: Natanstu is a quiet fighter whose years of unarmed training were later sharpened with a blade. Grief over a lost sibling drives every careful duel.

feats.scene: Natanstu cleaves a wooden training post in two with a single sword stroke.
Natanstu takes a hard kick to the ribs from a much larger opponent and keeps the guard up.

name: Naorse
summary: Naorse is a wealthy matriarch who stood by a son the world called a criminal. Naorse's polite hospitality hides a stubborn loyalty that no accusation could bend.

feats.scene: Naorse hurls a heavy porcelain vase at an intruder in the hallway.
Naorse is knocked to the floor by an armed thug and stays conscious to the end.

name: Riaenu
summary: Riaenu is a pale young sorceress who inherited a demon's dark gifts and spends her life keeping them leashed. When restraint slips, shadow pours out and bystanders feel her grief as their own.

feats.scene: Riaenu tears open a black rift beneath a stadium and swallows a whole parking structure.
Riaenu absorbs the collapse of a tower of black glass without a scratch.

name: Tummiasau
summary: Tummiasau is a small-town physician whose eyes pierce skin and stone, glowing painfully whenever the gift is used. Cut-free autopsies are the party trick, and a splitting headache is the price.

feats.scene: Tummiasau shoves a loaded gurney through swinging doors to block a pursuer.
Tummiasau is thrown over a porch rail by a drunk brawler and gets up swearing.

name: Inusortu
summary: Inusortu is a masked killer who comes apart into pieces that crawl and strike on their own, then knit back together. Dismemberment is no punishment, only an inconvenience.

feats.scene: Inusortu launches a detached fist through the windshield of a delivery van.
Inusortu is flattened by a truck and reassembles from the scraps by morning.

name: Anilora
summary: Anilora is a purple-haired goddess-soldier from a realm outside ordinary time who switched allegiances and still hungers for fights. Anilora mocks mortals who wield borrowed power and enjoys making them regret it.

feats.scene: Anilora hurls a spear that drops a whole mountainside into rubble.
Anilora strides out of a collapsing ridge with not a mark on the skin.

name: Tirson
summary: Tirson is an engineered being of living radiance, made by a doomed royal line to fight a single monster. Tirson's body is borrowed light, and every blast costs a piece of it.

feats.scene: Tirson condenses a sun-bright lance and pierces a hovering fortress from end to end.
Tirson is battered by its own energy turned back on it and holds together for a full minute.

name: Eontiamo
summary: Eontiamo is a conscripted villain in a suit stitched with emitters for burning rays. The armour is clumsy, and its master's leash is shorter still.

feats.scene: Eontiamo sweeps a red beam across a loading dock, melting a row of crates into slag.
Eontiamo is thrown through a plasterboard wall and staggers up again.

name: Cetircin
summary: Cetircin is a bald thug humming with unstable radioactivity, leaving a trail of sick light behind. Cetircin's blasts are crude, but the contamination lingers for years.

feats.scene: Cetircin lobs a ball of glowing waste that scorches an entire intersection.
Cetircin walks out of a gas-main explosion with smoking clothes and a grin.

name: Tismianus
summary: Tismianus is an ex-technician turned living reactor who wants to overload the world's power and rule the ashes. Dense muscle, long leaps and a gift for warping mass make him hard to stop.

feats.scene: Tismianus makes a freight engine weigh as much as a hill and crushes the rails beneath it.
Tismianus shrugs off a direct missile hit while glowing hotter than before.

name: Nusceser
summary: Nusceser is a clockwork guardian built as tribute to an older cosmic machine. Gears and polish are all the entry shows of what ticks inside.

feats.scene: Nusceser punches a steel shutter clean off its rails.
Nusceser takes a bus-sized impact at the shoulder and only dents.

name: Vorvorsti
summary: Vorvorsti runs a tiny cafe offering twenty-six blends and wishes customers would linger over a cup. Having fled a dictatorship, Vorvorsti now offers a cheap room and a kind ear to a struggling young artist upstairs.

feats.scene: Vorvorsti slaps a rolling pin onto the counter to end a petty argument.
Vorvorsti slips on a wet floor with a full tray of cups and laughs it off.

name: Rnitor
summary: Rnitor was a data pirate whose arms became razor blades after a monstrous feeding. Torn between vengeance and mercy, Rnitor chose to save a young hero rather than carve up the broker who ordered the hit.

feats.scene: Rnitor slices a steel lamppost in half with a single sweep of the forearm.
Rnitor drops from a warehouse rafter onto concrete and keeps fighting.

name: Resnust
summary: Resnust is a living world that fed and housed a species of small creatures until their greed turned it bitter. Resnust wiped them out, died at a sibling's hands, and rose again only to be broken once more.

feats.scene: Resnust heaves its own crust upward in a wave that scours a whole continent clean.
Resnust's buried heart is shattered and the great body drifts on in orbit.

name: Araute
summary: Araute is a sentient stitched doll, once a wartime villain, who now sews costumes for her allies. Torn apart, she can simply be sewn whole again.

feats.scene: Araute chokes a steel wire around a lamp post and snaps it with a twist.
Araute is shredded by claws and later reassembled with needle and thread.

name: Rnnauveo
summary: Rnnauveo is an orphan with a freakish memory for trivia who became a sidekick to a genius adventurer. Quick answers and quicker nerves carry Rnnauveo through puzzles that stump grown detectives.

feats.scene: Rnnauveo swings a thick almanac into a goon's jaw.
Rnnauveo is slammed to the floor by a hostage taker and keeps reciting facts to stay awake.

name: Riastrus
summary: Riastrus is a first-born archangel, winged and deathless, who serves a higher power. Its quiet stance in a heavenly city hides the weight of an ancient duty.

feats.scene: Riastrus brings a sword of light down on a ridge and splits it from summit to base.
Riastrus stands in the heart of a collapsing peak and brushes dust from the wings.

name: Sistton
summary: Sistton is the embodiment of divine retribution, first among celestial judges, who cut down rebels in a war over paradise. Sistton can stride between worlds and swell to enormous size, yet fell to a single blade.

feats.scene: Sistton swells to titan scale and cracks a continental shelf along its whole length.
Sistton weathers a rain of holy fire that boils a sea and walks on unharmed.

name: Esrialo
summary: Esrialo is a vain, bald crook in a monocle who commits crimes with garish flair. Colorful gimmicks make up for what Esrialo lacks in menace.

feats.scene: Esrialo swings a cane at a night watchman's knee.
Esrialo is clubbed by a vigilante's gun butt and sulks in the cell afterwards.

name: Ileriare
summary: Ileriare is a criminal from a later era who travels back in time to steal an alien mineral for weapons. Elaborate traps are the hallmark, and they fail whenever heroes team up.

feats.scene: Ileriare triggers a hidden counterweight that drops a steel girder across a corridor.
Ileriare is tossed into a wall by his own trap and staggers upright.

name: Anros
summary: Anros is a blue-skinned soldier of a cosmic police corps who fought his way into a tyrant's fortress and lost hand and ring for it. Later Anros drilled a squad for hellish battles and survived as a hostage.

feats.scene: Anros fires a green lance that pierces a swarm of armored flyers across a burning plain.
Anros has a hand and ring crushed by a laughing tyrant and still walks away.

name: Nineiu
summary: Nineiu is a lone watcher sent to a grim world who evaded capture and secretly warned a distant corps of an invading force. A ring and battery keep Nineiu alive among enemies.

feats.scene: Nineiu casts a green barrier then flings it as a ram through a line of enemy ships.
Nineiu hides inside a collapsing hangar as a hundred blasts rain down.

name: Elnto
summary: Elnto is a nuclear-powered fighter with yellow eyes who takes to the sky at hundreds of miles an hour. Elnto's blasts burn bright and wild, and control comes slowly.

feats.scene: Elnto flattens a row of warehouses with a single flaring burst of atomic fire.
Elnto walks through a collapsing fuel depot with only scorched clothes.
Elnto streaks across a river valley fast enough to outrun a pursuit helicopter.

name: Tiraneon
summary: Tiraneon is a blond soldier-assassin who believes his people must accept hard sacrifices to survive. Tiraneon struck at a general during a festival and was nearly torn apart by the crowd.

feats.scene: Tiraneon fires an energy rifle across a plaza, blowing a crater in the paving stones.
Tiraneon is buried under a mob of furious bystanders and keeps breathing.

name: Reostani
summary: Reostani is a gifted scientist who tricked a world into believing he was its first champion, then crowned himself ruler. Stunts of great strength and a talent for hypnosis kept the lie alive until a rival saw through it.

feats.scene: Reostani tears a metal spire from its foundation and sets it back in place before a cheering crowd.
Reostani fights off a sea monster bare-handed and strolls ashore unmarked.

name: Leoosa
summary: Leoosa is a stretchy child hero who ties himself in knots whenever a runaway playground ball rolls past. Cheerful and rubbery, Leoosa treats every scrape as a game.

feats.scene: Leoosa stretches an arm across a sandbox and flicks a beach ball into the sky.
Leoosa bounces off a trampoline wall and snaps back to shape giggling.

name: Neorn
summary: Neorn is a white-haired forensic scientist and puzzle fan who tried to commit a flawless crime to test his fellow sleuths. The scheme baffled most of them and fell apart on one stray clue.

feats.scene: Neorn slams a lab drawer shut on a nosy rival's fingers.
Neorn tumbles over a lab bench in the scuffle and stays on his feet.

name: Nasrn
summary: Nasrn is a gentle chemist who can command every element on the table, from steel to flame, and wishes he could stop. After years as a captive weapon, Nasrn turned his gift toward protecting friends.

feats.scene: Nasrn turns a foundry's girders to white fire and collapses the whole building.
Nasrn is tortured with electrodes and bluntly refuses to harm anyone.

name: Tiutorca
summary: Tiutorca is a bearded field leader of a secret band who uses ancestral rites to conjure light and flit through space. Tiutorca's gifts cannot touch the dead, which is a hard lesson.

feats.scene: Tiutorca flashes a blinding bolt of light that melts every window of a parked bus.
Tiutorca is hurled through a shop front and rises mumbling a prayer.

name: Resniasa
summary: Resniasa is a one-eyed ape warlord born centuries after a great catastrophe, schooled in brawling and brutal tactics. Scars and cunning make Resniasa a feared commander in a world gone wild.

feats.scene: Resniasa smashes a wooden barricade to splinters with a single fist.
Resniasa takes a spear to the shoulder and tears it out with a snarl.

name: Serninum
summary: Serninum is a deposed ape general whose command was taken in a savage challenge. Sulking and scarred, Serninum still barks orders at whoever will listen.

feats.scene: Serninum caves in a crate with a heavy overhand blow.
Serninum is beaten across a barracks floor by a bigger rival and gets up growling.

name: Tesser
summary: Tesser is a white-haired mercenary whose strange gifts came during decades of paid fighting. Recruited by a charismatic leader, Tesser stayed loyal until that leader's plans began to smell rotten.

feats.scene: Tesser kicks in a vault door and strolls past the shattered frame.
Tesser takes a point-blank volley from a squad and shakes off the bruises.

name: Auosael
summary: Auosael is a military police colonel who prefers firearms and discipline to speeches. Loyal to his flag above all, Auosael watches foreign heroes with careful suspicion.

feats.scene: Auosael fires a service pistol and drops a bottle at twenty paces.
Auosael takes a rifle butt to the shoulder and barks a command anyway.

name: Tilseve
summary: Tilseve is a white-haired crime mastermind who borrowed a cosmic entity's power to challenge an entire league of heroes. Five hired thugs once served as his fingers, and later a borrowed force served as a fist.

feats.scene: Tilseve channels borrowed starlight and levels a stadium and the streets around it.
Tilseve stands unmoved as a team of heroes batters the shell of cosmic force around him.

name: Rescorrn
summary: Rescorrn is a greedy businessman who dressed as a ghost to scare villagers away from oil-rich marshland. The scheme collapsed when a young hero exposed it, and a trap door finished the story.

feats.scene: Rescorrn swings a lantern at a curious villager and misses.
Rescorrn is dropped through a hidden floor hatch and the story ends there.

name: Seocor
summary: Seocor is a zealot convict who sprouts wings and fires beams from his eyes, convinced he serves a higher source. Seocor overpowers armored men and dies under a dropped airship.

feats.scene: Seocor scorches a prison wall with heat from his eyes until the concrete runs like wax.
Seocor is crushed beneath a falling airship in the final fight.

name: Canol
summary: Canol is a film-school graduate who once masked up as a vigilante behind a parent's back. Canol now writes screenplays and still joins the family when a haunted hearse needs stopping.

feats.scene: Canol punches a possessed hearse clean across a lawn.
Canol takes a swinging iron gate to the ribs at a graduation party and laughs.

name: Ceotor
summary: Ceotor is a white-haired elder from a noble house on a doomed world, patriarch of a long line. Ceotor's quiet authority is the only power the record speaks of.

feats.scene: Ceotor raps a staff on the stone floor to call a council to order.
Ceotor stumbles from a tremor in the great hall and catches the rail.

name: Natinore
summary: Natinore is a hard-faced hoodlum who works the docks of a decaying port city. Natinore keeps his head down and his fists ready.

feats.scene: Natinore throws a punch that splits a debtor's lip behind a warehouse.
Natinore is slammed into a stack of pallets and shakes it off.

name: Lanrau
summary: Lanrau is a party clown who lies to protect himself and pays for it in blood. A cowardly streak is the whole of his character, and it proves fatal.

feats.scene: Lanrau shoves a coworker aside in a locker room and takes the better coat.
Lanrau is flung into a dressing-room wall and cannot get back up.

name: Anuntean
summary: Anuntean is a professor warped into a hulking being of stone and space dust by a mishap on an orbital mission. Anuntean lashes out with confused fury until his friends coax him back to human shape.

feats.scene: Anuntean swings a rocky arm and shatters a launch tower at the base.
Anuntean stands through a barrage of rockets from a rescue team and barely chips.

name: Rerroam
summary: Rerroam is a gadget-minded vigilante from the bush country who swapped a rustic outfit for a jetpack and a pulse pistol and grew steadily more brutal. Rerroam's story ends when a masked rival steals the costume.

feats.scene: Rerroam fires a pulse pistol through an engine block in a quiet garage.
Rerroam crashes through a skylight with the jetpack sputtering and keeps going.

name: Rauil
summary: Rauil is a masked bush-country vigilante who joined a worldwide band of imitators. Nothing more is recorded, so Rauil stays a rumor with a cape and a good boomerang arm.

feats.scene: Rauil flings a heavy boomerang that ricochets off a lamp post and knocks a thief flat.
Rauil is tossed down an embankment and rolls up to his feet.

name: Cesria
summary: Cesria is a fiancé-bound lab scientist who can shrink to a speck or swell back to full height at will. Cesria pairs a sharp mind with a punch that lands harder than its owner's size suggests.

feats.scene: Cesria swells mid-swing and drives a fist through a reinforced door.
Cesria shrugs off a falling shelf of lab equipment while shrunk to a pebble.

source_title: Raymond Palmer (The Brave and the Bold)

name: Rnesici
summary: Rnesici is a mild lecturer who teaches physics to a lecture hall of sleepy students. Rnesici has no gifts beyond a patient manner and a stubborn memory for formulas.

feats.scene: Rnesici slaps a heavy textbook onto the desk to wake the back row.
Rnesici tumbles down a flight of lecture-hall steps and stands up with a bruise.

name: Nineru
summary: Nineru is a reporter reshaped by a failed weapon into a being that drinks sunlight and spends it as flight and blinding beams. Nineru fights for the powerless with stored daylight.

feats.scene: Nineru unloads a day's stored sunlight in one white beam that razes a warehouse.
Nineru bathes in a blast of concentrated glare and walks out unburnt.
Nineru streaks across a skyline as a trail of glowing vapour.

name: Tunan
summary: Tunan is a teenage student who skims the rooftops of a campus city between classes. Tunan flies well but has never fought anything bigger than a gym bully.

feats.scene: Tunan dives into a vending machine and dents it badly.
Tunan crashes through a hedge during flight practice and brushes off the scrapes.
Tunan races a school bus along the avenue and wins.

name: Colnuan
summary: Colnuan is a ruthless government operative who bends radiance into blinding bursts and cares only for personal escape. Colnuan trusts nobody and bolts at the first gap in a wall.

feats.scene: Colnuan flares a burst of white radiance that blinds a rival and scorches the floor.
Colnuan slams into an energy barrier at full speed and drops to the ground stunned but intact.

name: Osantna
summary: Osantna is a grim soldier from a possible future who feeds on daylight and turns violent and fascist. Osantna flies on stored radiance and fires it in punishing rays.

feats.scene: Osantna focuses a hoarded afternoon of sunshine into a ray that melts a tank column.
Osantna absorbs a full volley of flashes and glows brighter for it.

name: Tirllotil
summary: Tirllotil is a loyal feathered lawman who inherits a power ring when its previous bearer falls. Tirllotil conjures hard-light constructs and flies sector patrols with a rebel's conscience.

feats.scene: Tirllotil hammers a siege engine flat with a green construct the size of a barn.
Tirllotil raises a ring shield against an artillery barrage and holds.
Tirllotil speeds between two moons in a single sleepless night.

name: Siaul
summary: Siaul is a terrorist and reluctant squad leader whose hands spawn a burning scimitar. Siaul slices open doorways between rooms and spits roaring infernos from the blade.

feats.scene: Siaul swings the flaming scimitar and a wave of fire engulfs a prison courtyard.
Siaul takes a point-blank volley of rifle fire and stays on his feet.

name: Iumiute
summary: Iumiute is a ranting armored crusader who thinks people deserve a future of violence. Iumiute hurls razor shards and shrugs off hits that would flatten a mortal.

feats.scene: Iumiute fires a spray of metal slivers that shreds a row of parked cars.
Iumiute walks through a collapsing stage wall without a scratch.

name: Ornes
summary: Ornes is a bred killer with the gift of making anything vanish from sight. Ornes works for a dark matriarch and hunts siblings by sending unseen operatives ahead.

feats.scene: Ornes vanishes a whole squad of guards and strikes from the blank air.
Ornes absorbs a crushing tackle from a trained soldier and rolls away.

name: Liiasnel
summary: Liiasnel is a towering hired wrecker clad in a suit so slick that nothing grips it. Liiasnel flings razor discs that cut through almost anything and climbs with spiked gloves.

feats.scene: Liiasnel hurls a spinning disc that slices a steel girder in two.
Liiasnel lets a speeding lorry glance off the greased suit and keeps walking.
