name: Nente
summary: Nente is a pale alien warrior who has worn rings of three different colours and still fights with a drifter's grudge. Nente builds weapons from will and flies where the fight leads.

feats.scene: Nente forges a blazing red lance and spears an attack ship out of the sky.
Nente raises a ring shield against a planet-side bombardment and stands unmoved.
Nente crosses a battlefield in a lone blue streak.

name: Iuarleo
summary: Iuarleo is a laboratory test subject released from a warehouse who cuts at foes with unseen mental blades. Iuarleo has little control and slashes first, asking questions never.

feats.scene: Iuarleo slices through a steel door with an invisible force.
Iuarleo is hurled across a corridor and rises with a split lip.

name: Naustisi
summary: Naustisi is a petty crook who annoys a hotline of local do-gooders. Naustisi has no special gifts and relies on bluster and a quick exit.

feats.scene: Naustisi swings a crowbar at a shop window.
Naustisi falls from a fire escape onto a pile of rubbish bags.

name: Ulnelval
summary: Ulnelval is a blue-haired hired knife with talons nothing seems able to chip. Ulnelval fights in a pack of assassins and falls to bad luck before bad technique.

feats.scene: Ulnelval rakes his talons across a brick wall and leaves deep grooves.
Ulnelval is pinned beneath a toppled stone cross and is knocked out of the fight.

name: Tornumlis
summary: Tornumlis is a girl who accepted a stranger's bargain for strength and flattened her own town by accident. Tornumlis wears a hide like iron and begs for an end that never comes.

feats.scene: Tornumlis loses control and levels every street of a small town in one howl.
Tornumlis stands unharmed in the heart of a fiery blast.

name: Monnaamo
summary: Monnaamo is an orange-skinned mind thief from a distant planet who plots to steal every shred of known wisdom. Monnaamo drifts above the ground and reads thoughts from across a room.

feats.scene: Monnaamo rattles a guard's skull with a mental jolt that drops him cold.
Monnaamo is dropped by a stun baton and shakes it off within a minute.

name: Onenel
summary: Onenel is a masked scythe-carrying nuisance who prowls the margins of an old pulp city. Onenel has no known gifts and leaves little trace.

feats.scene: Onenel swings a cane at a lamppost in frustration.
Onenel is flung through a hedge and limps away.

name: Tecoror
summary: Tecoror is a hateful blond thug with a rifle and a loud mouth who runs with a band of bigots. Tecoror shoots well but falls to the first person who stands up to him.

feats.scene: Tecoror fires a rifle round that punches through a thin door.
Tecoror takes a heavy blow to the jaw and drops.

name: Tasneria
summary: Tasneria is a hired fighter whose palms summon and steer great volumes of water. Tasneria nearly drowns a rival in a flood of her own making before being subdued.

feats.scene: Tasneria flings a surge of water that bowls a truck onto its side.
Tasneria is slammed by a crackling bolt and collapses but keeps breathing.

name: Ntutite
summary: Ntutite is a schoolgirl who grows leathery wings and claws after taking a serum, and flies from nightmares she cannot name. Ntutite is nimble but lightly built.

feats.scene: Ntutite rakes her claws down a wooden fence and splinters it.
Ntutite is knocked from a rooftop and glides to a rough landing.
Ntutite glides over a canal faster than a sprinting rider.

name: Corcol
summary: Corcol is a red-haired coder who rose from poverty to lead a network of hackers and dreams of tearing a rich city down. Corcol hides behind a mask and a crew that thinks they are all equals.

feats.scene: Corcol overloads a power relay with a keystroke and blows its casing.
Corcol tumbles off a rooftop ledge onto a fire escape and keeps running.

name: Nelll
summary: Nelll is a fused being made of three minds who flies, and who can summon a ghostly attacker. Nelll breaks the usual rules of matter and fights beside a team of oddballs.

feats.scene: Nelll calls up a ghostly twin that tears a gantry from its bolts.
Nelll walks out of a collapsing brick street unmarked.

name: Llesan
summary: Llesan is a hard-bitten bomber pilot who rose to captain a band of hired spacefarers. Llesan grows crueler with each contract and fights with whatever blade is closest.

feats.scene: Llesan swings a boarding axe through a cabin bulkhead.
Llesan takes a rifle butt to the ribs and keeps flying the ship.

name: Iutiuli
summary: Iutiuli is a mechanical copy-machine that soaks up the abilities of every hero it fights. Iutiuli wears its makers' stolen strengths all at once and wages war on a whole league.

feats.scene: Iutiuli fires a copied blast that flattens a row of towers.
Iutiuli stays upright after a stacked volley of heroes' attacks.

name: Liatilli
summary: Liatilli is a cold-eyed arms dealer who fights hand to hand and sets lethal traps. Liatilli is loved by no one and survives by cunning, leaving her prey among wild beasts.

feats.scene: Liatilli spins into a kick that cracks a crate in half.
Liatilli withstands a crushing fall from a gantry and gets up.

name: Teanuca
summary: Teanuca is a red-haired bounty hunter who builds her own dart launchers. Teanuca fires blasting, stunning, and blinding darts at whoever carries a price.

feats.scene: Teanuca lands an explosive dart that bursts a parked van's door off.
Teanuca is thrown across a bar and sits up laughing.

name: Ntillullu
summary: Ntillullu is a manufactured copy of a famed flier, raised by hostile strangers to hate her original. Ntillullu flies, hits like an avalanche, and has a body that turns away bullets and blasts.

feats.scene: Ntillullu punches through a government building and the walls fold inward.
Ntillullu stands in a rain of heavy ordnance and shakes dust from her cape.
Ntillullu crosses an ocean before anyone reports her takeoff.

name: Nastu
summary: Nastu is a rumoured killer from a far tomorrow, known only through boasts and stories. Nastu has no verified feats and exists mostly as a whisper.

feats.scene: Nastu swings a blade at a shadow in a derelict hall.
Nastu staggers away from a heavy fall and vanishes into the dark.

name: Amtean
summary: Amtean is a skull-faced genius who traps knights in deadly gadgets and fights magic with machines. Amtean sought underworld power after society turned him away.

feats.scene: Amtean springs a spiked pit trap beneath a corridor floor.
Amtean survives a long fall from a ceiling hatch.

name: Tiatont
summary: Tiatont is a sharpshooting hired killer who stalks his targets like big game. Tiatont takes a rich contract, fails it, and sprints off a ledge rather than be captured.

feats.scene: Tiatont lands a rifle shot from a quarter mile away.
Tiatont tumbles down a steep slope and keeps moving.

name: Orsilsa
summary: Orsilsa is a hooded mob criminal who dies in a string of street killings. Orsilsa has no known abilities and plays no part in what happens next.

feats.scene: Orsilsa shoves a clerk against a counter.
Orsilsa is flung through a shop window and cut by the glass.

source_title: Red Hood (Dark Multiverse: The Grim Knight)

name: Oreiuson
summary: Oreiuson is a cheerful costumed hero from a mirror-world, scarred by a chemical bath but not broken. Oreiuson tries to rally an upended roster of heroes and thanks any ally who helps.

feats.scene: Oreiuson throws a wild punch that connects with a gang member's jaw.
Oreiuson shrugs off a bath of acid vat spray and grins.

source_title: Red Hood (The Brave and the Bold: Deep Cover for Batman!)

name: Lorllnia
summary: Lorllnia is a mannered immortal who feeds on agony and keeps its victims as pinned butterflies in a castle outside space. Lorllnia spares one boy for the pleasure of his pain.

feats.scene: Lorllnia crushes a carriage in one hand while smiling.
Lorllnia steps away from a blast that levels a lodging house.

name: Iunita
summary: Iunita is a professional thief who slips unseen through crowded rooms. Iunita works with a crew of lawbreakers and keeps out of sight when trouble arrives.

feats.scene: Iunita snatches a purse from a vault guard's hand.
Iunita is tossed over a counter and bounces up unharmed.

name: Setessar
summary: Setessar is a red-haired sergeant who leads guerrillas against an occupying army. Setessar fights on a patrol boat and helps sink three enemy undersea craft.

feats.scene: Setessar lobs depth charges from a patrol boat and sinks an enemy submarine.
Setessar takes a rifle butt to the head and keeps leading the raid.

name: Stllre
summary: Stllre is a helmeted soldier in a heavy suit who fights for a hateful cause. Stllre trades speed for armour and marches into every fight at a walk.

feats.scene: Stllre swings an armoured fist into a barricade of crates.
Stllre takes a burst of machine-gun fire on the breastplate.

source_title: Red Panzer (The Legend of Wonder Woman)

name: Irson
summary: Irson is a masked veteran of a vile cause who wears a stolen suit of power armour. Irson dies in his first showing and leaves a son to inherit the mess.

feats.scene: Irson clamps a gauntlet around a railing and wrenches it loose.
Irson stands against a volley of pistol rounds without a dent.

name: Ststisi
summary: Ststisi is a scarred terrorist who was raised in hatred and then hid his own heritage in shame. Ststisi wears his father's armour and has one limb missing.

feats.scene: Ststisi swings an armoured arm and caves in a wooden door.
Ststisi shrugs off a cluster of handgun rounds.

name: Rastaanu
summary: Rastaanu is a gang boss who loots the docks with a loyal crew. Rastaanu is arrested after one mistake and has no unnatural gifts.

feats.scene: Rastaanu clubs a night watchman with a pipe.
Rastaanu is bowled over by a charging rival and gets back up.

name: Luaueor
summary: Luaueor is a red-haired character stepped out of an old folk tale and into a modern village. Luaueor wears a hood and carries nothing but a basket and quick wits.

feats.scene: Luaueor swings a basket at a wolf's snout.
Luaueor stumbles down a wooded slope and stands up laughing.

name: Tunanrau
summary: Tunanrau is a legendary demigod champion of a mountain tribe, born of a sun deity and joined to his twin by an unbreakable bond. Tunanrau carries a flame in his chest that calls two peoples to follow him.

feats.scene: Tunanrau unleashes the flame from his chest and incinerates a sky-borne beast.
Tunanrau stands in a rain of burning stone and the shield of his sister's soul holds.

name: Cerisun
summary: Cerisun is an obsessive hunter in borrowed ritual dress who hopes to cleanse a nation by killing a mythical bird. Cerisun can project his spirit away from his body and has an uncanny sense of taste.

feats.scene: Cerisun fires a hunting rifle and cracks a boulder in two.
Cerisun is thrown against a tree trunk and wheezes back to his feet.

name: Coltireo
summary: Coltireo is an android hero with a body built to command the wind. Coltireo spins up gales and is destroyed in a scheme by a fallen friend.

feats.scene: Coltireo spins a funnel of wind that tears a roof from a warehouse.
Coltireo stands unmoved in a gale of shrapnel before the final blow.

name: Ntreoran
summary: Ntreoran is a dream-born android hero imagined by a grieving man, with a body that stirs the air into storms. Ntreoran exists only in a vision of a kinder world.

feats.scene: Ntreoran conjures a twister that hurls a convoy off a highway.
Ntreoran takes a shell on the chest plate and the casing barely scorches.

name: Rerialar
summary: Rerialar is a naval android who believes he is a human engineer and steers seawater in great sweeps. Rerialar is built by a scheming inventor and shut down when his loneliness spoils the plan.

feats.scene: Rerialar raises a wall of seawater and hurls it over a coastal battery.
Rerialar walks out of a depth-charge blast with dented plating.

name: Rumor
summary: Rumor is a robot heroine built to be a weapon who instead protects a distant city and houses a living water spirit. Rumor nearly kills her maker before a sibling calms her.

feats.scene: Rumor rips a column of seawater upward and smashes a fighter jet from the sky.
Rumor lies crushed by deep ocean pressure and still sends a signal.

name: Auesnte
summary: Auesnte is a synthetic man built to betray a team, then possessed by an air spirit and turned to good. Auesnte survives blows that would kill a mortal and commands the breeze around him.

feats.scene: Auesnte whips a column of air that overturns a bus.
Auesnte absorbs a collapsing wall and flexes his repaired frame.

name: Luenullu
summary: Luenullu is a hired agent from a foreign state who menaces a family of heroes. Luenullu has no special gifts and relies on cunning and an angry glare.

feats.scene: Luenullu swings a rifle butt into a guard's shield.
Luenullu is thrown from a truck bed and rolls to his feet.

name: Rnutelle
summary: Rnutelle is a colossal sleeper hidden inside a burning tidal wave, who wakes when the flames freeze and terrorizes a coastline. Rnutelle shrugs off poisons and bombs and finally drifts harmlessly around a star.

feats.scene: Rnutelle wades ashore and stamps flat a whole harbour district.
Rnutelle sits unharmed at the heart of a thermonuclear flash.

name: Llivatan
summary: Llivatan is a parasitic organism that infects living creatures and spreads between planets. Llivatan flies, tears through armour, speaks into minds, and is not easily killed until a sun swallows it.

feats.scene: Llivatan sheds a wave of crimson energy that turns a whole crew into hosts.
Llivatan is carried into a star's glare before it finally stops moving.

name: Rusll
summary: Rusll is a spy from a dark sibling world who passes news to an agent undercover on the bright one. Rusll dies at the hands of an unseen killer while relaying a secret.

feats.scene: Rusll blasts a sentry with a small handheld weapon.
Rusll is knocked off a platform and keeps transmitting.

name: Lloseosau
summary: Lloseosau is a wartime hero who leads a band of heroes inside a fake city for decades and later fights a monster to the death. Lloseosau hands out decoder rings and believes people can do better.

feats.scene: Lloseosau drives a bulldozer-sized boulder onto a snarling monster.
Lloseosau stands on an ice shelf as a fighter blows apart beside him.

name: Nialluori
summary: Nialluori is an enforcer in power armour who holds a grudge against a vigilante and carries a rotary blade. Nialluori loses an eye and then his life when his own gun backfires.

feats.scene: Nialluori slams a gauntlet into a car door and folds it in half.
Nialluori crashes through a window and stands up with a limp.

name: Striame
summary: Striame is a retired crime-fighter who once rode with a partner in a gaudy car. Striame is a spoof of a famous masked driver and fights bare-handed.

feats.scene: Striame lands a bone-rattling uppercut on a mugger.
Striame takes a rap on the head from a lamp and stays standing.

name: Ratoora
summary: Ratoora is a blue-skinned elder with a white mane who sits among a council of cosmic judges. Ratoora falls in the first act of a great war.

feats.scene: Ratoora holds a glowing hand over a ruined moon and the rubble rises.
Ratoora braces against a rush of heat before the end.

name: Seninesi
summary: Seninesi is a shapeshifter who infiltrates a rival force in the guise of one of its own. Seninesi digs graves with a straight face and plots the downfall of tyrants.

feats.scene: Seninesi swings a shovel in the shape of a bigger fighter.
Seninesi tumbles down a crater wall and rises in a new face.

name: Rilcorone
summary: Rilcorone is an antennaed youth who bends his shape to any form and wears a ring that lifts him into the air. Rilcorone is an adventurer in a future century.

feats.scene: Rilcorone turns his arm into a ram and bowls over a dock guard.
Rilcorone reshapes his chest into a dense plate to blunt a stun blast.

name: Vestire
summary: Vestire is a bald shapeshifter with pointed ears who joins a team of young heroes in a far-off century. Vestire hides his gift and keeps a low profile.

feats.scene: Vestire shifts a fist into a mallet and breaks a lock.
Vestire reforms from a flattened shape after a crash.

name: Iumcorll
summary: Iumcorll is a younger duplicate of a shapeshifting hero who flies with a ring and lives at a team base. Iumcorll comes from a time-twisted copy of a bygone roster.

feats.scene: Iumcorll becomes a bull and charges a bulkhead.
Iumcorll hardens his skin against a flailing robot arm.

name: Tuserle
summary: Tuserle is a red-feathered ring-bearer from a nesting people who falls in a duel of honour and passes the ring to his killer. Tuserle patrols a sector with a calm and feathery pride.

feats.scene: Tuserle shapes a green talon and tears a patrol cruiser in two.
Tuserle holds his ring shield against a missile volley.

name: Racelleo
summary: Racelleo is a baker's dream in disguise: a blonde shop heiress who wants to make hand-made chocolates and not sell cars. Racelleo is brainwashed into villainy and then happily gives up the grudge.

feats.scene: Racelleo hurls a tray of cooling truffles at an intruder.
Racelleo tumbles off a stack of tyres and giggles.

name: Tilna
summary: Tilna is a polished socialite and company executive who dies when a masked pair storm her workplace. Tilna has no gifts apart from a head for business.

feats.scene: Tilna slaps a ledger onto a boardroom table.
Tilna is shoved into a desk and stays on her feet.

name: Terana
summary: Terana is a rancher who dresses like his ancestor and robs stagecoaches on horseback. Terana is a fine swordsman and rider who is finally caught by a young officer.

feats.scene: Terana slashes a saddle strap in half with a rapier.
Terana is thrown from his horse and stands up dusty.

name: Erntinu
summary: Erntinu is a blond man raised on a distant world where weak gravity makes him a marvel. Erntinu flies, lifts, runs and cannot be hurt, and works by day as a television host.

feats.scene: Erntinu hurls a boulder through a tall glass tower.
Erntinu takes a collapsing glass tower on his shoulders and shakes off the dust.
Erntinu races over a plain in a breath.

name: Tanson
summary: Tanson is a bald hired killer whose skin is coated in a living alloy that traps anyone he touches in statue form. Tanson has one weak spot and is consumed by a blast.

feats.scene: Tanson grabs a rival and turns him into lifeless metal.
Tanson is swallowed by a blast and nearly walks out.

name: Ntinin
summary: Ntinin is a conquering weapon bred on a lost world, wielding dark powers from a limitless source. Ntinin raised a fortress in the desert and nearly broke a champion.

feats.scene: Ntinin shatters a continental shelf in one furious blow.
Ntinin stands through a stack of mountain-sized strikes and does not slow.

name: Sanumam
summary: Sanumam is a red-haired war machine created long ago by a regretful maker, who storms a great city and fights on until her purpose is clear. Sanumam burns for conquest.

feats.scene: Sanumam brings a skyscraper district crashing down with a single swing.
Sanumam stands up through a wall of falling bridges and sneers.

name: Numler
summary: Numler is a respectable attorney who wears a rubber mask and cloak to extort and murder his clients. Numler is surprisingly stealthy and carries a knife.

feats.scene: Numler stabs a knife into a cushion in frustration.
Numler leaps a fence in the dark and hits the pavement hard.

name: Telseter
summary: Telseter is a lab intern who breathes in spores from a dead monster and warps into something fearsome. Telseter grows gigantic strength and a hide that turns blades.

feats.scene: Telseter flattens a city block's parked cars with a stamp.
Telseter takes a rocket volley on the chest and keeps lumbering.

name: Ontmonco
summary: Ontmonco is a yellow-skinned being with white eyes who lives at the edge of creation. Ontmonco hoards a ring and offers a hero shelter inside an ancient barrier.

feats.scene: Ontmonco snuffs out a distant colony's sun-lit shell in one gesture.
Ontmonco is wrapped by a collapsing wall of energy and stays whole.

name: Tesont
summary: Tesont is a dark-haired aide who works with a partner for a mutated shark man. Tesont disappears when the boss is killed.

feats.scene: Tesont drops a crate of diving gear onto a dock.
Tesont is tipped off a pier and swims to safety.

name: Selan
summary: Selan is a red-eyed criminal who conjures lifelike illusions and fires bursts from his chest. Selan trades blows with a skull-faced brute and hides in the sewers.

feats.scene: Selan blasts a burst of energy from his chest that tears an iron grate loose.
Selan takes a point-blank explosion and a flung car without losing his head.

name: Tesas
summary: Tesas is a queen of a gem-wielding sisterhood who lands among villains, takes a mundane job, and is later mind-wiped. Tesas fights for a stolen jewel and a quiet life.

feats.scene: Tesas hurls a jewel-lit pulse that collapses an aircraft hangar roof.
Tesas stays upright after a heavy explosion rocks her hangar.

name: Olora
summary: Olora is a white-haired shapeshifting billionaire who hides his true nature behind a human name. Olora funds a youth team and mourns a wife long gone.

feats.scene: Olora reshapes his arm into a ram and breaks a window frame.
Olora spreads his body out to absorb a falling beam.

name: Eltor
summary: Eltor is a black-haired warrior woman trained in archery, riding, and blades. Eltor invades a foreign city alongside her sisters and carries an old goddess's gifts.

feats.scene: Eltor sends an arrow through a car door.
Eltor takes a fall from a horse onto cobblestones and keeps fighting.

name: Telelora
summary: Telelora is a black-haired hired killer who serves a shadowy council. Telelora has no known abilities and fails against a masked rival.

feats.scene: Telelora fires a pistol round through a window.
Telelora is shoved down a stair and winces.

name: Raurnnal
summary: Raurnnal is a divorced mother who lives with a rough past and a hard-bitten ex-husband. Raurnnal has no abilities but is brave in a crisis.

feats.scene: Raurnnal slaps a counter in frustration.
Raurnnal falls from a kerb in a scuffle and climbs back up.

name: Neoiuta
summary: Neoiuta is a detective who arrests a tycoon after a kidnapping scheme collapses. Neoiuta has no gifts beyond patience and a good eye.

feats.scene: Neoiuta cuffs a tycoon and shoves him into a patrol car.
Neoiuta tumbles over a hood during a chase and rolls up.

name: Ranto
summary: Ranto is a police detective who works a case that starts with a radio show. Ranto has no powers and solves the problem with tact.

feats.scene: Ranto flings a file at a suspect's desk.
Ranto slips on a stair and catches the rail.

name: Liavaste
summary: Liavaste is a bratty nephew who moves in with a nervous relative and makes everyone's day worse. Liavaste has no gifts beyond mischief.

feats.scene: Liavaste lobs a water balloon at a passing hero's cape.
Liavaste is dumped off a ladder and giggles.

name: Tecorva
summary: Tecorva is a young alien who can eat almost anything and resents a famous sibling. Tecorva plants a trick transmitter to frame a brother and quickly regrets it.

feats.scene: Tecorva chews through a steel chain in one sitting.
Tecorva swallows a tray of scrap and shrugs off the stomach ache.

name: Iuson
summary: Iuson is a patriotic soldier hiding strength from a distant world, who murders a colleague and gasses a champion with a poison. Iuson serves a corrupt boss and dies in a brawl.

feats.scene: Iuson wrenches a steel vault door off its hinges.
Iuson shrugs off a clip of rifle bullets in a bunker.

name: Siaronolu
summary: Siaronolu is a fugitive ally of a lone wanderer, living with a heart that turns radiation into a shield. Siaronolu belongs to a band of glowing outcasts in a ruined world.

feats.scene: Siaronolu shoves a rusted bulkhead off its rails.
Siaronolu steps through a fallout storm and glows brighter.

name: Tiuvalra
summary: Tiuvalra is a black-haired shapeshifting tycoon who bankrolls a team of young heroes. Tiuvalra hides a secret nature and has little interest in a fight.

feats.scene: Tiuvalra reshapes his hand into a mallet and cracks a lock.
Tiuvalra flows past a falling crate.

source_title: René Jacques Brande (Legion of Super-Heroes TV Series)

name: Ilerno
summary: Ilerno is a sneak-thief who escapes a prison cell and joins a crime crew. Ilerno smells a power battery through solid rock and snatches a ring from a hand in an instant.

feats.scene: Ilerno snatches a ring off a fighter's finger before he can blink.
Ilerno rolls out of a rope trap and sprints off.
Ilerno outruns a pursuit car on a desert road.

name: Auvalnau
summary: Auvalnau is a blond assassin who sends copies of himself against his targets. Auvalnau sticks to a strange code and keeps his home base a mystery.

feats.scene: Auvalnau fires a pistol and a copy fires from the other side.
Auvalnau takes a hard fall in a paper warehouse.

name: Ninta
summary: Ninta is a young burglar who can make copies of himself if he stays focused. Ninta commits small crimes and loses his focus to a buzzing noise.

feats.scene: Ninta shoves a drawer shut with a duplicate's help.
Ninta stumbles down an alley stair and checks his pockets.

name: Ntiumcor
summary: Ntiumcor is a blond sportsman who pushes and pulls with magnetic force. Ntiumcor works for a bossy tycoon and was once a champion at a ball game.

feats.scene: Ntiumcor flings a rack of steel girders across a yard.
Ntiumcor is dropped by a heavy tackle and gets up.

name: Rauasva
summary: Rauasva is a bald, grey-eyed minion serving a space tyrant. Rauasva has no known gifts and gets lost in a bigger plot.

feats.scene: Rauasva raises a heavy stun rod over a prisoner.
Rauasva is knocked flat and gets up slowly.

name: Ntsaulli
summary: Ntsaulli is a quiet loner from the frontier days who rides with a team nobody dares to question. Ntsaulli keeps a sullen distance and fights with grim calm.

feats.scene: Ntsaulli swings a war club into a post.
Ntsaulli is thrown off a saddle and rises unbothered.

name: Nintau
summary: Nintau is a cheerful young dreamer who sketches an elaborate hero costume for a fan contest and wins a day beside real champions. Nintau has no powers at all, only nerve and a costume made of stitched hope.

feats.scene: Nintau throws a wild, untrained punch at a masked intruder who stands calmly in the doorway.
Nintau takes a heavy blow to the ribs from a trained killer and drops without a sound.

name: Amreo
summary: Amreo is a rumpled talent scout and hopeful promoter who has chased one big break for years and never caught it. Amreo means well, cuts corners, and keeps pushing a teenage prodigy and a doting daughter toward the spotlight.

feats.scene: Amreo slaps a contract onto a table so hard that the coffee cups jump.
Amreo takes a surprise punch to the jaw from an angry photographer and stays upright out of pride.

name: Sanrilamo
summary: Sanrilamo is a night guard whose body was twisted by a chemical trap into a hulking, shifting mass. Sanrilamo learns to steady the change and haunts an abandoned church, scaring off thugs with a rumoured clay protector.

feats.scene: Sanrilamo drives a fist of hardened stone through a van door and into the engine block.
Sanrilamo walks through a rain of gunfire from a gang and wipes the dust from his shoulder.

name: Lurnill
summary: Lurnill lives in constant pain from a body that rewrites each of its elements on command, and has simply learned to bear it. Lurnill can stretch limbs, turn skin into other substances, and use the whole body as a living reagent.

feats.scene: Lurnill turns an arm into dense metal and flattens a steel door like foil.
Lurnill endures a burning acid flood by turning his skin to glass and waiting for it to pass.

name: Toorlu
summary: Toorlu is a living chemistry set who guards a drowned prison for a strongman regime. Toorlu burns, hardens, thins, and reshapes the body at will, but a mass jailbreak brings the whole cell block down on top of the warden.

feats.scene: Toorlu vents a roaring jet of flame down a flooded corridor and boils the water to steam.
Toorlu hardens his skin until a drawn blade snaps into pieces against his chest.

name: Neollilia
summary: Neollilia is a bald, pale metahuman who serves a government agency alongside other gifted misfits. Little is known of Neollilia beyond a loyal role in a small team and a single mission.

feats.scene: Neollilia caves in the side of a parked armoured truck during a training run.
Neollilia stands unharmed in the middle of a vehicle collision staged by the agency.

name: Iumtont
summary: Iumtont is a brown-haired fighter who lends a hand to a society of costumed veterans in a time-hopping fight against old foes. Iumtont dies in the line of duty after an honourable run with the group.

feats.scene: Iumtont lands a hard right hook on a thug in a rooftop scuffle.
Iumtont is hit by a heavy blast and falls, never to rise again.

name: Neoorar
summary: Neoorar is a wealthy man who puts on a mask in the cold years of a long standoff and fights street crime for the sheer decency of it. Neoorar fakes his own death after a deadly chase and later sits in a secret internment camp.

feats.scene: Neoorar flattens an armed robber with a single swing during a nighttime pursuit.
Neoorar survives a police chase that ends with a rusted rail giving way beneath the pursuers.

name: Erueruoro
summary: Erueruoro is a soldier in a wartime secret operation who swallows a performance tonic that adds strength, speed and a few inches of height. Erueruoro fights behind enemy lines in the mask of a clock.

feats.scene: Erueruoro hoists a field gun over his head and slams it down on a tank hatch.
Erueruoro shrugs off a shell burst that shreds a stone wall beside him.
Erueruoro sprints through a burning courtyard faster than the guards can aim.

name: Rnnusela
summary: Rnnusela is a cold queen of a warlike alien people whose blood holds a poison deadly to certain visitors. Rnnusela leaps tall walls, outmuscles armies, and fences with practised cruelty.

feats.scene: Rnnusela hurls a stone throne across the hall and shatters a column of the palace.
Rnnusela is struck by a falling pillar and steps out of the dust without a mark.
Rnnusela crosses a battlefield in a heartbeat to reach a rival commander.

name: Riere
summary: Riere is an ancient earth goddess of fertility, comfort and protection who hid a newborn son from a devouring husband. Riere is overthrown with her kin, imprisoned beneath the world, and later dwells on a broken fragment of moon.

feats.scene: Riere makes a mountainside split open and bear a field of wheat in a single night.
Riere is bound under the earth by the new gods and endures ages of weight without dying.

name: Torsorsor
summary: Torsorsor is a newborn whose heart was mended from the inside by a shrunken parent, who also quietly rewrote her blood so that she could one day grow gifts of her own. Torsorsor is an ordinary child for now.

feats.scene: Torsorsor kicks her blanket off the crib with a tiny foot.
Torsorsor survives a risky operation performed in the dark of a snowed-in hospital.

name: Natil
summary: Natil is a red-haired woman with a pull on iron and charge, once part of a team of outcasts before her mind frayed. Natil now lingers in a dreamed haven built by a kindly keeper.

feats.scene: Natil drags a rack of steel girders across a garage floor with a wave of her hand.
Natil is thrown against a wall in a panic and rises without a bruise.

name: Vareeo
summary: Vareeo is an orphan caught in an atomic blast who gains command over the whole electromagnetic band, plus strength, toughness and agility. Vareeo is inexperienced, harried by military doctors, and later changes into a wholly new form.

feats.scene: Vareeo drives a pulse of raw current through a radio tower and blacks out an entire district.
Vareeo is caught in the heart of a laboratory detonation and walks out singed but whole.

name: Lovatia
summary: Lovatia is a red-haired member of a team of misfits that includes a thinking brick and a floating chief. Lovatia handles magnetic pulls in a small fight and takes part in a single-issue adventure.

feats.scene: Lovatia flings a cart of scrap iron at a charging brute.
Lovatia is thrown clear of a blast and picks herself up unharmed.

name: Tonno
summary: Tonno is a trainee at a school for young heroes who has unusually sharp eyes. Tonno has no other talents of note and spends most of the time practising for a graduation that may never come.

feats.scene: Tonno tosses a practice ball and hits the target at a hundred paces.
Tonno takes a hard fall from a training wall and walks off sore.

name: Rauliu
summary: Rauliu is the black-haired leader of a team of rescued princes and princesses, who breaks with a warlord parent and jumps through space in a blink. Rauliu wears winged armour and borrows her friends' gifts to fly and speak across distance.

feats.scene: Rauliu leaps through a crack in the air and hurls a rescued prince clear of a collapsing citadel.
Rauliu rides out a bombardment of her mother's warship inside her powered armour.

name: Sernasan
summary: Sernasan is a loyal guard of a distant queen and a regent. Sernasan helps rescue the queen from a parasite and stands watch as a heartsick ruler tries to break the planetary shield.

feats.scene: Sernasan fires a rifle burst that brings down a charging beast in a palace hall.
Sernasan is knocked off his feet by a shield burst and stands again.

name: Risasral
summary: Risasral is a florist by day and a ruthless vigilante by night, split into a gentle self and a furious one after a grim childhood. Risasral learned fighting from a murdered father and cuts down criminals with cold skill.

feats.scene: Risasral breaks a gunman's wrist and the plank wall behind him in one spin.
Risasral keeps fighting through a beating from three armed men in a dark alley.

name: Resrini
summary: Resrini is a black-haired warrior from a mountain order sworn against a tyrant, who risks her own plans to save a stranger. Resrini later joins a team of seasoned heroes.

feats.scene: Resrini cleaves through a wooden gate with a single sweep of her blade.
Resrini holds a narrow bridge against a squad of guards and takes a spear on her shield.

name: Llmiairn
summary: Llmiairn is a gentle masseur who follows a living street across the stars, and later heals the residents of a beach with a magical jelly and a practised touch. Llmiairn was scattered across the universe and then reformed in a new role.

feats.scene: Llmiairn presses a glowing salve into a stranger's back and closes a deep gash.
Llmiairn is torn apart by a broken reality and reassembles from drifting motes.

name: Oritiran
summary: Oritiran is a brown-eyed crime boss raised in a hard orphanage, who trained himself in fighting and built a street empire out of a stolen drug. Oritiran refuses mercy and ends his career in a duel.

feats.scene: Oritiran drives a boosted fist through a door and drops the guard behind it.
Oritiran shrugs off a bar stool across the head and a chain on the ribs.

name: Titis
summary: Titis is a bald villain who exists only because a street dreamed him into being from a story. Titis seizes a galactic company, farms the dreamer for pain, and dies when a young woman he never knew turns against him.

feats.scene: Titis flattens a row of tenement fronts with a sweep of a weapon from his company.
Titis walks through a barrage of laser fire and keeps talking.

name: Vanummi
summary: Vanummi is a quiet priest with a brother and a gentle faith, who ministers to hard cases and meets a bad end at the hands of a deal with something terrible. Vanummi has only prayer and patience.

feats.scene: Vanummi pushes a heavy church door shut against a draught.
Vanummi takes a punch from a frightened convict and forgives him on the spot.

name: Osnus
summary: Osnus is a bank director who takes a bribe from a crime boss, then thinks better of it and resigns. Osnus plans to flee abroad with his wife but is gunned down outside a theatre before he can leave.

feats.scene: Osnus slams a ledger shut and slides it across his desk at a visitor.
Osnus is hit by gunfire from a passing car and falls on the pavement.

name: Siavarnte
summary: Siavarnte is a veteran pilot who trained a younger flier, retired to a desk job, and stole one last flight in a sun-powered jet. Siavarnte brings the damaged plane down on the desert and dies at the controls.

feats.scene: Siavarnte throws a hasty punch at a younger pilot and lays him out.
Siavarnte endures a rough crash landing on baked sand with his hand still on the stick.

name: Sasiater
summary: Sasiater is a blond former actor who turned to piracy in the dark between stars, and leads a crew with theatrical flair. Sasiater uses acting and bluster as much as steel.

feats.scene: Sasiater swings a cutlass in a showy arc and parts a thick rope.
Sasiater takes a boarding party's blow on the arm and laughs it off for the crowd.

name: Naamoosa
summary: Naamoosa is a fighter pilot and veteran commander who leads a unit of convicts through a war, then another unit in peacetime. Naamoosa loses a wife to a speeding car and gives his own life in a final blast.

feats.scene: Naamoosa detonates a stockpile of munitions to level an enemy hangar.
Naamoosa fights on through grazing wounds during a night raid.

name: Tirrnam
summary: Tirrnam is an emergency medic raised by a rich guardian and trained by a hard mercenary to lead a program of young pilots. Tirrnam rises from the clouds in a giant flying machine to take on a masked rival.

feats.scene: Tirrnam fires a mounted cannon from his giant machine and rips open a skyscraper's face.
Tirrnam's armoured mecha is struck by a falling vehicle and holds together in flight.

name: Aneol
summary: Aneol is an asylum orderly who carries meals to a patient who used to run the place and doubts the harsh methods of a new director. Aneol has no powers and no fighting skill.

feats.scene: Aneol pushes a heavy meal cart through a swinging door.
Aneol is shoved into a wall by an agitated inmate and keeps his tray steady.

name: Llvaast
summary: Llvaast is a young acrobat who fights alongside a grim mentor, and whose death leaves that mentor colder and bitter. Llvaast fights with flips, a gadget belt and a boy's brave heart.

feats.scene: Llvaast somersaults off a gargoyle and kicks a thug into a dumpster.
Llvaast crashes through a skylight and rolls to his feet.

name: Teosron
summary: Teosron is a boy vigilante in a stylised graphic-novel world, who protects a dark city alongside a masked mentor. Teosron drives flying machines and a laser gun in colourful, comic-strip fights.

feats.scene: Teosron fires a bright laser at a rogue robot and burns a hole through its torso.
Teosron tumbles from a rocket-powered whirlybird and rolls out of the crash.

name: Alres
summary: Alres is an ally of a masked hero in a corrupted timeline, written out of the story by the abuse of power of a tyrannical successor. Alres is remembered more than seen.

feats.scene: Alres throws a short punch at a guard in a hallway.
Alres is cut down in a flash of steel and does not rise.

name: Ronesi
summary: Ronesi is a young hero who tires of being the second half of a famous pair and retires from the costume. Ronesi is pulled back by a betrayal and killed with a friend before help can arrive.

feats.scene: Ronesi kicks a rogue teammate through a glass table in a rooftop argument.
Ronesi takes a hard blow from a rock-skinned traitor before falling.

source_title: Richard Grayson (Dark Multiverse: Teen Titans: The Judas Contract)

name: Rnetari
summary: Rnetari is a young trapeze artist who flies through the tent with his family, thrilling crowds as the troupe travels. Rnetari has agility and nerve, and no other gifts.

feats.scene: Rnetari swings from a high bar and catches his father's hands mid-air.
Rnetari lands hard in the safety net and bounces to his feet.

name: Tesntnt
summary: Tesntnt is a schoolboy and former circus tumbler who plays sidekick and snubs the girls at a convention until a bomb scare changes the mood. Tesntnt has pride, acrobatics and a quick tongue.

feats.scene: Tesntnt flips from a stage rail and lands a kick on a masked prankster.
Tesntnt is knocked off his chair by a small blast and dusts himself off.

source_title: Richard Grayson (DC Super Hero Girls TV Series)

name: Listivos
summary: Listivos is an agile vigilante who falls to a mind-eating plague and becomes one of the hollow dead, infecting those he once protected. Listivos is killed by the very people he would not hurt.

feats.scene: Listivos lunges at an old mentor and drives him into a stone wall.
Listivos keeps coming through a fusillade of kicks and blows without a flinch.

name: Oritiurni
summary: Oritiurni is a newspaper reporter who marries an ex-police officer and raises a child in a refugee camp after a terrible invasion. Oritiurni is later called to take up a cowl as one in a line of masked protectors.

feats.scene: Oritiurni swings a pipe into a looter who attacks the camp's food store.
Oritiurni shields his wife from a shower of falling debris.

name: Orrussas
summary: Orrussas is a young vampire hunter who was bitten and turned, now red-eyed and pale, haunting a mansion and tracking old allies by instinct. Orrussas fears garlic, daylight and the blade, and loses his mind if he goes without blood.

feats.scene: Orrussas rips a cellar door off its hinges and throws it at a pursuer.
Orrussas takes a wooden stake through the chest and falls into a deep sleep rather than dying.

name: Servarer
summary: Servarer is a young acrobatic crime fighter who works beside a caped flier from another planet in a world with no dark avenger. Servarer is quick, trained, and meets a visitor from a neighbouring reality with open curiosity.

feats.scene: Servarer vaults a railing and drives both boots into a smuggler's chest.
Servarer takes a thrown crate across the shoulders and stays on his feet.

name: Ilvalcor
summary: Ilvalcor is an orphaned trapeze performer trained as a masked partner, who refuses to join a plot against a gentle giant. Ilvalcor loses the memory of his whole career after his mentor tampers with his mind.

feats.scene: Ilvalcor swings from a rope and kicks a masked mugger into a stack of barrels.
Ilvalcor is struck by a heavy beam and gets up bruised but unbroken.

name: Stveosti
summary: Stveosti is the ward of a wealthy recluse, an orphan of a falling trapeze who learns his guardian's secret and joins the nightly war on crime. Stveosti grows up, takes a new name, and adopts a child of his own.

feats.scene: Stveosti spins through a crowd of enforcers and lays out four before they can swing.
Stveosti falls three storeys onto an awning and keeps fighting.

name: Serserli
summary: Serserli is a grown hero who leads a band of night watchers in a dying future, after the world turned cruel and beat down his adoptive father. Serserli survives wars of clay and demons and takes on a tyrant who rules the broken world.

feats.scene: Serserli drives a stolen war-engine into a gate of the tyrant's fortress and splits it open.
Serserli is caught in a collapsing tower and walks out coughing, still armed.

name: Nillanrni
summary: Nillanrni is a snap-together plastic acrobat who trades his old partner role for a new masked identity and leaves it to a younger boy. Nillanrni grins through every fight, in a world where everything is made of bricks.

feats.scene: Nillanrni hurls a brick-built boomerang and knocks a gang of toy thugs flat.
Nillanrni is crushed into pieces by a falling tower and snaps back together.

name: Vetorlli
summary: Vetorlli is a former circus tumbler and barkeep who becomes the first teenage sidekick of a grim vigilante, then outgrows the role to carve his own path inspired by a flying hero. Vetorlli leads younger fighters.

feats.scene: Vetorlli twirls a pair of batons and stuns three armed men in a heartbeat.
Vetorlli is thrown through a plaster wall by a hulking brute and rises smiling.

name: Lisatas
summary: Lisatas is the owner of a big airline in the late forties who is hunted by a test pilot scarred in an accident and blames his employer. Lisatas runs the business well but falls to a vengeful hijacker.

feats.scene: Lisatas bangs a fist on a conference table and seals a deal.
Lisatas is struck by a hijacker's pistol grip and goes down.

name: Veoosanum
summary: Veoosanum is a teenage vigilante who runs with a pack of young detectives and a talking dog to track a bat-winged scientist. Veoosanum leads, studies, and trades quips as the cases pile up.

feats.scene: Veoosanum cartwheels off a gondola and kicks a winged monster out of the air.
Veoosanum rides out a fall from a rooftop and dusts off his cape.

name: Reovorna
summary: Reovorna is a tiny, round-headed comic jester who cracks jokes between panels of a team's printed adventures. Reovorna is carried into a real world by a sneeze and keeps the mood light.

feats.scene: Reovorna bonks a robber on the head with an oversized comic book.
Reovorna is squashed flat by a falling anvil and pops back to shape.

source_title: Richard Grayson (Teen Titans TV Series: Tween Titans)

name: Coonern
summary: Coonern is a gunman in a gritty, slow-burning story, who knows firearms better than anyone and trusts few people. Coonern is more weary than wicked.

feats.scene: Coonern fires three shots in a row and hits the lamp, the lock and the bottle.
Coonern takes a hard blow to the ribs and keeps his gun steady.

name: Siaas
summary: Siaas is an enthusiastic young sidekick made of snapping blocks, with big green glasses and a costume patched together from a dancer's outfit. Siaas bounces through a toy city and helps a gloomy leader save it.

feats.scene: Siaas rams a block cart into a robot guard and sends it skidding.
Siaas is blown apart by a blast and is snapped back together by his friends.

name: Teramlan
summary: Teramlan is the loyal young helper of a shadowy crusader in a world where the usual hero never arrived. Teramlan is resourceful, brave and a bit green.

feats.scene: Teramlan lands a flying kick on a rival thug and takes his club.
Teramlan falls from a fire escape and gets up after a moment.

name: Tasillis
summary: Tasillis is a well-liked pupil in a schoolhouse of tiny heroes, who once tumbled with a circus and later wears a cape and mask. Tasillis crushes on a girl in a purple cowl and sometimes goes by a second bird name.

feats.scene: Tasillis tumbles across the classroom and pokes a prankster with a crayon sword.
Tasillis tumbles off the playground slide and laughs it off.

name: Tauar
summary: Tauar is a grown hero who briefly wears a dead mentor's mantle, finds that it is not his destiny, and goes back to his own name and a family with a fiery alien wife. Tauar dies in the end in a secret circumstance.

feats.scene: Tauar leaps from a ledge and slams a hulking bruiser through a window.
Tauar endures a savage beating in a rainy lane and answers with a grin.

name: Veoere
summary: Veoere is a lean, pun-loving vigilante who has fought crime for sixteen years and loves to tease the whole household. Veoere is skilled at gadgets, athletics and acrobatics, and stubborn beyond measure.

feats.scene: Veoere swings across the kitchen and tackles a burglar with a cheerful pun.
Veoere is thrown down the stairs by a prankster sibling and laughs it off.

name: Olutanan
summary: Olutanan is the heir of a rich coastal family who prefers solving private cases for wealthy clients to working at the family bank. Olutanan is forever fighting with his father over the right path.

feats.scene: Olutanan tackles a fleeing blackmailer on a rainy street.
Olutanan is slugged by a bodyguard and wakes up in a closet.

name: Nauren
summary: Nauren is the leader of a large nation during a long, tense standoff between two superpowers. Nauren is shrewd, political and always on camera.

feats.scene: Nauren slams a desk to quiet a room of advisers.
Nauren stands firm through a hail of questions in a crowded press room.

name: Vaurnniu
summary: Vaurnniu is the son of a crime family who would rather act than inherit a criminal empire. Vaurnniu is supple, a contortionist and a modest brawler, and becomes a stage-struck enemy of a blue insect hero.

feats.scene: Vaurnniu rolls under a table and trips a guard with a lazy sweep.
Vaurnniu is thrown into a prop wall and tumbles up to take a bow.

name: Russarci
summary: Russarci is a roguish playboy and daring pilot who treats the outer rim as a playground. Russarci is athletic, brash and always up for a wager among the stars.

feats.scene: Russarci vaults a cargo rail and punches a smuggler overboard.
Russarci crash-lands a battered skiff and crawls out laughing.

name: Niniu
summary: Niniu is a scientist-warlord who styles himself a monarch of the stars and opposes a team of heroes with his inventions. Niniu builds gadgets, bluffs and schemes.

feats.scene: Niniu detonates a pulse engine in orbit and cracks a floating platform in half.
Niniu shrugs off a blast from his own ray inside a shielded throne.

name: Oranallas
summary: Oranallas is a sergeant in an elite jungle unit during a long southeast war, investigating missing soldiers and running into time-wandering strangers. Oranallas is tough, wary and loyal to his team.

feats.scene: Oranallas fires a burst through the canopy and drops a sniper from a branch.
Oranallas takes a hard fall in the mud and keeps advancing under fire.

name: Orvalern
summary: Orvalern is a petty thief whose hidden genes are switched on by a company experiment, letting him soak up kinetic force and turn it into speed. Orvalern ricochets off walls and ceilings in dazzling bounds.

feats.scene: Orvalern soaks up a thrown bumper and rebounds off a wall into a rival with enough force to crack bricks.
Orvalern absorbs the force of a car's impact and sends it back as a bounce.
Orvalern pinballs through an alley faster than a sprinting rider.

name: Tilvarn
summary: Tilvarn is a magic user and hacker who steps between dimensions, bends reality and studies hidden lore with the same care as computers. Tilvarn is more at home with dark books than people.

feats.scene: Tilvarn unpicks a street's reality with a whispered word and reforms it as an empty field.
Tilvarn is caught in a spell's backlash and steps sideways out of it unscathed.

name: Ntuleota
summary: Ntuleota is a polished financier who collects old masks and secretly runs a cruel pit where his workers are forced to fight. Ntuleota enjoys the show and never gets his own hands dirty.

feats.scene: Ntuleota slaps an employee across the face in his glass office.
Ntuleota is knocked down by a furious worker and shouts for his guards.

name: Iulasul
summary: Iulasul is a masked vigilante of the forties who dresses in elaborate women's clothes to fool criminals. Iulasul appears at a government rally and watches a famed fighter unmask a cunning foe.

feats.scene: Iulasul swings a handbag loaded with lead into a gangster's jaw.
Iulasul is hit by a thug's pipe and answers by tipping his hat.

name: Rncisli
summary: Rncisli is a spy in mid-century who dresses as a woman to slip past guards and enemies. Rncisli joins forces with an ageless rogue to find his son's descendant in the hands of secret soldiers.

feats.scene: Rncisli trips an enemy agent with a parasol and takes his pistol.
Rncisli takes a heavy blow from a rifle stock and keeps up the act.

name: Astilin
summary: Astilin is a star-faring hero who once fell under the control of a giant mind-parasite starfish. Astilin flies a patrol craft and fights beside a crew of mismatched allies.

feats.scene: Astilin fires a ship cannon and bores a crater in a drifting rock.
Astilin's armour withstands a stray comet strike while he steers clear.

source_title: Richard Starr (The Brave and the Bold)

name: Valtilton
summary: Valtilton is a nineteenth-century father and friend of writers who became a thief of the night, later reformed and gone straight as a kind of reluctant elder statesman. Valtilton lives on long past his own era.

feats.scene: Valtilton gathers a cloak of darkness and tears the front off a bank vault.
Valtilton walks unharmed through a hail of police rounds in a fog.

name: Amonumvas
summary: Amonumvas is a young gunman of the frontier who dreamed of wearing his father's badge and ends up on the wrong side of the law. Amonumvas is fast and eager, held back by a stern father.

feats.scene: Amonumvas shoots a tin cup from a fence post at twenty paces.
Amonumvas takes a posse's rifle butt and runs for the hills.

name: Tesnusium
summary: Tesnusium is an aerialist who named a nephew after himself and was permanently paralysed by a cruel act of vandalism. Tesnusium was once graceful in the air and remains close to his brother.

feats.scene: Tesnusium catches a flyer's wrists on a high bar and swings him to safety.
Tesnusium falls from a ruined rig and never walks again.

name: Tumren
summary: Tumren is a seer who gets flashes of what is to come, troubled by visions of a beast and a riddle. Tumren speaks in fragments and is not always believed.

feats.scene: Tumren hurls a lantern at a looming shadow in a dream-lit hall.
Tumren is shaken by a vision that nearly breaks his mind and keeps speaking.

name: Riorosa
summary: Riorosa is a former detective turned career criminal who delights in puzzles and traps, and joins a league of arch-villains to torment a masked pair. Riorosa has a brilliant mind and fights with a cane.

feats.scene: Riorosa whips a cane across a hero's shin and slams a vault shut.
Riorosa is bowled over by a hero's tackle and laughs through the pain.

name: Senoar
summary: Senoar is a gloating foe who hangs his victims over death traps while posing riddles. Senoar always loses when the captive solves the puzzle and walks free.

feats.scene: Senoar springs a trap that drops a heavy cage into a pit.
Senoar is tackled by his captive and ends the night in handcuffs.

name: Naartor
summary: Naartor is a haunted fighter whose flesh is studded with shards of two broken rings of fear. Naartor is ferocious, usually with a partner, and was among the first to swear loyalty to a dark general.

feats.scene: Naartor lashes out with a surge of yellow light and rips open a docked freighter.
Naartor shrugs off a point-blank blast that wrecks the deck around him.

name: Ereorairn
summary: Ereorairn is a quiet figure on the edges of a large story, rarely seen and rarely named. Ereorairn keeps to the shadows and is known more by rumour than by deed.

feats.scene: Ereorairn tosses a small stone that rattles off a distant gate.
Ereorairn shrugs off a hard shove in a crowded market.

name: Veronan
summary: Veronan is a scientist and teacher who protests armed authority on campus and later becomes a time-wandering menace. Veronan's mind is sharp, his grudge is deep, and his grasp of applied science is far beyond that of his students.

feats.scene: Veronan overloads a lecture-hall device and blows out the wall of the building.
Veronan is flung across a lab bench by his own machine and rises, singed.

name: Riirn
summary: Riirn is a wild girl raised in the green depths by her grandfather after her mother died, befriended by animals and taught to sing by the birds. Riirn tracks, survives and fights hand-to-hand without fear.

feats.scene: Riirn throws a hunter over her hip into a stream.
Riirn tumbles down a rocky slope chasing a poacher and runs on.

name: Sallu
summary: Sallu is the queen of a seafaring people, wife of the king and mother of a princess. Sallu rules a kingdom of nets and boats with a calm hand.

feats.scene: Sallu hauls on a net rope and pulls a heavy catch on deck.
Sallu rides out a storm on the harbour wall without flinching.

name: Teiulu
summary: Teiulu is a barmaid by trade and a beast by moonlight, cursed with a wolf's change. Teiulu pours drinks at dusk and prowls the streets when the moon is high.

feats.scene: Teiulu changes into a wolf and tears a bar door from its frame.
Teiulu shrugs off a hail of bar-stool blows in wolf form.

name: Tauollsa
summary: Tauollsa is a hired killer born in a poor village over a buried bomb test site, where many neighbours were deformed but he was not. Tauollsa joined an army to feed his family and later befriended a fellow gunman.

feats.scene: Tauollsa fires a silenced pistol and drops a bodyguard behind a pillar.
Tauollsa walks away from a rooftop fall with a limp and a smile.

name: Luamre
summary: Luamre is a mercenary who wears borrowed colours to cause trouble for pay. Luamre trusts a bulky rented rifle and a very short contract.

feats.scene: Luamre empties a rifle clip through the windows of a stopped commuter train.
Luamre shrugs off a hard fall from a moving railcar onto gravel.

name: Niiuco
summary: Niiuco is a masked night guardian who leaves a single dried flower at each rescued doorstep. Niiuco works by lantern light and stubborn nerve, hunted by a rival with a horned helm.

feats.scene: Niiuco hurls a lantern hook that pins a thief's coat to a cellar door.
Niiuco takes a rival's charging shoulder and keeps standing in a stone passage.

name: Vastilis
summary: Vastilis is a veteran airman who built a hidden bunker under a monument by hand, shovel and midnight patience. Vastilis flies an old propeller craft and throws a rusted blade with uncanny aim.

feats.scene: Vastilis hurls a blade clean through a thick wooden crate lid.
Vastilis dives the propeller craft low over a muddy field to dodge searchlights.
Vastilis walks away from a rough crash landing in a ploughed field.

name: Niianria
summary: Niianria is a disciplined bodyguard turned freelancer whose throws and holds make weapons unnecessary. Niianria carries a quiet creed about protecting strangers from their own worst habits.

feats.scene: Niianria flips a heavy attacker over one hip and cracks a wooden table beneath him.
Niianria absorbs a full-speed tackle from a brawler twice her mass and stays balanced.

name: Auirnnol
summary: Auirnnol is a sergeant who learned grappling arts from islanders after a rescue, then took up a plain mask. Auirnnol fights with leverage, timing and a youthful partner who keeps watch.

feats.scene: Auirnnol drops a rifleman with a single sweeping throw onto packed sand.
Auirnnol rolls out of a collapsing bamboo watchtower with bruises only.

name: Ntnires
summary: Ntnires is a hulking lab-grown brute whose skin glows with trapped heat and whose temper is shorter than a fuse. Ntnires lunges at anything warm, leaving scorched footprints behind.

feats.scene: Ntnires bursts a steel bulkhead with a sudden gout of flame from its chest.
Ntnires wades through a fusillade of explosive rounds without slowing.

name: Tesiu
summary: Tesiu is a restless inventor who built a glass-domed vessel that slips along the river of days. Tesiu gathers a small crew of friends and wanders through lost ages for the thrill of it.

feats.scene: Tesiu launches the vessel's drive in a burst that flattens a hilltop of ferns.
Tesiu is jolted through a violent temporal rift and walks off shaken but whole.

name: Coriaiu
summary: Coriaiu is a calm martial specialist who joined an expendable strike team and outlasted most of it. Coriaiu relies on sharp joint locks, quick feet and well-chosen silence.

feats.scene: Coriaiu breaks a gunman's grip and slams him into a concrete wall.
Coriaiu takes a bruising rifle butt to the ribs and keeps fighting.

name: Nalte
summary: Nalte can stretch any limb to enormous lengths, growing stronger as her frame swells. Nalte uses her elasticity to hold falling bridges and catch plummeting strangers.

feats.scene: Nalte swells to the size of a house and flattens a parked bus with one palm.
Nalte stretches thin around a rockfall and bounces back unharmed.

name: Oneernun
summary: Oneernun is a stage performer turned rubbery guardian after an accident left her skin pliant. Oneernun gives up fame for a quiet mission, bending around danger with brave good humour.

feats.scene: Oneernun coils her arm around a toppling statue and hauls it upright.
Oneernun is flattened under a falling girder and slowly puffs back into shape.

source_title: Rita Farr (The Brave and the Bold)

name: Lenerucel
summary: Lenerucel is a cheerful crossing helper who patrols a toy-sized schoolyard with a stern lollipop sign. Lenerucel scolds rowdy children with a firm finger wag and nothing else.

feats.scene: Lenerucel thumps a stop sign into the pavement to halt a rolling toy truck.
Lenerucel takes a thrown snowball squarely on the chin and laughs.

name: Tiltau
summary: Tiltau is a shapeshifter raised by loving strangers, who later learns her true body is something vast and strange. Tiltau wins hard fights by using friends, terrain and cleverness, not just brute change.

feats.scene: Tiltau morphs into a horned giant and hurls a parked truck across a field.
Tiltau withstands a crushing blow from her elder kin on a cracked highway.

name: Amoralse
summary: Amoralse is a sea-dwelling brawler with webbed hands and a sour disposition toward surface folk. Amoralse swims fast and hits hard, though without any unusual training.

feats.scene: Amoralse punches a hole in a wooden hull below the waterline.
Amoralse sprints through a kelp bed after a rowing boat.
Amoralse takes a harpoon strike to the shoulder and keeps swimming.

name: Riatirirn
summary: Riatirirn is a quiet young adoptee who can rewrite facts at their source, bending data, machines and minds. Riatirirn weakens after each large act, since every change costs real stamina.

feats.scene: Riatirirn scrambles an incoming barrage of guided warheads so they detonate over empty ocean.
Riatirirn stays conscious while his own signal overloads and nearly burns him out.

name: Arsir
summary: Arsir is a gilled river lurker who stalks swimmers beneath muddy banks and hates dry land. Arsir glides through murk unseen and tears at nets, hulls and fishing lines.

feats.scene: Arsir rips a rowboat's keel free in one wrenching pull.
Arsir darts upriver ahead of a startled patrol boat.
Arsir brushes off a thrown anchor as if it were a pebble.

name: Iusetiu
summary: Iusetiu is the last of an exiled gilled lineage, nearly untouchable while submerged and clumsy on shore. Iusetiu sabotages tunnel work out of grief and plays dress-up in stolen coveralls.

feats.scene: Iusetiu plants a bundle of blasting sticks and shoves a worker through a plank wall.
Iusetiu takes a full cave-in on his back while submerged and swims out.

name: Raulas
summary: Raulas is a smuggler warped into a hulking rodent-faced brute by risky lab work. Raulas commands swarms of vermin and fights with surprising agility for such bulk.

feats.scene: Raulas swats a parked sedan into a brick storefront.
Raulas keeps charging after a van sideswipes him in an alley.

name: Ratiu
summary: Ratiu is a metal-clawed bear with a teleport pack and a gruff, human-level mind. Ratiu serves a scheming scientist and vanishes the moment a fight turns sour.

feats.scene: Ratiu rakes steel claws through a vault door and shreds the lock.
Ratiu absorbs an energy blast that scorches the wall behind him.

name: Lorsilli
summary: Lorsilli is a friendly resident who works a steady city job and shares a kitchen with a devoted spouse. Lorsilli has no special abilities and prefers quiet evenings and good coffee.

feats.scene: Lorsilli swings a briefcase at a snatched purse thief and connects.
Lorsilli slips on wet tiles and takes the fall without a scratch.

name: Nivasil
summary: Nivasil is a sticky-fingered burglar who strips mansions of silver spoons and never stays for breakfast. Nivasil prefers a quiet window latch to a loud fight.

feats.scene: Nivasil punches a guard dog's handler and bolts over a garden wall.
Nivasil drops from a second-floor sill onto soft hedges and walks away.

name: Elalluni
summary: Elalluni is a plucky songbird who dreams of crimefighting glory and tags along behind a grumpy canine hero. Elalluni flies fast, chirps loudly and accidentally gives away every plan.

feats.scene: Elalluni pecks a rope knot loose and drops a net on two bumbling hyenas.
Elalluni swoops over rooftops after a runaway delivery van.
Elalluni tumbles down a ventilation duct and shakes off the bruising.

name: Amurnti
summary: Amurnti is a chemist whose homemade tonic turned him into a strong, fast crimefighter with a tinkerer's mind. Amurnti built a rocket, copied his own memory into a machine and continued teaching.

feats.scene: Amurnti punches through a reinforced garage door and lifts the car behind it.
Amurnti survives a head-on collision with a freight truck.

name: Nannel
summary: Nannel is a former athlete who plays rough but fair and keeps a thick-skinned calm in crowded gyms. Nannel has no powers beyond a strong frame and a competitive streak.

feats.scene: Nannel drives a shoulder through a locker door in a bad-tempered scrimmage.
Nannel takes a full tackle from two linemen and stays upright.

name: Orevaeon
summary: Orevaeon is a jovial, round-bellied sidekick who was dropped by his flashier partner and found a better cause. Orevaeon gives up his life to stop a plot after standing beside a haunted fugitive.

feats.scene: Orevaeon tackles an armed schemer through a podium on a crowded stage.
Orevaeon takes a point-blank gunshot and still keeps his grip.

name: Niuco
summary: Niuco is a rogue operative who hides behind a crimson visor and works for a secretive cell. Niuco has few known abilities and mostly fights with trained discipline.

feats.scene: Niuco kicks a door off its hinges during a night raid.
Niuco shrugs off a thrown chair in a cramped corridor.

name: Nteenuau
summary: Nteenuau is a grey-haired field commander of a long-lost cause who learns that surrender can save more lives than victory. Nteenuau is carried over a battlefield and decides to lay down his arms.

feats.scene: Nteenuau swings a cavalry sabre across a tent post in a flash of temper.
Nteenuau endures a long, windy flight clinging to a stranger's arm.

name: Tanona
summary: Tanona is a cheerful long-lived man who teaches lessons and pours drinks across the centuries. Tanona has been spared by the figure who ends all stories, and he savours every year.

feats.scene: Tanona shoves a drunk patron out of the pub doorway with a steady push.
Tanona is hung, burned and drowned across the ages and wakes up each time.

name: Urnsia
summary: Urnsia is a newborn child of divine blood whose unstable potential could one day reshape the world. Urnsia is raised away from conflict, and the infant never learns what he was meant to become.

feats.scene: Urnsia kicks the edge of a cradle and rocks it in a crooked arc.
Urnsia sleeps through a loud thunderstorm without a whimper.

name: Tiamia
summary: Tiamia is a petty thief in an egg-shaped costume who steals trinkets from small-town museums. Tiamia prefers clever traps to fighting and is easily foiled by teenagers.

feats.scene: Tiamia swings a sack of loot into a guard's chest and runs.
Tiamia falls off a display ledge and bounces up grumbling.

name: Teoriia
summary: Teoriia is an aged vigilante in a dark cowl who believes in strict sentences and an unbending code. Teoriia stays in peak physical shape and passes his creed to a daughter.

feats.scene: Teoriia lands a spinning kick that folds a brute against a barrel.
Teoriia takes a rooftop fall onto a cart of hay and walks away.

source_title: Robert Kane (Legends of the Dead Earth)

name: Tiutorcis
summary: Tiutorcis is a godlike child who ages himself in a blink and rules the whole world as a mad dictator. Tiutorcis bends reality at will until elder spirits strip his gifts to teach humility.

feats.scene: Tiutorcis tears a distant planet apart in a single outstretched gesture.
Tiutorcis stands untouched as a barrage of solar flares breaks against his shoulders.

name: Sticost
summary: Sticost is a quiet masked vigilante who uses disguise, stealth and clever paper trails to unmask crooks. Sticost took up a long-abandoned persona and wears it like a loose coat.

feats.scene: Sticost drives an elbow into a thug's jaw from behind a curtain.
Sticost takes a hard baton blow in an alley and slips away.

name: Iacolsti
summary: Iacolsti is a pleasant elected official who handles budgets, ribbon cuttings and uneasy press conferences. Iacolsti has no special talents beyond a steady handshake.

feats.scene: Iacolsti slams a gavel and silences a rowdy council chamber.
Iacolsti trips on a podium step and rises with a smile.

name: Iumntern
summary: Iumntern is a wealthy shipping magnate whose final choice on a drifting raft saves the life of his only son. Iumntern has no powers, just a hard businessman's nerve and a heavy conscience.

feats.scene: Iumntern hurls a deck chair at a saboteur on a pitching yacht.
Iumntern clings to a capsized hull for hours in freezing swell.

name: Resere
summary: Resere is a government spymaster whose flesh is see-through except for a bare skeleton, and whose sweat is poisonous. Resere wears gloves to avoid harming friends and runs quiet operations from the shadows.

feats.scene: Resere grips a steel railing and bends it into a corkscrew.
Resere drives through a hail of pistol rounds that skip off his frame.

name: Torluori
summary: Torluori is a rough courier with a mechanical eye and a missing arm, upgraded by a back-alley surgeon. Torluori works for the highest bidder and tests every new gadget on rivals.

feats.scene: Torluori punches through a plywood barricade with his steel arm.
Torluori takes a thrown cinder block on the chest and laughs.

name: Iumosco
summary: Iumosco is a scrappy girl from a poor district who is rescued from an orphanage and becomes a street-level reporter. Iumosco has no powers but plenty of grit and loyal friends.

feats.scene: Iumosco throws a newspaper bundle that bowls over a hall monitor.
Iumosco tumbles down a stairwell and bounces to her feet.

name: Esiil
summary: Esiil is a teenage partner in a masked duo, trained young and lost young. Esiil carries a dutiful courage into a battle too large for him.

feats.scene: Esiil whips a short staff across an attacker's knees.
Esiil shields a friend and absorbs a cracking flat-handed blow.

name: Testalca
summary: Testalca is a warm young woman from a rainy port town whose last kiss ends in tragedy. Testalca has no powers, and her story gives another man his reason to fight.

feats.scene: Testalca smacks a pigeon-thief's hand away from her chips.
Testalca slips on a wet kerb and rubs her elbow.

name: Ntoriam
summary: Ntoriam is a cartoonish junior sidekick who bounces through slapstick chases in a bright cape. Ntoriam is never seriously hurt and keeps a perpetual grin.

feats.scene: Ntoriam flings a custard pie that knocks a bumbling crook off his stool.
Ntoriam is flattened by a falling anvil and pops back up.

name: Tiuun
summary: Tiuun is a legendary outlaw archer who robs corrupt lords and feeds hungry villagers. Tiuun is also a skilled rider and shrewd planner with a hearty band of followers.

feats.scene: Tiuun looses a long arrow that splits a distant target's wooden stake.
Tiuun survives a rough fall from a galloping steed into a thorn hedge.

name: Lluleona
summary: Lluleona is a young masked ally who joins a larger vigilante family during a jungle conflict. Lluleona is quick-witted and plays peacemaker between rival plant lovers.

feats.scene: Lluleona vaults a fallen log and kicks a vine-thrower in the ribs.
Lluleona is tossed into a trunk by a lashing vine and stays on her feet.

name: Aulneamo
summary: Aulneamo is a charming fabled archer who defends a besieged fortress and trades jests with a hunting goddess. Aulneamo stays at his post to the end, buying the last boat time to leave.

feats.scene: Aulneamo looses an arrow that pierces an armoured invader's visor.
Aulneamo stands against a wave of soldiers before finally falling.

name: Riaeruau
summary: Riaeruau is a gentle android bodyguard who learns detective work and falls in love with a fellow machine. Riaeruau fires energy bolts, hears distant whispers and remembers everything he sees.

feats.scene: Riaeruau fires a bolt that blasts a hole through a warehouse wall.
Riaeruau sprints down a corridor to cut off a fleeing thief.
Riaeruau absorbs a rocket hit and keeps walking.

name: Inucin
summary: Inucin is a hulking war automaton, built by a tinkerer and rebuilt by a loyal rescuer. Inucin gains a voice and a pompous personality, then sacrifices himself as a decoy.

feats.scene: Inucin punches through a prison gate with a hydraulic fist.
Inucin keeps walking after a volley of rifle fire dents his plating.

name: Naneru
summary: Naneru is a masked hunter who stalks mechanical beings and strips their circuits for trophies. Naneru prefers ambush, wire and acid to open fights.

feats.scene: Naneru drives a pry bar through a robot's chest panel in a dark shaft.
Naneru absorbs a flailing metal arm against a steel stairway rail.

name: Iuamont
summary: Iuamont is a patient mechanical tutor who crosses the stars to test young heroes on their gifts. Iuamont survived a world's end and quietly measures every pupil with strict kindness.

feats.scene: Iuamont fires a staged blast that flattens a rocky ridge to test a pupil.
Iuamont rides out the death of his home world inside a drifting shell.

name: Nolval
summary: Nolval is a hunched workshop tyrant who stitches grotesque beasts from scrap and spare parts. Nolval sends them out to frighten adventurers and keeps a grudge against anyone who laughs.

feats.scene: Nolval hurls a crate of tools that smashes a lamp post.
Nolval is struck by a swinging beam and stays standing.

name: Tarnre
summary: Tarnre is a clever young sibling of a noble family who studies chemistry and slips into a bright cape during a revolution. Tarnre fights with wit, borrowed tools and a sharp tongue.

feats.scene: Tarnre swings a bundled pole into a guard's helmet on a narrow bridge.
Tarnre falls from a market awning and rolls to her feet.

name: Arntovos
summary: Arntovos is a hired thug whose body is coated in living rock after a sorcerer's gift. Arntovos is slow-witted and tough, and works as muscle for a crime ring.

feats.scene: Arntovos punches a parked truck's door clean off its frame.
Arntovos stands his ground as a car rams his chest.

name: Nelsta
summary: Nelsta is a young stone-skinned child of retired mercenaries, growing up on a quiet rocky world. Nelsta likes tumbling down scree slopes and stacking boulders into towers.

feats.scene: Nelsta tosses a boulder the size of a stool into a gully.
Nelsta rolls down a cliffside without a chip.

name: Rusntrni
summary: Rusntrni is a patrol officer from a far future who flies a rocket belt and chases pirates with a ray pistol. Rusntrni grows a different hair colour in nearly every story.

feats.scene: Rusntrni fires a ray pistol that melts a docking clamp.
Rusntrni rockets across a skyline on a belt pack in pursuit of a hijacked cruiser.
Rusntrni survives a hard landing on a rooftop antenna.

name: Reniuti
summary: Reniuti is a rodeo rider who trains bucking broncos and slips on a mask to right wrongs on the frontier. Reniuti has no gifts beyond horsemanship, a steady aim and a fast fist.

feats.scene: Reniuti shoots a lantern from a bandit's hand at fifty paces.
Reniuti gallops a stallion across a dry riverbed at full tilt.
Reniuti is thrown from a bronco into a fence and stands up.

name: Iumerean
summary: Iumerean is a greedy corporate aide who plots to remove his employer and take over a star-building firm. Iumerean has no powers and relies on hired killers and spreadsheets.

feats.scene: Iumerean slaps a contract onto a desk with a loud crack.
Iumerean tumbles over an office chair and keeps scheming.

name: Resroreon
summary: Resroreon is an elderly patriarch confined to a breathing machine after a stroke. Resroreon watches his grandchildren grow up and communicates in slow, careful gestures.

feats.scene: Resroreon taps a bell on a bedside table to summon a nurse.
Resroreon endures a long night of laboured breathing.

name: Sauna
summary: Sauna is a masked adventurer who cracks a long leather lash to disarm villains and pull allies from danger. Sauna fights alongside a wartime squad and relies on speed over strength.

feats.scene: Sauna snaps a lash that strips a revolver from a gunman's grip.
Sauna takes a steel pipe across the shoulder and keeps swinging.

name: Veorneos
summary: Veorneos is a broad sea-dwelling guard captain who protects a royal court under the waves. Veorneos has strong limbs, quick reflexes and tough skin suited to deep water.

feats.scene: Veorneos hurls a rock slab that smashes a pirate skiff.
Veorneos takes a harpoon blast to the chest and keeps guard.

name: Anesleo
summary: Anesleo is a grey-haired community leader who guides his people out of a flooded homeland to a new shore. Anesleo has no powers, only wisdom and a steady voice.

feats.scene: Anesleo strikes a staff on a stone floor to call an assembly to order.
Anesleo marches across scorching sand for days with his people.

name: Numori
summary: Numori is a gigantic, ancient mechanical colossus with no eyes and an odd sense of purpose. Numori once terrorised cities, then ended up serving a ragtag crew on strange errands.

feats.scene: Numori swings a metal fist that levels a warehouse.
Numori shrugs off a barrage of artillery shells in an open lot.

name: Niuorant
summary: Niuorant is a lumbering piloted robot built for work on a distant moon and later repurposed by a villainous guild. Niuorant is guided by a driver sitting in its head and is armed with heavy weaponry.

feats.scene: Niuorant fires a shoulder cannon that crumples a concrete overpass.
Niuorant is struck by a missile volley and keeps walking.

name: Mialeoreo
summary: Mialeoreo is a travelling salesman who keeps a pickled lizard on his shelf, and the lizard starts talking. Mialeoreo is turned by a telepathic voice into a fictional monster who feeds on thoughts.

feats.scene: Mialeoreo clubs a victim with a heavy glass jar.
Mialeoreo takes a fall down a staircase and keeps stumbling forward.

name: Siatas
summary: Siatas is a disturbed performer who wears a fused faceplate that makes crowds feel whatever he wishes. Siatas drives himself mad with the mask and ends up forced into a cosmic crisis.

feats.scene: Siatas floods a stadium with rage and the stampede flattens the gates.
Siatas is thrown against a wall and remains conscious.

name: Iatelan
summary: Iatelan is a clever student who becomes a heat-draining creature of frost. Iatelan freezes bullets and flames alike but must keep feeding on warmth to avoid freezing solid.

feats.scene: Iatelan drains a flamethrower stream into a column of ice.
Iatelan shrugs off a burst of military gunfire in a dormitory hall.

name: Eruoraria
summary: Eruoraria is an orphan raised by a prospector who becomes a frontier archer with golden arrowheads. Eruoraria rides a white stallion and fights a greedy rancher.

feats.scene: Eruoraria looses a golden arrow that pins a bandit's hat to a tree.
Eruoraria gallops past a pursuing posse on a white stallion.
Eruoraria is dragged by a runaway horse across a prairie and rises sore.

name: Arancer
summary: Arancer is a small artist from an animal-people world who eats a glowing root and gains muscle, hearing and hopping power. Arancer leads a team of similarly empowered creatures.

feats.scene: Arancer leaps over a block of flats and drives his fists through a delivery truck.
Arancer bounds across a skyline in a few quick hops.
