Arancer is crushed flat by a cartoon roller and unfolds again.

name: Soresa
summary: Soresa is a lawyer who becomes a masked pirate hunter and captain after a courtroom battle goes sideways. Soresa wields a sabre, a sharp tongue and a talent for leadership.

feats.scene: Soresa cleaves a rope with a sabre and drops a boarding net on raiders.
Soresa shrugs off a cutlass slash across the arm and fights on.

name: Vasser
summary: Vasser is a thief who turns into mist to escape, then plots to frame the heroes of a satellite fortress. Vasser uses lasers, vapour form and a cunning mind.

feats.scene: Vasser slices a vault panel with a handheld laser.
Vasser takes a blast of pressurised steam in a corridor and drifts clear.

name: Llstior
summary: Llstior is a priest who runs an orphanage and secretly founds a fanatic cult. Llstior recruits troubled youths and gives them masks.

feats.scene: Llstior strikes a bully across a chapel pew with a heavy cane.
Llstior takes a blow to the stomach and keeps preaching.

name: Toranuan
summary: Toranuan is a prince of a distant stone-skinned race who lost his place at an academy. Toranuan has strength and toughness beyond human reach and a sour temperament.

feats.scene: Toranuan flings a stone bench through a wall.
Toranuan is thrown through a pillar and stands unfazed.

name: Anelalia
summary: Anelalia is a bald, ambitious descendant of a famous schemer who steals science from a far-future age. Anelalia dispatches robots as decoys while his crew robs laboratories.

feats.scene: Anelalia detonates a small charge that opens a lab wall.
Anelalia is hit by a thrown stool and goes down with a yelp.

name: Eslesres
summary: Eslesres is a stern police chief in a future city who is the reluctant heir of a clown-faced infamy. Eslesres works hard to atone and helps thwart a ring of space raiders.

feats.scene: Eslesres fires a stun baton that knocks a raider off his feet.
Eslesres takes a raider's punch and holds the line.

name: Ortirtir
summary: Ortirtir is a ring-wielding space cop who builds shields and projectiles from willpower. Ortirtir falls in battle while defending a distant colony from raiders.

feats.scene: Ortirtir drops a glowing construct onto an invader's ship and cracks the hull.
Ortirtir holds a shimmering barrier against a barrage of raider fire.

name: Ortes
summary: Ortes is a bored gambler from a post-scarcity world who drags visitors into elaborate games of chance. Ortes can move small objects with his mind and travels in star-crossing ships.

feats.scene: Ortes flicks a roulette wheel across a hall with a thought.
Ortes is knocked off his stool by an angry loser.

name: Rnonauvor
summary: Rnonauvor is a magnet-bending soldier from a war-torn age who joins a dark regime after captivity. Rnonauvor pulls steel from the walls of prison ships to use as weapons.

feats.scene: Rnonauvor rips a steel hull plate loose and hurls it at a patrol boat.
Rnonauvor takes a guard's rifle butt to the face and smirks.

name: Seost
summary: Seost is a young hero from the thirty-first century with a flight ring and a knack for bending iron. Seost leads a team of teenage volunteers, appearing only in a spinoff comic.

feats.scene: Seost bends a lamp post around a runaway cart.
Seost takes a falling girder on the shoulder and keeps flying.

name: Lorton
summary: Lorton is a magnetism-wielding youth who founded a club of super teens and later joined a time-hopping order. Lorton blocks traps with force fields and delegates cleverly under pressure.

feats.scene: Lorton lifts a battered shuttle with a magnetic pull and sets it down.
Lorton endures a crushing shock in a force-field trap.

name: Rnucol
summary: Rnucol is a younger copy of a magnetic hero who arrives through a time paradox. Rnucol wears a flight ring and keeps up the pretence of being a true clone.

feats.scene: Rnucol rips a steel door off a bunker with a magnetic lift.
Rnucol takes a hard hit from a stray blast and stays aloft.

name: Tiveoto
summary: Tiveoto is a tiny cartoon magnetic hero who drops by a toy fortress to retrieve a clever friend. Tiveoto joins a birthday party before leaving.

feats.scene: Tiveoto tugs a paper clip off a cake with a tiny magnetic pull.
Tiveoto is squashed by a party balloon and laughs it off.

name: Amooreto
summary: Amooreto is a friendly cab driver who ferries odd fares through starlanes in a talkative ship. Amooreto carries a pistol, a quick smile and a pocketful of tips.

feats.scene: Amooreto fires a pistol that cracks a hostile console.
Amooreto punches the cab's drive and shoots across a dock.
Amooreto is knocked out of his seat by a rough landing.

name: Erntiu
summary: Erntiu is a bald alien who becomes godfather to a doomed infant and later plays a mock devil. Erntiu carries a trident, a voodoo doll and a crippling soft spot for his godson.

feats.scene: Erntiu hurls a trident that cracks a stone pillar.
Erntiu endures a hard shove into a column and keeps up his act.

name: Lliamnel
summary: Lliamnel is a businessman who competes dirtily with a rival firm and invents a face-changing drug. Lliamnel loses control when a test subject turns into a clay monster.

feats.scene: Lliamnel slams a briefcase onto a boardroom table in a rage.
Lliamnel is shoved by a henchman and straightens his tie.

name: Seiarli
summary: Seiarli is a huge, bald enforcer who serves a mob boss and overpowers police effortlessly. Seiarli is finally subdued by a clever electronic trap.

feats.scene: Seiarli flips a police cruiser onto its roof with his bare hands.
Seiarli takes a barrage of baton blows and keeps walking.

name: Areolla
summary: Areolla is a respectable community leader who secretly runs a hideout for fugitives. Areolla wears a rubber grin and uses a glowing beam to freeze victims in place.

feats.scene: Areolla jabs a pointer into a guard's ribs during a town meeting.
Areolla is knocked down by two masked agents and unmasked.

name: Ereru
summary: Ereru is a scientist who builds a crime robot and later bolts a metal arm to his own shoulder. Ereru escapes prison with help from an old rival and carries a glowing stone.

feats.scene: Ereru drives a steel fist through a laboratory table.
Ereru takes a hard hit from a security guard and keeps moving.

name: Titorcel
summary: Titorcel is a white-haired accountant who runs a quiet embezzling scheme for a criminal club. Titorcel trusts ledgers, locks and a well-timed cough.

feats.scene: Titorcel slams a ledger on a rival's fingers.
Titorcel stumbles down a short stair and straightens his coat.

name: Iulor
summary: Iulor is a corrupt detective who blackmails junior colleagues and hires an assassin to silence a witness. Iulor is arrested when the plot backfires.

feats.scene: Iulor fires a service pistol at a parked car in a rage.
Iulor is beaten up by a determined junior officer and slumps.

name: Iutalna
summary: Iutalna is a ruthless crime boss who rules the streets with fear and gets hunted by a gun-toting vigilante. Iutalna is killed in a string of rooftop murders.

feats.scene: Iutalna fires a pistol at a defector across a conference table.
Iutalna takes a knock to the head and retaliates.

source_title: Roman Sionis (Dark Multiverse: The Grim Knight)

name: Ntuniacor
summary: Ntuniacor is a vain, moody mob boss who throws lavish parties and cruelly orders attacks on rivals. Ntuniacor chases a stolen gem across a city.

feats.scene: Ntuniacor fires a pistol that shatters a chandelier.
Ntuniacor is knocked across a bar and rises furious.

name: Anerto
summary: Anerto is a wealthy heir who burns down his family home and wears a mask carved from a tomb. Anerto joins a league of villains and speaks of death like an old friend.

feats.scene: Anerto empties a revolver into a row of paper targets.
Anerto takes a punch from a bodyguard and chuckles.

name: Stanan
summary: Stanan is a toy-brick crime boss who owns a factory and commands a plastic army. Stanan fights with firearms, disguises and toxic masks.

feats.scene: Stanan fires a toy pistol that pops a row of brick bricks.
Stanan is knocked apart into loose pieces and clicks back together.

name: Nilerere
summary: Nilerere is a pint-sized crime boss locked in an asylum cell in a cartoonish world. Nilerere mutters about firearms and never has one.

feats.scene: Nilerere rattles a tin cup on the bars to demand attention.
Nilerere gets bumped by a guard and shrugs it off.

name: Aucost
summary: Aucost is a mob boss who survives a gunshot and surrenders to a hospital cell. Aucost's mask lets him command inmates to fight for him during a siege.

feats.scene: Aucost commands a mob of inmates to batter down a steel door.
Aucost survives a point-blank gunshot and staggers to safety.

name: Raameo
summary: Raameo is a ring-bearing soldier of a fear-driven corps who joins a failed confrontation. Raameo is vaporised by a colossal living world's burst of energy.

feats.scene: Raameo launches a glowing construct that dents a hovering vessel.
Raameo raises a shield that holds for a moment against a planetary burst.

name: Lesllu
summary: Lesllu is a hollow-eyed ferryman who sails a rusted barge across a black salt lake, collecting the dread of passengers into a glowing bowl. Lesllu hurls that stored dread as a sickly beam when cornered.

feats.scene: Lesllu emptied the bowl of stored dread in one beam that cracked a stone pier into gravel.
Lesllu stood unmoved while a runaway cart slammed into the barge rail beside him.

name: Rerseill
summary: Rerseill is a deserter from a mining brigade who carries a cracked amber lamp that bends light into hard rays. Rerseill lives on the run through abandoned shafts, hunted by former comrades.

feats.scene: Rerseill focused the amber lamp into a ray that bored through a collapsed tunnel wall.
Rerseill shrugged off a rockfall that buried the rest of the corridor.

name: Tinoleon
summary: Tinoleon is a cold-eyed courier for a hidden ministry, trained in close combat and quiet firearms work. Tinoleon follows written orders without hesitation and never leaves witnesses.

feats.scene: Tinoleon drove a knee through a wooden door and splintered it off its hinges.
Tinoleon took a fall from a loading dock and rose to keep walking.
Tinoleon sprinted down a service stair to catch a closing lift.

name: Stillo
summary: Stillo is a cheerful navigator of a drifting orchard station who was gifted a ring of pale light. Stillo shapes that light into shields and glides between the hanging trees.

feats.scene: Stillo flung a lance of pale light that split a floating boulder in half.
Stillo raised a dome of pale light that held against a falling tree trunk.
Stillo glided the length of the orchard in a few heartbeats.

name: Stiiulli
summary: Stiiulli is a patient harbour inspector with a black belt and a stubborn memory for old cases. Stiiulli grapples smugglers on the docks and settles disputes with a firm hold rather than a blade.

feats.scene: Stiiulli flipped a heavy smuggler over a crate with a single hip throw.
Stiiulli took a rolling barrel to the ribs and kept the grip.

name: Mieoter
summary: Mieoter is a shapeshifting mimic from a travelling troupe who can pour into the outline of any person he has studied. Mieoter uses the talent to swap places with rivals and slip out of locked rooms.

feats.scene: Mieoter stretched an arm across a courtyard and hurled a bench like a mallet.
Mieoter spread his body thin and let a cart roll over him unharmed.

name: Esenuar
summary: Esenuar is a clerk from a cloud-city who can compress his body flat as paper and slide beneath doors. Esenuar was turned away by every guild for being too odd, and now sneaks into vaults for hire.

feats.scene: Esenuar unfolded from under a vault door and shoved a guard across the floor.
Esenuar lay flat as a rug while a wagon crossed over him and sprang back whole.

name: Nenst
summary: Nenst is a tide-scholar who studies in a coral academy and bends seawater with chanted verses. Nenst once ran with a band that despised outsiders, and now keeps to the library.

feats.scene: Nenst pulled a wave off the harbour and slammed it against a seawall, shaking the stones.
Nenst endured the crush of the deep trench without a mark.

name: Tieose
summary: Tieose is a travelling healer from a sunken reef city, renowned for tending rare ailments across the stars. Tieose breathes water and air alike but dries out quickly on dry land.

feats.scene: Tieose lifted an injured patient out of the shallows and carried them to the clinic.

name: Valmiri
summary: Valmiri is a young healer who learned forbidden verses and was slowly consumed by them, twisting reef-folk into monsters. Valmiri was finally petrified when his carved staff was shattered.

feats.scene: Valmiri fired a surge of warped water that capsized a trading barge.
Valmiri weathered a collapsing sea cave with only dust on his robe.
Valmiri raced through the current faster than a leaping dolphin.

name: Aseol
summary: Aseol is a teenager fused with an old professor by a reactor accident into a single blazing figure. Aseol burns with controlled nuclear heat and rearranges matter at close range.

feats.scene: Aseol flared white and vaporised a boulder the size of a bus.
Aseol stood inside the reactor core as it overheated and walked out smiling.
Aseol streaked across the sky faster than sound.

name: Stistiser
summary: Stistiser is a diligent reporter who chases leads across a metropolis with a notebook and no weapon. Stistiser has no powers but strong persistence and a sharp nose for a story.

feats.scene: Stistiser shoved open a jammed newsroom door with one firm push.
Stistiser fell down a flight of steps and still filed the story that night.

name: Sestote
summary: Sestote is a calm journalist working the city desk, tracking tips by phone and shoe leather. Sestote relies on contacts and patience to chase a scoop in a world of caped brawls.

feats.scene: Sestote swung a heavy camera bag into a fleeing thief and knocked him off balance.
Sestote took a slip on wet steps without dropping the notes.

name: Rnories
summary: Rnories is a wealthy shipping heir who leads a secret life as a masked archer in a quiet harbour town. Rnories also wears a disguise that makes him look like a famous newsman.

feats.scene: Rnories loosed an arrow that pinned a fleeing bandit's coat to a warehouse wall.
Rnories dropped from a rooftop onto canvas awnings and walked away.

name: Milstanu
summary: Milstanu is a laughing deity of calm after conflict who tricks armies into laying down their arms. Milstanu can rewrite the make-up of a substance and fly above the waves.

feats.scene: Milstanu rewrote a ridge of rock into soft wood and then into dust.
Milstanu sat unharmed as a siege engine volley broke around him.
Milstanu crossed the open sea in a single laugh.

name: Colntirau
summary: Colntirau is a former field soldier whose implants were stripped out after a discharge, leaving scars and a grudge. Colntirau now prowls the night as a vigilante, fighting with raw grit and hard boots.

feats.scene: Colntirau slammed a thug through a plywood wall with a shoulder charge.
Colntirau fought on after being thrown against a steel railing.
Colntirau sprinted across a car park to cut off a getaway van.

name: Tovaune
summary: Tovaune is a hybrid of two engineers fused in a lab mishap, giving off bursts of atomic fire and shaping matter. Tovaune was captured and drained by a tyrant who collects champions.

feats.scene: Tovaune burned a hole through a floating fortress wall in a single flash.
Tovaune took a blast that levelled a courtyard and stayed standing.
Tovaune shot upward through the cloud deck.

name: Lanorais
summary: Lanorais is a red-haired broadcaster for a coastal radio station who covers the exploits of a legendary warrior-princess. Lanorais carries only a microphone and a sharp tongue.

feats.scene: Lanorais swung a tripod to hold off a hungry stray dog.
Lanorais stumbled on the stairs of the booth and got up laughing.

name: Lilleru
summary: Lilleru is a young sea-boy living near a hidden island of warrior women, who dives for pearls and sings to fish. Lilleru hops awkwardly on land because he has a fin instead of legs.

feats.scene: Lilleru flicked his tail and sent a wave that rocked a rowboat.
Lilleru dived to the dark bottom of the trench and surfaced unharmed.
Lilleru raced a school of tuna and won.

name: Vatenum
summary: Vatenum is a blond merman who grew up admiring a teenage heroine and later reunited with her as an adult under a new name. Vatenum can sense currents from afar and soothe sea creatures.

feats.scene: Vatenum hurled a net full of driftwood clear of the rescue boat.
Vatenum remained at ease in the crushing dark of the abyss.

name: Assena
summary: Assena is a masked crook who strangles night watchmen with a length of tarred cord and vanishes into alleys. Assena is a petty menace rather than a conqueror, known to few.

feats.scene: Assena yanked a watchman off his feet with a single pull of the cord.
Assena dropped from a fence onto cobbles and fled without a limp.

name: Nillesi
summary: Nillesi is a pink-skinned scholar from a hyper-advanced world who spent years experimenting with collapsing stars. Nillesi wields a ring of green will that conjures shields and rays and lets him fly.

feats.scene: Nillesi dropped a focused ray that melted a hillside into glass.
Nillesi held a shield of green will against a tumbling asteroid fragment.
Nillesi crossed the upper air in seconds.

name: Tinacil
summary: Tinacil is a reserved orange-skinned guard of a ring-forged order who walks the crypts and watches for intruders. Tinacil conjures shields and rays through a ring and takes to the air.

feats.scene: Tinacil fired a heavy beam that shattered a stone effigy to powder.
Tinacil absorbed a strike that levelled a nearby wall.
Tinacil rose through the vault ceiling and out into open sky.

name: Coontlor
summary: Coontlor is a fugitive tinkerer in a patched coat who builds timed charges from scrap and hacks door locks. Coontlor hides among rubble blocks while the watch hunts him through the night.

feats.scene: Coontlor tripped a charge that dropped a disused footbridge into the river.
Coontlor rolled out of a stairwell after a blast and kept running.

name: Amson
summary: Amson is a self-aware, wry she-demon who drifts through taverns and alleys of the living world, dazzling mortals and teasing them with banana-skin luck. Amson sees the whole stage and plays along.

feats.scene: Amson snapped her fingers and a bar's sign burst into harmless sparks.
Amson sipped a drink while a falling beam crumbled against her shoulder.

name: Iaveast
summary: Iaveast is a patient infernal schemer who traps mortals in dream worlds and warps time inside them to bear fiendish heirs. Iaveast can burn with flame, change shape and strain reality itself.

feats.scene: Iaveast tore a rift in a dreamscape that swallowed a whole valley.
Iaveast shrugged off a collapse of the dream sky as though it were rain.

name: Iaentcor
summary: Iaentcor is a nimble thief who spins her eyes into a hypnotic whirl, dizzying anyone who meets her gaze. Iaentcor also feels the moods of nearby people and steals more than coins.

feats.scene: Iaentcor pushed a dizzy guard into a shelf of boxes and laughed.
Iaentcor tumbled down a fire escape and bounced back onto her feet.
Iaentcor ran across the rooftops after a heist.

name: Mareoro
summary: Mareoro is a young girl in a crowded neighbourhood who glimpses the dead before they fall, and sees events yet to come. Mareoro seeks an old fortune teller for advice.

feats.scene: Mareoro pushed a friend out of a doorway seconds before a sign fell.
Mareoro sat through a night of troubling visions and still went to school.

name: Tiiarva
summary: Tiiarva is a gadget-making crook who mastered spinning toys and bombs, joining a band of criminals planting charges under a museum. Tiiarva is a skilled swimmer and demolitions hobbyist.

feats.scene: Tiiarva set a charge that brought down a gallery ceiling.
Tiiarva took a dunk in the ocean and swam to shore.

name: Taslu
summary: Taslu is a spinning criminal obsessed with toys since boyhood, who whirls his body to sharpen his mind and shake off pursuers. Taslu threatened to crack a continent unless crowned its ruler.

feats.scene: Taslu spun up a whirlwind that levelled a toy factory roof.
Taslu was struck by a speeding runner and kept spinning.
Taslu whirled across the street at a gallop.

name: Rustere
summary: Rustere is a man struck by lightning as a boy who became a living tornado, flattening a town in three days when his tonic failed. Rustere was recruited by a traveller across time.

feats.scene: Rustere unleashed a funnel that tore through a market town and scattered its roofs.
Rustere stood in the heart of a lightning storm and walked on.
Rustere spun along the highway faster than a racing car.

name: Miceoni
summary: Miceoni is a test pilot lost in the wind of a prototype flight, swallowed by an endless race for seventy years. Miceoni returned to help a fast runner and later joined a gang of thieves.

feats.scene: Miceoni plowed a stolen plane through a wall of cargo crates.
Miceoni rode out a crash that scattered the hangar floor.
Miceoni shot across the airstrip faster than any aircraft.

name: Seorcin
summary: Seorcin is a white-haired sword-for-hire in a frozen realm who guides hostages over mountain passes through blizzards. Seorcin was raised apart from her father and learned a measure of foresight.

feats.scene: Seorcin cleaved an iced timber bridge in a single stroke.
Seorcin walked through a snowstorm in thin leathers.
Seorcin sprinted over the frozen ridge to overtake a sled.

name: Liniium
summary: Liniium is a pink-skinned plant-girl raised in a greenhouse who coaxes vines and sweet spores from the soil. Liniium has a twin and an adopted sister, and keeps to the garden roofs.

feats.scene: Liniium called up vines that ripped a paving slab from the street.
Liniium was trampled by a crowd and sprang back like a reed.

name: Teranti
summary: Teranti is a secretary who becomes a masked, auburn-wigged vigilante in her sleep after her father was killed by a syndicate. Teranti hunts the killers across waterfront streets with a quiet bow.

feats.scene: Teranti sent an arrow through a warehouse window and pinned a ledger to a post.
Teranti climbed a fire escape after a gunfight and kept her aim.

name: Estanvi
summary: Estanvi is a widowed farmer who found her small town lifted into the sky and set among strange cities. Estanvi befriended the new overseer and helped the many peoples live together.

feats.scene: Estanvi hauled a sack of grain onto a cart in a single heave.
Estanvi worked a field through a day of storm and hail.

name: Irnamne
summary: Irnamne is a homemaker who raised a son after her first husband died in a robbery and then remarried. Irnamne once held a knife at her throat and led the family to find her missing boy.

feats.scene: Irnamne swung a cast-iron pan at a startled intruder.
Irnamne held steady while a ruffian pressed a blade near her.

name: Lanreo
summary: Lanreo is a student who was meant to become the centre of all dreams and threaten to collapse the dreaming world. Lanreo links the dreams of sleepers across the land and once flew in a rush of dreams.

feats.scene: Lanreo gathered a thousand dreams into one vortex that shook the sleeping city.
Lanreo stood in the dream storm and was not torn.

name: Retonlu
summary: Retonlu is a determined writer and sharp investigator who once carried a dangerous dream power that bent reality around her. Retonlu fought to keep it under control and remained kind.

feats.scene: Retonlu let a dream surge loose and a block of apartments blurred into mist.
Retonlu endured a night of terror dreams without breaking.

name: Valellor
summary: Valellor is a white-haired student at a school for young heroes in the big city. Valellor trains in the gym, goes to class and keeps a quiet sense of humour.

feats.scene: Valellor sent a practice dummy flying across the gymnasium.
Valellor dropped from the climbing wall and bounced up smiling.

name: Niater
summary: Niater is a white-haired daughter of a comatose general who sets out to hunt vigilantes with sword and firearm. Niater heals fast and moves faster than most, but was caught by a team of young heroes.

feats.scene: Niater cut down a steel door with two fast strikes of her sword.
Niater took a rooftop fall and healed before dawn.
Niater outran a speeding car on the highway.

name: Reoriaceo
summary: Reoriaceo is a mischievous white-haired girl with an eye patch who befriends a gloomy teen and then turns out to be truly wicked. Reoriaceo fights with quick reflexes and a thin blade.

feats.scene: Reoriaceo cut a swing set cleanly in two with her blade.
Reoriaceo shrugged off a heavy slap and grinned.

source_title: Rose Wilson (Teen Titans Go! TV Series)

name: Nices
summary: Nices is a small pupil at a toy-scale school who wears an eye patch and endures a father who happens to be the headmaster. Nices warms to the idea after a day at the ballpark.

feats.scene: Nices tossed a rubber ball over the schoolyard fence.
Nices tumbled off a swing and giggled.

name: Sttiaaun
summary: Sttiaaun is a white-haired fighter from a grim possible future who joined a rebel band after leaving a harsh order. Sttiaaun is strong, agile and fast, trained with staff and sword.

feats.scene: Sttiaaun smashed a steel gate off its hinges with a staff blow.
Sttiaaun walked through a barrage of debris and kept her stride.
Sttiaaun overtook a speeding train on foot.

name: Rentiri
summary: Rentiri is a grey-haired operative from a coal-mining family, born in a rural valley and later posted to a quiet office in a lakeside city. Rentiri carries out sealed assignments for an agency.

feats.scene: Rentiri shoved a stuck filing cabinet across a polished floor.
Rentiri took a tumble on icy steps and climbed straight back up.

name: Elnelsto
summary: Elnelsto is a stern commander of a frozen border garrison who can move small objects with his mind and slip into the thoughts of subordinates. Elnelsto died in a strange jungle campaign.

feats.scene: Elnelsto lifted a field gun a hand's width off its carriage with his mind alone.
Elnelsto stood steady on the parade ground through a howling gale.

name: Ntorelen
summary: Ntorelen is a stone-bodied archivist who cannot see light but hears distant sounds across several districts. Ntorelen serves a ring-bearing watch and reads danger from echoes in the dark.

feats.scene: Ntorelen fired a ring beam that sheared the top off a slag heap.
Ntorelen stood inside a shield of green light while rockfall rang off it.
Ntorelen flew out of the cavern at the speed of a rifle shot.

name: Nesanau
summary: Nesanau is a sightless crystal-bodied warden who carries a chiming bell that shapes light into shields and rays. Nesanau was ambushed by hostile star-pirates plotting for their master.

feats.scene: Nesanau rang the bell and a ray of light split a drifting wreck in half.
Nesanau raised a wall of tone-light that stopped a volley of bolts.

name: Sorsernt
summary: Sorsernt is a bald, taloned, feathered brute fed on live prey in a jungle compound, who carries a tiny fork. Sorsernt took revenge on his makers together with two brothers.

feats.scene: Sorsernt tore the door off a steel cage with his talons.
Sorsernt stood through a fire that charred the surrounding trees.
Sorsernt swooped over the canopy faster than a hawk.

name: Liaamitia
summary: Liaamitia is an orange-skinned clone made from borrowed alien blood who dashes through crowds in a crackle of sparks. Liaamitia crews a ship and dodges bullets with ease.

feats.scene: Liaamitia ran into a barricade at full speed and burst it in a shower of sparks.
Liaamitia stood unharmed in a flurry of shrapnel.
Liaamitia crossed a crowded square before the echo of a shot died.

name: Iarnu
summary: Iarnu is a brawny copy of a gangster's thug, grown in a vat for a crime boss and prone to smashing things by hand. Iarnu fell in a fight, soon replaced by another copy.

feats.scene: Iarnu punched through a brick wall during a bank raid.
Iarnu was struck by a delivery truck and shook it off.

name: Neneamo
summary: Neneamo is a smooth-talking impresario who runs underground cage fights among masked powerhouses. Neneamo manipulates a proud brawler with flattery and keeps a dark crowd entertained.

feats.scene: Neneamo slapped a hand on the table and the crowd fell silent.
Neneamo kept her seat as a thrown chair clattered past.

name: Lliriiu
summary: Lliriiu is a shaggy night-wolf who lives with an old bookkeeper in a drafty hill fortress. Lliriiu changes shape under the full glow, claws open doors and tears through timber with great strength.

feats.scene: Lliriiu slashed a heavy oak door to pieces with his claws.
Lliriiu took a spill down the cellar stairs and trotted off.
Lliriiu bounded across the courtyard faster than a racing hound.

name: Teorliu
summary: Teorliu is a blind young man raised in a refugee camp, who trusts his ears more than most people trust their eyes. Teorliu once strummed a lyre for the first time and charmed the court musicians.

feats.scene: Teorliu pulled a stuck cart out of a rut by ear and instinct.
Teorliu stumbled in a crowded market and kept his footing.

name: Vaseveo
summary: Vaseveo is an elder scientist of a deep-sea kingdom who monitors the ocean for trouble and reports to the throne. Vaseveo breathes water, resists crushing pressure and sees in total darkness.

feats.scene: Vaseveo ripped a rusted gate off its pins in the research vault.
Vaseveo rested at the bottom of the trench under thousands of tons of water.
Vaseveo swam past a patrol craft without raising a wake.

name: Nttis
summary: Nttis is a far-future healer-warrior of a royal bloodline who wields a ring of hope-light and protects her twin. Nttis was banished to a ghost realm, escaped with unlikely help and returned to defend the moon fortress.

feats.scene: Nttis fired a lance of hope-light that toppled a siege tower.
Nttis braced behind a ring shield while an invader fleet fired at once.
Nttis crossed the fortress sky in a streak.

name: Sermilrn
summary: Sermilrn is a blond bruiser who entered a fighting tournament on a remote island and fell early. Sermilrn nevertheless lent a hand against the match's cruel hostess.

feats.scene: Sermilrn threw a heavy punch that bent a steel rail.
Sermilrn took a kick to the ribs and rose up laughing.

name: Eocorn
summary: Eocorn is a scientist in a masked disguise who builds her own glider and wears an armoured suit with a belt of gadgets. Eocorn fights with trained martial arts to free her fiance.

feats.scene: Eocorn kicked a smuggler through a stack of packing crates.
Eocorn rolled across a gravel roof after a landing and stood at once.
Eocorn banked her glider across the skyline.

name: Teliarori
summary: Teliarori is a blonde former punk singer turned thief who zips over the coast on spiked roller skates. Teliarori fights with springs in her padding and a quick-drying goo.

feats.scene: Teliarori set a timed bomb in a disco ball and ran for the door.
Teliarori bounced off a wall thanks to her spring padding.
Teliarori rolled down the boardwalk past a line of cyclists.

name: Irneoora
summary: Irneoora is a young student who can warp gravity around her, lifting herself and others into the air. Irneoora was born of a secret soldier and lives with a pet and a crowd of friends.

feats.scene: Irneoora crushed a parked car flat with a pulse of heavy gravity.
Irneoora took a fall from a rooftop and floated down unhurt.
Irneoora rose into the dusk faster than a diving bird.

name: Raule
summary: Raule is a former stunt performer ruined by her own recklessness, now a thief who rides a jet-powered saddle craft through the skyline. Raule loves danger more than money and fences her takings.

feats.scene: Raule crashed her rocket into a billboard and tore it from its frame.
Raule leapt from the craft onto a roof and rolled to her feet.
Raule streaked past the high towers on her rocket.

name: Roramooll
summary: Roramooll is a red-haired, thrill-loving thief who steals fireworks and jewels from the city's wealthy. Roramooll crashed her rocket into a party airship in a comic escapade.

feats.scene: Roramooll sent her rocket into a floating party balloon and burst it.
Roramooll tumbled out of the saddle onto a net and laughed.

name: Ceoamse
summary: Ceoamse is a red-haired fraud who pawns off other researchers' work as his own and brews a shrinking tonic. Ceoamse left his former fiancee and lives in a gloomy laboratory.

feats.scene: Ceoamse hurled a flask of shrinking tonic that left a puddle on the bench.
Ceoamse clung to a shelf as the laboratory shuddered.

name: Lelanco
summary: Lelanco is a failed painter turned art thief who colours moods with prismatic light. Lelanco raced in a deadly carnival contest and was transmuted by an alchemist's stone.

feats.scene: Lelanco flung a prism beam that scorched a circus tent flap.
Lelanco ducked a thrown stool and kept pace.

source_title: Roy G. Bivolo (DC Extended Universe: Midnight Circus)

name: Mianura
summary: Mianura is a bow-wielding vigilante who once gained brute strength from a rage-inducing serum and later trained to fight without it. Mianura hunts criminals across the old harbour and lives for his fiancee.

feats.scene: Mianura drove his fist through a steel locker during a serum rage.
Mianura took a heavy blow from a crowbar and kept climbing.
Mianura raced across a warehouse floor to catch a thief.

name: Tauvaleo
summary: Tauvaleo is a red-haired archer who guards survivors of a ruined world, firing trick shafts against the shambling horde. Tauvaleo stayed behind five years and fell protecting a group of refugees.

feats.scene: Tauvaleo fired an explosive arrow that blew the door off a barricade.
Tauvaleo took a fall from a bridge and rolled behind cover.

name: Auslaval
summary: Auslaval is a green-eyed security chief at an island firm who befriended his employer, urging him to inspire others. Auslaval fell to raiders while defending the base.

feats.scene: Auslaval swung a rifle butt into a raider at the base gate.
Auslaval stood in the gateway through a long volley.

name: Toaust
summary: Toaust is a veteran archer who has been a sidekick, a mercenary and a teacher, burdened by loss and a daughter who needs him. Toaust still shoots trick arrows and keeps his friends close.

feats.scene: Toaust fired an explosive arrow that cracked a concrete pillar.
Toaust fell through a warehouse skylight and walked it off.

name: Nunire
summary: Nunire is a brown-haired crook with one oversized eye who plagued a speedy hero in a short run. Nunire is remembered mainly for a single confrontation.

feats.scene: Nunire swung a heavy sack of loot into a door and dented it.
Nunire fell off a delivery truck and scrambled away.

name: Rneocor
summary: Rneocor is a chemist whose lab accident let him project explosive force through his body, kept in check by a wax suit. Rneocor fights beside a band of patriots, leaving wreckage wherever he goes.

feats.scene: Rneocor detonated himself in a factory yard and levelled a loading shed.
Rneocor stood inside his own blast and walked out scorched but whole.

name: Numarsi
summary: Numarsi is a grey-headed general with a quiet manner, tactical training and a stepfamily who learned a painful secret about a fallen soldier. Numarsi is a respected career officer.

feats.scene: Numarsi threw a trained punch that bent a cadet's practice shield.
Numarsi stood at attention through a long storm on the parade ground.

name: Ntrnil
summary: Ntrnil is a shape-changing visitor from a distant world who wished to live a day in the life of a young heroine, impersonating her until discovered. Ntrnil was stranded and invited to learn local ways.

feats.scene: Ntrnil reshaped her arm into a ram and bumped a door off its latch.
Ntrnil took a tumble from a cliff ledge and landed on her feet.

name: Tauceam
summary: Tauceam is a robotic peacekeeper with glowing photo-cell eyes who patrols a quiet sector with a ring of green will. Tauceam is distrusted by colleagues for rumoured origins as a rogue machine.

feats.scene: Tauceam fired a ring bolt that levelled a pirate outpost wall.
Tauceam endured a point-blank blast that cracked the pavement around him.
Tauceam flew over the sector rim in moments.

name: Celtest
summary: Celtest is a circus contortionist made of springy limbs who quit showbiz to commit crimes and was caught by a mechanical-bodied hero. Celtest tracked his gang back to the tent.

feats.scene: Celtest stretched an arm across a street and snatched a purse.
Celtest bounced off a brick wall and sprang up again.

name: Eonern
summary: Eonern is a rubbery henchman with a long neck who brawls for a kite-flying crook. Eonern is strong and resists blunt blows because his body bounces them off.

feats.scene: Eonern swung a rubber arm that flattened a lamp post.
Eonern shrugged off a thrown bench that bounced off his back.

name: Siniunt
summary: Siniunt is a green-skinned bastard of a warlord who guards a fiery world's streets and bullies those below him. Siniunt was undone by his own arrogance and fell to a single blade.

feats.scene: Siniunt smashed a cell door open with an armoured fist.
Siniunt stood in a rain of falling rubble and brushed it from his helm.

name: Telniuse
summary: Telniuse is a red-skinned woman who is a living ring of crimson flame, whose first outburst killed her foster parents. Telniuse crusades to find her missing father and has fought on both sides.

feats.scene: Telniuse unleashed a crimson blast that vaporised a laboratory wing.
Telniuse waded through a storm of gunfire wrapped in her own flame.
Telniuse rose on a column of flame above the city.

name: Viiaau
summary: Viiaau is a descendant of a long line of gravity masters who bends weight around him as a masked crook. Viiaau fights an uncanny range of heroes in a short run.

feats.scene: Viiaau crushed a delivery van flat with a surge of heavy gravity.
Viiaau landed from a tall wall and floated gently.

name: Iumressa
summary: Iumressa is a monocled spy who killed quietly for an enemy cause during a long war. Iumressa slipped through ballrooms and offices with a polite bow and a hidden pistol.

feats.scene: Iumressa fired a pistol shot through a lamp glass across the room.
Iumressa leapt from a balcony into a carriage and rode away.

name: Antaser
summary: Antaser is a white-eyed, bald brute who drains energy and abilities from anyone he touches. Antaser shows up as a playable menace in a blocky toy-world adventure.

feats.scene: Antaser released absorbed power in a pulse that cracked a street.
Antaser withstood a falling toy-brick tower.

name: Anuaurau
summary: Anuaurau is a purple-skinned family man mutated into a living battery by a warden in a mirror city. Anuaurau was forced to serve a tyrant and charges everything around him with stolen power.

feats.scene: Anuaurau discharged his stored power and knocked down a cell block wall.
Anuaurau took a barrage of shocks and glowed brighter.

source_title: Rudolph Jones (The World of the Knight)

name: Licelrno
summary: Licelrno is a former janitor and soldier exposed to a blast that stripped his humanity, letting him drain life and powers from anyone he touches. Licelrno grows, sprouts claws and copies strengths.

feats.scene: Licelrno hurled absorbed force and levelled a loading dock.
Licelrno stood through a fall of steel girders.
Licelrno rose into the air on a stolen gift of flight.

name: Stniu
summary: Stniu is a mercenary who hurls cars and smashes walls, bulletproof in a growth serum, a parody of old street heroes. Stniu swaps costumes with a flying suit and a lightning suit and once seized another man's body.

feats.scene: Stniu hurled a parked car across a street and cracked a shop front.
Stniu shrugged off a spray of bullets that chewed the wall behind him.
Stniu soared across the block in a winged suit.

name: Iumlen
summary: Iumlen is a distant ancestor from the dawn of a doomed planet, known only as a father of the line that later took a family title. Iumlen is described only in passing by a chronicler.

feats.scene: Iumlen raised a stone beam onto the rafters of the first hall.
Iumlen stood through a sandstorm outside the cave mouth.

name: Valcorne
summary: Valcorne is a young swordsman with a mystic link to lines of power under the land, who fights with a katana and smoke bombs. Valcorne keeps his true self secret from classmates.

feats.scene: Valcorne drew energy from the lines and split a boulder with a single cut.
Valcorne took a thrown beam on his blade and stood fast.

source_title: Rui Aramiya (Batman and the Justice League)

name: Stinornti
summary: Stinornti is a masked villain in a hulking armour that screams sonic waves and gives him great strength. Stinornti fights with a gang of five misfits who work for pay.

feats.scene: Stinornti loosed a sonic scream that shattered a row of shop windows.
Stinornti took a falling girder on his shoulder plate.

name: Nusrosna
summary: Nusrosna is a blur-footed pickpocket who treats every street as a racetrack and every pocket as a prize. Nusrosna once grabbed a glowing trinket she could not operate, and her speed outran her judgment.

feats.scene: Nusrosna slammed a shoulder into a vending cabinet at full sprint and knocked it flat.
Nusrosna skidded across a slick floor into a brick wall and walked away dazed.
Nusrosna crossed a crowded plaza faster than a bus could brake.

name: Sauanuter
summary: Sauanuter is a stooped inventor who bolts together clamps, hovering platforms and portal rigs for a brutal boss. Sauanuter is clever rather than strong, and every trap is built to squeeze harder the more its victim struggles.

feats.scene: Sauanuter cranked a spring-loaded clamp that crushed a steel drum flat.
Sauanuter survived being thrown through a wooden wall of his own workshop.

name: Rnieocin
summary: Rnieocin is a silver-haired racketeer who runs the docks, the dealers and half the night courts through bribes and fear. Rnieocin owns no powers, only a thick ledger of other people's secrets.

feats.scene: Rnieocin swung a heavy cane across a rival's jaw and dropped him.
Rnieocin was knocked down a flight of station stairs and rose still barking orders.

name: Colser
summary: Colser is a smooth council member who sold his town a dirty reactor and silenced a critic with poisoned dust. Colser fears masked watchers more than any law, and his real weapon is a handshake.

feats.scene: Colser shoved a rival aside on the council steps hard enough to bruise her ribs.
Colser was dragged from his office by officers and thrown against a cell door without breaking.

name: Rnsarias
summary: Rnsarias is a pale-haired courier who weaves through gridlock on a battered bicycle, delivering parcels no one else will carry. Rnsarias is cheerful, anonymous and always three minutes from being late.

feats.scene: Rnsarias hurled a heavy parcel over a locked gate and it landed at the doorstep.
Rnsarias tumbled over the handlebars at a junction and stood up laughing.

name: Stiir
summary: Stiir is a dark-haired dispatcher who knows every shortcut, red light and back alley of a crowded metropolis. Stiir directs a ragged pack of runners by radio and rarely leaves the control room.

feats.scene: Stiir slapped a jammed radio cabinet and rattled the door off its hinge.
Stiir was clipped by a swerving taxi and shrugged off the bump.

name: Tercest
summary: Tercest is a bald, red-bearded gang chief who rose through the sewers after a bitter youth and a snake-venom drug that swelled his muscles. Tercest speaks in colours and tastes, and rules the tunnels beneath the city.

feats.scene: Tercest lifted a parked sedan and flung it across a tunnel junction.
Tercest took a speeding van head on and kept walking toward its driver.

name: Nautan
summary: Nautan is a comic-collecting youth who was offered a bright costume by a stranger and briefly believed in it. Nautan quit the stunt the moment the deception came to light.

feats.scene: Nautan swung a toy shield and cracked a plank in half.
Nautan fell from a low rooftop onto a awning and bounced to his feet.

name: Tiastosto
summary: Tiastosto is a freckled runaway who built a raft with two friends and sailed into storms for the thrill of it. Tiastosto talks fast, trusts easily and lands on his feet aboard any deck.

feats.scene: Tiastosto heaved a rope-laden crate onto the rail of a wooden ship.
Tiastosto clung to a broken mast through a night of crashing waves.

name: Rortancer
summary: Rortancer is a robotic hound built around a single carbon core, loyal to the inventor who wound his springs. Rortancer can thicken his own frame to weigh far more than he looks, shrugging off blows aimed at metal bodies.

feats.scene: Rortancer bit through a girder to free a trapped mechanic.
Rortancer thickened his body and let a collapsing gantry fall across his back.

name: Lesllinin
summary: Lesllinin is a press photographer who hovers at the edge of every scoop with a heavy camera and a reporter partner. Lesllinin has no powers, only an eye for the instant a story turns.

feats.scene: Lesllinin swung a camera bag and clipped a purse-snatcher's elbow.
Lesllinin was shoved off a crowded curb and rolled upright holding the camera high.

name: Ransaeon
summary: Ransaeon is a red-haired schoolboy who rallies classmates into a patrol that guards a small campus town. Ransaeon outwits swindlers and bullies with chalk maps, whistles and stubbornness.

feats.scene: Ransaeon threw a snowball so hard it knocked a cap off a distant swindler.
Ransaeon tumbled down a hillside during a chase and kept running.

name: Tatorlas
summary: Tatorlas is a devoted mother who pushes her young son toward the safest cellar while a mob burns her neighbourhood. Tatorlas holds no powers, only the courage to stay behind.

feats.scene: Tatorlas shoved a heavy door shut and wedged it with a chair to shield her family.
Tatorlas stood braced in a doorway as a blast tore down the front of the house.

name: Asivar
summary: Asivar is a small, dark-haired woman who unleashes searing blasts of heat from her palms in the service of a villain syndicate. Asivar is a brittle fighter whose power is out of proportion to her patience.

feats.scene: Asivar melted the door of an armoured truck with a single palm blast.
Asivar was thrown into a parked car and climbed out furious.

name: Llnan
summary: Llnan is a young, purple-eyed traveller who crosses stars with a blade on her hip, chasing the killer of her father. Llnan fights with stubborn honour, plain steel and bare fists.

feats.scene: Llnan cut a wooden post in two with a single draw of her sword.
Llnan took a thrown boulder to the shoulder and rose with her blade still raised.

name: Stiiuros
summary: Stiiuros is a poised mayor who hides a sinister cabal behind ribbon cuttings and charity galas. Stiiuros leads through whispers and deception, and never raises a hand herself.

feats.scene: Stiiuros slapped a rival across the cheek during a tense debate.
Stiiuros was jostled by an angry crowd on the steps and held her composure.

name: Raosto
summary: Raosto is a brown-haired plainclothes investigator who works the cold cases of a sprawling city. Raosto relies on patience, notebooks and a stubborn nose for liars.

feats.scene: Raosto tackled a fleeing suspect over a fence and pinned him.
Raosto took a baton across the ribs during a riot and kept working the scene.

name: Cotica
summary: Cotica is a former trapeze artist who strapped a rocket pack to his back and charges foes head first in a padded helmet. Cotica flies only short hops, but he hits like a thrown anvil.

feats.scene: Cotica rammed his helmet into a van door and folded it inward.
Cotica smashed through a plate-glass window and stood up with the helmet cracked.
Cotica rocketed across a rooftop gap in a single burst.

name: Siaeoni
summary: Siaeoni is a gentle lecturer and physicist who runs a university lab and a home with a wife and daughter. Siaeoni is brilliant, mildly clumsy and learning a little self-defence on the side.

feats.scene: Siaeoni threw a basic jab at a training pad and rocked it back.
Siaeoni tripped on a lab cable and fell against a steel bench unhurt.

name: Aslla
summary: Aslla is a junior lab assistant who delivers equipment and keeps the shelves tidy for a famous researcher. Aslla appears only briefly, running a small errand during a hectic birth.

feats.scene: Aslla slammed a supply cabinet shut with a hip bump.
Aslla was bowled over by a trolley and got up still carrying the package.

name: Ntuvareo
summary: Ntuvareo is a bookish, dark-eyed science student who spends nights in a university lab. Ntuvareo solves problems with calculation and has little interest in fighting.

feats.scene: Ntuvareo shoved a rolling cart across the lab and bruised a colleague's shin.
Ntuvareo fell off a stool onto a tile floor and laughed it off.

name: Laosllo
summary: Laosllo is a tiny vigilante with asthma who shrinks and grows by means of a belt stitched with borrowed circuitry. Laosllo adds heft to his punches by cranking up his own mass, and he searches the microscopic world for a lost mentor.

feats.scene: Laosllo grew his mass and punched a steel locker through its door.
Laosllo took a robotic claw to the chest and stayed upright after a long wheeze.

name: Raamoes
summary: Raamoes is a quiet student, mentored by a size-shifting scientist, who learns the gadgets of a miniature hero trade. Raamoes dreads heights and sports, yet is the one person his teacher trusts.

feats.scene: Raamoes tightened a bolt on a prototype belt and cracked the casing.
Raamoes was thrown against a bookcase in a lab break-in and recovered quickly.

name: Laretum
summary: Laretum is a shrinking adventurer in a bright cartoon world, armed with a belt and a short club for fending off sea monsters. Laretum is sharp in physics and light in mood.

feats.scene: Laretum cracked a coral wall with a swing of his club.
Laretum was tossed by a wave against a reef and bobbed back up grinning.

source_title: Ryan Choi (The Brave and the Bold)

name: Amlleni
summary: Amlleni is a bartender and street fighter who inherited a stolen night-vigil costume after a crash, and now fights for the unavenged. Amlleni trained in the martial arts as a teen and leads a squad of allies.

feats.scene: Amlleni kicked a bolted door off its frame and knocked the guard behind it flat.
Amlleni fell from a fire escape onto a car roof and rolled clear to fight on.

name: Llirnelu
summary: Llirnelu is a van-dwelling programmer-turned-rebel who left clues for the police that they never followed up. Llirnelu fights hard and slips away, sure that official help will not arrive.

feats.scene: Llirnelu drove a flat palm into a guard's chest and sent him sprawling.
Llirnelu was thrown across a convention hall floor and sprang up to escape.

name: Vosrnci
summary: Vosrnci is a teenage swordsman who carries a hoard of old blades, each bound to the memory of an ancestor. Vosrnci seeks revenge on a mountain spirit and treats every weapon as a vow.

feats.scene: Vosrnci swung an ancestral blade and sliced through a thick stone lantern.
Vosrnci was flung into a stack of timber and rose with his grip unbroken.

name: Arraleon
summary: Arraleon is a red-bearded sovereign of a hidden deep-sea realm, strong and fast enough to command a fleet. Arraleon bends currents to his will, and his body is built for crushing depths.

feats.scene: Arraleon heaved a sunken warship upright and set it on a reef.
Arraleon stood untroubled in a trench where the weight of the sea would flatten steel.
Arraleon sliced through open water faster than a dolphin leaping.

name: Siaamosau
summary: Siaamosau is a weary ruler of a downtrodden sea kingdom who schemes to throw off a distant overlord. Siaamosau is built for the deep and leads troops to the brink of war before choosing talk.

feats.scene: Siaamosau hurled a rock wall onto a rival column of soldiers.
Siaamosau waded through crushing depth without so much as a wince.

name: Reresisar
summary: Reresisar is a blond monarch of a sea court, father of a far-off queen, and a reluctant diplomat. Reresisar is a strong swimmer who dries out quickly and relies on advisors for trade deals.

feats.scene: Reresisar slapped a ceremonial gong so hard it split from its frame.
Reresisar took a thrown trident to the arm and bore it without a cry.

name: Raraas
summary: Raraas is a green-eyed matriarch who has outlived centuries by bathing in a pool of restoring liquid and who guides a secretive order from an island fortress. Raraas casts spells from a worn grimoire and never fully dies.

feats.scene: Raraas cast a spell that collapsed a stone tower on a squad of intruders.
Raraas rose from the pool whole after being burned to ash.

name: Sonserora
summary: Sonserora is an ancient deity of raw might who dances while the world falls apart, and who lends his strength to chosen mortals. Sonserora's own power is unrefined and measureless compared with human heroes.

feats.scene: Sonserora stamped on a mountain range and ground its peaks to gravel.
Sonserora stood unmoved as a falling ridge broke over his shoulders.

name: Tenol
summary: Tenol is a lab-grown youth bred by a scientist to be a sidekick of a legendary runner. Tenol sprints with a boasting grin and soon learns that speed alone does not make a leader.

feats.scene: Tenol slammed into a steel door at a full run and burst it open.
Tenol tumbled across a rocky field after a failed turn and bounced up.
Tenol streaked across a valley and left a trail of dust rolling behind.

name: Lasvalta
summary: Lasvalta is a black-haired jackal chieftain with a metal arm in place of a lost limb, scheming to survive on any side. Lasvalta fights with a curved blade and abandons allies the moment the tide turns.

feats.scene: Lasvalta hacked through a wooden gate with his metal arm and blade together.
Lasvalta was hurled through a prison window and sprinted off at once.

name: Arsttia
summary: Arsttia is a fair-haired queen of a sunken city who covers her head and rules with a lightly stern hand. Arsttia calls sharks to her side with her mind and keeps two as pets.

feats.scene: Arsttia flung a goblet at a mutinous captain and split his brow.
Arsttia was struck from a throne room balcony and rose unbowed.

name: Iuulia
summary: Iuulia is a towering hero formed when six friends speak a single word and merge, calling down lightning and flight. Iuulia is mighty but fragile in resolve, and a stolen word can undo it.

feats.scene: Iuulia hurled a lightning-wrapped fist and levelled a city block of shacks.
Iuulia stood unharmed as a hail of siege shells exploded on his chest.
Iuulia flew over a battlefield faster than a jet.

name: Amian
summary: Amian is an orange-skinned, bald patroller who hears the dead and bears a ring of green will. Amian solves slaughters by reading grief, and carries a secret mission to bind a defeated cosmic spirit.

feats.scene: Amian shaped a ring beam that shattered a stone bridge.
Amian held his ground as a collapsing tower of ore rained across him.

name: Ialsir
summary: Ialsir is a red-skinned demon who hosts seven sinful spirits and sets his enemies ablaze for sport. Ialsir lives as a married man in a city of brick row houses.

feats.scene: Ialsir breathed a column of flame that gutted a row of houses.
Ialsir stood in the fire of his own blaze and was only warmed.

name: Nttase
summary: Nttase is a black-eyed assassin and disguise master who trains a successor to follow him. Nttase slips behind even alert targets, plants bombs and prefers a quiet shot to a brawl.

feats.scene: Nttase planted a small charge that ripped open a locked cabinet.
Nttase was thrown from a moving train carriage and rolled to his feet.

name: Sonstror
summary: Sonstror is a white-haired young sorceress, born to necromancers, who was chosen as an enforcer by a council of mages. Sonstror unleashes death charms and carries a grudge against the champion she was meant to replace.

feats.scene: Sonstror flung a death charm that withered a courtyard of trees in a breath.
Sonstror stood in a hail of enchanted knives and was untouched.

name: Reranan
summary: Reranan is a red-eyed fashion model whose body was borrowed by a hungry demoness, or so the story goes. Reranan lured men into a nightclub and may have been bluffing the entire time.

feats.scene: Reranan flung a heavy ashtray across a nightclub and cracked a mirror.
Reranan was struck by a spell and fell without a bruise.

name: Llurnile
summary: Llurnile is a germ-averse quizmaster who mimics every power her foes never imagined and rewrites matter on a whim. Llurnile turned a room of uniforms into clown costumes and linked minds to translate speech.

feats.scene: Llurnile turned a steel office desk into a heap of rubber balloons.
Llurnile was thrown through a glass wall and continued her quiz unfazed.

name: Lennusnau
summary: Lennusnau is a black-haired queen who commands a feared cabal of assassins from a walled desert capital. Lennusnau is ruthless, patient and wins by orders rather than blows.

feats.scene: Lennusnau sliced a rope bridge with a thrown dagger and dropped a patrol.
Lennusnau survived a fall from a palace balcony and walked off.

name: Telrnin
summary: Telrnin is a red-eyed horseback lawman who leads a band of western heroes, powered by a crystal in his chest. Telrnin soars over the plains on its glow and was once captured for his strength.

feats.scene: Telrnin drove a crystal-lit fist into a canyon wall and brought it down.
Telrnin stood unscathed as a rockslide buried the trail around him.

name: Ruslu
summary: Ruslu is a white-haired digger of old ruins who cannot speak after a knife wound. Ruslu rebuilt a vast temple stone by stone and spoke against thieves on the radio when his voice was gone.

feats.scene: Ruslu levered a fallen stone block into place with an iron bar.
Ruslu survived a slashed throat and a bombed radio hall and still worked the next day.

name: Ilernlu
summary: Ilernlu is an arrogant, blue-eyed half-alien zealot who believes that might alone should rule. Ilernlu flies, burns with eye-beams, outruns bullets and shrugs off fire, all in service of a dark sun cult.

feats.scene: Ilernlu fired a pair of eye-beams that razed a fortress of black glass.
Ilernlu stood unmarked as an orbital strike churned the ground around him.
Ilernlu crossed a battlefield in a clap of thunder.

name: Tausiuam
summary: Tausiuam is a being of root and bark who rose from a bog after a long-ago sacrifice and now sits in a council of green spirits. Tausiuam teaches the lesson of loneliness and mentors newer elementals of his kind.

feats.scene: Tausiuam called roots through a road and split a mile of pavement.
Tausiuam stood in a blaze that burned down a grove and regrew from the ash.

name: Unsti
summary: Unsti is a bald, red-eyed hired killer who feeds on his foe's hatred and grows stronger with it. Unsti stretches his limbs, trades blows with flying heroes and fights hardest when his victim is angriest.

feats.scene: Unsti stretched a fist across a street and shattered a shopfront.
Unsti took a flurry of blows from a flying hero and laughed through them.

name: Valreoma
summary: Valreoma is a green-eyed enforcer who takes orders from a crime boss until the boss falls, then takes revenge on a prosecutor. Valreoma settles scores with knives and a bottle of burning spirits.

feats.scene: Valreoma threw a flaming bottle that burst across a stairwell and scorched the walls.
Valreoma was dragged through a station doorway by officers and shrugged it off.

name: Revos
summary: Revos is a digger of ancient ruins who opened a gate to a buried world and was remade into the avatar of a war goddess. Revos wields a ringed staff that heals her wounds and feeds her divine power.

feats.scene: Revos swung the staff and split a stone gatehouse down the middle.
Revos took a monster's claw to the ribs and the staff knit the wound shut.

name: Leros
summary: Leros is a pink-skinned, hairless guardian who wears a glowing ring powered by a battery and a will that does not bend. Leros flies, throws beams and conjures shields and constructs from his ring.

feats.scene: Leros fired a ring beam that cut through an asteroid the size of a block.
Leros raised a shield that held under a meteor shower.

name: Sonseren
summary: Sonseren is a purple-skinned guardian of a space sector who was captured with his comrades to power a villain's weapon. Sonseren bends his ring to fly, fire beams and build barriers.

feats.scene: Sonseren fired a ring beam that melted a hull plate the size of a barn.
Sonseren raised a barrier that shrugged off a barrage of cannon fire.

name: Reoias
summary: Reoias is a desk-bound guardian with six limbs who handles paperwork at the home station of a space police. Reoias can still fly and fire ring beams when called upon.

feats.scene: Reoias fired a ring beam that cracked a station docking arm.
Reoias raised a ring shield against a falling ceiling panel.

name: Inlli
summary: Inlli is a white-eyed, six-limbed sentry who chats with a prisoner in a glass cell and is struck down from behind. Inlli carries a ring that flies and fires, though a surprise blow ended the conversation.

feats.scene: Inlli fired a ring beam that scorched a reinforced wall.
Inlli was clubbed by an intruder's punch and dropped.

name: Allntlan
summary: Allntlan is a hairless, multi-armed ring-bearer who stands with others at the edge of a victory celebration. Allntlan flies and fires beams, but is best known for being present.

feats.scene: Allntlan fired a ring beam that shattered a stone statue.
Allntlan raised a ring shield and stopped a flying slab.

name: Iarico
summary: Iarico is a white-eyed, purple-skinned ringbearer, one of thousands who patrol the stars. Iarico builds from will, hurls beams and flies between systems on a battery's charge.

feats.scene: Iarico fired a ring beam that vaporised a fleet of drones.
Iarico stood under a ring shield as a missile battery exploded around him.

name: Sisestu
summary: Sisestu is a purple-skinned veteran who once led the protocol desk of a star police and now guards a sacred book. Sisestu escaped a captivity and speaks several tongues, his ring carrying him through any void.

feats.scene: Sisestu fired a ring beam that cut a derelict freighter into sections.
Sisestu raised a ring shield as a station's reactor vented around him.

name: Eoceo
summary: Eoceo is a pink, hairless ring-bearer who turns up in a cartoon crowd of heroes. Eoceo flies and fires bolts when the plot demands, and otherwise stands among the throng.

feats.scene: Eoceo fired a ring bolt that blew out a wall of cartoon bricks.
Eoceo raised a green shield and held it against a falling anvil.

name: Riorva
summary: Riorva is a tiny, pink-skinned ring-bearer in a world of oversized heads and toy-sized villains. Riorva flies and zaps in a comic way, and is always home before supper.

feats.scene: Riorva fired a ring zap that popped a crate of balloons.
Riorva was bonked by a giant foam mallet and bounced back up.

name: Stiros
summary: Stiros is a blond, towering lawman from a far world who refused any treatment and fights on brawn and wit. Stiros followed a killer to a lighter planet and found himself astonishingly strong under its gravity.

feats.scene: Stiros ripped a rocket-carrying truck apart with his bare hands.
Stiros took a rocket blast to the chest and kept pursuing his target.

name: Rocelvos
summary: Rocelvos is a green-skinned, yellow-eyed girl cursed so that anyone she cares for meets misfortune. Rocelvos serves a mystic guardian as his apprentice and keeps friends at a distance with a prickly tongue.

feats.scene: Rocelvos tossed a hex that cracked a mausoleum door.
Rocelvos was thrown into a swamp bank by a lumbering clay brute and stood up spitting mud.

name: Rnoro
summary: Rnoro is a shape-shifting salesman from a dark reality who visits dying towns and offers desperate people a bargain they cannot refuse. Rnoro hypnotises, shifts forms, bends phones to his will and turns buyers into demons.

feats.scene: Rnoro turned a coal miner into a hulking demon in a single handshake.
Rnoro took a shotgun blast to the chest and smiled through the smoke.

name: Aniumas
summary: Aniumas is a blue-eyed, green-skinned defender of a distant planet, married for a time to a stranded amnesiac. Aniumas teleports, reads minds, sends memories into others and raises overlapping force fields.

feats.scene: Aniumas hurled a telekinetic wave that flattened a mercenary's war machine.
Aniumas held three overlapping force fields against a mercenary's barrage.

name: Stoiumnel
summary: Stoiumnel is a former dancer who took up crime-fighting with one gloved arm and a media-friendly name. Stoiumnel became a celebrity, tried films, and spent her later years reminiscing about the old days.

feats.scene: Stoiumnel kicked a mugger in the knee and sent him sprawling.
Stoiumnel took a pipe across the back and carried on with the fight.

name: Ntleve
summary: Ntleve is a brown-haired costumed regular at a quirky pub where heroes trade stories and jibes. Ntleve teases the newcomers with his milkman friend until a polite intervention ends the fun.

feats.scene: Ntleve slammed a pint glass on the bar so hard it cracked.
Ntleve fell from a barstool onto the floorboards and finished his pint.

name: Stlorlor
summary: Stlorlor is a black-haired patron of a hero pub who carries a coffin at a solemn funeral. Stlorlor is a loyal friend and has no powers beyond a steady hand.

feats.scene: Stlorlor lifted one corner of a heavy oak casket with a steady grip.
Stlorlor stumbled on the church steps and caught himself before falling.

name: Sevar
summary: Sevar is a black-eyed legionnaire who shrinks to atomic size and hides in plain sight as a rumour. Sevar keeps her full strength even when tiny and uses unarmed fighting styles tuned to each scale.

feats.scene: Sevar shrank to a speck and punched through a circuit board in a single blow.
Sevar was swatted across a lab bench and bounced to her feet.

name: Ianll
summary: Ianll is a black-haired young legionnaire from a far world who shrinks at will and wears a flight ring. Ianll comes from a displaced batch of duplicates, and all of them vanished with a great reset.

feats.scene: Ianll shrank to a speck and jabbed a hole in a power relay.
Ianll withstood a stun bolt that dropped a squad of guards.

name: Tesll
summary: Tesll is a grey-haired mobster who runs a small protection racket in a rainy port city. Tesll holds no powers and dies before his nephew can take over.

feats.scene: Tesll slapped a shopkeeper across the face for being late with his payment.
Tesll was shoved against a brick wall by a rival and stayed on his feet.

name: Numtaures
summary: Numtaures is a restaurateur and rising crime lord who slams the head of a young employee on a table after learning the lad has lied. Numtaures works with a trusted deputy and fears no one except the top boss.

feats.scene: Numtaures slammed a man's head against a dinner table hard enough to crack the wood.
Numtaures took a thrown chair across the shoulders and barked an order.

name: Vostil
summary: Vostil is a dark-haired gangster who admits that his gang is scared of the one person with nothing to lose. Vostil is a minor face in a rogues' meeting, and a mean one.

feats.scene: Vostil shoved a bar stool into a rival's legs and dropped him.
Vostil took a thrown ashtray to the head and snarled.

name: Iunatum
summary: Iunatum is a corrupt attorney who tries to have a metal-bodied hero scrapped for profit. Iunatum argues in court that the machine is a menace, and loses when it saves the room.

feats.scene: Iunatum slammed a thick law book onto a table and cracked the wood.
Iunatum was knocked over by a toppling bench in the courtroom and rose indignant.

name: Oletel
summary: Oletel is a spirit of the wind, once a human engaged to a lantern-bearing hero, and now the voice of an elemental force. Oletel speaks of the clock running out and rides storms across continents.

feats.scene: Oletel called a hurricane that stripped a coastal city's rooftops.
Oletel dispersed into mist as a blast tore through him, then reformed.

name: Resrici
summary: Resrici is a brown-eyed federal agent who investigates a city mayor on suspicion of a double life. Resrici questions, pressures and leverages secrets, with law, surveillance and firearms as her tools.

feats.scene: Resrici fired a service pistol and put a round through a steel door.
Resrici took a thrown chair on the arm and kept her composure.

name: Eonanne
summary: Eonanne is a black-haired inmate who claims she was burned as a witch long ago and resurrected with claws and brute strength. Eonanne hunts the descendants of her killers and breaks out of her cell whenever the walls fail.

feats.scene: Eonanne tore a steel cell door off its hinges and flung it down a corridor.
Eonanne shrugged off a guard's rifle butt to the face.

name: Vavalco
summary: Vavalco is a friendly actor and translator who doubles as an occasional agent in a faraway war. Vavalco travels with allies to a battlefield and brings charm, languages and a pistol.

feats.scene: Vavalco fired a pistol round through a wooden crate and hit the guard behind it.
Vavalco was knocked into a trench wall by a shell blast and got up.

name: Nanveolu
summary: Nanveolu is a grey-eyed, hairless woman from a pocket world where people have spliced their genes with squid to survive. Nanveolu blends into any backdrop, links minds with neighbours and heals fast from injury.

feats.scene: Nanveolu lashed a tentacled arm at a drone and cracked its casing.
Nanveolu was crushed under a fallen beam and healed within minutes.

source_title: Sammy J'onzz (Dark Crisis: Worlds Without a Justice League: Martian Manhunter)

name: Ntteltau
summary: Ntteltau is a cynical, black-haired private eye who walks the rough streets alongside a police chief and a quiet partner. Ntteltau cracks a kidnapping case, interrupts a ritual and puts out a fire with a coat.

feats.scene: Ntteltau punched a cultist in the jaw and dropped him cold.
Ntteltau was thrown against a burning wall and smothered the flames with his coat.

name: Sianatan
summary: Sianatan is a senior newspaperman who is laid off, grows despondent and is rescued from a bridge by a scheming demoness. Sianatan is transformed into a demon and eventually sees through her lies to help foil her.

feats.scene: Sianatan swung a demonic fist and demolished a printing press.
Sianatan stood in the flames of a collapsing newsroom and was unburned.

name: Erronnti
summary: Erronnti is a blue-eyed rifleman who earns his nickname by grinning in the middle of every battle. Erronnti follows a sergeant's orders and carries a rifle, a helmet and a good mood.

feats.scene: Erronnti fired a rifle and punched a round through a sandbag wall.
Erronnti was thrown into a foxhole by a shell burst and came up smiling.

name: Eosiu
summary: Eosiu is a stern military officer who frees a prisoner from a cell on the condition that he serve his country. Eosiu runs a briefing room, gives orders and has a daughter who is a reporter.

feats.scene: Eosiu slammed a folder on a briefing table and rattled the glasses.
Eosiu was knocked off his feet by a blast door and returned to his desk.

name: Sasesvos
summary: Sasesvos is a black-and-white-haired farmer who raises horses and two daughters on a quiet rural spread. Sasesvos has no powers, only calloused hands and a long-held patience.

feats.scene: Sasesvos swung a hay bale onto a wagon in a single heave.
Sasesvos was thrown by a startled horse and got back up laughing.

name: Ialcor
summary: Ialcor is a grey-haired, balding engineer who warns that his project is being sabotaged, and is ignored. Ialcor is silenced before his daughter can learn the truth, his death staged to look like despair.

feats.scene: Ialcor slammed a blueprint tube on a conference table and rattled the cups.
Ialcor stood against a gust of exhaust from a failed launch and kept shouting warnings.

name: Anneta
summary: Anneta is a medic who drives an ambulance with a new partner and lives with a young son and an aging mother. Anneta is drawn into a strange mission inside another being's mind and treats it like a house call.

feats.scene: Anneta forced open a jammed ambulance door with a shoulder shove.
Anneta fell down a flight of stairs carrying a stretcher and kept hold of it.

name: Valsau
summary: Valsau is a patient sniper in a special wartime squad who defends his comrades from prejudice and enemy alike. Valsau was killed alongside a friend when grenades landed in their nest.

feats.scene: Valsau fired a rifle round that dropped a guard on a distant tower.
Valsau was thrown to the ground by a nearby shell and picked up his rifle again.

name: Ntrianus
summary: Ntrianus is a grey-haired veteran who served in a covert unit in a global war and later became a leader of his nation. Ntrianus refuses to unleash a terrible weapon on civilians, though it means facing his best friend.

feats.scene: Ntrianus fired a rifle and punched a round through a sentry post's wall.
Ntrianus was thrown against a stone wall in a firefight and kept moving.

name: Nestau
summary: Nestau is a drifting physicist who once co-founded a failed start-up and now lives tethered to a mirrored dimension. Nestau steps through glass to cross the world while soulless copies of himself hunt him.

feats.scene: Nestau shattered a mirror wall and fired the shards at a pursuer.
Nestau was swarmed by his own copies and fought free.

name: Amlaau
summary: Amlaau is a thief who slips into a vehicle's mirror and steals secrets from a hero's cave. Amlaau uses illusions to fool a crowd of watchers and asks which of two copies is the real one.

feats.scene: Amlaau sliced a safe door open with a mirror-shard blade.
Amlaau was thrown against a garage wall and slipped away through a mirror.

name: Miltaunen
summary: Miltaunen is a green-eyed, white-haired burglar who builds his gadgets from physics and cunning. Miltaunen is a genius thief who plots from a hideout and favours mirrors over muscle.

feats.scene: Miltaunen fired a device that cracked a vault door.
Miltaunen was thrown into a display case and came up still plotting.

name: Iutaval
summary: Iutaval is an officer, nicknamed for his small stature, in a band of wartime heroes. Iutaval is little documented, but he has a strong reputation among his peers for courage.

feats.scene: Iutaval swung a gun butt and knocked a helmet off an enemy.
Iutaval was tossed into a ditch by a shell blast and climbed out cheerfully.

name: Valanuti
summary: Valanuti is a blue-eyed tailor who stitches the suits of a famous crime-fighter and grows bitter at being ignored. Valanuti turns criminal, tears costumes on purpose and sends a booby-trapped one to its owner.

feats.scene: Valanuti swung a heavy iron and bruised a henchman's ribs.
Valanuti was pinned by a steel door and shrugged it off after a groan.

name: Veoniule
summary: Veoniule is a being of dust, thought and borrowed strength, formed in a blast between two worlds. Veoniule wants to live and to help others, but can only gain power when a stronger hero loses it.

feats.scene: Veoniule swung a sand fist and levelled a warehouse.
Veoniule scattered into dust under a blast and reformed seconds later.

name: Rautonval
summary: Rautonval is a drifting figure of fine grit with no memory of where it came from. It turns up beside strangers at a fork in their lives and lends them a brief spark of borrowed might, then scatters on the wind.

feats.scene: Rautonval pours a stranger's stalled cart across a collapsing bridge in one surge of lent strength.
Rautonval is blown apart by a lorry and simply drifts back together a street later.

name: Sturan
summary: Sturan is a pale-haired winged being who fell from grace after a great uprising in the heavens. He bound a captive of higher rank and used him to breed a hidden line of half-born children, nearly all of them failures.

feats.scene: Sturan brings a cathedral-sized tower of white stone down on a besieging host with one wingbeat.
Sturan stands unmarked inside a firestorm that boils a harbour dry.

name: Ronleoes
summary: Ronleoes is a wild child who grew up among a pack of hounds in the northern jungle, and counts a lion and an elephant as friends. He is hunted by a cruel local king for reasons nobody remembers.

feats.scene: Ronleoes drives a hunting blade clean through a charging big cat.
Ronleoes shrugs off a fall from a high branch onto packed earth.

name: Sirin
summary: Sirin is a hulking fairground strongman whose jealousy curdled into violence after a scheming woman whispered in his ear. He ended his own spree by confessing to what he had done.

feats.scene: Sirin drops a heavy sack of grit from the rigging and flattens a man beneath it.
Sirin takes a flying kick to the jaw and stays on his feet.

name: Vacolria
summary: Vacolria is remembered as a masked crimefighter of an earlier age, honoured in a portrait hung in a hall of heroes. Little of her deeds survives except the respect she earned.

feats.scene: Vacolria lays out a cornered thief with a single clean punch.
Vacolria walks away from a rooftop tumble with only a bruise.

name: Nanaunre
summary: Nanaunre was a mystery woman who fought alongside a wartime squad of masked heroes. Her later life went unrecorded, and she appears mostly as a face in the crowd at a tense public rally.

feats.scene: Nanaunre vaults a barricade and floors an armed saboteur with a flying kick.
Nanaunre is thrown through a market stall and gets up swinging.

name: Valcor
summary: Valcor is a cousin of a famous star-themed hero who has no special gifts at all. She relies on a daring costume, quick wit and sharp nerve to distract and outfight criminals, and later raised a family that produced heroes of its own.

feats.scene: Valcor topples a gang leader from a balcony with a perfectly timed shoulder charge.
Valcor rides out a rough tumble down a flight of stairs.

name: Savalrum
summary: Savalrum is a mercenary fighter hired by a flightless-bird-themed crook to help with a string of jewel thefts. Her skill is real, but a team of clever rivals caught her at last.

feats.scene: Savalrum snaps a display case lock and a guard's wrist in the same motion.
Savalrum is pinned by three pursuers and still nearly breaks free.

name: Raeontu
summary: Raeontu is one of the many teachers a young runner learned to fight from. Her name survives only in passing mention, but the lessons clearly stuck.

feats.scene: Raeontu demonstrates a pivot throw and sends her student skidding across the mat.
Raeontu takes a full-speed tackle without giving ground.

name: Tancoti
summary: Tancoti runs the underworld of a harbour district and studied under a legendary master alongside two other prodigies. She is a peak-condition fighter and swordswoman who also manages the books and drives the getaway car.

feats.scene: Tancoti cuts a hanging lamp chain with one sword stroke so it lands on her rival's table.
Tancoti weathers a beating from four enforcers and finishes the conversation upright.

name: Lillini
summary: Lillini is a hired assassin who joined a crowd of villains chasing two famous heroes after an ally was destroyed. She works for a ruthless magnate and keeps her own counsel.

feats.scene: Lillini slips through a crowded lobby and drops a bodyguard before he can turn around.
