Lillini slides down a fire escape under heavy fire and escapes unharmed.

name: Isstni
summary: Isstni was a sworn guardian of one cosmic sector who wielded a ring that shapes light into barriers, blasts and wings. A killer cut his watch short, and his name was added to the hall of the fallen.

feats.scene: Isstni hardens a green beam into a wedge and cracks an asteroid in half.
Isstni holds a glowing shield against a collapsing orbital platform.

name: Liolu
summary: Liolu rules a stern empire where women are forbidden, hiding the fact that the throne holder is herself a woman in disguise. She is a seasoned soldier, tactician and politician who favours a whip and a pistol.

feats.scene: Liolu cracks her lash and disarms a rebel captain across the length of a hall.
Liolu keeps her composure and her feet through a point-blank brawl with palace guards.

name: Varni
summary: Varni is the soft-spoken aide to a scheming doctor, with a brother who shares the same dark line of work. He prefers to wait for his master's plans to bear fruit, and not all of them did.

feats.scene: Varni swings a heavy lab stool at an intruder and sends him reeling.
Varni survives a tumble down a stone stairwell with a few cuts.

name: Neoeoamo
summary: Neoeoamo is a young woman whose mind snapped under a predator's attack and woke with the power to rewrite the rules of what is real. She used it first to make her father face his own failings.

feats.scene: Neoeoamo rewrites a ruined factory district back into untouched meadow with a single thought.
Neoeoamo sits unharmed at the centre of a blast that flattens a city block.

name: Ausnum
summary: Ausnum is a cold, envious crime boss who dealt in narcotics and nursed old grudges against rival families. His greatest mistake was sparing the child he secretly fathered.

feats.scene: Ausnum backhands a debtor across a smoky office.
Ausnum takes a pistol-whip to the cheek and orders the culprit dealt with.

name: Serausiu
summary: Serausiu is a cross-bred being, half human and half shape-shifting alien, built in a lab by two schemers. She was made to fight a young volcano-themed champion.

feats.scene: Serausiu hurls a parked van over a rooftop with both hands.
Serausiu steps out of a collapsed wall with scarcely a scratch.

name: Iaramtes
summary: Iaramtes is a pirate monarch who holds an island ringed with hungry whirlpools and forces captives to dig for blue gems. Giant eagles and loyal guards patrol his domain until a winged hero brought his rule to an end.

feats.scene: Iaramtes hurls a trident that pins a deserter to a dock post.
Iaramtes shakes off a harsh blow from a flying adversary and keeps shouting orders.

name: Stuent
summary: Stuent is a scientist and singer who once merged with an ancient radiant mind and became a creature of light. In that form she could soar and lift enormous loads.

feats.scene: Stuent in her radiant form hoists an overturned lorry and sets it upright.
Stuent passes through a hail of gunfire as a cloud of glowing mist.

name: Tautel
summary: Tautel is a surgeon with a cruel streak who took a dark mantle and clashed once with a winged hero. Her scalpel work is the sharpest thing about her.

feats.scene: Tautel pins a guard's wrist with a surgical clamp and walks past him.
Tautel takes a punch in the stomach and keeps her hands steady.

name: Taniutum
summary: Taniutum was a hero in a parallel timeline and fell in with an archer's team. Rumours say she joined a shadowy order of killers instead of returning home from her travels.

feats.scene: Taniutum drops three armed attackers with a flurry of low sweeps.
Taniutum takes a fall from a moving vehicle and rolls to her feet.

name: Tumcolti
summary: Tumcolti is a politician who was twice elected to lead an island nation, only to be spirited away by a tyrant's successor. Her son fought to find her, and she returned to office afterwards.

feats.scene: Tumcolti slams a heavy gavel and silences a rowdy chamber.
Tumcolti endures long captivity and still stands to speak.

name: Lluvor
summary: Lluvor is a gang member who can wind time back a few heartbeats by speaking a single word aloud. She can also fly, and she has fought hard against an old habit.

feats.scene: Lluvor speaks her word, rewinds three seconds and lands the punch she missed.
Lluvor takes a bullet, rewinds and steps out of its path.

name: Teseontor
summary: Teseontor is a gifted mechanic who extorted the wealthy by mailing booby-trapped stuffed birds. His final plan, a flock of huge hollow machines with burning eyes, ended in one enormous blast.

feats.scene: Teseontor's giant bird bursts and wipes out his hidden workshop and everyone inside it.
Teseontor scrambles up a hillside just ahead of the shockwave.

name: Rnsto
summary: Rnsto is a research scientist at a high-tech laboratory. She spends her days among instruments and screens rather than fights.

feats.scene: Rnsto shoves a trolley of equipment into an intruder's path.
Rnsto shelters under a bench while the ceiling rains plaster.

name: Autiamo
summary: Autiamo is a laboratory worker in a world where machines turned on their makers. Not much more is recorded about her.

feats.scene: Autiamo hurls a toolbox at a rogue drone and dents its casing.
Autiamo ducks behind a console as sparks fly overhead.

name: Miteium
summary: Miteium is a teenager in a small farming town who struggles with a hard home life. She finds a kindred friend among the neighbours and slowly begins to look forward to things again.

feats.scene: Miteium shoves open a stuck barn door with her shoulder.
Miteium lands badly from a school fence and walks it off.

name: Terlenus
summary: Terlenus is a beat officer who helped seal off a graveyard after a killer left another victim there. She is steady, observant and good at piecing together clues.

feats.scene: Terlenus tackles a fleeing suspect over a low cemetery wall.
Terlenus takes a baton to the arm and holds her post.

name: Reosarlle
summary: Reosarlle is a police veteran in a gloomy crime story, divorced from a senior officer and mother to a daughter. She moves through a rain-soaked city of secrets.

feats.scene: Reosarlle cuffs a struggling pickpocket against a wet brick wall.
Reosarlle shrugs off a shove into a parked car.

name: Stvist
summary: Stvist is a farm housewife who watched a small rocket fall from the sky and kept the baby inside as her own. She helped her adopted son understand his gifts and sewed his first costume from the blankets he arrived in.

feats.scene: Stvist lifts a sack of feed onto the cart in one heave.
Stvist keeps her footing in a roaring prairie windstorm.

name: Tornoar
summary: Tornoar was a farmhand's wife who lost three babies and believed the foundling from a fallen craft was her own. She died proud of the powerful son who ended a long war.

feats.scene: Tornoar swings a heavy pail of milk onto the porch rail.
Tornoar survives a brutal labour that nearly claimed her life.

name: Torce
summary: Torce is an elderly nanny with grey hair and an ancient family line stretching back to a pharaoh. She lived in a quiet city, and her ghost was reused after she died.

feats.scene: Torce hoists a toddler and a hamper of laundry together up a stoop.
Torce keeps going through a night of fever and no sleep.

name: Oltia
summary: Oltia is a teenager who once ran with a criminal gang as a young sidekick. He turned on his bosses and helped the heroes put them away, and he is happiest in the water.

feats.scene: Oltia whips a wet towel across a thug's face and sprints off.
Oltia dives from a pier into shallow water and surfaces laughing.

name: Ceoriia
summary: Ceoriia is a green-eyed exile from a lost homeland who joined a band of shadow-hunters in a far future century. She carries a staff that fires bolts of raw energy.

feats.scene: Ceoriia sends a bolt from her staff through a stone gate and cracks it in two.
Ceoriia raises her staff and holds back a falling beam.

name: Lunaan
summary: Lunaan is a hardened veteran of the sea corps with thirty years of service, who led a younger comrade across a distant island during a huge war. He and his squad gave their lives holding the line in the last days of the fighting.

feats.scene: Lunaan empties a submachine gun into an oncoming charge and breaks it up.
Lunaan shrugs off a shrapnel graze and keeps moving up the beach.

name: Renrnti
summary: Renrnti is a government agent who lost a hand during a raid on a mountain stronghold and now wears a metal prosthesis that can shoot bullets. He leads an extradition squad.

feats.scene: Renrnti fires his prosthetic hand and drops a rooftop sniper.
Renrnti keeps leading his team after an explosion tears off his arm.

name: Ntstti
summary: Ntstti is the captain of a royal household guard on an undersea station, a deep-water native adapted to the crushing pressure of the abyss. He sees perfectly in the black and hears far better than any human.

feats.scene: Ntstti swings a trident and bats a patrol sub off course.
Ntstti walks across the trench floor where the water pressure would flatten a steel hull.

name: Niucol
summary: Niucol is a zealot born in a distant future who idolizes his fearsome grandfather. He travels back in time wielding a stolen gauntlet that summons crystalline beasts, aiming to keep a fallen order alive.

feats.scene: Niucol fires his gauntlet and vaporises a drifting freighter with a crystalline beam.
Niucol stands unharmed as a shielded station buckles around him.

name: Iullose
summary: Iullose is a bald mind-reader and the strongest psychic his people have ever produced. His thoughts can bend entire crowds to his will from a great distance.

feats.scene: Iullose projects a single psychic shockwave that silences a whole stadium.
Iullose shrugs off a blow to the head that would kill an ordinary person.

name: Lluosa
summary: Lluosa is a hired bodyguard who worked out her employer's hidden double life and was trained by him in return. She rose to become a senior operative in a government chess-themed agency.

feats.scene: Lluosa drops a would-be assassin with a flurry of trained strikes on a rainy rooftop.
Lluosa grits her teeth through a tumble across a skylight and still reaches her target.

name: Netelau
summary: Netelau is an evil double split off from a young hero by a strange glowing mineral. She had every power and memory of her original self, and was tougher than her, until her time ran out.

feats.scene: Netelau tears a ridge from its foundations and hurls it into a sea.
Netelau takes a blow that levels a hillside and does not flinch.

name: Anucor
summary: Anucor is a horned warrior from a ringed world who was enslaved on a red planet and forced into trial by combat. He fought a masked champion on horseback, riding backwards, and yielded once disarmed.

feats.scene: Anucor cuts a rival slave's shield in two with one sword stroke.
Anucor takes a saddle-high fall in the arena sand and stands again.

name: Iancinolu
summary: Iancinolu is a sinister sorcerer who hurls bolts of eldritch force, moves objects with his mind and wraps himself in protective barriers. He once served on a team of expendable convicts.

feats.scene: Iancinolu blasts a crumbling farmhouse into splinters with a bolt of dark force.
Iancinolu raises a barrier and shrugs off a speeding truck.

name: Eorralnt
summary: Eorralnt is a half-demon who passes as a newspaper tycoon by day and rules a smoldering netherworld by night. He is the offspring of a powerful wizard, and he shares a tangled bond with a fiery sibling.

feats.scene: Eorralnt raises a tide of black flame that swallows a mountain range.
Eorralnt stands unharmed beneath a collapsing fortress of molten stone.

name: Rivasia
summary: Rivasia is the towering overlord of a dark realm below the mortal world, able to overpower beings from other dimensions. He crosses between worlds at will and keeps a captured trickster as a prized plaything.

feats.scene: Rivasia crushes a rival demon's hall into a ball of cinders with one clenched fist.
Rivasia wades through a storm of searing light and shrugs it off.

name: Talialeo
summary: Talialeo is the last of the goat-legged woodland folk, a cowardly but loyal friend who follows brave companions on their quests. His reed pipe can stir feelings from desire to dread in anyone who hears it.

feats.scene: Talialeo plays a shrill tune that sends a squad of soldiers fleeing in terror.
Talialeo tumbles down a rocky slope and bounces up whimpering but whole.

name: Naialle
summary: Naialle is a white-haired attorney who inherited his seat at a law firm from his father. He quickly worked out the secret behind his closest friend's double life.

feats.scene: Naialle slams a thick case file onto the desk and ends the argument.
Naialle sits through a twelve-hour hearing without a break.

name: Aulla
summary: Aulla is a hairless war deity from a dark reflection of reality who fights for power, profit and blood. She wields a whip of flame, stirs bloodlust in others and can swell to enormous size.

feats.scene: Aulla cracks her whip of fire and carves a canyon of glass through a plain.
Aulla stands in the heart of a collapsing citadel and walks out unburned.

name: Siasertor
summary: Siasertor is an armoured, silent warrior serving a dark sun cult, a twisted echo of a heroic flier from a ruined reality. It is unclear whether his might comes from his body or from his plating.

feats.scene: Siasertor sears a mountain face with a beam from his eyes and leaves it glowing.
Siasertor plows through a barrage of missiles without a dent in his armour.
Siasertor crosses a valley in a blink with a crack of thunder.

name: Tivauni
summary: Tivauni is a self-proclaimed god of speed from a highland monastery who can cloak himself in a still field, lend velocity to others and mend wounds almost instantly. Followers worship him as a prophet.

feats.scene: Tivauni hands a boulder his own velocity and it levels a stone gatehouse.
Tivauni sits inside a field of stillness as a bunker collapses around him.
Tivauni runs across a plateau faster than a rifle round can follow.

name: Vecarren
summary: Vecarren is a blue-skinned elder of an ancient order who was banished for daring to feel, and who then helped trap a fearsome entity of dread. She foresaw a coming war of coloured lights.

feats.scene: Vecarren seals a screaming beast of fear inside a battery by sheer will.
Vecarren stands calm as a star-hot storm washes over her.

name: Salen
summary: Salen is a purple-skinned survivor who was chosen by a ring of living light after helping a whole world flee. She fights with a quarterstaff and a ring that shapes barriers, blasts and wings.

feats.scene: Salen casts a white bolt that splits a drifting boulder into gravel.
Salen raises a glowing shield against a rolling wall of debris.

name: Resinami
summary: Resinami is a pink-skinned handmaiden and adviser in a royal court who guards its customs and etiquette. She is a quiet keeper of tradition rather than a fighter.

feats.scene: Resinami slaps aside a clumsy courtier's grasping hand.
Resinami holds a stiff bow through an hour of ceremony.

name: Lareove
summary: Lareove is a green-skinned underwater radical who fought alongside his brother in a violent movement. His body is built for the deep, with great strength, thick hide and the gift of silent speech.

feats.scene: Lareove tears a hatch from a patrol boat with bare hands.
Lareove shrugs off a depth-charge blast beside a trench wall.

name: Amvaaus
summary: Amvaaus is a pitiable demon lord born as a goat after a cruel prank on his father. He loves his half-brother dearly, yet bears every sin of his burning homeland and rules a lonely keep.

feats.scene: Amvaaus stamps his hoof and a black crevasse splits a plain for a mile.
Amvaaus endures an avalanche of brimstone without bleating.

name: Leonumiu
summary: Leonumiu is a hidden elder of a cosmic order who raised a dead criminal and fitted him with a ring of dark power. Her identity and goals remain a mystery.

feats.scene: Leonumiu raises a fallen man from his grave with a gesture.
Leonumiu stands unscathed in a burning chapel.

name: Steonte
summary: Steonte is a ruthless hunter that commands swarms of flesh-eating beetles to change shape or strip a victim to the bone. When scattered, it simply reforms.

feats.scene: Steonte sends a swarm that strips a captive to bare bone within seconds.
Steonte is blown into a thousand pieces and gathers itself whole again.

name: Reresllo
summary: Reresllo is an ancient sorcerer freed when a small pyramid was moved across an ocean. He calls down lightning, makes fire, reads minds in limited fashion and wears an aura that destroys other spellcasters.

feats.scene: Reresllo calls a lightning bolt that splits an old oak and scorches the ground around it.
Reresllo shrugs off a hail of bullets inside his shimmering aura.

name: Sanse
summary: Sanse is a hairless mechanical being of alien make that menaced a pair of dueling heroes. Its inner workings and motives remain a puzzle.

feats.scene: Sanse rips a lamp post out of the street and swings it like a club.
Sanse walks through a wall of gunfire and leaves only dimples in its shell.

name: Lloarseo
summary: Lloarseo is a scarecrow-masked agent of a wartime regime who stalks a foreign countryside. His career was short and he met a swift end.

feats.scene: Lloarseo flings a pitchfork at a fleeing messenger.
Lloarseo takes a rifle-butt to the shoulder and keeps stalking.

name: Nasar
summary: Nasar is a white-haired thief in a scarecrow mask who also dabbles in occult lore. He lurks around a craggy city and mumbles to himself.

feats.scene: Nasar snatches a purse from a stall and vaults a low fence.
Nasar tumbles off a rooftop into a cart of hay unharmed.

name: Lanteore
summary: Lanteore is a blond criminal who styled herself after a sea maiden in vivid red. She crossed paths with a masked hero once and was not seen again.

feats.scene: Lanteore flicks a dagger across a pier and pins a coat to a post.
Lanteore dives off the dock and swims clear of a patrol.

name: Niill
summary: Niill is a white-eyed villain with a command over growing plants who was active in a distant land. Her life ended in a short, bloody run of events.

feats.scene: Niill makes thorny vines burst through a paved yard and wrap a truck.
Niill cloaks herself in a thicket and shrugs off a volley of shots.

name: Sturaulor
summary: Sturaulor is a gleeful armoured villain whose suit conjures far more weaponry than his enemies could ever need. He boasts about a grisly keepsake and delights in suffering.

feats.scene: Sturaulor conjures a battery of cannons from his suit and levels a warehouse.
Sturaulor shrugs off a hail of laser fire inside his plating.

source_title: Scarlet Scarab (The Brave and the Bold: Deep Cover for Batman!)

name: Iaesent
summary: Iaesent is a bald, flamboyant executioner and mid-ranking enforcer in an order of killers, devoted to its leader. He carries a long, curved blade.

feats.scene: Iaesent swings his curved blade and cleaves a stone pillar's corner off.
Iaesent takes a bruising blow and laughs through it.

name: Miserna
summary: Miserna is a masked criminal who terrorised a foggy capital until a pair of visiting vigilantes caught him. He refused to talk, and it cost him his life.

feats.scene: Miserna shoves a constable into a lamp post and flees over rooftops.
Miserna takes a cudgel to the ribs and keeps silent.

name: Torria
summary: Torria was a bloodsucking raider who plundered hospital supplies during a war on a distant peninsula. His gang was staked down by a caped hero.

feats.scene: Torria drags a sack of stolen blood bags across a ward floor with one arm.
Torria is shot in the chest and snarls without falling.

name: Sevasmil
summary: Sevasmil is a purple-haired geneticist who founded a biotech firm that offers customers more vigorous lives. Her parents were both infamous killers, and she was raised apart from them.

feats.scene: Sevasmil hurls a lab stool at a trespasser and sends him sprawling.
Sevasmil walks out of a lab fire with only singed cuffs.

name: Tiuliuau
summary: Tiuliuau is a muscle-bound thug who cannot be hurt by any blow he sees coming. The gift fails entirely against a surprise strike, which is how he was beaten.

feats.scene: Tiuliuau throws a punch that buckles a steel locker.
Tiuliuau watches a speeding sedan hit him and brushes it off.

name: Ernosan
summary: Ernosan is a green-skinned, red-eyed survivor from a people wiped out by a cruel experiment. She and her kin hunted the makers who sold the procedure to a ruthless syndicate.

feats.scene: Ernosan hurls a console into a cell door and bends it open.
Ernosan has a wound close within moments of a laser slash.

name: Amnineo
summary: Amnineo is an eyeless, hairless criminal with an odd body who was kept in an asylum for the unstable. He is a menace to the vigilantes who track him.

feats.scene: Amnineo bends the bars of a cell with his hands and slips out.
Amnineo is struck by a baton and does not react.

name: Nusvau
summary: Nusvau is a grey-haired convict who was freed to join a pirate crew. His career ended when a sea-king boarded their ship and snapped his spine over a knee.

feats.scene: Nusvau swings a boarding hook and snags a sailor's belt.
Nusvau is flung against the mast and gets up cursing.

name: Erllll
summary: Erllll is a black-haired criminal who schemed against a young boy hero in a bright cape. His plans were many and rarely worked.

feats.scene: Erllll tosses a sack of loot into a waiting van and slams the door.
Erllll falls off a fire escape and limps into an alley.

name: Eorirni
summary: Eorirni is a member of a crew of heavy-equipment crooks who tear down buildings for fun and profit. He wields the shovel-like arm of a machine.

feats.scene: Eorirni swings his heavy scoop and caves in a brick shed.
Eorirni is hit by a slab of concrete and brushes the dust off.

name: Lloest
summary: Lloest is the head of a terror outfit that styles itself after a stinging creature of the desert. She is cold, calculating and rarely seen.

feats.scene: Lloest drops a gloved hand onto a table and a bomb is armed.
Lloest walks through a smoky street unscratched.

name: Oleti
summary: Oleti is a masked criminal who clashed with a squadron of daring pilots. He took a stinging beast as his emblem.

feats.scene: Oleti shoves a crate off a ledge onto a pursuer.
Oleti falls onto a tarp from a loading dock and sprints on.

name: Tortiam
summary: Tortiam is a brown-haired crook who ruled a corner of a big metropolis and clashed with a boy dressed in blue. He took a stinging beast for his mark.

feats.scene: Tortiam knocks a newsboy aside and bolts down an alley.
Tortiam is clubbed in a scuffle and still slips the net.

name: Tervanu
summary: Tervanu is a ruthless schemer who murdered a scientist to steal a ray that disintegrates matter, then used it to sink a liner and level government buildings. He tried to start a global war, and his airship was shot down.

feats.scene: Tervanu fires his ray across the harbour and a liner dissolves into foam.
Tervanu sways on his airship deck as fighters strafe it.

name: Veleote
summary: Veleote was a salt-flat surveyor who woke one dawn as the living pull of the tides, bending weight and iron wherever they walked. Veleote now guards the shoreline from anyone who would strip it bare, and grows heavier and stronger as the sea swells.

feats.scene: Veleote dragged a whole harbor district's worth of steel cranes and hulls into a single crushing heap.
Veleote stood unmoved while a collapsing sea wall buried the entire quay around them.

name: Ammiallu
summary: Ammiallu is a steady rifleman who comes from a long line of soldiers and carries that weight quietly. Ammiallu fights with discipline, cover and patience rather than any gift.

feats.scene: Ammiallu put a single rifle round through a distant engine block to stop a convoy.
Ammiallu took a hard fall down a rubble slope and kept moving.

name: Ranleotiu
summary: Ranleotiu is a former bar guitarist whose hands swelled to enormous size, ending a music career and starting a brawling one. Ranleotiu hits like a falling beam and hates how clumsy the same hands are with small things.

feats.scene: Ranleotiu brought both fists down on a parked truck and folded it flat.
Ranleotiu shrugged off a van that rolled into them at speed.

name: Sasau
summary: Sasau is the failed product of a lab that spliced a man with something not of this world, leaving a twitchy, clawed hunter that mends quickly. Sasau is ashamed of the face that came with the change.

feats.scene: Sasau raked a steel door off its hinges in a single lunge.
Sasau walked away from a rooftop fall with the wounds closing as they went.

name: Roncor
summary: Roncor is a reckless test pilot turned crook who flies a stolen hot-rod jet low over rooftops for pay. Roncor has no special gift beyond nerve and a bad attitude.

feats.scene: Roncor clipped a rooftop water tank with a wing and sent it crashing into the street.
Roncor climbed out of a hard crash landing with only bruises.

name: Iuent
summary: Iuent is a stage fright specialist who can warp into a screeching winged horror at will. Iuent flies over crowds and shatters walls with a single shriek, though the shape comes with a monstrous face.

feats.scene: Iuent let out a scream that cracked a concrete wall into rubble.
Iuent shook off a pumpkin-sized blast to the face and kept flying.

source_title: Scream Queen (The Brave and the Bold)

name: Corriaanu
summary: Corriaanu wears a bone-white mask and carries a bundle of pipes that howl at painful pitches. Corriaanu is a one-time rooftop menace whose noise can shake windows from their frames.

feats.scene: Corriaanu blasted a note that burst every pane on a city street.
Corriaanu absorbed a hard tackle without dropping the pipes.

name: Nausiaoll
summary: Nausiaoll is a loud, impatient night creature, newly made and always hungry. Nausiaoll rides a stolen motorbike with her sisters and cannot hide her appetite for long.

feats.scene: Nausiaoll tore the wheel off a bike with her bare hands and used it to batter a door.
Nausiaoll climbed back up after being dragged along gravel behind a speeding bike.

name: Stauti
summary: Stauti is a young sketch artist who draws the neighborhood's trouble in ink and sells it for pennies. Stauti has no gift but a sharp eye and a quick pen.

feats.scene: Stauti shoved a rival's easel over in a fit of temper.
Stauti took a hard knock from a falling shelf of sketchbooks and finished the page.

name: Vamico
summary: Vamico is a red-skinned engineered brute raised in secret and set loose on an unsuspecting town. Vamico wrecked streets for days and fought an entire team of masked champions to a standstill.

feats.scene: Vamico drove a fist through the front of a brick bank and tore the vault door free.
Vamico stood up out of a collapsed warehouse that had been dropped on him.

name: Vaulliri
summary: Vaulliri is a swindling wizard who lives off a stolen focusing jewel that multiplies whatever spell passes through it. Vaulliri is helpless against open flame.

feats.scene: Vaulliri funneled a stream of raw spellfire through the jewel and flattened a fortress wall.
Vaulliri shrugged off a thrown chair before the jewel burst into flame in his grip.

name: Riaaun
summary: Riaaun is a small, loyal sea-beast who carries a young diver through coral canyons. Riaaun swims fast but has no other weapon than its willingness.

feats.scene: Riaaun butted a lurking eel away from its rider.
Riaaun took a hard knock against a reef and swam on.
Riaaun darted through the current to catch up with its rider.

name: Teraultis
summary: Teraultis is a one-handed, one-eyed deep-water raider who hauls a barbed fork and talks to sharks. Teraultis is stronger and tougher than any dockside brawler and trains for hours in the dark.

feats.scene: Teraultis hurled the fork through a steel trawler's hull and sank it.
Teraultis walked out from under a falling shipping container without a scratch.

name: Torrotel
summary: Torrotel is a swamp-born killer who howls at the tide and hunts from the water. Torrotel grudges anyone who turns him down and tracks them across the seas.

feats.scene: Torrotel leapt from the surf and bent a steel railing with his jaws.
Torrotel took a point-blank burst of gunfire and kept coming.

name: Sonaes
summary: Sonaes is a hired killer that wears the face of the last soul it ate. Sonaes lives in rage and hunger and pays for each new face with the loss of the last.

feats.scene: Sonaes burst from a human shape into a fanged brute and snapped a dock beam in two.
Sonaes took a hard fall from a deck into the black water without slowing.

name: Olenen
summary: Olenen is a mercenary captain who turns any scrap he touches into a loaded weapon. Olenen leads a crew of paid guns and arms them on the spot.

feats.scene: Olenen reshaped a drawer of nails into a rattling machine gun and emptied it.
Olenen took a hard punch in the ribs and kept firing.

name: Irnrasir
summary: Irnrasir is a high schooler whose body began draining heat after a night in a freezing lake. Irnrasir turns warmth into frost around them and cannot stop hungering for more.

feats.scene: Irnrasir drew all the heat out of a small lake and froze it solid in one night.
Irnrasir took a hard throw into a frozen pond and stood back up.

name: Rnlusi
summary: Rnlusi is a hardened guard rebuilt with metal limbs and fed a cold doctrine of order. Rnlusi is later broken by a puppeteer who wears his sorrow like a coat.

feats.scene: Rnlusi crushed a patrol car's door with a servo-driven fist.
Rnlusi took a point-blank shotgun blast on his armored chest.

name: Inutornt
summary: Inutornt is a tycoon who bought a predator's gift from a plant deity and wears it as a luxury. Inutornt hunts as a clawed, fanged athlete far faster and stronger than his frame suggests.

feats.scene: Inutornt leapt across an alley and tore a steel gate from its frame.
Inutornt slid down a glass roof and rose with no cuts.
Inutornt sprinted down a wharf faster than a car.

name: Seillval
summary: Seillval is the eighth ruler of a blood-red church that serves a demon in the deep. Seillval preaches fear and obedience from a stone altar and holds power only through the murder of a parent.

feats.scene: Seillval struck a kneeling worshipper across the altar in a show of fury.
Seillval survived a knife strike from his own son before the second blow.

name: Leoteile
summary: Leoteile is a soulless sorcerer, raised by a bargain he never agreed to, and works to prove he is better than his blood. Leoteile spends his nights in a cluttered workshop chalking sigils for those who need them.

feats.scene: Leoteile hurled a spiral of soul-fire that bored through a parking garage.
Leoteile took a heavy blow from a demon's claw and rose, still chanting.

name: Seciosa
summary: Seciosa is a gifted soul-caster who turned bitter when no one helped his dying child. Seciosa now bends borrowed spirits to his will and thinks of the world as a debt he is owed.

feats.scene: Seciosa unleashed a flood of spirit fire that flattened a whole block of tenements.
Seciosa walked through a rain of shrapnel unmarked.

name: Sernteium
summary: Sernteium is a high-society conjurer who lets his rage out through brews and murder. Sernteium is cursed into a withered tree-thing that returns to flesh only when rain falls.

feats.scene: Sernteium swung a rooted arm and caved in a stone mantel.
Sernteium took a thrown cauldron against his bark and did not fall.

name: Nulorau
summary: Nulorau is a ruthless heir who runs a family laboratory and puts profit before safety. Nulorau relies on engineers and a hulking machine that bears his name.

feats.scene: Nulorau signed away a whole warehouse with a flick of a pen and a push of a lever.
Nulorau took a hard shove in a boardroom and stayed smiling.

name: Telllurum
summary: Telllurum is a silver-tongued agent for a militia of the future-minded who works the capital's halls. Telllurum prefers whispering a lie to throwing a punch.

feats.scene: Telllurum slipped a knife between two guards in a crowded hall.
Telllurum took a hard shove down a flight of steps and stood up smiling.

name: Liura
summary: Liura is a teenage raider who fights through a bulbous helmet that sees through walls and spits energy spheres. Liura inflates the glowing eye to lift off the ground and float above the fray.

feats.scene: Liura sealed a hero in a glowing sphere and left it hanging above a mall atrium.
Liura raised a shimmering shell that stopped a hurled vending machine.

name: Rancisau
summary: Rancisau is a famed weapon-builder from a distant world who builds bombs able to crack planets. Rancisau is picky about her buyers and wears a yellow ring only to remain safe among the dangerous.

feats.scene: Rancisau finished a blink-bomb whose detonation tore a whole world apart.
Rancisau waved off a tossed wrench in her cluttered workshop.

name: Oracolvi
summary: Oracolvi was a rebel who swallowed her tyrant's ring and died for it in a camp. Oracolvi rose from the grave with the ring's glow and woke a silent army of the dead against him.

feats.scene: Oracolvi raised a legion of the dead and brought down a palace wall on the despot.
Oracolvi endured a long beating without giving up the hidden ring.

name: Sulorle
summary: Sulorle is a dark witch with the body of a far-off people and a cult at her back. Sulorle bends shadowy forces and moves with strength and speed most cannot hope to meet.

feats.scene: Sulorle called down a cloud of black fire that levelled a whole city block's roofs.
Sulorle stood in a blast that melted a street and walked out whole.

name: Losiasu
summary: Losiasu is an ambitious sorceress who lifts a glittering pyramid to power her spells. Losiasu banishes foes into a gray void and comes undone by her own trap.

feats.scene: Losiasu lifted the pyramid and hurled a storm of violet light that shattered a hillside.
Losiasu took a thrown candlestick on the shoulder and laughed.

name: Stiiulas
summary: Stiiulas is a lunar goddess of grace who lends her blessing to a chosen young champion. Stiiulas rarely fights herself and prefers to guide from the sky.

feats.scene: Stiiulas poured a river of silver blessing through a young champion and lit a mountain pass.
Stiiulas stood unhurt in the collapse of a marble hall.

name: Neont
summary: Neont is an ancient titan who crosses the night sky each evening and lights the dark with a soft glow. Neont is kin to the dawn and the sun and weeps golden fruit when grief strikes.

feats.scene: Neont set a whole valley aglow with a single sweep of her silver light.
Neont stood through the fall of a temple roof without a mark.

name: Sestoium
summary: Sestoium is a polished jewel thief with a green stare and a taste for rooftops. Sestoium keeps her hands quick and her promises loose, and has no gift beyond skill.

feats.scene: Sestoium swung a handbag into a guard's jaw and vanished through a window.
Sestoium dropped two stories onto an awning and sprang up laughing.

name: Tonilrn
summary: Tonilrn is a rooftop burglar thrown back to an age of castles and shuriken. Tonilrn cracks a long leather lash and flows over tile roofs with practiced grace.

feats.scene: Tonilrn snapped her lash around a sentry's blade and yanked it free.
Tonilrn rolled out of a long drop onto thatch and stood.

name: Auscolva
summary: Auscolva is a dancer wronged by wealthy men, cursed to grow claws and fur under a full sky. Auscolva hunts those who hurt her and keeps her softer nature hidden from the one man she loves.

feats.scene: Auscolva ripped a locked gate from a zoo cage in the dark of the night.
Auscolva took a volley of pistol rounds and kept running.

name: Sesvese
summary: Sesvese was the quiet younger sibling of a famous masked thief and raised a daughter alone. Sesvese died young at a criminal's hands, remembered only in a few bitter words.

feats.scene: Sesvese slapped a thug's hand away from her child's coat.
Sesvese stayed on her feet after a hard shove into a door.

name: Titirtiu
summary: Titirtiu is a thief given a glowing ring by a scheming warlord and sent to kill a lantern-bearer. Titirtiu is corrupted by the gift and slips away when beaten.

feats.scene: Titirtiu fired a violet beam from the ring that split a gantry in half.
Titirtiu took a green blast to the chest and fled still standing.

name: Lorno
summary: Lorno is a cabaret performer who dresses in cat ears for her act and quietly feeds tips to a young detective. Lorno meets a violent end at the hands of a gang boss.

feats.scene: Lorno hurled a shoe at a heckler on the stage.
Lorno took a hard slap and carried on dancing.

name: Tecoltes
summary: Tecoltes is a burglar bitten by a wolf-shaped fiend who turns into a swift, strong cat-creature after dark. Tecoltes hides among her real cats and rises faster than any watcher expects.

feats.scene: Tecoltes kicked a snarling wolf-thing across a bridge deck.
Tecoltes survived a long fall into the harbor and swam to shore.

name: Osnelnu
summary: Osnelnu is a riverside-city thief who lifted a family heirloom as a keepsake of a broken romance. Osnelnu slips across the rooftops with nine lives of luck and feeds secrets to a rival.

feats.scene: Osnelnu threw the necklace case at a pursuer's face and bounded over a chimney.
Osnelnu landed hard on slate and kept running.

name: Llucorall
summary: Llucorall is an aging widow who once stole for survival and then fought beside a masked partner. Llucorall raised a daughter between shifts and never fully settled down.

feats.scene: Llucorall snapped her lash around a mugger's wrist from across the street.
Llucorall took a rooftop tumble in stride and complained about her knees.

name: Sonil
summary: Sonil is a reformed master thief at peak human condition who fights with claws, a whip and trained moves. Sonil fights alongside strangers when two broken cities merge in a storm.

feats.scene: Sonil flipped a thug over her shoulder and wrapped her lash around a falling lamp.
Sonil took a thrown crate to the ribs and kept her footing.

source_title: Selina Kyle (Infinite Crisis Video Game: Earth-0)

name: Macis
summary: Macis is an aging thief turned collector who hoards weapons and relics in a locked vault. Macis made a quiet deal with a ruler she once loved and breaks it for a vanished warmth.

feats.scene: Macis swung a heavy iron cane across a trespasser's wrist.
Macis kept her calm while soldiers tore through her shelves.

name: Astcilst
summary: Astcilst is a widowed former thief who grew up unwanted and ended up wealthy and weary. Astcilst trades wry stories with a painted-face rival and mourns a long marriage.

feats.scene: Astcilst threw a vase at a clown's head and missed on purpose.
Astcilst took a hard stumble on the staircase and waved off help.

name: Amarmi
summary: Amarmi is a tiny cartoon-styled burglar who plays at racing and gets caught stealing jewelry. Amarmi runs from the family that adopted her and keeps her freedom close.

feats.scene: Amarmi kicked a toy racer into a wall and sped off laughing.
Amarmi spilled from a go-kart at speed and bounced up.

name: Anestutil
summary: Anestutil is a slick cat burglar who loves the chase more than the money and flirts with the man trying to catch her. Anestutil double-crosses partners and even helps strangers when it suits her.

feats.scene: Anestutil kicked a guard off a museum balcony and snatched a statue.
Anestutil was cuffed to her rival and kept running through a shower of sparks.

name: Urnam
summary: Urnam is a former burglar who put on a new costume to help a grieving hero stand again. Urnam fights and loves in a darker age and has a gift for getting back up.

feats.scene: Urnam beat a row of prison thugs with a swung chair leg.
Urnam took a bolt of energy from a maniac's gauntlets and woke minutes later.

name: Setiu
summary: Setiu is a young royal studying abroad who is hunted by a greedy relative for her homeland's riches. Setiu cheers on her college team and hurries home when danger threatens her father.

feats.scene: Setiu swung a field hockey stick at an assassin's wrist.
Setiu shrugged off a hard tumble in a footrace across the quad.

name: Erernse
summary: Erernse is a loud-mouthed magazine reporter who grumbles about everyone but keeps in touch with every colleague. Erernse changes his tune after a daring rescue and proposes a new masthead.

feats.scene: Erernse slammed his notebook on a desk in a fit of grumbling.
Erernse took a rough shove from a gang thug and still muttered his headline.

name: Seniures
summary: Seniures is a dread minstrel who plucks a harp strung from a slain angel's heart. Seniures makes listeners long for death and secretly plans to seize his master's army.

feats.scene: Seniures strummed a single chord that drove a whole crowd of soldiers to their knees.
Seniures was knocked flat by a thrown shield and kept playing.

name: Ntiasamo
summary: Ntiasamo is an elder thinker who rallies crowds in defense of the mindless clones used as living spare parts. Ntiasamo has no gift but a stubborn voice and a long memory.

feats.scene: Ntiasamo shoved a guard aside to reach a locked ward.
Ntiasamo stood in a line of protestors and endured a heavy shove.

name: Alvauam
summary: Alvauam is a restless goddess who walks between worlds with white eyes and purple hair. Alvauam can turn matter into raw force and back, glimpses what comes next and calls the fallen back to life.

feats.scene: Alvauam bent space around herself and shattered a whole continent's bedrock.
Alvauam stood in the heart of a collapsing citadel and was untouched.
Alvauam crossed the sky in a flash of violet fire.

name: Luamirn
summary: Luamirn is a ring-bearing guardian of a far sector who carries on after her partner's death. Luamirn shapes green light into shields and bolts and flies on a wave of will.

feats.scene: Luamirn fired a lance of green light that collapsed a whole tower.
Luamirn raised a glowing shell that held against a falling bridge span.

name: Veotiu
summary: Veotiu is a white-haired killer for a secret order of blades who trains in silence. Veotiu has no gift beyond decades of practice and a calm face.

feats.scene: Veotiu cut a hanging rope across a dark hall in a single stroke.
Veotiu took a hard kick to the ribs and kept his stance.

name: Niuium
summary: Niuium is a sinister servant conjured by a trickster's hand who steals the senses of those he meets. Niuium leaves victims deaf, blind and numb until he is driven off.

feats.scene: Niuium silenced a whole stairwell of people with a single sweep of his hand.
Niuium took a hard blow from a thrown pipe and kept reaching.

name: Torseli
summary: Torseli is a gray-templed schemer who reads minds and plants ideas that feel like a victim's own. Torseli prefers to work unseen from the back of a crowd.

feats.scene: Torseli planted a thought that sent a guard walking off a loading dock.
Torseli took a hard shove in a crowded hall and never lost his focus.

name: Ntsasmi
summary: Ntsasmi is a famous screen actress who is a pro at the set and a stern judge of character. Ntsasmi has no gift beyond confidence and a steady stare.

feats.scene: Ntsasmi slammed a script onto a table to end a bad rehearsal.
Ntsasmi took a hard fall during a stunt rehearsal and went straight back to her mark.

name: Sotornel
summary: Sotornel is a petite student with psychic gifts who leads a masked team that sews its own costumes. Sotornel guides her friends by mind alone and prefers stealth to fighting.

feats.scene: Sotornel linked her whole team's minds and turned a rampaging brute's charge aside.
Sotornel took a hard shove into a wall and kept directing from memory.

name: Asiar
summary: Asiar is a long-lived warrior from a bright sky-world who joins a band that wants to make humans more godlike. Asiar bursts out cartridges of borrowed energy, travels by glowing portal and takes little harm.

feats.scene: Asiar fired a returned burst of stored energy that levelled a whole block of towers.
Asiar stood unhurt in a blast that flattened the surrounding blocks.

name: Rntonlle
summary: Rntonlle is a government agent grown in a vat from two sources of DNA who works in a trio. Rntonlle surrounds her body with a force that mimics flight, speed, strength and toughness.

feats.scene: Rntonlle hurled a delivery van across a lot with a push of her force shell.
Rntonlle took a hard hit from a swung girder inside her shimmering shell.

name: Nunusi
summary: Nunusi is a fused hero and tennis champion from some far-off world who fights with a racket and borrowed armor. Nunusi holds the line while others lead people home.

feats.scene: Nunusi smashed a ball with her racket and knocked a thug's blade away.
Nunusi took a hard tackle in her bright armor and kept her stance.

source_title: Serena Williams (DC Extended Universe: Serving Up Justice)

name: Satarum
summary: Satarum is a clever horse who understands simple orders in the mind and senses danger as it nears. Satarum waits patiently for its rider in the capital and bolts when it feels harm.

feats.scene: Satarum kicked a locked stable door off its hinges to reach its rider.
Satarum took a hard tumble on a muddy road and shook it off.
Satarum thundered across the park at a full gallop.

name: Talcerne
summary: Talcerne is a cyborg soldier, the last of a failed program, who joins an underground fight against a tyrant. Talcerne has gears under his skin and a wry sense of humor about his own name.

feats.scene: Talcerne punched through a reinforced door with a servo-driven fist.
Talcerne took a point-blank rifle burst across his armored chest.

name: Ortisanu
summary: Ortisanu is a gray-haired master craftsman who once taught a young heir to build his own gadgets. Ortisanu has no gift but sharp ideas, and is stunned when his work is stolen.

feats.scene: Ortisanu slammed a workshop drawer on a thief's fingers.
Ortisanu took a hard bump in his crowded workshop and went back to his bench.

name: Luorolle
summary: Luorolle is a green-eyed hired killer with claws, fangs and a fast stride who flings throwing blades. Luorolle takes jobs from a corrupt mayor and loses a lethal duel in a lift shaft.

feats.scene: Luorolle hurled three blades that pinned a guard to a wall.
Luorolle took a hard fall down a lift shaft and rose swinging.

name: Siorelle
summary: Siorelle is an immortal warrior from a bright world who fights with a gun and a glowing cartridge. Siorelle is a quick shot and an engineer, and falls in with a rich schemer chasing a powerful child.

feats.scene: Siorelle fired a cartridge and brought down a whole skyscraper's lobby.
Siorelle shrugged off a collapsing bridge that crashed down around him.

name: Leornu
summary: Leornu is a green-haired young man with a scaly body, claws and a tail that coils like a cable. Leornu brawls for hire, binding foes in his tail and biting with venom.

feats.scene: Leornu coiled his tail around a gate guard and crushed him against the fence.
Leornu took a hard blow from a thrown barrel and kept coiling.

name: Seramern
summary: Seramern is the quiet twin and helper of a stage magician whose mind broke after an accident. Seramern is bound by mind control for a time and escapes with the help of an honest rope.

feats.scene: Seramern pushed a stage prop door open and ran into the night.
Seramern endured a long spell of control and awoke clear-headed.

name: Coreruamo
summary: Coreruamo is a towering alien construct that sleeps in a cocoon until a cult wakes it. Coreruamo seizes a man in a giant metal hand and blows itself apart when two conflicting orders collide.

feats.scene: Coreruamo crushed a parked bus in its hand and then blew apart in a bright burst.
Coreruamo walked through a barrage of police rounds without slowing.

name: Nuntlo
summary: Nuntlo is a water-dwelling reptile who breathes dry air only through a glowing yellow ring. Nuntlo returns home after a trip abroad with news of a new breeding ground.

feats.scene: Nuntlo slapped a guard's rifle aside with his thick tail.
Nuntlo took a hard fall onto dry gravel and gasped on.

name: Tisva
summary: Tisva is a bald, quiet islander who works alone with a rolled-up map and a thick rope. Tisva has no gift but patience and a stubborn will.

feats.scene: Tisva swung a coil of rope into a thief's knees.
Tisva took a hard fall from a ladder and hauled himself up.

name: Iuvalros
summary: Iuvalros is a bald, heavy-set watcher who guards a village crossing and keeps a grudge. Iuvalros has no gift beyond a quiet stubbornness.

feats.scene: Iuvalros slammed a gate shut on a prowler's coat.
Iuvalros took a hard shove from a mule cart and kept guard.

name: Serterva
summary: Serterva is a bald former sailor who haunts the docks, unnoticed by most and trusted by few. Serterva carries a deckhand's strength and nothing more.

feats.scene: Serterva threw a mooring line across a gap to a drifting boat.
Serterva took a hard knock from a swinging boom and stayed on his feet.

name: Riarirn
summary: Riarirn is the cool head of a covert agency who runs spy rings from a quiet office. Riarirn throws, climbs and fights well and relies on gadgets and training.

feats.scene: Riarirn hurled a knife through a rope and dropped a hanging lamp onto a pursuer.
Riarirn took a hard tumble off a fire escape and rolled to his feet.

name: Veoresti
summary: Veoresti is a red-haired magazine editor who prints a bold journal and pays for it with his life. Veoresti stays quietly at his desk when everyone else is shouting.

feats.scene: Veoresti slammed a stack of proofs onto a desk.
Veoresti took a hard shove in a crowded newsroom and went back to his desk.

name: Rontoeol
summary: Rontoeol is a blue-haired wing commander of a bird-people army who serves a cult worshipping a star-eater. Rontoeol is a sharp marksman and a skilled pilot, and falls in battle.

feats.scene: Rontoeol shot a rifle round through a canopy and dropped a rival's glider.
Rontoeol took a hard crash landing in her glider and walked out.

name: Aunent
summary: Aunent is a mother from a sea kingdom who once served a villain and slowly recovers from deep sorrow. Aunent swims with ease, and is much stronger and tougher than a land-dweller.

feats.scene: Aunent bent a steel hatch outward with her bare hands.
Aunent withstood the crushing pressure of the deepest trench.

name: Stotiam
summary: Stotiam is a hairless officer in a dimensional police force who patrols pocket worlds. Stotiam steps through the seams between them as easily as through a door.

feats.scene: Stotiam slipped through a fold in the air and tackled a smuggler from behind.
Stotiam took a hard fall out of a closing seam and rose smiling.

name: Ritauni
summary: Ritauni is a conjurer of shadows who sits on a council of dark mages and trusts the wrong voice. Ritauni helps trap an innocent and then blinds the liar who deceived him.

feats.scene: Ritauni raised a wave of darkness that blacked out a whole plaza.
Ritauni took a thrown pillar fragment and stayed standing.

name: Loterta
summary: Loterta is a prisoner from a pocket dimension who wears a harness of black wires that bends reality and warps his own face. Loterta flies, turns aside bullets and projects dread.

feats.scene: Loterta twisted the air around a guard and flung him into a wall.
Loterta bent a volley of bullets harmlessly around himself.

name: Osaresler
summary: Osaresler is a hired archer from a mountain order who raises a daughter in the shadow of an assassin cult. Osaresler duels a rival across a boardroom floor and fires arrows in rapid volleys.

feats.scene: Osaresler loosed three arrows in a row and pinned a rider's coat to a wall.
Osaresler took a hard fall off a motorbike and rolled away.

name: Rosrossia
summary: Rosrossia is an ancient hound of dreams born from lightning, set by a first man to watch over a dark prisoner. Rosrossia walks in the shared mind of the world and is blamed for every grief.

feats.scene: Rosrossia lunged out of a thunderbolt and split a great oak.
Rosrossia stood in a lightning storm and drank the strike in.

name: Laiaria
summary: Laiaria is a red-eyed torturer who sheds sticky strands of dark matter and drinks from the living. Laiaria tracks prey by the bits he leaves behind and ends up undone by them.

feats.scene: Laiaria lashed a dark tendril around a victim and hauled her across the floor.
Laiaria took a hard blow from a swung chain and kept stretching.

name: Taeorcor
summary: Taeorcor is a white-haired grandson who can tie his body to others so they share his injuries. Taeorcor turns that link against a class of children to force a surgeon to act.

feats.scene: Taeorcor shared a single blow across a whole room of strangers to hold them quiet.
Taeorcor took a hard punch and spread it thin across his bound hostages.

name: Amiuco
summary: Amiuco is a mischievous imp with brown eyes and white hair from a bright pocket world who steals comics for fun. Amiuco hops through space, flies, and summons small things from the air.

feats.scene: Amiuco snapped his fingers and hurled a whole rack of boxes across a hall.
Amiuco took a hard bump against a convention booth and giggled.

name: Lovari
summary: Lovari is a lab-grown giant with red eyes, kept out of sight and let loose only to exercise. Lovari bullies captives and beats down heroes at his master's command.

feats.scene: Lovari smashed a steel blast door and flung the wreckage across a vault.
Lovari took a heavy blow from two big hitters and stayed upright.

name: Celesran
summary: Celesran is an unstoppable frontier brute who runs wild across dusty plains beside a stone-hearted partner. Celesran has near limitless strength and flattens whatever stands in his path.

feats.scene: Celesran charged through a whole canyon wall and left a tunnel behind.
Celesran took a dynamite blast on his chest and kept charging.

name: Cavaar
summary: Cavaar is a long-lived sorcerer who tries to move his life into a younger body and seals a whole neighborhood behind a barrier. Cavaar can swell in size, hypnotize and shift shape before being driven out.

feats.scene: Cavaar swelled to the height of a pagoda and hurled a lamppost like a spear.
Cavaar held a magic barrier against an assault that would have flattened a block.

name: Sanco
summary: Sanco is a stammering hired gun who shakes the ground with humming bursts from his palms. He sells his talent to whoever pays and tends to lose duels against patient long-range foes.

feats.scene: Sanco rattles a warehouse with a low hum until its walls crumble into rubble.
Sanco shrugs off a heavy truck clipping him at a junction.

name: Nenstior
summary: Nenstior is a jungle warrior from a lost underground land who can melt into the shape of a black cat and back again. She fights beside exiles and relies on claws and quick reflexes.

feats.scene: Nenstior leaps from a ledge as a cat and bowls over a charging guard.
Nenstior rolls out of a collapsing ledge and walks away bruised.
Nenstior sprints across a cavern floor as a cat, outpacing a thrown spear.

name: Senaium
summary: Senaium is a former arena slave who wanders a hidden world and may be a cat that dreams of being a woman. Her origin stays mysterious even to her closest companion.

feats.scene: Senaium slashes a rope bridge as a cat and drops a pursuing patrol into the gorge.
Senaium survives a fall through a tent roof with only scratches.

name: Ialsa
summary: Ialsa is a sky-worshipping priest and sorcerer who warns his brother that sealing the city under a dome will bring a curse. His rituals draw lightning, and his faith ends up dividing a kingdom.

feats.scene: Ialsa calls down a bolt from a cloudless sky that splits a stone altar.
Ialsa stands unharmed inside a ring of collapsing temple pillars.

name: Autanreo
summary: Autanreo is a pretend frontier outlaw with a revolver and a loud mouth who builds absurd traps involving livestock. He is brave only while he has the upper hand.

feats.scene: Autanreo fires a pistol into a barn and splinters a door.
Autanreo tumbles off a saddle onto packed dirt and stands up grumbling.

name: Ntanlla
summary: Ntanlla is a ranch-themed prisoner who breaks out of jail whenever the guards look away. He has been mind-controlled into singing and loaded back onto transport trucks more than once.

feats.scene: Ntanlla swings a lasso that yanks a guard off his feet.
Ntanlla is slammed into a cell wall and shakes it off.

name: Ceoalli
summary: Ceoalli is a small brown rabbit who rides in a handbag and nips anyone who steps too close to his owner. He once survived being singed by a fiery spirit.

feats.scene: Ceoalli bites a burglar on the ankle and the burglar hops backward.
Ceoalli survives a scorching blast that blackens his fur.
Ceoalli bolts across an office floor chasing a pair of boots.

name: Nuscorn
summary: Nuscorn is a paramedic whose dying plea for strangers brought a gentle spirit into his body. While hosting it he radiates warmth that mends the hurt and calms the violent.

feats.scene: Nuscorn releases a wave of warm light that stops a street brawl cold.
Nuscorn rises unscratched from the wreckage of a flipped ambulance.

name: Lluseoium
summary: Lluseoium is a clockwork guardian built to watch over a tomb, later refit with alien parts and sent to serve a modern state. He flies, fires bursts of light and endures heavy blows without a dent.

feats.scene: Lluseoium fires a beam from his chest that melts through a bunker door.
Lluseoium stands in the middle of a collapsing tower and walks out.
Lluseoium soars above rooftops with a metallic whine.

name: Lertonnau
summary: Lertonnau is a hairless menace whose past is sketchy and whose motives are even less clear. He turns up where trouble is already brewing and leaves before anyone can ask questions.

feats.scene: Lertonnau hurls a crate across an alley and dents a van.
Lertonnau takes a kick to the ribs and does not flinch.

name: Riave
summary: Riave is a university student who drank a mutating serum and turned into a toothy swimmer with bulging muscle. He thrives in water and hates being dry.

feats.scene: Riave bites through the steel rail of a diving pier.
Riave is thrown through a lab window and surfaces laughing.
Riave darts through a flooded tunnel faster than a motorboat.

name: Tautotia
summary: Tautotia is the one-eyed ruler of an undersea kingdom of predators, a proud father whose rule rests on fear and sheer bulk. His teeth and muscle are legendary.

feats.scene: Tautotia smashes a stone throne into gravel with one fist.
Tautotia takes a harpoon blast to the chest and laughs.

name: Tasoan
summary: Tasoan is a swindler who hides behind a metal mask and sabotages a building site to dodge a payment. His schemes are petty and his fists are ordinary.

feats.scene: Tasoan topples a stack of girders onto a scaffold.
Tasoan is knocked flat by a swinging plank and groans.

name: Rumceliu
summary: Rumceliu is a gambler-world teenager who bends the atom with concentration, holding a glowing sphere of restrained force. A lapse in attention makes the sphere sputter and die.

feats.scene: Rumceliu flexes his mind and the glowing sphere flattens a stage platform.
Rumceliu stumbles back from a blast and keeps his footing.

name: Tumval
summary: Tumval is a harsh matriarch who punishes her daughter for small acts of rebellion with cruel, drawn-out discipline. She rules the kitchen table with a flat voice.

feats.scene: Tumval shoves a chair across the linoleum with a single push.
Tumval stands through a long argument without giving an inch.

name: Raeonium
summary: Raeonium is a sharp-tongued mother in a seaside neighborhood who lies easily and loves loudly. Her divorce has not made her any quieter.

feats.scene: Raeonium slaps a ladle on a counter and the whole room goes silent.
Raeonium shrugs off a tumble down a stoop.

name: Alanura
summary: Alanura is a dyed-hair mother with violet eyes who gets along with her grandchildren far better than with her ex-husband. She is an ordinary person in an extraordinary family.

feats.scene: Alanura swings a handbag and knocks a mugger off balance.
Alanura slips on a wet step and brushes herself off.

name: Rusile
summary: Rusile is a former lab researcher turned doting parent who patched up a long family rift late in life. She forgives easily and offers practical advice over coffee.

feats.scene: Rusile throws a slipper across a kitchen and hits a fly mid-air.
Rusile endures a rough road trip and a long night without complaint.

name: Roiumtor
summary: Roiumtor is a film actress whose beauty and bad luck lead her to unseal a dark thing in a vault. She is cheerful, famous and completely out of her depth.

feats.scene: Roiumtor flings open a heavy vault door in a panic.
Roiumtor stumbles from a collapsing set and waves to the cameras.

name: Secoranu
summary: Secoranu is a hero who can become a real mountain, complete with slopes, lifts and tiny skiers, and his teammates mock the power. His rocky body is nearly unbreakable but not quite.

feats.scene: Secoranu rolls a boulder-sized slab down his own slope onto a speeding jet.
Secoranu holds his stone face still as a doomed airliner slams into it.

name: Iumnuanu
summary: Iumnuanu is a hive-minded order spirit who breaks from his kin to seek revenge and slips into a dead man's body. His anger outlives his flesh and he schemes patiently.

feats.scene: Iumnuanu hurls a column of pale force that flattens a city block.
Iumnuanu holds together after a spell blast scatters the room.

name: Tiseoiu
summary: Tiseoiu is a dark-haired engineer who builds machines for crime and dies in the same blow that ends his scheme. He is clever with bolts but careless with people.

feats.scene: Tiseoiu starts a press that crushes a delivery van flat.
Tiseoiu walks away from a workshop fire with singed sleeves.

name: Tetiiu
summary: Tetiiu is a lanky young woman whose mind moves objects, and she takes it out on a doll that she speaks through without touching. Rejection turned her talent into a lethal habit.

feats.scene: Tetiiu shoves a jeering classmate across a road with an invisible push.
Tetiiu takes a hard punch and keeps smiling.

name: Iuonest
summary: Iuonest is a blond opportunist who posts private photos online and sells shirts with them. She meant to help but profited instead.

feats.scene: Iuonest slaps a stack of shirts on a table and calls out a price.
Iuonest endures a furious tirade with a shrug.

name: Lomia
summary: Lomia is a winged warrior from a sky-faring people who hardens under an iron regime, wielding a heavy metal mace. She keeps one secret doubt close to her chest.

feats.scene: Lomia swings her mace and caves in the door of an armored truck.
Lomia takes a car impact and rises to her feet.
Lomia banks hard between towers on her wide wings.

name: Neosaall
summary: Neosaall is a disciplined soldier from a distant world, adept with metal blades and a heavy mace, and she keeps her feelings under armor. She follows orders until they stop making sense.

feats.scene: Neosaall swings her mace through a barricade of crates.
Neosaall is hurled into a wall and gets back up at once.

name: Ronnaule
summary: Ronnaule is a winged adventurer who is married to a fellow hero and fights hand to hand with a heavy mace. She is tougher and stronger than any ordinary person and flies with ease.

feats.scene: Ronnaule swings her mace through a wooden gate and splinters it.
Ronnaule absorbs a crushing blow and shakes it off.
Ronnaule dives from a cliff on her broad wings.

name: Teltorsi
summary: Teltorsi is a widowed officer with red hair and metal wings, once handed rings of cosmic power by a godlike benefactor. She lost the rings but kept her wings and her nerve.

feats.scene: Teltorsi slams her wings against a door and bursts it from its frame.
Teltorsi takes a rocket blast and keeps her grip on the ledge.
Teltorsi cuts through the sky above a skyline.

name: Nasraunus
summary: Nasraunus is an ancient shepherd turned cosmic wizard, one of five watchers who observe the world while rarely lifting a hand. He pleads for mercy when his peers plot to rewrite events.

feats.scene: Nasraunus hurls a ribbon of starlight that parts a dark cloud above the sea.
Nasraunus is unmoved as a shockwave crosses the plain.

name: Amolo
summary: Amolo is a wise old wizard who once received the might of six gods and now gives that strength to a chosen champion. He ages slowly and keeps an evil sealed beneath a hidden cavern.

feats.scene: Amolo speaks a word and a bolt of white fire levels a ruined fortress.
Amolo stands calmly while a curse hammers the cavern roof.

name: Semiava
summary: Semiava is a green-skinned fiend with white eyes and orange hair, a body-snatcher who hurls victims into limbo. Her talons are strong but her power fades when she steps into the real world.

feats.scene: Semiava rips a stone pillar loose and flings it across a hall.
Semiava shrugs off a speeding blow that cracks a boulder.

name: Lineonco
summary: Lineonco is a horned officer of a galactic police force who wields a glowing ring charged from a lantern-shaped battery. The ring builds shields, shoots energy and carries him through space.

feats.scene: Lineonco aims his ring and a green beam demolishes a hangar.
Lineonco raises a glowing shield that withstands a missile.
Lineonco rockets above a landing field in a trail of light.

name: Cetir
summary: Cetir is a calm envoy from a council that writes the rules of existence and remains untouched when the world is rewritten. He serves as diplomat to a dreamer and a hidden court.

feats.scene: Cetir lifts one hand and the sky rearranges itself.
Cetir sits calmly while a whole cosmos folds into nothing around him.

name: Coamo
summary: Coamo is a brown dog who was once pumped up by experimental drugs and briefly became unnaturally strong. Now he lives quietly with a loving family and chews slippers.

feats.scene: Coamo bursts through a kennel gate during a spell of fury.
Coamo bounces off a speeding sedan and trots home.
Coamo races across a farm field after a tennis ball.

name: Ririacis
summary: Ririacis is a hired killer who works with a pistol in each hand as part of a group of seven. A blade took his hands once, and a replacement now carries the title.

feats.scene: Ririacis empties both pistols into a steel door and scatters the lock.
Ririacis takes a heavy punch and keeps his aim.

name: Sartautor
summary: Sartautor is a green-haired mercenary with great strength who works for a covert crew in a big city. She breaks things first and bills for them later.

feats.scene: Sartautor lifts a parked car and tosses it down a ramp.
Sartautor tanks a shotgun blast to the chest.

name: Serosa
summary: Serosa is a healer chosen in each age to protect people, who can hop through space and mend wounds. Her gifts bend signals into music and soothe a city.

feats.scene: Serosa lets loose a shockwave of sound that shatters a building facade.
Serosa steps through a burst of gunfire and heals the scratches at once.

name: Cororre
summary: Cororre is a slow-footed, round patrolman who blunders through every case and trips over his own handcuffs. He carries a revolver more for show than use.

feats.scene: Cororre swings his nightstick and misses a lamp by an inch.
Cororre rolls down a hill on his own belly and sits up dazed.

name: Lernin
summary: Lernin is a laid-back zealot who flies, shrugs off bullets and moves like a blur, with the mood of a lazy cat and the tastes of a killer. He answers to a dark sun.

feats.scene: Lernin punches a ridge and the whole peak slides into a valley.
Lernin takes a falling mountain on his shoulders without a scratch.
Lernin darts across a desert in the blink of an eye.

name: Amtelci
summary: Amtelci is a gruff caretaker of a bone-strewn borderland who leads lost travelers to the living heart of nature. He stays loyal to the council that rules the place.

feats.scene: Amtelci tears a gnarled root from the soil and swings it like a club.
Amtelci stands firm as a wave of decay washes over him.

name: Sortota
summary: Sortota is a crimson planet-eater who poses as a radiant god to lull worlds, fattens them up and devours them to the core. His hide drinks energy and his strength is monstrous.

feats.scene: Sortota swallows a world and cracks it open like a nut in his jaws.
Sortota shrugs off the collision of a rogue moon.
Sortota crosses the void between two worlds in a short span.

name: Osveo
summary: Osveo is a vain striped cat of the jungle who looks down on lesser animals and hunts the fleeing. He does not age past his prime and tracks prey by scent.

feats.scene: Osveo pounces on a deer and drags it across a clearing.
Osveo leaps from a high branch and lands unharmed.
Osveo bounds through tall grass with his claws out.

name: Ntlineon
summary: Ntlineon is an aging actress who bargained with a moon goddess for lasting beauty, letting the deity ride her body and cast spells. The goddess flinched from sudden bright light.

feats.scene: Ntlineon flicks her fingers and a black blast shatters a park fountain.
Ntlineon shrugs off a thrown bench while the goddess stirs within.

name: Cortorre
summary: Cortorre is a violet-skinned lawkeeper who patrols a remote sector with a glowing ring and a lantern-shaped power cell. The ring builds shields and blasts and lifts her into flight.

feats.scene: Cortorre fires a beam from her ring and levels a row of outlaw shacks.
Cortorre conjures a glowing wall that stops a crashing freighter.
Cortorre streaks past a moon in a ribbon of light.

name: Cororent
summary: Cororent is a brown-haired sleuth in a long coat who solves puzzles from tiny details and attends a hero gathering. His wits are his only weapon.

feats.scene: Cororent taps a walking stick and flips a latch across the room.
Cororent tumbles into a hedge and straightens his collar.

name: Oluti
summary: Oluti is a hero in a team of strongmen who cannot be wounded by blows, bullets or blasts. His real talent is standing still while the world hits him.

feats.scene: Oluti punches a post and cracks it down the middle.
Oluti stands in the path of a shell and watches it bounce.

name: Leleta
summary: Leleta is a living fragment of a shape-changing hero who can turn his body into different compounds and mold them at will. He yearns for a life of his own and gives it up out of guilt.

feats.scene: Leleta turns an arm into iron and swings it through a brick wall.
Leleta becomes dense stone and takes a rocket blast.

name: Tananrn
summary: Tananrn is a pale-haired member of a manufactured hero team who believes her twin brother is real. Her makers gave her power and a short life, and she fights to be remembered.

feats.scene: Tananrn hurls a shimmering burst that smashes a rooftop vent.
Tananrn falls through a ceiling and stands up in the dust.

name: Coreonso
summary: Coreonso is a nightclub mesmerist who enslaves a gifted man and siphons his inner force, then wears a lined suit for a spree of thefts. She once lifts a whole roof off a building as a weapon.

feats.scene: Coreonso tears the dome from a hall and flings it at a fire engine.
Coreonso walks through a shower of broken glass without a mark.

name: Sortaria
summary: Sortaria is a widowed mother from a river city who raised a son bound for the stars. In later years her memory fades, but her warmth stays.

feats.scene: Sortaria swats a cat off the counter with a dish towel.
Sortaria sits through a long winter night without a coat.

name: Auseranu
summary: Auseranu is a purple-haired enforcer who grows glowing blades from his palms and hunts gifted teenagers on behalf of a city government. He talks cruelly and fights with a swordsman's grace.

feats.scene: Auseranu cuts a lamp post in two with a crackling blade.
Auseranu rolls off a van roof and springs up.

name: Tauaules
summary: Tauaules is a blond rogue who reshapes his body to slip through crowds and steal in plain sight. His disguises fail whenever he gets overconfident.

feats.scene: Tauaules stretches an arm through a grate and yanks a strongbox free.
Tauaules flattens himself and slips through a closing gate.

name: Valsune
summary: Valsune is a yellow-scaled mechanic from a distant star who keeps a rebel crew running but faints when frightened. His fear has saved him more than once, since predators ignore a body that looks dead.

feats.scene: Valsune swings a wrench and clangs it off a hull plate.
Valsune topples limp from a gantry and survives the drop.

name: Olete
summary: Olete is the youngest of a hired assassin gang, able to generate and hurl electric surges while flying under his own power. He dies with his crew when a vengeful spirit finds them.

feats.scene: Olete fires a crackling arc that blows apart a parked truck.
Olete lets a transformer blow beside him and brushes off the sparks.
Olete slices through the night sky above a harbor.

name: Unsor
summary: Unsor is a spoiled imp with lightning for hair who lives in a cloud house and hurls electric bolts when summoned. He likes mischief and ignores his parents.

feats.scene: Unsor sneezes and a thunderbolt scorches a tree trunk.
Unsor tumbles down a cloud bank and bounces back up giggling.
Unsor zips around a chimney trailing sparks.

name: Estannum
summary: Estannum is a bald crook with a footwear fixation whose gang schemes are petty and easily foiled. Little else is known about him.

feats.scene: Estannum kicks a bin lid across a back alley.
Estannum falls off a loading dock and walks it off.

name: Seranil
summary: Seranil is a blue-skinned recruit to a corps of hope-powered flyers who loses faith in the middle of a battle and drops from the sky. His ring leaves him the moment his optimism fades.

feats.scene: Seranil flings a ring-forged lance that splinters a grove of trees.
Seranil is flung from a treetop and gets up stunned.
Seranil darts between trunks in a streak of light.

name: Toiarvi
summary: Toiarvi is a sharp-eyed warlord of a garbage-strewn island who treats ruin as an opportunity. She leads a gang of look-alikes and laughs at danger.

feats.scene: Toiarvi swings a baseball bat and cracks a rusted gate.
Toiarvi gets thrown into a trash heap and climbs out grinning.

name: Amarolu
summary: Amarolu is a blond professional wrestler who joins a cult of assassins and fights in a tournament to the death. He once got dragged along behind a speeding car.

feats.scene: Amarolu body-slams an opponent through a wooden table.
Amarolu is dragged across asphalt and still staggers upright.

name: Esciron
summary: Esciron is a dark-haired intelligence officer from a bottled-city people who tracks escaped convicts for a military guild. She works with analysts and never leads the assault.

feats.scene: Esciron punches a console and cracks the casing.
Esciron walks away from a collapsing wall of a bunker.

name: Arstoor
summary: Arstoor is a purple, one-eyed, tentacled officer who guards a distant sector with a glowing ring. The ring forms shields and bolts and lets him cross space.

feats.scene: Arstoor fires a green bolt that levels a smuggler depot.
Arstoor wraps himself in a glowing bubble that holds against a missile.
Arstoor shoots across a dust field in a trail of light.

name: Risiol
summary: Risiol is a many-armed desk sergeant who hands out gear to rookies and grumbles about careless pilots who smash their power cells. He is gruff, fussy and fiercely loyal to the rules.

feats.scene: Risiol swats a stray drone with a glowing fist and smashes it flat.
Risiol holds a glowing wall against a runaway cart of supplies.

name: Ntoserria
summary: Ntoserria is a theatrical troublemaker who feeds on the anger of crowds and grows stronger as people rage. He leaves a room in tatters and drains it of calm.

feats.scene: Ntoserria throws a podium into a crowd barrier and snaps it.
Ntoserria shrugs off a tackle from a bouncer fuelled by rage.

name: Asiausor
summary: Asiausor is a nightclub bodyguard who wears a powered frame and hits hard, but his armor is not meant for glass floors. He answers to a broker of hired guns.

feats.scene: Asiausor punches a bar counter and splits it in half.
Asiausor takes a thrown stool on the shoulder without moving.

name: Stisese
summary: Stisese is a white-haired luckless villain who joins a band of gamblers and loses to a team of heroes the first time out. His trick is never fully explained.

feats.scene: Stisese tosses a coin that clips a lamp.
Stisese tumbles down a flight of stairs and sits up blinking.

name: Lesnau
summary: Lesnau is a winged herald who defied the heavens to save a ruthless warrior and was doomed to be reborn again and again across ages. Her immortal spirit heals every old curse eventually.

feats.scene: Lesnau unfurls her wings and a surge of light cracks a stone cliff.
Lesnau stands unharmed within a column of burning light.
Lesnau climbs through the clouds on wide red wings.

name: Ilniuva
summary: Ilniuva is an officer of a futuristic police force who keeps order in a crowded interplanetary city. She keeps to the rules and pursues smugglers with patience.

feats.scene: Ilniuva fires a stun rod that drops a smuggler at twenty paces.
Ilniuva falls from a hover cart and rolls to her feet.

source_title: Shvaughn Erin (Legion of Super-Heroes TV Series)

name: Telanelia
summary: Telanelia is a red-haired scientist from a bottled-city people who built a device to steal other people's strength after failing a fitness test. Exiled for it, she returns decades later with a new alias.

feats.scene: Telanelia drains a bystander and hurls a bench across a quad.
Telanelia stumbles through a collapsing lab and keeps her device intact.

name: Reniar
summary: Reniar is a bald, one-armed lieutenant who slashes with a curved blade and brags that he will cut foes to ribbons. He parted ways with a conjoined twin after a quarrel and later reconciled.

feats.scene: Reniar bursts through a plaster wall with a bellow and a swing of his blade.
Reniar takes a baton to the jaw and grins.

name: Seosas
summary: Seosas is a masked blade-for-hire who fights with two swords and thrown knives in a southeastern style. He hides his history and speaks only through steel.

feats.scene: Seosas crosses both blades and cuts through a bamboo post.
Seosas takes a kick to the ribs and counters with a spin.

name: Amsese
summary: Amsese is a perpetual drunk who tells tall tales in a bar until the day an unearthly menace shows up and a glowing wall appears around him. He sobers up, forgets the whole thing and attends meetings.

feats.scene: Amsese flails a bottle and a ripple of force knocks a booth over.
Amsese stands in a glowing barrier as monstrous hands pound at it.

name: Aunival
summary: Aunival is a swaggering bank robber who tricks two magical kids into helping with a heist and ends up in handcuffs. He talks big and runs fast.

feats.scene: Aunival hurls a sack of coins that thuds against a vault door.
Aunival tumbles off a counter and scrambles to his feet.

name: Reostocor
summary: Reostocor is a famous nerve doctor and teacher in an old imperial city who listens to a wealthy student describe his nightmares. He asks gentle questions and writes everything down.

feats.scene: Reostocor slaps a ledger shut and startles a sleeping cat.
Reostocor stands unmoved through a long, stormy lecture hall.

name: Eolere
summary: Eolere is a bald clerk who slips on a hood and robs the bank where he works. His plan is simple and his nerve is not.

feats.scene: Eolere shoves a cash drawer shut with his hip.
Eolere trips on a rug and lands on a stack of ledgers.

name: Tisaral
