summary: Tisaral is a gentle engineer who agrees to decode a strange alien ship for a powerful patron. He meets his end beside his son at the hands of a metal killer.

feats.scene: Tisaral pries a panel off an alien console with a crowbar.
Tisaral bangs into a bulkhead and shakes his head.

name: Mintnan
summary: Mintnan is a widowed scientist and father of a rebuilt young hero, who spends years mending a broken bond and designs a headquarters for the boy. Radiation from a lab accident ends his life.

feats.scene: Mintnan hauls a beam into place on a half-built tower.
Mintnan staggers out of a smoking lab, coughing.

name: Nisoau
summary: Nisoau is a patriotic super-soldier who splits himself into copies that share a single mind, and a joke nickname sticks to him. He defeats a young hero during a team brawl and dies by his own hand later.

feats.scene: Nisoau splits into five copies that tackle a man into a wall.
Nisoau takes a blast to the chest and splits to cover the damage.

name: Oroora
summary: Oroora is a projected swordsman, a holographic killer built from a captured woman, who hunts a martial artist through a distant country. A single kick to his neck ends him and his source together.

feats.scene: Oroora slices a katana through a bamboo thicket in a single stroke.
Oroora takes a thrown dagger and keeps advancing.

name: Lloror
summary: Lloror is a shadowy trickster whose special box swallows victims and turns their shadows into obedient copies. He prefers to hide in the dark.

feats.scene: Lloror opens the box and a shadow copy knocks a guard flat.
Lloror takes a fall down a stairwell and melts into darkness.

name: Cacil
summary: Cacil is a hybrid of human and red-planet stock, built by a scheming pair to fight a stony hero. Little is recorded about her beyond her family of mismatched siblings.

feats.scene: Cacil hurls a cart across a courtyard and smashes a fountain.
Cacil takes a falling beam on her back and keeps walking.

name: Niuin
summary: Niuin is a stretchy, shape-shifting robot with yellow eyes who fires streams of mineral from his hands. He lives only as long as a delicate core stays whole.

feats.scene: Niuin stretches an arm across a street and flips a delivery truck.
Niuin flattens himself and a rocket flies through his middle.

name: Sessevi
summary: Sessevi is a dark-haired rocker with claws and tremendous toughness who plays a rowdy band in a rough small town. Her fingernails double as weapons.

feats.scene: Sessevi rips the door off a tour van with her claws.
Sessevi gets hit by a pickup and bounces up.

name: Varereti
summary: Varereti is a dark-haired, web-spinning crook once ranked near the top of the criminal list until a newcomer who loved plants showed everyone up. Her claim to fame is mostly notoriety.

feats.scene: Varereti flings a cord across a rooftop and yanks a guard off his feet.
Varereti tumbles through a skylight and lands in a crouch.

name: Sorvalau
summary: Sorvalau is a stretchy, metal-bodied automaton made by a lab scientist who thinks of him as a son. He changes shape to fit any task and sees with light-sensitive eyes.

feats.scene: Sorvalau stretches into a hammer and flattens a steel drum.
Sorvalau flattens into a sheet and a collapsing crane passes over him.

name: Essereor
summary: Essereor is a silver-eyed biker with a pistol and two-tone hair, who rides through a ruined city and shoots straight. She prefers speed to speeches.

feats.scene: Essereor fires a pistol and shatters a streetlight a block away.
Essereor skids on gravel, slides clear and gets back on the bike.

name: Tilutal
summary: Tilutal is a dark-haired crime figure from a harbor metropolis who opposes a group of earth-force guardians. Records of his methods are thin and mostly hearsay.

feats.scene: Tilutal kicks in a warehouse door and scatters the crates behind it.
Tilutal rolls off a fire escape and sprints away.

name: Seoluliu
summary: Seoluliu is a would-be crime fighter and private eye of an earlier era, who wears a homemade suit with a metallic vest and goggles. He is eager, brave and mostly overlooked.

feats.scene: Seoluliu throws a punch that cracks a thug across the jaw.
Seoluliu is hurled into a barrel and climbs out grinning.

name: Coteia
summary: Coteia is a white-haired secretary who sang lead in a youthful rock band and now keeps the office of a heroic team running. Her calm voice settles any room.

feats.scene: Coteia slams a filing drawer so hard that a pen rolls off the desk.
Coteia stays seated through a rattling earthquake.

name: Coiumaul
summary: Coiumaul is a white-haired socialite who falls for a secretive billionaire and gets kidnapped by a mad doctor's monsters. Later she turns to organizing conventions.

feats.scene: Coiumaul slaps a champagne flute from a waiter's tray.
Coiumaul stumbles out of a rickety cage and straightens her gown.

name: Amoliiu
summary: Amoliiu is a blond spy and singer who uses a gem in her throat to hypnotize crowds and scream with sonic force. Her loyalty belongs to a foreign flag.

feats.scene: Amoliiu lets out a scream that bursts the windows of a concert hall.
Amoliiu takes a stage collapse and keeps singing.

name: Litean
summary: Litean is a metalworking villain who can seal targets inside a shell of precious metal. His method is flashy but easy to shatter with the right tool.

feats.scene: Litean touches a statue and it hardens into a gleaming shell.
Litean crashes through a display case and shrugs off the glass.

name: Nttilan
summary: Nttilan is a black-haired outlaw from a classic adventure serial who plagues a masked captain. He has no known powers and a long list of misdeeds.

feats.scene: Nttilan fires a revolver and clips a signpost.
Nttilan falls from a saddle and rolls into the dust.

name: Tetia
summary: Tetia is a married mother from a distant triple-bodied people who can divide into three identical selves. Her daughter inherited the trick and uses it far more publicly.

feats.scene: Tetia splits into three and each copy hauls a grocery crate.
Tetia gets knocked down and one body stays standing.

name: Listiter
summary: Listiter is a blond criminal who decides that dull, everyday tools make a safer career than showy schemes and leaves no clues. Ordinary rope and crowbars are his whole arsenal.

feats.scene: Listiter pries a window frame loose with a crowbar.
Listiter tumbles off a fence and shakes out his coat.

name: Carrumni
summary: Carrumni is a dark-eyed scientist whose experiments turn on him, an arrogant researcher with a talent for building and a temper for losing. He talks in a smooth growl.

feats.scene: Carrumni throws a switch and a lab machine bursts a concrete pillar.
Carrumni staggers out of an exploding console, singed.

source_title: Simon Ecks (The Brave and the Bold)

name: Llilalu
summary: Llilalu is a lab researcher whose swollen skull houses a mind that can reach into other heads across a whole district. Llilalu trades blows poorly but wins by turning crowds against each other from a quiet corner.

feats.scene: Llilalu focuses a silent surge that drops every guard in a corridor at once.
Llilalu shrugs off a thrown chair that cracks against the oversized skull.

name: Cortiti
summary: Cortiti was a wandering mystic whose name survives only in rumour after a death that nobody can explain. Cortiti left behind unfinished charms and a quarrel with an unseen killer.

feats.scene: Cortiti snaps a ritual staff over one knee to break a binding circle.

name: Torasitor
summary: Torasitor is a gruff old press owner who fishes a stranded girl out of a harbour and shelters her. Torasitor fights battles with phone calls, lawyers and stubborn kindness rather than fists.

feats.scene: Torasitor slams a ledger onto a desk to silence a room of reporters.
Torasitor stays on both feet after a hard shove from a panicked bystander.

name: Iumlones
summary: Iumlones is a white-haired financier who bankrolls a risky oil outfit and demands his money back with a smile. Iumlones wishes for a fortune and loses everything within a single afternoon.

feats.scene: Iumlones throws a signed contract across a boardroom table.
Iumlones is hauled out of a raided office without a scratch.

name: Llenineol
summary: Llenineol is a retired screen hero who now teaches stagecraft to schoolchildren. Llenineol wears an old costume on rare nights and rescues a frightened student from a jealous rival.

feats.scene: Llenineol punches a prop cannon out of a masked intruder's grip.
Llenineol tumbles down the theatre stairs and rises laughing.

name: Lataam
summary: Lataam is a space-lane tycoon whose ruined body was stitched onto a shapeless living weapon. Lataam stretches limbs of grey protoplasm across a station deck and crushes steel beams like straws.

feats.scene: Lataam wraps a cargo hatch in elastic limbs and rips it off its hinges.
Lataam absorbs a point-blank blast and reforms within seconds.

name: Valreoar
summary: Valreoar is a brilliant teenager who breeds clever animals in the school lab and hunts a rumoured lake creature on weekends. Valreoar may grow into a friend or a foe, and even the fortune tellers cannot agree.

feats.scene: Valreoar sets off a homemade charge that scorches a lab bench.

name: Ntsorul
summary: Ntsorul is a palace sentry on a hidden island of warrior women, drilled in the bow, the saddle and the blade. Ntsorul stands every watch with a spear and never leaves the gate unmanned.

feats.scene: Ntsorul drives a spear through a training shield at full gallop.
Ntsorul keeps her post after a heavy practice blade rings off her helm.

name: Amlieo
summary: Amlieo is a scheming prison keeper from a harsh divine realm, quick with machines and slow to forgive. Amlieo builds cruel devices out of scrap and sells them to anyone who will pay.

feats.scene: Amlieo overloads a salvaged engine and levels the shack around it.
Amlieo walks out of the wreck with only singed sleeves.

name: Valanar
summary: Valanar is a mountain-raised girl who was shaped from birth into a flawless killer, then taken in by a loving guardian. Valanar carries a hungry spirit that sharpens every reflex when rage rises.

feats.scene: Valanar kicks through a stone wall to reach a trapped friend.
Valanar walks off a fall from a cliff ledge without slowing.

name: Vanal
summary: Vanal is a cave-schooled conqueror who learned to steer his own muscles and other minds with one disciplined breath. Vanal fields armies of loyal thugs and rules whole valleys through puppets.

feats.scene: Vanal breathes in, holds, and sends a mental shove that flattens a squad of soldiers.
Vanal stands unmoved as a truck bumper dents against his chest.

name: Nirereor
summary: Nirereor is an island heir who lost his family to raiders and then spent a fortune on fighting arts, science and forbidden rites. Nirereor hosts trials for strangers and dies by his own failed experiment.

feats.scene: Nirereor breaks a stone pillar with a spinning heel strike.
Nirereor takes a full-force club blow and answers with a counter throw.

name: Tutian
summary: Tutian is a rope-hardened sea captain who looks like a pirate but secretly carries messages for a young rebel government. Tutian lets his name be dragged through the mud so that the cause survives.

feats.scene: Tutian swings a cutlass through a thick mooring cable in one stroke.

name: Carvos
summary: Carvos is a smiling property dealer who returns to a boom town with a briefcase and a deadly insect. Carvos was conjured by a fiery bargain, and when the bargain breaks, his body slumps into charred remains.

feats.scene: Carvos crushes a rental sign with a single hand clap.
Carvos stands unharmed after a car clips him on a crowded street.

name: Lantelneo
summary: Lantelneo is a mountain-city sorceress who carries a glowing gem inside her skull that her people milk for power. Lantelneo opens a psychic bridge to her daughter and shares dresses, spells and warnings through it.

feats.scene: Lantelneo calls up a rockslide to bury a pursuing mob.
Lantelneo survives a crash that wrecks the car around her.

name: Ratiava
summary: Ratiava is a red-skinned zealot who leads a splinter order of ring bearers and disguises her camps as shelters for the poor. Ratiava feeds on the stolen life of crowds to refill drained ring batteries.

feats.scene: Ratiava funnels harvested life into a machine that withers a village in a minute.
Ratiava shrugs off a volley that scatters her bodyguards.

name: Tirstiu
summary: Tirstiu is a disgraced ring policeman turned outlaw who steals batteries and impersonates old rivals. Tirstiu raids a bank town in a stolen guise and joins a cabal of crooks.

feats.scene: Tirstiu shapes a glowing wedge that rams through a vault door.
Tirstiu walks through a barrage behind a pale yellow shield.

name: Lacornti
summary: Lacornti is a ruined ring guardian who rules a homeworld by terror until a rebel hero strips his ring. Lacornti returns with a stolen mind in his skull and corrupts two city fixtures into hunters.

feats.scene: Lacornti hurls a glowing lance that scorches a block of warehouses.
Lacornti survives a collapsing bridge and flies off in a rage.

name: Serlenva
summary: Serlenva is a sulking exile wielding a yellow ring and a long grudge against his old coworker. Serlenva teams up with a speed-obsessed crook to swap faces with two heroes and loot a harbour.

feats.scene: Serlenva carves a crane arm out of light and drops it on a freighter.
Serlenva bounces a hail of rounds off a thin glowing shell.

name: Leorrne
summary: Leorrne is a stern pink-skinned ring bearer who guards a distant homeworld from a hilltop base and trusts only his own will. Leorrne projects dread into enemies and moulds green light into walls and blades.

feats.scene: Leorrne forges a glowing hammer and flattens an invading walker.
Leorrne weathers a cannon salvo behind a glowing barrier.

name: Siaaul
summary: Siaaul is a bitter ring officer who despises the garbage-collector duties his superiors assign. Siaaul mentors a clumsy newcomer through hard lessons and tortures a bartender for a lead.

feats.scene: Siaaul lifts a derelict ship out of a dock using a fist-shaped glow.
Siaaul stays upright in a bar brawl that wrecks the room.

name: Iumestau
summary: Iumestau is a blond drifter of a far-off star cluster, a heavy presence who bends the space around himself. Iumestau serves a cult and leaves craters where he walks.

feats.scene: Iumestau folds the air into a knot that levels a plaza.
Iumestau stands in the middle of a collapsing hall and does not blink.

name: Telore
summary: Telore is a pale advocate who is secretly a living pit of gravity, feeding on the despair of her clients. Telore opens hungry vortices around desperate people and swallows whatever stands nearby.

feats.scene: Telore opens a vortex that pulls a whole warehouse district into the dark.
Telore takes a barrage of cosmic blasts that vanish without a trace.

name: Lironnau
summary: Lironnau is a petty gang boss in a smoky mid-century city. Lironnau runs numbers, bribes cops and fears nothing but a faster rival.

feats.scene: Lironnau swings a bat into the jaw of a late payer.

name: Tevalco
summary: Tevalco is a green-skinned prophet from a ringed gas giant who sends cryptic warnings to rivals. Tevalco watches from a floating chair and bends fate with spiteful riddles.

feats.scene: Tevalco flicks a ring of light that smashes a stone statue.

name: Colval
summary: Colum Colval is a clan heir dragged into the underworld by a failed rite and remade as a shrieking wraith. Colval screams, claws and flies at crushing speed, and even the lord of the dead respects the sound.

feats.scene: Colval unleashes a wail that shatters every window on a long avenue.
Colval takes a charging brute's full weight and stays in the air.

name: Rnrnerau
summary: Rnrnerau is a student who sings with a rock band and shapes sound waves for fun. Rnrnerau floats above the stage and bends an amp's roar into a gentle breeze.

feats.scene: Rnrnerau cranks a note that blows open a pair of locker doors.

name: Rarnse
summary: Rarnse is a secret screamer who joins a gang of crooks in a floating fortress. Rarnse flies, lifts trucks and shrugs off blows, but a stronger villain ends her run.

feats.scene: Rarnse tosses a delivery truck across an empty lot.
Rarnse grins through a crushing tackle that dents the wall behind her.

name: Sarraar
summary: Sarraar is a brick-built sound mage who speeds through toy cities with a grin. Sarraar bargains with a hag after a ritual goes wrong and returns louder than ever.

feats.scene: Sarraar rattles a block of toy towers into dust with a joyful shout.
Sarraar lands face first on a pavement and bounces up giggling.

name: Artelvas
summary: Artelvas is an inheritor of a stone castle who was murdered and cursed, then slips from a painting into the bodies of guests. Artelvas wears new flesh, strikes with unnatural strength and screams with a force that cracks glass.

feats.scene: Artelvas hurls a heavy oak door across a hallway with borrowed arms.
Artelvas keeps moving after a car clips the borrowed body.

name: Lanronlas
summary: Lanronlas is a red-eyed screamer who hunts two famous heroes alongside dozens of other crooks. Lanronlas ambushes them first, then is carried up beyond breathable air and defeated.

feats.scene: Lanronlas screeches a blast that rips a steel gate off its hinges.
Lanronlas takes a thrown lamp post to the ribs and keeps charging.

name: Anuveo
summary: Anuveo is a prison alumnus turned leech who drinks the power from machines and fighters alike. Anuveo stores what he steals and fires it back in bright bursts at his attackers.

feats.scene: Anuveo drains a fair's generator and fires the whole charge in one flash.
Anuveo laughs off a ray he is able to swallow.

name: Tiaci
summary: Tiaci is a desert-dwelling child of a thunder deity, a lone resident of a palace of ghosts. Tiaci launches storms of blades at visitors and turns lethal traps into a game.

feats.scene: Tiaci stands in a collapsing hall as the pillars fall and stays clean.

name: Ntsuse
summary: Ntsuse is a twenty-foot wolfish giant who walks the lightless tunnels beneath a fiery world as its eternal warden and prisoner. Ntsuse spares the curious child but kills grown intruders, and finds release only in a final sacrifice.

feats.scene: Ntsuse rakes a tunnel wall and brings a cavern ceiling down on a squad.
Ntsuse takes a rocket volley point blank and keeps walking.

name: Amotelne
summary: Amotelne is an insect-like fiend from the gap between dimensions who scrapes its forelegs to unleash a maddening drone. Amotelne carries a ring of fear and may have been dragged here by a cosmic accident.

feats.scene: Amotelne rubs its limbs together and a whole crowd falls to its knees.
Amotelne waits unharmed in the void between worlds.

name: Tivau
summary: Tivau is a blond android posing as a daughter in a radioactive family of crooks. Tivau projects bright blasts and shrugs off contamination that would kill a human.

feats.scene: Tivau blasts an armoured van into a smoking husk.
Tivau wades through a leaking reactor hall without a mark.

name: Nenali
summary: Nenali is a strawberry-haired robot girl in a family of crooks, built to fly and to hurl shockwaves. Nenali is untroubled by radiation and fights for her fake relatives with a smile.

feats.scene: Nenali claps both hands together and a shockwave tears up a parking lot.
Nenali takes a head-on hit from a truck and dusts off her shoulders.

name: Niamo
summary: Niamo is a tall blond daughter of a lord of chance, almost deathless, stronger than any human and quick to mend. Niamo warps probability around her so that the least likely thing happens.

feats.scene: Niamo lifts a collapsing beam off a trapped crowd and tosses it aside.
Niamo takes a bullet barrage that somehow all misses vital places.

name: Ereteco
summary: Ereteco is a bald monk of a criminal faith whose beaten limbs were replaced with metal. Ereteco fights left-handed from a shrine on a sand-swept shore.

feats.scene: Ereteco shatters a stack of tiles with a prosthetic fist.
Ereteco shrugs off a cudgel blow against a steel forearm.

name: Ilnor
summary: Ilnor is a heavy bald fighter of a criminal faith, patched together with machine limbs after a bad beating. Ilnor drills in silence and strikes with a left hand that few have seen coming.

feats.scene: Ilnor drops a steel fist onto a wooden crate and splinters it.
Ilnor takes a pipe to the back and turns around unfazed.

name: Lluriais
summary: Lluriais is a spear-carrying guard of an island of warrior women who falls when invaders swarm the shore. Lluriais drills daily with bow, blade and horse and stands her ground to the end.

feats.scene: Lluriais throws a spear through a wooden shield at thirty paces.
Lluriais keeps fighting after a blow bends her breastplate.

name: Stullores
summary: Stullores is a man fused with war machinery, leased out as a living weapon and then freed by his own conscience. Stullores sends thoughts through nearby minds and orders crowds to do his bidding.

feats.scene: Stullores fires an internal cannon that levels a college annex.
Stullores weathers a missile strike with a few dented plates.

name: Liasttia
summary: Liasttia is a pair of masked brothers, one who swells in size and one who shrinks away. Liasttia works with two other duos of crooks and falls when a horn trick hurls one twin into the other.

feats.scene: Liasttia stomps down at tree height and cracks a loading dock.
Liasttia shrinks out of a net and slips between the bars.

name: Tonent
summary: Tonent is a glowing woman woven from stolen polar light, jealous and unpredictable. Tonent rebuilds machines into people and people into machines, and may or may not have blown herself apart.

feats.scene: Tonent rewrites a whole train carriage into flesh in a pulse of green light.
Tonent bursts apart in a flash and the shards twitch on the floor.

name: Siatan
summary: Siatan is a red-haired night hunter who rides a motorbike across the desert and feeds on drifters. Siatan and four sisters turn on their cruel master, then roll west toward the bright lights.

feats.scene: Siatan tears a motorcycle door off a parked car with one wrench.
Siatan shrugs off a roadside crash and rises with a smirk.

name: Taucortal
summary: Taucortal is a floating robot companion that hovers at its master's shoulder. Taucortal speaks with a polite voice and runs on a battery from the far future.

feats.scene: Taucortal zips into a falling vase and nudges it onto the sofa.

name: Viontte
summary: Viontte is a small robot sidekick powered by a rare cell from the distant future. Viontte floats beside a swaggering hero and quips about the fine print on every plan.

feats.scene: Viontte discharges a burst of battery power that fries a lock.
Viontte bounces off a cave wall and keeps humming.

name: Nasnes
summary: Nasnes is a bony masked killer who haunts a stone castle and hunts the heirs of an old family. Nasnes plots to erase every relative named in a will, and vanishes into a flooded cellar.

feats.scene: Nasnes swings a rusty cleaver at a lawyer's door and splits the wood.

name: Larnmi
summary: Larnmi is a masked thief who drops a stolen vial and then butchers street sleepers in a frantic hunt for it. Larnmi is dying and wants the cure only for himself.

feats.scene: Larnmi swings a rusty blade at a shopfront shutter and dents it.

name: Llorasti
summary: Llorasti is an ancient hunting spirit that crawls into strangers and wears them like coats until the fabric rots. Llorasti prowls the underground rail lines looking for the next body.

feats.scene: Llorasti wrenches a turnstile out of its housing with a stolen arm.
Llorasti walks off a hard fall onto the tracks in a borrowed body.

name: Iarcar
summary: Iarcar is a furred pacifist born in wartime who wears a power ring and is distrusted by his neighbours. Iarcar shapes light into shields and nets, and would rather stop a fight than win one.

feats.scene: Iarcar weaves a glowing net that halts a falling cargo barge.
Iarcar shelters behind a glowing wall as a shell bursts nearby.

name: Titete
summary: Titete is a brown-haired corps member and public hero of a remote mining world. Titete flies on a ring of green light and carries a battery that must be recharged.

feats.scene: Titete casts a glowing wedge that cleaves a mine tunnel open.
Titete holds still as a shower of debris bounces off a glowing dome.

name: Tiateor
summary: Tiateor is a brown-skinned fighter who is caged in a living death-house on a primitive moon. Tiateor allies with a spellcaster and bites an opponent when the trap turns on him.

feats.scene: Tiateor leaps from a ledge and drives a shoulder through a wooden barricade.
Tiateor takes a deflected bolt and keeps snarling.

name: Lesornan
summary: Lesornan is a mind-bending servant created from a joker's whim and a scrap of reality-warping power. Lesornan blankets allies in invisibility, fries brains with psychic bolts and fades when the world snaps back.

feats.scene: Lesornan sends a psychic spike that drops a whole street of passersby.
Lesornan hides behind a psychic shield as a lamp post crashes down.

name: Tiutiurnu
summary: Tiutiurnu is an ant-like marcher given a ring of power and a dream of fighting evil. Tiutiurnu flies toward a looming canopy, gets caught in a sticky web and is eaten.

feats.scene: Tiutiurnu hurls a bushel of berries from the air and clobbers a marching line.
Tiutiurnu thrashes against a thick strand of web.

name: Osaeor
summary: Osaeor is a red-eyed bird who serves as a loyal companion to a winged adventurer. Osaeor dives with sharp talons and rides the wind above a distant rocky world.

feats.scene: Osaeor dives and rakes a cloth sack open with its talons.
Osaeor plunges through a canyon at full tilt.

name: Miaanca
summary: Miaanca is a wealthy bald schemer who frees prisoners to steal back his youth. Miaanca steps into a machine tuned for animals and withers to dust.

feats.scene: Miaanca shoves a gate open and orders his hired thugs in.

name: Oraral
summary: Oraral is a hulking brawler whose bulky suit does all the heavy lifting. Oraral smashes through walls and takes pounding, but without the suit he is merely an angry man.

feats.scene: Oraral punches a delivery van over a guardrail.
Oraral shrugs off a bus bumper in the suit.

name: Niosaria
summary: Niosaria is a red-skinned bounty hunter who reads minds and tosses objects with a thought. Niosaria hunts a fugitive across space and is cut down by a child shape-changer.

feats.scene: Niosaria hurls a crate across a docking bay with a glance.
Niosaria takes a fist to the ribs and keeps tracking his quarry.

name: Stliau
summary: Stliau is a zeppelin captain who raids rooftops and feels stronger the higher he floats. Stliau fires a pistol of sleeping gas and goes weak and fearful once he steps onto flat ground.

feats.scene: Stliau flings a thief overboard from a gondola high above the streets.
Stliau stays upright when a mast swings into his chest at altitude.

name: Iarntean
summary: Iarntean is an inventor of light one-man gliders who turned to robbing ships and aircraft. Iarntean trains a gang to swoop in low, grab loot and vanish.

feats.scene: Iarntean swoops across a deck and rips a hatch lid open with a hook.
Iarntean dives a glider along a harbour wall.

name: Vataure
summary: Vataure is a grey-skinned winged killer in an inverted world, one of many lives of a cursed soul. Vataure murders to keep the cycle spinning and fears only the one lover he slays.

feats.scene: Vataure drops from a rooftop and cleaves a car roof apart with a spiked mace.
Vataure pulls a lance out of his chest and carries on.

name: Osstau
summary: Osstau is a blond young mystic who rides the air with magic and joins a night-time team. Osstau perishes in a short, bright career against forces far larger than herself.

feats.scene: Osstau flings a bolt of cold light that topples a statue.
Osstau hangs on after a magical blast knocks her off her feet.

name: Tumnus
summary: Tumnus is a blonde sleigh-riding daughter of a frozen northern king, quick with a bow and a plan. Tumnus uses tiny pheromone shafts and smoke tips, and shares a bed with the man she was meant to ensnare.

feats.scene: Tumnus looses a smoke shaft that fills a cabin in one breath.

name: Lesleast
summary: Lesleast is a legendary sword-for-hire in a wintry kingdom of islands, blessed with uncanny strength and a body that mends fast. Lesleast kills a king from across a city with a giant crossbow, then bears the curse that follows.

feats.scene: Lesleast lifts a siege crossbow and sends a bolt through a castle wall.
Lesleast pulls a blade from his shoulder and keeps swinging.

name: Nenlan
summary: Nenlan is a blind hired fighter with horns implanted in her skull, her senses sharpened by lab work. Nenlan befriends a rival assassin and fights through a tyrant's towers to the top.

feats.scene: Nenlan listens, steps, and drives a kick through a steel door.
Nenlan keeps fighting after a hard blow to the skull.

name: Nuvaleo
summary: Nuvaleo is a ruined killer from a darker twin world who lost his friend early and every restraint with him. Nuvaleo is drugged and stripped of his mending gift, and offers a bitter warning in his last breath.

feats.scene: Nuvaleo plants a heel in a thug's chest and sends him through a window.
Nuvaleo takes a stab to the gut and keeps walking.

name: Lestau
summary: Lestau is a one-eyed mercenary and leader of a covert blade society, trained in every weapon and fighting style. Lestau shadows a telepath to keep her honest and fights off two killers who want a captive dead.

feats.scene: Lestau shoots a spinning disc out of the air in mid-flight.
Lestau takes a body blow from a rival and keeps his stance.

name: Ninuno
summary: Ninuno is a one-eyed pirate captain with a quick-mending body and a slow-ticking age. Ninuno leads a crew across stormy seas and is skilled at blades, torture and deceit.

feats.scene: Ninuno cleaves a mast with a boarding axe.
Ninuno staggers up from a deep gash and orders the crew to hoist sail.

name: Sernres
summary: Sernres is a general whose experiments gave him a body that mends itself, overseeing prisons for outlaw vigilantes. Sernres survives a blast that levels a facility, losing only an eye.

feats.scene: Sernres slams a baton into the jaw of a vigilante.
Sernres crawls out of a collapsing prison block after the blast.

name: Rontatas
summary: Rontatas is a future hired killer with a fake exploding eye, tracked by older heroes turned tyrants. Rontatas loses an arm to a cruel captor and escapes with help from an unlikely ally.

feats.scene: Rontatas pops a false eye and the flash blows the cell door off.
Rontatas keeps moving after a crushing beating in a tower cell.

name: Iumeonta
summary: Iumeonta is a trained falcon who serves a quiet armoured rider. Iumeonta swoops at foes with sharp talons and sees far across a battlefield.

feats.scene: Iumeonta dives and snatches a helm plume from a startled soldier.
Iumeonta stoops over a castle wall in a steep dive.

name: Stvalva
summary: Stvalva is a legendary crime boss who woke at fourteen with sharper sight and unstoppable strength. Stvalva avenges his father by killing a rival gang and then rules an entire coastline.

feats.scene: Stvalva rips a steel door out of its frame with one arm.
Stvalva takes a machine-gun burst across the chest without flinching.

name: Luurn
summary: Luurn is a wild woman of a frozen wilderness who nurses a lost explorer and gives birth to a powerful child. Luurn conjures imaginary beasts out of her mind and outlives her whole clan.

feats.scene: Luurn calls a shaggy beast out of thin air to crush an attacker.
Luurn lives through a winter that kills the rest of her camp.

name: Ialla
summary: Ialla is a grey-skinned razor-faced alien sent into a prison dimension, a warm and loyal partner. Ialla hugs a long-lost brother and the embrace turns out to be fatal for both.

feats.scene: Ialla squeezes a brother tight and the shock cracks the prison floor.
Ialla takes a jolting shove and laughs it off.

name: Telvatia
summary: Telvatia is a green dwarfish exile from a hellish world who feeds on the desires of others. Telvatia swells in size after a meal and takes blasts that would level a shed.

feats.scene: Telvatia zaps a rod and knocks a giant woman out cold.
Telvatia takes a thrown body into the wall and climbs back up.

name: Ontti
summary: Ontti is a green bald god who flatters passersby and drinks in their wants. Ontti grows when full and shrugs off blasts that would flatten a shed.

feats.scene: Ontti swells to twice his height and throws a dumpster across an alley.
Ontti shrugs off a small explosion without a mark.

name: Stamoeo
summary: Stamoeo is a brown-haired mob leader who takes charge after his boss is jailed and arranges a nasty trick on a government agent. Stamoeo ties a heroine to a post at the tide line, and her escape wrecks his gang.

feats.scene: Stamoeo shoves a prisoner against a post and knots the rope himself.

name: Sernent
summary: Sernent is a green-skinned aquatic god in a terror cell of the underworld, immortal and strong. Sernent disintegrates people with a touch and twists sea beasts into worse forms.

feats.scene: Sernent sinks through a depth charge blast and keeps swimming.

name: Vavalton
summary: Vavalton is a lanky cowhand on a dusty ranch who chats about modern riders and old stories. Vavalton has few ambitions beyond a full bunk and a quiet range.

feats.scene: Vavalton lassoes a calf and flips it onto its side.

name: Ricortel
summary: Ricortel is a wartime tank crewman who fights across desert and forest alongside a ghostly general. Ricortel drives an armoured machine whose shell would flatten a house.

feats.scene: Ricortel fires a tank gun and levels a farmhouse with one round.
Ricortel climbs out of a burning hull and keeps his head down.

name: Vaeruin
summary: Vaeruin is an ordinary man who inherits a spooky house and ends up rooming with a runaway ape. Vaeruin returns the animal to its circus and collects a fat reward.

feats.scene: Vaeruin swings a broom at a counterfeiter and lands a clean hit.

name: Ronres
summary: Ronres is a grieving father who dresses as a spooky avenger to haunt the gangs that killed his family. Ronres lets go of vengeance when his surviving son recognizes him.

feats.scene: Ronres clubs a street thug with a heavy lantern.

name: Iutetia
summary: Iutetia is a black-haired hired gun, one of many enhanced guards hired to patrol an amusement park. Iutetia slips past locked gates and is among the first to be rounded up.

feats.scene: Iutetia shoulders a turnstile gate off its post.

name: Nttora
summary: Nttora is a spine-sucking parasite that slips into town to feed on spinal fluid, a vicious pack hunter. Nttora is killed when a grenade lands in its open mouth.

feats.scene: Nttora tears through a soldier's armour with its jaws.
Nttora takes a grenade in the mouth and bursts apart.

name: Seoolltu
summary: Seoolltu is a bald warrior of a dreaded tribe who carries a violet ring. Seoolltu is a neutral hunter, known on his homeworld for ruthless trophies.

feats.scene: Seoolltu aims a ring and splits a boulder the size of a house.
Seoolltu endures a rain of rocks with his ring raised.

name: Stuirnte
summary: Stuirnte is a bald yellow-eyed teen hero who boasts about his father, a high officer of a distant world. Stuirnte joins a youth team and does his best to look unbothered.

feats.scene: Stuirnte hurls a boulder of goo that splatters a training dummy.

name: Nttorva
summary: Nttorva is the first crook ever caught by a masked vigilante, who turns a clock obsession into a revenge plan. Nttorva rigs a statue to blow and promises a death at the stroke of three.

feats.scene: Nttorva triggers a charge that blows a giant clock statue to pieces.
Nttorva takes a punch from behind and drops like a sack.

name: Ninlosa
summary: Ninlosa is a faceless fear-corps soldier who carries a ring of dread and marches against a living planet. Ninlosa is erased in a single burst along with a quarter of the army.

feats.scene: Ninlosa fires a ring blast that carves a trench across a plain.
Ninlosa is caught in a vast pulse that scours a whole battlefield.

name: Tiueota
summary: Tiueota is a toddler-sized prankster whose belt squeezes the body down to speck scale. Every playground bet ends with Tiueota winning simply by being tinier than everyone else.

feats.scene: Tiueota shoulder-barges a crumb off the nursery rug while shrunk to speck size.
Tiueota is trodden on by an excited puppy and bounces back up giggling.

name: Autalern
summary: Autalern is a grinning enforcer for a neon-painted street gang, fond of swinging chains and cheap tricks. Autalern is loud, cruel and rarely seen without a crowd of clowns behind.

feats.scene: Autalern whips a heavy chain through a shop window and shatters the whole pane.
Autalern is flung through a diner booth and stands up still grinning.

name: Llust
summary: Llust is a bald alien warlord who has erased the populations of a dozen worlds for sport. A parasite on the neck keeps Llust's mind intact, and Llust brawls with famous bounty hunters and walks away.

feats.scene: Llust drives both fists through the wall of a fortress and brings down the whole district around it.
Llust shrugs off a volley of siege cannons and keeps advancing.

name: Tiaveto
summary: Tiaveto is a conscript of a fear-fuelled space legion, armed with a yellow ring that shapes light into blasts and shields. Tiaveto marches into a standoff beside thousands of others and is caught in a single colossal burst.

feats.scene: Tiaveto fires a ring blast that cuts a patrol skiff in half.
Tiaveto's ring shield holds against a barrage of thrown debris.

name: Oriesitis
summary: Oriesitis is a purple-skinned alien consumed by hatred for a kinsman who joined the opposing corps. Oriesitis hoards a charging battery and a ring, and swears vengeance across the stars.

feats.scene: Oriesitis blasts a cargo hauler apart with a beam of yellow light.
Oriesitis is thrown through a bulkhead and stands back up swearing.

name: Virannt
summary: Virannt is a quiet hired gun who can melt into drifting vapour at will. Virannt kills only those judged beyond saving, and privately dreams of a future where nobody needs to.

feats.scene: Virannt steps out of a cloud of vapour and fires a single round through a window into a target across the yard.
Virannt takes a rifle round to the chest in the final ambush.

name: Stnorn
summary: Stnorn is a petty crook who poisons a partner to keep a share of stolen cash. Guilt and sleepwalking unravel Stnorn's mind on a lonely island hideout.

feats.scene: Stnorn heaves a shovelful of earth over a hasty grave in the dark.
Stnorn is clipped by a car door and keeps running toward the canoe.

name: Lleon
summary: Lleon is a gentle, pink-skinned sewer dweller with cape-like wings, made in a lab. Lleon tends to the sick while others rage, and wraps those in her care in a pocket of air under poisoned water.

feats.scene: Lleon snaps her wings open to fan a cloud of fumes away from the sick.
Lleon holds her wings over a flooded tunnel while a heavy gas pours across the surface.

name: Rosolu
summary: Rosolu is a tall dock brawler who tears through walls with swinging fists and dives to the river bottom. Rosolu speaks two languages and survives a flying hero's scorching gaze without a serious burn.

feats.scene: Rosolu punches a hole through a warehouse wall in one blow.
Rosolu stands unharmed under a long burst of searing light from a flying hero's eyes.

name: Ineoanu
summary: Ineoanu is a magenta crocodile-headed alien who mesmerises prey with an unblinking stare. Ineoanu bites down on victims with enormous jaws and wields a yellow ring and its charging battery.

feats.scene: Ineoanu chomps the nose off a small shuttle and spits out the cockpit.
Ineoanu's hide takes a point-blank shot from a heavy cannon and only scars.

name: Ninvalci
summary: Ninvalci is a gruff veteran news editor who runs a magazine from a glass office. Ninvalci wields a red pen and a sharp tongue instead of any weapon, and once took a sabbatical.

feats.scene: Ninvalci slaps a desk so hard that the whole newsroom goes quiet.
Ninvalci takes a full week of deadline stress without missing an issue.

name: Anuole
summary: Anuole is a swaggering hoodlum who loses to a speedster, then enters a boat race rigged with a hidden line. Anuole ends up skipping across the lake like a flat pebble.

feats.scene: Anuole swings a fist at a rival and misses by a mile.
Anuole is flung from a speedboat, skips across the water several times and lands in a patrolman's arms.

name: Laoseo
summary: Laoseo is a hired jailer who keeps wealthy relatives locked in a care home until the law declares them dead. Laoseo is no match for a fast chaser and is spun into a wall by a revolving door.

feats.scene: Laoseo slams a cell door shut with a shove of the shoulder.
Laoseo is flung off the spinning door into plaster and wakes up under a bucket of cold water.

name: Taurnles
summary: Taurnles is a grey-skinned alien who pays a bounty hunter with fine cigars to free a younger brother from prison. The brothers embrace and the hug proves fatal to both.

feats.scene: Taurnles squeezes a sibling in a farewell hug with enough force to crush bone.
Taurnles bargains through a cell's bars and is shoved into the wall without complaint.

name: Taucinum
summary: Taucinum is a masked marksman who hides in an iron tower and hunts enemy officers across a continent and then across a sea. Taucinum strikes without warning and vanishes before the alarm rings.

feats.scene: Taucinum fires a single rifle round across a market square into a general's window.
Taucinum drops from a rooftop to a haystack and rolls up unhurt.

name: Tumcorte
summary: Tumcorte is a fluffy blue kitten whose cuteness conceals a thieving, schemey heart. Tumcorte wears a necklace that mutates shelter cats into monsters.

feats.scene: Tumcorte's necklace pulses and three cats swell into snarling beasts that crush a fence.
Tumcorte tumbles down a steep alley and bounces away unbothered.

name: Nusamam
summary: Nusamam is a mysterious northern agent who pulls heat out of the air and sets moisture into ice. Nusamam hurls frozen debris on gusts of bitter wind and glazes targets with a shell of frost.

feats.scene: Nusamam breathes a wave of killing cold that sheathes a whole tenement in ice.
Nusamam wades unhurt through a storm of flaming debris.

name: Riatorrus
summary: Riatorrus is a pale queen with orange hair who rules a frozen kingdom from a high throne. Riatorrus turns away two eager suitors and sets a hard test for anyone hoping to win the crown.

feats.scene: Riatorrus raps a sceptre on the ice floor and the whole court falls silent.
Riatorrus sits unbothered through a howling blizzard on the open balcony.

name: Lianeo
summary: Lianeo is a white-haired smuggler who snorts powder to become a blazing, tireless brute. Lianeo's flaming touch can make bystanders reel, and Lianeo preaches his habit like a faith.

feats.scene: Lianeo detonates a ring of flame that guts a loading shed and everything in it.
Lianeo laughs through a rain of gunfire and a boulder thrown at his chest.

name: Telceo
summary: Telceo is a white-haired island crime lord who gains temporary muscle, speed and pain immunity from a chemical rush. Telceo runs a small private empire from a seaside villa.

feats.scene: Telceo smashes a car door off its hinges with a single backhand.
Telceo ignores a flurry of kicks and a crowbar to the ribs.

name: Lennelli
summary: Lennelli is a pale, orange-haired princess who cannot survive warm air and rules a hidden ice country. Lennelli is betrayed by an ambitious minister who steals a climate machine.

feats.scene: Lennelli slaps a conspirator's hand off the throne arm.
Lennelli endures a night of freezing wind without a shiver.

name: Illoleeo
summary: Illoleeo is a tiny henchman from a far future age who dresses like a copy of a stage magician. Illoleeo follows a master into the past to meddle with a famous trial.

feats.scene: Illoleeo pokes a lever with a short stick and a trapdoor drops open.
Illoleeo is tossed across a courtroom bench and scurries away.

name: Luril
summary: Luril is a black-eyed alien soldier who wears a will-powered ring and carries a charging battery. Luril casts shields, bolts and glowing constructs and flies between star systems.

feats.scene: Luril brings down a hovering fortress with a stream of green light.
Luril's glowing shield soaks up a salvo of missiles.

name: Nusial
summary: Nusial is a shape-shifting metal robot who serves a rogue machine inventor. Nusial's variable body is cold and strong, and a small response device in the chest drives it.

feats.scene: Nusial's steel fist caves in the door of a vault.
Nusial's body takes a direct hit from a lab's industrial press and dents but holds.

name: Llcatiu
summary: Llcatiu is a vengeful, manipulative crime queen who is also a masked serial killer. Raised hard by a cold father, Llcatiu hits with startling violence and plans every move.

feats.scene: Llcatiu hurls a heavy man across a banquet hall and through a table.
Llcatiu takes a pistol-whipping and answers with a knife.

name: Osnalrer
summary: Osnalrer is a student whose family was altered in a secret facility. After a warlord brainwashed Osnalrer into a soldier, a team of heroes freed her mind and she joined them.

feats.scene: Osnalrer smashes through a reinforced door with a single lunge.
Osnalrer is flung through a wall during a rooftop brawl and gets back up.

name: Ntereo
summary: Ntereo is a sharp-eyed investigator who carries a will-fuelled ring and leads a new team of champions. Ntereo makes shields, flies and builds glowing tools, and finds the culprit before anyone else.

feats.scene: Ntereo drops a glowing wedge on an invading warship and splits it from bow to stern.
Ntereo's glowing barrier holds against a wave of rockets.

name: Celmi
summary: Celmi is a former soldier and officer of the law who bears a ring and polices a sector so remote that nobody numbered it. Celmi flies, shields and forms glowing constructs, and fights for fairness in a city of ancient grudges.

feats.scene: Celmi hammers a giant glowing fist into a rogue tower and levels it with a single blow.
Celmi holds up a glowing dome over a crowd during a violent blast.

name: Iumreoto
summary: Iumreoto is a genderless guardian intelligence living in a suit of power armour and a glowing crystal. Iumreoto fights only when it must, gathers energy from a nearby star, and chooses deletion over serving a hacker.

feats.scene: Iumreoto fires the armour's stored sunlight in a flash that melts a tank column.
Iumreoto holds the armour intact while a hostile machine hammers it with orbital fire.

name: Esnitor
summary: Esnitor is a software copy of a tycoon that runs a company's decision engine. Esnitor can jump into an android body, shoots energy and wrestles with machine strength, but is helpless if its code is erased.

feats.scene: Esnitor's android hand fires a white beam that melts a server rack.
Esnitor's metal body shrugs off a collapsing ceiling in the data hall.

name: Tetiusa
summary: Tetiusa is a red-skinned, blond engineered minion who sends out blasts of what looks like captured sunlight. Tetiusa serves a manipulative master and is sent after two young holders of a magic dial.

feats.scene: Tetiusa fires a pulse of sunlit force that splits a lamppost and scorches the pavement for a block.
Tetiusa is slammed by a speeding truck and stumbles up grinning.

name: Nteirnir
summary: Nteirnir is a red-eyed metal mind that moves objects with thought alone. Nteirnir appears for a single story and is destroyed before anyone learns what it wanted.

feats.scene: Nteirnir lifts a delivery truck with its mind and drops it on a lab roof.
Nteirnir's metal casing endures a thorough hammering from a team of heroes.

name: Lliau
summary: Lliau is a green-skinned warlord who leads a band of oversized fighters in an invasion of a peaceful world. Lliau offers a rigged duel to the captives and breaks the promise at once.

feats.scene: Lliau cracks a stone pillar in half with a sweep of a sword arm.
Lliau takes a hard punch from a rival and merely staggers.

name: Llatiu
summary: Llatiu is a blond criminal in a suit of sun-themed armour who terrorises a big modern city. Llatiu's plated suit adds power to every blow and shot.

feats.scene: Llatiu's armoured fist smashes a bus shelter and the bench behind it.
Llatiu walks through a police barricade and takes dozens of rounds on the chest plate.

name: Ntcornu
summary: Ntcornu is a dark-haired trainee who signs up to a hero academy in a dream. Ntcornu is drilled by a metal mentor and joins a squad of recruits in matching uniforms.

feats.scene: Ntcornu lands a clumsy kick on a practice dummy and tips it over.
Ntcornu takes a bruising round on the obstacle course and keeps jogging.

name: Unesiiu
summary: Unesiiu is a brown-haired trainee who joins the same dream academy as a fellow recruit. Unesiiu wears a military-styled uniform that hints at a link to an older band of cadets.

feats.scene: Unesiiu throws a firm punch at a bag and rattles its chain.
Unesiiu is flattened by a sparring partner and rolls back to her feet.

name: Isvalrn
summary: Isvalrn is a cheerful warrior of light from an idyllic sky-city who trades blows with dark invaders. Isvalrn streaks overhead as a beam of pure radiance and fires dazzling bolts.

feats.scene: Isvalrn fires a lance of radiance that carves a canyon through a hostile army.
Isvalrn streaks across the sky as a living beam of light.

name: Lonial
summary: Lonial is a red-haired god of light who turns a wedding feast into a slaughter. Lonial fights for a city of dreams that has become cruel.

feats.scene: Lonial scorches a ballroom into a pit of glass with a single burst.
Lonial takes a blast to the face during the melee and laughs.

name: Tacorora
summary: Tacorora is a blue-eyed god of light from a bright sky-city in a world where history diverged. Tacorora has rarely been shown in action.

feats.scene: Tacorora fires a burst of light that blows a hole in a stone wall.
Tacorora stands in a rain of burning rubble and is not scratched.

name: Iasanrus
summary: Iasanrus is a red-haired prince from an undersea civilisation who makes trouble for an Amazon heroine. Iasanrus is an old schemer who fights with brute cunning.

feats.scene: Iasanrus drives a trident through a harbour boat's hull.
Iasanrus is bowled over by a wave and rises with a scowl.

name: Unelst
summary: Unelst is a wise ancient king with a vast household, a dream-granted gift of judgement and a famous temple. Unelst joins a band of old heroes and later pays for pride with a divided realm.

feats.scene: Unelst raises a sword and a whole courtroom goes silent before the verdict.
Unelst endures a desert march of many days without rest.

name: Tianiaser
summary: Tianiaser is a dark-haired outcast from a distant world whose people slip through solid walls. Tianiaser fails an audition for a hero club and forms a rival team of rejects.

feats.scene: Tianiaser steps through a vault wall and punches a guard from behind.
Tianiaser lets a volley of rounds pass through his body without a mark.

name: Nicela
summary: Nicela is a white-haired ape who rules a hidden city after a regime falls. Nicela joins an assassin's league in a plan to cull humanity, and can stop other apes' breathing with mind alone.

feats.scene: Nicela hurls a wrecked truck across a plaza at a charging rival.
Nicela takes a rocket on the chest and goes on speaking.

name: Meilco
summary: Meilco is an ancient ape who was touched by a strange light and woke up able to think, read and speak. Meilco studies the nature of that light, walks its dimension and crosses time to warn a boy who has not yet received it.

feats.scene: Meilco hurls a spiral of light that levels a whole mountain range.
Meilco runs through a dimension of pure motion in an instant.

name: Soniall
summary: Soniall is a bald, scrappy newcomer who brawls with basic technique and a lot of nerve. Soniall appears briefly alongside a team of young heroes.

feats.scene: Soniall lands a plain right hook on a mugger's jaw.
Soniall takes a hard shove into a lamppost and shakes it off.

name: Stisilsia
summary: Stisilsia is a black-haired alien heroine who turns lifeless objects into living creatures. Stisilsia's gift is gentle but startling, and a lamp may suddenly stretch and trot away.

feats.scene: Stisilsia wakes a toppled statue and it lumbers off to block a runaway cart.
Stisilsia is knocked flat by a rolling barrel and is soon laughing.

name: Colces
summary: Colces is a black-haired young man with mystical talent who turns up in the middle of a contest-gone-wrong. Colces draws on a quiet, unexplained magic and keeps his past in shadow.

feats.scene: Colces flings a ball of pale fire that tears a dumpster apart.
Colces shields himself with a shimmering wall as a pipe swings at his head.

name: Illtor
summary: Illtor is a bald heroine from the future who boasts of unusually sharp hearing underwater. Illtor is cheery, chatty and keen for a dip in any pool she can find.

feats.scene: Illtor knocks a rival off a springboard with a quick shove.
Illtor takes a belly flop from the high board without a bruise.

name: Vaernti
summary: Vaernti is a tall red-haired criminal whose body is packed with implants that scream at deadly pitch. Vaernti conquers a small town in an afternoon, then breaks out of jail to demand a gang's release.

feats.scene: Vaernti hits a civic hall with a scream and cracks every window on the block.
Vaernti survives a hard clash with a pair of costumed heroes in a stairwell.

name: Sorlliria
summary: Sorlliria is a black-haired hero with feathered wings who flies in a brief and bright career. Sorlliria belongs to a modest team and dies in the very first story she appears in.

feats.scene: Sorlliria strikes a drone with a wing and sends it spinning.
Sorlliria is battered against a wall of sheet metal and rises again.

name: Vacorva
summary: Vacorva is a detective who joins two friends in hiding behind a bat-eared costume to hit back at a mob boss. Vacorva shoots, glides on a custom wing and investigates, until she is unmasked and loses her badge.

feats.scene: Vacorva fires a flare pistol and the rafters of a warehouse catch fire.
Vacorva rolls off a roof onto a canopy and limps away.

name: Lesaco
summary: Lesaco is a young member of a powerful crime clan, known only by name and family ties. Lesaco is mentioned a few times and has no recorded deed.

feats.scene: Lesaco slaps a table and a bartender flinches.
Lesaco is elbowed in a crowded club and keeps smiling.

name: Nauleota
summary: Nauleota is a bald, brown-skinned alien slaver who raises a child as property, hoping to marry her one day. Nauleota is skilled at cruelty and torture and meets his end at the hands of his escaped ward.

feats.scene: Nauleota lashes a captive with a braided whip and cracks a stone post.
Nauleota is hurled down a flight of stairs and gets up shouting orders.

name: Lisoar
summary: Lisoar is a purple-skinned judge who rules a refuelling outpost and waves off outsiders as irrelevant. After a disaster wrecks his ship, Lisoar accepts a ring and joins a fresh corps of space police.

feats.scene: Lisoar forges a green gavel the size of a barge and smashes a rogue hull flat.
Lisoar's glowing barrier holds back a blast that melts a hangar roof.

name: Llaslor
summary: Llaslor is a green-skinned judge and member of an old interstellar police force. Llaslor attends a meeting called after a hidden listening trap is found, and carries a ring and a charging battery.

feats.scene: Llaslor shapes a glowing ram and punches a hole through a rogue freighter.
Llaslor's ring shield soaks up a stream of heavy turret fire.

name: Tiaveoirn
summary: Tiaveoirn is a brown-eyed teenager who grows up alongside a brother and a very odd stepfather. Tiaveoirn speaks two languages, has asthma and brandishes a knife and a meat mallet to scare a clown.

feats.scene: Tiaveoirn swings a meat mallet into a table and the wood splinters.
Tiaveoirn is knocked down by a door and wheezes back to her feet.

name: Veool
summary: Veool is a disciplined private security agent trained at a military school and skilled with fists and a sidearm. Veool joins a masked team after a broken romance and a hard choice about honesty.

feats.scene: Veool lands a boxing hook that drops a bruiser in an alley.
Veool takes a baton across the ribs and fires back without pause.

name: Tonnusiu
summary: Tonnusiu is a pink-skinned surgeon who becomes the bearer of a will-driven ring and patrols a distant sector. Tonnusiu flies, shields and shoots glowing bolts, and heals as readily as she fights.

feats.scene: Tonnusiu slices a pirate cruiser in two with a razor sheet of green light.
Tonnusiu throws up a barrier that stops a volley of heavy shells.

name: Iumterma
summary: Iumterma is a pink-skinned neurosurgeon of a people who hate the ring she now wears. Iumterma proudly calls herself the finest doctor on her home world and keeps a whole sector safe with a glowing shield and flaming constructs.

feats.scene: Iumterma moulds a glowing lance and impales a raider's frigate through the keel.
Iumterma braces her ring shield while a cannon burst melts a landing deck behind her.

name: Orcorme
summary: Orcorme is a yellow-skinned ruler of a planet of gamblers who stages false-stakes contests. Orcorme confesses at the first match and happily keeps the games going as pure sport.

feats.scene: Orcorme spins a huge wheel and throws the stage lights into a shower of sparks.
Orcorme sits through a thrown brick without moving a muscle.

name: Iarorast
summary: Iarorast is a bald, orange-and-blue gambler from a planet where all work is done by machines. Iarorast drags star-travellers into rigged contests with oversized slot machines and roulette wheels, and puts whole worlds at stake for fun.

feats.scene: Iarorast overloads a giant slot machine and the blast rips the roof off a casino.
Iarorast is tumbled by a shockwave and is up in time to place another bet.

name: Nestoni
summary: Nestoni is a brown-eyed sorcerer who blends ritual and machines to seize the minds and gifts of rivals. Nestoni prowls a rough city and makes fighters into puppets.

feats.scene: Nestoni drives a captive fighter to smash a brick wall with her borrowed strength.
Nestoni's wards soak up a hail of bullets in a back alley.

name: Aranent
summary: Aranent is a green-skinned, eyeless alien who once carried a greed-fuelled ring. Aranent flies, shoots bolts and forms glowing constructs, and has since put the ring down.

feats.scene: Aranent casts a hail of orange bolts that strips a freighter's plating.
Aranent weathers a crash against a cargo crane and rises unhurt.

name: Riiulas
summary: Riiulas is a whitish alien made of a soft vat-grown substance, stuck in place behind a burger shack. Riiulas steals cattle with remote saucers to power a planet-ending machine, and makes duplicate managers from the same material.

feats.scene: Riiulas fires up a planet-cracking device and the whole globe shakes before it is shut off.
Riiulas is dunked on a plate and drenched in sauce while he spills his secrets.

name: Aurennin
summary: Aurennin is a blue-haired, blue-eyed killer who tears across a huge country by train and truck. Aurennin fights with a pair of short blades of crackling light and is almost caught by mounted officers.

feats.scene: Aurennin slashes a freight car's roof open with twin blades of light.
Aurennin takes a tumble across the rails and keeps running.

name: Saralu
summary: Saralu is a talkative driver who ferries alien passengers around the stars in a battered cab. Saralu knows many languages, tells tall tales and avoids brawls at all cost.

feats.scene: Saralu slams a cab door on a stubborn fare's coat tail.
Saralu bounces through a rough landing in an old cab and complains about the paint.

name: Cotontiu
summary: Cotontiu is a woman adventurer who drinks in a cosy pub and appears at a villain's showdown. Cotontiu is never named in her first stories, and nobody can say for sure whose side she is on.

feats.scene: Cotontiu tosses a pint at a ruffian and follows it with a stool.
Cotontiu is shoved over a table in a bar fight and laughs.

name: Unmiar
summary: Unmiar is a black-haired mad scientist who battles a young hero in a bright costume. Unmiar builds odd machines and little else is known of him.

feats.scene: Unmiar fires a bulky ray gadget and melts a hole in a laboratory table.
Unmiar is tossed into a rack of beakers and crawls out coughing.

name: Lorceliu
summary: Lorceliu is a tall professional thief who crackles with electricity. Lorceliu blasts police cars with bolts, cuts power to alarm systems and offers to work with a cat burglar.

feats.scene: Lorceliu fires a bolt that bursts the tyres and lights of three squad cars.
Lorceliu shrugs off a fall from a balcony and keeps running.

name: Ulmirus
summary: Ulmirus is a blond orphan raised by a wealthy lord who fights crime beside a beetle-themed hero in the 1940s. Ulmirus is a plucky student with basic scrapping skills.

feats.scene: Ulmirus kicks a thug's ankle out from under him.
Ulmirus is clipped by a speeding sedan and limps home.

name: Laterirn
summary: Laterirn is a brash city urchin whose low-level electric gift can knock a person out on touch. Laterirn is an apprentice killer who brags about big talent that is still growing.

feats.scene: Laterirn puts two people to sleep with a crackling grab in a hotel lobby.
Laterirn is knocked cold by a single punch.

name: Neere
summary: Neere is a dark-haired criminal who wears a bird costume and clashes with a dream-sand hero. Neere appears in one story and leaves little record behind.

feats.scene: Neere swoops down a fire escape and kicks a ladder into a guard.
Neere falls from a window ledge onto an awning and is up at once.

name: Llelicis
summary: Llelicis is a green-skinned queen whose memory of a divine school drove her mad. Llelicis conquers her own world with borrowed godly power and hunts fellow seeds to drain their gifts, until her mind is burned out by a trick.

feats.scene: Llelicis tears the peak off a mountain in a rage with a wave of divine force.
Llelicis absorbs a flood of channelled godly energy that restores her elders and scorches her mind.

name: Ntoro
summary: Ntoro is a brainy, brash astronaut from a lost expedition. Ntoro dies far from home and his body is moved around by friendly spores for decades until a surviving friend brings the ship back to rest.

feats.scene: Ntoro presses a switch with a spore-guided hand and the cabin lights flicker on.
Ntoro's frozen body endures decades of drift in deep space.

name: Corcolter
summary: Corcolter is a blonde whose body was revived by a snake-themed cult and sent out to fight a team of heroes. Corcolter can fly and takes orders without much fuss.

feats.scene: Corcolter swoops over a courtyard and kicks a guard through a window.
Corcolter pulls out of a dive just above a parked truck.

name: Ntriase
summary: Ntriase is a brown-haired criminal chief who loots small towns for gold and gems. Ntriase plans to buy up a small nation's debt and runs a disguised ship with a squadron of jets.

feats.scene: Ntriase orders a jet squadron to strafe a convoy and flips every lorry.
Ntriase is tackled onto a deck by a squad of airmen.

name: Stonenosa
summary: Stonenosa is a blonde hired killer from a secret guild who falls to a squad of flyers. Stonenosa strikes quietly and is gone before the alarm.

feats.scene: Stonenosa fires a silenced pistol into a cabin door and a guard drops.
Stonenosa tumbles down a stairwell and keeps moving.

name: Lluererum
summary: Lluererum is a white-eyed phantom of vengeance who signs up to an online dating service. Lluererum arrives at a tower to meet a date and is stuffed into a closet by a jealous guard, then hires an apprentice who outscares him.

feats.scene: Lluererum raises a ghostly tide that rattles every window in a building.
Lluererum is pummelled and squeezed into a closet and keeps his composure.

name: Rilonte
summary: Rilonte is a black-haired technician who was altered by a cult's experiments and generates bolts of electricity. Rilonte once fought alongside a snake-themed squad and returned in a later crisis.

feats.scene: Rilonte releases a thick arc that blows out a whole street's power.
Rilonte shrugs off a hard blow and a lengthy tumble from a stairwell.

name: Sitaau
summary: Sitaau is an orange-haired heroine from a dream realm who runs at a blistering pace. Sitaau is erased in a cosmic collapse, returns for a short time and is sent home when the cast learns they are in a story.

feats.scene: Sitaau sprints across a plaza faster than sound and leaves the fountain rippling.
Sitaau slams a gate at full tilt and it flies off its hinges.

name: Niseoan
summary: Niseoan is an orange-haired musician who channels a force of pure motion on a parallel world. Niseoan is one of a dream-realm team of heroes and runs at a blistering pace.

feats.scene: Niseoan strums a note and bolts across a valley before the sound fades.
Niseoan slams into a bank vault door at full tilt and splits it from its frame.

name: Anure
summary: Anure is a pink-haired student and elite fighter from a fiery world of tyrants. Anure runs with godly speed, reacts in a blink and cannot die of age.

feats.scene: Anure crosses the school grounds in a blur before a dropped book hits the floor.
Anure drives a fist through a school bus and blows its engine block clear.

name: Auleruli
summary: Auleruli is a red-haired archer who is a friend and rival to a team leader. Auleruli forms a rival team after losing a contest for the tower and asks a teammate on a date.

feats.scene: Auleruli fires an arrow that pins a flying robot to a wall.
Auleruli takes a blow from a thrown chair and grins.

name: Rnunte
summary: Rnunte is a red-haired young helper and student who studies medicine. Rnunte tends the sick and bruised in a small town and joins a youth squad of volunteers.

feats.scene: Rnunte heaves a crate of medicine onto a cart.
Rnunte falls off a bicycle and bandages his own knee.

name: Sorisval
summary: Sorisval was once a mighty champion before a corrupting red mineral twisted him into a crimson ant-like creature. Rescued from a dying world by a gentle-sounding patron, Sorisval now pays for shelter with a share of life-energy.

feats.scene: Sorisval lifts a collapsing bridge span and sets it down across a river.
Sorisval takes a falling tower on the carapace and crawls out from the rubble.

name: Ernststi
summary: Ernststi is a walking-world-sized city threaded with circuitry, able to watch and act on anything within reach. Ernststi bends gravity and the ground itself, and once chose to become a haven for vice.

feats.scene: Ernststi drags a mountain range into a tidal ridge with one heave of its gravity engines.
Ernststi's central core takes a full planetary bombardment and keeps humming.

name: Sacarel
summary: Sacarel is a white-haired high priest who radiates a crimson glow he calls grace and slips markers into followers' blood to remake them. Sacarel is no god, but he is worshipped like one by those he has rewired.

feats.scene: Sacarel floods a plaza with radiant red light that blisters the stone and drops a crowd.
Sacarel weathers a barrage of heavy weapons fire at the temple steps without flinching.

name: Coanam
summary: Coanam is a slow-witted red-eyed courier who teleports across worlds, hopping between known landing points. Coanam delivers parcels and passengers for a bar owner without asking what is inside.

feats.scene: Coanam hauls a heavy crate aboard and vanishes in a flash that pops every nearby window.
Coanam is thrown across a bar by an angry customer and finishes the delivery anyway.

name: Vallutor
summary: Vallutor is a freelance killer who cannot feel pain, a former circus acrobat who learned to resent the rich. Callused skin and a quiet bitterness make Vallutor an unsettling partner on any job.

feats.scene: Vallutor drives a blade through an oak door and into the guard behind it.
Vallutor keeps fighting on a broken arm without a flicker of discomfort.

name: Riastuaun
summary: Riastuaun is a teenager from a rough neighborhood who dreams of writing novels and talks a stranded alien into becoming a hero. A belt of borrowed technology turns Riastuaun into a flying, shielded sidekick.

feats.scene: Riastuaun smashes a parked car through a shop front with a belt-boosted punch.
Riastuaun is shot in the chest by a rifle and the belt's field hums.

name: Numneoti
summary: Numneoti is a gymnast and former pickpocket who wears a belt that drinks the force of every blow aimed at her. The stored energy becomes strength, a shield and flight, and a long fall can fuel a punch strong enough to level a building.

feats.scene: Numneoti falls from a plane, soaks up the impact and demolishes a house in a single blow.
Numneoti is hit by a speeding van and the belt bleeds the force into her fists.

name: Cimares
summary: Cimares served a cosmic police corps with a ring of will-powered light. Cimares perished when a mad deity seized the sector and the galaxy beyond it tore itself apart.

feats.scene: Cimares weaves a lattice of green light that snares a raider fleet in a single sweep.
Cimares holds a shield against a collapsing star-lane long enough to evacuate a station.

name: Irntta
summary: Irntta is a twirling rodent hero in a cartoon troupe of animal adventurers. Spinning like a small whirlwind is the whole act, and the audience loves it.

feats.scene: Irntta spins into a cheese tower and knocks every wedge flying.
Irntta is flattened by a cartoon anvil and pops back to a round shape.

name: Iumaunnt
summary: Iumaunnt is a red-furred courier deity who scampers up and down a world-tree carrying news and gossip. Iumaunnt tells long sagas to four small children and asks a warrior for help when the tree begins to die.

feats.scene: Iumaunnt kicks a heavy branch loose and sends it crashing into a gorge.
Iumaunnt tumbles from the topmost bough to the roots and chirps happily on landing.

name: Orrau
summary: Orrau is a gentle inventor-thief who built a remote that commands rodents. Poverty and addiction drove Orrau to steal trinkets by rat, and a daughter inherited both the remote and the kindness.

feats.scene: Orrau thumbs the remote and a swarm of rats drag a jewelry case across the floor.
Orrau is thrown against a wall by a hired guard and keeps smiling.

name: Unseoti
summary: Unseoti is a red-eyed bald demon of great strength and burning temper, one of a triad of infernal brothers. Unseoti hurls flame and brute force at anyone who dares summon the trio.

feats.scene: Unseoti hurls a ball of fire into a warehouse and levels it in one burst.
Unseoti stands in a blazing collapse that would level a house and shrugs.

name: Amnuses
summary: Amnuses is a pink-skinned demon with black eyes and red hair, one of three brothers conjured by a greedy wizard. A pair of rival tricksters teleported the trio away before they could do much harm.

feats.scene: Amnuses claws a crater into the courtyard stones with a swing of the arm.
Amnuses shakes off a volley of enchanted bolts that scatter a squad of soldiers.

name: Linrneno
summary: Linrneno is a white-skinned demon with black hair and eyes, a minister of fear among infernal brothers. Linrneno lurks in the margins of a cartoon city, waiting for a summoner.

feats.scene: Linrneno rakes a talon across a bridge's cables and drops a span into the bay.
Linrneno is pelted by missiles and wipes the soot off a shoulder.

name: Nanosator
summary: Nanosator is a white-haired, red-eyed rat-man, a product of a secret breeding program, who serves as seer to an island king. Nanosator reads old newspapers as scripture and sets harsh trials for a stranger.

feats.scene: Nanosator triggers a wall of automatic turrets across a bunker corridor.
Nanosator is hurled from a ladder and scrambles up again hissing.

name: Astvi
summary: Astvi is a hired stooge who runs errands for a masked mastermind. Dull and obedient, Astvi folds the moment a team of heroes arrives.

feats.scene: Astvi swings a crowbar at a hero's shoulder and bends it on the armor.
Astvi is knocked off a loading dock and sulks in the dumpster.

name: Isaneiu
summary: Isaneiu was a librarian and amateur occultist who translated a mystic text and used it to animate a clay avenger. Isaneiu sent the figure after a murderer for a grieving friend, and was cut down by gangsters in the end.

feats.scene: Isaneiu breathes life into a clay avenger that tears a car door off its hinges.
Isaneiu is beaten in a back alley by gangsters and left to bleed.

name: Tesorn
summary: Tesorn is a hired killer who built a name as a serial murderer to bait a famous hero. The plan led to a showdown atop a dam, where Tesorn fell into the water and was never seen again.

feats.scene: Tesorn fires a rifle across a canyon and drops a lantern from a rail.
Tesorn falls from the crest of a dam and surfaces somewhere downriver.

name: Iuninti
summary: Iuninti is a violet-eyed schoolgirl and a demon lord's daughter who would rather study than conquer. Iuninti opens portals from the underworld to the surface, though they have a way of going wrong.

feats.scene: Iuninti tears open a portal that swallows a whole intersection and everything on it.
Iuninti takes a hit from her furious father that levels a block of homes.

name: Amillco
summary: Amillco is a moody young hero who turns down invitations to join a squad and hides his reasons. Amillco's soul can slip out of the body, feel what others feel and move things from beyond.

feats.scene: Amillco sends a soul-form through a wall and hurls a rooftop unit into the street.
Amillco absorbs a crowd's panic and a collapsing balcony and remains standing.

name: Tisre
summary: Tisre is a student from a rural reservation who flies, teleports and moves objects with the mind. Tisre's soul-form can leave the body and read the feelings of anyone nearby.

feats.scene: Tisre pulls a parked truck across a field with a flick of the mind.
Tisre lands from a hundred-foot fall and checks her sleeves for dust.

name: Esisoami
summary: Esisoami is a yellow-eyed, red-skinned mystic in a team of occultists. Esisoami was turned to glass during a quarrel and shattered, never to rise again.

feats.scene: Esisoami hurls a hand-shaped soul and flattens a squad of demon-ridden thugs.
Esisoami is turned to glass and fractured by a blow that levels a doorway.

name: Covaval
summary: Covaval is a blue-skinned mystic who dislikes violence and still wins fights with portals, shadows and bolts of dark energy. Covaval once turned a barrage of missiles back on the villains who fired them.

feats.scene: Covaval hurls a bolt of dark energy that blows a hole through a concrete wall.
Covaval takes a rocket volley on a shield of shadows and sends it back.

name: Uncolu
summary: Uncolu is a tall empath, half-demon by birth and monk-raised, who teleports and sends out a ghostly soul-form that fights and shields. Uncolu's calm discipline holds back a fury inherited from a conquering father.

feats.scene: Uncolu looses a black soul-form that smashes a wall of towers into dust.
Uncolu stands within a storm of hellish flame that melts a bridge and emerges calm.

name: Llenor
summary: Llenor is a bald scientist-engineer who builds machines for villainy. Gadgets are all Llenor has, and the audience of a cartoon world can tell.

feats.scene: Llenor drives a robot arm into a lamp post and bends it double.
Llenor is knocked off a control console by a hero's shield and groans.

name: Osaamo
summary: Osaamo is a pocket-sized comic sprite who tells lighthearted jokes and floats on hexes. Osaamo wanders into a bigger world by accident and tries to tidy the mess.

feats.scene: Osaamo flings a stack of crates across a rooftop with a wave of the tiny hands.
Osaamo is sneezed on and flattened, then pops back to full round shape.

source_title: Raven (Teen Titans TV Series: Tween Titans)

name: Turum
summary: Turum is a winged criminal who preys on rooftops and fire escapes. Black feathers and a nasty temper make Turum an annoyance to heroes.

feats.scene: Turum dives from a gargoyle and claws a hero's cloak to ribbons.
Turum is knocked off a ledge and glides in a flapping heap to the alley.

name: Sotiiar
summary: Sotiiar is a thug known on the street for a gruesome nickname. Little is recorded beyond a grudge against a rival work crew.

feats.scene: Sotiiar swings a pipe at a rival's elbow in a quarry yard.
Sotiiar is thrown over a hood and lands in gravel.

name: Torvacor
summary: Torvacor is a blond assistant to a great scientist who helped build the ship that carried a child to safety. Banished to a prison dimension, Torvacor met the grown child there, escaped with him, and died in a fight on a farm.

feats.scene: Torvacor smashes a barn door off its hinges with a hand and slides under the frame.
Torvacor is thrown through a silo wall by a brute and keeps fighting.

name: Nelres
summary: Nelres is an elderly antique dealer, kind and well informed, who hands useful clippings to a scruffy friend. He was beaten and killed by bigots, and his spirit appeared once to say goodbye.

feats.scene: Nelres pushes a stuck shop door open against the wind.
Nelres is knocked against his display cabinet by a gang and keeps shielding a guest.

name: Sirve
summary: Sirve is a scientist who co-founded a research lab and invented a technique for shrinking to a size smaller than an atom. Sirve faked his death and now explores a tiny world, chasing a dark, impenetrable particle.

feats.scene: Sirve fires a pulse from a prototype lens and punches a hole in a lab wall.
Sirve is caught in the blast of an exploding microscope and keeps working.

name: Lilela
summary: Lilela is a janitor in a twisted world who retained a scrap of genius and built a gun that restores the minds of the altered. Lilela later regained a powered suit during a siege and died in the final fight.

feats.scene: Lilela fires a salvaged gun and a whole hallway of dazed staff shake themselves awake.
Lilela is struck by a crimson speedster in a siege and is erased from the world.

name: Irncolren
summary: Irncolren is a vigilante-scientist who can shrink to tiny size. Knowledge of survival and science makes up for a lack of raw power.

feats.scene: Irncolren shrinks, then swells back to size and shoves a rubble pile off a trapped civilian.
Irncolren is flung into a wall by a thug and recovers swiftly.

name: Amosti
summary: Amosti is a divorced physics professor in a toy-brick world who wears a belt that shrinks, grows and thickens him on demand. The belt also grants strength, toughness, flight and the ability to pass through walls.

feats.scene: Amosti swells and punches a brick tower into a cloud of loose studs.
Amosti takes a falling crate of bricks on the shoulder and brushes it off.

name: Neoiumtau
summary: Neoiumtau is a tiny scientist hero who appears in a children's cartoon crew. Few details survive, but the shrinking trick is what everyone remembers.

feats.scene: Neoiumtau shrinks and tugs a pin out of a cartoon bomb.
Neoiumtau is swatted off a lab table by a cartoon henchman and bounces.

name: Seostocor
