summary: Seostocor is a wingless exile of a radiant choir who tends an orchard of memory glass beside a drowned cathedral. Seostocor bends borrowed dusk light into wards and mends wounded travellers with a touch.

feats.scene: Seostocor folds a column of dusk light into a lance that topples a stone belfry.
Seostocor stands unharmed beneath a collapsing cathedral vault.

name: Tiateeo
summary: Tiateeo is a swaggering enforcer for a rooftop gambling ring, dressed in loud leather and quick with a barbed tongue. Tiateeo wins scraps through bluff, theatre and a weighted chain.

feats.scene: Tiateeo whips a weighted chain across a card table and splinters it in two.
Tiateeo drops from a second storey and lands in a cart of laundry, laughing.

name: Sereveo
summary: Sereveo is a bald hired shadow who lurks in the rafters of a decaying opera house, running errands for a scheming patroness. Sereveo prefers ropes, nets and patience to open combat.

feats.scene: Sereveo snaps a rope taut and yanks a pickpocket off his feet.
Sereveo drops from the chandelier gantry onto the stalls and walks away.

name: Sornuto
summary: Sornuto is a ragged muckraker who prowls a sprawling neon metropolis with a pocket recorder and a loaded sidearm. Sornuto fights dirty, rants loudly and trades sleep for a story.

feats.scene: Sornuto empties a pistol into a rooftop transformer and blacks out the block.
Sornuto is thrown through a shop window and gets up still typing.

name: Nareost
summary: Nareost is a masked tinkerer who drives a clanking brass arachnid through a sleepy mill town, wrecking machinery for a grudge only he understands. Nareost talks to the machine as though it were a pet.

feats.scene: Nareost steers the brass arachnid through a freight wagon and flattens it.
Nareost rides the arachnid off a loading dock and shrugs off the crash.

name: Tisenttel
summary: Tisenttel is a lab-grown scout with extra limbs who walked away from a desert syndicate and now guards a patched-together neighbourhood. Tisenttel climbs walls, hauls crates and trusts very few people.

feats.scene: Tisenttel swings two crates at once and caves in a barricade of steel drums.
Tisenttel takes a jeep head-on and pushes it aside.

name: Ceolili
summary: Ceolili is a nervous repairer who keeps a hulking steel brute running in a workshop beneath a harbour. Ceolili zips between gantries on a jet harness and mutters about overdue bolts.

feats.scene: Ceolili fires a cutting torch through a bulkhead door in one pass.
Ceolili is knocked from a gantry by a swinging girder and lands on a coil of cable.

name: Valcoror
summary: Valcoror is a rubbery burglar who pours through vents and keyholes, stealing sealed parts from rival workshops. Valcoror is reckless when cornered and has outlived two bad plans through sheer stubbornness.

feats.scene: Valcoror stretches a limb across a gap and wrenches a vault hatch off its hinges.
Valcoror absorbs a burst from a snapped power line and crawls away smoking.

name: Ntoane
summary: Ntoane is a rumour in the alleyways, a masked weaver of snares and false trails that city folk blame for every missing watch. Ntoane has never been caught on a photograph.

feats.scene: Ntoane cinches a wire noose around a lamp post and drags a thief into the road.
Ntoane tumbles down a fire stair and rises without a limp.

name: Iumtonre
summary: Iumtonre is a green-haired warehouse guard who can briefly trade the gifts of two bystanders, to the horror of both. Iumtonre likes the job, the pay and the dramatic pauses.

feats.scene: Iumtonre swaps the gifts of two brawlers and one of them detonates a loading bay wall.
Iumtonre shrugs off a thrown crate and keeps chewing gum.

name: Seoamo
summary: Seoamo is a short-lived member of a demon-hunting band who can rewind a single heartbeat of time around a target. Seoamo uses the trick to dodge blows and to retrieve dropped keys.

feats.scene: Seoamo rewinds a falling beam by a breath and lets it drop again on a lurking ghoul.
Seoamo rewinds a stab wound before it bleeds and keeps fighting.

name: Rianasora
summary: Rianasora is a quick-witted wanderer who sprouts silk from her fingertips after waking from a chrysalis in a ruined savannah. Rianasora weaves nets, ropes and bridges between broken towers.

feats.scene: Rianasora spins a cable between two towers and hauls a stranded beast to safety.
Rianasora falls from a ruined parapet and lands in her own silk hammock.

name: Luorniu
summary: Luorniu is a blue-skinned racketeer with green eyes who runs a gaudy pleasure barge on a polluted bay. Luorniu pays in glitter, collects in favours and holds grudges against inventors.

feats.scene: Luorniu hurls a gilded anchor through the hull of a rival skiff.
Luorniu is slammed through a banquet table and brushes off the splinters.

name: Lasro
summary: Lasro is a private sleuth who dons a grotesque winged mask to scare rich victims into paying ransoms. Lasro is clever, vain and always one step ahead until the final chapter.

feats.scene: Lasro swings a cane and cracks the glass of a display cabinet.
Lasro tumbles down a flight of stone steps in full costume and keeps running.

name: Naeonlo
summary: Naeonlo is a sinister archer in a parody uniform who sells arrows to anyone with coin and a grudge. Naeonlo has survived an exile and a manhunt by being the least interesting target in the room.

feats.scene: Naeonlo looses three arrows at once and pins a guard's sleeve to a door.
Naeonlo rolls off a collapsing gantry and lands behind cover.

name: Cersern
summary: Cersern is a costumed athlete turned jailbird who gets thrown into a floating penitentiary and joins a gang for protection. Cersern brings trick equipment, a loud mouth and a short future.

feats.scene: Cersern swings a spiked club and bends a cell bar.
Cersern is flung against a wall by a rioter and stays upright.

name: Sirel
summary: Sirel is a grey-haired amphibian mechanic who keeps the tide engines of a sunken city running with salvage and quiet spells. Sirel mutters charms over every valve.

feats.scene: Sirel releases a surge of pent-up tide through a sluice and flushes a corridor of silt.
Sirel shelters under a failing pressure door while it buckles around him.

name: Sorranra
summary: Sorranra is a cold-breathed leaper who bounds from rooftop to rooftop across a foggy capital and kills a masked guardian in the dark. Sorranra is rumoured to be a noble in disguise.

feats.scene: Sorranra breathes frost across a bridge and snaps its cables.
Sorranra lands from a bell tower without breaking stride.

name: Vavirni
summary: Vavirni is a short, stooped gatekeeper demon with an axe grafted in place of one hand, who insults every visitor in rhyme. Vavirni cannot truly die and takes pride in that.

feats.scene: Vavirni chops through an iron portcullis with a single swing of his axe hand.
Vavirni is flipped onto his back and a collapsing gate lands on him with no ill effect.

name: Oletonnu
summary: Oletonnu is a simple-minded lion knight who sits at a round table at his sister's insistence and says very little beyond a single odd syllable. Oletonnu is brave, loyal and nearly always lost.

feats.scene: Oletonnu swings a broadsword by accident and cleaves a banquet bench.
Oletonnu is kicked off a drawbridge and bounces off the moat bank.

name: Coraton
summary: Coraton is a many-eyed ringbearer with a tail like a barbel, known to his superiors for using too much force. Coraton patrols a distant sector and falls to a pack of brutes.

feats.scene: Coraton hurls a spear of emerald light through a pirate dreadnought.
Coraton withstands a barrage of cannon fire behind a shield of light.

name: Nucelsau
summary: Nucelsau is a tribal warrior of an ancient people who predate the sky-city dwellers on their homeworld. Nucelsau fights with club and boulder and holds the old ground against a mad lord.

feats.scene: Nucelsau hurls a boulder through a stockade wall.
Nucelsau takes a thunderous blow from a charging beast and stands his ground.

name: Leolorau
summary: Leolorau is a bald hunter bred in an antimatter foundry and sent to fetch a ringbearer across the void. Leolorau forgets his mission for a while and works as a human thug, then remembers.

feats.scene: Leolorau tears the cargo door off a hauler and hurls it a hundred paces.
Leolorau walks through a flare of green light that would melt a bridge.

name: Vellva
summary: Vellva is a friendly waitress at a corner cafe who knows every regular's order and every rumour on the block. Vellva passes warnings to friends when trouble comes through the door.

feats.scene: Vellva slams a tray on the counter and silences a rowdy table.
Vellva slips on a wet floor, falls hard and carries on the shift.

name: Iurnse
summary: Iurnse is a young adventurer who can shrink to a thumb or swell to a doorway at will, though she cannot say how. Iurnse joins a ragged band of rookies against a relentless hunter.

feats.scene: Iurnse swells to a giant and shoves a parked van across a lot.
Iurnse shrinks into a vent as a blast shreds the room behind her.

name: Stiiuri
summary: Stiiuri is a bald big-game hunter whose broken spine was rebuilt with machinery, leaving him faster and stronger than any quarry. Stiiuri grew bored of easy prey and chased a legend through a neon city.

feats.scene: Stiiuri bare-handedly pins a leopard to the ground and ends the chase.
Stiiuri takes a rooftop fall and a rifle butt and keeps stalking.

name: Eolenust
summary: Eolenust is an eight-foot warrior who sold his soul to a god of battle and cannot die until that god's last worshipper is gone. Eolenust fights for scraps of freedom through centuries of war.

feats.scene: Eolenust cleaves a siege tower in two and the rubble flattens a stone barracks.
Eolenust is buried under a falling fortress wall and walks out of the dust.

name: Torvalnel
summary: Torvalnel is a gentle old ruler of a coral city who is ousted by an ambitious schemer and restored by young friends. Torvalnel later hands over the crown and takes up fishing.

feats.scene: Torvalnel raps his sceptre on a table and ends a heated debate.
Torvalnel survives a week in a damp cell without complaint.

name: Veosiseo
summary: Veosiseo is a blond smuggler who ferries the dying past a quarantine wall in a rattling truck. Veosiseo believes in the cause and pays dearly for it.

feats.scene: Veosiseo throws a crate at a patrol drone and knocks it off course.
Veosiseo rolls out of the truck at speed and gets up bruised.

name: Irnamtor
summary: Irnamtor is a dark-haired fixer with a venomous nickname who works the back rooms of a port town. Irnamtor trades secrets, cuts corners and keeps a knife in his boot.

feats.scene: Irnamtor drives a knife through a thick oak door.
Irnamtor takes a beating from three dockhands and still bargains.

name: Stoco
summary: Stoco is a cheerful exile and fighter pilot who flees a crushed air force with a friend and joins a daring volunteer squadron. Stoco knows plants, chemicals and several languages.

feats.scene: Stoco strafes a convoy in a single pass and halts it dead.
Stoco ejects from a burning plane and survives a rough landing.

name: Ronninse
summary: Ronninse is a loyal flier from a conquered homeland who serves alongside an old friend in a roving air squadron. Ronninse meets an unlucky end in a hangar and later a gentler fate in a rewritten timeline.

feats.scene: Ronninse fires a burst from a fighter and downs an enemy scout.
Ronninse crawls from the wreck of a crashed fighter with a sprained wrist.

name: Valres
summary: Valres is a patient, cold-blooded killer who studies his victims before he ever meets them. Valres favours small blades, forged confessions and poisons mixed from hospital stock.

feats.scene: Valres drives a blade through a leather jacket from behind with one thrust.
Valres takes a beating in a prison yard and smiles through it.

name: Celoll
summary: Celoll is a researcher whose lab accident twisted him into a hulking, flexible brute bent on revenge against his clinic. Celoll wraps around pillars and squeezes steel bars.

feats.scene: Celoll crushes a steel gurney into a tight ball.
Celoll is hit by a speeding ambulance and keeps coming.

name: Lluve
summary: Lluve is a reporter who absorbed strange rays and learned to bend light, then sold his skills to a secret agency. Lluve is vain, disciplined and mostly interested in himself.

feats.scene: Lluve focuses sunlight into a beam that burns through an armoured transport.
Lluve turns to pure light as a missile passes through him.

name: Ntimatir
summary: Ntimatir is a young colonist who breathes flame after inhaling smoke from a fallen rock, and becomes dangerously hot in richer air. Ntimatir bands together with other rejected applicants.

feats.scene: Ntimatir exhales a blaze that torches an entire audition hall.
Ntimatir shrugs off a burning ceiling beam.

name: Siavast
summary: Siavast is the owner of a cluttered mystic shop who sells charms, lipstick and gentle meddling to young romantics. Siavast has a strong hunch about the future and often keeps it to herself.

feats.scene: Siavast shoves a heavy trunk across the floor to block a door.
Siavast slips in the stockroom and stops her own fall with a shelf.

name: Auncis
summary: Auncis is a glamorous alien singer whose people swell with age until they burst, and who survives the vacuum without a suit. Auncis gives a performance so loud it blows the clothes off a listener.

feats.scene: Auncis lets out a full-throated note that shatters a stadium's glass roof.
Auncis floats unharmed in hard vacuum while a nearby hull cracks.

name: Anniacor
summary: Anniacor is a divorced detective who works the grey streets of a frontier colony and talks too much about his ex. Anniacor trusts his hunches and a battered revolver.

feats.scene: Anniacor decks a bouncer with a single right hook.
Anniacor tumbles down a flight of iron stairs and lights a cigar at the bottom.

name: Sanme
summary: Sanme is a gardener who wields a magical bloom to coax whole forests into growth, and shares the thoughts of nearby plants. Sanme protects the balance of a hidden palace garden.

feats.scene: Sanme grows a thicket of roots that crushes a stone wall.
Sanme stands in a burning grove while vines draw the fire aside.

name: Limimia
summary: Limimia is a horned, fur-faced conqueror who darkens a whole sky with his ship and projects a giant face to announce the invasion. Limimia commands cold rays and heat beams.

feats.scene: Limimia drags his ship across the sun and freezes a whole coastline.
Limimia shrugs off his own reflected beam until the hull finally buckles.

name: Celvauosa
summary: Celvauosa is an exiled gem-wielder who hates open air and plants, and dreams of stripping a whole world of green. Celvauosa builds floating stairs and banishes foes to a spinning pocket realm.

feats.scene: Celvauosa pitches a rival into a spinning pocket realm and the doorway burns out.
Celvauosa stands in a blast of heat and survives with singed hair.

name: Naullo
summary: Naullo is a small masked child who keeps strange pets at a school club and takes them very seriously. Naullo's pets slowly take over an underwater clubhouse.

feats.scene: Naullo tosses a pet and it latches onto a classmate's face.
Naullo tumbles off a desk and rolls to his feet.

name: Setiern
summary: Setiern is a brown-haired hero in a quiet league of alternate champions who fills a chair at an emergency meeting. Setiern is dependable, modest and keen on the usual rules.

feats.scene: Setiern hurls a glowing bolt that splits a park bench.
Setiern takes a hit from a thrown car door and stays on his feet.

name: Lititi
summary: Lititi is a boastful nuisance in a pair of gauntlets that each fire a different weapon from every finger. Lititi mocks all doubters until his gadgets spawn a menace he did not foresee.

feats.scene: Lititi fires every finger at once and blows a hole in a billboard.
Lititi is tossed into a heap of crates and stumbles out dizzy.

name: Autelam
summary: Autelam is an orange-skinned warrior princess with green eyes who drinks in energy and fires it back as bolts of light. Autelam flies between rooftops and far beyond.

feats.scene: Autelam gathers a surge of sunlight and unleashes it through a tower of rock.
Autelam soaks up a blast that would level a city district and glows brighter.

name: Stinte
summary: Stinte is a wandering freedom fighter who crashes into a household of teen heroes and gets turned into a lamp by a prankster. Stinte takes the joke with good humour.

feats.scene: Stinte throws a bolt through a hovering drone and it rains scrap across a yard.
Stinte takes a fall through a roof and gets up asking for tea.

name: Miateste
summary: Miateste is a blue-skinned brawler snatched from a lightless world and forced into a gladiatorial pit before a crowd of dimensions. Miateste kills ruthlessly and meets a flash of heat that ends the fight.

feats.scene: Miateste hurls a rival through a stone arena wall and the colonnade collapses.
Miateste walks through a sheet of fire for three strides before it drops him.

name: Nusstrn
summary: Nusstrn is a bald researcher whose lab accident left him radiant and bitter, and who appears once to torment a team of daredevil explorers. Nusstrn rants about being overlooked.

feats.scene: Nusstrn flings a canister of glowing sludge and eats through a steel door.
Nusstrn survives a lab explosion that wrecks the bench beside him.

name: Iatacer
summary: Iatacer is a vain space-faring conqueror who splits herself into copies and seizes the minds of festival leaders on the last night of a year. Iatacer is undone by a team of eager apprentices.

feats.scene: Iatacer commands a dozen puppeted heroes to topple a bandstand.
Iatacer is struck by a stage lamp and divides into two intact halves.

name: Stiameon
summary: Stiameon is a caged sea creature, once the star turn of a travelling show, who sits in a rusting tank in a park that never opened. Stiameon can still tug at passing minds.

feats.scene: Stiameon nudges a night guard into unlocking a gate and then lets him go.
Stiameon waits years in a cracked tank with no food and does not die.

name: Stasia
summary: Stasia is a vast flat predator that can split into millions of copies and bend a whole planet to its will. Stasia stows away in an infant's rocket and waits for decades.

feats.scene: Stasia drives a swarm of copies to topple a mountain range around a capital.
Stasia is ripped open by a shell blast and the pieces rejoin.

name: Rostornen
summary: Rostornen is a genderless sea-creature invader that survives a world-wide plague and tries to seize a southern nation. Rostornen is beaten by a freshly reformed league of heroines.

feats.scene: Rostornen enslaves a regiment to level a harbour district.
Rostornen endures a salvo of rockets and keeps crawling.

name: Tovos
summary: Tovos is the last of an old purple species, a centuries-old drifter caged in a vault of curiosities until a chance slip lets it seize the guardian. Tovos rules minds with a touch.

feats.scene: Tovos steers a mind-held giant to punch a crater across a glacier.
Tovos shrugs off a shot that would raze a city block.

name: Iulle
summary: Iulle is a purple and white conqueror from between worlds who needs flooded land to move in and brainwashes scientists into raising the seas. Iulle is undone by a determined team of colourful heroes.

feats.scene: Iulle makes a crew of pirates fire a shell that bursts a sea wall.
Iulle absorbs a missile strike and floats on the swell.

name: Sesanra
summary: Sesanra is a galaxy-hopping conqueror who joins a corps fuelled by rage and wields a fierce red ring until a late battle ends him. Sesanra bends weaker minds with ease.

feats.scene: Sesanra overpowers a fleet of rival ships with a flood of scarlet light.
Sesanra withstands a bombardment that scours the surface of a moon.

name: Aseonti
summary: Aseonti is a hulking purple and green overlord born billions of years back, leader of a race of conquering sea creatures that rule stars. Aseonti throws whole fleets of spawn at world after world.

feats.scene: Aseonti drives a stellar swarm into a continent and shatters its crust.
Aseonti rides out the collapse of a dying sun and regrows.

name: Stutinrn
summary: Stutinrn is a cartoonish sea-creature recruited as a secret weapon by a scheming mogul. Stutinrn latches onto classmates and pets and tries to take an underwater schoolhouse.

feats.scene: Stutinrn commands a swarm of tiny spores that topple a toy tower.
Stutinrn is squashed under a desk and pops back to shape.

name: Eotelrn
summary: Eotelrn is a purple and green conqueror glimpsed only in a rumoured future, an invader beaten off at the cost of a ruined defence grid. Eotelrn is remembered as a warning.

feats.scene: Eotelrn smashes a defensive array and leaves a coastline blind.
Eotelrn is blasted by an orbital cannon and is only barely driven off.

name: Renenone
summary: Renenone is a house cat with a grand name who sleeps in a coastal home and shreds the sofa. Renenone is spoiled, haughty and entirely content.

feats.scene: Renenone claws a curtain to ribbons in one pounce.
Renenone falls from a bookshelf and lands neatly on all four paws.

name: Eotiasi
summary: Eotiasi is a leather-jacketed street kid with a cosmic rod and a belt that converts its energy, who wears a flag on his head in a jaded spirit of rebellion. Eotiasi breaks out of a prison with his partner.

feats.scene: Eotiasi fires the rod at a gate and blows it off its pillars.
Eotiasi tumbles through a prison wall and gets back to his feet.

name: Tirnomi
summary: Tirnomi is a winged woman who serves a hard-nosed cabal and drops from the clouds onto its enemies. Tirnomi is quiet, precise and aloof.

feats.scene: Tirnomi dives from above and cracks a car roof with a single kick.
Tirnomi crashes into a skylight and glides out unharmed.

name: Amiammia
summary: Amiammia is a blue-skinned hero whose helmet bends light, jams hostile constructs and locates hidden power sources. Amiammia is hunted by a tyrant, ordered never to wear it again, and finally pays the price.

feats.scene: Amiammia focuses starlight through his helmet and carves a canyon in a cliff.
Amiammia is flung across a plaza and rolls to a stop.

name: Unnal
summary: Unnal is a man who envied a rival's gift, built a trap to bathe himself in a comet's radiance, and awoke with strong mental powers. Unnal turns jealousy into a campaign of harassment.

feats.scene: Unnal lifts a delivery truck with thought and drops it on a barricade.
Unnal shrugs off a hail of bullets with a flicker of will.

name: Asitenia
summary: Asitenia is a petty criminal who gained force-field powers from a shady procedure at a gang's lab. Asitenia nearly kills a ringbearer and is hauled off to jail with the rest of the crew.

feats.scene: Asitenia swells a force field and squeezes a ringbearer against a wall.
Asitenia raises a shield and holds off a stream of emerald blasts.

name: Sesene
summary: Sesene is a loud, green-feathered parrot who chatters at his owner and dives into fights with talons out. Sesene is opinionated, brave and always the last to leave.

feats.scene: Sesene dive-bombs a thug and snatches a revolver from his grip.
Sesene is swatted into a bookcase and flaps back out.

name: Orvalnt
summary: Orvalnt is a rich shipping magnate with one of the biggest fleets ever assembled, who pretends to care about the sea while plotting a coup. Orvalnt swears revenge and then does nothing.

feats.scene: Orvalnt bangs a fist on a map table and orders his goons to loot a harbour.
Orvalnt is hauled off a pier, soaked and shaken.

name: Seooreeon
summary: Seooreeon is a mocking counterpart conjured to stop a healer, who teleports to her target and fights him across the universe. Seooreeon must finally join with her foe to mend a wounded wall of creation.

feats.scene: Seooreeon strikes her foe so hard that a moon-sized sphere of rock cracks apart.
Seooreeon crashes into a populated world and the planet barely trembles.

name: Canuceo
summary: Canuceo is a solitary man cursed with knowledge of time after a barrier broke, now the avatar of a force of stillness. Canuceo waits in a laboratory to greet a runner with a warning.

feats.scene: Canuceo halts a speeding truck mid-street with a raised palm.
Canuceo stands still as a shockwave of racing energy splits around him.

name: Ornttau
summary: Ornttau is a cyborg thug brainwashed by a cult leader and sent to wreck a factory in a staged brawl. Ornttau rolls over rookies until a veteran's leadership turns the fight.

feats.scene: Ornttau flattens a forklift and rips a pillar out of the factory floor.
Ornttau absorbs a barrage of energy blasts and keeps rolling.

name: Sueotel
summary: Sueotel is a braggart in plated armour on mechanical legs who proclaims himself king of the alleyways. Sueotel tries to rob a liner and is beaten by a couple of vigilantes.

feats.scene: Sueotel slams a gauntlet through a ticket booth.
Sueotel takes a chemical blast to the breastplate and keeps boasting.

name: Vivaeon
summary: Vivaeon is a gangster with a heavy prosthetic fist who kills a stage magician on orders. Vivaeon crosses a young hero once and regrets it.

feats.scene: Vivaeon drives his steel fist through a plank door.
Vivaeon is thrown into a crate stack and sits up cursing.

name: Lerlloaun
summary: Lerlloaun is a bitter rival scholar who tweaks a serum to turn an old classmate into a rampaging beast, then drinks it himself. Lerlloaun wrecks a quiet street until he is stopped.

feats.scene: Lerlloaun tears a lamp post from its base and swings it into a shop.
Lerlloaun is hit by a speeding van and lands on his wings.

name: Veome
summary: Veome is a metal ringbearer from a robot world, trained by an exile, who faces down a rogue elder and is destroyed. Veome is later honoured with a monument at home.

feats.scene: Veome pierces a drifting warship with a spear of green light.
Veome weathers a volley that tears the shell off a moonlet before yielding.

name: Lorsauco
summary: Lorsauco is a patrolman of a distant sector whose oath is a rhyme and whose ring is his only weapon. Lorsauco builds shields and flies between worlds before a quiet ending.

feats.scene: Lorsauco shapes a hammer of light and splits a derelict satellite.
Lorsauco takes a hit from a falling relay tower and holds the shield.

name: Tisest
summary: Tisest is an astrophysicist who has become a living pulsar, pouring out radiation from her body. Tisest is born under a lucky night sky and works with a shadowy cabinet.

feats.scene: Tisest releases a pulse that blanks a city's power grid and cracks a viaduct.
Tisest absorbs a surge from a broken reactor and glows brighter.

name: Reooraent
summary: Reooraent is a lab director who mentors two young heroes and soaks up and redirects stray energy. Reooraent runs her company with a firm hand and a warm laugh.

feats.scene: Reooraent redirects a stray surge through a lab wall and clears a jam.
Reooraent absorbs a failed experiment's blast and dusts off her coat.

name: Iuseri
summary: Iuseri is a brainwashed soldier who replaces a fallen leader in a fake family of killers, powered by a pharmaceutical boost. Iuseri is cut down when his handler is found.

feats.scene: Iuseri flips a delivery van with a boosted shove.
Iuseri shrugs off a volley of rounds before the drug wears off.

name: Rnosvi
summary: Rnosvi is a sword-wielding rider and thief in a medieval kingdom who serves a prince in a mask. Rnosvi is nimble, fond of horses and light-fingered.

feats.scene: Rnosvi cleaves a barrel with a mounted sword stroke.
Rnosvi is thrown from a horse and rolls out of the fall.

name: Osace
summary: Osace is a young orphan who gets caught up in a thief's scheme in a rain-slicked city. Osace is scrappy, hopeful and quick on her feet.

feats.scene: Osace shoves a stack of crates and blocks a pursuer in an alley.
Osace tumbles down a flight of steps and scrambles away.

name: Rnlocor
summary: Rnlocor is a young fighter in a trio of masked women who answer to a dark-clad mastermind in a ruined future. Rnlocor is agile, blunt and loyal.

feats.scene: Rnlocor spins a staff and crushes a guard's helmet.
Rnlocor takes a rooftop fall and bounds back up.

name: Cinceco
summary: Cinceco is a teenage vigilante who takes a call from a talking ape mid-fight and splits her time between a robbery and a bomb threat. Cinceco is brisk, witty and overstretched.

feats.scene: Cinceco slams a kite-shaped glider into a bank pillar.
Cinceco bounces off a collapsing awning and finishes the call.

name: Serstes
summary: Serstes is a cheerful vigilante who first tried to foil her father's schemes, then took on a series of mantles in a big, noisy household. Serstes cracks jokes while she fights.

feats.scene: Serstes vaults a counter and kicks a mugger into a stack of cans.
Serstes falls through a skylight and walks off the pain.

name: Vanol
summary: Vanol is a grieving teenager in a branching timeline who follows her criminal father, intending to end him, then walks away from the act. Vanol takes up a mask and a cause.

feats.scene: Vanol clubs a safe door with a pipe and dents it.
Vanol takes a hard fall off a loading dock and gets up shaking.

name: Ntenia
summary: Ntenia is a bubbly broadcaster who hosts a live celebration and tries to name a new squad of teenage champions on the spot. Ntenia keeps the cameras rolling through the chaos.

feats.scene: Ntenia swings a microphone stand and fends off a stagehand's grab.
Ntenia is knocked off the podium and keeps talking from the floor.

name: Osrosiu
summary: Osrosiu is the headstrong daughter of an island warrior-queen and a pilot, who inherits her mother's gifts and joins a league of heroes. Osrosiu is bold, lively and fond of her family.

feats.scene: Osrosiu punches through a bridge pier and the span falls into the river.
Osrosiu catches a falling tower crane and sets it down gently.

name: Rniamsar
summary: Rniamsar is a veteran black-ops soldier whose whole team was changed by a mysterious factor and given psychic gifts. Rniamsar flees with his family and is hunted down by killers.

feats.scene: Rniamsar throws a hard punch and drops a guard through a screen door.
Rniamsar shrugs off a rifle butt to the ribs and keeps moving.

name: Aunusam
summary: Aunusam is a child prodigy who breezes through school and builds a living copy of an enormous machine inside his own skull. Aunusam works for a secret government wing and tends to overthink.

feats.scene: Aunusam tosses a stack of files and brings down a shelf on an intruder.
Aunusam is thrown off a stair and lands on a pile of papers.

name: Setelri
summary: Setelri is a hooded crimelord by night and a respected publisher by day, and the first villain a young hero ever faces. Setelri hides behind print, ink and bluster.

feats.scene: Setelri fires a revolver through a pressroom window.
Setelri is tossed through a pile of newspapers and gasps.

name: Sernuce
summary: Sernuce is a masked crook whose face changes with his moods, a goofy menace on the margins of a grim city. Sernuce is more annoying than deadly.

feats.scene: Sernuce slams a barrel into a door and splits it down the middle.
Sernuce is knocked into a wall and grins through the dust.

name: Tatilasi
summary: Tatilasi is the steady captain of a navy cruiser on wartime patrol, calm in a gale and polite to his crew. Tatilasi keeps his ship afloat through hard seas and harder orders.

feats.scene: Tatilasi slams a fist on the chart table and ends an argument.
Tatilasi is thrown across the bridge by a wave and braces on a rail.

name: Vanumes
summary: Vanumes is a salt-stained tide scholar who catalogues drowned shrines along a fog-bound coast; a talent for reading currents lets Vanumes predict where the sea will give up its secrets, though the obsession has cost every friendship.

feats.scene: Vanumes swings a brass sounding-weight into a looter's ribs hard enough to drop him on the jetty.
Vanumes takes a falling crane hook across the back and walks on with a bruise.

name: Nelria
summary: Nelria is a courier pilot who flies a patched biplane over a war-torn archipelago, ferrying sealed orders between besieged ports; stubborn loyalty keeps Nelria in the air long after the maps stop being accurate.

feats.scene: Nelria rams a pursuing gunner with a heavy flare pistol butt and knocks him off the wing strut.
Nelria survives a rough crash landing in shallow surf, climbing out with only cracked ribs.
Nelria dives the biplane toward the water at full throttle to shake a pursuer.

name: Letecol
summary: Letecol is a quiet customs inspector who trained in baton drills and sidearm discipline, working the night dock where smugglers prefer to land their cargo; Letecol wins by patience and clean footwork rather than force.

feats.scene: Letecol cracks a baton across a smuggler's forearm and disarms him in one motion.
Letecol shrugs off a thrown crate that splinters against his shoulder.

name: Riasttau
summary: Riasttau is a border-sector warden armed with a glowing wristband that shapes hard light into shields, wings and bolts; the band drains when its bearer doubts, so Riasttau has learned to keep a flat, unhurried temper.

feats.scene: Riasttau condenses a lance of light and punches it through a derelict cargo hull, splitting it open.
Riasttau holds a light barrier against a collapsing gantry the size of a house.
Riasttau rides a streak of hard light across the orbital yard in seconds.

name: Leovito
summary: Leovito is a horned war-king of a burning iron moon who wields a twin-bladed axe and bends the crossing gates between worlds; centuries of conquest have left Leovito proud, brittle and desperate for a throne that was never his.

feats.scene: Leovito brings the axe down on a fortress wall and flattens the whole citadel district behind it.
Leovito stands unmoved while an orbital cannon volley levels the plain around him.
Leovito charges across the battlefield faster than a sprinting horse team can follow.

name: Renas
summary: Renas is a swaggering warlord of a smouldering iron world who rides a pack of hounds into battle and collects admirers among rival tyrants; behind the showmanship, Renas is a competent, long-lived brawler with a favourite axe.

feats.scene: Renas hurls the axe through a skyscraper-sized slab of slag and drops it across a street.
Renas laughs off a collapsing bunker roof that crushes his hound sled.

name: Lisiunau
summary: Lisiunau is a lean hunter-general from a burning iron world who tracks prey across systems with a jetpack harness and a sharp tactical mind; Lisiunau rarely fights fair when a cleaner kill is available.

feats.scene: Lisiunau slams a rifle burst into a hangar door and blows it off its rails.
Lisiunau stays on his feet after a hover-truck lands on him.
Lisiunau streaks across the canyon floor on his harness thrusters.

name: Tisoriu
summary: Tisoriu is a horned flesh-eater from a lava-lit underworld whose hide turns aside any blade or spell; the only way to hurt Tisoriu is from the inside, which poisoners and jealous heirs have learned well.

feats.scene: Tisoriu tears an iron gate from its pillars and hurls it into a ranks of guards.
Tisoriu stands in the path of a collapsing cavern roof and the blocks bounce off his skin.

name: Orarllu
summary: Orarllu is a silver-haired station manager who keeps a small broadcast company solvent through budgets, bargains and a talent for remembering everyone's favourite sponsor; Orarllu has never thrown a punch in earnest.

feats.scene: Orarllu shoves a stuck studio door open with a shoulder.
Orarllu tumbles down a short flight of stairs and gets up grumbling.

name: Ronntlor
summary: Ronntlor is a shop teacher whose obsession with silver has bloomed into a fantasy of duelling with a cane blade; Ronntlor lectures children while imagining each of them as a monster to be skewered.

feats.scene: Ronntlor swings the cane blade and slices a hanging wooden practice dummy in two.
Ronntlor takes a fall from a workshop loft onto sawdust and complains about the damage to his coat.

name: Totiseo
summary: Totiseo is a hunted wanderer in a ruined future where animals rule, kept alive by a fission-fed organ that shields the body from the worst glow of the wastes; Totiseo runs messages between scattered survivor camps.

feats.scene: Totiseo clubs a feral raider with a pipe and sends him through a rotten fence.
Totiseo walks through a cloud of leaking glow dust that would put an ordinary traveler down.

name: Monralsa
summary: Monralsa is a disgraced mineral researcher selling glowing space rocks to tourists while chasing a cure for his own failing body; a lifetime of exposure has turned every tremor into a countdown.

feats.scene: Monralsa swings a rock hammer into a locked crate and splits the lid.
Monralsa collapses from a seizure onto a concrete floor and wakes up with only scrapes.

name: Cevilu
summary: Cevilu is a vain former screen performer yanked across space to guard a desert-ringed alien city; Cevilu enjoys the cheering far more than the duty, and answers criticism with a rough knuckle.

feats.scene: Cevilu lands a haymaker on a sand-crawler beast and flips it onto its back.
Cevilu is thrown across a plaza by a tail whip and rises with a smirk.

name: Valanser
summary: Valanser is a brick-built enforcer for a harbour crime boss, nicknamed for how he wrecks doors, safes and rivals' cars; Valanser's career is short, loud and generally ends in a pile of rubble.

feats.scene: Valanser drives a sledgehammer through a brick wall to reach a rival's stash.
Valanser stands in a collapsing doorway and shrugs the lintel off his shoulders.

name: Sasos
summary: Sasos is a showboating campus sports star turned local broadcaster, famous for a perfect arm and an imperfect sense of when to stop talking; Sasos is more annoying than dangerous.

feats.scene: Sasos throws a football through a gym window from the far end of the field.
Sasos takes a full-speed tackle from two linebackers and stays up.

source_title: Steven Lombard (DC Super Hero Girls TV Series)

name: Setaslu
summary: Setaslu is a lawyer by day and amateur burglar by night, a prosecutor who keeps lock picks in his coat because the rules of the courtroom never reach the criminals; Setaslu can graze a scalp with a pistol shot.

feats.scene: Setaslu fires a pistol shot that grazes a scalp and drops a suspect cold.
Setaslu falls off a fire escape onto a canvas awning and brushes himself off.

name: Stitum
summary: Stitum is a frontier-raised flier who learned to shoot before he could read and now stalks enemy observation balloons from the cockpit of a wooden biplane; Stitum disobeys orders whenever the order is dumber than the target.

feats.scene: Stitum rakes a hydrogen balloon with twin machine guns until it burns in the sky.
Stitum crash-lands in a wheat field and limps away from the wreck.
Stitum dives the biplane on a pursuer at full speed.

name: Luntisa
summary: Luntisa is a silver-haired media executive with a gambling habit, running a broadcast empire like a casino floor; Luntisa never plays a hand that isn't rigged a little in his favour.

feats.scene: Luntisa slaps a stack of chips onto the table hard enough to scatter them.
Luntisa trips on a lobby carpet and bounces off a marble pillar, merely embarrassed.

source_title: Steven Sharpe III (The Brave and the Bold)

name: Rosorent
summary: Rosorent is a bitter career thief who reads every spared chance as a joke at his expense, and answers each with a bigger crime; Rosorent's pistol is usually pointed at someone else and sometimes, unfortunately, at himself.

feats.scene: Rosorent fires a revolver round that punches through a wooden door.
Rosorent grabs a billboard frame mid-fall and hangs on until a rescuer arrives.

name: Tertelva
summary: Tertelva is a former aviator granted a goddess's blessing and bound to guard a warrior-woman from monsters; Tertelva can pull four spectral arms from the dark and swing them like hammers.

feats.scene: Tertelva swings four ghostly arms together and crushes a stone gatehouse into gravel.
Tertelva takes a monster's charge on crossed spectral arms and skids back a few paces.

name: Leamoco
summary: Leamoco is the quiet companion of a grieving warrior-woman in a doomed pocket reality, present at a funeral and gone when the world ends; Leamoco is an ordinary person caught in extraordinary ruin.

feats.scene: Leamoco grips a cold wrought-iron gate and rattles it open.
Leamoco is thrown against a chapel wall and slides to the floor groaning.

name: Varrnni
summary: Varrnni is a flier stranded in a world not his own, memories scrubbed by a meddling goddess; Varrnni has a mind well suited to the spirit world and is half-aware of it, which makes him a useful and unwilling medium.

feats.scene: Varrnni lashes a pilot's flare gun into a villain's chest and knocks him back.
Varrnni survives a wound that would have killed an ordinary man, thanks to a healing glow.

name: Reliuor
summary: Reliuor is a white-haired spy who slipped into a hostile island capital to find a missing reporter, and paid dearly for being caught; Reliuor is brave, careful and not nearly fast enough.

feats.scene: Reliuor fires a pistol at close range and drops a sentry at a rooftop door.
Reliuor is hauled up by a cord and hangs there, struggling, for a long minute.

name: Colsiser
summary: Colsiser is a dashing airman with a gift for getting into trouble, forever needing rescue from a stronger friend; Colsiser takes it well and always returns the favour with a meal.

feats.scene: Colsiser rams his shoulder into a hangar door and bursts it open.
Colsiser survives a bumpy ejection into a hay barn.

name: Amostu
summary: Amostu is a space-flying officer and secret agent who has died and returned under a new name; Amostu works for an organisation of spies and has been impersonated by a cunning tyrant.

feats.scene: Amostu swings a heavy console stool into a guard and floors him.
Amostu rides out a rough re-entry in a battered capsule.
Amostu ejects from an experimental jet at high altitude and falls free.

name: Asirenlor
summary: Asirenlor is one of three serpent-haired sisters who lured travellers into a maze and hunted them there; Asirenlor met her end at the hands of a clever occult investigator.

feats.scene: Asirenlor lashes out with a claw and rips a stone door lintel out of its frame.
Asirenlor takes a thrown boulder to the chest and rises, snarling.

name: Nureni
summary: Nureni is a winged immortal from the underworld whose stare turns living things to statues; Nureni is strong, durable and a competent duellist, and has more patience for revenge than any sister.

feats.scene: Nureni drops from the sky and punches through a temple roof and the floor below it.
Nureni takes a falling column across the shoulders and shrugs it aside.
Nureni dives on her prey with folded wings.

name: Ilteslle
summary: Ilteslle is a bald shock-fighter in a hidden cabal, strong and tough and able to wear a mundane face; Ilteslle struck a stronger man out of grief and was swiftly arrested for it.

feats.scene: Ilteslle drives a fist through a car door and dents the frame beyond it.
Ilteslle shrugs off a car collision and keeps his feet.

name: Saucarren
summary: Saucarren is a grimy, kindly old drifter and part-time team ally with a surprisingly long list of skills, from swordplay to music to animal wrangling; Saucarren once flew and ran faster than anyone but gave it up.

feats.scene: Saucarren hurls a rusty garbage-can lid and cuts a rope across the yard.
Saucarren falls from a second-floor balcony and climbs out of the hedge whistling.

source_title: Sticky Joe (Teen Titans Go! TV Series)

name: Eruium
summary: Eruium is a hero of a free commercial world who survived a radiation accident and now bounces any attack back at its sender; Eruium once lost a team tryout, and has never quite forgiven the judges.

feats.scene: Eruium turns a falling girder back into the sky with an invisible wall.
Eruium takes a heavy cannon blast and reflects it harmlessly overhead.

name: Valnaeo
summary: Valnaeo is a quiet member of an occult cell who may have died by her own hand or by another's; Valnaeo is remembered by a few chalk marks and a locked room.

feats.scene: Valnaeo drives a thin dagger into a wooden table and pins a letter beneath it.
Valnaeo is thrown against a stone wall and rises with a hiss.

name: Lereruva
summary: Lereruva is a masked street thug who prefers stings and ambushes to fair fights, haunting the rooftops and picking fights with a costumed local hero; Lereruva has a mean streak and a poor memory for faces.

feats.scene: Lereruva knocks a lamp post clean off its bracket with a thrown wrench.
Lereruva drops from a rooftop onto a delivery truck and rolls off unhurt.

name: Aneias
summary: Aneias is a hired gun in a mask who swings between buildings on a line and shoots from awkward angles; Aneias takes a contract, finishes it and rarely stops to ask who is paying.

feats.scene: Aneias fires a rifle burst through a windshield from a rooftop.
Aneias takes a fall onto a fire escape and keeps his grip on the line.
Aneias swings from a high line between two towers at full stretch.

name: Iaoronte
summary: Iaoronte is a masked would-be hero who applied to join a team and was turned away for a reason nobody wants to discuss; Iaoronte's talent fills a room faster than courage does.

feats.scene: Iaoronte flicks a foul-smelling cloud into a stairwell and clears it of people.
Iaoronte is shoved into a locker and climbs out with a bruise.

name: Rnisaiu
summary: Rnisaiu is a long-lived criminal remade by a hidden program, with altered glands that give off a sickening mist and a carapace that lifts him a few metres off the ground; Rnisaiu is cruel, petty and finally outmatched.

feats.scene: Rnisaiu bursts out of the carapace and hurls a hard punch through a plaster wall.
Rnisaiu takes a dozen rifle rounds against the carapace and keeps coming.
Rnisaiu skims low across the town square on his carapace.

name: Anresrn
summary: Anresrn is a mangy yellow-furred tabby universally detested for the way he smells and the scratches he leaves; Anresrn is otherwise an ordinary cat who somehow rules a headquarters.

feats.scene: Anresrn claws a visiting hero's sleeve into ribbons.
Anresrn is tossed across a room and lands on all four paws.

name: Annas
summary: Annas is a stitched rag-doll apprentice of a mystic guardian, animated by magic and gifted with a soul; Annas claims to be effectively immortal and dreams of adventures in distant planes.

feats.scene: Annas weaves a ribbon of thread into a spear and hurls it through a stone wall.
Annas is crushed under a toppled classroom pillar and pulls itself back into shape.

name: Setas
summary: Setas is a hulking female soldier in a fortress-world order of brutal warriors, trained to storm a city on command; Setas is strong, stubborn and a capable hand-to-hand fighter.

feats.scene: Setas smashes a bus onto its side with a single stomp and shoulder.
Setas takes a missile hit on the chest and keeps walking.

name: Rnllurn
summary: Rnllurn is a foundling of a fortress-world orphanage who can swell her body mass and stamp so hard that the ground cracks; Rnllurn is loyal to her trainer, prone to fighting for whoever is closest and heavy on the offensive.

feats.scene: Rnllurn stamps a foot down and splits a city block's pavement into a ravine.
Rnllurn takes a collapsing tower on her back and straightens up under it.

name: Mitint
summary: Mitint is a grim fortress-world fighter working for a cruel matron, strong and straightforward; Mitint's one wish is to be the one standing when the dust settles.

feats.scene: Mitint punches a car clean across a street.
Mitint takes a full tank shell to the shoulder and stays up.

name: Letuca
summary: Letuca is a pebble-sized child stolen from his tribe and trained into an assassin by a hidden order; Letuca moves earth with a gesture and fights with disciplined silence.

feats.scene: Letuca raises a wall of rock and hurls it down a corridor.
Letuca takes a collapsing floor on his stone-hard back.

name: Amilmil
summary: Amilmil is a long-beaked crimelord who ran a smuggling ring and was caught by a diminutive hero; Amilmil is a neat, patient schemer with a limp.

feats.scene: Amilmil whips a cane across a rival's knuckles and cracks them.
Amilmil is knocked down a flight of steps and rises stiffly.

name: Riliumau
summary: Riliumau is a purple-skinned seahorse who carries a sea-king across the reef at a gallop; Riliumau is trusted, fast and a bit affectionate with a young companion.

feats.scene: Riliumau butts a shark aside with his snout.
Riliumau absorbs a heavy reef-crash and swims on.
Riliumau sprints through the kelp forest at full stretch.

name: Eoamorus
summary: Eoamorus is a yellow-eyed seahorse in a world of toy-brick adventures, a swimmer by nature and a mount by habit; Eoamorus doesn't do much but does it cheerfully.

feats.scene: Eoamorus flicks his tail and sends a pile of loose bricks flying.
Eoamorus is bounced off a coral wall without a scratch.

name: Orevi
summary: Orevi is a faithful purple steed of a sea-king, bald and black-eyed, often seen with a smaller companion; Orevi is calm, quick and utterly loyal.

feats.scene: Orevi shoulders a drifting wreck plank out of the way.
Orevi takes a heavy surge against a rock shelf and keeps swimming.

name: Miirli
summary: Miirli is a tiny purple-eyed seahorse who carries a lost child through a strange city; Miirli is as cartoonish as the rest of his world, and just as kind.

feats.scene: Miirli nudges a crate aside with his nose.
Miirli is dropped from a cart and bounces on the cobbles.

name: Tortesi
summary: Tortesi is a rogue colonel in a cold-war bloc who built a cyclone machine to flatten cities by dropping air pressure; Tortesi rampaged across a continent's centre before a flying locomotive ended the machine.

feats.scene: Tortesi drives the cyclone machine at a town and strips it to the foundations with hurricane winds.
Tortesi's machine shrugs off a heavy artillery barrage that bounces off its armour.

name: Esilleco
summary: Esilleco is a masked wartime volunteer who guards a dockside district under an invented title, more morale booster than brawler; Esilleco quietly vanished from the record once the fighting ended.

feats.scene: Esilleco swings a lead-weighted club and flattens a saboteur against a crate.
Esilleco drops from a warehouse beam onto a tarp and rolls to his feet.

name: Iumlin
summary: Iumlin is a meek chemist's assistant who gulps a home-brewed tonic and becomes a street vigilante for an evening; Iumlin is brave only while the dose holds and sheepish once it wears off.

feats.scene: Iumlin lifts a parked cart overhead and tips it onto a getaway wagon.
Iumlin takes a thug's pipe across the skull and laughs it off.

name: Renrno
summary: Renrno is a sibilant grey-skinned recruit of a fear-powered army who patrols a remote star sector with a ring-charged lantern; Renrno hisses menace but dies quickly against a real fight.

feats.scene: Renrno fires a yellow bolt that blasts a cargo skiff into scrap.
Renrno raises a ring shield against a falling hull plate and holds it briefly.

name: Teseosor
summary: Teseosor is a towering grey stone-skinned officer from a peaceful silicon-bodied people, a gentle wife and mother with the build of a landslide; Teseosor serves in an interstellar police force without ever raising her voice.

feats.scene: Teseosor smashes a stone bridge arch in half with one overhead fist.
Teseosor stands in the centre of a rockfall and shakes the dust from her shoulders.

name: Toranse
summary: Toranse is a cloud-bodied artificial bodyguard bound to a mobster, able to whip up gusts and rainstorms on command; Toranse speaks many tongues, shoots well and fences with a thin blade.

feats.scene: Toranse gathers a gale and flings a parked truck into a wall.
Toranse is shot full of holes and the mist simply re-knits.

name: Siavees
summary: Siavees is an immortal survivor of a siege on a hidden campus, fanged, clawed and with the senses of a hound; Siavees guards the few who are left and can't be killed.

feats.scene: Siavees rakes a steel door open with her claws.
Siavees takes a fatal wound and stands again within the hour.

name: Telcorori
summary: Telcorori is a travelling newsreel photographer who stumbles onto secret harbours and dangerous expeditions; Telcorori's camera is the only weapon, and his luck is the real shield.

feats.scene: Telcorori swings a heavy camera tripod into a smuggler's jaw.
Telcorori falls from the rigging onto a coil of rope and shakes it off.

name: Autelos
summary: Autelos is a playful orange cat who lives on a farm and is easily bored; Autelos is otherwise entirely ordinary.

feats.scene: Autelos pounces on a field mouse.
Autelos drops from a hay loft and lands on four paws.

name: Austser
summary: Austser is a striped tabby with a taste for chaos and a habit of breaking his claws on a strong young owner; Austser is playful, clumsy and fully ordinary.

feats.scene: Austser rakes a cushion to shreds.
Austser is swatted off a counter and lands lightly.

name: Rnicor
summary: Rnicor is a blunt gangster who makes cities rise in stone avatars to fight for him; Rnicor is the least subtle of his team and gets run over for it.

feats.scene: Rnicor calls a stone giant out of the pavement and flattens a row of tenements.
Rnicor takes a bike crash at speed and can't get back up.

name: Nanamria
summary: Nanamria is a petty thief who stole an experimental suit, robbed an armoured car and demanded the guards remember his name; Nanamria wanted fame more than money and got a short and noisy career.

feats.scene: Nanamria punches the suit's gauntlet through a vault door.
Nanamria is caught in a stairwell collapse and the suit protects him.

name: Esiumllo
summary: Esiumllo is a ruthless naval officer who sells out his own fleet to an ancient undersea power; Esiumllo commands from the bridge and dies in a flooded corridor.

feats.scene: Esiumllo clubs a mutineer with a pistol grip and drops him to the deck.
Esiumllo is thrown against a bulkhead by a wave and keeps his grip on the rail.

name: Lonucor
summary: Lonucor is a brown-haired bruiser who briefly ran with a gang of villains and left after a quarrel; Lonucor's arms are bigger than his plans.

feats.scene: Lonucor throws a punch that dents a steel mailbox.
Lonucor is hit by a swung bat and keeps standing.

name: Antiuau
summary: Antiuau is a stretching villain who fights as a flat, rubbery ribbon and answers to a three-person gang; Antiuau is a flexible fighter but not a durable one.

feats.scene: Antiuau whips a stretched arm through a window and snatches a briefcase.
Antiuau is hit by a fist and bounces back into shape.

name: Lasamson
summary: Lasamson is a tall black-haired thug who once ran with a web of street hoods; Lasamson is an anonymous brawler with an unfortunate alias.

feats.scene: Lasamson punches a pedestrian door off its hinge.
Lasamson is hit by a swung chair and merely curses.

name: Setausi
summary: Setausi is an orphan who tagged along as a kid sidekick to a masked rider and later fathered a son with his nickname; Setausi was killed by a puppet-wielding foe and avenged by the boy.

feats.scene: Setausi hurls a rope lasso and snares a runaway horse.
Setausi takes a fall from a galloping horse and walks it off.

name: Celmonlan
summary: Celmonlan is a stunt performer turned hero on a parallel world, a daredevil homage who fights beside a team of local heroes; Celmonlan's reflexes are his gift, and his bruises are his badge.

feats.scene: Celmonlan hurls a spiked cable and tears a car door off.
Celmonlan falls from a billboard and rolls onto his feet.

name: Lescelu
summary: Lescelu is a dreamt-up mental copy of a patient hero, a gentle, loving and deeply stubborn manifestation of his better self; Lescelu appears only inside a shared mindscape and can't be hurt there.

feats.scene: Lescelu shoves a looming memory out of a doorway.
Lescelu steps through a collapsing dream wall and is unscathed.

source_title: Subconscious Lawrence Trainor (Doom Patrol TV Series)

name: Numvar
summary: Numvar is a grey-skinned lab clone built by a rich tycoon in an effort to copy a stronger being; Numvar is a flawed duplicate, huge, angry and short-lived.

feats.scene: Numvar rips a truck in half and throws both halves into a wall.
Numvar is hit by a rocket round and staggers a few paces.

name: Totece
summary: Totece is a blonde henchwoman in a bright suit who keeps a split-faced crime boss comforted while he heals; Totece fights only when cornered and runs when it's over.

feats.scene: Totece slaps a courier and knocks the satchel from his hand.
Totece is shoved into a table and rolls off with a bruise.

name: Sastine
summary: Sastine is a fluffy-dressed henchwoman and half of a double act, always cheering her boss on and celebrating a rival's downfall; Sastine is silly, loyal and loud.

feats.scene: Sastine swings a handbag into a guard and drops him.
Sastine falls from a balcony onto a stack of cushions.

name: Tivallu
summary: Tivallu is a blonde aviatrix who flew a bomber to help a squadron of fighter pilots in wartime; Tivallu is brave, practical and a cool hand at the stick.

feats.scene: Tivallu drops a bomb load onto a bridge and brings it down.
Tivallu crash-lands the bomber in a field and walks away.
Tivallu dives the bomber out of a cloud bank.

name: Tanlullu
summary: Tanlullu is a blonde private eye from a small suburban town with a gun, a pilot's licence and a nose for trouble; Tanlullu solves cases with persistence and a stubborn streak.

feats.scene: Tanlullu fires a pistol shot that shatters a thug's lamp.
Tanlullu is knocked down a flight of stairs and keeps going.

name: Rilsenan
summary: Rilsenan is a red-skinned, orange-eyed demon prince loyal to an older half-sibling and his burning ambitions; Rilsenan strikes with brute force and dies in a flaming ditch.

feats.scene: Rilsenan hurls a fireball that blows a stone hall to rubble.
Rilsenan walks through a collapsing tunnel unharmed.

name: Aniianral
summary: Aniianral is a young factory worker and activist who became a water-wielding hero after a refinery accident; Aniianral fights for her village and her family, whatever the odds.

feats.scene: Aniianral unleashes a surge of water and floods a plaza.
Aniianral turns to liquid and a hail of bullets passes through.

name: Noramo
summary: Noramo is a volunteer who helps the terminally ill slip into a walled city so they can be turned; Noramo is determined, calm and ordinary.

feats.scene: Noramo swings a gate chain and cracks a guard's hand.
Noramo is hit by a van door and shrugs it off.

name: Sercocel
summary: Sercocel is a bald glassmaker and stargazer who found a means of crossing between worlds from an ancestor's notes; Sercocel is a gentle scholar who ends up a slave.

feats.scene: Sercocel hurls a glass-working anvil across a hall.
Sercocel takes a falling roof beam and walks out.

name: Enttese
summary: Enttese is an orange-maned lion who lives in a ruined future where beasts rule the old cities; Enttese is proud, direct and a bit of a pest.

feats.scene: Enttese pounces on a raider and pins him to a rusted car.
Enttese is thrown across a courtyard and lands on his paws.
Enttese runs down a fleeing raider across the plain.

name: Iltosti
summary: Iltosti is a smooth, careful diplomat and political fixer who rules a desert nation from behind a desk; Iltosti never lifts a finger when a lie will do.

feats.scene: Iltosti slaps a ledger onto a table to end a debate.
Iltosti falls off a podium and gets back up.

name: Noleonnus
summary: Noleonnus is a general who plots to overthrow a queen and takes his brother's throne; Noleonnus is a calm planner who uses an enemy against another.

feats.scene: Noleonnus fires a pistol shot at an advancing guard and drops him.
Noleonnus is knocked off a parade stand and rises dusty.

name: Nencoror
summary: Nencoror is a policeman's daughter pushed into sport and later into a cursed, animal-like shape; Nencoror hunts as a hyena for a shadowy society and finally dies in a fight.

feats.scene: Nencoror leaps and rakes a guard across the chest.
Nencoror falls from a roof onto a car and rises.
Nencoror bounds across a rooftop on all fours.

name: Amtall
summary: Amtall is a clawed, fanged shapeshifter in a league of criminals, agile and savage; Amtall hunts from the shadows and strikes in packs.

feats.scene: Amtall slashes a steel door open with her claws.
Amtall takes a fall from a bridge and rolls clear.
Amtall sprints through an alley on all fours.

name: Cerosrni
summary: Cerosrni is a stone-born monkey sage who hatched from a rock, learned a mountain's magic and now rules a fruit-laden peak; Cerosrni wields a vast staff and calls himself the equal of the heavens.

feats.scene: Cerosrni swings the staff and splits a mountain in two.
Cerosrni stands in the heart of a collapsing range and walks out dusty.
Cerosrni somersaults across the sky faster than the eye can follow.

name: Leosas
summary: Leosas is a masked fighter in a team of rocket-booted agents who shoots energy from a cannon; Leosas is a skilled engineer with a hidden identity and a tight formation.

feats.scene: Leosas fires the energy cannon and blows a hole in a wall.
Leosas is thrown from a rooftop and the boots cushion the fall.
Leosas streaks over the city on rocket boots.

name: Tucorlle
summary: Tucorlle is a young fire-starter and recruit of a time-travelling team who was struck down by a mechanical servant; Tucorlle is brave, hot-headed and short-lived.

feats.scene: Tucorlle hurls a ball of flame that melts a barricade.
Tucorlle takes a robot's punch and staggers.

name: Urnntoser
summary: Urnntoser is a lab-grown police officer with chameleon skin and a nimble frame, built from a pile of game-like templates; Urnntoser patrols a district of costumed neighbours and outruns almost anyone.

feats.scene: Urnntoser leaps and kicks a robber through a shop window.
Urnntoser takes a rooftop fall and lands in a crouch.
Urnntoser sprints down a street faster than a car.

name: Ulstau
summary: Ulstau is a black-haired mercenary partner of a famous assassin, quick, stubborn and headstrong; Ulstau took a contract to hit a masked vigilante and nearly pulled it off.

feats.scene: Ulstau fires a rifle burst through a windshield.
Ulstau is hit by a swung bat and recovers within a breath.

name: Arnol
summary: Arnol is a white-haired, tall fighter of a secret order with a taste for joint locks and throws; Arnol protects a hidden headquarters and always seems to be smiling.

feats.scene: Arnol throws a larger opponent over his hip into a wall.
Arnol absorbs a punch and answers with a grin.

name: Anirni
summary: Anirni is a dream-born adventurer who stepped out of a mask and found out he was a fictional hero; Anirni protested being written out and now lives in a place of love and legends.

feats.scene: Anirni punches through a stone tower and topples it.
Anirni takes a collapsing wall and brushes the dust off.
Anirni flies across the dream sky faster than a jet.

name: Lovalreo
summary: Lovalreo is a patchwork being built by a petty thief from stolen gear and borrowed body parts, a head here and legs there; Lovalreo is immune to a yellow glow and quick on her feet.

feats.scene: Lovalreo punches a truck through a warehouse wall.
Lovalreo takes a rocket blast and stays standing.
Lovalreo sprints across a field faster than a plane taking off.

name: Riasto
summary: Riasto is a lab-made emperor-in-waiting grown by a mad scientist from a stolen template, with no self to get in the way of a current of inner power; Riasto commands a state ministry before it collapses.

feats.scene: Riasto lets the inner current surge and levels a stadium and its parking lots.
Riasto absorbs a missile barrage and walks through the fire.
Riasto flies through the sky at jet speed.

name: Celsanreo
summary: Celsanreo is a spoiled clone raised in a quiet household who turned bitter after learning how he was made; Celsanreo is strong, fast and furious, with a temper that destroys his own life.

feats.scene: Celsanreo hurls a boulder through a house and out the back wall.
Celsanreo takes a collapsing barn roof and shakes it off.
Celsanreo races across a field faster than a jet.

name: Sirnanstu
summary: Sirnanstu is a runaway warrior from a mirrored world who rules a mountain hideout and robs vaults for sport. She carries the strength of her exiled sisterhood but ages like anyone else, which makes her reckless.

feats.scene: Sirnanstu hurls a freight locomotive through a rival's fortress wall and brings the whole tower down.
Sirnanstu stands unmoved as a collapsing bridge deck lands across her shoulders.
Sirnanstu outflies a patrol jet over the ridge and loops back before it can turn.

name: Lascoau
summary: Lascoau is a lab-grown teenager who believes he was copied from a famous hero, though his donor was an ordinary man. He lives on an island and moves objects with touch alone, rising into the air when he concentrates.

feats.scene: Lascoau pushes a stalled cargo ship off a reef with both palms flat on the hull.
Lascoau shrugs off a crashing delivery truck and checks his jacket for dents.
Lascoau races a storm front along the coast and reaches the harbour first.

name: Tiiansil
summary: Tiiansil is a brash young metahuman who styles himself a replacement for a fallen champion. He joins a rag-tag resistance underground and learns that wrecking an occupier's stronghold is easier than keeping people alive.

feats.scene: Tiiansil caves in an occupier's mountain outpost with a single dive from altitude.
Tiiansil takes a point-blank cannon salvo and keeps walking toward the gunners.
Tiiansil streaks ahead of a retreating convoy and lands on its lead vehicle.

name: Iumtesles
summary: Iumtesles is a bitter survivor from a nightmare mirror of a crisis, a last son who sours on a would-be world-maker and turns on him. He fights alone and cannot rest, battling teenagers for hours without pause.

feats.scene: Iumtesles punches through a mountain's flank and leaves a tunnel that runs out the far side.
Iumtesles absorbs a stack of detonating warheads while still gripping his enemy.
Iumtesles crosses an ocean in a heartbeat chasing a runaway youth.

name: Sermian
summary: Sermian is a dead conqueror whose followers try to bring him back from sleeping pods. The attempt fails when a gleeful saboteur smashes the machinery, so he exists mostly as a threat that never arrives.

feats.scene: Sermian flattens a hillside fortress in a single memory of a past battle.
Sermian's sealed pod survives a blast that levels the surrounding vault.

name: Stiralres
summary: Stiralres is a ruffian who crackles with stored current and runs with a speed-obsessed gang. He drifts between towns on a battered bike and zaps anything that blocks his way.

feats.scene: Stiralres blasts a substation transformer and blacks out three streets.
Stiralres shakes off a baton volley and a thrown bottle without flinching.

name: Rirumrum
summary: Rirumrum is a hero idea soured by a faceless company, rebuilt into a brutal mascot that sells itself. It rampages across neighbouring worlds, taking their saviours' place and turning a hopeful symbol into a brand.

feats.scene: Rirumrum shears the crust off a coastline in one backhand and logs the footage for advertisers.
Rirumrum steps out of a collapsing skyscraper cluster smiling for the cameras.
Rirumrum circles a planet before a broadcast ends.

name: Unntse
summary: Unntse is a young alien girl sent to safety on a rocket and raised among cartoon heroes. She is bubbly and capable, and she fights with the strength and flight of her people.

feats.scene: Unntse lifts a collapsing stadium roof over a screaming crowd and sets it aside.
Unntse takes a robot's full-power rocket barrage and brushes soot from her sleeves.
Unntse crosses the bay faster than the sound of her own laugh.

name: Resesnil
summary: Resesnil is a runaway lab clone, copied from a famous heroine and a stranger, who befriends a team of veterans. She moves objects with touch and defends her borrowed costume loudly.

feats.scene: Resesnil flips an armoured van with one flat palm against its underside.
Resesnil takes a guard's heavy cannon shot and complains about her jacket.
Resesnil outflies a hover-drone along the rooftops.

name: Leotaor
summary: Leotaor is a young hero on a world where roles are flipped, a cousin to a famous heroine who protects his city alongside a grand league. He is the sort who says the loud line first and punches second.

feats.scene: Leotaor knocks a falling comet fragment off course with a double-fisted swing.
Leotaor stands in the path of a collapsing dam wall and holds his ground.
Leotaor reaches a hostage tower on the far shore before the alarm finishes ringing.

name: Sontlan
summary: Sontlan is a cell-grown double made by a greedy professor with a malfunctioning machine, so he came out the wrong shape and without a conscience. He robs a bank on orders, then starts asking who he really is.

feats.scene: Sontlan splits the street open with one punch and drops his pursuer into the crack.
Sontlan takes a runaway tram head-on and carries on with the stolen cash.
Sontlan skims a river valley at low altitude to the professor's workshop.

name: Auaurn
summary: Auaurn is a gentle flying protector of a lonely world, married to a reporter, who dies at the hands of a thief with a cursed book. He is mourned on live television, remembered by a torn banner on a battlefield.

feats.scene: Auaurn lifts a collapsing bridge span and its traffic onto the bank in a single motion.
Auaurn stands in the heart of a refinery blast and walks out untouched.
Auaurn races a missile to its target and beats it by seconds.

name: Asanst
summary: Asanst is a tyrant of a dark mirror world, a hero split into a cold azure copy who enslaved his planet. He guards prisoners for a horned master and mocks them as he beats them.

feats.scene: Asanst flattens a prison tower with a single blast of cold light.
Asanst eats a volley of missiles and sneers at the smoke.
Asanst darts between dungeon pillars before a captive can blink.

name: Seoso
summary: Seoso is the second to carry a legendary hero's mantle, left behind when the first wanders into deep space. He guards a far-future home world and battles a living machine that wants to run it.

feats.scene: Seoso crushes a mining platform in orbit and scatters its wreckage into the sun.
Seoso stands in an engine flare that vaporises the hull behind him.
Seoso crosses the inner system to answer a distress beacon.

name: Sirsiia
summary: Sirsiia is a long-serving heroine on a mirrored world, an ally of a masked partner who inspires her city. She stands against an invasion by an army of armoured warriors with strong hands and a calm voice.

feats.scene: Sirsiia hurls a transport carrier into a charging army and halts the advance.
Sirsiia stands through a barrage of lances and swords without a mark.
Sirsiia crosses a battlefield and returns with three rescued scouts.

name: Veoseoniu
summary: Veoseoniu is a crowned officer of a golden patrol on a red planet, tasked by a peace body with keeping a green menace in check. She jails visitors by mistake and drives them into the wrong alliance.

feats.scene: Veoseoniu levels a barricade with a blast from her ray gun and flies through the smoke.
Veoseoniu rolls with a cannon shell and rises to give the next order.
Veoseoniu glides above her patrol to scout the canyon ahead.

name: Amrau
summary: Amrau is a hard-faced chairman of a grim armoury world who buys war wholesale. He sits behind a mile of steel and hates freedom fighters.

feats.scene: Amrau orders a foundry cannon fired and a cliff face drops into the valley.
Amrau's armoured chair survives a collapsing roof beam.

source_title: Supreme Chairman (The Brave and the Bold)

name: Iumvossia
summary: Iumvossia is the loudest hero of a flag-waving world, a homage to a lineage of strongmen with white hair and a proud team. He fights villains in front of cameras and thinks about legacy more than anyone should.

feats.scene: Iumvossia lifts a freight ship out of a flooded dock and sets it on the pier.
Iumvossia stands in a blazing warehouse and strikes a pose.
Iumvossia outraces a news helicopter to the scene of a collapse.

name: Raronra
summary: Raronra is a clever socialite and crime-solving partner to a stretchy detective husband. She has no powers, only nerve and a quick tongue, and she keeps the mystery moving.

feats.scene: Raronra swings a handbag into a burglar's jaw and ends the chase.
Raronra rolls down a flight of stairs and gets up with a plan.

name: Vausauti
summary: Vausauti is a well-loved socialite who marries a stretchy hero and spends decades in his orbit, at the edge of a famous team. Danger finds her more than once, and the grief that follows shapes an entire league.

feats.scene: Vausauti slams a vase over a kidnapper's head and runs for the door.
Vausauti survives a hard fall from a tilting carriage and laughs it off.

name: Sevos
summary: Sevos is a lab-born child grown from dozens of stolen gene samples, raised by shifting caretakers who keep quitting. She bends reality at a whim and outsmarts adults twice her height.

feats.scene: Sevos folds a cliff face into a cube and flings it into the sea.
Sevos steps through a collapsing vault wall and leaves the debris behind.
Sevos blinks across an island chain and arrives before her own echo.

name: Voraurn
summary: Voraurn is a disguise artist with plant-borne strength who flies and shrugs off bullets. She slips into crowds under borrowed faces and lets her fists do the unmasking.

feats.scene: Voraurn punches a vault door off its hinges and flies away with the contents.
Voraurn takes a machine-gun burst and straightens her wig.
Voraurn glides over a gala skylight to drop in on a smuggler.

source_title: Susan Linden (The Brave and the Bold)

name: Tiuriaaul
summary: Tiuriaaul is a violet-skinned plant-human who grew from child to guardian, tied to a hidden network of vegetal life. She flies, regrows into spare bodies, and can wear any face she likes.

feats.scene: Tiuriaaul rips a ship's anchor out of the seabed and swings it at a hull.
Tiuriaaul burns away in a fire and wakes the next day in a fresh body.
Tiuriaaul rides a thermal over the treetops to cut off a convoy.

name: Talsorne
summary: Talsorne is a spy and team leader in a mashed-together world, torn between two teammates and loyal to her brother. She leads a mountain-bound gang of adventurers with a quick grin.

feats.scene: Talsorne sidekicks a guard through a crate wall and grabs the briefcase.
Talsorne drops three floors onto a canvas awning and bounces up.

name: Iaosacor
summary: Iaosacor is a heavyset gang enforcer who survives being shot and returns to haunt a masked gunman. She hardly has a special gift, but her size and spite carry her through a hospital ward and a lounge.

feats.scene: Iaosacor flings a steel gurney across the ward and pins a guard against the wall.
Iaosacor takes a heavy pistol round and keeps reaching for her victim.

name: Ntivaseo
summary: Ntivaseo is a magazine reporter chasing a story about a candidate. She decides the wrong brother is a hero, marries him, and raises children while sure of her own theory.

feats.scene: Ntivaseo shoves a stuck press door open and delivers the copy.
Ntivaseo skids on wet pavement and catches herself on a rail.

name: Seslois
summary: Seslois is a gene-altered schemer whose hair grows and moves at will, a weapon and a snare. She auditions for a hero club, fails, and drifts into a rival gang of crooks.

feats.scene: Seslois cinches a steel girder with her braids and drags it into a doorway.
Seslois takes a stun bolt to the back and keeps knotting her captive.
Seslois swings across a atrium on a ribbon of her own hair.

name: Rnnieo
summary: Rnnieo is a small-town sweetheart who marries her old boyfriend and raises a son. She turns up for one terrible day and then drops from the story.

feats.scene: Rnnieo throws a pan at a prowler and shouts for the neighbours.
Rnnieo falls off a porch step and laughs it away.

name: Niuliu
summary: Niuliu is a resistance fighter in a wartime island chain, trained by her grandfather in the art of the throw. A treacherous brother frames her as a traitor, but she never wavers from defending her people.

feats.scene: Niuliu flips a rifleman over her hip and breaks his charge.
Niuliu rolls off a collapsing bamboo watchtower and sprints for the trees.

name: Corto
summary: Corto is a veteran homicide chief who is turned into a hungry undead and drawn into a cover-up. He blows up a kitchen to hide his tracks and is honoured as a hero for it.

feats.scene: Corto lights a gas stove and the kitchen goes up with a thump.
Corto takes a bullet to the leg and keeps plotting.

name: Nauviau
summary: Nauviau is a cold copy of a nuclear-powered hero, built by a fallen empire with the same might and none of the heart. A fusion with his original ends the rampage, and he is later freed into a long hunt for a partner.

feats.scene: Nauviau rewrites the core of a cooling tower and the plant erupts in white light.
Nauviau takes a missile salvo and reknits before the dust clears.
Nauviau shoots across the frozen plains in a streak of glare.

name: Rnitasse
summary: Rnitasse is a scientist whose body can turn into any beast, plant or rock after a chemical accident. He guards a hideout for a defence team and gains a taste for eating foes.

feats.scene: Rnitasse becomes a boulder and drops through the roof of a hideout onto the intruders.
Rnitasse turns to granite and lets a dozen blasts roll off.

name: Valsauval
summary: Valsauval is a shapeshifter in a cartoon world who can become any animal, plant or mineral. He gleefully menaces a team of misfits while the animators work out his next costume.

feats.scene: Valsauval turns into a bull and smashes through a workshop wall.
Valsauval becomes a stone slab and shrugs off a hammer swing.

source_title: Sven Larson (The Brave and the Bold)

name: Nucelsi
summary: Nucelsi is a redheaded childhood friend who defends a quiet boy from bullies. She is jailed in a labour camp under a ruthless regime and lives long enough to see him once more.

feats.scene: Nucelsi shoves a bully off a snowbank and drags her friend up.
Nucelsi survives a winter in the pit and still lifts her head.

name: Vascin
summary: Vascin is an impulsive young sailor who serves on a wartime ship with a rival marine. The pair bicker and brawl but never go far apart.

feats.scene: Vascin swings a mop bucket at his rival and soaks the deck.
Vascin goes down a ladder and bounces up complaining.

name: Ernanu
summary: Ernanu is a con artist who poses as a psychic and runs a side hustle in spinning-top bombs. His plot to fake his own death in a blazing windmill is undone by two crime fighters.

feats.scene: Ernanu sets a timer and the windmill base blows apart behind a screen of smoke.
Ernanu rolls from a collapsing stage and gets up smiling.

name: Osarerlis
summary: Osarerlis is a green swamp elemental who saves a bruised hero from a burial and helps hold off a sorceress. He grows and shrinks at will and bends the plants to his side.

feats.scene: Osarerlis tears up a graveyard's roots and flings a stone slab across the field.
Osarerlis takes a blast that vaporises a mausoleum and regrows his arm.

name: Stmiaolu
