summary: Stmiaolu is a scholar whose mind lives on in the swamp after a lab fire, rising as a green guardian of all growing things. He serves a council of elemental parliaments and loves his wife and daughter.

feats.scene: Stmiaolu raises a forest in one night and a whole district's roads crack apart.
Stmiaolu burns to ash in a chemical blaze and regrows from the soil by dawn.
Stmiaolu travels the vines under a continent to surface at a far marsh.

name: Eoncor
summary: Eoncor is a bald militiaman and anarchist who endangers bystanders in a fight with powered fighters. He is caged in a prison camp, wounded, and later disciplined on an island.

feats.scene: Eoncor smashes a car window and drags a driver clear to cover his retreat.
Eoncor takes a slash to the throat and lives through the blast.

name: Anuntni
summary: Anuntni is a baker with a bad reputation among thugs, remembered for a poisoned pastry and a toxic dessert. He is mentioned in passing at a party and never appears.

feats.scene: Anuntni slides a tray of poisoned tarts across a counter to a hungry gang.
Anuntni takes a thrown cake pan to the ribs and keeps stirring.

name: Collicil
summary: Collicil is a pink-skinned, flaxen-haired criminal and a boss's companion who runs with a party gang. She uses seduction, swimming and weapons to get her way.

feats.scene: Collicil slings a harpoon across a pool and pins a guard's sleeve to the tiles.
Collicil dives from a balcony into the shallow end and swims away unhurt.

name: Lescar
summary: Lescar is a bandleader from the golden age of dance halls who also runs a nightclub. When rough customers show up he settles it with his fists, even against bigger crowds.

feats.scene: Lescar swings a trombone case into a bouncer's chin and the dance floor goes quiet.
Lescar takes a barstool across the back and finishes the song.

name: Sanrnenen
summary: Sanrnenen is a pale spy and assassin who throws poisoned needles and nurses a grudge against one relentless fighter. He flees by motorbike and meets his end in a scrapyard.

feats.scene: Sanrnenen flicks three poisoned needles into a doorframe in a single motion.
Sanrnenen skids a motorbike across gravel and keeps his feet.
Sanrnenen tears down a mountain highway to shake off his pursuer.

name: Amerese
summary: Amerese is a swift little reptile from the age of stone tools who soaked up stray lightning from a time traveller. He now streaks across ancient plains with a tamed caveman in tow.

feats.scene: Amerese leaps at a charging beast and knocks it flat with a claw swipe.
Amerese bursts with stored energy and reforms on the riverbank.
Amerese crosses a valley in a blink and snaps at a startled herd.

name: Anliurni
summary: Anliurni is a murderer with a sword hidden in a cane who strikes at a museum tank. He is mangled by predatory fish and arrested after a fight with a pocket-sized crimefighter.

feats.scene: Anliurni draws a blade from his cane and ends a witness's evening in one stroke.
Anliurni staggers through a burst fish tank and still reaches for the exit.

name: Ilisar
summary: Ilisar is a mother on an icy moon with a gift of reading minds, mother of two daughters. She lives a quiet family life and rarely needs her gift.

feats.scene: Ilisar plants a calming thought in a crying child and the room settles.
Ilisar waits out a long storm on a bare ridge without complaint.

name: Seslirne
summary: Seslirne is a top scientist who serves a ruthless tycoon and studies cloning in a hidden lab. He is burned by a failed copy and loses his nerve when his master backs down from a standoff.

feats.scene: Seslirne slams a lab lever and a cage of test subjects crashes open.
Seslirne is scorched by a flare of heat and staggers out alive.

name: Iariumeol
summary: Iariumeol is a brother mentioned only in passing, an engineer whose work is later twisted by the military. He disappears at an early age and is remembered with a sigh.

feats.scene: Iariumeol bolts a prototype housing shut with a single wrench turn.
Iariumeol trips over a cable and catches himself on a workbench.

name: Vastleo
summary: Vastleo is a mutant moth larva kept as a pet by a fiery alien princess. It changes clothes in a flash, floats, and sprays charm that makes people shy and bold at once.

feats.scene: Vastleo squirts a cloud of scent and two bystanders drop their guard.
Vastleo rides out a tumble down the stairs and wriggles up unhurt.

name: Aulrntel
summary: Aulrntel is a vicious student with a shrinking belt who stalks dorm halls and hires a killer. He is lured to a hotel room by a vengeful giantess and does not walk out.

feats.scene: Aulrntel shrinks to a pinhead and stabs a sleeping rival through a keyhole.
Aulrntel survives a long stay in a time-warped bubble, ragged but alive.

name: Eollvi
summary: Eollvi is the head of a team of costumed veterans on a parallel world. He wears a belt that channels cosmic force and stands his ground when strangers arrive.

feats.scene: Eollvi fires a bolt from his belt and splits a cargo crate in two.
Eollvi is thrown into a wall and rises with a grin.
Eollvi hovers over a brawl and swoops in on the leader.

name: Vestam
summary: Vestam is a red-eyed officer in a pale warrior caste at war with a rival people. She is stern and disciplined and keeps to the soldiers' book.

feats.scene: Vestam drives a spear butt into a rebel's shield and splits it.
Vestam stands through a mortar barrage and calls the next order.

name: Neseon
summary: Neseon is a general who leads a pale warrior people against their rivals. He is strong beyond his kind and falls in the last war.

feats.scene: Neseon smashes a siege tower with a single swing of his arm.
Neseon takes a cannon shot to the chest and keeps shouting orders.

name: Rusvar
summary: Rusvar is a redhaired contract killer in a criminal order who murders a young woman and her family. A swift hero foils her mission in a foreign city.

feats.scene: Rusvar fires a rifle from a rooftop and a window shatters across the plaza.
Rusvar drops from a fire escape and rolls up into a run.

name: Asill
summary: Asill is a hazel-eyed woman of a doomed planet who appears in a single story and dies in it. She faces the end of her world with a steady hand.

feats.scene: Asill pushes a cracked door open and shepherds neighbours to the shelter.
Asill steps through a collapsing archway and keeps walking.

name: Nencar
summary: Nencar is a sorceress from the far future who rules an age of spells with her father and marries a rival. She hurls a stone through time and later sends a dark lord to the pit.

feats.scene: Nencar flings a glowing stone through time and a hillside shakes loose.
Nencar takes a heavy blow and vanishes, only to return unharmed.

name: Celtiran
summary: Celtiran is a white-haired enchantress who works dark magic for her own ends. She conjures hexes from a quiet room.

feats.scene: Celtiran flicks her wrist and a stone arch collapses on a team of guards.
Celtiran takes a sword blow behind a flicker of violet light.

name: Corsaual
summary: Corsaual is a gentle blond woman of a crimson people in a war with a pale clan. She keeps to the edge of the story and helps where she can.

feats.scene: Corsaual hauls a wounded scout across a ravine and sets him down.
Corsaual rides out a long march through snow without complaint.

name: Lincinam
summary: Lincinam is an ancient tentacled god of shadow, summoned from long sleep by a sinister voice. He is as strong as a giant ape grown to full height and drinks the light from a room.

feats.scene: Lincinam slams a tentacle through a hilltop village and levels it.
Lincinam takes a volley of rockets and the dark folds closed around the wounds.

name: Austiti
summary: Austiti is a winged police chief in a great walled city, a calm investigator who learns forensics from an outsider. She takes flight over her district and keeps the peace.

feats.scene: Austiti dives from a tower and takes down a runner with a tackle.
Austiti lands from a long glide and walks off the jolt.
Austiti sweeps over the market roofs to cut off a thief.

name: Rilrer
summary: Rilrer is a forensic scientist working the night shift for a city force. He pores over strange crime scenes with a steady hand and a dry sense of humour.

feats.scene: Rilrer pries open a stuck evidence locker with a crowbar.
Rilrer stays at the scene through a long night of rain.

name: Ranve
summary: Ranve is the younger brother of a famous shapechanger on a red desert world, and he shares his people's fatal fear of flames. He keeps to the family home.

feats.scene: Ranve shoves a stone door open and drags his brother through.
Ranve shrugs off a sandstorm and checks the horizon.

name: Nennor
summary: Nennor is a tribal chief who tortures a visiting doctor out of jealousy and is killed and thrown in a pit. He returns as a ghost to torment the same man, untouchable until a spirit stabs him.

feats.scene: Nennor hurls a rack of tools across the cellar with a ghostly sweep of his hand.
Nennor lets a volley of fists pass through him as if through smoke.

name: Correona
summary: Correona is a wealthy former football player who hunts crooks as a masked vigilante with claws. His fortune and his flippant manner hide his secret from the police.

feats.scene: Correona drives a claw into a crook's door and rips the lock free.
Correona vaults a rail and lands on the dock beside the thief.

name: Caisria
summary: Caisria is a crime boss and scientist who poses as a visitor from the future to impress his marks. A knight in armour exposes the bluff.

feats.scene: Caisria flips a switch and a prop beam burns a hole in the stage backdrop.
Caisria is thrown against a podium and straightens his coat.

name: Ntiaulti
summary: Ntiaulti is a scientist who studied under a stern professor and joined a covert program aimed at neutralising heroes. He is stabbed by a droid at a country house while the rest of the group argues.

feats.scene: Ntiaulti bolts a lab door and wedges it with a chair.
Ntiaulti takes a hard shove into a bookcase and keeps talking.

name: Tortamia
summary: Tortamia is a whip-wielding fighter trained by an old order who goes from criminal to unlikely protector. She is a deadly shot, a skilled knife thrower and a master of hand-to-hand combat.

feats.scene: Tortamia cracks a whip across a rooftop and pulls a rifle out of a gunman's grip.
Tortamia takes a crossbow bolt-strike on her armour and shoots back.

name: Cesnautir
summary: Cesnautir is a bald hacker in a gang of masked crooks who seizes control of a hero's robots. He keeps to the keyboard and out of the fight.

feats.scene: Cesnautir wires a robot's arm to swing and pushes a guard through a door.
Cesnautir rides out a crash of falling shelves behind a console.

name: Lennil
summary: Lennil is a lab-made strategist who despises disorder and builds a crime syndicate after leaving a covert team. He sees only pattern and wants to tear down the pretence of an ordered world.

feats.scene: Lennil redirects a convoy's route and wrecks a bridge with a single call.
Lennil takes a gunshot and a fall from a gantry and walks away.

name: Terusam
summary: Terusam is a square student who turns green and flies as a swinging hero, unaware of his own double life. He backs up a family of misfits and plays guitar at weddings.

feats.scene: Terusam bounces a guitar chord and a window wall shatters across the street.
Terusam wipes out on a wild landing and pops up with a grin.
Terusam zooms over the school rooftops to catch up with a runaway dog.

name: Ranter
summary: Ranter is a farm-town athlete who gains speed from a strange mineral after a blast. He joins the army and is the last of a short-lived band of powered youths.

feats.scene: Ranter's arm spasms at a blur and shatters a locker door.
Ranter takes a bonfire blast and walks off with a broken arm.
Ranter crosses the practice field before the whistle finishes.

name: Tanaul
summary: Tanaul is an ancient princess of a river kingdom, married and hidden behind a mask of secrecy. She surfaces in a modern tale of a cartoon mystery gang.

feats.scene: Tanaul shoves a sarcophagus lid aside and slips into the corridor.
Tanaul rides out a tomb collapse and brushes off the dust.

name: Seescor
summary: Seescor is a green terrier with a stretching tail that works like a lasso. He serves in a patrol of heroic dogs and helps chase a rogue cat.

feats.scene: Seescor snaps his tail around a fleeing alley cat and hauls it back.
Seescor tumbles down a stack of crates and bounces up wagging.
Seescor sprints through a cat shelter after a mutated tabby.

name: Ossti
summary: Ossti is a snake-bodied woman whose fangs hold a lethal toxin and whose coils crush with man-breaking strength. She takes over a farm town with her gang and is torn in half by a rival.

feats.scene: Ossti coils around a tractor and crushes its frame.
Ossti takes a scatter of buckshot and keeps coiling.

name: Lloselle
summary: Lloselle is a scientist from a vanished people who is recast as a gilded hunter by a cruel order. A failsafe built into his new body opens a black hole to end him.

feats.scene: Lloselle triggers the failsafe and a pinpoint void swallows the dock behind him.
Lloselle takes a ship's cannon blast on his gilded plating and keeps advancing.

name: Eortor
summary: Eortor is a coward and a tyrant who builds a stone palace from forced labour in a primitive age. He surrenders at once when the workers turn their headbands into weapons.

feats.scene: Eortor orders a block raised and a guard slams a whip against the stone.
Eortor tumbles from his litter and runs for the gate.

name: Auntlen
summary: Auntlen is a hell-born demigod, eldest son of a fallen angel and an island goddess, who attacks his father in revenge. He flies on wings, wields a sword, and calls down raw magic.

feats.scene: Auntlen drives his sword into the ground and a plain of fire opens for miles.
Auntlen stands in a blast that collapses a cavern wall and answers with a laugh.
Auntlen dives through the pit on black wings and strikes his foe before the echo fades.

name: Naamisan
summary: Naamisan is a man who flees a wartime camp as a boy and nurses a lifelong grudge. A test in a lab gives him the power to move objects with his mind, and he takes hostages to draw out the person he blames.

feats.scene: Naamisan lifts a lab table with his mind and hurls it across the room.
Naamisan takes a shove into a cabinet and keeps staring down his hostage.

name: Leeonane
summary: Leeonane is a crime-family swordsman who kills his brother out of jealousy with a blade that steals souls. He summons the dead man's spirit to hunt a widow and is slain by the same sword.

feats.scene: Leeonane strikes with a soul-drinking blade and a guard drops without a sound.
Leeonane takes a slash on his sleeve and counters in the same breath.

name: Nausent
summary: Nausent is a conquering half-brother of a hero in a far reality who turns a town into a nest of his own kind. He levels a metropolis in minutes and crushes all resistance, until the secret weakness is found.

feats.scene: Nausent brings down a skyline in minutes with a sweep of his arms.
Nausent stands in a shelling that cracks the street and brushes off the dust.
Nausent crosses a county in a breath to reach the next town.

name: Enusil
summary: Enusil is a gentle, bar-hopping brother in a topsy-turvy world, quick to pay for a round and happy to be an uncle. He falls for a bartender, marries her, and tries to mediate a family feud.

feats.scene: Enusil catches a toppling billboard and sets it down gently on the lawn.
Enusil steps through a splintering barn wall with a sheepish grin.
Enusil flies across the plains to reach a family dinner on time.

name: Calocin
summary: Calocin is a violet-haired sorceress with white eyes who bends shadow, flame and distance. She is a rogue in a game world and treats the occult as a trade.

feats.scene: Calocin sets a rooftop ablaze in a burst of dark flame and steps through a rift.
Calocin takes a heavy blow behind a shimmer of shadow and vanishes.

name: Coolunt
summary: Coolunt is a respected noble and councillor of a glass-towered people, who argues for a technocracy. He is set a test with lightning rods on a stormy plain to settle a dispute.

feats.scene: Coolunt hefts a lightning rod and stands alone on a bare plain.
Coolunt stands at the centre of a thunderstorm and waits for the strike.

name: Rntesrus
summary: Rntesrus is an orange-skinned queen who gives herself up to an invading empire to spare her home. She loses her husband and sons and is led away as a slave while her youngest rules in her stead.

feats.scene: Rntesrus shoves aside a guard and strides to the invader's shuttle.
Rntesrus stands unbowed before a barrage of insults and chains.
Rntesrus glides over the throne room to shield her youngest son.

name: Sirliuser
summary: Sirliuser is a pale-haired winged sentinel who abandoned his post for love and paid for it with a swift, merciless trial. Sirliuser fights with radiant blades and little hope of mercy.

feats.scene: Sirliuser drove a blazing blade through a stone pillar in one lunge.
Sirliuser stood through a volley of heavenly spears before finally falling.

name: Sanansor
summary: Sanansor is a poised heiress of a hidden order of killers, equally at home with poison, politics and a drawn blade. Sanansor trades loyalty like currency.

feats.scene: Sanansor cut a rope bridge with a single slash while pursuers crossed it.
Sanansor took a heavy cudgel blow to the ribs and kept walking.

name: Asist
summary: Asist is a ruthless heir to a dynasty of masked killers, a strategist who raises her child to conquer. Asist rules by fear, inheritance and carefully timed betrayals.

feats.scene: Asist split a wooden training dummy in two with one sword stroke.
Asist shrugged off a fall from a balcony onto packed sand.

name: Rniumria
summary: Rniumria is a faceless cosmic envoy chosen by a ring of pure white light, summoned to hold back a devouring darkness. Rniumria then drifted away into the dark between stars.

feats.scene: Rniumria hurled a beam of white light that carved a canyon through a drifting asteroid.
Rniumria sheltered inside a glowing shell while a shockwave rolled across a barren moon.

name: Telcose
summary: Telcose is a scarred frontier markswoman who lives by her pistol and a hard-earned grudge. Telcose fights dirty, shoots straight and trusts almost nobody.

feats.scene: Telcose fired two shots through a swinging saloon door and dropped both targets.
Telcose was thrown through a window and stood up with only bruises.

name: Taunumco
summary: Taunumco is a mutilated bounty hunter driven by revenge and later by a quiet longing for a settled life. Taunumco learned the pistol late and learned it well.

feats.scene: Taunumco shot a lantern off a hook from across a dusty street.
Taunumco survived a knife attack that would have dropped a larger fighter.

name: Stotescol
summary: Stotescol is a rumoured collector of overdue debts, said to fire across enormous distances. Stotescol appears only as whispered fear among people who cannot pay.

feats.scene: Stotescol sent one rifle round across a prison yard and silenced a witness.
Stotescol took a rooftop tumble and vanished before the dust settled.

name: Conisor
summary: Conisor is a gaunt, white-eyed hitman raised in poverty who turned every unpaid debt into a killing. Conisor still hears a mother's sorrowful refrain with each knock.

feats.scene: Conisor caved a door with a crowbar and went through the frame.
Conisor walked off a cruel beating from men twice his weight.

name: Niasati
summary: Niasati is a young mutant with taloned limbs and wings joined to her arms, a thief who screams to stun crowds. Niasati would sell out former allies for a reward.

feats.scene: Niasati shattered a row of shop windows with one piercing shriek.
Niasati slammed into a brick wall at full glide and rose again.
Niasati swooped over rooftops faster than a sprinting man.

name: Rnnaeon
summary: Rnnaeon is an acrobatic assistant who left his master's service for love and drifted across worlds with a young rebel. Rnnaeon fights with agility, gadgets and short tempers.

feats.scene: Rnnaeon vaulted a railing and drove both boots into a guard.
Rnnaeon rolled out of a collapsing scaffold unharmed.

name: Covalan
summary: Covalan is a trained falcon used as a scout and delivery bird for a crew of criminals. Covalan once carried a heavy payload to a distant wall.

feats.scene: Covalan raked a man's forearm with a quick pass of its claws.
Covalan tumbled through a rattling gust and recovered height.
Covalan dove on a target in a rapid stoop.

name: Rnisant
summary: Rnisant is a balding interstellar patrol officer who wields a ring fueled by sheer determination. Rnisant raises shields and bolts of green light on command.

feats.scene: Rnisant melted a hull plate the size of a house with a focused emerald ray.
Rnisant held a glowing barrier against a falling slab of rock.

name: Rnela
summary: Rnela is a bald, black-skinned monarch of a people adapted to molten caverns. Rnela commands heat and flame and rules an underground realm from a glowing throne.

feats.scene: Rnela hurled a ball of flame that vaporised a boulder.
Rnela waded through a lava channel as if it were a shallow stream.

name: Reolile
summary: Reolile is a brilliant engineer who built her own racing chair and uses it with rare confidence. Reolile treats every first date as a systems test.

feats.scene: Reolile rammed a door off its hinges with the footrest of her chair.
Reolile survived a spill at speed with only a scraped palm.
Reolile launched her chair to highway speed in five seconds.

name: Rauntnu
summary: Rauntnu is a purple-skinned hairless soldier who once carried a ring fed by greed. Rauntnu has since lost that power and brooded on the world of his birth.

feats.scene: Rauntnu launched an amber bolt that flattened a fortified gatehouse.
Rauntnu weathered a storm of debris inside a hard-light dome.

name: Iariuleo
summary: Iariuleo is a rifle-toting guard from a bottled city, a loyal fighter who followed a hero through a portal of light. Iariuleo held back raiders so allies could escape.

feats.scene: Iariuleo flattened a charging brute with a single backhand.
Iariuleo took a blast from an alien cannon and kept firing.

name: Reniasta
summary: Reniasta is a ditch-ball star who donned a borrowed cape and tried to be a hero. Reniasta later tricked robot scouts into reporting a false massacre.

feats.scene: Reniasta spiked a metal crate across a plaza and smashed a wall.
Reniasta was thrown through a barricade by electric gauntlets and rose swaying.

name: Lorronlle
summary: Lorronlle is a green-eyed researcher sent abroad as an envoy who studies how sunlight changes his kind. Lorronlle swears dire revenge for slights and prison.

feats.scene: Lorronlle shattered a lab table with one furious overhead blow.
Lorronlle stood unharmed under a collapsing shelf of equipment.

name: Rnuneia
summary: Rnuneia is an island-raised broadcaster who chased stories from a helicopter and befriended a young champion. Rnuneia exposed a producer's staged disasters.

feats.scene: Rnuneia swung a microphone into a cameraman's shin.
Rnuneia rode out a rough landing in a swaying helicopter.

name: Retutel
summary: Retutel is a red-haired youth from a far future who was lamed, then granted borrowed divine gifts by an ancient wizard. Retutel now guards a rock that stands outside time.

feats.scene: Retutel struck a rocky moonlet and split it from end to end.
Retutel took a falling tower on his shoulders and shook off the dust.
Retutel crossed a valley in a blink of golden light.

name: Aniiumco
summary: Aniiumco is a blond tavern worker who once ran product for a smuggler and also passed tips to a detective. Aniiumco is among the walking dead.

feats.scene: Aniiumco hurled a bottle crate across the bar floor.
Aniiumco took a full blow from a bat and just laughed.

name: Tonle
summary: Tonle is a villain raised in secret who can throw up a field that sends attacks right back at their source. Tonle spent her earnings caring for a sick parent.

feats.scene: Tonle reflected a thrown beam and cracked a concrete column with it.
Tonle stood inside her shimmering field while a van crashed into it.

name: Asista
summary: Asista is a displaced fighter born with the ability to move stone, uneasy about an identity she borrowed. Asista wants a life that is truly her own.

feats.scene: Asista lifted a slab of bedrock and dropped it on a column of armour.
Asista was buried in a rockfall and climbed out in minutes.

name: Amino
summary: Amino is a pint-sized schoolgirl with a fondness for hurling pebbles at a pestering classmate. Amino shows off by leading friends down a tunnel to a hot cavern.

feats.scene: Amino lobbed a pebble that knocked a hat off a pursuer's head.
Amino tumbled down a small hill without a scratch.

name: Tinnto
summary: Tinnto is a blond stone-mover from a dark possible tomorrow who joined a breakaway band against heavy-handed rulers. Tinnto bends gravity to crush opposition.

feats.scene: Tinnto pulled a rooftop down on a convoy by warping weight itself.
Tinnto rode out a collapsing overpass without breaking stride.

name: Coralun
summary: Coralun is a masked adventurer and member of a veteran crimefighting society in a world that never was. Coralun's methods are mostly unrecorded and wholly his own.

feats.scene: Coralun kicked a locked cellar door off its frame.
Coralun fell from a loft into a pile of crates and stood up.

name: Valire
summary: Valire is a bald, secretive mob muscle who works for gangsters and keeps his face hidden. Valire hunts a nocturnal doctor and prefers to stay in the shadows.

feats.scene: Valire cracked a table in half with a clenched fist.
Valire shook off a crowbar blow to the shoulder.

name: Ntonensti
summary: Ntonensti is a blue-skinned mother who shares her people's gift for shadow and was once menaced by an avenger with a grudge. Ntonensti hides her child's heritage.

feats.scene: Ntonensti swallowed a courtyard in blackness to cover an escape.
Ntonensti walked out of a collapsed cellar behind a veil of dark.

name: Reoautor
summary: Reoautor is an escaped captive who joined a young warrior sisterhood and later sought bloody justice for her sister. Reoautor prayed to a god of the sun and paid dearly.

feats.scene: Reoautor drove a spear through a wooden shield.
Reoautor ran through a spear volley and kept her feet.

name: Iaamst
summary: Iaamst is a green-skinned tavern owner turned bounty broker whose bar was flattened by a careless visitor. Iaamst is a talker and not a fighter.

feats.scene: Iaamst slung a stool across the bar into a heckler.
Iaamst took a keg to the skull and still finished his speech.

name: Maorami
summary: Maorami is an orange-skinned officer who loved a prince in secret and bore his child alone. Maorami soaks up starlight to fly and fight, then bears the cost of war.

feats.scene: Maorami crashed through a rampart wall at the end of a long dive.
Maorami endured a bombardment of heavy catapult stones.
Maorami streaked across the sky at the speed of a fighter jet.

name: Llecoleo
summary: Llecoleo is a blond feaster from a distant planet who can swallow any material by the ton. Llecoleo turns meals into brawn and speed, and finds iron as tasty as dessert.

feats.scene: Llecoleo punched through a steel locker door after a large lunch.
Llecoleo shrugged off a crushing hug from a prison machine.

name: Numrnni
summary: Numrnni is the daughter of a heroic armoured man and a steadfast mother, raised in a family that expects courage. Numrnni has only just stepped onto the stage.

feats.scene: Numrnni threw a snowball hard enough to sting.
Numrnni took a slip on ice and laughed it off.

name: Ilirntel
summary: Ilirntel is a white-haired widow from a vanished world of superpowered royals who survived its destruction and then joined a peacekeeping army. Ilirntel was once fused into a dictator.

feats.scene: Ilirntel blasted a bulkhead into slag with a surge of energy.
Ilirntel crossed a depressurised corridor under heavy fire.

name: Valerntir
summary: Valerntir is a blue-skinned heir to an ancient line of dark-casters who can unmake light in a room at will. Valerntir flies on a ring and views justice in black and white.

feats.scene: Valerntir smothered a crashing hover-carrier in a field of night and crushed it.
Valerntir sat inside a pocket of dark while heavy rounds struck it.

name: Mianesval
summary: Mianesval is a blue-skinned trained champion of a dim world, fired when her post became obsolete. Mianesval conjures fields of darkness and then won a place among young hero recruits.

feats.scene: Mianesval cast a dome of shadow that stopped a cannon crew cold.
Mianesval stayed active in vacuum for long minutes.

name: Nunia
summary: Nunia is a blue-skinned heroine who was scared as a child, locked in a cave with her cousin, and came out bearing her ancestors' gift. Nunia now throws a blanket of night over entire cities.

feats.scene: Nunia drowned a stadium in black and gently stalled a riot.
Nunia withstood a blast of heat inside a pocket of dark.

name: Tonres
summary: Tonres is a violet-eyed, bald thug whose painted skin can come to life and attack. Tonres works the streets and is known by a scrawled nickname.

feats.scene: Tonres loosed a swarm of inked snakes that bit a policeman's cuff.
Tonres took a baton blow across the back and just grinned.

name: Iumoneno
summary: Iumoneno is a black-haired visitor from a small hidden people, quiet and unrecorded, who wandered into a seaside adventure. Iumoneno has few known deeds.

feats.scene: Iumoneno shoved a driftwood plank hard enough to dent a hull.
Iumoneno fell off a pier into shallow water and swam on.

name: Oroansu
summary: Oroansu is a visitor who steps between worlds and wears a hideous catlike shape while away from home. Oroansu is struggling and a little ridiculous in the human realm.

feats.scene: Oroansu raked a wooden fence post with a swipe of claws.
Oroansu bounced off a parked truck and sprang up angry.

name: Neeoium
summary: Neeoium is a widowed sword protector who shelters refugees on the fringe of a police state. Neeoium wields a blade said to trap the souls of whoever it kills.

feats.scene: Neeoium sliced through an armoured plate with a single stroke.
Neeoium stayed standing after a cybernetic soldier's heavy punch.

name: Sornte
summary: Sornte is a swordswoman of a hidden order of shadows who went after a laughing killer and wound up caged. Sornte keeps her soul-taking blade close.

feats.scene: Sornte cut a steel chain in half with one clean draw.
Sornte took a hard strike from a guard's club without flinching.

name: Siterva
summary: Siterva is a former spy who posed as an assassin, stole a cursed blade to keep it from others and faked her death. Siterva now serves as bodyguard and driver to a wealthy man.

feats.scene: Siterva cleaved a mounted steel gate hinge in a single swing.
Siterva leapt from a moving limousine and rolled to her feet.

name: Lanvauti
summary: Lanvauti is a masked blade-wielding rebel who fought under a tyrant's rule until she was captured in a sewer. Lanvauti was freed by a clown clan.

feats.scene: Lanvauti slashed a rusted grate away from a drain.
Lanvauti shrugged off a brutal beating in the dark.

name: Tonurn
summary: Tonurn is a small, widowed sword fighter who lost her family, took up a soul-drinking blade and found a new family among outcasts. Tonurn once chose a husband over a rival's love.

feats.scene: Tonurn bisected a stone lantern with a flick of a haunted blade.
Tonurn rolled through a burning doorway and stood in the open air.

name: Tiavanum
summary: Tiavanum is a swordswoman drafted onto a presidential task force and ordered to catch two fugitives. Tiavanum follows orders and trusts her steel.

feats.scene: Tiavanum split a metal pipe with a single stroke.
Tiavanum was thrown into a car door and went right back at it.

name: Rnusau
summary: Rnusau is a dark-haired man hauled across time to a lost island and made to fight in a vast war against giant beasts. Rnusau has no known powers beyond nerve.

feats.scene: Rnusau swung a thick branch into a charging lizard's snout.
Rnusau lay under a toppled fern trunk and crawled free.

name: Irtauau
summary: Irtauau is a bald, scar-faced enforcer who rose to second place in a masked gang by killing a rival's guard. Irtauau is strong, a sharp shot and quick to suspect a plant.

feats.scene: Irtauau drove a fist into a steel locker and left a dent.
Irtauau took a chair across the back and kept hauling his captive.

name: Cestil
summary: Irtauau's cousin in crime, Cestil, is a blond terrorist who can animate her painted skin. Cestil served in a violent cell and was soon beaten by a lone hero.

feats.scene: Cestil sent ink-drawn wolves racing across a warehouse floor.
Cestil was flung against a pallet stack and kept snarling.

name: Anunauirn
summary: Anunauirn is a mischievous brother who flings bolts of electricity from his hands while riding a storm cloud. Anunauirn was once a menace for fun and later a reluctant ally.

feats.scene: Anunauirn flung a bolt that split a billboard tower.
Anunauirn shook off a hard slam into a water tank.
Anunauirn raced across the skyline on a roaring cloud.

name: Stoser
summary: Stoser is a talking orange tiger who grew up with a missionary's son, was gifted speech by a hermit's serum and now works as a museum guide. Stoser clears his own name with paw prints.

feats.scene: Stoser pinned a runaway burglar with one paw.
Stoser shook off a pack of thrown spears during a jungle chase.

name: Ntsta
summary: Ntsta is a big blue-eyed tiger who lives in a city zoo and loves a boy as family. Ntsta once received a flicker of borrowed magic, but his body could not hold it.

feats.scene: Ntsta clamped his jaws on a rope and tore it free.
Ntsta was hurled across a courtyard by a stronger foe and got back up.

name: Tisata
summary: Tisata is a tiger-woman consort created in a lab, living in a walled jungle city. Tisata tracks by scent, fights with claws and understands that crowns come before hearts.

feats.scene: Tisata shredded a leather harness with a flick of her claws.
Tisata took a heavy club to her shoulder and shrugged it off.

name: Tosti
summary: Tosti is a brown kitten kept by a cheerful girl, equipped with only tiny claws and a very loud purr. Tosti is small, playful and endlessly curious.

feats.scene: Tosti snagged a curtain with his claws and tore a strip free.
Tosti dropped from a shelf and landed squarely on four paws.

name: Lusiuile
summary: Lusiuile is a teenage prodigy whose lab accident left him able to become insubstantial at will. Lusiuile turned the gift to burglary, then joined a covert team as its stealth expert.

feats.scene: Lusiuile slipped through a vault wall and pulled a safe free behind him.
Lusiuile let a shotgun blast pass harmlessly through his chest.

name: Inson
summary: Inson is a stubborn widowed warrior from a war-ravaged planet who defeated the last of her enemies, then buried her husband. Inson joined a starship crew and jabs anyone who patronises her.

feats.scene: Inson jabbed an old pirate in the gut so hard he doubled over.
Inson trudged on after a harsh crash landing.

name: Onetasceo
summary: Onetasceo is a red-haired multi-armed general who commands swarms of stinging insects and plots against her own master. Onetasceo was betrayed in turn.

feats.scene: Onetasceo struck four foes at once with her extra arms.
Onetasceo took a blade across the ribs and swung back.

name: Ntetonte
summary: Ntetonte is a white-haired instructor who teaches chemistry and stick-fighting in a harsh school for young criminals. Ntetonte wields a three-part staff.

feats.scene: Ntetonte snapped a bamboo post with a whirling staff strike.
Ntetonte took a kick to the ribs and answered with a sweep.

name: Ilvater
summary: Ilvater is a teenage mechanic and acrobat who ran with a gang of street children and was cursed with a tragic early end. Ilvater built gadgets from scrap.

feats.scene: Ilvater flipped over a rail and drove both heels into a crate.
Ilvater fell from a fire escape and rolled to safety.

name: Resniuium
summary: Resniuium is a green-skinned, genius-level strategist who leads a resistance on her home world and handles both computers and firearms. Resniuium has a famous family.

feats.scene: Resniuium fired a rifle through a window and disabled a patrol drone.
Resniuium walked out of a collapsed bunker with a bad limp.

name: Ntleoirn
summary: Ntleoirn is a dark-haired criminal who clashed with a young hero and left few traces. Ntleoirn works alone, keeps his methods to himself and rarely makes the news.

feats.scene: Ntleoirn swung a wrench into a door lock and burst it.
Ntleoirn dropped from a loading dock and kept running.

name: Auarasi
summary: Auarasi is a blond tinkerer who bolts add-on gear onto heroes, a mild figure with grease on his sleeves. Auarasi has no known powers and plenty of spare parts.

feats.scene: Auarasi hammered a bracket into a steel frame with one swing.
Auarasi was knocked off a workbench and got back up.

name: Stior
summary: Stior is a red-haired, muscular college student who joined an inventor's mad voyage and brags about wrestling lions. Stior is the brawn of a two-man team.

feats.scene: Stior hauled a crate of equipment up a ramp and slammed it down.
Stior hung on through a violent landing in a pressure suit.

name: Anrntau
summary: Anrntau is a toy-store owner whose obsession with childhood playthings drove him to wire cars with explosives. Anrntau wept when his shop burned.

feats.scene: Anrntau detonated a toy truck and blew a hole in a loading bay wall.
Anrntau was caught in the burning doorway and dragged out coughing.

name: Serter
summary: Serter is a battle-scarred general who secretly returns from death each time he is killed. Serter refused a cowardly attack and paid for it with his life, again.

feats.scene: Serter charged a siege ram with a lowered shoulder and splintered it.

name: Iarsa
summary: Iarsa is a red-eyed cat bound to a wicked boy as his companion. Iarsa is clever, sharp-toothed and fiercely loyal to a master who calls it his best friend.

feats.scene: Iarsa slashed a hanging cord and dropped a lantern.
Iarsa landed from a high shelf without a scratch.

name: Nenumsto
summary: Nenumsto is a black-haired hometown sweetheart who followed her love across the sea, married him and raised a family. Nenumsto reconciled with him after a long separation.

feats.scene: Nenumsto slung a bag onto a train rack with one pull.
Nenumsto endured a gruelling winter walk to a distant station.

name: Arereter
summary: Arereter is a red-haired burglar who robbed a mansion with her partner and shot at police. Arereter was betrayed by that partner and met a bitter end.

feats.scene: Arereter pistol-whipped a butler into the pantry floor.
Arereter ran along a broken trail of pearls with a bruised shoulder.

name: Veotuam
summary: Veotuam is a deity of wisdom glimpsed only as a statue in a city of heroes, posed like a thinker with chin in hand. Veotuam is more reverence than record.

feats.scene: Veotuam stood as a stone idol while a storm of sand scoured the avenue for a century.

name: Lleseotel
summary: Lleseotel is a bald, purple-skinned, yellow-eyed member of an antimatter race who showed up in a team adventure. Lleseotel fights for freedom with standard weapons.

feats.scene: Lleseotel punched a hovering drone out of the air.
Lleseotel took a hard fall in a hangar and stood up grim.

name: Sesniutel
summary: Sesniutel is a one-eyed pale warrior and refugee who wears a pendant and carries the old gifts of his people. Sesniutel is vulnerable to fire and moves warily.

feats.scene: Sesniutel crushed a stone bench in his white fists.
Sesniutel waded through shrapnel and kept walking, unsmiling.

name: Cerusast
summary: Cerusast is a white-haired hired wrecker who toppled several laboratory buildings and was paid in broken promises. Cerusast retreated twice from a masked hero.

feats.scene: Cerusast brought down a research lab with a series of shuddering stomps.
Cerusast shrugged off a squad of police fire.

name: Stiern
summary: Stiern is a blue-eyed chief aide who lives in an undersea city of the far future and senses the whole ocean around her. Stiern fires energy, raises storms and swims at great speed.

feats.scene: Stiern took the full weight of a tidal surge and swam on.
Stiern raced through the deeps faster than a speeding bullet train.

name: Tanrnema
summary: Tanrnema is a red-eyed, one-armed sea-born villain from another dimension, a twisted mirror of a kinder hero. Tanrnema leads a gang of teen tyrants.

feats.scene: Tanrnema smashed a harbour crane with a single blow.
Tanrnema took a heavy slam into a dock and spat salt water.

source_title: Tempest (Teen Titans TV Series: Wrong Place, Wrong Time)

name: Vinumtor
summary: Vinumtor is a brunette who grew up beside two friends and became a thief with them, using a stolen map as bait. Vinumtor stood by while her partner froze a victim solid.

feats.scene: Vinumtor hurled a stone planter that cracked a shop counter.
Vinumtor shrugged off a tumble from a parade float.

name: Ceomeasi
summary: Ceomeasi is a clock-obsessed schemer who built a device that freezes time at the press of a button. Ceomeasi planned to own the future and was foiled by a rival's trick.

feats.scene: Ceomeasi lashed a rapier through a wooden door in a fit of impatience.
Ceomeasi dropped from a clock tower ledge onto an awning and kept scheming.

name: Iuoreeo
summary: Iuoreeo is a shapeshifting being from a realm of chaos who treats mortals as game pieces, tempting them into misery for rank. Iuoreeo traffics in pacts, memories and stolen sight.

feats.scene: Iuoreeo ripped a hole between rooms and a cold wind poured through it.
Iuoreeo took a blow from a mental shadow and slowly reformed.

name: Iancorllo
summary: Iancorllo is a black-haired grudge-holder who built a monstrous clock to wipe out the world over a spoiled monument. Iancorllo is petty, patient and dangerously inventive.

feats.scene: Iancorllo set off his ticking engine and cracked the plaza pavement.
Iancorllo took a stumble from a ladder in his workshop.

name: Tiaus
summary: Tiaus is a black-haired card-themed thief who planned a casino heist in the desert and ran into a stage magician. Tiaus fled without the cash.

feats.scene: Tiaus swung a bag of coins into a guard's chest.
Tiaus tumbled from a slot machine and ran on.

name: Valaulre
summary: Valaulre is a red-eyed professional criminal with a mask and a gun, hired to make trouble for a league of heroes. Valaulre has a flair for the dramatic.

feats.scene: Valaulre kicked a metal drum across a loading yard.
Valaulre took a hard fall from a catwalk and sprang up.

name: Iutelta
summary: Iutelta is a brown-eyed crook who zips around on a card-shaped scooter and keeps getting arrested, then escaping, in a comic loop. Iutelta enjoys the chase.

feats.scene: Iutelta rammed her scooter into a wooden fence and broke it.
Iutelta bounced off a car hood and scrambled away.
Iutelta raced down a boulevard on her scooter.

name: Satilium
summary: Satilium is a professional thief who works with a card gang and sports a flashy suit. Satilium thrives on the heist and shrugs off the occasional bruise.

feats.scene: Satilium cracked a vault dial with a mallet blow.
Satilium took a nasty fall from a rope and bounded up.

source_title: Ten of Spades (The Brave and the Bold)

name: Liinunt
summary: Liinunt is a red-haired card-gang thief who joined a society of villains. Liinunt keeps quiet about her past and her trade, and strikes when the heist is ripe.

feats.scene: Liinunt shattered a jewellery case with her elbow.
Liinunt hit the pavement after a rooftop jump and dashed away.

name: Taualco
summary: Taualco is a blue-eyed, black-haired father from a doomed planet, a proud parent in a society of rigid scientists. Taualco leaves little record of his deeds.

feats.scene: Taualco shoved a wall panel aside to reach a trapped neighbour.
Taualco took a falling beam on his back and held steady.

name: Amoiarci
summary: Amoiarci is a crow-like mountain goblin freed from a prison dimension, who possesses human hosts and rampages. Amoiarci can open rifts to bring in hordes of smaller kin.

feats.scene: Amoiarci tore down a wooden temple gate with a thrown boulder.
Amoiarci took a beating that would have felled several men and snarled on.

name: Iasvalnen
summary: Iasvalnen is a hearty cook from a world of omnivores who can swallow any substance and keeps the team's kitchen busy. Iasvalnen wears a ring that lets him fly.

feats.scene: Iasvalnen chewed through a steel pot lid in a few bites.
Iasvalnen shook off a pan to the skull and kept stirring.

name: Iuserco
summary: Iuserco is a famous eater who once swallowed an unbreakable cosmic engine, which cost him his sanity for years. Iuserco later became a free-spirited celebrity and politician.

feats.scene: Iuserco swallowed a vast machine whole and unleashed its stored energy.
Iuserco survived the machine's overloaded pulse and woke in an infirmary.

name: Ornure
summary: Ornure is a black-haired team member from a far future who can eat nearly anything and flits about on a flight ring. Ornure joined an unlikely crossover with dog detectives.

feats.scene: Ornure chomped through a padlock and a chain in seconds.
Ornure shrugged off a collision with a golf cart.

name: Llrasia
summary: Llrasia is a rust-skinned mechanical mercenary built by a vanished tinkerer, sent to slip into rival crews and sabotage them from within. She hurls compressed gusts from her palms that can fell a wall, and she never needs to breathe.

feats.scene: Llrasia flattens a warehouse with a single pressurised blast from both palms.
Llrasia keeps fighting after a collapsing gantry crushes her torso.

name: Torsaulan
summary: Torsaulan is a turncoat who commands soil and stone, raising crushing ridges beneath her foes. After dying once, she returned as an obedient puppet of a hive-minded cult, her old loves reduced to targets.

feats.scene: Torsaulan heaves a ridge of bedrock out of the ground and buries a transport convoy.
Torsaulan walks away from a rooftop collapse with only a cracked jaw.

name: Nasola
summary: Nasola is a murderous drifter who can call a single drizzling cloud to hover above whoever he has chosen. The little storm is his signature, a grim herald that precedes each ambush in the harbour districts.

feats.scene: Nasola gathers a thunderhead over a dockyard and drops a hard hailstorm on a fleeing crowd.
Nasola shakes off a heavy fall onto a concrete pier.

name: Vausa
summary: Vausa is a crime-fighter who cannot walk, relying on a suit packed with clever tools and a rotor-winged flying chair to patrol rooftops. He keeps up the nightly campaign out of stubbornness rather than hope.

feats.scene: Vausa rams a gunman off a ledge using the whirling blades of his rotor chair.
Vausa rides out a crash against a brick chimney in his padded suit.

name: Selorlu
summary: Selorlu is a bright teenage assistant at a monthly periodical, inking panels late into the night and quietly learning that his employer hides a luminous second life.

feats.scene: Selorlu shoves a stack of heavy paper crates across a studio floor to block a door.
Selorlu tumbles down a flight of stairs and gets up laughing.

name: Tertata
summary: Tertata answers calls at a hotline for masked helpers, and can devour a stack of dossiers in the time it takes a kettle to whistle. His only gift is a mind that races through print.

feats.scene: Tertata slams a heavy telephone directory onto a desk to wake a sleeping colleague.
Tertata stumbles into a filing cabinet and shrugs it off.

name: Rerliaval
summary: Rerliaval brokers contracts between paying clients and professional killers from the back office of a flashy dance hall. He has no talent for fighting, only a thick address book and a gift for smiling while he lies.

feats.scene: Rerliaval swings a leather ledger at an intruder's face.
Rerliaval is thrown across a bar top and remains conscious.

name: Taliater
summary: Taliater is a masonry-themed burglar who works as the junior partner of a clumsy crew, carrying a hod of mortar and a hard head. He is sturdy for a thief but easily outwitted.

feats.scene: Taliater drives a mason's trowel through a vault door's thin panel.
Taliater headbutts a wall of fired clay and keeps on walking.

name: Tiusenti
summary: Tiusenti is a nervous laboratory researcher who sells secrets to a rival while pretending loyalty to his employer. His greed for a bigger payoff is his undoing, since the buyer prefers silence to haggling.

feats.scene: Tiusenti hurls a glass beaker at a guard to cover his escape.
Tiusenti survives a nasty tumble over a laboratory bench.

name: Orcelnan
summary: Orcelnan is a stern school administrator who assigns reflective essays to slackers and holds grudges against wealthy meddlers. He is nearly drained of vitality by a hungry student, and survives only thanks to a timely rescue.

feats.scene: Orcelnan slaps a ruler across a desk so hard that a whole classroom falls silent.
Orcelnan stays upright while a ravenous student pulls at his life force.

name: Serstacar
summary: Serstacar is a government researcher haunted by glimpses of tomorrow, who detonates a captured alien machine and erases several countries to dodge what he saw. Years later he counsels generals with chilling calm, convinced that history will judge him as either saviour or butcher.

feats.scene: Serstacar overloads a captured alien engine and wipes four nations off the map.
Serstacar survives a hard crash while kidnapping a rival thinker.

name: Saseos
summary: Saseos is a covert agent of a wartime coalition, trained in infiltration and sabotage. Documents about him are sparse, but rumours say he never lost a game of chance.

feats.scene: Saseos plants a satchel charge that drops a small railway trestle.
Saseos rolls out of a moving truck and sprints on.

name: Orolluoro
summary: Orolluoro is a prodigy who finished school as a child, mastered sport, and grew rich, only to find the world dull. A single rescue on a bridge convinces him to wear a mask and drive petty gangsters out of the city.

feats.scene: Orolluoro flattens three armed hoodlums with a flurry of precise blows.
Orolluoro withstands a heavy beating in an alley and still wins.

name: Matauli
summary: Matauli is a physician who can split into thirteen copies scattered across the globe, each living a separate life. The copies chat silently through a shared mental channel and pool what each has learned.

feats.scene: Matauli's thirteen copies all drop their work at once and hammer a barred gate open.
Matauli loses one copy to a fall and carries on through the others.

name: Leollni
summary: Leollni is a sceptical ghost-hunter who debunks hauntings with spreadsheets and a patient eye. He is father to a spell-casting daughter and an uneasy ally of a wandering spectral drifter.

feats.scene: Leollni hurls a salt-filled flask and cracks a crooked medium's lantern.
Leollni stands his ground in a haunted cellar while shelves topple around him.

name: Rntilli
summary: Rntilli is a loyal, well-drilled bull terrier who follows orders from a gruff handler without hesitation. He has a fierce bite and an unshakable trust in his master.

feats.scene: Rntilli clamps his jaws on a thug's sleeve and drags him down a hallway.
Rntilli bounces up after being kicked across a cobbled yard.

name: Tiastmil
summary: Tiastmil is a colony of winged insects that walk inside a patchwork cloth outfit, passing for a lone man. It bends stone and ore to its will, and its body drifts apart into buzzing sparks when the shell is broken.

feats.scene: Tiastmil lifts a slab of granite from a courtyard and hurls it through a barricade.
Tiastmil is punched clean through the chest and its swarm simply reforms.

name: Iacol
summary: Iacol is a blue-haired brawler who breaks from a clown-faced mob after a rival takeover and founds her own rowdy band. Her rebellion is short, ended by a professional marksman.

feats.scene: Iacol swings a baseball bat and breaks a rival enforcer's guard.
Iacol takes a hard hit from a crowbar and keeps charging.

name: Tataslia
summary: Tataslia is a bloated, shadow-skinned horror from beneath the waves, wriggling with feelers and moving through water with surprising grace. A foul tide of hostile spirits follows its path, though a team of misfits eventually puts it down.

feats.scene: Tataslia wraps a freighter in its feelers and crushes the hull like foil.
Tataslia absorbs a barrage of depth charges before it finally falters.

name: Tiaute
summary: Tiaute is a bonded labourer who rises against his taskmasters after receiving gifts from a cold machine intelligence. He then sleeps for millennia in stasis before waking in an age that has forgotten his name.

feats.scene: Tiaute levels a fortified citadel with a single hammering blow.
Tiaute stands untouched at the centre of a collapsing temple district.

name: Lloceseon
summary: Lloceseon is a phantom of a fallen champion conjured in a young hero's feverish mind during a transformation. Crackling with borrowed godly thunder, it flies, hits like a collapsing tower, and cannot be hurt or aged.

feats.scene: Lloceseon drives a lightning-wreathed fist into the ground and cracks an entire plaza.
Lloceseon takes a blow that would level a tower and does not flinch.

name: Riaeote
summary: Riaeote was once the chosen heir of an ancient sorcerer, until power curdled into tyranny and he seized a throne by force. Exiled to the farthest light in the sky, he spent five thousand years crossing the void to return home with a grudge.

feats.scene: Riaeote tears a palace from its foundations and flings it into the river.
Riaeote crosses the void and re-enters the atmosphere without a scratch.

name: Telstian
summary: Telstian is a vengeful apprentice who usurps his old master's seat of magic by stealing a sphere that doubles his might. He frees an ancient pack of wish-bound spirits upon the world before being hurled back across the centuries.

feats.scene: Telstian unleashes a torrent of sorcerous force that shatters a mountaintop citadel.
Telstian is battered by two champions at once and rises smiling.

name: Iumauam
summary: Iumauam is an ancient prince empowered by deities who comes to believe himself one of them. He treats mortals as ants beneath a heel, and his arrogance drives his last campaign.

feats.scene: Iumauam brings down the walls of a rival capital with a stroke of his fist.
Iumauam is buried under a collapsing monument and strides out of the rubble.

name: Esttal
summary: Esttal is a primordial tide-mother who once shared rule of every river and sea with her consort sibling. Locked away beneath the world by younger gods, she is freed to join a doomed uprising and falls in the chaos.

feats.scene: Esttal calls up a tidal wave that drowns an entire coastal city.
Esttal endures a storm of divine fire and cracked marble without yielding.

name: Aullor
summary: Aullor is a rural grower and family man who can split off at least three copies of himself, linked by thought. He uses the extra hands mostly for harvest season.

feats.scene: Aullor and his three copies shove a stalled tractor out of a ditch.
Aullor is flattened by a fallen hay bale and one of his copies pulls him free.

name: Vasetis
summary: Vasetis is a bred successor, grown in glass to take a fallen champion's place, and he alone among his squad is shaken by the team's cruelty. He craves a partner but is mocked, and he ends up beaten down by a ruthless fighter.

feats.scene: Vasetis pounds the original champion into a collapsing wall of his own fortress.
Vasetis takes the full weight of a heavy blow and loses only his composure.

name: Rautor
summary: Rautor is a ranch hand of the open range who bets freely and brags louder, partnered with a lanky friend in short western tales.

feats.scene: Rautor throws a punch that lays a card cheat flat on a saloon floor.
Rautor is thrown from a bucking horse and dusts himself off.

name: Liutaueo
summary: Liutaueo is a daredevil aircraft tester who earns his fiery nickname by bringing down a fugitive raider in wartime. He ferries bombers across the ocean, tangles with enemy warships, and escapes captivity aboard a seized freighter.

feats.scene: Liutaueo rakes a raider's plane with gunfire and sends it into a field.
Liutaueo walks away from a smoking prototype after a hard emergency landing.

name: Liurno
summary: Liurno is a hulking temple warrior sheathed in bronze plate that is charged by forgotten deities through grim offerings. Spring-loaded blades and venomous bolts leap from the gauntlets, until he turns on his own commander and gives his life to unmake her scheme.

feats.scene: Liurno swings a gauntlet blade through a stone doorway and splits the lintel.
Liurno stands unmoved as a runner and a lantern bearer blast him with full force.

name: Osirncin
summary: Osirncin is an exiled peacekeeper turned despot who fuels a golden ring with the terror of his captives. He raises glowing constructs and shields, and marshals a legion of followers to bend entire star systems to his idea of order.

feats.scene: Osirncin pours the fear of a conquered world into his ring and cracks an orbiting moon.
Osirncin holds a shimmering shield against the blast of a collapsing fortress world.

name: Teauoro
summary: Teauoro is a ring-bearing warlord from a parallel reality, remembered mainly because a grim rival slays him and mounts his body as a trophy in a fortress.

feats.scene: Teauoro blasts a hole through the hull of a patrol cruiser with his ring.
Teauoro is run through before he can raise a shield.

name: Milnen
summary: Milnen is a stern off-world commander who tears a rookie's ring away before the youth can call for help, then proves surprisingly sincere when he warns a ruling tyrant of an approaching armada. His cautious alliance ends in a fatal betrayal.

feats.scene: Milnen collapses a mountain fortress with a vast golden construct.
Milnen holds off an orbital bombardment behind a bright ring-forged shield.

name: Silveurn
summary: Silveurn is a ring-wielding warlord who dominates a skyline duel with glowing shields and blasts until his foe's grit wears him down. He hits harder when his victims panic.

feats.scene: Silveurn flattens a row of towers with a sweeping beam of golden light.
Silveurn tanks a barrage of green constructs above a crowded avenue.

name: Raeonti
summary: Raeonti is a snooty plastic-limbed tyrant with a glowing ring, bent on ordering the galaxy through intimidation. He bickers with his fellow schemers but vanishes and reappears in a flash when cornered.

feats.scene: Raeonti blasts a toy fortress to scattered studs with one burst from his ring.
Raeonti is knocked into pieces and snaps himself back together.

name: Rninusval
summary: Rninusval is a gloating ring-bearer who joins a cabal of baddies to shrink and ambush heroes, only to have his ring flee his hand when two terrified kids panic nearby.

feats.scene: Rninusval traps a flying heroine in a crackling field of golden force.
Rninusval takes a thrashing from a full squad of heroes and is bound with rope.

name: Leston
summary: Leston is a brilliant defector who decides his order's elders are liars and takes up a golden power to oppose them. His ring lets him fly, turn unseen, and slip through walls, and he leads a rebel force that ends in his defeat.

feats.scene: Leston drives a spear of golden light through the heart of a fortress moon.
Leston walks through a rain of energy bolts behind a hardened shield.

name: Erncosan
summary: Erncosan is a revered elder politician of a galactic assembly who secretly sells out his own allies to a tyrant of a roaming war-fortress. He prefers quiet appeasement to open war, until his betrayals are exposed.

feats.scene: Erncosan strikes a servant with his ceremonial staff.
Erncosan survives a hard tumble from his dais during an assassination attempt.

name: Reotistan
summary: Reotistan is a vain inventor who frees a long-imprisoned despot out of spite, and thereby sets off an old wizard's choice of a new champion.

feats.scene: Reotistan blows a crypt door off its hinges with a homemade charge.
Reotistan is thrown across his workshop and sits up complaining.

name: Aunral
summary: Aunral is a bald, chilling genius who rewrites his own past by murdering a rival's champion before birth, then raids other worlds for rare ingredients. His boredom is deadly, and his obsession leads him to fatal overreach on a distant parallel.

feats.scene: Aunral executes two parallel guardians with a staggering burst from a time-twisting device.
Aunral is shot at close range and dies on the spot.

name: Orreoamo
summary: Orreoamo is a precocious youth who borrows super-strong gifts through a family science trick, powering up and down by speaking a certain word. A single swing from a rival sends him sailing all the way to the moon.

feats.scene: Orreoamo hurls a steel girder through the side of a warehouse.
Orreoamo is struck by a construction vehicle and flung to the moon intact.

name: Seoleia
summary: Seoleia is a wealthy scientist and inventor, notorious for mind-control gadgets, whose bitter rivalry with a caped champion consumes his fortune and marriage.

feats.scene: Seoleia blows up a rival's tower with a hastily wired contraption.
Seoleia is flung against a laboratory wall and staggers up.

name: Enullucel
summary: Enullucel is a white-haired elder of a hawk-like alien people, divorced and bitter, known mostly as a difficult father to a famous warrior.

feats.scene: Enullucel slams a clenched fist on a council table.
Enullucel survives a rough fall from a watchtower balcony.

name: Eltecil
summary: Eltecil is the quiet personification of mortality, son of night, who glides above deathbeds holding twin blades of fire. He appears to the dying as a vision, sparing no one once his stare settles.

feats.scene: Eltecil sweeps both flaming blades across a battlefield and reduces a hillside to ash.
Eltecil stands unharmed in the heart of a firestorm.

name: Riavasirn
summary: Riavasirn is the iron-fisted master of a burning industrial world, driven by a plan to erase every star but his own and win a lover who is death itself. He rides a clunky personal flying machine and cannot be killed by ordinary means.

feats.scene: Riavasirn drops a mountain-sized weapon onto a rebel stronghold and levels the range.
Riavasirn shrugs off a barrage of orbital cannons without a mark.

name: Stsean
summary: Stsean is a battle-hardened guard of a bottled metropolis, orphaned as a child when robotic harvesters plundered her city. She rises to lead its defences and takes up a winged masked identity in a doomed effort to stop two worlds from warring.

feats.scene: Stsean crushes a hovering harvester drone with a single overhand strike.
Stsean absorbs the full blast of a siege cannon and keeps fighting.

name: Tontiva
summary: Tontiva is a green-eyed youngster trapped alongside her father when a cold machine steals their city and shrinks it inside a glass jar. She is a loyal friend of a cousin hero and waits for rescue.

feats.scene: Tontiva shoves a fallen beam off her father's leg.
Tontiva clings to a lattice as the city shudders and rattles.

name: Amilean
summary: Amilean is a dark-haired woman from the old family of a shrunken city, married to a masked hero and surrounded by a sprawling tree of cousins and uncles.

feats.scene: Amilean flings a heavy vase at an intruder in her family hall.
Amilean stumbles through a tremor and is unhurt.

name: Tiureoau
summary: Tiureoau is a bitter surgeon who sharpens old grudges the way others sharpen scalpels. Hauled off in restraints after a failed scheme, the doctor still smirks at the guards, convinced the next plan will work.

feats.scene: Tiureoau drives a surgical clamp into a guard's padded vest with a vicious jab.
Tiureoau takes a heavy baton blow across the ribs and keeps on laughing.

name: Ruslianu
summary: Ruslianu is a pint-sized schoolyard bully-turned-crook who treats every playground as a heist target. The scheming is loud, clumsy and surprisingly persistent.

feats.scene: Ruslianu hurls a rubber ball so hard it cracks a classroom window.
Ruslianu tumbles down a flight of stairs and bounces up grinning.

name: Vorasi
summary: Vorasi is a cheerful small-town reporter who organizes an enormous autumn costume parade every year. Everyone in the valley knows the booming laugh and the homemade cape.

feats.scene: Vorasi heaves a crate of pumpkins onto a float with one swing.
Vorasi shrugs off a collapsing parade banner pole across the shoulders.

name: Llineonte
summary: Llineonte is a restless inventor who once sprinted for decades across a dark sea of stars to carry a warning home. The long journey frayed the mind, but the stubborn courage held.

feats.scene: Llineonte detonates a hand-built engine pack to blast a wrecked relay tower apart.
Llineonte rides out a crash landing on a barren moon and walks away.
Llineonte streaks between worlds in a single long, screaming leap.

name: Lentesil
summary: Lentesil is a quiet field operative who learned to throw bigger opponents with perfect balance. Duty and a stubborn sense of honor keep the temper in check.

feats.scene: Lentesil flips a hulking smuggler onto a concrete loading dock.
Lentesil absorbs a swinging steel pipe on a braced forearm.

name: Artello
summary: Artello is a patient engineer who tunes jet engines at a busy hangar and puts up with cruel teasing. A calm pride in the work wins respect in the end.

feats.scene: Artello wrenches a seized bolt loose from an engine casing.
Artello is knocked flat by a rolling tool cart and stands up unhurt.

name: Neoter
summary: Neoter is a wisecracking aviation technician who keeps a friend's secret and a flatbed truck always ready. Loyalty matters more than any gadget.

feats.scene: Neoter slams a hangar door shut against a gust of wind.
Neoter is thrown against a workbench by a test drone and laughs it off.

name: Tintuami
summary: Tintuami is a lone detective who was stitched together after death and now heals faster than any patrolman should. Night shifts and a slow-aging body keep the secret hard to share.

feats.scene: Tintuami hurls a snarling brute clean through a brick wall.
Tintuami is stabbed through the chest, pulls the blade out and closes the wound within minutes.

name: Seoca
summary: Seoca is a former sideshow performer whose rubbery limbs now rescue stranded kittens and stuck children. A long career has left the body a little less springy than it once was.

feats.scene: Seoca whips a lengthened arm to snatch a child from a falling shelf.
Seoca is struck by a thrown toolbox and bounces back into shape.

name: Nilial
summary: Nilial is a discarded guard twisted into a many-armed, fanged horror by a cruel experiment. Anger at a stolen life drives each lurching attack.

feats.scene: Nilial wrenches a steel gurney frame in half with a dozen claws.
Nilial takes a full magazine of rifle fire and keeps advancing.

name: Numlorirn
summary: Numlorirn is a scarred, one-eyed brute with a mohawk and a long list of victims. All muscle and no plan, the thug crashes into trouble head first.

feats.scene: Numlorirn smashes a bar stool across a rival's back.
Numlorirn is kicked and clubbed by a mob of officers before going down.

name: Valersau
summary: Valersau is a disciplined bowman who blends calm breathing with a fighter's reflexes. Trick arrows, sharp stealth and rigorous training keep the aim honest.

feats.scene: Valersau looses an arrow that pins a guard's sleeve to a pillar.
Valersau rolls out of a fall from a rooftop and sprints away.

name: Tisesmi
summary: Tisesmi is a masked swordsman from a darker mirror world who fights with grim precision. Captured at last, the prisoner refuses to bend and chooses a final silence.

feats.scene: Tisesmi cuts a steel cable with one sweeping blade stroke.
Tisesmi shrugs off a stun baton while pinned against a wall.

name: Roniumra
summary: Roniumra is a cold-eyed contract killer who prefers rooftops and a quiet pistol. Every job is planned and every exit mapped before the first shot.

feats.scene: Roniumra puts a single round through a window pane at long range.
Roniumra lands hard on a fire escape and keeps climbing.

name: Asorsi
summary: Asorsi is a swordsman trained in a mountain dojo, taught a secret rite that lets the body take the shape of beasts. Pride and vengeance push the blade through every mission.

feats.scene: Asorsi leaps as a great cat and rakes a bunker door into ribbons.
Asorsi weathers a barrage of thrown knives and rifle butts.

name: Rnonu
summary: Rnonu is a scheming gadget-maker who builds clanking helpers for criminal consortiums. Big ideas, loud boasts and a habit of getting arrested together with the whole crew.

feats.scene: Rnonu switches on a prototype robot that crushes a lamp post.
Rnonu is dragged from a lab chair and cuffed without a scratch.

name: Teltolla
summary: Teltolla is a flashy casino-district crook who swaggers under glowing signs and burns out young. A hot temper and a loud wardrobe make every escape memorable.

feats.scene: Teltolla smashes a display case with a thrown ashtray.
Teltolla survives a fall through an awning outside a hotel.

name: Sesoau
summary: Sesoau is a boy in a bright cape who leads a gang of friends against local crooks, later growing into a respected civic leader. The old clubhouse is still kept tidy.

feats.scene: Sesoau flings a sack of marbles across a warehouse floor to trip thugs.
Sesoau tumbles off a loading crane's hook into a haystack and hops up.

name: Assesa
summary: Assesa is a jumpy, suspicious patient with a head full of whispers, recruited to run errands for a grinning troublemaker. Nerves fray but the legs are quick.

feats.scene: Assesa swings a fire extinguisher at a locked door until the hinge gives.
Assesa takes a tackle from two orderlies and keeps shouting.

name: Rnmeosa
summary: Rnmeosa is a determined newspaper columnist chasing one big story about a secret neighborhood of storybook exiles. Curiosity leads to a bad night in a damp cellar.

feats.scene: Rnmeosa slams a notebook against a desk in frustration hard enough to split the spine.
Rnmeosa wakes after a drugged fall onto a stone floor.

name: Lacarnt
summary: Lacarnt is a soft-spoken lecturer on the mind who writes late into the night. Chalk dust, strong tea and a good memory for faces fill the days.

feats.scene: Lacarnt shoves a heavy lecture-hall door open against the wind.
Lacarnt trips on a staircase and tumbles to the landing, unhurt.

name: Orerontan
summary: Orerontan is a cocky newsboy who drives a rattling kit-built wagon and runs with a pack of friends. Fast tongue, loyal heart and a taste for messy adventure.

feats.scene: Orerontan rams the wagon's bumper through a cardboard barricade.
Orerontan is thrown from the wagon seat into a hedge and bounces right up.

name: Antaes
summary: Antaes is a sour tycoon who dares students to finish five impossible chores or lose their school. Money and spite are the only weapons, and neither works for long.

feats.scene: Antaes bangs a cane on a marble floor with a dramatic crack.
Antaes collapses in a puddle after losing the bet and walks it off.

name: Arorist
summary: Arorist is a gruff drill sergeant who barks cadence at dawn and rarely sleeps. A battered helmet and a thick notebook of rules go everywhere.

feats.scene: Arorist throws a duffel bag across a barracks into the far wall.
Arorist keeps marching after a long forced trek in pouring rain.

name: Nuiarirn
summary: Nuiarirn is a cheerful rocket pilot from a future where neighboring worlds all teem with life. A wrist radio doubles as a tiny flame-thrower for emergencies.

feats.scene: Nuiarirn fires the wrist radio's flame to melt a jammed airlock seal.
Nuiarirn survives a hard rocket landing strapped into the cockpit seat.

name: Ceollieo
summary: Ceollieo is a clever orphan raised in a domed asteroid school who rose to command a patrol flight. Tinkering since childhood and a gift for impressions come in handy on missions.

feats.scene: Ceollieo rewires a shuttle thruster to blast through a rock blockade.
Ceollieo rides out a decompression jolt inside a patched helmet.

name: Nuseorvos
summary: Nuseorvos is a minor space hero in a gaudy jumpsuit who relies on a trusty ray pistol. Fame is thin, but the grin is constant.

feats.scene: Nuseorvos fires the ray pistol and scorches a metal crate into slag.
Nuseorvos is flung into a bulkhead by a panicking robot.

name: Teoroli
summary: Teoroli is a scruffy frontier kid with a glowing secret: a flood of atomic power turns the boy into the mightiest being around. A bright flash announces every change.

feats.scene: Teoroli flares into a blazing form and flattens a rustler's fort with one blast.
Teoroli stands in the middle of a collapsing mine without a bruise.
Teoroli sprints across the plain and overtakes a runaway train.

name: Revalle
summary: Revalle is a hot-headed gunslinger who fights alongside a lookalike brother and carries a broken nose as a souvenir. Pistols come out before words do.

feats.scene: Revalle fires two pistols together and shreds a wooden door.
Revalle takes a kick to the face and keeps firing.

name: Rnuni
summary: Rnuni is a respected physician who appears in a hero's fevered visions, first as a pale figure and later as a warm voice urging him toward the light. Memory is the only place he lives now.

feats.scene: Rnuni lays a steady hand on a trembling shoulder in a vision.
Rnuni fades and returns unchanged through a swirl of toxic haze.

name: Naulesnum
summary: Naulesnum is a dapper physician and wealthy philanthropist of the bright, campy kind. Fine suits and polite manners hide a worried parent.

feats.scene: Naulesnum swings a cane at a pickpocket in a theater lobby.
Naulesnum stumbles on the grand staircase and brushes off the dust.

name: Renansti
summary: Renansti is a wealthy father who takes his family to an evening show and tries to shield them from a robber. A gaslit alley and a single gunshot end the night.

feats.scene: Renansti steps between a robber and his spouse and shoves the gun arm aside.
Renansti keeps his feet after a hard blow to the jaw.

name: Lencecol
summary: Lencecol is a dignified husband and father in a story about a tycoon's last whispered word. A single sled and a single mugger tie the saga together.

feats.scene: Lencecol raises a fist against an armed mugger in a drizzle.
Lencecol is knocked flat onto wet cobblestones.

name: Tilisan
summary: Tilisan is a generous surgeon and company head who whispers courage to his child in a dark alley. Wisdom about getting back up is his lasting gift.

feats.scene: Tilisan lunges at an armed mugger to cover his family.
Tilisan takes a heavy shove into a brick wall and straightens up.

name: Elsiu
summary: Elsiu is a weary husband in an odd timeline where one terrible night hands his orphaned son a glowing ring. A stoic man, he is seen only in the last moments.

feats.scene: Elsiu pulls his spouse behind him with a sudden tug.
Elsiu staggers into a lamp post and holds on.

name: Cetelse
summary: Cetelse is a once-wild doctor who returns as a masked, grim night-watcher in a darker world, trying to atone for a reckless youth. A cape, a growl and old surgical hands do the work.

feats.scene: Cetelse drives a gloved fist through a wooden crate to reach a hostage.
Cetelse takes a bone-shaking beating from three thugs and rises.

name: Rnneocis
summary: Rnneocis is a veteran field surgeon in a smoky, gas-lit city of old carriages. A friendship soured by jealousy leads to a hired knife in the dark.

feats.scene: Rnneocis shoves a carriage door shut against a pursuer.
Rnneocis falls from a carriage step onto packed earth.

name: Varias
summary: Varias is an aging doctor in a grim future city, remembered only for a night outside a theater. A reach for a robber's weapon is his final act.

feats.scene: Varias grapples a robber's wrist hard enough to twist the pistol aside.
Varias is slammed against a theater wall and stays upright a moment longer.

name: Rnoraca
summary: Rnoraca is a gentle city father from a bright, old-fashioned era who leaves a cinema with his family into an ordinary tragedy. His memory fuels a son's crusade.

feats.scene: Rnoraca pushes his child behind a lamp post.
Rnoraca is shoved to the ground and slowly stands.

name: Veoiu
summary: Veoiu is a ruthless, grief-torn vigilante who beats criminals across many worlds and keeps a drink in a hidden flask. Rage at an unbearable loss drives a bloody mission.

feats.scene: Veoiu hammers a gang boss through a rotten wooden table with bare fists.
Veoiu is thrown down a stairwell by three fighters and walks on.

name: Tesninre
summary: Tesninre is a well-off resident murdered before his child's eyes, though a prankster later insists the whole memory was planted. The truth stays muddled in a funhouse of lies.

feats.scene: Tesninre swats a persistent mosquito from a cinema seat.
Tesninre stumbles over a curb during a night walk.

name: Auaunes
summary: Auaunes is a revered physician, philanthropist and founder of a charitable fund, raised by a stern father and remembered by a whole extended family. A single act of mercy in a dark street ends his story.

feats.scene: Auaunes hauls a stretcher cart across a crowded emergency ward.
Auaunes works a thirty-hour surgery shift without a pause.

name: Erecolam
summary: Erecolam is a white-haired swordsman in a revolutionary capital who serves a council of fear and carries a keen blade. Law and terror blur at the end of the day.

feats.scene: Erecolam cleaves a hardwood table in half with a single stroke.
Erecolam parries a dozen blows in a crowded square and stays on his feet.

name: Corteme
summary: Corteme is a blond teen in a distant future who dons a bright suit and continues a family fight against alien invaders. Courage is inherited, and so is the stubbornness.

feats.scene: Corteme drives a boosted kick into a hostile drone's casing.
Corteme survives a long fall in an armored suit and rolls to his feet.

name: Neoreser
summary: Neoreser is a jittery, bumbling doctor in a mirror world who bungles operations and drains the family fortune on legal fees. Resentful children plot an ugly end in an alley.

feats.scene: Neoreser throws a surgical tray in a panic and dents a cabinet.
Neoreser is shoved against a trash bin and wheezes back up.

name: Risoirn
summary: Risoirn is a quick-tempered but big-hearted lawwoman of a quirky rural town who swaps curse words for silly euphemisms. A baton with a hidden electric jolt keeps rowdy neighbors in line.

feats.scene: Risoirn jabs the charged baton into a brawler and drops him cold.
Risoirn takes a thrown chair across the shoulder and keeps arresting.

name: Seoaul
summary: Seoaul is a green-skinned, thorny child of a laboratory garden raised by a protective plant-loving guardian. Gentle by nature, but a touch can be dangerous.

feats.scene: Seoaul rakes claws through a steel fence and shreds it.
Seoaul is hit by a falling beam in a greenhouse and rises unhurt.

name: Elnita
summary: Elnita is a masked, nervy menace who stalks winged heroes from the shadows. Little is known beyond a name that rattles the nerves.

feats.scene: Elnita hurls a brick through a skylight from a rooftop.
