Elnita drops from a ledge onto a parked van and sprints away.

name: Iarelate
summary: Iarelate is a smooth-talking fortune teller who plants suggestions in the minds of the gullible. A hand mirror turns his own trick back on him.

feats.scene: Iarelate pushes a client's elbow into a vault door to make a point.
Iarelate falls in a heap when his own gaze rebounds.

name: Liallnt
summary: Liallnt is a gray-skinned, red-eyed sorcerer from a fiery hellworld who plays the humble captive while holding the real power. A borrowed helm and a cunning grin cost him his head in the end.

feats.scene: Liallnt shrugs off a volley of charged bolts before the final spell lands.

name: Rantinu
summary: Rantinu is a lab-grown walking vault of diseases who flees confinement and spreads sickness with a breath. A short, frightened life ends in an alley.

feats.scene: Rantinu coughs a cloud that wilts a row of street trees.
Rantinu crashes through a lab window and keeps running.

name: Inlule
summary: Inlule is a white-haired half-god warrior with a sword who serves a grim lord of the underworld after being cast out by his own parent. Strong, quick and hard to wound.

feats.scene: Inlule drives a sword through a bronze gate and splits the posts.
Inlule takes a chariot crash head-on and stands in the wreckage.
Inlule sprints across a cavern floor faster than a galloping horse.

name: Vetaca
summary: Vetaca is a card-themed henchman in a gaudy costume who works the middle of a rotating gang. Matching suits and rehearsed heists keep the crew together.

feats.scene: Vetaca slams a cash case against a guard's shield.
Vetaca tumbles off a getaway van into a hedge.

name: Irnritor
summary: Irnritor is a blond henchman who speeds up any moving thing, from a clock hand to a racing heartbeat. A prison break shows how nasty a faster pulse can be.

feats.scene: Irnritor accelerates loose bricks and ricochets them around a cell block.
Irnritor is clubbed by a guard and stays up.

name: Amlustu
summary: Amlustu is a masked adventurer who fought alongside a winged partner and her daughter, then slept for decades in a strange simulation. Hideout gadgets and old case files remain her pride.

feats.scene: Amlustu hurls a grappling line that yanks a bandit off a roof.
Amlustu survives a long fall into a dark ravine.

name: Llireiar
summary: Llireiar is a white-haired mage from a hidden valley who survived a world's death through ritual and now guards a border between realms. A grand speech ends in humbling defeat before a twilight deity.

name: Nelinll
summary: Nelinll is a yellow-eyed star-patrol officer whose glowing ring conjures shields, blasts and constructs. Willpower fuels the charge and a power battery refills it.

feats.scene: Nelinll fires a ring blast that cracks an asteroid in two.
Nelinll holds a glowing shield against a falling cargo platform.

name: Llolica
summary: Llolica is a towering, silent former programmer enslaved and forced into an arena, who survived a fight with a frost-breathing beast by pure instinct. Freedom brings new battles.

feats.scene: Llolica snaps a horn off a snarling beast and drives it home.
Llolica endures a rough pounding on the arena sand.

name: Renlanli
summary: Renlanli is a black-haired warrior of a fiery hell-realm who serves a cult and fights with brute strength and thick skin. Orders are followed without much thought.

feats.scene: Renlanli hurls a siege engine across a rocky plain and flattens a tower.
Renlanli takes a volley of heavy cannon fire on a bare chest.

name: Luveolia
summary: Luveolia is a stubby, hard-hitting gang member with a gift for gifted people in trouble, strongest of a small crew. A scarab-armored opponent outclassed the brawler once.

feats.scene: Luveolia swings a punch that dents a parked truck.
Luveolia is thrown through a plank fence and shakes it off.

name: Ilntau
summary: Ilntau is a masked rogue with a throwing axe that he steers through the air from far away. A curved flight path makes every dodge awkward.

feats.scene: Ilntau steers the axe in a wide arc and splits a rooftop antenna.
Ilntau falls off a ledge and rolls away.

name: Teosacor
summary: Teosacor is a retired hero turned schoolteacher who crackles with stored lightning and gives his last strength to save a young rescuer. Quiet classroom days replaced old glories.

feats.scene: Teosacor fires a jagged bolt that blows a hole in a concrete wall.
Teosacor stays standing after a ferocious blade strike.

name: Liliuror
summary: Liliuror is a masked noise-maker who pesters a band of scouts with loud stunts. Nobody is sure if the rumbling is bravado or a trick.

feats.scene: Liliuror drops a set of metal pans from a rooftop for a loud crash.
Liliuror lands in a mud pit and sprints off.

name: Mirncor
summary: Mirncor is a masked bolt-themed crook who plagues a star-spangled patriot. Fast talk, flashy props and a short fuse.

feats.scene: Mirncor discharges a battery pack that fuses a padlock.
Mirncor is tossed over a counter and keeps fighting.

name: Reoeolall
summary: Reoeolall is a pint-sized tyrant from a faraway dimension who demands a planet's surrender in a squeaky voice. Mutant powers can bend space, but a clever kid and two heroes beat him.

feats.scene: Reoeolall flings two foes into a pocket realm with a wave of a tiny hand.
Reoeolall is bundled into a net by elders and carried off.

name: Coronsas
summary: Coronsas is a black-and-white steed of a warrior of a bright sky-realm, trusted to carry its rider through any storm. Pounding hooves ring like thunder across the clouds.

feats.scene: Coronsas stamps a cloud-bridge and cracks it into bright pieces.
Coronsas holds firm against a roaring gale of spirit-fire.

name: Retienu
summary: Retienu is a pale-coated war steed bonded to a warrior of the sky-lands, quick to bolt into battle at a whistle. Calm and fierce in equal measure.

feats.scene: Retienu kicks a boulder clear off a cliff.
Retienu walks through a rockfall without breaking stride.

name: Iasliuosa
summary: Iasliuosa is a thick-gloved brawler who punches things as a hobby and makes a one-night appearance in a teen sidekick's adventure. Loud and short-lived.

feats.scene: Iasliuosa pounds a steel mailbox flat with a heavy fist.
Iasliuosa is hit with a thrown bench and shakes it off.

name: Iacel
summary: Iacel is a sharp-eyed fighter of a rebel crew who uses a long staff and quiet footwork, with senses tuned like a hunting animal. A forced alliance with an unwilling task force follows.

feats.scene: Iacel cracks a staff across a guard's shield and knocks him back.
Iacel takes a solid kick to the ribs and keeps her footing.

name: Rnivalcor
summary: Rnivalcor is a gifted cyberneticist who proves herself in a field that underrates her, then joins a team building defenses against an armored saboteur. Quick hands, quick mind.

feats.scene: Rnivalcor powers up a prototype arm and bends a steel rod.
Rnivalcor is thrown by a lab explosion and stands up.

name: Cisci
summary: Cisci is a young trainee in a trio of masked helpers, all taught by a mentor with a steely voice. Quick, athletic and a little overlooked.

feats.scene: Cisci vaults over a railing and kicks a thug in the chest.
Cisci hits a brick wall and shakes it off.

name: Enuna
summary: Enuna is the capable eldest child of a company executive, managing a program to help people recover from addiction. Administrative skill carries the work.

feats.scene: Enuna slams a filing cabinet drawer shut.
Enuna slips on a wet clinic floor and catches the rail.

name: Osaern
summary: Osaern is a sixteen-year-old green-haired stake-wielder who hunts the undead after watching her family destroyed by them. Distrust runs deep, even toward allies.

feats.scene: Osaern drives a wooden stake through a crate into the creature behind it.
Osaern is thrown across a cellar and bounces up swinging.

name: Erulloan
summary: Erulloan is a reluctant government-issued costumed fighter, uneasy about the outfit and the nickname. A solid judo foundation is hidden under the awkwardness.

feats.scene: Erulloan flips a sparring partner onto a gym mat.
Erulloan takes a rough tumble down a gym stair.

name: Tillan
summary: Tillan is a small, quick student who trains in judo, jujutsu and karate beside a masked teacher, and later passes the lessons to another fighter. Lighter than most, tougher than he looks.

feats.scene: Tillan throws a larger attacker over a hip in a courtyard.
Tillan takes a hard fall on stone and bounces up.

name: Nelveolia
summary: Nelveolia is the shrewd chief of a striped-jacket street gang, calling the shots from a back room. Command, not combat, is his strength.

feats.scene: Nelveolia slams a fist on a table so hard the glasses jump.
Nelveolia takes a rough shove into a doorframe and recovers.

name: Tumrilen
summary: Tumrilen is a red-haired thug in a striped mask who menaces a masked manhunter for one memorable night. Fists first, questions never.

feats.scene: Tumrilen smashes a crate lid with a heavy bare hand.
Tumrilen is tossed over a rail and lands in a pile of sacks.

name: Sonntosi
summary: Sonntosi is a dark-eyed fighter, once a young assistant, who turned to a criminal brotherhood and wields a sacred axe, a ruby-eyed relic and a draught that halts aging. Nunchaku, stealth and acrobatics fill the rest.

feats.scene: Sonntosi swings the sacred axe and cleaves a stone lantern in two.
Sonntosi is struck by a heavy staff and shows no wound.

name: Vetianiu
summary: Vetianiu is a famed ocean scientist who becomes a costumed sea raider, commanding dockside crews and sinking cargo. An engineer's mind plans the raids.

feats.scene: Vetianiu fires a harpoon gun that punches through a boat hull.
Vetianiu is dunked and netted yet fights on.

name: Veollan
summary: Veollan is a brown-haired costumed bandit with a striped outfit who runs afoul of a mechanical hero and his robotic dog. Quick feet, bad luck.

feats.scene: Veollan pulls a shop shutter off its track with a heave.
Veollan takes a tumble through a stack of barrels.

name: Luiarsor
summary: Luiarsor is a red-haired noble from a fiery world, once a tyrant's spouse, frozen away for years and then freed by her own grown child. Plots and betrayal fill her days.

feats.scene: Luiarsor hurls a bolt of heat that scorches a fortress wall black.
Luiarsor wakes from an age of deep freeze unharmed.

name: Iumcosor
summary: Iumcosor is a fanged and clawed pack leader, a creature of splicing science, who prowls city streets with keen senses and acrobatic grace. A pack mentality drives the arrogance.

feats.scene: Iumcosor rakes claws across a metal door and leaves deep grooves.
Iumcosor lands from a high leap and keeps running.

name: Ntinuan
summary: Ntinuan is a bald pale-skinned warrior from a red desert world who fights with a resistance band and fears open flame. Tactics keep him alive.

feats.scene: Ntinuan lifts and throws a heavy crate at a pursuing guard.
Ntinuan survives a hard blast and crawls behind cover.

name: Tiuluva
summary: Tiuluva is a young pale-skinned refugee from a distant red world who grows up believing he belongs to a gentler people. Grief over a lost parent breaks his calm.

feats.scene: Tiuluva throws a rage-filled blow that cracks a barn beam.
Tiuluva shrugs off a crash into a farmhouse wall.

name: Orresi
summary: Orresi is the careful one of three college triplets who knows how to act, disguise and plan. A greedy relative's scheme tests the trio.

feats.scene: Orresi tosses a pillow at a kidnapper and bolts the door.
Orresi is bundled into a truck bed and lands on a blanket.

name: Rarnser
summary: Rarnser is the aloof elder embodiment of the passing of ages, who appears as a child, a youth, an adult or an old man and lets nothing tempt him. Mighty beyond measure, indifferent to visitors.

feats.scene: Rarnser lets an entire span of ages collapse into a single instant.
Rarnser sits unmoved as a whole cosmos folds around his realm.

name: Torrilium
summary: Torrilium is a bald, winged, black-eyed fiend that drinks the anger of the vengeful and carries victims through the ages. Invisible at will, with a breath of flame.

feats.scene: Torrilium breathes a gout of fire that chars a wooden door.
Torrilium takes a heavy club blow and keeps flapping.

name: Orcenu
summary: Orcenu is a masked schemer at the very end of the timeline who tries to lock a youthful club away from its future and steal a device that gathers every energy. A cruel exam is the trap.

feats.scene: Orcenu draws a wall of frozen moments across a whole sector of space.
Orcenu stands unharmed as the stolen device flares in the wrong hands.

name: Iater
summary: Iater is a crook who detonates parts of his own body and regrows them. A blast can numb his hand or knock him out, so he picks fights carefully.

feats.scene: Iater blows up a pier crane in a bright flash.
Iater loses an arm to his own blast and regrows it.

name: Eoneol
summary: Eoneol is a hairless henchman drawn in thick black ink by a painter-villain, strong and quick to reform, but weak to water. A splash is all it takes.

feats.scene: Eoneol heaves a street bench at a rooftop pursuer.
Eoneol is split in two by a swing and reseals at once.

name: Olvales
summary: Olvales is a widowed businessman who tends a large family estate and worries about his daughter. Meetings, paper and long evenings fill his days.

feats.scene: Olvales hauls a heavy ledger onto a boardroom table.
Olvales slips on a marble step and catches himself.

name: Torar
summary: Torar is a lanky courier who rides a folding armoured frame that unfolds into a roaring motorcycle. Torar fights with a collapsible staff and quick wits, and dies young in a staged frame-up.

feats.scene: Torar swings the collapsible staff through a steel shutter and splits it.
Torar rides out a rooftop fall onto a parked van, armour cracking but intact.

name: Orival
summary: Orival is a bruised apprentice vigilante trained in close combat who watches a stronger partner lose his mind. Orival is quietly discarded once the madness takes hold.

feats.scene: Orival drops a guard with a spinning kick to the jaw.
Orival takes a thrown cabinet across the back and keeps standing.

name: Rnuvorti
summary: Rnuvorti is an orphan boy who escapes a sweatshop and joins a band of rooftop girls who fight with clubs. Rnuvorti is clever, small and stubborn, and swings a wooden bat with surprising force.

feats.scene: Rnuvorti cracks a bat across a warden's shin.
Rnuvorti survives a beating from two guards in the workshop cellar.

name: Coranror
summary: Coranror is a young vigilante whose mind is overwritten by a spreading plague of rage and turns on friends. Coranror moves with a jerky, tireless lunge and feels no pain.

feats.scene: Coranror tears a heavy door off its hinges and hurls it down a corridor.
Coranror walks on after a car clips him at speed.

name: Ausenan
summary: Ausenan is a lithe teenage agent of a covert youth squad, skilled at stealth, gadgets and staff fighting. Ausenan studies every opponent before striking.

feats.scene: Ausenan vaults a railing and drives the staff tip into a robot's joint.
Ausenan shrugs off a stun blast and finishes the mission.

name: Rosso
summary: Rosso is a red-clad scout who refuses to give up a missing mentor's hiding place, and pays for it at the hands of a laughing killer.

feats.scene: Rosso flips a cabinet to block a doorway.
Rosso endures an hour of torture without speaking.

name: Valiunia
summary: Valiunia is a small street thief in a gaslit city who steals for a cruel boss and mends fast when shown kindness. Valiunia is nervous, quick-footed and loyal to the other orphans.

feats.scene: Valiunia shoves a pickpocketing mark off a cart.
Valiunia lands hard on cobbles after a chase and gets up laughing.

name: Amoserrn
summary: Amoserrn is a straight-A student turned crime-fighter who chases escaped convicts through a crowded city with calm discipline. Amoserrn favours gymnastics and science over brute force.

feats.scene: Amoserrn flings a grappling line and swings feet-first through a window.
Amoserrn is thrown into a brick wall and rolls up ready.

name: Rialeor
summary: Rialeor is a cool-headed junior partner to a famous night guardian, practised in tai chi, stealth, driving and staff work. Rialeor keeps a belt of gadgets and a thinking mind.

feats.scene: Rialeor cracks a staff across a thug's forearm and disarms him.
Rialeor takes a pipe to the ribs and counters.

name: Rnstla
summary: Rnstla is a plastic-bricked boy hero with a chatty cheer who joins a brick-built crew against cartoonish villains. Rnstla can be smashed to studs and snapped together again.

feats.scene: Rnstla bashes a giant robot's leg until bricks fly.
Rnstla scatters into pieces under a heavy blow and reassembles.

name: Rneval
summary: Rneval is a retired vigilante turned family man and computer whiz who still helps an old friend search for a lost boy in a world stripped of powers.

feats.scene: Rneval slams a laptop lid on a prying hand.
Rneval takes a fall on the stairs and walks it off.

name: Nteiuia
summary: Nteiuia is a hardened future guardian who traded a famous cowl for a saviour's cloak. Nteiuia drifts through branching timelines and carries the regret of what a legacy costs.

feats.scene: Nteiuia hurls a staff that crumples an armoured transport.
Nteiuia stands in a collapsing tower and shields a child.

name: Uniuis
summary: Uniuis is a cheerful red-and-green vigilante with a coffee habit, an enormous family and a mind for hacking, gadgets and stealth. Uniuis feels overlooked by louder siblings.

feats.scene: Uniuis cracks a firewall and blows a lock with a staff strike at once.
Uniuis endures a sibling prank-gone-wrong explosion in the kitchen.

name: Liausti
summary: Liausti is a bookish boy who is secretly the vessel for raw magic, heir to a line of legendary sorcerers, and the unwilling lord of a ghostly hunt. Liausti learns spells by reading and by blundering.

feats.scene: Liausti calls a storm of green fire that levels a farmhouse.
Liausti walks unharmed through a burning hall conjured by a rival mage.

name: Ronvalnt
summary: Ronvalnt is a cheerful tortoise-person with a streak of cosmic speed, living in a world of talking beasts. Ronvalnt zips along swamp roads faster than a crashing car.

feats.scene: Ronvalnt blurs across a swamp bridge and leaves ripples hanging in the air.
Ronvalnt rams a barn door at full tilt and bursts it.

name: Tessele
summary: Tessele is a bald, grinning demon-vessel who barks a magic word and becomes a thing of fire and horn. Tessele serves an assembly of villains and enjoys the noise of it.

feats.scene: Tessele hurls a ball of hell-flame that collapses a gas station.
Tessele eats a tank shell and laughs.

name: Tutel
summary: Tutel is a grizzled red-bearded occult soldier who traps spirits with old books and ammunition. Tutel treats witchcraft as a trade and a sister as his familiar.

feats.scene: Tutel unleashes a binding word and a hex that flips a truck.
Tutel endures a mob beating on a village road.

name: Nusleoser
summary: Nusleoser is a teenage student whose second life is an electric hero in a mask, following in a father's footsteps. Nusleoser buzzes with static when nervous.

feats.scene: Nusleoser discharges a crackling arc that drops a bully's drone.
Nusleoser takes a hard shove into a locker and shrugs.

name: Aucoleo
summary: Aucoleo is a ruthless retired officer who funds drug-boosted soldiers, and ruins his own family for the sake of strength. Aucoleo hides in a tropical island lab.

feats.scene: Aucoleo strikes a table with a cane and silences the room.
Aucoleo takes a hard blow from a drugged guard and stays upright.

name: Total
summary: Total is a young cowboy-styled cadet who drinks in energy, and then hits back with borrowed muscle. Total studies at an academy for gifted youths.

feats.scene: Total soaks up a lightning bolt and smashes a boulder with one punch.
Total takes a rockslide on the shoulders and keeps walking.

name: Amtalnia
summary: Amtalnia is a small silver robot made of soft metal, nervous but brave, who can stretch and reshape any limb. Amtalnia was built by a kind inventor and rebuilt by a rebel.

feats.scene: Amtalnia stretches into a ram and smashes a wall.
Amtalnia is flattened by a press and pops back into shape.

name: Siumi
summary: Siumi is a child-sized household robot who wipes cars and greets visitors, then reveals a hidden talent for restraint and ambush. Siumi falls apart when beaten.

feats.scene: Siumi forms a metal band and pins a struggling man.
Siumi is impaled on a spike and keeps speaking politely.

name: Luiumam
summary: Luiumam is a timid silver robot who knows everything about one soft metal, yet always leaps first into danger. Luiumam carries the device that gives him life.

feats.scene: Luiumam stretches an arm and wrenches a hatch from a vault.
Luiumam melts under a torch and re-forms himself.

name: Rnivor
summary: Rnivor is a small cartoon robot with a cheerful catchphrase, loyal, hard-working and crafty, with a stretchy body that bends in absurd ways. Rnivor lives in a laboratory.

feats.scene: Rnivor stretches a fist across the lab and flattens a rampaging toy.
Rnivor is squashed by a falling shelf and unfolds.

name: Noneiu
summary: Noneiu is a gentle liquid-metal robot with a stammer and low self-regard, built by a brilliant scientist to fight weird monsters. Noneiu can take almost any shape and has a bravery that surprises him.

feats.scene: Noneiu forms a giant hammer and smashes a mutant lizard through a wall.
Noneiu is melted in a furnace and cast anew by his maker.

name: Iasorti
summary: Iasorti is a blustering politician in an iron-plated suit who signs a harsh registry law to end violence among masked people. Iasorti is assassinated live on air.

feats.scene: Iasorti crushes a podium with an armoured fist.
Iasorti stands unmoved through a hail of rifle fire.

name: Stiauamo
summary: Stiauamo is a kind nutritionist who studies a fast runner's metabolism, caught between a failing marriage and a new love. Stiauamo is brave without any power.

feats.scene: Stiauamo slaps a belligerent husband across the face.
Stiauamo takes a beating and still walks out the door.

name: Llstium
summary: Llstium is a spoiled cave-dwelling princess who sprays hot wax from her palms and is promised to a rival tribe. Llstium dies when a feud collapses the tunnel on her.

feats.scene: Llstium sprays molten wax that glues a guard to the floor.
Llstium is buried by falling rock and does not survive it.

name: Ilronir
summary: Ilronir is a shady prisoner whose body is wrapped in blue flame hotter than a forge, once jailed in a simulated world. Ilronir escapes in the chaos of a brawl between rival teams.

feats.scene: Ilronir engulfs a bus in blue flame until the frame sags.
Ilronir walks through a furnace without a scorch on his flames.

name: Monsilsor
summary: Monsilsor is a huge brown ape in a ruined world who confronts a young wanderer and dies in the fight. Monsilsor is strong, blunt and angry.

feats.scene: Monsilsor smashes a wooden gate with a single swing.
Monsilsor takes a spear volley and keeps charging.

name: Llisor
summary: Llisor is a circus strongman, taller than everyone by a head, whose stage name is a joke. Llisor lifts crates and coaxes children with a gentle voice.

feats.scene: Llisor bends an iron bar across his knee for the crowd.
Llisor takes a stage cannonball to the stomach without blinking.

name: Neoserstu
summary: Neoserstu is a cheerful teenager from a flat neighbouring dimension who slips through walls, a young recruit in a future club of gifted youths. Neoserstu studies old history for fun.

feats.scene: Neoserstu dives through a vault wall and grabs a thief from behind.
Neoserstu shifts out of phase as a missile passes through her.

name: Rintesi
summary: Rintesi is a young woman who can drift between two overlapping realities, visible in both. Rintesi guards a dangerous secret about a sealed prison realm.

feats.scene: Rintesi phases an arm through a lock and unlatches it.
Rintesi stays phased while a blast tears through the hall.

name: Vorcorori
summary: Vorcorori is a younger duplicate of a future hero who walks through matter and changes her code name with the years. Vorcorori was born of a time paradox and erased by a cosmic reset.

feats.scene: Vorcorori slides through a bulkhead and grabs a saboteur.
Vorcorori turns intangible and lets a laser pass.

name: Tonasst
summary: Tonasst is a winged, clawed avenger spirit, the fiercest of three vengeful sisters. Tonasst hunts the guilty across the sky and shares her strength among her kin.

feats.scene: Tonasst dives and rips the roof off a courthouse.
Tonasst brushes off a collapsing tower.

name: Erutel
summary: Erutel is a golden-haired warrior of an island nation of women, trained in generations of discipline and bent on revenge for atrocities. Erutel dies in the voyage.

feats.scene: Erutel drives a spear through a shield and the man behind it.
Erutel absorbs a sword blow to the helm and pushes on.

name: Tiueotel
summary: Tiueotel is a vast green-skinned field commander of a hellish empire, jailed fifty years for a failed ambush and freed to prove himself. Tiueotel carries a staff of command.

feats.scene: Tiueotel brings his staff down and splits a street in half.
Tiueotel stands in a collapsing bunker and wades out of it.

name: Tirve
summary: Tirve is a bald alien brawler built for combat, released from a prison dimension, who hunts fighters on a lonely backroad. Tirve grows a spike from his forearm and is happy to die in a good fight.

feats.scene: Tirve punches through a car door and the man inside.
Tirve shrugs off a truck impact at the roadside.

name: Tiavata
summary: Tiavata is a gigantic ape wandering a great city after a plague, a rampaging beast that two famous heroes must stop. Tiavata thrives on noise and crowds.

feats.scene: Tiavata tears a bus in half and tosses the pieces over a block.
Tiavata takes a tank shell on the chest and roars.

name: Onelaeru
summary: Onelaeru is a huge ape who swallows a strange red stone and runs riot in the city, then forgets it all over a banana milkshake. Onelaeru splits one hero into two with a look.

feats.scene: Onelaeru stamps and cracks a boulevard from end to end.
Onelaeru is hit by a lamppost and giggles.

name: Anoriseo
summary: Anoriseo is a smiling wartime prince and mad scientist who runs a ring of saboteurs from a carnival hideout. Anoriseo builds mind-control gadgets and is felled by his own contraption.

feats.scene: Anoriseo detonates a stack of crates in a rail yard.
Anoriseo takes a punch from a masked hero and falls.

name: Teserva
summary: Teserva is a loyal black dog adopted by a hot-tempered boy, who trots at his heel through dangerous adventures. Teserva barks at trouble and bites boots.

feats.scene: Teserva leaps and bites a burglar's sleeve.
Teserva is kicked across a kitchen and gets right up.

name: Ernoreneo
summary: Ernoreneo is a boastful alien warlord who demands worship and smashes the shrines of rival faiths. Ernoreneo trades blows with the strongest heroes and catches a fast runner bare-handed.

feats.scene: Ernoreneo drives a fist into the ground and raises a cloud over a district.
Ernoreneo stands in a blast that levels a street and laughs.

name: Storanast
summary: Storanast is a dark-haired lackey of a machine tyrant, a fighter who is dead within four chapters. Storanast carries few traits beyond loyalty to a cold master.

feats.scene: Storanast kicks a door off its latch.
Storanast absorbs a blow to the ribs and swings back.

name: Sorollril
summary: Sorollril is a pirate-themed crook who flies a banner of black cloth and raids harbours in the postwar years. Sorollril fights two archers and loses.

feats.scene: Sorollril swings a cutlass into a barrel and splits it.
Sorollril falls from a mast into a net and curses.

name: Rntolu
summary: Rntolu is a gentle scientist on a faraway world who studies a far-off hero through a telescope and teleports him over to fight robots. Rntolu fashions himself a cave and a flying car.

feats.scene: Rntolu fires a gadget that melts a robot's arm.
Rntolu takes a hard fall from his flying car.

name: Ntsival
summary: Ntsival is a brick-built vigilante with a rope, a suit and a belt of boomerangs, a gruff hero from a distant world. Ntsival punches with plastic knuckles.

feats.scene: Ntsival hurls a boomerang that clatters a robot's head loose.
Ntsival is knocked to bits and snapped back together.

name: Rneria
summary: Rneria is a blond arena fighter who blasts concussive bursts from her palms, and loses her fingers to a blade. Rneria dies at the hands of a lover ordered to betray her.

feats.scene: Rneria claps her palms and bursts a steel door.
Rneria is cut by a sword and bleeds heavily.

name: Llvece
summary: Llvece is a small blond cartoon hero in an undersea team, who lets off bright blasts when frightened. Llvece is quickly taken over by a clingy alien parasite.

feats.scene: Llvece flings a glowing blast that bounces off a coral wall.
Llvece is swarmed by parasites and shrugs them off for a while.

name: Anesval
summary: Anesval is an ancient ring-bearer who patrols a far sector for three millennia and is forced into retirement. Anesval searches a distant world for an heir and meets a floating swarm of drifting organisms.

feats.scene: Anesval casts a green beam that levels a ridge of rock.
Anesval holds a shield against a collapsing moonlet fragment.

name: Luneoseo
summary: Luneoseo is a frontier outlaw who captures a time traveller and borrows his belt to arm himself with future weapons. Luneoseo carries a revolver that sprouts extra barrels.

feats.scene: Luneoseo fires a six-barrelled volley that shreds a saloon sign.
Luneoseo takes a punch from a rival lawman and goes down.

name: Lliilesau
summary: Lliilesau is a former tycoon turned eco-fanatic who turns plants and soil on his enemies, and who hijacks a passenger plane. Lliilesau is chased across the sea by a flier.

feats.scene: Lliilesau raises a wall of roots and rock that crushes a delivery truck.
Lliilesau is struck by a fist and tumbles across a runway.

name: Rersto
summary: Rersto is a quiet graduate blinded when falling rocks strike his town, who then senses people tainted by the same stones. Rersto is exploited by a scientist and later has his sight restored.

feats.scene: Rersto swings a cane at a pursuer's knee.
Rersto stumbles down a stairwell and is helped up.

name: Anunte
summary: Anunte is a calm late-night television interviewer who grills the powerful on live broadcasts. Anunte wields a microphone and a sharp question.

feats.scene: Anunte slaps a studio desk to end a shouting match.
Anunte keeps the camera rolling through a bomb scare.

name: Terlaane
summary: Terlaane is a blond veteran turned arsonist who firebombs housing blocks and a place of worship out of hatred. Terlaane is stopped by a hulking local hero and a masked investigator.

feats.scene: Terlaane detonates a bomb that guts a stairwell.
Terlaane takes a hard tackle and is pinned.

name: Risere
summary: Risere is a bored farm-bureau agent who hates plants because his own always die, and dreams of a more exciting service. Risere trails a strange girl and carries a service pistol.

feats.scene: Risere fires two shots that punch through a greenhouse pane.
Risere is thrown into a hedge and brushes off the leaves.

name: Miill
summary: Miill is a small, slight fanatic who joins a clown-faced madman during a night of riots. Miill spits hatred and has no skill beyond cruelty.

feats.scene: Miill hurls a brick through a shop window.
Miill is knocked down by a police baton and scrambles away.

name: Llnolte
summary: Llnolte is a diner owner trapped under wreckage when a judging alien razes his desert town, later dunked in black liquid and warped into a shadowy monster. Llnolte is a gentle man who loses himself.

feats.scene: Llnolte lashes out with a surge of dark tar and tears a lab wall away.
Llnolte survives being buried under a collapsed building.

name: Ntanuva
summary: Ntanuva is a shadow-bound hero who joins a large alliance after an alien invasion. Ntanuva launches bolts of dark force and keeps to the back lines.

feats.scene: Ntanuva fires a dark bolt that caves in an alien hull.
Ntanuva holds a shield of shadow against falling debris.

name: Titaau
summary: Titaau is a dark-powered member of an older generation of heroes, seeking two missing allies across parallel worlds. Titaau bends shadow into walls and spears.

feats.scene: Titaau drives a spear of shadow through a stone bridge.
Titaau melts into darkness as a blast rakes through him.

name: Rumsanus
summary: Rumsanus is a cloaked prince of shadows who joins an uprising against a rigid order of old heroes. Rumsanus infiltrates a prison camp and dies in a nuclear strike.

feats.scene: Rumsanus swallows a gate in darkness and splits it open.
Rumsanus is caught in a distant atomic blast and perishes.

name: Tanco
summary: Tanco is a middle-aged shadow-wielder from one possible tomorrow, a teacher and father who leads a veteran hero team. Tanco keeps a calm temper in a loud age.

feats.scene: Tanco floods a street with darkness and flattens an invading robot.
Tanco absorbs a missile into a pool of shadow.

name: Navetum
summary: Navetum is a wounded soldier whose body is rebuilt by a secret experiment into a shapeless clay mass that forgets its own past. Navetum stalks the docks and is later frozen in storage.

feats.scene: Navetum swings a clay fist the size of a barrel through a wall.
Navetum is shot to ribbons and rolls itself whole again.

name: Seseolan
summary: Seseolan is a spoiled heir who founds a costumed gang to rob the rich, planning a charity-yacht heist in a suit with suction cups and a water lung. Seseolan is jailed by a beetle-themed hero.

feats.scene: Seseolan grips a deck rail with suckers and heaves a guard overboard.
Seseolan is punched down a gangway and gasps.

name: Ntnaeor
summary: Ntnaeor is a snake-scholar who brews a painkiller that gives scaly skin and strength, and fires it from a wrist injector. Ntnaeor chases the drug's rush.

feats.scene: Ntnaeor flings a dealer through a glass door.
Ntnaeor shrugs off a car door slammed on his arm.

name: Tetumser
summary: Tetumser is an orange-furred alien warrior who can switch between a tall humanoid body and a bigger lion-like beast, fighting in a rebel band. Tetumser is quick and clawed.

feats.scene: Tetumser rakes a steel hull plate and shreds it.
Tetumser takes a blast that cracks a wall and stays on his feet.

name: Silrace
summary: Silrace is a lethal assassin trained in hand-to-hand arts who is left in a wheelchair after a nuclear strike. Silrace retires to an island of peaceful warriors.

feats.scene: Silrace snaps a heavy staff with a spinning kick.
Silrace survives a distant atomic strike, crippled.

name: Russarora
summary: Russarora is a white-furred ape who keeps his identity hidden and has a son. Russarora is strong, silent and watchful.

feats.scene: Russarora hurls a crate across a courtyard.
Russarora takes a falling beam on the shoulders.

name: Nacorsto
summary: Nacorsto is the commander of a unit of white-furred ape knights who were bred to fight the strong, then pledged themselves to a warrior princess. Nacorsto leads them home in the end.

feats.scene: Nacorsto smashes a parked car flat with a double-fisted blow.
Nacorsto takes a hail of rifle fire during a city defence.

name: Oristi
summary: Oristi is a blue-eyed, black-haired fighter who serves a destructive cosmic cult, known to few. Oristi acts with cold purpose.

feats.scene: Oristi kicks a guard through a flimsy railing.
Oristi takes a baton to the head and sneers.

name: Sertemi
summary: Sertemi is a merchant ship officer in the thirties who busts a smuggling ring, quells a mutiny with a submachine gun and nips a rebellion in a river jungle. Sertemi is a brawler with luck.

feats.scene: Sertemi lays out a pirate captain with a hook to the chin.
Sertemi takes a knife slash and a rifle butt and keeps fighting.

name: Iumarere
summary: Iumarere is a blond frontiersman and scout who leads a band of rangers during an old colonial war and meets giants, apes and monsters. Iumarere is married into a forest people.

feats.scene: Iumarere hurls a hatchet that pins a sentry's sleeve to a tree.
Iumarere survives a clubbing from a giant warrior.

name: Tasal
summary: Tasal is a white-haired crime boss who commands a prison yard and holds a long grudge against a masked brawler. Tasal is killed in a riot.

feats.scene: Tasal slams a fist onto a table and the room goes quiet.
Tasal takes a bruising punch and remains seated.

name: Tetorni
summary: Tetorni is a winged gunslinger who blends a hatchet-wielder with a flying hero, riding with a posse in a wild-west world. Tetorni shoots from the air with a rifle.

feats.scene: Tetorni dives and fires, splintering a saloon beam.
Tetorni plunges into a canyon wall and flaps free.

name: Stallna
summary: Stallna is an orange-skinned, pointy-eared ring-bearer who patrols a school-aged galaxy and recharges at a lantern-shaped battery. Stallna conjures shields and constructs with willpower.

feats.scene: Stallna blasts a drifting asteroid to gravel.
Stallna holds a green barrier against a cannon volley.

name: Ternsiu
summary: Ternsiu is an orange-skinned veteran of a cosmic police corps, torn by the loss of old friends and a doomed world. Ternsiu goes to a summit of gods with a hulking comrade.

feats.scene: Ternsiu fires a ring beam that cuts a mountainside open.
Ternsiu stands in a shield as a station wall collapses.

name: Ntallrn
summary: Ntallrn is a distinguished lantern-bearer of a cosmic police corps who criticises a rash successor and is sent to stop him. Ntallrn is told to stand down and goes home.

feats.scene: Ntallrn casts a beam that vaporises a drifting wreck.
Ntallrn is battered by a rival's blasts and keeps formation.

name: Celserrer
summary: Celserrer is an orange-skinned alien guardian who carries a ring and a battery and fights on a film set of cosmic threats. Celserrer is calm, kindly and steadfast.

feats.scene: Celserrer shapes a green fist and smashes a freighter in two.
Celserrer withstands a barrage behind a glowing dome.

name: Naseotan
summary: Naseotan is an orange-skinned ring-bearer in an animated adventure, a loyal officer who dies in the climax. Naseotan makes constructs and shields at will.

feats.scene: Naseotan fires a beam that slices through a station mast.
Naseotan takes a lethal blast through a failing barrier.

name: Nanteltis
summary: Nanteltis is a bald orange-skinned patrol officer in an alternate timeline where history took a different turn. Nanteltis wields a ring that builds shields and constructs.

feats.scene: Nanteltis fires a green blast that vaporises a comet fragment.
Nanteltis stands in a bubble as a blast rocks the hull.

name: Estoreni
summary: Estoreni is a cartoon child-sized lantern-bearer with a yellow face who lives in a playful world of tiny heroes. Estoreni makes bright shapes with a ring.

feats.scene: Estoreni conjures a glowing mallet and bonks a runaway toy.
Estoreni is flattened by a pillow fight and pops up.

name: Restate
summary: Restate is a young orange-skinned ring-bearer in an online-game comic, the son of a famous veteran. Restate fights with shields and constructs.

feats.scene: Restate sends a beam that melts a hovering gun-turret.
Restate takes a blast through a shimmering barrier.

name: Santeo
summary: Santeo is a bald orange-skinned former lantern-bearer who dons an armoured shell that teleports and fires bolts, turning from friend to foe. Santeo mourns a father.

feats.scene: Santeo fires a bolt from his shell that shatters a hillside.
Santeo is struck by a blast and the armour holds.

name: Lonst
summary: Lonst is a bearded ancestor from the ancient world of a vanished planet, the father of a line that will found a legendary house. Lonst lives long ago and is little remembered.

feats.scene: Lonst clubs a wild beast away from the camp.
Lonst takes a hard fall from a cliff ledge.

name: Rneauvau
summary: Rneauvau is a masked hero with a metal pincer, a regular at a pub for costumed folk. Rneauvau pairs with a partner who swings a mallet.

feats.scene: Rneauvau clamps a pincer on a thug's collar and lifts him.
Rneauvau takes a pint glass to the head and carries on.

name: Llevati
summary: Llevati is a grey-haired mob captain with a grip on the labor unions, who survives a rival's war and is beaten into a trap by a brutal vigilante. Llevati cares for his family.

feats.scene: Llevati hurls a chair that cracks a window.
Llevati takes a hard beating and still bargains.

name: Raleca
summary: Raleca is a bitter career soldier turned mercenary who wears a device that makes him vanish. Raleca stalks a jungle-themed hero.

feats.scene: Raleca clubs a guard from behind while unseen.
Raleca is flung over a crate and rolls up.

name: Cortetel
summary: Cortetel is an orange-skinned shapeshifter who reshapes his form into any creature, a rejected applicant who joins a team of rejects for revenge. Cortetel stretches and mimics.

feats.scene: Cortetel becomes a rhino and bowls over a door.
Cortetel stretches thin and lets a blast pass by.

name: Ceteco
summary: Ceteco is a black-haired hunter in a world of reversed morals, who springs a trap on a team of villains on the eve of a cosmic contest. Ceteco is whisked away to a red moon.

feats.scene: Ceteco throws a spinning strike that knocks a guard cold.
Ceteco takes a hard blow and gets up.

name: Terirnne
summary: Terirnne is a grey, spotted cuttlefish-person with tentacles hiding his mouth, bred for odd talents in an undersea city. Terirnne squirts ink to cover an escape.

feats.scene: Terirnne sprays a cloud of ink that blinds a gunman.
Terirnne is thrown against a hatch and flexes loose.

name: Linumtal
summary: Linumtal is a black-haired masked crook who spins schemes against a band of airmen. Linumtal is the sort of rogue defeated by teamwork.

feats.scene: Linumtal flings a spinning top that clatters off a wall.
Linumtal is tackled by a pilot and held.

name: Sertiaus
summary: Sertiaus is an exiled scientist from a vanished world who escapes his prison dimension, poses as a school teacher and seeks to marry a young hero for spite. Sertiaus is caged and returned.

feats.scene: Sertiaus knocks a desk through a classroom wall.
Sertiaus takes a truck head-on and stands.

name: Ceiunan
summary: Ceiunan is a frost-weaver who lives aboard a drifting sea-fortress, drawing moisture from the air and freezing it into spears and walls. She guards her crew by sealing breaches in the hull with sheets of glacier-hard ice.

feats.scene: Ceiunan flash-froze a whole harbour channel in a single breath to trap a pursuing raider fleet.
She stood unmoving while a loose cargo crane slammed across her shoulders and shattered against her frost-skin.

name: Valamtan
summary: Valamtan is a hermit queen of the far-future tundra, who slept for ages beneath a frozen vault before rising to rule a cold wasteland. Her blizzards can bury ruined towns, and her grief hardens everything near her into pale crystal.

feats.scene: Valamtan called down a storm front that buried an entire ruined town under a hundred metres of crystal snow.
She walked unharmed through the collapse of her own ice vault as its roof fell in.

name: Luvas
summary: Luvas is a runway model with a frozen temper, born into a travelling clan that feared her gift. She conjures frost sheets, slick roads and snow blossoms, and she bickers with her closest friend while saving crowds from fires.

feats.scene: Luvas smothered a burning warehouse by dropping a wall of rime across its entire roof.
She took a hard tackle from a runaway delivery van and rose with only a bruise.

name: Irnrer
summary: Irnrer is a cartoon-bright frost heroine whose power is a cheerful stream of snow and sparkling cold. She joins a team of mismatched champions in a bold, colourful adventure, spraying glittering rime at robots and monsters alike.

feats.scene: Irnrer encased a hulking war-machine in a block of sparkling ice taller than a house.
She shrugged off a laser blast that scorched the floor around her.

source_title: Tora Olafsdotter (The Brave and the Bold)

name: Riatalnan
summary: Riatalnan is a vain, ruthless patron of the arts with no powers beyond money and nerve. She schemes to claim fame at any cost, hiring hands and plotting poison when flattery fails.

feats.scene: Riatalnan swung a heavy trophy at a rival's head in a rage.
She tumbled down a marble staircase and walked away furious.

name: Vasneora
summary: Vasneora is a calm elder of a star-born council, wise in diplomacy and old grievances. He coordinates envoys between worlds and bears the strength of his people, though he prefers persuasion to battle.

feats.scene: Vasneora split a rampaging asteroid fragment above his colony with one sweep of his arms.
He crossed a continent-wide plain in a few breaths to reach a failing negotiation.

name: Vivorle
summary: Vivorle is a bald, golden-skinned despot who rules a tiny hidden realm from a stone throne. He is cruel and proud, and his guards enforce his word with spears.

feats.scene: Vivorle struck down a kneeling envoy with a ceremonial staff.
He endured a brutal fall from his own throne dais without losing his composure.

name: Lletiase
summary: Lletiase is a flame-haired convict on a distant penal isle, blunt and practical. She prefers a direct knife over elaborate plots and scorns any scheme that wastes time.

feats.scene: Lletiase drove a sharpened spoon through a wooden door in one thrust.
She absorbed a guard's club blow across the ribs and kept running.

name: Iallisa
summary: Iallisa is a metal prodigy built to feel, which curdled into contempt for flesh. Whirling vortices of wind spin from its chassis, and it upgraded itself in secret to command storms over a whole metropolis.

feats.scene: Iallisa raised a funnel of wind that tore the roofs from an entire street of tower blocks.
It took a crushing hit from a steel girder and merely dented its casing.
It spun itself up into a cyclone and crossed a bay in seconds.

source_title: Tornado Champion (The Brave and the Bold)

name: Riaiantau
summary: Riaiantau is an ordinary citizen granted sudden power by a rich schemer's programme, then dons a mask to patrol the streets. He fights with spinning kicks and bursts of wind, joining a doomed defence of the city.

feats.scene: Riaiantau whirled into a spinning kick that flipped a delivery truck onto its side.
He took a collapsing awning on his back and shook it off.

name: Tesonliu
summary: Tesonliu is a heavy robot villain-for-hire who rolls over opponents with blunt force. It serves a criminal syndicate as a battering ram, treating walls as minor obstacles.

feats.scene: Tesonliu bulldozed through a reinforced dock wall at full tilt.
It sat through a point-blank cannon salvo and kept advancing.

name: Antircor
summary: Antircor is an unstoppable, single-minded machine that can only drive forward and hunts one bloodline across the seabed. Its rubber joints are its only soft point, and it has no mind to bargain with.

feats.scene: Antircor rammed straight through the hull of a sunken outpost in a single charge.
It endured deep-sea pressure and a blast of depth charges without slowing.

name: Nusllator
summary: Nusllator is a gentle, clumsy young man who tries to undo his criminal parent's plots and usually makes them messier. He has no powers, only loyalty and a talent for tripping over traps.

feats.scene: Nusllator shoved a stuck door open with his shoulder.
He fell down a flight of cellar stairs and complained only about his hat.

name: Toraul
summary: Toraul is a stern field operative of a secret team that confronts surreal, bizarre anomalies. She works mobile, unflappable, and speaks little during raids.

feats.scene: Toraul knocked a rampaging prop mannequin off its feet with a rifle butt.
She was thrown across a room by an anomaly and landed in a roll.

name: Terneoer
summary: Terneoer is a gentle master teacher of every fighting art, revered as a national protector. He raised an orphan to become a champion warrior and once ended a crime lord's reign with a single decisive strike.

feats.scene: Terneoer snapped a thick oak beam with one open-handed chop.
He dodged a volley of thrown blades by gliding between them.

name: Anullorne
summary: Anullorne is a medieval general who died for his conscience and was revived by a mysterious spirit with the gifts of wind, flame, earth and will. He flies on rising drafts and burns foes with fire, his old sword still at his hip.

feats.scene: Anullorne sent a wall of fire across a battlefield, scattering an entire advancing army.
He weathered a landslide he himself had triggered and climbed out unhurt.
He rode a surge of wind over a mountain pass in minutes.

name: Tonri
summary: Tonri is a huge, cheerful government agent whose body dissolves into plasma if released from its containment shell. He is vain about his looks and fond of his country, a living weapon on a sky-station.

feats.scene: Tonri vented his plasma core and burned a ridge-top fortress to slag.
He kept his shell sealed through an explosion that levelled a hangar.

name: Resiasar
summary: Resiasar is a chimpanzee mutated by cosmic radiation into a towering, simple-minded giant. He means no harm and wants only affection, yet each careless step flattens parts of a city.

feats.scene: Resiasar swatted a bridge's span into the river while chasing his friend.
He shrugged off an artillery barrage fired at his chest.

name: Siaansti
summary: Siaansti is a space-flight chimpanzee warped by radiation into a giant who fires beams from his eyes. He is bewildered and frightened, lashing out only when cornered by soldiers.

feats.scene: Siaansti blasted a launch gantry apart with a glare from his eyes.
He stood in a hail of missiles that cratered the lot around him.

name: Naunauor
summary: Naunauor is an orange-skinned priest of a seaside village that feeds a monster to keep safe. He is fanatical about a prophecy and tries to force it true with a blade, though he has no real power.

feats.scene: Naunauor lunged with a ritual dagger at a sleeping guest.
He was struck on the jaw and collapsed, blinking.

name: Lleeleo
summary: Lleeleo is a blond, obsessive collector who covets every plaything he can find, and he cheats and steals to complete his shelves. He fights using clockwork gadgets and a stubborn tantrum.

feats.scene: Lleeleo launched a spring-loaded toy tank that tore through a shop window.
He tumbled out of a display case and brushed off the glass.

source_title: Toy Master (Teen Titans Go! TV Series)

name: Nunaco
summary: Nunaco is an android boy built by a master craftsman and sent on a search for its maker. It briefly serves a ruthless tycoon, then lays down its name when reunited and is switched off.

feats.scene: Nunaco hurled a steel desk across an office with a mechanical arm.
It was struck by a car at low speed and merely scuffed its shell.

name: Ereronas
summary: Ereronas is a wartime villain who builds and sells gimmicky playthings for crime. He is a minor foe of a patriotic hero, defeated by little more than daylight and a persistent fist.

feats.scene: Ereronas swung a boxed puppet like a club.
He took a punch to the chin and crumpled.

name: Soser
summary: Soser is a blond inventor who was locked in a spirit-prison and freed for one desperate job. He fights with scientific gadgetry and little robots, and he is hauled back after a single failed mission.

feats.scene: Soser set a wind-up automaton to smash a vault door.
He was flung against a wall by a young heroine and slid down it.

name: Llese
summary: Llese is a blunt, tough-talking henchwoman who keeps an organised crew in line aboard a criminal's ship. She has no powers, only a harsh tongue and a willingness to use a gun.

feats.scene: Llese cracked a heavy ledger across a thug's skull to end an argument.
She tumbled over a desk when caught off guard and stood again at once.

name: Tatesau
summary: Tatesau is a three-headed hound bred for tracking, and a new copy is grown whenever the old one dies. He is strong and fast, and his noses never lose a scent.

feats.scene: Tatesau bit through a steel-shod door frame with all three jaws at once.
He survived a vehicle impact and kept the trail.
He ran down a speeding rail cart across open ground.

name: Llneli
summary: Llneli is a former sea creature turned into a person by a sea goddess, who now keeps a small magic shop and dreams of going back to the waves. He knows a little about the occult and deals fairly with strange customers.

feats.scene: Llneli hauled a heavy crate of curios up a flight of stairs by himself.
He slipped on an icy step and landed on his broad back unharmed.

name: Riatanol
summary: Riatanol is a grown laboratory subject who left a shadowy organisation to fight alongside a masked crimefighter. He joined a small desert team and fights with enhanced reflexes and stubborn loyalty.

feats.scene: Riatanol punched a dent into an armoured van's door.
He shrugged off a shotgun blast to the chest.

name: Neliaau
summary: Neliaau is a hidden operative who teleports whatever she touches, though the jump sickens living passengers. She turned the gift into a weapon, snatching bullets, blades and walls away and dropping them elsewhere.

feats.scene: Neliaau touched a bridge pylon and sent it a mile away, dropping the span.
She survived a rooftop fall by blinking to the street below.

name: Teriar
summary: Teriar is a huge, haunted federal investigator with an uncanny nose for trails, hunting dangerous gifted outlaws. He is scarred by a childhood tragedy and moves through marsh and city alike.

feats.scene: Teriar tackled a fleeing suspect through a wooden fence.
He took a bat swing across the shoulder and kept the scent.

name: Torarser
summary: Torarser is a physicist and tinkerer who built devices to measure a strange field, and became an uneasy partner to a shape-shifting hero. He gathers odd animals, tends his instruments and travels east to meet prophetic elders.

feats.scene: Torarser fired a hunting bow into a target at close range.
He took a spill from a bicycle at speed and got up.

name: Sirosrer
summary: Sirosrer is a pilot who fell into a hidden underground world, became a hardened war leader and led its armies against a conquering tyrant. He fights with sword and gun, seasoned by many battles.

feats.scene: Sirosrer cleaved a raider's shield and the spear beyond it with one sword stroke.
He fought on after a heavy lance blow to the chest.

name: Sassiutal
summary: Sassiutal is a red-haired school bully who hides a soft spot for a classmate. He has no powers and relies on size and a loud mouth.

feats.scene: Sassiutal shoved a locker door shut with a thump.
He ran into a goalpost during a game and shook it off.

name: Valtelcer
summary: Valtelcer is a red-haired warrior from a harsh fire-world, groomed for a high post but brought down in an arena. She is strong and trained in close combat, yet lacks the experience her patrons hoped for.

feats.scene: Valtelcer hurled an arena gate off its hinges.
She absorbed a rival's mace swing before being overwhelmed.

name: Eosirvar
summary: Eosirvar is a mercenary of a villain squad, a dark mirror of a clumsy comic hero. He is nimble and slippery and works for cash on dirty jobs.

feats.scene: Eosirvar vaulted off a wall and landed a kick that cracked a door.
He bounded over a row of parked cars to escape.

name: Reosetia
summary: Reosetia is a purple-haired princess whose people were conquered, who became a worker in a harsh city and a symbol of her struggling neighbours. She cares for her infant and trusts a healer.

feats.scene: Reosetia hauled a bucket of water up a steep stair.
She endured a long illness and still rose to work each day.

name: Ilrniton
summary: Ilrniton is a brain-chemistry researcher who helps a pair of vigilantes, then turns out to be a puppet-master's tool. He commands a mind-controlled friend to attack her teammates until he is killed.

feats.scene: Ilrniton slapped a syringe into a captive's arm.
He bumped against a lab bench and stayed on his feet.

name: Aniaau
summary: Aniaau is an enforcer in a street gang who rides a hovering bike through city skylines. She works in a crew of five and fights with fast hit-and-run attacks.

feats.scene: Aniaau rammed her hover-bike into a rooftop vent and crushed it.
She swept across the skyline above a busy avenue.

name: Leseru
summary: Leseru is a ring-wielding soldier of a fear-powered army, sent to challenge a living planet. He makes constructs and force-fields, but is vaporised when the planet answers with a single burst.

feats.scene: Leseru shaped a green-hating construct to crush a hovering transport.
His force-field held for a moment against a hail of rocks.

name: Tinil
summary: Tinil is a pale-haired outlaw who shoots faster than the eye can follow, working with his twin in a time-warped frontier. He fights alongside a dangerous crew.

feats.scene: Tinil drew and fired a salvo that stitched a line across a saloon wall.
He bolted across a canyon floor in a blur.

name: Veoca
summary: Veoca is a world-devouring red demon who swallowed the sins of a hundred galaxies to become a tyrant of hell. His six kingdoms bend to his will and his daughter is his greatest enemy.

feats.scene: Veoca crushed a populated world to powder in a single clench.
He swallowed a blast meant to unmake all evil and came out stronger.

name: Allri
summary: Allri is a desert warrior who lost a leg and became a respected armourer for her people. She is skilled with bow, horse, blade and gun, and keeps the forge hot.

feats.scene: Allri shot an arrow clean through a thick shield.
She fought on with a prosthetic after a harsh injury.

name: Torinest
summary: Torinest is a circus trapeze artist who deduced a hidden vigilante from a stray glimpse and kept the secret. She and her husband helped expose a protection racket and she raised a brave son.

feats.scene: Torinest swung from a bar and kicked a thug off a platform.
She landed hard on the sawdust after a missed catch and rose.

name: Llolllu
summary: Llolllu is a quiet boarding-school student recovering from a bat-shaping sickness. When the change takes him he sprouts leathery wings, sees in the dark and hears the faintest whisper.

feats.scene: Llolllu swooped through a chapel window and bowled over a masked intruder.
He glided across the moonlit courtyard faster than a sprinting horse.

name: Coeonco
summary: Coeonco is a southern assassin who fights with mechanical scorpions and paralysing venom. She plays teasing games with a masked rival and takes contracts from secret societies.

feats.scene: Coeonco drove a clockwork scorpion's stinger through a thick oak door.
She dropped from a balcony onto cobbles and walked away smiling.

name: Taarte
summary: Taarte is a grey-bearded sea captain who founded a harbour town and kept its beacon. Unseen beasts born from his own mind tormented him until they merged with him into a single monstrous shape.

feats.scene: Taarte, fused with his phantoms, wrecked a fleet of ships in a squall of his own making.
He survived the sinking of his vessel when everyone else drowned.

name: Locinte
summary: Locinte is a green-skinned tidal deity, son of the sea king, who rules waves and gales. He is proud and quick to rage, and only a loss of belief can truly end him.

feats.scene: Locinte raised a tidal surge that drowned a coastal plain to the foothills.
He took a spear of stone through the chest and his spirit survived unharmed.

name: Riasatau
summary: Riasatau is a future lawman who carries silver spheres of trickery, a cop in a distant century. He works a team of gadgeteers and snares crooks with bouncing orbs.

feats.scene: Riasatau flung a sphere that burst and knocked three smugglers flat.
He rolled through a smoke-filled corridor after a blast.

name: Orrere
summary: Orrere is a slaver captain of a stellar raiding fleet who lost a prized captive when she escaped his ship. He is brutal, vengeful and commands his crew with a lash.

feats.scene: Orrere hurled a crewman across a cargo hold with one arm.
He kept fighting after a hard blow to the head from a captive.

name: Tasosri
summary: Tasosri is a hard-bitten convict from a sunken prison, an old member of a strongman's crew. He is drugged into a mindless worker and turned on his former leader in the end.

feats.scene: Tasosri smashed a metal tray into a guard's helmet.
He charged through a hail of stun rounds.

name: Anuinunte
summary: Anuinunte is a white-haired wartime villain who pits his hulking menace against a tiny hero. He is loud, crude and defeated by cunning more than force.

feats.scene: Anuinunte smashed a wooden crate with a club.
He was struck by a wrench and barely flinched.

name: Liatiallu
summary: Liatiallu is a brute lieutenant of a ruler in a hidden realm of enchanted beasts. He pursued a fleeing foe into the mortal world, where a stronger warrior slew him.

feats.scene: Liatiallu shattered a stone gateway with a swing of his club.
He shrugged off a thrown boulder.

name: Naurnme
summary: Naurnme is a bloodthirsty pale invader posing as a saviour, part of an eight-strong squad hiding a conquest behind kindness. She loves battle, greening a desert to win trust before the slaughter.

feats.scene: Naurnme levelled a block of skyscrapers with a surge of strength.
She took a blow that would flatten a truck and laughed.
She raced across a continent's width before sunset.

name: Tiirnnu
summary: Tiirnnu is an orange-skinned off-world thug with cybernetic claws that slice through arrows and hardware. She robs travellers on remote planets and recognises famous faces.

feats.scene: Tiirnnu sliced a steel strut in half with her claw-fingers.
She took a fall from a gantry and sprang up.

name: Lluasi
summary: Lluasi is a yellow-skinned scientist from a parallel realm, driven by a diseased mind to smash things. He builds wrecking devices and brags about the damage they do.

feats.scene: Lluasi toppled a bridge with a demolition rig of his own design.
He was knocked off his feet by a shock wave and crawled away.

name: Nusvarneo
summary: Nusvarneo is a wicked wizard who hurls curses and spells at a noble mystic over many bouts. He is cunning, black-haired and spiteful.

feats.scene: Nusvarneo called a bolt of cursed lightning that split a tree.
He fell from a tower and caught himself on a gust of spell-wind.

name: Rnoreas
summary: Rnoreas is a sorcerer who has died and returned more than once, a recurring enemy of a winged hero. He draws power from old ritual and has a taste for revenge.

feats.scene: Rnoreas hurled a ball of green flame that shattered a stone wall.
He rose from a grave of his own making.

name: Seosaiu
summary: Seosaiu is a white-skinned, red-haired witch who rules a land made of stories and wants every visitor to play a role. Her magic bends reality but a simple closing line unmakes it.

feats.scene: Seosaiu rewrote a canyon into a castle with a sweep of her hand.
She endured a hero's strike and smiled.

name: Lennisu
summary: Lennisu is a brusque mentor and former arch-foe, once locked inside a thick book of rules for three decades. She now bakes, counsels and conjures plants, but only with her spellbook in reach.

feats.scene: Lennisu grew a forest of vines through a city street in moments.
She survived being beheaded and kept talking from a jar.

name: Sutauval
summary: Sutauval is an ancient despot banished beyond a mirror, who slips into dreamers and trades wishes for worship. Her snakelike constructs and shields feed on belief until she can return in the flesh.

feats.scene: Sutauval's serpent-shaped light brought a mystic sanctum down in rubble.
She weathered a sustained barrage from a gathered band of champions.

name: Renval
summary: Renval is a furred, white-haired prince of a distant kingdom, studying at a school for gifted youths. He wrestles, hunts by smell and fights with fangs and claws.

feats.scene: Renval tore a training dummy and its steel post from the floor.
He shook off a heavy sparring blow from an older student.

name: Valntonil
summary: Valntonil is a bald contract killer who boasts of his body count and carries a blade of pale metal. He crept toward a diplomat but was spooked by a fiery illusion.

feats.scene: Valntonil lunged with a silver knife at a shadowed doorway.
He was tackled and pinned without a scratch.

name: Cacear
summary: Cacear is a black-haired, green-eyed servant created by a scheming overlord, able to summon crashing waves. She is sent against a boy who borrows heroic forms.

feats.scene: Cacear raised a wave that swamped a seaside promenade.
She was thrown into a pier post and shook it off.

name: Auiasrau
summary: Auiasrau is a retired soldier and former stage entertainer who favours singing and dancing. He and his wife fuss over their grandson, argue loudly and make up fast.

feats.scene: Auiasrau swept a heavy carpet over his shoulder to haul it out.
He took a stumble on stage and finished the song.

name: Tiutent
summary: Tiutent is an adopted noblewoman of a sunken city who led a revolt against a tyrant. She helps her sweetheart on a few quests and breathes underwater like her people.

feats.scene: Tiutent rallied a crowd and hurled a spear through a barricade.
She swam against a current to catch a fleeing guard.

name: Lloesmia
summary: Lloesmia is an unstable energy-bearer locked in a containment suit, a prisoner turned soldier. He threatens to blow himself up and everything for miles with him.

feats.scene: Lloesmia ruptured his suit and levelled a district in a blinding flash.
He weathered a heavy rifle volley inside his suit.

name: Llonau
summary: Llonau is a former priest who fell to jealousy and used forbidden magic to steal a rival's divine role. Rebuilt by an ancient hologram, he wields psionic and cosmic power and crowns himself monarch.

feats.scene: Llonau bent a world's population to his will and cracked its crust.
He rebuilt himself after being burned to nothing.

name: Leoosatel
summary: Leoosatel is a blond southern troublemaker who picks fights with a hot-headed hero. He has no powers and relies on fists and bluster.

feats.scene: Leoosatel threw a heavy right hook at a bar door.
He was shoved into a car and stood back up.

name: Anistusa
summary: Anistusa is a re-engineered flier who absorbs other people's gifts and borrows them for herself. She fires blasts from her palms and steals strength from a famed heroine before fighting a stronger champion.

feats.scene: Anistusa blasted a bunker's roof into the sky with stolen force.
She took a punch from a powerful warrior and stayed airborne.

name: Ciliaiu
summary: Ciliaiu is a grey-haired crook who bets that slow and casual movement will baffle a speedy hero. He runs a mine hideout, bickers with his gadget-maker and loses to a welding torch.

feats.scene: Ciliaiu swung a wrench at a pursuer in the dim of a mine.
He was hit by a rolling crate and stayed calm.

name: Amornlia
summary: Amornlia is a widowed genius whose rushed experiment aged him and tied him to a force that slows everything. He drags speedsters to a crawl, preferring patience over frenzy.

feats.scene: Amornlia stilled a whole avenue of traffic and fliers in a single pulse.
He endured a barrage of high-speed blows without moving.

name: Niantnu
summary: Niantnu is a brown-haired villain from long ago who uses shelled gimmicks against a bow-wielding hero. He is stubborn and quickly beaten.

feats.scene: Niantnu rammed a shell-shaped cart into a fence.
He was knocked down by a rope arrow and got up.

name: Niatiutir
summary: Niatiutir is a red-skinned, yellow-haired ring-bearer who patrols a sector of space and holds a grudge over a fallen predecessor. He makes constructs and shields from his ring and keeps vigil for the dead.

feats.scene: Niatiutir built a giant fist of light that levelled an asteroid outpost.
His shield held against a barrage that cratered a moon base.
He crossed a solar system's width riding his ring's light.

name: Inutiaeon
summary: Inutiaeon is a faithful pet walrus of a young swimmer, barking like a dog and rallying sea life in a crisis. He can stay under water indefinitely and calls neighbours for help.

feats.scene: Inutiaeon butted a lurking raider's skiff into a rock.
He shrugged off a harpoon bump and swam on.

name: Leonto
summary: Leonto is a grey-whiskered walrus friend of a small child, who visits him when he gets lost in a big city. He is a strong swimmer and a loyal companion.

feats.scene: Leonto nudged a bus-stop bench aside to reach his friend.
He bumped along a pier and wasn't hurt.

name: Statau
summary: Statau is an orange-furred space dog with a large tusk, a hero in a hound patrol. He digs through rock with his tooth and guards faraway worlds.

feats.scene: Statau drilled through a rock wall with his spinning tusk.
He shrugged off a falling boulder.

name: Riliarte
summary: Riliarte is a blue-furred space hound with a long pointed tooth he spins to drill, dig or cut like a sword. He is strong but exposed whenever the tooth is lost and regrowing.

feats.scene: Riliarte bored through a steel bulkhead with his spinning tooth.
His tooth parried a heavy cannon shot.

name: Anuve
summary: Anuve is a dark-haired schemer in formal wear who bedevils a stretchy hero with puddle-based traps. He is smooth, sinister and dressed for a gala.

feats.scene: Anuve shoved a rolling cart into a doorway.
He slipped on his own puddle and brushed himself off.

name: Tesva
summary: Tesva is a mind-reading, hypnotic villain in formal clothes who can read notes through sealed paper. He controls minds with a stare and tangles a rubbery hero in a poultry plot.

feats.scene: Tesva flicked a heavy cane at a guard's shin.
He tumbled down some stairs and kept his composure.

name: Rauan
summary: Rauan is one of a pair of bald cousins who retired from crime in an old, grim future. One wears a breathing tube and the other a hearing aid, and both are quizzed by a masked heroine.

feats.scene: Rauan tapped a cane on the floor in irritation.
He sat through a long, stern grilling without flinching.

name: Loteirn
summary: Loteirn is a squabbling pair of round, cartoonish villains who serve a baby-faced boss in a bright animated adventure. They bounce around, bicker and are carted off to an asylum.

feats.scene: Loteirn bumped into a crate and sent it flying into a wall.
They survived a drop from a ladder and bounced.

source_title: Tweedledum and Tweedledee (The Brave and the Bold)

name: Tanri
summary: Tanri is a purple-skinned agent who weaves illusions, flies and fights with a sword. He serves an interdimensional agency and masks his face.

feats.scene: Tanri cut through a steel fence with a swordstroke.
He flew over a river and landed behind a pursuer.

name: Celvor
summary: Celvor is a brown-haired flying mercenary in a villain squad hired by a crime family. She dies when the whole squad is wiped out by a lone hit-man.

feats.scene: Celvor dived from the sky and hit a rooftop guard hard.
She flew across a skyline in seconds.

name: Ceiumsti
summary: Ceiumsti is a hulking bruiser who weighs a great deal and shoves through opponents. He fights for money in a pair of capes-and-umbrellas adventures.

feats.scene: Ceiumsti bowled over a pair of bouncers with a shoulder charge.
He took a cricket bat to the ribs and chuckled.

name: Ticeona
summary: Ticeona is a bald seaman who lost his sight to eastern sorcery and raised a long-dead prince from the grave. He wears an enchanted armour of guardian spirits and fights a team of misfits.

feats.scene: Ticeona clove a wall of stone with the armour's gauntlet.
He endured a barrage of bullets in the armour.

name: Neotumsau
summary: Neotumsau is a dark-haired thief in a trio that steals with weather powers. She fills rooms and cars with freezing air and uses a beauty contest as cover.

feats.scene: Neotumsau froze a flower shop solid in seconds.
She tumbled across a stage and kept her pose.

name: Amliunt
summary: Amliunt is a blond former artist mutated by a meteor shower, with telekinetic command over glass. He uses it to rob a jewellery shop, kills to escape, and loses to his own daughter.

feats.scene: Amliunt shattered a shop window and flung the shards like a swarm.
He took a hard fall while fleeing and rose.

name: Tarnva
summary: Tarnva is a god who balances chaos and order between two siblings. He is immortal, reshapes matter and reality, travels between dimensions and moves things by thought.

feats.scene: Tarnva rewrote the laws of a continent and thereby shattered its landmass.
He weathered a clash of his siblings' powers unscathed.

name: Toniava
summary: Toniava is a jade-skinned patron of disorder who lends borrowed might to a hungry mortal pawn. Toniava grows strong only while its chosen host is bold, and withers when rivals scatter the host's allies.

feats.scene: Toniava pours a river of raw sorcery through a stolen relic and cracks a hillside in two.
Toniava shrugs off a barrage of binding spells that would flatten a district.

name: Illlli
summary: Illlli is a cheerful retiree in a quiet village who once terrorised readers over bad grammar. Illlli keeps a sedative needle and a gardening spade handy, and a smile that never quite reaches the eyes.

feats.scene: Illlli drives a spade into packed soil to bury a captive up to the neck.
Illlli takes a hard fall down the cellar steps and still stands to finish the lecture.

name: Tesrecor
summary: Tesrecor is a one-handed deity of oaths and battle, honoured by those who want fair judgement. Tesrecor gave up a limb to bind a monstrous wolf and never complains about the price.

feats.scene: Tesrecor brings a war-hammer of sworn light down and splits a granite ridge to its roots.
Tesrecor stands unmoved as a rockslide the size of a mountain buries him.

name: Ntotail
summary: Ntotail is a scaled monarch who judges disputes in a cavern kingdom and punishes without mercy. Ntotail respects strength from the surface world but trusts only the law of his own deep halls.

feats.scene: Ntotail slams his tail into a stone pillar and topples it across a cavern road.
Ntotail walks away from a collapsing tunnel roof with only dust on his scales.

name: Astllo
summary: Astllo is a pale-eyed soldier from a doomed warrior world who methodically scours the stars for one fugitive. Astllo has a patient cruelty and a gravity weapon that pins even the mightiest quarry.

feats.scene: Astllo fires a crushing gravity lance that carves a trench across a mountain range.
Astllo takes a cannon salvo from an armoured fleet on his chest and keeps marching.

name: Valrn
summary: Valrn is a bald hired killer who breeds fearsome hounds and takes pride in a flawless record. Valrn learns the hard way that a reputation is a poor shield against a change of heart.

feats.scene: Valrn fires a heavy rifle through a reinforced door and drops the guard behind it.
Valrn takes a full-strength blow from a furious warrior and stays upright.

name: Nintel
summary: Nintel is a smooth, soft-voiced swindler who runs a criminal syndicate on forged charm and stolen rites. Nintel bends minds with a stare, and relies on traps because he is no brawler.

feats.scene: Nintel springs a pair of sealed glass cylinders that crush the unwary slowly.
Nintel takes a fall from a balcony and rises to bow.

name: Sauiulia
summary: Sauiulia is a blond researcher of a vanished world who traded lab coats for a crime trio. Sauiulia pairs sharp wits with unusual strength under a foreign sun.

feats.scene: Sauiulia lifts a rail car overhead and flings it through a warehouse wall.
Sauiulia is struck by a falling crane and brushes the splinters away.

name: Stluel
summary: Stluel is a hulking machine assembled from many smaller devices and ruled by one central brain. Stluel can swap its metal shell, but a sudden pulse of current scrambles its thinking.

feats.scene: Stluel swings a steel girder arm and shears a loading crane off its tracks.
Stluel absorbs a truck impact and merely re-seats a displaced panel.

name: Rnorelli
summary: Rnorelli is a pale-haired widow whose spirit shares a body with a hunting mountain cat. Rnorelli's claws reach out when she is angered, and she has outlived centuries of mourning.

feats.scene: Rnorelli rakes a steel door open with curved claws in a single stroke.
Rnorelli walks away from a burning lorry crash and heals before the flames die.

name: Tercinasi
summary: Tercinasi is a hairless, black-eyed super-agent made by a secret programme to match a legendary strongman. Tercinasi leaps across rooftops and punches through armour, and then simply disappears from the record.

feats.scene: Tercinasi punches a bank vault door clean off its hinges.
Tercinasi takes a tank round in the chest and answers with a grin.
Tercinasi bounds across four rooftops in the time it takes a sentry to shout.

name: Reorntu
summary: Reorntu is a bald, silent manservant who clears a path for his master with brute persistence. Reorntu favours pistols and heavy fists, and always thinks of himself last.

feats.scene: Reorntu knocks a stack of crates down onto an intruder with one heavy swing.
Reorntu takes a baton blow to the skull without losing his stride.

name: Riveosa
summary: Riveosa is a zealous bodyguard who shoves aside every stranger who steps near his employer. Riveosa believes loyalty is a form of worship, and hits like a door slammed shut.

feats.scene: Riveosa slams a rival against a stone wall and leaves a dent in the plaster.
Riveosa takes a heavy blow from a cane and does not blink.

name: Seotalirn
summary: Seotalirn is a tiny, round-faced guard in a storybook city who takes his post very seriously. Seotalirn once locked a heavy gate against an undead swarm and refused to open it for hours.

feats.scene: Seotalirn heaves a gate bolt across and pins it with his whole weight.
Seotalirn is bowled over by a shambling crowd and gets up with his helmet askew.

name: Lorosava
summary: Lorosava is the title passed between several burly retainers of an old master. Lorosava is feared in harbours and temples alike, and each wearer fights a little differently.

feats.scene: Lorosava hurls a smuggler's crate across a dock in a single throw.
Lorosava takes a long fall from a gantry and lands on his feet.

name: Ressoros
summary: Ressoros is a masked enforcer in a cartoon world, built like a wardrobe and as quiet as one. Ressoros brawls with grim efficiency and never explains himself to anyone.

feats.scene: Ressoros flips a heavy table onto a squad of henchmen.
Ressoros is slammed through a wooden door and walks back through it.

name: Miltuval
summary: Miltuval is a stone-faced bald minder in a world where the machinery of the old order never stopped turning. Miltuval stays close to his master's elbow and lets few people speak first.

feats.scene: Miltuval pushes a locked cabinet over to block a corridor.
Miltuval takes a thrown chair across the shoulders and does not turn.

name: Rnuerein
summary: Rnuerein is a young ape noble in a hidden forest metropolis who inherits a crown too early. Rnuerein works to hold off a war between his people and the ones outside, while a whispering mind pulls at the council.

feats.scene: Rnuerein tears a thick palm from its roots and hurls it across a plaza.
Rnuerein is thrown into a marble column and shakes his head clear.

name: Orreste
