summary: Orreste is a teenage swimmer from a sea-folk line who can swap legs for a finned tail. Orreste glides above the waves and can only dive for a day before she must surface.

feats.scene: Orreste hurls herself at a fishing trawler and rams a hole through its hull.
Orreste dives into the deepest trench and feels only a mild squeeze.

name: Ralsan
summary: Ralsan is a printed hero engineered to defend a ruined world, powered by the attention of everyone who reads his pages. Ralsan feels the dread of his own awareness, and can warp a page's rules when fighting back.

feats.scene: Ralsan turns a stolen gem into a flood of acid that eats through a collapsed tower.
Ralsan is ripped in half by a rival and folds himself back into a single frame.

name: Rnlaiu
summary: Rnlaiu is an albino ape-bodied genius who plans the grand crimes of a hidden council. Rnlaiu prefers machines and medicine to fists, but is physically formidable.

feats.scene: Rnlaiu lifts a laboratory generator and hurls it through a plate-glass window.
Rnlaiu takes a pistol volley across the chest and keeps his composure.

name: Arntton
summary: Arntton is a tiny, toy-styled white ape villain in a cute and violent city. Arntton's thick hide makes him a tough nut to crack for even the larger kids.

feats.scene: Arntton hurls a toy cart across the playground and cracks a bench.
Arntton is flattened under a wrecking ball and pops back up unharmed.

name: Naneosu
summary: Naneosu is a frail old scholar whose brilliant brain keeps burning out its body, so he steals new ones. Naneosu reads minds, hides behind front men, and always keeps a replacement host in mind.

feats.scene: Naneosu triggers a lab device that fells a row of guards at once.
Naneosu survives a long fall in a stolen body and walks away thinking.

name: Tiserva
summary: Tiserva is a towering fusion of three brothers who vowed to stand against their mother across all realities. Tiserva has a body that shifts size with the threat, and burns like a collapsing universe.

feats.scene: Tiserva unleashes a wave that scours a cluster of galaxies down to bare light.
Tiserva absorbs the full fury of a mother-force and holds the line for a heartbeat.

name: Sesernia
summary: Sesernia is a blond, blue-eyed bruiser of a mirror world who joined an outlaw crew for the thrill. Sesernia is missing after a shattering blast and nobody has dared declare her gone.

feats.scene: Sesernia punches a bus clear over a bridge rail and into the river.
Sesernia takes a cannon shell to the face and sneers.

name: Aunuser
summary: Aunuser is a blue-eyed crime lord from a world of reversed morals who brags about every rival he has buried. Aunuser flies and punches like a falling meteor, and leads a team of mirrored heroes.

feats.scene: Aunuser punches a gap through a skyscraper's lower floors and lets it settle.
Aunuser walks out of a missile strike with burnt cloth and no wounds.
Aunuser crosses a harbour in an instant.

source_title: Ultraman (Crisis on Two Earths: Crime Syndicate Earth)

name: Unnti
summary: Unnti is a lab-grown strongman who obeys his maker, built to be louder and tougher than the original. Unnti hits first and thinks later, and a clever voice in his ear steers him.

feats.scene: Unnti punches a freight train off its rails and into a field.
Unnti takes a battery of artillery fire and dusts off his shoulders.
Unnti streaks over a city before a camera crew can turn.

name: Lloli
summary: Lloli is a resentful sky-born conqueror who grows stronger with every strange new mineral he meets. Lloli rules a harsh reversed world from a fortress, and resents everyone who laughs at him.

feats.scene: Lloli drops a cliff-sized slab on a rebel army and flattens its camp.
Lloli is hit by a battery of siege weapons and brushes the soot aside.

name: Nanros
summary: Nanros is a timeless riddling judge from the dawn of civilisation who hunts thieves across the ages. Nanros can freeze a victim between living and dying, and always poses a single impossible question.

feats.scene: Nanros folds a heartbeat into a loop and tears a hole in the fabric of a century.
Nanros is struck by a star's worth of force and does not shift his stance.

name: Loresinum
summary: Loresinum is a white-skinned alien who wields an unseen band of light through a stolen ring. Loresinum fights beside a crew of villains and falls to a team of impostor heroes.

feats.scene: Loresinum shapes a violet cage that crumples an armoured van into a cube.
Loresinum shields herself from a hail of rubble with a ring-made wall.

name: Rnotia
summary: Rnotia is a lab assistant whose odd talent is changing the hue of anything he touches. Rnotia cheerfully applied to a famous team and was told his gift was too small.

feats.scene: Rnotia turns a whole fence from white to violet in one pass.
Rnotia is knocked flat by a thrown crate and stands up laughing.

source_title: Ulu Vakk (Legion of Super-Heroes TV Series)

name: Stirnu
summary: Stirnu is a laboratory technician struck by a ray from a neighbouring dimension that gave him control over colour. Stirnu's trick looks trivial until it blinds a gunman with the wrong shade.

feats.scene: Stirnu changes a traffic signal to green for an entire boulevard.
Stirnu falls down a stairwell and gets up with a bruise.

name: Rnures
summary: Rnures is a bearded wartime general turned national leader who sends a gunslinger on a perilous errand. Rnures keeps calm under threat and relies on paperwork more than force.

feats.scene: Rnures slams a fist on the war table and scatters a stack of maps.
Rnures walks through a smoke-filled hall with a steady, unbroken stride.

name: Tiutilnu
summary: Tiutilnu is a city founder who was betrayed and returned as a vengeful ghost. Tiutilnu drifts through walls to hunt the descendants of the traitor, and fades when his story is told.

feats.scene: Tiutilnu closes a spectral fist around a lawman's throat and lifts him off the ground.
Tiutilnu lets a volley of bullets pass through his chest unnoticed.

name: Taseoern
summary: Taseoern is a quiet pilot-turned-farm-dweller who raised a son while his spouse served in the skies. Taseoern's gentle, steady patience carried the family through years of absence.

feats.scene: Taseoern pulls a stuck plough free from a muddy furrow.
Taseoern takes a hard tumble from a ladder and laughs it off.

name: Nitelre
summary: Nitelre is a polished eldest heir of a mob family who shares power with a twin and plays both sides. Nitelre never quite earns the trust of rivals, and does not live to see the feud end.

feats.scene: Nitelre shoves a heavy restaurant table across the floor to block a door.
Nitelre takes a punch from a bodyguard and checks his cufflinks.

name: Rnanvar
summary: Rnanvar is the hidden source of an unseen band of feeling that commands a legion of ring-bearers. Rnanvar spreads like a sickness and wields a chain forged from a strange mark.

feats.scene: Rnanvar sweeps a ripple of cold dread across a star system and quiets every sun.
Rnanvar is pierced by a thousand beams and merely hums.

name: Erosalla
summary: Erosalla is a bald fisherman who becomes invisible as soon as he enters the water. Erosalla uses his trick to sink nets and boats, and goes visible again on dry land.

feats.scene: Erosalla snaps the rope of a nearby dinghy and drags it under.
Erosalla is thrown against a dock and shakes the water from his ears.

name: Iaiuvi
summary: Iaiuvi is a red-haired schemer who commands roots and rock as if the planet itself were her weapon. Iaiuvi works with a twin to hold the world for ransom, and a reckless escape ends them.

feats.scene: Iaiuvi raises a wall of stone and twisting vines that locks a motorway solid.
Iaiuvi cushions a fall inside a thick cocoon of roots.

name: Riceanu
summary: Riceanu is a good-natured relative of a small hero who wears a helmet that resizes the creatures around him. Riceanu prefers a quiet afternoon to a grand stunt, and the insects never ask to be bigger.

feats.scene: Riceanu swells a picnic basket to the size of a shed to rescue shrunken children.
Riceanu is squashed under a toy block and bounces up with a grin.

name: Eotant
summary: Eotant is a white-haired elder statesman who commands a team of misfit patriots with stern warmth. Eotant appears when needed and slips out of sight when the crowd grows loud.

feats.scene: Eotant hurls a bundle of heavy flagpoles through a squad of attackers.
Eotant stands in a barrage of thrown debris and keeps his speech going.

name: Nerno
summary: Nerno is the living soul of a nation, born from a crowd's shared hope and worn down by decades of defeat. Nerno fades into a deep sleep after his allies are lost, and wakes only when someone believes again.

feats.scene: Nerno hurls a shining standard that splits a river dam in two.
Nerno stands through an invasion's barrage and does not fall.

name: Tausiu
summary: Tausiu is a spirit conjured by a circle of founders, bound to a charm and wearing the faces of fallen patriots. Tausiu rises again each time a new host takes up the banner, and leads a troop of costumed fighters.

feats.scene: Tausiu swings a heavy banner pole and caves in the side of a warship.
Tausiu is struck by a cannonade of shells and is up before the smoke clears.

name: Oluole
summary: Oluole is a long-lived national avatar who joined an elder council and runs errands for a spy agency. Oluole cuts through prison brawlers with a veteran's calm.

feats.scene: Oluole lifts a pair of convicts and tosses them through a cell door.
Oluole takes a barrage of blows from a prison yard mob and does not sway.

name: Olloroti
summary: Olloroti is a cartoon patriot whose strength rises and falls with the nation's mood. Olloroti can open a pocket world to spirit his friends away, and share his gifts with anyone in need.

feats.scene: Olloroti slams the ground and sends a ring of cracks through the courtyard.
Olloroti takes a cannon blast on the chest without losing his smile.

source_title: Uncle Sam (The Brave and the Bold)

name: Tiuter
summary: Tiuter is a crime boss who claims to be a living thought feeding on the greed of every city at once. Tiuter hires street heroes for dirty jobs and bursts apart when one clever trick lands.

feats.scene: Tiuter swells and hurls a parked van through a shopfront.
Tiuter shrugs off a hail of pistol fire and sneers.

name: Iasta
summary: Iasta is a dark-haired criminal whose wrists end in grasping shadow that can choke the breath out of anyone nearby. Iasta works from alleys and basements, and the shadow only reaches as far as a long arm.

feats.scene: Iasta lets a black hand grow from the wall and squeeze a guard senseless.
Iasta takes a baton blow to the ribs and keeps squeezing.

name: Llentror
summary: Llentror is a grim, dark-haired hoodlum who arrives wherever a funeral is held and plans a heist around it. Llentror prefers disguise and misdirection to open combat.

feats.scene: Llentror tips a heavy coffin lid onto a pursuer.
Llentror takes a sprint into a brick wall and keeps running.

name: Oroau
summary: Oroau is a brown-haired thief who runs a string of gangs in a smoky harbour town. Oroau is crafty rather than strong, and loses his nerve when a determined fighter pins him down.

feats.scene: Oroau flings a lantern into a warehouse of straw.
Oroau tumbles down a stack of crates and shakes it off.

name: Lenvalent
summary: Lenvalent is a theatrical gangster who stages every theft around a black funeral carriage. Lenvalent delights in clever props and macabre jokes, and hides behind a sinister mask.

feats.scene: Lenvalent kicks a loaded coffin down a ramp into a pursuing patrol.
Lenvalent hits a brick wall at a run and rolls to his feet.

name: Orelasiar
summary: Orelasiar is a blond deep-sea soldier who regrets the crimes of his comrades and sees the horror of what his people avoided. Orelasiar swims faster than any ship and sees in the darkest trench.

feats.scene: Orelasiar rams a patrol boat and splits it in two.
Orelasiar dives into crushing depths and keeps swimming.
Orelasiar cuts a straight line across open water faster than a speedboat.

name: Numaun
summary: Numaun is a black-haired super soldier with red eyes who fuses sunlight, cybernetics and a hunter's tactics. Numaun flies, fires heat from the eyes, and feeds on bright light.

feats.scene: Numaun scorches a vehicle convoy with a sweep of heat from his eyes.
Numaun shrugs off a missile and keeps his course.
Numaun streaks across a valley before a spotter can raise a hand.

name: Osaniutor
summary: Osaniutor is an invisible creature of pure energy that wandered the stars and gathered strange companions. Osaniutor wanted a place with heroes and turned hostile when it was refused.

feats.scene: Osaniutor seizes the glow of a ring and bends it into a ribbon that levels a small hill.
Osaniutor lets a hail of shells pass through its unseen body without a ripple.

name: Lleres
summary: Lleres is a young woman carried from a possible tomorrow and gifted borrowed power by two ancient givers. Lleres is still learning how large her inheritance is, and she keeps her foster father's name close.

feats.scene: Lleres raises two glowing hands and a hillside of rubble drifts apart.
Lleres stands in a surge of blue flame and lets it pass over her.

name: Natinan
summary: Natinan is a sleeper who loses decades to a strange sickness and wakes into a legacy she did not choose. Natinan becomes a channel that links the dreams of strangers, and spends her last strength to save a descendant.

feats.scene: Natinan joins a thousand sleepers in one dream and the shared vision shakes a town's walls.
Natinan absorbs a deluge of nightmare force and calmly smiles.

name: Osacin
summary: Osacin is a blond wanderer who woke on a battlefield with no memory and took up a lonely war against invaders. Osacin travels light, fights by night, and will not give a name.

feats.scene: Osacin lobs a bundle of grenades into a supply truck.
Osacin takes a rifle butt to the temple and crawls on.

name: Celtum
summary: Celtum is a widowed soldier given a quiet medical upgrade that makes him a little quicker and tougher than any fighter. Celtum leads rough teams on thankless missions and speaks only when needed.

feats.scene: Celtum disarms a gunman and breaks a table with the follow-through.
Celtum takes a fall from a rooftop and keeps moving.

name: Taast
summary: Taast is a masked traveller from a distant century who joins a troop of heroes on a trip to the beginning. Taast hides behind a plain name and a calm smile, and leaves cryptic warnings for the curious.

feats.scene: Taast lifts a collapsing bridge span and sets it gently on the bank.
Taast stands in a burst of radiation that cooks the trees around him.

name: Veollirn
summary: Veollirn is a reanimated champion with a blade in place of one forearm, driven by a distant master's will. Veollirn is mindless and relentless, and strikes down much stronger fighters.

feats.scene: Veollirn drives its blade arm through a fortress door and keeps going.
Veollirn is struck full-speed by a flying hero and does not slide.
Veollirn blurs across the arena before the watchers can blink.

name: Viiumeo
summary: Viiumeo is a test subject released by accident who can blink from place to place. Viiumeo tries to enjoy his freedom, but a bounty hunter has other plans.

feats.scene: Viiumeo blinks behind a guard and clubs him with a wrench.
Viiumeo is thrown against a warehouse door and blinks away in a rush.

name: Tessernt
summary: Tessernt is a hard-faced sea commander who serves a tyrant until she grows tired of him. Tessernt leads her troops carefully and eventually changes sides, paying the price.

feats.scene: Tessernt drives a trident into a hull plank and holds it fast.
Tessernt takes a blow to the shield and remains standing.

name: Rinto
summary: Rinto is a blue-skinned stranger from a lost colony who prowls a drowned town after dark. Rinto is feared by locals and keeps his secrets from outsiders.

feats.scene: Rinto splinters a rotten dock beam with a swift kick.
Rinto falls into the harbour and swims out unhurt.

name: Ormint
summary: Ormint is a dark-haired herald of a heavenly host who leads his brothers in a doomed battle. Ormint carries a long spear and fights with sword and spell.

feats.scene: Ormint drives a shining spear through a rampart and shatters a mountain pass.
Ormint absorbs a thunderous roar and flies on.
Ormint crosses a battlefield on shining wings before the first arrow lands.

name: Caneta
summary: Caneta is a blue-eyed soldier and parent of a young heir who is torn from a failing world. Caneta leads elite troops with ruthless discipline.

feats.scene: Caneta throws a convoy truck through a brick warehouse.
Caneta stands under a collapsing cliff and walks out.

name: Niaterlle
summary: Niaterlle is a ruthless exile who is freed from a prison of shadows and delights in the weakness of the people she meets. Niaterlle discovers a new talent when a strike glances off her skin.

feats.scene: Niaterlle sweeps a burning ray across a hillside and fells a forest.
Niaterlle takes a rattlesnake bite and a rifle round without a flinch.

name: Teriutel
summary: Teriutel is a captive in a pocket of shadow who is released as a last resort against a robotic invader. Teriutel fights with brutal enthusiasm and with the strength of an exile.

feats.scene: Teriutel hurls a smashed car at an advancing drone line.
Teriutel stands in a drone barrage and smiles.

name: Esrisi
summary: Esrisi is a proud commander who calls herself the weapon beside her strategist partner. Esrisi enjoys the thrill of the kill and the freedom of the open sky.

feats.scene: Esrisi dives into a city street and buckles three blocks of pavement.
Esrisi shrugs off a missile battery with a grin.
Esrisi shoots over the skyline faster than any jet.

name: Amotanto
summary: Amotanto is a lieutenant and mother who holds a conquered world beside her husband and mourns him. Amotanto loses her partner and keeps his dream alive for their son.

feats.scene: Amotanto drives a boulder through a fortress gate and into the keep.
Amotanto stands at the heart of a twin-sun storm and blinks.

name: Listuse
summary: Listuse is a shy student raised in near seclusion who steps into a lively dance in an outdated gown. Listuse finds friends when she least expects them and helps unmask a fraud.

feats.scene: Listuse pushes open a stuck mansion door with her shoulder.
Listuse trips down the grand stair and laughs.

name: Oristures
summary: Oristures is a mystic being of the savannah worshipped by a hunting cult. Oristures grants power through a carved totem and expects loyalty in return.

feats.scene: Oristures stamps the ground and the plain splits in a mile-long crack.
Oristures bears the blast of a thousand spears without a mark.

name: Eostues
summary: Eostues is the spirit of a young girl bound in a keepsake who rises to protect her homeland. Eostues cannot harm symbols she loves, and her enemies learn to hide beneath them.

feats.scene: Eostues punches through a spy car's engine block in a single swing.
Eostues takes a hail of gunfire and keeps pursuing.

name: Teslitas
summary: Teslitas is a vain regional governor of a tiny city who laughs off a messenger's warning. Teslitas is nearsighted and proud, and refuses to look through the telescope again.

feats.scene: Teslitas swats the telescope away with a ringed hand.
Teslitas stumbles on his own robe and catches the railing.

name: Lonvava
summary: Lonvava is a brown-haired warlord of a snowy northern realm who lays down his weapons to save his daughter. Lonvava finds his enemy had a gentler plan than he feared.

feats.scene: Lonvava splits a thick shield with a single axe stroke.
Lonvava takes a mace blow to the helm and keeps shouting orders.

name: Lurniiar
summary: Lurniiar is a red-haired cult sorceress who inherited vast spellcraft from her divine parent. Lurniiar can blink between rooms, send her mind abroad, and shape raw force into weapons.

feats.scene: Lurniiar hurls a sphere of force that levels an abandoned warehouse district.
Lurniiar is struck by a thunderous spell and unravels it with a gesture.

name: Vatellu
summary: Vatellu is a blond professor turned convict who builds clever traps from stolen lab parts. Vatellu once tried to blow his prison into another reality and ended up trapped in his own gadget.

feats.scene: Vatellu overloads a belt device and nearly collapses a pocket realm.
Vatellu stands in the shock of a clashing beam and keeps scheming.

name: Liastarn
summary: Liastarn is a dark-haired rebel and old comrade who leads a band of riders against an occupying army. Liastarn has long outlived the usual span and stays good-humoured in the saddle.

feats.scene: Liastarn gallops a horse through a barricade of barrels.
Liastarn is dragged from his horse and gets back up swinging.

name: Leoiumnau
summary: Leoiumnau is an orphan raised by a series of masters, now the finest fighter of his age. Leoiumnau teaches his friends to defend themselves and trains an ally to control a wild talent.

feats.scene: Leoiumnau breaks a stack of stone slabs with a single palm.
Leoiumnau takes a full-speed kick to the ribs and answers with a bow.

name: Orelu
summary: Orelu is a dark-skinned former ruler of a volcanic people who can burn from within. Orelu cools to the touch at will, and can draw flame from the sun.

feats.scene: Orelu calls a column of solar fire that boils away a stretch of sea.
Orelu walks out of a lava lake humming a tune.

name: Soore
summary: Soore is a white-haired elder scientist who shares tales and tools with his grandson. Soore is better with a notebook than a weapon, and stays calm through any storm.

feats.scene: Soore throws a heavy tome across the room to stop a runaway cart.
Soore is tumbled by a stumbling crowd and gets up with a laugh.

name: Coaul
summary: Coaul is a young fisher-boy who finds a glowing stone and brings it to his elders. Coaul uses a stolen skiff to take the glowing prize back to its resting place.

feats.scene: Coaul heaves a glowing rock onto a skiff by himself.
Coaul tumbles out of the skiff and paddles back.

name: Iumcora
summary: Iumcora is a grey-haired cruel schemer who levelled a whole metropolis to escape a patrol. Iumcora has a deep scar and one blind eye, and keeps an old faith.

feats.scene: Iumcora vaporises a district with a flash of focused heat.
Iumcora takes a volley of armour-piercing shells on his chest and grins.

name: Ststse
summary: Ststse is a bald war hero who rebuilds a band of survivors after a crash landing. Ststse keeps his chin up and his brother close, and shields his team with a glowing barrier.

feats.scene: Ststse hurls a blazing bolt that melts a barricade of cars.
Ststse holds the line against an armoured assault without a scratch.

name: Stotin
summary: Stotin is a champion of the old light, marked by a clawed hand he hides behind a crimson glove. Stotin trains in a divine hall and meets tyrants with sword and cunning.

feats.scene: Stotin swings a heavy sword through a stone gate and cleaves it apart.
Stotin is knocked down a cliff face and climbs back with a laugh.

name: Seinni
summary: Seinni is a medieval knight flung out of her age by a strange beast and left in a modern tavern. Seinni resorts to her blade first and makes a rough promise to hold it in check.

feats.scene: Seinni cuts through a bar table with a single blow.
Seinni takes a stab to the side and keeps her stance.

name: Vacorlor
summary: Vacorlor is a machine built to rob a shop by a pair of scheming inventors. Vacorlor shrugs off bullets, yet a stray radio signal fries its circuits.

feats.scene: Vacorlor pops a safe door with one hand.
Vacorlor takes a volley of police pistol fire without slowing.

name: Stuciri
summary: Stuciri is a red-haired hunter of fugitives who spies on a crime lord and pays for it. Stuciri's son carries on her work under a wise teacher.

feats.scene: Stuciri slams a heavy crate onto a fleeing target's ankle.
Stuciri takes a rooftop fall and rolls to her feet.

name: Titirne
summary: Titirne is a cold scientist who forges a rival fusion of two minds to win a long standoff. Titirne grows unstable without the right equipment and burns out in a flash.

feats.scene: Titirne bursts into a column of flame and melts a steel gate.
Titirne withstands a spray of radiation and calls for her coat.

name: Torciirn
summary: Torciirn is a former pilot swaddled in treated cloth to contain an unruly negative charge. Torciirn finds a second career as a spy chief and a reluctant fighter.

feats.scene: Torciirn lets a dark glow burst from her bandages and fells a squad.
Torciirn walks away from a plane crash without a bruise.

name: Esoraore
summary: Esoraore is a former sculptor who leaves her family for a cult and is later freed from a controlling will. Esoraore holds a bow and a gentle love of clay.

feats.scene: Esoraore draws a bow and sinks an arrow into a post.
Esoraore takes a tumble down a dune and laughs.

name: Nttesos
summary: Nttesos is a grey-skinned bruiser whose body falls apart into jigsaw tiles and puts itself back together. Nttesos dreams of joining a famous team and settles for crime.

feats.scene: Nttesos scatters into tiles and reforms behind a guard to club him.
Nttesos is shattered by a punch and reassembles with a shrug.

name: Nalve
summary: Nalve is a bold newspaper reporter who dives into danger for a front-page story. Nalve earns a nickname from the readers and a grudge from the criminals.

feats.scene: Nalve swings a heavy camera case at a thug's knee.
Nalve rolls down a flight of newsroom stairs and gets right up.

name: Iuiumeo
summary: Iuiumeo is a mindless giant with a bright strength who smashes whatever his team points him at. Iuiumeo shrugs off blasts and unleashes energy bursts from his fists.

feats.scene: Iuiumeo hammers a bridge span with an energy-laced fist and drops it into the river.
Iuiumeo stands through a tank volley and stomps forward.

name: Teltauter
summary: Teltauter is a towering bred weapon with a slab of a body and a skull that hums with raw static. It was grown to stand against a star-devouring swarm, yet it drifts toward whoever pays for its rampages.

feats.scene: Teltauter slammed both fists into a canyon wall and the whole rim sheared away in a single roar.
Teltauter walked out of a collapsing orbital dock with only dust on its shoulders.

name: Telelacol
summary: Telelacol is a sun-fed conqueror who commanded the great engines of a wandering war fortress in a reality where no liberator ever arrived. She stores starlight in her body and spends it in brutal bursts of strength.

feats.scene: Telelacol drove her spear through a siege tower and the blast flattened the barracks beneath it.
Telelacol shrugged off a collapsing furnace dome that rained molten slag on her armor.

name: Cosare
summary: Cosare is a cunning enforcer for a gang of mirror-world rogues who can melt her body into beasts mid-fight. Her animal shapes are strong for their size, but a single hard blow to the gut drops her back into human form.

feats.scene: Cosare swiped as a great cat and tore a steel door off its hinges.
Cosare took a knee to the midsection and was knocked senseless in one blow.

source_title: Vamp (Crisis on Two Earths: Crime Syndicate Earth)

name: Reneium
summary: Reneium is a pale schoolmaster who runs a hip academy by day and feeds on blood by night. He is cheerful, fussy and not especially dangerous.

feats.scene: Reneium lifted a desk over his head to scold a rowdy class.
Reneium waved off a stumble down a full flight of stairs and straightened his tie.

name: Cotorlan
summary: Cotorlan is a sunny boy who exists only inside a drugged dream, a son imagined by a homesick father. He has no real strength, just a warm laugh and a lot of questions.

feats.scene: Cotorlan threw a ball across a dream-courtyard to a smiling parent.
Cotorlan tumbled off a garden wall and bounced up grinning.

name: Orleoti
summary: Orleoti is a long-dead resistance captain who rallied the weary after a war of grown bodies and stolen lifespans. He rebuilt a wrecked homeworld wearing an armored suit of ancestral design.

feats.scene: Orleoti fired his suit weapon and cut a barricade of fused alloy in half.
Orleoti stood in a shelling and the suit plates only rang like bells.

name: Cosern
summary: Cosern is a soft-spoken scholar who gathers a flock of devotees inside a miniature preserved city. His weapon is persuasion, and he fights with neither fists nor gadgets.

feats.scene: Cosern struck a lectern so hard during a sermon that the whole hall went silent.
Cosern took a thrown chair across the back and kept preaching.

name: Inureolu
summary: Inureolu is a retired masked champion who now leads his sealed city as a statesman. In his prime he swung between disguise and duty, partnered with a trusted ally and a borrowed cloak.

feats.scene: Inureolu hurled a rusted cargo pod across the harbor and shattered it against a pier.
Inureolu was thrown into a brick tower and the tower broke first.

name: Ntutima
summary: Ntutima is a bodyguard who becomes a flawless fighter for minutes at a time by speaking a hero's name. The effect warps his judgment, and his boots carry him into the air.

feats.scene: Ntutima punched a parked van and folded it around a lamppost.
Ntutima took a rooftop fall in his hardened suit and sprinted away.
Ntutima sprinted down an alley faster than a pursuing car.

name: Rnucor
summary: Rnucor is a prehistoric tribesman made deathless by a glowing rock from the sky. Over countless ages he has bent whole peoples to his will and hired killers by the dozen.

feats.scene: Rnucor broke a spear shaft across his knee and drove the tip through a shield.
Rnucor healed from a cliff fall before his guards finished gasping.

name: Sororer
summary: Sororer is a deathless warlord from a pirate-ridden dimension who topples empires for sport. He wields stolen sorcery and brute might, and needs the blood of another deathless one to wake a demon.

feats.scene: Sororer called down a witch-bolt that blew a galleon's mast into splinters.
Sororer took a cannon salvo on the chest and laughed.

name: Temileo
summary: Temileo is a captive ancient who senses dread from an island of monsters. Penned in a desert fortress with other odd prisoners, he mocks his jailers and cannot die.

feats.scene: Temileo hammered a cell bar until the bolt bent at the base.
Temileo sat unharmed inside a chamber of choking vapor for an hour.

name: Nasil
summary: Nasil is a pampered schoolboy who hires a cheat to impersonate a famous hero so he can pose as a sidekick. He fences well and flips better, and learns a lesson in humility.

feats.scene: Nasil thrust a foil through a hanging ring at full lunge.
Nasil tumbled off a gymnasium beam and landed on both feet.

name: Retelam
summary: Retelam is a bald, genial executive who ran a security firm before a graceful step up to a boardroom seat. His battles are budgets and meetings.

feats.scene: Retelam slapped a stack of contracts on a table and sealed the deal.
Retelam sat through a hotel fire drill without spilling his coffee.

name: Isore
summary: Isore is a former arena slave who freed his city from blood sport and was handed a ring of willpower. He now patrols a quiet stretch of space, shaping hard light into walls and weapons.

feats.scene: Isore condensed a green lance of will and drove it through a pirate cruiser.
Isore raised a shell of hard light that held against a barrage from a battleship.

name: Orseoser
summary: Orseoser is a pale-haired star being who walks through void and drifts between light and shade. She flies, hits hard and glows with hot energy, and she once carried a collapsed star inside her.

feats.scene: Orseoser unleashed a blazing lance that gouged a trench through a barren moon.
Orseoser flew straight through a stellar flare and came out glowing.

name: Riaveotel
summary: Riaveotel is a physician from a long-gone age who joined a doomed cause, then turned against it after centuries. She paid with her life to end what she once helped to start.

feats.scene: Riaveotel pressed a trembling lever and sealed a bulkhead on her former allies.
Riaveotel stayed upright through a corridor blast that tore her coat.

name: Iumauern
summary: Iumauern runs a small corner shop and takes in a grieving niece after a family killing. His strict beliefs lead him to a terrible overreaction one night.

feats.scene: Iumauern swung a heavy shop mop handle against a counter and splintered it.
Iumauern fell against his own display shelves and rose with only bruises.

name: Silresau
summary: Silresau is a pale-haired enforcer who held to his oath when his order turned murderous. He bore two rings of will and ended his own comrades before ending himself.

feats.scene: Silresau shaped a great hammer of hard light and flattened an armored line.
Silresau stood inside a green dome while cannon fire broke on its face.

name: Nanseor
summary: Nanseor is a bald alien thug who works for a rebel general. He relies on raw strength and a thick hide, and carries any weapon within reach.

feats.scene: Nanseor punched a delivery truck and sent it through a warehouse wall.
Nanseor took a rocket to the chest and only swore.

name: Amornora
summary: Amornora is a grey-bearded sea lord who lives in a forgotten town of drowned deities. He commands rain and rivers and punishes the unworthy, and his awareness reaches beyond the stars.

feats.scene: Amornora raised a wall of black water that swallowed an entire coast.
Amornora sat motionless on the sea floor as a trench collapsed on him.

name: Rosllese
summary: Rosllese is a grey president who marches his army into a neighbor's land on the word of a rich schemer. His rule ends with a long drop from a flying hero's arms.

feats.scene: Rosllese pounded a podium while denouncing a rival on live broadcast.
Rosllese was pinned to a thorny plant and merely complained.

name: Vorrnrni
summary: Vorrnrni is a replacement infantryman who feeds belts into a heavy gun during a week of hard fighting. He is brave, ordinary and quickly forgotten.

feats.scene: Vorrnrni emptied a belt in a long burst that chewed through a hedgerow.
Vorrnrni took a wall of mud and debris from a near shell burst and kept firing.

name: Orisser
summary: Orisser is a ruthless beverage tycoon who hides a fatal flaw in his product through bribery and killing. His empire is built on silence and spreadsheets.

feats.scene: Orisser threw a glass against his office wall in a rage.
Orisser fell from his chair during a board shouting match and got right up.

name: Teamova
summary: Teamova is a hulking mercenary in a powered suit that builds barriers of hard light. He once walled off an entire shopping complex and sorted his captives with ruthless efficiency.

feats.scene: Teamova threw up a bubble around a market hall that no crowd could break.
Teamova's field took a barrage of heavy blasts without a flicker.

name: Corvalest
summary: Corvalest is a many-armed alien who wields a ring of willpower in a distant sector. He fights beside a trusted partner and falls bravely in his first outing.

feats.scene: Corvalest launched a burst of green light that broke a raider's hull in two.
Corvalest raised a shell of hard light against a volley of missiles.

name: Netorva
summary: Netorva is a giant engineered sea beast with a mind that screams across a city. It was dropped into a metropolis by a clever schemer and left millions dead, then died within days.

feats.scene: Netorva appeared above a skyline and its mind-burst flattened the streets around it.
Netorva sagged under a rain of shells and kept swimming through the air.

name: Numunne
summary: Numunne is a hairless oddity whose blood vessels wear themselves outside his skin. He lashes his veins around enemies, but a masked rival beats him.

feats.scene: Numunne whipped a red cord around a lamp post and dragged it down.
Numunne took a rooftop dive and rose with his tendrils still lashing.

name: Saianle
summary: Saianle is a white-skinned raider admiral who connected to a hidden river of speed before his people did. He hid the gift under harness-gear and used it to run circles around heroes.

feats.scene: Saianle ran through a battlecruiser deck and the shockwave stripped its plating.
Saianle took a full broadside and rose with a laugh.
Saianle crossed a whole battlefield before the first shell landed.

name: Liuestia
summary: Liuestia is a blond schemer who steals a ring that turns her into giant insects. She joins a gang to ruin a famous hero and loses the ring to a trick.

feats.scene: Liuestia, changed into a huge beetle, rammed a vault door off its frame.
Liuestia shrugged off a thrown tire in her chitin form.

name: Rialuia
summary: Rialuia is a blond island warrior who rides and fights with sword and bow. She dies in battle, faithful to her sisters to the end.

feats.scene: Rialuia leapt from her horse and split a shield with one stroke.
Rialuia took a cavalry charge on her shield and stood fast.

name: Irnve
summary: Irnve is a green-skinned, white-eyed parasite that drops to a planet to feed on spinal fluid. She awakens new powers in unlucky hosts before she dies.

feats.scene: Irnve sank her fangs into a sleeping victim and drank in silence.
Irnve survived a fall from a fire escape and crawled away.

name: Seorareo
summary: Seorareo is a masked avenger who stalks the shadowy edges of a big city. Little is known about him, only a trail of grudges and an early death.

feats.scene: Seorareo swung a pipe against a dumpster and left a deep dent.
Seorareo took a hard fall from a fire escape and kept running.

name: Numtumirn
summary: Numtumirn is a grown-in-a-tank fighter, raised to serve a coastal regime and later turned against her makers. She hunts the one who killed her model and is bound for a quest in a stone monastery.

feats.scene: Numtumirn smashed a stone lintel with a single heavy kick.
Numtumirn took a hard blow from a sword-wielding rival and retreated on her own legs.

name: Lileo
summary: Lileo is a pink-haired activist who became a ring-bearer in her sector and hunts meddling experimenters with a partner. Her will forges barriers and beams of hard light.

feats.scene: Lileo swept a beam of green light across a hostile fleet and cracked its flagship.
Lileo took a volley behind a glowing shell and flew on unharmed.

name: Arstoca
summary: Arstoca is a jittery ventriloquist who loses his mind over a brother's death. He kidnaps a reporter, plots with a rich criminal and gets outfoxed by his own brainwashing machine.

feats.scene: Arstoca flung a heavy puppet case across his lair at a captive.
Arstoca tumbled off his workbench onto concrete and cursed.

name: Teserni
summary: Teserni is a mercenary toymaker who throws talking dolls and bomb-stuffed toys at his enemies. His craft is delightful and his hunger for pain is not.

feats.scene: Teserni set off a crate of exploding dolls inside a tower hall.
Teserni rolled down a spiral stair and kept laughing.

name: Toiutel
summary: Toiutel is a brown-haired goddess of love in a pantheon of old crowned gods. She speaks up for a doomed mortal and shares a piece of her grace with him.

feats.scene: Toiutel spread her arms and a wave of golden light levelled a rebel city.
Toiutel stood unhurt in the heart of a collapsing temple dome.

name: Lanmiaia
summary: Lanmiaia is a blond socialite who divorces a scheming scientist after he betrays her. She raised two odd children and keeps out of his plots.

feats.scene: Lanmiaia slapped a signed paper onto a lawyer's desk.
Lanmiaia sat through a flooded cellar party and walked out dripping but fine.

name: Ereore
summary: Ereore is a pink-haired woman who was a test subject for a harsh drug and now shapes living flesh like clay. She is a menace to a dark-cloaked detective in a gloomy city.

feats.scene: Ereore pressed her palms to a guard and bent his arm into a spiral.
Ereore was thrown into a car door and shook it off.

name: Tonve
summary: Tonve is a blond team leader who lost both forearms as a girl and replaced them with machines that become any weapon. She runs black-ops missions and steers her squad away from collapse.

feats.scene: Tonve turned her forearm into a heavy cannon and blew a tank off its tracks.
Tonve took a point-blank blast on her reinforced frame and stayed on her feet.

name: Rerco
summary: Rerco is a corporate sister who sits in on meetings while her brother schemes to rule the markets. She is cold, wealthy and not one to get her hands dirty.

feats.scene: Rerco slid a ledger across a table with a flat hand.
Rerco stepped out of a stalled elevator after hours and said nothing.

name: Neronll
summary: Neronll is a shadowy figure who grants stolen powers to a chosen herald and weaves false images of a lost friend to torment an exile. His power is borrowed and shaky, but his cruelty is steady.

feats.scene: Neronll cast a mirage so convincing that a veteran fighter wrecked his own garden.
Neronll dissolved into smoke before a punch could land.

name: Innauin
summary: Innauin is a self-made tycoon with three degrees who rose from poverty to rule an island of mad scientists. She is polished, bitter and certain that she deserves the crown.

feats.scene: Innauin shoved a rival's files off a desk and stared her down.
Innauin walked unaided out of a burning lab with scorched sleeves.

name: Eoncelva
summary: Eoncelva is an eco-terrorist who leads a band of fanatics and builds a bomb meant to wipe a great city clean. She dies mid-flight, and the weapon goes off early over a lonely stretch.

feats.scene: Eoncelva's device went off above a shoreline and flattened a few blocks.
Eoncelva took a bullet in the cockpit and held the stick for one more minute.

name: Iumauori
summary: Iumauori is a ghost-eating spirit who was once a girl dabbling in magic. She drifts through walls, rides the air and vanishes in a blink, hungry for the souls of the living.

feats.scene: Iumauori swept through a chapel and every candle flame went out.
Iumauori passed through a hail of bullets as though it were smoke.

name: Lerlor
summary: Lerlor is a tall warrior woman from a tribe that guards a sacred spring. She follows a brash champion abroad, her mind bound to his in battle.

feats.scene: Lerlor drove her spear butt into a thug's chest and he flew across the bar.
Lerlor took a bar stool across her shoulders and did not blink.

name: Taltauane
summary: Taltauane is a blond gunman from a small eastern country who bends sense of balance around him. He joined a disposable strike team and died on the first job.

feats.scene: Taltauane emptied a rifle at a bunker and tore a hole in its door.
Taltauane got up from a rooftop fall, steadied by his own warped sense of tilt.

name: Ratialis
summary: Ratialis is a banished minor deity who presides over bad breaks and mishaps and cannot turn it off. He wanders a rust-belt city, and every accident around him falls hardest on himself.

feats.scene: Ratialis sneezed and a crane toppled across an entire parking lot.
Ratialis climbed out of a collapsed tavern with a chipped tooth.

name: Lormiltel
summary: Lormiltel is a quiet blade-for-hire who serves a secret order of killers. He is trained in close combat and falls to the first hero who sees him coming.

feats.scene: Lormiltel drove a short blade through a wooden door and into the guard behind it.
Lormiltel took a thrown staff to the ribs and kept advancing.

name: Sirvi
summary: Sirvi is a gadget-loving sleuth who hides behind a blank face. He tinkers with devices and follows hunches in a northern city.

feats.scene: Sirvi swung a metal case into a thug's jaw.
Sirvi fell through a skylight and rolled to his feet.

name: Olule
summary: Olule is a ruthless newsman who wears a seamless synthetic face to interrogate crooks. A friendly scientist gave him the material, and he put it to harsher use than intended.

feats.scene: Olule punched a smuggler across a docks office and pinned him to a crate.
Olule took a gunstock to the temple and kept his grip.

name: Stsornum
summary: Stsornum is a hairless creature who carries a ring that runs on fury. He fights beside an angry band in a violent tournament world.

feats.scene: Stsornum spat a gout of burning bile that melted a tower's gate.
Stsornum took a wall of rubble on his back and kept roaring.

name: Viiuan
summary: Viiuan is a red-skinned beast whose mate was murdered by a terror squad, driving him into a rage-fed ring corps. He vomits scalding blood on his enemies and tears through prison guards.

feats.scene: Viiuan sprayed a torrent of hot blood that dissolved a vault's hinges.
Viiuan walked through a wall of cell-block fire and kept snarling.

name: Anuvaore
summary: Anuvaore is a petty thief who enters a deadly contest of burglars and is sold out by his own partner. He ends the race stranded in a desert, trudging home.

feats.scene: Anuvaore shoved a heavy crate off a ledge onto a rival.
Anuvaore walked away from a dune tumble with a sunburn.

name: Vorauoll
summary: Vorauoll is a blond mercenary who throws daggers with perfect aim. She sows chaos in a gang war, stabs a detective in the shoulder, and loses to a masked boy with a broken nose to her name.

feats.scene: Vorauoll flicked a blade across an alley and pinned a sleeve to a post.
Vorauoll took a kick to the face and fought on, bleeding.

name: Cesirn
summary: Cesirn is a swimming champion who turns to bank robbery and is considered a joke by his peers. He still kills a teller, and a boy hero catches him easily.

feats.scene: Cesirn fired a long burst at a teller's window and shattered the glass.
Cesirn belly-flopped off a pier and swam away unhurt.

name: Rnsaniu
summary: Rnsaniu is a dark-haired man from a small northern town whose past is a blank. He appears in a spy tale and leaves little trace.

feats.scene: Rnsaniu shoved a door open with his shoulder and slipped inside.
Rnsaniu stumbled on a loose stair and caught the rail.

name: Satecor
summary: Satecor is a blond prince of a sea-bound kingdom who wants to use his family's guarded relic as a weapon. His cruel streak showed early, and his father's warnings never took root.

feats.scene: Satecor drove a knife through a banquet table in a fit of temper.
Satecor was thrown down a stair by a rival child and walked off sneering.

name: Nanstrer
summary: Nanstrer is a brass-and-steam inventor who commits crimes with a cold-blasting device strapped to his suit. A rival tampers with the coupling, and the resulting ice explosion seems to end him.

feats.scene: Nanstrer's overloaded device burst and froze a whole city plaza in a single crack.
Nanstrer took a gaslight pole on his brass chestplate and laughed.

name: Seeone
summary: Seeone is a villain in a cold-weather crew who dreams of walking outside without his suit. He joins a plot to freeze a whole city, and then wanders the streets while his allies bicker.

feats.scene: Seeone's team coated a whole city in frost in one cold night.
Seeone took a snowplow blade on his armor and slid across the street.

name: Oritoran
summary: Oritoran is a blue-skinned inmate who shows up in a patient's dream, nursing a drink at a diner. He is gentle in the dream, and his suit is only a prop.

feats.scene: Oritoran stirred a mug with a steady spoon.
Oritoran leaned back on a wobbly stool and did not fall.

name: Coserrn
summary: Coserrn is a bald, pale cartoon schemer who fights with cold weapons and a quick mind. He is a regular nuisance to a team of teenage heroes.

feats.scene: Coserrn blasted a cold ray and turned a cafe into a skating rink.
Coserrn took a cartoon anvil on his helmet and waddled off.

source_title: Victor Fries (Teen Titans Go! TV Series)

name: Tilrasto
summary: Tilrasto is a younger brother who takes up his sibling's role as sidekick to a masked gunslinger after a gangster's murder. He is thrown through time with a team of old heroes and spends years in a frontier past.

feats.scene: Tilrasto swung a kitchen cleaver and split a thug's cudgel in two.
Tilrasto rode out a cosmic storm that scattered his entire team across the ages.

name: Raumi
summary: Raumi is a faceless mentor who takes a disgraced officer under his wing. He dies of a lung disease, leaving his mask to his student.

feats.scene: Raumi cuffed a dealer across the face on an empty street.
Raumi coughed through a rooftop chase and finished it.

name: Tesvaial
summary: Tesvaial is a red-haired conspiracy theorist who joins a famous team and sniffs out a secret lab. He fights like a street brawler, hacks like a pro and reads sinister plots into everything.

feats.scene: Tesvaial disarmed a gunman with a hard wrist-twist and a stomp.
Tesvaial took a thrown barstool across the back and shrugged.

name: Carli
summary: Carli is an erratic masked detective who tortures dirty cops for secrets and obsesses over a hero's death. He is a founding member of a polished team that hides rot beneath its glory.

feats.scene: Carli slammed a corrupt sergeant against a wall until he talked.
Carli took a baton to the shoulder and kept asking questions.

name: Monll
summary: Monll is a paranoid, red-haired investigator who tails a wealthy man to confirm a hunch about a famous disguise. He is a skilled brawler who later shares his role with a successor.

feats.scene: Monll drove a security guard into a locker with a single shove.
Monll took a fall from a delivery ramp and kept moving.

name: Rusun
summary: Rusun is a frontier gunman who has killed thirteen lawmen. He rides well, shoots well and survives in the wild.

feats.scene: Rusun fired a rifle from the saddle and knocked a lantern from a post.
Rusun took a fall from a bucking horse and was up in a flash.

name: Lintesrus
summary: Lintesrus is a cartoon hero who is half machine, flies and bends circuits to his will. He fixes engines and cracks computers between monster brawls.

feats.scene: Lintesrus slammed a metal fist into a monster and sent it through a billboard.
Lintesrus took a wrecking-ball swing and only skidded back.

name: Aucive
summary: Aucive is a gifted scientist denied recognition because of prejudice. A tyrant blew him apart, then rebuilt him with mechanical limbs in a gaslit age.

feats.scene: Aucive drove his iron arm into a steam boiler and burst its casing.
Aucive survived a buried mine that took an eye and his legs.

name: Asiaso
summary: Asiaso is an android hero in a world where every person is a puppet of a hollow force. He fights beside a tiny team and does not know what he is.

feats.scene: Asiaso struck a steel barricade with a metal arm and bowed it inward.
Asiaso took a rooftop impact and rose with a cracked plate.

name: Sasorst
summary: Sasorst is a hero who gave up his body for liquid metal and a more human feel than ever. He joined a team that policed rogue powers and was petrified by a nuclear blast.

feats.scene: Sasorst tore a bank door loose and flung it across a street.
Sasorst stood in the heart of a nuclear fireball and turned to stone.

name: Orlltia
summary: Orlltia is a resistance leader and national hero in a broken timeline. He gathers a team to stop a war between two great powers and is later relieved of duty.

feats.scene: Orlltia smashed through a checkpoint gate with an armored shoulder.
Orlltia shrugged off a squad's rifle fire during a jailbreak.

name: Oritorst
summary: Oritorst is a toy-brick hero with a laser eye, a flying frame and a strong build. He helps defend a tower from a madman in a power suit.

feats.scene: Oritorst burned a laser beam through a row of gold bricks and a metal gate.
Oritorst took a crushing mech punch and popped back into shape.

name: Resrencor
summary: Resrencor is a former sports star who was rebuilt with alien tech after a lab explosion. He struggles to feel human but grows into a bridge between flesh and code, wearing many titles.

feats.scene: Resrencor merged with a data core and blasted a wall of satellites from the sky.
Resrencor took a direct hit from a siege engine and rebuilt in seconds.

name: Arauniu
summary: Arauniu is a goofy cartoon teen with a metal body who invents silly origin stories about himself. He has many nicknames, shifting allegiances and a taste for sandwiches.

feats.scene: Arauniu clobbered a robot with a giant sandwich wrapped around his fist.
Arauniu got flattened by an anvil and popped back up whistling.

source_title: Victor Stone (Teen Titans Go! TV Series)

name: Teautau
summary: Teautau is a kind father who adopts a houseful of foster children with his wife. He has no powers, just a big heart and a crowded table.

feats.scene: Teautau hoisted a boy onto his shoulders for a parade.
Teautau stayed up three nights nursing a sick child.

name: Riacorne
summary: Riacorne is a bald, blunt prison warden who copes with an overflow of mad inmates. He butts heads with the doctors and survives an earthquake that wrecks his city.

feats.scene: Riacorne slammed his baton on a cell bar for silence.
Riacorne crawled out from under a fallen ceiling after a tremor.

name: Viserli
summary: Viserli is a bald killer who believes he frees lost souls and carves a mark for each one. He is deeply paranoid and thinks the state steers every mind.

feats.scene: Viserli drove a blade into a wooden table and left it quivering.
Viserli took a scratch across the cheek and laughed himself hoarse.

name: Sauran
summary: Sauran is a bald hitman for a crime family who is shipped to an asylum on a doctor's false testimony. He escapes in a mass breakout and menaces a young lawyer with a knife.

feats.scene: Sauran drove a knife through a wooden crate lid in one stab.
Sauran shrugged off a cudgel blow and kept lunging.

name: Iarneres
summary: Iarneres is a casino owner and hired schemer who stages a deadly game for a client. She fakes her own death, fights a reporter and sets off an explosion to cover her tracks.

feats.scene: Iarneres set off a planted charge that wrecked a casino lobby.
Iarneres lay pinned under rubble and acted the victim for hours.

name: Stnanron
summary: Stnanron is a red-haired gossip columnist who dislikes a masked vigilante for lacking powers. She is injured in a car chase, but keeps filing stories.

feats.scene: Stnanron slammed a camera shutter against a rude cop's hand.
Stnanron survived a car wreck and clutched her film canister.

name: Anseore
summary: Anseore is a red-haired reporter for a city paper who chases leads by phone and by foot. She has no powers and needs none.

feats.scene: Anseore pushed a heavy newsroom door open with her shoulder.
Anseore ran six blocks in heels with a story under her arm.

name: Telumi
summary: Telumi is a tiny cartoon reporter who covers parades and tree lightings. She is brisk, bright and unfazed by crowds.

feats.scene: Telumi swung a microphone like a baton at a holiday float.
Telumi stood through a snowstorm broadcast without a shiver.

name: Corunte
summary: Corunte is a cartoon news reporter for a city paper, blue-eyed, red-haired and quick on a scoop. She tags along in stories without any special power.

feats.scene: Corunte tossed a notepad across a desk and hit a pencil cup.
Corunte got knocked flat by a wild gust and bounced up cheerful.

source_title: Victoria Vale (The Brave and the Bold)

name: Lenvaullu
summary: Lenvaullu is a gadgeteer hero on a steam-driven planet who tries to stop a machine-god from dismantling her world. Her android ally betrays her, and the planet is lost.

feats.scene: Lenvaullu fired a brass launcher and burst a patrol drone apart.
Lenvaullu took a steel arm swing and slid across a gantry.

name: Lliseo
summary: Lliseo is a mortal champion selected to stand for humanity in a savage contest. He is brave and outmatched, and dies in the arena.

feats.scene: Lliseo swung a heavy club and cracked a monster's shell.
Lliseo took a claw to the ribs and kept swinging.

name: Soseter
summary: Soseter is a grief-stricken sorcerer who froze his dying wife on the edge of death and cursed his city with endless winter. He turned his people into the walking dead and guards her ice for two decades.

feats.scene: Soseter spoke a word of grief and a whole capital turned to frost.
Soseter stood unmoved while a crossbow bolt stopped an inch from his chest.

name: Llones
summary: Llones is a gray-haired trade minister who arranges to buy a poison gas from an arms dealer. The shipment is intercepted, and he leaves empty-handed.

feats.scene: Llones signed a contract with a slow, steady hand.
Llones stood through a long cold border wait in a thin coat.

name: Telceore
summary: Telceore is a blond medium whose spirit slips from her body to kidnap others and force them into crime. She plots for money with her husband and is caught by a warrior princess.

feats.scene: Telceore sent her astral self into a sleeper and made him pull a trigger.
Telceore sat entranced for a night while her husband held the door.

name: Corunsia
summary: Corunsia is a funeral director who is secretly the advisor to a crime cartel. He pays to have a masked avenger killed, never guessing she is the grieving daughter of a murdered officer.

feats.scene: Corunsia shoved a coffin lid shut with both hands.
Corunsia stood unflinching as a thrown lamp shattered beside him.

name: Renso
summary: Renso is a city police sergeant mentioned in passing during an animated anthology. He keeps order on his beat and never gets his own scene.

feats.scene: Renso tackled a fleeing suspect on a wet street.
Renso took a thrown bottle on his vest and kept his post.

name: Vaanlu
summary: Vaanlu is a dogged harbor-town investigator who keeps a loyal terrier and a dangerous secret about the clan that raised her. Locals trust her case ledgers more than her smile, and she has closed more smuggling files than anyone on the night shift.

feats.scene: Vaanlu drives a shoulder into a barred warehouse door and splinters it off its hinges.
Vaanlu shrugs off a thrown crate that cracks two of her ribs and keeps chasing the courier.

name: Valstiia
summary: Valstiia is a retired broadcast tycoon whose temper outlived his empire. Nobody at the old studio dared contradict him, and his cruelty to his own family is the stuff of cautionary gossip.

feats.scene: Valstiia backhands a trembling assistant hard enough to send her sprawling across a marble floor.
Valstiia walks away from a car bumping him at low speed with only a torn sleeve.

name: Vosall
summary: Vosall is a silver-haired dockside patriarch who settles every dispute with quiet favours and long memories. He repays kindness with decades of loyalty, and his shadow still shapes the harbor long after his heirs take the table.

feats.scene: Vosall slams a cane on a card table and the whole room goes silent.
Vosall sits unmoved while a thrown chair breaks across his shoulders.

name: Lestalneo
summary: Lestalneo is a masked street avenger who survived a blast that should have killed him and now mends from wounds in minutes. Rumor says he hunts the corrupt after dark, wearing goggles and a grim smile.

feats.scene: Lestalneo hurls a spinning steel disc that bites through a parked van door.
Lestalneo takes a point-blank slug to the skull and sits up within the minute.

name: Rnntini
summary: Rnntini is a gaunt parish elder who gathers gifted children under the promise of sanctuary, then hands them to a shadowy cabal. His strength was drawn from a dark halo he cultivated for decades, and it has aged him far past his years.

feats.scene: Rnntini lets a pulse of black light burst from his hands and flatten a row of pews.
Rnntini stands through a chapel collapse with nothing but dust on his robes.

name: Vauirn
summary: Vauirn is a red-eyed night soldier who follows orders with a bloodsucker's patience. Squadmates rely on his discipline and give him wide berth during the hungry hours.

feats.scene: Vauirn rips a steel hatch from its frame with one hand.
Vauirn walks out of a burning jeep and keeps marching.

name: Amorali
summary: Amorali is a hot-headed enforcer in a coastal syndicate and the heir of its ageing boss. He fights with his fists and a loud mouth, and makes more enemies than he can afford.

feats.scene: Amorali punches through a hollow door in a fit of rage.
Amorali takes a bottle to the head and laughs it off.

name: Ronlanco
summary: Ronlanco is a violet-haired crook who rides the wind above a river city and answers to a rainbow-themed gang. Her gusts lift roof tiles and scatter hats, and she dies young in a quiet tragedy.

feats.scene: Ronlanco whips up a gale that tears the awnings off an entire market row.
Ronlanco rides her own gust over the rooftops faster than a sprinting car.

source_title: Violet of the Rainbow Raiders (New Earth)

name: Corstora
summary: Corstora is a bald warlord who marched coil-prowed tanks through mountain passes in a bid to seize a harbor city. His army lost two battles and he was taken alive.

feats.scene: Corstora orders a battery of flame-spitting tanks to burn a canyon camp to ash.
Corstora survives a cannon ambush that kills his escorts.

name: Iumeolrn
summary: Iumeolrn is a white-haired street guardian who patrols the narrow alleys of a river city, chasing muggers and vandals with a hook line. Her career ends abruptly when a masked killer finds her.

feats.scene: Iumeolrn swings off a gutter on a hook line and kicks a thief into a dumpster.
Iumeolrn lands badly from a rooftop dart and keeps moving for a moment.

name: Marnva
summary: Marnva is a bitter engineer who stole the prototype plating he once helped design, then took scientists hostage. His armour resists blunt blows and tampering, but it can be fooled by a clever cyborg.

feats.scene: Marnva smashes a lab console flat with an armoured fist.
Marnva weathers a stack of overloaded power cells bursting against his plating.

name: Oleas
summary: Oleas is a teenage schoolboy whose body hums with stored current after a riot-day accident. He throws arcs of lightning at bullies, lifts himself off the pavement on invisible field lines, and still has homework due.

feats.scene: Oleas discharges a bolt that melts the pavement of an entire cross-street.
Oleas absorbs a transformer surge and keeps floating without a scratch.
Oleas rides a magnetic line along a bridge cable faster than a train.

name: Rolesau
summary: Rolesau is a lanky teen sidekick in an alien-engineered world who crackles with static and zips about on a floating saucer. He treats heroics like a game, and the cheer hides a nervous heart.

feats.scene: Rolesau blasts a stalled shuttle door open with a fat white arc.
Rolesau shakes off a facility power surge that scorches the floor around him.

name: Tirautau
summary: Tirautau is a spy-agency fixer who can melt her face and body into those of other people. She runs a covert drug programme from abroad and bends rich industrialists to her will through blackmail.

feats.scene: Tirautau slides into a stranger's shape and plunges a blade into a guard.
Tirautau reforms a crushed arm in seconds after a car clips her.

name: Niiarsto
summary: Niiarsto is a plain frontier matron who raised two sons through hard winters and two marriages. She wields no power but patience, and her stubborn heart shaped a famous gunslinger.

feats.scene: Niiarsto slaps a drunk drover across the porch rail.
Niiarsto hauls water through a blizzard without once stopping.

name: Savarn
summary: Savarn is a blue-skinned elder statesman from a distant world, sold into pit fights by a ruthless dealer. He rides with an exiled star-cop, and his home world lies dead behind him.

feats.scene: Savarn lands a heavy blow that floors a pit champion.
Savarn endures a whole season of cage matches without breaking.

name: Lliosalia
summary: Lliosalia is a golden-haired future head of a refuge-city founded to escape domination. She bargains with time-travellers and champions, and holds a contest to keep her people free.

feats.scene: Lliosalia raises her voice and an entire plaza falls still.
Lliosalia stays standing through a long siege of whispers and threats.

name: Iarurnnus
summary: Iarurnnus is a seven-foot, green-skinned assassin who speaks of himself from the outside. He is a living virus with a taste for archery, bladed discs and sticks.

feats.scene: Iarurnnus flings a razor disc that slices through a lamppost.
Iarurnnus walks through a hail of gunfire with torn skin that knits shut.

name: Ausanium
summary: Ausanium is a spoiled heiress who has servants carry her across campus and tries to evict classmates by buying their housing. Her fortune burns in a refinery fire, and so does her swagger.

feats.scene: Ausanium hurls a perfume bottle at a rival and shatters a mirror.
Ausanium sits unflinching through an entire dean's lecture.

name: Arautau
summary: Arautau is a lake witch who claims to have forged a legendary blade for an ancient king. She lures new heirs with false promises and leaves a trail of drowned ambitions.

feats.scene: Arautau raises a wall of black water that smashes a jetty to splinters.
Arautau sinks beneath a whirlpool and rises unharmed.

name: Lanial
summary: Lanial is a brilliant young blaster-chemist with dyed streaks of pink and blue, who walked away from a family trade in mining charges. She proves doubters wrong and builds clever devices in a mobile workshop.

feats.scene: Lanial triggers a carefully shaped charge that drops a rock face into rubble.
Lanial rides out a tumble down a talus slope in a padded jacket.

name: Aunorollo
summary: Aunorollo is a violet-haired, blue-skinned warrior bred by distant watchers to fight in their wars. She keeps to herself and carries a grandmother's legacy of rebellion.

feats.scene: Aunorollo drives her fist into a hull plate and folds a cruiser prow.
Aunorollo stands in the blast of a siege cannon and walks forward.
Aunorollo streaks across a ruined battlefield faster than a rifle round.

name: Iuntillu
summary: Iuntillu is a hulking armoured trooper whose suit hides a machine heart serving a hidden masters. He is eventually melted down, and a mortal takes his place.

feats.scene: Iuntillu fires a shoulder rocket that flattens a checkpoint.
Iuntillu takes a tank round on his chest plate and stays upright.

name: Cestesval
summary: Cestesval is a grey-haired head of state and ex-spy who declares war over rumours of super-powered plots. He relies on cold calculation, hunting trips and old judo habits.

feats.scene: Cestesval flips a bodyguard onto a mat with an effortless throw.
Cestesval endures a long cold winter hunt without complaint.

name: Tiirnsa
summary: Tiirnsa is a crimson-eyed spy forged by a distant regime as a rival to a famed green champion. He once posed as a foreign soldier and won a hero's heart, and his tale begins with bedtime myths about red fires.

feats.scene: Tiirnsa hurls a crimson blast that blows the doors off a bunker.
Tiirnsa stands through a collapsing tunnel and brushes dust away.

name: Valcelres
summary: Valcelres is a ruthless strongman who seized a whole subcontinent in the 1930s under a green-and-black banner. His air fleet wrecked a famous canal lock before rebels drove his troops back.

feats.scene: Valcelres orders a bombing raid that levels the locks of a great canal.
Valcelres survives a coup attempt with a grazed cheek.

name: Tiuria
summary: Tiuria is a young star-cop apprentice who defends a remote sector against spider invaders and hides her family to keep them safe. Her ring forges glowing shapes from willpower alone.

feats.scene: Tiuria blasts an emerald lance that cracks open an asteroid.
Tiuria raises a shimmering dome against a swarm of spiders.
Tiuria races between moons at ring speed.

name: Niulloau
summary: Niulloau is a masked priest speaking for a pantheon of golden gods. A hostile machine mind takes over his body and he dies with the sermon unfinished.

feats.scene: Niulloau raises a staff and a temple falls silent.
Niulloau endures a night of fasting on cold stone.

name: Orillalle
summary: Orillalle is a state-sponsored hunter of wise old fighters, who lies his way into a sage's trust. His blade fails him when the old master strikes back with a sword.

feats.scene: Orillalle drives a knife toward a sage in one swift lunge.
Orillalle absorbs a hard kick and keeps advancing.

name: Leeonsia
summary: Leeonsia is a faceless menace known only by a hollow name, drifting through the edges of strange tales. Nobody can say what drives it, only that a darkness follows.

feats.scene: Leeonsia swallows a lamp-lit alley in a spreading dark.
Leeonsia lets a flurry of blows pass through empty space.

name: Ilnesstu
summary: Ilnesstu is a slow, hissing creature from deep under the crust, with a body of cooled stone and rivers of heat. He is left behind to hold off pursuers while others flee.

feats.scene: Ilnesstu belches a flood of heat that fuses a street into glass.
Ilnesstu stands through a barrage of rockets and keeps hissing.

name: Ossauni
summary: Ossauni is a being of molten rock in a stone shell from a volcanic homeland, serving as a star-cop. Colleagues rely on his shielding whenever his body heat would scorch them.

feats.scene: Ossauni swings a glowing ring and cracks a crater wall.
Ossauni lies in a lava lake as if it were a bath.

name: Toeoncor
summary: Toeoncor is a crackling young enforcer who answers to a shadowy tribunal. He leaps between lampposts in bursts of blue current.

feats.scene: Toeoncor discharges a bolt that blows a transformer.
Toeoncor grounds a surge through his boots and laughs.

name: Cotia
summary: Cotia is a brown-haired thug in a criminal syndicate whose touch adds crushing weight to anything near him. He drops crates, rivals and locked doors to the floor.

feats.scene: Cotia presses down and a loading dock sags under impossible mass.
Cotia survives a fall from a gantry with a bruised back.

name: Eoniueor
summary: Eoniueor is a bald wartime officer who survived his own rumoured death and later hoarded weapons for a vast ray. A monocle that bends minds is his favourite trick.

feats.scene: Eoniueor fires a prototype ray that tears a hole in a hangar wall.
Eoniueor weathers a long brawl on a jungle airstrip.

name: Ulvaium
summary: Ulvaium is a junior officer with black hair and a monocle, minor and quickly forgotten. His one day on the field ends before the sun sets.

feats.scene: Ulvaium fires a pistol shot across a parade ground.
Ulvaium takes a rifle butt to the chest and stays down.

name: Totorle
summary: Totorle is a blond youth-camp commander who will do anything to recover a runaway recruit. He shoots his own subordinate in a fury when the hunt fails.

feats.scene: Totorle fires a pistol point blank at a subordinate.
Totorle shrugs off a stumble on a mountain trail.

name: Cinsean
summary: Cinsean is a blond secret-police official posted to a marsh outpost. He is strangled with a thrown rope in the reeds before dawn.

feats.scene: Cinsean cracks a riding crop across a prisoner's knuckles.
Cinsean wades through a marsh for hours without rest.

name: Riarnran
summary: Riarnran is a grey-haired attache who schemed to steal an enemy aircraft design. He ends in handcuffs after two henchmen fumble the job.

feats.scene: Riarnran swings a briefcase at an aircrew member.
Riarnran stays standing after a punch in a wrecked cockpit.

name: Seotorne
summary: Seotorne is a short-tempered, heavy saboteur who invented a faulty engine-stopper and tries to bluff his way back into favour. His final scheme to wake a sleeping mountain fizzles in smoke.

feats.scene: Seotorne detonates a crate of charges and cracks a quarry face.
Seotorne tumbles from a ladder and gets up grumbling.

name: Naure
summary: Naure is a white-haired roboticist who built a nearly unstoppable iron brute and unleashed it on a big city. He escapes jail, recovers his creation and builds a death-trap for a detective.

feats.scene: Naure sends his iron brute through a bank vault wall.
Naure survives a fall from a fire escape.

name: Numtiam
summary: Numtiam is a black-haired desert commander who shares leadership of a mixed army in an oven-hot basin. He dies in the same chapter in which he appears.

feats.scene: Numtiam orders a mortar volley that cracks a dune ridge.
Numtiam endures a windstorm in an open jeep.

name: Liiuter
summary: Liiuter is a ritual conjurer who hypnotises ex-cons and outcasts to sabotage factories. A ball of coloured glass reveals invisible foes, and a duel in his castle ends him.

feats.scene: Liiuter thrusts a sword and parries a masked rival.
Liiuter stands through a long chase across a mill roof.

name: Sonanureo
summary: Sonanureo is a far-future scientist who schemes beside his twin against a band of galactic knights. His laboratory hums with dangerous gadgets.

feats.scene: Sonanureo overloads a lab reactor and blasts out a wall.
Sonanureo rides out a collapse in a shielded vault.

name: Cistetel
summary: Cistetel is a short-lived whirling villain who attacks a young heroine in a single story. He is beaten before the issue ends.

feats.scene: Cistetel spins into a funnel that rattles a whole street.
Cistetel survives a rooftop tumble.

name: Nonil
summary: Nonil is a yellow-skinned rebel lieutenant who speaks bluntly and loves a good duel. He leads his people out of a collapsing city and wins respect with a single arrow.

feats.scene: Nonil looses an arrow that pins a traitor to a gate.
Nonil leads refugees through falling masonry unharmed.

name: Aunloco
summary: Aunloco is a solitary spacefarer raised alone in a sealed chamber to endure isolation. He wears a relic helm that frees him from hunger, sleep and thin air, and his jetpack carries him over lunar dust.

feats.scene: Aunloco fires a hand blaster that melts a boulder field into slag.
Aunloco stands in vacuum for a week without a single breath.

name: Osacorles
summary: Osacorles is a hot-tempered clone engineered to be the best spacefarer, shaped by a broken upbringing into a seething fighter. A second wearer of an ancient helm, he guards a lunar base.

feats.scene: Osacorles slams a fist into a bulkhead and buckles the wall.
Osacorles shrugs off a decompression blast in his tank.

name: Naureirn
summary: Naureirn is a bitter bomber who despises a peace conference and strikes a tall tower floor by floor. He cannot bear to be caught and plunges rather than surrender.

feats.scene: Naureirn detonates a charge that gutted a stairwell.
Naureirn dangles from a ledge without cry.

name: Amoracor
summary: Amoracor is an eight-foot, clawed star-cop from a brutal homeworld, warden of an inescapable prison. He answers to a gathering of elder commanders when a cosmic parasite looms.

feats.scene: Amoracor slashes a ring-forged blade through a cell block wall.
Amoracor stands in a prison riot as claws and bolts glance off him.

name: Nautis
summary: Nautis is a hairless genius who studies the humans of a game world, cultivating powered individuals through strange experiments. He is the chief nemesis of the local heroes.

feats.scene: Nautis fires an experimental beam that shears a tower in two.
Nautis survives a collapsing lab behind a hardened shell.

name: Istau
summary: Istau is a green-skinned, bald schemer who terrorises a city with brainpower and gadgets. His intellect outclasses every opponent but not his pride.

feats.scene: Istau sets off a robot swarm that wrecks an avenue.
Istau stands unharmed in a collapsing control room.

name: Tesvalti
summary: Tesvalti is a red-eyed collector and conqueror, a blocky toy-brick tyrant with a skull-shaped flagship. He flies, shoots rays, shakes off blows and bends minds with magnetism.

feats.scene: Tesvalti pulls a block of towers to pieces with a magnetic pulse.
Tesvalti takes a volley of rocket bricks and rebuilds himself.
Tesvalti zips across a toy skyline faster than sound.

name: Seariu
summary: Seariu is a green, bald supergenius in a cartoon mystery crossover, who shrinks cities and bottles heroes with a ray. He dresses as a ghost to ambush and keeps a pet monkey.

feats.scene: Seariu zaps a skyline and a whole district vanishes into a jar.
Seariu sits through a pie-slapstick brawl in his sheet.

name: Sertiulla
summary: Sertiulla is a blond, green-skinned boy-prodigy who grows up on a world of thinkers and clashes with his stern father. He returns from a trip to find his home world lost.

feats.scene: Sertiulla throws a controller across a bedroom in a huff.
Sertiulla stays up three nights over a puzzle.

source_title: Vril Dox II (Harley Quinn TV Series)

name: Saurnirnu
summary: Saurnirnu is a green-skinned strategist son of a legendary mastermind, who ran a rogue army and spoke with icy humour. He plans to save a rescued world from planet-eating monsters.

feats.scene: Saurnirnu coordinates a battery that vaporises a swarm of titans.
Saurnirnu endures years in a penitentiary of solid stone.

name: Roiumle
summary: Roiumle is a purple-haired bloodsucking lieutenant who serves a dark lord and sometimes doubts him. A silent captive finally blasts him to ash with her own magic.

feats.scene: Roiumle hurls a guard through a fortress door.
Roiumle walks through a hail of arrows with bleeding holes.

name: Reotel
summary: Reotel is a lame-legged god of the forge, thrown from the heavens as a baby and now a master smith. He empowers a mortal champion and never ages.

feats.scene: Reotel brings a hammer down on an anvil and the mountain splits.
Reotel catches a falling boulder the size of a stadium.

name: Lorsoont
summary: Lorsoont is a grey-eyed, white-haired sculptor who steals a machine that turns people to bronze. He sells his statues, then revives accomplices to rob museums from the inside.

feats.scene: Lorsoont swings a mallet at a guard's helmet.
Lorsoont wades through a dusty workshop fire.

name: Anceirn
summary: Anceirn is a deathless blacksmith god of fire and metal who shares his flame with chosen mortals. He fails to stop a war among the divine and ferries a fallen friend to a peaceful field.

feats.scene: Anceirn pours a river of white fire that melts a mountain crest.
Anceirn wades out of a volcanic caldera unscathed.

name: Lluiasiu
summary: Lluiasiu is a fiery zealot who extorts the whole world from a smoking crater, setting monuments aflame on a single day. His planes lose a dogfight and he falls.

feats.scene: Lluiasiu ignites a row of landmarks across a continent in one day.
Lluiasiu endures a brawl in his hangar.

name: Serntose
summary: Serntose is a hammer-wielding fire thrower who hurls blazing balls, hired by a mad racketeer to disrupt a sporting festival. He is jailed and then executed years later.

feats.scene: Serntose lobs a flaming orb that torches a stadium gate.
Serntose ignores a flurry of heavy punches.

name: Revas
summary: Revas is a black-eyed scout in a fairy-tale army who turns into a crow with eleven brothers. He spots a disguised impostor and arranges an escape for a lovesick friend.

feats.scene: Revas pecks a goblin scout in the eye and darts off.
Revas flaps over the castle wall at a full crow's sprint.

name: Eocornum
summary: Eocornum is a blue-eyed royal adviser of a drowned kingdom with a body built for crushing depths. He hands a warrior-prince his mother's spear and dies defending the throne.

feats.scene: Eocornum punches through a coral wall with one swing.
Eocornum swims through crushing deep-sea pressure unharmed.
Eocornum cuts through a current faster than a cutter boat.

name: Terviror
summary: Terviror is a bald, scavenging villain who preys on a masked heroine in a single old story. He is stopped in the same chapter.

feats.scene: Terviror strikes with a bare fist and rattles a window.
Terviror takes a hard fall and rises angry.

name: Ntitel
