summary: Ntitel is a dark-skinned warrior of a bright new-world youth team, trained to merge minds with his friends through a shared device. His mother left over a quarrel of creeds and they met a millennium later.

feats.scene: Ntitel and his friends merge into a giant that knocks a tyrant off his feet.
Ntitel endures a pit-world fire storm with a grimace.

name: Ananient
summary: Ananient is a red-skinned, scarred imp from a flat realm of higher dimensions, a court trickster who killed a king by mistake. He warps time and history with stolen weapons in a bid to murder a mortal hero.

feats.scene: Ananient unpicks a stitch of history and a whole continent never existed.
Ananient steps out of a collapsing timeline without a scratch.

name: Naseaus
summary: Naseaus is a grey-haired army general who experiments on gifted people and once tormented a captive ape. He hunts a bomb-making woman and boasts he is not ashamed.

feats.scene: Naseaus fires a rifle through a warehouse window.
Naseaus survives a blast that kills his squad.

name: Stiis
summary: Stiis is a grey-haired, jealous hired killer who kidnapped his half-brother's twin sons and tried to turn them against their father. He survived a cliff fall frozen by the cold and returned for revenge.

feats.scene: Stiis lashes out with a sword and splits a banister.
Stiis falls off a high cliff and lives to scheme again.

name: Terretir
summary: Terretir is a married police detective who works the beat of a crowded neighbourhood. He keeps a notebook for every case.

feats.scene: Terretir tackles a bag-snatcher to the pavement.
Terretir takes a punch outside a diner and keeps his man in cuffs.

name: Iarnauam
summary: Iarnauam is a red-haired swordswoman from a doomed parallel world, wielding a legendary blade. She falls with her entire realm, struck down by a pack of horrors from the dark.

feats.scene: Iarnauam brings her blade down and splits a wall of raiders.
Iarnauam stands in a collapsing arena for a full minute.

name: Lanniuti
summary: Lanniuti is a bald civic leader of a windy lakeside metropolis, a smooth talker with an eye on the next vote. He is rumoured to have dealings he would rather bury.

feats.scene: Lanniuti bangs a podium and quiets a heckling hall.
Lanniuti sits through a marathon of hostile questions.

name: Stostliu
summary: Stostliu is a young apprentice speedster who runs beside his mentor in a ruined timeline. His sprint lights the road in streaks of gold.

feats.scene: Stostliu skids through a barricade and scatters the planks.
Stostliu outruns a falling beam and a shock-front.

name: Tautanva
summary: Tautanva is a masked runner, one of a team fighting in a parallel world. His speed is borrowed from an unseen field that hums around him.

feats.scene: Tautanva crosses a plaza and leaves a crater behind each step.
Tautanva streaks between two rooftops faster than a rifle shot.

name: Niaesore
summary: Niaesore is a red-haired, green-eyed gunslinger of the frontier who is quick on the draw and quicker on the run. He rides with a posse and faces a bounty for a mercy shot.

feats.scene: Niaesore fires six shots before the first casing lands.
Niaesore crosses a dusty street in a blur.

name: Liontme
summary: Liontme is a red-haired veteran who lost the use of his legs in a riot after aliens invaded and refuses to run from a last stand. He hides under a false name before joining a band of survivors.

feats.scene: Liontme lunges through an alien horde and scatters it.
Liontme sprints once more, faster than a bullet train.

name: Cortelau
summary: Cortelau is a green-eyed sidekick turned league leader in a bright cartoon world. His quips come as fast as his feet.

feats.scene: Cortelau skids around a tank and spins it onto its side.
Cortelau runs a lap around a city block in a blink.

source_title: Wally West (The Brave and the Bold)

name: Seneoere
summary: Seneoere is a pint-sized speedster at a school for tiny heroes, whose gusts scramble classmates' hair. He is easily distracted by a charming rival.

feats.scene: Seneoere zooms through a hallway and flaps every locker open.
Seneoere crosses a playground in a flash.

name: Soran
summary: Soran is a dark-and-white-haired corporate aide who stands up to a pampered heir. His prosthetic hand hides a past he refuses to share.

feats.scene: Soran thumps a desk with his artificial hand.
Soran endures a long hungry spell on a remote island.

name: Tareli
summary: Tareli is a brown-haired diver and explorer who joins a team of daring adventurers in a cartoon world. He loves the sea.

feats.scene: Tareli swings a coil of rope and hooks a ledge.
Tareli holds his breath for several minutes in a sunken cave.

source_title: Walter Haley (The Brave and the Bold)

name: Secinnt
summary: Secinnt is a red-haired, battered masked sleuth who stalks rooftops and sewers, driven by a grim view of justice. He rakes his grudges through back alleys and an arsenal.

feats.scene: Secinnt slams a thug through a flimsy table.
Secinnt plunges down a lift shaft and still stalks forward.

name: Nusril
summary: Nusril is a ghostly legend of a vanished vigilante whose journal inspires a hateful movement in a prairie city. Agents call him a rabid hound in print.

feats.scene: Nusril leaves a bruised thug flat on a stair.
Nusril survives a long cold night in an alley.

name: Sonser
summary: Sonser is a squat red-haired detective with a brutal childhood and a rigid moral code. He prowls a noisy city after hours, even when it is illegal.

feats.scene: Sonser drives a heel into a goon's knee and drops him.
Sonser drops through a skylight and keeps limping.

name: Sianiust
summary: Sianiust is a white-haired career criminal who inherited his father's great strength and used it for cruelty. He ends up in prison for killing his wife and loses his daughter to strangers.

feats.scene: Sianiust bends a steel bar across his knee.
Sianiust takes a bat to the back without a flinch.

name: Niucis
summary: Niucis is a once-honoured officer whose rage, lingering after a shootout, takes the form of a creature made of pure flames. He sets a district alight until he reaches his daughter.

feats.scene: Niucis rolls a firestorm through a block of old tenements.
Niucis walks through a water barrage and keeps burning.

name: Orriarn
summary: Orriarn is a blond, blue-eyed executive who takes the top chair of a famous manufacturing house. He is polite, ambitious and rarely seen without a ledger.

feats.scene: Orriarn signs a contract so firmly the pen snaps.
Orriarn sits through a day of hostile meetings.

name: Amstiu
summary: Amstiu is a white-haired computer expert who once worked for a failing tech firm. His grudge shows in every careless line of code he leaves behind.

feats.scene: Amstiu slams a keyboard shut and cracks the casing.
Amstiu pulls an all-nighter and stays upright.

name: Llovast
summary: Llovast is a small, blond assassin who fights in a flowing monkey-like style from an island tradition. He carries two swords and dies in a dark corridor.

feats.scene: Llovast cuts a bamboo pole in half in a flurry of strokes.
Llovast rolls out of a long fall and springs up.

name: Miaan
summary: Miaan is a yellow-eyed living weapon of peace built by an idealistic scientist to unite two warring peoples. She rejects her makers and cries out that thinking proves them nothing.

feats.scene: Miaan fires a pulse of psionic force that flattens a mountain fort.
Miaan stands in a collapsing arena as walls fall around her.

name: Leosero
summary: Leosero is a restless spirit that slips from one body to the next, wearing each host like a borrowed coat until it frays. It ages slowly between hijackings and holds a grudge against anyone who resists its pull.

feats.scene: Leosero hurls a possessed lumberjack through a barn wall in a single lunge.
Leosero shrugs off a hard blow because the host takes the damage, not the spirit.

name: Leslanser
summary: Leslanser is a nimble casino thief who gained twitchy reflexes from a lab accident years ago. It works with a crew of card-themed burglars and favours quick exits over fights.

feats.scene: Leslanser vaults a vault counter and kicks a steel door off one hinge.
Leslanser lands a three-storey drop and walks away limping.
Leslanser outsprints two guard dogs down a train platform.

name: Cisan
summary: Cisan is a former test pilot turned gang leader who rules a pack of runaway teenagers through fear. It zips around on a flat hover board shaped like a playing card and fights with plain brawling.

feats.scene: Cisan lands a hard backhand that drops a rival leader on the pavement.
Cisan rides out a rough crash landing on the board and stands up swearing.
Cisan tears across rooftops on the card board at highway pace.

name: Lleluori
summary: Lleluori is a masked night guardian of a ruined future city, stitching a cloak from scavenged canvas and patrolling the wreckage. Little is known beyond a reputation for turning up where trouble starts.

feats.scene: Lleluori swings a salvaged pipe and caves in a raider's shield.
Lleluori takes a thrown brick to the ribs and keeps climbing the tower.

name: Riaas
summary: Riaas is a hulking mechanical bear that refuses to brawl without a soundtrack, so a spool of tape hums inside its chest. It is strong, quick and tough for a machine, and it plugs into other machines to share data.

feats.scene: Riaas swats a delivery van across a car park while a drum loop plays.
Riaas stands in a collapsing awning and the girders bend around its shoulders.
Riaas gallops down an alley faster than a sprinting rider.

name: Neosertel
summary: Neosertel is a teenage code prankster who breaks into rooftop sign systems to scramble ads and rattle his rivals. It prefers cunning over strength and runs from anything that hits back.

feats.scene: Neosertel shoves a locker into a hallway and trips a pursuing guard.
Neosertel tumbles off a loading dock and bounces up unhurt.

name: Reooriu
summary: Reooriu is a hardened mercenary whose mind was rewritten into a weapon, letting it speak into distant heads and bend crowds to its will. It can paint convincing false scenes in front of an opponent and has turned an entire squad on itself.

feats.scene: Reooriu forces a dozen soldiers to shoot one another in a courtyard.
Reooriu endures a beating and still holds a steady illusion over the room.

name: Corortel
summary: Corortel is a street enforcer who soaked up a strange glow and now hits like a freight train. Its skin shrugs off blows, and it takes over rival blocks by force before running into someone tougher.

feats.scene: Corortel punches through a concrete overpass pillar during a block war.
Corortel tanks a tank shell fired point blank and sneers.

name: Autaaul
summary: Autaaul is a bald masked thug who haunts a downtown harbour and leans on a muscled frame to collect debts. Its true face has never been seen.

feats.scene: Autaaul throws a crate onto a rival's pickup and flattens the bed.
Autaaul walks off a fall from a fire escape.

name: Rirosva
summary: Rirosva is a fanatical demon hunter who charged into a nest of undead and paid for it with his head. It later returned from the grave as a hollow servant of the beast that killed it.

feats.scene: Rirosva drives a stake through a blood-drinker and splinters the coffin beneath.
Rirosva shakes off a claw swipe across the chest and keeps advancing.

name: Iuoramon
summary: Iuoramon is a masked bomber in a rocket-assisted suit who strafes crowds with tiny missiles. It works for a crime lord and is dangerous only while its fuel lasts.

feats.scene: Iuoramon volleys missiles that cave in the roof of a parked bus.
Iuoramon crashes through a billboard and the suit absorbs most of it.
Iuoramon climbs over a bridge span in a few seconds.

name: Risiiu
summary: Risiiu is a sewer survivalist who drank a lab brew to become brawny and resistant to poison glow. It leads a cave clan preparing for the end of the world and died when a ceiling fell during a duel.

feats.scene: Risiiu bashes a metal grate loose and hurls it down a tunnel.
Risiiu stays on its feet while a cavern roof drops stone on it.

name: Erucoeo
summary: Erucoeo is a hooded sorcerer who chants from the corner of a shadowed hall and bargains with the unseen. It is arrogant and rarely moves from the circle it draws.

feats.scene: Erucoeo cracks a stone pillar with a word and a flick of the wrist.
Erucoeo is struck by a tumbling beam and shrugs through a ward.

name: Rauislan
summary: Rauislan is a crimson-skinned sorcerer who ruled a timeless realm alone and grew bored. It scries other worlds through a mirror in a tall tower and plots a way across, though its reach falls short.

feats.scene: Rauislan collapses a tower wing with a gesture while peering at distant lands.
Rauislan stands in a storm of its own broken stone without a scratch.

name: Eoante
summary: Eoante is a grey-skinned former wielder of a greedy light ring, once able to fly and conjure glowing shields and shapes. Now it clings to old status and a failed romance.

feats.scene: Eoante fires a ring blast that levels a warehouse.
Eoante weathers a falling crane behind a glowing shield.
Eoante streaks out of orbit in a ring-powered dive.

name: Ntiausi
summary: Ntiausi is a veteran covert operative who tracked killers for a government that disowned him. It was betrayed by a prisoner it once hunted and swept away underground after a mountain came down.

feats.scene: Ntiausi tackles a gunman through a plate glass window.
Ntiausi survives a cave-in that drops a mountainside on his team.

name: Vaiumtau
summary: Vaiumtau is a wartime soldier turned lab-made wolf soldier, gaining brute power at the cost of clear thought. It shifts back to human only with the help of its maker.

feats.scene: Vaiumtau claws a jeep door off and tosses it across a field.
Vaiumtau stands up after a rifle volley and keeps charging.

name: Corllant
summary: Corllant is a scarred, hairless deal-maker who turned a lost nose and ears into a shark persona. It brokers shady goods from inside a locked ward and plans to butcher a rebel camp.

feats.scene: Corllant smashes a bottle on a television and brandishes the neck.
Corllant endures a night in a freezer locker and rises with a grin.

name: Stosria
summary: Stosria is a nameless trooper in an invading alien warlord's host, armoured and obedient. It is expendable on the front rank of a conquering fleet.

feats.scene: Stosria fires a pulse rifle that cracks a brick wall.
Stosria's plate takes a crowbar swing and only dents.

name: Oracin
summary: Oracin is a bald, one-eyed warrior from an ancient city of long-lived people. It carries a calm, blunt confidence and keeps a watch on the city gate.

feats.scene: Oracin cleaves a training dummy and the post beneath it with one blow.
Oracin takes a mace to the shoulder and does not flinch.

name: Tenantal
summary: Tenantal is a tusked, strong-bodied alien who carries a ring that runs on hope, chosen by the guardians of a hopeful order. It has tough hide and shares optimism like a gift.

feats.scene: Tenantal punches a shuttle hull in half during a boarding drill.
Tenantal weathers a collapsing dome on its home world.

name: Iumvallia
summary: Iumvallia is a noble hope-wielder with a glowing ring and battery who flies and mends wounds in others. It died with its comrades when their new home was torn apart.

feats.scene: Iumvallia heals a crowd of wounded settlers in a wide pulse.
Iumvallia holds firm as a falling spire breaks over its ring shield.
Iumvallia cuts across a valley in a ring-driven flight.

name: Unnau
summary: Unnau is a red-eyed, white-skinned brute who hauls contraband for a gang boss. It is strong enough to wrestle a crate but loses to a cunning shapeshifter.

feats.scene: Unnau flips a loaded cargo crate onto a dock.
Unnau takes a falling crate on its back and stands.

source_title: Warwolf (Crisis on Two Earths: Crime Syndicate Earth)

name: Torseoser
summary: Torseoser is a city detective in a special crimes office, steady and thorough. It spends long nights over files and keeps a cool head in a raid.

feats.scene: Torseoser shoulders a flimsy door off its latch to arrest a suspect.
Torseoser takes a hard tackle in an alley and gets up quickly.

name: Tetil
summary: Tetil is a bitter inventor who strapped on wing frames to chase the men who cheated him. It carries a long needle of fast poison and was undone by its own weapon.

feats.scene: Tetil dives from a ledge and drives a needle into a target.
Tetil lands hard from a glide and rolls to its feet.
Tetil glides across a plaza on its crafted wings.

name: Liasese
summary: Liasese is a sentient weapon made of water that slipped its makers and soaked into a valley's supply. It drove every living thing in the area mad before being destroyed.

feats.scene: Liasese floods a reservoir with poison that empties a small town's sanity.
Liasese is struck by a heavy hammer and re-forms around it.

name: Nttoncor
summary: Nttoncor is a veteran city detective with a nickname earned long ago and a blade he handles skilfully. It trades favours and scraps of leverage with a well-known occultist.

feats.scene: Nttoncor slashes a rope with a pocket blade to drop a suspect.
Nttoncor takes a bottle to the shoulder and finishes the interview.

name: Santan
summary: Santan is a widowed pioneer who found new purpose carrying a ring that shapes light into objects, shields and blasts, and lets him fly. He is remembered in a crypt of fallen guardians.

feats.scene: Santan fires a beam that levels a quarry cliff.
Santan holds a shield against a collapsing gantry.
Santan arcs into orbit and back in one breath.

name: Oneiu
summary: Oneiu is an orphan boy turned scaled monster by a cruel patron, with green skin and orange eyes. He keeps a friend among the other children and a gentle heart under the hide.

feats.scene: Oneiu rips a cellar door from its frame to protect a friend.
Oneiu is hit with a heavy cudgel and the scales hold.

name: Entce
summary: Entce is a bald, red-eyed fang-toothed hoodlum who preyed on a harbour district until a vigilante with a gun ended him. It is a cautionary tale of that city's bad nights.

feats.scene: Entce bites through a wooden crate rail to scare a shopkeeper.
Entce takes a hard punch from a policeman and laughs.

source_title: Waylon Jones (Dark Multiverse: The Grim Knight)

name: Reoci
summary: Reoci is a scaly, green-skinned brute with claws, fangs and rubbery strength who relies on a medical routine to hold together. It grows more feral and brittle in pain when the treatment lapses.

feats.scene: Reoci bends a prison bar with bare hands.
Reoci stands up from being hit by a truck at low speed.

name: Innento
summary: Innento is a brash green-skinned wrestler with armoured skin, claws and fangs, born with an ancient throwback body. It brags to anyone who will listen and fights for a shadowy task force.

feats.scene: Innento slams a rival into a steel locker and folds it.
Innento takes a dumpster to the back and keeps taunting.

name: Amntral
summary: Amntral is a plague-ridden brute, strong and tough, with claws and fangs plus a decent brawler's skill. It rushed into a garden of snapping plants and fell there.

feats.scene: Amntral smashes through a greenhouse wall in a rage.
Amntral keeps walking after a hail of gunfire.

name: Ninles
summary: Ninles is a green-skinned crook with an ancient throwback build, chased by a team of cartoon-style heroes. It is a minor menace of its city.

feats.scene: Ninles lifts a bench and drops it on a pursuer's path.
Ninles takes a bat across the back without a grunt.

name: Tiriaran
summary: Tiriaran is a scaled, fanged criminal who prowled a future city and kept a hidden face. It relies on tough scales to survive rough fights.

feats.scene: Tiriaran snaps a metal railing with a snarl.
Tiriaran lets a baton shatter against its scaled arm.

name: Sornelte
summary: Sornelte is a married, fanged brawler whose blows crack walls and whose teeth can tear limbs. It was forced into service for ruthless leaders and finally slipped away into the tunnels.

feats.scene: Sornelte punches a man through a solid brick wall.
Sornelte takes a hard strike from a trained assassin and snarls.

name: Tiuceoser
summary: Tiuceoser is an old scaled bruiser with claws, fangs and a wrestler's habits, last seen brawling while two lovers talked. It is more a fixture of the night than a plot.

feats.scene: Tiuceoser tosses a market stall into a lane.
Tiuceoser takes a thrown barrel and shakes its head.

name: Ausanrnu
summary: Ausanrnu is a hybrid born from a swamp contaminated by a crashed plane, with an odd pheromone that nearly started a massacre among crooks. It fled to the sewers to give birth to a horrifying brood.

feats.scene: Ausanrnu releases a scent cloud that sets a whole room against itself.
Ausanrnu is pummelled by a crowd and stays upright.

name: Naconu
summary: Naconu is a red-eyed scaled inmate who prowled a grim asylum and its halls. It pops up once in a gloomy tale and does not last long.

feats.scene: Naconu grips a cell bar and bends it with a groan.
Naconu takes a guard's club on the head without effect.

name: Cotiuor
summary: Cotiuor is a clawed, fanged crime boss in a timeline where a certain team never formed. It runs a street gang from a warehouse and enjoys a reputation for fear.

feats.scene: Cotiuor slashes a car door from its frame with a claw.
Cotiuor shrugs a bat swing and smiles.

name: Amitiu
summary: Amitiu is a lanky youth whose presence curses others with misfortune, so every attack aimed at him goes astray. He joined a team of oddballs and later a squad of expendables, and fell in a war of gods.

feats.scene: Amitiu makes a rival's gun jam and misfire into a wall.
Amitiu watches a line of bullets all miss him by inches.

name: Ileiar
summary: Ileiar is a struggling stage performer who kept bad luck as a companion and ended up kidnapped, cursed and chased across a city. It can sing, act and run fast when scared.

feats.scene: Ileiar swings a stage prop and clips a kidnapper.
Ileiar falls off a stage riser and laughs it off.

name: Nuscoriu
summary: Nuscoriu is a red-haired frontier gunman who rode with his twin brother and fought outlaws on dusty plains. It was a married man who died in a later adventure.

feats.scene: Nuscoriu fires a revolver and shatters a bottle at forty paces.
Nuscoriu takes a fall from a bolting horse and rises.

name: Tauteva
summary: Tauteva is a divorced wasteland scrounger rebuilt with machine limbs that let it hop great distances. It fixes gear and carries scavenged arms.

feats.scene: Tauteva lands on a wrecked truck and flattens the roof.
Tauteva takes a crash through a wall and stands.
Tauteva bounds across a ruined freeway in great leaps.

name: Ntnico
summary: Ntnico is a big dog rebuilt as a government weapon, with armour, lasers, super strength and a scent that cows other animals. It was killed by soldiers before it could hurt anyone else.

feats.scene: Ntnico bites through a steel pipe and fires a laser at a fence.
Ntnico takes a bullet burst against its armour and keeps coming.

name: Niuvalau
summary: Niuvalau is a dark-haired blacksmith of a metal-working people who forged a feared ring and then built a bigger weapon from scraps of white light. It beat five guardians single-handed before being talked out of revenge.

feats.scene: Niuvalau fires its new weapon and knocks five ring-wearers across a plain.
Niuvalau stands in a forge blast that melts rock.

name: Lunumaun
summary: Lunumaun is a dark-haired arms dealer who sells shiny weapons out of a trunk and keeps a low profile. It is a mere merchant with a mean streak and a long list of buyers.

feats.scene: Lunumaun hands out a rifle and the crate lid blows off with the shot.
Lunumaun ducks behind a crate and survives a shootout unscathed.

name: Temiirn
summary: Temiirn is an elderly keeper of a vast factory that makes the planet's skies, immortal and sensitive about complaints. It sulks and shuts the machinery down, leaving the world without heat, wind or rain.

feats.scene: Temiirn throws a world-wide storm front over the crops in a fit of pique.
Temiirn absorbs a sulking tantrum and a heckling crowd with mild embarrassment.

name: Neliar
summary: Neliar is a cheerful immortal who sets the skies by simply saying what they should do, wearing a mountain hat. It dumps its leftover storms on whichever patch of land is handy.

feats.scene: Neliar orders a week of hail and lightning onto one farm field.
Neliar sips tea through a squall that tears the roof off a barn.

name: Amsiau
summary: Amsiau is a short, dark-eyed executive in a council of three tycoons who runs a downtown from a tower. It is dismissive of old legends and prefers spreadsheets to swords.

feats.scene: Amsiau slams a ledger on a desk to end a meeting.
Amsiau slips on a polished floor and brushes off the bruise.

name: Llutiser
summary: Llutiser is a pint-sized infantryman in a battle-worn squad, given a nickname for his small frame. He keeps pace on long marches and carries more than his share.

feats.scene: Llutiser throws a grenade across a cratered field.
Llutiser dives into a ditch as shells land and climbs out.

name: Veseonan
summary: Veseonan is a walking, thinking shrub that steals growth formulas to grow monstrous seedlings and conquer capitals. Its creations rarely behave, and it has often ended up in a cell.

feats.scene: Veseonan sets a giant vine loose that tears up a plaza pavement.
Veseonan is hacked with an axe and regrows a branch.

name: Sorsau
summary: Sorsau is a masked heir who took over a family trade of pranks and plots, later aiding a mad doctor and a clown prince. It is sad-faced and persistent.

feats.scene: Sorsau flings a vial and the fumes drive a crowd off a pier.
Sorsau is knocked down a stairwell and gets up sobbing.

name: Cesiumval
summary: Cesiumval is a blue-eyed businesswoman who runs a firm in a harbour metropolis and raises a daughter. It deals with officials and keeps a neutral line in any fight.

feats.scene: Cesiumval slaps a contract down and signs a deal.
Cesiumval stands steady through a rough ferry crossing.

name: Llares
summary: Llares is an energy being from another plane that wears a dead man's body like a jar and can turn insubstantial or step across space. It was seized by a scheming machine-man for its power and freed by an unlikely team.

feats.scene: Llares releases a surge of cosmic energy that melts a warehouse block.
Llares stays intangible as a tower falls through it.

name: Esilia
summary: Esilia is a sea-dwelling inventor hired to build a stand-in for a king and secretly rigged a mechanical beast to break the city dome. He was caught and kept silent about his paymaster.

feats.scene: Esilia unleashes a machine monster that batters the dome supports.
Esilia is dragged to a cell and shows no sign of cracking.

name: Veovanan
summary: Veovanan is a sausage-obsessed saboteur in a wartime gang, loud and not very bright. It brandishes a coiled link of explosive meat and cackles over it.

feats.scene: Veovanan throws a string of sausage bombs through a bakery window.
Veovanan takes a rolling pin to the head and laughs.

name: Erusor
summary: Erusor is a grey-haired army officer who distrusts handing a nation's safety to one person or to smiling visitors. It was proven right when invaders turned off the world's weapons.

feats.scene: Erusor orders a salvo and a battery fires across a river.
Erusor stays at the command table as an explosion rattles the room.

name: Llusocor
summary: Llusocor is a blond noble turned professional thief in a world that went another way. It dresses elegantly and steals with a smile.

feats.scene: Llusocor knocks a guard down with a gilded cane.
Llusocor leaps from a balcony and lands in a hedge.

name: Sauoll
summary: Sauoll is a blond criminal with a dead brother and a dark record, who met a bad end at the hands of an angry gunman. It is a villain the story does not mourn.

feats.scene: Sauoll pistol-whips a clerk and runs from the shop.
Sauoll takes a rough fall down a stairwell.

name: Niuialreo
summary: Niuialreo is a mystery-minded vigilante in a twisted timeline who works alongside a machine-bodied ally. It has few details but is steadfast.

feats.scene: Niuialreo tosses a smoke canister and slips away in the cloud.
Niuialreo takes a lash across the back and keeps going.

name: Stoarco
summary: Stoarco is a chemist-turned-vigilante who invented a sleep gas after being laughed at by generals. It leaves criminals snoring beside their evidence and once sat on a council of masked veterans.

feats.scene: Stoarco fires a gas gun and puts a whole warehouse to sleep.
Stoarco takes a hard blow to the chest and lays his attacker out.

name: Telrnesti
summary: Telrnesti is a married city mayor who plays politics from a polished office, shifting between sides. It keeps a nervous grip on power and meets a sudden end.

feats.scene: Telrnesti bangs a gavel and calls a meeting to order.
Telrnesti is shoved by a crowd and does not fall.

name: Moncortor
summary: Moncortor is a blond data specialist who plugs into networks and works under a false identity for an expendable team. It meets an early end on a mission.

feats.scene: Moncortor overloads a console and a door bursts open in sparks.
Moncortor takes a hard fall from a gantry.

name: Sirnnt
summary: Sirnnt is a brown-haired boarding student who sleeps deeply and struggles with a drinking habit. It trashes a room in a binge, then accepts help and recovers.

feats.scene: Sirnnt throws a chair across a dorm room in a stupor.
Sirnnt wakes after a rough night and walks to class.

name: Lorteleon
summary: Lorteleon is a red-eyed, red-haired enforcer of a gang, met by players deep in the sewers. It blocks a path to a warehouse and falls to a determined crew.

feats.scene: Lorteleon slashes with a blade and cuts a pipe in half.
Lorteleon takes a hail of fists before dropping.

name: Tervorcor
summary: Tervorcor is a green-eyed assassin with a snakelike look, kept alive and shifty by a serum. It bends minds, leads a cult of stolen children and commands animal-changing servants.

feats.scene: Tervorcor bends a squad of guards to its will with a single glance.
Tervorcor survives a long fall and slithers away.

name: Tasmia
summary: Tasmia is a yellow-eyed, hairless evil god once locked in a crystal that whispers into the minds of underground settlers. It possesses people, raises an army and tries to take over every world before being buried and then defeated.

feats.scene: Tasmia tears open a cavern city and turns its people into a host.
Tasmia endures a crushing collapse that buries it for ages.

name: Rnliium
summary: Rnliium is a white-haired lowlife who whistles a signal before each heist and rules a handful of streets. It plays dirty and has only one known caper.

feats.scene: Rnliium sounds a whistle and a gang pours out of a doorway.
Rnliium takes a nightstick to the ribs and runs.

name: Vosria
summary: Vosria is a black-haired fighter raised in secret by her father after a lightning strike spared her. She hunted down her brothers, schemed against rivals and staged a duel with a child as bait.

feats.scene: Vosria kicks through a plank wall in a single move.
Vosria takes a heavy staff blow on the forearm and counters.

name: Rnmitel
summary: Rnmitel is a white-haired reformed thief and hand-to-hand fighter with a breezy way of announcing herself. It arrives to help at the right moment and keeps a private life.

feats.scene: Rnmitel drops a gang member with a spinning kick.
Rnmitel takes a blow in the ribs and finishes the combination.

name: Suninta
summary: Suninta is a member of a star-spanning guard that patrols the lanes between systems. It is from a dense-bodied species and appears only briefly.

feats.scene: Suninta slams into a drifting hull and cracks the plating.
Suninta takes a glancing hit from a cruiser without a mark.

name: Rialase
summary: Rialase is a young woman of a frontier tribe who wed a chieftain's son and later mourned him. It lives quietly and is remembered as someone's first love.

feats.scene: Rialase draws a bow and hits a target across a clearing.
Rialase walks a long trail in a hard winter.

name: Colstival
summary: Colstival is a white-haired young scholar of old lore who lives in a cloud castle and later a forest hut. It guides allies in battle with knowledge and uses modest magic.

feats.scene: Colstival summons a flash of light that shatters a stone arch.
Colstival is hit by falling masonry and shrugs it off behind a ward.

name: Tincil
summary: Tincil is a brown-haired hired gun who takes jobs from a gadget broker and works alone. It is quiet and professional.

feats.scene: Tincil fires a carbine and punches a hole in a van door.
Tincil rolls from a blast and comes up firing.

name: Torlence
summary: Torlence is a teleporting rogue who swaps anything in reach with something from its own hidden dimension. It uses this to steal, to dodge and to discard what it dislikes.

feats.scene: Torlence swaps a truck for a boulder and lets both fall.
Torlence is struck with a pipe and trades places with a mailbox.

name: Leron
summary: Leron is a white-eyed, white-skinned thug who erases parts of what it touches, leaving victims alive but missing pieces. It works for a magnet-minded boss and fell to a bruiser.

feats.scene: Leron wipes away a section of wall in one touch.
Leron is bashed to the ground and recovers on one elbow.

name: Erenau
summary: Erenau is a brown-haired teenager who saw a classmate rescue a bus of children from a river and kept the secret. It is ordinary in every other way.

feats.scene: Erenau throws a ball across a field.
Erenau walks out of a crashed bus with scrapes.

name: Oreiala
summary: Oreiala is a fast young hero in a mashed-up team who offers to speed along a rescue mission. It enjoys saying things will go quicker.

feats.scene: Oreiala runs through a hangar door and breaks it off its track.
Oreiala skids on pavement and keeps running.
Oreiala crosses a valley in a blur before a shout fades.

name: Veonau
summary: Veonau is a legless assassin from a destroyed home world who refuses repair. It fires a beam from its head that cancels the abilities of whoever it hits.

feats.scene: Veonau focuses its beam and cracks the armour of a vault door.
Veonau is thrown across a room and keeps its aim.

name: Nullutor
summary: Nullutor is a bad-luck criminal in a costume that burns far too easily. It joined a mass jailbreak and made a very smoky mess.

feats.scene: Nullutor lights a torch and sets its own sleeve on fire.
Nullutor rolls on the ground and puts the fire out.

name: Tatirn
summary: Tatirn is a broad-shouldered young ally who stands in doorways and protects friends. It is gentle, patient and large for its age.

feats.scene: Tatirn shoves a stuck truck out of a ditch.
Tatirn takes a hard tackle and does not budge.

name: Rorvilu
summary: Rorvilu is a red-haired woman who serves a sinister mistress and trails after a cat burglar. It is shadowy and patient, always one step behind.

feats.scene: Rorvilu jabs a stiletto through a leather jacket.
Rorvilu slips off a roof edge and catches a gutter.

name: Naumante
summary: Naumante is a lone blade killer who joined a secret order and ambushed a group gathering clues, cutting several down in a night. It prefers stealth and steel.

feats.scene: Naumante cuts a rope bridge in a single slash.
Naumante takes a stab wound and keeps fighting.

name: Luerutal
summary: Luerutal is a red-haired hunter-hero who guards a western country and joined an international team. It rides out at night and protects villages from raiders.

feats.scene: Luerutal fires a crossbow and pins a bandit's sleeve to a post.
Luerutal falls from a horse and gets back on.

name: Surni
summary: Surni is a teenage mystery solver with hair that shifts between blond and red, one of four friends who relied on a ghostly guide. It is brave but needs rescuing.

feats.scene: Surni throws a lantern at a lurking figure.
Surni tumbles down a cellar stair and keeps searching.

name: Cenente
summary: Cenente is a red-haired settler raised in a peaceful community who decided war was needed for liberty. It enlisted gladly with a band of rangers.

feats.scene: Cenente swings a hatchet and splits a log in one blow.
Cenente takes a musket butt to the shoulder and stays in line.

name: Linal
summary: Linal is a small preschool student with brown hair and a strange body who plays in a toy-sized city. It is cheerful and cuddly.

feats.scene: Linal pushes a toy truck across the classroom floor.
Linal falls from a swing and bounces up laughing.

name: Cisserle
summary: Cisserle is a red-haired alien prince, long lost, whose name was borrowed by a shape-shifting impostor. It was sent off in a rocket as a child to be safe from invaders.

feats.scene: Cisserle shatters a metal door with a hot bolt of fury.
Cisserle weathers a crash landing on a barren rock.

name: Levesti
summary: Levesti is a black-haired man mutated into a brute by a gene weapon, strong and tough. It attacked a red-skinned hero and was stopped by allies.

feats.scene: Levesti tears a lamp post out of the road.
Levesti shakes off a car being thrown into him.

name: Stoial
summary: Stoial is a black-haired pirate who hijacks passenger ships and announces himself loudly. It knows the sea and little else.

feats.scene: Stoial swings a cutlass and splits a mast rail.
Stoial is knocked overboard and hauls himself up a rope.

name: Rornti
summary: Rornti is a brown-haired woman in a chaotic crew of speed-town criminals. It fights dirty and slips away through a crowded market.

feats.scene: Rornti kicks a stall over and blocks a chasing guard.
Rornti lands off a roof and jogs away.

name: Iamon
summary: Iamon is a red-haired physicist from a far future who built a one-way time device and planned a crime spree backward through history. It spent loot on hospitals and settled quietly in an earlier century.

feats.scene: Iamon triggers a tachyon burst that blows out a museum window.
Iamon stumbles out of a time jump with a bloody nose.

name: Numar
summary: Numar is a blond singer with feathered wings and a mental bond that sharpens when a partner is near. It is gentle and a skeptic about the divine.

feats.scene: Numar beats its wings and knocks a mugger off balance.
Numar lands hard on a stage and finishes the verse.
Numar glides across a plaza on a hot updraft.

name: Inullrni
summary: Inullrni is a bald mercenary who lost his family to stray bullets and grew into a professional shooter. It borrowed another gunman's alias and drove a kidnapping job alone.

feats.scene: Inullrni fires a rifle round that punches through a car door.
Inullrni takes a beating in a cell and plans his next move.

name: Reoterser
summary: Reoterser is a quiet night-clerk who learned to slip bodies through solid walls, and later through the bodies of others. Grief hardened into a cold mission, and a salvaged harness amplifies the gift into something lethal.

feats.scene: Reoterser drags a bus-sized crowd of shadows through a warehouse wall and leaves the bricks glowing red.
Reoterser shrugs off a thrown steel pipe that bends against the harness plating.

name: Ultorni
summary: Ultorni is a schoolboy who once carried a borrowed beast-mind and a stranger's stolen strength in his head. When the loans were repaid he became an ordinary kid with odd dreams.

feats.scene: Ultorni shoves a stuck classroom door off its hinges while the borrowed strength still lingers.
Ultorni tumbles down a flight of stairs and walks away with bruises.

name: Sermil
summary: Sermil is a petty thief who found a glowing bracelet and discovered that stubbornness can drive it. Years behind bars sharpened his focus until he could tug at the bracelet from far away.

feats.scene: Sermil bends a vault door inward by hauling on the bracelet with sheer obstinacy.
Sermil takes a cudgel across the ribs and keeps tugging.

name: Rentel
summary: Rentel is a college wrestler hired to wear a gaudy costume as a walking advertisement. He fights well for a mortal and trusts his loud outfit too much.

feats.scene: Rentel pins two armed robbers with a single hip throw against a marble counter.
Rentel absorbs a swinging crowbar across the shoulder without dropping his guard.

name: Numsereon
summary: Numsereon is a former acrobat whose body was soaked in a gold-grey tonic, leaving him unable to age and hard to cut. He serves hidden masters with blades and thrown knives, and tires of the work.

feats.scene: Numsereon hurls a dagger through a car door and pins a driver to the seat.
Numsereon walks out of a collapsed balcony with the beams still across his back.
Numsereon crosses a courtyard faster than a sprinting horse.

name: Nanseo
summary: Nanseo is a long-lived assassin drafted into a cobbled-together squad and dressed in a bat costume he despises. His mind frayed centuries ago and his tonic cravings never fade.

feats.scene: Nanseo cleaves a steel locker in half with a curved blade.
Nanseo stands back up after a collapsing gantry crushes him to the floor.

name: Telronval
summary: Telronval is a disgraced detective who was recruited into a vigilante circle by a wealthy patron. In old age he leans on cheap stimulants to keep his punches heavy.

feats.scene: Telronval breaks a thug's jaw with one stimulant-fuelled hook.
Telronval shakes off a baton blow to the head.

name: Rnties
summary: Rnties is a farm-raised freshman who trails an older student around campus, writing cheerful lies in letters home. He has no gift beyond persistence.

feats.scene: Rnties shoulders a heavy dorm door open to rescue a roommate's luggage.
Rnties falls from a bunk bed onto a stone floor and laughs it off.

name: Llont
summary: Llont is one half of a pair of identical brothers who roam the jungle together, swinging from vines and settling disputes between villages. He relies on speed, rope and his sibling.

feats.scene: Llont lashes a rope around a charging boar and flips it onto its back.
Llont drops from a tree branch onto packed clay and rolls to his feet.

name: Eorces
summary: Eorces is a swaggering hero of a pulp romance, always rescued by a bubble of shimmering force and a backpack engine. He exists mostly between book covers and fan imaginings.

feats.scene: Eorces blasts a cargo door off its rails with a jolt from his belt.
Eorces sits inside his bubble while a falling crate splinters against it.
Eorces rockets down a corridor on the backpack engine.

name: Vauco
summary: Vauco inherited a gift for copying the nature of whatever he touches, turning his skin to timber, stone or glass. The talent is strong, but it leaves him exposed to anything that shatters brittle forms.

feats.scene: Vauco turns his fists to granite and caves in a loading-dock wall.
Vauco becomes iron and withstands a toppling crane arm.

name: Illesau
summary: Illesau is remembered as a street guardian of a bygone age, honoured by a faded portrait in a marble hall. Little record survives beyond the painted likeness.

feats.scene: Illesau topples a looter with a single shoulder charge.
Illesau takes a thrown brick on the forearm without flinching.

name: Anunumrni
summary: Anunumrni was an athlete turned janitor whose body took on the make-up of anything he touched after a lab blast. He aged slowly, taught his family the trick, and fought in a wartime team.

feats.scene: Anunumrni becomes stone and punches a tank turret off its ring.
Anunumrni turns to steel as a collapsing hangar roof rains on him.

name: Tisercel
summary: Tisercel is a masked outlaw with a dark cowl, known only through a handful of old rumours. He runs with a gang of lawbreakers on a parallel world.

feats.scene: Tisercel kicks open a steel gate with a single swing of his boot.
Tisercel absorbs a truncheon strike across his cowled head.

name: Milri
summary: Milri is a physician from the plains who put on a winged mask and made a name aiding the sick as much as fighting crime. His son fights beside him, and healing remains his strongest talent.

feats.scene: Milri tackles an armed raider off a porch and into the dust.
Milri grits his teeth through a thrown bottle shattering across his back.

name: Elsoirn
summary: Elsoirn grew up among coffins and came to worship endings. A stolen rod ended his family, and a grim ring now lets him throw cold bolts and float over graves.

feats.scene: Elsoirn fires a bolt from the ring that cracks a stone tomb in half.
Elsoirn rises again after being flattened under a toppled headstone.
Elsoirn drifts across a cemetery on a column of grey light.

name: Orrortia
summary: Orrortia is a wealthy heir who poisoned his own mind with hatred and funded hate groups. He masks himself as a vigilante and fights with money, weapons and cruelty.

feats.scene: Orrortia fires a rifle round through a van engine block.
Orrortia takes a punch to the jaw and keeps sneering.

name: Rilnaeru
summary: Rilnaeru is a patient city inspector who solves cases with phone calls, warrants and tired patience. He keeps a steady hand and a short fuse for nonsense.

feats.scene: Rilnaeru fires a service revolver and stops a fleeing car's tyre.
Rilnaeru is knocked into a desk and stands up buttoning his coat.

name: Rilluoll
summary: Rilluoll is a veteran detective with a sidearm and a notebook, born from a radio serial. He leans on interviews and ledgers far more than on fists.

feats.scene: Rilluoll shoots a lock off a storage cage from ten paces.
Rilluoll takes a thrown chair against the shoulder and presses on.

name: Nanistor
summary: Nanistor is a ruthless gang boss who leads a dockside crew and answers to a more dangerous patron. His violence is loud, and his luck is thin.

feats.scene: Nanistor hurls a rival through a market stall with one shove.
Nanistor takes a bottle to the head and keeps shouting orders.

name: Amoiumva
summary: Amoiumva is a grieving widower who watches television while his adopted son studies sorcery in secret. A healer once gave him a new hand through ritual, and he remains an unwitting target of cultists.

feats.scene: Amoiumva swings a fire poker and drives off an intruder in the hallway.
Amoiumva survives a house fire that scorches the hall to ash.

name: Rilserte
summary: Rilserte is a medieval monarch brought back to life by lab technicians in a modern age and sent out to conquer. His armour and loyal soldiers are his only weapons.

feats.scene: Rilserte brings a broadsword down through a shield and the bench beneath it.
Rilserte endures a lance strike on his chain mail.

name: Aramaul
summary: Aramaul is a convict reshaped by a clinic into a winged, taloned creature that glides over rooftops. The experiment made him stronger and meaner, though not clever enough to win.

feats.scene: Aramaul rakes his talons through a parked truck's door panel.
Aramaul slams into a brick chimney and stays airborne.
Aramaul dives off a tower and levels out above a street.

name: Ntilorval
summary: Ntilorval is a nervous bowman in a team of misfits who would rather hide than face danger. His aim is decent, and his courage is not.

feats.scene: Ntilorval fires an arrow that pins a coat to a wall from across a yard.
Ntilorval tumbles down a stack of crates and apologises to them.

source_title: William King (The Brave and the Bold)

name: Cairn
summary: Cairn is a small-town mage who adopted a legendary sorcerer's emblem to earn respect. His scrying works, and his earth-moving spells lift small stones and little more.

feats.scene: Cairn heaves a cart-sized boulder aside with a clumsy earth charm.
Cairn is cuffed across a bar floor and keeps talking.

name: Reotent
summary: Reotent is a hired marksman and demolitions expert in a city of knock-off names. He loves a clean shot and a loud bang.

feats.scene: Reotent drops a charge that crumples a stairwell floor.
Reotent staggers after a blade lands between his shoulder blades.

name: Rironias
summary: Rironias is a lonely genius whose body grew a command over radiant fields and magnets. He wields strange talents with cold calculation, and a time rift eventually erased him.

feats.scene: Rironias sweeps a magnetic surge that peels the steel skeleton off an unfinished tower.
Rironias stands unharmed inside a collapsing blast furnace.
Rironias skims across a river on a magnetic cushion.

name: Urnci
summary: Urnci is a wise inventor with command over radiant fields who floats through the air and builds his own space pod. He keeps to himself, balding and thoughtful.

feats.scene: Urnci hurls a bolt that melts a hole through a bridge pylon.
Urnci rides out a crashing satellite fragment.

name: Raerullu
summary: Raerullu is a divorced small-town lawyer with a wry sense of humour and a stubborn streak. He fights in court, not on the street.

feats.scene: Raerullu slams a thick binder onto a table and silences a room.
Raerullu slips on wet steps and gets up laughing.

name: Teslor
summary: Teslor is a forgotten metallurgist who designed elastic alloy servants that shift shape on command. Governments hunted his work, so he hid the devices in gifts.

feats.scene: Teslor activates a bundle of living alloy that forms a hammer and flattens a prototype vehicle.
Teslor waits out a lab explosion behind a workbench.

name: Inuanusto
summary: Inuanusto is a bespectacled tinkerer who builds gadgets in a cluttered workshop. He is a soft-spoken helper to a team of artificial beings.

feats.scene: Inuanusto wires a cell to a spring and launches a bolt through a plank.
Inuanusto drops a shelf of parts onto his own feet.

name: Reeorus
summary: Reeorus is a tall former preacher who bound himself to an idol-god, and a staff channels its wrath. He swore revenge after losing his people to a catastrophe.

feats.scene: Reeorus empties a storm from the staff and flattens a valley of pines.
Reeorus walks out of a collapsing temple dome with the staff humming.

name: Seramtal
summary: Seramtal is an elected leader of a young republic, short, white-haired and sharp-tongued in debate. He relies on speeches and ledgers.

feats.scene: Seramtal bangs a gavel hard enough to crack its handle.
Seramtal stumbles off a podium step and recovers his composure.

name: Mater
summary: Mater is a bald zealot who leads a fanatical church of armoured bombers and laser-wielding disciples. He preaches burning away sin, and his followers wear flying plate.

feats.scene: Mater orders a volley from his followers that collapses a bridge deck.
Mater takes a handcuff against the wrist and keeps preaching.

name: Milas
summary: Milas is a crime lord who runs rackets under a dark stage name and clashes with a band of costumed rivals. He prefers henchmen to fistfights.

feats.scene: Milas fires a pistol that shatters a chandelier.
Milas takes a cane to the ribs and spits blood.

name: Rinaco
summary: Rinaco is a disgraced swordsman woken from long sleep and hired for one last grim job. He fights hand to hand with a curved blade.

feats.scene: Rinaco slices a hanging chain in two with a single sweep.
Rinaco bounces off a wall and keeps his blade high.

name: Vaste
summary: Vaste is a hiker struck by a beam from the sky who became a living star. He was reborn as a prince of the heavens and drifts among the constellations.

feats.scene: Vaste unleashes a burst of starlight that boils a stretch of ocean.
Vaste endures a collapsing comet fragment wrapped in his own glow.
Vaste crosses the upper sky in a streak of white light.

name: Amisse
summary: Amisse is a zealous tactical sergeant who prefers storming doors to negotiating. He splits from his commander during a siege of the city.

feats.scene: Amisse breaches a warehouse door with a battering ram.
Amisse takes a rifle butt to the helmet and keeps charging.

name: Sersasa
summary: Sersasa is a hired camera operator turned attack-armour wearer, sent to start a fight and discredit a rival. His suit lets him spin gusts and swing an energy staff.

feats.scene: Sersasa swings the staff and splinters a parked van.
Sersasa survives a hard landing on a rooftop in his armour.

name: Iusauam
summary: Iusauam is a grey-haired agency functionary who handles files and quiet orders. He appears briefly, issues instructions and disappears.

feats.scene: Iusauam slaps a folder onto a desk with a loud crack.
Iusauam is shoved against a cabinet and brushes off his sleeves.

name: Eoriti
summary: Eoriti is an artificial-limbed squad leader who guides a ragged unit across a dangerous island. He is courageous to the end and sacrifices himself for a friend.

feats.scene: Eoriti hurls a grenade that drives back a charging lizard.
Eoriti drops from a ledge onto a rock and keeps walking on a bent prosthesis.

name: Siuleias
summary: Siuleias is a one-legged naval officer who commands small boats and seeks revenge for his lost crew. He fights on a wooden peg with a stubborn grip on his helm.

feats.scene: Siuleias fires a deck gun that rattles a hull plate.
Siuleias is thrown overboard by a blast and swims back to the wreck.

name: Rnineo
summary: Rnineo is a veteran who lost an eye and a leg yet survived for decades on a remote island, taming a winged beast. He never learned the war had ended.

feats.scene: Rnineo lashes a winged beast's harness tight and steers it into a cliff gap.
Rnineo survives being carried aloft and dropped into a nest.

name: Siaos
summary: Siaos is a frontier lawman who keeps order in a dusty desert town. His son grows into a legendary gunslinger.

feats.scene: Siaos fires a rifle and drops a lantern off a high hook.
Siaos is flung from a horse onto hard clay and gets back up.

name: Taurni
summary: Taurni is a downtrodden clerk who gained borrowed powers from a freak storm and hastily charged fees for his rescues. He lost the gifts when a rival drained them.

feats.scene: Taurni catches a falling lift and hurls it into a field.
Taurni stands in the path of a runaway locomotive and halts it.
Taurni flies from a roof to a bridge in a blink.

name: Asstva
summary: Asstva is a mercenary and former soldier who terrorises a faraway land under a jackal alias. He fights with blades and firearms and takes contracts from shadowy firms.

feats.scene: Asstva fires a rifle round through a sandbag wall.
Asstva is dragged across rough ground and still returns fire.

name: Miainu
summary: Miainu is a museum curator and anthropologist, born under a visionary dream of spirit beasts. He studies cave paintings and helps heroes at a crucial hour.

feats.scene: Miainu pries a stone slab loose with a crowbar.
Miainu is knocked down by falling dust and rubble in a cavern.

name: Renamor
summary: Renamor is a teen who was doused in chemicals that turned his skin blue and let him roll himself into a living ball. He bounces through fights and mourns a lost twin.

feats.scene: Renamor curls up and rams through a brick wall like a wrecking ball.
Renamor survives a blast in orbit, wrapped tightly in his own rubbery bulk.

name: Loteiu
summary: Loteiu is a dark-haired sorcerer who joins a circle of casters to split a town into two halves with a chant. He throws crackling blasts of raw energy when cornered.

feats.scene: Loteiu hurls a blast of raw sorcery that flattens a row of market stalls.
Loteiu is thrown against a stone arch and rises with a hiss.

name: Nantauli
summary: Nantauli is an alien freedom fighter who wears a hero's colours on a ruined future world. Few records of his deeds remain.

feats.scene: Nantauli hurls a ruined car across a desert road.
Nantauli walks out of a collapsing bunker with his cape smouldering.

name: Nincera
summary: Nincera is a petty warden on a fiery slave-world who invents cruel contests and abuses his rank. He is a strong brute until he faces a real fighter.

feats.scene: Nincera slams a fist into a furnace door and bends it from its frame.
Nincera takes a thrown boulder to the chest and sneers.

name: Iumsor
summary: Iumsor is a blunt occult magician who leads a secret order and helps with desperate rescues. He is curt, weary, and short of patience with youth.

feats.scene: Iumsor draws a chalk sigil that bursts and hurls a parked lorry across a lot.
Iumsor takes a blow to the stomach and mutters a curse.

name: Sorarsi
summary: Sorarsi is a banker's assistant who dresses as a crowned monarch of sewer-dwelling outcasts and organises their raids. She is clever and ruthless but trapped by her employer's betrayal.

feats.scene: Sorarsi drives a dagger through a leather coat and into a plank.
Sorarsi leaps into a narrow culvert and lands hard on stone.

name: Esiserau
summary: Esiserau is a famed beast handler who turned to crime and leads a stampede of trained animals against rivals. He is bold in a cage and meek outside it.

feats.scene: Esiserau commands a bull elephant to smash through a circus gate.
Esiserau is knocked flat by a startled camel and bounces up grinning.

name: Ammiatiu
summary: Ammiatiu is a grey-haired city mayor who dislikes masked vigilantes and orders their arrest. He is a politician through and through.

feats.scene: Ammiatiu slaps a stack of papers on a podium and demands silence.
Ammiatiu trips on a stair carpet at a gala and brushes off his coat.

name: Necornt
summary: Necornt is a wealthy socialite with a protective streak, who ignores the signs of his wife's trouble. His fate comes from a surprising source in his own home.

feats.scene: Necornt slams a heavy door shut against a draught.
Necornt is shoved into a sofa and falls over it.

name: Miasti
summary: Miasti is a captive with the gift of flight who tried to escape a frozen prison complex. He betrays a friend in a panic and is taken again.

feats.scene: Miasti flings a fellow captive across a snowfield in a desperate trick.
Miasti tumbles into a snowdrift at speed and gets up shaking.
Miasti skims over the ice faster than a galloping horse.

name: Rininnt
summary: Rininnt is a loyal chauffeur turned sidekick who dons a bright costume and aids a crimson-cloaked employer. He is small but fearless, and wins the heart of a whole squadron.

feats.scene: Rininnt kicks a gunman's wrist and sends a pistol into a fountain.
Rininnt tumbles out of a speeding sedan and rolls onto the verge.

name: Varsatia
summary: Varsatia is a smooth pickpocket and burglar who joins a band of masked rivals. He is quick with his hands and quicker with excuses.

feats.scene: Varsatia vaults a gallery rail and cracks a display case with a baton.
Varsatia lands on a skylight and rolls clear unhurt.

name: Noreon
summary: Noreon is a gifted toymaker driven mad by loss who builds deadly playthings for a shadowy firm. His inventions walk, fly and explode, while he stays small and soft-spoken.

feats.scene: Noreon wakes a giant wind-up soldier that stamps a loading bay into rubble.
Noreon is struck by a thrown mallet and sits down with a groan.

name: Auosne
summary: Auosne is a deranged inventor who holds a bus of schoolchildren hostage with a mechanical spider. His cruelty ends high above the streets.

feats.scene: Auosne sends the spider scuttling through a lobby and tears up the marble floor.
Auosne is thrown against a squad car and wheezes.

name: Nasnau
summary: Nasnau is a cunning father and inventor who hides blades in a yo-yo and builds traps lined with thermite. His cruelty is deadly, though his strength is that of an old man.

feats.scene: Nasnau ignites a quicksand pit packed with thermite beneath a loading dock.
Nasnau is bowled over by a blast of air and gets back up wheezing.

name: Sorminil
summary: Sorminil is a dignified ancestor of a famous clan who rode into battle beside a roughrider president. Few details survive beyond a family portrait.

feats.scene: Sorminil fires a carbine that punches a hole through a signboard.
Sorminil is thrown from a mount and lands in tall grass.

name: Tounren
summary: Tounren is a wartime prime minister who delivers speeches by radio and cigars by the box. He fights with words, stubbornness and rousing broadcasts.

feats.scene: Tounren thumps a map table and rattles every teacup in the bunker.
Tounren shrugs off a tremor from distant shells and keeps dictating.

name: Llnel
summary: Llnel is a stern army officer who knows every rule of conduct and command procedure. He enforces order in a field office and rarely leaves the desk.

feats.scene: Llnel stamps a seal onto an order with a resounding thud.
Llnel is jolted from a jeep and dusts off his cap.

name: Sersiusa
summary: Sersiusa is a scholar-inventor of an ancient dying world who builds the first device for recording voices. His legacy lives on in a long family line and a carved statue.

feats.scene: Sersiusa sparks a bright coil and shatters a crystal flask across the lab.
Sersiusa stands his ground as a lab shelf crashes down.

name: Nticove
summary: Nticove is a manipulative woman who bends minds to her wishes and treats others as playthings. She stirs up killers for fun until she is sent into the void.

feats.scene: Nticove whispers to a stranger and sends him charging through a glass wall.
Nticove is flung onto a tiled floor and lands with a gasp.

name: Rnvaleo
summary: Rnvaleo is a violet-haired underboss who commands the magical wing of a crime syndicate. She stays loyal to her old master during a feud.

feats.scene: Rnvaleo calls a column of flame that burns a warehouse roof away.
Rnvaleo is hurled down a stairwell and rises already chanting.

name: Silturni
summary: Silturni is a pale grey-skinned guardian of a far-off world, once worshipped as a god after ending a civil war. He wears a glowing ring that shapes solid light and carries him through the sky.

feats.scene: Silturni projects a lance of light that cleaves a mountain ridge in two.
Silturni shelters in a shield of light as a cliff-face collapses.
Silturni crosses the heavens above his planet in moments.

name: Elalesta
summary: Elalesta is a masked mystic of a bygone comic age who menaces a tiny hero with charms and rattles. Little more is known about this figure.

feats.scene: Elalesta shakes a bone rattle and cracks a clay jar across a hut.
Elalesta falls from a hut roof and skips away unhurt.

name: Orniau
summary: Orniau is an orange-haired hedge witch who zooms around on a motorised broom of a household sort. She is meddlesome rather than malicious, with a niece to look after.

feats.scene: Orniau casts a clumsy spell that sends a cart rolling off a pier.
Orniau crashes her flying cleaner into a hedge and sits up giggling.
Orniau zips along a lane faster than a bicycle racer.

name: Sutinium
summary: Sutinium is a hooded sorcerer and criminal of an old pulp series who schemes against a stretchy hero. Details about his powers are scarce.

feats.scene: Sutinium lifts a pointed staff and cracks a stone bench in half.
Sutinium falls from a ledge and picks himself up with a scowl.

name: Lital
summary: Lital is a centuries-old hermit master of the deadly touch who moves from body to body. He teaches a quick young student a fraction of his craft.

feats.scene: Lital taps a stone pillar with two fingers and splits it along its length.
Lital settles under a falling beam and lets it slide off his shoulders.

name: Tasena
summary: Tasena is a skilled marksman who bolts extra cybernetic arms onto his torso to fire many weapons at once. He fights as part of a ring of assassins and stages a faked duel.

feats.scene: Tasena fires four pistols together and punches a row of holes through a steel door.
Tasena is knocked flat by a blast and sprawls over a cobbled lane.

name: Niseollu
summary: Niseollu is a bald, genial spirit of the forest who lounges in a lush mansion after death. He bets on rising champions and gives sly advice.

feats.scene: Niseollu coaxes an enormous root up through the floor and splits a lawn in two.
Niseollu waves off a falling branch as it snaps against his shoulder.

name: Terorci
summary: Terorci is a good-natured sidekick with a dopey grin who ferries a stretchy ally over the sea by air. He tries to lie low when the law comes calling.

feats.scene: Terorci shoves a heavy crate off a wing and sends it into the waves.
Terorci tumbles from a cockpit hatch and bounces on the grass.

name: Aulriaval
summary: Aulriaval is a genderless giant of living awe, old as the cosmos, who stands in judgement over worlds. It watches silently while a sibling devours.

feats.scene: Aulriaval turns its violet gaze to a planet and begins to unmake it.
Aulriaval stands unmoved as a storm of cosmic shrapnel breaks around it.

name: Leolle
summary: Leolle is a refugee from a doomed planet who arrived in a meteor and wanders the world with enormous strength. He charges into foreign wars to stop the killing.

feats.scene: Leolle hurls an artillery piece over a ridge and into a ravine.
Leolle takes a cannon shell on the chest and walks on.
Leolle swims a wide strait faster than a motor launch.

name: Leroreter
summary: Leroreter is a grey-furred hound in a little cape who tags along with a pair of teenagers on adventures. He is smart for a dog and has no special powers.

feats.scene: Leroreter bites a rope and drops a net over a startled thief.
Leroreter tumbles from a truck bed and trots off unhurt.

name: Orcoes
summary: Orcoes is a marble-born guardian of a far-future colony, given life by a goddess of truth. She flies, fights in a team of cosmic champions and survives an energy blast.

feats.scene: Orcoes swings a sword of stone and shears a tower off its foundation.
Orcoes endures a robot barrage that flattens the plaza around her.
Orcoes crosses a city skyline in a heartbeat.

name: Amtoriu
summary: Amtoriu is an amazon of a parallel realm who challenges a visitor to feats of strength and skill. She settles the rivalry by crowning her rival.

feats.scene: Amtoriu hurls a boomerang of oak that fells a row of giants.
Amtoriu catches a swinging tree-trunk on her forearm and stays upright.

name: Lorsttir
summary: Lorsttir is a red-eyed warrior of a nightmare realm, turned into a bloodsucker with a band of undead champions. She guards an enormous antenna in a final battle.

feats.scene: Lorsttir tears a lamp-post out of the street and impales a parked truck.
Lorsttir shrugs off a collapsing wall of concrete in the dark.

name: Entliuri
summary: Entliuri is a physician-princess who leads a band of riders keeping nature in balance. She carries a wand, a magic lasso and a jewel that lets her glide through the air.

feats.scene: Entliuri flicks her wand and uproots a whole stand of pines.
Entliuri catches a falling boulder on her bracers and sets it aside.

name: Tiacolium
summary: Tiacolium is a toymaker's android decoy built to lure a heroine into an ambush. She has a strong metal frame and a flat, polite voice.

feats.scene: Tiacolium punches a hole in a steel cabinet while still smiling.
Tiacolium stays upright after a pallet of crates lands on her.

source_title: Wonder Woman robot (Wonder Woman TV Series)

name: Rniniva
summary: Rniniva is a green horned dinosaur from an island of warrior beasts who dreams of a coming evil. She wields a sword made from a great jawbone and rides an unseen flying lizard.

feats.scene: Rniniva swings a jawbone sword and fells a giant fern tree.
Rniniva charges through a rockslide and keeps running.

name: Eoraunia
summary: Eoraunia is a bald, respected elder of a bustling district who acts as its unofficial mayor. He passes information to a masked ally and pays for it in the end.

feats.scene: Eoraunia swings a wooden stool and cracks a lantern off its hook.
Eoraunia is knocked against a desk and scratches a message into its top.

name: Manal
summary: Manal is a white-haired sensei who trains pupils in hand-to-hand arts at a small school. He is calm, exacting and brave.

feats.scene: Manal snaps a hardwood board with a single palm strike.
Manal takes a staff blow across the ribs and stays rooted.

source_title: Wong Fei (The Brave and the Bold)

name: Catico
summary: Catico is a bald, wooden-bodied invader who drains moisture with root-like tendrils and turns captives into timber. He rides in a crystalline meteor ship and commands only those he has converted.

feats.scene: Catico lashes out with roots and drags a ferry into a river-bed.
Catico shrugs off an axe blow that lodges in his trunk.

name: Serlema
summary: Serlema is a tall, bald axeman with a rage problem who drinks too much and swings a heavy axe. He cannot age and has a violent past.

feats.scene: Serlema buries an axe deep in a pool table and splits it across the middle.
Serlema is thrown through a plate-glass window and stands up cursing.

name: Tausecol
summary: Tausecol is a bumbling castaway who gets stranded on an island and unwittingly inherits a fortune. He befriends a captive and stays lost out of sheer ineptitude.

feats.scene: Tausecol swings a coconut and misses a gull by a wide margin.
Tausecol falls out of a palm tree and rolls down a dune.

name: Lelli
summary: Lelli is a bald, cheerful handyman who bumbles into a mystery-solving team's cases. His luck often works better than his skill.

feats.scene: Lelli drops a toolbox on a prowler's foot by accident.
Lelli slips down a staircase and lands on a pile of coats.

name: Anren
summary: Anren is a cheerful investigator who joins a federal bureau and tags along with a team of heroes. He is clumsy but earnest.

feats.scene: Anren hurls a briefcase and knocks a lamp off a ledge.
Anren bounces off a car bonnet and keeps jogging.

name: Lloiu
summary: Lloiu is a cosmic being born from the first utterance of a creator, a vessel of divine speech that unmakes any challenge. It slays elemental councils and is undone only by cancelling sound.

feats.scene: Lloiu speaks a single syllable and a council of living elements collapses.
Lloiu stands unmoved as a continent-sized storm breaks over its form.

name: Telcinse
summary: Telcinse is a red-skinned living weapon, a parasitic armour that possesses hosts to strengthen worlds through slaughter. It feeds on the fear of worlds and moves from host to host.

feats.scene: Telcinse unleashes a crimson burst that destroys a district's skyline.
Telcinse absorbs a missile salvo and leaves the host unmarked.
Telcinse streaks across a continent in a few breaths.

name: Amoile
summary: Amoile is a planetary architect hired to reshape a whole world with his own energies and a vehicle of even greater power. He conjures a material no strongman can break.

feats.scene: Amoile sculpts a mountain range from molten rock with a sweep of his arm.
Amoile sits inside a crystal shell as a rockslide thunders past.

name: Cinamsti
summary: Cinamsti is a bald henchman who splits into an army of look-alikes, each one weaker than the last. He fights with kitchen gadgets in a plot to distract a hero.

feats.scene: Cinamsti sends a dozen copies charging and topples a stack of barrels.
Cinamsti is flung across a floor and his copies cheer.

name: Seroslo
summary: Seroslo is a towering brute grown in a laboratory from distilled ambition, shipped across an ocean to wear down a harbour city's nerve. It boasts of endless identical brothers while hoisting cranes like toys, yet it unravels the moment its makers machine is wrecked.

feats.scene: Seroslo rips a dockside warehouse from its footings and hurls the whole frame into the bay.
Seroslo walks through a barrage of artillery shells with only scorched skin to show for it.

name: Rnivalrn
summary: Rnivalrn is one of many bickering demon siblings who gather in the underworld for rowdy family feasts. Quick to bully the youngest relative, the bald yellow-eyed brute is easily tricked into brawling with his own brothers.

feats.scene: Rnivalrn flattens a stone banquet hall with a single stamping tantrum.
Rnivalrn laughs off a collapsing cavern roof dropped on his head by a sibling.

name: Esnau
summary: Esnau is a former particle researcher whose obsession with a hidden subatomic ingredient ended in an accelerator breach that rewired her body. Drafted by a state that needed soldiers, she now bears squads of short-lived clones in days and cannot be harmed by radiation.

feats.scene: Esnau hurls a heavy lab stool at a fleeing guard and cracks the wall behind him.
Esnau stands unharmed in the glow of a ruptured reactor core while technicians flee.

name: Cortira
summary: Cortira is a patient veteran who guarded a distant sector with a willpower-driven ring for thousands of years before passing the duty to an apprentice. A tireless teacher with red and silver hair, the retired guardian earned a quiet place in the order's crypts.

feats.scene: Cortira shapes a glowing green wall and rams a drifting asteroid off its collision course.
Cortira holds a ring-made shield against a cascading shower of space debris.

name: Neonumosa
summary: Neonumosa is a dark-haired sea-city warrior who stands loyally beside an old sorcerer lord. Equally comfortable with blade and pistol, the soldier trusts craft and nerve over any magic.

feats.scene: Neonumosa cleaves a driftwood barricade in half with one overhead sword stroke.
Neonumosa takes a cannon-ball glance on a shield and keeps advancing.

name: Rervalolu
summary: Rervalolu is a masked guerrilla and master of disguise, so convincing that occupying officers believe a man is behind her work. A sharpshooter and charmer, she blows up bridges, frees hostages and stirs rival officers into shooting each other.

feats.scene: Rervalolu fires a satchel charge that drops a rail bridge into the gorge beneath it.
Rervalolu tumbles down a stairwell under gunfire and rises with only bruises.

name: Varcorau
summary: Varcorau is a long-lived raider from a far world whose people bend time to drift across the stars. Stranded after a scheme to rule mortals, the pirate lunged for a duo of rivals and froze them on the seabed for centuries.

feats.scene: Varcorau congeals the air around a schooner so its crew freezes mid-shout.
Varcorau sits out a century of crushing deep-sea pressure without ageing a day.

name: Allntiu
summary: Allntiu is an eyeless, hairless young hero of the far future who sees through walls and wears a ring that carries her through the air. Calm and curious, she serves a youth team from a tall headquarters in a gleaming capital.

feats.scene: Allntiu spots a hidden fuse inside a vault door and kicks it open before it fires.
Allntiu rides out a tumbling crash against a station bulkhead and keeps flying.

name: Oreoro
summary: Oreoro is a teacher and masked hero created when a ray of radiation transformed him in a fictional timeline. Living out an imagined life, the blond champion befriends a famous alien and flies from his home world to marry a reporter.

feats.scene: Oreoro bends a runaway rocket sled back onto its rails with both hands.
Oreoro stands in the blast of a failed engine and brushes soot from his cape.

name: Vallrnu
summary: Vallrnu is an ancient ruler of anarchic beings, once sealed inside an artifact by her own rivals and kin. Waking inside an unwilling host, the chaos sorceress outfights lightning-slinging brutes and cracks open the wards of a tower of fate.

feats.scene: Vallrnu hurls a ragged bolt of raw disorder that melts a city's tallest spire into slag.
Vallrnu stands in a thunderstorm of divine lightning and yawns.

name: Stllereo
summary: Stllereo is a green-eyed envoy who died young and was half revived by a drained spirit, so they walk both the living streets and the realm of the dead. Dutiful and blunt, the envoy escorts souls home and fights haunting threats.

feats.scene: Stllereo smashes a possessed streetlamp into a wailing spirit and scatters it.
Stllereo takes a car's full impact without any bone breaking, as half of them is already dead.

name: Irnrina
summary: Irnrina is a green-skinned, blond scientist whose intellect far outranks the planet's best minds. Rather than fists, the cold schemer uses memory, calculation and invention to join a band of rogue villains.

feats.scene: Irnrina rewires a lab capacitor and discharges it at a guard's weapon rack.
Irnrina survives a collapsing lab ceiling by calculating the single safe corner.

name: Lastellon
summary: Lastellon is a calm voodoo practitioner in a southern port city who opens the gates of buried memory for a wandering stranger. Skilled but modest, the occultist is hunted by a centuries-old vampire.

feats.scene: Lastellon chalks a ring and sets a heap of rotting candles alight in one breath.
Lastellon lies in a trance through a night of howling storm without shivering.

name: Rennumnan
summary: Rennumnan is a fair-haired drug lord who rose in a masked gangster's empire and ran its streets with cold arithmetic. Careful and ruthless, the crime boss has no powers beyond money and men.

feats.scene: Rennumnan swings a heavy ledger across a rival's jaw and ends the meeting.
Rennumnan walks away from a sedan that rolled twice down an embankment.

name: Ialol
summary: Ialol is a hairless, white-eyed multi-armed alien who keeps order over a vast stretch of space with a ring powered by willpower. Dutiful and proud, the sector guardian flies, shields allies and sculpts light into weapons.

feats.scene: Ialol launches a lance of green light that cleaves a small moon in two.
Ialol shelters a crew behind a glowing dome while a warship pounds it.

name: Irntorent
summary: Irntorent is a grey-haired watery denizen who lives in a hidden aquatic dimension and meddles in no one's war. Wise and reserved, the elder watches strangers pass through his domain.

feats.scene: Irntorent hurls a coral spear across a sunken plaza and pins a drifting thief by the sleeve.
Irntorent endures deep-sea pressure and a surging whirlpool without losing his grip on his staff.

name: Terlimi
summary: Terlimi is a blond vigilante from a flat alternate realm, armed with a bow and a belt that lets him cross between worlds. Wounded as the belt fails under strange physics, the masked archer reads minds in a pinch.

feats.scene: Terlimi looses a tethered arrow and yanks a falling crate clear of a bystander.
Terlimi shrugs off a blow from a heavy gang bruiser before his belt flickers.

name: Rnsute
summary: Rnsute is a white-haired prisoner from a monstrous race, woken after a crash and bent on seeding a city with eggs that hatch into predators. Her humanlike body is merely a larval state before she grows fangs and wings.

feats.scene: Rnsute scatters clutches of eggs from a rooftop and the hatchlings gouge a bus open.
Rnsute sits unflinching in a hail of police fire until her suit is shredded.

name: Ananin
summary: Ananin is a far-future ring bearer who fled backward through time to rescue a tangled history, disguising himself as a pompous costumed criminal. A subtle planner, the green-haired guardian lays traps built from tracking beacons and borrowed capes.

feats.scene: Ananin carves a shining bridge across a rift in time with a hard, bright beam.
Ananin braces a ring-forged shell through a wave of pruned timelines.

name: Rniton
summary: Rniton is a brown-eyed engineer who was forced at gunpoint to build weapons for a besieging tyrant, then freed and invited to build a fortress for heroes. Quiet and brilliant, he designs gear and falls for a teammate.

feats.scene: Rniton overloads a coil and the pulse knocks a cutter drone out of the sky.
Rniton stays on his feet after a collapsing scaffold drops a steel frame beside him.

name: Taiust
summary: Taiust is a red-eyed, green-skinned trainee at a school for villains who can swell to enormous size. Awkward and boastful, the former pupil lumbers through the city like a walking wall.

feats.scene: Taiust swells tall and stamps a parked truck flat in one footfall.
Taiust takes a swinging wrecking ball to the chest and only grunts.

name: Ceerntel
