summary: Ceerntel is a yellow-eyed trickster posing as a god of flame and storm, borrowing the dread of a buried pantheon. Pale and cunning, the impostor leans on stolen myths, though a wall of fire can still undo him.

feats.scene: Ceerntel calls a sheet of lightning that blackens a whole plaza of stone.
Ceerntel steps through a rooftop explosion with only a smoking sleeve.

name: Elaaulle
summary: Elaaulle is a brown-haired thief with the gift of bending other minds to her will, which she uses to rob banks and art convoys. Smug and calm, the criminal turns a speedster against himself before being jailed.

feats.scene: Elaaulle stares down a guard and he hands over the vault keys without a word.
Elaaulle takes a fast pursuer's tackle and bounces up with a grin.

name: Rnanaul
summary: Rnanaul is a black-eyed, hairless commander of a warlike species who gave up his caste to take a personal name, an unheard-of step. A clever strategist and engineer, the fleet leader works beside rebels against a starry conqueror.

feats.scene: Rnanaul directs a volley from his flagship that cuts a drifting freighter in half.
Rnanaul rides out a hull breach on his bridge, sealed in with a suit.

name: Iales
summary: Iales is a bald, red-skinned ring wielder who patrols a far sector with a tireless will. Cheerful and brave, the lantern bearer flies, builds shields and fires bright blasts.

feats.scene: Iales casts a glowing hammer made of light and crushes an enemy cruiser's prow.
Iales wraps himself in a ring-made bubble and drifts through a stellar flare.

name: Malerora
summary: Malerora is an orange-skinned ring wearer who was captured, replaced by shapeshifters and later bent to serve a stern leader. Loyal to a sector partner, the hairless guardian still shields, flies and shoots with his glowing band.

feats.scene: Malerora fires a thick emerald lance that rips the engine from a raider ship.
Malerora hunkers inside a green shell while shrapnel hammers it flat.

name: Orstsia
summary: Orstsia is a white-haired, blue-skinned elder from an ancient race who served a secret order of enforcers of its kind. Silent and stern, the warden stood alongside peers who are rarely named.

feats.scene: Orstsia gestures and a drifting space station is turned into a cloud of dust.
Orstsia stays standing amid the flash of an exploding sun-ship.

name: Stiveote
summary: Stiveote is a dark-eyed spy and saboteur serving an empire, cloaked in a scorpion costume. Quick and venomous, the agent strikes from rooftops and leaves no tracks.

feats.scene: Stiveote drives a barbed sting into a plank door and splits it down the middle.
Stiveote lands from a three-storey leap and slips away unhurt.

name: Aulita
summary: Aulita is the great tree of life that shelters every living thing, blessing a chosen mortal to fight a rotten jewel. Rooted deep in the world, the tree also lights a team of champions to defend justice.

feats.scene: Aulita bursts roots through a city's foundations and lifts an entire district to the sky.
Aulita stands through a raging firestorm over a whole forest and keeps growing.

name: Tinamilo
summary: Tinamilo is a small mischievous imp that serves a greater fiend and pesters a helmeted mage. Cowardly but spiteful, the little demon hisses curses from the shadows.

feats.scene: Tinamilo flings a ball of crackling hex at a candlestick and the whole room blazes.
Tinamilo dusts himself off after being stepped on by a startled guard.

name: Ameollu
summary: Ameollu is a renegade cosmic being who grew tired of the endless war between order and disorder and walked away from both. Aloof and bitter, the outcast slips into bodies and hurls bolts of raw force.

feats.scene: Ameollu fires a bolt of eldritch force that shears the top off a mountain.
Ameollu takes a divine counter-blast and re-forms in a breath.

name: Ialilor
summary: Ialilor is a blond gimmick criminal who hurls yo-yos at pursuers and tumbles over rooftops for a clown boss. Acrobatic and talkative, she trains in hand-to-hand fighting and gadget craft.

feats.scene: Ialilor snaps a weighted yo-yo across a guard's wrist and drops his pistol.
Ialilor is thrown off a roof and survives the fall to the pavement.

name: Llinnen
summary: Llinnen is a blond henchwoman whose motif is the toy on a string, who snatches a judge's children for a madcap boss. Jittery and mocking, she sprints down fire escapes with a grin.

feats.scene: Llinnen whips a yo-yo into a window and showers the alley with glass.
Llinnen is dropped from a ledge and still laughs on the way down.

name: Tonseoeo
summary: Tonseoeo is a green-skinned alien student writing a thesis on planet-bound heroes with a sibling. Casual and curious, the scholar posts devices to strangers that grant them strange powers as samples.

feats.scene: Tonseoeo triggers a crate of enhancement devices and the warehouse roof lifts a metre.
Tonseoeo shrugs off a stray lab blast and checks his notes.

name: Aninaune
summary: Aninaune is a long-forgotten goddess of two moons and of weddings, honoured by couples who swapped bracelets shaped like her satellites. Her worship faded after a flood and a lost colony, leaving only a mechanical statue in festival parades.

name: Lullire
summary: Lullire is an eight-foot, red-eyed, blue-haired patriarch who ruled a fiery empire for ages, then tried to breach the barrier that guards the source of all things and was turned into a captive giant. His kin turned on one another and his family tree burned.

feats.scene: Lullire hurls his full strength at the great barrier and a star-sized crater splits the void.
Lullire is held for ages in a cosmic prison and does not die.

name: Orleau
summary: Orleau is a powered-armour hero who joined a large team after an alien invasion, never speaking a word on screen. The suit lets the masked soldier fly and fire blasts from its gauntlets.

feats.scene: Orleau fires a gauntlet blast that melts a parked tank's turret.
Orleau's armour takes a direct cannon shell and the pilot walks away.

name: Iumillor
summary: Iumillor is a purple-haired teen who carries copies of sacred bracelets, a tiara and a rope that compels honesty, fighting beside her twin. Lively and loyal, she inherited her gear after a mentor's apparent death.

feats.scene: Iumillor deflects a thrown bottle with a silvery bracelet and spins her rope around an attacker.
Iumillor takes a fall from a theatre balcony and tumbles up grinning.

name: Ileeoau
summary: Ileeoau is a green-eyed teen heroine who channels electricity through her body, eager to prove herself even if she blunders. Overzealous, she sets off a harbour fuel tank by accident and later wins a fight by charging her opponent.

feats.scene: Ileeoau sparks a fuel depot and the explosion levels a loading shed.
Ileeoau shrugs off a thug's punch and discharges a crackling shock in return.

name: Niaori
summary: Niaori is a dark-haired reporter and former ventriloquist who prowls the night as a menacing figure, murdering to find a hidden treasure. Clever with voices and shadows, she falls to her own end during a clash with a flying youth.

feats.scene: Niaori throws her voice across a dark hall and a guard fires at an empty doorway.
Niaori tumbles through a rooftop skylight and lands on her feet.

name: Taneorora
summary: Taneorora is a pink-eyed, hairless genie bound to a mortal master, swinging between helping heroes and fighting for a hypnotist. Strong and magical, the djinn cannot act without the human's will and falls when that master dies.

feats.scene: Taneorora takes a tank volley and fades only when his master falls.

name: Miarale
summary: Miarale is a hairless robot commander who cast an army of copies of himself against a far planet to find a missing sweetheart. Proud and lovesick, the machine leader sees his troops dismantled with ease.

feats.scene: Miarale orders a swarm of clone machines and they crush a freight depot's roof.
Miarale walks off a blast that melts the front of his troop carrier.

name: Rosva
summary: Rosva is a blond saboteur in a suit of armour who rewrites plans so skyscrapers become death traps. Obsessed with an inherited legacy, the architect speaks in riddles and plants blasts in girders.

feats.scene: Rosva detonates hidden charges and an entire construction frame buckles in on itself.
Rosva takes explosive darts to the armour and staggers but stays upright.

name: Iroreenu
summary: Iroreenu is a former highway patrolman turned soldier and spy, an able detective who shows up wherever trouble brews. Arrogant at times, he fails to prevent a breakout from a remote stone prison.

feats.scene: Iroreenu levels a service rifle and knocks a fleeing suspect off a wall with one shot.
Iroreenu rolls from a jeep that flips on a mountain road and walks on.

name: Astelor
summary: Astelor is a brash teenage stage magician who suddenly gains sorcery like his kin after a magical upheaval, and boasts of being the most popular conjurer around. Tactless and vain, he alienates teammates and grieves in secret.

feats.scene: Astelor snaps his fingers and a stage curtain bursts into a shower of sparks.
Astelor takes a tumble from a stage lift and comes up bowing.

name: Ntesttel
summary: Ntesttel is a gorilla scientist from a hidden city who studies the bodies of alien visitors, and now leads research for a military project. Calm and bookish, the doctor works with soldiers who do not trust him.

feats.scene: Ntesttel snaps a steel clamp with one hand while pinning a specimen tray.
Ntesttel waves off a laboratory fire and keeps scribbling in his notebook.

name: Tauerneon
summary: Tauerneon is a brown-haired young police officer in a rundown port city who takes up a borrowed hero name beside his sister. Honest but unsure of his calling, he relies on a pistol, law knowledge and car chases.

feats.scene: Tauerneon fires a pistol round that drops a fleeing driver's tyre.
Tauerneon walks away from a cruiser that rolls on a wet bridge.

name: Teonteol
summary: Teonteol is a brown-haired investigator for a cross-reality agency who probes a vaporized victim and trails a runaway hero to another earth. Tricked by a forcefield, the agent later makes his arrest and goes home.

feats.scene: Teonteol snaps a pair of restraints onto a struggling suspect.
Teonteol stays composed inside a collapsing crime scene.

name: Stntira
summary: Stntira is a scientist and criminal from a bottled city who invented a ray that makes small people grow tall. Slippery and vain, he enlarges himself, escapes and poses as a famous hero for a brief, annulled marriage.

feats.scene: Stntira swells under his own ray and bursts out of a glass jar the size of a barn.
Stntira rides out a lab blast and keeps his mask on straight.

name: Rallelu
summary: Rallelu is a black-haired, blue-eyed imagined sibling of a famed hero, conjured in a computer's what-if of a world never destroyed. Doomed with his parents in a rocket wreck, he is remembered with a monument.

feats.scene: Rallelu hurls a boulder aside to clear a path for a stranded rocket crew.

name: Titerne
summary: Titerne is a blonde warrior princess raised in a castle and fostered among fierce island fighters, loyal to her brother and a half-sibling. Trained in the arts of war, she falls in love and takes sides in a medieval struggle.

feats.scene: Titerne drives a broadsword through a shield wall and the line breaks.
Titerne takes a charging horse's blow on her breastplate and stays upright.

name: Rauoleaul
summary: Rauoleaul is a white-eyed, blue-skinned elder who once belonged to a sect of enforcers inside an ancient ruling council. Calm and watchful, she lives on a living world.

feats.scene: Rauoleaul raises a hand and a drifting asteroid is ground into dust.
Rauoleaul stands unharmed in the heart of a collapsing starship.

name: Erecost
summary: Erecost is a blond mentor who showed a young girl the glowing power source of her city, and then took the blame for losing it. Imprisoned in a ghostly realm, he gives her one last push and whispers faith as she fights a witch.

feats.scene: Erecost waves a wand and a clay figure rises, lives and bows.
Erecost clings to a collapsing gap and shoves his pupil through before falling.

name: Eolserone
summary: Eolserone is a physician of a far-future century who mixes a serum that undoes a patient's runaway weight. Gentle and clever, he is later scarred by a royal enemy.

feats.scene: Eolserone shatters a medicine cabinet's glass with a thrown stool to reach a patient.
Eolserone endures a vicious facial burn and still sets his own bandages.

name: Ticaril
summary: Ticaril is a soldier of a doomed world who wears a rugged battle suit of his people. Quiet and dutiful, he serves in the final years before the planet fails.

feats.scene: Ticaril smashes a barricade with an armoured shoulder and a crate stack topples.
Ticaril shrugs off a hail of shrapnel inside his battle suit.

name: Osaci
summary: Osaci is a male villain known as the maker of chaos, sowing disorder in the city and clashing with a team of veterans. Elusive and sly, he strikes through confusion, sudden panic and crooked spells.

feats.scene: Osaci hexes a high-rise and its elevators plunge and doors fly open at once.
Osaci steps through a collapsing wall of rubble that should have buried him.

name: Teoroseo
summary: Teoroseo is a blue-eyed, white-haired field agent who trains operatives and hunts strange phenomena for a secret agency. Her code is simple: protect the deserving, whatever it costs.

feats.scene: Teoroseo cuts a car door off its hinges with a single blade stroke.
Teoroseo walks out of an abandoned base after a fierce firefight.

name: Lotaesi
summary: Lotaesi is a white-haired immortal warrior from a distant people, among the first to land on earth, who founded a sisterhood and then a hero team. Skilled with sword and fist, she is strong, tough and heals quickly.

feats.scene: Lotaesi slices through a tank's gun barrel in a single sweep.
Lotaesi takes a rocket blast to the chest and her wounds close in minutes.

name: Iarnoltau
summary: Iarnoltau is an ancient spirit of performance, born when a prehistoric shadow-puppet show delighted children, now a sinister imp who haunts a hero. Bound for ages inside circuses, he thrives where joy and terror mix.

feats.scene: Iarnoltau twists a carnival into a maze and the big top collapses in laughter.
Iarnoltau reforms from a puff of confetti after a heavy blow.

name: Oretelau
summary: Oretelau is a female criminal sentenced to a ghostly prison before her world's end, taunting a famous hero with two other convicts. Bitter and amazed, she can only watch while a rival rescues the day.

feats.scene: Oretelau hurls a shard of pale light and rattles a prison wall.
Oretelau endures years of icy isolation without breaking.

name: Casint
summary: Casint is a talking bear in a cartoon world of animal heroes who casts spells by saying words backward. Cheerful and quick-witted, the panda joins a funny team.

feats.scene: Casint mutters a backward word and a cartoon boulder pops out of thin air.
Casint is flattened by a falling anvil and inflates straight back.

name: Vallin
summary: Vallin is a brown-haired cult priestess who clashes with a time-travelling warrior queen and then joins a league of rogues. She wields a ritual blaze that answers to her will.

feats.scene: Vallin sets a ritual bonfire roaring and engulfs a stone altar.
Vallin walks through the flames she calls without a scorch.

name: Lelin
summary: Lelin is a tyrant imp from a fifth-dimensional world who snaps his fingers to shrink, grow, teleport and bend gravity. Clever with machines, he plots to steal an energy supply and rule his starved home.

feats.scene: Lelin snaps his fingers and flips a delivery truck over a power plant fence.
Lelin grows to a hulking size and shrugs off a truckload of rubble.

name: Rirnune
summary: Rirnune is a purple-skinned exile who turned on his old allies and plotted vengeance for ages, gathering telepaths to magnify his mind. With a youth-giving fiery blade, he controls the fear of ring wielders from afar.

feats.scene: Rirnune swings a flaming sword and slices a ship's engine pod open.
Rirnune stands under a hail of ring beams and shows no scar.

name: Toriuna
summary: Toriuna is a bald actor and former chemist who dresses as a green bird-man to kidnap and extort. Theatrical and murderous, the masked hawk is finally caught by a young hero.

feats.scene: Toriuna hurls a flask of acid and eats a hole through a safe door.
Toriuna swoops from a balcony in his costume and rolls clear.

name: Iantiares
summary: Iantiares is a brown-eyed scientist who lived in a crystal mountain range on a doomed planet, long before any recorded dynasty. A young hero assumes kinship with him based on a shared name.

feats.scene: Iantiares fires a crystal-powered lamp and a quarry wall flakes away.
Iantiares waits out a rockfall inside his laboratory dome.

name: Lucorva
summary: Lucorva is a black-haired sorceress who sits on a heroic council of an alternate world. Quick and stagey, she is a sorcerer who casts spells to fight beside friends.

feats.scene: Lucorva waves a wand and a stage prop cannon fires a real blast.
Lucorva takes a fall from a stage platform and dusts off her hat.

name: Celliosa
summary: Celliosa is a street stage magician with a hat that opens doors to other worlds and calls bunnies or fiends. She fires blasts, teleports and raises barriers, but cannot cast if she is gagged.

feats.scene: Celliosa fires a crackling blast and a reanimated horde scatters.
Celliosa raises a glowing barrier against a rampaging demon's swing.

name: Titilnan
summary: Titilnan is a violet-eyed stage magician and hero who helps a caped crusader time and again. Her spells only work when she speaks them aloud, so a gag is her greatest worry.

feats.scene: Titilnan speaks a reversed command and a bank vault door flies off its hinges.
Titilnan shrugs off a stage prop crash and keeps her smile.

source_title: Zatanna Zatara (The Brave and the Bold)

name: Lltauca
summary: Lltauca is a black-haired seer and father who dreams of a coming evil and leads his people to safety in a central city. Heeding his dreams, he moves a whole community before the storm.

feats.scene: Lltauca strikes a staff on a gate and the rusted lock shatters.
Lltauca walks through a blizzard leading a long line of refugees.

name: Nantarni
summary: Nantarni is a brown-haired winged guardian bound to earth by a grieving boy's dark spell and tortured for months. Refusing to tell what lies beyond, he later opens a gateway, is freed, and returns after being burned.

feats.scene: Nantarni tears open a shimmering gateway and a blast of heat rolls out.
Nantarni is burned at the stake and returns centuries later.

name: Lenntute
summary: Lenntute is a white-haired, red-eyed winged guardian from the eagle host who protected the souls of famous women for ages. He gave up his post for love, escaped the wrath of a vicious general, and now serves as an envoy.

feats.scene: Lenntute dives from the clouds and splits a rival angel's shield in one stroke.
Lenntute endures a storm of holy fire from a legion of rebels.

name: Cosiium
summary: Cosiium is a cheerful night watchman who patrols a walled river town armed with nothing but a lantern and a sharp memory for faces. Locals trust the watchman to catch thieves before dawn.

feats.scene: Cosiium tackles a fleeing pickpocket off a market cart with one shoulder charge.
Cosiium shrugs off a thrown crate that splinters against his back.

name: Reslerni
summary: Reslerni is a bitter smelter-engineer who plates a hulking suit and floating barge with a glowing metal that drinks starlight. The harder the glare, the stronger the rig grows, and grudges drive every test.

feats.scene: Reslerni vents hoarded sunlight from the barge in one beam that melts a hillside quarry wall.
Reslerni stands inside a collapsing furnace tower while the plated suit holds without a dent.

name: Orecore
summary: Orecore is a mirror-image strategist of a drone swarm, rumored to command from a sealed orbital hive. Little is recorded beyond her calm, clipped orders.

feats.scene: Orecore snaps a signal baton across a table to start a swarm drill.
Orecore endures a tumble down a stair of cold stone without a bruise.

name: Laranni
summary: Laranni is a grey-haired smuggler captain who glides above rooftops and calls stinging insect clouds to cover her thefts. She keeps a flat in a disused foundry.

feats.scene: Laranni sends a buzzing cloud through a warehouse wall and strips its shelves bare.
Laranni lands from a rooftop fall and walks away limping only slightly.
Laranni skims over a canal at the speed of a galloping horse.

name: Vassoran
summary: Vassoran is a winged tyrant of a hundred small moons who hands out carved rods that turn loyal crowds into drones. A rival wielding a silver ring forced her to bargain.

feats.scene: Vassoran raises a rod and a whole fleet dock hums into drones in one sweep.
Vassoran weathers a hail of dropped girders on her wing-shield.
Vassoran dives from a spire faster than a falling hawk.

name: Llulinnum
summary: Llulinnum is a patient empress of a swarm planet who plans conquest across decades and keeps rivals alive only as hostages. She prizes a single vial that would grant long life.

feats.scene: Llulinnum orders a signal that splits the shell of a drifting freighter.
Llulinnum sits unharmed beside a burst pressure line.

name: Leoniator
summary: Leoniator is a floating courtier who drifts without wings and exhales a drowsy pollen that bends minds. Crowds of stinging creatures follow wherever the courtier goes.

feats.scene: Leoniator breathes out a golden haze that lulls an entire guard post asleep.
Leoniator takes a knockout swing from a robot and shakes it off after a minute.
Leoniator drifts over a rooftop chase without a single wingbeat.

name: Llunu
summary: Llunu is a stripe-masked vigilante from a toy-sized town who dresses in black and white bands. He joins a ragtag line-up to unfreeze a stopped clock tower.

feats.scene: Llunu flings a striped glove that cracks a clockwork guard's casing.
Llunu takes a dropped cog on the cowl and keeps climbing.

name: Rnicercor
summary: Rnicercor is a hired blade with a stern face and a steady aim who turns from taking a contract to guarding the target. He dies far from home on a last errand.

feats.scene: Rnicercor fires three shots that clip a lamp chain and drop it on a pursuer.
Rnicercor takes a rifle butt to the ribs and keeps firing.

name: Nansaueo
summary: Nansaueo is a soft, absorbent rescuer who soaks up floods and wrings them out far from town. He works the late hours on a hotline of odd helpers.

feats.scene: Nansaueo wrings out a swollen body to flush a stuck drain tunnel.
Nansaueo is squashed under a delivery van and slowly re-inflates.

name: Sotalont
summary: Sotalont is a stammering lamplighter's apprentice with pale hair who drinks in glow from any lamp and stores it. Pressed, she lets it burst out as a dazzling lance and rides the beam skyward.

feats.scene: Sotalont releases a stored sunrise in a single lance that bores through a cliffside.
Sotalont soaks a laser volley and glows brighter for it.
Sotalont rides a beam between two towers faster than a thought.

name: Carle
summary: Carle is a pale, hairless visitor who claims to be a gardener of dying worlds but really prepares a hostile landing. Carle conjures bright weapons from thin air.

feats.scene: Carle shapes a glowing hammer from the air and brings it down on a dune that flattens.
Carle stands against a storm of green fire and sags slightly.

name: Ntmiael
summary: Ntmiael is a black-belt grappler who runs a dusty barracks gym and loves a clean throw. He loses a bout by a single desperate blow.

feats.scene: Ntmiael lifts and slams a sparring partner onto the mat with a hip throw.
Ntmiael takes a hard fist to the jaw and stays on his feet.

name: Vivaan
summary: Vivaan is a faceless spirit of the warm western wind who can pour into any shape. He is sent on errands by older powers and hunts runaways across forests.

feats.scene: Vivaan gathers a gale that peels roofs from a whole valley town.
Vivaan is scattered by a lightning strike and re-forms instantly.
Vivaan overtakes a fleeing winged beast over open canopy.

name: Lennto
summary: Lennto is a golden-haired spirit of the soft evening breeze who lends the gift of flight to a favored mortal girl. She prefers gentle patronage to fighting.

feats.scene: Lennto lifts a stone bridge with a breath and sets it across a river.
Lennto lets a storm front pass through her and comes out calm.

name: Toranill
summary: Toranill is a dark-haired spirit of the western gale who joins a council of patrons for a young champion. She funnels her own lift into a protege.

feats.scene: Toranill spins a gale that tears the sails from an entire harbor fleet.
Toranill weathers a falling cliff face and sweeps the dust away.
Toranill crosses a bay in a single rush on her wings.

name: Rneor
summary: Rneor is a tiny green-haired visitor from a red desert world who arrives for one odd afternoon of chaos. Nobody learns much about why he came.

feats.scene: Rneor pushes over a stack of boxes in a failed prank.
Rneor falls off a fence and bounces up laughing.

name: Valnol
summary: Valnol is a white-haired archivist who steals a memory crystal out of spite and plans to rebuild a lost people inside borrowed bodies. Valnol falls at the end of a long scheme.

feats.scene: Valnol triggers a vault door charge that blows the wall out.
Valnol is thrown against a console and gets up in a daze.

name: Lueoas
summary: Lueoas is a white-bearded overlord of storms who hurls bolts that burn rebels to ash and steps through walls as if they were mist. His sons obey out of fear.

feats.scene: Lueoas calls down a storm that levels a vast stone temple and the hills around it.
Lueoas lets a mighty punch pass straight through him and smiles.

name: Luonetor
summary: Luonetor is a white-haired lord of the thunder who rules a mountain court. He weaves lightning with a pair of forged rods.

feats.scene: Luonetor hurls a rod that vaporizes a stone tower and carves a crater.
Luonetor endures a hammer blow that cracks the throne beneath him.

name: Anritel
summary: Anritel is a half-remembered brother in a rumor, known only as a distant voice behind a storm door. No deeds are recorded.

feats.scene: Anritel is said to have rattled a cellar door with a distant gust.
Anritel is described as sitting unmoved through a long gale.

name: Cantir
summary: Cantir is a thunder patriarch in a branching timeline where a younger kin hands out the favors instead. He mostly stays silent on the sidelines.

feats.scene: Cantir stirs a storm cloud above a hall without ever speaking a word.
Cantir sits through a crashing roof beam and lifts a cup.

name: Mesttor
summary: Mesttor is a rookie from a frozen moon who wields a jade ring that shapes light into walls and shots. He leaves home after his parent is murdered by cruel hunters.

feats.scene: Mesttor casts a green hammer that crushes a derelict hull.
Mesttor holds a shield of light against a blast of searing plasma.
Mesttor races a comet across an ice field.

name: Corcenan
summary: Corcenan is a silk-spinning orange creature with a long tail who wields a ring of green light. Corcenan helps a friend fend off a webbed invasion and then retreats into solitude.

feats.scene: Corcenan weaves a luminous net that snares a whole raiding skiff.
Corcenan raises a glowing wall that holds under constant barrage.
Corcenan darts across a moon crater on a thread of light.

name: Alceolu
summary: Alceolu is a ring-bearing soldier who is sent to check on missing comrades and falls under a sorceress's spell. A rescue team frees him.

feats.scene: Alceolu is forced to loose a bright volley that scorches a rescuer's barrier.
Alceolu keeps fighting through a thunderous hail without a scratch.
Alceolu streaks over a dusk plain under a sorcerous command.

name: Llieon
summary: Llieon is a long-dead sentry with a yellow face who faces a nigh-unkillable beast on a tiny world. The ring is taken and used to carry the horror toward the elders.

feats.scene: Llieon fires bolt after bolt that only teaches the beast to shrug them off.
Llieon takes a single claw swipe and is ended on the spot.

name: Eoser
summary: Eoser is a gentle matriarch from a shifting-flesh people whose homeland burned in a short war. She raised small twins in the rubble before an early death.

feats.scene: Eoser reshapes her arms into a lever and hauls a beam off a trapped child.
Eoser flows around a falling brick and reforms unharmed.

name: Iallnan
summary: Iallnan is a yellow-eyed brawler from a rage-fueled world who carries a crimson ring. He fights for the sheer heat of it.

feats.scene: Iallnan vomits a crimson flare that melts a crashed ship.
Iallnan takes a barrage of shrapnel and only grows angrier.

name: Stola
summary: Stola is a white-haired aide in a federation's government hall who greets newcomers and reads their orders. Stola never raises a hand in anger.

feats.scene: Stola slaps a stack of forms onto a desk with a crisp bang.
Stola trips on a stair and recovers with a laugh.

name: Tisauva
summary: Tisauva is a dark-haired scholar who tinkers with machines in the shadow of a famous family. His quiet work ends abruptly.

feats.scene: Tisauva arcs a spark across a coil that blackens a tabletop.
Tisauva falls off a stool and cracks a rib.

name: Micolson
summary: Micolson is a blond flyer and sharpshooter in a miniature cartoon town who joins a hurried team to roust crooks at a frozen bar. She trusts her sidearm.

feats.scene: Micolson shoots a hanging sign that crashes onto a hoodlum.
Micolson rolls off a counter and takes a chair on the shoulder.

name: Setiian
summary: Setiian is a green student from a far world who writes a thesis by mailing enhancement gadgets to random strangers. The experiment goes wildly sideways.

feats.scene: Setiian thumps a launch button that fires a gadget parcel across the street.
Setiian is knocked off a stool by an exploding crate and shrugs it off.

name: Alreoveo
summary: Alreoveo is a bragging test pilot who flies far beyond the sky and dies on the journey. Drifting spores later walk his body home.

feats.scene: Alreoveo yanks a flight stick and rolls a capsule out of a spin.
Alreoveo endures several times his weight in a hard burn.

name: Rnitum
summary: Rnitum is a blonde rebel fighter who feeds on sunlight and uses it to rise into the air. Rnitum fights hand to hand with practiced skill.

feats.scene: Rnitum channels stored radiance into a palm strike that caves a bunker door.
Rnitum takes a rifle volley while basking in daylight and walks on.
Rnitum streaks across a canyon under a bright sky.

name: Tessesto
summary: Tessesto is a vain stage performer who plots to remove a rival after losing a role. The plot collapses and the police arrive.

feats.scene: Tessesto hurls a vase that shatters against a doorframe.
Tessesto is yanked off her feet and stumbles but stays upright.

name: Tiuran
summary: Tiuran is an ancient conqueror who sleeps in a frozen vault for ages and wakes to rebuild a vanished empire. His folk once opened a dark gate and ruined two worlds.

feats.scene: Tiuran rouses a dormant fortress that flattens a whole ice shelf.
Tiuran rises from beneath collapsing ice without a scratch.

name: Nusnor
summary: Nusnor is a retired champion of a peaceful world who stays home to watch over a pregnant wife. A murderous visitor with a shard of crystal ends him.

feats.scene: Nusnor sweeps the whole globe with a slow scan and lifts a collapsed dam.
Nusnor is hit by a crashing satellite and brushes the debris off.

name: Osatan
summary: Osatan is a renegade commander who swears a kingdom will rise again. Osatan carries grief for a lost family and ends up trapped in a gray void.

feats.scene: Osatan smashes through a barn wall and carries the beams across a field.
Osatan stands in a flash fire that guts a granary.

name: Ollau
summary: Ollau is a masked schemer who takes orders from a clown and wears star-sign costume pieces. Little else is on record.

feats.scene: Ollau tosses a star-shaped charm that pops in a doorway.
Ollau falls from a ledge into a hedge and runs on.

name: Eocisra
summary: Eocisra is an orange-haired island pilot who ferries a princess in a red prop plane and joins a fleet of swan-shaped craft. She wears a pair of bracelets.

feats.scene: Eocisra dives a prop plane through a cloud gap and drops a parcel on a target.
Eocisra lands hard and steps out unhurt.

name: Rnterole
summary: Rnterole is a red-haired youth on a young team of the far future who can push objects with her mind. She cannot move living things.

feats.scene: Rnterole shoves a parked cart across a plaza with a focused glare.
Rnterole stumbles into a wall and catches her breath.

name: Corcoram
summary: Corcoram is a chemist with a mean streak who returns to crime to help a son. Corcoram mixes bright tricks and stinging gases.

feats.scene: Corcoram sprays a hissing flask that fills a corridor with stinging fog.
Corcoram is tackled by a tall opponent and gets up groggy.

name: Iucornt
summary: Iucornt is a bald occultist who raises the restless dead to harass a young hero. Iucornt is rarely seen in daylight.

feats.scene: Iucornt rings a bone bell and a graveyard row stirs up.
Iucornt is shoved against a crypt wall and mutters a curse.

name: Teleoce
summary: Teleoce is a pale, red-eyed thing with a dead body that haunts a rival conjurer. Teleoce lasts one chilling night.

feats.scene: Teleoce claws through a wooden door in a single swipe.
Teleoce keeps lurching forward after taking a pistol volley.

name: Riiumnt
summary: Riiumnt is a runaway stable hand who steals a spellbook and founds a student cult. His raw spellwork shreds a hero's tough uniform.

feats.scene: Riiumnt hurls a dark bolt that collapses a lecture hall ceiling.
Riiumnt loses his horned mask to a single blow but stays standing.

name: Rnitorer
summary: Rnitorer is a tiny orange imp who steps through a rift and becomes a hero's pet and secret friend. He can swell or shrink at will.

feats.scene: Rnitorer swells to the size of a barrel and bowls over two crooks.
Rnitorer is flung against a wall and bounces off.

name: Mititer
summary: Mititer is a small dark-haired orange imp who tags along on a team-up adventure with a cartoon hound. Nothing more is known.

feats.scene: Mititer hops onto a lever and yanks it with both paws.
Mititer tumbles down a staircase and pops up.

name: Nasanan
summary: Nasanan is a blond engineer who drives a small flying car to the market with three of his daughters on the day his world is shattered. He never returns home.

feats.scene: Nasanan fires up a hover motor that lurches a car off its mount.
Nasanan is jostled by the shockwave of a distant blast.

name: Cirnunia
summary: Cirnunia is a brown-haired scientist who prepares a doomed craft in a prequel story. Cirnunia and a spouse send a child away.

feats.scene: Cirnunia seals a pod hatch with a heavy turn of a wheel.
Cirnunia braces against a trembling floor and stays up.

name: Amnuosa
summary: Amnuosa is a quiet rocket-builder who trusts a sibling's warning when the elders ignore it. He quietly assembles a small escape craft in a hillside workshop.

feats.scene: Amnuosa fires a test engine that scorches the workshop yard black.
Amnuosa is thrown from a bench by a bad valve and brushes off the soot.

name: Veontiler
summary: Veontiler is a dark-haired father and gunner who holds a harbor gate against a metal armada. He falls before he can see a parting launch.

feats.scene: Veontiler empties a rifle into a probe drone and knocks it into a wall.
Veontiler takes a glancing strike on his chest plate and keeps shooting.

name: Nanliaun
summary: Nanliaun is a scientist who survives a cataclysm under a protective dome and later slips into a hidden pocket world with his spouse. Nanliaun watches over a daughter from afar.

feats.scene: Nanliaun fires a lifeboat that arcs out of a dying city.
Nanliaun rides out a shockwave inside a shimmering dome.

name: Relluan
summary: Relluan is a brown-haired researcher in a parallel world who launches a baby in a rocket as his planet falls apart. He dies in the blast.

feats.scene: Relluan primes a small rocket that pushes off its cradle with a roar.
Relluan clings to a trembling railing as the ground cracks.

name: Reneorni
summary: Reneorni is a massive hired bruiser who tears doors off armored vans and walks out of rubble with scratches. He prefers intimidation to technique.

feats.scene: Reneorni peels the roof off a moving van with his hands.
Reneorni stands at the center of a blast and walks out of the rubble in tattered clothes.

name: Taiutiu
summary: Taiutiu is a silent gambler-adventurer in a bold red coat who carries a hidden blade and an uncanny cat. Taiutiu rarely says a word.

feats.scene: Taiutiu slides a blade from a cane and parries a thug's pistol aside.
Taiutiu absorbs a punch from a larger thug and answers with a kick.

name: Nanliinu
summary: Nanliinu is a patient schoolteacher who chants a short verse and unlocks hidden inner powers. He fights for a distant bureau but keeps his own conscience.

feats.scene: Nanliinu focuses his will and shatters a stone ferry pier in a single blow.
Nanliinu fights a mighty opponent to a standstill in the center of a crowded avenue.

name: Ellor
summary: Ellor is a many-clawed, long-skulled merger of a meteor creature and a smuggler, armored in a hard shell. It stalks a lawyer across a snowy capital.

feats.scene: Ellor rakes a steel door open with three long claws.
Ellor takes a car's full impact on its shell and turns around.

name: Staaun
summary: Staaun is a convicted killer who is handed godlike force moments before his sentence. He tears open rifts between worlds and rules half of his home by fear.

feats.scene: Staaun tears a dimensional rift wide enough to swallow a mountain range.
Staaun is struck by a rival and merely stumbles back through the rift.

name: Stiunt
summary: Stiunt is an orange-skinned ring soldier who rushes to a ruined homeworld to aid former foes. Stiunt dies at the hands of an angry ally.

feats.scene: Stiunt stuns a pack of risen corpses with a single wave of light.
Stiunt wades through a swarm of lunging claws behind a glowing shield.
Stiunt crosses a battlefield in one streak of green.

name: Tausaceo
summary: Tausaceo is a masked runner built by a hidden lab to sprint at inhuman speed. He steals a famous bell and loses to a rival's sharper reflexes.

feats.scene: Tausaceo runs through a market stall row and scatters every crate.
Tausaceo is thrown into a stone pillar and only dusts himself off.
Tausaceo races across a plaza as a blur.

name: Numnumtes
summary: Numnumtes is a hooded sprinter in a wartime army who dashes past guards in the blink of an eye. Numnumtes works for a cruel regime.

feats.scene: Numnumtes slams through a fence at full run and leaves a gap.
Numnumtes tumbles over a crate pile and keeps running.
Numnumtes outruns a motorcycle on a straight road.

name: Lentestel
summary: Lentestel is a bald sellsword whose raw strength makes him a favorite of a vain warlord. He works for pay and nothing else.

feats.scene: Lentestel heaves a crate through a wall and grunts.
Lentestel takes a baton blow on the skull and laughs.

name: Amolanrn
summary: Amolanrn is a bored red-haired apprentice conjurer who flees strict teachers to cause mischief. Amolanrn returns to win back stripped spells through three odd trials.

feats.scene: Amolanrn flicks his fingers and a lamppost twists into a spiral.
Amolanrn is hit by a stray spell and sneezes it away.

name: Sonstnto
summary: Sonstnto is a spark-bodied being who hides in a metal figurine for ages and craves a host. It commands every kind of current and magnetic pull.

feats.scene: Sonstnto arcs a fork of lightning that melts a mine cart rail.
Sonstnto flickers under a hammer swing and reforms.

name: Artano
summary: Artano is a memory-less youth from a distant world who crashes to earth and unexpectedly flies, lifts boulders, and shrugs off blows. His amnesia hides an errand inherited from an injured lawman father, to track down a gang of metal thieves.

feats.scene: Artano hoists a power station's generator over his head and carries it across a rooftop.
Artano is struck by a falling girder and merely brushes off the dust.

name: Savalst
summary: Savalst is a bald space-age thief rebuilt with machine parts after a stolen warhead goes off in his face. The implants sharpen his mind and fuel a bitter career of heists across the stars, until a pardon is dangled in front of him.

feats.scene: Savalst tears a cargo door from a freighter with his metal arm.
Savalst survives a warhead detonating in his hands, losing half his body but not his life.

name: Stirenu
summary: Stirenu is a red-eyed, hairless outlaw whose augmented skull fires bolts and crunches numbers faster than a computer. He travels with a crew of misfit raiders in a distant century.

feats.scene: Stirenu blasts a hole through a vault wall with a bolt from his temple.
Stirenu shakes off a stun blast and keeps firing.

name: Tilora
summary: Tilora is a spreading mass of living meat that stretches, folds, and animates the bodies of its victims to swell its bulk. Eyeless and hungry, it drifts through the air and stalks one bloodline of night-dwellers in particular, haunting them even from afar.

feats.scene: Tilora engulfs a ruined church and compresses the walls to a heap of splinters.
Tilora reknits itself after a firestorm tears away half of its mass.

name: Tuasiu
summary: Tuasiu is a shape-shifting silver weapon of the mind, forged by a hostile intellect to grant every heartfelt wish of its targets. Its gifts are poisoned, since a dream fulfilled can trap as surely as a cage.

feats.scene: Tuasiu grants a skyline's worth of wishes at once and the whole district warps into a dream.
Tuasiu is pummelled by a coalition of champions and its form simply reshapes.

name: Stunoium
summary: Stunoium is a hairless, disturbed man whose scent coaxes strangers into acting on their basest urges. He lurks in the countryside, shunned for his appearance and driven by a frayed mind.

feats.scene: Stunoium wrenches an iron gate off its hinges in a fit of fury.
Stunoium is beaten with a farm tool by a mob and keeps on lurching.

name: Laneocol
summary: Laneocol is a widowed murderer from a southern port who dabbles in forbidden ritual and keeps company with infernal creatures. He waits patiently for the arrival of a rival conjurer, which proves to be his end.

feats.scene: Laneocol chalks a ritual circle and slams a demon's claw into a bystander.
Laneocol absorbs a heavy blow from a pipe and laughs.

name: Caorallu
summary: Caorallu is a petty hedge-wizard with a morbid habit of binding the souls of his victims into marriage. He is interrupted before the fourth ceremony, and a zealous mob finishes the job with fire.

feats.scene: Caorallu hurls a hissing curse that knocks a doorway out of its frame.
Caorallu takes a heavy blow to the skull and stays on his feet for a moment.

name: Seiumin
summary: Seiumin is a stoic cage brawler in a gated megacity, who sees each bout as a civic ritual. He speaks little, bleeds quietly, and treats every punch as a duty.

feats.scene: Seiumin lays out a heavyweight champion with a single overhand right.
Seiumin absorbs a barrage of elbows and stays on his feet.

name: Llestose
summary: Llestose is a glass-like green husk packed with a churning broth of bones and organs, which he can swell and hurl at will. Anything he slays dissolves into the same broth, and he floats above his prey like a bloated lantern.

feats.scene: Llestose bursts his shell over a chapel and floods it with a corroding tide.
Llestose re-gathers his broth after being blown apart by a cannon.

name: Iumiumval
summary: Iumiumval is a divorced craftsman who stitches costumes, fixes gadgets, and tunes getaway cars for anyone with cash. He takes no sides, only payment, and once ran with a short-lived gang.

feats.scene: Iumiumval fires a pistol round through a thief's tool bag.
Iumiumval is shoved into a rack of fabric bolts and shrugs it off.

name: Annumamo
summary: Annumamo is a pious sword-bearer who wanders a green kingdom in service of a secretive holy order. He bears a grandiose title that he insists marks him as the single true heir of an angelic office.

feats.scene: Annumamo cleaves a heavy shield in two with a downward sweep.
Annumamo stands in chain mail under a volley of arrows.

name: Nestiva
summary: Nestiva is the mother of two children in a crowded harbour city and the spouse of its chief lawman. She dies young, leaving only a name that no one speaks aloud.

feats.scene: Nestiva swats a stray dog away from her children with a broom.
Nestiva carries her youngest through a cold rain without complaint.

name: Llsonum
summary: Llsonum is an immaculately tailored attorney and former soldier, the sharpest dresser in a band of five adventurers. A concealed blade in his walking stick backs up his rhetoric, and he trades barbs with a hairy friend over a prank from the war.

feats.scene: Llsonum draws the blade from his walking stick and disarms two toughs.
Llsonum straightens his cravat after a heavy tumble down a staircase.

name: Irnvorco
summary: Irnvorco is a young member of an eccentric hero troupe who has been put into a deep coma. Whatever talent he has is on hold while his teammates wait for him to wake.

feats.scene: Irnvorco grips the hand of a friend at his bedside with surprising force.
Irnvorco lies unresponsive through a long night in an infirmary.

name: Liiansti
summary: Liiansti is a polished tycoon whose family nurses a centuries-old grudge against a rival dynasty, and he plots with a secret order to topple the city's established powers. Dressed as an avenging angel, he calls himself an executioner of sinners before dying.

feats.scene: Liiansti swings a ceremonial sword and takes a guard's arm off at the elbow.
Liiansti takes a hail of rounds through his armour and keeps advancing.

name: Lanren
summary: Lanren is a decorated officer who is dismissed from an elite flying band for being too rigid, then returns decades later with a pirate ally to destroy it. Presumed dead overseas, he proves to have survived on pure spite.

feats.scene: Lanren fires a rifle volley that grounds a biplane on a rural strip.
Lanren survives a crash in a burning port city and returns years later.

name: Eolton
summary: Eolton is a grey-haired agent of a secret wartime cabal, drafted to stop a tyrant in a cape. He straps the tyrant to a warhead and sends it skyward, trusting the blast to finish the work.

feats.scene: Eolton binds a caped tyrant to an atomic device and launches it into the upper sky.
Eolton leaps behind a boulder and escapes a fusillade with bruises.

name: Celre
summary: Celre is a veteran champion who soars on a gravity-bending wand and fires radiant bolts from a second staff. Having long since passed a torch to his descendants, he remains revered by an old guild of costumed fighters.

feats.scene: Celre vaporises a bridge pylon with a radiant bolt from his staff.
Celre rides out a collapsing scaffold on his floating wand.

name: Nilnol
summary: Nilnol is a stand-up comic in a gaudy nightspot ruled by mirthless gangsters, mentioned in passing and then forgotten.

feats.scene: Nilnol hurls a heckler's drink back across a crowded stage.
Nilnol keeps his routine going after slipping off the edge of the stage.

name: Stociros
summary: Stociros is an elderly tinkerer who still crawls into an armoured bug-shaped shell fuelled by an enchanted beetle charm. He goes undercover among a tyrant's allies as part of a rebel cell, then dies when an atomic strike levels the prison.

feats.scene: Stociros rips a hatch from a prison transport with the servos of his shell.
Stociros is caught in an atomic strike that levels the prison grounds.

name: Rirne
summary: Rirne is a brilliant corporate heir who built insect-sized drones before he could drive, and later wears an armour of his own design. Self-doubting but kind, he prefers small jobs and helps a successor find his footing.

feats.scene: Rirne unleashes a swarm of tiny drones that chew through a steel door.
Rirne's armour holds as a hovering gunship pounds him with cannon fire.

name: Veoseram
summary: Veoseram is a smiling executive who runs a large manufacturing firm and, when pressed, throws a capable punch learned from years of serious training.

feats.scene: Veoseram drops a hired thug with a clean right cross in a boardroom.
Veoseram bounces off a conference table and straightens his tie.

name: Ntcaes
summary: Ntcaes is a masked robber who hides behind sports gear and wields a battered military rifle in raids on rich vaults. Raised in the shadow of a dead father, he joins a card-themed crew of burglars.

feats.scene: Ntcaes empties a rifle magazine through the glass of an armoured van.
Ntcaes slides down a fire escape and rolls into an alley unhurt.

name: Lonlia
summary: Lonlia is a barrel-chested politician who climbs from rancher and big-game hunter to the nation's highest office. He faces danger head-on, and a single legend has him fighting beside a rival family's forebear.

feats.scene: Lonlia charges a gang of ruffians and lays two flat with a swinging stick.
Lonlia is thrown from a horse in rough country and remounts at once.

name: Nelliu
summary: Nelliu is a demigod monarch of a classical city-state, celebrated for slaying a bull-headed beast in its labyrinth. A cunning swordsman and ruthless officer, he later helps enslave a tribe of warrior women and weds their princess.

feats.scene: Nelliu drives his sword through the skull of a horned beast and cleaves a wall behind it.
Nelliu withstands the charge of a rampaging bull-headed monster.

name: Reoauis
summary: Reoauis is the last survivor of a coven of sorceresses that even the heavens dreaded, and she has spent millennia erasing any trace of herself. When an old enemy tracks her down, she kills them and every witness, then quietly moves on.

feats.scene: Reoauis wipes out an entire apartment block with a single whispered hex.
Reoauis stands in the heart of an enemy's curse and walks out whole.

name: Reornne
summary: Reornne is a blond mercenary with metahuman gifts, hired by a covert government bureau to hit targets alongside a partner. She flies, bruises steel with her fists, and fires blasts from her hands.

feats.scene: Reornne blasts a parking structure to rubble with a point-blank energy burst.
Reornne takes a missile on her shoulder and laughs it off.

name: Anilan
summary: Anilan is a sea nymph with black hair who lives below the waves and has borne a mighty warrior. Depictions differ, sometimes a graceful woman and sometimes a fish-tailed enchantress.

feats.scene: Anilan raises a whirlpool that swallows a whole fleet of ships.
Anilan floats unharmed at the centre of a crashing storm.

name: Rnsiori
summary: Rnsiori is an unkillable, rose-skinned imp who mangles his grammar and tries earnestly to atone for a thieving past so that he may leave a prison realm. His good heart is tested when a fiery brute shares his captivity.

feats.scene: Rnsiori shoves a boulder down a slope onto a pursuing hound.
Rnsiori is hurled into a canyon wall and reassembles himself without complaint.

name: Liluso
summary: Liluso is a program grown from a human mind, appearing as a man made of light-sensing eyes and humming circuits. He sells his cunning to a fraternity of speedster-hunters, which collapses when the quarry's allies answer back.

feats.scene: Liluso overloads a city's traffic grid and crashes a whole intersection of cars.
Liluso flickers back into place after a pulse of static scatters his image.

name: Esiiunti
summary: Esiiunti is a smug mob boss who always slips away by staging a distraction elsewhere, until he slights a humble journalist and ends up knocked cold against a marble likeness of himself.

feats.scene: Esiiunti shoves a lackey into a pile of crates to cover his retreat.
Esiiunti takes a punch and is knocked out against the base of a statue.

name: Lesautil
summary: Lesautil is a hulking figure of cracked riverbed clay that drinks the moisture and vitality from everything near him, leaving husks he commands. Immune to sorcery, he stalks spirits that guard an imaginary ocean, until a surrender of will washes him away.

feats.scene: Lesautil drains an entire river dry and leaves a valley of withered husks.
Lesautil shrugs off a barrage of sorcerous bolts that would have toppled a tower.

name: Tonratel
summary: Tonratel is a time-displaced youth who bends gravity, making objects dense and ponderous, and floats on his own pull. Found babbling about the future, he is committed to an asylum, where he befriends a half-scarred inmate.

feats.scene: Tonratel crushes a parked bus flat by tripling its weight with a gesture.
Tonratel survives a collision with a moving truck.

name: Corolan
summary: Corolan is a young peacekeeper from a mining world who siphons mass from distant stars to make anything crushingly heavy. A ring lets him fly, and he is said to be capable of birthing tiny collapsed stars.

feats.scene: Corolan siphons the weight of a distant star into a cargo hauler and drives it through a space station.
Corolan holds his ground against a blast that levels a city block.

name: Amlanveo
summary: Amlanveo is a dark-eyed volunteer of an interstellar youth patrol whose gift is warping gravity, pinning enemies to the floor or letting them drift.

feats.scene: Amlanveo pins an armoured squad to a deck plate and caves in the plating beneath them.
Amlanveo shrugs off a hard impact against a bulkhead.

source_title: Thom Kallor (Legion of Super-Heroes TV Series)

name: Siliaeo
summary: Siliaeo is a gold-skinned guardian who can raise the weight of any object by stealing mass from far suns, enough to drag a whole metropolis down. He flies on a ring and punches hard in a pinch.

feats.scene: Siliaeo weighs down a skyscraper with starlight mass until its foundation gives way.
Siliaeo walks through a collapsing arcade without a scratch.

name: Sarora
summary: Sarora is a young hero who temporarily gains wild bonus abilities through starship mishaps but struggles to control them. His steady gift is increasing mass, and he carries guilt over a fallen comrade whose seat he now fills.

feats.scene: Sarora adds the weight of a mountain to a rock and smashes a landing platform.
Sarora endures a hull breach and a hard fall to the deck.

name: Nensir
summary: Nensir is a time-travelling guardian from the far future who joins a band of young defenders, and is rumoured to be dating a dreamy telepath.

feats.scene: Nensir throws a punch at a training dummy and cracks its casing.
Nensir takes a tumble through a time portal and lands on his feet.

name: Mairn
summary: Mairn is a blond guerrilla commander and the final holder-out against an ape tyrant's takeover of a continent. Skilled with weapons and survival, he is slain in single combat, then dragged out of time to serve his killer.

feats.scene: Mairn snares a patrol with a trip-wire net and strikes three of them down.
Mairn endures a bruising blow from the tyrant before the final grapple.

name: Ntunuca
summary: Ntunuca is a widowed grey-haired Englishman rescued from a doomed world by his son's counterpart, though the deaths along the escape leave him bitter toward the double.

feats.scene: Ntunuca slaps the mage who saved him across the cheek.
Ntunuca stumbles through a burning street and emerges unhurt.

name: Eotiuca
summary: Eotiuca is a blond widower who dons a dark winged cowl at night in a rain-slicked city, mourning his wife through every patrol.

feats.scene: Eotiuca vaults a rail and flattens a mugger with a double kick.
Eotiuca absorbs a hard fall onto a fire escape and climbs on.

name: Amolantor
summary: Amolantor is a power-line worker revived by a double jolt of current that leaves him magnetic. Coils along his arms let him haul himself through the air toward metal and throw up a repelling shield, though he meets his end in a surprise assault on a naval harbour.

feats.scene: Amolantor drags a parked truck across a street with a pulse of magnetic pull.
Amolantor throws up a repelling field against a strafing run of bullets.

name: Sturaiu
summary: Sturaiu is a grey-haired elder in a sleepy village, father of a slain gunman for hire. He appears briefly before his own death.

feats.scene: Sturaiu slams a pub door shut against a rowdy crowd.
Sturaiu sits through a long winter night beside a cold hearth.

name: Orseniu
summary: Orseniu is a hired strongman who resents wearing a gaudy numbered costume yet joins a gang of card-themed crooks all the same. He once poses as a magistrate, and dies in an ambush involving a collapsing cliff.

feats.scene: Orseniu hoists a heavy safe onto a truck bed and swings a fist at a guard.
Orseniu is buried under a collapsing cliff face and does not rise again.

name: Rusllori
summary: Rusllori is a blond tycoon whose childhood friendship curdles into hatred after a masked savior spares his mother over his father. He builds a property empire, loses it, and turns to crime in pursuit of revenge.

feats.scene: Rusllori draws a pistol and shatters the armoured glass of a limousine.
Rusllori takes a heavy fall from a balcony and rises.

name: Llianuane
summary: Llianuane is a pale-eyed criminal enslaved by a broken avenger's mind-warping formula, posted as a guard on an asylum island. When the master dies, the compulsion fades and he turns docile.

feats.scene: Llianuane clubs an intruder with a baton in a dim corridor.
Llianuane keeps fighting through a brutal melee in the asylum yard.
